Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit vordefinierten Werten unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` für die Initialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_val_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS create_sflight_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_val_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sflight_table.
    rt_sflight = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_val_table_create( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight) = lo_cut->create_sflight_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflight ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von internen Tabellen direkt bei der Deklaration oder Zuweisung, ohne separate `APPEND` oder `INSERT` Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften aus einer bestehenden Tabelle enthält, deren ID mit 'L' beginnt, und konvertieren Sie sie in Kleinbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #() WHERE (...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_in,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_in.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_in WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrid_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_and_lower_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_t_sflight_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrids) TYPE ty_t_carrid_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_lower_carrids.
    rt_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )
                             ( CONV s_carr_id( to_lower( ls_sflight-carrid ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lower FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lower.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_for_expression=>ty_t_sflight_in(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LX' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_lower_carrids( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'lh' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'lx' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #()` ermöglicht eine deklarative und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Hier wird gefiltert (`WHERE`) und gleichzeitig transformiert (Konvertierung in Kleinbuchstaben).
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, String Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugverbindungs-IDs aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_connid) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_connid.
    rv_total_connid = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_total_connid( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 427 ). " 400 + 17 + 10
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu Schleifen mit expliziten Akkumulatoren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugverbindungen, um nur die Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflight) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_sflight = FILTER #( it_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_carrid.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_filter_expression=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_carrid( it_sflight = lt_input iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE` Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface für Objekte, die eine Nachricht ausgeben können, und implementieren Sie es in zwei verschiedenen Klassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` und `INTERFACES`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_provider PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_greeting_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Hello from Greeting!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_provider.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_farewell_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_provider~get_message.
    rv_message = 'Goodbye from Farewell!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_message
      IMPORTING
        io_message_provider TYPE REF TO zif_message_provider
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_message.
    rv_output = io_message_provider->get_message( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_message_providers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_message_providers.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_message_processor( ).

    DATA(lo_greeting) = NEW zcl_greeting_message( ).
    DATA(lv_greeting_msg) = lo_processor->process_message( lo_greeting ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greeting_msg exp = 'Hello from Greeting!' ).

    DATA(lo_farewell) = NEW zcl_farewell_message( ).
    DATA(lv_farewell_msg) = lo_processor->process_message( lo_farewell ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_farewell_msg exp = 'Goodbye from Farewell!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Interfaces ermöglichen Polymorphie und lose Kopplung. Die `zcl_message_processor` Klasse kann mit jedem Objekt arbeiten, das das `zif_message_provider` Interface implementiert, ohne die konkrete Klasse kennen zu müssen.
keywords: INTERFACE, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Erweitern Sie ein Interface um eine Methode mit einer Standardimplementierung, die von implementierenden Klassen optional überschrieben werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `METHODS ... DEFAULT`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  METHODS get_default_prefix RETURNING VALUE(rv_prefix) TYPE string DEFAULT 'LOG: '.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console/file
    DATA(lv_output) = zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ) && iv_message.
    " For demonstration, we'll just store it or output to a test variable
    " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    DATA(lv_output) = zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ) && 'CUSTOM: ' && iv_message.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~get_default_prefix.
    rv_prefix = 'CUSTOM LOG: '. " Override default
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS consume_logger
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger
        iv_message TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_prefix) TYPE string. " Return prefix for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD consume_logger.
    io_logger->log_message( iv_message ).
    rv_prefix = io_logger->get_default_prefix( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_method.
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_logger_consumer( ).

    DATA(lo_console_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_console_prefix) = lo_consumer->consume_logger( io_logger = lo_console_logger iv_message = 'Test 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_console_prefix exp = 'LOG: ' ).

    DATA(lo_custom_logger) = NEW zcl_custom_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_custom_prefix) = lo_consumer->consume_logger( io_logger = lo_custom_logger iv_message = 'Test 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_custom_prefix exp = 'CUSTOM LOG: ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Default-Methoden in Interfaces (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglichen es, Interfaces um neue Methoden zu erweitern, ohne alle implementierenden Klassen sofort anpassen zu müssen. Sie bieten eine Standardimplementierung, die bei Bedarf überschrieben werden kann.
keywords: INTERFACE, Default Methods, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster, um verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien über ein Interface auszutauschen.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für die Strategie und lassen Sie eine Kontextklasse dieses Interface verwenden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_calculation_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate IMPORTING iv_value1 TYPE i iv_value2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 + iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_calculation_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_calculation_strategy~calculate.
    rv_result = iv_value1 * iv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_calculation_strategy
        iv_value1   TYPE i
        iv_value2   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = io_strategy->calculate( iv_value1 = iv_value1 iv_value2 = iv_value2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_strategy_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_strategy_pattern.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator_context( ).

    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = NEW zcl_add_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_add_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_add_strategy iv_value1 = 5 iv_value2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_add_result exp = 8 ).

    DATA(lo_multiply_strategy) = NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_multiply_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_multiply_strategy iv_value1 = 5 iv_value2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_multiply_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster nutzt Interfaces, um Algorithmen in separate Klassen zu kapseln und sie zur Laufzeit austauschbar zu machen. Dies fördert die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: INTERFACE, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns

Instructions: Verwenden Sie ein Interface für die Dependency Injection, um eine Abhängigkeit in einer Klasse zu übergeben und die Testbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Übergeben Sie das Interface-Referenzobjekt im Konstruktor der abhängigen Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_reader PUBLIC.
  METHODS read_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_reader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_reader~read_data.
    " Simulate reading from a file
    rv_data = 'Data from file system'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_reader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mock_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_reader~read_data.
    " Simulate reading from a mock source for testing
    rv_data = 'Mocked data for test'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: constructor IMPORTING io_data_reader TYPE REF TO zif_data_reader.
    METHODS: process_and_get_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_data_reader TYPE REF TO zif_data_reader.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_data_reader = io_data_reader.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD process_and_get_data.
    DATA(lv_raw_data) = mo_data_reader->read_data( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Sitze für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Werte zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_booked_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_booked_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + flight-booked ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_total_booked_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_seats( ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_booked_seats( 'AA' ).

    " Assuming 'AA' flights exist and have booked seats. For a real test, insert test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_aa_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ideal für Aggregationen wie Summen, Minima, Maxima oder das Zusammenführen von Werten. Sie ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem sie über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable (`sum`) aktualisiert. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr ausdrucksstarke Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern (connid) der Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' (Alitalia) enthält, getrennt durch ein Komma und Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` zum Filtern und `REDUCE` zum Verketten der Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_reduce_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_az_connids_string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_reduce_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_az_connids_string.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lt_az_connids) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = 'AZ' ) ( flight ) ).
    SORT lt_az_connids BY connid.

    rv_connids_string = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                          FOR flight IN lt_az_connids
                                          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flight-connid
                                                                ELSE s && ', ' && flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_az_connids_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_az_connids_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_reduce_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_az_connids_string( ).

    " To make this test robust without modifying sflights, we can check properties.
    " Get actual 'AZ' connids from sflights
    SELECT connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_az_connids) WHERE carrid = 'AZ'.
    SORT lt_az_connids BY connid. " Sort for consistent comparison if order matters, though REDUCE order is usually stable.

    IF lines( lt_az_connids ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).
    ELSEIF lines( lt_az_connids ) = 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lt_az_connids[1]-connid ).
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_expected_string) = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                                    FOR connid_entry IN lt_az_connids
                                                    NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN connid_entry-connid
                                                                          ELSE s && ', ' && connid_entry-connid ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_string ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst werden mit `FOR` die relevanten Flüge gefiltert, und dann wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um die `connid`-Werte zu einem einzigen String zu verketten. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `REDUCE` behandelt den Fall des ersten Elements, um ein führendes Komma zu vermeiden. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode zur String-Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, String Concatenation, COND, Internal Tables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der gebuchten Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_booked TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
TYPES: tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_for_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY flight-carrid AS carrid
                              ( carrid       = carrid
                                flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                total_booked = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT s = s + member-booked ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_flight_group_summary FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ). " Expecting some groups
    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_booked >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`-Expression ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt komplexe `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Konstrukte und ermöglicht eine deklarative Definition der Gruppierung und der aggregierten Werte (hier `GROUP SIZE` und `REDUCE` für die Summe).
keywords: FOR GROUP BY, Grouping, Aggregation, REDUCE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Finden Sie die höchste Anzahl gebuchter Sitze (booked) unter allen Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'DL'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und eine `MAX`-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_booked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_booked_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_booked) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_booked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_booked_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rv_max_booked = REDUCE i( INIT max_val = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                  WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT max_val = nmax( val1 = max_val val2 = flight-booked ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_max_booked_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_booked_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_booked( ).
    DATA(lv_max_dl_seats) = lo_cut->get_max_booked_seats( 'DL' ).

    " Assuming 'DL' flights exist. For a real test, insert test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_max_dl_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` kann nicht nur Summen bilden, sondern auch andere Aggregationen wie das Finden des Maximums. Durch die Verwendung der `nmax`-Funktion im `NEXT`-Teil der Expression wird der Akkumulator (`max_val`) bei jeder Iteration mit dem größeren der beiden Werte aktualisiert. Dies ist eine prägnante und funktionale Art, den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
keywords: REDUCE, MAX, Aggregation, nmax, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, die die Fluggesellschaft (carrid) als Schlüssel und den Namen der Fluggesellschaft (carrname aus `scarr`) als Wert enthält, für alle Fluggesellschaften, die in `sflights` vorkommen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `CORRESPONDING` oder direkter Zuweisung für die Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_map_entry,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier_map_entry.
TYPES: tt_carrier_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_map_entry
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

CLASS zcl_for_create_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_names_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_map) TYPE tt_carrier_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_create_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_names_map.
    " Get unique carriers from sflights
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_unique_carriers).

    " Get carrier names from scarr for these unique carriers
    SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_scarr_data)
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_unique_carriers
      WHERE carrid = @lt_unique_carriers-carrid.

    rt_carrier_map = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN lt_scarr_data ( 
                                    carrid   = carrier-carrid
                                    carrname = carrier-carrname
                                  ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_result_map) = lo_cut->get_carrier_names_map( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result_map ) > 0 ). " Expecting some carriers
    " Check for a known carrier, e.g., 'LH'
    READ TABLE lt_result_map WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_entry).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_entry-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` ist hervorragend geeignet, um eine neue interne Tabelle (hier eine Hash-Tabelle) aus einer anderen zu erstellen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Lookup-Tabellen oder Maps zu generieren, die später für schnellen Zugriff verwendet werden können. Die Syntax ist sehr kompakt und vermeidet explizite `LOOP` und `INSERT` Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Hashed Table, Map, Internal Tables, Data Structures

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Flugbeschreibungen. Wenn die Anzahl der gebuchten Sitze (booked) über 100 liegt, soll die Beschreibung "High Demand Flight: [Carrid]-[Connid]" lauten, ansonsten "Standard Flight: [Carrid]-[Connid]".

TYPES: tt_flight_descriptions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_descriptions = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights ( 
                                     COND string( WHEN flight-booked > 100
                                                  THEN |High Demand Flight: { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                                                  ELSE |Standard Flight: { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| ) ) ).

    " Check for a specific pattern in the first entry (if exists)

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Leerzeichen aus einem gegebenen String mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Operationen, um den String Zeichen für Zeichen zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_remove_spaces DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_remove_spaces IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_spaces.
    rv_output = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                  FOR char IN iv_input
                                  NEXT s = COND string( WHEN char = ` ` THEN s
                                                        ELSE s && char ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_spaces FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_spaces.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_remove_spaces( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_spaces( 'Hello World' ) exp = 'HelloWorld' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_spaces( '  A B C  ' ) exp = 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_spaces( '' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->remove_spaces( 'NoSpaces' ) exp = 'NoSpaces' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` kann auch für die zeichenweise Verarbeitung von Strings verwendet werden. In diesem Beispiel wird der Eingabestring als interne Tabelle von Zeichen (`FOR char IN iv_input`) behandelt. Die `COND`-Expression entscheidet, ob ein Zeichen zum Ergebnisstring hinzugefügt wird oder nicht, wodurch Leerzeichen effektiv entfernt werden. Dies ist eine funktionale Alternative zu `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ' ' IN ... WITH ''`.
keywords: REDUCE, String Processing, COND, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die ersten 5 Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, die von 'UA' durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `UNTIL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_take_n_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE sflights_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_take_n_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                          UNTIL lv_counter = iv_count
                          ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_n_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_take_n_flights( ).

    DATA(lt_result_ua) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_count = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result_ua ) <= 5 ). " Should be at most 5

    DATA(lt_result_lh) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_count = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result_lh ) <= 2 ). " Should be at most 2

    " Verify all returned flights are for the correct carrier
    LOOP AT lt_result_ua INTO DATA(ls_flight_ua).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_ua-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit der `UNTIL`-Klausel ermöglicht es, die Iteration zu beenden, sobald eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist (hier: eine bestimmte Anzahl von Elementen wurde gesammelt). TYPES: tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connids,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connids  TYPE tt_connids,
           END OF ty_carrier_connids.
TYPES: tt_carrier_connids_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_carrier_connids
                                   WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_to_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_carrier_connids_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_map) TYPE tt_carrier_connids_map.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_to_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connids_map.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_map = REDUCE tt_carrier_connids_map( INIT m = VALUE tt_carrier_connids_map( )
                                            FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                            NEXT m = VALUE tt_carrier_connids_map( m
                                                      ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                                        connids = VALUE tt_connids( 
                                                                    m[ KEY carrid = flight-carrid ]-connids
                                                                    ( flight-connid ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der gebuchten Sitze (booked) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_booked DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_booked_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_avg_booked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_booked_seats.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).

    DATA(lv_total_booked) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                      NEXT sum = sum + flight-booked ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( lt_filtered_flights ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_booked / lv_flight_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_avg_lh_seats >= 0 ).

    DATA(lv_avg_xx_seats) = lo_cut->get_average_booked_seats( 'XX' ). " Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_xx_seats exp = 0 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck und `cl_abap_math=>add`.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_sum_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT sum = '0'
      FOR  item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = cl_abap_math=>add( sum item-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die prozentuale Veränderung zwischen einem alten und einem neuen Wert. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der alte Wert Null ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_math=>subtract`, `cl_abap_math=>divide` und `cl_abap_math=>multiply`. Verwenden Sie `COND` für die Nullprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_percentage_change
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_value TYPE decfloat34
        iv_new_value TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_percentage_change) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_percentage_change.
    IF iv_old_value = 0.
      " Handle division by zero for percentage calculation
      rv_percentage_change = COND decfloat34(
        WHEN iv_new_value = 0 THEN '0'
        ELSE '1000000000000000000000000000000000' " Representing infinite change
      ).
    ELSE.
      DATA(lv_difference) = cl_abap_math=>subtract( iv_new_value iv_old_value ).
      DATA(lv_ratio) = cl_abap_math=>divide( lv_difference iv_old_value ).
      rv_percentage_change = cl_abap_math=>multiply( lv_ratio '100' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_max_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_number,
           tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_maximum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_maximum) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_max_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_maximum.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_maximum = '0'. " Or raise an exception, depending on requirements
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_maximum = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT max_val = it_numbers[ 1 ]-value
      FOR  number IN it_numbers
      NEXT max_val = cl_abap_math=>max( max_val number-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_signed_xml

CLASS zcl_xml_sign_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_signed_xml.
    DATA: lo_xml_document TYPE REF TO cl_xml_document,
          lo_signature_factory TYPE REF TO if_xml_signature_factory,
          lo_signature TYPE REF TO if_xml_signature,
          lo_key_info TYPE REF TO if_xml_key_info,
          lv_certificate TYPE xstring,
          lv_private_key TYPE xstring.

    " Simulate certificate and private key (in a real scenario, these would be loaded securely)
    lv_certificate = '0123456789ABCDEF'. " Placeholder
    lv_private_key = 'FEDCBA9876543210'. " Placeholder

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xml_document.
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    lo_signature_factory = cl_xml_signature_factory=>get_instance( ).
    lo_signature = lo_signature_factory->create_signature(
      document = lo_xml_document
      signature_method = if_xml_signature_factory=>c_signature_method_rsa_sha256
      digest_method = if_xml_signature_factory=>c_digest_method_sha256
    ).

    lo_key_info = lo_signature_factory->create_key_info( ).
    lo_key_info->set_x509_certificate( lv_certificate ).
    lo_signature->set_key_info( lo_key_info ).

    lo_signature->sign( private_key = lv_private_key ).

    rv_signed_xml = lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem bestehenden XML-Dokument ein neues Element mit Attributen hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen, `create_element`, `set_attribute` und `append_child`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_add_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_element_with_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_parent_xpath TYPE string
        iv_new_element_name TYPE string
        it_attributes TYPE cl_xml_document=>tt_attributes
        iv_element_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_add_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_element_with_attributes.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_parent_xpath ).
    IF lo_parent_node IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_xml_error EXPORTING text = 'Parent node not found'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_new_element) = lo_xml_document->create_element( name = iv_new_element_name ).

    LOOP AT it_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
      lo_new_element->set_attribute( name = ls_attr-name value = ls_attr-value ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF iv_element_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_text_node) = lo_xml_document->create_text_node( value = iv_element_value ).
      lo_new_element->append_child( lo_text_node ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_parent_node->append_child( lo_new_element ).

    rv_modified_xml = lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie ein spezifisches XML-Element aus einem Dokument mittels XPath.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xml_document` zum Parsen, `get_node_by_path` zum Finden des Elements und `remove_child` vom Elternelement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_remove_element DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_xml_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
        iv_xpath    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_xml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_remove_element IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_xml_element.
    DATA(lo_xml_document) = NEW cl_xml_document( ).
    lo_xml_document->parse_xstring( iv_xml_data ).

    DATA(lo_node_to_remove) = lo_xml_document->get_node_by_path( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node_to_remove IS BOUND.
      DATA(lo_parent_node) = lo_node_to_remove->get_parent( ).
      IF lo_parent_node IS BOUND.
        lo_parent_node->remove_child( lo_node_to_remove ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rv_modified_xml = lo_xml_document->render_xstring( pretty_print = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,

           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_city_and_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data

CLASS zcl_filter_multi_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_city_and_seats.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_city AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Flugzeugtyp eine Kategorie ('Wide-body', 'Narrow-body', 'Regional') zu. Verwenden Sie '747', 'A380' als Wide-body, '737', 'A320' als Narrow-body und alle anderen als Regional.

solution:
CLASS zcl_case_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             category  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_categories
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_categories) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_categories.
    rt_flight_categories = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                                      connid    = flight-connid
                                      planetype = flight-planetype
                                      category  = CASE flight-planetype
                                                    WHEN '747' THEN 'Wide-body'
                                                    WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Wide-body'
                                                    WHEN '737' THEN 'Narrow-body'
                                                    WHEN 'A320' THEN 'Narrow-body'
                                                    ELSE 'Regional'
                                                  END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen, die nach 'LONDON' gehen. Erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden dieser Flüge ein Feld 'SERVICE_LEVEL' enthält. 'SERVICE_LEVEL' soll 'Premium' sein, wenn der Flugzeugtyp 'A380' ist, ansonsten 'Standard'.
hint: Ketten Sie den FILTER-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer CASE-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_case_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_service,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityto      TYPE sflight-cityto,
             planetype   TYPE sflight-planetype,
             service_level TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_service.
    TYPES: tt_flight_service TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_service WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_london_flights_service
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_service_flights) TYPE tt_flight_service.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_case_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_london_flights_service.
    rt_service_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityto = 'LONDON' )
                                    ( carrid      = flight-carrid
                                      connid      = flight-connid
                                      cityto      = flight-cityto
                                      planetype   = flight-planetype
                                      service_level = CASE flight-planetype
                                                        WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Premium'
                                                        ELSE 'Standard'
                                                      END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen, die als 'Langstreckenflug' gelten. Ein Flug ist ein Langstreckenflug, wenn die Anzahl der maximalen Sitze (seatsmax) größer als 200 ist. Verwenden Sie eine lokale Methode als Prädikat für die Filterung.
hint: Definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse mit einer Methode, die als Prädikat im FILTER-Operator verwendet wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_predicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_long_haul_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_predicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_long_haul_flights.
    CLASS lcl_flight_predicate DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS-METHODS is_long_haul
          IMPORTING
            is_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_result) TYPE abap_bool.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_flight_predicate IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD is_long_haul.
        IF is_flight-seatsmax > 200.
          rv_result = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE lcl_flight_predicate=>is_long_haul( table_line ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    mt_test_data = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 250 ) " Long-haul
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 180 ) " Not long-haul
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' seatsmax = 300 ) " Long-haul
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' seatsmax = 100 ) " Not long-haul
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_long_haul_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_predicate( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung einer lokalen Klasse mit einer statischen Methode als Prädikat im FILTER-Operator ermöglicht die Kapselung komplexer Filterlogik und verbessert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Lesbarkeit. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster für flexible Filterbedingungen.
keywords: FILTER, Predicate, Local Class, Object Orientation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung verschiedener Flugzeugtypen. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Flugzeugtyp (planetype) eine spezifische Aktion ausführt oder einen spezifischen Wert zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie '747' für 'Jumbo', 'A320' für 'Short-Haul' und andere für 'Unknown'.
hint: Verwenden Sie die CASE-Expression, um verschiedene Flugzeugtypen zu unterscheiden und entsprechende Aktionen oder Werte zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_type_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_aircraft_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_type_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aircraft_description.
    rv_description = CASE iv_planetype
                       WHEN '747' THEN 'Jumbo Jet'
                       WHEN 'A320' THEN 'Short-Haul Aircraft'
                       WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Super Jumbo'
                       ELSE 'Unknown Aircraft Type'
                     END.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_aircraft_description( 'A320' ) exp = 'Short-Haul Aircraft' ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen, die zu einer Liste spezifischer Fluggesellschaften gehören (z.B. 'LH', 'AA', 'UA').

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flug basierend auf seinem Abflugland eine Region zu. 'DE' (Deutschland) und 'FR' (Frankreich) sind 'Europe', 'US' (USA) ist 'North America', alle anderen sind 'Other'.
hint: Nutzen Sie die CASE-Expression mit WHEN OTHERS für den Standardfall.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_region,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             country  TYPE sgeocity-country,
             region   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_region.
    TYPES: tt_flight_region TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_region WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_regions
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_regions) TYPE tt_flight_region.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_regions.
    " Annahme: sflight-cityfrom kann zu einem Land gemappt werden, hier simuliert.
    " In einer realen Anwendung würde man eine Mapping-Tabelle verwenden.
    rt_flight_regions = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    LET country_code = COND string( WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' THEN 'DE'
                                                                    WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'PARIS' THEN 'FR'
                                                                    WHEN flight-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' THEN 'US'
                                                                    ELSE 'XX' ) IN
                                    ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                                      connid   = flight-connid
                                      country  = country_code
                                      region   = CASE country_code
                                                   WHEN 'DE' THEN 'Europe'
                                                   WHEN 'FR' THEN 'Europe'
                                                   WHEN 'US' THEN 'North America'
                                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Other'
                                                 END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_flight_regions FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_data = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = 'AF' connid = '0100' cityfrom = 'PARIS' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'SINGAPORE' ) " Other
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0050' cityfrom = 'LONDON' ) " Other
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_regions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_when_others( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_regions( mt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-region exp = 'Europe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-region exp = 'Europe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-region exp = 'North America' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-region exp = 'Other' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 5 ]-region exp = 'Other' ).

explanation: Die CASE-Expression mit WHEN OTHERS ist ideal, um einen Standardwert oder eine Standardaktion zu definieren, wenn keine der expliziten WHEN-Bedingungen zutrifft. In Kombination mit dem LET-Ausdruck für temporäre Variablen wird der Code noch lesbarer und modularer.
keywords: CASE, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, LET, Expression

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen mit verfügbaren Sitzen (seatsocc < seatsmax). Gruppieren Sie die gefilterten Flüge nach Zielstadt (cityto) und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Stadt. Kategorisieren Sie jede Stadt als 'High Demand' (mehr als 1 Flug) oder 'Low Demand' (1 Flug oder weniger) basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER, GROUP BY und eine CASE-Expression innerhalb eines VALUE-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             cityto      TYPE sflight-cityto,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             demand_level TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_demand_by_city
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_demand_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_demand_by_city.
    rt_demand_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE seatsocc < seatsmax )
                                  GROUP BY ( cityto = flight-cityto )
                                  ( cityto       = flight-cityto
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE
                                    demand_level = CASE WHEN GROUP SIZE > 1 THEN 'High Demand'
                                                       ELSE 'Low Demand'
                                                   END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_demand_levels FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_data = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityto = 'LONDON'    seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 ) " Available
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityto = 'NEW YORK'  seatsocc = 250 seatsmax = 250 ) " Full
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' cityto = 'LONDON'    seatsocc = 280 seatsmax = 300 ) " Available
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 100 ) " Available
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0050' cityto = 'LONDON'    seatsocc = 150 seatsmax = 160 ) " Available
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' cityto = 'PARIS'     seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 150 ) " Available
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_demand_levels.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_case( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_demand_by_city( mt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_london) = lt_result[ cityto = 'LONDON' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_london-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_london-demand_level exp = 'High Demand' ).

    DATA(ls_frankfurt) = lt_result[ cityto = 'FRANKFURT' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_frankfurt-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_frankfurt-demand_level exp = 'Low Demand' ).

    DATA(ls_paris) = lt_result[ cityto = 'PARIS' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_paris-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_paris-demand_level exp = 'Low Demand' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert FILTER, GROUP BY und eine CASE-Expression in einem einzigen VALUE-Ausdruck, um eine komplexe Datenanalyse durchzuführen. Es zeigt, wie moderne ABAP-Syntax es ermöglicht, Filterung, Aggregation und bedingte Logik deklarativ und effizient zu verketten, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: FILTER, GROUP BY, CASE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen, die in den nächsten 7 Tagen stattfinden (basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum).
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER mit einer Datumsbereichsbedingung und dem aktuellen Systemdatum (sy-datum).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_date_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_upcoming_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_date_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_upcoming_flights.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_seven_days_later) = sy-datum + 7.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate BETWEEN lv_today AND lv_seven_days_later ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_upcoming_flights FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_filter_date_range=>tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = lv_today ) " Today
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_today + 3 ) " In 3 days
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_today + 7 ) " In 7 days
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_today - 1 ) " Yesterday

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen 'Bonusfaktor' für Flüge basierend auf der Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax). Wenn die Auslastung über 90% liegt, ist der Faktor 1.2, zwischen 70% und 90% ist er 1.1, sonst 1.0. Verwenden Sie eine CASE-Expression mit WHEN-Bedingungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine CASE-Expression mit logischen Bedingungen in den WHEN-Zweigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_cond_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_bonus,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc    TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax    TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             occupancy   TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             bonus_factor TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_bonus.
    TYPES: tt_flight_bonus TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_bonus WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_flight_bonus
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bonus_flights) TYPE tt_flight_bonus.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_cond_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_bonus.
    rt_bonus_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    LET occupancy_rate = COND p( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) IN
                                    ( carrid       = flight-carrid
                                      connid       = flight-connid
                                      seatsocc     = flight-seatsocc
                                      seatsmax     = flight-seatsmax
                                      occupancy    = occupancy_rate
                                      bonus_factor = CASE
                                                       WHEN occupancy_rate > 90 THEN 1.2
                                                       WHEN occupancy_rate >= 70 THEN 1.1
                                                       ELSE 1.0
                                                     END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie sflights nach Flügen, deren Abflugstadt mit 'NEW' beginnt. Erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle, in der die Zielstadt in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie FILTER mit einem LIKE-Muster und dann einen FOR-Ausdruck mit der Funktion to_upper.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_like_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_processed,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_processed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_like_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( it_flights WHERE cityfrom LIKE 'NEW%' )
                                    ( carrid   = flight-carrid
                                      connid   = flight-connid
                                      cityfrom = flight-cityfrom
                                      cityto   = to_upper( flight-cityto ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug einen 'Rabattpreis' basierend auf dem ursprünglichen Preis (hypothetisches Feld 'price'). Wenn der Flugzeugtyp '747' ist, gibt es 10% Rabatt, bei 'A380' 15% Rabatt, sonst keinen Rabatt. Verwenden Sie eine CASE-Expression für die Rabattberechnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine CASE-Expression, um den Rabattfaktor zu bestimmen, und wenden Sie ihn dann auf den Preis an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             price     TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
             discounted_price TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_discounted_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_prices.
    rt_discounted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    LET discount_factor = CASE flight-planetype
                                                            WHEN '747' THEN '0.90'
                                                            WHEN 'A380' THEN '0.85'
                                                            ELSE '1.00'
                                                          END IN
                                    ( carrid    = flight-carrid
                                      connid    = flight-connid
                                      planetype = flight-planetype
                                      price     = flight-price
                                      discounted_price = flight-price * discount_factor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS test_discount_calculation FOR TESTING.
    DATA mt_test_data TYPE zcl_case_discount=>tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_data = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' planetype = '747' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' planetype = 'A380' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' planetype = '737' price = '50.00' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' planetype = 'A380' price = '300.00' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_discount_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_discount( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_prices( mt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-discounted_price exp = '90.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-discounted_price exp = '170.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-discounted_price exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-discounted_price exp = '255.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die CASE-Expression ist hervorragend geeignet, um unterschiedliche Berechnungslogiken basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zu implementieren. Hier wird sie verwendet, um dynamisch einen Rabattfaktor zu bestimmen, der dann im LET-Ausdruck auf den Preis angewendet wird, was zu einem klaren und effizienten Code führt.
keywords: CASE, Conditional Logic, Math, LET, Expression, Discount

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String mit deutschen Umlauten (UTF-8) in die Codepage ISO-8859-1 und überprüfen Sie das Ergebnis durch Rückkonvertierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Konvertierung und `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` für die Rückkonvertierung zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utf8_to_iso
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_iso_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utf8_to_iso.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'L' " Little Endian (default for most systems)
    ).
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      endian   = 'L'
    ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_conv_out->u_to_x_string( iv_utf8_string ).
    rv_iso_string = lo_conv_in->x_to_u_string( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = `ÄÖÜäöüß`.
    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_converter->convert_utf8_to_iso( lv_original ).

    " For ISO-8859-1, these characters are usually represented directly.
    " The conversion back to UTF-8 should yield the original string if successful.
    DATA(lo_conv_out_iso) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'ISO-8859-1' ).
    DATA(lo_conv_in_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_iso) = lo_conv_out_iso->u_to_x_string( lv_converted ).
    DATA(lv_back_to_utf8) = lo_conv_in_utf8->x_to_u_string( lv_xstring_iso ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_back_to_utf8
      exp = lv_original
      msg = 'Conversion from UTF-8 to ISO-8859-1 and back should preserve characters'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung von Strings zwischen Codepages unter Verwendung der Klassen `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und `cl_abap_conv_in_ce`. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Handhabung von Textdaten in heterogenen Systemlandschaften, insbesondere bei Sonderzeichen wie Umlauten.
keywords: Codepage, UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Konvertierung, cl_abap_conv_out_ce, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Variable, die eine 32-Bit-Integer-Zahl im Little-Endian-Format enthält, in das Big-Endian-Format.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `x_to_x_string` von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` mit unterschiedlichen Endian-Einstellungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_endian_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_little_to_big_endian
      IMPORTING
        iv_little_endian_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_big_endian_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_endian_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_little_to_big_endian.
    DATA(lo_conv_le_to_be) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8' " Encoding doesn't matter for pure endian conversion of XSTRING
      endian   = 'L' " Source is Little Endian
    ).

    " Convert from Little Endian XSTRING to internal representation (which is then converted to Big Endian XSTRING)
    rv_big_endian_xstring = lo_conv_le_to_be->x_to_x_string(
      xstring = iv_little_endian_xstring
      target_endian = 'B' " Explicitly convert to Big Endian
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_endian_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_endian_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_endian_converter( ).
    " Example: 0x12345678 (Little Endian: 78 56 34 12)
    DATA(lv_little_endian) = '78563412'X.
    " Expected Big Endian: 12 34 56 78
    DATA(lv_expected_big_endian) = '12345678'X.

    DATA(lv_converted) = lo_converter->convert_little_to_big_endian( lv_little_endian ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted
      exp = lv_expected_big_endian
      msg = 'Little Endian to Big Endian conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Endian-Konvertierung von binären Daten (XSTRING) mithilfe von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`. Dies ist wichtig beim Austausch von Binärdaten zwischen Systemen mit unterschiedlicher Byte-Reihenfolge, um die korrekte Interpretation der Daten sicherzustellen.
keywords: XSTRING, Endian, Konvertierung, Binary, cl_abap_conv_out_ce

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation unter Verwendung einer bestimmten Codepage.
hint: Fügen Sie Zeilenumbrüche zwischen den Strings hinzu und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die gesamte Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_encoding  TYPE abap_encod DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).
    DATA(lv_temp_string) TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      lv_temp_string = lv_temp_string && lv_string && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf. " Add newline for separation
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->u_to_x_string( lv_temp_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( `Hello` ) ( `World` ) ( `ÄÖÜ` ) ).
    DATA(lv_encoding) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lv_xstring_result) = lo_converter->convert_string_table_to_xstring(
      it_strings = lt_strings
      iv_encoding = lv_encoding
    ).

    " To verify, convert back to string
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = lv_encoding ).
    DATA(lv_back_to_string) = lo_conv_in->x_to_u_string( lv_xstring_result ).

    DATA(lv_expected_string) = `Hello` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                       `World` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                                       `ÄÖÜ`   && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_back_to_string
      exp = lv_expected_string
      msg = 'String table to XSTRING conversion and back failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable konvertiert werden kann, wobei eine spezifische Codepage verwendet wird. Dies ist nützlich für die Speicherung oder Übertragung von Textdaten als Binärdaten, z.B. für Dateiexporte oder Webservices.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (`sflights`) so auf, dass sie als generische Objektliste für eine 3D-Visualisierung dienen könnte (z.B. als JSON-String).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die Transformation und `cl_abap_json_serializer` für JSON.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_for_3d DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_3d_object,
             id       TYPE string,
             type     TYPE string,
             position TYPE string, " Simplified for demo
             color    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_3d_object.
    TYPES tt_3d_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_3d_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_as_3d_objects
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_3d_objects) TYPE tt_3d_objects.

    METHODS get_flights_as_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_for_3d IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_as_3d_objects.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_flights ROWS.

    rt_3d_objects = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( 
      id       = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }-{ flight-fldate }|,
      type     = 'Flight',
      position = |{ flight-deptime }-{ flight-arrtime }|, " Placeholder for actual 3D coords
      color    = COND string( WHEN flight-planetype = '747' THEN 'Blue' ELSE 'Green' )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_as_json.
    DATA(lt_3d_objects) = get_flights_as_3d_objects( iv_max_flights ).
    cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = lt_3d_objects
      RECEIVING
        json        = rv_json_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_data_preparation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_json_serialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_preparation.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_flight_data_for_3d( ).
    DATA(lt_3d_objects) = lo_preparer->get_flights_as_3d_objects( iv_max_flights = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_3d_objects )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Should return 3 3D objects'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_3d_objects[1]-id IS INITIAL
      msg = 'First object ID should not be initial'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_3d_objects[1]-type
      exp = 'Flight'
      msg = 'First object type should be Flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_json_serialization.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_flight_data_for_3d( ).
