Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Integrität einer XSTRING-Variable nach einer Codepage-Konvertierung, indem Sie die Länge vor und nach der Konvertierung vergleichen.
hint: Beachten Sie, dass die Länge sich bei Codepage-Konvertierungen ändern kann. Der Fokus liegt auf der Fehlererkennung bei unerwarteten Längenänderungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_integrity_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_conversion_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_target_encoding TYPE abap_encod
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integrity_ok) TYPE abap_bool
      EXPORTING
        ev_error_msg TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_integrity_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_conversion_integrity.
    DATA(lv_xstring_utf8) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_xstring_target) TYPE xstring.
    DATA(lv_back_to_string) TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Convert original string to XSTRING in UTF-8 (standard internal representation)
        DATA(lo_conv_out_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).
        lv_xstring_utf8 = lo_conv_out_utf8->u_to_x_string( iv_original_string ).

        " Convert to target encoding
        DATA(lo_conv_out_target) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_target_encoding ).
        lv_xstring_target = lo_conv_out_target->u_to_x_string( iv_original_string ).

        " Convert back from target XSTRING to string for comparison
        DATA(lo_conv_in_target) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = iv_target_encoding ).
        lv_back_to_string = lo_conv_in_target->x_to_u_string( lv_xstring_target ).

        IF iv_original_string = lv_back_to_string.
          rv_integrity_ok = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ev_error_msg = 'String content changed after conversion and back-conversion.'.
          rv_integrity_ok = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        ev_error_msg = lx_error->get_text( ).
        rv_integrity_ok = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_codepage INTO DATA(lx_codepage).
        ev_error_msg = lx_codepage->get_text( ).
        rv_integrity_ok = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_integrity_ok FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_integrity_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_integrity_ok.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_conv_integrity_check( ).
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_original) = `Hello World ÄÖÜ`.
    DATA(lv_integrity_ok) = lo_checker->check_conversion_integrity(
      iv_original_string = lv_original
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
      ev_error_msg       = lv_error_msg
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_integrity_ok
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Integrity check should pass for UTF-8 to UTF-8 conversion'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg
      msg = 'No error message expected'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_integrity_fail.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_conv_integrity_check( ).
    DATA(lv_error_msg) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_original) = `€uro`.
    " ISO-8859-1 does not support the Euro symbol, so conversion back will fail integrity
    DATA(lv_integrity_ok) = lo_checker->check_conversion_integrity(
      iv_original_string = lv_original
      iv_target_encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
      ev_error_msg       = lv_error_msg
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_integrity_ok
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Integrity check should fail for Euro symbol in ISO-8859-1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_error_msg
      msg = 'Error message expected for integrity failure'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Überprüfung der Datenintegrität nach einer Codepage-Konvertierung. Es konvertiert einen String in eine Zielcodepage und dann zurück, um sicherzustellen, dass der ursprüngliche Inhalt erhalten bleibt. Dies ist entscheidend, um Datenverluste oder -korruption bei der Codepage-Umwandlung zu vermeiden, insbesondere bei Zeichen, die in der Zielcodepage nicht darstellbar sind.
keywords: Data Integrity, Codepage, Konvertierung, XSTRING, cl_abap_conv_out_ce, cl_abap_conv_in_ce

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine große interne Tabelle von Strings effizient in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und modernen ABAP-Features.
hint: Vermeiden Sie unnötige String-Konkatenationen in Schleifen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für effiziente Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bulk_conv_perf DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_table_bulk
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_encoding  TYPE abap_encod DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bulk_conv_perf IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table_bulk.
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = iv_encoding ).

    " Efficiently concatenate strings with newlines using REDUCE
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR  str IN it_strings
      NEXT s = s && str && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    rv_xstring = lo_conv_out->u_to_x_string( lv_concatenated_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bulk_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bulk_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bulk_conv_perf( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL 1000 ( |String { i } with some special chars ÄÖÜß| )
    ).
    DATA(lv_encoding) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lv_xstring_result) = lo_converter->convert_string_table_bulk(
      it_strings = lt_strings
      iv_encoding = lv_encoding
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_xstring_result
      msg = 'Resulting XSTRING should not be initial'
    ).

    " Verify by converting back and checking a sample
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( encoding = lv_encoding ).
    DATA(lv_back_to_string) = lo_conv_in->x_to_u_string( lv_xstring_result ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_back_to_string CS lt_strings[1]-table_line )
      msg = 'First string should be present in the converted result'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_back_to_string CS lt_strings[1000]-table_line )
      msg = 'Last string should be present in the converted result'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine performante Methode zur Konvertierung einer großen internen Tabelle von Strings in eine XSTRING-Variable. Durch die Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators wird eine effiziente String-Konkatenation erreicht, die im Vergleich zu traditionellen Schleifen mit `CONCATENATE` oder `&&` deutlich performanter ist, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Anschließend wird `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` für die Codepage-Konvertierung verwendet.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, konvertieren Sie diese in ein CSV-Format und komprimieren Sie die CSV-Daten in ein ZIP-Archiv. Verwenden Sie Konstanten für den Dateinamen und das CSV-Trennzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` für `SFLIGHTS`, `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die CSV-Generierung und `cl_abap_zip` für die Komprimierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_csv_file_name TYPE string VALUE 'sflights_data.csv'.
    CONSTANTS gc_csv_delimiter TYPE string VALUE ';'.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_sflights_to_csv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zipped_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_csv_header) = |carrid{ gc_csv_delimiter }connid{ gc_csv_delimiter }fldate{ gc_csv_delimiter }price{ gc_csv_delimiter }currency|.

    DATA(lv_csv_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
               |{ flight-carrid }{ gc_csv_delimiter }{ flight-connid }{ gc_csv_delimiter }{ flight-fldate }{ gc_csv_delimiter }{ flight-price }{ gc_csv_delimiter }{ flight-currency }|
    ).

    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_zip->add( iv_name    = gc_csv_file_name
                  iv_content = lv_csv_content ).
    lo_zip->zip( IMPORTING ev_zip_xstring = rv_zipped_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_sflights_csv_zip.

    DATA(lv_zipped_data) = lo_cut->compress_sflights_to_csv( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_zipped_data msg = 'Komprimierte Daten sollten nicht leer sein.' ).

    DATA(lo_unzip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_unzip->load( lv_zipped_data ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_csv) = lo_unzip->get_file_content_as_string( zcl_zip_sflights_csv=>gc_csv_file_name ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_decompressed_csv msg = 'Dekomprimierter CSV-Inhalt sollte nicht leer sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'carrid;connid' act = lv_decompressed_csv msg = 'CSV-Header fehlt oder ist falsch.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'LH;0400' act = lv_decompressed_csv msg = 'Beispiel-Flugdaten fehlen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Konstanten definieren den Dateinamen und das Trennzeichen, was die Flexibilität und Lesbarkeit des Codes erhöht. `REDUCE` ist hier besonders effizient für die zeilenweise Erstellung des CSV-Strings.

Instructions: Dekomprimieren Sie eine CSV-Datei aus einem ZIP-Archiv und parsen Sie den Inhalt zurück in eine interne Tabelle, die der Struktur von `SFLIGHTS` entspricht. Verwenden Sie Konstanten für den Dateinamen und das CSV-Trennzeichen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_zip` zur Dekomprimierung, `SPLIT` und `VALUE` mit `FOR` für das Parsen der CSV-Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_csv_to_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_csv_file_name TYPE string VALUE 'sflights_data.csv'.
    CONSTANTS gc_csv_delimiter TYPE string VALUE ';'.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS decompress_csv_to_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_zipped_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_csv_to_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_csv_to_sflights.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_content) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zipped_data ).
        lv_csv_content = lo_zip->get_file_content_as_string( gc_csv_file_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zip_error.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt_csv_lines) = VALUE string_table( FOR <line> IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_csv_content sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) WHERE ( <line> IS NOT INITIAL ) ( <line> ) ).

    IF lines( lt_csv_lines ) < 2. " Header + mindestens eine Datenzeile
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DELETE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1. " Header entfernen

    rt_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR <line> IN lt_csv_lines
      LET parts = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = <line> sep = gc_csv_delimiter )
      IN
      ( carrid   = parts[1]
        connid   = parts[2]
        fldate   = CONV sflight-fldate( parts[3] ) " Annahme: Datum ist im richtigen Format
        price    = CONV sflight-price( parts[4] ) " Annahme: Preis ist numerisch
        currency = parts[5] )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_csv_to_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_csv_to_sflights.
    DATA(lv_csv_content) = |carrid;connid;fldate;price;currency{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
                           && |LH;0400;20251204;100.00;EUR{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }|
                           && |AA;0017;20251205;250.50;USD|.

    DATA(lo_compress) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    lo_compress->add( iv_name = zcl_zip_csv_to_sflights=>gc_csv_file_name
                      iv_content = lv_csv_content ).
    DATA(lv_zipped_data) = lo_compress->zip( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_csv_to_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_result) = lo_cut->decompress_csv_to_sflights( lv_zipped_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Anzahl der geparsten Zeilen ist falsch.' ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung bei `cl_abap_zip` Operationen, insbesondere wenn ungültige ZIP-Daten übergeben werden. Verwenden Sie Konstanten für die Fehlermeldungen.
hint: Umschließen Sie die `cl_abap_zip`-Methoden mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_zip_error` und nutzen Sie Konstanten für die Ausgaben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_error_invalid_zip TYPE string VALUE 'Fehler: Ungültige ZIP-Daten übergeben.'.
    CONSTANTS gc_error_file_not_found TYPE string VALUE 'Fehler: Datei nicht im ZIP-Archiv gefunden.'.
    CONSTANTS gc_success_message TYPE string VALUE 'Operation erfolgreich.'.

    METHODS process_zipped_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_zipped_data TYPE xstring
        iv_file_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_zipped_data.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).
    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zipped_data ).
        DATA(lv_content) = lo_zip->get_file_content_as_string( iv_file_name ).
        rv_status_message = gc_success_message.
      CATCH cx_sy_zip_error INTO DATA(lx_zip_error).
        IF lx_zip_error->textid = cl_abap_zip=>cx_sy_zip_error=>file_not_found.
          rv_status_message = gc_error_file_not_found.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_message = gc_error_invalid_zip.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Definieren Sie Konstanten für die Kompressionslevel und nutzen Sie diese in einem `CASE`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_compression_levels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_level_none TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_level_fast TYPE i VALUE 1.
    CONSTANTS gc_level_default TYPE i VALUE 5.
    CONSTANTS gc_level_best TYPE i VALUE 9.
    CONSTANTS gc_level_unknown TYPE i VALUE -1.

    METHODS get_compression_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_level TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_compression_levels IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_compression_description.
    CASE iv_level.
      WHEN gc_level_none.
        rv_description = 'Keine Komprimierung (Speicherplatz sparen).'.
      WHEN gc_level_fast.
        rv_description = 'Schnelle Komprimierung (weniger CPU-Zeit).'.
      WHEN gc_level_default.
        rv_description = 'Standard Komprimierung (guter Kompromiss).'.
      WHEN gc_level_best.
        rv_description = 'Beste Komprimierung (maximale Platzersparnis).'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekanntes Kompressionslevel.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ZIP-Archiv mit dynamisch generierten Dateinamen und Inhalten. Die Basis für die Dateinamen und die Anzahl der Dateien sollen durch Konstanten gesteuert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `FROM` und `TO` für die Schleife und String-Templates für die Dateinamen. `cl_abap_zip` Instanz für `add` und `zip`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_dynamic_files DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS gc_file_prefix TYPE string VALUE 'dynamic_file_'.
    CONSTANTS gc_file_extension TYPE string VALUE '.txt'.
    CONSTANTS gc_number_of_files TYPE i VALUE 3.

    METHODS create_dynamic_zip
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_zipped_data) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_dynamic_files IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    FOR i = 1 FROM 1 TO gc_number_of_files.
      DATA(lv_file_name) = |{ gc_file_prefix }{ i }{ gc_file_extension }|.
      DATA(lv_file_content) = |Inhalt für Datei { i } im dynamischen ZIP-Archiv.|.
      lo_zip->add( iv_name    = lv_file_name
                    iv_content = lv_file_content ).
    ENDFOR.

    lo_zip->zip( IMPORTING ev_zip_xstring = rv_zipped_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 20.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT und eine Schleife mit Überprüfung auf Eindeutigkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_nums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      " Check for uniqueness using table expression
      IF NOT line_exists( rt_unique_nums[ table_line = lv_new_num ] ).
        APPEND lv_new_num TO rt_unique_nums.
      ELSE.
        " If not unique, try again (decrement loop counter)
        SY-INDEX = SY-INDEX - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_list( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of unique random numbers' ).

    " Check for actual uniqueness
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY ( FOR num IN lt_numbers ( num ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 5
                                       msg = 'Numbers are not unique' ).

    " Check range
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 20 )
                                         msg  = 'Random number out of range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_entry) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_entry.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_data ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rs_random_entry = it_data[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Positionen zum Tauschen zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_original_table. " Start with a copy

    IF rt_shuffled_table IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_table_size
    ).

    " Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm
    DO lv_table_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap elements
      DATA(ls_temp) = rt_shuffled_table[ lv_current_index ].
      rt_shuffled_table[ lv_current_index ] = rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index ].
      rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index ] = ls_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'C' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'D' )
      ( id = 5 text = 'E' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    " Check if size remains the same
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original )
                                       msg = 'Shuffled table has incorrect size' ).

    " Check if all original elements are still present (order doesn't matter)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY id.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_sorted) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_shuffled_sorted BY id.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled_sorted exp = lt_original_sorted
                                       msg = 'Shuffled table does not contain same elements' ).

    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be identical to the original (unless size 0 or 1)
    IF lines( lt_original ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original
                                          msg = 'Table was not shuffled (or extremely lucky)' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_empty) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_empty) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_empty ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_shuffled_empty ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert den Fisher-Yates-Mischalgorithmus, um die Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig neu anzuordnen. Es verwendet CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT für die zufällige Indexgenerierung und moderne Syntax für den Tabellenzugriff.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Tables, Shuffle, Algorithm

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines angegebenen Datumsbereichs.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Daten in Tage seit 00000000, generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl für die Tage und konvertieren Sie zurück.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " For invalid date range
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    IF iv_date_from IS INITIAL OR iv_date_to IS INITIAL OR iv_date_from > iv_date_to.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Invalid date range provided'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_days_from) = iv_date_from - '00000000'.
    DATA(lv_days_to)   = iv_date_to - '00000000'.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = lv_days_from
      max  = lv_days_to
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = '00000000' + lv_random_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, um zufällige Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_charset_len) = strlen( lc_charset ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = 0
      max  = lv_charset_len - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_char_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_charset+lv_random_char_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_empty_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->get_random_string( lv_length ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length
                                       msg = 'Generated string has incorrect length' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->get_random_string( 20 ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    " Check if all characters are from the defined charset
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_random_string ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_string+sy-index(1).
      IF NOT ( lc_charset CS lv_char ). " CS checks if lv_char is contained in lc_charset
        lv_is_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_is_valid msg = 'String contains invalid characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_empty_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->get_random_string( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_random_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung eines zufälligen alphanumerischen Strings. Es wählt Zeichen zufällig aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz aus, indem es CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT verwendet, um Indizes zu generieren. String-Templates (&&) werden für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet.
keywords: RANDOM, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, String Processing, String Templates, Password Generation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines bestimmten Fluges in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Open SQL Anweisung UPDATE mit einer WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid   TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate   TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights
       SET price = @iv_new_price
     WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
       AND connid = @iv_connid
       AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_updater( ).
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.

    " Prepare test data (ensure it exists and is unique for testing)
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ls_sflight = VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' ).
      INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_old_price) = ls_sflight-price.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = lv_old_price + 50.00.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid    = 'AA'
      iv_connid    = '0017'
      iv_fldate    = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
    ).
    COMMIT WORK. " Commit changes for verification

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_success msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    " Verify update
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_verified_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_verified_price exp = lv_new_price
                                       msg = 'Price was not updated correctly' ).

    " Clean up (optional, but good practice for test data)
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_updater( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid    = 'XX'
      iv_connid    = '9999'
      iv_fldate    = '20251231'
      iv_new_price = 123.45
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( cond = lv_success msg = 'Update should fail for non-existent flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die grundlegende Verwendung der Open SQL UPDATE-Anweisung, um einen einzelnen Datensatz in der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle zu ändern. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit @ ist ein Merkmal von modernem Open SQL.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL, Host Variable

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Preise mehrerer Flüge in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Open SQL Anweisung UPDATE FROM @(itab).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_mass_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES: tt_flight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_flight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_mass_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flight_prices.
    UPDATE sflights FROM @it_updates.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_update_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mass_update_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_mass_updater( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight_template TYPE sflights.

    " Prepare test data
    ls_sflight_template = VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' currency = 'EUR' ).
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250102' price = 110.00 )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250103' price = 120.00 )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflights_mass_updater=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = 160.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250104' price = 170.00 ) " Non-existent entry
    ).

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->mass_update_flight_prices( lt_updates ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 2
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated' ).

    " Verify updates
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE DATA(lt_prices)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate IN ('20250101', '20250102', '20250103')
      ORDER BY fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 1 ] exp = 150.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 2 ] exp = 160.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 3 ] exp = 120.00 ). " This one should not be updated

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate IN ('20250101', '20250102', '20250103').
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_mass_updater( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflights_mass_updater=>tt_flight_update( ).
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->mass_update_flight_prices( lt_empty_updates ).
    COMMIT WORK.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 0
                                       msg = 'No rows should be updated for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis von Flügen in SFLIGHTS basierend auf einer Bedingung direkt in der UPDATE-Anweisung. Erhöhen Sie den Preis um 10%, wenn der Flug vor einem bestimmten Datum liegt, sonst um 5%.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine CASE-Expression in der SET-Klausel der UPDATE-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS conditional_price_update
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_cond_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD conditional_price_update.
    UPDATE sflights
       SET price = CASE WHEN fldate < @iv_threshold_date
                        THEN price * 1.10
                        ELSE price * 1.05
                   END
     WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'. " Example filter for testability

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_price_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_price_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_cond_updater( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight_template TYPE sflights.

    " Prepare test data
    ls_sflight_template = VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' currency = 'EUR' ).
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 ) " Before threshold
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250115' price = 200.00 ) " On threshold
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250130' price = 300.00 ) " After threshold
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_threshold_date) = '20250115'.

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->conditional_price_update( iv_threshold_date = lv_threshold_date ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 3
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated' ).

    " Verify updates
    SELECT fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE DATA(lt_prices)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'
      ORDER BY fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 1 ]-price exp = 110.00 ). " 100 * 1.10
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 2 ]-price exp = 210.00 ). " 200 * 1.05
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_prices[ 3 ]-price exp = 315.00 ). " 300 * 1.05

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die CASE-Expression direkt in der SET-Klausel der UPDATE-Anweisung. Dies ermöglicht eine bedingte Aktualisierung von Spaltenwerten direkt auf der Datenbankebene, was die Logik vereinfacht und die Performance verbessert, da keine Daten zum Applikationsserver transportiert werden müssen.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL, CASE Expression, Conditional Update

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Währung von Flügen in SFLIGHTS basierend auf der Währung des zugehörigen Flugzeugtyps aus der Tabelle SAPLANE.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Subquery oder einen JOIN in der UPDATE-Anweisung (falls die Datenbank dies unterstützt, sonst SELECT und dann UPDATE). Modernes ABAP Open SQL erlaubt Subqueries in der WHERE-Klausel und in der SET-Klausel (als Scalar Subquery).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_join_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_currency_from_plane
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_join_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_from_plane.
    " This example assumes a direct update using a subquery in SET clause
    " which is supported by modern Open SQL for scalar subqueries.
    " For more complex joins, a SELECT into an internal table followed by
    " UPDATE FROM @itab might be necessary depending on the exact scenario.

    UPDATE sflights AS f
       SET currency = ( SELECT SINGLE p~currencycode
                          FROM saplane AS p
                         WHERE p~planetype = f~planetype )
     WHERE f~carrid = @iv_carrid
       AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM saplane AS p WHERE p~planetype = f~planetype ). " Ensure plane type exists

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_currency_from_plane FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_currency_from_plane.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_join_updater( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight_template TYPE sflights.
    DATA: ls_saplane_template TYPE saplane.

    " Prepare test data for SFLIGHTS
    ls_sflight_template = VALUE sflights( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 500.00 ).
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH planetype = '747-400' currency = 'USD' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH planetype = 'A380'    currency = 'USD' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH planetype = 'A320'    currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.

    " Prepare test data for SAPLANE
    ls_saplane_template = VALUE saplane( carrid = 'SQ' ).
    INSERT saplane FROM VALUE #( ls_saplane_template WITH planetype = '747-400' currencycode = 'SGD' ).
    INSERT saplane FROM VALUE #( ls_saplane_template WITH planetype = 'A380'    currencycode = 'EUR' ).
    " A320 will not have an entry in SAPLANE for this test to show it's not updated
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->update_currency_from_plane( iv_carrid = 'SQ' ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 2
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated' ).

    " Verify updates
    SELECT planetype, currency FROM sflights INTO TABLE DATA(lt_currencies)
      WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND connid = '0001'
      ORDER BY planetype.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_currencies[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'EUR' ). " A380
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_currencies[ 2 ]-currency exp = 'SGD' ). " 747-400
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_currencies[ 3 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ). " A320 (original, not updated)

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND connid = '0001'.
    DELETE FROM saplane WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND planetype IN ('747-400', 'A380').
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexere UPDATE-Operation, bei der der Wert einer Spalte (Währung) aus einer anderen Tabelle (SAPLANE) über eine Skalar-Subquery in der SET-Klausel abgeleitet wird. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion von modernem Open SQL, um datenbankinterne Abhängigkeiten direkt zu verarbeiten.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, SAPLANE, Open SQL, Subquery, JOIN

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Anzahl von Flügen aus SFLIGHTS aus und aktualisieren Sie deren Preise um einen zufälligen Betrag.
hint: Kombinieren Sie die Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit der Massenaktualisierung von Datenbankeinträgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_random_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights_to_update TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_min_price_change      TYPE s_price DEFAULT -10.00
        iv_max_price_change      TYPE s_price DEFAULT 10.00
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_random_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_random_flights.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " 1. Get all possible flight keys
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 2. Determine how many flights to update (randomly)
    DATA(lo_random_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = 1
      max  = MIN( iv_max_flights_to_update, lines( lt_all_flights ) )
    ).
    DATA(lv_num_to_update) = lo_random_count->get_next( ).

    " 3. Select random flights to update
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lines( lt_all_flights )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) TYPE tt_flight_key.
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO lv_num_to_update TIMES.
      DATA(lv_rand_idx) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      " Ensure unique selection for this run
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_selected_indices[ table_line = lv_rand_idx ] ).
        APPEND lv_rand_idx TO lt_selected_indices.
        APPEND CORRESPONDING #( lt_all_flights[ lv_rand_idx ] ) TO lt_flights_to_update.
      ELSE.
        SY-INDEX = SY-INDEX - 1. " Try again
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    IF lt_flights_to_update IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " 4. Generate random price changes and update
    DATA(lo_random_price_change) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create( )->get_next( )
      min  = CONV i( iv_min_price_change * 100 ) " Convert to cents for integer random
      max  = CONV i( iv_max_price_change * 100 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_update_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY (
      FOR ls_key IN lt_flights_to_update
        LET lv_change_cents = lo_random_price_change->get_next( ) IN
        ( carrid = ls_key-carrid
          connid = ls_key-connid
          fldate = ls_key-fldate
          price  = ( SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights WHERE carrid = ls_key-carrid AND connid = ls_key-connid AND fldate = ls_key-fldate ) + ( CONV s_price( lv_change_cents / 100 ) )
        )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM @lt_update_data.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_random_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_random_flights_empty_db FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_random_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_random_update( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_sflight_template TYPE sflights.

    " Prepare test data
    ls_sflight_template = VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0001' currency = 'EUR' price = 100.00 ).
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250101' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250102' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250103' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250104' )
      ( ls_sflight_template WITH fldate = '20250105' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_max_flights) = 3.
    DATA(lv_min_change) = -5.00.
    DATA(lv_max_change) = 5.00.

    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->update_random_flights(
      iv_max_flights_to_update = lv_max_flights
      iv_min_price_change      = lv_min_change
      iv_max_price_change      = lv_max_change
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_rows_updated >= 1 AND lv_rows_updated <= lv_max_flights )
                                       msg = 'Incorrect number of rows updated' ).

    " Verify that prices are within expected range (original price +/- change)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE DATA(lt_updated_flights)
      WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0001'
      ORDER BY fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_updated_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_original_flight) = lt_sflights_initial[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ].
      DATA(lv_original_price) = ls_original_flight-price.

      " Check if price is within the bounds of original price +/- max change
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-price >= lv_original_price + lv_min_change AND
                                                  ls_flight-price <= lv_original_price + lv_max_change )
                                         msg = |Price { ls_flight-price } for { ls_flight-fldate } out of expected range| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND connid = '0001'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_random_flights_empty_db.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_random_update( ).
    DATA(lv_rows_updated) = lo_cut->update_random_flights( iv_max_flights_to_update = 5 ).
    COMMIT WORK.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 0
                                       msg = 'No rows should be updated for empty database' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit Datenbankaktualisierungen. Es wählt zufällig eine Teilmenge von Flügen aus und aktualisiert deren Preise um einen ebenfalls zufällig generierten Betrag. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie FOR-Iteratoren, LET-Ausdrücke und Tabellenausdrücke für die Datenmanipulation vor dem UPDATE.
keywords: RANDOM, UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables, FOR, LET, Table Expression, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Zielorte aus einer bestehenden Flugtabelle enthält, indem Sie den FOR-Operator verwenden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_for_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_full.
    TYPES tt_flights_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             cityto TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flights_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_full TYPE tt_flights_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_summary) TYPE tt_flights_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    rt_flights_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights_full
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    cityto = ls_flight-cityto ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_for_operator_demo=>tt_flights_full(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zusammenfassung falsch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 2 ]-cityto exp = 'LONDON' msg = 'Zweite Zusammenfassung falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere (SUM(PASSENGER)) für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle mit dem REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... ) für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN it_flight_data
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_input_data) = VALUE zcl_reduce_operator_demo=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' passengers = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' passengers = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' passengers = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_input_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 450 msg = 'Falsche Gesamtzahl der Passagiere' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und sehr prägnanten Weise, was traditionelle Schleifen ersetzt und den Code lesbarer macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_filter_operator_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             passengers TYPE i,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen internen Zähler verwaltet. Der Zählerwert soll nur über öffentliche Methoden erhöht und abgerufen werden können, während die Zählervariable selbst privat bleibt.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Zählervariable im PRIVATE SECTION der Klasse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_section_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS increment_counter.
    METHODS get_counter_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i.
    METHODS internal_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_section_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_counter = 0.
    internal_log( 'Zähler initialisiert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD increment_counter.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.
    internal_log( |Zähler erhöht auf { mv_counter }.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_counter_value.
    rv_value = mv_counter.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD internal_log.
    " In einer echten Anwendung würde hier z.B. in ein Log geschrieben
    " WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_counter_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_counter_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_private_section_demo( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_counter_value( ) exp = 0 msg = 'Initialwert sollte 0 sein' ).

    lo_cut->increment_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_counter_value( ) exp = 1 msg = 'Nach erster Erhöhung sollte 1 sein' ).

    lo_cut->increment_counter( ).
    lo_cut->increment_counter( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_counter_value( ) exp = 3 msg = 'Nach weiteren Erhöhungen sollte 3 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von PRIVATE SECTION erzwingt Kapselung, indem interne Daten (mv_counter) und Hilfsmethoden (internal_log) vor externem Zugriff geschützt werden. Dies fördert eine saubere Schnittstelle und erleichtert die Wartung und Erweiterung der Klasse.
keywords: Object Orientation, Encapsulation, PRIVATE SECTION

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Fluent-API-Klasse für die Konfiguration eines Objekts. Die Methoden sollen sich selbst zurückgeben (Method Chaining), und eine Abhängigkeit soll über den Konstruktor injiziert werden.
hint: Geben Sie ME-> zurück, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen. Nutzen Sie den Konstruktor für die Dependency Injection.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In einer echten Anwendung würde hier z.B. in ein Log geschrieben
    " WRITE: / iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_api_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger. " Dependency Injection

    METHODS set_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_api_demo.

    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_api_demo.

    METHODS build
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_config.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name  TYPE string.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
    DATA mo_logger TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_api_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_logger = io_logger.
    mo_logger->log_message( 'Fluent API Builder initialisiert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_name.
    mv_name = iv_name.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Name gesetzt: { iv_name }| ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    mo_logger->log_message( |Wert gesetzt: { iv_value }| ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD build.
    rs_config = VALUE #( name = mv_name value = mv_value ).
    mo_logger->log_message( 'Konfiguration erstellt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_api FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_api.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_fluent_api_demo( io_logger = lo_logger ).

    DATA(ls_config) = lo_builder->set_name( 'MyObject' )->set_value( 123 )->build( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-name  exp = 'MyObject' msg = 'Name falsch gesetzt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_config-value exp = 123      msg = 'Wert falsch gesetzt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Fluent API) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem Methodenaufrufe kaskadiert werden können. Dependency Injection über den Konstruktor fördert lose Kopplung und Testbarkeit, da Abhängigkeiten von außen bereitgestellt werden.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent API, Dependency Injection, PRIVATE SECTION

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Event-Handling-Szenario, bei dem eine 'Publisher'-Klasse ein Event auslöst und eine 'Subscriber'-Klasse dieses Event empfängt und verarbeitet. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Muster für die Interaktion mit GUI-Controls wie cl_gui_container.
hint: Verwenden Sie EVENTS, FOR EVENT und RAISE EVENT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS value_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_value TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    IF iv_new_value <> mv_current_value.
      mv_current_value = iv_new_value.
      RAISE EVENT value_changed EXPORTING iv_new_value = mv_current_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.

    METHODS handle_value_changed FOR EVENT value_changed OF zcl_event_publisher
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_value.

    METHODS get_last_received_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_received_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_value_changed FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_value_changed.
    mv_last_received_value = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_received_value.
    rv_value = mv_last_received_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_subscriber) = NEW zcl_event_subscriber( io_publisher = lo_publisher ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->get_last_received_value( ) exp = 0 msg = 'Initialwert des Subscribers sollte 0 sein' ).

    lo_publisher->set_value( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->get_last_received_value( ) exp = 10 msg = 'Wert nach erstem Event falsch' ).

    lo_publisher->set_value( 10 ). " Kein Event, da Wert gleich
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->get_last_received_value( ) exp = 10 msg = 'Wert sollte unverändert sein' ).

    lo_publisher->set_value( 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->get_last_received_value( ) exp = 25 msg = 'Wert nach zweitem Event falsch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Event-Handling ermöglicht eine lose Kopplung zwischen Objekten (Publisher und Subscriber). Der Publisher muss den Subscriber nicht kennen, sondern löst lediglich ein Event aus. Der Subscriber registriert sich für dieses Event und reagiert darauf. Dies ist ein Schlüsselkonzept für die Interaktion mit GUI-Controls, bei denen Benutzeraktionen Events auslösen, die von Anwendungslogik verarbeitet werden.
keywords: Object Orientation, Event Handling, EVENTS, RAISE EVENT, SET HANDLER, PRIVATE SECTION, cl_gui_container (concept)

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung in eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie die moderne SELECT-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und WHERE-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modern_select_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_connection
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modern_select_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_connection.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_select_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modern_select_demo( ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT für LH 0400
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_connection( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Falsche Fluggesellschaft' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Falsche Flugverbindung' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne SELECT-Syntax mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und Hostvariablen-Markierung (@) ermöglicht eine kompaktere und sicherere Datenbankabfrage. CORRESPONDING #(...) wird für die einfache Zuweisung von Feldern gleicher Namen verwendet.
keywords: SELECT, Database Access, Inline Declaration, Host Variables

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft, indem Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key) ... GROUP WHERE ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                     count  = group_key->* ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_input_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_demo=>tt_sflights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 msg = 'Falsche Anzahl an Gruppen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' ]-count exp = 3 msg = 'LH-Flüge falsch gezählt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count exp = 1 msg = 'AA-Flüge falsch gezählt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_counts[ carrid = 'UA' ]-count exp = 1 msg = 'UA-Flüge falsch gezählt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ersetzt komplexe Sortierungen und Schleifen mit temporären Tabellen und macht den Code wesentlich lesbarer und effizienter für Aggregationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Grouping, LOOP AT GROUP BY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle nach einem übergebenen Feldnamen sortiert. Nutzen Sie hierfür die moderne Syntax für dynamische Sortierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie SORT itab BY (field_name).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_data     TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_sort_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    TRY.
        SORT ct_data BY (iv_field_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_by_name FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort_demo=>tt_data(
      ( id = 2 name = 'Berta' date = '20230102' )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Anna'  date = '20230101' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cäsar' date = '20230103' )
    ).

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Anna' msg = 'Sortierung nach Name falsch (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-name exp = 'Berta' msg = 'Sortierung nach Name falsch (2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort_demo=>tt_data(
      ( id = 2 name = 'Berta' date = '20230102' )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Anna'  date = '20230101' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cäsar' date = '20230103' )
    ).

    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Sortierung nach ID falsch (1)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 2 msg = 'Sortierung nach ID falsch (2)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_sort_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_sort_demo=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Test' date = '20230101' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_dyn_table_error ).
    lo_cut->sort_table_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Sortierung mit SORT itab BY (field_name) ermöglicht es, den Sortierschlüssel zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist flexibler als statische Sortierungen und wird oft in generischen Berichten oder Tools benötigt. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH für cx_sy_dyn_table_error ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SORT, Internal Tables, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Klasse, die verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt. Nutzen Sie hierfür die moderne Syntax für dynamische Objekterzeugung und Interfaces.
hint: Verwenden Sie INTERFACE, CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING, und NEW #( ) für die Objekterzeugung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_name
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = |ZCL_PRODUCT_{ iv_product_type }|.
    TRY.
        ro_product = NEW #( lv_class_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_error
            textid   = lx_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_product RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_a->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Produkt A falsch erstellt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_b->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' msg = 'Produkt B falsch erstellt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_product.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_create_object_error ).
    zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'X' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern mit dynamischer Objekterzeugung und Interfaces. Die Factory-Methode create_product erzeugt Instanzen verschiedener Klassen, die alle dasselbe Interface implementieren, basierend auf einem String-Parameter. Dies fördert Flexibilität und Erweiterbarkeit, da neue Produkttypen hinzugefügt werden können, ohne die Factory-Logik ändern zu müssen. Die Verwendung von NEW #( class_name ) ist die moderne Art der dynamischen Instanziierung.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, Interfaces, Dynamic Object Creation, PRIVATE SECTION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine kommaseparierte Liste aller Flugnummern aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die einen bestimmten Carrier (z.B. 'LH') haben. Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Schleife und String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Inline-FOR-Schleife innerhalb des String-Templates und den Operator `&&` für die Verkettung oder REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data OPTIONAL " For testing, pass data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_numbers.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_flights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rv_flight_list = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |{ flight-connid }| ELSE |{ result }, { flight-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_list.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_sflight_list=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_list( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers( iv_carrier = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = '0400, 0401',
      msg = 'Die Flugnummernliste sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers( iv_carrier = 'UA' it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = '0010',
      msg = 'Einzelne Flugnummer sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->get_flight_numbers( iv_carrier = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = '',
      msg = 'Leere Liste für nicht existierenden Carrier.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von REDUCE mit einer Inline-FOR-Schleife und COND innerhalb des String-Templates ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Erstellung von Listen aus internen Tabellen, ohne explizite LOOP-Anweisungen und IF-Blöcke.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, FOR, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT
