Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine dynamische SELECT-Anweisung für die Tabelle SFLIGHT, die basierend auf Eingabeparametern Spalten und WHERE-Bedingungen variiert. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Bauen Sie den SQL-String schrittweise mit String-Templates auf, um die Lesbarkeit zu gewährleisten. Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM (dbtab) ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_result.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_columns   TYPE string OPTIONAL " e.g. 'carrid, connid'
        iv_where_cond TYPE string OPTIONAL " e.g. 'carrid = ''LH'''
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_sflight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sql_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_columns_str) = COND string( WHEN iv_columns IS NOT INITIAL THEN iv_columns ELSE 'carrid, connid, fldate, price' ).
    DATA(lv_where_clause_str) = COND string( WHEN iv_where_cond IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE { iv_where_cond }| ELSE '' ).

    DATA(lv_table_name) = 'SFLIGHT'. " Dynamic table name

    " Execute the dynamic SELECT
    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_columns_str) FROM (lv_table_name) { lv_where_clause_str } INTO TABLE @rt_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic SQL error occurred' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sql FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sql.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_sql_template( ).
    DATA lt_result TYPE zcl_dyn_sql_template=>tt_sflight_result.

    " Test 1: Select all columns for a specific carrier
    lt_result = lo_cut->get_sflight_data_dynamic( iv_where_cond = `carrid = 'LH'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      msg = 'Sollte Daten für Carrier LH zurückgeben.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = <fs_flight>-carrid,
        exp = 'LH',
        msg = 'Carrier sollte LH sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test 2: Select specific columns
    lt_result = lo_cut->get_sflight_data_dynamic( iv_columns = 'carrid, connid' iv_where_cond = `carrid = 'AA'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      msg = 'Sollte Daten für Carrier AA zurückgeben.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = <fs_flight>-fldate,
        msg = 'Fldate sollte initial sein, da nicht ausgewählt.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = <fs_flight>-price,
        msg = 'Price sollte initial sein, da nicht ausgewählt.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test 3: No WHERE condition
    lt_result = lo_cut->get_sflight_data_dynamic( iv_columns = 'carrid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      msg = 'Sollte Daten ohne WHERE-Bedingung zurückgeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates sind ideal, um dynamische SQL-Anweisungen lesbar und sicher zu konstruieren. Durch die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken kann der SQL-String flexibel angepasst werden. Die Verwendung von `SELECT ... FROM (dbtab) ...` ist die moderne Art, dynamische Tabellen und Spalten in Open SQL zu handhaben.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, Dynamic SQL, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer angegebenen Anzahl von Zufallszahlen vom Typ Float zwischen 0 und 1.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT in Kombination mit einer FOR-Schleife für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_random_floats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF f WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_floats_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_values) TYPE tt_random_floats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_floats_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    rt_random_values = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_count
                                ( lo_random->get_next( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_random_values) = lo_cut->get_random_floats_table( 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_random_values ),
      exp = 5,

keywords: Random, Float, cl_abap_random_float, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl vom Typ Float innerhalb eines benutzerdefinierten Bereichs (Minimum und Maximum).
hint: Skalieren Sie die von CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT->GET_NEXT() zurückgegebene Zahl, um sie an den gewünschten Bereich anzupassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_float_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE f
        iv_max TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_value) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_float_in_range.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_normalized_random) = lo_random->get_next( ). " Value between 0 (inclusive) and 1 (exclusive)

    " Scale to the desired range: min + (random * (max - min))
    rv_random_value = iv_min + ( lv_normalized_random * ( iv_max - iv_min ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_float_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_float_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_float_range( ).
    DATA(lv_min) = 10.0.
    DATA(lv_max) = 20.0.
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_cut->get_random_float_in_range( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_random_value >= lv_min AND lv_random_value < lv_max ),
      msg = 'Zufallszahl sollte im definierten Bereich liegen.'
    ).

    lv_min = -5.0.
    lv_max = 0.0.
    lv_random_value = lo_cut->get_random_float_in_range( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_random_value >= lv_min AND lv_random_value < lv_max ),
      msg = 'Zufallszahl sollte im negativen Bereich liegen.'
    ).

    lv_min = 5.0.
    lv_max = 5.0.
    lv_random_value = lo_cut->get_random_float_in_range( iv_min = lv_min iv_max = lv_max ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_random_value,
      exp = 5.0,
      msg = 'Bei gleichem Min und Max sollte der Wert selbst zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Skalierung der von CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT generierten Zahl kann ein beliebiger Float-Bereich abgedeckt werden. Dies ist eine gängige mathematische Technik, die hier in einer modernen ABAP-Klasse gekapselt wird.
keywords: Random, Float, cl_abap_random_float, Range, Math

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT aus und formatieren Sie dessen Details (Carrier, Flugnummer, Datum, Preis) in einem lesbaren String. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT und String-Templates.
hint: Generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex für die interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie dann String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data OPTIONAL " For testing, pass data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_flight_details) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight_details.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data.

    IF it_sflights IS SUPPLIED.
      lt_flights = it_sflights.
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_flight_details = 'Keine Flüge gefunden.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_flights ).
    " Generate a random index between 1 and lv_table_size (inclusive)
    DATA(lv_random_index_float) = lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_table_size.
    DATA(lv_random_index) = trunc( lv_random_index_float ) + 1. " +1 because table index starts at 1

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO DATA(ls_random_flight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_flight_details = |Zufälliger Flug: Carrier { ls_random_flight-carrid }, Flugnummer { ls_random_flight-connid }, Datum { ls_random_flight-fldate DATE = USER }, Preis { ls_random_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_random_flight-currency } { ls_random_flight-currency }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_flight_details = 'Fehler beim Zugriff auf zufälligen Flug.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight_details FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_random_sflight=>tt_sflight_data.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum - 1.
    <fs_flight>-price = '200.50'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_details( it_sflights = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_result CS 'Carrier LH' OR lv_result CS 'Carrier AA' ),
      msg = 'Ergebnis sollte Details eines der Testflüge enthalten.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_result CS 'Flugnummer 0400' OR lv_result CS 'Flugnummer 0010' ),
      msg = 'Ergebnis sollte Details eines der Testflüge enthalten.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_data) TYPE zcl_random_sflight=>tt_sflight_data.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_random_flight_details( it_sflights = lt_empty_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = 'Keine Flüge gefunden.',
      msg = 'Sollte eine Nachricht für leere Tabelle zurückgeben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Zufallszahlengenerierung mit der Verarbeitung interner Tabellen und der String-Formatierung. CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT wird verwendet, um einen zufälligen Index zu bestimmen, und String-Templates formatieren die komplexen Daten eines Fluges lesbar, inklusive Datum- und Währungsformatierung.
keywords: Random, Float, cl_abap_random_float, String Templates, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Date/Time, Currency

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine eindeutige ID, die ein Präfix, das aktuelle Datum und eine zufällige dreistellige Zahl kombiniert. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT.
hint: Nutzen Sie SY-DATUM und CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, um die Komponenten zu erhalten, und String-Templates für die Zusammenstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_id_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_id_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_id.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    " Generate a random integer between 0 and 999
    DATA(lv_random_int) = trunc( lo_random->get_next( ) * 1000 ).

    " Format to 3 digits with leading zeros
    DATA(lv_random_str) = |{ lv_random_int ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }|.

    rv_unique_id = |{ iv_prefix }-{ sy-datum DATE = ISO }-{ lv_random_str }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_id_uniqueness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_id_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'DEV'.
    DATA(lv_id) = lo_cut->generate_unique_id( lv_prefix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches(
      act = lv_id,
      exp = |{ lv_prefix }-{ sy-datum(4) }-{ sy-datum+4(2) }-{ sy-datum+6(2) }-\d{3}|,
      msg = 'Generierte ID sollte dem erwarteten Format entsprechen.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( strlen( lv_id ) = strlen( lv_prefix ) + 1 + 10 + 1 + 3 ), " Prefix-YYYY-MM-DD-XXX
      msg = 'Länge der ID sollte korrekt sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_id_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_id_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_prefix) = 'TEST'.
    DATA(lv_id1) = lo_cut->generate_unique_id( lv_prefix ).
    DATA(lv_id2) = lo_cut->generate_unique_id( lv_prefix ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs(
      act = lv_id1,
      exp = lv_id2,
      msg = 'Zwei generierte IDs sollten sich unterscheiden (aufgrund des Zufallsanteils).'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung komplexer Strings durch die Kombination von statischem Text, Systemvariablen (SY-DATUM), dynamisch generierten Zufallszahlen und Formatierungsoptionen (ALPHA = OUT, WIDTH) innerhalb eines einzigen String-Templates. Dies ist sehr effizient und lesbar für die ID-Generierung.
keywords: String Templates, Random, cl_abap_random_float, ID Generation, Date/Time, CONCATENATE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen mehrzeiligen Berichtstext, der Informationen über einen Flug (Carrier, Flugnummer, Datum) enthält, wobei jede Information in einer neuen Zeile steht und eingerückt ist. Verwenden Sie String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Formatierungsoptionen `NEWLINE` und `INDENT` in String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_report
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_report.
    rv_report_text = |Flugbericht:{ NEWLINE
                      INDENT = 2 }Carrier: { iv_carrid }{ NEWLINE
                      INDENT = 2 }Flugnummer: { iv_connid }{ NEWLINE
                      INDENT = 2 }Datum: { iv_fldate DATE = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_report FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: String-Templates bieten leistungsstarke Formatierungsoptionen wie NEWLINE und INDENT, die es ermöglichen, komplexe, mehrzeilige Texte strukturiert und lesbar zu erstellen, ohne manuelle Zeilenumbrüche oder Leerzeichen hinzufügen zu müssen.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen String aus einer vorgegebenen Liste von Strings aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT, um einen Zufallsindex für die interne Tabelle der Strings zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_list_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        it_string_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_list_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    IF it_string_list IS INITIAL.
      RETURN. " Return initial string if list is empty
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_list_size) = lines( it_string_list ).
    " Generate a random index between 0 (inclusive) and lv_list_size (exclusive)
    DATA(lv_random_index_float) = lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_list_size.
    DATA(lv_random_index) = trunc( lv_random_index_float ). " 0-based index

    " Access the string using the generated index
    rv_selected_string = it_string_list[ lv_random_index + 1 ]. " +1 for 1-based table access
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine Nachricht, die den Status eines Auftrags anzeigt. Je nach Status (z.B. 'NEW', 'IN_PROCESS', 'COMPLETED') soll ein anderer Text verwendet werden. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den SWITCH-Operator.

solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_order_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status_message.
    rv_message = |Auftragsstatus: { SWITCH string( iv_status
                                        WHEN 'NEW'        THEN 'Neu erstellt'
                                        WHEN 'IN_PROCESS' THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                                        WHEN 'COMPLETED'  THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                                        ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Liste von Artikeln zufällig eine von drei Kategorien ('A', 'B', 'C') zu und geben Sie die Artikel mit ihrer zugewiesenen Kategorie aus. Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT und String-Templates.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl, um eine Kategorie auszuwählen, und verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_category_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name     TYPE string,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS assign_random_categories
      IMPORTING
        it_item_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_items) TYPE tt_items.

    METHODS get_categorized_items_report
      IMPORTING
        it_categorized_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_category_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_random_categories.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ).
    DATA(lv_num_categories) = lines( lt_categories ).

    rt_categorized_items = VALUE #( FOR item_name IN it_item_names
                                    LET lv_random_index = trunc( lo_random->get_next( ) * lv_num_categories ) IN
                                    ( name = item_name, category = lt_categories[ lv_random_index + 1 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_categorized_items_report.
    rv_report = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = 'Kategorisierte Artikel:'
      FOR item IN it_categorized_items
      NEXT result = |{ result }{ NEWLINE }  - { item-name } (Kategorie: { item-category })|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_categories FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_report_output FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_category_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_item_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Laptop' ) ( 'Maus' ) ( 'Tastatur' ) ( 'Monitor' ) ).
    DATA(lt_categorized_items) = lo_cut->assign_random_categories( lt_item_names ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_categorized_items ),
      exp = 4,
      msg = 'Es sollten 4 kategorisierte Artikel zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_categorized_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( <fs_item>-category = 'A' OR <fs_item>-category = 'B' OR <fs_item>-category = 'C' ),
        msg = 'Kategorie sollte A, B oder C sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_report_output.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_category_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_test_items) = VALUE zcl_random_category_assign=>tt_items(
      ( name = 'Artikel 1' category = 'A' )
      ( name = 'Artikel 2' category = 'B' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_report) = lo_cut->get_categorized_items_report( lt_test_items ).

    DATA(lv_expected_report) = |Kategorisierte Artikel:{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
                               }  - Artikel 1 (Kategorie: A){ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
                               }  - Artikel 2 (Kategorie: B)|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_report,
      exp = lv_expected_report,
      msg = 'Der Bericht sollte korrekt formatiert sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_category_assign( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_names) TYPE string_table.
    DATA(lt_categorized_items) = lo_cut->assign_random_categories( lt_empty_names ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_categorized_items ),
      msg = 'Für leere Eingabe sollte eine leere Tabelle zurückgegeben werden.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_report) = lo_cut->get_categorized_items_report( lt_categorized_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_report,
      exp = 'Kategorisierte Artikel:',
      msg = 'Bericht für leere Liste sollte nur Überschrift enthalten.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Generierung von Zufallszahlen mit der Verarbeitung interner Tabellen und der String-Formatierung für Berichte. Die Zuweisung der Kategorien erfolgt deklarativ mit einer FOR-Schleife und LET-Ausdrücken, während der Bericht mit REDUCE und String-Templates erstellt wird, was beides moderne und effiziente ABAP-Muster sind.
keywords: Random, Float, cl_abap_random_float, String Templates, Internal Tables, FOR, LET, REDUCE, Grouping

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen des Carriers 'LH' mit der Verbindungsnummer '0400'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = cl_demo_sflight_data=>get_sflights( ).
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_basic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_basic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'Connection ID mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Die Syntax ist kompakt und gut lesbar, was die Wartbarkeit verbessert. `FILTER #(...)` ist die Kurzform für `FILTER type(...)`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, WHERE, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die im Jahr 2025 stattfinden und noch freie Plätze haben (seatsocc < seatsmax).
hint: Kombinieren Sie Datumsvergleich und numerische Bedingungen im `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_available_flights_2025
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights_2025.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = cl_demo_sflight_data=>get_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_year_start) = '20250101'.
    DATA(lv_year_end)   = '20251231'.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = cl_demo_sflight_data=>get_sflights( ).

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übernommen werden sollen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_only_in_source TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_only_in_target TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS transfer_data
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING is_source TO rs_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_move_corr_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corr_struct( ).
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_move_corr_struct=>ty_source,
          ls_expected_target TYPE zcl_move_corr_struct=>ty_target.

    ls_source-field1 = 'Hello World'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field_only_in_source = 'SourceOnly'.

    ls_expected_target-field1 = 'Hello World'.
    ls_expected_target-field2 = 123.
    " field3 and field_only_in_target remain initial

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->transfer_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field1 exp = ls_expected_target-field1 msg = 'Field1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-field2 exp = ls_expected_target-field2 msg = 'Field2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-field3 msg = 'Field3 should be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_result-field_only_in_target msg = 'Field_only_in_target should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` ist eine klassische ABAP-Anweisung, die Felder zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit identischen Namen überträgt. Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn Quell- und Zielstrukturen unterschiedliche Felder haben, aber eine Teilmenge der Felder übereinstimmt.

    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_filter_calc_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_calc_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_min_free_seats.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = cl_demo_sflight_data=>get_sflights( ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_toolbar.
    DATA(lt_base_buttons) = VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button(
      ( function = 'REFRESH' icon = icon_refresh text = 'Aktualisieren' )
      ( function = 'SEP1'    type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_separator )
    ).

    DATA(lt_edit_buttons) = VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button(
      ( function = 'EDIT'    icon = icon_edit text = 'Bearbeiten' )
      ( function = 'DELETE'  icon = icon_delete text = 'Löschen' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_final_buttons) = VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button(
      FOR ls_button IN lt_base_buttons (
        ls_button
      )
      FOR ls_button IN COND #( WHEN iv_edit_mode = abap_true THEN lt_edit_buttons ELSE VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button( ) ) (
        ls_button
      )
    ).

    mo_toolbar->add_button_group(
      EXPORTING
        id       = 'DYNAMIC'
        buttons  = lt_final_buttons
    ).
    mo_toolbar->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    mo_toolbar->add_button_group( id = 'ACTIONS' buttons = lt_buttons ).
    mo_toolbar->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_last_clicked_function = fcode.
    " Example logic using CASE expression
    DATA(lv_message) = CASE fcode
                         WHEN 'SAVE' THEN |'Speichern' wurde geklickt.|
                         WHEN 'PRINT' THEN |'Drucken' wurde geklickt.|
                         ELSE |Unbekannte Funktion: { fcode }|
                       END.
    " In a real scenario, you would display this message or trigger further actions.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_clicked_function.
    rv_function = mv_last_clicked_function.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füllen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` mit Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `GROUP BY` um die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und als Baumstruktur darzustellen.
hint: `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` ist hier der Schlüssel, um hierarchische Daten zu erzeugen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_node,
             node_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key,
             text     TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>text,
             relatkey TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
             expanded TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_sflight_node.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Fluggesellschaften' is_folder = abap_true expanded = abap_true )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      ( LET lv_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid IN
        VALUE ty_sflight_node(
          node_key = lv_carrid
          text     = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }|
          relatkey = 'ROOT'
          is_folder = abap_true
          expanded = abap_true
        )
        FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_sflight (
          VALUE ty_sflight_node(
            node_key = |{ lv_carrid }_{ ls_flight-fldate }|
            text     = |Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate }|
            relatkey = lv_carrid
            is_folder = abap_false
          )
        )
      )
    ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE=>T_OUTTAB'
        table_structure_type = 'FLAT'
        nodes_table          = lt_nodes
    ).
    mo_tree->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` und implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die die angezeigten Knoten basierend auf einem Suchkriterium filtert. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: `FILTER` kann eine neue Tabelle mit gefilterten Daten erzeugen, die dann dem Baum neu zugewiesen werden kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS set_initial_data IMPORTING it_data TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab.
    METHODS filter_tree IMPORTING iv_search_term TYPE string.
    METHODS display_tree.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_all_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab.
    DATA mt_filtered_nodes TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_initial_data.
    mt_all_nodes = it_data.
    mt_filtered_nodes = it_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_tree.
    IF iv_search_term IS INITIAL.
      mt_filtered_nodes = mt_all_nodes.
    ELSE.
      mt_filtered_nodes = FILTER #( mt_all_nodes USING KEY primary_key WHERE text CP |*{ iv_search_term }*| OR node_key CP |*{ iv_search_term }*| ).
    ENDIF.
    display_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    mo_tree->delete_all_nodes( ).
    mo_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE=>T_OUTTAB'
        table_structure_type = 'FLAT'
        nodes_table          = mt_filtered_nodes
    ).
    mo_tree->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ). " Dummy container

    DATA(lt_initial_data) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Wurzel' is_folder = abap_true expanded = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'NODE_A' text = 'Knoten A' relatkey = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'NODE_B' text = 'Knoten B' relatkey = 'ROOT' )
      ( node_key = 'SUB_A1' text = 'Unterknoten A1' relatkey = 'NODE_A' )
    ).
    lo_cut->set_initial_data( lt_initial_data ).

    lo_cut->filter_tree( 'A' ).

    " We can't directly access mt_filtered_nodes, so we'd need a getter or test the display_tree effect.
    " For unit test, we simulate the filter logic directly.
    DATA(lt_expected_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_initial_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE text CP '*A*' OR node_key CP '*A*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expected_filtered ) exp = 3 ). " ROOT, NODE_A, SUB_A1
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expected_filtered[ 2 ]-node_key exp = 'NODE_A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_nodes_not_found.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ). " Dummy container
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_filter( lo_container ).

    lo_cut->filter_tree( 'XYZ' ).

    DATA(lt_expected_filtered) = FILTER #( lt_initial_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE text CP '*XYZ*' OR node_key CP '*XYZ*' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_expected_filtered ) exp = 1 ). " Only ROOT remains if no children match
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_expected_filtered[ 1 ]-node_key exp = 'ROOT' ).

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ). " Dummy container

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE`, bei dem die Icons der Knoten dynamisch basierend auf dem Wert eines Feldes in den zugrunde liegenden Daten gesetzt werden. Nutzen Sie `COND` oder `CASE` Ausdrücke.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             status TYPE char1,
             text   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree

    mo_tree->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE` aus `SFLIGHTS` Daten. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die mit `REDUCE` die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle angezeigten Flüge berechnet.
hint: `REDUCE` ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE mt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_nodes) = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_outtab(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Flugübersicht' is_folder = abap_true expanded = abap_true )
      FOR ls_sflight IN mt_sflights (
        VALUE #( node_key = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }_{ ls_sflight-connid }_{ ls_sflight-fldate }|
                 text     = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate } (Sitze: { ls_sflight-seatsocc })|
                 relatkey = 'ROOT'
               )
      )
    ).

    mo_tree->add_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        table_structure_name = 'CL_GUI_SIMPLE_TREE=>T_OUTTAB'
        table_structure_type = 'FLAT'
        nodes_table          = lt_nodes
    ).
    mo_tree->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN mt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_passengers_calculation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_passengers_calculation.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'CONTAINER' ). " Dummy container

    lt_mock_sflights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 100 )
                                ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' seatsocc = 50 )
                                ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' seatsocc = 75 ) ).

    " Set the internal table directly for testing the REDUCE logic
    lo_cut->('MT_SFLIGHTS') = lt_mock_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers().

CLASS zcl_tree_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             node_key TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key,
             text     TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>text,
             relatkey TYPE cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_key,
             sort_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES: tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sorted_tree IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_node_data.

CLASS zcl_tree_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar und implementieren Sie eine Methode, die Buttons basierend auf einer Liste von Berechtigungen dynamisch aktiviert oder deaktiviert. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `mo_toolbar->set_button_enabled` und `FOR` mit `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_toolbar_permissions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_permissions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_toolbar IMPORTING it_user_permissions TYPE tt_permissions.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_toolbar_permissions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_toolbar.
    DATA(lt_all_buttons) = VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button(
      ( function = 'CREATE' icon = icon_create text = 'Anlegen' )
      ( function = 'CHANGE' icon = icon_change text = 'Ändern' )
      ( function = 'DELETE' icon = icon_delete text = 'Löschen' )
      ( function = 'DISPLAY' icon = icon_display text = 'Anzeigen' )
    ).

    mo_toolbar->add_button_group( id = 'ACTIONS' buttons = lt_all_buttons ).

    " Dynamically enable/disable buttons based on permissions
    FOR ls_button IN lt_all_buttons.
      DATA(lv_is_enabled) = COND abap_bool(
        WHEN line_exists( it_user_permissions[ table_line = ls_button-function ] ) THEN abap_true
        ELSE abap_false
      ).
      mo_toolbar->set_button_enabled( fcode = ls_button-function enabled = lv_is_enabled ).
    ENDFOR.

    mo_toolbar->set_all_visible( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) mithilfe eines Cursors und geben Sie die Flugnummern aus. Verwenden Sie `FETCH NEXT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_sflights_by_carrid.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT connid
        FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO @ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight-connid TO rt_connids.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_info.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @ls_sflight.

      rv_formatted_string = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } am { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } mit { ls_sflight-seatsocc } belegten Sitzen.|.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf dem Wert eines Eingabeparameters für die Verspätung in Minuten. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Ausdruck für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 THEN 'Verspätet'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes < 0 THEN 'Früher'
      ELSE 'Pünktlich'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_status_delayed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_status_early FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_status_delayed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 10 ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).

  METHOD test_flight_status_early.

explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine funktionale und kompakte bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt mehrerer `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke kann der Wert einer Variablen direkt basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 1200 msg = 'Expected 1200 occupied seats for AA (example data)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die funktionale Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable zu berechnen, indem über die Elemente einer Tabelle iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik angewendet wird, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Expressions

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und übergeben Sie Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object) PARAMETER-TABLE pt_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS _get_greeting IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
    METHODS _get_farewell IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_farewell) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lx_exception  TYPE REF TO cx_root.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF ME
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            rv_greeting = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO lx_exception.
        rv_result = |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hallo, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_farewell.
    rv_farewell = |Auf Wiedersehen, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_greeting FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_farewell FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_greeting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_GET_GREETING' iv_value = 'Welt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hallo, Welt!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_farewell.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = '_GET_FAREWELL' iv_value = 'ABAP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Auf Wiedersehen, ABAP!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( iv_method_name = 'INVALID_METHOD' iv_value = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Fehler' act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object` ist ein mächtiges Feature für flexible und erweiterbare Anwendungen. Er ermöglicht es, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was in Szenarien wie Plugin-Architekturen oder generischen Frameworks nützlich ist. Die Parameterübergabe erfolgt über `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
keywords: Dynamic Call, Reflection, Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Anzahl der Flüge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         count  TYPE i,
       END OF ty_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = group_ref->*-carrid
                                    count  = group_ref->*->count( ) ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_counts msg = 'Should return grouped flight counts' ).

    DATA(ls_count_lh) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'LH' DEFAULT `carrid = '', count = 0` ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_lh-count exp = 48 msg = 'Expected 48 flights for LH' ).

    DATA(ls_count_aa) = lt_counts[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT `carrid = '', count = 0` ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_aa-count exp = 12 msg = 'Expected 12 flights for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Sortierungen und Schleifen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und ermöglicht eine direkte Verarbeitung der Gruppen. `REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref)` ist hierbei die moderne Variante.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, LOOP AT

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Eintrag aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` mit der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' und der Flugnummer '0400' mithilfe eines Tabellenausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_key.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        CLEAR rs_sflight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl der Einträge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).

    DATA(lv_num_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_num_flights > 0.
      rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lv_num_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_seats_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( 'AZ' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '100.00' msg = 'Expected average 100.00 for AZ (example data)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_seats_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.00' msg = 'Expected average 0.00 for no flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE` Ausdruck zur Summenbildung mit der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Einträge, um einen Durchschnitt zu berechnen. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT34` für das Ergebnis gewährleistet eine präzise Gleitkommaarithmetik. Dies zeigt eine moderne, funktionale Herangehensweise an mathematische Aggregationen in ABAP.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Internal Tables, SFLIGHTS, DECFLOAT

Instructions: Listen Sie alle öffentlichen Instanzattribute einer gegebenen ABAP-Klasse auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_get_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_attribute_info.
    TYPES: tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_get_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ).

    rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR <ls_attr> IN lt_attributes
                             WHERE ( visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public )
                             ( name = <ls_attr>-name
                               type = <ls_attr>-type_descr->get_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_attributes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_class RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_attributes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_get_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_public_attributes( 'ZCL_RTT_GET_ATTRIBUTES' ). " Test with itself

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_attributes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_attributes )
      exp = 3 " name, type, rt_attributes (public section)
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_attributes[ name = 'RT_ATTRIBUTES' ]-type
      exp = 'ZCL_RTT_GET_ATTRIBUTES=>TT_ATTRIBUTE_INFO'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtt_get_attributes( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_public_attributes( 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_descr_error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_cut ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `DATA(...) = NEW ...` für die Instanziierung und `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... )` für die Transformation und Filterung der Attributliste. Dies macht den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar. Die RTTI-Klasse `cl_abap_classdescr` ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Klassen zur Laufzeit.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_classdescr, get_attributes, VALUE, FOR, dynamische Analyse

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer gegebenen ABAP-Klasse und deren Parameter.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_methods`. Für Parameterdetails verwenden Sie `parameter_descr_tab`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_get_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_parameter_info,
             name TYPE string,
             kind TYPE string, " e.g., 'importing', 'exporting'
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_parameter_info.
    TYPES: tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
             name TYPE string,
             parameters TYPE tt_parameter_info,
           END OF ty_method_info.
    TYPES: tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_methods_with_params
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_get_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_methods_with_params.
    DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

    rt_methods = VALUE #( FOR <ls_meth> IN lt_methods
                            WHERE ( visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public )
                            ( name = <ls_meth>-name

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die gesamte Vererbungshierarchie einer Klasse bis zur Wurzelklasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und die Methode `get_superclass_descr` rekursiv.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtt_get_superclass_h DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_class_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF clike WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_superclass_hierarchy
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hierarchy) TYPE tt_class_names
      RAISING
        cx_sy_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtt_get_superclass_h IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_superclass_hierarchy.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA: lv_current_class_name TYPE clike.

    lv_current_class_name = iv_class_name.

    WHILE lv_current_class_name IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_current_class_name TO rt_hierarchy.
      lo_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( lv_current_class_name ).
      DATA(lo_superclass_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_superclass_descr( ).
      IF lo_superclass_descr IS BOUND.
        lv_current_class_name = lo_superclass_descr->get_name( ).
      ELSE.
        CLEAR lv_current_class_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights` und, falls vorhanden, die zugehörigen Buchungsdaten aus `sbook` mittels LEFT OUTER JOIN. Flüge ohne Buchungen sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_bookings_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_bookings_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_bookings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_bookings_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
      compress = abap_true
    ).

    " Überprüfen, ob auch Flüge ohne Buchungen enthalten sind (bookid ist initial)
    DATA(lv_found_unbooked) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-bookid IS INITIAL.
        lv_found_unbooked = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_unbooked
      msg = 'Should contain flights without bookings (LEFT OUTER JOIN)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der LEFT OUTER JOIN stellt sicher, dass alle Datensätze von der linken Tabelle (`sflights`) im Ergebnis enthalten sind, auch wenn keine passenden Datensätze in der rechten Tabelle (`sbook`) gefunden werden. In solchen Fällen werden die Felder der rechten Tabelle mit Initialwerten gefüllt. Dies ist nützlich, um eine vollständige Liste von Elementen (hier: Flüge) zusammen mit optionalen zugehörigen Daten (hier: Buchungen) abzurufen.
keywords: JOIN, SELECT, LEFT OUTER JOIN, sflights, sbook, Database Access

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` basierend auf ihrem Preis in 'Günstig' (Preis < 500), 'Standard' (500 <= Preis < 1000) oder 'Teuer' (Preis >= 1000) direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck in Ihrem `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price,
           CASE
             WHEN price < 500 THEN 'Günstig'
             WHEN price >= 500 AND price < 1000 THEN 'Standard'
             ELSE 'Teuer'
           END AS category
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_categorized_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_categories FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_category( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'
      compress = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lv_found_cheap) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_standard) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_expensive) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-price < 500 AND ls_entry-category = 'Günstig'.
        lv_found_cheap = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-price >= 500 AND ls_entry-price < 1000 AND ls_entry-category = 'Standard'.
        lv_found_standard = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-price >= 1000 AND ls_entry-category = 'Teuer'.
        lv_found_expensive = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_cheap
      msg = 'Should find at least one "Günstig" flight'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_standard
      msg = 'Should find at least one "Standard" flight'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_expensive
      msg = 'Should find at least one "Teuer" flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CASE`-Ausdruck im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt auf der Datenbankebene anzuwenden und ein berechnetes Feld basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien zu erstellen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Daten in den ABAP-Arbeitsspeicher zu laden und dort zu verarbeiten, was die Performance verbessert und den Code sauberer macht.
keywords: CALCULATE, SELECT, CASE, Conditional Logic, sflights, Database Access

CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid    TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname  TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             avg_price TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.

CLASS zcl_carrier_flight_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(s~price) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_stats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN Funktion in Ihrem `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_days_until DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_days,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             days_until TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_days.
    TYPES tt_flight_days TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_days WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_days_until_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_days) TYPE tt_flight_days.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_days_until IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_until_flight.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           DATS_DAYS_BETWEEN( @lv_current_date, fldate ) AS days_until
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,

CLASS zcl_flights_above_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_above_avg.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights AS s
      WHERE price > ( SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = s~carrid )
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )

    " Manuelle Überprüfung für eine Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH')
    SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @DATA(lv_avg_price_lh).
    DATA(lv_found_higher) = abap_false.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle `lt_flights` unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflights-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_sum_prices=>tt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 250 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 400
      msg = 'Total price should be 400'
    ).

    CLEAR lt_test_flights.
    lv_total = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionaler Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren und einen einzelnen Wert zu berechnen. Er ist Teil der modernen ABAP-Syntax (ab 7.40) und bietet eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit expliziter Summenbildung. Die Initialisierung des Akkumulators (`INIT sum = 0`) und die Iteration über die Tabelle (`FOR ls_flight IN it_flights`) sind klar definiert.
keywords: CALCULATE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Math

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle `lt_flights` die Summe der Preise und die Anzahl der Flüge unter Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in ABAP.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit Inline-Deklarationen und Aggregatfunktionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflights-price,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflights-price
                                        FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                        NEXT sum = sum + ls_member-price ).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
                      total_price = lv_total_price
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_summary.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = 250 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->summarize_flights_by_carrier( it_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_summary )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Should have 2 summary entries (LH, AA)'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_summary-total_price
      exp = 350
      msg = 'Total price for LH should be 350'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_summary-flight_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Flight count for LH should be 2'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_aa_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_summary-total_price
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Total price for AA should be 200'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Flight count for AA should be 2'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`-Syntax (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Preis pro Passagier für alle Flüge aus `sflights`, indem Sie den Preis durch die maximale Anzahl der Passagiere teilen. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer definierten maximalen Passagierzahl.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine arithmetische Operation und eine `WHERE`-Klausel, um Division durch Null zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_price_per_passenger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_price_per_pax,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
             max_pax  TYPE sflights-max_pass,
             price_per_pax TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_price_per_pax.
    TYPES tt_price_per_pax TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_price_per_pax WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_price_per_passenger
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_price_per_pax) TYPE tt_price_per_pax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_price_per_passenger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_per_passenger.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, max_pass AS max_pax,
           price / max_pass AS price_per_pax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE max_pass > 0
      INTO TABLE @rt_price_per_pax.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge, die entweder 'Günstig' (Preis < 500) oder 'Teuer' (Preis >= 1000) sind, unter Verwendung von `CASE` und `SUM` in einer `GROUP BY`-Abfrage.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CASE` mit `SUM` und `GROUP BY` im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price_count,
             carrid        TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carrname      TYPE scarr-carrname,
             cheap_flights TYPE i,
             expensive_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_price_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_price_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cheap_expensive_flight_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_price_count) TYPE tt_carrier_price_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cheap_expensive_flight_count.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname,
           SUM( CASE WHEN s~price < 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS cheap_flights,
           SUM( CASE WHEN s~price >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS expensive_flights
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY s~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_price_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_ida_custom_data_prov.
  INTERFACES if_salv_gui_table_ida_data_prov.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_ida_custom_data_prov DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_ida_custom_data_prov.
    METHODS display_custom_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_custom_data_prov IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_ida_custom_data_prov~get_data.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies Daten aus einer benutzerdefinierten Quelle abrufen.
    " Zur Vereinfachung geben wir einen kleinen statischen Datensatz zurück.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr.
    SELECT * FROM scarr INTO TABLE @lt_data UP TO 20 ROWS.
    et_data = CORRESPONDING #( lt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_ida_custom_data_prov~get_metadata.
    " Define metadata for the fields we are returning
    DATA: ls_field TYPE if_salv_gui_table_ida_data_prov=>ty_s_field_metadata.

    ls_field-field_name = 'CARRID'.
    ls_field-datatype   = 'CHAR'.
    ls_field-length     = 3.
    ls_field-label      = 'Fluggesellschaft ID'.
    APPEND ls_field TO et_field_metadata.

    ls_field-field_name = 'CARRNAME'.
    ls_field-datatype   = 'CHAR'.
    ls_field-length     = 20.
    ls_field-label      = 'Name der Fluggesellschaft'.
    APPEND ls_field TO et_field_metadata.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_ida_custom_data_prov~get_total_row_count.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde dies die Gesamtzahl aus der Quelle zurückgeben.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scarr INTO @ev_total_row_count.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_custom_data.
    DATA(lo_ida_alv) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_data_provider( iv_data_provider = me ).
    lo_ida_alv->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
