Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, bei denen die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert (z.B. 100) liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die moderne Syntax `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_flights_by_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_low_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_threshold  TYPE s_maxseats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_flights_by_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_low_capacity_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE TABLE rt_filtered_flights WHERE max_seats < iv_threshold.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_flights_by_capacity( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'A320' max_seats = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' planetype = 'B737' max_seats = 90 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251202' planetype = 'A380' max_seats = 500 )

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugbuchungen, basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_adjacent_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             bookid TYPE s_book_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_booking.
    TYPES: tt_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_booking
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_bookings) TYPE tt_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_adjacent_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_bookings = it_bookings.
    SORT rt_unique_bookings BY carrid connid. " Wichtig für ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_bookings COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist effizient, um direkt aufeinanderfolgende doppelte Zeilen zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den Vergleichsfeldern zu sortieren, da sonst nicht alle Duplikate gefunden werden. Die `COMPARING` Klausel erlaubt die Spezifikation der Felder, die für den Duplikatsvergleich relevant sind.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, außer denen, die zu einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gehören, unter Verwendung eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FILTER it_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden, indem Sie alle Einträge entfernen, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die neue Tabelle iterativ aufzubauen und dabei unerwünschte Elemente zu überspringen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_delete_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_flights_with_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_delete_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_flights_with_reduce.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE tt_sflight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE flight-carrid <> iv_carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Eingabeparameter (z.B. eine Flugnummer) ungültig ist (z.B. leer oder nicht numerisch).
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_field_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid        LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous      LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        iv_field_name TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_field_name = iv_field_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_number.
    IF iv_connid IS INITIAL OR NOT iv_connid CO '0123456789'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>default_text
          iv_field_name = 'Flugnummer'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' ). " Dummy-Assert, um den Test als erfolgreich zu markieren
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_flight_number.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_invalid_flight_data(

      exp = NEW zcx_invalid_flight_data(
        textid = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>default_text
        iv_field_name = 'Flugnummer' )
      act_code = `lo_cut->validate_flight_number( '' )`
    ).

Durch die Definition eigener Ausnahmeklassen (hier `ZCX_INVALID_FLIGHT_DATA`) kann man spezifische Fehlerinformationen transportieren und die Fehlerbehandlung im aufrufenden Code präziser gestalten. `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erzwingt die Deklaration der Ausnahme in der Methodensignatur.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht und die entsprechende Ausnahme abfängt, um eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result_text = |{ divide( iv_numerator, iv_denominator ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result_text = 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` und `TRY` innerhalb eines `COND`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcx_value_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_value_or_raise
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_key  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_value_not_found.

    METHODS get_value_with_fallback
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_data
        iv_key         TYPE string
        iv_fallback    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_or_raise.
    READ TABLE it_data INTO DATA(ls_data) WITH KEY key = iv_key.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_value_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_value_not_found=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_value = ls_data-value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value_with_fallback.
    rv_result = COND string(
      TRY
          WHEN get_value_or_raise( it_data = it_data iv_key = iv_key ) IS NOT INITIAL THEN
            get_value_or_raise( it_data = it_data iv_key = iv_key )
        CATCH zcx_value_not_found
          WHEN OTHERS THEN
            iv_fallback
      ENDTRY
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt und nicht lokal behandelt wird, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_resource_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_resource_status TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS process_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS cleanup_resource.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resource_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_resource.
    mv_resource_status = 'Resource initialisiert'.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        mv_resource_status = 'Resource verarbeitet'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        mv_resource_status = 'Fehler bei Verarbeitung'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Ausnahme weitergeben
      CLEANUP.
        " Dieser Block wird ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt
        " und nicht vollständig im CATCH-Block behandelt wird (d.h. weitergegeben wird).
        me->cleanup_resource( ).
    ENDTRY.
    IF mv_resource_status = 'Resource verarbeitet'.
      me->cleanup_resource( ). " Normaler Cleanup, wenn keine Ausnahme auftrat
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_resource.
    mv_resource_status = mv_resource_status && ' + Resource aufgeräumt'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_cleanup_on_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    lo_cut->process_resource( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_status exp = 'Resource verarbeitet + Resource aufgeräumt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resource_manager( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_resource( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_status exp = 'Fehler bei Verarbeitung + Resource aufgeräumt' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block in einer `TRY...CATCH`-Struktur ist entscheidend für die zuverlässige Freigabe von Ressourcen. Er wird immer dann ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt und diese Ausnahme nicht vollständig im `CATCH`-Block behandelt, sondern weitergegeben wird. Dies stellt sicher, dass Ressourcen auch bei unerwarteten Fehlern ordnungsgemäß geschlossen oder freigegeben werden, was die Stabilität der Anwendung erhöht.
keywords: RAISE, Exception, CLEANUP, TRY CATCH, Resource Management

CLASS zcl_delete_first_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_first_matching_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid     TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_first_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_first_matching_flight.
    rt_modified_flights = it_flights.
    LOOP AT rt_modified_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      DELETE rt_modified_flights INDEX sy-tabix.
      EXIT. " Nur den ersten Treffer löschen
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke oder eine `FINALLY`-Klausel, um den Status zu verwalten und die Ausnahme zu verpacken.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_operation_name TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mo_original_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid          LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous        LIKE previous OPTIONAL
        iv_operation_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
        io_original_exception TYPE REF TO cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_operation_failed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_operation_name = iv_operation_name.
    me->mo_original_exception = io_original_exception.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_operations
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_operation_failed.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS perform_single_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_operations.
    DATA(lv_success_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_error_occurred) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      IF lv_error_occurred = abap_true.
        CONTINUE. " Überspringe weitere Operationen nach dem ersten Fehler
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          me->perform_single_operation( lv_value ).
          lv_success_count = lv_success_count + 1.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
          lv_error_occurred = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_operation_failed
            EXPORTING
              textid = zcx_operation_failed=>default_text
              iv_operation_name = |Operation mit Wert { lv_value }|
              io_original_exception = lx_root.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_status_message = |{ lv_success_count } von { lines( it_values ) } Operationen erfolgreich abgeschlossen.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_single_operation.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulierte Operation
    DATA(lv_dummy) = 100 / iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_operations_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operations_with_failure FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_operation_failed.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operations_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_operation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      ( 10 ) ( 20 ) ( 5 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->execute_operations( lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = '3 von 3 Operationen erfolgreich abgeschlossen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operations_with_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_operation_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i(
      ( 10 ) ( 0 ) ( 5 ) " Fehler bei der zweiten Operation
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->execute_operations( lt_values ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).
      CATCH zcx_operation_failed INTO DATA(lx_op_failed).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_op_failed->mv_operation_name exp = 'Operation mit Wert 0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_op_failed->mo_original_exception ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Fehlerbehandlung, bei der eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`ZCX_OPERATION_FAILED`) verwendet wird, um eine Kette von Operationen zu verwalten. Bei einem Fehler wird die ursprüngliche Ausnahme in die neue Ausnahme 'verpackt' (Exception Chaining), was eine detaillierte Fehleranalyse ermöglicht. Die `CONTINUE`-Anweisung im `LOOP` stellt sicher, dass nach dem ersten Fehler keine weiteren Operationen ausgeführt werden, was für kritische Prozessketten wichtig sein kann.
keywords: RAISE, Exception, Exception Chaining, TRY CATCH, Control Flow

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT mit einer modernen ABAP-Syntax.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_sflight_prices( ).

    " Assuming SFLIGHT has at least some data, check if the sum is greater than 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle LOOP-Anweisungen mit expliziten Summenvariablen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER und REDUCE, um zuerst die relevanten Flüge auszuwählen und dann den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_sflight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_sflight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lines( lt_filtered_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                      FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                                        NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price_aa) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price_xx) = lo_cut->get_average_price( 'XX' ). "Non-existent carrier

    " Assuming 'LH' has flights and average price is positive
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_avg_price_lh > 0 ) msg = 'Average price for LH should be positive' ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights and average price is positive

    " For non-existent carrier, average price should be 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Average price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von FILTER- und REDUCE-Operatoren. FILTER ermöglicht eine elegante und performante Vorfilterung von internen Tabellen, während REDUCE für die anschließende Aggregation (Summe) verwendet wird. Die Division erfolgt dann klassisch. Dies ist deutlich lesbarer als verschachtelte LOOPs und IF-Anweisungen.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Average, CALCULATE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt auf einen Flugpreis basierend auf dem Preis: 10% für Preise über 500, sonst 5%. Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie COND für die bedingte Zuweisung des Rabattsatzes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_rate) = COND #( WHEN iv_original_price > 500 THEN '0.10'
                                     ELSE '0.05' ).
    rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - lv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_discounted_high) = lo_cut->get_discounted_price( lv_price_high ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted_high exp = 540 msg = 'Discount for price > 500 incorrect' ).

    " Test price <= 500 (5% discount)
    DATA(lv_price_low) = 400.
    DATA(lv_discounted_low) = lo_cut->get_discounted_price( lv_price_low ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted_low exp = 380 msg = 'Discount for price <= 500 incorrect' ).

    " Test price exactly 500 (5% discount)
    DATA(lv_price_boundary) = 500.
    DATA(lv_discounted_boundary) = lo_cut->get_discounted_price( lv_price_boundary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted_boundary exp = 475 msg = 'Discount for price = 500 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und ausdrucksstarke Implementierung von bedingten Zuweisungen. Anstatt mehrerer IF-ELSE-Anweisungen kann die Logik in einer einzigen Zeile formuliert werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache 'Calculator'-Klasse, die grundlegende arithmetische Operationen (Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide) über Method Chaining ermöglicht. Die Klasse soll den aktuellen Wert speichern und jede Operation soll den Wert aktualisieren und die Instanz für weitere Operationen zurückgeben.
hint: Jede Methode sollte 'ME' zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS divide   IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value / iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 5 )->subtract( 2 )->multiply( 3 )->divide( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 13 msg = 'Chained calculation result incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_calculator2) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( 0 ).
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_calculator2->add( 10 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 10 msg = 'Simple add incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( 10 ).
    TRY.
        lo_calculator->divide( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE correctly raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) ist ein Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes verbessert, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgibt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, CALCULATE, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis. Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY.
hint: Nutzen Sie die GROUP BY-Klausel in einer LOOP-Anweisung und den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             num_flights TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                            INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_num_flights) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                      FOR GROUP flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                        NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
                                      num_flights = lv_num_flights
                                      total_price = lv_total_price ) TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    " Assert that there are summaries (assuming SFLIGHT is not empty)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summaries is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'No flight summaries generated' ).

    " Find a specific carrier (e.g., 'LH') and check its data
    READ TABLE lt_summaries WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_lh_summary is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'Summary for LH not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_lh_summary-num_flights > 0 ) msg = 'Number of LH flights should be positive' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_lh_summary-total_price > 0 ) msg = 'Total price for LH should be positive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in ABAP 7.40+, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. In Kombination mit dem REDUCE-Operator für die Summenbildung innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird der Code für komplexe Datenanalysen extrem kompakt und effizient.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, CALCULATE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes in einer SFLIGHT-Struktur basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen ausliest und zurückgibt. Dies könnte zur dynamischen Datenextraktion für einen 3D-Viewer verwendet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_flight   TYPE sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight TO <lv_field_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <lv_field_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_value_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_field_access( ).
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflight.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
    ls_flight-price = '123.45'.
    ls_flight-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lv_carrid_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_value exp = 'LH' msg = 'Dynamic access to CARRID failed' ).

    DATA(lv_price_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_value exp = '123.45' msg = 'Dynamic access to PRICE failed' ).

    DATA(lv_non_existent_field) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_flight = ls_flight iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_non_existent_field exp = 'Field not found' msg = 'Dynamic access to non-existent field failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von FIELD-SYMBOLS in Verbindung mit ASSIGN COMPONENT ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Routinen oder wenn die Feldnamen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, z.B. bei der Vorbereitung von Daten für flexible UI-Komponenten wie einem 3D-Viewer, der unterschiedliche Datenfelder visualisieren kann.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI, cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHT, die einen Preis über 1000 haben, und speichern Sie sie in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Dies könnte für die Anzeige von 'Premium-Flügen' in einem 3D-Viewer relevant sein.

CLASS zcl_filter_premium_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_filter_premium_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_premium_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_premium_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > 1000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und eine berechnete 'Route' (z.B. 'FRA-JFK') enthält. Dies könnte für die Visualisierung von Routen in einem 3D-Viewer nützlich sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_flight_routes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_route,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             route  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_route.
    TYPES: tt_flight_route TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_route WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_routes RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_routes) TYPE tt_flight_route.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_flight_routes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_routes.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_routes = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_flight-connid
                                   route  = |{ ls_flight-cityfrom }-{ ls_flight-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_routes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_routes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_flight_routes( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_routes) = lo_cut->get_flight_routes( ).

    " Assert that the transformed table is not empty (assuming SFLIGHT has data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_routes is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'Transformed table is empty' ).

    " Check a specific entry (assuming 'LH' '0400' exists and has cities)
    READ TABLE lt_flight_routes WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_route).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_route-route IS NOT INITIAL ) msg = 'Route string is empty' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = ls_route-route pattern = '\w+-\w+' msg = 'Route format is incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit VALUE ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und manuell Zeilen in eine neue Tabelle einzufügen, kann die gesamte Transformation in einem einzigen Ausdruck formuliert werden, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, SFLIGHT, cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit die Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer SFLIGHT-Struktur mittels RTTI. Dies ist eine Vorbereitung, um dynamisch Daten für einen 3D-Viewer zu interpretieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_sflight_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_components RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_sflight_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_components.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHT' ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_component_info( name = ls_component-name
                                          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error if type 'SFLIGHT' not found or not a structure
        MESSAGE 'Type SFLIGHT not found or not a structure' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_components.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_sflight_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_sflight_components( ).

    " Assert that components are found (SFLIGHT is a standard table)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_components is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'No components found for SFLIGHT' ).

    " Check for a specific component like 'CARRID'
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' INTO DATA(ls_carrid_comp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_carrid_comp is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'CARRID component not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_carrid_comp-type exp = 'CARRID' msg = 'Type of CARRID component incorrect' ).

    " Check for 'PRICE'
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'PRICE' INTO DATA(ls_price_comp).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_price_comp is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'PRICE component not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_price_comp-type exp = 'PRICE' msg = 'Type of PRICE component incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Informationen über Datentypen und Objekte zur Laufzeit zu erhalten. Dies ist entscheidend für generische Anwendungen, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen, wie z.B. ein 3D-Viewer, der dynamisch Datenfelder aus verschiedenen Quellen visualisieren soll. Die Verwendung von CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR und CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR ist der moderne Weg, diese Metadaten abzufragen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, SFLIGHT, cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die dynamisch Instanzen von Klassen basierend auf einem übergebenen Klassennamen erzeugt. Dies könnte verwendet werden, um verschiedene Visualisierungs-Engines für einen 3D-Viewer zu laden.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE OBJECT TYPE (name) und eine Interface-Referenz.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_visualizer.
  METHODS display_data IMPORTING iv_data TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_visualizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_visualizer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_visualizer IMPLEMENTATION.

    " In a real scenario, this would display data in a 3D viewer
    WRITE: / 'Displaying data with Simple Visualizer:', iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factory_visualizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_visualizer
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE clike
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_visualizer) TYPE REF TO zif_visualizer
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factory_visualizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_visualizer.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_visualizer TYPE (iv_class_name).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_visualizer FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_visualizer FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_visualizer.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_factory_visualizer( ).
    DATA(lo_visualizer) = lo_factory->create_visualizer( 'ZCL_SIMPLE_VISUALIZER' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_visualizer is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'Visualizer object not created' ).
    lo_visualizer->display_data( 'Test Data' ). " Check if method can be called
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamische Objekterzeugung mittels CREATE OBJECT TYPE (name) ist ein Kernkonzept der dynamischen Programmierung und des Factory-Musters. Es ermöglicht, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Klasse instanziiert werden soll, was die Flexibilität von Anwendungen erheblich steigert. Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen verschiedene Implementierungen (z.B. für unterschiedliche 3D-Viewer-Technologien) je nach Konfiguration oder Benutzerwahl geladen werden müssen.
keywords: Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming, Factory Pattern, CREATE OBJECT, Interface, cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Quadratwurzel einer Zahl und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Verwenden Sie moderne mathematische Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die eingebaute Funktion SQRT und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculate_sqrt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_rounded_sqrt
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculate_sqrt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_rounded_sqrt.
    DATA(lv_sqrt_value) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    rv_result = |{ lv_sqrt_value COUNTRY = 'DE' DECIMALS = 2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_rounded_sqrt FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_rounded_sqrt_negative FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_rounded_sqrt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_sqrt( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->get_rounded_sqrt( 9 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '3,00' msg = 'SQRT of 9 incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_rounded_sqrt( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '1,41' msg = 'SQRT of 2 incorrect' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->get_rounded_sqrt( 16.81 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = '4,10' msg = 'SQRT of 16.81 incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_rounded_sqrt_negative.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculate_sqrt( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_rounded_sqrt( -4 ).
    " SQRT of negative number results in NaN, which might be represented as '0,00' or similar depending on system locale/settings
    " For simplicity, we assert it's not a valid positive number representation.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0,00' msg = 'SQRT of negative number should be 0,00 or similar' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP bietet eine Reihe von eingebauten mathematischen Funktionen wie SQRT, die direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden können. In Kombination mit String-Templates, die erweiterte Formatierungsoptionen (wie Dezimalstellen und länderspezifische Formate) bieten, lassen sich Berechnungen und deren Darstellung sehr elegant und effizient gestalten.
keywords: SQRT, Math, CALCULATE, String Templates, Formatting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine Hash-Tabelle umwandelt, wobei der Schlüssel aus CARRID und CONNID besteht. Dies ermöglicht einen schnellen Zugriff auf Flugdaten, was für interaktive 3D-Viewer-Anwendungen wichtig sein kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einer HASHED TABLE-Definition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_to_hash_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS get_sflight_hashed_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight_hashed) TYPE tt_sflight_hashed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_to_hash_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_hashed_table.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_sflight_hashed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                 ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_to_hash_table( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_sflight_hashed is_not_initial = abap_true msg = 'Hashed table is empty' ).

    " Try to read an entry from the hashed table
    DATA ls_sflight_entry TYPE sflight.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und die Aggregatfunktion SUM (oder REDUCE).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_pass TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_passengers) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                            FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                            NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-passengers ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                      total_pass = lv_total_passengers ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_passenger_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_passenger_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_passenger_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) > 0 ).

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_lh_summary) = lt_summary[ carrid = 'LH' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-total_pass > 0 ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " LH might not exist in test system, handle gracefully or skip assertion
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisung ermöglicht eine effiziente Gruppierung von Daten direkt in ABAP, ohne temporäre Tabellen oder komplexe Schleifenkonstrukte. In Kombination mit der REDUCE-Expression können Aggregationen wie Summen direkt innerhalb der Schleife berechnet werden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_flights_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_passenger_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_passengers TYPE i DEFAULT 200
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_passenger_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                              WHERE ( passengers > iv_min_passengers )
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die je nach Typ eines übergebenen Objekts unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Nutzen Sie CASE TYPE OF für Polymorphie und Downcasts.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * cl_abap_math=>pi( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shape
      IMPORTING io_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shape.
    CASE TYPE OF io_shape.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
        rv_description = |Kreis mit Radius { lo_circle->mv_radius } und Fläche { lo_circle->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN TYPE zcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
        rv_description = |Quadrat mit Seitenlänge { lo_square->mv_side } und Fläche { lo_square->zif_shape~get_area( ) }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannte Form'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_shape FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shape.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).

    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '10' ).
    DATA(lv_circle_desc) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_circle_desc exp = 'Kreis' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_circle_desc exp = 'Radius 10' ).

    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '5' ).
    DATA(lv_square_desc) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_square ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_square_desc exp = 'Quadrat' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_square_desc exp = 'Seitenlänge 5' ).

    DATA lo_unknown TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA(lv_unknown_desc) = lo_processor->process_shape( lo_unknown ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_unknown_desc exp = 'Unbekannte Form' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die CASE TYPE OF-Anweisung (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine typsichere und elegante Behandlung von Polymorphie. Sie erlaubt es, den tatsächlichen Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu prüfen und gleichzeitig einen Downcast in eine spezifischere Referenzvariable durchzuführen (INTO DATA(...)), was den Zugriff auf typspezifische Attribute und Methoden vereinfacht und IF TYPE OF-Kaskaden ersetzt.
keywords: CASE, TYPE OF, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Downcast

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine Tabelle und aktualisieren Sie einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung, wobei Sie Tabellenausdrücke verwenden, um einen Standardwert zu setzen, falls kein Eintrag gefunden wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie LOOP AT mit TABLE EXPRESSIONS und COND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_update_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_status
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_update_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_status) = COND string(
                               WHEN ls_flight-passengers > 300 THEN 'Full'
                               WHEN ls_flight-passengers > 100 THEN 'Partially Booked'
                               ELSE 'Available' ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_status( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid
                                     status = lv_status ) TO rt_updated_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE sflights_tab.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' passengers = 350 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' passengers = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '003' passengers = 50 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_update_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_status( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_updated ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_updated[ carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-status exp = 'Full' ).

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_updated[ carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '002' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-status exp = 'Partially Booked' ).

    DATA(ls_ua) = lt_updated[ carrid = 'UA' AND connid = '003' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua-status exp = 'Available' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die COND-Expression ist eine moderne und sehr flexible Alternative zu IF-ELSE-IF-Kaskaden, wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. In Kombination mit einer LOOP-Schleife ermöglicht sie die konditionale Zuweisung von Werten für jeden Eintrag einer internen Tabelle auf eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Weise.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, LOOP AT, Expression, Internal Tables

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob für jeden Flug in einer Haupttabelle ein entsprechender Eintrag in einer Nebentabelle existiert und markieren Sie diesen.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte LOOP AT und LINE_EXISTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_check_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_status,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             has_detail TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_with_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_details
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_status) TYPE tt_flight_with_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_sflight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " In a real scenario, this would be a different table or a subset
    " For demo, we use sflight itself as 'details' for simplicity
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_details.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_has_detail) = abap_false.
      IF line_exists( lt_sflight_details[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                          connid = ls_flight-connid
                                          fldate = ls_flight-fldate ] ).
        lv_has_detail = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_with_status( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                           connid = ls_flight-connid
                                           fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                           has_detail = lv_has_detail ) TO rt_flights_status.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_check_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_flight_details.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE sflights_tab.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights. " Non-existent

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_check_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_status) = lo_cut->check_flight_details( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_status ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_status[ carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-has_detail exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_status[ carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '9999' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-has_detail exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus LOOP AT und dem Tabellenausdruck mit LINE_EXISTS ermöglicht eine effiziente Prüfung der Existenz von Einträgen in einer anderen Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten LOOPs oder READ TABLE-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn nur die Existenz und nicht der Inhalt des Eintrags relevant ist.
keywords: LOOP AT, LINE_EXISTS, Table Expression, Internal Tables

solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = COUNT( GROUP ls_group_key ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                             flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_counts ) > 0 ).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie eine neue Tabelle erstellen, die nur bestimmte Felder enthält und dabei leere Felder mit einem Standardwert befüllt.
hint: Verwenden Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ) mit COND für die Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
             departure_city TYPE s_city,
             arrival_city TYPE s_city,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE sflights_tab
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                               ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connection_id = ls_flight-connid
                                 departure_city = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-cityfrom IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_flight-cityfrom ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
                                 arrival_city = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-cityto IS NOT INITIAL THEN ls_flight-cityto ELSE 'UNKNOWN' )
                                 status = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-cancelled = 'X' THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'SCHEDULED' ) )
                             ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE sflights_tab.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' cancelled = '' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = '' cityto = 'CHICAGO' cancelled = 'X' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh) = lt_transformed[ carrier_id = 'LH' AND connection_id = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-departure_city exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-arrival_city exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-status exp = 'SCHEDULED' ).

    DATA(ls_aa) = lt_transformed[ carrier_id = 'AA' AND connection_id = '0010' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-departure_city exp = 'UNKNOWN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-arrival_city exp = 'CHICAGO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-status exp = 'CANCELLED' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus VALUE-Konstruktor, FOR-Expression und verschachtelten COND-Expressionen ermöglicht eine sehr mächtige und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. Man kann in einer einzigen Anweisung eine neue Tabelle erstellen, Felder umbenennen, Werte bedingt zuweisen und Standardwerte für leere Felder setzen, was den Code extrem kompakt und wartbar macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Methode auf einem Objekt aus, dessen Typ zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist, und verarbeiten Sie das Ergebnis.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen (CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR) und dynamische Methodenaufrufe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_mtddescr,
          lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_table,
          ls_parameter TYPE cl_abap_methdescr=>parameter_descr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_descr( iv_method_name ).

        " Check if method has a returning parameter
        lt_parameters = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).
        READ TABLE lt_parameters INTO ls_parameter WITH KEY parameter_kind = cl_abap_methdescr=>ret_parameter.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING (ls_parameter-name) = rv_result.
        ELSE.
          CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name).
          rv_result = 'Method executed, no returning parameter'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial cx_sy_class_not_found cx_sy_struct_creation.
        rv_result = 'Error during dynamic call or object description'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for testing
CLASS zcl_test_dynamic_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS do_nothing.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_dynamic_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_text = 'Hello from dynamic method!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD do_nothing.
    " Does nothing
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_no_return FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'GET_GREETING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from dynamic method!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_no_return.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'DO_NOTHING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method executed, no returning parameter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_error.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_dynamic_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe in ABAP, oft in Verbindung mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), ermöglichen es, Methoden zur Laufzeit aufzurufen, deren Namen oder Parameter zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt sind. Dies ist entscheidend für Frameworks, Plugins oder generische Verarbeitungslogiken. Die Verwendung von CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR und TRY...CATCH für Fehlerbehandlung ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, Object Orientation, Reflection

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei einige Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator mit explizitem `MAPPING`.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder von einer internen Quelltabelle in eine interne Zieltabelle, wobei bestimmte Felder von der Kopieroperation ausgeschlossen werden sollen. Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... EXCEPT field1 field2 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_source_line,
           tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE i,
             created_by TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line,
           tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_table_except IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_table_except.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source EXCEPT status ).
    LOOP AT rt_target ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
      <fs_target>-created_by = sy-uname.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_table_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_table_except.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_except( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_except=>tt_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = 10 status = 'NEW' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = 20 status = 'OLD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table_except( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two lines should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'ID should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-name exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Name should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = 10 msg = 'Value should be copied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-created_by msg = 'Created_by should be initial before loop' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-created_by exp = sy-uname msg = 'Created_by should be set after loop' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING #` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel bietet eine präzise Kontrolle darüber, welche Felder beim Kopieren von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen ignoriert werden sollen. Dies ist effizienter und fehlerunanfälliger als das manuelle Zuweisen einzelner Felder und ersetzt komplexe `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` Anweisungen mit `EXCEPT` oder Schleifen mit manuellen Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Struktur mit vordefinierten Werten unter Verwendung des `VALUE #` Konstruktors.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( field1 = 'X' field2 = 'Y' )`.
solution:
