Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER #` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE field = value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
                                   IV_CITYFROM TYPE s_from_cit
                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_filter_table=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'LONDON' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'CHICAGO' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two flights from FRANKFURT expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered flight should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' msg = 'Second filtered flight should be 0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER #` Operator ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit von Schleifen mit `CHECK` oder `DELETE` Anweisungen und führt zu deutlich kürzerem und lesbarerem Code. Die gefilterten Daten werden direkt in eine neue Tabelle kopiert, was die Implizite `MOVE` Operation für die gefilterten Zeilen übernimmt.
keywords: FILTER, TABLE, CONDITION, Internal Table, MOVE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE #` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR <wa> IN itab NEXT sum = sum + <wa>-value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_total_sum = REDUCE i( INIT total = 0
                             FOR <fs_item> IN it_items
                             NEXT total = total + <fs_item>-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 60 msg = 'Sum should be 60' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_items( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE #` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulationslogik anwendet. Dies ersetzt manuelle Schleifen mit expliziten `MOVE` Operationen zur Akkumulation und ist wesentlich prägnanter und funktionaler.
keywords: REDUCE, TABLE, AGGREGATION, SUM, Functional Programming, MOVE

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen Zeitstempel von einer Zeitzone in eine andere unter Verwendung von `xco_cp_time`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `xco_cp_time=>from_timestamp()` und `convert_to_time_zone()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_timezone_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_timestamp_tz IMPORTING iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
                                           iv_source_tz TYPE timezone
                                           iv_target_tz TYPE timezone
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_converted_ts) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_timezone_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_timestamp_tz.
    rv_converted_ts = xco_cp_time=>from_timestamp( iv_timestamp )->convert_to_time_zone( iv_target_tz )->get_timestamp( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_convert_timestamp_tz FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_timestamp_tz.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_timezone_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp_utc) = '20251204100000.0000000'. " 10:00 AM UTC
    DATA(lv_source_tz) = 'UTC'.
    DATA(lv_target_tz_berlin) = 'CET'. " Central European Time (UTC+1)

    DATA(lv_converted_ts) = lo_cut->convert_timestamp_tz(
      iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp_utc
      iv_source_tz = lv_source_tz
      iv_target_tz = lv_target_tz_berlin
    ).

    " Expected: 10:00 AM UTC -> 11:00 AM CET
    DATA(lv_expected_ts) = '20251204110000.0000000'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_ts exp = lv_expected_ts msg = 'Timestamp should be converted to CET' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `xco_cp_time` API bietet umfassende Funktionen zur Zeitzonenkonvertierung, was in globalen Anwendungen unerlässlich ist. `from_timestamp()` erstellt ein Zeitobjekt aus einem Zeitstempel, `convert_to_time_zone()` führt die Konvertierung durch, und `get_timestamp()` liefert den konvertierten Wert. Dies ist eine robuste und standardisierte Methode, die komplexe manuelle Berechnungen und die damit verbundenen Fehlerquellen vermeidet.
keywords: xco_cp, TIMEZONE, CONVERSION, TIMESTAMP, DATE, TIME, MOVE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle filtern und die gefilterten Einträge in ein anderes Format transformieren. Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #`, `FOR`, `WHERE` und `CORRESPONDING #`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             text   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
             value  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source_data,
           tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             item_id     TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             calculated_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data,
           tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_data
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter.
    CONSTANTS: lc_tax_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.19'.

    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source WHERE ( active = abap_true )
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING item_id = id description = text )
                             calculated_value = ls_source-value * 10 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_and_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mix_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_mix_transform=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Active Item 1' active = abap_true value = 5 )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Inactive Item' active = abap_false value = 10 )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Active Item 2' active = abap_true value = 15 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_and_filter( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two active items expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 msg = 'First item ID should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Active Item 1' msg = 'First item description should be Active Item 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-calculated_value exp = 50 msg = 'First item calculated value should be 50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_id exp = 3 msg = 'Second item ID should be 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-calculated_value exp = 150 msg = 'Second item calculated value should be 150' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit der Kombination von Konstruktor-Ausdrücken. `VALUE #` wird verwendet, um die Zieltabelle zu erstellen. Innerhalb dessen iteriert eine `FOR` Schleife über die Quelltabelle, die durch eine `WHERE` Klausel gefiltert wird. Jede gefilterte Zeile wird dann mit `CORRESPONDING #` in das Zielformat kopiert und zusätzlich ein Feld berechnet. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen mit `IF` Bedingungen und manuellen `MOVE` Anweisungen und ist ein Paradebeispiel für modernes, funktionales ABAP.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, CORRESPONDING, TABLE, TRANSFORMATION, FILTER, MOVE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Daten unter Verwendung von `xco_cp_time`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `xco_cp_time=>from_date()` und `get_difference_in_days()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_date_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_difference IMPORTING iv_date1 TYPE d
                                          iv_date2 TYPE d
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_date_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_difference.
    DATA(lo_time1) = xco_cp_time=>from_date( iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lo_time2) = xco_cp_time=>from_date( iv_date2 ).
    rv_days = lo_time1->get_difference_in_days( lo_time2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_date_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_date_difference.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_date_diff( ).
    DATA(lv_date1) = '20251201'.
    DATA(lv_date2) = '20251206'.
    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->get_date_difference( iv_date1 = lv_date1 iv_date2 = lv_date2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 5 msg = 'Difference should be 5 days' ).

    DATA(lv_diff_negative) = lo_cut->get_date_difference( iv_date1 = lv_date2 iv_date2 = lv_date1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff_negative exp = -5 msg = 'Difference should be -5 days' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `xco_cp_time` API vereinfacht die Berechnung von Datumsdifferenzen erheblich. Anstatt manuell mit Datumsfeldern zu rechnen, werden Zeitobjekte erstellt und die Methode `get_difference_in_days()` verwendet. Dies ist eine saubere und fehlerresistente Methode, die die Notwendigkeit von expliziten `MOVE` Operationen für Zwischenergebnisse eliminiert.
keywords: xco_cp, DATE, DIFFERENCE, DAYS, Calculation, MOVE

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere durch, wobei Sie den `CORRESPONDING #` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR` Schleife verwenden, um zusätzliche Logik pro Zeile anzuwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( CORRESPONDING #( ... ) ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_source_item,
           tt_source_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             item_id     TYPE i,
             item_name   TYPE string,
             net_price   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
             gross_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_target_item,
           tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_items IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_items
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_items.
    CONSTANTS: lc_tax_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.19'.

    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING item_id = id item_name = name net_price = price )
                             gross_price = ls_source-price * ( 1 + lc_tax_rate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_items FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_for_loop=>tt_source_items(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Product A' price = '100.00' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Product B' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_items( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two items expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 msg = 'First item ID should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-net_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'First item net price should be 100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-gross_price exp = '119.00' msg = 'First item gross price should be 119.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-item_id exp = 2 msg = 'Second item ID should be 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-gross_price exp = '238.00' msg = 'Second item gross price should be 238.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die `FOR` Schleife innerhalb des `VALUE #` Konstruktors ermöglicht die Iteration über die Quelltabelle. Für jeden Eintrag wird `CORRESPONDING #` verwendet, um die passenden Felder zu kopieren, und zusätzlich können weitere Felder direkt berechnet oder zugewiesen werden. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und kompakte Art, komplexe Transformationen durchzuführen, die früher mehrere Schleifen und explizite `MOVE` Anweisungen erfordert hätten.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, FOR, VALUE, TABLE, TRANSFORMATION, Calculation, MOVE

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String von der aktuellen System-Codepage nach UTF-8 und zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    METHODS convert_from_utf8
      IMPORTING
        iv_utf8_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_original_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'UTF-8' ).
    rv_utf8_xstring = lo_codepage->convert_to( iv_input_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_from_utf8.
    DATA(lo_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>create_by_external_name( 'UTF-8' ).
    rv_original_string = lo_codepage->convert_from( iv_utf8_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_utf8_conversion FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lv_original) = 'Hallo Welt äöüß'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_to_utf8( lv_original ).
    DATA(lv_converted_back) = lo_converter->convert_from_utf8( lv_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_back exp = lv_original msg = 'UTF-8 conversion failed' ).

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE` bietet eine moderne und typsichere Möglichkeit, Strings zwischen verschiedenen Codepages zu konvertieren, anstatt ältere Funktionsbausteine zu verwenden. Die `CREATE_BY_EXTERNAL_NAME` Methode erstellt eine Instanz für die gewünschte Codepage.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, UTF-8, String Conversion, XSTRING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `sflights` enthält, bei denen die maximale Kapazität größer als 300 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_capacity_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_capacity_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( seatsmax > 300 )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid
                            connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflights_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_large_capacity_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) > 0 msg = 'Expected at least one flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    SELECT seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_seats).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR flight IN lt_sflights_seats
                               NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_seats( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total seats should not be zero if sflights has data' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total > 0 msg = 'Expected a positive sum of seats' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen oder anderen Iterationen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatorvariablen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights`, um nur Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines) zu erhalten, die mehr als 200 Sitzplätze haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND seatsmax > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_new_syntax DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid

  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

    METHODS test_open_sql_syntax FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_open_sql_syntax.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_open_sql_new_syntax( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_reader->get_flight_details( lv_carrid ).

Dies führt zu kürzerem, lesbarerem und typsichererem Code, da keine expliziten `DATA` Deklarationen vor dem `SELECT` notwendig sind.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Host Variable, SELECT, SFlight

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run Time Type Information), um den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und dessen Komponenten aufzulisten.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und ihre Unterklassen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_data_object
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_data_object.
    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lo_descr->kind = lo_descr->kind_struct.
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_descr ).
      rt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_rtti_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_rtti_struct.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            field_a TYPE string,
            field_b TYPE i,
          END OF ls_test_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ls_test_data TO <fs_data>.

    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_rtti_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_analyzer->analyze_data_object( REF #( <fs_data> ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 components' ).
    READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp-name exp = 'FIELD_A' msg = 'Component name mismatch' ).
    READ TABLE lt_components INTO ls_comp INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp-name exp = 'FIELD_B' msg = 'Component name mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen und -objekten zur Laufzeit. Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und ihre Unterklassen bieten Methoden, um detaillierte Informationen über Strukturen, Tabellen, elementare Typen usw. zu erhalten. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programmieransätze und dynamische Verarbeitungen.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, Type Information, Dynamic Programming, Structure

CLASS zcl_gzip_string_compress DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_and_decompress
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_gzip_string_compress IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).
    rv_output_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) in ein GZIP-Format und dekomprimiere ihn anschließend wieder in eine identische Tabelle. Verwenden Sie XML-Transformation für die Serialisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_xml_helper` für die XML-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung und `cl_abap_gzip` für die Kompression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_xml_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert(
      EXPORTING
        data = cl_abap_xml_helper=>table_to_xml( it_input_table )
    ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xml_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_xml_string) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).
    cl_abap_xml_helper=>xml_to_table(
      EXPORTING
        iv_xml = lv_xml_string
      IMPORTING
        et_table = rt_output_table
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_table_xml( ).
    DATA lt_original_sflight TYPE zcl_gzip_table_xml=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_original_sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_result_sflight) = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress_table( lt_original_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_sflight ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflight ) msg = 'Anzahl der Zeilen sollte übereinstimmen.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_sflight exp = lt_original_sflight msg = 'Dekomprimierte Tabelle sollte dem Original entsprechen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle komprimiert. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mittels `cl_abap_xml_helper` in einen XML-String serialisiert, dann in `XSTRING` konvertiert, komprimiert und der Prozess umgekehrt. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um strukturierte Daten zu speichern oder zu übertragen.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Internal Table, XML, Serialization, cl_abap_xml_helper

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Versuch, ein absichtlich korrumpiertes GZIP-XSTRING zu dekomprimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahme `cx_sy_compression_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_corrupted_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_corrupted_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_corrupted_data.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( iv_corrupted_xstring ).
        rv_success = abap_true. " Should not be reached
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error.
        rv_success = abap_false. " Expected behavior
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corrupted_decompression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corrupted_decompression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( `Valid data` ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_valid_xstring ).

    " Corrupt the compressed data
    DATA(lv_corrupted_xstring) = lv_compressed_xstring.
    lv_corrupted_xstring+0(1) = 'FF'X. " Change first byte

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->decompress_corrupted_data( lv_corrupted_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Dekomprimierung von korrupten Daten sollte fehlschlagen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die robuste Fehlerbehandlung beim Dekomprimieren von Daten. Wenn das Eingabe-XSTRING kein gültiges GZIP-Format hat oder korrupt ist, löst `cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring` eine Ausnahme vom Typ `cx_sy_compression_error` aus, die hier abgefangen wird.
keywords: GZIP, Error Handling, Exception, cx_sy_compression_error, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Komprimiere eine ABAP-Struktur in ein GZIP-Format und dekomprimiere sie wieder. Verwenden Sie JSON-Transformation für die Serialisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/ui2/cl_json` für die JSON-Serialisierung/Deserialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_struct_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS compress_and_decompress_struct
      IMPORTING
        is_input_struct TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_output_struct) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_struct_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_struct.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = is_input_struct pretty_name = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( lv_json_string ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    DATA(lv_json_output) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).
    /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = lv_json_output CHANGING data = rs_output_struct ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_struct_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_struct_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_struct_json( ).
    DATA ls_original_data TYPE zcl_gzip_struct_json=>ty_flight_data.
    ls_original_data = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '123.45' ).

    DATA(ls_result_data) = lo_cut->compress_and_decompress_struct( ls_original_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_data-carrid exp = ls_original_data-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_data-connid exp = ls_original_data-connid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_data-price exp = ls_original_data-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die JSON-Serialisierung (`/ui2/cl_json`) um eine ABAP-Struktur in einen String zu wandeln, der dann komprimiert wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Kommunikation mit externen Systemen oder Web-APIs, die JSON verwenden.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Structure, JSON, Serialization, /ui2/cl_json

Instructions: Komprimiere einen String und berechne das Kompressionsverhältnis (Originalgröße vs. komprimierte Größe).
hint: Verwenden Sie `xstrlen` für die Größe von XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_compression_ratio
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ratio) TYPE f. " Float for ratio

    METHODS get_compressed_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_original_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_ratio IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_original_size.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_input_string ).
    rv_size = xstrlen( lv_xstring_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_compressed_size.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    rv_size = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_compression_ratio.
    DATA(lv_original_size) = get_original_size( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_size) = get_compressed_size( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_original_size > 0.
      rv_ratio = lv_compressed_size / lv_original_size.
    ELSE.
      rv_ratio = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere einen String, Base64-kodieren Sie das Ergebnis und dekodieren Sie es anschließend wieder, bevor Sie es dekomprimieren. Dies ist nützlich, um binäre GZIP-Daten in Textfeldern zu übertragen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_utility=>encode_base64` und `cl_http_utility=>decode_base64`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_base64_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_base64_decompress
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_base64_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_base64_decompress.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).

    " Base64 encode
    DATA(lv_base64_string) = cl_http_utility=>encode_base64( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    " Base64 decode
    DATA(lv_decoded_xstring) = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( lv_base64_string ).

    " Decompress
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_decoded_xstring ).
    rv_output_string = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_decoder( )->convert( lv_decompressed_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Komprimiere eine große interne Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) in ein GZIP-Format und dekomprimiere sie anschließend wieder in eine identische Tabelle. Verwenden Sie die binäre Serialisierung (`cl_abap_expimp_utilities`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_expimp_utilities=>export_to_xstring` und `cl_abap_expimp_utilities=>import_from_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table_binary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_gzip_table_binary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_and_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_binary_xstring) = cl_abap_expimp_utilities=>export_to_xstring( it_input_table ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_binary_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_expimp_utilities=>import_from_xstring(
      EXPORTING
        iv_xstring = lv_decompressed_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ev_data    = rt_output_table
    ).

ENDCLASS.

Die komprimierten Daten können dann z.B. in einem `RAWSTRING`-Feld in der Datenbank gespeichert werden.

Instructions: Komprimiere einen sehr langen String und demonstrieren Sie, wie man (falls verfügbar) verschiedene Kompressionsstufen nutzen könnte, um die Balance zwischen Kompressionsrate und Geschwindigkeit zu steuern. (Hinweis: `cl_abap_gzip` bietet keine direkte Steuerung der Kompressionsstufe, aber das Konzept kann simuliert werden, indem man die Auswirkungen auf die Größe zeigt).
hint: `cl_abap_gzip` hat keine direkte Level-Steuerung. Fokus auf die Messung der Kompressionsrate für große Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_levels DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_compression_result,
             original_size   TYPE i,
             compressed_size TYPE i,
             compression_ratio TYPE f,
           END OF ty_compression_result.

    METHODS get_compression_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_info) TYPE ty_compression_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compression_levels IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_compression_info.
    DATA(lv_xstring_input) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( iv_input_string ).
    rs_info-original_size = xstrlen( lv_xstring_input ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_xstring( lv_xstring_input ).
    rs_info-compressed_size = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    IF rs_info-original_size > 0.
      rs_info-compression_ratio = rs_info-compressed_size / rs_info-original_size.
    ELSE.
      rs_info-compression_ratio = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compression_levels FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compression_levels.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_compression_levels( ).
    DATA(lv_long_string) = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.`.
    DO 10 TIMES.
      CONCATENATE lv_long_string lv_long_string INTO lv_long_string.
    ENDDO. " Make it very long

    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_compression_info( lv_long_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less( act = ls_info-compression_ratio exp = 1.0 msg = 'Sehr langer String sollte stark komprimiert werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_info-original_size exp = 0 msg = 'Originalgröße sollte nicht 0 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_info-compressed_size exp = 0 msg = 'Komprimierte Größe sollte nicht 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Obwohl `cl_abap_gzip` keine expliziten Kompressionsstufen bietet, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man die Effektivität der Kompression für große Datenmengen misst. Es unterstreicht die Bedeutung der Kompressionsrate für die Optimierung von Speicher und Bandbreite.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Large Data, Performance, Compression Ratio

CLASS zcl_sflights_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype

Instructions: Lesen Sie die nächsten 5 Flüge (Seite 2) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, nach Flugdatum und Uhrzeit sortiert, beginnend nach den ersten 5 Einträgen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie ORDER BY, OFFSET und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_offset_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_page_of_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_offset         TYPE i
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_offset_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_page_of_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING, fltime ASCENDING
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      OFFSET @iv_offset ROWS
      FETCH NEXT @iv_number_of_rows ROWS ONLY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_page_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_page_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_offset_pagination( ).
    " Annahme: Es gibt mindestens 10 Flüge in SFLIGHTS für einen aussagekräftigen Test
    DATA(lt_first_page) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( iv_offset = 0 iv_number_of_rows = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_second_page) = lo_cut->get_page_of_flights( iv_offset = 5 iv_number_of_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_first_page ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_second_page ) exp = 5 ).
    " Überprüfen, ob der erste Flug der zweiten Seite sich von den Flügen der ersten Seite unterscheidet
    IF lines( lt_first_page ) > 0 AND lines( lt_second_page ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_first_page[1] exp = lt_second_page[1] ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von OFFSET und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY ermöglicht eine effiziente serverseitige Paginierung großer Datenmengen, ohne alle Daten in den Anwendungsserver zu laden.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, OFFSET, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Pagination

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge in SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie GROUP BY, COUNT(*), ORDER BY und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_carriers
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_agg_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY flight_count DESCENDING
      INTO TABLE @rt_carrier_counts
      FETCH NEXT @iv_number_of_rows ROWS ONLY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_agg_pagination( ).
    DATA(lt_top_carriers) = lo_cut->get_top_n_carriers( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top_carriers ) exp = 2 ).
    " Weitere Assertions könnten überprüfen, ob die Top-Carrier wie erwartet sind,
    " dies hängt jedoch von den SFLIGHTS-Daten ab.
    IF lines( lt_top_carriers ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_top_carriers[1]-carrid IS INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_top_carriers[1]-flight_count IS INITIAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: GROUP BY in Kombination mit FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY ermöglicht das effiziente Abrufen aggregierter Top-N-Ergebnisse direkt aus der Datenbank.

hint: Verwenden Sie CLIENT SPECIFIED und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_client_pagination DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             mandt    TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_client_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_of_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_client_pagination IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_client_flights.
    SELECT mandt, carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight CLIENT SPECIFIED
      WHERE mandt = @sy-mandt
      ORDER BY fldate ASCENDING
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      FETCH NEXT @iv_number_of_rows ROWS ONLY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_client_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_client_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_client_pagination( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_first_n_client_flights( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[1]-mandt exp = sy-mandt ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CLIENT SPECIFIED in Kombination mit WHERE mandt = @sy-mandt und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY ermöglicht mandantenabhängige Paginierung, was in vielen SAP-Szenarien wichtig ist.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, CLIENT SPECIFIED, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Mandant

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Theme-Eigenschaften, um nur die aktiven Eigenschaften zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_theme_property,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_theme_property.
    TYPES tt_theme_properties TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_property WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_active_properties
      IMPORTING
        it_all_properties TYPE tt_theme_properties
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_properties) TYPE tt_theme_properties.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_active_properties.
    rt_active_properties = FILTER #( it_all_properties WHERE is_active = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_properties FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_properties.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_ui5_theme_filter=>tt_theme_properties.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color1' value = 'Red' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color2' value = 'Blue' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color3' value = 'Green' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui5_theme_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_active_properties( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[1]-name exp = 'Color1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[2]-name exp = 'Color3' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und effizienter macht als traditionelle LOOP ... WHERE ... DELETE Konstrukte.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, UI5 Theming, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Zählen Sie die Anzahl der aktiven Theme-Eigenschaften in einer Liste.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die aktiven Eigenschaften zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_theme_property,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
             is_active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_theme_property.
    TYPES tt_theme_properties TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_property WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_active_properties
      IMPORTING
        it_all_properties TYPE tt_theme_properties
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_active_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_active_properties.
    rv_active_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                FOR property IN it_all_properties
                                WHERE ( property-is_active = abap_true )
                                NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_properties FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_properties.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_ui5_theme_reduce=>tt_theme_properties.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color1' value = 'Red' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color2' value = 'Blue' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color3' value = 'Green' is_active = abap_true ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'Color4' value = 'Yellow' is_active = abap_false ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui5_theme_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_active_properties( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen, ausdrucksstarken Weise, die oft kompakter und effizienter ist als explizite Schleifen mit Zwischenvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, UI5 Theming

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Liste von Theme-IDs in eine interne Tabelle mit einer zusätzlichen Statusinformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression, um die Transformation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_theme_id TYPE string.
    TYPES tt_theme_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_theme,
             id     TYPE ty_theme_id,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_theme.
    TYPES tt_transformed_themes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_theme WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_theme_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_theme_ids TYPE tt_theme_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_themes) TYPE tt_transformed_themes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_theme_ids.
    rt_transformed_themes = VALUE #( FOR theme_id IN it_theme_ids
                                     ( id = theme_id
                                       status = COND string( WHEN theme_id CP 'sap_fiori*' THEN 'Standard' ELSE 'Custom' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_themes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_themes.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_ui5_theme_for_transform=>tt_theme_ids.
    APPEND 'sap_fiori_3' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'my_custom_theme' TO lt_input.
    APPEND 'sap_fiori_dark' TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui5_theme_for_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_theme_ids( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[1]-status exp = 'Standard' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[2]-status exp = 'Custom' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: FOR-Expressions ermöglichen die deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen, indem sie eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den Elementen einer Quelltabelle erstellen. Dies ist sehr effizient und lesbar für Mapping-Szenarien.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, UI5 Theming, COND

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie eine hypothetische UI5-Theme-Utility-Klasse und rufen Sie eine Methode auf, um eine Theme-Eigenschaft abzurufen.

solution:

keywords: NEW, Object Orientation, UI5 Theming, Class, Interface

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter verschiedene Implementierungen einer Theme-Strategie zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den NEW-Operator mit einem Typnamen und einer CASE-Anweisung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_theme_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_theme_settings
      IMPORTING
        io_theme_data TYPE REF TO object.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_light_theme_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_theme_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_light_theme_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_theme_strategy~apply_theme_settings.
    " Implementierung für helles Theme
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dark_theme_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_theme_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dark_theme_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_theme_strategy~apply_theme_settings.
    " Implementierung für dunkles Theme
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_theme_strategy_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_strategy
      IMPORTING
        iv_theme_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_strategy) TYPE REF TO zif_theme_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_theme_strategy_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_strategy.
    CASE iv_theme_type.
      WHEN 'LIGHT'.
        ro_strategy = NEW zcl_light_theme_strategy( ).
      WHEN 'DARK'.
        ro_strategy = NEW zcl_dark_theme_strategy( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Standardstrategie oder Fehlerbehandlung
        ro_strategy = NEW zcl_light_theme_strategy( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_strategy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_strategy.
    DATA(lo_light_strategy) = zcl_theme_strategy_factory=>get_strategy( 'LIGHT' ).
    DATA(lo_dark_strategy) = zcl_theme_strategy_factory=>get_strategy( 'DARK' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_light_strategy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_dark_strategy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_light_strategy IS INSTANCE OF zcl_light_theme_strategy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_dark_strategy IS INSTANCE OF zcl_dark_theme_strategy ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Factory-Methoden in Kombination mit Interfaces und dem NEW-Operator ermöglichen die flexible Erstellung von Objekten, ohne die konkrete Implementierung direkt im aufrufenden Code zu kennen. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und erleichtert die Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: NEW, Factory Method, Interface, Object Orientation, UI5 Theming

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer UI5-Theme-Utility-Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie dynamische Methodenaufrufe mit dem Operator `=>` oder `->` und dem Namen in Klammern.
solution:
CLASS zif_ui5_theme_util_dyn DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_theme_version RETURNING VALUE(rv_version) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_active_theme  RETURNING VALUE(rv_theme) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_util_dyn_mock DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_ui5_theme_util_dyn.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_theme_util_dyn_mock IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_ui5_theme_util_dyn~get_theme_version.
    rv_version = '1.108.0'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_ui5_theme_util_dyn~get_active_theme.
    rv_theme = 'sap_fiori_3_dark'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_theme_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_theme_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lo_theme_util) = NEW zcl_ui5_theme_util_dyn_mock( ).
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_theme_util->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'ERROR: Method not found or call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_theme_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_version) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'ZIF_UI5_THEME_UTIL_DYN~GET_THEME_VERSION' ).
    DATA(lv_theme) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'ZIF_UI5_THEME_UTIL_DYN~GET_ACTIVE_THEME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_version exp = '1.108.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_theme exp = 'sap_fiori_3_dark' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_theme_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ERROR: Method not found or call failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe ermöglichen es, den Namen einer aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Frameworks oder wenn die Methode basierend auf Konfigurationen variieren kann. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, UI5 Theming, Object Orientation, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Inline-Deklaration einer internen Tabelle durch und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS, wobei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_table_declaration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_table_declaration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_for_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_for_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_table_declaration( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_lh_flights ).
    IF lines( lt_lh_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_lh_flights[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_for_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_inline_table_declaration( ).
    DATA(lt_non_existent_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_non_existent_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration von Datenobjekten mit DATA(...) direkt im SELECT-Statement vereinfacht den Code, da keine separate Deklaration der internen Tabelle mehr notwendig ist. Dies ist ein Merkmal von ABAP 7.40+.
keywords: DATA, Inline Declaration, SELECT, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte interne Tabelle für Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 10 Einträgen. Demonstrieren Sie den Zugriff auf einen Eintrag mittels Schlüssel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ...` und `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted_key.

    METHODS get_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` und `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count_sorted(
      FOR GROUPS <group_key> OF <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights GROUP BY <fs_sflight>-carrid
      (
        carrid = <group_key>,
        count  = GROUP SIZE
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_flight_counts IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( msg = 'Result table should have entries' act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(ls_count) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>ty_flight_count( carrid = 'LH' ).
    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO ls_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( msg = 'LH should have flights' act = ls_count-count exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die leistungsstarke `FOR GROUPS ... GROUP BY` Syntax, um Daten aus einer sortierten Tabelle effizient zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. `VALUE #` ermöglicht die direkte Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR GROUPS, GROUP BY, VALUE #, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus den `SFLIGHTS` Daten, die in einer sortierten Tabelle gespeichert sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT total = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
                               NEXT total = total + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equals( msg = 'Total price should be non-negative' act = lv_total_price exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total price should not be initial' act = lv_total_price IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Summe der Flugpreise berechnet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( lv_test_carrid ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier ID should match filter' act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = lv_test_carrid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_filter=>tt_sflight_sorted(

    IF line_exists( lt_all_flights[ carrid = lv_test_carrid ] ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Filtered table should not be initial' act = lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_docking_alv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_docking_alv IMPLEMENTATION.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING

        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 500.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_docking_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency

          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      ).
      mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( i_ready_for_input = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
