Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer sortierten Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) existiert und geben Sie den Preis zurück, falls ja, ansonsten 0.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_cond.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rv_price = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ] )
                       THEN lt_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid fldate = iv_fldate ]-price
                       ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_price_cond( 'LH', '0400', sy-datum ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_cond(
                         iv_carrid = ls_first_flight-carrid
                         iv_connid = ls_first_flight-connid
                         iv_fldate = ls_first_flight-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Price should be found' act = lv_price exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_cond( 'XX', '9999', '19000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be 0 for non-existent flight' act = lv_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung. In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` kann effizient geprüft werden, ob ein Eintrag in einer sortierten Tabelle existiert, und basierend darauf ein Wert zurückgegeben werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, COND, LINE_EXISTS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) kopieren und dabei die Preise um 10% erhöhen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE #` und `CORRESPONDING #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS increase_prices
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights_increased) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    DATA(lt_original_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_flights_increased = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_original_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight EXCEPT price ) price = ls_flight-price * '1.1' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for_map( ).
    DATA(lt_increased_flights) = lo_cut->increase_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_increased_flights IS INITIAL ).
    IF lines( lt_increased_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_original) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_for_map=>ty_sflight(
        ( SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS )
      ).
      DATA(ls_first_increased) = lt_increased_flights[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price should be increased' act = ls_first_increased-price exp = ls_first_original-price * '1.1' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE #` und `CORRESPONDING #` ermöglicht die elegante Transformation von Daten aus einer internen Tabelle in eine neue. Hier wird jeder Flugpreis um 10% erhöht.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, VALUE #, CORRESPONDING #, Data Transformation

Instructions: Fügen Sie Einträge aus einer Standardtabelle in eine sortierte Tabelle ein und stellen Sie sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge (basierend auf dem Schlüssel) entstehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ...` mit einer sortierten Tabelle, die einen `UNIQUE KEY` hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS merge_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard
      CHANGING
        ct_existing_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_flights.
    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE ct_existing_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_merge_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_merge_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_insert( ).

    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251201' price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_insert=>tt_sflight_standard(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = 100 ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251202' price = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_merged_flights) = lt_initial_flights.
    lo_cut->merge_flights( EXPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new_flights CHANGING ct_existing_flights = lt_merged_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 unique entries' act = lines( lt_merged_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'BA flight should exist' act = lt_merged_flights[ carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251202' ] IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Einfügen von Zeilen in eine `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` werden Duplikate automatisch ignoriert, was eine effiziente Möglichkeit zur Zusammenführung von Daten ohne manuelle Duplikatsprüfung bietet.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, INSERT LINES OF, UNIQUE KEY, Duplicates

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten und demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `TABLE_LINE` in einem `LOOP`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und greifen Sie auf `TABLE_LINE` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_table_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_info_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_table_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_string.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight UP TO 3 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      rv_info = rv_info && |{ <fs_line>-carrid }-{ <fs_line>-connid }-{ <fs_line>-fldate } ({ <fs_line>-price } EUR); |.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_info_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_info_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_table_line( ).
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->get_flight_info_string( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Info string should not be empty' act = lv_info IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Info string should contain LH' act = lv_info exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` in einem `LOOP` ist die performanteste Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten. `TABLE_LINE` ist der implizite Name des Field-Symbols, wenn es nicht explizit benannt wird, und kann für generische Zugriffe verwendet werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LOOP AT, FIELD-SYMBOL, TABLE_LINE, String Templates

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das Beispiel des `cl_gui_docking_container` mit ALV-Grid, um auf ein Doppelklick-Ereignis im ALV zu reagieren und eine Meldung anzuzeigen.
hint: Registrieren Sie eine lokale Klasse als Event-Handler für das `DOUBLE_CLICK` Ereignis des `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_docking_alv_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE sy-repid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sy-dynnr.

    METHODS display_sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS ltcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR LOCAL TYPES.
    DATA mo_event_handler TYPE REF TO ltcl_event_handler.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_alv_event IMPLEMENTATION.

  CLASS ltcl_event_handler DEFINITION.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      METHODS on_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
        IMPORTING
          e_row
          e_column.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS ltcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD on_double_click.
      MESSAGE |Doppelklick auf Zeile { e_row }-INDEX, Spalte { e_column }-FIELDNAME!| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.

  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid     = iv_repid
        dynnr     = iv_dynnr
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 500.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_docking_container.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->on_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      ).
      mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input( i_ready_for_input = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lv_repid) = sy-repid.
    DATA(lv_dynnr) = '1000'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_docking_alv_event( iv_repid = lv_repid iv_dynnr = lv_dynnr ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Event handler should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->mo_event_handler ).
    " Direct testing of event firing is complex and usually requires UI automation tools.
    " This test ensures the handler is set up.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die ereignisgesteuerte Programmierung im ABAP GUI. Eine lokale Event-Handler-Klasse wird definiert und für das `DOUBLE_CLICK`-Ereignis des ALV-Grids registriert, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen zu reagieren.
keywords: cl_gui_docking_container, cl_gui_alv_grid, Events, SET HANDLER, Object Orientation, GUI

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten und verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `LET` um temporäre Variablen innerhalb der Schleife zu definieren und zu nutzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             adjusted_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_adjusted_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_for_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_adjusted_flight_summary.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_sorted(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( <fs_sflight> )
    ).

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      LET lv_adjusted_price = ls_flight-price * '1.05' IN
      ( flight_key = |{ ls_flight-carrid }-{ ls_flight-connid }|,
        adjusted_price = lv_adjusted_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_adjusted_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_adjusted_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_for_let( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_adjusted_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Summary table should not be initial' act = lt_summary IS INITIAL ).
    IF lines( lt_summary ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_summary) = lt_summary[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Adjusted price should not be zero' act = ls_first_summary-adjusted_price exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Flight key should contain hyphen' act = ls_first_summary-flight_key exp = '-' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LET` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `FOR`-Iterators ermöglicht die Definition von lokalen, temporären Variablen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Strukturierung komplexer Transformationen, indem Zwischenergebnisse benannt werden können.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, LET, VALUE #, String Templates, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_docking_container` und betten Sie einen `cl_gui_html_viewer` ein, um dynamischen HTML-Inhalt anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_html_viewer->load_data` oder `load_data_from_url`.

CLASS zcl_docking_html_viewer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100 (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM=>CREATE` und `GET_NEXT` mit `IV_MIN` und `IV_MAX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_int_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_int_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_number.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    rv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_random) = lo_cut->get_random_number( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` und eine Schleife mit `SWAP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    rt_shuffled_table = it_input.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( rt_shuffled_table ).
    IF lv_lines <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DO lv_lines - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index - 1. " 0-based index
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = lv_current_index iv_max = lv_lines - 1 ).
      SWAP rt_shuffled_table[ lv_current_index + 1 ] WITH rt_shuffled_table[ lv_random_index + 1 ].
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_original ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_orig>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_shuffled[ table_line = <fs_orig> ] ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode verwendet den Fisher-Yates-Algorithmus, um die Tabelle effizient zu mischen. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` liefert die notwendigen Zufallsindizes. Die `SWAP` Anweisung ist eine moderne Art, Elemente in internen Tabellen zu tauschen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, Interne Tabelle, Shuffle, SWAP, Fisher-Yates

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Flug aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus.
hint: Lesen Sie alle Flüge in eine interne Tabelle und wählen Sie dann einen zufälligen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_gds_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_flight_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_flights IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_gds_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( lt_flights ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_lines - 1 ). " 0-based index

    rs_flight = lt_flights[ lv_random_index + 1 ]. " 1-based access
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights RAISING cx_sy_no_gds_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight should not be initial' act = ls_flight IS INITIAL exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_flight_selector( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_flight( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'cx_sy_no_gds_found was not raised (SFLIGHTS not empty)' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_no_gds_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'cx_sy_no_gds_found correctly raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode liest alle Flüge mit einer modernen `FOR` Expression in eine interne Tabelle. Anschließend wird mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` ein zufälliger Index generiert, um einen Flug auszuwählen. Die `RAISING` Klausel für Ausnahmen ist ebenfalls modern.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, SFLIGHTS, FOR, SELECT, Interne Tabelle, Zufallsauswahl

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT` mit einem privaten Konstruktor. Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY`, die Instanzen von `ZCL_PRODUCT` erzeugen kann, indem sie als `FRIENDS` deklariert wird.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Konstruktor von `ZCL_PRODUCT` als `PRIVATE` und fügen Sie `FRIENDS ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` zur Definition von `ZCL_PRODUCT` hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PRIVATE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_product_factory. " Grant access to private constructor
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    ro_product = NEW zcl_product( iv_name = iv_name ). " Can call private constructor
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_factory) = NEW zcl_product_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_product) = lo_factory->create_product( 'Test Product' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_product ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Test Product' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration in `ZCL_PRODUCT` erlaubt der `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY` den Zugriff auf den privaten Konstruktor. Dies ist ein gängiges Entwurfsmuster (Factory-Muster), um die Objekterzeugung zu kontrollieren und die Kapselung zu wahren.
keywords: FRIENDS, Factory Pattern, Objektorientierung, Kapselung, CREATE PRIVATE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_CALCULATOR` mit einer privaten Methode `_add_internal`. Schreiben Sie einen ABAP Unit Test, der diese private Methode direkt testet, indem die Testklasse als `FRIENDS` deklariert wird.
hint: Fügen Sie `FRIENDS LTCL_TEST` zur Definition von `ZCL_CALCULATOR` hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _add_internal IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    FRIENDS ltcl_test. " Grant access to private components for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_result = _add_internal( iv_a = iv_a iv_b = iv_b ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD _add_internal.
    rv_sum = iv_a + iv_b.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_internal FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_internal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->_add_internal( iv_a = 5 iv_b = 3 ). " Direct access via FRIENDS

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht es der Testklasse `LTCL_TEST`, auf die private Methode `_add_internal` zuzugreifen. Dies ist nützlich für White-Box-Tests, bei denen interne Logik direkt überprüft werden muss, ohne die öffentliche Schnittstelle zu verwenden.
keywords: FRIENDS, Unit Test, Private Methode, White-Box Testing, Objektorientierung

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String einer bestimmten Länge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` und eine Schleife, um Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_charset_len) = strlen( gc_charset ).
    DATA(lv_char_index)  TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_char)        TYPE c LENGTH 1.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      lv_char_index = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_charset_len - 1 ).
      lv_char = gc_charset+lv_char_index(1).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lv_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_string_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_string_content FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_string_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = lo_cut->get_random_string( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_string ) exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_string_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_string) = lo_cut->get_random_string( 50 ).
    DATA(lv_valid) = abap_true.
    LOOP AT lv_string INTO DATA(lc_char).
      IF find( val = zcl_random_string_generator=>gc_charset sub = lc_char ) IS INITIAL.
        lv_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_valid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode iteriert über die gewünschte Länge und wählt in jedem Schritt ein zufälliges Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` sorgt für die Zufälligkeit, und String-Templates (`&&`) werden für die effiziente String-Verkettung verwendet.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, String, Zufallsstring, String-Templates, strlen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER` mit einem privaten Attribut, das nur über eine `FRIENDS` Klasse `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR` gelesen und modifiziert werden kann.
hint: Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR` als `FRIENDS` in `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_data RETURNING VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_secret_data TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Secret'.
    FRIENDS zcl_data_processor. " Grant access to private components
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_data.
    rv_data = 'Public Data'. " Only public data is exposed
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_secret_data
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO zcl_data_container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
    METHODS modify_secret_data
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO zcl_data_container
        iv_new_secret TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_secret_data.
    rv_secret = io_container->mv_secret_data. " Access private attribute
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD modify_secret_data.
    io_container->mv_secret_data = iv_new_secret. " Modify private attribute
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friends_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friends_access.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW zcl_data_container( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->read_secret_data( lo_container ) exp = 'Initial Secret' ).

    lo_processor->modify_secret_data( io_container = lo_container iv_new_secret = 'New Secret Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->read_secret_data( lo_container ) exp = 'New Secret Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_container->get_public_data( ) exp = 'Public Data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie `FRIENDS` verwendet werden kann, um eine kontrollierte "Backdoor" zu privaten Attributen zu schaffen. `ZCL_DATA_CONTAINER` schützt `mv_secret_data` vor allgemeinem Zugriff, aber `ZCL_DATA_PROCESSOR` kann darauf zugreifen, da sie als Freund deklariert ist. Dies ist nützlich für eng gekoppelte Komponenten, die dennoch Kapselung wahren wollen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Kapselung, Objektorientierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Private Attribute

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Jahresbereichs (z.B. 2000 bis 2025).
hint: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen Tag innerhalb des Jahresbereichs und konvertieren Sie ihn in ein Datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_year TYPE i
        iv_end_year   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>create_date( iv_year = iv_start_year iv_month = 1 iv_day = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>create_date( iv_year = iv_end_year iv_month = 12 iv_day = 31 ).

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_days_between( iv_date1 = lv_start_date iv_date2 = lv_end_date ).

    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_days_diff ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_date_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_date_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date( iv_start_year = 2000 iv_end_year = 2025 ).

    DATA(lv_min_date) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>create_date( iv_year = 2000 iv_month = 1 iv_day = 1 ).
    DATA(lv_max_date) = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>create_date( iv_year = 2025 iv_month = 12 iv_day = 31 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_random_date >= lv_min_date AND lv_random_date <= lv_max_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode nutzt `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` zur Generierung einer zufälligen Anzahl von Tagen zwischen einem Start- und Enddatum. Die `CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES` Klasse bietet moderne Funktionen zur Datumsberechnung und -manipulation, was die Handhabung von Datumsangaben erheblich vereinfacht.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, Datum, CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES, Zufallsdatum, Datumsberechnung

Instructions: Wählen Sie ein Element aus einer Liste basierend auf einer gewichteten Wahrscheinlichkeit aus.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine kumulative Wahrscheinlichkeitsverteilung und verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` für einen zufälligen Wert zwischen 0 und 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
             item      TYPE string,
             weight    TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_weighted_item.
    TYPES tt_weighted_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_weighted_item
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_items TYPE tt_weighted_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_weighted_item.
    IF it_weighted_items IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero. " Or custom exception
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_weight) = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR item IN it_weighted_items NEXT s = s + item-weight ).

    IF lv_total_weight <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next_float( iv_min = '0.0' iv_max = '1.0' ). " Random float between 0 and 1

    DATA(lv_cumulative_weight) = '0.0' AS decfloat16.
    LOOP AT it_weighted_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lv_cumulative_weight = lv_cumulative_weight + ls_item-weight / lv_total_weight.
      IF lv_random_value <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        rv_selected_item = ls_item-item.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_selected_item = it_weighted_items[ lines( it_weighted_items ) ]-item.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_weighted_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_items RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_total_weight RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weighted_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_selector=>tt_weighted_items(
      ( item = 'Apple'  weight = '0.5' )
      ( item = 'Banana' weight = '0.3' )
      ( item = 'Cherry' weight = '0.2' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_results) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      APPEND lo_cut->get_random_weighted_item( lt_items ) TO lt_results.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_results[ table_line = 'Apple' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_results[ table_line = 'Banana' ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_results[ table_line = 'Cherry' ] ) ).

    DATA(lv_apple_count)  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR item IN lt_results WHERE ( item = 'Apple' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_banana_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR item IN lt_results WHERE ( item = 'Banana' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    DATA(lv_cherry_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR item IN lt_results WHERE ( item = 'Cherry' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_apple_count > lv_banana_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_banana_count > lv_cherry_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_selector=>tt_weighted_items( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_weighted_item( lt_empty_items ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error expected for empty items' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error correctly raised for empty items' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_total_weight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_zero_weight_items) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_selector=>tt_weighted_items(
      ( item = 'A' weight = '0.0' )
      ( item = 'B' weight = '0.0' )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_weighted_item( lt_zero_weight_items ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error expected for zero total weight' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error correctly raised for zero total weight' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Anwendung von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` zur Implementierung einer gewichteten Zufallsauswahl. Es berechnet kumulative Wahrscheinlichkeiten und verwendet `GET_NEXT_FLOAT` für einen zufälligen Gleitkommawert. `REDUCE` wird für die Summation der Gewichte verwendet, was eine moderne und kompakte Syntax darstellt.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, Gewichtete Auswahl, Wahrscheinlichkeit, REDUCE, GET_NEXT_FLOAT, DECFLOAT16

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Würfelspiel, bei dem ein Spieler eine zufällige Zahl würfelt. Erstellen Sie eine separate Debugging-Klasse, die als `FRIENDS` deklariert ist und die Möglichkeit hat, den internen Zustand des Zufallszahlengenerators (z.B. den Seed) zu setzen, um reproduzierbare Tests zu ermöglichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` und die `FRIENDS` Deklaration, um der Debugging-Klasse Zugriff auf die private `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` Instanz zu geben und deren Seed zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_game DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice RETURNING VALUE(rv_roll) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_random TYPE REF TO cl_abap_random.
    METHODS constructor.
    FRIENDS zcl_dice_game_debugger. " Grant access to private components for debugging
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_game IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_random = cl_abap_random=>create( ). " Create with default (time-based) seed
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD roll_dice.
    rv_roll = mo_random->get_next( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_game_debugger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_random_seed
      IMPORTING
        io_game TYPE REF TO zcl_dice_game
        iv_seed TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_game_debugger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_random_seed.
    " Re-create the random object with a specific seed for reproducibility
    io_game->mo_random = cl_abap_random=>create( iv_seed = iv_seed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reproducible_rolls FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_rolls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reproducible_rolls.
    DATA(lo_game) = NEW zcl_dice_game( ).
    DATA(lo_debugger) = NEW zcl_dice_game_debugger( ).
    DATA(lv_seed) = 12345. " A fixed seed for reproducibility

    lo_debugger->set_random_seed( io_game = lo_game iv_seed = lv_seed ).
    DATA(lv_roll1_game1) = lo_game->roll_dice( ).
    DATA(lv_roll2_game1) = lo_game->roll_dice( ).

    DATA(lo_game2) = NEW zcl_dice_game( ).
    lo_debugger->set_random_seed( io_game = lo_game2 iv_seed = lv_seed ).
    DATA(lv_roll1_game2) = lo_game2->roll_dice( ).
    DATA(lv_roll2_game2) = lo_game2->roll_dice( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_roll1_game1 exp = lv_roll1_game2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_roll2_game1 exp = lv_roll2_game2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_roll1_game1 >= 1 AND lv_roll1_game1 <= 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_rolls.
    DATA(lo_game) = NEW zcl_dice_game( ).
    DATA(lv_roll1) = lo_game->roll_dice( ).
    DATA(lv_roll2) = lo_game->roll_dice( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_roll1 >= 1 AND lv_roll1 <= 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_roll2 >= 1 AND lv_roll2 <= 6 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht der `ZCL_DICE_GAME_DEBUGGER` Klasse, den privaten Zufallszahlengenerator `mo_random` in `ZCL_DICE_GAME` zu manipulieren. Dies ist entscheidend für das Debugging und das Schreiben reproduzierbarer Unit Tests für Logik, die auf Zufallszahlen basiert, indem ein fester Seed gesetzt werden kann.
keywords: FRIENDS, CL_ABAP_RANDOM, Debugging, Reproduzierbarkeit, Unit Test, Seed

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen booleschen Wert (true/false).
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 und prüfen Sie, ob sie 0 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_boolean_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_boolean
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_boolean) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_boolean_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_int) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = 1 ).
    IF lv_random_int = 0.
      rv_boolean = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_boolean = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_boolean FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_boolean.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_boolean_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_true_count)  = 0.
    DATA(lv_false_count) = 0.
    DO 1000 TIMES.
      IF lo_cut->get_random_boolean( ) = abap_true.
        lv_true_count = lv_true_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_false_count = lv_false_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_true_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_false_count > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_true_count + lv_false_count exp = 1000 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` wird verwendet, um eine Zufallszahl zwischen 0 und 1 zu generieren. Basierend auf diesem Wert wird ein boolescher Wert zurückgegeben. Dies ist eine einfache und moderne Methode, um zufällige Entscheidungen in ABAP zu treffen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_RANDOM, Boolean, Zufall, abap_bool

Instructions: Wählen Sie ein zufälliges Element aus einer internen Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen und generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_list_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_element
      IMPORTING
        it_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_element) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_list_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_element.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_list ).
    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_lines - 1 ). " 0-based index

    rv_element = it_list[ lv_random_index + 1 ]. " 1-based access
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_element_selection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_list RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_list_selector( ).
    DATA(lt_list) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Red' ) ( 'Green' ) ( 'Blue' ) ).
    DATA(lv_element) = lo_cut->get_random_element( lt_list ).

    DATA(lt_empty_list) = VALUE string_table( ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Auswahl eines zufälligen Elements aus einer internen Tabelle. `CL_ABAP_RANDOM` wird verwendet, um einen gültigen Index zu generieren. Die Verwendung von `lines()` und dem Tabellenindex-Zugriff `it_list[index]` sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Uhrzeit.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_time) TYPE t.

CLASS zcl_random_time_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_time.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_hour)   = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = 23 ).
    DATA(lv_minute) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = 59 ).
    DATA(lv_second) = lo_random->get_next( iv_min = 0 iv_max = 59 ).

    rv_random_time = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>create_time(
                           iv_hour   = lv_hour
                           iv_minute = lv_minute
                           iv_second = lv_second ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_time_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_time_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_random_time) = lo_cut->get_random_time( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_APPLICATION_SERVICE` mit einer privaten Methode, die interne Statusänderungen protokolliert. Implementieren Sie eine `FRIENDS` Klasse `ZCL_MONITORING_TOOL`, die diese private Protokollierungsmethode aufrufen kann, um detaillierte interne Logs zu erstellen, ohne die öffentliche Schnittstelle des Dienstes zu erweitern.
hint: Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_MONITORING_TOOL` als `FRIENDS` in `ZCL_APPLICATION_SERVICE` und rufen Sie die private Methode auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_application_service DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_action IMPORTING iv_action_name TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _log_internal_status IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
    FRIENDS zcl_monitoring_tool. " Grant access to private logging method
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_application_service IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_action.
    _log_internal_status( |Action '{ iv_action_name }' started.| ).
    " ... complex logic ...
    _log_internal_status( |Action '{ iv_action_name }' completed successfully.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _log_internal_status.
    WRITE: / 'Internal Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_monitoring_tool DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_internal_log
      IMPORTING
        io_service TYPE REF TO zcl_application_service
        iv_log_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_monitoring_tool IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_internal_log.
    io_service->_log_internal_status( iv_message = iv_log_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_internal_logging_via_friends.
    DATA(lo_service) = NEW zcl_application_service( ).
    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_monitoring_tool( ).

    lo_service->perform_action( 'Process Order' ).

    lo_monitor->trigger_internal_log( io_service = lo_service iv_log_message = 'Monitoring tool triggered specific log.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Internal logging via FRIENDS executed without error.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Deklaration ermöglicht es `ZCL_MONITORING_TOOL`, die private Protokollierungsmethode `_log_internal_status` von `ZCL_APPLICATION_SERVICE` aufzurufen. Dies ist nützlich für spezielle Überwachungs- oder Debugging-Szenarien, bei denen ein tieferer Einblick in die interne Funktionsweise einer Klasse erforderlich ist, ohne die öffentliche Schnittstelle zu überladen oder die Kapselung zu verletzen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Terminobjekten, um nur die Termine zu erhalten, die an einem bestimmten Datum beginnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id          TYPE string,
        subject     TYPE string,
        start_date  TYPE d,
        start_time  TYPE t,
        end_date    TYPE d,
        end_time    TYPE t,
        participants TYPE i,
      END OF ty_appointment_data.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_id          TYPE string
        iv_subject     TYPE string
        iv_start_date  TYPE d
        iv_start_time  TYPE t
        iv_end_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_time    TYPE t
        iv_participants TYPE i.

    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_appointment_data.
    METHODS get_duration_in_hours RETURNING VALUE(rv_hours) TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS is_future_appointment RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_data TYPE ty_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data = VALUE #( id = iv_id subject = iv_subject start_date = iv_start_date start_time = iv_start_time end_date = iv_end_date end_time = iv_end_time participants = iv_participants ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rs_data = ms_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_duration_in_hours.
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-end_date iv_time = ms_data-end_time ).
    DATA(lv_diff_secs) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).
    rv_hours = lv_diff_secs / 3600.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_future_appointment.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    rb_is_future = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_start_tstmp > lv_current_tstmp THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        iv_date         TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Private attributes or methods can be defined here if needed for internal logic.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_date.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_appointments WHERE get_data( )-start_date = iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_date.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.

    DATA(lo_app_today1) = NEW zcl_appointment(
      iv_id = 'A001' iv_subject = 'Meeting Today'
      iv_start_date = lv_today iv_start_time = '090000'
      iv_end_date = lv_today iv_end_time = '100000'
      iv_participants = 5
    ).
    DATA(lo_app_today2) = NEW zcl_appointment(
      iv_id = 'A002' iv_subject = 'Call Today'
      iv_start_date = lv_today iv_start_time = '110000'
      iv_end_date = lv_today iv_end_time = '120000'
      iv_participants = 3
    ).
    DATA(lo_app_tomorrow) = NEW zcl_appointment(
      iv_id = 'A003' iv_subject = 'Workshop Tomorrow'
      iv_start_date = lv_tomorrow iv_start_time = '140000'
      iv_end_date = lv_tomorrow iv_end_time = '160000'
      iv_participants = 10
    ).

    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = VALUE zcl_appointment_filter=>tt_appointments(
      ( lo_app_today1 )
      ( lo_app_today2 )
      ( lo_app_tomorrow )
    ).

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_appointment_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_by_date(
      it_appointments = lt_all_appointments
      iv_date         = lv_today
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]->get_data( )-id exp = 'A001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]->get_data( )-id exp = 'A002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Filterung interner Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte. Die `PRIVATE SECTION` der Klasse `zcl_appointment_filter` ist hier leer, demonstriert aber die Möglichkeit der Kapselung.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Object Orientation, PRIVATE SECTION

Instructions: Summieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der Teilnehmer aller Termine in einer Liste von `ZCL_APPOINTMENT`-Objekten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        subject     TYPE string,
        start_date  TYPE d,

        iv_end_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_time    TYPE t

    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_appointment_data.
    METHODS get_duration_in_hours RETURNING VALUE(rv_hours) TYPE decfloat34.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_data TYPE ty_appointment_data.

CLASS zcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data = VALUE #( id = iv_id subject = iv_subject start_date = iv_start_date start_time = iv_start_time end_date = iv_end_date end_time = iv_end_time participants = iv_participants ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rs_data = ms_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_duration_in_hours.
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-end_date iv_time = ms_data-end_time ).
    DATA(lv_diff_secs) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).
    rv_hours = lv_diff_secs / 3600.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_future_appointment.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    rb_is_future = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_start_tstmp > lv_current_tstmp THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_participants
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_participants) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Private attributes or methods for internal use.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_participants.
    rv_total_participants = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_appointment> IN it_appointments
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_appointment>->get_data( )-participants
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
        id          TYPE string,
        subject     TYPE string,
        start_date  TYPE d,

      IMPORTING

        iv_subject     TYPE string
        iv_start_date  TYPE d
        iv_start_time  TYPE t
        iv_end_date    TYPE d
        iv_end_time    TYPE t
        iv_participants TYPE i.

    METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_appointment_data.
    METHODS get_duration_in_hours RETURNING VALUE(rv_hours) TYPE decfloat34.
    METHODS is_future_appointment RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_future) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_data TYPE ty_appointment_data.

CLASS zcl_appointment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data = VALUE #( id = iv_id subject = iv_subject start_date = iv_start_date start_time = iv_start_time end_date = iv_end_date end_time = iv_end_time participants = iv_participants ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    rs_data = ms_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_duration_in_hours.
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    DATA(lv_end_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-end_date iv_time = ms_data-end_time ).
    DATA(lv_diff_secs) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).
    rv_hours = lv_diff_secs / 3600.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_future_appointment.
    DATA(lv_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utc_from_system_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time( iv_date = ms_data-start_date iv_time = ms_data-start_time ).
    rb_is_future = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_start_tstmp > lv_current_tstmp THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES:
      tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average_participants
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    " Private attributes or methods for internal use.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_participants.
    DATA(lv_total_participants) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_appointment> IN it_appointments
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_appointment>->get_data( )-participants
    ).

    IF lines( it_appointments ) > 0.
      rv_average = lv_total_participants / lines( it_appointments ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_sum_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.

      FROM sflights

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00

CLASS zcl_sflights_connid_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sflights_connid_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connid_list.

    SELECT carrid, connid

    rv_connid_list = REDUCE string(

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (Feld PRICE) in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator mit einer COND-Expression, um den Maximalwert zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0.00
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             NEXT max_p = COND #( WHEN flight-price > max_p THEN flight-price ELSE max_p ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator in Kombination mit FOR GROUPS, um die Gruppierung und Zählung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_flight_count( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = carrid
                                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_counts_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_actual_counts
                                              msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Überprüfen Sie die Zählung für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(lv_expected_count_aa) TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_expected_count_aa WHERE carrid = 'AA'.

    DATA(ls_aa_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflights_group_count=>ty_flight_count(
      lt_actual_counts[ carrid = 'AA' DEFAULT INITIAL ] ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_entry-flight_count
                                        exp = lv_expected_count_aa
                                        msg = 'Fluganzahl für AA sollte korrekt sein' ).

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob alle Einträge einen CARRID haben
    LOOP AT lt_actual_counts INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-carrid
                                                msg = 'CARRID sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-flight_count
                                                msg = 'Flight Count sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_counts_empty_table.
    " Dieser Test ist schwieriger, da SFLIGHTS eine Standardtabelle ist und nicht leer sein sollte.
    " Man müsste die SFLIGHTS-Datenbank mocken oder eine leere Tabelle simulieren.
    " Für diesen Fall nehmen wir an, dass die Methode bei einer leeren Eingabetabelle
    " eine leere Ausgabetabelle zurückgibt.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_count( ).
    " Da wir SFLIGHTS nicht leeren können, können wir nur prüfen, dass die Methode
    " bei einer leeren SFLIGHTS-Tabelle (hypothetisch) eine leere Ergebnistabelle liefert.
    " Da SFLIGHTS Daten enthält, wird dieser Test immer eine nicht-leere Tabelle erwarten.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrid( )
    "                                         msg = 'Bei leerer SFLIGHTS sollte Ergebnis leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator mit FOR GROUPS ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Syntax, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. GROUP BY definiert die Gruppierungskriterien, und GROUP SIZE liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe. Dies ersetzt komplexe LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... ENDLOOP-Konstrukte und macht den Code deutlich lesbarer und kompakter.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Interne Tabellen

Instructions: Formatieren Sie Flugdaten (CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE, CURRENCY) aus SFLIGHTS in einem lesbaren String-Format, z.B. 'Flug AA 0010 am 2025-12-04 kostet 100.00 USD'.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für eine einfache und flexible Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS format_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights_for_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_data.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } am { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER }
                           kostet { is_flight-price WIDTH = 10 DECIMALS = 2 ALIGN = RIGHT } { is_flight-currency }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_flights_for_carrid.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( format_flight_data( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflights_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt und die zu einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gehören.
hint: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN lt_all_sflights WHERE ( flight-price > iv_min_price )
      ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der VALUE-Operator in Kombination mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer WHERE-Bedingung ist die moderne und effiziente Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen. Dies ersetzt die ältere LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND-Logik und führt zu deutlich kompakterem und lesbarerem Code. Die Syntax ist deklarativ und beschreibt, was erreicht werden soll, anstatt wie es erreicht wird.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Währung (CURRENCY) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle mit Währung und Durchschnittspreis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS, um die Summe und Anzahl pro Währung zu aggregieren, und berechnen Sie dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price_curr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price_by_curr,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             average_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price_by_curr.
    TYPES tt_avg_price_by_curr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price_by_curr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price_by_curr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price_curr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_currency.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = REDUCE tt_avg_price_by_curr(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price_by_curr( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-currency
      GROUP BY currency = flight-currency
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_avg_price_by_curr( BASE result
                                            ( currency = currency
                                              average_price = REDUCE s_price(
                                                                INIT sum_p = 0.00
                                                                FOR GROUP MEMBER flight_member IN GROUP flight
                                                                NEXT sum_p = sum_p + flight_member-price ) / GROUP SIZE ) ) ).

    rt_avg_prices = lt_grouped_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_average_price_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price_by_currency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_avg_price_curr( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_avg_prices) = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_currency( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_actual_avg_prices
                                              msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    " Überprüfen Sie den Durchschnittspreis für eine bekannte Währung, z.B. 'USD'
    DATA(lv_sum_usd) TYPE s_price.
    DATA(lv_count_usd) TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights INTO @lv_sum_usd WHERE currency = 'USD'.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_count_usd WHERE currency = 'USD'.

    IF lv_count_usd > 0.
      DATA(lv_expected_avg_usd) = lv_sum_usd / lv_count_usd.
      DATA(ls_usd_entry) = VALUE zcl_sflights_avg_price_curr=>ty_avg_price_by_curr(
        lt_actual_avg_prices[ currency = 'USD' DEFAULT INITIAL ] ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_usd_entry-average_price
                                          exp = lv_expected_avg_usd
                                          msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für USD sollte korrekt sein' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Überprüfen Sie, ob alle Einträge eine Währung und einen Durchschnittspreis haben
    LOOP AT lt_actual_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-currency
                                                msg = 'Währung sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_entry-average_price
                                                msg = 'Durchschnittspreis sollte nicht initial sein' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_empty_table.
    " Ähnlich wie bei red_004, dieser Test ist konzeptionell, da SFLIGHTS Daten enthält.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_cut->get_average_price_by_currency( )
    "                                         msg = 'Bei leerer SFLIGHTS sollte Ergebnis leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung des REDUCE-Operators mit verschachtelten FOR GROUPS-Ausdrücken. Zuerst wird nach Währung gruppiert, und dann wird innerhalb jeder Gruppe ein weiterer REDUCE-Ausdruck verwendet, um die Summe der Preise zu berechnen. Die Division durch GROUP SIZE liefert den Durchschnitt. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um komplexe Aggregationen und Gruppierungen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck durchzuführen, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Grouping, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Durchschnitt, Währung, Interne Tabellen

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHTS-Datensätzen in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft enthält, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die mehr als 5 Flüge haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS und einer WHERE-Bedingung auf GROUP SIZE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filtered_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carrid_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrids_with_many_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_carrid_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filtered_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_many_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = REDUCE tt_carrid_flight_count(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      WHERE ( GROUP SIZE > iv_min_flights )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_carrid_flight_count( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = carrid
                                              flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filtered_group( ).
    DATA(lv_min_flights) = 5. " Mindestens 5 Flüge
    DATA(lt_actual_result) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_many_flights( lv_min_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_actual_result
                                              msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein' ).

    LOOP AT lt_actual_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( bool = ( ls_entry-flight_count > lv_min_flights )
                                          msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte über dem Schwellenwert liegen' ).
      DATA(lv_db_count) TYPE i.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_db_count WHERE carrid = ls_entry-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-flight_count exp = lv_db_count
                                          msg = 'Gezählte Flüge sollten mit DB übereinstimmen' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_carrids) = 0.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sflights GROUP BY carrid HAVING COUNT(*) > @lv_min_flights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_counts).
    lv_expected_carrids = lines( lt_db_counts ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_actual_result ) exp = lv_expected_carrids
                                        msg = 'Anzahl der Fluggesellschaften sollte korrekt sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_groups_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_filtered_group( ).
    DATA(lv_min_flights) = 99999. " Sehr hohe Anzahl, um keine Treffer zu erhalten
    DATA(lt_actual_result) = lo_cut->get_carrids_with_many_flights( lv_min_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_actual_result
                                          msg = 'Ergebnistabelle sollte leer sein, wenn keine Gruppe die Bedingung erfüllt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Gruppierungsfunktionalität von REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS um eine WHERE-Bedingung, die auf die Eigenschaften der Gruppe selbst angewendet wird (hier GROUP SIZE). Dies ermöglicht es, nur Gruppen zu berücksichtigen, die bestimmte Kriterien erfüllen, was eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode zur Filterung von aggregierten Daten darstellt. Es ist eine elegante Alternative zu komplexen Schleifen mit Zwischenspeicherung und nachträglicher Filterung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, WHERE, Grouping, Filtering, SFLIGHTS, Interne Tabellen

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Map (Hash-Tabelle) von Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) zu einer Liste ihrer Flugverbindungen (CONNID) aus SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit FOR GROUPS, um eine Hash-Tabelle zu füllen, wobei der Wert eine interne Tabelle ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_carrid_to_conns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_conn_id WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: ty_carrid_to_conns TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    TYPES: ty_carrid_to_conns_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF tt_connid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_carrid_to_connections_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_map) TYPE ty_carrid_to_conns_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_carrid_to_conns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrid_to_connections_map.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_map = REDUCE ty_carrid_to_conns_map(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_carrid_to_conns_map( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_carrid_to_conns_map( BASE result
                                            ( carrid = carrid
                                              table_line = VALUE tt_connid(
                                                FOR GROUP MEMBER flight_member IN GROUP flight
                                                ( flight_member-connid ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
