Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Interface mit zwei verschiedenen Klassen (z.B. Kreis und Quadrat). Erstellen Sie eine Liste von Referenzen auf das Interface und rufen Sie eine polymorphe Methode auf, um den Flächeninhalt und den Namen der Formen zu ermitteln.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit Methoden wie `get_area` und `get_name`. Implementieren Sie dieses Interface in mehreren Klassen und verwenden Sie `TYPE REF TO zif_shape`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Circle'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Square'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE ty_t_shapes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lr_shape).
      APPEND |Shape: { lr_shape->get_name() }, Area: { lr_shape->get_area() }| TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphism FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphism.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5.0' ).
    DATA(lo_square) = NEW zcl_square( iv_side = '4.0' ).

    DATA(lt_shapes) = VALUE zcl_shape_processor=>ty_t_shapes(
      ( lo_circle )
      ( lo_square )
    ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Circle' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 1 ] exp = 'Area: 78.53975' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Square' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Area: 16' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Polymorphismus ist ein Kernkonzept der objektorientierten Programmierung. Durch die Verwendung von Interface-Referenzen (`REF TO zif_shape`) kann eine Liste von Objekten unterschiedlicher Klassen, die dasselbe Interface implementieren, einheitlich verarbeitet werden. Jedes Objekt reagiert auf den Methodenaufruf (`get_name()`, `get_area()`) gemäß seiner eigenen Implementierung, was zu flexiblem und erweiterbarem Code führt.
keywords: REF TO, Interface, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, Class

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein anonymes Datenobjekt (Struktur) mit `NEW #( )` erzeugt, befüllt und dessen Inhalt als Referenz zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW #( VALUE ty_s_my_struct( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 ) )` um ein anonymes Datenobjekt zu instanziieren und zu befüllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_anon_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_person,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_person.

    METHODS create_and_get_person
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_person) TYPE ty_s_person.

    METHODS get_person_as_ref
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_person) TYPE REF TO ty_s_person.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_anon_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_get_person.
    rs_person = VALUE #( name = iv_name age = iv_age ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_person_as_ref.
    rr_person = NEW #( VALUE ty_s_person( name = iv_name age = iv_age ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_anon_struct FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_anon_ref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_anon_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_anon_data( ).
    DATA(ls_person) = lo_cut->create_and_get_person( iv_name = 'Alice' iv_age = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-name exp = 'Alice' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-age exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_anon_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_anon_data( ).
    DATA(lr_person) = lo_cut->get_person_as_ref( iv_name = 'Bob' iv_age = 25 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lr_person ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_person->name exp = 'Bob' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_person->age exp = 25 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW #( )` Operator in Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die kompakte Erstellung und Initialisierung von anonymen Datenobjekten (Strukturen oder Tabellen) und deren Rückgabe als Referenz (`REF TO`). Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit, insbesondere bei der Arbeit mit temporären Datenstrukturen.
keywords: REF TO, NEW, Anonymous Data Object, Value Operator, Syntax Sugar

Instructions: Kopieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer tiefen Struktur (d.h., die Zeilen enthalten weitere interne Tabellen) in eine andere, identische Tabelle. Demonstrieren Sie, dass die Kopie eine echte tiefe Kopie ist und Änderungen im Original die Kopie nicht beeinflussen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `MAPPING` für eine effiziente tiefe Kopie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_deep_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             item_id TYPE i,
             text    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item.
    TYPES: ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_header,
             header_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             items       TYPE ty_t_items,
           END OF ty_s_header.
    TYPES: ty_t_headers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_header WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_deep_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_t_headers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_t_headers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_deep_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_deep_table.
    " Using CORRESPONDING with BASE and MAPPING for deep copy
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ) it_source MAPPING header_id = header_id description = description items = items ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deep_copy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deep_copy.
    DATA(lt_source_items1) = VALUE zcl_deep_copy=>ty_t_items(
      ( item_id = 101 text = 'Item A' )
      ( item_id = 102 text = 'Item B' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source_items2) = VALUE zcl_deep_copy=>ty_t_items(
      ( item_id = 201 text = 'Item X' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_source_headers) = VALUE zcl_deep_copy=>ty_t_headers(
      ( header_id = 1 description = 'Header One' items = lt_source_items1 )
      ( header_id = 2 description = 'Header Two' items = lt_source_items2 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_deep_copy( ).
    DATA(lt_target_headers) = lo_cut->copy_deep_table( lt_source_headers ).

    " Assertions for deep copy
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_headers ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-header_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Header One' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-items ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-items[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 101 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-items[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Item A' ).

    " Verify it's a deep copy (modifying source should not affect target)
    lt_source_headers[ 1 ]-items[ 1 ]-text = 'Modified Item A'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target_headers[ 1 ]-items[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Item A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `MAPPING` ist die moderne und effiziente Art, tiefe Strukturen und Tabellen zu kopieren. Er stellt sicher, dass nicht nur die oberste Ebene, sondern auch alle verschachtelten internen Tabellen und Strukturen als eigenständige Kopien angelegt werden, wodurch Änderungen im Quellobjekt das Zielobjekt nicht beeinflussen.
keywords: REF TO, Deep Copy, CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Value Operator

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen den Tabellen `sflights` und `sairport` durch, um Flugdaten mit den entsprechenden Flughafeninformationen (Abflug- und Zielflughafen) zu verknüpfen und die Ergebnisse in eine interne Tabelle zu laden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM sflights AS a INNER JOIN sairport AS b ON a~airpfrom = b~id ...` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @data_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_airport,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sairport-city,
             cityto   TYPE sairport-city,
           END OF ty_s_flight_airport.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_airport TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_airport WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_airport_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_airport.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_airport_names.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate,
           a_from~city AS cityfrom,
           a_to~city   AS cityto
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN sairport AS a_from ON s~airpfrom = a_from~id
      INNER JOIN sairport AS a_to   ON s~airpto   = a_to~id
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_inner_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_airport_names( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 ). " Assuming 10 rows are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights[ 1 ]-cityfrom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights[ 1 ]-cityto ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INNER JOIN` in Open SQL ist die Standardmethode, um Datensätze aus zwei oder mehr Datenbanktabellen zu kombinieren, basierend auf einer gemeinsamen Spalte. Die moderne Syntax mit Aliasnamen (`AS s`, `AS a_from`, `AS a_to`) und dem `@`-Zeichen für Hostvariablen (`@rt_flights`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und ist für ABAP 7.40+ obligatorisch.
keywords: JOINS, Inner Join, SELECT, sflights, sairport, Database Access

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Left Outer Join zwischen `sflights` und `sbook` durch, um alle Flüge und deren zugehörige Buchungen zu erhalten. Zeigen Sie, wie Flüge ohne Buchungen erkannt werden können.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und prüfen Sie auf `IS NULL` für Felder der rechten Tabelle, um nicht-gematchte Einträge zu identifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_left_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_s_flight_booking.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_bookings) TYPE ty_t_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_left_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate,
           b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflights AS f
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b
        ON f~carrid = b~carrid AND
           f~connid = b~connid AND
           f~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights_bookings
      UP TO 20 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_left_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_bookings) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights_bookings ).
    " Check if there are entries with and without bookings
    DATA(lv_has_booking) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_no_booking) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flights_bookings INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-bookid IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_has_booking = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        lv_no_booking = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_booking ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_no_booking ). " Expecting some flights without bookings
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`sflights`) zurück und die passenden Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`sbook`). Wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird, werden `NULL`-Werte für die Spalten der rechten Tabelle zurückgegeben. Dies ist nützlich, um alle 'linken' Entitäten zu sehen, auch wenn keine 'rechten' Entitäten zugeordnet sind. Die Prüfung auf `IS NULL` für ein Feld der rechten Tabelle identifiziert diese Fälle.
keywords: JOINS, Left Outer Join, SELECT, sflights, sbook, IS NULL, Database Access

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie zwei interne Tabellen (z.B. simulierte Flugdaten und Buchungsdaten) mithilfe des `FOR ... IN ... JOIN` Ausdrucks, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit kombinierten Daten zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ls_flight IN it_flights FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings WHERE ls_flight-carrid = ls_booking-carrid ...` innerhalb eines `VALUE #()` Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_booking_data,
             carrid TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_s_booking_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_joined_data,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflights-price,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_s_joined_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_joined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_joined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS join_internal_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_flights  TYPE ty_t_flight_data
        it_bookings TYPE ty_t_booking_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined) TYPE ty_t_joined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_internal_tables.
    rt_joined = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings WHERE ls_flight-carrid = ls_booking-carrid
                                      AND ls_flight-connid = ls_booking-connid
                                      AND ls_flight-fldate = ls_booking-fldate
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        price  = ls_flight-price
        bookid = ls_booking-bookid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_join.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_join=>ty_t_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_bookings) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_join=>ty_t_booking_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B001' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B002' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' bookid = 'B003' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_join( ).
    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_internal_tables(
      it_flights  = lt_flights
      it_bookings = lt_bookings
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 1 ]-bookid exp = 'B001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 2 ]-bookid exp = 'B002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[ 3 ]-bookid exp = 'B003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR ... IN ... JOIN` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code zu verknüpfen, ähnlich wie SQL-Joins auf Datenbankebene. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht dies die deklarative und kompakte Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen aus den verknüpften Daten, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: JOINS, FOR, Internal Tables, Table Expression, Value Operator

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Buchungen, indem Sie `sflights`, `sbook` und `scarr` verknüpfen und das Ergebnis nach Fluggesellschaft gruppieren.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, die Aggregatfunktion `COUNT( b~bookid )` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_agg_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_carrier_bookings,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             carriername TYPE scarr-carrname,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_carrier_bookings.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_carrier_bookings WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_bookings_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_bookings) TYPE ty_t_carrier_bookings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_agg_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_bookings_by_carrier.
    SELECT f~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT( b~bookid ) AS total_bookings
      FROM sflights AS f
      INNER JOIN sbook AS b
        ON f~carrid = b~carrid AND
           f~connid = b~connid AND
           f~fldate = b~fldate
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c
        ON f~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY f~carrid, c~carrname
      ORDER BY f~carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_carrier_bookings
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_agg_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_agg_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_agg_join( ).
    DATA(lt_carrier_bookings) = lo_cut->get_total_bookings_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carrier_bookings ).
    " Check if at least one carrier has bookings
    DATA(lv_found_bookings) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_carrier_bookings INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-total_bookings > 0.
        lv_found_bookings = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_bookings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carrier_bookings[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_carrier_bookings[ 1 ]-carriername ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `INNER JOIN` mit Aggregatfunktionen (`COUNT`) und der `GROUP BY`-Klausel. Dies ist ein Standardmuster in SQL, um zusammenfassende Daten aus verknüpften Tabellen zu erhalten. Die moderne Open SQL Syntax erlaubt die direkte Verwendung von Aggregatfunktionen und Gruppierungen, um komplexe Berichte direkt auf der Datenbankebene zu erstellen.
keywords: JOINS, Aggregation, GROUP BY, SELECT, sflights, sbook, scarr, Database Access

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie `sflights` und `sbook` und verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Expression im `SELECT`-Statement, um den Buchungsstatus jedes Fluges basierend auf der Anzahl der Buchungen zu kategorisieren (z.B. 'No Bookings', 'Few Bookings', 'Moderate Bookings', 'Many Bookings').
hint: Nutzen Sie `LEFT OUTER JOIN` mit `sbook`, `GROUP BY` und eine `CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS ...` Expression auf das Ergebnis von `COUNT( b~bookid )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_case_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             total_bookings TYPE i,
             booking_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_flight_status.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_booking_category
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE ty_t_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_case_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking_category.
    SELECT f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate,
           COUNT( b~bookid ) AS total_bookings,
           CASE
             WHEN COUNT( b~bookid ) = 0 THEN 'No Bookings'
             WHEN COUNT( b~bookid ) < 5 THEN 'Few Bookings'
             WHEN COUNT( b~bookid ) < 20 THEN 'Moderate Bookings'
             ELSE 'Many Bookings'
           END AS booking_category
      FROM sflights AS f
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b
        ON f~carrid = b~carrid AND
           f~connid = b~connid AND
           f~fldate = b~fldate
      GROUP BY f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate
      ORDER BY f~carrid, f~connid, f~fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flight_status
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_case_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_case_join.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_case_join( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_booking_category( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_status ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_status ) exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_status[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flight_status[ 1 ]-booking_category ).

    " Check for expected category values (at least one should match)
    DATA(lv_found_category) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_status INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-booking_category = 'No Bookings' OR
         ls_entry-booking_category = 'Few Bookings' OR
         ls_entry-booking_category = 'Moderate Bookings' OR
         ls_entry-booking_category = 'Many Bookings'.
        lv_found_category = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_category ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Expression in Open SQL ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten direkt in der `SELECT`-Anweisung, was die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing im ABAP-Code reduziert. In Kombination mit `LEFT OUTER JOIN` und `GROUP BY` kann man komplexe Geschäftslogik zur Datenkategorisierung direkt auf der Datenbankebene implementieren, was die Performance und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: JOINS, CASE Expression, SELECT, sflights, sbook, GROUP BY, Database Access

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, und extrahieren Sie eine Liste von Werten in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` und `get_array_as_table`, um über die Array-Elemente zu iterieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        DATA(lt_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array_as_table( '/' ). " Root ist ein Array
        LOOP AT lt_json_array INTO DATA(ls_json_element).
          DATA(lo_element_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
          lo_element_parser->parse_json( ls_json_element-value ). " Jedes Element ist ein JSON-Objekt
          APPEND VALUE #(
            carrid = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_string( 'carrid' )
            connid = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_string( 'connid' )
          ) TO rt_flights.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_array.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_parser_array( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400"}, {"carrid": "AA", "connid": "0017"}]`.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->parse_flight_data( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0017' ).

  METHOD test_parse_empty_array.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_parser_array( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[]`.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->parse_flight_data( lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).

ENDCLASS.

Dann wird jeder String-Eintrag des Arrays als separates JSON-Objekt geparst, um die einzelnen Felder zu extrahieren. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` ist eine moderne Art, interne Tabellen zu füllen.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem Baum an, wobei Fluggesellschaften die Wurzelknoten und deren Flüge die Kindknoten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `GROUP BY` und iterieren Sie, um Knoten hinzuzufügen. String-Templates für Knotentexte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    " Flugdaten lesen, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit für Demo

    " Gruppieren nach carrid
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carrid) = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_carr_key) = lv_carrid.

      lo_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_node_text      = |Fluggesellschaft: { lv_carrid }|
        e_new_node_key   = lv_carr_key
      ).

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_conn).
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |{ lv_carrid }-{ ls_conn-connid }|.
        lo_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carr_key
          i_node_text      = |Flug { ls_conn-connid } am { ls_conn-fldate DATE = USER }|
          e_new_node_key   = lv_conn_key
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_first_visible_node( cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root ).
    lo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String mit verschachtelten Objekten und extrahieren Sie Werte aus verschiedenen Ebenen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` und navigieren Sie mit Pfaden (`/parent/child`) zu den verschachtelten Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_address,
             street TYPE string,
             city   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_address.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             name    TYPE string,
             age     TYPE i,
             address TYPE ty_address,
           END OF ty_person.

    METHODS parse_person_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_person) TYPE ty_person.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_person_data.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        rs_person-name = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'name' ).
        rs_person-age = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_int( 'age' ).
        rs_person-address-street = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'address/street' ).
        rs_person-address-city = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'address/city' ).
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_parse_nested.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der möglicherweise fehlende Felder enthält, und geben Sie Standardwerte zurück, falls ein Feld nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke, um spezifische Fehler beim Abrufen von Werten abzufangen und Standardwerte zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_default DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.

    METHODS parse_product_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_product) TYPE ty_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_product_data.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).

        rs_product-id = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'id' ).
        rs_product-name = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( 'name' ).

        TRY.
            rs_product-price = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_decfloat16( 'price' ).
          CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
            rs_product-price = '0.00'. " Standardpreis, wenn nicht gefunden
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Allgemeine Fehlerbehandlung für das Parsen des gesamten JSON-Strings
        CLEAR rs_product.
        rs_product-name = 'INVALID JSON'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Baum, der dynamisch aus einer verschachtelten internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights` mit zusätzlichen Ebenen) aufgebaut wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie rekursive Methoden oder verschachtelte Schleifen, um die Hierarchie der Daten abzubilden und Knoten hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connections TYPE tt_connections,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_dynamic_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS add_nodes_recursively
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_carriers
        iv_parent_key  TYPE string
        io_tree        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_tree.
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    " Beispiel-Datenstruktur aus sflights
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE tt_carriers(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw BY ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connections = VALUE tt_connections(
          FOR ls_conn IN GROUP ls_flight
          ( connid = ls_conn-connid fldate = ls_conn-fldate )
        )
      )
    ).

    DATA(lv_root_key) = 'ROOT'.
    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
      i_node_text      = 'Alle Flüge'
      e_new_node_key   = lv_root_key
    ).

    add_nodes_recursively(
      it_data       = lt_carriers
      iv_parent_key = lv_root_key
      io_tree       = lo_tree
    ).

    lo_tree->set_first_visible_node( cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root ).
    lo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_nodes_recursively.
    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      DATA(lv_carr_key) = |{ iv_parent_key }-{ ls_carrier-carrid }|.
      io_tree->add_node(
        i_relat_node_key = iv_parent_key
        i_node_text      = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_carrier-carrid }|
        e_new_node_key   = lv_carr_key
      ).

      LOOP AT ls_carrier-connections INTO DATA(ls_connection).
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |{ lv_carr_key }-{ ls_connection-connid }|.
        io_tree->add_node(
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carr_key
          i_node_text      = |Flug { ls_connection-connid } am { ls_connection-fldate DATE = USER }|
          e_new_node_key   = lv_conn_key
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in einen JSON-String und parsen Sie diesen dann zurück in eine andere interne Tabelle, um die Roundtrip-Fähigkeit zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` für das Parsen und `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` mit der Option `json` für die Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_and_parse
      IMPORTING
        it_flights_in TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_out) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_parse.
    DATA(lv_json_string) TYPE string.

    " 1. Interne Tabelle in JSON-String konvertieren
    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE flights = it_flights_in RESULT XML lv_json_string OPTIONS( json = 'X' ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_deserialization_error cx_xslt_serialization_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    " 2. JSON-String zurück in interne Tabelle parsen
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( lv_json_string ).
        DATA(lt_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array_as_table( '/' ).
        LOOP AT lt_json_array INTO DATA(ls_json_element).
          DATA(lo_element_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
          lo_element_parser->parse_json( ls_json_element-value ).
          APPEND VALUE #(
            carrid = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_string( 'CARRID' ) " Beachten Sie Groß-/Kleinschreibung bei der Transformation
            connid = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_string( 'CONNID' )
            fldate = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_date( 'FLDATE' )
          ) TO rt_flights_out.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_in) = VALUE zcl_json_roundtrip=>tt_flight_data(

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-Array von Objekten und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse basierend auf einem Kriterium, bevor Sie sie in eine interne Tabelle laden.
hint: Parsen Sie das gesamte Array und verwenden Sie dann `FILTER` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_and_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_min_value   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_items) TYPE tt_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_filter_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_filter.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
    DATA(lt_all_items) TYPE tt_items.

    TRY.
        lo_json_parser->parse_json( iv_json_string ).
        DATA(lt_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array_as_table( '/' ).
        LOOP AT lt_json_array INTO DATA(ls_json_element).
          DATA(lo_element_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( ).
          lo_element_parser->parse_json( ls_json_element-value ).
          APPEND VALUE #(
            id    = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_string( 'id' )
            value = lo_element_parser->get_value_as_int( 'value' )
          ) TO lt_all_items.
        ENDLOOP.

        rt_filtered_items = FILTER #( lt_all_items WHERE value >= iv_min_value ).

      CATCH cx_clb_json_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_filter_data( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"id": "A", "value": 10}, {"id": "B", "value": 5}, {"id": "C", "value": 15}]`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_and_filter( iv_json_string = lv_json iv_min_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_filter_data( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_and_filter( iv_json_string = lv_json iv_min_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Nach dem Parsen des JSON-Arrays in eine interne Tabelle wird `FILTER` verwendet, um die Elemente zu selektieren, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen. CLASS zcl_tree_node_properties DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS display_tree_with_properties
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_properties IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_properties.
    DATA(lo_tree) = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lv_root_key) = 'ROOT'.
    lo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
      i_node_text      = 'Wurzelknoten'
      e_new_node_key   = lv_root_key
    ).

      i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key

    ).

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `delete_node` von `cl_gui_list_tree`.

CLASS zcl_tree_delete_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree_with_delete
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS delete_tree_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_node_key TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_delete_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_delete.
    mo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lv_root_key) = 'ROOT'.
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
      i_node_text      = 'Wurzelknoten'
      e_new_node_key   = lv_root_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_to_delete_key) = 'DELETE_ME'.
    mo_tree->add_node(
      i_relat_node_key = lv_root_key
      i_node_text      = 'Diesen Knoten löschen'
      e_new_node_key   = lv_node_to_delete_key
    ).

    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( lv_root_key ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( lv_root_key ).
    mo_tree->update_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_tree_node.
    IF mo_tree IS BOUND.
      TRY.
          mo_tree->delete_node( iv_node_key ).
          mo_tree->update_tree( ).
        CATCH cx_gui_error.
          " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Knoten nicht gefunden
          MESSAGE |Fehler beim Löschen des Knotens '{ iv_node_key }'.| TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die eine Operation ausführt, die potenziell eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie alle möglichen Ausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab und geben Sie eine generische Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception) WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        " Simulate a potential error, e.g., division by zero
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = |Operation successful with input { iv_input }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception) WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_operation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_operation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_operation.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result sub = 'successful' msg = 'Successful operation failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_operation.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result sub = 'unexpected error' msg = 'Error operation not handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `WHEN OTHERS` in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block ist ein Fallback für alle nicht explizit abgefangenen Ausnahmen. Es ist nützlich, um unerwartete Fehler abzufangen und eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung zu gewährleisten, sollte aber sparsam eingesetzt werden, um spezifische Fehler nicht zu verschleiern.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, WHEN OTHERS, EXCEPTION, ERROR HANDLING, CX_ROOT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die Daten aus der `sflights`-Tabelle liest. Fangen Sie alle Datenbankausnahmen mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab und protokollieren Sie den Fehler mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und fangen Sie `CX_SY_SQL_ERROR` oder `CX_ROOT` mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab. Werfen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest. " Custom exception for clearer error propagation
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    TRY.
        SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
          FROM sflight
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate
          INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " Specific business error, not a DB exception
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate } not found.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error) WHEN OTHERS.
        " Generic catch for any other SQL errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |Database error: { lx_sql_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_db_error_simulation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_sflight_reader=>ty_sflight( ).
    TRY.
        ls_flight = lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_fldate = '20250101' ). " Assuming this flight exists in sflights
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-price ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '20251231' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_msg->get_text( ) sub = 'not found' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exception_caught msg = 'Expected exception for non-existing flight not caught' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_db_error_simulation.
    " Dieser Test ist konzeptionell, da die Simulation eines echten DB-Fehlers komplex ist.
    " Hier wird nur sichergestellt, dass der TRY/CATCH-Block aktiv ist.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_sflight_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'INVALID' iv_connid = '0000' iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_exception_caught msg = 'Expected exception not caught' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Datenbankzugriffe mit `TRY...CATCH` absichert. `WHEN OTHERS` fängt hier generische `cx_sy_sql_error` ab, die bei unerwarteten Datenbankproblemen auftreten können. Spezifische Geschäftsfehler (Flug nicht gefunden) werden separat behandelt und als benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme weitergegeben.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die versucht, eine Datei zu lesen. Fangen Sie spezifische Dateisystemausnahmen ab und verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler. Geben Sie eine detaillierte Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities` oder ähnliche Klassen und fangen Sie `cx_static_check` oder `cx_dynamic_check` mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_reader_robust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader_robust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_content.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_file_utilities=>read_file_x( EXPORTING i_filename = iv_file_path IMPORTING e_content = lv_xstring ).
        rv_content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in( )->convert( lv_xstring ).

      CATCH cx_abap_file_utilities_error INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        " Specific file utility errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |File access error: { lx_file_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        " Codepage conversion errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |Codepage conversion error: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error) WHEN OTHERS.
        " Catch all other unexpected errors
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
            message = |An unexpected error occurred during file processing: { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " This test is conceptual. To truly test WHEN OTHERS for file operations,

Die `execute_report`-Methode soll `generate_report_data` aufrufen und dann eine gemeinsame Formatierung anwenden. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Klasse `zcl_sflight_report_gen` für `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie das Template Method Pattern. Die abstrakte Methode wird von der konkreten Template-Methode aufgerufen.

CLASS zcl_report_generator_abs DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS execute_report RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_report) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_generator_abs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_report.
    DATA(lt_raw_data) = generate_report_data( ).
    DATA(lv_header) = '--- Report Data ---' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    DATA(lv_footer) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && '--- End of Report ---'.
    DATA(lv_body) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <line> IN lt_raw_data
      NEXT s = s && <line> && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    rv_formatted_report = lv_header && lv_body && lv_footer.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_report_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_report_generator_abs CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_report_data REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_report_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_report_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    rt_data = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_data
      ( |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid } | &&
        |{ ls_sflight-fldate } | &&
        |{ ls_sflight-price }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen externen Web-Service aufruft. Fangen Sie spezifische Kommunikationsausnahmen ab und verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler. Geben Sie eine strukturierte Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_http_client` oder `cl_web_http_client` und fangen Sie `cx_http_dest_state_error`, `cx_http_client_error` oder `cx_root` mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_web_service_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_ws_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             message     TYPE string,
             payload     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_ws_response.

    METHODS call_external_service
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_ws_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_web_service_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_external_service.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    rs_response-status_code = 500.
    rs_response-message = 'Initial error'.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |HTTP client creation failed (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc })|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |HTTP send failed (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc })|.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_abap_message_digest=>default_text
              message = |HTTP receive failed (SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc })|.
        ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        rs_response-message = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).
        rs_response-payload = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rs_response-message = |HTTP Destination Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_client_error INTO DATA(lx_client_error).
        rs_response-message = |HTTP Client Error: { lx_client_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest INTO DATA(lx_msg_digest).
        rs_response-message = lx_msg_digest->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error) WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_response-message = |An unexpected error occurred during web service call: { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
      cl_http_client=>close_and_free(
        EXPORTING
          client = lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_source_abs DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_auth_checker_robust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_authorization.
    rv_authorized = abap_false.
    TRY.
        AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT iv_object
                 ID iv_field1 FIELD iv_value1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_authorized = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_authorization_error INTO DATA(lx_auth_error).
        " Specific authorization error
        " Log error: cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_auth_error->get_text( ) ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error) WHEN OTHERS.
        " Catch all other unexpected errors
        " Log error: cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_other_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine Methode, die einen externen Systembefehl ausführt (z.B. über `cl_abap_os_commands`). Fangen Sie spezifische OS-Befehls-Ausnahmen ab und verwenden Sie `WHEN OTHERS` als Fallback für alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler. Geben Sie den Status und die Ausgabe des Befehls zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_os_commands` und fangen Sie `cx_abap_os_commands_error` oder `cx_root` mit `WHEN OTHERS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_os_command_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_command_result,
             exit_code TYPE i,
             output    TYPE string,
             error_msg TYPE string,
           END OF ty_command_result.

    METHODS execute_os_command
      IMPORTING
        iv_command TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_command_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_os_command_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_os_command.
    DATA: lv_output TYPE string,
          lv_error  TYPE string,
          lv_exit_code TYPE i.

    rs_result-exit_code = -1.
    rs_result-error_msg = 'Initial error'.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_os_commands=>execute_command(
          EXPORTING
            i_command = iv_command
          IMPORTING
            e_output  = lv_output
            e_error   = lv_error
            e_exit_code = lv_exit_code ).

        rs_result-exit_code = lv_exit_code.
        rs_result-output = lv_output.
        rs_result-error_msg = lv_error.

      CATCH cx_abap_os_commands_error INTO DATA(lx_os_error).
        rs_result-error_msg = |OS Command Error: { lx_os_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error) WHEN OTHERS.
        rs_result-error_msg = |An unexpected error occurred during OS command execution: { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` und String-Templates, um die Daten zu formatieren. Nutzen Sie `set_text_as_stream` für die Übergabe an das Control.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_in_textedit
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS get_formatted_sflights_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_in_textedit.
    io_textedit_control->set_text_as_stream( text = get_formatted_sflights_text( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_sflights_text.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rv_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER } { ls_sflight-cityfrom } -> { ls_sflight-cityto }\n|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Inhalt eines `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT`-Controls ausliest und die Anzahl der Zeilen sowie die Gesamtzahl der Wörter zurückgibt. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei, dass der Text Leerzeilen enthalten kann.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_text_as_stream` und String-Funktionen wie `COUNT` und `SPLIT` mit `LINES OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_analyze DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_stats,
             lines TYPE i,
             words TYPE i,
           END OF ty_text_stats.

    METHODS analyze_textedit_content
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_text_stats.

    METHODS get_text_stats
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_text_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_analyze IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_textedit_content.
    DATA(lv_text) = io_textedit_control->get_text_as_stream( ).
    rs_stats = get_text_stats( lv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_stats.
    DATA: lt_lines TYPE string_table,
          lv_words TYPE i.

    SPLIT iv_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_lines.
    rs_stats-lines = lines( lt_lines ).

    LOOP AT lt_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      IF lv_line IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lt_words_in_line) = VALUE string_table( FOR word IN ( SPLIT lv_line AT ` ` ) WHERE ( word IS NOT INITIAL ) ( word ) ).
        lv_words = lv_words + lines( lt_words_in_line ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rs_stats-words = lv_words.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die überprüft, ob der Cache für einen bestimmten Enterprise Search Connector aktiv ist. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als Boolean zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `IS_CACHE_ACTIVE` der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_connector_cache_active
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE esh_cn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_connector_cache_active.
    TRY.
        rv_is_active = cl_esh_ca_check=>is_cache_active( iv_connector_id ).
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., connector not found or cache not configured
        rv_is_active = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_cache_active.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_status( ).
    " Mock CL_ESH_CA_CHECK=>IS_CACHE_ACTIVE to return true
    " In a real system, you'd use a test double framework like ABAP Unit Test Assistant
    " For demonstration, we assume a connector that is typically active or mock the static method.
    " As direct mocking of static methods is complex without specific tools, we'll simulate.
    " For this example, we'll assume a dummy connector ID and expect false if not found.
    " A real test would involve setting up a mock for cl_esh_ca_check=>is_cache_active.

    " Since direct mocking of static methods is not straightforward in standard ABAP Unit,
    " we'll test the error handling path and assume a valid connector would return true.
    " For a robust test, a test double for cl_esh_ca_check would be used.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->is_connector_cache_active( 'DUMMY_ACTIVE_CONNECTOR' ).
    " Assuming 'DUMMY_ACTIVE_CONNECTOR' is not a real active connector, it should return false due to CX_ESH_CA_ERROR
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = abap_false msg = 'Expected cache to be inactive for dummy connector' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_status( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Cache-Statistiken für einen gegebenen Enterprise Search Connector abruft. Die Methode soll eine Struktur mit Informationen wie der Anzahl der Einträge und dem letzten Aktualisierungszeitpunkt zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_CACHE_STATISTICS` der Klasse `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_stats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cache_stats,
             entries TYPE i,
             last_update TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_cache_stats.

    METHODS get_connector_cache_stats
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE esh_cn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_cache_stats
      RAISING
        cx_esh_ca_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_stats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_connector_cache_stats.
    DATA: ls_esh_stats TYPE esh_s_ca_statistics.

    cl_esh_ca_check=>get_cache_statistics(
      EXPORTING
        iv_connector_id = iv_connector_id
      IMPORTING
        es_statistics   = ls_esh_stats
    ).

    rs_stats-entries = ls_esh_stats-number_of_entries.
    rs_stats-last_update = ls_esh_stats-last_update_timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_cache_statistics FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_get_cache_statistics_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_cache_statistics.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_stats( ).
    DATA(ls_stats) = VALUE zcl_esh_cache_stats=>ty_cache_stats(
      entries = 100
      last_update = '20251204100000.0000000'
    ).

    " Mock cl_esh_ca_check=>get_cache_statistics to return predefined values.
    " This requires a test double framework or a local mock class.
    " For simplicity, we'll simulate the expected output for a dummy connector.
    " In a real test, you'd use a test double for cl_esh_ca_check.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_connector_id) = 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_WITH_STATS'.
        " Simulate the behavior of cl_esh_ca_check=>get_cache_statistics
        " by directly assigning to ls_esh_stats if mocking was possible.
        " Since it's not, we'll just test the structure mapping.
        " A proper test would involve a test double for cl_esh_ca_check.
        DATA(ls_result_stats) = lo_cut->get_connector_cache_stats( lv_connector_id ).

        " As we cannot mock the static method, the actual call will likely raise an error.
        " We assert that the error is handled or that the structure is correctly mapped if it were to succeed.
        " For this test, we expect an error for a dummy connector.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_esh_ca_error for dummy connector' ).

      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_esh_ca_error for dummy connector' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_cache_statistics_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_stats( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_connector_cache_stats( 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_esh_ca_error for non-existent connector' ).
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Correctly caught cx_esh_ca_error' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie detaillierte Cache-Statistiken für einen Enterprise Search Connector mit `CL_ESH_CA_CHECK=>GET_CACHE_STATISTICS` abgerufen werden können. Die Methode gibt eine benutzerdefinierte Struktur (`ty_cache_stats`) zurück, die die relevanten Informationen enthält. Die Verwendung von `RAISING cx_esh_ca_error` in der Methodensignatur ist eine moderne Art der Ausnahmebehandlung, die den Aufrufer zwingt, potenzielle Fehler zu behandeln.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die für eine Liste von Enterprise Search Connectoren den Cache-Status (aktiv/inaktiv) abruft und eine interne Tabelle mit den Connector-IDs und ihrem Status zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie dabei funktionale Programmierkonzepte.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb des `FOR`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_multi_cache_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connector_status,
             connector_id TYPE esh_cn_id,
             is_active    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_connector_status,
           tt_connector_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connector_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_multiple_connector_status
      IMPORTING
        it_connector_ids TYPE esh_cn_id_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_connector_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_multi_cache_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multiple_connector_status.
    rt_status = VALUE tt_connector_status(
      FOR connector_id IN it_connector_ids
      LET lv_is_active = COND abap_bool(
                             WHEN abap_true THEN
                               TRY.
                                   cl_esh_ca_check=>is_cache_active( connector_id )
                                 CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
                                   abap_false
                               ENDTRY
                             ELSE abap_false )
      IN ( connector_id = connector_id, is_active = lv_is_active )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multiple_connectors FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_connectors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_multi_cache_check( ).
    DATA(lt_connector_ids) = VALUE esh_cn_id_tab(
      ( 'CONNECTOR_A' )
      ( 'CONNECTOR_B' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_multiple_connector_status( lt_connector_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of results' ).
    " As static methods cannot be easily mocked, we expect both to be inactive for dummy IDs.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'Connector A status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'Connector B status incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_multi_cache_check( ).
    DATA(lt_connector_ids) = VALUE esh_cn_id_tab( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_multiple_connector_status( lt_connector_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result should be empty for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_multi_cache_check( ).
    DATA(lt_connector_ids) = VALUE esh_cn_id_tab(
      ( 'CONNECTOR_X' )
      ( 'CONNECTOR_Y' )
      ( 'CONNECTOR_Z' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_multiple_connector_status( lt_connector_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of results for mixed status' ).
    " Again, assuming all dummy connectors will result in inactive status due to lack of mocking.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'Connector X status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'Connector Y status incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-is_active exp = abap_false msg = 'Connector Z status incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert fortgeschrittene funktionale Programmierung in ABAP mit dem `FOR`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. Innerhalb des `FOR`-Blocks wird der `COND`-Operator verwendet, um bedingt den Cache-Status abzurufen und potenzielle Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` abzufangen. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu verarbeiten und Fehler zu behandeln.
keywords: CL_ESH_CA_CHECK, FOR, COND, TRY...CATCH, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die versucht, den Cache für einen Enterprise Search Connector zu invalidieren. Bei einem Fehler soll eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zurückgegeben werden, die den Fehlergrund enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei die Möglichkeit, Ausnahmen in Strings zu konvertieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und die Methode `GET_TEXT` der Ausnahme-Klasse, um die Fehlermeldung zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_cache_error_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invalidate_cache_with_error_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_connector_id TYPE esh_cn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_error_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invalidate_cache_with_error_info.
    TRY.
        cl_esh_ca_check=>invalidate_cache( iv_connector_id ).
        rv_error_message = 'Cache erfolgreich invalidiert.'.
      CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_esh_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalidate_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalidate_failure_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalidate_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_error_info( ).
    " Assuming a valid connector would succeed if cl_esh_ca_check was mocked.
    " For dummy, it will fail.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->invalidate_cache_with_error_info( 'DUMMY_SUCCESS_CONNECTOR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Cache erfolgreich invalidiert.' msg = 'Expected failure message for dummy connector' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Error message should not be empty on failure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalidate_failure_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_esh_cache_error_info( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->invalidate_cache_with_error_info( 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Error message should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'ESH' msg = 'Error message should contain ESH context' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel konzentriert sich auf die detaillierte Fehlerbehandlung bei der Cache-Invalidierung. Es verwendet einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block, um die Ausnahme `CX_ESH_CA_ERROR` abzufangen. Im Fehlerfall wird die Methode `GET_TEXT()` der Ausnahmeinstanz aufgerufen, um eine aussagekräftige Fehlermeldung zu erhalten. Dies ist eine Best Practice, um Benutzern oder aufrufenden Systemen präzise Informationen über aufgetretene Probleme zu liefern.
keywords: CL_ESH_CA_CHECK, Error Handling, Exceptions, CX_ESH_CA_ERROR, GET_TEXT, String

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sim_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_simulated_avg_price.
    DATA: lv_avg_price TYPE sflight-price.

    SELECT AVG( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_avg_price.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
      DATA(lv_random_factor) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      COMPUTE rv_sim_price = lv_avg_price * ( 1 + ( ( lv_random_factor * 0.2 ) - 0.1 ) ).
    ELSE.
      rv_sim_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 100 (inklusive). Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Listenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Schleife und prüfen Sie auf Duplikate, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist. `cl_abap_random_int` ist hier ideal.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_nums DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_nums IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).

    DO iv_count * 20 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).
      IF NOT line_exists( lt_temp_numbers[ table_line = lv_random_num ] ).
        APPEND lv_random_num TO lt_temp_numbers.
        IF lines( lt_temp_numbers ) = iv_count.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_numbers = lt_temp_numbers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_numbers_properties FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_nums( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 10 ).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_inner_num).
        IF lv_inner_num = lv_num.
          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_numbers_properties.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_nums( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 3 iv_min = 50 iv_max = 52 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_numbers[ table_line = 50 ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_numbers[ table_line = 51 ] ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = line_exists( lt_numbers[ table_line = 52 ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Generierung einer Liste von eindeutigen Zufallszahlen. Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` für die Zufallszahlengenerierung und moderne Tabellenoperationen (`line_exists`, `lines`) zur Überprüfung der Eindeutigkeit und der Anzahl der Elemente. Die Schleife mit einer Abbruchbedingung ist eine effiziente Methode, um die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen zu erhalten.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Berechnung durch, die von einer zufällig generierten Zahl abhängt. Wenn die Zahl kleiner als 0.5 ist, multiplizieren Sie einen Eingabewert mit 2; andernfalls dividieren Sie ihn durch 2. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_float` und `COMPUTE`.
