CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_price_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_price_update.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_manip( ).

    DATA(lt_updated_sflight) = lo_cut->update_sflight_prices_dynamic(
      it_sflight_data = lt_sflight
      iv_carrid       = 'LH'
      iv_percentage   = 10
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE sflight.

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflight WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0400 price should be 220.00' act = <fs_line>-price exp = '220.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflight WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH 0002 price should be 330.00' act = <fs_line>-price exp = '330.00' ).

    READ TABLE lt_updated_sflight WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'AA 0001 price should remain 150.00' act = <fs_line>-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Manipulation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs_field>` kann man generisch auf Felder zugreifen und deren Werte ändern. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die zu manipulierenden Felder zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden. Die direkte Zuweisung an das Feld-Symbol `<fs_field>` ist effizient, da sie ohne Datenkopie erfolgt.
keywords: Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Data Manipulation, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Datenreferenz entgegennimmt und die Anzahl der Zeilen sowie die Namen der Spalten zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) mit `cl_abap_structdescr` oder `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_column_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_column_info,
           ty_t_column_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_column_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref    TYPE REF TO data
      EXPORTING
        ev_line_count   TYPE i
        et_column_info  TYPE ty_t_column_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_info.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      ev_line_count = lines( <fs_table> ).

      DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
      DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).

      LOOP AT lo_line_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_column_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( )
        ) TO et_column_info.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generic_table_info FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_table_info.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_info( ).
    DATA: lv_line_count  TYPE i,
          lt_column_info TYPE zcl_generic_table_info=>ty_t_column_info.

    lo_cut->get_table_info(
      ir_table_ref   = REF #( lt_sflight )
      EXPORTING
        ev_line_count  = lv_line_count
        et_column_info = lt_column_info
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Line count should be 5' act = lv_line_count exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Column info should not be initial' act = lines( lt_column_info ) ).

    DATA(ls_carrid_info) = VALUE zcl_generic_table_info=>ty_s_column_info( name = 'CARRID' ).
    READ TABLE lt_column_info WITH KEY name = 'CARRID' INTO ls_carrid_info.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID column should be found' act = ls_carrid_info-name exp = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID type should be S_CARR_ID' act = ls_carrid_info-type exp = 'S_CARR_ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) in Kombination mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, um Informationen über eine zur Laufzeit unbekannte interne Tabelle zu erhalten. Die Methode `get_table_info` akzeptiert eine Datenreferenz auf eine beliebige Tabelle. Mit `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` können Metadaten wie Zeilenanzahl und Spaltennamen sowie deren Typen dynamisch ermittelt werden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks und Tools.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, cl_abap_structdescr, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch filtert, basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden. Die gefilterte Tabelle soll zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `FILTER` mit einer dynamischen Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_fieldname    TYPE string
        iv_value        TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflight_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( it_sflight_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE (iv_fieldname) = iv_value ).

    " Alternativ (falls FILTER mit dynamischem Feldnamen nicht direkt funktioniert oder für ältere Versionen):
    " DATA(lt_temp_table) = it_sflight_data.
    " LOOP AT lt_temp_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    "   ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
    "   IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> = iv_value.
    "     APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered_table.
    "   ENDIF.
    " ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_filter( ).

    " Filtern nach CARRID = 'LH'
    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_sflight_dynamic(
      it_sflight_data = lt_sflight
      iv_fieldname    = 'CARRID'
      iv_value        = 'LH'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered flight should be LH' act = lt_filtered_lh[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Filtern nach CONNID = '0001'
    DATA(lt_filtered_connid) = lo_cut->filter_sflight_dynamic(

Seit ABAP 7.50 kann der `FILTER` Operator auch dynamische Feldnamen in der `WHERE`-Klausel verwenden, was eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Lösung für generische Filteranforderungen darstellt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch aggregiert (z.B. Summe eines Feldes), basierend auf einem Feldnamen, der zur Laufzeit übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `REDUCE` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_fieldname    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0.00 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                       FOR <fs_line> IN it_sflight_data
                       LET lv_current_value = 0.00 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 IN
                         BLOCK
                           ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
                           IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_field> IS NOT INITIAL.
                             TRY.
                                 lv_current_value = <fs_field>.
                               CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                                 " Feld ist nicht numerisch, überspringen
                             ENDTRY.
                           ENDIF.
                         ENDBLOCK
                       NEXT s = s + lv_current_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_reduce.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_reduce( ).

    " Summe des Feldes PRICE
    DATA(lv_sum_price) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_field(
      it_sflight_data = lt_sflight
      iv_fieldname    = 'PRICE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of prices should be 650.00' act = lv_sum_price exp = '650.00' ).

    " Summe eines nicht-numerischen Feldes (sollte 0 sein)
    DATA(lv_sum_carrid) = lo_cut->sum_dynamic_field(
      it_sflight_data = lt_sflight
      iv_fieldname    = 'CARRID'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of CARRID should be 0' act = lv_sum_carrid exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Aggregation von Daten in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`. Der zu summierende Feldname wird zur Laufzeit übergeben. Die `BLOCK` Syntax innerhalb von `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, komplexere Logik für den dynamischen Feldzugriff zu kapseln und Typkonvertierungsfehler abzufangen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, REDUCE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, SFLIGHT, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch transformiert, indem sie den Wert eines Feldes basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit übergebenen Logik ändert. Zum Beispiel, alle Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umwandeln.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `FOR` mit dynamischem Feldzugriff und `CONDENSE` oder `TO UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_fieldname    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflight_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_transformed_table = VALUE #( FOR <fs_line> IN it_sflight_data
                                    LET lv_transformed_value = '' TYPE string IN
                                      BLOCK
                                        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
                                        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                                          lv_transformed_value = to_upper( <fs_field> ).
                                        ENDIF.
                                      ENDBLOCK
                                    ( <fs_line> WITH ( (iv_fieldname) = lv_transformed_value ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_transform.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_transformed_carrid) = lo_cut->transform_sflight_dynamic(

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_group_result,
             group_key TYPE string,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_group_result,
           ty_t_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_group_fieldname TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_group_result) TYPE ty_t_group_result.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_sflight_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_key>  TYPE any.

    rt_group_result = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF <fs_line> IN it_sflight_data
                                GROUP BY ( <fs_line>-(iv_group_fieldname) ) AS group_key
                                ( group_key = group_key
                                  count     = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle dynamisch nach mehreren Feldern sortiert, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge (aufsteigend/absteigend) und die Feldnamen zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `SORT` mit einer dynamischen Sortierliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sort_criteria,
             fieldname TYPE string,
             descending TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_s_sort_criteria,
           ty_t_sort_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sort_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflight_multi_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        it_sort_criteria TYPE ty_t_sort_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_multi_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflight_multi_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_sort_clause TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_sort_criteria INTO DATA(ls_criteria).
      IF lv_sort_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_sort_clause = lv_sort_clause && ', '.
      ENDIF.
      lv_sort_clause = lv_sort_clause && ls_criteria-fieldname.
      IF ls_criteria-descending = abap_true.
        lv_sort_clause = lv_sort_clause && ' DESCENDING'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_sorted_table = it_sflight_data.
    SORT rt_sorted_table BY (lv_sort_clause).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.
    INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = '20250104' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_sort_criteria) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_multi_sort=>ty_t_sort_criteria(

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine Liste von Flügen aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einem ALV an. Fügen Sie eine zusätzliche Spalte 'Status' hinzu, die basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze ('SEATSOCC' vs. 'SEATSMAX') den Status 'Verfügbar', 'Begrenzt' oder 'Ausgebucht' anzeigt. Nutzen Sie eine `COND`-Expression für die Statuslogik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und eine `COND`-Expression in einem `FOR`-Loop, um die Statusspalte zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights RETURNING VALUE(ro_salv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( 
        carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        seatsocc = flight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax = flight-seatsmax,
        status   = COND string(
                       WHEN flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Verfügbar'
                       WHEN flight-seatsocc < flight-seatsmax THEN 'Begrenzt'
                       ELSE 'Ausgebucht'
                   )
    ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_flight_data
        ).
        ro_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_filtered_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,

CLASS zcl_alv_filtered_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight.
    DATA lt_filtered_flights TYPE tt_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights

    lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE
        ( cityfrom = 'FRA' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 100 ) OR
        ( cityfrom = 'JFK' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) < 50 )
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING

        ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze und die Gesamtzahl der maximalen Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `FOR GROUPS OF`, um die Aggregation durchzuführen. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem ALV an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer internen Tabelle, die nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
             total_seatsmax TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_flight.
    TYPES tt_agg_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_agg_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_flights RETURNING VALUE(ro_salv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_aggregated_flights TYPE tt_agg_flight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    lt_aggregated_flights = REDUCE #( 
        INIT result = VALUE tt_agg_flight( )
        FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY carrid
        GROUP BY carrid
        ( 
            result = VALUE #( result ( 
                carrid       = flight-carrid,
                total_seatsocc = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP flight ( s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ),
                total_seatsmax = REDUCE i( INIT m = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP flight ( m + <fs_flight>-seatsmax ) )
            ) )
        )
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_aggregated_flights
        ).
        ro_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flüge aus `sflight` in einem ALV an. Basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter (z.B. 'SHORT', 'MEDIUM', 'FULL') sollen nur bestimmte Spalten sichtbar sein. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` um die Feldkatalogeigenschaften dynamisch zu setzen.
hint: Erstellen Sie den Feldkatalog dynamisch und setzen Sie die `set_visible`-Eigenschaft basierend auf der `COND`-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_dynamic_cols
      IMPORTING
        iv_display_mode TYPE string DEFAULT 'FULL' " 'SHORT', 'MEDIUM', 'FULL'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_dynamic_cols.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = ro_salv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lt_column_names) = VALUE string_table(
            ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ( 'CITYFROM' ) ( 'CITYTO' ) ( 'SEATSOCC' ) ( 'SEATSMAX' )
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
          DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_name ).
          lo_column->set_visible(
            COND abap_bool(
              WHEN iv_display_mode = 'SHORT' AND ( lv_column_name = 'CARRID' OR lv_column_name = 'CONNID' ) THEN abap_true
              WHEN iv_display_mode = 'MEDIUM' AND ( lv_column_name = 'CARRID' OR lv_column_name = 'CONNID' OR lv_column_name = 'FLDATE' OR lv_column_name = 'CITYFROM' ) THEN abap_true
              WHEN iv_display_mode = 'FULL' THEN abap_true
              ELSE abap_false
            )
          ).
        ENDLOOP.

        ro_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_style DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_style IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_style.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA lt_flight_data_with_style TYPE tt_flight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    lt_flight_data_with_style = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( 
        carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        seatsocc = flight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax = flight-seatsmax,
        style    = COND #( 
                       WHEN flight-seatsocc = flight-seatsmax THEN VALUE lvc_t_styl( ( fieldname = 'CARRID' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_error ) )
                       WHEN ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) > ( flight-seatsmax * 0.75 ) THEN VALUE lvc_t_styl( ( fieldname = 'CARRID' style = cl_gui_alv_grid=>mc_style_ok ) )
                       ELSE VALUE lvc_t_styl( )
                   )
    ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_flight_data_with_style
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = ro_salv->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_key_fixation( abap_true ).

        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>style_fieldname ).

        ro_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV, das Flugdaten anzeigt. Simulieren Sie einen Fehler bei der Datenbeschaffung und fangen Sie die Ausnahme mit `TRY...CATCH` ab. Zeigen Sie im Fehlerfall eine leere Tabelle oder eine Fehlermeldung an, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Nutzen Sie `CASE` (implizit durch Exception-Typen) in der Fehlerbehandlung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um potenzielle Fehler abzufangen. Die `cl_salv_table=>factory` Methode kann `cx_salv_msg` werfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_error_handling.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight.

    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_false.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
        UP TO 5 ROWS.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate an error, e.g., by passing an invalid table type or no data
      " For cl_salv_table, passing an empty table is not an error, but we can
      " simulate a data retrieval error that results in no data.
      CLEAR lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).
        IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Keine Flugdaten gefunden oder Fehler bei der Beschaffung.' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        ENDIF.
        ro_salv->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        " Fallback: Create an empty ALV or handle gracefully
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_table=>SALV_OM_OBJECTS
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = ro_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights " Still empty, but ALV object created
        ).
        ro_salv->display( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die älter als ein Jahr sind, um 'kalte' Daten zu simulieren. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen und Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aged_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_reference_date TYPE sy-datum DEFAULT sy-datum
        iv_age_in_days    TYPE i DEFAULT 365
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aged_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aged_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_aged_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate < iv_reference_date - iv_age_in_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_aged_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_aged_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_filter( ).
    DATA(ld_one_year_ago) = sy-datum - 365.

    " Simulate some test data in sflight if not available or for consistent testing
    " For this example, we assume sflight has data.
    " A more robust test would insert specific data.

    DATA(lt_aged_flights) = lo_cut->get_aged_flights( iv_reference_date = sy-datum iv_age_in_days = 365 ).

    " Assert that all returned flights are indeed older than one year
    LOOP AT lt_aged_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate < ld_one_year_ago ) msg = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate } is not aged.| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that some flights are returned (if sflight is not empty)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_aged_flights ) exp = 0 msg = 'No aged flights found, check test data or logic.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators, um effizient Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung zu selektieren. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und relevant für die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, wie sie im Kontext von Data Aging auftreten können. Die Datumsberechnung `sy-datum - 365` ist ebenfalls eine moderne Kurzform.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_count.
    TYPES tt_sflight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hot_data_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_reference_date TYPE sy-datum DEFAULT sy-datum
        iv_days_back      TYPE i DEFAULT 30
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_sflight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hot_data_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    DATA(ld_threshold_date) = iv_reference_date - iv_days_back.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 WHERE ( fldate >= ld_threshold_date )
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = GROUP carrid,
                                   count  = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch auf eine interne Tabelle zugreift und nur Felder zurückgibt, die für 'kalte' Daten relevant sind (z.B. nur Schlüssel, keine sensiblen Felder). Dies simuliert eine reduzierte Sicht auf gealterte Daten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und dynamische Feldzugriffe, um die Struktur der Ausgabetabelle zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_aged_data
      IMPORTING
        it_full_data TYPE tt_sflight_full
        it_fields    TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_reduced_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_aged_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lr_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_type   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    " 1. Create dynamic structure for the reduced data
    LOOP AT it_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      DATA(ls_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = lv_field_name
        type = CAST cl_abap_typedescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( |SFLIGHT-{lv_field_name}| ) )
      ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_data_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_data_descr ).

    " 2. Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_reduced_data TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_reduced_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_table>).

    " 3. Populate the dynamic internal table
    LOOP AT it_full_data ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA lr_line_type TYPE HANDLE lr_data_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_line_type->* TO <fs_target_line>.

      LOOP AT it_fields INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_target_line> INTO TABLE <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_reduced_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_reduced_data->* TO <fs_reduced_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_reduced_table> msg = 'Reduced data table should not be empty.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_reduced_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows in reduced data.' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_reduced_line> TYPE any.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lr_descr->get_components( ) ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of components in reduced structure.' ).

    " Check content of a field

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem simulierten 'Data Aging Status' (z.B. ein Datum) entscheidet, ob Daten als 'heiß' oder 'kalt' gelten. Die Methode soll einen ENUM-Wert zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF` und `CASE` mit modernen Datumsfunktionen und einem lokalen ENUM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ENUM t_data_temperature,
             hot,
             cold,
             frozen,
           END OF ENUM t_data_temperature.

    METHODS get_data_temperature
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_date      TYPE sy-datum
        iv_hot_threshold  TYPE i DEFAULT 30 " Days for hot data
        iv_cold_threshold TYPE i DEFAULT 365 " Days for cold data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE t_data_temperature.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_temperature.
    DATA(ld_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(ld_days_old) = ld_today - iv_data_date.

    CASE ld_days_old.
      WHEN 0 TO iv_hot_threshold.
        rv_temperature = t_data_temperature-hot.
      WHEN iv_hot_threshold + 1 TO iv_cold_threshold.
        rv_temperature = t_data_temperature-cold.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_temperature = t_data_temperature-frozen.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_data_temperature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_status( ).

    " Test hot data
    DATA(ld_hot_date) = sy-datum - 10.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temp_hot exp = zcl_data_aging_status=>t_data_temperature-hot msg = 'Date 10 days ago should be HOT.' ).

    " Test cold data
    DATA(ld_cold_date) = sy-datum - 100.
    DATA(lv_temp_cold) = lo_cut->get_data_temperature( iv_data_date = ld_cold_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temp_cold exp = zcl_data_aging_status=>t_data_temperature-cold msg = 'Date 100 days ago should be COLD.' ).

    " Test frozen data
    DATA(ld_frozen_date) = sy-datum - 400.
    DATA(lv_temp_frozen) = lo_cut->get_data_temperature( iv_data_date = ld_frozen_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temp_frozen exp = zcl_data_aging_status=>t_data_temperature-frozen msg = 'Date 400 days ago should be FROZEN.' ).

    " Test custom thresholds
    DATA(lv_temp_custom) = lo_cut->get_data_temperature( iv_data_date = sy-datum - 50 iv_hot_threshold = 40 iv_cold_threshold = 60 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temp_custom exp = zcl_data_aging_status=>t_data_temperature-cold msg = 'Date 50 days ago with custom thresholds should be COLD.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Logik zur Bestimmung des Status nutzt moderne Datumsberechnungen und eine `CASE`-Anweisung, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` in ein vereinfachtes Format, das für die Archivierung von 'kalten' Daten geeignet ist, indem Sie nur relevante Felder behalten und umbenennen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` mit `BASE` und `EXCEPT` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_archive,
             flight_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_archive.
    TYPES tt_sflight_archive TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_archive WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_full.
    TYPES tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_for_archive
      IMPORTING
        it_full_data TYPE tt_sflight_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_archive_data) TYPE tt_sflight_archive.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_for_archive.
    rt_archive_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_full IN it_full_data
                                ( flight_id   = ls_full-carrid,
                                  flight_num  = ls_full-connid,
                                  flight_date = ls_full-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_for_archive FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_for_archive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_transform( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_data_aging_transform=>tt_sflight_full.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20240101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20240201' price = '200' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_archive_data) = lo_cut->transform_for_archive( it_full_data = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_archive_data msg = 'Archive data table should not be empty.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_archive_data ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of rows in archive data.' ).

    DATA(ls_first_entry) = lt_archive_data[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-flight_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect flight_id in archive data.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-flight_num exp = '0400' msg = 'Incorrect flight_num in archive data.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_entry-flight_date exp = '20240101' msg = 'Incorrect flight_date in archive data.' ).

    " Check that original fields like price are not present
    DATA lr_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    lr_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ls_first_entry ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_descr->get_components( ).
    DATA(lv_price_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_comp).
      IF ls_comp-name = 'PRICE'.
        lv_price_exists = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_price_exists msg = 'PRICE field should not exist in archive structure.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Transformation von Daten in ein neues Format unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators mit einer `FOR`-Schleife. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen zu mappen und umzustrukturieren. Im Kontext von Data Aging ist dies nützlich, um 'kalte' Daten für die Archivierung zu vereinfachen und nur die notwendigen Informationen zu speichern, was Speicherplatz spart und die Performance verbessert.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Data Transformation, Internal Tables, Data Aging (simulated), SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.

                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = GROUP carrid,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS display_flight_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        it_chart_data TYPE tt_flight_count
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.

CLASS zcl_chart_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_itab(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = it_chart_data
        i_x_name = 'CARRID'
        i_y_name = 'COUNT'
    ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Fluganzahl pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_flight_chart FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_flight_chart.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_display( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_chart_display=>tt_flight_count.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' count = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' count = 5 ) TO lt_test_data.

    " Mock the GUI container for unit testing. In a real scenario, this would be a screen element.
    " For unit testing, we can only verify that the methods are called correctly.
    " We cannot actually render a GUI chart in a unit test environment.
    " Here, we'll just call it and catch potential GUI exceptions.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    " In a real test, you might use a test double framework to check method calls.
    " For simplicity here, we just ensure no exception is raised with valid input.
    TRY.
        " This will likely fail if not run in a GUI context with a real container
        " For a true unit test, you'd mock cl_gui_chart_engine_win and cl_gui_custom_container
        " to verify method calls without actual GUI interaction.
        " Here, we'll just call it and catch potential GUI exceptions.
        lo_cut->display_flight_chart( io_container = lo_mock_container " This would be a real container in a Dynpro
                                      it_chart_data = lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Chart display method called without exception (mocked container).' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |GUI Exception: { lx_gui->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtumsatz pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` und bereiten Sie die Daten für ein Tortendiagramm vor. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_sales,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_sales TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_sales.
    TYPES tt_carrier_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_sales WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_sales_for_chart
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_sales) TYPE tt_carrier_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_reduce_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_sales_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_carrier_sales = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                                 ( carrid = GROUP carrid,
                                   total_sales = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                                           FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                           NEXT sum = sum + ls_group_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für die Diagrammerstellung mit `cl_gui_chart_engine_win`, falls die Daten ungültig sind oder das Custom Control nicht verfügbar ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um potenzielle Ausnahmen von GUI-Klassen abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_chart_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL
        it_chart_data TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.

    TRY.
        IF io_container IS NOT BOUND.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception EXPORTING text = 'GUI Container not bound.'.
        ENDIF.

        CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

        IF it_chart_data IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception EXPORTING text = 'Chart data is empty.'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_itab(
          EXPORTING
            i_t_data = it_chart_data
            i_x_name = 'LABEL'
            i_y_name = 'VALUE'
        ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Dynamisches Diagramm' ).
        lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
        " Log the error or display a message to the user
        MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " In a real application, you might also write to an application log (e.g., SLG1)
        " or provide a fallback display.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_error_handling_empty_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling_no_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_error_handling( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_chart_error_handling=>tt_chart_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( label = 'A' value = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.

    " Expecting an error message due to missing container
    DATA(lv_message_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_chart_with_error_handling( it_chart_data = lt_test_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_plugin INTO DATA(lx_msg_in_plugin).
        " This exception is raised when MESSAGE E is called in a unit test
        lv_message_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'GUI Container not bound.' act = lx_msg_in_plugin->get_text( ) msg = 'Expected error message not found.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_message_caught msg = 'No exception caught for missing container.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling_empty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_error_handling( ).
    DATA lt_empty_data TYPE zcl_chart_error_handling=>tt_chart_data.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    DATA(lv_message_caught) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_chart_with_error_handling( io_container = lo_mock_container it_chart_data = lt_empty_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_plugin INTO DATA(lx_msg_in_plugin).
        lv_message_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Chart data is empty.' act = lx_msg_in_plugin->get_text( ) msg = 'Expected error message not found.' ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_message_caught msg = 'No exception caught for empty data.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_successful_display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_error_handling( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_chart_error_handling=>tt_chart_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( label = 'X' value = 1 ) TO lt_test_data.
    DATA lo_mock_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    " In a real test, you'd mock cl_gui_chart_engine_win and cl_gui_custom_container
    " to verify method calls without actual GUI interaction.
    " Here, we just ensure no exception is raised with valid input (mocked container).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_chart_with_error_handling( io_container = lo_mock_container it_chart_data = lt_test_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Chart display method called without exception (mocked container).' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |GUI Exception: { lx_gui->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_plugin INTO DATA(lx_msg_in_plugin).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Unexpected message: { lx_msg_in_plugin->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die verschiedene Diagrammtypen (Balken, Linie) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter dynamisch setzen kann, unter Verwendung von `cl_gui_chart_engine_win`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung mit den Konstanten von `cl_gui_chart_engine` für die Diagrammtypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES t_chart_type TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE IS INITIAL.
    CONSTANTS: gc_type_bar  TYPE t_chart_type VALUE 'BAR',
               gc_type_line TYPE t_chart_type VALUE 'LINE'.

    METHODS display_dynamic_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        it_chart_data TYPE tt_chart_data
        iv_chart_type TYPE t_chart_type DEFAULT gc_type_bar
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_dynamic_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.
    DATA: lv_chart_type_const TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine EXPORTING parent = io_container.

    CASE iv_chart_type.
      WHEN gc_type_bar.
        lv_chart_type_const = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar.
      WHEN gc_type_line.
        lv_chart_type_const = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception EXPORTING text = 'Unsupported chart type provided.'.
    ENDCASE.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( lv_chart_type_const ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_from_itab(
      EXPORTING
        i_t_data = it_chart_data
        i_x_name = 'LABEL'
        i_y_name = 'VALUE'
    ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( |Dynamisches { iv_chart_type } Diagramm| ).
    lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und bereiten Sie die Daten für ein Liniendiagramm des Preises über das Datum vor. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `FILTER`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` für die Selektion und `FOR` mit `VALUE` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_line_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_by_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_by_date.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_by_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_by_date WITH UNIQUE KEY fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_prices_for_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_flight_price_by_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_line_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_prices_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                  price  = ls_flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (aus `sflight`) nur die Flugverbindungen auflistet, die im Jahr 2025 stattfinden. Die Ausgabe soll eine geschachtelte Tabelle sein: Fluggesellschaft -> Liste der Verbindungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `FOR` Ausdrücke mit `FILTER` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connections,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connections TYPE tt_connections,
           END OF ty_carrier_connections.
    TYPES tt_carrier_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connections WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_2025_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_conns) TYPE tt_carrier_connections.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_2025_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_conns = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        connections = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' )
          ( connid = ls_flight-connid, fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_nested_filter FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH connections are empty' act = ls_lh_group-connections ).
      LOOP AT ls_lh_group-connections INTO DATA(ls_conn).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date not in 2025' act = ( ls_conn-fldate >= '20250101' AND ls_conn-fldate <= '20251231' ) ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: FOR, GROUPS OF, FILTER, NESTING, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (Summe aus `seatsocc` und `seatsmax`) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' (American Airlines), die im Jahr 2025 stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_aa_2025_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aa_2025_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' )
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsocc + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_capacity( ).
    DATA(lv_capacity) = lo_cut->get_aa_2025_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total capacity should be greater than or equal to 0' act = ( lv_capacity >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight` dynamisch nach einem Feld und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit einem dynamischen `WHERE`-Ausdruck, der als String übergeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA lv_condition TYPE string.
    lv_condition = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_value }'|. 

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE (lv_condition) ). 
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_filter_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamic( iv_field_name = 'CARRID' iv_value = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result for LH should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier is not LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_filter_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_filter( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_dynamic( iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' iv_value = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid field name' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_type.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected exception for invalid field name' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`-Bedingung des `FILTER`-Operators kann dynamisch als String übergeben werden. Dies ermöglicht flexible Filterungen zur Laufzeit, basierend auf Benutzereingaben oder Konfigurationen.
keywords: FILTER, Dynamic WHERE, Field Symbols, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflight`, die von Fluggesellschaften durchgeführt werden, die auch Flüge mit der Flugnummer '0017' anbieten, und deren Flugdatum im Jahr 2025 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen geschachtelten `FILTER` Ausdruck, bei dem der äußere Filter auf dem Ergebnis eines inneren Filters basiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.

      RETURNING

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA lt_carrids_with_0017 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_carrids_with_0017 = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE connid = '0017' ) ( ls_flight-carrid ) ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid IN lt_carrids_with_0017 AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie alle Flüge aus `sflight` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Für jede Gruppe sollen nur die Flüge berücksichtigt werden, deren Flugdatum im Jahr 2025 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit einem inneren `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_filter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_date.
    TYPES tt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             key   TYPE ty_flight_key,
             dates TYPE tt_flight_dates,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_2025_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_filter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_2025_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid )
      ( key = VALUE #( carrid = ls_group-carrid connid = ls_group-connid )
        dates = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' )
          ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_filter_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_2025_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group) WITH KEY key-carrid = 'LH' key-connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH 0400 dates should not be empty' act = ls_group-dates ).
      LOOP AT ls_group-dates INTO DATA(ls_date).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date not in 2025' act = ( ls_date-fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ) ).
      ENDLOOP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflight` nur die Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die von 'LH' oder 'AA' durchgeführt werden. Wenn das Flugdatum vor 2025 liegt, soll es auf '99991231' gesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_mapped_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_mapped_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA' )
      ( connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-fldate < '20250101' THEN '99991231' ELSE ls_flight-fldate ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_mapped_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_mapped_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_map_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_mapped_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_all.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      READ TABLE lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_original_flight) WITH KEY connid = ls_flight_info-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Original flight not found' act = ( sy-subrc = 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Carrier not LH or AA' act = ( ls_original_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_original_flight-carrid = 'AA' ) ).

      IF ls_original_flight-fldate < '20250101'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Date not mapped correctly' act = ls_flight_info-fldate exp = '99991231' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Date not kept correctly' act = ls_flight_info-fldate exp = ls_original_flight-fldate ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `FILTER` Operator, um eine Untermenge der Daten zu selektieren, mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, der die Daten transformiert. Die `COND` Expression wird verwendet, um eine bedingte Zuweisung des Flugdatums vorzunehmen, was den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar macht.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Mapping, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die Flüge mit einer durchschnittlichen Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) von über 70% im Jahr 2025 haben. Die Ausgabe soll die Fluggesellschaft und ihre durchschnittliche Auslastung enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für die Berechnung der Durchschnittswerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_occupancy,
             carrid          TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_carrier_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_carrier_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_high_occupancy_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carrier_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_occupancy_carriers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carriers = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      LET lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' AND seatsmax > 0 ) IN
      LET lv_total_seats_occ = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT s = s + flight-seatsocc ) IN
      LET lv_total_seats_max = REDUCE i( INIT m = 0 FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT m = m + flight-seatsmax ) IN
      LET lv_avg_occupancy = COND f( WHEN lv_total_seats_max > 0 THEN ( lv_total_seats_occ / lv_total_seats_max ) ELSE 0 ) IN
      WHERE lv_avg_occupancy > 0.7
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, avg_occupancy = lv_avg_occupancy )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_count IMPLEMENTATION.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      LET lv_count_2025 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ) IN
      LET lv_count_pre25 = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate < '20250101' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ) IN
      WHERE lv_count_2025 > 0
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        count_2025 = lv_count_2025,
        count_pre25 = lv_count_pre25 )

hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit geschachtelten `FILTER` und `INTERSECT` (oder ähnlicher Logik) für die Mengenoperation.

CLASS zcl_filter_intersect_conns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_common_conns,
             carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE tt_connids,
           END OF ty_carrier_common_conns.
    TYPES tt_carrier_common_conns TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_common_conns WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_common_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_conns) TYPE tt_carrier_common_conns.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_intersect_conns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_common_connections.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_conns = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      LET lt_conns_2025 = VALUE tt_connids( FOR flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ) ( flight-connid ) ) IN
      LET lt_conns_2024 = VALUE tt_connids( FOR flight IN FILTER #( ls_group WHERE fldate BETWEEN '20240101' AND '20241231' ) ( flight-connid ) ) IN
      LET lt_common_conns = VALUE tt_connids( FOR conn_2025 IN lt_conns_2025 WHERE LINE_EXISTS( lt_conns_2024[ table_line = conn_2025 ] ) ( conn_2025 ) ) IN
      WHERE NOT INITIAL( lt_common_conns )
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        connids = lt_common_conns )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_common_connections FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_common_connections.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_intersect_conns( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_common_connections( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    DATA lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_all.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_carrier_conns).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Common connections should not be empty' act = ls_carrier_conns-connids ).
      LOOP AT ls_carrier_conns-connids INTO DATA(lv_connid).
        DATA(lv_in_2025) = xsdbool( NOT INITIAL( FILTER #( lt_sflights_all WHERE carrid = ls_carrier_conns-carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231' ) ) ).
        DATA(lv_in_2024) = xsdbool( NOT INITIAL( FILTER #( lt_sflights_all WHERE carrid = ls_carrier_conns-carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate BETWEEN '20240101' AND '20241231' ) ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connection not found in 2025' act = lv_in_2025 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Connection not found in 2024' act = lv_in_2024 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Ermittlung gemeinsamer Elemente zwischen zwei gefilterten Mengen. Es verwendet `FOR GROUPS OF` zur Gruppierung, `LET` und `FILTER` um die Flugnummern für 2025 und 2024 zu extrahieren. Anschließend wird eine 'Schnittmenge' (Intersection) der beiden Listen gebildet, indem die 2025er-Flugnummern gefiltert werden, die auch in der 2024er-Liste existieren (`LINE_EXISTS`). Dies ist eine elegante Art, Mengenoperationen in modernem ABAP durchzuführen.

CLASS zcl_excel_sflights_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lo_excel    TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA: lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    DATA: lv_row      TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA: lv_col      TYPE i VALUE 1.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_sheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_name = 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Write Header
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CARRID' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CONNID' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'FLDATE' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'PRICE' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CURRENCY' ).

    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write Data
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-price ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
