CLASS zcl_excel_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row.
    TYPES: tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_excel_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name    TYPE string
        iv_start_row     TYPE i
        iv_start_col     TYPE i
        iv_end_row       TYPE i
        iv_end_col       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data)   TYPE tt_excel_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_dummy_excel_xstring RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_excel_data.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA: lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    DATA: ls_row   TYPE ty_excel_row.

    TRY.
        lo_excel = cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet=>create_from_xstring( iv_excel_xstring ).
        lo_sheet = lo_excel->get_sheet_by_name( iv_sheet_name ).

        DO iv_end_row - iv_start_row + 1 TIMES.
          DATA(lv_current_row) = iv_start_row + sy-index - 1.
          CLEAR ls_row.
          ls_row-col1 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_current_row ip_column = iv_start_col ).
          IF iv_end_col >= iv_start_col + 1.
            ls_row-col2 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_current_row ip_column = iv_start_col + 1 ).
          ENDIF.
          IF iv_end_col >= iv_start_col + 2.
            ls_row-col3 = lo_sheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_current_row ip_column = iv_start_col + 2 ).
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_row TO rt_data.
        ENDDO.

      CATCH cx_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
        " Handle error, e.g., sheet not found or invalid Excel data
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_excel_xstring.
    DATA: lo_excel TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA: lo_sheet TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_sheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_name = 'TestSheet' ).

    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Header1' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Header2' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Header3' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Data A1' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Data B1' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Data C1' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Data A2' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Data B2' ).
    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 3 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Data C2' ).

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_excel_read_data( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Excel-Datei mit mehreren Arbeitsblättern, wobei jedes Blatt SFLIGHTS-Daten für eine andere Fluggesellschaft enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_sheet` mehrmals mit unterschiedlichen Namen und filtern Sie die SFLIGHTS-Daten für jedes Blatt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_excel RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_excel.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lo_excel    TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 30 ROWS.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE string_table( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid INTO ( carrid = GROUP KEY ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrid).
      DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_name = lv_carrid ).
      DATA(lv_row) = 1.
      DATA(lv_col) = 1.

      " Write Header
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CARRID' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CONNID' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'FLDATE' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'PRICE' ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = 'CURRENCY' ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.

      " Write Data for current carrier
      LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
        lv_col = 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-carrid ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-connid ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-fldate ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-price ). lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_col ip_value = ls_sflight-currency ).
        lv_row = lv_row + 1;
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_sheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Some data' ).

Instructions: Exportieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS) effizient in eine Excel-Datei, indem Sie `set_range_values` verwenden, um mehrere Zellen gleichzeitig zu schreiben.
hint: Bereiten Sie die Daten als Tabelle von Tabellen (oder ähnliche Struktur) vor und nutzen Sie `set_range_values` für eine performante Befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_excel_range_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_range RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_excel_range_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_range.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lo_excel    TYPE REF TO cl_fdt_xl_spreadsheet.
    DATA: lo_sheet    TYPE REF TO if_fdt_xl_sheet.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_excel,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_excel.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_excel TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_excel WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_excel_data TYPE tt_sflight_excel.
    DATA: lt_headers    TYPE string_table.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Prepare headers
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_headers.
    APPEND 'CONNID' TO lt_headers.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_headers.
    APPEND 'PRICE' TO lt_headers.
    APPEND 'CURRENCY' TO lt_headers.

    " Prepare data for range writing
    lt_excel_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights (
      carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
      connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
      fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
      price    = ls_sflight-price,
      currency = ls_sflight-currency
    ) ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_excel.
    lo_sheet = lo_excel->add_sheet( iv_name = 'SFLIGHTS Range' ).

    " Write headers using set_range_values (single row)
    lo_sheet->set_range_values( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_values = VALUE #( ( lt_headers ) ) ).

    " Write data using set_range_values
    lo_sheet->set_range_values( ip_row = 2 ip_column = 1 ip_values = lt_excel_data ).

    rv_xstring = lo_excel->get_package_as_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Anstatt jede Zelle einzeln zu schreiben, können hier ganze Datenbereiche auf einmal übertragen werden, was die Performance bei großen Datenmengen erheblich verbessert. Die Daten werden hierfür in eine Tabelle von Strukturen umgewandelt.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_lang_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_language  TYPE sy-langu

        VALUE(rv_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.

      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
        iv_language  TYPE sy-langu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_lang_file_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_lang_file.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>delete_file(
          iv_file_path = iv_file_path,
          iv_language  = iv_language
        ).
        rv_deleted = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " File might not exist, or other error. Log or handle as needed.
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. " Use 'S' for info in test
        rv_deleted = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_file.
    DATA: lo_lang_file TYPE REF TO cl_cts_language_file_io.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_lang_file EXPORTING
          iv_file_path = iv_file_path
          iv_language  = iv_language.
        lo_lang_file->create_file( ).
        lo_lang_file->write_line( 'Content to be deleted' ).
        lo_lang_file->close_file( ).
      CATCH cx_cts_language_file_io.
        " Ignore errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und fügen Sie Einträge hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_dynamic_line,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_dynamic_line.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return reference to dynamic table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    " 1. Describe the line type (e.g., a local structure)
    DATA: ls_template_line TYPE ty_s_dynamic_line.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_template_line ).

    " 2. Create a table type description
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                      p_line_type  = lo_struct_descr
                                      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                      p_unique     = abap_false ).

    " 3. Create data reference for the dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    " 4. Assign to field symbol to work with it
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 5. Add an entry dynamically
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_col1>).
    IF <fs_col1> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_col1> = 'Dynamic Entry 1'.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_col2>).
    IF <fs_col2> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_col2> = 100.
    ENDIF.

    INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Add another entry using a different method (if structure is known)
    DATA(ls_new_line) = VALUE ty_s_dynamic_line( col1 = 'Dynamic Entry 2' col2 = 200 ).
    INSERT ls_new_line INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dyn_itab( ).
    DATA(l_dref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN l_dref->* TO <lt_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned(
      act = <lt_table>
      msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <lt_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 entries in dynamic table' ).

    " Verify content of the first entry
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_col1> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_col1>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_col1>
      exp = 'Dynamic Entry 1'
      msg = 'Expected value for COL1 in first entry' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_col2> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_col2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_col2>
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Expected value for COL2 in first entry' ).

    " Verify content of the second entry
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 2 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_col1>. 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_col1>
      exp = 'Dynamic Entry 2'
      msg = 'Expected value for COL1 in second entry' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'COL2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <fs_col2>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_col2>
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Expected value for COL2 in second entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.

    METHODS is_compatible_with_interface
      IMPORTING
        ir_object_ref TYPE REF TO object
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_compatible_with_interface.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_intf_descr) = cl_abap_intfdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_interface_name ).
        DATA(lo_object_descr) = cl_abap_objectdescr=>describe_by_object_ref( ir_object_ref ).
        rv_is_compatible = lo_object_descr->is_compatible( lo_intf_descr ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        rv_is_compatible = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_is_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.

    TRY.

        LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method).
          APPEND ls_method-name TO rt_method_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_param_error.
        " Handle invalid class name
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um alle Flüge zu finden, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit einer einfachen `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_from_frankfurt
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_from_frankfurt.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_frankfurt FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_frankfurt.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_filter_basic=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Add some test data if sflight is empty or doesn't contain 'FRANKFURT'
    IF lines( lt_sflights ) < 2.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_from_frankfurt( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_msg_type_error ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'City from should be FRANKFURT' act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ersetzt die traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und das anschließende `APPEND` in vielen Szenarien.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, WHERE, ABAP 7.40

CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

  METHOD filter_flights_by_carriers.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE carrid IN it_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_in_operator FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_in_operator.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_filter_in_operator=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Add some test data
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' cityfrom = 'SINGAPORE' cityto = 'LONDON' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_preferred_carriers) = VALUE zcl_filter_in_operator=>tt_carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_in_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carriers( it_sflights = lt_sflights it_carriers = lt_preferred_carriers ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste der eindeutigen Verbindungsnummern (CONNID) für Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und mehr als 100 verfügbare Sitzplätze haben.
hint: Verketten Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eindeutige Werte zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_connids.
    rt_unique_connids = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > 100 ) GROUP BY ( connid = ls_flight-connid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_for_distinct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_for_distinct.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_filter_for_distinct=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 180 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' seatsocc = 120 seatsmax = 240 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250104' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 110 seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_sflights. " Duplicate connid, should only appear once
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0900' fldate = '20250105' cityfrom = 'LONDON' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 110 ) TO lt_sflights. " Not from FRANKFURT

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_unique_connids( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 unique connection IDs' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'CONNID 0400 should be in result' act = ( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = '0400' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'CONNID 0050 should be in result' act = ( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = '0050' ] ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'CONNID 0401 should not be in result (seats)' act = ( line_exists( lt_result[ table_line = '0401' ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verkettung von `FILTER` mit einem `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck, um nicht nur zu filtern, sondern auch eine neue Tabelle mit eindeutigen Werten aus den gefilterten Zeilen zu erstellen. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP 7.50+.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, GROUPS OF, DISTINCT, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS, um alle Flüge zu finden, deren Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in einer separaten Liste bevorzugter Fluggesellschaften enthalten ist.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_preferred_carriers.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE line_exists( it_preferred_carriers[ table_line = carrid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' cityto = 'FRANKFURT' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0050' fldate = '20250103' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250104' cityfrom = 'SINGAPORE' cityto = 'LONDON' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_preferred_carriers) = VALUE zcl_filter_line_exists=>tt_carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg` zur Validierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF OBJECT lo_object` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_method_exist`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _dummy_method_one.
    METHODS _dummy_method_two.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_method_exist( p_class_name = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( io_object ) p_method_name = iv_method_name ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>method_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF OBJECT io_object.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _dummy_method_one.
    " Dummy implementation
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _dummy_method_two.
    " Dummy implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  CLASS zcl_test_target DEFINITION.
    PUBLIC SECTION.
      DATA mv_called TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
      METHODS my_dynamic_method.
  ENDCLASS.

  CLASS zcl_test_target IMPLEMENTATION.
    METHOD my_dynamic_method.
      mv_called = abap_true.
    ENDMETHOD.
  ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_test_target( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).

    lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'MY_DYNAMIC_METHOD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Dynamic method should have been called' act = lo_target->mv_called ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und ändern Sie deren Wert, wobei der Komponentenname als String übergeben wird. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg` zur Validierung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE <ls_data> TO <lv_field_value>` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_dynamic_field_value
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING cs_data        TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_dynamic_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist( p_struct_name = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_name( cs_data ) p_component_name = iv_field_name ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <lv_field_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    <lv_field_value> = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle (SFLIGHTS) dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert, die zur Laufzeit als Strings bereitgestellt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab WHERE (lv_dynamic_condition)` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist` zur Validierung des Feldnamens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    DATA: lv_dynamic_condition TYPE string.

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist( p_struct_name = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_name( VALUE ty_sflight( ) ) p_component_name = iv_field_name ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    lv_dynamic_condition = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_value }'|.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE (lv_dynamic_condition).
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie dynamisch eine einfache lokale Klasse zur Laufzeit, instanziieren Sie diese und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_class_pool` und `CREATE OBJECT (lv_class_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_class_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_run_dynamic_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_message    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_run_dynamic_class.
    DATA: lv_source TYPE string_table,
          lv_class_pool_name TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_CLASS_POOL'.

    APPEND `CLASS ` && iv_class_name && ` DEFINITION.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `  PUBLIC SECTION.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `    METHODS ` && iv_method_name && ` IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `ENDCLASS.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `CLASS ` && iv_class_name && ` IMPLEMENTATION.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `  METHOD ` && iv_method_name && `.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `    rv_output = |Hello from dynamic class: { iv_input }|.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `  ENDMETHOD.` TO lv_source.
    APPEND `ENDCLASS.` TO lv_source.

    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_class_pool( EXPORTING p_class_pool_name = lv_class_pool_name p_source = lv_source ).

    DATA(lo_dyn_object) = cl_abap_dyn_prg=>get_class_instance( p_class_name = iv_class_name ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_result> TYPE string.
    CALL METHOD lo_dyn_object->(iv_method_name)
      EXPORTING
        iv_input = iv_message
      RECEIVING
        rv_output = <lv_result>.

    rv_result = <lv_result>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Typenprüfung zwischen zwei Datenreferenzen durch und versuchen Sie einen dynamischen Cast, wenn die Typen kompatibel sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility` und `CAST`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_dynamic_cast
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_target_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_cast.
    DATA: lr_source_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_target_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    lr_source_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_source_data ).
    lr_target_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility( p_source_type = lr_source_type_descr p_target_type = lr_target_type_descr ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_move_cast_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_move_cast_error=>cast_error.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_target_data TYPE HANDLE lr_target_type_descr.
    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source>).
    ASSIGN rr_target_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target>).
    <fs_target> = <fs_source>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compatible_cast FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_incompatible_cast FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compatible_cast.
    DATA: lv_source_int TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lr_source_int TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_int INTO lr_source_int.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_type_check( ).
    DATA(lr_target_char) = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_cast( ir_source_data = lr_source_int iv_target_type = 'CHAR10' ).

    ASSIGN lr_target_char->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_char>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cast to CHAR10 should be successful' act = <fs_target_char> exp = '123' ).

    DATA: lv_source_char TYPE char10 VALUE 'Hello',
          lr_source_char TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_char INTO lr_source_char.
    DATA(lr_target_string) = lo_cut->perform_dynamic_cast( ir_source_data = lr_source_char iv_target_type = 'STRING' ).
    ASSIGN lr_target_string->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_string>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Cast to STRING should be successful' act = <fs_target_string> exp = 'Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_incompatible_cast.
    DATA: lv_source_int TYPE i VALUE 123,
          lr_source_int TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_int INTO lr_source_int.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_type_check( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_move_cast_error ).
    lo_cut->perform_dynamic_cast( ir_source_data = lr_source_int iv_target_type = 'ZCL_DYN_TYPE_CHECK' ). " Incompatible type
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Typenprüfung und das Casting sind fortgeschrittene Techniken, die es ermöglichen, mit Daten zu arbeiten, deren Typen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility` ist hierbei unerlässlich, um die Kompatibilität der Typen vor einem potenziell fehlerhaften `CAST` oder Zuweisung zu überprüfen und so robuste dynamische Lösungen zu erstellen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Komponenten einer beliebigen Struktur und geben Sie deren Namen und Typen zurück. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg` für die Typbeschreibung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `cl_abap_structdescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_rtti_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lr_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lr_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    IF lr_type_descr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>invalid_type.
    ENDIF.

    lr_struct_descr ?= lr_type_descr.

    LOOP AT lr_struct_descr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_component-name type = ls_component-type_descr->get_relative_name( ) ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_struct_components FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_struct_input FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
           id   TYPE i,
           text TYPE string,
           date TYPE d,
         END OF ty_test_struct.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_struct_components.

          lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( lr_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 components' act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'ID' INTO DATA(ls_comp_id).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` in Verbindung mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_def.
    TYPES tt_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE tt_field_def
        it_data_rows         TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_data TYPE REF TO data.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      DATA(lr_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_field_def-type ).
      IF lr_type_descr IS INITIAL.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>invalid_type.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND VALUE #( name = ls_field_def-name type_descr = lr_type_descr ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ft_dynamic_table>).

    CREATE DATA lr_line_data TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
    ASSIGN lr_line_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_data_row).
      DATA(lt_values) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( iv_string = lv_data_row iv_delimiter = ',' ).
      CLEAR <fs_line>.
      LOOP AT lt_values INTO DATA(lv_value) FROM 1 TO lines( lt_components ).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = lv_value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_type_def FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_create=>tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID'   type = 'I' length = 0 )
      ( name = 'NAME' type = 'STRING' length = 0 )
      ( name = 'DATE' type = 'D' length = 0 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_data_rows) = VALUE string_table(
      ( '1,Alice,20230101' )
      ( '2,Bob,20230102' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
      it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs
      it_data_rows         = lt_data_rows
    ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ft_dynamic_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <ft_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 rows in dynamic table' act = lines( <ft_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    ASSIGN <ft_dynamic_table>[ 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_row1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row1> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_id1>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NAME' OF STRUCTURE <fs_row1> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_name1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Row 1 ID' act = <fs_id1> exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Row 1 Name' act = <fs_name1> exp = 'Alice' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type_def.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE zcl_dyn_table_create=>tt_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID' type = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' length = 0 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_data_rows) = VALUE string_table( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_dyn_call_error ).
    lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
      it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs
      it_data_rows         = lt_data_rows
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTS (Run-Time Type Services) und `cl_abap_dyn_prg` eine interne Tabelle mit einer vollständig dynamischen Struktur zur Laufzeit erstellen und befüllen kann. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario für generische Datenverarbeitung, bei der die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Import von externen Dateien.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Aggregation (z.B. Summe) über ein Feld einer internen Tabelle durch, wobei der Feldname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist` und dynamische `ASSIGN` mit `REDUCE` oder `LOOP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights   TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist( p_struct_name = cl_abap_structdescr=>get_struct_name( VALUE ty_sflight( ) ) p_component_name = iv_field_name ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>component_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                       LET lv_current_value = 0 IN
                         ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_field>.
                         IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> IS BOUND.
                           TRY.
                               lv_current_value = <fs_field>.
                             CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                               " Ignore non-numeric fields or handle error
                           ENDTRY.
                         ENDIF.
                         sum = sum + lv_current_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field_sum FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
    METHODS test_non_numeric_field_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dyn_aggregation=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'SEATSOCC' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected sum of SEATSOCC' act = lv_sum exp = 270 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dyn_aggregation=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_dyn_call_error ).
    lo_cut->get_dynamic_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_numeric_field_sum.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_dyn_aggregation=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_aggregation( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_sum( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_field_name = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of non-numeric field should be 0 (or handled)' act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert dynamischen Feldzugriff mit dem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Aggregation über ein zur Laufzeit bestimmtes Feld durchzuführen. `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_component_exist` validiert den Feldnamen, während der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck eine kompakte und funktionale Art der Summenbildung darstellt, auch wenn hier eine Fehlerbehandlung für nicht-numerische Felder hinzugefügt wurde.
keywords: cl_abap_dyn_prg, Dynamic Programming, Aggregation, REDUCE, Field Symbols, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Registrieren Sie dynamisch einen Event-Handler für ein Ereignis, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER (lv_handler_method) FOR (lo_event_source)` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_event_exist`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS my_dynamic_event EXPORTING VALUE(i_message) TYPE string.

    METHODS register_and_raise_dynamic_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_name TYPE string
        iv_message    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_handler_called) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_event_handled TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS handle_my_dynamic_event FOR EVENT my_dynamic_event OF zcl_dyn_event_handler IMPORTING i_message.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_and_raise_dynamic_event.
    DATA: lv_handler_method TYPE string VALUE 'HANDLE_MY_DYNAMIC_EVENT'.

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_event_exist( p_class_name = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( me ) p_event_name = iv_event_name ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>event_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_my_dynamic_event FOR me.

    RAISE EVENT (iv_event_name) EXPORTING i_message = iv_message.

    rv_handler_called = mv_event_handled.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_my_dynamic_event.
    mv_event_handled = abap_true.
    " Optionally process i_message
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht flexible Event-basierte Architekturen, bei denen Ereignisse und deren Handler zur Laufzeit konfiguriert werden können.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Wert von einem dynamisch bestimmten Quelltyp in einen dynamisch bestimmten Zieltyp, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_dyn_prg` zur Typenprüfung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility` und `CREATE DATA` mit `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` oder direkter Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_data_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_data TYPE REF TO data
        iv_target_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_data) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lr_source_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_target_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    lr_source_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_source_data ).
    lr_target_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).

    IF lr_target_type_descr IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_conversion_error=>invalid_target_type.
    ENDIF.

    IF cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility( p_source_type = lr_source_type_descr p_target_type = lr_target_type_descr ) = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_conversion_error=>conversion_not_possible.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA rr_target_data TYPE HANDLE lr_target_type_descr.
    ASSIGN ir_source_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_source>).
    ASSIGN rr_target_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target>).

    TRY.
        <fs_target> = <fs_source>.
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_conversion_error EXPORTING previous = lx_conv_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compatible_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_incompatible_conversion FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
    METHODS test_invalid_target_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compatible_conversion.
    DATA: lv_source_int TYPE i VALUE 42,
          lr_source_int TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_int INTO lr_source_int.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_convert( ).
    DATA(lr_target_char) = lo_cut->convert_dynamic_data( ir_source_data = lr_source_int iv_target_type = 'CHAR10' ).

    ASSIGN lr_target_char->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_char>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Integer to Char conversion' act = <fs_target_char> exp = '42' ).

    DATA: lv_source_date TYPE d VALUE '20231231',
          lr_source_date TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_date INTO lr_source_date.
    DATA(lr_target_string) = lo_cut->convert_dynamic_data( ir_source_data = lr_source_date iv_target_type = 'STRING' ).
    ASSIGN lr_target_string->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_target_string>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Date to String conversion' act = <fs_target_string> exp = '20231231' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_incompatible_conversion.
    DATA: lv_source_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
          lr_source_string TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_string INTO lr_source_string.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_convert( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_conversion_error ).
    lo_cut->convert_dynamic_data( ir_source_data = lr_source_string iv_target_type = 'I' ). " String to Integer is not directly compatible
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_target_type.
    DATA: lv_source_int TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lr_source_int TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_source_int INTO lr_source_int.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_data_convert( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_conversion_error ).
    lo_cut->convert_dynamic_data( ir_source_data = lr_source_int iv_target_type = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Datenkonvertierung zwischen beliebigen Typen. `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>check_type_compatibility` ist entscheidend, um vor der eigentlichen Zuweisung die Kompatibilität der Typen zu prüfen und so Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden. Dies ist nützlich in Szenarien, in denen Datenformate flexibel gehandhabt werden müssen.
keywords: cl_abap_dyn_prg, Dynamic Programming, Data Conversion, Type Check, CREATE DATA, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Ganzzahlen, um nur die geraden Zahlen zu behalten. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und dem Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_even_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_even IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_even_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even.
    rt_even_numbers = FILTER #( it_numbers WHERE ( table_line MOD 2 = 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_even FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_even FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_even.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_even_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_even( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_even_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_even( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_even.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_even_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 3 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_even( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP`s mit `IF`-Bedingungen und die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` nach `READ TABLE` oder `LOOP` zu prüfen, da das Ergebnis direkt eine neue, gefilterte Tabelle ist. Ist kein Element vorhanden, ist die Tabelle leer.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FILTER` mit mehreren Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und logischen Operatoren (`AND`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                           WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'
                             AND carrid = iv_carrier ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_frankfurt_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_frankfurt_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-cityfrom exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_flight>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( 'XX' ). "Non-existent carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `FILTER` mit mehreren Bedingungen verwendet wird, um präzise Daten aus einer internen Tabelle zu extrahieren. Die Bedingungen werden direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks kombiniert, was zu sehr lesbarem und kompaktem Code führt. Die Notwendigkeit, `sy-subrc` nach einem `LOOP` zu prüfen, entfällt, da `FILTER` direkt das Ergebnis liefert.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Multiple Conditions, sflights, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, deren Zielort in einer vorgegebenen Liste von Städten enthalten ist. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `IN`-Operators im `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und dem `IN`-Operator, der eine interne Tabelle als Vergleichsbasis akzeptiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_cities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-cityto WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_to_cities
      IMPORTING
        it_target_cities TYPE tt_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_to_cities.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                           WHERE cityto IN it_target_cities ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_to_cities FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_target_cities FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_to_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_in( ).
    DATA(lt_target_cities) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflights_in=>tt_cities( ( 'NEW YORK' ) ( 'LONDON' ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_cities( lt_target_cities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND_B( WHEN <fs_flight>-cityto = 'NEW YORK' OR <fs_flight>-cityto = 'LONDON' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_target_cities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_in( ).
    DATA(lt_target_cities) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflights_in=>tt_cities( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_cities( lt_target_cities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights_in( ).
    DATA(lt_target_cities) = VALUE zcl_filter_sflights_in=>tt_cities( ( 'NONEXISTENTCITY' ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_to_cities( lt_target_cities ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `IN`-Operator im `FILTER`-Ausdruck ermöglicht das Filtern einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Werten. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `LOOP`s oder komplexen `IF`-Bedingungen. Es vermeidet explizite `sy-subrc`-Prüfungen, da das Ergebnis direkt die gefilterte Tabelle ist.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, IN Operator, sflights, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (Anzahl der Sitze) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen. Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie zuerst `FILTER`, um die relevanten Flüge zu selektieren, und dann `REDUCE`, um die `SEATSMAX`-Werte zu summieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, cityfrom, seatsmax
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                               WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'
                                 AND carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach einem potentiell fehlerhaften Vorgang durch eine moderne Ausnahmebehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    METHODS perform_division_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_division_safe.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = divide_numbers( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle nicht gefunden wird, soll ein Standardwert zugewiesen werden. Vermeiden Sie die explizite Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach `READ TABLE`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_assignment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_text_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_assignment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_id.
    rv_text = COND string(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_data[ id = iv_id ] )
        THEN it_data[ id = iv_id ]-text
      ELSE 'Eintrag nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) basierend auf einer komplexen Bedingung, die in einer lokalen Methode gekapselt ist. Demonstrieren Sie `FILTER` mit einer Methodenaufruf-Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit `WHERE ( method_call )`, wobei die Methode einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_with_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_low_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_occupancy_percent TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS is_low_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_sflight
        iv_max_occupancy_percent TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_low) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_low_occupancy.
    IF is_flight-seatsmax = 0.
      rv_is_low = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_occupancy) = ( is_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / is_flight-seatsmax.
    IF lv_occupancy < iv_max_occupancy_percent.
      rv_is_low = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_low = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_with_low_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                           WHERE ( is_low_occupancy( is_flight = table_line
                                                     iv_max_occupancy_percent = iv_max_occupancy_percent ) = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_low_occupancy_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_high_occupancy_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_occupancy_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_low_occupancy_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_method( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_low_occupancy( 50 ). " Max 50% occupancy
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      IF <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0.
        DATA(lv_occupancy) = ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc * 100 ) / <fs_flight>-seatsmax.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_occupancy < 50 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_high_occupancy_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_method( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_low_occupancy( 10 ). " Max 10% occupancy (should be few/none)
    " Depending on sflight data, this might be initial or not. Asserting initial for a strict test.
    " If sflight data guarantees some low occupancy, adjust assertion.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_occupancy_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_with_method( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_low_occupancy( 0 ). " Max 0% occupancy (should be none)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit einer komplexen Bedingung verwendet werden kann, die in einer separaten Methode gekapselt ist. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Lesbarkeit des Codes, da die Logik der Filterbedingung ausgelagert wird. Die Methode `is_low_occupancy` wird für jede Zeile der Tabelle aufgerufen, und nur wenn sie `abap_true` zurückgibt, wird die Zeile in die gefilterte Tabelle aufgenommen. Dies ist eine elegante Möglichkeit, komplexe Filterlogik zu implementieren, ohne `sy-subrc` explizit zu prüfen.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Methods, Object Orientation, sflights, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Eintrag aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflight` und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, ohne eine explizite `sy-subrc`-Prüfung nach `SELECT SINGLE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO @DATA(...)` und prüfen Sie die Existenz des Ergebnisses mit `LINE_EXISTS` oder `IS SUPPLIED`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_read_no_sy_subrc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        is_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_read_no_sy_subrc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight
      INTO @rs_flight_data
      WHERE carrid = @is_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_key-fldate.

    IF NOT line_exists( rs_flight_data ). " Modern check for initial structure after SELECT SINGLE
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_sy_read_error=>read_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und filtern Sie dann die Gruppen, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen enthalten. Demonstrieren Sie die Kombination von `FILTER` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und dann `FILTER` auf die resultierenden Gruppen, um die Bedingung zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             flights     TYPE tt_sflight,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_large_flight_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights_in_group TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_large_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_large_flight_groups.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    DATA lt_grouped_flights TYPE tt_flight_groups.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lt_current_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
        FOR flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_group_key
        ( flight_in_group ) ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid      = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lines( lt_current_flights )
        flights     = lt_current_flights
      ) TO lt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_large_groups = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights
                                WHERE flight_count >= iv_min_flights_in_group ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_large_groups FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_small_groups FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_large_groups) = lo_cut->get_large_flight_groups( 2 ). " Groups with at least 2 flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_large_groups ).
    LOOP AT lt_large_groups ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( <fs_group>-flight_count >= 2 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_small_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_small_groups) = lo_cut->get_large_flight_groups( 1000 ). " Groups with at least 1000 flights (unlikely in sflights)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_small_groups ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_no_groups) = lo_cut->get_large_flight_groups( 1 ). " Should return all groups with at least 1 flight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_no_groups ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `FILTER`-Ausdruck. Zuerst werden die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft gruppiert und die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe ermittelt. Anschließend wird die resultierende Tabelle der Gruppen mit `FILTER` gefiltert, um nur die Gruppen zu behalten, die eine Mindestanzahl von Flügen aufweisen. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittener funktionaler Ansatz, der komplexe Aggregations- und Filteranforderungen in sehr lesbarem Code umsetzt und die Notwendigkeit manueller `sy-subrc`-Prüfungen überflüssig macht.
keywords: FILTER, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, sflights, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie die Verwendung von `MESSAGE ... TYPE 'E'` zur Fehlerbehandlung durch das Auslösen einer Ausnahme (`RAISE EXCEPTION`) in einer Methode, die einen Wert zurückgibt.
hint: Definieren Sie die Methode mit `RAISING cx_static_check` und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` anstelle von `MESSAGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_raise_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_value.

    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_raise_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_input.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value.
    ENDIF.
    rv_is_valid = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_value.
    TRY.
        validate_input( iv_value ).
        rv_processed_value = |Verarbeiteter Wert: { iv_value }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_processed_value = |Fehler bei der Verarbeitung: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der aufrufende Code kann den Fehler mit `TRY...CATCH` abfangen und angemessen darauf reagieren, ohne `sy-subrc` prüfen zu müssen.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_prefix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
        iv_prefix  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_string_prefix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_prefix.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = iv_prefix && '*'.
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings WHERE ( table_line CP lv_pattern ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (`sflights`) und transformieren Sie die gefilterten Daten sofort in ein neues Format. Demonstrieren Sie die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR`.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             route     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                               WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
                                 AND cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( flight_id = |{ flight-carrid } { flight-connid }|,
        route     = |{ flight-cityfrom } -> { flight-cityto }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             id   TYPE i,

      IMPORTING

        iv_id   TYPE i

        iv_new_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE tt_data.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_data_old_way.
    ro_data = io_data.
    MODIFY TABLE ro_data TRANSPORTING text WHERE id = iv_id.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error (e.g., entry not found)
      " In a real scenario, this would be more complex.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD modify_data_modern_way.
    ro_data = io_data.
    IF LINE_EXISTS( ro_data[ id = iv_id ] ).
      ro_data[ id = iv_id ]-text = iv_new_text.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error (e.g., entry not found) without sy-subrc
      " In a real scenario, you might raise an exception here.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
