CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynamic_condition TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    TRY.
        rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw WHERE ( iv_dynamic_condition ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Handle case where dynamic condition might lead to error (e.g., invalid field name)
        " In this specific case, FILTER with dynamic WHERE does not raise this exception for invalid condition syntax,
        " but for non-existent lines if used with table expression.
        " For invalid WHERE clause syntax, a syntax error occurs at runtime.
        " A more robust solution would involve CL_ABAP_DYN_PRG for dynamic code generation/validation.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `sy-subrc` nach einem `COLLECT` auf einer internen Tabelle und zeigen Sie, dass `COLLECT` implizit `sy-subrc` setzt, aber in modernem ABAP oft durch `REDUCE` oder `GROUP BY` ersetzt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COLLECT` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc`. Erklären Sie dann, wie `REDUCE` oder `GROUP BY` eine modernere Alternative bieten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_collect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             material TYPE matnr,
             quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES tt_sales_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_summary,
             material TYPE matnr,
             total_quantity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_summary.
    TYPES tt_sales_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY material.

    METHODS collect_sales_old_way
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_items TYPE tt_sales_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sales_summary) TYPE tt_sales_summary.

    METHODS collect_sales_modern_way
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_items TYPE tt_sales_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sales_summary) TYPE tt_sales_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_collect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD collect_sales_old_way.
    LOOP AT it_sales_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      COLLECT ls_item INTO rt_sales_summary.
      " sy-subrc is set here: 0 if new line, 4 if existing line updated
      " In traditional code, one might check sy-subrc for specific logic.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD collect_sales_modern_way.
    rt_sales_summary = VALUE tt_sales_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_item IN it_sales_items GROUP BY ls_item-material
      ( material = ls_item-material,
        total_quantity = REDUCE i(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR item_in_group IN GROUP ls_item
          NEXT sum = sum + item_in_group-quantity ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_weekend_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekend_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_filter_weekend_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekend_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw.

    rt_weekend_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights_raw
                                   WHERE ( cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( table_line-fldate ) = 6 OR
                                           cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( table_line-fldate ) = 7 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_weekend_flights_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_weekend_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekend_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_weekend_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_weekend_flights) = lo_cut->get_weekend_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_weekend_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_weekend_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( <fs_flight>-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND_B( WHEN lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_weekend_flights.
    " This test assumes sflight might not have weekend flights for a specific date range
    " or if the data is manipulated to exclude them. For a general test, it's harder to guarantee.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking sflight data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_weekend_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_weekend_flights) = lo_cut->get_weekend_flights( ).
    " If sflight always has weekend flights, this test might fail. Adjust as per data.
    " For demonstration, we assume there might be cases where no weekend flights are found.
    IF lines( lt_weekend_flights ) = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_weekend_flights ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_weekend_flights ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie der `FILTER`-Ausdruck mit Datumsfunktionen kombiniert werden kann, um Einträge basierend auf Datumsbedingungen zu filtern. Die statische Methode `cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday` liefert den Wochentag, der dann für die Filterung verwendet wird. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Datumslogik direkt in den Filterausdruck zu integrieren, ohne explizite `LOOP`s und `sy-subrc`-Prüfungen.
keywords: FILTER, Date/Time, Internal Tables, cl_abap_date_helper, sflights, sy-subrc avoidance

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse `ZCL_PRODUCT` mit einem privaten Konstruktor. Erstellen Sie eine separate Fabrikklasse `ZCL_PRODUCT_FACTORY`, die als Freund von `ZCL_PRODUCT` deklariert ist und die einzige Möglichkeit bietet, Instanzen von `ZCL_PRODUCT` zu erzeugen.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    " Attempting to create directly should cause a syntax error or runtime error

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_product) = NEW zcl_product( 'Invalid Product' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Direct creation of ZCL_PRODUCT should not be possible.' ).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: FRIENDS, Factory Pattern, Private Constructor, Object Creation, Design Patterns, Encapsulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer privaten Methode. Schreiben Sie einen Unit-Test, der diese private Methode direkt testet, indem die Testklasse als Freund der zu testenden Klasse deklariert wird.

solution:
CLASS zcl_private_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_public IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _add_private IMPORTING iv_a TYPE i iv_b TYPE i
                         RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
    " Declare the local test class as a friend
    FRIENDS ltcl_test.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_public.
    rv_result = _add_private( iv_a = iv_val1 iv_b = iv_val2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD _add_private.
    rv_sum = iv_a + iv_b.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_private_calc( ).
    " Access to private method _add_private is allowed because ltcl_test is a friend
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->_add_private( iv_a = 5 iv_b = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).

Instructions: Eine Klasse `ZCL_CONFIG_DATA` enthält private Konfigurationsdaten. Eine separate Serialisierungsklasse `ZCL_CONFIG_SERIALIZER` soll diese privaten Daten für die Speicherung in einem JSON-Format lesen können, ohne dass die Daten öffentlich sind.
hint: Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_CONFIG_SERIALIZER` als Freund von `ZCL_CONFIG_DATA` und nutzen Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION` für JSON.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_setting1 TYPE string iv_setting2 TYPE i.
    METHODS get_setting1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_setting) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mv_setting1 TYPE string,
          mv_setting2 TYPE i.
    FRIENDS zcl_config_serializer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_setting1 = iv_setting1.
    mv_setting2 = iv_setting2.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_setting1.
    rv_setting = mv_setting1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_config IMPORTING io_config TYPE REF TO zcl_config_data
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_config.
    DATA: ls_data TYPE zcl_config_data=>ty_config_structure.
    " Access to private attributes is allowed
    ls_data-setting1 = io_config->mv_setting1.
    ls_data-setting2 = io_config->mv_setting2.

    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE data = ls_data RESULT XML rv_json_string.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use a proper JSON transformation or library
    " For simplicity, this example simulates JSON output with XML for demonstration
    " of private access. A real JSON serialization would involve more complex logic
    " or CL_ABAP_JSON.
    rv_json_string = |{{"setting1":"{ ls_data-setting1 }","setting2":{ ls_data-setting2 }}}|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialization.
    DATA(lo_config) = NEW zcl_config_data( iv_setting1 = 'ValueA' iv_setting2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_config_serializer( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_serializer->serialize_config( lo_config ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_json exp = '{"setting1":"ValueA","setting2":123}' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Beziehung ermöglicht der `ZCL_CONFIG_SERIALIZER` den Zugriff auf die privaten Konfigurationsdaten der `ZCL_CONFIG_DATA` Klasse. Dies ist nützlich für Aufgaben wie die Serialisierung, bei der interne Zustände für externe Zwecke (z.B. Speicherung) gelesen werden müssen, ohne die Kapselung der Klasse zu verletzen. Die JSON-Erzeugung ist hier vereinfacht, um den Fokus auf `FRIENDS` zu legen.
keywords: FRIENDS, Serialization, JSON, Private Data, Object Orientation, Data Exchange

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die aktuelle System-Ländereinstellung und die zugehörigen Formatierungseinstellungen (z.B. Dezimalzeichen, Datumsformat).
hint: Verwenden Sie Methoden wie `CL_I18N_UTILS=>GET_LOCALE_INFO` oder `GET_LOCALE_HANDLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_locale_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_locale_details,
             language TYPE sy-langu,
             country TYPE sy-cprog,
             decimal_char TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             date_format TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             time_format TYPE c LENGTH 2,
           END OF ty_locale_details.
    METHODS get_current_locale_details RETURNING VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_locale_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_locale_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_locale_details.
    DATA(lv_locale_handle) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_locale_handle( sy-langu ).
    DATA(ls_locale_info) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_locale_info( lv_locale_handle ).

    rs_details-language = sy-langu.
    rs_details-country = sy-cprog.
    rs_details-decimal_char = ls_locale_info-decimal_char.
    rs_details-date_format = ls_locale_info-date_format.
    rs_details-time_format = ls_locale_info-time_format.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_locale_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_locale_details.
    DATA(lo_locale_info) = NEW zcl_i18n_locale_info( ).
    DATA(ls_details) = lo_locale_info->get_current_locale_details( ).

    " Assertions depend on the system's current locale settings
    " For example, if system language is DE:
    IF sy-langu = 'DE'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-language exp = 'DE' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-decimal_char exp = ',' ).
    ELSEIF sy-langu = 'EN'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-language exp = 'EN' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_details-decimal_char exp = '.' ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_details-date_format ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_details-time_format ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Eine Klasse `ZCL_REPORT_DATA` verwaltet interne Daten, die privat gehalten werden sollen. Eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_ALV_ADAPTER` soll diese privaten Daten exklusiv für die Anzeige in einem ALV-Grid aufbereiten und bereitstellen.

CLASS zcl_report_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_line,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_data_line,
           tt_data_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_data IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_desc TYPE string iv_value TYPE decfloat34.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mt_internal_data TYPE tt_data_lines.
    FRIENDS zcl_alv_adapter.

CLASS zcl_report_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Initialize with some dummy data
    add_data( iv_id = 1 iv_desc = 'Item A' iv_value = '100.50' ).
    add_data( iv_id = 2 iv_desc = 'Item B' iv_value = '200.75' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD add_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_data_line( id = iv_id description = iv_desc value = iv_value ) TO mt_internal_data.

CLASS zcl_alv_adapter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_alv_output,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             formatted_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_alv_output,
           tt_alv_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_alv_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

                           RETURNING VALUE(rt_alv_data) TYPE tt_alv_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_adapter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_data.
    " Access to private internal table mt_internal_data is allowed
    rt_alv_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_data IN io_report_data->mt_internal_data
                             ( id = ls_data-id
                               description = ls_data-description
                               formatted_value = |{ ls_data-value COUNTRY = 'DE' }|
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Werten (Zahlen, Daten, Währungen) dynamisch basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit übergebenen Ländereinstellung formatiert.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_I18N_UTILS` Methoden mit `FOR` oder `REDUCE` Ausdrücken und dynamischer Typisierung oder Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_value,
             type TYPE string, " 'NUMBER', 'DATE', 'CURRENCY'
             value TYPE string,
             currency TYPE waers,
           END OF ty_dynamic_value,
           tt_dynamic_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS format_values_dynamically IMPORTING it_values TYPE tt_dynamic_values
                                      IMPORTING iv_locale TYPE sy-langu
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_values_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_locale_handle) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_locale_handle( iv_locale ).

    rt_formatted_values = VALUE #( FOR ls_value IN it_values
                                   LET lv_formatted_item = COND string(
                                     WHEN ls_value-type = 'NUMBER' THEN
                                       cl_i18n_utils=>number_format( number = CONV decfloat34( ls_value-value ) locale = lv_locale_handle grouping = abap_true decimals = 2 )
                                     WHEN ls_value-type = 'DATE' THEN
                                       cl_i18n_utils=>date_format( date = CONV d( ls_value-value ) locale = lv_locale_handle )
                                     WHEN ls_value-type = 'CURRENCY' THEN
                                       cl_i18n_utils=>currency_format( amount = CONV decfloat34( ls_value-value ) currency = ls_value-currency locale = lv_locale_handle grouping = abap_true )
                                     ELSE
                                       ls_value-value " Fallback for unknown types
                                   )
                                   IN
                                     lv_formatted_item ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_formatting_de FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_formatting_us FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_formatting_de.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter=>tt_dynamic_values(
      ( type = 'NUMBER' value = '12345.67' )
      ( type = 'DATE' value = '20231204' )
      ( type = 'CURRENCY' value = '987.65' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_values_dynamically( it_values = lt_values iv_locale = 'DE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 1 ] exp = '12.345,67' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 2 ] exp = '04.12.2023' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 3 ] exp = '987,65 €' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_dynamic_formatting_us.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter( ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE zcl_i18n_dynamic_formatter=>tt_dynamic_values(
      ( type = 'NUMBER' value = '12345.67' )
      ( type = 'DATE' value = '20231204' )
      ( type = 'CURRENCY' value = '987.65' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_values_dynamically( it_values = lt_values iv_locale = 'EN' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 1 ] exp = '12,345.67' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 2 ] exp = '12/04/2023' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_formatted[ 3 ] exp = '$987.65' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Formatierung verschiedener Datentypen (Zahlen, Daten, Währungen) basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit übergebenen Ländereinstellung. Die Kombination von `CL_I18N_UTILS` Methoden mit dem `FOR` Ausdruck und dem `COND` Operator (ABAP 7.55+) ermöglicht eine kompakte und effiziente Implementierung, die die Notwendigkeit umfangreicher `IF`-`ELSE` Blöcke reduziert und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein benutzerdefiniertes Event in einer Klasse `ZCL_EVENT_SOURCE`. Eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_EVENT_LISTENER` soll in der Lage sein, dieses Event zu registrieren und zu behandeln, auch wenn die Event-Methode privat ist.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die Event-Methode als privat und die Listener-Klasse als Freund.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_value) TYPE i.
    METHODS trigger_data_change IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_source
                                IMPORTING iv_new_value.
    FRIENDS zcl_event_listener.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_data_change.
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_new_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    " This private method would typically contain internal logic
    " For this example, it's just a placeholder.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_listener DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_last_received_value TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_event_source TYPE REF TO zcl_event_source.
    METHODS on_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_source
                            IMPORTING iv_new_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_listener IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER on_data_changed FOR io_event_source.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD on_data_changed.
    mv_last_received_value = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Text in Groß- oder Kleinbuchstaben, wobei die Ländereinstellung berücksichtigt wird, um korrekte Ergebnisse für Sonderzeichen (z.B. 'ß' zu 'SS' in Deutsch) zu erzielen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_I18N_UTILS=>TO_UPPER` und `TO_LOWER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_case_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_locale,
             text TYPE string,
             locale TYPE sy-langu,
           END OF ty_text_locale.
    METHODS to_upper_by_locale IMPORTING is_input TYPE ty_text_locale
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_upper_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS to_lower_by_locale IMPORTING is_input TYPE ty_text_locale
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_lower_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_case_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_upper_by_locale.
    DATA(lv_locale_handle) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_locale_handle( is_input-locale ).
    rv_upper_text = cl_i18n_utils=>to_upper( text = is_input-text locale = lv_locale_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD to_lower_by_locale.
    DATA(lv_locale_handle) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_locale_handle( is_input-locale ).
    rv_lower_text = cl_i18n_utils=>to_lower( text = is_input-text locale = lv_locale_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_german_case_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_turkish_case_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_german_case_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_i18n_case_converter( ).
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE zcl_i18n_case_converter=>ty_text_locale( text = 'Straße' locale = 'DE' ).
    DATA(lv_upper) = lo_converter->to_upper_by_locale( ls_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_upper exp = 'STRASSE' ).

    ls_input = VALUE zcl_i18n_case_converter=>ty_text_locale( text = 'GROSS' locale = 'DE' ).
    DATA(lv_lower) = lo_converter->to_lower_by_locale( ls_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lower exp = 'gross' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_turkish_case_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_i18n_case_converter( ).
    " Turkish 'i' without dot becomes 'I' with dot in upper, 'I' with dot becomes 'i' without dot in lower
    DATA(ls_input_i) = VALUE zcl_i18n_case_converter=>ty_text_locale( text = 'istanbul' locale = 'TR' ).
    DATA(lv_upper_i) = lo_converter->to_upper_by_locale( ls_input_i ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_upper_i exp = 'İSTANBUL' ).

    DATA(ls_input_I) = VALUE zcl_i18n_case_converter=>ty_text_locale( text = 'İZMİR' locale = 'TR' ).
    DATA(lv_lower_I) = lo_converter->to_lower_by_locale( ls_input_I ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_lower_I exp = 'izmir' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `TO_UPPER` und `TO_LOWER` der Klasse `CL_I18N_UTILS` ermöglichen eine länderspezifische Konvertierung von Text in Groß- oder Kleinbuchstaben. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Handhabung von Texten in verschiedenen Sprachen, da einfache ASCII-Konvertierungen bei Sonderzeichen oder diakritischen Zeichen zu falschen Ergebnissen führen können (z.B. 'ß' zu 'SS' in Deutsch oder die türkischen 'i' und 'İ').
keywords: I18N, String Processing, Case Conversion, Locale, CL_I18N_UTILS, Internationalization

Instructions: Eine Klasse `ZCL_DATA_CACHE` verwaltet einen privaten Daten-Cache. Eine Freundesklasse `ZCL_CACHE_MONITOR` soll den Zustand dieses Caches (z.B. Anzahl der Einträge) überwachen können, ohne die Cache-Implementierung öffentlich zu machen.
hint: Deklarieren Sie `ZCL_CACHE_MONITOR` als Freund von `ZCL_DATA_CACHE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_cache DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_entry IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string iv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS get_entry IMPORTING iv_key TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_cache_entry TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA: mt_cache TYPE ty_cache_entry.
    FRIENDS zcl_cache_monitor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_cache IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_entry.
    mt_cache-table_line = iv_value.
    INSERT mt_cache-table_line INTO TABLE mt_cache ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entry>).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      <fs_entry> = iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_entry.
    READ TABLE mt_cache WITH KEY table_line = iv_key TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = mt_cache-table_line.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_cache_size IMPORTING io_cache TYPE REF TO zcl_data_cache
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_size) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cache_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cache_size.
    " Access to private internal table mt_cache is allowed
    rv_size = lines( io_cache->mt_cache ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cache_monitoring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cache_monitoring.
    DATA(lo_cache) = NEW zcl_data_cache( ).
    lo_cache->add_entry( iv_key = 'Key1' iv_value = 'Value1' ).
    lo_cache->add_entry( iv_key = 'Key2' iv_value = 'Value2' ).

    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_cache_monitor( ).
    DATA(lv_size) = lo_monitor->get_cache_size( lo_cache ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_size exp = 2 ).

    lo_cache->add_entry( iv_key = 'Key3' iv_value = 'Value3' ).
    lv_size = lo_monitor->get_cache_size( lo_cache ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_size exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS` Beziehung ermöglicht es der `ZCL_CACHE_MONITOR` Klasse, die private interne Tabelle `mt_cache` der `ZCL_DATA_CACHE` Klasse zu inspizieren. Dies ist ein Muster für die Implementierung von Überwachungs- oder Debugging-Funktionen, die Zugriff auf interne Zustände einer Klasse benötigen, ohne diese Zustände öffentlich zu machen und somit die Kapselung zu wahren.
keywords: FRIENDS, Data Cache, Monitoring, Private Data, Object Orientation, Encapsulation

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit Betreff und Text an einen Empfänger.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent`, `set_sender`, `add_recipient`, `set_document` und `send`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_text            TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent( ).

    " Sender
    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( 'sender@example.com' ).
    lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    " Recipient
    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Document (text)
    DATA(lt_text) = VALUE bcs_text_tab( ( iv_text ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
                            i_text    = lt_text
                            i_subject = iv_subject ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Send
    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_email FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_simple_email( ).
    " In a real scenario, you'd mock the BCS send or check for side effects.
    " For a unit test, we can only verify the call structure or mock the BCS.
    " Here, we just ensure no dump occurs.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_email(
          iv_recipient_email = 'test@example.com'
          iv_subject         = 'Test E-Mail'
          iv_text            = 'Dies ist ein Test.'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump expected' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_bcs_message` Klasse bietet eine objektorientierte API zum Versenden von E-Mails. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die Texttabelle und die Verkettung der Methodenaufrufe macht den Code kompakt und lesbar. `COMMIT WORK` ist entscheidend, um die E-Mail tatsächlich in den Sendestatus zu überführen.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Textdokument als Anhang.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_document_bcs=>create_document` für den Anhang und `add_attachment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_with_attachment
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_text            TYPE string
        iv_attachment_name TYPE string
        iv_attachment_data TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_with_attachment.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( 'sender@example.com' ).
    lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Main document
    DATA(lt_text) = VALUE bcs_text_tab( ( iv_text ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(
                            i_text    = lt_text
                            i_subject = iv_subject ).
    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Attachment
    DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                            i_type    = 'RAW' " or 'TXT', 'HTM', 'PDF', etc.
                            i_text    = VALUE bcs_text_tab( ( cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( iv_attachment_data ) ) ) " Convert xstring to string_table
                            i_length  = xstrlen( iv_attachment_data )
                            i_subject = iv_attachment_name ).
    lo_bcs->add_attachment(
      i_document = lo_attachment
      i_attachment_type = 'ATT' " Standard attachment
      i_attachment_name = iv_attachment_name
    ).

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_send_with_attachment FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_with_attachment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_send_with_attach( ).
    DATA(lv_attachment_content) = 'Hello, this is an attachment.' ##NO_TEXT.
    DATA(lv_xstring_content) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_attachment_content ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_email_with_attachment(
          iv_recipient_email = 'test_attach@example.com'
          iv_subject         = 'E-Mail mit Anhang'
          iv_text            = 'Siehe Anhang.'
          iv_attachment_name = 'test_file.txt'
          iv_attachment_data = lv_xstring_content

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).

explanation: Das Senden von Anhängen erfordert die Erstellung eines separaten Dokuments für den Anhang (`cl_document_bcs=>create_document`) und dessen Hinzufügen zur Nachricht (`add_attachment`). Die Konvertierung von `xstring` zu `string_table` für den Anhangstext ist hier demonstriert.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_multi_recip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lt_text) = VALUE bcs_text_tab( ( iv_text ) ).
    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_text(

                            i_subject = iv_subject ).

Instructions: Mappen Sie Felder von einer Quellstruktur auf eine Zielstruktur, wenn die Feldnamen identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_simple_struct_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
        field4 TYPE string, " Different field
      END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_structures
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_simple_struct_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structures.
    " Mappt identische Feldnamen
    CORRESPONDING #( EXPORTING is_source TO rs_target ).
    " Manuelle Zuweisung für nicht-korrespondierende Felder
    rs_target-field4 = is_source-field3.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structures FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structures.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_simple_struct_map( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_simple_struct_map=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 100
      field3 = 'ABC'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structures( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field4 exp = 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist die moderne und prägnante Art, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit identischen Feldnamen zu kopieren. Er ersetzt die Notwendigkeit manueller Zuweisungen für jedes Feld.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Mapping, Structures, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine interne Tabelle auf eine andere interne Tabelle, wobei die Zieltabelle bereits Einträge enthält und diese beibehalten werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `BASE` Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        id     TYPE i,
        name   TYPE string,
        value  TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        id     TYPE i,
        name   TYPE string,
        status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
        amount TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_tables_with_base
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
        it_base   TYPE ty_target_table OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables_with_base.
    " Initialisiere rt_target mit den Einträgen von it_base
    rt_target = it_base.

    " Mappt die Quelltabelle auf die Zieltabellen, wobei vorhandene Einträge in rt_target
    " (von it_base) beibehalten und neue/überschreibende Einträge hinzugefügt/aktualisiert werden.
    " Hier wird 'value' von source auf 'amount' von target gemappt.
    CORRESPONDING #(
      BASE ( rt_target )
      MAPPING amount = value
      FROM it_source TO rt_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_tables_with_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_tables_with_base.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_map_base( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_map_base=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.5' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = '20.0' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_base) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_map_base=>ty_target_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' status = 'P' amount = '5.0' ) " Existing entry, should be updated
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item C' status = 'N' amount = '30.0' ) " Existing entry, should remain
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_tables_with_base( it_source = lt_source it_base = lt_base ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 ). " 2 from source + 1 unique from base
    " Check updated entry
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_target_1) WITH KEY id = 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-amount exp = '10.5' ). " Updated from source
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-status exp = 'P' ). " Retained from base

    " Check new entry from source
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_target_2) WITH KEY id = 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-name exp = 'Item B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-amount exp = '20.0' ).

    " Check retained entry from base
    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_target_3) WITH KEY id = 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_3-name exp = 'Item C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_3-amount exp = '30.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `BASE` Option im `CORRESPONDING` Operator ermöglicht es, eine Zielstruktur oder -tabelle mit einem initialen Wert zu befüllen, bevor die Korrespondenz angewendet wird. Dies ist nützlich, um vorhandene Daten zu ergänzen oder zu aktualisieren, anstatt sie vollständig zu überschreiben. Die `MAPPING` Klausel erlaubt die explizite Zuweisung von Feldern mit unterschiedlichen Namen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Mapping, Internal Tables, BASE, MAPPING, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine interne Tabelle auf eine andere, wobei bestimmte Felder ausgeschlossen und andere mit Transformationen gemappt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `EXCEPT` und `USING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
        id        TYPE i,
        name      TYPE string,
        value     TYPE decfloat16,
        timestamp TYPE timestampl,
      END OF ty_source_line,
      ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
        item_id   TYPE i,
        item_name TYPE string,
        amount    TYPE decfloat16,
        created_at TYPE d,
        created_time TYPE t,
      END OF ty_target_line,
      ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_tables_with_except
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_itab_map_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables_with_except.
    CORRESPONDING #(
      MAPPING
        item_id   = id
        item_name = name
        amount    = value
      USING
        " Transformation für timestamp zu created_at und created_time
        cl_abap_corresponding=>timestamp_to_date_time(
          source      = timestamp
          target_date = created_at
          target_time = created_time
        )
      FROM it_source TO rt_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_tables_with_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_tables_with_except.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_itab_map_except( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_itab_map_except=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Product A' value = '100.50' timestamp = '20231204103000.0000000' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Product B' value = '200.75' timestamp = '20231205114500.0000000' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_tables_with_except( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_target_1) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-item_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-item_name exp = 'Product A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-amount exp = '100.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-created_at exp = '20231204' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_1-created_time exp = '103000' ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INTO DATA(ls_target_2) INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-item_id exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-item_name exp = 'Product B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-amount exp = '200.75' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-created_at exp = '20231205' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target_2-created_time exp = '114500' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `USING` Klausel ermöglicht die Anwendung von Transformationen auf Felder während des Mappings. Hier wird die statische Methode `cl_abap_corresponding=>timestamp_to_date_time` verwendet, um einen Zeitstempel in separate Datums- und Zeitfelder aufzuteilen. Dies ist eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Daten während der Zuweisung zu manipulieren.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Data Mapping, Internal Tables, USING, Transformation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie ein dynamisches Mapping zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei die Mapping-Regeln zur Laufzeit definiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_corresponding` und seine Methoden `add_mapping` oder `add_mapping_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
        source_field_a TYPE string,
        source_field_b TYPE i,
        source_field_c TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_source_data,
      BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
        target_field_x TYPE string,
        target_field_y TYPE i,
        target_field_z TYPE decfloat16,
        additional_info TYPE string,
      END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS perform_dynamic_mapping
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
        it_mapping_rules TYPE cl_abap_corresponding=>ty_mapping_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_dynamic_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_mapping.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = NEW cl_abap_corresponding(
      i_source_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source )
      i_target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_target )
    ).

    lo_corresponding->add_mapping_table( it_mapping_rules ).

    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING

Instructions: Mappen Sie Daten von der Tabelle SFLIGHT auf eine benutzerdefinierte Zielstruktur, wobei Sie eine komplexe Transformation für das Feld 'FLDATE' anwenden und nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft berücksichtigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `FILTER` und einer `USING` Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_sflight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_target,
        carrier_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connection_id TYPE s_conn_id,
        flight_date  TYPE string, " Transformed date
        price        TYPE s_price,
        currency     TYPE s_curcode,
      END OF ty_sflight_target,
      ty_sflight_target_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_sflight_target_tab.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS transform_fldate
      IMPORTING
        source TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(target) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_sflight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflight_data.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id.

    CORRESPONDING #(
      MAPPING
        carrier_id    = carrid
        connection_id = connid
        price         = price
        currency      = currency
      USING
        transform_fldate( source = fldate target = flight_date )
      FILTER
        carrid = iv_carrier_id
      FROM lt_sflight TO rt_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_fldate.
    target = |{ source DATE = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_map_sflight_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_sflight_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'. " Beispiel-Fluggesellschaft

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_sflight_data( lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrier_id exp = lv_carrier ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( act = ls_flight-flight_date exp = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' msg = 'Flugdatum sollte im ISO-Format sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test mit einer nicht existierenden Fluggesellschaft
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->map_sflight_data( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_empty_result msg = 'Für nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft sollten keine Flüge gefunden werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination des `CORRESPONDING` Operators mit `FILTER` und einer `USING` Transformation. `FILTER` ermöglicht es, nur bestimmte Zeilen der Quelltabelle zu berücksichtigen, während `USING` eine benutzerdefinierte Transformation (hier `transform_fldate` zur Formatierung des Datums) auf ein Feld anwendet. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`DATE = ISO`) innerhalb der Transformation ist ein weiteres modernes Feature für die Datumformatierung.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_download_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_data.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_title         = 'Datei speichern unter'
            i_default_extension = 'txt'
            i_default_file_name = iv_filename
          CHANGING
            c_selected_file = lv_filepath
          EXCEPTIONS
            cntl_error      = 1
            error_no_gui    = 2
            OTHERS          = 3
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_filepath IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_filepath
            filetype                = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = it_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_write_error        = 1
            no_authority            = 2
            gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
            OTHERS                  = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open_mode INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_authority INTO DATA(lx_file_auth).
        MESSAGE lx_file_auth->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_gui_refuse_filetransfer INTO DATA(lx_refuse).
        MESSAGE lx_refuse->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_read_filter_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_filter_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_keyword TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_read_filter_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_filter_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string,
          lt_raw_data TYPE string_table.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_title         = 'Textdatei zum Filtern auswählen'
            i_default_extension = 'txt'
            i_file_mask     = '*.txt'
          CHANGING
            c_selected_file = lv_filepath
          EXCEPTIONS
            cntl_error      = 1
            error_no_gui    = 2
            OTHERS          = 3
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_filepath IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_filepath
            filetype                = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_raw_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_open_error         = 1
            no_authority            = 2
            gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
            OTHERS                  = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Hochladen der Datei.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " Modern ABAP: Filter internal table
        rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_raw_data USING KEY primary_key WHERE table_line CS iv_keyword ).

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open_mode INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.

Instructions: Laden Sie Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle herunter und speichern Sie sie als CSV-Datei auf dem Frontend. Behandeln Sie alle Ausnahmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT`, `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` und `TRY...CATCH`. Nutzen Sie `LOOP` und String-Templates für die CSV-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_sflights_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_sflights_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_sflights_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data,
          lt_csv_lines TYPE string_table,
          lv_filepath TYPE string.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    " Read data from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      MESSAGE 'Keine Daten in SFLIGHTS gefunden.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create CSV header
    APPEND 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY' TO lt_csv_lines.

    " Format data as CSV using FOR and String Templates
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }| TO lt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_title         = 'SFLIGHTS als CSV speichern'
            i_default_extension = 'csv'
            i_default_file_name = iv_filename
          CHANGING
            c_selected_file = lv_filepath
          EXCEPTIONS
            cntl_error      = 1
            error_no_gui    = 2
            OTHERS          = 3
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_filepath IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_filepath
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            write_field_separator   = abap_false " We handle separator manually
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_csv_lines
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_write_error        = 1
            no_authority            = 2
            gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
            OTHERS                  = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der CSV-Datei.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open_mode INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_authority INTO DATA(lx_file_auth).
        MESSAGE lx_file_auth->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_gui_refuse_filetransfer INTO DATA(lx_refuse).
        MESSAGE lx_refuse->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit dynamischen Daten. Lassen Sie den Benutzer einen Speicherort auf dem Frontend auswählen und laden Sie die Daten als Textdatei herunter. Verwenden Sie `COND` für dynamische Dateinamen und behandeln Sie alle Ausnahmen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog`, `gui_download`, `TRY...CATCH` und den `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fes_dynamic_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_prefix TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fes_dynamic_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_dynamic_data.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE string_table,
          lv_filepath TYPE string.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    " Generate some dynamic data
    LOOP AT sy-tabix FROM 1 TO 5 INTO DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND |Zeile { lv_index }: Aktuelles Datum { sy-datum DATE = USER } und Uhrzeit { sy-uzeit TIME = USER }| TO lt_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_default_filename) = COND string(
      WHEN iv_prefix IS NOT INITIAL THEN |{ iv_prefix }_dynamic_data_{ sy-datum }.txt|
      ELSE |dynamic_data_{ sy-datum }.txt|
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
          EXPORTING
            i_title         = 'Dynamische Daten speichern'
            i_default_extension = 'txt'
            i_default_file_name = lv_default_filename
          CHANGING
            c_selected_file = lv_filepath
          EXCEPTIONS
            cntl_error      = 1
            error_no_gui    = 2
            OTHERS          = 3
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_filepath IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'Dateiauswahl abgebrochen oder Fehler aufgetreten.' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_filepath
            filetype                = 'ASC'
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_write_error        = 1
            no_authority            = 2
            gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
            OTHERS                  = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der dynamischen Datei.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_file_open_mode INTO DATA(lx_file_open).
        MESSAGE lx_file_open->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_authority INTO DATA(lx_file_auth).
        MESSAGE lx_file_auth->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_gui_refuse_filetransfer INTO DATA(lx_refuse).
        MESSAGE lx_refuse->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_line_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_line_type IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle, die die gleiche Zeilenstruktur wie eine gegebene Quelltabelle hat, aber einen anderen Tabellentyp (z.B. Hashed Table).
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>CREATE` mit dem Zeilentyp der Quelltabelle und dem gewünschten neuen Tabellentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_hashed_table_like
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_new_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hashed_table_like.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_source_table ).
    DATA(lo_source_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
    DATA(lo_line_typedescr) = lo_source_tabledescr->get_line_type( ).

    DATA(lt_key_components) = lo_source_tabledescr->get_keys( ).
    IF lt_key_components IS INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_typedescr ).
      lt_key_components = lo_structdescr->get_components( ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_new_tabledescr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
      p_line_type  = lo_line_typedescr
      p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
      p_unique     = abap_true
      p_key        = lt_key_components
    ).

    CREATE DATA rr_new_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_tabledescr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` so auf, dass sie für ein einfaches Zeitreihen-Diagramm verwendet werden können. Aggregieren Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum.

CLASS zcl_chart_simple_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date       TYPE d,
             value      TYPE decfloat16,
             series_id  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_per_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_simple_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_per_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
                             ( date      = ls_flight-fldate
                               value     = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 )
                               series_id = 'Anzahl Flüge' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_filter_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für die Flugdaten aus `sflights` die kumulative Anzahl der Flüge pro Datum, um einen Trend über die Zeit darzustellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und einer zusätzlichen Variablen für die kumulative Summe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date       TYPE d,
             value      TYPE decfloat16,
             series_id  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cumulative_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_cumulative IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cumulative_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_flights_per_date) = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
                                             ( date  = ls_flight-fldate
                                               count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) ).

    SORT lt_flights_per_date BY date ASCENDING.

    DATA(lv_cumulative_count) = 0.
    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_date_count IN lt_flights_per_date
                                 LET lv_cumulative_count = lv_cumulative_count + ls_date_count-count IN
                                 ( date      = ls_date_count-date
                                   value     = lv_cumulative_count
                                   series_id = 'Kumulative Flüge' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_cumulative( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_cumulative_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_chart_data ).
    DATA(lv_previous_value) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_data-value >= lv_previous_value ).
      lv_previous_value = ls_data-value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Berechnung kumulativer Werte in ABAP 7.50+ unter Verwendung von `FOR` mit einer `LET`-Expression. Zuerst werden die Flüge pro Datum aggregiert und sortiert. Dann wird in einer weiteren `FOR`-Schleife die kumulative Summe (`lv_cumulative_count`) berechnet und in die Ergebnisstruktur überführt. Dies ist eine elegante und funktionale Art, solche Berechnungen durchzuführen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, LET, Aggregation, Cumulative Sum, sflights, Math

Instructions: Füllen Sie fehlende Datenpunkte in einer Zeitreihen-Datenmenge mit Standardwerten (z.B. 0), um eine kontinuierliche Darstellung im Diagramm zu gewährleisten.
hint: Erzeugen Sie eine vollständige Liste von Daten im Bereich und mergen Sie diese mit den vorhandenen Daten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_fill_gaps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             date       TYPE d,
             value      TYPE decfloat16,
             series_id  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH UNIQUE KEY date series_id.

    METHODS get_flights_with_filled_gaps
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_fill_gaps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_filled_gaps.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_existing_data) = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-fldate
      ( date      = ls_flight-fldate
        value     = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 )
        series_id = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
    ).

    DATA: lt_all_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      APPEND lv_current_date TO lt_all_dates.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    DATA(lt_default_data) = VALUE tt_chart_data(
      FOR ls_date IN lt_all_dates
      ( date      = ls_date
        value     = 0
        series_id = 'Anzahl Flüge' )
    ).

    rt_chart_data = lt_default_data.
    LOOP AT lt_existing_data INTO DATA(ls_existing).
      MODIFY TABLE rt_chart_data FROM ls_existing.
    ENDLOOP.

    SORT rt_chart_data BY date ASCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fill_gaps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_gaps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_fill_gaps( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20000101'.
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = '20000103'.

    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_filled_gaps(
      iv_start_date = lv_start_date
      iv_end_date   = lv_end_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart_data ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = lv_start_date.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-date exp = lv_expected_date ).
      lv_expected_date = lv_expected_date + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man fehlende Datenpunkte in einer Zeitreihe auffüllt, um eine lückenlose Darstellung zu gewährleisten. Es generiert zuerst eine vollständige Liste von Daten für den gewünschten Zeitraum. Dann wird eine Standardtabelle mit diesen Daten und Nullwerten erstellt. Schließlich werden die tatsächlich vorhandenen aggregierten Daten in diese Standardtabelle gemergt, wobei die Nullwerte überschrieben werden. Dies ist eine robuste Methode zur Datenaufbereitung für Diagramme.

CLASS zcl_itb_read_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Flugpreis in der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Zeigen Sie die moderne Fehlerbehandlung mit Ausnahmen anstelle von sy-subrc.
hint: Verwenden Sie UPDATE mit der @-Syntax und fangen Sie Datenbankausnahmen mit TRY...CATCH ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.

    CLASS-METHODS update_flight_price_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    TRY.
        UPDATE sflight SET price = @iv_new_price
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        IF sy-dbcnt = 0. " Check if any row was updated
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
            EXPORTING
              text = 'No flight found for update'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_db
            text     = lx_db->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_flight_price_legacy.
    UPDATE sflight SET price = iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    CLASS-METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.

    CLASS-METHODS check_component_exists_legacy
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Component '{ iv_component }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
    rv_value = |{ <lv_component> }|. " Convert to string for generic return
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_component_exists_legacy.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <lv_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

* Custom Exception Class (ZCX_FLIGHT_NOT_FOUND) - needs to be created separately in SE24
* CLASS ZCX_FLIGHT_NOT_FOUND DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM CX_STATIC_CHECK.
*   PUBLIC SECTION.
*     INTERFACES if_t100_message.
*     METHODS constructor
*       IMPORTING
*         textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
*         previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
* ENDCLASS.
*
* CLASS ZCX_FLIGHT_NOT_FOUND IMPLEMENTATION.
*   METHOD constructor.
*     CALL METHOD super->constructor
*       EXPORTING
*         previous = previous.
*     me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
*   ENDMETHOD.
* ENDCLASS.
*
* Message Class ZMSG_APP (needs to be created in SE91)
* Message 001: Flight &1 &2 on &3 not found.

CLASS zcl_oo_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_flight_not_found.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_status_legacy
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0. " sy-subrc is still set by SELECT SINGLE, but we convert it to an exception
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_flight_not_found=>zmsg_app_001
          carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
          connid = is_flight_key-connid
          fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.
    ENDIF.
    rv_status = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } is active.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_status_legacy.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } is active.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Flight not found (legacy)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit mehreren Methoden, die verkettet aufgerufen werden können, und instanziieren Sie Objekte mit dem NEW-Operator.

CLASS zcl_chaining_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chaining_example.
    METHODS multiply_value IMPORTING iv_factor TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chaining_example.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chaining_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply_value.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_factor.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges basierend auf dem Preis. Verwenden Sie COND und SWITCH für die bedingte Zuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die COND- und SWITCH-Operatoren, um bedingte Logik in Ausdrücken zu implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_switch_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_price TYPE sflight-price.
    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_status_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE ty_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flight_category_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE ty_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_cond.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN 'Budget'
      WHEN iv_price >= 100 AND iv_price < 500 THEN 'Standard'
      WHEN iv_price >= 500 THEN 'Premium'
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_category_switch.
    rv_category = SWITCH string( iv_price
      WHEN 0 TO 99 THEN 'Economy'
      WHEN 100 TO 499 THEN 'Business'
      WHEN 500 TO 99999 THEN 'First Class'
      ELSE 'Undefined'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_cond_switch_example=>get_flight_status_cond( '0.00' ) exp = 'Budget' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_category_switch.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_cond_switch_example=>get_flight_category_switch( '300.00' ) exp = 'Business' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = zcl_cond_switch_example=>get_flight_category_switch( '1000.00' ) exp = 'First Class' ).

explanation: Die Operatoren `COND` und `SWITCH` ermöglichen die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einem Ausdruck, was eine kompaktere und lesbarere Alternative zu traditionellen `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen darstellt, insbesondere wenn das Ergebnis einer Bedingung direkt zugewiesen werden soll.
