Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Legacy-Funktionsbaustein auf, der sy-subrc setzt, und wandeln Sie das Ergebnis in eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung (Ausnahme) um.
hint: Verwenden Sie CALL FUNCTION und prüfen Sie sy-subrc, um dann eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auszulösen.
solution:
* Note: BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST is a standard BAPI.
* This example assumes it exists and can be called.
* For a real scenario, ensure the BAPI is available and activated.

CLASS zcl_legacy_wrapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_modern
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_external_function_error. " Or a custom exception

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_legacy_wrapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_modern.
    DATA: lt_bapi_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapisfligt.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST'
      EXPORTING
        airlineid = iv_carrid
      TABLES
        flightlist = lt_bapi_flights.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_external_function_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Error calling BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }|.
    ENDIF.

    " Map BAPI structure to local type using CORRESPONDING
    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_bapi_flights MAPPING carrid = airlineid connid = connectnum fldate = flightdate ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_legacy.
    DATA: lt_bapi_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF bapisfligt.

    CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST'
      EXPORTING
        airlineid = iv_carrid
      TABLES
        flightlist = lt_bapi_flights.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_bapi_flights INTO DATA(ls_bapi_flight).
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
          carrid = ls_bapi_flight-airlineid
          connid = ls_bapi_flight-connectnum
          fldate = ls_bapi_flight-flightdate
        ) TO rt_flights.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_modern_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flights_modern_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_external_function_error.
    METHODS test_get_flights_legacy_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_modern_success.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_legacy_wrapper=>get_flights_modern( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_modern_error.
    EXPECTED EXCEPTION cx_sy_external_function_error.
    zcl_legacy_wrapper=>get_flights_modern( iv_carrid = 'ZZ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flights_legacy_success.
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_legacy_wrapper=>get_flights_legacy( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man einen älteren Funktionsbaustein (`BAPI_FLIGHT_GETLIST`), der `sy-subrc` zur Fehleranzeige verwendet, in eine moderne `CLASS-METHOD` einbindet. Das `sy-subrc`-Ergebnis wird abgefangen und in eine objektorientierte Ausnahme (`cx_sy_external_function_error` oder eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme) umgewandelt. Dies ermöglicht eine konsistente Fehlerbehandlung im modernen ABAP-Code. Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator wird für die effiziente Datenübertragung verwendet.
keywords: sy-subrc, FUNCTION MODULE, Legacy Code, Wrapper, Exceptions, CLASS-METHODS, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT und verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen und die moderne Open SQL-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie DATA(...) für Inline-Deklarationen und die @-Syntax für Hostvariablen in SELECT-Anweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS get_flights_for_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

    CLASS-METHODS get_single_flight_legacy
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_single_flight_legacy.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine neue Tabelle mit nur ausgewählten Feldern und einem berechneten Wert. Verwenden Sie den FOR-Operator.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             display_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS-METHODS transform_flights_to_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights_to_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
                              ( airline_id    = ls_raw-carrid
                                flight_num    = ls_raw-connid
                                display_price = |{ ls_raw-price CURRENCY = ls_raw-currency }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) zufällig durch. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_random` und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine temporäre Tabelle mit Zufallszahlen als Sortierschlüssel und sortieren Sie danach. `FOR` und `VALUE` können helfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             sflight    TYPE sflight,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflights.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_temp) = VALUE tt_sflight_shuffled(
      FOR wa_sflight IN it_sflights
        ( random_key = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = 1000000 )
          sflight    = wa_sflight )
    ).

    SORT lt_temp BY random_key.

    rt_shuffled_sflights = VALUE #( 
      FOR wa_temp IN lt_temp
        ( wa_temp-sflight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ASSERT lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_1) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_2) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled_1 ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled_1 exp = lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled_1 exp = lt_shuffled_2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `cl_abap_random` mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken und `VALUE`-Operatoren ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Implementierung des Mischens einer Tabelle. Durch das Hinzufügen einer Zufallszahl als Sortierschlüssel wird die Tabelle effektiv gemischt. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus der internen Tabelle `sflights` aus.
hint: Generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex mit `cl_abap_random` und greifen Sie direkt auf die Tabelle zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sflight
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_sflight) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_sflights ).
    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = lv_lines ).

    rs_random_sflight = it_sflights[ lv_random_index ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_random_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_random_sflight_empty RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ASSERT lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_entry( ).
    DATA(ls_random_entry) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_random_entry-carrid msg = 'Random entry should not be initial' exp = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight = ls_random_entry.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_found msg = 'Selected random entry not found in original table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_random_sflight_empty.
    DATA lt_empty_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_entry( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_sflight( lt_empty_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_table_line_not_found for empty table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_table_line_not_found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine konstante Anzahl von zufälligen und eindeutigen Einträgen aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random` und eine Klassenkonstante für die Anzahl.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_abap_random` mit einer Schleife und einer Klassenkonstante für die Iterationen. Stellen Sie die Eindeutigkeit der Auswahl sicher.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_n_items DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS gc_num_items TYPE i VALUE 3.

    METHODS get_n_random_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_n_items IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_n_random_sflights.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( it_sflights ).
    IF lv_lines = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_picked_indices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO gc_num_items TIMES.
      IF lines( lt_picked_indices ) >= lv_lines. 
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = lv_lines ).
      WHILE line_exists( lt_picked_indices[ table_line = lv_random_index ] ).
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 1 ip_max = lv_lines ).
      ENDWHILE.
      APPEND lv_random_index TO lt_picked_indices.

      APPEND it_sflights[ lv_random_index ] TO rt_random_sflights.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen String (z.B. ein Passwort) einer bestimmten Länge, der aus Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben und Ziffern besteht.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Zeichensatz als Konstante und wählen Sie Zeichen zufällig mit `cl_abap_random` aus. Nutzen Sie String-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_chars_upper TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
      gc_chars_lower TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
      gc_chars_digits TYPE string VALUE '0123456789'.

    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    DATA(lv_all_chars) = gc_chars_upper && gc_chars_lower && gc_chars_digits.
    DATA(lv_all_chars_len) = strlen( lv_all_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_result) TYPE string.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ip_min = 0 ip_max = lv_all_chars_len - 1 ).
      lv_result = lv_result && lv_all_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
    rv_random_string = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_rand_str) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_rand_str ) exp = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_allowed_chars) = zcl_random_string=>gc_chars_upper && zcl_random_string=>gc_chars_lower && zcl_random_string=>gc_chars_digits.
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_rand_str ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_rand_str+sy-index-1(1).
      IF NOT lv_allowed_chars CS lv_char.
        lv_is_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_is_valid msg = 'Generated string contains invalid characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generate_random_string_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string( ).
    DATA(lv_rand_str) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_rand_str ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Klassenkonstanten definieren die erlaubten Zeichen. String-Templates (`&&`) werden für die Zeichenkettenverkettung verwendet, was den Code modern und lesbar macht.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Klassenkonstanten für Wochentage und verwenden Sie diese, um den Namen eines Wochentags basierend auf einer Zahl zurückzugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-CONSTANTS` und einen `SWITCH`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_constants_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-CONSTANTS:
      gc_mon TYPE i VALUE 1,
      gc_tue TYPE i VALUE 2,
      gc_wed TYPE i VALUE 3,
      gc_thu TYPE i VALUE 4,
      gc_fri TYPE i VALUE 5,
      gc_sat TYPE i VALUE 6,
      gc_sun TYPE i VALUE 7.

    METHODS get_weekday_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_weekday_num TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_weekday_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_constants_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH string(
      iv_weekday_num
      WHEN gc_mon THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN gc_tue THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN gc_wed THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN gc_thu THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN gc_fri THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN gc_sat THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN gc_sun THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Wochentag'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_weekday_name FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weekday_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_constants_weekday( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( zcl_constants_weekday=>gc_mon ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( zcl_constants_weekday=>gc_sun ) exp = 'Sonntag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 0 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Wochentag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_weekday_name( 8 ) exp = 'Ungültiger Wochentag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` in Kombination mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD flight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ) ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator, insbesondere in Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE`, ermöglicht eine elegante und effiziente Zuweisung von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen, aber teilweise übereinstimmenden Feldnamen. Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' aus einer gegebenen internen Tabelle und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise dieser Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit dem `REDUCE` Operator für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_lh_price_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_lh_price_sum.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR <fs_flight> IN FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_flight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key->*-carrid count = group_key->*->count( ) ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Logarithmus zur Basis 10 (`log10`) für eine Liste von positiven Dezimalzahlen und geben Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen Tabelle zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler (z.B. Logarithmus von Null oder negativen Zahlen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_math=>log10` und `TRY...CATCH` in einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_log10 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_result,
             input_value TYPE decfloat34,
             log10_value TYPE decfloat34,
             error_msg   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_result.
    METHODS calculate_log10 IMPORTING it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_log10 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_log10.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR value IN it_values
      LET lv_log10_val = VALUE decfloat34( )
          lv_error_msg = VALUE string( )
      IN
        TRY.
            lv_log10_val = cl_abap_math=>log10( value ).
          CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
            lv_error_msg = lx_error->get_text( ).
        ENDTRY.
        ( input_value = value, log10_value = lv_log10_val, error_msg = lv_error_msg ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_increase DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_increased_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights

                                     connid = flight-connid,

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_increase( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_increased_prices( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-price exp = ls_sflight_orig-price * '1.1' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Maximalwert aus einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_math=>max` in einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value IMPORTING it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY RETURNING VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    IF it_values IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Standardabweichung einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen. Nehmen Sie an, dass die Liste mindestens zwei Elemente enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_math=>sqrt`, `pow`, `add`, `divide` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_stddev DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_std_dev IMPORTING it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY RETURNING VALUE(rv_std_dev) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_stddev IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_std_dev.
    IF lines( it_values ) < 2.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_values ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR val IN it_values NEXT s = cl_abap_math=>add( val1 = s val2 = val ) ).
    DATA(lv_mean) = cl_abap_math=>divide( val1 = lv_sum val2 = lv_count ).

    DATA(lv_sum_sq_diff) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT ssd = 0 FOR val IN it_values NEXT ssd = cl_abap_math=>add( val1 = ssd val2 = cl_abap_math=>pow( val1 = cl_abap_math=>subtract( val1 = val val2 = lv_mean ) val2 = 2 ) ) ).

    DATA(lv_variance) = cl_abap_math=>divide( val1 = lv_sum_sq_diff val2 = cl_abap_math=>subtract( val1 = lv_count val2 = 1 ) ). " Sample variance

    rv_std_dev = cl_abap_math=>sqrt( lv_variance ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_expensive_flights_per_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_expensive_flights_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_tab FROM group_key->* WHERE ( price > 500 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key->*-carrid count = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und eine berechnete 'Auslastungsrate' (seatsocc / seatsmax) als Prozentsatz enthält. Flüge ohne maximale Sitzplatzkapazität sollen ignoriert werden.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             occupancy TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    METHODS get_occupancy_rates RETURNING VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_rates.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            WHERE ( seatsmax > 0 )
                            ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                              connid    = flight-connid,
                              occupancy = cl_abap_math=>divide( val1 = flight-seatsocc val2 = flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_occupancy_rates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_seatsmax FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_rates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_rates( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Assuming a flight exists with seatsocc=50, seatsmax=100, occupancy should be 50.0
    " For robust testing, insert specific test data into sflight or mock it.
    " READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_occ) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_occ-occupancy exp = 50.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_seatsmax.
    " This test implicitly checks that flights with seatsmax = 0 are ignored.
    " To explicitly test, one would need to insert a flight with seatsmax = 0 and assert it's not in the result.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_occupancy( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_occupancy_rates( ).
    " Assert that no entries with seatsmax = 0 are present (if such data exists in sflight)
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      DATA ls_sflight_orig TYPE sflight.
      SELECT SINGLE seatsmax FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight_orig WHERE carrid = ls_entry-carrid AND connid = ls_entry-connid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_sflight_orig-seatsmax > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE`-Klausel filtert ungültige Daten direkt heraus. Die Berechnung der Auslastungsrate erfolgt inline unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_math=>divide` für präzise Dezimaldivision, was die Lesbarkeit und Fehlervermeidung verbessert.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Musters in einem String.

CLASS zcl_regex_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matches) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_pattern.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text ).
    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_matched_substring( ) TO rt_matches.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = '123' ).

Instructions: Teile einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks in eine Tabelle von Substrings auf.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_regex` mit `create_matcher`, `match` und `substring` für eine Regex-basierte Aufteilung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_text ).
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      IF lo_matcher->get_matched_offset( ) > lv_offset.
        APPEND iv_text+lv_offset( lo_matcher->get_matched_offset( ) - lv_offset ) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lo_matcher->get_matched_offset( ) + lo_matcher->get_matched_length( ).
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_offset < strlen( iv_text ).
      APPEND iv_text+lv_offset TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_regex FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_regex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_split( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = 'apple,banana;orange' iv_pattern = '[,;]' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'banana' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3] exp = 'orange' ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->split_by_regex( iv_text = '  word1   word2  ' iv_pattern = '\s+' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 'word1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 'word2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da ABAP keine direkte `SPLIT` Anweisung mit Regex-Unterstützung bietet, wird hier eine manuelle Implementierung mit `cl_abap_regex` und `substring` demonstriert. Dies zeigt die Flexibilität der Regex-Klasse, auch wenn es etwas mehr Code erfordert.

Instructions: Extrahiere spezifische Teile eines Strings, die einem regulären Ausdruck mit Gruppen entsprechen.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_regex` und die Methode `GET_SUBMATCH` des Matcher-Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_address_part,
        street TYPE string,
        number TYPE string,
        city   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_address_part.
    METHODS extract_address
      IMPORTING
        iv_address_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_address_parts) TYPE ty_address_part.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_address.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '^(.*)\s+([\w\d]+),\s*(.*)$'. "Example: 'Street Name 123, City' or 'Street Name 45B, City'
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( iv_address_string ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_address_parts-street = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 ).
      rs_address_parts-number = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 ).
      rs_address_parts-city   = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 3 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_address FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_address.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_group( ).
    DATA(ls_address) = lo_cut->extract_address( 'Main Street 123, New York' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-street exp = 'Main Street' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-number exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-city   exp = 'New York' ).

    CLEAR ls_address.
    ls_address = lo_cut->extract_address( 'Another Road 45B, London' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-street exp = 'Another Road' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-number exp = '45B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_address-city   exp = 'London' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit Klammern `()` im regulären Ausdruck können Gruppen definiert werden. Die Methode `GET_SUBMATCH(n)` ermöglicht den Zugriff auf den Inhalt der n-ten Gruppe. Dies ist extrem nützlich, um strukturierte Daten aus unstrukturierten Texten zu extrahieren.
keywords: REGEX, GROUPING, cl_abap_regex, GET_SUBMATCH, Extraction

Instructions: Mische die Elemente einer internen Tabelle zufällig durch.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und eine Schleife, um Elemente an zufälligen Positionen zu tauschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        io_table TYPE REF TO data "Generic table reference
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string. "Example type, can be generic
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lv_lines) = lines( ct_table ).
    IF lv_lines <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_lines
    ).

    DO lv_lines - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_idx1) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_idx2) = lo_random->get_next( ). " Random index between 1 and lv_lines

      " Swap elements
      DATA(lv_temp) = ct_table[ lv_idx1 ].
      ct_table[ lv_idx1 ] = ct_table[ lv_idx2 ].
      ct_table[ lv_idx2 ] = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lt_original.

    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).
    SORT lt_original ASCENDING.
    SORT lt_shuffled ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Mischen einer internen Tabelle kann durch wiederholtes Tauschen von Elementen an zufälligen Positionen erreicht werden. `cl_abap_random_int` liefert die benötigten Zufallsindizes. Dies ist eine gängige Methode, um Listen zu randomisieren.

Instructions: Generiere eine bestimmte Anzahl von *eindeutigen* Zufallszahlen innerhalb eines gegebenen Bereichs.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_random_int` und eine interne Tabelle mit `UNIQUE` Schlüssel, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_nums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lv_range_size) = iv_max - iv_min + 1.
    IF iv_count > lv_range_size.
      " Handle error or adjust iv_count
      MESSAGE 'Count exceeds range size' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random_int=>get_seed( )
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).

    DO.
      DATA(lv_rand_num) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_rand_num INTO TABLE rt_unique_nums.
      IF lines( rt_unique_nums ) = iv_count.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_unique_nums) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 iv_count = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_nums ) exp = 5 ).
    LOOP AT lt_unique_nums INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_num >= 1 AND lv_num <= 10 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    CLEAR lt_unique_nums.
    lt_unique_nums = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 3 iv_count = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_nums ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_unique_nums INTO lv_num.
      lv_sum = lv_sum + lv_num.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 6 ). " 1+2+3 = 6
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eindeutige Zufallszahlen zu generieren, werden Zahlen zufällig erzeugt und in eine interne Tabelle mit einem `UNIQUE` Schlüssel eingefügt. Der `UNIQUE` Schlüssel stellt sicher, dass keine Duplikate hinzugefügt werden. Die Schleife läuft, bis die gewünschte Anzahl eindeutiger Zahlen erreicht ist.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE, cl_abap_random_int, Internal Table, Data Generation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der nach 3 Sekunden einmalig ein Event auslöst. Die Event-Handler-Methode soll eine einfache Statusmeldung setzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_timer` und registrieren Sie eine `FOR EVENT` Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_single_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_finished EXPORTING VALUE(iv_message) TYPE string.
    METHODS:
      start_timer,
      get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string VALUE 'Timer not started'.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_single_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 3. " 3 seconds
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
      mv_status = 'Timer started'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    mv_status = 'Timer finished!'.
    RAISE EVENT timer_finished EXPORTING iv_message = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_event FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT timer_finished OF zcl_timer_single_event.
    DATA mv_event_received TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA mv_event_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_single_event( ).
    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    " Simulate the timer event directly for testing purposes
    " In a real scenario, the timer would trigger this.
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ). " Directly call the event handler

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_status( )
      exp = 'Timer finished!'
      msg = 'Status should be updated after timer event'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = mv_event_received
      msg = 'Event should have been raised'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = mv_event_message
      exp = 'Timer finished!'
      msg = 'Event message should match status'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_event_received = abap_true.
    mv_event_message = iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert die grundlegende Verwendung von `cl_gui_timer` für einmalige Events. Der `NEW`-Operator wird für die Objekterstellung verwendet. Die Event-Behandlung (`SET HANDLER FOR`) ist ein moderner ABAP-Standard. Der Unit-Test ruft die Event-Handler-Methode direkt auf, um die Timer-Aktion zu simulieren, was für das Testen von GUI-bezogener Logik ohne tatsächliche GUI-Interaktion entscheidend ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen periodischen Timer, der alle 1 Sekunde einen internen Zähler inkrementiert. Basierend auf dem Zählerstand (z.B. < 3, = 3, > 3) soll eine Statusmeldung mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression generiert werden. Der Timer soll nach 5 Durchläufen deaktiviert werden.
hint: `cl_gui_timer` für Periodizität, `SWITCH` für Statusprüfung, `DEACTIVATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_periodic_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      start_periodic_timer,
      get_current_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_status TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_periodic_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_periodic_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_periodic_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_periodic_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 1. " 1 second
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_periodic.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
      mv_status = 'Timer activated, waiting for first tick.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_periodic_event.
    mv_counter = mv_counter + 1.

    mv_status = SWITCH #( mv_counter
                              WHEN 1 THEN |First tick, counter is { mv_counter }|
                              WHEN 2 THEN |Second tick, counter is { mv_counter }|
                              WHEN 3 THEN |Third tick, counter is { mv_counter }, almost done!|
                              WHEN 4 THEN |Fourth tick, counter is { mv_counter }, last one!|
                              WHEN OTHERS THEN |Final tick, counter is { mv_counter }, deactivating timer.| ).

    IF mv_counter >= 5.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
      mv_status = mv_status && ' Timer deactivated.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_status.
    rv_status = mv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_periodic_timer_switch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_periodic_timer_switch.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_periodic_switch( ).
    lo_cut->start_periodic_timer( ). " Just to initialize the timer object

    " Simulate 5 timer ticks
    DO 5 TIMES.
      lo_cut->handle_periodic_event( ). " Directly call the event handler
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_current_status( )
      exp = 'Final tick, counter is 5, deactivating timer. Timer deactivated.'
      msg = 'Status should reflect final tick and deactivation'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ein periodischer Timer soll alle 2 Sekunden eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) filtern und die Anzahl der Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aggregieren. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` in der Event-Handler-Methode.
hint: `FOR ... IN ... WHERE`, `REDUCE` für Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_table_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      start_aggregation_timer,
      get_aggregated_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_timer_runs TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_runs TYPE i VALUE 3.
    METHODS handle_aggregation_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_table_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_aggregation_timer.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_aggregation_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 2. " 2 seconds
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_periodic.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_aggregation_event.
    mv_timer_runs = mv_timer_runs + 1.

    " Simulate data from sflights
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
    ).

    " Filter for 'LH' and count using REDUCE
    mv_current_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                     NEXT count = count + 1 ).

    IF mv_timer_runs >= gc_max_runs.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_aggregated_count.
    rv_count = mv_current_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timer_table_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_table_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_table_agg( ).
    lo_cut->start_aggregation_timer( ). " Initialize timer object

    " Simulate timer ticks
    DO 3 TIMES.
      lo_cut->handle_aggregation_event( ).
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_aggregated_count( )
      exp = 3 " Based on the mock data for 'LH'
      msg = 'Aggregated count should be 3 for LH flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

WHERE`-Expression wird zum Filtern verwendet, und `REDUCE` zur Aggregation, was einen funktionalen Programmierstil demonstriert. Dies ist äußerst effizient und lesbar für die Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen langlaufenden Prozess, dessen Fortschritt periodisch von einem `cl_gui_timer` aktualisiert wird. Die Statusmeldung soll mit String-Templates formatiert werden.

solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_progress_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      start_process_simulation,
      get_progress_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_progress TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_progress TYPE i VALUE 100.
    METHODS handle_progress_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_progress_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_process_simulation.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_progress_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 1. " 1 second
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_periodic.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_progress_event.
    mv_progress = mv_progress + 10.
    IF mv_progress > gc_max_progress.
      mv_progress = gc_max_progress.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.

    " Modern String Template for status update
    DATA(lv_status_text) = |Process running: { mv_progress }% completed.|
                            && COND string( WHEN mv_progress >= gc_max_progress THEN ' Process finished.' ELSE '' ).
    MESSAGE lv_status_text TYPE 'I'. " In a real GUI, this would update a status bar
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_progress_status.
    rv_status = |Current progress: { mv_progress }%|.
    IF mv_progress >= gc_max_progress.
      rv_status = rv_status && ' (Finished)'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    lo_cut->start_process_simulation( ). " Initialize timer object

    " Simulate 10 timer ticks to reach 100% progress
    DO 10 TIMES.
      lo_cut->handle_progress_event( ).
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_progress_status( )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Timer, der nach einer bestimmten Zeit eine Methode dynamisch aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die aufgerufene Methode soll eine Statusmeldung setzen.
hint: `cl_gui_timer` und `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      start_dynamic_timer IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string,
      get_last_called_method RETURNING VALUE(rv_method) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_method_to_call TYPE string.
    DATA mv_last_called_method TYPE string.
    METHODS handle_timer_event FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
    METHODS method_a.
    METHODS method_b.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD start_dynamic_timer.
    mv_method_to_call = iv_method_name.
    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_timer_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 2. " 2 seconds
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_single_shot.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_event.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (mv_method_to_call) OF ME.
        mv_last_called_method = mv_method_to_call.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        mv_last_called_method = |Error: Method '{ mv_method_to_call }' not found or callable.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_a.
    MESSAGE |Method A was called by timer!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    MESSAGE |Method B was called by timer!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_called_method.
    rv_method = mv_last_called_method.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic_call( ).
    lo_cut->start_dynamic_timer( 'METHOD_A' ). " Initialize timer object with method name

    " Simulate timer event
    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->get_last_called_method( )
      exp = 'METHOD_A'
      msg = 'Method A should have been called dynamically'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_dynamic_call( ).
    lo_cut->start_dynamic_timer( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_event( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(

      msg = 'Should report an error for non-existent method'

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_gui_timer` mit dynamischem Methodenaufruf (`CALL METHOD OF ME`). Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen die auszuführende Aktion zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden muss. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für dynamische Aufrufe ist ebenfalls enthalten.

    IF mo_timer IS INITIAL.
      mo_timer = NEW cl_gui_timer( ).
      SET HANDLER handle_grouping_event FOR mo_timer.
      mo_timer->interval = 3. " 3 seconds
      mo_timer->run_mode = cl_gui_timer=>run_mode_periodic.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_grouping_event.
    mv_timer_runs = mv_timer_runs + 1.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_mock,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_mock.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_mock WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0403' )
    ).

    " Group by carrid and count flights, then filter for those with > 2 flights
    mt_top_airlines = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
      LET flight_count = GROUP SIZE IN GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( flight_count > 2 )
      ( CONV string( GROUP KEY ) )
    ).

    IF mv_timer_runs >= gc_max_runs.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_top_airlines.
    rt_airlines = mt_top_airlines.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `DIVIDE` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `COND` zur Vermeidung von Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_avg_prices = REDUCE tt_avg_price(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_avg_price( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET total_price = REDUCE sflight-price( INIT sum = 0 FOR <f> IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + <f>-price )
          num_flights = lines( GROUP flight ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( 
        BASE result
        ( carrid    = flight-carrid
          avg_price = COND #( WHEN num_flights > 0 THEN total_price / num_flights ELSE 0 ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch, die potenziell eine Division durch Null verursachen könnte. Implementieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung, die einen vordefinierten Standardwert zurückgibt, falls dies geschieht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Ausnahmebehandlung oder `COND` für eine präventive Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_zero_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide_try_catch
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.

    METHODS safe_divide_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_zero_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide_try_catch.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 0.0. " Standardwert im Falle einer Division durch Null
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide_cond.
    rv_result = COND #( WHEN iv_denominator <> 0 THEN iv_numerator / iv_denominator ELSE 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in der Tabelle `sflights` den Anteil des Flugpreises am Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft als Prozentsatz.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `DIVIDE` innerhalb einer Schleife, geschützt durch `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             price      TYPE sflight-price,
             percentage TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_flight_percentages
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_flight_percentages.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    rt_flight_percentages = VALUE tt_flight_detail(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid     = flight-carrid
        connid     = flight-connid
        price      = flight-price
        percentage = COND #( WHEN lv_total_price > 0 THEN ( flight-price / lv_total_price ) * 100 ELSE 0.0 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für jeden Flug ein neues Feld hinzufügen, das das Verhältnis von Preis zu Distanz darstellt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_transformed,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflight-connid,
             price        TYPE sflight-price,
             distance     TYPE sflight-distance,
             price_per_mile TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.
    TYPES tt_flight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_raw TYPE tt_flight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_transformed) TYPE tt_flight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flight_data.
    rt_flight_transformed = VALUE tt_flight_transformed(
      FOR flight IN it_flight_raw
      ( flight
        price_per_mile = COND #( WHEN flight-distance > 0 THEN flight-price / flight-distance ELSE 0.0 ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus `sflights`, bei denen das Verhältnis von Preis zu Distanz einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und den `DIVIDE`-Operator innerhalb der Filterbedingung, geschützt durch eine Prüfung auf Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_divide_filter_ratio DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             distance TYPE sflight-distance,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price_ratio
      IMPORTING
        iv_ratio_threshold TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_divide_filter_ratio IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price_ratio.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, distance FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_flight_data(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE ( distance > 0 AND ( price / distance ) > iv_ratio_threshold ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_ratio_match.

    " Example: Flight with price=200, distance=50 -> ratio=4.0. Threshold = 3.0.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_filter_ratio( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price_ratio( 3.0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_filter_ratio( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price_ratio( 1000.0 ). " Sehr hoher Schwellenwert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Expected no filtered flights for a very high threshold.'
    ).

  METHOD test_filter_ratio_zero_distance_excluded.
    " This test relies on the `distance > 0` condition in the FILTER expression.
    " If SFLIGHT contains entries with distance = 0, they should be excluded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_divide_filter_ratio( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price_ratio( 1.0 ).
    " Assert that no flights with distance = 0 are included.
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

Die Bedingung `distance > 0` ist entscheidend, um eine Division durch Null zu vermeiden und nur gültige Verhältnisse zu berücksichtigen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Kontextmenü und simulieren Sie die Auswahl eines Menüeintrags, um eine Aktion auszulösen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_CTMENU` und die Methode `GET_SELECTED_FUNCTION` nach der Anzeige des Menüs (simuliert).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ctmenu_action DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS menu_item_selected EXPORTING VALUE(i_fcode) TYPE c LENGTH 4.

    METHODS create_and_handle_menu
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulated_fcode TYPE c LENGTH 4 OPTIONAL " For testing/simulation
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_fcode) TYPE c LENGTH 4.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_action IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_handle_menu.
    DATA(lo_menu) = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SAVE' text = 'Speichern' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'LOAD' text = 'Laden' ).

    " In a real UI scenario, lo_menu->show_context_menu(...) would be called.
    " The user would then select an item, and the fcode would be returned.
    " For this example, we simulate the selection.
    IF iv_simulated_fcode IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_selected_fcode = iv_simulated_fcode.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate no selection or default
      rv_selected_fcode = ''.
    ENDIF.

    IF rv_selected_fcode IS NOT INITIAL.
      RAISE EVENT menu_item_selected EXPORTING i_fcode = rv_selected_fcode.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS zcl_i18n_str_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_str_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_strings.
    " CL_I18N_UTILS=>COMPARE_STRINGS_LOCALE returns 0 if equal, <0 if s1<s2, >0 if s1>s2
    IF cl_i18n_utils=>compare_strings_locale(
         iv_string1 = iv_string1,
         iv_string2 = iv_string2,
         iv_locale  = 'DE', " German locale
         iv_case_sensitive = abap_false ) = 0.
      rv_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->compare_strings( iv_string1 = 'Straße' iv_string2 = 'strasse' ),
      msg = 'Locale-sensitive comparison failed for "Straße" vs "strasse"' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_cut->compare_strings( iv_string1 = 'Müller' iv_string2 = 'Mueller' ),
      msg = 'Locale-sensitive comparison failed for "Müller" vs "Mueller"' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_cut->compare_strings( iv_string1 = 'Apfel' iv_string2 = 'Birne' ),
      msg = 'Incorrectly identified unequal strings as equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COMPARE_STRINGS_LOCALE` bietet eine robuste Möglichkeit, Strings unter Berücksichtigung sprachspezifischer Regeln zu vergleichen. Dies ist wichtig für Suchfunktionen oder Sortierungen, bei denen die Standard-Binärvergleiche nicht ausreichen.
keywords: I18N, Locale, String Comparison, CL_I18N_UTILS, Sortierung

Instructions: Normalisieren Sie einen Unicode-String in die Normalisierungsform C (NFC), um konsistente Darstellungen von Zeichen zu gewährleisten, die auf verschiedene Weisen kodiert werden können (z.B. é als einzelnes Zeichen oder als e + Akzent).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_I18N_UTILS=>NORMALIZE_STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_normalize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS normalize_unicode
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_normalize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD normalize_unicode.
    " Normalization Form C (NFC) is the default for this method
    rv_output = cl_i18n_utils=>normalize_string( iv_string = iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_normalization FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normalization.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_normalize( ).

    " Example: 'é' can be represented as U+00E9 (single character) or U+0065 U+0301 (e + combining acute accent)
    " Assuming the input might be in decomposed form (e + accent)
    DATA(lv_decomposed_e) TYPE string VALUE 'e' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>char_0301. " U+0065 U+0301
    DATA(lv_composed_e) TYPE string VALUE 'é'. " U+00E9

    " Test normalization of decomposed form to composed form (NFC)
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->normalize_unicode( lv_decomposed_e ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = lv_composed_e,
      msg = 'Unicode normalization (NFC) failed' ).

    " Test that already normalized string remains the same
    lv_result = lo_cut->normalize_unicode( lv_composed_e ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result,
      exp = lv_composed_e,
      msg = 'Already normalized string changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Unicode-Normalisierung ist entscheidend, um die Gleichheit von Strings zu gewährleisten, die dasselbe Zeichen, aber unterschiedliche interne Darstellungen haben. `NORMALIZE_STRING` vereinfacht diese komplexe Aufgabe und fördert die Datenkonsistenz.
keywords: I18N, Unicode, Normalization, NFC, CL_I18N_UTILS, String Processing

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen einfachen CSV-String mit Komma als Trennzeichen in eine interne Tabelle. Die CSV-Daten enthalten zwei Spalten: `ID` und `Name`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ICF_CSV=>PARSE_CSV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_simple_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_simple_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      iv_separator = ',',
      iv_has_header = abap_false ). " Assuming no header for simplicity in this example

    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv(
      EXPORTING
        iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        et_data       = DATA(lt_parsed_data) ).

    " Map the parsed data (which is a table of string tables) to the target structure
    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data ( 
                               id   = row[1],
                               name = row[2] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen CSV-String aus einer internen Tabelle mit `ID` und `Name` Spalten. Die Ausgabe soll Komma als Trennzeichen verwenden und einen Header enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ICF_CSV=>SERIALIZE_CSV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_serializer) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      iv_separator = ',',
      iv_has_header = abap_true ).

    " Convert internal table to a table of string tables for serialization
    DATA(lt_data_for_csv) = VALUE cl_icf_csv=>tt_data_string_table(
      ( 'ID' 'Name' ) " Header row
      FOR row IN it_data ( 
        VALUE #( ( CONV string( row-id ) ) ( row-name ) ) ) ).

    lo_csv_serializer->serialize_csv(
      EXPORTING
        it_data       = lt_data_for_csv
      IMPORTING
        ev_csv_string = rv_csv_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

FOR ... )` ist ein Beispiel für moderne ABAP-Syntax, die die Code-Lesbarkeit und -Kompaktheit verbessert.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String, der eine Kopfzeile enthält. Die Kopfzeile soll ignoriert werden, aber die Spaltennamen können zur Validierung verwendet werden.
hint: Setzen Sie `iv_has_header = abap_true` und nutzen Sie die `et_header` Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_header_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_record,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             date      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_record.
    TYPES: tt_records TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_record WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_records) TYPE tt_records.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_header_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_header.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      iv_separator  = ',',
      iv_has_header = abap_true ).

    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv(
      EXPORTING
        iv_csv_string = iv_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        et_data       = DATA(lt_parsed_data)
        et_header     = DATA(lt_header) ).

    " Optional: Validate header here if needed
    IF lt_header IS NOT INITIAL.
      IF lt_header[1] <> 'Flight ID' OR lt_header[2] <> 'Date'.
        " Handle error: unexpected header
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_records = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data ( 
                               flight_id = row[1],
                               date      = row[2] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_csv_header.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_header_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_input) = `Flight ID,Date` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `LH400,2025-12-04` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `UA123,2025-12-05`.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_csv_with_header( lv_csv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Incorrect number of data rows parsed' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[1]-flight_id,
      exp = 'LH400',
      msg = 'Incorrect Flight ID for first row' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_result[1]-date,
      exp = '2025-12-04',
      msg = 'Incorrect Date for first row' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_csv_invalid_header.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_header_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_input) = `Wrong Header,Date` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `LH400,2025-12-04`.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_abap_unit_assert_error( ),
      exp_type = 'CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST',

    TRY.
        lo_cut->parse_csv_with_header( lv_csv_input ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST was expected' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest.
        " Expected exception caught
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Durch Setzen von `iv_has_header = abap_true` kann `CL_ICF_CSV` die erste Zeile als Kopfzeile behandeln. Die Kopfzeile wird separat zurückgegeben (`et_header`), was eine Validierung der Spaltennamen ermöglicht, bevor die eigentlichen Daten verarbeitet werden.

CLASS zcl_csv_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine CSV-Datei, die als XSTRING vorliegt (z.B. aus einem Upload), und geben Sie die Daten als interne Tabelle zurück. Die CSV-Daten sind UTF-8 kodiert und haben einen Header.

CLASS zcl_csv_xstring_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             product_id TYPE string,
             name       TYPE string,
             price      TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_from_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_csv_xstring_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_from_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source      = iv_csv_xstring
      target_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = NEW cl_icf_csv(
      iv_separator  = ',',
      iv_has_header = abap_true ).

    lo_csv_parser->parse_csv(
      EXPORTING
        iv_csv_string = lv_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        et_data       = DATA(lt_parsed_data)
        et_header     = DATA(lt_header) ).

    " Assuming header is 'ProductID', 'Name', 'Price'
    rt_products = VALUE #( FOR row IN lt_parsed_data ( 
                               product_id = row[1],
                               name       = row[2],
                               price      = CONV p( row[3] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
