Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine private Methode `calculate_sum` und ein privates Attribut `mv_total` verwendet, um die Summe von zwei Zahlen zu berechnen und zu speichern. Die Summe soll über eine öffentliche Methode `add_numbers` zugänglich sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die Kapselung von Attributen und Hilfsmethoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_members DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_total TYPE i.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_val1 TYPE i
        iv_val2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_members IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    me->calculate_sum( iv_val1 = iv_num1 iv_val2 = iv_num2 ).
    rv_sum = me->mv_total.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_sum.
    me->mv_total = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_private_members( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->add_numbers( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->add_numbers( iv_num1 = -10 iv_num2 = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `PRIVATE SECTION` in ABAP-Klassen dient der Kapselung von Implementierungsdetails. Private Attribute und Methoden sind nur innerhalb der Klasse sichtbar und zugänglich, was die Wartbarkeit und Robustheit des Codes erhöht, indem interne Logik vor externen Zugriffen geschützt wird.
keywords: CLASS, PRIVATE SECTION, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle doppelten Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights), wobei die Duplikate anhand der Felder `carrid` und `connid` identifiziert werden. Behalten Sie die erste gefundene Zeile bei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` mit der `COMPARING` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid connid. " Must be sorted for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight_key.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230101'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230102'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20230103'. " Duplicate

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine klassische ABAP-Anweisung, die in Kombination mit `SORT` sehr effizient Duplikate aus internen Tabellen entfernt. Die `COMPARING` Klausel (seit ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht es, nur bestimmte Felder für den Duplikatsvergleich heranzuziehen, was eine präzisere Kontrolle bietet.
keywords: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Table, SORT, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die eine öffentliche Methode zur Verarbeitung von Flugdaten hat. Diese Methode soll eine private Hilfsmethode verwenden, um die Flugdauer zu validieren, bevor die Daten weiterverarbeitet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die Hilfsmethode, um die interne Logik zu kapseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS process_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_deptime TYPE sflight-deptime
        iv_arrtime TYPE sflight-arrtime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid_duration) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    IF me->validate_flight_duration( iv_deptime = is_flight-deptime iv_arrtime = is_flight-arrtime ) = abap_true.
      " Further processing of valid flight data
      rb_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_flight_duration.
    " Simple validation: arrival time must be after departure time
    IF iv_arrtime > iv_deptime.
      rb_is_valid_duration = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_is_valid_duration = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_duration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_duration.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum deptime = '100000' arrtime = '120000' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_duration.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_flight_processor=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum deptime = '120000' arrtime = '100000' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_cut->process_flight_data( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von privaten Hilfsmethoden in der `PRIVATE SECTION` fördert die Modularität und Lesbarkeit des Codes. Komplexe Logik kann in kleinere, wiederverwendbare Einheiten aufgeteilt werden, die nur intern von der Klasse genutzt werden. Dies verbessert die Struktur und erleichtert Tests.
keywords: CLASS, PRIVATE SECTION, Helper Method, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die in einer Liste von zu löschenden Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind. Verwenden Sie eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `COND` oder `FILTER`.
hint: Der `FILTER` Operator mit einer `IN` Bedingung ist hier sehr elegant.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_filter_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_out_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carriers_to_exclude TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_filter_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_out_carriers.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights EXCEPT IN it_carriers_to_exclude WHERE carrid = table_line ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_out_carriers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_out_carriers.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_filter_in=>tt_sflight,
          lt_exclude TYPE zcl_delete_with_filter_in=>tt_carrid.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.

    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_exclude.
    APPEND 'AA' TO lt_exclude.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_filter_in( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_out_carriers( it_all_flights = lt_flights it_carriers_to_exclude = lt_exclude ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator mit der `EXCEPT IN` Klausel (seit ABAP 7.50) bietet eine sehr prägnante und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen, die in einer anderen Tabelle oder Liste enthalten sind. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu filtern, die die Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, EXCEPT IN, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die private Konstanten für Fehlermeldungen enthält. Eine öffentliche Methode soll diese Konstanten verwenden, um spezifische Fehlermeldungen zurückzugeben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_private_constants DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_error_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_error_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_error_invalid_input TYPE string VALUE 'Ungültige Eingabe erkannt.',
               gc_error_not_found   TYPE string VALUE 'Eintrag nicht gefunden.'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_constants IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    CASE iv_error_code.
      WHEN 1.
        rv_message = gc_error_invalid_input.
      WHEN 2.
        rv_message = gc_error_not_found.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Fehler.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_private_constants( ).

    DATA(lv_msg1) = lo_cut->get_error_message( 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_msg1 exp = 'Ungültige Eingabe erkannt.' ).

    DATA(lv_msg2) = lo_cut->get_error_message( 2 ).

    DATA(lv_msg3) = lo_cut->get_error_message( 99 ).

Dies verbessert die Wartbarkeit, da Änderungen an diesen Konstanten keine Auswirkungen auf externe Konsumenten der Klasse haben.

explanation: Das Löschen einer Zeile über ihren Index ist eine direkte Methode, um spezifische Einträge zu entfernen. Die Überprüfung, ob die Tabelle nicht leer ist (`IF lines(...) > 0`), ist eine gute Praxis, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die ein bestimmtes Flugdatum haben, und geben Sie die gelöschten Zeilen zurück. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `VALUE` um die zu löschenden Zeilen zu sammeln und dann die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_and_return DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_and_get_deleted
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_deleted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_and_return IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_get_deleted.
    rt_deleted_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN ct_flights WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate ) ( flight ) ).
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_and_get FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_and_get.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_and_return=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_and_return( ).
    DATA(lt_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_and_get_deleted( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING iv_fldate = '20230101' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_deleted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `VALUE` und `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` (seit ABAP 7.40), um zuerst die zu löschenden Zeilen zu sammeln und dann die Originaltabelle zu modifizieren. Dies ist eine funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Art, Daten zu manipulieren, die die Lesbarkeit und Effizienz verbessert, insbesondere wenn sowohl die gelöschten als auch die verbleibenden Daten benötigt werden.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FOR, VALUE, WHERE, ABAP 7.50, Functional Programming

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT`, deren Flugdatum älter als ein Jahr ist, und protokollieren Sie die Anzahl der gelöschten Zeilen in einer privaten Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM` mit einem Datumsausdruck und rufen Sie eine private Protokollierungsmethode auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights_and_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS log_deleted_rows
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_sflight_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights_and_log.
    DATA(lv_one_year_ago) = sy-datum - 365.

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE fldate < @lv_one_year_ago.
    DATA(lv_deleted_count) = sy-dbcnt.

    IF lv_deleted_count > 0.
      me->log_deleted_rows( lv_deleted_count ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD log_deleted_rows.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log table or system log.
    " For this example, we'll just simulate it.
    MESSAGE |{ iv_count } Zeilen aus SFLIGHT gelöscht.| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_and_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_and_log.
    " Setup: Insert some test data into SFLIGHT
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20200101' ) " Old flight
      ( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum )   " Today's flight
      ( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '0003' fldate = ( sy-datum - 366 ) ) " Very old flight
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflight_log( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights_and_log( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).

    " Verify: Check remaining entries
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'ZZ' INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 1 ).

    " Cleanup
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'ZZ'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert die Datenbankoperation `DELETE FROM` mit einer privaten Protokollierungsmethode. Die Berechnung des Datums (`sy-datum - 365`) und die Verwendung von Hostvariablen (`@`) sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken. Die private Methode `log_deleted_rows` kapselt die Protokolllogik und hält die öffentliche Schnittstelle sauber.
keywords: DELETE, Database, SFLIGHT, PRIVATE SECTION, Logging, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die einen bestimmten Primärschlüssel (carrid, connid, fldate) haben. Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE itab WITH TABLE KEY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` für effizientes Löschen über den Tabellenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS delete_by_key
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
      IMPORTING
        is_key     TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_deleted) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_by_key.
    DELETE TABLE ct_flights FROM is_key.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rb_deleted = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_deleted = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_existing_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_non_existing_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_existing_key.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_key=>tt_sflight_key.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_delete_with_key=>ty_sflight_key(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_key( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_by_key( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING is_key = ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_non_existing_key.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_key=>tt_sflight_key.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_delete_with_key=>ty_sflight_key(
      carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20230101' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_key( ).
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_by_key( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING is_key = ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Löschen von Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle mittels `DELETE TABLE ... FROM wa` oder `DELETE TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY` ist die performanteste Methode, wenn der Tabellenschlüssel bekannt ist. Dies setzt voraus, dass die interne Tabelle einen definierten Schlüssel hat (hier `UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate`), was seit ABAP 7.40 Standard ist.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, Table Key, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine private, statische Methode zur Generierung einer eindeutigen ID hat. Eine öffentliche Instanzmethode soll diese private statische Methode nutzen, um Objekten eine ID zuzuweisen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `PRIVATE SECTION` für die statische Methode und `CLASS-METHODS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_private_static_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_counter TYPE i.
    CLASS-METHODS get_next_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_private_static_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->mv_id = zcl_private_static_id=>get_next_id( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_next_id.
    gv_counter = gv_counter + 1.
    rv_id = |ID-{ gv_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_id_generation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_id_generation.
    DATA(lo_obj1) = NEW zcl_private_static_id( ).
    DATA(lo_obj2) = NEW zcl_private_static_id( ).
    DATA(lo_obj3) = NEW zcl_private_static_id( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_obj1->mv_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_obj2->mv_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_obj3->mv_id ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lo_obj1->mv_id exp = lo_obj2->mv_id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lo_obj2->mv_id exp = lo_obj3->mv_id ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj1->mv_id exp = 'ID-0000000001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_obj2->mv_id exp = 'ID-0000000002' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer privaten statischen Methode (`CLASS-METHODS` in `PRIVATE SECTION`) ermöglicht es, Hilfsfunktionen zu implementieren, die klassenweit und ohne Instanzzugriff verfügbar sind, aber dennoch gekapselt bleiben. Dies ist ideal für die Verwaltung von klassenweiten Zuständen oder für Hilfslogik, die nicht an eine spezifische Objektinstanz gebunden ist. String-Templates (`|...|`) und `ALPHA = OUT` sind moderne ABAP 7.40+ Features für die String-Formatierung.
keywords: CLASS, PRIVATE SECTION, Static Method, CLASS-METHODS, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.55, String Templates

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct TYPE any
        iv_comp_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_comp_name OF STRUCTURE iv_struct TO <fs_component>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_component>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Value 1',
            field2 TYPE string VALUE 'Value 2',
          END OF ls_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_component_access( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_component_value( iv_struct = ls_data iv_comp_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Value 1' msg = 'Should get Value 1' ).

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten für ein einfaches Zeitdiagramm vor, das Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` visualisiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE` und moderne Tabellenoperationen wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_time_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             value     TYPE decfloat16,
             series_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_time_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                             LET lv_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                                                    iv_date = ls_flight-fldate
                                                    iv_time = '000000' ) IN
                             ( timestamp = lv_timestamp
                               value     = ls_flight-price
                               series_id = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_time_chart( ).
    DATA(lt_chart_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_data( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_chart_data msg = 'Chart data should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart_data ) exp = 10 msg = 'Should retrieve 10 flight entries' ).
    LOOP AT lt_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_data-timestamp msg = 'Timestamp should be set' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_data-value msg = 'Value should be set' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_data-series_id msg = 'Series ID should be set' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxen wie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` und `LET` eine interne Tabelle für ein Zeitdiagramm vorbereitet. Die `CL_ABAP_TSTMP=>CREATE_TSTMP_FROM_DATE_TIME` Methode wird verwendet, um Zeitstempel aus Datumswerten zu generieren, was für Zeitdiagramme unerlässlich ist.
keywords: cl_time_chart_simple, SFLIGHTS, VALUE, FOR, TIMESTAMP, INTERNAL TABLES

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN` mit `(method_name)` und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS dummy_method1.
    METHODS dummy_method2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string.

    lv_method_name = iv_method_name. " Assign to non-string type for ASSIGN (older syntax requirement)

    ASSIGN ('(IO_OBJECT)->(LV_METHOD_NAME)') TO <fs_method>. " Dynamic method access
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CALL METHOD <fs_method>.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method1.
    " Simulate some action
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Dummy Method 1 called!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method2.
    " Simulate some action
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Dummy Method 2 called!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).

    " Test calling an existing method
    DATA(lv_success1) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success1 exp = abap_true msg = 'Dummy Method 1 should be called successfully' ).

    " Test calling another existing method
    DATA(lv_success2) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success2 exp = abap_true msg = 'Dummy Method 2 should be called successfully' ).

    " Test calling a non-existent method
    DATA(lv_success3) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success3 exp = abap_false msg = 'Non-existent method call should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Methode `CALL METHOD` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN` und einem Feld-Symbol ermöglicht es, Methoden zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem String-Namen aufzurufen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder Plugins. Beachten Sie die Zuweisung des Methodennamens zu einer Nicht-String-Variable für die `ASSIGN`-Syntax.
keywords: ASSIGN, CALL METHOD, DYNAMIC, OBJECT, METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`-Objekt und setzen Sie dynamisch den Titel und fügen Sie eine Serie hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `set_title` und `add_series` der Klasse `CL_TIME_CHART_SIMPLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS configure_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_chart_title TYPE string
        iv_series_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_chart) TYPE REF TO cl_time_chart_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_chart_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD configure_chart.
    " In a real scenario, cl_time_chart_simple would be instantiated
    " and rendered in a UI context (e.g., Web Dynpro, Fiori).
    " Here, we simulate its configuration.
    ro_chart = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
    ro_chart->set_title( iv_chart_title ).
    ro_chart->add_series( iv_series_name ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chart_configuration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chart_configuration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_chart_config( ).
    DATA(lo_chart) = lo_cut->configure_chart( iv_chart_title = 'My Dynamic Chart' iv_series_name = 'Series A' ).

    " Since cl_time_chart_simple doesn't expose its internal state easily,

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer internen Tabelle zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und ändern Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL(...)`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_table_field
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    READ TABLE ct_data ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX iv_index.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen dynamischen Downcast eines Objekts durch, dessen Zieltyp zur Laufzeit als String bekannt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN` mit `CAST` und `TYPE HANDLE`.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cast DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message. " Just for a simple interface to cast to

    METHODS perform_dynamic_cast
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_target_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_casted_object) TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cast IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_dynamic_cast.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    DATA lo_target_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_object> TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type_name ).
        lo_target_type ?= lo_type_descr. " Cast to class descriptor

        IF lo_target_type IS BOUND.
          ASSIGN io_object TO <fs_object> CASTING TYPE (iv_target_type_name).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ro_casted_object = <fs_object>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        " Handle unknown type
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Type { iv_target_type_name } not found.| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle cast error
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Cast to { iv_target_type_name } failed.| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie dynamisch Werte aus einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `ASSIGN`, wobei das zu aggregierende Feld zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT sum = CONV decfloat16( 0 )
                       FOR ls_item IN it_items
                       LET lv_current_value = VALUE decfloat16( 0 ) IN
                       BLOCK:
                         ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_item TO <fs_field>.
                         IF sy-subrc = 0.
                           lv_current_value = <fs_field>.
                         ENDIF.
                       ENDBLOCK:
                       NEXT sum = sum + lv_current_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = '17' msg = 'Sum of AMOUNT should be 17' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_sum_non_existent.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = '10.5' amount = 5 ) TO lt_items.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reduce( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Felder innerhalb der Schleife. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Summenbildung über verschiedene Felder einer internen Tabelle, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Die `BLOCK` Syntax ist hier notwendig, um `ASSIGN` innerhalb des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks zu verwenden.

        iv_value     TYPE string

CLASS zcl_dynamic_variable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_assign_dynamic_var.
    DATA lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_dynamic_var> TYPE any.
    DATA l_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA l_data TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.
        ASSIGN l_data->* TO <fs_dynamic_var>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_dynamic_var> = iv_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Type { iv_type_name } not found.| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
        cl_demo_output=>display( |Assignment error for type { iv_type_name } with value { iv_value }.| ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_color_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_chart_color_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_chart_colors.
    ro_chart = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).
    ro_chart->set_title( 'Colored Chart' ).

    DATA(lv_color1) = SWITCH string( iv_color_scheme
                                     WHEN 'RED_BLUE' THEN '#FF0000' " Red
                                     WHEN 'GREEN_YELLOW' THEN '#00FF00' " Green
                                     ELSE '#808080' ). " Grey default
    DATA(lv_color2) = SWITCH string( iv_color_scheme
                                     WHEN 'RED_BLUE' THEN '#0000FF' " Blue

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_line_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_line,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_line.
    TYPES tt_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_line_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_line_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE ty_line.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie zwei Strings 'Hallo' und 'Welt' mit einem Leerzeichen dazwischen. Demonstrieren Sie sowohl die klassische CONCATENATE-Anweisung als auch moderne String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie `&&` für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_concat_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_classic IMPORTING iv_part1 TYPE string iv_part2 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
    METHODS concatenate_modern IMPORTING iv_part1 TYPE string iv_part2 TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_concat_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_classic.
    CONCATENATE iv_part1 iv_part2 INTO rv_result SEPARATED BY space.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_modern.
    rv_result = |{ iv_part1 } { iv_part2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne und bevorzugte Methode zur String-Verkettung in ABAP. Sie sind lesbarer, flexibler und ermöglichen die direkte Einbettung von Variablen und Ausdrücken (`{ variable }`). Die klassische `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung ist weniger intuitiv und erfordert oft zusätzliche Schritte für komplexe Verkettungen.
keywords: CONCATENATE, String Templates, String Processing

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften. Erstellen Sie einen einzelnen String, der alle Fluggesellschaftscodes, durch Kommas getrennt, enthält. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator und String-Templates.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_reduce_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier,
           tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_list IMPORTING it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrier_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_list.
    rv_carrier_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_carrier> IN it_carriers
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_carrier>-carrid ELSE |{ s }, { <fs_carrier>-carrid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache ALV-Liste für die Tabelle `sflights`. Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table` zur Anzeige und `cl_salv_ex_util` zur Generierung des Feldkatalogs.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` und `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS display_sflights IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lt_field_catalog TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog(
        EXPORTING
          r_data          = REF #( <fs_data> )
        IMPORTING
          et_field_catalog = lt_field_catalog
      ).

      cl_salv_table=>factory(
        EXPORTING
          r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
        IMPORTING
          r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
        CHANGING
          t_table      = <fs_data>
      ).

      lo_salv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_field_catalog ).

      lo_salv_table->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).
      lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( 'Flugliste (SFLIGHTS)' ).

      lo_salv_table->display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen Feldkatalog für die Tabelle `sflights`. Modifizieren Sie anschließend den Eintrag für das Feld `CARRID`, um es als nicht ausgabefähig (`NO_OUT`) zu markieren und eine benutzerdefinierte Überschrift zu setzen. Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_ex_util` und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog` und anschließend `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` zur Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_modify_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS modify_field_catalog IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_modify_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_field_catalog.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      cl_salv_ex_util=>factory_field_catalog(
        EXPORTING
          r_data          = REF #( <fs_data> )
        IMPORTING
          et_field_catalog = rt_field_catalog
      ).

      LOOP AT rt_field_catalog ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fcat_entry>) WHERE fieldname = 'CARRID'.
        <fs_fcat_entry>-no_out = abap_true.
        <fs_fcat_entry>-seltext = 'Fluggesellschaft ID'.
        <fs_fcat_entry>-reptext = 'Fluggesellschaft ID'.
        <fs_fcat_entry>-coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft ID'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen dynamischen Titel für eine ALV-Liste, der den aktuellen Benutzer und das aktuelle Datum enthält. Zeigen Sie dann eine einfache ALV-Liste der `sflights`-Tabelle mit diesem Titel an. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für den Titel und `cl_salv_table` für die Anzeige.
hint: Verwenden Sie `sy-uname` und `sy-datum` in String-Templates und setzen Sie den Titel über `lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_title DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_title IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_title IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_title.
    DATA: lo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table,
          lv_title      TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      lv_title = |Flugliste erstellt von { sy-uname } am { sy-datum DATE = USER }|.

      cl_salv_table=>factory(
        EXPORTING
          r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
        IMPORTING
          r_salv_table = lo_salv_table
        CHANGING
          t_table      = <fs_data>
      ).

      lo_salv_table->get_display_settings( )->set_list_header( lv_title ).
      lo_salv_table->get_functions( )->set_all( abap_true ).

      lo_salv_table->display( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Flugnummer validiert. Wenn die Flugnummer ungültig ist (z.B. leer oder nicht numerisch), soll eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_num DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    INTERFACES if_t100_message. 
    DATA flight_number TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY. 
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL 
                                  flight_number TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_num IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD constructor. 
    CALL METHOD super->constructor 
      EXPORTING 
        textid = textid. 
    me->flight_number = flight_number. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    METHODS validate_flight_number 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_flight_num TYPE s_carr_id 
      RAISING 
        zcx_invalid_flight_num. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD validate_flight_number. 
    IF iv_flight_num IS INITIAL OR NOT iv_flight_num CO '0123456789'. 
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_num 
        EXPORTING 
          textid        = zcx_invalid_flight_num=>default_text 
          flight_number = iv_flight_num. 
    ENDIF. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Für jeden Flug, der einen bestimmten Schwellenwert für die maximale Belegung überschreitet, soll eine Warnmeldung im Anwendungsprotokoll (`BAL`) erzeugt werden. Fehlerhafte Einträge sollen als Fehlermeldung protokolliert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` zum Erstellen und Verwalten des Anwendungsprotokolls.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data, 
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid, 
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid, 
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate, 
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc, 
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax, 
           END OF ty_flight_data. 
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS process_flights 
      IMPORTING 
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data 
        iv_occupancy_threshold TYPE i DEFAULT 80. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv3 TYPE bal_t_msgv3 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv4 TYPE bal_t_msgv4 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_flight_processor IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
        i_msgv3 = iv_msgv3 
        i_msgv4 = iv_msgv4 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD process_flights. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight). 
      IF ls_flight-seatsmax = 0. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid iv_msgv3 = 'Max seats is zero' ). 
        CONTINUE. 
      ENDIF. 

      DATA(lv_occupancy_percent) = ( ls_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_flight-seatsmax. 

      IF lv_occupancy_percent > iv_occupancy_threshold. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid iv_msgv3 = lv_occupancy_percent ). 
      ELSE. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = ls_flight-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_flight-connid ). 
      ENDIF. 
    ENDLOOP. 

    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null versucht. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und protokollieren Sie sie. Wenn die Ausnahme behandelbar ist, soll die Verarbeitung fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` und prüfen Sie `is_resumable()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    METHODS divide 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_numerator   TYPE i 
        iv_denominator TYPE i 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f 
      RAISING 
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD divide. 
    TRY. 
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator. 
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith). 
        MESSAGE lx_arith->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. 

        IF lx_arith->is_resumable( ) = abap_true. 
          " In a real scenario, you might try to fix the denominator or provide a default. 
          " For this example, we re-raise it as it's not truly fixable here. 
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith. 
        ELSE. 
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith. 
        ENDIF. 
    ENDTRY. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    ENDTRY. 
  ENDMETHOD.

Das Konzept der 'resumable exceptions' (`is_resumable`) erlaubt es, nach der Fehlerbehandlung die Ausführung fortzusetzen, falls der Fehler behoben werden kann. `RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith` ermöglicht das erneute Auslösen einer gefangenen Ausnahme.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie eine Liste von Flugbuchungen auf Konsistenz (z.B. `SEATS` darf `MAX_SEATS` nicht überschreiten). Protokollieren Sie Inkonsistenzen als Fehlermeldungen und gültige Einträge als Erfolgsmeldungen im Anwendungsprotokoll.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und moderne interne Tabellenoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_booking_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_data, 
             carrid    TYPE sbook-carrid, 
             connid    TYPE sbook-connid, 
             fldate    TYPE sbook-fldate, 
             bookid    TYPE sbook-bookid, 
             seats     TYPE sbook-seats, 
             max_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax, 
           END OF ty_booking_data. 
    TYPES tt_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS validate_bookings 
      IMPORTING 
        it_bookings TYPE tt_booking_data. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv3 TYPE bal_t_msgv3 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv4 TYPE bal_t_msgv4 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_booking_validator IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
        i_msgv3 = iv_msgv3 
        i_msgv4 = iv_msgv4 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD validate_bookings. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    LOOP AT it_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking). 
      IF ls_booking-seats > ls_booking-max_seats. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SBOOK' iv_msgno = '001' 
                     iv_msgv1 = ls_booking-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_booking-connid 
                     iv_msgv3 = ls_booking-bookid iv_msgv4 = 'Seats exceed max' ). 
      ELSEIF ls_booking-seats <= 0. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'SBOOK' iv_msgno = '002' 
                     iv_msgv1 = ls_booking-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_booking-connid 
                     iv_msgv3 = ls_booking-bookid iv_msgv4 = 'Invalid seat count' ). 
      ELSE. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'SBOOK' iv_msgno = '003' 
                     iv_msgv1 = ls_booking-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_booking-connid 
                     iv_msgv3 = ls_booking-bookid iv_msgv4 = 'Booking valid' ). 
      ENDIF. 
    ENDLOOP. 
    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Überwachung eines kritischen Systems. Wenn ein bestimmtes Ereignis (z.B. hoher Speicherverbrauch) auftritt, soll eine kritische Fehlermeldung im Anwendungsprotokoll erzeugt werden, die auch technische Details enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und die Möglichkeit, detaillierte Nachrichten zu protokollieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_system_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    METHODS check_system_status 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_memory_usage_mb TYPE i 
        iv_cpu_load_percent TYPE i. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv3 TYPE bal_t_msgv3 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv4 TYPE bal_t_msgv4 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_system_monitor IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
        i_msgv3 = iv_msgv3 
        i_msgv4 = iv_msgv4 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD check_system_status. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    CONSTANTS: lc_mem_threshold TYPE i VALUE 1024, 
               lc_cpu_threshold TYPE i VALUE 90. 

    IF iv_memory_usage_mb > lc_mem_threshold. 
      add_message( iv_msgty = 'A' iv_msgid = 'ZMONITOR' iv_msgno = '001' 
                   iv_msgv1 = 'High Memory Usage' iv_msgv2 = iv_memory_usage_mb iv_msgv3 = lc_mem_threshold ). 
    ELSEIF iv_cpu_load_percent > lc_cpu_threshold. 
      add_message( iv_msgty = 'A' iv_msgid = 'ZMONITOR' iv_msgno = '002' 
                   iv_msgv1 = 'High CPU Load' iv_msgv2 = iv_cpu_load_percent iv_msgv3 = lc_cpu_threshold ). 
    ELSE. 
      add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZMONITOR' iv_msgno = '003' 
                   iv_msgv1 = 'System OK' ). 
    ENDIF. 

    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

      RAISING 
        zcx_flight_not_found.

      FROM sflights

        EXPORTING

          carrid = iv_carrid

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Protokollieren Sie jede Zahl als Erfolgsmeldung. Wenn eine Zahl negativ ist, protokollieren Sie eine Warnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und eine einfache Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS process_numbers 
      IMPORTING 
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD process_numbers. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number). 
      IF lv_number < 0. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'ZNUMPROC' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = lv_number ). 
      ELSE. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZNUMPROC' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = lv_number ). 
      ENDIF. 
    ENDLOOP. 
    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die ein Objekt eines bestimmten Typs erstellt. Wenn der angeforderte Typ ungültig ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` in der Factory-Methode und eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC. 
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string. 
ENDINTERFACE. 

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    INTERFACES zif_product. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD zif_product~get_name. 
    rv_name = 'Product A'. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    INTERFACES zif_product. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD zif_product~get_name. 
    rv_name = 'Product B'. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcx_invalid_product_type DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    INTERFACES if_t100_message. 
    DATA product_type TYPE string READ-ONLY. 
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL 
                                  product_type TYPE string OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcx_invalid_product_type IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD constructor. 
    CALL METHOD super->constructor 
      EXPORTING 
        textid = textid. 
    me->product_type = product_type. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    CLASS-METHODS create_product 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_product_type TYPE string 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product 
      RAISING 
        zcx_invalid_product_type. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_product. 
    CASE iv_product_type. 
      WHEN 'A'. 
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ). 
      WHEN 'B'. 
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ). 
      WHEN OTHERS. 
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_product_type 
          EXPORTING 
            textid       = zcx_invalid_product_type=>default_text 
            product_type = iv_product_type. 
    ENDCASE. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Wenn ein Feld (z.B. `PLANETYPE`) leer ist, soll eine Warnung im Anwendungsprotokoll erzeugt werden, aber die Transformation fortgesetzt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und `FOR` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight, 
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid, 
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid, 
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype, 
           END OF ty_raw_flight. 
    TYPES tt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight, 
             flight_key TYPE string, 
             aircraft   TYPE sflight-planetype, 
           END OF ty_transformed_flight. 
    TYPES tt_transformed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS transform_flights 
      IMPORTING 
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_raw_flights 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flights. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD transform_flights. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights 
      ( 
        flight_key = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid }|, 
        aircraft   = COND #( 
                       WHEN ls_raw-planetype IS INITIAL 
                         THEN ( add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'ZFLTRANS' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = ls_raw-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_raw-connid ) ) ; 'UNKNOWN' 
                       ELSE ls_raw-planetype 
                     ) 
      ) 
    ). 

    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD test_flight_transformation. 
    DATA: lt_raw_flights TYPE zcl_flight_transformer=>tt_raw_flights. 

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_raw_flights. 
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' planetype = '' ) TO lt_raw_flights. 
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' planetype = 'B747' ) TO lt_raw_flights. 

    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ). 
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( it_raw_flights = lt_raw_flights ). 

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_transformer->mo_bal_log ). 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 3 ). 
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-aircraft exp = 'UNKNOWN' ). 
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe einer Liste von Zahlen. Wenn die Liste leer ist, soll eine Ausnahme ausgelöst werden. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `RAISE EXCEPTION` in Kombination mit einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_list_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    INTERFACES if_t100_message. 
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcx_empty_list_error IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD constructor. 
    CALL METHOD super->constructor 
      EXPORTING 
        textid = textid. 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_list_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS calculate_sum 
      IMPORTING 
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i 
      RAISING 
        zcx_empty_list_error. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_list_calculator IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD calculate_sum. 
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL. 
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_list_error 
        EXPORTING 
          textid = zcx_empty_list_error=>default_text. 
    ENDIF. 

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 
                       FOR lv_num IN it_numbers 
                       NEXT s = s + lv_num ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. 
  PRIVATE SECTION. 
    METHODS test_sum_non_empty_list FOR TESTING. 
    METHODS test_sum_empty_list FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_empty_list_error. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD test_sum_non_empty_list. 
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE zcl_list_calculator=>tt_numbers. 
    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers. 
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers. 
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flugbuchungen nach einem bestimmten Kunden. Protokollieren Sie jede gefilterte Buchung als Erfolgsmeldung. Wenn keine Buchungen für den Kunden gefunden werden, protokollieren Sie eine Warnung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und `FILTER` für die Datenfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_booking_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking, 
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid, 
             customid TYPE sbook-customid, 
             carrid   TYPE sbook-carrid, 
             connid   TYPE sbook-connid, 
           END OF ty_booking. 
    TYPES tt_bookings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS filter_bookings_by_customer 
      IMPORTING 
        it_all_bookings TYPE tt_bookings 
        iv_customer_id  TYPE sbook-customid 
      RETURNING 
        VALUE(rt_filtered_bookings) TYPE tt_bookings. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_booking_filter IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD filter_bookings_by_customer. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    rt_filtered_bookings = FILTER #( it_all_bookings WHERE customid = iv_customer_id ). 

    IF rt_filtered_bookings IS INITIAL. 
      add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'ZBOOKFIL' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = iv_customer_id ). 
    ELSE. 
      LOOP AT rt_filtered_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking). 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZBOOKFIL' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = ls_booking-bookid ). 
      ENDLOOP. 
    ENDIF. 

    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität für Flüge in `SFLIGHTS`. Wenn ein Update fehlschlägt (z.B. wegen eines nicht existierenden Fluges), protokollieren Sie einen Fehler im Anwendungsprotokoll. Erfolgreiche Updates sollen als Erfolgsmeldung protokolliert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und `UPDATE` mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update, 
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid, 
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid, 
             new_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax, 
           END OF ty_flight_update. 
    TYPES tt_flight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS update_flight_seats 
      IMPORTING 
        it_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_flight_updater IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD update_flight_seats. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update). 
      UPDATE sflights 
        SET seatsmax = @ls_update-new_seatsmax 
        WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid 
          AND connid = @ls_update-connid. 

      IF sy-subrc = 0. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZFLUPD' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = ls_update-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_update-connid ). 
      ELSE. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZFLUPD' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = ls_update-carrid iv_msgv2 = ls_update-connid ). 
      ENDIF. 
    ENDLOOP. 

    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_validator IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD validate_email. 
    CONSTANTS: lc_email_regex TYPE string VALUE '^\S+@\S+\.\S+$'. " Simple regex for demonstration

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Hintergrundjob, der eine lange Liste von Aufgaben verarbeitet. Protokollieren Sie den Start und das Ende des Jobs sowie den Status jeder einzelnen Aufgabe im Anwendungsprotokoll. Wenn eine Aufgabe fehlschlägt, protokollieren Sie einen Fehler.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und strukturieren Sie den Log-Aufbau für einen Job.
solution:
CLASS zcl_background_job_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. 
  PUBLIC SECTION. 
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task, 
             id     TYPE i, 
             status TYPE string, 
           END OF ty_task. 
    TYPES tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY. 

    METHODS run_job 
      IMPORTING 
        it_tasks TYPE tt_tasks. 

  PROTECTED SECTION. 
    DATA mo_bal_log TYPE REF TO cl_s_aut_bal_log. 
    METHODS create_log_handle. 
    METHODS add_message 
      IMPORTING 
        iv_msgty TYPE bal_t_msgtp 
        iv_msgid TYPE bal_t_msgid 
        iv_msgno TYPE bal_t_msgno 
        iv_msgv1 TYPE bal_t_msgv1 OPTIONAL 
        iv_msgv2 TYPE bal_t_msgv2 OPTIONAL. 
ENDCLASS. 

CLASS zcl_background_job_sim IMPLEMENTATION. 
  METHOD create_log_handle. 
    mo_bal_log = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ). 
    mo_bal_log->create_log_handle( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD add_message. 
    mo_bal_log->add_message( 
      EXPORTING 
        i_msgty = iv_msgty 
        i_msgid = iv_msgid 
        i_msgno = iv_msgno 
        i_msgv1 = iv_msgv1 
        i_msgv2 = iv_msgv2 
    ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 

  METHOD run_job. 
    create_log_handle( ). 

    add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = 'ZJOB' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgv1 = 'Job started' ). 

    LOOP AT it_tasks INTO DATA(ls_task). 
      IF ls_task-status = 'ERROR'. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZJOB' iv_msgno = '002' iv_msgv1 = ls_task-id iv_msgv2 = 'Task failed' ). 
      ELSE. 
        add_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_msgid = 'ZJOB' iv_msgno = '003' iv_msgv1 = ls_task-id iv_msgv2 = 'Task completed' ). 
      ENDIF. 
    ENDLOOP. 

    add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = 'ZJOB' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = 'Job finished' ). 
    mo_bal_log->save_log( ). 
  ENDMETHOD. 
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei interne Tabellen mit identischer Struktur in eine dritte Tabelle. Die erste Tabelle enthält Flugdaten von Lufthansa, die zweite von Air France. Fügen Sie alle Einträge der Air France-Tabelle an die Lufthansa-Tabelle an.

CLASS zcl_itab_append_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA: lt_lufthansa TYPE zcl_itab_append_lines=>tt_flights,

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung der Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io` zum Lesen einer Sprachdatei. Nehmen Sie an, es existiert eine Sprachdatei auf dem Applikationsserver.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `READ_FILE_TO_TABLE` der Klasse `cl_cts_language_file_io`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cts_lang_file_io_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_file_content TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_language_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_file_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE tt_file_content
      RAISING
        cx_cts_language_file_io.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cts_lang_file_io_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_language_file.
    " In a real scenario, iv_file_path would point to a language file
    " on the application server, e.g., in a transport directory.
    TRY.
        cl_cts_language_file_io=>read_file_to_table(
          EXPORTING
            i_file_name = iv_file_path
          IMPORTING

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ). " Annahme: AA-Flüge existieren
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Airline
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle zu durchlaufen und einen einzelnen Wert (hier die Summe) zu berechnen, ohne explizite Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen. Die `INIT` Klausel setzt den Startwert des Akkumulators, und `NEXT` definiert die Iterationslogik.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Math

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Struktur `ty_source_flight` zu einer Struktur `ty_target_flight`, die ähnliche, aber nicht identische Feldnamen haben (z.B. `carrid` zu `airline_id`, `connid` zu `flight_num`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_source_flight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             amount     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency   TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_target_flight.

    METHODS map_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING airline_id = carrid
                                                 flight_num = connid
                                                 flight_date = fldate
                                                 amount = price ).
    rs_target-currency = 'EUR'. " Zusätzliches Feld manuell setzen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_flight_data( ls_source ).

Er kann Felder automatisch zuordnen, wenn die Namen übereinstimmen, und bietet die `MAPPING` Klausel für explizite Zuordnungen bei unterschiedlichen Namen. Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach allen Flügen, die nach 'New York' (CITYTO = 'NEW YORK') gehen und deren Flugdatum (FLDATE) nach dem 01.01.2025 liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_cityto TYPE sflight-cityto
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE cityto = iv_cityto AND fldate > iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_cityto = 'NEW YORK' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge nach NEW YORK nach dem 01.01.2025
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate > '20250101' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_operator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

WHERE` und kann mit Schlüsseln (`USING KEY`) für optimierte Performance verwendet werden. Dies führt zu kürzerem und besser verständlichem Code.
