Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflight` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, die in einer internen Tabelle definiert sind, um einen gegebenen Prozentsatz. Nutzen Sie moderne Syntax für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung und den `UPDATE`-Befehl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` um die zu aktualisierenden Daten vorzubereiten und `UPDATE FROM TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbu_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbu_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_updated_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Select flights for the given airline
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_updated_rows = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Modern way to update internal table using FOR and VALUE
    lt_updated_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( ls_flight WITH price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) ).

    " Update database table from internal table
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_updated_sflights.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbu_single_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_dbu_single_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_status.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    " Select the specific flight
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Annahme: sflight hat ein benutzerdefiniertes Feld 'STATUS' für Demonstrationszwecke.
      " In einem realen Szenario würden Sie ein vorhandenes Feld oder eine benutzerdefinierte Tabelle verwenden.
      ls_sflight-status = iv_new_status.
      MODIFY sflight FROM ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Berechnung durch und prüfen Sie, ob das Ergebnis den maximalen oder minimalen Wert eines `i` (Integer) überschreitet oder unterschreitet. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung zurück.

CLASS zcl_mth_overflow_check IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result) = iv_value1 + iv_value2.

      rv_message = |Ergebnis { lv_result } unterschreitet den minimalen Integer-Wert { cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Ergebnis { lv_result } liegt im gültigen Integer-Bereich.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch ein `UPDATE`-Statement für die Tabelle `sflight` generiert und ausführt, um ein beliebiges Feld zu aktualisieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_update_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
        iv_carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid     TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_update_sflight.
    DATA(lv_sql_statement) = |UPDATE sflight SET { iv_field_name } = '{ iv_new_value }' | &
                             |WHERE carrid = '{ iv_carrid }' AND connid = '{ iv_connid }' AND fldate = '{ iv_fldate }'|.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          {lv_sql_statement}
        ENDEXEC.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          COMMIT WORK.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          ROLLBACK WORK.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das Feld `CARRID` in `sflight` für alle Einträge, bei denen es Leerzeichen enthält, indem Sie die Leerzeichen entfernen. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CONDENSE` (oder String-Funktionen) in Kombination mit `UPDATE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` um eine interne Tabelle mit bereinigten `CARRID`s zu erstellen, dann `UPDATE FROM TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_update_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_carrid_in_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_update_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_carrid_in_sflight.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA lt_flights_to_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Select flights where CARRID might contain spaces
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid LIKE '% %'.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_updated_rows = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Use FOR and VALUE to create a new table with cleaned CARRID
    lt_flights_to_update = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    ( ls_flight WITH carrid = condense( ls_flight-carrid ) ) ).

    " Update database table from internal table
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ) ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'AA'. " Cleaned up entries
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE mt_sflight_initial.

  METHOD test_clean_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_update_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_updated_rows) = lo_cut->clean_carrid_in_sflight( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_rows exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 rows updated' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_lh exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID LH not cleaned' ).

    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_carrid_aa) WHERE connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid_aa exp = 'AA' msg = 'CARRID AA not cleaned' ).

    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_carrid_ba) WHERE connid = '0001' AND fldate = '20250101'.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe von Flugpreisen für eine Fluggesellschaft. Prüfen Sie während der Aggregation mit `REDUCE`, ob ein Überlauf des Summenfeldes (Typ `i`) droht, und brechen Sie ab, falls dies der Fall ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int` für die Prüfung. Werfen Sie eine Exception bei Überlauf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_overflow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price_with_check
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE i. " Using I for demonstration of overflow check
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_overflow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price_with_check.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_prices) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    TRY.
        rv_total_price = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_price IN lt_prices
                                   NEXT sum = COND #( WHEN sum > cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int - ls_price-price
                                                      THEN THROW cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow( )
                                                      ELSE sum + ls_price-price ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        rv_total_price = -1. " Indicate overflow
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '20000' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '30000' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int - 100 currency = 'EUR' ) " Near max int
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 currency = 'EUR' ) " Will cause overflow
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' OR carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE mt_sflight_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_no_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_overflow( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_with_check( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 60000 msg = 'Sum without overflow incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_with_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_overflow( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price_with_check( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = -1 msg = 'Overflow not handled correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Integer-Wert entgegennimmt und basierend darauf, ob der Wert nahe am Minimum, Maximum oder dazwischen liegt, eine Beschreibung zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int`, `max_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cnd_value_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cnd_value_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_description.
    DATA(lv_max_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int.
    DATA(lv_min_int) = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int.

    CASE iv_value.
      WHEN lv_max_int.
        rv_description = 'Der Wert ist der maximal mögliche Integer-Wert.'.
      WHEN lv_min_int.
        rv_description = 'Der Wert ist der minimal mögliche Integer-Wert.'.
      WHEN lv_max_int - 1 TO lv_max_int - 10.
        rv_description = 'Der Wert liegt nahe am maximalen Integer-Wert.'.
      WHEN lv_min_int + 10 TO lv_min_int + 1.
        rv_description = 'Der Wert liegt nahe am minimalen Integer-Wert.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Der Wert liegt im mittleren Bereich.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück.

solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_body) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        i_url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        e_http_client        = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found   = 1
        plugin_not_active    = 2
        internal_error       = 3
        OTHERS               = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. "Simplified error handling for example
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. "Simplified error handling for example
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. "Simplified error handling for example
    ENDIF.

    rv_response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine URL durch, die einen Fehler (z.B. 404 Not Found) zurückgibt, und verarbeiten Sie den HTTP-Statuscode und die Fehlermeldung.
hint: Überprüfen Sie `lo_http_client->response->get_status()` und `get_status_text()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_error_info,
             status_code TYPE i,
             status_text TYPE string,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_error_info.

    METHODS fetch_and_handle_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_error_info) TYPE ty_http_error_info
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_and_handle_error.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            i_url         = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            e_http_client = lo_http_client
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        rs_error_info = VALUE #(
          status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( )
          status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( )
          response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( )
        ).

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_req_send_error cx_http_io_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        " In a real scenario, you would log the exception details
        rs_error_info = VALUE #(
          status_code = -1 "Indicate a client-side communication error
          status_text = lx_http_error->get_text( )
          response_body = ''
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie verschiedene Arten von Nachrichten (Erfolg, Warnung, Fehler) in einer `cf_reca_message_list` und geben Sie die Anzahl der Fehler zurück.

CLASS zcl_msg_collector_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    lo_message_list->add_message(
      i_msgty = 'S' " Success
      i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      i_msgno = '001'
      i_msgv1 = 'Operation successful'
    ).

    IF iv_value < 0.

        i_msgty = 'W' " Warning
        i_msgid = 'ZMSG'
        i_msgno = '003'
        i_msgv1 = 'Value is zero'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rv_error_count = lo_message_list->get_number_of_messages_by_type( i_msgty = 'E' ).

Instructions: Sammeln Sie verschiedene Nachrichten und filtern Sie diese, um nur die Fehlermeldungen zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_messages_by_type()` oder `FILTER` auf die gesamte Nachrichtenliste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_filter_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message,
             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             msgid TYPE symsgid,
             msgno TYPE symsgno,
             msgv1 TYPE symsgv,
           END OF ty_message.
    TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_filter_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Success' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Warning' ).
    IF iv_input_value < 0.
      lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Error: Negative value' ).
    ENDIF.
    lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Info' ).

    " Modern way to get and filter messages
    rt_error_messages = VALUE #( FOR <message> IN lo_message_list->get_messages( )
                                 WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
                                 ( msgty = <message>-msgty
                                   msgid = <message>-msgid
                                   msgno = <message>-msgno
                                   msgv1 = <message>-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sammeln Sie mehrere Fehlermeldungen und fassen Sie deren Texte zu einem einzigen String zusammen, getrennt durch Semikolons.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_reduce_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS summarize_error_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_reduce_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      IF lv_value < 0.
        lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = |Error: Value { lv_value } is negative| ).
      ELSEIF lv_value = 0.
        lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = |Warning: Value { lv_value } is zero| ).
      ELSE.
        lo_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'S' i_msgid = 'ZMSG' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = |Success: Value { lv_value } is positive| ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Use REDUCE to concatenate error messages
    rv_summary = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR <message> IN lo_message_list->get_messages( )
      WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
      NEXT result = COND string(
                      WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <message>-msgv1
                      ELSE |{ result }; { <message>-msgv1 }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_validation_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_data.
    ro_message_list = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

      ro_message_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'ZVAL' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Text field cannot be empty' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Nachrichtenklasse und verwenden Sie diese, um Nachrichten in einer `cf_reca_message_list` zu sammeln.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Nachrichtenklasse (z.B. `ZCL_MY_MESSAGE`) und verwenden Sie `add_message_from_exception()`.
solution:
" Define a custom message class (e.g., ZCL_MY_MESSAGE) in SE24
" It should inherit from CX_STATIC_CHECK or a more specific exception class
" and implement IF_T100_MESSAGE.
" For this example, we simulate it with a simple exception and direct message addition.
" In a real scenario, ZCL_MY_MESSAGE would have message numbers defined in SE91.

CLASS zcl_msg_custom_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_custom_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    ro_message_list = cf_reca_message_list=>create_message_list( ).

    IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
      " Simulate a custom error message
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = 'ZCUSTOM_MSG' " Assume ZCUSTOM_MSG is a message class in SE91
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgv1 = 'Custom Error: Input data is empty'
      ).
    ELSEIF strlen( iv_data ) > 20.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgid = 'ZCUSTOM_MSG'
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgv1 = 'Custom Warning: Data is too long'
      ).
    ELSE.
      ro_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = 'ZCUSTOM_MSG'
        i_msgno = '003'
        i_msgv1 = 'Custom Success: Data processed'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights), basierend auf den Feldern 'CARRID' und 'CONNID'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` mit der `COMPARING` Ergänzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flight_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_duplicates=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_duplicates( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flight_duplicates( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine effiziente Methode, um Duplikate in einer sortierten internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Die `COMPARING` Ergänzung erlaubt die Angabe spezifischer Felder für den Vergleich, was seit ABAP 7.40 verfügbar ist und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: DELETE, ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, COMPARING

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus einer internen Tabelle, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, unter Verwendung einer funktionalen Methode.

solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_by_condition DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS delete_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_max_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_by_condition IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_expensive_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE price <= iv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum, die bereits in der Vergangenheit liegen.

CLASS zcl_delete_db_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_delete_db_entries IMPLEMENTATION.

    DELETE FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND fldate < @iv_fldate.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_db_entries( ).
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'LH',
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20251201'.

    " Setup test data (insert some records first)
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflights(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251130' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251201' )

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die moderne Open SQL Syntax (ab ABAP 7.40) erlaubt die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit dem `@`-Zeichen direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel, was die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit gegenüber SQL-Injections verbessert. `sy-dbcnt` liefert die Anzahl der betroffenen Zeilen.
keywords: DELETE, Open SQL, Database, WHERE, Host Variables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle enthält, außer denen, die eine bestimmte Währung haben und deren Preis unter einem Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `IF` Bedingung, um Elemente selektiv zu übernehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_with_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_with_reduce
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_currency TYPE s_curcode
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_with_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_with_reduce.
    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE tt_sflight( )
                                    FOR flight IN it_flights
                                    WHERE NOT ( flight-currency = iv_currency AND flight-price < iv_price_threshold )
                                    APPEND flight TO result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_with_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_with_reduce.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_with_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_with_reduce( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = '250'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-price = '80'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_with_reduce(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      iv_currency = 'EUR'
      iv_price_threshold = '100' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ). " LH 0400 EUR 100 (not deleted because price is not < 100)"
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ). " LH 0401 USD 250 (not deleted because currency is not EUR)"
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein mächtiger funktionaler Operator (ab ABAP 7.50), der es erlaubt, eine neue Werteliste aus einer bestehenden zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann man komplexe Filter- und Löschlogiken sehr kompakt und deklarativ ausdrücken.
keywords: DELETE, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Schreiben Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine lokale CSV-Datei auf dem Frontend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>GUI_DOWNLOAD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_write_to_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_flights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_to_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_flights_to_csv.
    DATA: lv_file_path TYPE string.

    " In einem echten Szenario sollte der Dateipfad vom Benutzer gewählt werden oder ein Standardpfad verwendet werden.
    " Für den Test wird ein temporärer Pfad angenommen.
    lv_file_path = |C:\temp\{ iv_filename }|.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = lv_file_path
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            has_field_separator     = abap_true
          CHANGING
            data_tab                = it_flights
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS                  = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_download_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_download_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_write_to_file=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_write_to_file( ).
    DATA: lv_filename TYPE string VALUE 'test_flights.csv'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-price = '100'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.

    " GUI_DOWNLOAD kann in einem automatisierten Unit-Test nicht direkt ausgeführt werden,
    " da es eine Interaktion mit dem Frontend erfordert. Hier wird nur der Aufruf simuliert
    " und geprüft, ob keine Exceptions geworfen werden.
    " In einem realen Test würde man die Methode mocken oder einen Integrationstest durchführen.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->download_flights_to_csv( it_flights = lt_flights iv_filename = lv_filename ).

    " Da GUI_DOWNLOAD Frontend-Interaktion erfordert, kann der Erfolg hier nicht
    " direkt verifiziert werden. Wir prüfen nur, ob der Aufruf ohne Dumps durchläuft.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ). " Annahme: Im Testumfeld wird es als erfolgreich betrachtet.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES=>GUI_DOWNLOAD` ist die Standardmethode (seit langem verfügbar, aber immer noch relevant und modern in der Anwendung) zum Herunterladen von Daten auf das Frontend. Die Verwendung von `abap_true` und `abap_false` (ab ABAP 7.40) verbessert die Lesbarkeit gegenüber 'X' und SPACE.
keywords: WRITE, File I/O, Frontend Services, GUI_DOWNLOAD, CSV

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, bei denen das Flugdatum vor dem heutigen Datum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE itab WHERE` mit `sy-datum`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_past_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_before_today
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_current_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_past_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_before_today.
    rt_current_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE rt_current_flights WHERE fldate < sy-datum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_past_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_past_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_past_dates=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_past_dates( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum - 1.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_before_today( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE itab WHERE` ist eine grundlegende, aber effiziente Methode zum Löschen von Zeilen aus internen Tabellen basierend auf einer Bedingung. In Kombination mit `sy-datum` (Systemdatum) ist dies eine häufige und moderne Anwendung.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Tables, WHERE, sy-datum, Date

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei jede Fluggesellschaft in einer neuen Zeile steht.

solution:
CLASS zcl_write_list_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

` INTO s ).

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, die nicht in einer Liste von bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` oder `FILTER` um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Einträge enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_delete_not_preferred DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_carr_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_preferred_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_preferred_carrids TYPE tt_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_delete_not_preferred IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_preferred_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( COND #( WHEN line_exists( it_preferred_carrids[ table_line = flight-carrid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) = abap_true )
      ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_preferred FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_preferred.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_delete_not_preferred=>tt_sflight,
          lt_preferred_carrids TYPE zcl_delete_not_preferred=>tt_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_not_preferred( ).

    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_preferred_carrids.
    APPEND 'UA' TO lt_preferred_carrids.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_preferred_flights(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      it_preferred_carrids = lt_preferred_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` Schleifen in Wertzuweisungen (ab ABAP 7.40) mit dem `COND` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50, erweitert in 7.55) und `line_exists` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine moderne Art, komplexe Löschlogiken zu implementieren, indem man nur die gewünschten Elemente in eine neue Tabelle kopiert.
keywords: DELETE, FOR, COND, line_exists, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen JSON-String aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, wobei nur 'CARRID', 'CONNID' und 'PRICE' enthalten sein sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` oder `cl_abap_json_serializer` für die JSON-Serialisierung. Für eine einfache Demonstration kann auch manuell mit String-Templates gearbeitet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_write_json_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_json,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_json.
    TYPES tt_sflight_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_json WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_json_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_to_json.
    DATA(lt_json_data) = VALUE tt_sflight_json(
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, price = flight-price ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = lt_json_data
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_serializer_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_json_string = |Error serializing to JSON: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_write_json_string( ).

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

  {

  },

explanation: `CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER` (ab ABAP 7.50) ist die moderne und empfohlene Klasse zur Serialisierung von ABAP-Daten in JSON-Strings. Sie bietet eine robuste und typsichere Methode, um komplexe Datenstrukturen in das JSON-Format zu überführen, was für die Integration mit externen Systemen unerlässlich ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten Bericht über die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflights`-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `LOOP` Anweisung und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_write_grouped_report DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flight_report
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_report) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_grouped_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_report.
    DATA: lv_report_line TYPE string.

    rv_report = |Flugbericht nach Fluggesellschaft:\n|.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      lv_report_line = |  Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid ALPHA = OUT }, Flüge: { lv_count }\n|.
      rv_report = rv_report && lv_report_line.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_report.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_write_grouped_report=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_write_grouped_report( ).

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.

    DATA(lv_expected) = |Flugbericht nach Fluggesellschaft:\n  Fluggesellschaft: LH, Flüge: 2\n  Fluggesellschaft: AA, Flüge: 1\n|.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_flight_report( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Anweisung (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen direkt in der Schleife. In Kombination mit String-Templates können so formatierte Berichte sehr effizient und lesbar erstellt werden, ohne temporäre Aggregationstabellen.
keywords: WRITE, GROUP BY, LOOP, Internal Tables, String Templates, Report

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einem dynamisch erstellten `RANGE` für das Feld `CARRID`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` oder `FILTER` mit einem `RANGE` als Filterkriterium.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_multiple_carrids FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_single_carrid.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_rng_filter_sflights=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_rng_filter_sflights=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231201' price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrid( it_flights = lt_flights it_carrid_range = lr_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Incorrect count for single CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Incorrect CARRID filtered' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_multiple_carrids.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_rng_filter_sflights=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_rng_filter_sflights=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231201' price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20231201' price = '150.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrid( it_flights = lt_flights it_carrid_range = lr_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect count for multiple CARRIDs' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax, die das Filtern interner Tabellen erheblich vereinfacht. In Kombination mit einem `RANGE`-Objekt kann man komplexe Filterbedingungen elegant und performant auf interne Tabellen anwenden, ohne explizite Schleifen programmieren zu müssen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `RANGE` für numerische Werte, der alle Zahlen zwischen 100 und 200 (inklusive) sowie den Wert 500 enthält. Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Wert in diesem `RANGE` liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` für die dynamische Range-Erstellung und den `IN` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_int TYPE RANGE OF i.

    METHODS create_and_check_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_dynamic_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_check_range.
    DATA(lt_range) = VALUE ty_range_int(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 100 high = 200 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 500 )
    ).

    IF iv_value IN lt_range.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein Datum und eine Uhrzeit von einer Zeitzone in eine andere, unter Berücksichtigung der länderspezifischen Formatierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datfm` und Methoden, die Zeitzonen berücksichtigen, wie `get_timestamp_from_date_time` und `get_date_time_from_timestamp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_timezone_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_datetime_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_date       TYPE d
        iv_time       TYPE t
        iv_from_tzone TYPE timezone
        iv_to_tzone   TYPE timezone
        iv_country    TYPE land1 OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        ev_to_date    TYPE d
        ev_to_time    TYPE t
        ev_formatted_datetime TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_timezone_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_datetime_timezone.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( iv_country ).

    " 1. Convert local date/time to UTC timestamp
    DATA(lv_timestamp_utc) = lo_datfm->get_timestamp_from_date_time(
      iv_date    = iv_date
      iv_time    = iv_time
      iv_tzone   = iv_from_tzone
    ).

    " 2. Convert UTC timestamp to target timezone date/time
    lo_datfm->get_date_time_from_timestamp(
      EXPORTING
        iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp_utc
        iv_tzone     = iv_to_tzone
      IMPORTING
        ev_date      = ev_to_date
        ev_time      = ev_to_time
    ).

    " 3. Format the result for display in target locale
    ev_formatted_datetime = |{ lo_datfm->date_to_string( ev_to_date ) } { lo_datfm->time_to_string( ev_to_time ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timezone_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timezone_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_timezone_convert( ).
    DATA: lv_to_date TYPE d,
          lv_to_time TYPE t,
          lv_formatted_datetime TYPE string.

    " Example: Convert 2023-12-04 10:00:00 from Berlin (CET) to New York (EST)
    lo_cut->convert_datetime_timezone(
      EXPORTING
        iv_date       = '20231204'
        iv_time       = '100000'
        iv_from_tzone = 'CET'
        iv_to_tzone   = 'EST'
        iv_country    = 'US'
      IMPORTING
        ev_to_date    = lv_to_date
        ev_to_time    = lv_to_time
        ev_formatted_datetime = lv_formatted_datetime
    ).

    " CET is UTC+1, EST is UTC-5. So 10:00 CET is 09:00 UTC. 09:00 UTC is 04:00 EST.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_to_date exp = '20231204' msg = 'Converted date incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_to_time exp = '040000' msg = 'Converted time incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_datetime exp = '12/04/2023 04:00:00 AM' msg = 'Formatted datetime incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_abap_datfm`-Klasse bietet robuste Methoden zur Zeitzonenkonvertierung. Zuerst wird das lokale Datum/Uhrzeit in einen UTC-Zeitstempel umgewandelt (`get_timestamp_from_date_time`), dann dieser Zeitstempel in das Datum/Uhrzeit der Zielzeitzone (`get_date_time_from_timestamp`). String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die elegante Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: cl_abap_datfm, Internationalisierung und Datumsformat, Date/Time, Zeitzone, String Templates

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die basierend auf einem numerischen Wert und vordefinierten `RANGE`s unterschiedliche Aktionen ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE ... WHEN IN range_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_case_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_score TYPE RANGE OF i.

    METHODS evaluate_score
      IMPORTING
        iv_score TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_case_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate_score.
    DATA(lr_excellent) = VALUE ty_range_score( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 90 high = 100 ) ).
    DATA(lr_good)      = VALUE ty_range_score( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 70 high = 89 ) ).
    DATA(lr_average)   = VALUE ty_range_score( ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 50 high = 69 ) ).

    CASE iv_score.
      WHEN IN lr_excellent.
        rv_message = 'Excellent Score!'.
      WHEN IN lr_good.
        rv_message = 'Good Score!'.
      WHEN IN lr_average.
        rv_message = 'Average Score.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Needs Improvement.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie zwei `RANGE`-Tabellen für Fluggesellschaften (`CARRID`) logisch (z.B. Union) und filtern Sie damit eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue `RANGE`-Tabelle und fügen Sie die Einträge der Quell-Ranges hinzu. Nutzen Sie dann `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rng_combine_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_combined_ranges
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_range1 TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
        it_carrid_range2 TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rng_combine_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_combined_ranges.
    DATA(lt_combined_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      FOR ls_entry IN it_carrid_range1 ( ls_entry )
      FOR ls_entry IN it_carrid_range2 ( ls_entry )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_combined_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_ranges FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_ranges.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_rng_combine_filter=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_rng_combine_filter=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231201' price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20231201' price = '150.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' fldate = '20231201' price = '250.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lr_carrid1) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lr_carrid2) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rng_combine_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_combined_ranges(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      it_carrid_range1 = lr_carrid1
      it_carrid_range2 = lr_carrid2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect count after combining ranges' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'LH not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'UA not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ... IN ...`-Konstruktion innerhalb von `VALUE` ermöglicht das elegante Zusammenführen von Einträgen aus mehreren internen Tabellen (hier `RANGE`-Tabellen) in eine neue Tabelle. Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, Daten zu aggregieren, bevor sie für weitere Operationen wie das Filtern verwendet werden.
keywords: RANGES, Internal Tables, FILTER, VALUE, FOR, sflights

CLASS zcl_dat_rng_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight

CLASS zcl_dat_rng_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_locale_date_range.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( iv_country ).

    DATA(lv_date_to)   = lo_datfm->string_to_date( iv_date_to_str ).

    DATA(lr_fldate) = VALUE RANGE OF s_date(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = lv_date_from high = lv_date_to )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate IN lr_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei Daten unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden und Feiertagen (simuliert durch einen `RANGE` von Feiertagen).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch den Datumsbereich, prüfen Sie den Wochentag und ob das Datum in einem `RANGE` von Feiertagen liegt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_holiday TYPE RANGE OF d.

    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
        it_holidays  TYPE ty_range_holiday OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_date_from.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_date_to.
      DATA(lv_weekday_num) = lo_datfm->get_weekday_number( lv_current_date ). " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

      IF lv_weekday_num <> 6 AND lv_weekday_num <> 7. " Not Saturday or Sunday
        IF NOT ( lv_current_date IN it_holidays ). " Not a holiday
          rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_workdays_no_holidays FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_workdays_with_holidays FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_workdays_weekend_only FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_workdays_no_holidays.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_workdays( ).
    " 2023-12-04 (Mon) to 2023-12-08 (Fri) = 5 workdays
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_date_from = '20231204' iv_date_to = '20231208' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays exp = 5 msg = '5 workdays expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workdays_with_holidays.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_workdays( ).
    DATA(lr_holidays) = VALUE zcl_dat_workdays=>ty_range_holiday(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '20231205' ) " Tuesday is a holiday
    ).
    " 2023-12-04 (Mon) to 2023-12-08 (Fri) = 5 workdays - 1 holiday = 4 workdays
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_date_from = '20231204' iv_date_to = '20231208' it_holidays = lr_holidays ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays exp = 4 msg = '4 workdays expected with holiday' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_workdays_weekend_only.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_workdays( ).
    " 2023-12-09 (Sat) to 2023-12-10 (Sun) = 0 workdays
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_date_from = '20231209' iv_date_to = '20231210' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays exp = 0 msg = '0 workdays expected for weekend' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Datumsarithmetik, die `cl_abap_datfm`-Methode `get_weekday_number` und den `IN`-Operator für `RANGES`. Es zeigt, wie man eine Schleife über einen Datumsbereich ausführt und dabei komplexe Bedingungen (Wochenende, Feiertag) effizient prüft, um die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zu ermitteln.

CLASS zcl_count_with_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_with_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_expensive_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                         WHERE ( price > iv_price_threshold )
                         NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Der Unit Test prüft lediglich die erfolgreiche Objekterzeugung, da eine vollständige GUI-Interaktion im Unit Test nicht möglich ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container und betten Sie ein `cl_gui_textedit`-Control darin ein, um Text anzuzeigen.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_textedit` und übergeben Sie den Docking Container als Parent.
solution:
CLASS zcl_docking_textedit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dock_and_textedit
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE syrepid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr
        iv_text  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_textedit) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dock_and_textedit.
    DATA lo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid                       = iv_repid
        dynnr                       = iv_dynnr
        side                        = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension                   = 300
        caption                     = 'Text Editor'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_error.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent                      = lo_docking_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_error.
    ENDIF.

    ro_textedit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dock_textedit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dock_textedit.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_docking_textedit( ).
    DATA(lv_test_text) = 'Dies ist ein Testtext für den Texteditor.'.
    DATA(lo_textedit) = lo_cut->create_dock_and_textedit( iv_repid = sy-repid iv_dynnr = sy-dynnr iv_text = lv_test_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_textedit ).
    DATA lv_read_text TYPE string.
    lo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_read_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_read_text exp = lv_test_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ein `cl_gui_docking_container` dient als 'Eltern'-Container für andere GUI-Controls. Hier wird ein `cl_gui_textedit`-Control erstellt und der Docking Container als sein Parent zugewiesen. Dies ermöglicht die flexible Anordnung von UI-Elementen. Der Unit Test überprüft die erfolgreiche Erstellung beider Objekte und die Textzuweisung.
keywords: cl_gui_docking_container, cl_gui_textedit, GUI, Object Orientation, Parent-Child

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Docking Container mit einem Button und implementieren Sie einen Event Handler für dessen `CLICK`-Ereignis.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_button` und `SET HANDLER` für die Ereignisregistrierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_docking_button_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS create_dock_and_button
      IMPORTING
        iv_repid TYPE syrepid
        iv_dynnr TYPE sydynnr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_button) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button
      IMPORTING
        sender.

    DATA mv_click_count TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_docking_button_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dock_and_button.
    DATA lo_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_docking_container
      EXPORTING
        repid                       = iv_repid
        dynnr                       = iv_dynnr
        side                        = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension                   = 100
        caption                     = 'Aktionsleiste'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_error.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT ro_button
      EXPORTING
        parent                      = lo_docking_container
        text                        = 'Klick mich!'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                      = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_error.
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR ro_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_click_count = mv_click_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING e_text = 'Button wurde geklickt!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_button_event_handler FOR TESTING.
    METHODS handle_test_event FOR EVENT button_clicked OF zcl_docking_button_event
      IMPORTING e_text.
    DATA mv_event_received TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA mv_event_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_event_handler.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_docking_button_event( ).
    DATA(lo_button) = lo_cut->create_dock_and_button( iv_repid = sy-repid iv_dynnr = sy-dynnr ).

    SET HANDLER handle_test_event FOR lo_cut.

    " Simulate button click - direct call to event handler for unit test
    lo_cut->handle_button_click( sender = lo_button ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_click_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_event_received exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = mv_event_text exp = 'Button wurde geklickt!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_test_event.
    mv_event_received = abap_true.
    mv_event_text = e_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Integration von Ereignishandlern ist entscheidend für interaktive GUIs. Hier wird ein `cl_gui_button` in einem Docking Container platziert und ein lokaler Event Handler (`handle_button_click`) mit `SET HANDLER` registriert. Der Unit Test simuliert den Klick durch direkten Aufruf des Event Handlers und prüft, ob der Zähler aktualisiert und das Ereignis korrekt ausgelöst wurde.
keywords: cl_gui_docking_container, cl_gui_button, Event Handling, GUI, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit gefilterten `sflights`-Daten und zählen Sie deren Einträge in einer einzigen Anweisung unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators und `COUNT`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR`, `WHERE` und `COUNT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_count_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_occupancy TYPE s_max_occ
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_count_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( max_occ > iv_max_occupancy ) ( flight ) ).
    rv_count = COUNT( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_value_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_count_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->create_and_count_flights( 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 10 ). " Assuming 10 flights with max_occ > 200 in sflights
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Filterbedingung zu erstellen. Anschließend wird `COUNT` direkt auf diese neu erstellte Tabelle angewendet, was eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Datenverarbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, WHERE, COUNT, Internal Tables, sflights, Functional Programming

Instructions: Zählen Sie Flüge basierend auf einer Bedingung (z.B. unterschiedliche Zählungen für verschiedene Fluggesellschaften) unter Verwendung des `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks und `COUNT`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` in Kombination mit `COUNT` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_condition
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE string " 'LH', 'AA', 'OTHER'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_condition.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_count = SWITCH #( iv_condition
               WHEN 'LH' THEN COUNT( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ) )
               WHEN 'AA' THEN COUNT( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' ) )
               ELSE COUNT( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid <> 'LH' AND carrid <> 'AA' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_switch_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_switch_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_count_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_condition( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_lh exp = 40 ). " Assuming 40 flights for LH

    DATA(lv_count_aa) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_condition( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_aa exp = 20 ). " Assuming 20 flights for AA

    DATA(lv_count_other) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_condition( 'OTHER' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_other exp = 20 ). " Assuming 20 flights for UA (other)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen, ähnlich einer `CASE`-Anweisung, aber als Ausdruck. Hier wird er verwendet, um dynamisch die Zähllogik zu wählen, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt, insbesondere in Kombination mit `COUNT` und `FILTER`.
keywords: SWITCH, COUNT, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, sflights, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_count_multi_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fibonacci-Sequenz bis zu einem Wert, der 1000 überschreitet, unter Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife und moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife und Inline-Deklarationen für die Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fibonacci_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_fibonacci
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_fib_sequence) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fibonacci_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_fibonacci.
    DATA(lv_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_b) = 1.

    APPEND lv_a TO rt_fib_sequence.
    APPEND lv_b TO rt_fib_sequence.

    WHILE lv_b <= 1000.
      DATA(lv_next) = lv_a + lv_b.
      APPEND lv_next TO rt_fib_sequence.
      lv_a = lv_b.
      lv_b = lv_next.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fibonacci FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fibonacci.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fibonacci_calculator( ).
    DATA(lt_sequence) = lo_calculator->calculate_fibonacci( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sequence should not be initial' act = lt_sequence IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First element should be 0' act = lt_sequence[ 1 ] exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second element should be 1' act = lt_sequence[ 2 ] exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last element should be > 1000' act = lt_sequence[ lines( lt_sequence ) ] exp = 1597 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife für eine iterative Berechnung, bei der die Abbruchbedingung dynamisch vom Ergebnis der vorherigen Iteration abhängt. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) machen den Code kompakter und lesbarer.
keywords: WHILE, Fibonacci, Inline Declaration, Iteration

Instructions: Messen Sie den privaten Speicherverbrauch einer Operation, die eine große interne Tabelle füllt, unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_memory_utilities`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption()` vor und nach der Operation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_monitor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_sflight_load
      IMPORTING iv_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_memory_delta) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_monitor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_sflight_load.
    DATA(lv_mem_before) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_rows
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = 400 fldate = sy-datum price = ( i * 10 ) currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_mem_after) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).

    rv_memory_delta = lv_mem_after - lv_mem_before.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_measurement FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_measurement.
    DATA(lo_monitor) = NEW zcl_memory_monitor( ).
    DATA(lv_memory_used) = lo_monitor->measure_sflight_load( iv_rows = 10000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Memory usage should be measured' act = lv_memory_used ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Memory usage should be positive' act = lv_memory_used > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption()` den Speicherverbrauch einer bestimmten Operation misst. Die interne Tabelle wird mit einem `VALUE`-Operator und einem `FOR`-Ausdruck effizient gefüllt, was modernen ABAP-Stil demonstriert. Die Messung hilft bei der Performance-Optimierung.
keywords: Memory, cl_abap_memory_utilities, Performance, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie Elemente aus einer internen Tabelle, die als Warteschlange fungiert, bis diese leer ist. Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife und moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHILE NOT itab IS INITIAL` und `DELETE TABLE itab INDEX 1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING it_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_input.

    WHILE lt_queue IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_item) = lt_queue[ 1 ].
      APPEND lv_item TO rt_processed_items.
      DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_queue_processing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_queue FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_queue_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_queue_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Item A' ) ( 'Item B' ) ( 'Item C' ) ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_processor->process_queue( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of processed items incorrect' act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item incorrect' act = lt_output[ 1 ] exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last item incorrect' act = lt_output[ 3 ] exp = 'Item C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_queue.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_queue_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_processor->process_queue( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Output should be initial for empty input' act = lt_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eine WHILE-Schleife ist ideal, um eine Warteschlange (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle) zu verarbeiten, bis sie leer ist. Die moderne Syntax `lt_queue[ 1 ]` für den Zugriff auf das erste Element und `DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1` für das Entfernen sind effizient und lesbar.
keywords: WHILE, Queue, Internal Table, DELETE TABLE, IS INITIAL

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie den privaten Speicherverbrauch zweier Methoden zum Füllen einer großen internen Tabelle: einmal mit `APPEND` in einer Schleife und einmal mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption()` für beide Szenarien und vergleichen Sie die Deltas.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_memory_usage
      IMPORTING iv_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_deltas) TYPE STRUCTURE.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_result,
             append_delta TYPE i,
             for_delta    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_result.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_memory_usage.
    DATA(lv_mem_before_append) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    DATA lt_data_append TYPE tt_data.
    DO iv_rows TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index text = |Text { sy-index }| ) TO lt_data_append.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_mem_after_append) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    rs_memory_deltas-append_delta = lv_mem_after_append - lv_mem_before_append.

    FREE lt_data_append. " Speicher freigeben für fairen Vergleich

    DATA(lv_mem_before_for) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    DATA(lt_data_for) = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_rows
      ( id = i text = |Text { i }| )
    ).
    DATA(lv_mem_after_for) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    rs_memory_deltas-for_delta = lv_mem_after_for - lv_mem_before_for.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_comparison.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_memory_compare( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_comparer->compare_memory_usage( iv_rows = 10000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Append method should use memory' act = ls_results-append_delta > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FOR expression should use memory' act = ls_results-for_delta > 0 ).
    " In der Regel ist der FOR-Ausdruck speichereffizienter oder gleichwertig
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'FOR expression should be more memory efficient or equal' act = ls_results-for_delta <= ls_results-append_delta ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht den Speicherverbrauch zweier gängiger Methoden zum Füllen interner Tabellen. Es nutzt `cl_abap_memory_utilities` zur präzisen Messung.
