Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Zustandsmaschine mit einer WHILE-Schleife, die durch verschiedene Zustände iteriert, bis ein Endzustand erreicht ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb der `WHILE`-Schleife, um Zustandsübergänge zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_state_machine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_state_info,
             current_state TYPE string,
             message       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_state_info.
    TYPES tt_state_history TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_state_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS run_state_machine
      IMPORTING iv_start_state TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_history) TYPE tt_state_history.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_state_start TYPE string VALUE 'START',
               gc_state_process TYPE string VALUE 'PROCESS',
               gc_state_finish TYPE string VALUE 'FINISH',
               gc_state_error TYPE string VALUE 'ERROR'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_state_machine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_state_machine.
    DATA(lv_current_state) = iv_start_state.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_state <> gc_state_finish AND lv_current_state <> gc_state_error AND lv_counter < 10. " Max 10 Iterationen zur Sicherheit
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.
      APPEND VALUE ty_state_info( current_state = lv_current_state message = |Entering state { lv_current_state }| ) TO rt_history.

      CASE lv_current_state.
        WHEN gc_state_start.
          lv_current_state = gc_state_process.
        WHEN gc_state_process.
          IF lv_counter MOD 2 = 0. " Simuliere eine Bedingung für den Übergang
            lv_current_state = gc_state_finish.
          ELSE.
            APPEND VALUE ty_state_info( current_state = lv_current_state message = 'Still processing...' ) TO rt_history.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_current_state = gc_state_error.
          APPEND VALUE ty_state_info( current_state = gc_state_error message = |Unknown state: { lv_current_state }| ) TO rt_history.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDWHILE.

    APPEND VALUE ty_state_info( current_state = lv_current_state message = |Exiting state machine in state { lv_current_state }| ) TO rt_history.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie, wie man eine Operation abbricht, wenn der private Speicherverbrauch einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet, unter Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife und `cl_abap_memory_utilities`.
hint: Prüfen Sie in jeder Iteration den Speicherverbrauch und brechen Sie die Schleife mit `EXIT` ab, wenn der Schwellenwert erreicht ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_safe_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_large_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             raw_data TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_large_data.
    TYPES tt_large_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_large_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data_with_memory_check
      IMPORTING iv_max_memory_mb TYPE i DEFAULT 100 " Max memory in MB
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_large_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_safe_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_with_memory_check.
    DATA(lv_initial_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    DATA(lv_max_memory_bytes) = iv_max_memory_mb * 1024 * 1024.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    WHILE lv_counter < 1000000. " Max iterations to prevent infinite loop
      lv_counter = lv_counter + 1.

      DATA(lv_current_memory) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
      IF ( lv_current_memory - lv_initial_memory ) > lv_max_memory_bytes.
        MESSAGE |Memory limit of { iv_max_memory_mb } MB exceeded after { lv_counter - 1 } entries.| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'W'.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND VALUE ty_large_data(
        id = lv_counter
        text = |Entry { lv_counter }|
        raw_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = |Large data block for entry { lv_counter }| codepage = 'UTF-8' )
      ) TO rt_data.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Wörter aus einem Satz, die mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnen, unter Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife und moderner String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND NEXT OCCURRENCE` in einer `WHILE`-Schleife und `SUBSTRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_prefix_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_words_with_prefix
      IMPORTING iv_sentence TYPE string
                iv_prefix   TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_prefix_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_words_with_prefix.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_true.

    WHILE lv_found = abap_true.
      FIND NEXT OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\b\w+\b' IN SECTION OFFSET lv_offset OF iv_sentence MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_word_offset) MATCH LENGTH DATA(lv_word_length).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_word) = iv_sentence+lv_word_offset(lv_word_length).
        IF lv_word CP |{ iv_prefix }*|.
          APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.
        ENDIF.
        lv_offset = lv_word_offset + lv_word_length.
      ELSE.
        lv_found = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine iterative Binärsuche in einer sortierten internen Tabelle unter Verwendung einer WHILE-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit `low <= high` und passen Sie `low` oder `high` in jeder Iteration an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS search_value
      IMPORTING it_sorted_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line
                iv_search_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_value.
    DATA(lv_low) = 1.
    DATA(lv_high) = lines( it_sorted_table ).
    rv_found_index = 0. " Not found

    WHILE lv_low <= lv_high.
      DATA(lv_mid) = ( lv_low + lv_high ) DIV 2.
      DATA(lv_mid_value) = it_sorted_table[ lv_mid ].

      IF lv_mid_value = iv_search_value.
        rv_found_index = lv_mid.
        RETURN.
      ELSE IF lv_mid_value < iv_search_value.
        lv_low = lv_mid + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_high = lv_mid - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das zeilenweise Lesen einer Datei, bis ein bestimmtes Schlüsselwort gefunden wird oder das Dateiende erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und eine Hilfsvariable, um den 'Dateizeiger' zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_reader_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_until_keyword
      IMPORTING it_file_content TYPE string_table
                iv_keyword      TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_read_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_until_keyword.
    DATA(lv_line_index) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max_lines) = lines( it_file_content ).
    DATA(lv_keyword_found) = abap_false.

    WHILE lv_line_index <= lv_max_lines AND lv_keyword_found = abap_false.
      DATA(lv_current_line) = it_file_content[ lv_line_index ].
      APPEND lv_current_line TO rt_read_lines.

      IF lv_current_line CS iv_keyword. " CS = Contains String
        lv_keyword_found = abap_true.
      ENDIF.

      lv_line_index = lv_line_index + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_file_reader_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_content) = VALUE string_table(

      ( 'Line 2: Some data' )
      ( 'Line 3: Keyword HERE!' )
      ( 'Line 4: More data after keyword' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should read 3 lines' act = lines( lt_read ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last read line should contain keyword' act = lt_read[ 3 ] exp = 'Line 3: Keyword HERE!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_keyword_not_found.

      ( 'Line 1' )

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should read all lines' act = lines( lt_read ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel simuliert das zeilenweise Lesen einer Datei mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife. Die Schleife läuft, solange der 'Dateizeiger' (simuliert durch `lv_line_index`) innerhalb der Grenzen liegt und das Schlüsselwort noch nicht gefunden wurde. `CS` (Contains String) ist ein einfacher und moderner Operator für die String-Prüfung. Dies ist eine flexible Methode für das Parsen von Textdateien.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Speicherverbrauch einer internen Tabelle nach dem Löschen von Einträgen misst, um die Freigabe von Speicher zu demonstrieren.
hint: Füllen Sie eine Tabelle, messen Sie den Speicher, löschen Sie Einträge und messen Sie erneut. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_memory_utilities` und `DELETE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_memory_release_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_large_entry,
             id   TYPE i,
             data TYPE string LENGTH 255,
           END OF ty_large_entry.
    TYPES tt_large_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_large_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS demonstrate_memory_release
      IMPORTING iv_initial_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
                iv_delete_rows  TYPE i DEFAULT 50000
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_memory_deltas) TYPE STRUCTURE.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_memory_release_result,
             initial_usage TYPE i,
             after_delete_usage TYPE i,
             delta_release TYPE i,
           END OF ty_memory_release_result.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_memory_release_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_memory_release.
    DATA(lv_mem_before_fill) = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_large_entries.

    lt_data = VALUE tt_large_entries(
      FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_initial_rows
      ( id = i data = |This is a long string for entry { i } to consume memory.| )
    ).

    rs_memory_deltas-initial_usage = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ) - lv_mem_before_fill.

    DELETE lt_data FROM 1 TO iv_delete_rows.

    rs_memory_deltas-after_delete_usage = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption( ) - lv_mem_before_fill.
    rs_memory_deltas-delta_release = rs_memory_deltas-initial_usage - rs_memory_deltas-after_delete_usage.

    FREE lt_data. " Final cleanup
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_memory_release FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_memory_release.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_memory_release_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_demo->demonstrate_memory_release( iv_initial_rows = 50000 iv_delete_rows = 25000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Initial usage should be positive' act = ls_results-initial_usage > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'After delete usage should be positive' act = ls_results-after_delete_usage > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Memory should be released' act = ls_results-delta_release > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'After delete usage should be less than initial' act = ls_results-after_delete_usage < ls_results-initial_usage ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie Speicher durch das Löschen von Einträgen aus einer internen Tabelle freigegeben wird. `cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_private_memory_consumption()` wird verwendet, um den Speicherverbrauch vor und nach dem Löschen zu messen. Der `VALUE`-Operator für die Tabellenfüllung und `DELETE` für das Entfernen von Einträgen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken. Die Messung der `delta_release` zeigt den Effekt der Speicherfreigabe.
keywords: Memory, cl_abap_memory_utilities, DELETE, Internal Table, Performance, Memory Release

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Schleife, die eine Operation wiederholt, bis ein externer Zähler (simuliert) einen bestimmten Wert erreicht. Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, die eine externe Variable als Bedingung prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_external_counter_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS run_loop_until_counter
      IMPORTING iv_target_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_iterations) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_external_counter TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_external_counter_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_loop_until_counter.
    mv_external_counter = 0.
    rv_iterations = 0.

    WHILE mv_external_counter < iv_target_count.
      " Simulate some work
      WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Simulate external delay
      mv_external_counter = mv_external_counter + 1.
      rv_iterations = rv_iterations + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should run 3 iterations' act = lv_iterations exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist typisch für Szenarien, in denen eine Schleife auf das Eintreten eines bestimmten Zustands wartet oder eine bestimmte Anzahl von extern gesteuerten Schritten ausführt. `WAIT UP TO` simuliert eine externe Verzögerung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die versucht, auf einen Index einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen, der außerhalb der Grenzen liegt. Fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Standardzeile zurück, falls der Index ungültig ist.

CLASS zcl_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TRY.
        rs_sflight = VALUE #( it_sflights[ iv_index ] ).

        " Return initial structure if index is out of bounds
        CLEAR rs_sflight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die verschiedene Arten von Fehlern verursachen kann (z.B. Division durch Null und ungültiger Tabellenindex). Fangen Sie jede Ausnahme in einem separaten `CATCH`-Block ab und geben Sie spezifische Fehlermeldungen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke innerhalb eines `TRY`-Blocks, um verschiedene Ausnahmetypen zu behandeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data        TYPE tt_data
        iv_index       TYPE i
        iv_divisor     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE i,
          lv_result TYPE fltp.

    TRY.
        lv_value = it_data[ iv_index ]-value.
        lv_result = lv_value / iv_divisor.
        rv_message = |Ergebnis: { lv_result }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_message = |Fehler: Ungültiger Tabellenindex { iv_index }.|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_message = |Fehler: Division durch Null oder arithmetischer Überlauf.|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie in einer Klasse Konstanten für verschiedene Statuscodes (z.B. 'SUCCESS', 'ERROR', 'WARNING') und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode, um einen Status zu verarbeiten.

CLASS zcl_status_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE string

CLASS zcl_status_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_status.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status_success.
        rv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'.
      WHEN gc_status_error.
        rv_message = 'Ein Fehler ist aufgetreten.'.
      WHEN gc_status_warning.
        rv_message = 'Warnung: Überprüfen Sie die Details.'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = 'Unbekannter Status.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Feldnamen der Tabelle `sflights` und verwenden Sie diese, um eine interne Tabelle von `sflights` zu filtern.
hint: Konstanten können die Lesbarkeit verbessern. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator mit den definierten Konstanten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS: gc_field_carrid TYPE string VALUE 'CARRID',
               gc_field_connid TYPE string VALUE 'CONNID',
               gc_field_price  TYPE string VALUE 'PRICE'.

    METHODS filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrier      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price    TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_all_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier AND price > iv_min_price ) ).
    " Note: Direct use of constants for field names in FILTER is not possible for type-safe access.
    " This example demonstrates the intent, but actual filtering uses direct field names.
    " Constants are useful for dynamic programming or documentation.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_test_data TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) TO mt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 ) TO mt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = 150 ) TO mt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250104' price = 50 ) TO mt_test_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_sflight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->filter_sflights( it_all_sflights = mt_test_data iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_min_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von Konstanten, um Feldnamen zu repräsentieren. Obwohl der `FILTER`-Operator direkt die Feldnamen verwendet (aus Typsicherheitsgründen), können solche Konstanten in dynamischen Szenarien (z.B. bei der Erstellung dynamischer WHERE-Klauseln) oder zur Dokumentation nützlich sein. Der `FILTER`-Operator selbst ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature zur effizienten Filterung interner Tabellen.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine lokale Konstante innerhalb einer Methode, die den maximalen Wert für eine Schleife festlegt. Verwenden Sie diese Konstante in einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONSTANTS` innerhalb der Methode, um eine lokale Konstante zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_local_constant_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_up_to
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_local_constant_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_up_to.
    CONSTANTS lc_start_value TYPE i VALUE 1.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR i = lc_start_value THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_max_value
                       NEXT s = s + i ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_to_five FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_to_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_to_five.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_local_constant_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calculator->sum_up_to( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 15 ). " 1+2+3+4+5 = 15
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_to_zero.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_local_constant_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_calculator->sum_up_to( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Deklaration und Verwendung einer lokalen Konstante innerhalb einer Methode. `lc_start_value` wird als Startwert für die `FOR`-Schleife verwendet. Die Verwendung von Konstanten, auch lokal, verbessert die Lesbarkeit und stellt sicher, dass wichtige Werte nicht versehentlich geändert werden. Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature für Aggregationen in Schleifen.
keywords: CONSTANTS, LOCAL, FOR, REDUCE, LOOP

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen einer Datei, die möglicherweise nicht existiert. Fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine informative Fehlermeldung zurück. Verwenden Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme für den Fall, dass der Dateiname leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_file_utilities` (oder simulieren Sie es) und fangen Sie `cx_sy_file_access` ab. Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme für leere Dateinamen.
solution:
CLASS zcx_empty_filename DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_empty_filename IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_empty_filename
        cx_sy_file_access.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_content.
    IF iv_filename IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_empty_filename
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_empty_filename=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " Simulate file read - in a real scenario, use OPEN DATASET, READ DATASET, etc.
        IF iv_filename = 'existing_file.txt'.
          rv_content = 'This is the content of the existing file.'.
        ELSE.
          " Simulate file not found
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_sy_file_access=>file_not_found.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_file_access
          EXPORTING
            textid = lx_file_error->textid.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie Konstanten für Datumsformate und verwenden Sie diese, um ein Datum in einem String-Template zu formatieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONV` und String-Templates mit Konstanten für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_date_format_iso TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'YYYY-MM-DD',
               gc_date_format_us  TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

    METHODS format_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date       TYPE d
        iv_format_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date.
    DATA(lv_year)  = iv_date(4).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).
    DATA(lv_day)   = iv_date+6(2).

    CASE iv_format_key.
      WHEN gc_date_format_iso.
        rv_formatted_date = |{ lv_year }-{ lv_month }-{ lv_day }|.
      WHEN gc_date_format_us.
        rv_formatted_date = |{ lv_month }/{ lv_day }/{ lv_year }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_formatted_date = |{ iv_date DATE = USER }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_component_names) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_names.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_component> TYPE abap_compdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) ASSIGNING <ls_component>.
          APPEND <ls_component>-name TO rt_component_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error if iv_data is not a structure
        " For this example, we'll just return an empty table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein bestimmtes Feld in einer übergebenen Struktur existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_component_type` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_struct_component`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS field_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_data     TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD field_exists.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
        lo_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ). " This will raise an exception if component doesn't exist
        rv_exists = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " iv_data is not a structure
        rv_exists = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_component.
        " Field does not exist in the structure
        rv_exists = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_char_field_length
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE any " Must be a character-like elementary type
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_char_field_length.
    DATA: lo_elem_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_elem_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
        IF lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char OR
           lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
          rv_length = lo_elem_descr->length.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Not an elementary type or not character-like
        rv_length = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Datentypnamen (z.B. 'SFLIGHTS') als String entgegennimmt und eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle dieses Typs dynamisch erzeugt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_table_ref
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_create_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_table_ref.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
      CATCH cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        " Type not found or not a table type
        CLEAR rr_data.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Error during data creation
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             code TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_item.

explanation: `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_reader` initialisiert einen Reader mit dem JSON-String. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Namen des Tabellentyps einer übergebenen internen Tabelle dynamisch ermittelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_relative_name` des Zeilentyp-Deskriptors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type_name DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_line_type_name
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE any TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_type_name.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA: lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
        lo_line_descr = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        rv_type_name = lo_line_descr->get_relative_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Not a table type
        CLEAR rv_type_name.
      CATCH cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        " Error describing type
        CLEAR rv_type_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_structure TO <lv_field_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <lv_field_value>.
    ELSE.
      " Field not found or not accessible
      CLEAR rv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in einen JSON-String und umgekehrt. Demonstrieren Sie die Serialisierung und Deserialisierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_fdt_json` und ihre Methoden `create_json_from_data` und `create_data_from_json`.

CLASS zcl_json_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS serialize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.

    METHODS deserialize_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights.
    TRY.
        rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_from_data( it_flights ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD deserialize_flights.
    TRY.
        cl_fdt_json=>create_data_from_json(
          EXPORTING
            iv_json_string = iv_json_string
          IMPORTING
            eo_data        = rt_flights
        ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die zeilenweise Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine bestimmte Anzahl von Zeilen in Chunks liest.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` für die Datenbankabfrage, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer Schleife und stellen Sie sicher, dass `CLOSE CURSOR` immer aufgerufen wird, auch bei Fehlern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_chunk  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_chunk
        PACKAGE SIZE iv_chunk_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " Process the chunk (e.g., extract keys)
      LOOP AT lt_chunk INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) TO rt_processed_keys.
      ENDLOOP.

      CLEAR lt_chunk.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cursor_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cursor_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_cursor_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_keys) = lo_processor->process_flights_in_chunks( 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_keys ). " Check if some data was fetched
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_keys ) exp = 0 ).

    " Verify content (example: check first few entries)
    IF lines( lt_keys ) >= 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_keys[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Assuming AA is first in sflight
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl moderne ABAP-Syntax oft `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` bevorzugt, ist die explizite Cursor-Verarbeitung mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` weiterhin relevant für die effiziente Verarbeitung extrem großer Datenmengen in Chunks. Dies hilft, den Speicherverbrauch zu kontrollieren und Timeouts zu vermeiden, insbesondere wenn nicht alle Daten auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher geladen werden können. Die Verwendung von `PACKAGE SIZE` und Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(ls_flight)`) hält den Code dabei modern.
keywords: Cursor, Database, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, sflights, Performance, Memory Management

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Konstruktor-Ausdruck `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             flight_id   TYPE string,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > iv_date )
                                   ( flight_id   = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|,
                                     flight_date = flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_value( ).
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Assuming there are flights in sflight for tomorrow or later
    DATA(lt_res) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( lv_today ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_res ). " Check if some data was returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_res ) exp = 0 ).

    " Verify that all returned flights are indeed in the future
    LOOP AT lt_res INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-flight_date > lv_today ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE` Konstruktor-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` ermöglicht die deklarative und sehr kompakte Erstellung und Filterung interner Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `APPEND` und `IF` zu schreiben, wird die Logik in einer einzigen, gut lesbaren Zeile ausgedrückt. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden hier für die Erstellung der `flight_id` verwendet.
keywords: Internal Table, VALUE, FOR, Filtering, sflights, Constructor Expression, String Templates

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck kann verwendet werden, um eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    " Get expected sum using traditional loop for comparison
    DATA: lt_sflights_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_all.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_all INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_price( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarker Konstruktor-Ausdruck, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren und einen einzelnen Wert zurückzugeben. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren und führt zu kompakterem, funktionalerem und besser lesbarem Code, insbesondere bei komplexeren Aggregationslogiken.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, sflights, Constructor Expression, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_itab_optional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    rs_flight = lt_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid OPTIONAL ].

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Instanz einer Klasse und rufen Sie direkt eine Methode auf, die eine weitere Methode zurückgibt, um eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen zu demonstrieren (Method Chaining).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung und den Pfeil-Operator (`->`) für die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS append_text IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = me->mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD append_text.
    me->mv_value = me->mv_value && iv_text.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_value( 'Initial' )->append_text( ' Appended' )->get_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Initial Appended' ).

    DATA(lo_chained) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    lo_chained->set_value( 'Hello' )->append_text( ' World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_chained->get_value( ) exp = 'Hello World' ).

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die mit `VALUE` und `FOR` erstellt wurde, und verwenden Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( ... FOR ... IN ... )` mit `INSERT LINES OF ...` oder direkt in der `VALUE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_insert_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_insert_items.
    DATA(lt_initial_items) = VALUE tt_item( ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
                                            ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' ) ).

    DATA(lt_new_items) = VALUE tt_item( ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' )
                                        ( id = 4 text = 'Item D' ) ).

    rt_items = VALUE tt_item( BASE lt_initial_items
                              FOR ls_new_item IN lt_new_items
                              ( ls_new_item ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_insert FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_insert.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_itab_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_creator->create_and_insert_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-text exp = 'Item D' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE` mit `BASE` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und effiziente Methode, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die auf einer bestehenden basiert und zusätzliche Einträge aus einer anderen Tabelle oder Liste hinzufügt. keywords: Internal Table, VALUE, FOR, BASE, Insert, Constructor Expression, Inline Declaration

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, einschließlich CC und BCC.

solution:
CLASS zcl_email_multi_recipients DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_multi_recipients
      IMPORTING
        it_to_recipients  TYPE string_table
        it_cc_recipients  TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_recipients TYPE string_table OPTIONAL
        iv_subject        TYPE bcs_st_subject
        iv_body           TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_email_multi_recipients IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_multi_recipients.
    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).

    " TO recipients
    LOOP AT it_to_recipients INTO DATA(lv_to_email).
      DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_to_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " CC recipients
    LOOP AT it_cc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_cc_email).
      DATA(lo_cc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc_recipient i_express = 'X' ). " CC
    ENDLOOP.

    " BCC recipients
    LOOP AT it_bcc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_bcc_email).
      DATA(lo_bcc_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_email ).
      lo_send_request->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc_recipient i_blind_copy = 'X' ). " BCC
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    TRY.
        lo_send_request->send( ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Delimiter getrennt sein kann (z.B. Komma oder Semikolon), und geben Sie die bereinigten Teile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Sequenz von `SPLIT`-Operationen oder die `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES` Anweisung, um Delimiter zu vereinheitlichen, bevor Sie `SPLIT` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_multi_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_primary_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ','
        iv_secondary_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ';'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    " Vereinheitlichen der Delimiter zum primären Delimiter
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_secondary_delimiter IN lv_temp_string WITH iv_primary_delimiter.

    " Dann den String mit dem primären Delimiter splitten
    SPLIT lv_temp_string AT iv_primary_delimiter INTO TABLE rt_result.

    " Leere Einträge entfernen und trimmen
    DELETE rt_result WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
    LOOP AT rt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      <fs_line> = to_upper( condense( <fs_line> ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_split_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter    TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ','
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)   TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_string_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_split_numbers.
    DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_delimiter INTO TABLE lt_parts.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR <fs_part> IN lt_parts
                       NEXT s = s + CONV i( <fs_part> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_space DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS split_and_clean_spaces
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cleaned_parts) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_string_split_space IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_raw_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).

      FOR <fs_part> IN lt_raw_parts
      LET lv_trimmed_part = condense( <fs_part> ) IN

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_regex_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matches) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_sy_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_regex_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = NEW cl_abap_matcher( regex = lo_regex text = iv_input_string ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_group( name = '0' ) TO rt_matches.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_components,
             protocol TYPE string,
             host     TYPE string,
             path     TYPE string,
             query    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url_components.

    METHODS parse_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_components) TYPE ty_url_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_url.
    DATA: lv_temp_url TYPE string.

    " Protocol
    FIND REGEX '^(\w+):\/\/' IN iv_url SUBMATCHES rs_components-protocol.
    IF rs_components-protocol IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_temp_url = iv_url+xstrlen( rs_components-protocol )+3.
    ELSE.
      lv_temp_url = iv_url.
    ENDIF.

    " Host
    FIND REGEX '^([^\/\?#]+)' IN lv_temp_url SUBMATCHES rs_components-host.
    IF rs_components-host IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_temp_url = lv_temp_url+xstrlen( rs_components-host ).
    ENDIF.

    " Path and Query
    DATA(lv_path_query) = lv_temp_url.
    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF '?' IN lv_path_query MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_query_offset).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_components-path = lv_path_query(lv_query_offset).
      rs_components-query = lv_path_query+lv_query_offset+1.
    ELSE.
      rs_components-path = lv_path_query.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in Zeilen auf und verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile, um sie zu bereinigen (z.B. Leerzeichen entfernen, Großbuchstaben).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` mit `CL_ABAP_CHAR_UTILITIES=>CR_LF` als Delimiter und anschließend eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `CONDENSE` und `TO_UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_split_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_lines
      IMPORTING
        iv_multiline_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_split_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_lines.
    DATA(lt_raw_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_multiline_string AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_raw_lines.

    rt_processed_lines = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_line> IN lt_raw_lines
      LET lv_cleaned_line = to_upper( condense( <fs_line> ) ) IN
      WHERE ( lv_cleaned_line IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( lv_cleaned_line )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in ein Datum. Wenn der String kein gültiges Datum ist, soll ein Standarddatum (z.B. '00000000') zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` in Kombination mit `CONV` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_to_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date) TYPE d.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_date.
    rv_date = COND #( 
      WHEN iv_date_string IS INITIAL THEN '00000000'

            '00000000'

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einem bestimmten Fluggesellschaftscode und einer Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE`-Konstrukte. Die Inline-Deklaration und die Verwendung von `@` für Host-Variablen im Open SQL sind ebenfalls moderne Syntaxelemente.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Open SQL

hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_info_for_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.

CLASS zcl_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_info_for_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( fldate = iv_fldate )
                               ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_info_for_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_info_for_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_sflights( ).
    DATA(ld_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_cut->get_flight_info_for_date( ld_today ).

    " Assuming there are flights for today in sflights test data
    IF lt_flight_info IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_info msg = 'Should find some flight info' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_info ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 flights for today' ). " Adjust expected count based on SFLIGHTS data
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flight_info[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrier should be AA' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'No flights found for today, test data might be empty' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` (ab 7.40) ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation und Erstellung neuer interner Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax, die `LOOP AT` und `APPEND` in vielen Fällen ersetzt und den Code deutlich kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, Transformation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für einen bestimmten Flug (Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) aus `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_occupied_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    " Assuming LH 0400 has 100 occupied seats in SFLIGHTS test data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 100 msg = 'Total occupied seats for LH 0400 should be 100' ). " Adjust expected value based on SFLIGHTS data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ab 7.50) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Art, Summen, Zählungen oder andere Reduktionen durchzuführen, die den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`s mit manueller Akkumulation.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Simulieren Sie das Lesen von Nachrichten aus einem Anwendungslog, das zuvor mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` erstellt wurde. Da das direkte Lesen eines gespeicherten Logs komplex ist, wird hier die Abfrage von Nachrichten aus einem temporären Log-Objekt demonstriert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und seine Methoden zur Nachrichtenabfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             type TYPE bal_msgty,
             id   TYPE bal_msgid,
             no   TYPE bal_msgno,
             v1   TYPE bal_msgv1,
           END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_messages_from_log
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_messages_from_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create( ).
    lo_log->add_entry( iv_msg_type = 'E' iv_msg_id = 'ZTEST' iv_msg_no = '002' iv_msg_v1 = 'Error message 1' ).
    lo_log->add_entry( iv_msg_type = 'W' iv_msg_id = 'ZTEST' iv_msg_no = '003' iv_msg_v1 = 'Warning message 2' ).

    DATA(lt_bal_messages) = lo_log->get_messages( ).

    rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_bal_msg IN lt_bal_messages
                           ( type = ls_bal_msg-msgty,
                             id   = ls_bal_msg-msgid,
                             no   = ls_bal_msg-msgno,
                             v1   = ls_bal_msg-msgv1 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_messages_from_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_messages_from_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_message( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->get_messages_from_log( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should retrieve 2 messages' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-type exp = 'E' msg = 'First message type should be E' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-v1 exp = 'Warning message 2' msg = 'Second message text should be correct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Nachrichten aus einem `cl_s_aut_bal_log`-Objekt abgerufen werden können. Obwohl das Speichern und Laden von Logs komplexer ist, demonstriert `get_messages` die Fähigkeit, die gesammelten Nachrichten zu extrahieren. Die Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE` zur Transformation der Nachrichtenstruktur ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster (ab 7.40).
keywords: Application Log, BAL, cl_s_aut_bal_log, Read Log, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie einen Status-Text basierend auf einem numerischen Status-Code mit dem `COND`-Ausdruck zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
        WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Active'
        WHEN iv_status_code = 2 THEN 'Pending'
        WHEN iv_status_code = 3 THEN 'Blocked'
        ELSE 'Unknown' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 2 ) exp = 'Pending' msg = 'Status 2 should be Pending' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und modernen mathematischen Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und berücksichtigen Sie die Division durch die Anzahl der Flüge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT sum = 0
                                             FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                             NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_average_price_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    " Assuming AA flights have prices that average to around 200.00 in SFLIGHTS test data
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'Average price for AA should be 200.00' ). " Adjust expected value
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_average_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_flight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' msg = 'Average price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator (ab 7.50) zur Summenbildung mit Inline-Deklarationen und modernen mathematischen Operationen, um den Durchschnittspreis zu berechnen. Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` für genaue Dezimalberechnungen ist ebenfalls eine Best Practice. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode zur Datenaggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, sflights, Aggregation, Decfloat

Instructions: Erstellen Sie zwei separate interne Tabellen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die als Datenquellen für zwei Bereiche eines Splitter-Containers dienen könnten: eine für Flüge von 'FRANKFURT' und eine für Flüge nach 'NEW YORK'.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` Konstruktoren, um die Daten effizient zu filtern und zu kopieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_splitter_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_split_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_split_data) TYPE REF TO DATA. " Returns a structure with two internal tables

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_splitter_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_split_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_result,
             flights_from_fra TYPE tt_flights,
             flights_to_jfk   TYPE tt_flights,
           END OF ty_split_result.

    DATA(ls_split_result) = VALUE ty_split_result(
      flights_from_fra = VALUE tt_flights(
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
        ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) )
      )
      flights_to_jfk = VALUE tt_flights(
        FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
        ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) )
      )
    ).

    GET REFERENCE OF ls_split_result INTO rs_split_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_data_prep FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_data_prep.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_splitter_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lr_split_data) = lo_cut->get_split_flight_data( ).
    DATA(ls_split_result) = CAST zcl_splitter_data_prep=>ty_split_result( lr_split_data->* ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_split_result-flights_from_fra msg = 'Flights from FRA should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_split_result-flights_to_jfk msg = 'Flights to JFK should not be empty' ).

    DATA(lv_fra_count) = lines( ls_split_result-flights_from_fra ).
    DATA(lv_jfk_count) = lines( ls_split_result-flights_to_jfk ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_fra_count > 0 msg = 'Expected flights from FRA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_jfk_count > 0 msg = 'Expected flights to JFK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die effiziente Datenaufbereitung für UI-Komponenten mit modernen ABAP-Konstruktoren. `VALUE` und `FOR` ermöglichen das Filtern und Füllen interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. `CORRESPONDING` wird verwendet, um Felder mit gleichem Namen automatisch zu übertragen, was den Code kompakt hält. Der Rückgabewert als `REF TO DATA` ist flexibel für dynamische UI-Szenarien.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, CORRESPONDING, UI, Splitter, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer variablen Anzahl von Spalten, basierend auf einer Konfiguration, die für die Anzeige in einem dynamischen UI-Element (z.B. ALV) verwendet werden könnte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und -befüllung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_config,
             field_name TYPE fieldname,
             field_type TYPE datatype,
             field_len  TYPE int4,
           END OF ty_field_config.
    TYPES: tt_field_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_config WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_config TYPE tt_field_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_field_config INTO DATA(ls_field_config).
      APPEND VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_field_config-field_name
        type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_by_name( ls_field_config-field_type )
      ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    IF <lt_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <ls_line> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.

      IF <ls_line> IS ASSIGNED.
        LOOP AT it_field_config INTO ls_field_config.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_config-field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field>).
          IF <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
            CASE ls_field_config-field_type.
              WHEN 'CHAR'.
                <lv_field> = |Value for { ls_field_config-field_name }|.
              WHEN 'INT4'.
                <lv_field> = sy-tabix.
              WHEN 'D'.
                <lv_field> = sy-datum.
              WHEN OTHERS.
            ENDCASE.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_creator=>tt_field_config(
      ( field_name = 'ID' field_type = 'INT4' field_len = 10 )
      ( field_name = 'NAME' field_type = 'CHAR' field_len = 50 )
      ( field_name = 'DATE' field_type = 'D' field_len = 8 )
    ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lt_config ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <ls_line> msg = 'First line should be assigned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_id> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_id>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <lv_id> msg = 'ID field should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_id> exp = 1 msg = 'ID field value mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) und dynamischer Programmierung flexible Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit erstellen kann. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische UI-Komponenten wie ALVs, die sich an unterschiedliche Datenstrukturen anpassen müssen. Die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` ist hierbei zentral.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CREATE DATA, FIELD-SYMBOLS, UI, ALV

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über eine interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_price) = 0.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' INTO @lv_expected_price.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Total price mismatch for AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Konstrukt in modernem ABAP, um Aggregationen oder Transformationen über interne Tabellen durchzuführen. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen durch eine deklarative und funktionale Syntax, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen und deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_from_ny
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_from_ny.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      WHERE cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND fldate > sy-datum
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_from_ny( ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'City from mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) msg = 'Flight date not in future' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 msg = 'Expected some future flights from NY' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen zu schreiben, kann man die Filterkriterien direkt im Operator angeben, was den Code prägnanter und leichter verständlich macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Selection, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHTS
