Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Flugstatus basierend auf dem Flugdatum und der Buchungskapazität einen Wert zu. Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = SWITCH #( 
      WHEN iv_fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
      WHEN iv_seatsocc >= iv_seatsmax THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN iv_seatsocc > iv_seatsmax / 2 THEN 'Stark gebucht'
      ELSE 'Verfügbar'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum - 1 iv_seatsocc = 10 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' msg = 'Status for past flight mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 iv_seatsocc = 100 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Ausgebucht' msg = 'Status for full flight mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 iv_seatsocc = 60 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Stark gebucht' msg = 'Status for half full flight mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_fldate = sy-datum + 1 iv_seatsocc = 30 iv_seatsmax = 100 ) exp = 'Verfügbar' msg = 'Status for available flight mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen. Er macht den Code kompakter, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig, da der Rückgabewert direkt zugewiesen wird.
keywords: Conditional Logic, SWITCH, Expression, Case

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen und die Verwendung von Konstruktorausdrücken (`NEW`) in einem einzigen Statement.
hint: Instanziieren Sie ein Objekt und rufen Sie direkt Methoden auf, die Referenzen auf sich selbst zurückgeben oder weitere Methoden aufrufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_final_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_value( 10 )->add_value( 5 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_result exp = 18 msg = 'Chained method call result mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, kombiniert mit dem `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung, ermöglicht es, mehrere Operationen auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen, flüssigen Anweisung auszuführen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, insbesondere bei Fluent Interfaces, bei denen Methoden die Referenz auf das eigene Objekt zurückgeben.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Constructor Expressions, NEW, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE` verwenden, um eine neue Tabelle mit abgeleiteten Werten zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um eine neue Tabelle zeilenweise zu füllen und dabei Transformationen anzuwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_original.
    TYPES: tt_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_original TYPE tt_original
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_transformed = VALUE tt_transformed(
      FOR ls_orig IN it_original
      ( key = |ID_{ ls_orig-id }|
        value = to_upper( ls_orig-text ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_transform=>tt_original(
      ( id = 1 text = 'hello' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'world' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->transform_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_transformed ) exp = 2 msg = 'Line count mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_trans1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_trans1-key exp = 'ID_1' msg = 'Key 1 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_trans1-value exp = 'HELLO' msg = 'Value 1 mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_transformed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_trans2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_trans2-key exp = 'ID_2' msg = 'Key 2 mismatch' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_trans2-value exp = 'WORLD' msg = 'Value 2 mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ist ideal für die Transformation von internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, indem jede Zeile der Quelltabelle verarbeitet und in ein neues Format überführt wird, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `APPEND`-Anweisungen. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und effizienter Ansatz.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle mit einem Tabellenausdruck (`[...]`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck `it_table[ key_field = 'value' ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_name_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_name_by_id.
    rv_name = it_data[ id = iv_id ]-name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_read_non_existing EXPECTING CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Bob' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_name) = lo_cut->get_name_by_id( iv_id = 1 it_data = lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Alice' msg = 'Name for ID 1 mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_non_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alice' )
    ).

    lo_cut->get_name_by_id( iv_id = 99 it_data = lt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`[...]`) sind die moderne und prägnante Art, auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zuzugreifen. Sie ersetzen `READ TABLE` und ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Felder der gefundenen Zeile. Bei nicht gefundenen Zeilen wird eine Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND`) ausgelöst, was eine klare Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: Internal Tables, Table Expression, Read Table, Exception Handling

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine funktionale Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten verarbeitet und eine neue Liste mit transformierten Objekten zurückgibt, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `NEW`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um eine neue interne Tabelle von Objektreferenzen zu erstellen, wobei jedes Objekt mit `NEW` instanziiert und transformiert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_functional_object_proc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS process_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_input_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_objects) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_functional_object_proc=>zcl_simple_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_simple_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
        METHODS get_transformed_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_original_value TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_simple_object IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_original_value = iv_value.
      ENDMETHOD.

      METHOD get_transformed_value.
        rv_value = |Transformed: { to_upper( mv_original_value ) }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_functional_object_proc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_objects.
    rt_processed_objects = VALUE #( 
      FOR value IN it_input_values
      ( NEW zcl_simple_object( value ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_objects FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_objects.
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF string(
      ( 'apple' )
      ( 'banana' )
      ( 'cherry' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_processed) = zcl_functional_object_proc=>process_objects( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 msg = 'Number of processed objects mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 1 INTO DATA(lr_obj1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_obj1->get_transformed_value( ) exp = 'Transformed: APPLE' msg = 'First object transformation mismatch' ).

    READ TABLE lt_processed INDEX 2 INTO DATA(lr_obj2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_obj2->get_transformed_value( ) exp = 'Transformed: BANANA' msg = 'Second object transformation mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren und dem `NEW`-Operator innerhalb eines `VALUE`-Konstruktors, um eine funktionale Transformation einer Liste von Werten in eine Liste von Objekten durchzuführen. Jedes Objekt wird dabei direkt bei der Erstellung instanziiert und mit dem entsprechenden Wert initialisiert. Dies ist ein sehr moderner und effizienter Weg, um Sammlungen von Objekten zu verwalten und zu transformieren.
keywords: Object Orientation, Functional Programming, FOR, NEW, VALUE, Object Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle 'sflights'. Die Hashed Table soll 'carrid' und 'connid' als eindeutigen Schlüssel haben.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.

Hashed Tables bieten einen sehr schnellen Zugriff auf Einträge über ihren eindeutigen Schlüssel, was sie ideal für große Datenmengen macht, bei denen der Zugriff über den Schlüssel häufig erfolgt. Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer Hashed Table basierend auf ihrem Schlüssel und geben Sie den Preis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO ...` oder `LINE OF ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_sflights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_price_from_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE ty_hashed_sflights.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_price_from_key.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_price = ls_sflight-price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_read( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_price_from_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '422.00' ). " Example price for AA 0017

    lv_price = lo_cut->get_price_from_key( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zugriff auf Hashed Tables erfolgt am effizientesten über den Schlüssel mit `READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...`. Die moderne Syntax erlaubt die direkte Zuweisung in eine inline deklarierte Struktur (`INTO DATA(ls_sflight)`), was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, READ TABLE, TABLE KEY, DATA

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie den Preis eines Eintrags in einer Hashed Table basierend auf dem Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ... WHERE ...` oder `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_sflights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS modify_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE ty_hashed_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    READ TABLE ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight> WITH TABLE KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_sflight>-price = iv_new_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_modify( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_hsh_table_modify=>ty_hashed_sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_old_price) = lo_cut->get_price_from_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ). " Assuming this method exists or get it directly
    READ TABLE lt_sflights WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_original).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_original ).

    lo_cut->modify_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' iv_new_price = '999.99' CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_for_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_for_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights WHERE ( price > 500 )
                             ( ls_sflight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur gleichnamige Felder übertragen werden sollen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer Hashed Table unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_sflights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_all_sflights TYPE ty_hashed_sflights.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @mt_all_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN mt_all_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_to_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table aus 'sflights' und transformieren Sie die Daten, indem Sie den Preis verdoppeln, unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Expression mit `LET`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ... FOR ... IN ... LET ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hsh_table_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_hashed_sflights TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE ty_hashed_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hsh_table_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights.

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_sflights
                             LET lv_doubled_price = ls_sflight-price * 2 IN
                             ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid,
                               connid   = ls_sflight-connid,
                               fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate,
                               price    = lv_doubled_price,
                               currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hsh_table_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_transformed ).

    " Check a specific entry (e.g., AA 0017) and verify its price is doubled
    DATA(ls_original_aa0017) TYPE zcl_hsh_table_transform=>ty_sflight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @ls_original_aa0017-price WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017'.

    READ TABLE lt_transformed WITH TABLE KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_transformed_aa0017).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_transformed_aa0017 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_transformed_aa0017-price exp = ls_original_aa0017-price * 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit der `LET`-Klausel (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb der Expression. Dies ist ideal für komplexe Transformationen, bei denen Zwischenberechnungen für die Erstellung neuer Tabellenzeilen erforderlich sind, und führt zu sehr lesbarem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: HASHED TABLE, FOR, LET, VALUE, DATA TRANSFORMATION, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf Fluggesellschaft, Verbindungsnummer und Flugdatum. Prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Operation mit `sy-subrc`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_date_threshold) = '20250101'.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE cityfrom IN ( 'NEW YORK', 'SAN FRANCISCO' )
                             AND fldate > lv_date_threshold ).

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Komponentenwert einer Struktur zu und prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Zuweisung mit `sy-subrc`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

        iv_component TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_component_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_assign_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_assign( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_sy_subrc_assign=>ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->assign_component_dynamically( is_data = ls_data iv_component = 'FIELD1' ).

CLASS zcl_filter_predicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight.

    CLASS-METHODS is_long_haul_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_long_haul) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_long_haul_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_predicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_long_haul_flight.
    " Example logic: A flight is long-haul if it's from FRA to JFK or vice versa
    IF ( is_flight-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND is_flight-cityto = 'NEW YORK' ) OR
       ( is_flight-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' AND is_flight-cityto = 'FRANKFURT' ).
      rv_is_long_haul = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_long_haul = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_long_haul_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE zcl_filter_predicate=>is_long_haul_flight( CORRESPONDING #( is_flight = <fs_table_line> ) ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 long-haul flights' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    LOOP AT lt_result ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).

Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Modularität des Codes, da die Filterbedingung in einer separaten Methode definiert und getestet werden kann. Die `CORRESPONDING` Syntax innerhalb des Methodenaufrufs ist eine moderne Art, Daten an die Methode zu übergeben.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in die Tabelle `sflights` ein und prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Operation mit `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT` und überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             mandt    TYPE mandt,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             payments TYPE s_payments,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS insert_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS delete_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flight.
    INSERT sflights FROM is_flight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_flight.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = is_flight-carrid
                          AND connid = is_flight-connid
                          AND fldate = is_flight-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.

    DATA gs_test_flight TYPE zcl_sy_subrc_insert=>ty_flight_data.

    CLASS-METHODS class_setup.
    CLASS-METHODS class_teardown.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD class_setup.
    gs_test_flight = VALUE #( mandt = sy-mandt
                                carrid = 'XX'
                                connid = '0001'
                                fldate = sy-datum
                                price = '100.00'
                                currency = 'EUR'
                                planetype = 'A380'
                                seatsmax = 500
                                seatsocc = 100
                                payments = 100000
                                cityfrom = 'TESTCITY'
                                cityto = 'TESTDEST' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD class_teardown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_insert( ).
    lo_cut->delete_flight( gs_test_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_insert( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight( gs_test_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Insert should succeed' act = lv_success ).

    " Verify insertion
    DATA ls_check TYPE sflights.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_check
      WHERE carrid = gs_test_flight-carrid
        AND connid = gs_test_flight-connid
        AND fldate = gs_test_flight-fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight should exist after insert' act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_insert( ).
    " First insert (should succeed)
    lo_cut->insert_flight( gs_test_flight ).
    " Second insert (should fail due to duplicate key)
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight( gs_test_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Insert of duplicate should fail' act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei Datenbankoperationen wie `INSERT`, `UPDATE`, `MODIFY` und `DELETE` ist `sy-subrc` der Standardmechanismus, um den Erfolg oder Misserfolg der Operation zu überprüfen. Ein `sy-subrc` von 0 bedeutet Erfolg, während ein anderer Wert (z.B. 4 bei `INSERT` für doppelten Schlüssel) einen Fehler anzeigt. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Fehlerbehandlung bei der Datenmanipulation.
keywords: sy-subrc, Database Operations, INSERT, sflights

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus `sflights`, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einem `FOR GROUPS OF` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto   TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carr_counts) TYPE tt_carr_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate cityfrom cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ).

    rt_carr_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                               GROUP BY flight-carrid
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_group FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_group.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_grouped_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 1 entry for LH' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH count should be 2' act = ls_lh_count-count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` mit `FOR GROUPS OF`. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` auf relevante Einträge reduziert. Anschließend wird der `FOR GROUPS OF`-Ausdruck verwendet, um die gefilterten Daten nach einem Kriterium zu gruppieren und Aggregationen (hier: `GROUP SIZE` für die Anzahl der Elemente) durchzuführen. Dies ermöglicht komplexe Datenanalysen in einer sehr modernen und funktionalen Weise.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Grouping, FOR GROUPS, sflights

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Datensatz aus einer internen Tabelle und prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Operation mit `sy-subrc`.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             key_field TYPE i,

           END OF ty_item.

CLASS zcl_sy_subrc_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_item.
    DATA ls_item TYPE ty_item.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_found = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_found = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sy_subrc_read_table( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_sy_subrc_read_table=>tt_items(
      ( key_field = 1 value_field = 'Value 1' )
      ( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Value 2' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_found) = lo_cut->read_item( it_items = lt_test_data iv_key = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Item with key 99 should not be found' act = lv_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `READ TABLE` ist eine der am häufigsten verwendeten Anweisungen für interne Tabellen. `sy-subrc` ist hier der direkte Indikator dafür, ob ein Datensatz mit dem angegebenen Schlüssel gefunden wurde. Ein Wert von 0 bedeutet Erfolg, während 4 anzeigt, dass kein passender Eintrag gefunden wurde. Dies ist eine grundlegende und effiziente Methode zur Überprüfung des Lesezugriffs.
keywords: sy-subrc, Internal Tables, READ TABLE

CLASS zcl_sflight_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_single( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251204' ). " Use current date for example

keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine dynamische Liste von Fluggesellschaften. Die Liste der Fluggesellschaften soll als interne Tabelle übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `WHERE field IN @( internal_table )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_where_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrids
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_where_in IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrids.
    IF it_carrids IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_where_in FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_where_in_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_where_in.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_where_in( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_where_in=>tt_carrids( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrids( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' exp = abap_true act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid should be LH or AA' exp = abap_true act = ( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid = 'LH' OR lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid = 'AA' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_where_in_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_where_in( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_sflight_where_in=>tt_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrids( lt_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be initial for empty input' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `@internal_table` direkt in der `WHERE IN`-Klausel ist eine moderne und sichere Methode, um dynamische Listen von Werten für die Datenbankabfrage zu übergeben. Dies verhindert SQL-Injections und ist effizienter als die manuelle Konstruktion von dynamischem SQL.
keywords: SELECT, WHERE IN, Internal Table, SFLIGHT, Host Variable

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften ('LH' und 'AA') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste. Die Ergebnisliste soll die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `UNION ALL` Operator zwischen zwei SELECT-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_union_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_union_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_union_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected at least one entry' exp = abap_true act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected LH entries' exp = abap_true act = ( lv_lh_count > 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected AA entries' exp = abap_true act = ( lv_aa_count > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator (verfügbar ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. `UNION ALL` behält alle Duplikate bei, während `UNION` Duplikate entfernt. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Datenintegrationen direkt auf der Datenbankebene.
keywords: SELECT, UNION, UNION ALL, SFLIGHT, Database Join

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Custom Container und platzieren Sie ein Textfeld (CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT) darin. Das Textfeld soll einen initialen Text anzeigen. Der Fokus liegt auf der korrekten Instanziierung und Verknüpfung der GUI-Objekte.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT` und verknüpfen Sie diese. Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_container=>screen` als Parent für den Custom Container in einer Testumgebung.

CLASS zcl_gui_simple_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_simple_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Create custom container (assuming a custom control area 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' on screen 100 for a real program)
    " For unit testing, we can use cl_gui_container=>screen as a placeholder parent.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " This name would link to a screen element
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen. " Placeholder parent for testability

    " Create text edit control
    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container.

  METHOD get_custom_container.
    ro_container = mo_custom_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_edit.
    ro_text_edit = mo_text_edit.
  ENDMETHOD.

    IF mo_text_edit IS BOUND.
      mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_text_setting FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_container_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_simple_container( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Text edit control should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_text_edit( ) ).

Die Tests überprüfen die erfolgreiche Objekterstellung und die grundlegende Funktionalität wie das Setzen von Text.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für einen Button, der in einem Custom Container platziert ist. Wenn der Button geklickt wird, soll ein Zähler erhöht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_BUTTON` und die `SET HANDLER` Anweisung für das `CLICK`-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_event_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_button RETURNING VALUE(ro_button) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    METHODS get_click_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_button         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mv_click_count    TYPE i VALUE 0.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " Placeholder
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
        text   = 'Click Me'.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_click_count = mv_click_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button.
    ro_button = mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_click_count.
    rv_count = mv_click_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_button_click_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_click_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_event_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Initial click count should be 0' exp = 0 act = lo_cut->get_click_count( ) ).

    " Simulate button click event
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->get_button( )->raise_event
      EXPORTING
        event_name = cl_gui_button=>eventid_click.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Click count should be 1 after one click' exp = 1 act = lo_cut->get_click_count( ) ).

    CALL METHOD lo_cut->get_button( )->raise_event
      EXPORTING
        event_name = cl_gui_button=>eventid_click.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Click count should be 2 after two clicks' exp = 2 act = lo_cut->get_click_count( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Ereignisbehandlung in ABAP Objects erfolgt über die `FOR EVENT` Syntax in der Methoden-Definition und die `SET HANDLER` Anweisung. Hier wird das `CLICK`-Ereignis eines `CL_GUI_BUTTON`-Objekts abgefangen und eine private Methode `handle_button_click` aufgerufen, die den Zähler erhöht. Die Simulation des Ereignisses im Unit-Test zeigt die korrekte Verknüpfung.
keywords: cl_gui_container, cl_gui_button, Event Handling, SET HANDLER, GUI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in einem ALV Grid innerhalb eines Custom Containers an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SALV_TABLE=>FACTORY` und die Methode `DISPLAY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_alv_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_sflight_alv.
    METHODS get_custom_container RETURNING VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    METHODS get_alv_table RETURNING VALUE(ro_alv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " Placeholder
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflight_alv.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_custom_container
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " Redundant if r_container is used, but good for clarity
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflight
        ).

        mo_alv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_custom_container.
    ro_container = mo_custom_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_alv_table.
    ro_alv = mo_alv_table.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_alv_demo( ).
    lo_cut->display_sflight_alv( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Custom container should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_custom_container( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'ALV table object should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_alv_table( ) ).

    " Further assertions would require mocking CL_SALV_TABLE or more complex integration tests.
    " For a basic unit test, checking object instantiation is sufficient.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_SALV_TABLE` bietet eine moderne und einfache Möglichkeit, ALV-Listen anzuzeigen, ohne die komplexen Funktionsbausteine der Vergangenheit. Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Tabstrip-Container mit zwei Tabs. Platzieren Sie auf jedem Tab ein CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TABSTRIP_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_CONTAINER` für die Tab-Bereiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tabstrip_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_tabstrip_container RETURNING VALUE(ro_tabstrip) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_tabstrip_container.
    METHODS get_tab1_text_edit RETURNING VALUE(ro_text_edit) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    METHODS get_tab2_text_edit RETURNING VALUE(ro_text_edit) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    METHODS set_tab_texts IMPORTING iv_text1 TYPE string iv_text2 TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tabstrip_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_tabstrip_container.
    DATA mo_tab1_container     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_tab2_container     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit1         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_text_edit2         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tabstrip_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tabstrip_container
      EXPORTING
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen " Placeholder
        container_name = 'TABSTRIP_CONTROL'. " Name of the custom control on screen

    mo_tab1_container = mo_tabstrip_container->get_tab_page_container( 'TAB1' ).
    mo_tab2_container = mo_tabstrip_container->get_tab_page_container( 'TAB2' ).

    mo_tabstrip_container->add_tab( name = 'TAB1' text = 'Tab 1' ).
    mo_tabstrip_container->add_tab( name = 'TAB2' text = 'Tab 2' ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit1
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_tab1_container.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit2
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_tab2_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tabstrip_container.
    ro_tabstrip = mo_tabstrip_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tab1_text_edit.
    ro_text_edit = mo_text_edit1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tab2_text_edit.
    ro_text_edit = mo_text_edit2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_tab_texts.
    IF mo_text_edit1 IS BOUND.
      mo_text_edit1->set_text_as_stream( iv_text1 ).
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_text_edit2 IS BOUND.
      mo_text_edit2->set_text_as_stream( iv_text2 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_tabstrip_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_tab_texts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_tabstrip_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tabstrip_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Tabstrip container should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_tabstrip_container( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Tab 1 text edit should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_tab1_text_edit( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Tab 2 text edit should be instantiated' act = lo_cut->get_tab2_text_edit( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_tab_texts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_tabstrip_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_text1) = 'Content for Tab 1'.
    DATA(lv_text2) = 'Content for Tab 2'.
    lo_cut->set_tab_texts( iv_text1 = lv_text1 iv_text2 = lv_text2 ).

    DATA(lv_actual_text1) = ''.
    lo_cut->get_tab1_text_edit( )->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_actual_text1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Text in Tab 1 should match' exp = lv_text1 act = lv_actual_text1 ).

    DATA(lv_actual_text2) = ''.
    lo_cut->get_tab2_text_edit( )->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_actual_text2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Text in Tab 2 should match' exp = lv_text2 act = lv_actual_text2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_GUI_TABSTRIP_CONTAINER` ermöglicht die Erstellung von Registerkarten-Oberflächen. Jede Registerkarte erhält einen eigenen `CL_GUI_CONTAINER`, in den weitere Controls platziert werden können. Dies ist eine gängige Methode zur Strukturierung komplexer GUI-Anwendungen.
keywords: cl_gui_container, cl_gui_tabstrip_container, cl_gui_textedit, GUI, Tabstrip

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Custom Container und fügen Sie ein Toolbar-Control (CL_GUI_TOOLBAR) hinzu. Fügen Sie der Toolbar einen Button hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` und die Methode `ADD_BUTTON`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS get_toolbar RETURNING VALUE(ro_toolbar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    METHODS get_button_click_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_toolbar          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mv_button_click_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    CONSTANTS: gc_button_id TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>function VALUE 'MY_BUTTON'.

    METHODS handle_toolbar_function FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_gui_toolbar.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' " Placeholder
        parent         = cl_gui_container=>screen.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = gc_button_id
      icon  = icon_ok
      text  = 'Execute'
      quickinfo = 'Click to execute'
    ).

    SET HANDLER handle_toolbar_function FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_toolbar_function.
    IF fcode = gc_button_id.
      mv_button_click_count = mv_button_click_count + 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_toolbar.
    ro_toolbar = mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button_click_count.
    rv_count = mv_button_click_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_toolbar_button_click FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_toolbar_button_click.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_toolbar_demo( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Initial click count should be 0' exp = 0 act = lo_cut->get_button_click_count( ) ).

    " Simulate toolbar button click event
    DATA(ls_event_data) TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>s_function_selected.
    ls_event_data-fcode = zcl_gui_toolbar_demo=>gc_button_id.

    CALL METHOD lo_cut->get_toolbar( )->raise_event
      EXPORTING
        event_name = cl_gui_toolbar=>eventid_function_selected
        event_data = ls_event_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Click count should be 1 after one click' exp = 1 act = lo_cut->get_button_click_count( ) ).

    ls_event_data-fcode = zcl_gui_toolbar_demo=>gc_button_id.
    CALL METHOD lo_cut->get_toolbar( )->raise_event
      EXPORTING
        event_name = cl_gui_toolbar=>eventid_function_selected
        event_data = ls_event_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Click count should be 2 after two clicks' exp = 2 act = lo_cut->get_button_click_count( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` ermöglicht die Erstellung von anpassbaren Toolbars in ABAP-GUI-Anwendungen. Buttons und andere Elemente können mit `ADD_BUTTON` hinzugefügt werden. Die Ereignisbehandlung für Toolbar-Funktionen erfolgt über das `FUNCTION_SELECTED`-Ereignis, das den Funktionscode des geklickten Elements liefert.
keywords: cl_gui_container, cl_gui_toolbar, GUI, Toolbar, Event Handling

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in eine interne Tabelle, wobei nur die Felder übernommen werden, deren Namen in beiden Strukturen übereinstimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_corresponding
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_corr_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_corresponding.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_corr_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_corresponding( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRIER ID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CONNECTION ID should not be initial' act = ls_flight-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Klausel in `SELECT` ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten aus der Datenbank in eine interne Tabelle zu laden, wenn die Feldnamen der Zielstruktur mit denen der Datenbanktabelle übereinstimmen. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen.
keywords: SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer internen Tabelle in eine andere, wobei nur die Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden. Die Quelltabelle enthält zusätzliche Felder, die in der Zieltabelle ignoriert werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MOVE-CORRESPONDING ... TO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             extra_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_corresponding_tables
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_corresponding_tables.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING it_source TO rt_target.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_tables.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_move_corr_tables=>tt_source,
          ls_source TYPE zcl_move_corr_tables=>ty_source.

    ls_source = VALUE #( field1 = 1 field2 = 'Test1' field3 = 'ABC' extra_field = 99 ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.
    ls_source = VALUE #( field1 = 2 field2 = 'Test2' field3 = 'DEF' extra_field = 100 ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corr_tables( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->copy_corresponding_tables( it_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of rows should match' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 should be 1' act = ls_target-field1 exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 should be Test1' act = ls_target-field2 exp = 'Test1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field3 should be ABC' act = ls_target-field3 exp = 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` ist eine einfache und lesbare Anweisung, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen oder Strukturen zu kopieren, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen haben. Sie ist besonders nützlich, um Redundanz bei der Datenzuweisung zu vermeiden.
keywords: MOVE-CORRESPONDING, Internal Tables, Structures, Data Transfer

Instructions: Weisen Sie die entsprechenden Felder einer Quellstruktur einer Zielstruktur zu, wobei Sie den modernen `CORRESPONDING` Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator für Strukturen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_operator_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             unused TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_operator_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING amount = value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_operator_struct=>ty_source(
      id = 1
      name = 'Item A'
      value = '123.45'
      unused = 'X'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_operator_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID should match' act = ls_target-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name should match' act = ls_target-name exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Amount should be mapped from value' act = ls_target-amount exp = '123.45' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) bietet eine flexible und prägnante Syntax für die Zuweisung von Strukturen und internen Tabellen. Mit der `MAPPING` Klausel können Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zugeordnet werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes verbessert.
keywords: CORRESPONDING operator, Structures, MAPPING, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten von einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators, wobei Sie alle Felder außer einem bestimmten Feld übertragen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_operator_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             key_field TYPE i,
             data_field1 TYPE string,
             data_field2 TYPE string,
             sensitive_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             key_field TYPE i,
             data_field1 TYPE string,
             data_field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_table_except
      IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_operator_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_table_except.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source EXCEPT sensitive_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_table_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_table_except.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_corr_operator_table=>tt_source,
          ls_source TYPE zcl_corr_operator_table=>ty_source.

    ls_source = VALUE #( key_field = 1 data_field1 = 'A' data_field2 = 'B' sensitive_field = 'SECRET' ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.
    ls_source = VALUE #( key_field = 2 data_field1 = 'C' data_field2 = 'D' sensitive_field = 'TOP SECRET' ).
    APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_operator_table( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->copy_table_except( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of rows should match' act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Key field should be 1' act = ls_target-key_field exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data field 1 should be A' act = ls_target-data_field1 exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Data field 2 should be B' act = ls_target-data_field2 exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sensitive field should not be copied' act = ls_target-sensitive_field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel ermöglicht es, alle Felder einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle zu kopieren, außer den explizit ausgeschlossenen Feldern. Dies ist nützlich, um sensible Daten oder irrelevante Felder bei der Transformation zu ignorieren.
keywords: CORRESPONDING operator, Internal Tables, EXCEPT, Data Filtering

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Korrespondenzzuweisung zwischen zwei Strukturen durch, wobei Sie eine Basisstruktur als Ausgangspunkt verwenden und dann spezifische Felder überschreiben oder ausschließen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit `BASE` und `EXCEPT` oder `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corr_operator_base DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_base,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_base.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             new_status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_with_base
      IMPORTING is_base   TYPE ty_base
                is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corr_operator_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_base.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( is_base ) is_source MAPPING status = new_status value = amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_with_base FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_with_base.
    DATA(ls_base) = VALUE zcl_corr_operator_base=>ty_base(
      id = 100
      name = 'Base Item'
      status = 'A'
      value = '10.00'
    ).

    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corr_operator_base=>ty_source(
      id = 200 " This should be ignored due to BASE
      name = 'Source Item'
      new_status = 'B'
      amount = '25.50'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corr_operator_base( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_with_base( is_base = ls_base is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID from base should be 100' act = ls_target-id exp = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name from source should be Source Item' act = ls_target-name exp = 'Source Item' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Status should be mapped from new_status (B)' act = ls_target-status exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value should be mapped from amount (25.50)' act = ls_target-value exp = '25.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator mit der `BASE` Klausel ermöglicht es, eine Zielstruktur oder -tabelle mit Werten aus einer Basisstruktur/tabelle zu initialisieren und diese dann mit Werten aus einer Quellstruktur/tabelle zu überschreiben. Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen Standardwerte übernommen und nur spezifische Felder angepasst werden sollen. Die `MAPPING` Klausel erlaubt dabei die flexible Zuordnung von Feldern mit unterschiedlichen Namen.
keywords: CORRESPONDING operator, BASE, MAPPING, Structures, Data Transformation

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen ABAP-String, der Sonderzeichen enthält, in eine UTF-8-kodierte XSTRING-Repräsentation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` mit der Zielkodierung 'UTF-8'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_utf8
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_string_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_utf8.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_string ).
    rv_utf8_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_to_utf8 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_utf8.
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hallo Welt mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜäöüß und € Zeichen'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_string_to_utf8( ).
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_to_utf8( lv_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'UTF-8 XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_utf8_xstring ).

    " Optional: Verify by converting back (requires cl_abap_conv_in_ce)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = lv_utf8_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_converted_back) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_converted_back ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Converted string should match original' act = lv_converted_back exp = lv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` ist das Standardwerkzeug in ABAP für die Konvertierung von Daten in verschiedene Codepages und Endian-Formate. Durch die Angabe von `encoding = 'UTF-8'` wird der Eingabestring korrekt in die universelle UTF-8-Kodierung umgewandelt, was besonders wichtig für die Interaktion mit externen Systemen oder die Verarbeitung von Texten mit Sonderzeichen ist.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, UTF-8, XSTRING, Codepage Conversion, String Conversion
