explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Flexibilität von `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` bei der Auswahl spezifischer Codepages. Die Konvertierung in 'ISO-8859-1' ist relevant, wenn Daten mit Systemen ausgetauscht werden müssen, die diese ältere, aber immer noch verbreitete Kodierung verwenden. Die `write`-Methode akzeptiert den String, und `get_buffer` liefert die binäre Repräsentation.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, ISO-8859-1, Codepage Conversion, XSTRING

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING-Variable, die binäre Daten in einer bestimmten Codepage (z.B. UTF-16 Little Endian) enthält, in eine andere Codepage (z.B. UTF-8).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` zum Lesen und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` zum Schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_codepage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_codepage
      IMPORTING iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
                iv_source_encoding TYPE string
                iv_target_encoding TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_xstring_codepage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_codepage.
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_source_encoding
      endian   = 'LITTLE'
    ).
    lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_string_from_xstring) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_string_from_xstring ).

    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_target_encoding
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_string_from_xstring ).
    rv_converted_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_xstring.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello World with special chars: ©®™'.

    " First, create a UTF-16LE XSTRING for testing
    DATA(lo_conv_utf16le) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-16'
      endian   = 'LITTLE'
    ).
    lo_conv_utf16le->write( EXPORTING data = lv_original_string ).
    DATA(lv_utf16le_xstring) = lo_conv_utf16le->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_xstring_codepage( ).
    DATA(lv_converted_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_xstring_codepage(
      iv_input_xstring   = lv_utf16le_xstring
      iv_source_encoding = 'UTF-16'
      iv_target_encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Converted XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_converted_xstring ).

    " Verify by converting the final UTF-8 XSTRING back to string
    DATA(lo_conv_in_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_in_utf8->write( EXPORTING data = lv_converted_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_final_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in_utf8->read( IMPORTING data = lv_final_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Final string should match original' act = lv_final_string exp = lv_original_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den vollständigen Zyklus der Codepage-Konvertierung für binäre Daten. Zuerst wird `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` verwendet, um die XSTRING-Daten aus der Quellkodierung (z.B. UTF-16LE) in einen internen ABAP-String zu dekodieren. Anschließend wird dieser String mit `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` in die Zielkodierung (z.B. UTF-8) kodiert und als XSTRING zurückgegeben. Dies ist entscheidend für die Interoperabilität mit Systemen, die unterschiedliche binäre Textformate verwenden.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, cl_abap_conv_in_ce, XSTRING, Codepage Conversion, Endianness

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine numerische Variable (Integer) in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation unter Berücksichtigung der Endianness (z.B. von System-Endian zu Big Endian).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und geben Sie die gewünschte `endian` an. Beachten Sie, dass für reine numerische Typen die Codepage oft 'RAW' oder 'BINARY' ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_int_endian DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_int_to_big_endian_xstring
      IMPORTING iv_input_int TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_big_endian_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_int_endian IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_int_to_big_endian_xstring.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'RAW'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = iv_input_int ).
    rv_big_endian_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_int_endian FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_int_endian.
    DATA(lv_input_int) = 256.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_int_endian( ).
    DATA(lv_big_endian_xstring) = lo_cut->convert_int_to_big_endian_xstring( lv_input_int ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Big Endian XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_big_endian_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Length of XSTRING should be 4 bytes for type I' act = xstrlen( lv_big_endian_xstring ) exp = 4 ).

    " For 256 (decimal), Big Endian hex is 00000100
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'XSTRING value should be 00000100' act = lv_big_endian_xstring exp = '00000100' ).

    " Test with another value
    lv_input_int = 1.
    lv_big_endian_xstring = lo_cut->convert_int_to_big_endian_xstring( lv_input_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'XSTRING value should be 00000001' act = lv_big_endian_xstring exp = '00000001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Konvertierung von numerischen Typen ist die Endianness entscheidend, insbesondere beim Austausch von Binärdaten mit anderen Systemen. `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` ermöglicht die explizite Angabe der `endian` (hier 'BIG' für Big Endian). Die `encoding = 'RAW'` ist hier passend, da es sich um eine direkte binäre Repräsentation ohne Codepage-Interpretation handelt. Dies stellt sicher, dass die Bytes in der korrekten Reihenfolge für das Zielsystem angeordnet sind.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, Endianness, XSTRING, Binary Data, RAW encoding

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine ABAP-Struktur in eine XSTRING-Repräsentation unter Verwendung einer spezifischen Codepage und Endianness, um sie für die Übertragung vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` und übergeben Sie die Struktur an die `write`-Methode. Die Struktur wird dabei feldweise serialisiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_record,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             amount TYPE decfloat16,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data_record.

    METHODS serialize_structure
      IMPORTING is_data_record TYPE ty_data_record
                iv_encoding    TYPE string DEFAULT 'UTF-8'
                iv_endian      TYPE string DEFAULT 'BIG'
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_serialized_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_structure.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = iv_encoding
      endian   = iv_endian
    ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = is_data_record ).
    rv_serialized_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_structure.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring=>ty_data_record(
      id = 123
      name = 'Produkt X'
      amount = '199.99'
      active = abap_true
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_serialized_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_structure( ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Serialized XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_serialized_xstring ).

    " Optional: Verify by deserializing (requires cl_abap_conv_in_ce)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = lv_serialized_xstring ).
    DATA(ls_deserialized_data) TYPE zcl_conv_struct_to_xstring=>ty_data_record.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = ls_deserialized_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'ID should match' act = ls_deserialized_data-id exp = ls_data-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Name should match' act = ls_deserialized_data-name exp = ls_data-name ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Amount should match' act = ls_deserialized_data-amount exp = ls_data-amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Active should match' act = ls_deserialized_data-active exp = ls_data-active ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` Klasse kann nicht nur einfache Datentypen, sondern auch komplexe Strukturen direkt serialisieren. Wenn eine Struktur an die `write`-Methode übergeben wird, werden ihre Komponenten sequenziell in den Puffer geschrieben, wobei die angegebene Codepage und Endianness berücksichtigt werden. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um strukturierte Daten für die Übertragung über Schnittstellen oder die Speicherung in Binärformaten vorzubereiten.
keywords: cl_abap_conv_out_ce, Structure Serialization, XSTRING, Codepage, Endianness, Data Transfer

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von SFLIGHT-Daten in eine einzelne XSTRING-Repräsentation, wobei jede Zeile als separater Datensatz in UTF-8 kodiert wird.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und schreiben Sie jede Zeile einzeln in `cl_abap_conv_out_ce`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflight_table
      IMPORTING it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_simple
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_serialized_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).

    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = ls_sflight ).
      " Optional: Add a separator if needed, e.g., a newline character
      lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_serialized_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_sflight_table.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE zcl_conv_table_to_xstring=>tt_sflight_simple,
          ls_sflight TYPE zcl_conv_table_to_xstring=>ty_sflight_simple.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ).
    APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lv_serialized_xstring) = lo_cut->serialize_sflight_table( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Serialized XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_serialized_xstring ).

    " Verify by converting back and checking content
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = lv_serialized_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_full_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_full_string ).

    " Expected string content (approximate, depends on internal structure serialization)
    " The exact string representation of a structure serialized this way can be complex
    " but we can check for parts of it.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String, der in einer nicht-standardmäßigen Codepage (z.B. 'CP1252' - Windows Latin 1) vorliegt, in die interne ABAP-Darstellung (UTF-16) und dann in UTF-8.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` zum Lesen der Quellkodierung und `cl_abap_conv_out_ce` zum Schreiben der Zielkodierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_cp1252_to_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_cp1252_to_utf8
      IMPORTING iv_cp1252_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_utf8_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_cp1252_to_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_cp1252_to_utf8.
    " Step 1: Convert from CP1252 XSTRING to internal ABAP string (UTF-16)
    DATA(lo_conv_in) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'CP1252'
      endian   = 'BIG' " Endianness usually not relevant for single-byte encodings, but good practice
    ).
    lo_conv_in->write( EXPORTING data = iv_cp1252_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_abap_string) TYPE string.
    lo_conv_in->read( IMPORTING data = lv_abap_string ).

    " Step 2: Convert from internal ABAP string (UTF-16) to UTF-8 XSTRING
    DATA(lo_conv_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_abap_string ).
    rv_utf8_xstring = lo_conv_out->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_cp1252_to_utf8.
    " Example string with CP1252 specific characters (e.g., Euro sign, smart quotes)
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Ein € Zeichen und „Anführungszeichen“'.

    " First, create a CP1252 XSTRING for testing (simulating external input)
    DATA(lo_conv_cp1252_out) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(

      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv_cp1252_out->write( EXPORTING data = lv_original_string ).
    DATA(lv_cp1252_xstring) = lo_conv_cp1252_out->get_buffer( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_cp1252_to_utf8( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'UTF-8 XSTRING should not be initial' act = lv_utf8_xstring ).

    " Verify by converting the final UTF-8 XSTRING back to string
    DATA(lo_conv_in_utf8) = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(

    lo_conv_in_utf8->write( EXPORTING data = lv_utf8_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_final_string) TYPE string.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Final string should match original' act = lv_final_string exp = lv_original_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine zweistufige Konvertierung: von einer externen, spezifischen Codepage (CP1252) über die interne ABAP-String-Darstellung (UTF-16) zu einer anderen externen Codepage (UTF-8). `cl_abap_conv_in_ce` wird verwendet, um die externen Binärdaten in einen lesbaren ABAP-String zu dekodieren. solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_csv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_csv.
    TYPES tt_sflight_csv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_csv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflight_to_csv_xstring
      IMPORTING it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_csv
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_csv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_table_to_csv_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflight_to_csv_xstring.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_header) TYPE string.

    " Create CSV header
    lv_header = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY'.
    lv_csv_string = lv_header && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    " Append data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflight_data INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_csv_string = lv_csv_string &&
                      |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }|
                      && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Convert CSV string to UTF-8 XSTRING
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create(
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
      endian   = 'BIG'
    ).
    lo_conv->write( EXPORTING data = lv_csv_string ).
    rv_csv_xstring = lo_conv->get_buffer( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carriers.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-table_line
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_multi_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_detail.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_multi_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_keys.
    IF it_flight_keys IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_flight_keys
        WHERE carrid = @it_flight_keys-carrid
          AND connid = @it_flight_keys-connid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einem `INNER JOIN` und verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` für die Zieltabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES tt_carrier_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_names
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_names.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency
        FROM sflight AS s
        INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE s~carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_names FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_names.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_join( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_join=>tt_carrier_id( ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( carrid = 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_names( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrname exp = 'American Airlines' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrname exp = 'Lufthansa' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_join( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_join=>tt_carrier_id( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_names( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit einem `INNER JOIN`. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Technik, um Daten aus mehreren Tabellen effizient zu verknüpfen, basierend auf einer dynamischen Liste von Kriterien. Die Verwendung von Aliasen (`s~` und `c~`) verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei Joins.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, INNER JOIN, Database Query, SCARR

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft, aber nur für diejenigen, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` und `HAVING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_group_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES tt_carrier_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_id
        iv_min_flights TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_group_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_counts.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        GROUP BY carrid
        HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
        INTO TABLE @rt_flight_counts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_group_having=>tt_carrier_id( ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( carrid = 'LH' ) ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie die teuersten 3 Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES tt_carrier_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_id
        iv_top_n    TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_expensive_flights.
    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        ORDER BY price DESCENDING
        UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit=>tt_carrier_id( ( carrid = 'AA' ) ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_expensive_flights( it_carriers = lt_carriers iv_top_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) = 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[1]-price >= lt_flights[2]-price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_order_limit=>tt_carrier_id( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_expensive_flights( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit `ORDER BY` zur Sortierung und `UP TO N ROWS` zur Begrenzung der Ergebnismenge kombiniert. Dies ist ideal, um Top-N-Listen oder die neuesten/ältesten Einträge effizient aus der Datenbank abzurufen.
keywords: FOR ALL ENTRIES, SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, Database Query, Sorting, Limiting

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge nur für Fluggesellschaften aus, deren ID mit 'A' beginnt, aus einer größeren Liste von Fluggesellschaften.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die Treibertabelle für `FOR ALL ENTRIES` vorzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES tt_carrier_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_filtered_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_filtered_carriers.
    DATA(lt_filtered_carriers) = FILTER zcl_dbq_fae_filter=>tt_carrier_id(
      it_all_carriers WHERE carrid CS 'A'
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_filtered_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @lt_filtered_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_carriers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_filter=>tt_carrier_id(
      ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( carrid = 'UA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_filtered_carriers( lt_all_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-carrid CS 'A' ).
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_lh_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_lh_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_lh_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matching_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_filter=>tt_carrier_id(
      ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( carrid = 'UA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_filtered_carriers( lt_all_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FILTER`-Operators, um eine interne Tabelle vor der Verwendung in `FOR ALL ENTRIES` zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um die Treibermenge für die Datenbankabfrage zu reduzieren und somit die Performance zu verbessern, indem weniger unnötige Daten an die Datenbank gesendet werden.

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flüge für eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus und transformieren Sie die Ergebnisse sofort in eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, wobei die Flugnummer als String formatiert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ALL ENTRIES` und verarbeiten Sie die Ergebnisse direkt mit dem `VALUE` Operator und einer `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE scarr-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES tt_carrier_id TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_flight,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simplified_flight.
    TYPES tt_simplified_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simplified_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_simplified_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carrier_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simplified_flights) TYPE tt_simplified_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dbq_fae_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_simplified_flights.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_simplified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                     ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid
                                       connection_id = |{ ls_flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }|
                                     ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_simplified_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_simplified_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_value_for=>tt_carrier_id( ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( carrid = 'LH' ) ).
    DATA(lt_simplified_flights) = lo_cut->get_simplified_flights( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_simplified_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_simplified_flights INTO DATA(ls_simplified_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_simplified_flight-connection_id IS NOT INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( strlen( ls_simplified_flight-connection_id ) > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dbq_fae_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_dbq_fae_value_for=>tt_carrier_id( ).
    DATA(lt_simplified_flights) = lo_cut->get_simplified_flights( lt_carriers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_simplified_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FOR ALL ENTRIES` mit dem `VALUE` Operator und einer `FOR` Schleife zur Nachbearbeitung der Ergebnisse. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation der selektierten Daten, indem die interne Tabelle direkt bei der Zuweisung aufgebaut wird. String Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung der Flugnummer verwendet.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, aber geben Sie den Status des Fluges ('Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Unbekannt') basierend auf einem hypothetischen Verspätungsfeld (das Sie simulieren können) direkt im SELECT-Statement aus. Nutzen Sie hierfür einen CASE-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CASE-Ausdruck direkt in der SELECT-Liste, um eine neue Spalte zu definieren. Simulieren Sie ein Verspätungsfeld mit einem festen Wert oder einer einfachen Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE WHEN fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Pünktlich'
                WHEN fldate = sy-datum THEN 'Unbekannt'
                ELSE 'Verspätet'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_data
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität aller Flüge aus SFLIGHT, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie hierfür den REDUCE-Operator in Kombination mit einer bedingten Logik (z.B. COND).
hint: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen. Verwenden Sie COND innerhalb des REDUCE-Blocks, um nur relevante Werte zu addieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      NEXT sum = sum + COND i( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity THEN ls_flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_cond( ).

    " Assuming some flights in SFLIGHT have seatsmax > 100
    DATA(lv_capacity_gt_100) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_capacity_gt_100 exp = 0 ).

    " Assuming no flights have seatsmax > 10000 (or very few)
    DATA(lv_capacity_gt_10000) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity( 10000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_capacity_gt_10000 exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. Die Integration von COND innerhalb des NEXT-Ausdrucks erlaubt es, bedingte Logik direkt in den Reduktionsprozess einzubetten, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: REDUCE, COND, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. aus SFLIGHT) so, dass nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen übrig bleiben. Nutzen Sie hierfür den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Die WHERE-Klausel kann mehrere Bedingungen enthalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                          ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' has flights with free seats
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_lh_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assuming 'AA' has no flights with 1000 free seats
    DATA(lt_aa_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_free_seats = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_aa_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Er ist Teil der funktionalen Programmieransätze in modernem ABAP und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten. Für jeden Flug soll ein neues Feld 'ServiceLevel' hinzugefügt werden, das 'Premium' ist, wenn die maximale Sitzplatzanzahl über 200 liegt, ansonsten 'Standard'. Nutzen Sie hierfür den FOR-Operator mit einem CASE-Ausdruck.
hint: Der FOR-Operator ermöglicht die Transformation von internen Tabellen. Verwenden Sie CASE innerhalb der VALUE-Konstruktion für die bedingte Zuweisung des neuen Feldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_case_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_transformed,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax    TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             servicelevel TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_flight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_case_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid       = ls_flight-connid
                                        seatsmax     = ls_flight-seatsmax
                                        servicelevel = CASE WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_case_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = lo_cut->transform_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_transformed_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_transformed_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsmax > 200.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-servicelevel exp = 'Premium' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-servicelevel exp = 'Standard' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Operator in Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. Die direkte Integration des CASE-Ausdrucks erlaubt es, bedingte Logik für die Zuweisung neuer Feldwerte direkt im Transformationsschritt anzuwenden, was den Code kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CASE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzanzahl. Nutzen Sie hierfür den GROUP BY-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem REDUCE-Operator und einem CASE-Ausdruck für eine zusätzliche Bedingung.
hint: Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck im FOR-Loop des REDUCE-Operators. Der CASE-Ausdruck kann innerhalb der Aggregation verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_reduce_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seatsmax  TYPE f,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_reduce_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_sum_seats = REDUCE i(
                           INIT s = 0
                           FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                           NEXT s = s + CASE WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0 THEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax ELSE 0 END
                         )
          lv_count_flights = REDUCE i(
                               INIT c = 0
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
                               NEXT c = c + 1
                             )
      IN
      ( lt_result = VALUE #( BASE lt_result
                             ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
                               avg_seatsmax = COND f( WHEN lv_count_flights > 0 THEN lv_sum_seats / lv_count_flights ELSE 0 ) 
                               flight_count = lv_count_flights ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_reduce_case( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_summary-avg_seatsmax >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for a specific carrier if known to exist in SFLIGHT
    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_lh_summary) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_summary-flight_count > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den aktuellen Inhalt eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls aus und geben Sie ihn als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_text_as_r3table` und String-Templates zum Zusammenführen der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_txt_get_textedit_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_text
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_txt_get_textedit_content IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text.
    DATA: lt_text_lines TYPE string_table.

    io_textedit->get_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        only_if_modified = abap_false
      IMPORTING
        table            = lt_text_lines
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    rv_content = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN lt_text_lines
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line>
        ELSE |{ s }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }{ <line> }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnt_file_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_text_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS download_text_file
      IMPORTING
        it_file_content TYPE tt_text_lines
        iv_default_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnt_file_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_text_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string,
          lv_filename TYPE string.

    IF iv_default_name IS INITIAL.
      lv_filename = 'download.txt'.
    ELSE.
      lv_filename = iv_default_name.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_save_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        default_extension = 'txt'
        default_file_name = lv_filename
        file_filter       = '*.txt'
        initial_directory = 'C:\'
      CHANGING
        filename          = lv_filepath
        rc                = DATA(lv_rc)
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS            = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_rc <> 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = it_file_content
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_write_error        = 1
        no_batch                = 2
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
        invalid_type            = 4
        no_authority            = 5
        unknown_error           = 6
        bad_data_format         = 7
        header_not_allowed      = 8
        separator_not_allowed   = 9
        kbytes_too_large        = 10
        others                  = 11
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services.
    ENDIF.

    rv_success = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Suchen-und-Ersetzen-Funktionalität in einem `cl_gui_textedit` Control. Der Text soll vor und nach der Operation ausgelesen werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `find_and_replace` und `get_text_as_r3table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_txt_find_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS replace_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_find_string    TYPE string
        iv_replace_string TYPE string
        iv_all_occurances TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_true
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replacements) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_txt_find_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_textedit = io_textedit.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_text.
    DATA: lv_replacements TYPE i.

    IF mo_textedit IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    mo_textedit->find_and_replace(
      EXPORTING
        find_string     = iv_find_string
        replace_string  = iv_replace_string
        all_occurances  = iv_all_occurances
      IMPORTING
        replacements    = lv_replacements
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS          = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    rv_replacements = lv_replacements.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `set_language_mode` mit `CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT=>LANGUAGE_MODE_ABAP` und `set_readonly_mode`.

CLASS zcl_txt_abap_syntax_editor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS set_abap_code
      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_txt_abap_syntax_editor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.

    mo_textedit->set_language_mode(
      EXPORTING
        language_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>language_mode_abap
    ).

    mo_textedit->set_readonly_mode(
      EXPORTING
        readonly_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>readonly_mode_true
    ).

    mo_textedit->set_toolbar_mode(
      EXPORTING
        toolbar_mode = cl_gui_textedit=>toolbar_mode_full
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_abap_code.
    IF mo_textedit IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.

    mo_textedit->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = it_abap_code
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` und die Methode `find_all`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`. " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
                           pattern = lv_pattern
                           text    = iv_text ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-found TO rt_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( '123' ) ( '45' ) ( '67' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_name) TYPE ty_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_name IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_name.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\w+),\s*(\w+)$`. " Group 1: Last Name, Group 2: First Name
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
                           pattern = lv_pattern
                           text    = iv_full_name ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_matcher->get_submatches( ).
      IF lines( lt_submatches ) >= 2.
        rs_name-last_name = lt_submatches[ 1 ]-found.
        rs_name-first_name = lt_submatches[ 2 ]-found.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format YYYY-MM-DD enthält und extrahieren Sie Jahr, Monat und Tag.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit Gruppen für Jahr, Monat und Tag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_date_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_date_parts,
             year  TYPE string,
             month TYPE string,
             day   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_date_parts.

    METHODS extract_date_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_date_parts) TYPE ty_date_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_date_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_date_parts.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$`. " YYYY-MM-DD
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create(
                           pattern = lv_pattern
                           text    = iv_date_string ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lt_submatches) = lo_matcher->get_submatches( ).
      IF lines( lt_submatches ) >= 3.
        rs_date_parts-year  = lt_submatches[ 1 ]-found.
        rs_date_parts-month = lt_submatches[ 2 ]-found.
        rs_date_parts-day   = lt_submatches[ 3 ]-found.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Flugpreis (PRICE) in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS), die für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) gefiltert wurden. Nutzen Sie hierfür moderne ABAP-Funktionalitäten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `FILTER` für eine funktionale Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flights USING KEY primary
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_price = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-price
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                             NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price < min_price THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE min_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_flight_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_min_fldate_filtered DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_earliest_fldate
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_earliest_date) TYPE sflight-fldate.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_fldate_filtered IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_earliest_fldate.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_flights USING KEY primary
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price >= iv_min_price.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_earliest_date = '00000000'. " Return initial date if no flights found
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_earliest_date = REDUCE #( INIT earliest_date = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-fldate
                                 FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                                 NEXT earliest_date = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-fldate < earliest_date THEN <fs_flight>-fldate ELSE earliest_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie den niedrigsten Flugpreis (PRICE) für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Flugverbindungsnummer (CONNID) haben und deren Flugdatum (FLDATE) nach einem bestimmten Stichtag liegt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Filterung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `LINE_EXISTS` für die Filterung, dann `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_price_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price_complex
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_cutoff_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_price_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price_complex.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( connid = iv_connid AND fldate > iv_cutoff_date )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_min_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( INIT min_price = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-price
                             FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_filtered_flights
                             NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN <fs_flight>-price < min_price THEN <fs_flight>-price ELSE min_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_min_price_complex FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_min_price_complex_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_min_price_complex_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_price_complex.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_min_price_complex_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '50.00' ) " Excluded by date
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250103' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '120.00' ) " Excluded by date
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250110' price = '75.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->get_min_price_complex( iv_connid = '0400' iv_cutoff_date = '20250104' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '75.00' msg = 'Min price for 0400 after 20250104 should be 75.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_min_price_complex_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_min_price_complex_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250105' price = '100.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->get_min_price_complex( iv_connid = '0401' iv_cutoff_date = '20250101' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '0.00' msg = 'Should return 0.00 if no match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_min_price_complex_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_min_price_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_min_price_complex_filter=>tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_min) = lo_cut->get_min_price_complex( iv_connid = '0400' iv_cutoff_date = '20250101' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min exp = '0.00' msg = 'Should return 0.00 for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf komplexen Filterkriterien zu erstellen. Anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den minimalen Preis aus dieser gefilterten Tabelle zu ermitteln. Dies zeigt die Leistungsfähigkeit der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP, um komplexe Datenmanipulationen in einer sehr lesbaren und effizienten Weise auszudrücken.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, REDUCE, MINIMUM, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein `cl_gui_textedit`-Control, das die Möglichkeit bietet, Text aus der Zwischenablage einzufügen und Text in die Zwischenablage zu kopieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `paste_from_clipboard` und `copy_to_clipboard`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_clipboard DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_textedit  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS copy_and_paste_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_to_copy TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_pasted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_clipboard IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD copy_and_paste_text.
    " Set text to be copied
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text = iv_text_to_copy
    ).
    " Select all text (required for copy_to_clipboard)
    mo_textedit->set_selection_pos(
      EXPORTING
        start_column = 1
        start_row    = 1
        end_column   = strlen( iv_text_to_copy )
        end_row      = 1
    ).
    " Copy selected text to clipboard
    mo_textedit->copy_to_clipboard( ).

    " Clear textedit content to simulate pasting into an empty control
    mo_textedit->clear_text( ).

    " Paste from clipboard
    mo_textedit->paste_from_clipboard( ).

    " Get pasted text
    mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream(
      IMPORTING
        text = rv_pasted_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_copy_paste_empty FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_paste.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_clipboard( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lv_original_text) = `Text for clipboard operations.`.

    DATA(lv_pasted_text) = lo_cut->copy_and_paste_text( lv_original_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_pasted_text exp = lv_original_text msg = 'Pasted text should match original text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_copy_paste_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_clipboard( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lv_original_text) = ``.

    DATA(lv_pasted_text) = lo_cut->copy_and_paste_text( lv_original_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_pasted_text exp = lv_original_text msg = 'Pasted text should be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration des `cl_gui_textedit`-Controls mit der System-Zwischenablage. Die Methoden `copy_to_clipboard` und `paste_from_clipboard` ermöglichen es, Textinhalte einfach zwischen dem Control und anderen Anwendungen auszutauschen. Für `copy_to_clipboard` muss der Text zuvor selektiert werden, was hier mit `set_selection_pos` erreicht wird. Der Unit Test simuliert den gesamten Kopiervorgang und überprüft, ob der Text korrekt eingefügt wurde.
keywords: cl_gui_textedit, GUI, Object Orientation, Controls, Clipboard, copy_to_clipboard, paste_from_clipboard

Instructions: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (sflights) und filtere diese basierend auf einem dynamisch erzeugten RANGE für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Nutze `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und `FILTER` mit einem `RANGE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = iv_carrier ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING lr_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found for LH' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_ua) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights should be found for UA' act = lines( lt_filtered_ua ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered_ua INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be UA' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` zur dynamischen Erstellung eines Ranges und `FILTER` zur effizienten Filterung einer internen Tabelle. Dies ist kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` oder `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY` Konstrukte mit Ranges.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflight

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein numerischer Wert in einem dynamisch erstellten RANGE liegt, der mehrere Intervalle und Ausschlüsse enthält, ohne eine explizite Schleife zu verwenden.
hint: Nutze den `IN` Operator mit einem `RANGE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_check_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_value_in_complex_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_check_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_in_complex_range.
    DATA(lr_numbers) = VALUE RANGE OF i(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 100 high = 200 )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 150 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 50 )
    ).

    rv_is_in_range = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IN lr_numbers THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_value_in_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_value_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_check_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '50 should be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 50 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '100 should be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 100 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '101 should be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 101 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '200 should be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 200 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '150 should NOT be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 150 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '99 should NOT be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 99 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '201 should NOT be in range' act = lo_cut->is_value_in_complex_range( 201 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `IN` Operator in Kombination mit einem Range-Tabelle bietet eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Zugehörigkeit eines Wertes zu einem komplexen Auswahlkriterium zu prüfen. `COND` ermöglicht eine kompakte Zuweisung des booleschen Ergebnisses.
keywords: RANGES, IN operator, COND, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Filtere eine Liste von Strings, die mit einem der Präfixe in einem dynamischen RANGE beginnen. Die Präfixe können Wildcards enthalten.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit einem `RANGE` und dem `CP` Operator (Cover Pattern).
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_filter_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_strings_by_prefix
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE tt_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_filter_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings_by_prefix.
    DATA(lr_prefixes) = VALUE RANGE OF string(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'AB*' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'XYZ*' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_strings USING lr_prefixes ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_strings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_filter_strings( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE zcl_range_filter_strings=>tt_strings(
      ( 'ABCDE' )
      ( 'AB123' )
      ( 'XYZ987' )
      ( 'PQRST' )
      ( 'AB' )
      ( 'XYZ' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_strings_by_prefix( lt_input_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 5 filtered strings' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'ABCDE should be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'ABCDE' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'PQRST should NOT be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'PQRST' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` mit einem Range, der den `CP` (Cover Pattern) Operator verwendet, ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Filterung von Strings basierend auf Mustervergleichen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `IF ... CP ...`.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, String, CP, Wildcards

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die einen generischen RANGE als Importparameter (Typ `if_abap_range_table`) akzeptiert und diesen verwendet, um Daten aus einer internen Tabelle zu filtern. Demonstriere die Typumwandlung.
hint: Verwende `CAST` zu `cl_abap_range_table` oder `cl_abap_range_table=>create` für generische Range-Typen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_generic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_data_with_generic_range
      IMPORTING
        ir_range TYPE if_abap_range_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_generic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_data_with_generic_range.
    DATA(lt_all_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 10 text = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 20 text = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 30 text = 'Cherry' )
      ( id = 40 text = 'Date' )
      ( id = 50 text = 'Elderberry' )
    ).

    " Cast the generic range interface to the concrete class for filtering
    DATA(lo_range_table) = CAST cl_abap_range_table( ir_range ).

    " Assuming the range is for the 'id' field
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_all_data WHERE id IN lo_range_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_generic_range_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generic_range_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_generic_filter( ).

    " Create a range for IDs 20 to 40
    DATA(lr_id_range) = VALUE RANGE OF i(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 20 high = 40 )
    ).

    " Pass the range as if_abap_range_table
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_data_with_generic_range( lr_id_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 3 filtered items' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID should be 20' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Last item ID should be 40' act = lt_filtered[ 3 ]-id exp = 40 ).

    " Test with a different range (e.g., ID 10 and 50)
    DATA(lr_id_range_2) = VALUE RANGE OF i(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 10 )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 50 )
    ).
    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_data_with_generic_range( lr_id_range_2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 filtered items' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First item ID should be 10' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit generischen Range-Typen über das Interface `if_abap_range_table` arbeitet. Die Typumwandlung mittels `CAST` zu `cl_abap_range_table` ist notwendig, um den Range direkt im `WHERE` Zusatz des `FILTER` Ausdrucks verwenden zu können. Dies fördert die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code.
keywords: RANGES, Object Orientation, CAST, if_abap_range_table, FILTER

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine Methode bereitstellt, um die Größe eines bestehenden `cl_gui_docking_container` dynamisch anzupassen.
hint: Verwende die Methode `set_size` des `cl_gui_docking_container` Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_docking_container_resizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS resize_docking_container

        io_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container

CLASS zcl_docking_container_resizer IMPLEMENTATION.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_resize_docking_container FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resize_docking_container.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_docking_container_resizer( ).

    " Create a dummy docking container for testing the method call
    DATA(lo_docking_container) = NEW cl_gui_docking_container(
      EXPORTING
        repid     = sy-repid
        dynnr     = '1000'
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Docking container object should be created' act = lo_docking_container ).

    " Attempt to resize it
    TRY.
        lo_cut->resize_docking_container( io_docking_container = lo_docking_container iv_new_size = 500 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Resize method should execute without error' act = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |Exception during resize: { lx_gui->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD lo_docking_container->free
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error = 1

CLASS zcl_docking_container_freer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS free_docking_container
      IMPORTING
        io_docking_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_docking_container
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_docking_container_freer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD free_docking_container.
    IF io_docking_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD io_docking_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception.
      ENDIF.
      FREE OBJECT io_docking_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_docking_container_freer( ).

    DATA(lo_docking_container) = NEW cl_gui_docking_container(
      EXPORTING
        repid     = sy-repid
        dynnr     = '1000'
        side      = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_left
        extension = 100 ).
