Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) basierend auf einem Range für Flugdatum und einem Range für die Fluggesellschaft filtert. Die Filterung soll in einem einzigen Ausdruck erfolgen.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit mehreren `USING` Klauseln für verschiedene Ranges.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_multi_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_multi_range
      IMPORTING
        ir_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid
        ir_fldate_range TYPE RANGE OF sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_multi_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_multi_range.
    DATA: lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_all_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_sflights USING ir_carrid_range USING ir_fldate_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multi_range_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_range_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_multi_filter( ).

    " Create range for carrier 'LH'
    DATA(lr_carrid) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).

    " Create range for flight dates in 2025 (example)
    DATA(lr_fldate) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-fldate(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '20250101' high = '20251231' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_multi_range(
      ir_carrid_range = lr_carrid
      ir_fldate_range = lr_fldate
    ).

    " Assuming there are LH flights in 2025 in sflight table
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should find some LH flights in 2025' act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date should be in 2025' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-fldate IN lr_fldate THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Test with a carrier that has no flights in 2025 (or no flights at all)
    DATA(lr_carrid_no_match) = VALUE RANGE OF sflight-carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'XX' )
    ).
    lt_filtered = lo_cut->filter_flights_multi_range(
      ir_carrid_range = lr_carrid_no_match
      ir_fldate_range = lr_fldate
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should find no flights for carrier XX' act = lines( lt_filtered ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarke Fähigkeit des `FILTER` Ausdrucks, mehrere Ranges gleichzeitig auf eine interne Tabelle anzuwenden. Durch die Angabe von `USING` für jeden Range wird eine UND-Verknüpfung der Filterkriterien erreicht, was zu sehr kompaktem und effizientem Code führt.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Internal Tables, Multiple Filters, sflight

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strings hat und einen Range von Mustern (mit Wildcards) als Eingabe akzeptiert. Die Methode soll alle Strings zurückgeben, die NICHT einem der Muster im Range entsprechen.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` mit einem Range, der `SIGN = 'E'` (Exclude) und `OPTION = 'CP'` (Cover Pattern) verwendet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_exclude_patterns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_strings_exclude_patterns
      IMPORTING
        it_all_strings TYPE tt_strings
        ir_pattern_range TYPE RANGE OF string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_strings) TYPE tt_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_exclude_patterns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_strings_exclude_patterns.
    rt_filtered_strings = FILTER #( it_all_strings WHERE table_line IN ir_pattern_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exclude_patterns FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exclude_patterns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_exclude_patterns( ).
    DATA(lt_input_strings) = VALUE zcl_range_exclude_patterns=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Apple' )
      ( 'Banana' )
      ( 'Cherry' )
      ( 'Date' )
      ( 'Apricot' )
      ( 'Blueberry' )
    ).

    " Create a range to exclude strings starting with 'A' or 'B'
    DATA(lr_exclude_patterns) = VALUE RANGE OF string(
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'CP' low = 'A*' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'CP' low = 'B*' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_strings_exclude_patterns(
      it_all_strings   = lt_input_strings
      ir_pattern_range = lr_exclude_patterns
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Expected 2 filtered strings (Cherry, Date)' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Cherry should be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'Cherry' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Date should be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'Date' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Apple should NOT be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'Apple' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Banana should NOT be in result' act = COND abap_bool( WHEN 'Banana' IN lt_filtered THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von Ranges mit `SIGN = 'E'` (Exclude) und `OPTION = 'CP'` (Cover Pattern) innerhalb eines `FILTER` Ausdrucks. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr deklarative und effiziente Filterung von Daten, indem Elemente ausgeschlossen werden, die bestimmten Mustern entsprechen. Es ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke Alternative zu komplexen `LOOP` und `IF NOT ... CP ...` Konstrukten.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, Exclude, CP, Wildcards, String Processing

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und füllen Sie diese mit den ersten 3 Einträgen der Originaltabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` für die Typbeschreibung und `CREATE DATA` für die Instanziierung. Feldsymbole sind für den Zugriff unerlässlich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        eo_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error
        cx_sy_table_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    " 1. Dynamische Struktur- und Tabellenbeschreibung erhalten
    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
    lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    " 2. Dynamische interne Tabelle erzeugen
    CREATE DATA eo_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <ls_sflight>       TYPE sflight.

    ASSIGN eo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " 3. Daten aus SFLIGHT lesen und dynamisch füllen
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 3 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_data ASSIGNING <ls_sflight>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lo_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lo_new_line->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.
      <ls_dynamic_line> = <ls_sflight>.
      APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_cut           TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_table_creator,
          lo_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).

    lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( EXPORTING iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT' IMPORTING eo_dynamic_table = lo_dynamic_table ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_table> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_table> ) exp = 3 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <ls_line> IS NOT INITIAL ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE c LENGTH 3.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lv_carrid> IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der genaue Typ der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. bei generischen Datenverarbeitungsprogrammen. Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `CREATE DATA` in Verbindung mit Feldsymbolen ist der moderne Weg, dies in ABAP zu erreichen.
keywords: Dynamic, Internal Table, RTTI, Field Symbols, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu und modifizieren Sie dessen Wert, wobei der Feldname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (field_name) OF STRUCTURE (structure) TO <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS modify_field_dynamically
      CHANGING
        cs_data     TYPE ty_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <lv_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <lv_field> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_string_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_int_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_string_field.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_field_modifier,
          ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_modifier=>ty_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_field_modifier( ).
    ls_data-field1 = 'Initial'.
    ls_data-field2 = 10.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD1'
                                                                   iv_new_value  = 'Modified' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field1 exp = 'Modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_int_field.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_field_modifier,
          ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_modifier=>ty_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_field_modifier( ).
    ls_data-field1 = 'Initial'.
    ls_data-field2 = 10.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
                                                                   iv_new_value  = '20' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_field_modifier,
          ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_modifier=>ty_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_field_modifier( ).
    ls_data-field1 = 'Initial'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT'
                                                                   iv_new_value  = 'Value' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_field_modifier,
          ls_data TYPE zcl_dyn_field_modifier=>ty_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_field_modifier( ).
    ls_data-field1 = 'Initial'.
    ls_data-field2 = 10.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_data
                                                         IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'FIELD2'
                                                                   iv_new_value  = 'ABC' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-field2 exp = 10 ). " Value should remain unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Felder einer Struktur mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung. Es ermöglicht die Entwicklung generischer Routinen, die mit beliebigen Datenstrukturen arbeiten können, ohne deren Felder zur Designzeit kennen zu müssen. Die Fehlerbehandlung für Typkonvertierungen ist hierbei wichtig.
keywords: Dynamic, Field Access, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird, und übergeben Sie Parameter dynamisch.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF (object) PARAMETER-TABLE ...` und `cl_abap_container_utilities` für die Parameterübergabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_call
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters  TYPE cl_abap_container_utilities=>parameter_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA: lo_caller TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_method_caller,
          lt_params TYPE cl_abap_container_utilities=>parameter_table,
          lv_result TYPE string.

    lo_caller = NEW zcl_dyn_method_caller( ).

    " Beispiel: Dynamischer Aufruf einer Methode mit Parametern
    APPEND VALUE cl_abap_container_utilities=>parameter(
        name = 'IV_INPUT'
        value = cl_abap_container_utilities=>set_container_value( 'Hello Dynamic World' )
    ) TO lt_params.

    TRY.
        lv_result = lo_caller->execute_dynamic_call(
            iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYN_TARGET_CLASS'
            iv_method_name = 'PROCESS_STRING'
            it_parameters  = lt_params
        ).
        out->write( |Dynamic call result: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        out->write( |Error during dynamic call: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_call.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lt_param_tab TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_param_bind TYPE abap_parmbind,
          lv_value_ref TYPE REF TO data.

    " Dynamische Instanziierung der Zielklasse
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    " Parameter für den dynamischen Aufruf vorbereiten
    LOOP AT it_parameters INTO DATA(ls_param).
      CREATE DATA lv_value_ref LIKE ls_param-value.
      cl_abap_container_utilities=>get_container_value(
          EXPORTING
            container_value = ls_param-value
          IMPORTING
            value           = lv_value_ref
      ).
      ls_param_bind-name = ls_param-name.
      ls_param_bind-kind = cl_abap_parmbind_kind=>importing.
      ls_param_bind-value = lv_value_ref.
      APPEND ls_param_bind TO lt_param_tab.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Dynamischer Methodenaufruf
    CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF lo_object
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_param_tab
      RECEIVING
        result = DATA(lv_method_result).

    " Ergebnis extrahieren
    IF lv_method_result IS BOUND.
      CREATE DATA lv_value_ref LIKE lv_method_result.
      ASSIGN lv_method_result TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result_ref>).
      ASSIGN <fs_result_ref>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_result>).
      rv_result = <fs_result>.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsklasse für den dynamischen Aufruf
CLASS zcl_dyn_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.

ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_CONTAINER_UTILITIES` vereinfacht die Handhabung von Parametern für solche dynamischen Aufrufe, indem Werte in und aus generischen Containern verpackt werden können. Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Anweisung aus, bei der die Liste der zu selektierenden Felder zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Selektieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (field_list) FROM ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dynamic,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_dynamic.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_dynamic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dynamic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_list TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_dynamic
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_fields.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string VALUE `CARRID = 'LH'`.

    " Dynamische SELECT-Anweisung
    SELECT (iv_field_list) FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_result
      WHERE (lv_where_clause).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Dynamic SELECT failed for field list '{ iv_field_list }'.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate IS INITIAL ). " Should be initial as not selected
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_select_all_fields.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_select_fields,

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_select_fields( ).

    TRY.
        lt_result = lo_cut->select_dynamic_fields( 'CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE, PRICE, CURRENCY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate IS NOT INITIAL ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-price IS NOT INITIAL ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).

  METHOD test_invalid_field_list.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_select_fields,

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_select_fields( ).

    TRY.
        lt_result = lo_cut->select_dynamic_fields( 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error, but no exception was raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die dynamische Angabe der Feldliste in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung (`SELECT (field_list) ...`) ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für flexible Datenbankabfragen. Sie ermöglicht es, die zur Laufzeit benötigten Felder zu bestimmen, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code erhöht und die Entwicklung generischer Berichte oder Schnittstellen vereinfacht. Die `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Klausel ist hierbei besonders nützlich, um die dynamisch gelesenen Daten in eine vordefinierte Struktur zu mappen.
keywords: Dynamic, SELECT, Field List, Database, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Instanz einer Klasse, deren Typ zur Laufzeit als String angegeben wird, und rufen Sie eine Methode über eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (lv_class_name)` und einen `CAST` auf eine Schnittstelle.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_dyn_processor.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_processor_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dyn_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_processor_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dyn_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor A: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_processor_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_dyn_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_processor_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_dyn_processor~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processor B: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_processor
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_processor) TYPE REF TO zif_dyn_processor
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_processor.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    ro_processor ?= lo_object.
    IF ro_processor IS NOT BOUND.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Class '{ iv_class_name }' does not implement ZIF_DYN_PROCESSOR.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_create_invalid_processor FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_processor_a.
    DATA: lo_factory TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_factory,
          lo_processor TYPE REF TO zif_dyn_processor,
          lv_result TYPE string.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_dyn_factory( ).

    TRY.
        lo_processor = lo_factory->create_processor( 'ZCL_DYN_PROCESSOR_A' ).
        lv_result = lo_processor->process_data( 'Data for A' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processor A: Data for A' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Unexpected error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_processor_b.
    DATA: lo_factory TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_factory,
          lo_processor TYPE REF TO zif_dyn_processor,
          lv_result TYPE string.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_dyn_factory( ).

    TRY.
        lo_processor = lo_factory->create_processor( 'ZCL_DYN_PROCESSOR_B' ).
        lv_result = lo_processor->process_data( 'Data for B' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processor B: Data for B' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Unexpected error: { lx_error->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_processor.
    DATA: lo_factory TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_factory,
          lo_processor TYPE REF TO zif_dyn_processor.

    lo_factory = NEW zcl_dyn_factory( ).

    TRY.
        lo_processor = lo_factory->create_processor( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ). " A class not implementing the interface
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_create_object_error, but no exception was raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught cx_sy_create_object_error for invalid class/interface.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch Objekte von Klassen erzeugt, deren Namen zur Laufzeit bekannt sind. Durch die Verwendung einer gemeinsamen Schnittstelle (`ZIF_DYN_PROCESSOR`) kann der aufrufende Code polymorph mit den dynamisch erzeugten Objekten interagieren, ohne deren konkreten Typ zur Kompilierzeit kennen zu müssen. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Muster für Factory-Implementierungen und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: Dynamic, Class Creation, Object Orientation, Interface, CAST, Factory Pattern

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `DELETE`-Anweisung auf einer internen Tabelle, um Zeilen basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit definierten Kriterium zu entfernen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DELETE TABLE itab WHERE (lv_where_condition)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_dynamically
      CHANGING
        ct_data           TYPE tt_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_where_condition TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_data ).

    DELETE ct_data WHERE (iv_where_condition).

    rv_deleted_rows = lv_initial_lines - lines( ct_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_delete_by_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_delete_by_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_condition FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_by_id.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_table_deleter,
          lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_table_deleter=>tt_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_table_deleter( ).
    lt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ( id = 2 value = 'B' ) ( id = 3 value = 'C' ) ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                                    IMPORTING iv_where_condition = `ID = 2` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_delete_by_value.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_table_deleter,
          lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_table_deleter=>tt_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_table_deleter( ).
    lt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'Apple' ) ( id = 2 value = 'Banana' ) ( id = 3 value = 'Apple' ) ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                                    IMPORTING iv_where_condition = `VALUE = 'Apple'` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-id exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_table_deleter,
          lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_table_deleter=>tt_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_table_deleter( ).
    lt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ( id = 2 value = 'B' ) ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                                    IMPORTING iv_where_condition = `ID = 99` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_condition.
    DATA: lo_cut TYPE REF TO zcl_dyn_table_deleter,
          lt_data TYPE zcl_dyn_table_deleter=>tt_data.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_dyn_table_deleter( ).
    lt_data = VALUE #( ( id = 1 value = 'A' ) ).

    " An invalid condition will typically lead to a syntax error at runtime
    " or simply not match anything, depending on the exact invalidity.
    " For internal tables, it usually just results in 0 deletions.
    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_dynamically( CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
                                                    IMPORTING iv_where_condition = `NONEXISTENT_FIELD = 'X'` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel ist nicht nur für `SELECT`-Anweisungen, sondern auch für `DELETE`-Anweisungen auf internen Tabellen verfügbar. Dies ermöglicht es, Zeilen basierend auf Kriterien zu entfernen, die erst zur Laufzeit festgelegt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Filter- oder Bereinigungsroutinen, die auf unterschiedliche Daten und Bedingungen angewendet werden müssen. Die moderne Syntax ist kompakt und effizient.
keywords: Dynamic, DELETE, Internal Table, WHERE, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT in einem einfachen Balkendiagramm an. Das Diagramm soll in einem Custom Control auf einem Dynpro angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE` und die Methoden `SET_DATA` und `DRAW`. Aggregieren Sie die Daten vorab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_chart_data.

    " Daten aggregieren
    lt_data = get_sflight_data( ).

    " Chart Engine instanziieren
    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    " Chart-Typ setzen (Balkendiagramm)
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_bar ).

    " Daten für das Diagramm vorbereiten und setzen
    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-category )
    ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-value )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Anzahl Flüge'
            data_values = lt_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    " Titel setzen
    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Anzahl' ).

    " Diagramm zeichnen
    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    " Daten aus SFLIGHT aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_agg).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_agg IN lt_sflight_agg (
      category = ls_agg-carrid,
      value    = ls_agg-num_flights
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_display_chart_calls FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_sflight_bar( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data IS NOT INITIAL ).

Instructions: Visualisieren Sie die Verteilung der Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHT in einem Tortendiagramm. Zeigen Sie die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften und fassen Sie den Rest als 'Andere' zusammen.
hint: Setzen Sie den Diagrammtyp auf `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE=>CHART_TYPE_PIE`. Aggregieren und sortieren Sie die Daten, um die Top N zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data.
    TYPES: tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_pie_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_chart_data.

    lt_data = get_sflight_pie_data( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_pie ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-category )
    ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-value )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Fluggesellschaften'
            data_values = lt_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Verteilung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_legend_position( cl_gui_chart_engine=>legend_pos_right ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_pie_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight_agg TYPE SORTED TABLE OF struct_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHT aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid
      ORDER BY num_flights DESCENDING
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_agg.

    DATA(lv_other_flights) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight_agg INTO DATA(ls_agg).
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      IF lv_count <= 3.
        APPEND VALUE ty_chart_data( category = ls_agg-carrid value = ls_agg-num_flights ) TO rt_data.
      ELSE.
        lv_other_flights = lv_other_flights + ls_agg-num_flights.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_other_flights > 0.
      APPEND VALUE ty_chart_data( category = 'Andere' value = lv_other_flights ) TO rt_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsstruktur für Aggregation
TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_carrid_count,
         carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
         num_flights TYPE i,
       END OF struct_carrid_count.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 0 ).

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_found_other exp = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Stellen Sie simulierte monatliche Umsatzdaten für ein Jahr in einem Liniendiagramm dar. Die Daten sollen eine leichte Aufwärtstendenz mit saisonalen Schwankungen zeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE=>CHART_TYPE_LINE` und generieren Sie die Daten programmatisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_sim_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_sales,
             month TYPE string,
             sales TYPE i,
           END OF ty_monthly_sales.
    TYPES: tt_monthly_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_sales WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_simulated_sales_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_monthly_sales.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sim_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_monthly_sales.

    lt_data = get_simulated_sales_data( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_line ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-month )
    ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-sales )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Umsatz'
            data_values = lt_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Simulierte monatliche Umsatzentwicklung' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Umsatz (EUR)' ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_simulated_sales_data.
    DATA: lv_base_sales TYPE i VALUE 10000,
          lv_month_increase TYPE i VALUE 500,
          lv_seasonal_factor TYPE f.

    DO 12 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_month_num) = sy-index.
      DATA(lv_month_name) = |{ lv_month_num ALPHA = OUT }|.

      " Saisonale Schwankung (z.B. höher im Sommer, niedriger im Winter)
      IF lv_month_num >= 6 AND lv_month_num <= 8.
        lv_seasonal_factor = 1.2.
      ELSEIF lv_month_num >= 1 AND lv_month_num <= 3.
        lv_seasonal_factor = 0.8.
      ELSE.
        lv_seasonal_factor = 1.0.
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lv_current_sales) = lv_base_sales + ( lv_month_num * lv_month_increase ) * lv_seasonal_factor.

      APPEND VALUE ty_monthly_sales( month = lv_month_name sales = lv_current_sales ) TO rt_data.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_stacked IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_occupancy_data.

    lt_data = get_sflight_occupancy_data( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_stacked_bar ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-carrid )
    ).

    DATA(lt_occupied_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-occupied_seats )
    ).
    DATA(lt_free_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(

    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Belegte Sitze'
            data_values = lt_occupied_values
          )
          ( series_name = 'Freie Sitze'
            data_values = lt_free_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Sitzbelegung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Anzahl Sitze' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_legend_position( cl_gui_chart_engine=>legend_pos_right ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_occupancy_data.
    " Daten aus SFLIGHT aggregieren: Belegte und freie Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft
    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_occupied, SUM( seatsmax - seatsocc ) AS total_free
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsmax > 0
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_agg).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_agg IN lt_sflight_agg (
      carrid       = ls_agg-carrid,
      occupied_seats = ls_agg-total_occupied,
      free_seats     = ls_agg-total_free
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_avg_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_chart_data.

    lt_data = get_sflight_avg_traveltime( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_bar ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-category )
    ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-value )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Durchschnittliche Flugdauer (Minuten)'
            data_values = lt_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    " Datenbeschriftungen aktivieren
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_label_visible( abap_true ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_data_label_format( cl_gui_chart_engine=>data_label_format_value ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugdauer pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Dauer (Minuten)' ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_avg_traveltime.
    " Annahme: TRAVELTIME ist in Minuten oder kann entsprechend umgerechnet werden.
    " SFLIGHT hat keine TRAVELTIME, daher simulieren wir diese oder verwenden eine andere Metrik.
    " Für dieses Beispiel verwenden wir eine simulierte TRAVELTIME basierend auf DISTANCE.
    SELECT carrid, AVG( distance ) AS avg_distance, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflight

    ) ).

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_grouped IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_monthly_flights.

    lt_data = get_sflight_monthly_data( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_grouped_bar ).

    " Kategorien (Monate)
    DATA(lt_months) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 12 ( |{ i ALPHA = OUT }| )
    ).

    " Serien (Fluggesellschaften) und deren Werte
    DATA(lt_series_data) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
      FOR ls_carrid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM @lt_data AS data_source ORDER BY carrid )
      LET lv_carrid = ls_carrid-carrid IN
      ( series_name = lv_carrid
        data_values = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
          FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 12
          LET lv_count = COND i( WHEN i = lt_data[ carrid = lv_carrid AND month = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }| ]-count THEN lt_data[ carrid = lv_carrid AND month = |{ i ALPHA = OUT }| ]-count ELSE 0 ) IN
          ( lv_count )
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = lt_series_data
        category_data = lt_months
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Monatliche Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Monat' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_legend_position( cl_gui_chart_engine=>legend_pos_right ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_monthly_data.
    " Daten aus SFLIGHT aggregieren: Anzahl Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft und Monat
    SELECT carrid, SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 ) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid, SUBSTRING( fldate, 5, 2 )
      ORDER BY carrid, month
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_scatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_series_data.

    lt_data = get_sflight_scatter_data( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_scatter ).

    DATA(lt_series_config) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
      FOR ls_series IN lt_data
      ( series_name = ls_series-carrid
        data_values = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
          FOR ls_point IN ls_series-points ( ls_point-y_value )
        )
        category_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
          FOR ls_point IN ls_series-points ( ls_point-x_value )
        )
      )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = lt_series_config
    ).

    " Farben für jede Serie setzen (Beispielhaft)
    DATA(lv_color_index) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_series_config ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_series_config>).
      lv_color_index = lv_color_index + 1.
      lo_chart_engine->set_series_color(
        series_name = <fs_series_config>-series_name
        color       = SWITCH cl_gui_chart_engine=>ty_color(
          lv_color_index
          WHEN 1 THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>color_blue
          WHEN 2 THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>color_red
          WHEN 3 THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>color_green
          WHEN OTHERS THEN cl_gui_chart_engine=>color_black
        )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flugdistanz vs. Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Distanz (km)' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Preis' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_legend_position( cl_gui_chart_engine=>legend_pos_right ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_scatter_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, distance, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    " Daten nach Fluggesellschaft gruppieren und für Streudiagramm aufbereiten
    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
      GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group)
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        points = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group (
          x_value = ls_flight-distance,
          y_value = ls_flight-price
        ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_hist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

             bin_label TYPE string,

    METHODS get_sflight_price_histogram

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_hist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_price_bins.

    lt_data = get_sflight_price_histogram( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_bar ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-bin_label )
    ).
    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-count )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Anzahl Flüge'
            data_values = lt_values
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Verteilung der Flugpreise (Histogramm)' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Preisbereich' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_price_histogram.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_price_bins) = VALUE tt_price_bins(
      ( bin_label = '0-100'   count = 0 )
      ( bin_label = '101-200' count = 0 )
      ( bin_label = '201-300' count = 0 )
      ( bin_label = '301-400' count = 0 )
      ( bin_label = '401-500' count = 0 )
      ( bin_label = '>500'    count = 0 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      CASE cl_abap_math=>trunc( ls_sflight-price / 100 ).
        WHEN 0.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '0-100' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '0-100' ]-count + 1.
        WHEN 1.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '101-200' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '101-200' ]-count + 1.
        WHEN 2.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '201-300' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '201-300' ]-count + 1.
        WHEN 3.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '301-400' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '301-400' ]-count + 1.
        WHEN 4.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '401-500' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '401-500' ]-count + 1.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '>500' ]-count = lt_price_bins[ bin_label = '>500' ]-count + 1.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_data = lt_price_bins.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_trend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy_trend,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_occupancy TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_occupancy_trend.
    TYPES: tt_occupancy_trend TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy_trend WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_occupancy_trend
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_occupancy_trend.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflight_trend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart.
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine,
          lt_data         TYPE tt_occupancy_trend.

    lt_data = get_sflight_occupancy_trend( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_chart_engine
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_line ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_text_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-carrid )
    ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_data ( ls_data-avg_occupancy )
    ).

    " Einfache simulierte Trendlinie (z.B. Durchschnitt aller Auslastungen)
    DATA(lv_overall_avg) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_data
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_entry-avg_occupancy
    ) / lines( lt_data ).

    DATA(lt_trend_values) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_value_table(
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > lines( lt_data ) ( lv_overall_avg )
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_data(
      EXPORTING
        series_data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>tt_series_data(
          ( series_name = 'Durchschnittliche Auslastung'
            data_values = lt_occupancy_values
          )
          ( series_name = 'Gesamtdurchschnitt (Trend)'
            data_values = lt_trend_values
            chart_type  = cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_type_line " Explizit als Linie, falls Haupttyp anders
            line_style  = cl_gui_chart_engine=>line_style_dotted
            marker_type = cl_gui_chart_engine=>marker_type_none
          )
        )
        category_data = lt_categories
    ).

    lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugauslastung pro Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_category title = 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_axis_title( axis_id = cl_gui_chart_engine=>axis_id_value title = 'Auslastung (%)' ).
    lo_chart_engine->set_legend_position( cl_gui_chart_engine=>legend_pos_bottom ).

    lo_chart_engine->draw( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflight_occupancy_trend.
    SELECT carrid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_occupied, SUM( seatsmax ) AS total_max_seats
      FROM sflight
      WHERE seatsmax > 0
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_agg).

    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_agg IN lt_sflight_agg (
      carrid        = ls_agg-carrid,
      avg_occupancy = COND decfloat16( WHEN ls_agg-total_max_seats > 0 THEN ( ls_agg-total_occupied / ls_agg-total_max_seats ) * 100 ELSE 0 )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_occupancy_trend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_sflight_trend( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_sflight_occupancy_trend( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_data IS NOT INITIAL ).

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_entry-carrid IS NOT INITIAL ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equals( act = ls_entry-avg_occupancy exp = 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = ls_entry-avg_occupancy exp = 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Prüfen der Berechnung des Gesamtdurchschnitts (simulierte Trendlinie)
    DATA(lv_overall_avg) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR ls_entry IN lt_data
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_entry-avg_occupancy

CLASS zcl_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+(\.\d+)?`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_text ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <match> IN lt_matches ( <match>-found ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie aus einer Log-Zeile, die ein bestimmtes Format hat (z.B. 'Timestamp: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, Level: INFO, Message: ...'), den Zeitstempel, das Level und die Nachricht in eine Struktur.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit benannten Capture-Groups im Regex-Muster und greifen Sie über `get_group` auf die extrahierten Werte zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             timestamp TYPE string,
             level     TYPE string,
             message   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

    METHODS parse_log_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_line TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry
      RAISING
        cx_sy_regex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_entry.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `Timestamp: (?<timestamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}), Level: (?<level>\w+), Message: (?<message>.*)`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->match( ).
      rs_log_entry-timestamp = lo_matcher->get_group( 'timestamp' ).
      rs_log_entry-level     = lo_matcher->get_group( 'level' ).
      rs_log_entry-message   = lo_matcher->get_group( 'message' ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_regex_error EXPORTING text = 'Log line format mismatch'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine XSTRING von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage. Behandeln Sie dabei mögliche Konvertierungsfehler, indem Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Fehlermeldung zurückgeben, falls die Konvertierung fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` und `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks für `cx_sy_codepage_conversion`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_codepage_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_xstring_robust
      IMPORTING
        ix_source_data TYPE xstring
        iv_source_cp   TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_target_cp   TYPE abap_codepage
      EXPORTING
        ex_target_data TYPE xstring
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_codepage_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_robust.
    DATA lv_temp_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lv_temp_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( source      = ix_source_data
                                                          codepage    = iv_source_cp
                                                          replacement = '#' ).
        ex_target_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source      = lv_temp_string
                                                        codepage    = iv_target_cp
                                                        replacement = '#' ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        ev_error_msg = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_robust_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lx_source) = '4772FCDF6520617573204DFC6E6368656E21'. " 'Grüße aus München!' in ISO-8859-1
    DATA lx_target TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_error_msg TYPE string.
    DATA lv_success TYPE abap_bool.

    lo_converter->convert_xstring_robust(
      EXPORTING
        ix_source_data = lx_source
        iv_source_cp   = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
        iv_target_cp   = '4103' " UTF-16BE
      IMPORTING
        ex_target_data = lx_target
        ev_error_msg   = lv_error_msg
      RECEIVING
        rv_success     = lv_success
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Conversion should be successful' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_error_msg msg = 'No error message expected' ).
    " Expected UTF-16BE for 'Grüße aus München!'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_target exp = '0047007200FC00DF006500200061007500730020004D00FC006E006300680065006E0021' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_robust_codepage_converter( ).
    DATA(lx_source) = 'C3BC'. " UTF-8 'ü' - invalid as single byte in ISO-8859-1
    DATA lx_target TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_error_msg TYPE string.
    DATA lv_success TYPE abap_bool.

    lo_converter->convert_xstring_robust(
      EXPORTING
        ix_source_data = lx_source
        iv_source_cp   = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
        iv_target_cp   = '4103' " UTF-16BE
      IMPORTING
        ex_target_data = lx_target
        ev_error_msg   = lv_error_msg
      RECEIVING
        rv_success     = lv_success
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Conversion should fail' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_error_msg msg = 'Error message expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_target msg = 'Target data should be initial on failure' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die robuste Konvertierung zwischen verschiedenen Codepages unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_codepage`. Durch die Kapselung der Konvertierungslogik in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block können `cx_sy_codepage_conversion`-Ausnahmen abgefangen und benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldungen zurückgegeben werden. Dies ist entscheidend für Anwendungen, die mit heterogenen Datenquellen arbeiten und eine hohe Fehlertoleranz benötigen.

CLASS zcl_json_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_json_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_basic_json_object.
    " This regex checks for a string starting with '{' and ending with '}'
    " and having at least one character in between. It's a basic structural check, not full JSON validation.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^\s*\{.*\}\s*$`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_json_string ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable, wobei jeder String in einer bestimmten Codepage kodiert und durch einen Zeilenumbruch getrennt wird.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle, konvertieren Sie jeden String einzeln mit `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und konkatenieren Sie die XSTRINGs mit dem kodierten Zeilenumbruch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_table_to_xstring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_strings     TYPE string_table
        iv_codepage    TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rx_result) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_table_to_xstring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_xstring.
    DATA(lx_line_break) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf codepage = iv_codepage ).
    DATA(lx_temp_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    LOOP AT it_strings INTO DATA(lv_string).
      DATA(lx_converted_line) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_string codepage = iv_codepage ).
      IF lx_temp_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
        lx_temp_xstring = lx_temp_xstring && lx_line_break.
      ENDIF.
      lx_temp_xstring = lx_temp_xstring && lx_converted_line.
    ENDLOOP.

    rx_result = lx_temp_xstring.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_to_xstring_iso FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_to_xstring_utf8 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_to_xstring_iso.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_string_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Line 1 with special chars: äöü' ) ( 'Line 2' ) ).
    DATA(lx_result) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_strings iv_codepage = '1100' ). " ISO-8859-1

    " Expected: 'Line 1 with special chars: äöü' + CR_LF + 'Line 2'
    " Hex for 'Line 1 with special chars: äöü' in ISO-8859-1: 4C696E6520312077697468207370656369616C2063686172733A20E4F6FC
    " Hex for CR_LF in ISO-8859-1: 0D0A
    " Hex for 'Line 2' in ISO-8859-1: 4C696E652032
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_result exp = '4C696E6520312077697468207370656369616C2063686172733A20E4F6FC0D0A4C696E652032' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_to_xstring_utf8.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_string_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ).
    DATA(lx_result) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_strings iv_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>utf8 ).

    " Expected: 'Hello' + CR_LF + 'World' in UTF-8
    " Hex for 'Hello' in UTF-8: 48656C6C6F
    " Hex for CR_LF in UTF-8: 0D0A
    " Hex for 'World' in UTF-8: 576F726C64
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_result exp = '48656C6C6F0D0A576F726C64' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_string_table_to_xstring( ).
    DATA(lt_strings) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lx_result) = lo_converter->convert_table_to_xstring( it_strings = lt_strings iv_codepage = '1100' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lx_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Konvertierung einer internen Tabelle von Strings in eine einzelne XSTRING-Variable, wobei jeder String und der Zeilenumbruch explizit in einer bestimmten Codepage kodiert werden. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` in einer Schleife und die Konkatenation der XSTRINGs ist die moderne und flexible Methode, um binäre Datenströme für Dateiexporte oder externe Schnittstellen zu erzeugen. `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` stellt dabei einen plattformunabhängigen Zeilenumbruch bereit.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine Zeichenkette ein gültiges IPv4-Adressformat hat (z.B. '192.168.1.1'), indem Sie reguläre Ausdrücke verwenden.
hint: Erstellen Sie ein komplexeres Regex-Muster, das die Struktur einer IPv4-Adresse (vier Oktette, durch Punkte getrennt) validiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_ipv4
      IMPORTING
        iv_ip_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ipv4_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_ipv4.
    " Regex for IPv4: each octet 0-255
    DATA(lv_octet) = `(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)`.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^` && lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet && `\.` && lv_octet && `$`.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = cl_abap_matcher=>create( pattern = lv_pattern text = iv_ip_string ).
    rv_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '0.0.0.0' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '255.255.255.255' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '10.0.0.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '1.2.3.4' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_ipv4.
    DATA(lo_validator) = NEW zcl_ipv4_validator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '256.0.0.0' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1.1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.256' ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_validator->is_valid_ipv4( '192.168.1.1 ' ) ).

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen, und speichern Sie die Flugnummern in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FOR`-Iteration mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_frankfurt_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frankfurt_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(flight) GROUP BY flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                         INTO DATA(group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_count( carrid = group_key-carrid
                                     flight_count = group_key->* ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
      " Assert that at least one carrier has a count > 0
      DATA(lv_found_positive_count) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(entry).
        IF entry-flight_count > 0.
          lv_found_positive_count = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_positive_count ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ist eine leistungsstarke Syntax für die Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation und Verarbeitung von Daten pro Gruppe direkt im Loop, was zu sehr effizientem Code führt. `group_key->*` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: LOOP, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHTS mit einer Liste von möglichen Flugzeugtypen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit allen möglichen Kombinationen.
hint: Nutzen Sie verschachtelte `FOR`-Iterationen mit `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_combinations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aircraft_type,
             type_id TYPE string,
           END OF ty_aircraft_type.
    TYPES: tt_aircraft_types TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aircraft_type WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_aircraft_combo,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             aircraft_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_aircraft_combo.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_aircraft_combos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_aircraft_combo WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_aircraft_combos RETURNING VALUE(rt_combos) TYPE tt_carrier_aircraft_combos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_combinations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_aircraft_combos.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA lt_aircraft_types TYPE tt_aircraft_types.
    APPEND VALUE ty_aircraft_type( type_id = 'A320' ) TO lt_aircraft_types.
    APPEND VALUE ty_aircraft_type( type_id = 'B747' ) TO lt_aircraft_types.
    APPEND VALUE ty_aircraft_type( type_id = 'A380' ) TO lt_aircraft_types.

    rt_combos = VALUE #( FOR carrier IN lt_sflights
                           FOR aircraft IN lt_aircraft_types
                           ( carrid = carrier-carrid,
                             aircraft_type = aircraft-type_id ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_aircraft_combos FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_aircraft_combos.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_combinations( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_aircraft_combos( ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
      " Assuming at least one carrier (e.g., 'AA') and 3 aircraft types
      DATA(lv_expected_min_lines) = 3 * lines( VALUE #( FOR car IN lt_result GROUP BY car-carrid ( car-carrid ) ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_result ) >= lv_expected_min_lines ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen verschachtelten `LOOP`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`) in ein XSTRING und dekomprimieren Sie ihn zurück in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst in einen String (z.B. JSON oder XML) oder verwenden Sie `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce` für binäre Konvertierung. Hier verwenden wir `cl_abap_conv_obj_json` für JSON.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compress_decompress_table
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_decompress_table.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>to_json( it_sflights ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( lv_json_string ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text( lv_compressed_xstring ).
    cl_abap_conv_obj_json=>from_json( EXPORTING iv_json_string = lv_decompressed_string IMPORTING eo_data = rt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compress_decompress_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compress_decompress_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_table( ).
    DATA: lt_original_sflights TYPE zcl_gzip_table=>tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight           TYPE zcl_gzip_table=>ty_sflight.

    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_original_sflights.
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ).
    INSERT ls_sflight INTO TABLE lt_original_sflights.

    DATA(lt_decompressed_sflights) = lo_cut->compress_decompress_table( lt_original_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decompressed_sflights ) exp = lines( lt_original_sflights ) msg = 'Line count should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = lt_original_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_decompressed_sflights[ 2 ]-currency exp = lt_original_sflights[ 2 ]-currency ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt einen gängigen Anwendungsfall: das Komprimieren einer internen Tabelle. Da `CL_ABAP_GZIP` direkt keine Tabellen komprimieren kann, wird die Tabelle zuerst in einen JSON-String serialisiert (`CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_JSON`), dieser String komprimiert und dekomprimiert, und dann der dekomprimierte String zurück in eine Tabelle deserialisiert.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Internal Table, JSON, Serialization, Deserialization, CL_ABAP_GZIP, CL_ABAP_CONV_OBJ_JSON

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie einen sehr langen String und messen Sie die Größenreduktion.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die Länge des Original-Strings mit der Länge des komprimierten XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_size_reduction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_compression_ratio
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_ratio) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_size_reduction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_compression_ratio.
    DATA(lv_original_length) = strlen( iv_input_string ).
    IF lv_original_length = 0.
      rv_ratio = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_length) = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ).
    rv_ratio = ( 1 - ( lv_compressed_length / lv_original_length ) ) * 100.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_compression_ratio FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compression_ratio.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_size_reduction( ).
    DATA(lv_long_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 100
      NEXT s = s && |This is a repeating sentence to make the string long. |
    ).

    DATA(lv_ratio) = lo_cut->get_compression_ratio( lv_long_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lv_ratio ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_than( act = lv_ratio exp = 0.0 msg = 'Compression ratio should be greater than 0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lv_ratio exp = 100.0 msg = 'Compression ratio should be less than or equal to 100' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Effizienz der GZIP-Komprimierung misst, indem man die Länge des Original-Strings mit der Länge des resultierenden XSTRINGs vergleicht. Die Komprimierungsrate wird als Prozentsatz der Größenreduktion berechnet.
keywords: GZIP, Compression, Size Reduction, Performance, CL_ABAP_GZIP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Ergebnis einer Division zweier Zahlen und speichern Sie es in einer Inline-Variable. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Division durch Null ab.

solution:
CLASS zcl_math_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Division by zero is not allowed.'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        )
    ).

CLASS zcl_itab_avg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_avg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    IF it_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Cannot calculate average of an empty table.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN it_data NEXT s = s + <fs>-value ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_data ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
