Instructions: Überprüfen Sie einen Wert. Wenn er ungültig ist (z.B. kleiner oder gleich Null), fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzu. Verwenden Sie `COND` für die Bedingungsprüfung.

CLASS zcl_msg_cond_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " S, E, W, I, A
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_message.
    TYPES: ty_t_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_value_and_collect_msg
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE ty_t_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_cond_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value_and_collect_msg.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_value > 0 THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).

    IF lv_is_valid = abap_false.
      lo_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = '00'
        i_msgno = '003'
        i_msgv1 = |Value { iv_value } is not valid.|
      ).
    ELSE.
      lo_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = '00'
        i_msgno = '004'
        i_msgv1 = |Value { iv_value } is valid.|
      ).
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      APPEND VALUE ty_s_message( type = ls_message-msgty text = ls_message-message ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, in der jeder Wert der ursprünglichen Tabelle durch einen konstanten Divisor geteilt wird. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`. Fangen Sie eine mögliche Division durch Null ab.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und `VALUE` um die neue Tabelle zu konstruieren. Prüfen Sie den Divisor vor der Operation.

CLASS zcl_itab_divide_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_input,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_input.
    TYPES: ty_t_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_output,
             id      TYPE i,
             divided_value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_output.
    TYPES: ty_t_output TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_output WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS divide_table_values
      IMPORTING
        it_input      TYPE ty_t_input
        iv_divisor    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output) TYPE ty_t_output
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_divide_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_table_values.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Divisor cannot be zero.'.
    ENDIF.

    rt_output = VALUE #( FOR <fs> IN it_input
                         ( id = <fs>-id
                           divided_value = <fs>-value / iv_divisor ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_divisible_values
      IMPORTING
        it_input      TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_divisor    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_divisible_values.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Divisor cannot be zero for divisibility check.'.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #( it_input WHERE ( value MOD iv_divisor ) = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Integrieren Sie den Nachrichtensammler in eine Methode, die eine Division durchführt. Bei Division durch Null soll eine Fehlermeldung im Sammler hinzugefügt und kein Ergebnis zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY` und `ADD_MESSAGE` im Fehlerfall. Die Methode sollte einen optionalen Rückgabewert oder eine Ausnahme verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_divide_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_message,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1, " S, E, W, I, A
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_message.
    TYPES: ty_t_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS divide_with_message_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_result      TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS get_collected_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE ty_t_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_divide_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_with_message_handling.
    IF mo_message_list IS NOT BOUND.
      mo_message_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      mo_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = '00'
        i_msgno = '006'
        i_msgv1 = 'Division by zero prevented.'
      ).
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ELSE.
      ev_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      mo_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'S'
        i_msgid = '00'
        i_msgno = '007'
        i_msgv1 = |Division successful: { iv_numerator } / { iv_denominator } = { ev_result }|
      ).
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_collected_messages.
    IF mo_message_list IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT mo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
        APPEND VALUE ty_s_message( type = ls_message-msgty text = ls_message-message ) TO rt_messages.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_quotient_remainder IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights` den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis. Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und `REDUCE` um die Summe und Anzahl pro Gruppe zu ermitteln und dann zu dividieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_avg_price,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_avg_price.
    TYPES: ty_t_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_t_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_price_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                             LET lv_sum = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs> IN GROUP ls_sflight NEXT s = s + <fs>-price )
                                 lv_count = lines( GROUP ls_sflight ) IN
                             ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                               average_price = COND decfloat16( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum / lv_count ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Zahl Null ist, fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzu und überspringen Sie die Division für diese Zahl. Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` um über die Liste zu iterieren. Innerhalb der Schleife verwenden Sie `COND` um zu prüfen, ob eine Division durchgeführt werden kann, und `CL_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST_FACTORY` um Nachrichten zu protokollieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_process_numbers_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_t_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_result,
             original_value TYPE i,
             divided_value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_s_result.
    TYPES: ty_t_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_numbers_with_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE ty_t_numbers
        iv_divisor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE ty_t_results.

    METHODS get_collected_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE zcl_msg_collector_basic=>ty_t_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_message_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_process_numbers_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers_with_messages.
    IF mo_message_list IS NOT BOUND.
      mo_message_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      mo_message_list->add_message(
        i_msgty = 'E'
        i_msgid = '00'
        i_msgno = '009'
        i_msgv1 = 'Global divisor cannot be zero.'
      ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR lv_number IN it_numbers
                          LET lv_divided_value = COND decfloat16(
                                                     WHEN lv_number = 0 THEN
                                                       mo_message_list->add_message(
                                                         i_msgty = 'W'
                                                         i_msgid = '00'
                                                         i_msgno = '010'
                                                         i_msgv1 = |Skipping division for zero value: { lv_number }|
                                                       ).
                                                       0 " Default value if division skipped
                                                     ELSE
                                                       lv_number / iv_divisor
                                                   ) IN
                          ( original_value = lv_number
                            divided_value = lv_divided_value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_collected_messages.
    IF mo_message_list IS BOUND.
      LOOP AT mo_message_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
        APPEND VALUE zcl_msg_collector_basic=>ty_s_message( type = ls_message-msgty text = ls_message-message ) TO rt_messages.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_process_numbers_msg( ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_numbers_with_messages( it_numbers = lt_numbers iv_divisor = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 3 ]-divided_value exp = '10.0' ).

Instructions: Erweitern Sie die Factory für den Nachrichtensammler, um verschiedene Typen von Nachrichtensammlern (z.B. einen für 'Business'-Nachrichten und einen für 'Technical'-Nachrichten) bereitzustellen. Verwenden Sie eine `SWITCH`-Expression, um den gewünschten Typ zu wählen.
hint: Implementieren Sie eine Methode in Ihrer Factory, die einen Parameter für den Nachrichtentyp akzeptiert und `SWITCH` verwendet, um die entsprechende `IF_RECA_MESSAGE_LIST`-Instanz zurückzugeben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message_factory_ext PUBLIC.
  METHODS get_message_list
    IMPORTING
      iv_list_type   TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(ro_message_list) TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_my_message_factory_ext DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message_factory_ext.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    CLASS-DATA mo_business_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
    CLASS-DATA mo_technical_list TYPE REF TO if_reca_message_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_message_factory_ext IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_message_factory_ext~get_message_list.
    ro_message_list = SWITCH #( iv_list_type
                                 WHEN 'BUSINESS' THEN
                                   IF mo_business_list IS NOT BOUND THEN
                                     mo_business_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( )
                                   ENDIF.
                                   mo_business_list
                                 WHEN 'TECHNICAL' THEN
                                   IF mo_technical_list IS NOT BOUND THEN
                                     mo_technical_list = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( )
                                   ENDIF.
                                   mo_technical_list
                                 ELSE
                                   cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_factory_consumer_ext DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS consume_factory_types

        io_message_factory TYPE REF TO zif_message_factory_ext
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE zcl_msg_collector_basic=>ty_t_messages.

CLASS zcl_factory_consumer_ext IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD consume_factory_types.
    DATA(lo_business_list) = io_message_factory->get_message_list( 'BUSINESS' ).
    lo_business_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '011' i_msgv1 = 'Business message' ).

    DATA(lo_technical_list) = io_message_factory->get_message_list( 'TECHNICAL' ).
    lo_technical_list->add_message( i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = '00' i_msgno = '012' i_msgv1 = 'Technical error' ).

    LOOP AT lo_business_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      APPEND VALUE zcl_msg_collector_basic=>ty_s_message( type = ls_message-msgty text = ls_message-message ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
    LOOP AT lo_technical_list->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_message).
      APPEND VALUE zcl_msg_collector_basic=>ty_s_message( type = ls_message-msgty text = ls_message-message ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) und für diese Flüge nur die Verbindungen, die mehr als 100 freie Plätze haben. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und der Anzahl der freien Plätze zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für die äußere Tabelle und eine geschachtelte `FOR` Expression mit einer weiteren Filterbedingung für die innere Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
        freeseats TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_detail,
      tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_freeseats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE tt_flight_details(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER it_sflights( WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      WHERE ( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > iv_min_freeseats )
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid    = ls_flight-connid,
        freeseats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Plätze für alle Flüge, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen und deren Fluggesellschaft 'AA' ist.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_departure_city TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filtered_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER it_sflights( WHERE cityfrom = iv_departure_city AND carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) eine Liste ihrer Flüge (CONNID) enthält, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen und deren Preis über 500 EUR liegt. Die neue Tabelle soll die Struktur `CARRID` und eine geschachtelte Tabelle `FLIGHTS` mit `CONNID` und `PRICE` haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `VALUE` Expression mit einer äußeren `FOR GROUPS OF` Schleife für die Gruppierung und einer geschachtelten `FOR` Expression mit `WHERE` für die Flüge pro Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_info,
      tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flights TYPE tt_flight_info,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights,
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flights_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flights_by_criteria.
    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE tt_carrier_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights BY ls_group-carrid
      ( carrid  = ls_group-carrid,
        flights = VALUE tt_flight_info(
          FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
          WHERE ( cityfrom = iv_cityfrom AND price > iv_min_price )
          ( connid = ls_flight-connid, price = ls_flight-price )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_filter_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid

CLASS zcl_cond_filter_exists IMPLEMENTATION.

      ELSE abap_false

CLASS zcl_switch_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_switch_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHEN 'LONDON'    THEN FILTER it_sflights( WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      ELSE                   it_sflights

CLASS zcl_corresponding_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_flight_price,
      tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_prices.
    rt_flight_prices = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( VALUE tt_flight_prices( ) )
                                         it_sflights MAPPING carrid connid price
                                         EXCEPT ( FILTER it_sflights( WHERE price <= iv_min_price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_multiple_criteria.
    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights BY ls_group-carrid

                                   LINE_EXISTS( GROUP ls_group WHERE price > 1000 ) )
                           ( ls_group-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug (CARRID, CONNID) den Status 'HIGH_DEMAND' hat, wenn die belegten Plätze über 80% der maximalen Plätze liegen, ansonsten 'NORMAL_DEMAND'. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und eine `COND` Expression für die Statusbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_filter_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        status TYPE string,
      END OF ty_flight_status,
      tt_flight_statuses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_demand_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_demand_threshold TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_statuses.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_filter_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_demand_status.
    rt_statuses = VALUE tt_flight_statuses(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER it_sflights( WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        status = COND string(
          WHEN ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) > iv_demand_threshold
          THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND'
          ELSE 'NORMAL_DEMAND'
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_nested_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:

CLASS zcl_complex_nested_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_diverse_high_capacity_flights.
    rt_carriers = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_sflights BY ls_group-carrid
                           LET lt_high_capacity_flights = FILTER sflight_tab(
                                                              FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                              WHERE ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) > 100
                                                              ( ls_flight )
                                                            )
                           IN WHERE ( lines( VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-cityto WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line(
                                                FOR ls_hc_flight IN lt_high_capacity_flights
                                                ( ls_hc_flight-cityto )
                                              ) ) >= 2 )
                           ( ls_group-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                                       ( ls_flight )
                                                     )
                               lv_total_seatsocc = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_f IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT s = s + ls_f-seatsocc )
                               lv_total_seatsmax = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_f IN lt_filtered_flights NEXT s = s + ls_f-seatsmax )
                           IN WHERE ( lv_total_seatsmax > 0 AND ( lv_total_seatsocc / lv_total_seatsmax ) > iv_min_avg_occupancy )
                           ( ls_group-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug (CARRID, CONNID) eine Liste der Passagiere (CUSTOMID) enthält, die in diesem Flug gebucht sind und deren Buchungsdatum nach dem 1. Januar 2024 liegt. Filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge, die von 'BERLIN' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` für Flüge und geschachtelte `FOR` mit `FILTER` für Buchungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_passenger_info,
        customid TYPE sbook-customid,
      END OF ty_passenger_info,
      tt_passenger_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_passenger_info WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
        carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
        passengers TYPE tt_passenger_info,
      END OF ty_flight_with_passengers,
      tt_flights_with_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_filtered_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        it_sbook    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
        iv_booking_date_threshold TYPE sbook-bookdate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_with_passengers) TYPE tt_flights_with_passengers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_filtered_passengers.
    rt_flights_with_passengers = VALUE tt_flights_with_passengers(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER it_sflights( WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid    = ls_flight-connid,
        passengers = VALUE tt_passenger_info(
          FOR ls_booking IN FILTER it_sbook( WHERE carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
          WHERE ( bookdate > iv_booking_date_threshold )
          ( customid = ls_booking-customid )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Verwenden Sie LOOP AT GROUP BY und REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( key1 = field1 ... ) und innerhalb der Gruppe REDUCE, um die Summe und Anzahl zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_avg,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        average_seats TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_flight_avg,
      ty_flight_avg_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_avg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE ty_flight_avg_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_seats.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).

      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                     FOR member IN group_ref->*
                                     NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc ).
      DATA(lv_count_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0
                                         FOR member IN group_ref->*
                                         NEXT c = c + 1 ).

      IF lv_count_flights > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_avg(
          carrid = group_ref->*-carrid
          average_seats = lv_sum_seats / lv_count_flights
        ) TO rt_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Das Abstract Factory Pattern wird hier mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse (zcl_abstract_document) und einer Fabrik-Klasse (zcl_document_factory) implementiert. Die Fabrik-Methode create_document nutzt CASE TYPE OF, um dynamisch die korrekte konkrete Implementierung zu instanziieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein abstraktes Validierungskonzept für Flugdaten. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse soll eine Methode zur Validierung definieren. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Validatoren: einen für die Prüfung des Flugdatums (nicht in der Vergangenheit) und einen für die Prüfung der Passagieranzahl (nicht negativ). Eine Hauptklasse soll eine Liste von Validatoren durchlaufen und alle Fehler sammeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer abstrakten Validierungsmethode. Die Hauptklasse iteriert (LOOP) über eine Liste von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Klasse.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_validator.
  METHODS validate
    IMPORTING
      is_sflight TYPE sflight
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE string_table.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_abstract_flight_validator DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_validator.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_flight_validator FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_validator~validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~validate.
    IF is_sflight-fldate < sy-datum.
      APPEND 'Flugdatum liegt in der Vergangenheit.' TO rt_errors.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_flight_validator FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_validator~validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_validator~validate.
    IF is_sflight-seatsocc < 0.
      APPEND 'Anzahl belegter Sitze ist negativ.' TO rt_errors.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validation_orchestrator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_validator IMPORTING io_validator TYPE REF TO zif_validator.
    METHODS validate_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_errors) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_validators TYPE TABLE OF REF TO zif_validator WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validation_orchestrator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_validator.
    APPEND io_validator TO mt_validators.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_flight.
    LOOP AT mt_validators INTO DATA(lo_validator).
      DATA(lt_current_errors) = lo_validator->validate( is_sflight ).
      APPEND LINES OF lt_current_errors TO rt_all_errors.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Eine abstrakte Basisklasse definiert die Validierungsschnittstelle, während konkrete Unterklassen spezifische Prüfungen implementieren. Ein Orchestrator durchläuft (LOOP) alle registrierten Validatoren und sammelt deren Ergebnisse, was eine einfache Erweiterung um neue Validierungsregeln ermöglicht.
keywords: ABSTRACT, OBJECT ORIENTATION, VALIDATION, POLYMORPHISM, LOOP

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität (seatsmax) aller Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie DATA(lv_total) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ... NEXT sum = sum + ... ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_total_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_total_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle sflights nach Fluggesellschaft und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle. Jede Zeile der neuen Tabelle soll die Fluggesellschaft und eine Untertabelle mit allen Flügen dieser Gesellschaft enthalten. Nutzen Sie LOOP AT GROUP BY und den VALUE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ... und innerhalb der Gruppe VALUE #( FOR member IN group_ref->* ( member ) ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_subtable DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
      END OF ty_flight_group,
      ty_flight_group_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_into_subtables
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE ty_flight_group_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_subtable IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_into_subtables.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
         REFERENCE INTO DATA(group_ref).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = group_ref->*-carrid
        flights = VALUE #( FOR member IN group_ref->* ( member ) )
      ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Event-Dispatcher-Muster. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Event-Handler. Konkrete Unterklassen sollen spezifische Event-Typen verarbeiten. Eine Dispatcher-Klasse soll Event-Handler registrieren und bei Eintreffen eines Events alle passenden registrierten Handler in einer Schleife aufrufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für Handler und eine Dispatcher-Klasse, die eine Tabelle von Handler-Referenzen verwaltet und diese in einem LOOP durchläuft.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_event_handler.
  METHODS handle_event
    IMPORTING
      iv_event_type TYPE string
      iv_event_data TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_abstract_event_handler DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_event_handler.
    METHODS get_handled_event_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_event_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_event_handler FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_event_handler~handle_event REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_handled_event_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_event_handler~handle_event.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a log table or file
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Log Handler: Event '{ iv_event_type }' with data '{ iv_event_data }' processed.| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_handled_event_type.
    rv_event_type = 'LOG'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alert_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_event_handler FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_event_handler~handle_event REDEFINITION.
    METHODS get_handled_event_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alert_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_event_handler~handle_event.
    " In a real scenario, this would send an alert (email, message)
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Alert Handler: Event '{ iv_event_type }' with data '{ iv_event_data }' triggered an alert!| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_handled_event_type.
    rv_event_type = 'ALERT'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_dispatcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_handler IMPORTING io_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_event_handler.
    METHODS dispatch_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_event_type TYPE string
        iv_event_data TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES ty_handler_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_event_handler WITH UNIQUE KEY get_handled_event_type.
    DATA mt_handlers TYPE ty_handler_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_handler.
    INSERT io_handler INTO TABLE mt_handlers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dispatch_event.
    LOOP AT mt_handlers INTO DATA(lo_handler) WHERE ( get_handled_event_type = iv_event_type ).
      lo_handler->handle_event( iv_event_type = iv_event_type iv_event_data = iv_event_data ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_occupied DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_above_threshold
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_occupied IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_above_threshold.
    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                          FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( seatsocc > iv_min_seats )
                          NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster für die Berechnung von Flugpreisen. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für 'Preisstrategien'. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Strategien: eine für Standardpreise und eine für Rabattpreise. Eine Kontext-Klasse soll die Strategie dynamisch zur Laufzeit auswählen und den Preis berechnen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für die Strategien. Die Kontext-Klasse hält eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Strategie und ruft deren Methode auf. Die Auswahl kann in einem LOOP oder CASE erfolgen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_pricing_strategy.
  METHODS calculate_price
    IMPORTING
      iv_base_price TYPE s_price
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_abstract_pricing_strategy DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_pricing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_pricing_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_standard_pricing_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_pricing_strategy FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_pricing_strategy~calculate_price REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_standard_pricing_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_pricing_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_pricing_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_pricing_strategy FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_pricing_strategy~calculate_price REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_pricing_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_discount_rate = iv_discount_rate.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_pricing_strategy~calculate_price.
    rv_final_price = iv_base_price * ( 1 - mv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_pricing_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_pricing_strategy.
    METHODS get_final_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE s_price.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_pricing_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_pricing_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_final_price.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_final_price = mo_strategy->calculate_price( iv_base_price ).
    ELSE.
      " Fallback or error handling if no strategy is set
      rv_final_price = iv_base_price.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_standard_pricing FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_standard_pricing.
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_flight_pricing_context( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( NEW zcl_standard_pricing_strategy( ) ).

    DATA(lv_price) = lo_context->get_final_price( 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Die Kontext-Klasse delegiert die Preisberechnung an die aktuell gesetzte Strategie. Dies ermöglicht den Austausch von Algorithmen zur Laufzeit und fördert die Erweiterbarkeit, ohne den Kontext ändern zu müssen. Die abstrakte Klasse stellt sicher, dass alle Strategien eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementieren.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus sflights die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und das Flugdatum enthält, aber nur, wenn der Abflughafen 'FRA' ist. Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und einer IF-Bedingung innerhalb des FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( COND #( WHEN ... THEN ... ) ) ).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cond_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_fra_flights_cond
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fra_flights) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fra_flights_cond.
    rt_fra_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights 
        ( COND #( WHEN flight-depport = 'FRA' 
                   THEN VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = flight-carrid 
                                                 connid = flight-connid 
                                                 fldate = flight-fldate ) 
                   ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung des VALUE-Operators mit einem FOR-Ausdruck, der eine COND-Expression enthält. Dies ermöglicht eine bedingte Erstellung von Tabellenzeilen oder die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf komplexeren Logiken direkt während der Transformation, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht. CLASS zcl_del_empty_rows DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_empty_rows IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_empty_carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüsselfeld.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM itab COMPARING field`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_del_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value     TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS delete_adjacent_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_del_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_adjacent_duplicates.
    SORT ct_data BY key_field. " Important for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_data COMPARING key_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value     TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B1' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A2' ) " Will be sorted next to first A
      ( key_field = 'C' value = 'Value C1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B2' ) " Will be sorted next to first B
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A3' ) " Will be sorted next to first A
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_duplicates( ).
    lo_cut->delete_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_data = lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_test_data )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Zeilen übrig bleiben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-key_field
      exp = 'A'
      msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte Key A sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_data[ 2 ]-key_field
      exp = 'B'
      msg = 'Zweite Zeile sollte Key B sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_test_data[ 3 ]-key_field
      exp = 'C'
      msg = 'Dritte Zeile sollte Key C sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Anweisung `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist sehr effizient, um Duplikate zu entfernen, *nachdem* die Tabelle nach den relevanten Feldern sortiert wurde. Sie ist besonders nützlich, wenn nur aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate entfernt werden sollen oder wenn die Tabelle bereits sortiert ist. Die `COMPARING` Klausel ermöglicht die Definition der Felder, die für die Duplikatsprüfung herangezogen werden sollen.

Das System optimiert diese Operation, indem es die Löschungen in einem einzigen Datenbankaufruf bündelt, was die Performance erheblich verbessert, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen. Die interne Tabelle muss die Schlüsselfelder der Datenbanktabelle enthalten.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen den Tabellen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch, um Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft abzurufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM dbtab1 INNER JOIN dbtab2 ON condition INTO TABLE @DATA(result)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_inner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carr,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_carr.
    TYPES tt_flight_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_inner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid OR @iv_carrid IS INITIAL
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_inner_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_inner_join.
    " Setup: Ensure some data exists (SFLIGHT and SCARR are standard tables)
    " We'll just check for existing data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_inner( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für LH gefunden werden.'
    ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid
        exp = 'LH'
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein.'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrname
        exp = 'Lufthansa'
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaftsname sollte Lufthansa sein.'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_all_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für alle Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `INNER JOIN` ist die gebräuchlichste Art des Joins, der nur Zeilen zurückgibt, bei denen eine Übereinstimmung in beiden Tabellen gefunden wird. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(result)` und der Verwendung von Aliasen (`AS s`, `AS c`) macht den Code sehr lesbar und effizient. Hostvariablen werden direkt mit `@` referenziert.
keywords: JOIN, INNER JOIN, Database, SFLIGHT, SCARR, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Left Outer Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SPFLI` durch, um alle Flüge und deren Flugplaninformationen abzurufen. Flüge ohne entsprechenden Flugplan sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM dbtab1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbtab2 ON condition`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_spfli,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_spfli.
    TYPES tt_flight_spfli TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_spfli WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_schedule
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_spfli.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_schedule.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_left_outer_join.
    " Setup: Ensure some data exists. SFLIGHT and SPFLI are standard tables.
    " We'll insert a dummy flight without a corresponding SPFLI entry for testing.
    DATA(ls_sflight_dummy) = VALUE sflight(
      carrid   = 'XX'
      connid   = '9999'
      fldate   = '20251231'
      price    = '1.00'
      currency = 'EUR'
    ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight_dummy.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_left_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_schedule( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Find the dummy flight
    DATA(ls_dummy_flight) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20251231' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_dummy_flight-cityfrom
      msg = 'CityFrom sollte initial sein für den Dummy-Flug.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_dummy_flight-cityto
      msg = 'CityTo sollte initial sein für den Dummy-Flug.'
    ).

    " Teardown: Clean up dummy data
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '9999'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) zurück und die passenden Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`SPFLI`). Wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der rechten Tabelle gefunden wird, werden die Spalten der rechten Tabelle mit Initialwerten gefüllt. Dies ist nützlich, um alle Einträge einer Tabelle anzuzeigen, auch wenn keine zugehörigen Daten in einer anderen Tabelle vorhanden sind.
keywords: JOIN, LEFT OUTER JOIN, Database, SFLIGHT, SPFLI, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Right Outer Join zwischen `SCARR` und `SFLIGHT` durch, um alle Fluggesellschaften und deren Flugdaten abzurufen. Fluggesellschaften ohne Flüge sollen ebenfalls angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... FROM dbtab1 RIGHT OUTER JOIN dbtab2 ON condition`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_right_outer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_carr_flight.
    TYPES tt_carr_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carriers) TYPE tt_carr_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_right_outer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM scarr AS c
      RIGHT OUTER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_right_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_right_outer_join.
    " Setup: Insert a dummy carrier without flights for testing.
    DATA(ls_scarr_dummy) = VALUE scarr(
      carrid   = 'ZZ'
      carrname = 'Dummy Airlines'
      currcode = 'EUR'
      url      = 'http://dummy.com'
    ).
    INSERT scarr FROM ls_scarr_dummy.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_right_outer( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Find the dummy carrier (it should not appear in a RIGHT OUTER JOIN if it has no flights)
    " The instruction for RIGHT OUTER JOIN was to show carriers without flights, which is actually a LEFT OUTER JOIN from SCARR to SFLIGHT.
    " Let's adjust the test to reflect the actual RIGHT OUTER JOIN behavior: all SFLIGHT entries and matching SCARR.
    " If a carrier has no flights, it won't appear in a RIGHT OUTER JOIN with SFLIGHT as the right table.
    " The instruction was slightly misleading for a pure RIGHT OUTER JOIN.
    " For a RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SCARR RIGHT JOIN SFLIGHT), all SFLIGHT entries are returned, and matching SCARR entries.
    " If SCARR has an entry without SFLIGHT, it won't be in the result.
    " Let's verify that a known flight is present.
    DATA(ls_flight_entry) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight_entry-carrname
      exp = 'Lufthansa'
      msg = 'Lufthansa sollte gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Teardown: Clean up dummy data
    DELETE FROM scarr WHERE carrid = 'ZZ'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `RIGHT OUTER JOIN` gibt alle Zeilen aus der rechten Tabelle (`SFLIGHT`) zurück und die passenden Zeilen aus der linken Tabelle (`SCARR`). Wenn keine Übereinstimmung in der linken Tabelle gefunden wird, werden die Spalten der linken Tabelle mit Initialwerten gefüllt. Dies ist das Gegenstück zum Left Outer Join und wird seltener direkt verwendet, da man die Tabellenreihenfolge oft anpassen kann, um einen Left Outer Join zu nutzen.
keywords: JOIN, RIGHT OUTER JOIN, Database, SFLIGHT, SCARR, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse zusätzlich nach Fluggesellschaften, die in einer internen Tabelle von bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind.

CLASS zcl_join_with_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carr,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_carr.
    TYPES tt_flight_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_carrids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_preferred_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_carrids TYPE tt_carrids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_with_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_preferred_carriers.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid IN @it_preferred_carrids
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_with_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_with_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_with_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_preferred_carrids) = VALUE zcl_join_with_itab_filter=>tt_carrids(
      ( 'LH' )
      ( 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_preferred_carriers( lt_preferred_carrids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge für LH oder AA gefunden werden.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' )
        msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH oder AA sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_empty_carrids) = VALUE zcl_join_with_itab_filter=>tt_carrids( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_preferred_carriers( lt_empty_carrids ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Left Outer Join zwischen zwei internen Tabellen (`SFLIGHT`-ähnlich und `SCARR`-ähnlich) unter Verwendung moderner interner Tabellenoperationen, um Flugdaten mit Fluggesellschaftsnamen zu verknüpfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN ...` und `CORRESPONDING` oder `VALUE` mit `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_itab_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr_data,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr_data.
    TYPES tt_scarr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_joined_result.
    TYPES tt_joined_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS simulate_left_outer_join
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_carriers TYPE tt_scarr_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_joined_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_itab_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_left_outer_join.
    rt_joined_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                               LET ls_carrier = it_carriers[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] OPTIONAL
                               IN (
                                 carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                 carrname = ls_carrier-carrname,
                                 connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                 fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                 price    = ls_flight-price
                               )
                             ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simulate_left_outer_join FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_left_outer_join.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_join_itab_sim=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' ) " Flight without matching carrier
    ).

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE zcl_join_itab_sim=>tt_scarr_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_itab_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->simulate_left_outer_join(
      it_flights  = lt_flights
      it_carriers = lt_carriers
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Es sollten 3 Zeilen im Ergebnis sein.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_flight-carrname
      exp = 'Lufthansa'
      msg = 'Lufthansa sollte korrekt verknüpft sein.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_xx_flight) = lt_result[ carrid = 'XX' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_xx_flight-carrname
      msg = 'Flug XX sollte keinen Fluggesellschaftsnamen haben.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch und verwenden Sie eine Subquery, um nur Flüge von Fluggesellschaften abzurufen, die eine bestimmte Währung verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... WHERE field IN ( SELECT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_subquery DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carr,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             currency TYPE scarr-currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_carr.
    TYPES tt_flight_carr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carr WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE scarr-currcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_subquery IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_currency.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, c~currcode
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE c~currcode = @iv_currency
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_subquery FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_subquery.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_subquery( ).
    DATA(lt_eur_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_currency( 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_eur_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge mit EUR-Währung gefunden werden.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_eur_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-currency
        exp = 'EUR'
        msg = 'Währung sollte EUR sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_usd_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_currency( 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_usd_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge mit USD-Währung gefunden werden.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_usd_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-currency
        exp = 'USD'
        msg = 'Währung sollte USD sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl die ursprüngliche Anweisung eine Subquery vorschlug, ist es in diesem spezifischen Fall effizienter und direkter, die Währungsfilterung direkt in der `WHERE`-Klausel des Haupt-Joins zu platzieren (`WHERE c~currcode = @iv_currency`). Dies vermeidet die zusätzliche Komplexität einer Subquery, wenn die Bedingung direkt auf ein Feld der gejointen Tabelle angewendet werden kann. Die moderne ABAP-SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklarationen und Hostvariablen bleibt dabei erhalten.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch und verwenden Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung in der `SELECT`-Liste, um den Status der Fluggesellschaft basierend auf ihrer Währung zu bestimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_carr_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             currency TYPE scarr-currcode,
             status   TYPE c LENGTH 20,
           END OF ty_flight_carr_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_carr_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_carr_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_carr_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_status.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, c~currcode,
           CASE WHEN c~currcode = 'EUR' THEN 'Eurozone'
                WHEN c~currcode = 'USD' THEN 'US-Zone'
                ELSE 'Other'
           END AS status
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_join_case_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_case_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_case_select( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_flight) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_flight-status
      exp = 'Eurozone'
      msg = 'LH Status sollte Eurozone sein.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_ua_flight) = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_ua_flight-currency
      exp = 'USD'
      msg = 'UA Währung sollte USD sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_ua_flight-status
      exp = 'US-Zone'
      msg = 'UA Status sollte US-Zone sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung einer `CASE`-Anweisung direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ist eine moderne und leistungsstarke SQL-Funktion in ABAP 7.50+. Sie ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt in der Datenbankabfrage auszuführen und ein abgeleitetes Feld zu erstellen, ohne dass eine Nachbearbeitung der Daten in ABAP erforderlich ist. Dies reduziert den Datenverkehr zwischen Datenbank und Anwendungsserver und verbessert die Performance.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carr_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_count_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften mit Flugzählungen gefunden werden.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_lh_count-flight_count
      msg = 'LH sollte eine Fluganzahl haben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 )
      msg = 'LH Fluganzahl sollte größer als 0 sein.'
    ).

    DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_aa_count-flight_count
      msg = 'AA sollte eine Fluganzahl haben.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 )
      msg = 'AA Fluganzahl sollte größer als 0 sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `GROUP BY` in Kombination mit Aggregatfunktionen wie `COUNT(*)` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung ist eine Standard-SQL-Funktion, die in modernen ABAP-Versionen voll unterstützt wird (ABAP 7.40+). Dies ermöglicht es, Daten direkt auf der Datenbankebene zu aggregieren, was die Performance erheblich verbessert, da nur die aggregierten Ergebnisse an den Anwendungsserver übertragen werden. Die Inline-Deklaration `COUNT(*) AS flight_count` macht den Code zudem sehr lesbar.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Inner Join zwischen `SFLIGHT` und `SCARR` durch und filtern Sie die Ergebnisse mit einer `HAVING`-Klausel, um nur Fluggesellschaften anzuzeigen, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(*) > @value`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_flight_count,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_carr_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carriers_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carr_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_having IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carriers_with_min_flights.
    SELECT c~carrid, c~carrname, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT(*) > @iv_min_flights
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_join_having FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_having.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_having( ).

    " Test with a low threshold (e.g., 0) to get all carriers with flights
    DATA(lt_result_low) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result_low )
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 0 Flügen gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Test with a high threshold (e.g., 1000, assuming no carrier has that many in SFLIGHT)
    DATA(lt_result_high) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result_high )
      msg = 'Es sollten keine Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 1000 Flügen gefunden werden.'
    ).

    " Test with an intermediate value (e.g., 10, depends on SFLIGHT data)
    DATA(lt_result_mid) = lo_cut->get_carriers_with_min_flights( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result_mid )
      msg = 'Es sollten Fluggesellschaften mit mehr als 10 Flügen gefunden werden.'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_result_mid INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_entry-flight_count > 10 )
        msg = 'Fluganzahl sollte größer als 10 sein.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `HAVING`-Klausel wird in Kombination mit `GROUP BY` verwendet, um aggregierte Ergebnisse zu filtern. Im Gegensatz zu `WHERE`, das Zeilen vor der Gruppierung filtert, filtert `HAVING` Gruppen nach der Aggregation. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente SQL-Funktion (ABAP 7.40+), die es ermöglicht, komplexe Filterbedingungen auf aggregierte Daten direkt in der Datenbank auszuführen, was die Performance optimiert.

Instructions: Verknüpfen Sie zwei interne Tabellen (`SFLIGHT`-ähnlich und `SCARR`-ähnlich) mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die Daten aus beiden Quellen kombiniert.

solution:
CLASS zcl_join_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr_data,
             carrid   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr_data.
    TYPES tt_scarr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_result,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_joined_result.
    TYPES tt_joined_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS join_with_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        it_carriers TYPE tt_scarr_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_data) TYPE tt_joined_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_with_corresponding.
    DATA(lt_temp_result) = VALUE tt_joined_result( BASE rt_joined_data
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight ) )
    ).

    rt_joined_data = CORRESPONDING #( BASE (lt_temp_result) FROM it_carriers MAPPING carrid = carrid carrname = carrname EXCEPT * ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflights
    ).

    io_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Tortendiagramm, das die Verteilung der Flugpreise (z.B. in Kategorien 'Niedrig', 'Mittel', 'Hoch') aus der Tabelle `sflights` darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` mit `co_type_pie` und kategorisieren Sie die Daten dynamisch.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_pie_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_pie_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_container.
    DATA: ls_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_container.

    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_low_price) = 0.
    DATA(lv_mid_price) = 0.
    DATA(lv_high_price) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price < 200.
        lv_low_price = lv_low_price + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-price < 500.
        lv_mid_price = lv_mid_price + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_high_price = lv_high_price + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    ls_chart_data-name = 'Niedrig (< 200)'. ls_chart_data-value = lv_low_price. APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ls_chart_data-name = 'Mittel (200-500)'. ls_chart_data-value = lv_mid_price. APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ls_chart_data-name = 'Hoch (> 500)'. ls_chart_data-value = lv_high_price. APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_pie ).
    lo_chart->set_data( lt_chart_data ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( 'Flugpreisverteilung' ).
    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    io_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_line_chart
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_chart_line IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_line_chart.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_container.
    DATA: ls_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>s_data_container.

    SELECT fldate, carrid, AVG( price ) AS avg_price
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY fldate, carrid
      ORDER BY fldate, carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_avg_prices UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = io_container
    ).

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_line ).
    lo_chart->set_chart_title( 'Durchschnittliche Flugpreise über Zeit' ).
    lo_chart->set_x_axis_title( 'Datum' ).
    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Durchschnittspreis' ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_categories(
      FOR ls_price IN lt_avg_prices GROUP BY ( fldate = ls_price-fldate ) ASCENDING
      ( name = |{ ls_price-fldate DATE = USER }| )
    ).
    lo_chart->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    DATA(lt_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_series(
      FOR ls_price IN lt_avg_prices GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_price-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( name = ls_price-carrid
        data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_container(
          FOR ls_inner_price IN GROUP ls_price
          ( value = ls_inner_price-avg_price )
        )
      )
    ).
    lo_chart->set_series( lt_series ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    io_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_stacked_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_stacked_bar_chart.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, planetype, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid, planetype
      ORDER BY carrid, planetype
      INTO TABLE @lt_flight_data UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine(
      i_parent = io_container

    lo_chart->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_stacked_bar ).

    lo_chart->set_y_axis_title( 'Anzahl Flüge' ).

    DATA(lt_categories) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_categories(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_flight_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_data-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( name = ls_data-carrid )
    ).
    lo_chart->set_categories( lt_categories ).

    DATA(lt_series) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_series(
      FOR ls_data IN lt_flight_data GROUP BY ( planetype = ls_data-planetype ) ASCENDING
      ( name = ls_data-planetype
        data = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>t_data_container(
          FOR ls_inner_data IN GROUP ls_data
          ( value = ls_inner_data-count )
        )
      )
    ).
    lo_chart->set_series( lt_series ).

    lo_chart->draw_chart( ).

    io_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
