Instructions: Simulieren Sie den Konsum eines OData-Dienstes für Mitarbeiterdaten (z.B. `ODATA_HCMFAB_REUSE`) und extrahieren Sie die Namen der Mitarbeiter. Da eine echte OData-Verbindung hier nicht möglich ist, wird die Antwort des Dienstes als String simuliert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client` und `cl_abap_json_parser` zur Verarbeitung der simulierten OData-Antwort. Beachten Sie, dass in einem realen Szenario `cl_odata_client_factory` verwendet würde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_odata_employee_consumer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_employee_names RETURNING VALUE(rt_employee_names) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS: gc_simulated_odata_response TYPE string VALUE
      `{"d":{"results":[{"id":"001","name":"Max Mustermann"},{"id":"002","name":"Erika Musterfrau"}]}}`.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_odata_employee_consumer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_employee_names.
    DATA: lv_json_data TYPE string VALUE gc_simulated_odata_response,
          ls_data      TYPE REF TO data,
          lt_employees TYPE tt_employees.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_employee> TYPE ty_employee.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_parser=>parse( EXPORTING json = lv_json_data
                                     RECEIVING r_result = ls_data ).

        ASSIGN ls_data->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_root>).
        ASSIGN <ls_root>-d TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_d>).
        ASSIGN <ls_d>-results TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lt_results>).

        LOOP AT <lt_results> ASSIGNING <ls_employee>.
          APPEND <ls_employee>-name TO rt_employee_names.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_abap_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle JSON parsing error
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Handle other errors
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_employee_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_employee_names.
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW zcl_odata_employee_consumer( ).
    DATA(lt_names) = lo_consumer->get_employee_names( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_names ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 1 ] exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_names[ 2 ] exp = 'Erika Musterfrau' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man eine simulierte OData-Antwort, die Mitarbeiterdaten enthält, mit `cl_abap_json_parser` verarbeitet. Obwohl es sich um eine Simulation handelt, zeigt es die moderne Vorgehensweise zur JSON-Verarbeitung in ABAP. In einem realen Szenario würde man `cl_odata_client_factory` verwenden, um den OData-Dienst direkt aufzurufen, aber die JSON-Parsing-Logik bliebe ähnlich für die Antwortverarbeitung.

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Mitarbeiter aus einer gegebenen Liste von Mitarbeitern aus. Die Liste soll aus drei Namen bestehen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` um einen zufälligen Index zu generieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_employee_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_employee_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_employee_name) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES tt_employee_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_employees,
                 name1 TYPE string VALUE 'Alice',
                 name2 TYPE string VALUE 'Bob',
                 name3 TYPE string VALUE 'Charlie',
               END OF gc_employees.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_employee_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_employee_name.
    DATA(lt_employee_names) = VALUE tt_employee_names( ( gc_employees-name1 )
                                                        ( gc_employees-name2 )
                                                        ( gc_employees-name3 ) ).

    DATA(lv_list_size) = lines( lt_employee_names ).

    IF lv_list_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>get_seed( )
                                                   min  = 1
                                                   max  = lv_list_size ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_employee_name = lt_employee_names[ lv_random_index ].

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_random_employee_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_employee_name.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_random_employee_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_employee) = lo_selector->get_random_employee_name( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Random employee name should not be initial' act = lv_employee ).
    " Due to randomness, we can only assert it's one of the expected values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Employee name should be Alice, Bob or Charlie' cond = ( lv_employee = 'Alice' OR lv_employee = 'Bob' OR lv_employee = 'Charlie' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_random=>get_seed()` sorgt für eine gute Initialisierung des Zufallszahlengenerators. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um Zufallszahlen in ABAP zu erzeugen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Tabelle von Mitarbeiterstrukturen, um nur aktive Mitarbeiter zu erhalten, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur deren Namen enthält. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für interne Tabellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` und `VALUE #( ... )` für Tabellen-Comprehensions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_table_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             active TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_employee,
           tt_employees TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_employee_names
      IMPORTING it_all_employees TYPE tt_employees
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_active_names) TYPE string_table.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_table_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_employee_names.
    rt_active_names = VALUE #( FOR ls_employee IN it_all_employees
                                 WHERE ( active = abap_true )
                                 ( ls_employee-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_active_employee_names FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_active_employee_names.
    DATA: lt_employees TYPE zcl_employee_table_processor=>tt_employees.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = '001' name = 'Max' active = abap_true ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '002' name = 'Anna' active = abap_false ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '003' name = 'Peter' active = abap_true ) TO lt_employees.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_employee_table_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_active_names) = lo_processor->get_active_employee_names( it_all_employees = lt_employees ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_active_names ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_active_names[ 1 ] exp = 'Max' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_active_names[ 2 ] exp = 'Peter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke und kompakte Syntax von Tabellen-Comprehensions (`FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`) in Verbindung mit dem `VALUE`-Operator. Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Zeile, was den Code erheblich verkürzt und die Wartbarkeit verbessert, verglichen mit traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukten.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE, Table Comprehension

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine personalisierte Begrüßungsnachricht für einen Mitarbeiter, die dessen Namen und ID enthält, unter Verwendung von String-Templates.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `|...|`-Syntax für String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_greeter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

unit_test:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten (Carrier ID, Connection ID, Flight Date) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) und ein bestimmtes Datum. Verwenden Sie moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und den `@`-Escape-Charakter für Host-Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_date    TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
        AND fldate = @iv_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_data_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.

    " Insert dummy data for testing if sflights is empty or specific data is needed
    " In a real system, sflights would have data.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 1 ) ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_reader->get_flights_by_carrier_date( iv_carrier = lv_carrier iv_date = lv_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = sy-datum - 1.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Open SQL-Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (`INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`) und dem `@`-Escape-Charakter für Host-Variablen vereinfacht den Datenbankzugriff erheblich. Es entfällt die Notwendigkeit, explizite Datenobjekte vor dem `SELECT`-Statement zu deklarieren, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht. Der `@`-Charakter kennzeichnet Host-Variablen eindeutig und verhindert Syntaxfehler.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Database, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `Employee`-Klasse mit einem Konstruktor, der Mitarbeiter-Eigenschaften (ID, Name) initialisiert. Demonstrieren Sie die Objekterzeugung mit dem `NEW`-Operator und die Initialisierung mit `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `NEW`-Operator zur Objekterzeugung und `VALUE` für die Strukturinitialisierung im Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee_data.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_employee_data TYPE ty_employee_data.

    METHODS get_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_id) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_employee_data TYPE ty_employee_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_employee_data = is_employee_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_id.
    rv_id = ms_employee_data-id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = ms_employee_data-name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_employee_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_employee_creation.
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_employee=>ty_employee_data( id = 'EMP001' name = 'John Doe' ).
    DATA(lo_employee) = NEW zcl_employee( is_employee_data = ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_employee->get_id( ) exp = 'EMP001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_employee->get_name( ) exp = 'John Doe' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `NEW`-Operator ist die moderne Art, Objekte in ABAP zu instanziieren. In Kombination mit dem `VALUE`-Operator für die Initialisierung von Strukturen oder internen Tabellen im Konstruktor ermöglicht dies eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Objekterzeugung und -initialisierung. Dies fördert einen funktionaleren Programmierstil und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.
keywords: Object Orientation, NEW, VALUE, Constructor, Class

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Gehälter einer Liste von Mitarbeitern unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators. Jeder Mitarbeiter hat eine ID, einen Namen und ein Gehalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Gehälter zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salary_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_salary,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             salary TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_employee_salary,
           tt_employee_salaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_salary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_salary
      IMPORTING
        it_employee_salaries TYPE tt_employee_salaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_salary) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salary_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_salary.
    rv_total_salary = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE decfloat16( 0 ) )
                                 FOR ls_employee IN it_employee_salaries
                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_employee-salary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_salary_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_salary_calculation.
    DATA: lt_salaries TYPE zcl_salary_calculator=>tt_employee_salaries.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = '001' name = 'Max' salary = '5000.00' ) TO lt_salaries.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '002' name = 'Anna' salary = '7500.50' ) TO lt_salaries.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '003' name = 'Peter' salary = '3000.00' ) TO lt_salaries.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_salary_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_salary) = lo_calculator->calculate_total_salary( it_employee_salaries = lt_salaries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_salary exp = '15500.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug der funktionalen Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen zu schreiben, kann man mit `REDUCE` den Code kompakter und ausdrucksstärker gestalten, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Functional Programming, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme (`cx_static_check`) für den Fall, dass ein Mitarbeiter nicht gefunden wird, und demonstrieren Sie deren Verwendung in einer Methode.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_employee_not_found DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL
        iv_employee_id TYPE string OPTIONAL.

    DATA mv_employee_id TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_employee_not_found IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_employee_id = iv_employee_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_behv_message~get_message_text.
    rv_message_text = |Mitarbeiter mit ID '{ mv_employee_id }' nicht gefunden.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_employee_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_employee_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_employee_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_employee_by_id.
    " Simulate employee data
    DATA(lt_employees) = VALUE string_table( ( 'EMP001:Max Mustermann' )
                                              ( 'EMP002:Erika Musterfrau' ) ).

    DATA(lv_found_name) = ''.
    LOOP AT lt_employees INTO DATA(lv_entry).
      IF lv_entry CS iv_employee_id.
        SPLIT lv_entry AT ':' INTO DATA(lv_id) DATA(lv_name).
        IF lv_id = iv_employee_id.
          lv_found_name = lv_name.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_found_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_employee_not_found
        EXPORTING
          iv_employee_id = iv_employee_id.
    ENDIF.

    rv_employee_name = lv_found_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_employee_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_employee_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_employee_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_employee_success.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_employee_finder( ).
    DATA(lv_name) = lo_finder->find_employee_by_id( 'EMP001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_name exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_employee_not_found.
    DATA(lo_finder) = NEW zcl_employee_finder( ).
    TRY.
        lo_finder->find_employee_by_id( 'EMP999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception zcx_employee_not_found was not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_employee_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_not_found->mv_employee_id exp = 'EMP999' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_not_found->get_text( ) exp = 'Mitarbeiter mit ID ''EMP999'' nicht gefunden.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Klassenbasierte Ausnahmen, insbesondere solche, die von `cx_static_check` erben, sind der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglichen eine klare Trennung von Geschäftslogik und Fehlerbehandlung, verbessern die Robustheit des Codes und bieten detailliertere Fehlerinformationen. Die Implementierung der Schnittstelle `if_abap_behv_message` erlaubt eine einfache und konsistente Nachrichtenbehandlung.
keywords: Exceptions, Error Handling, cx_static_check, Class-based Exceptions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das aktuelle Alter eines Mitarbeiters basierend auf seinem Geburtsdatum. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Funktionen für Datumsberechnungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie direkte Datumsarithmetik oder `cl_abap_date_helper`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_age) = lv_current_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF lv_current_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( lv_current_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND lv_current_date(4) < iv_birth_date(4) ).
      lv_age = lv_age - 1.
    ENDIF.

    rv_age = lv_age.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_age_before_birthday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_age_after_birthday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_age_on_birthday FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_age_before_birthday.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_employee_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20251204
    DATA(lv_birth_date) = '19901205'. " Birthday tomorrow
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_calculator->calculate_age( lv_birth_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 34 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_age_after_birthday.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_employee_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20251204
    DATA(lv_birth_date) = '19901203'. " Birthday yesterday
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_calculator->calculate_age( lv_birth_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_age_on_birthday.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_employee_age_calculator( ).
    " Assume current date is 20251204
    DATA(lv_birth_date) = '19901204'. " Birthday today
    DATA(lv_age) = lo_calculator->calculate_age( lv_birth_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_age exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Alters kann in ABAP effizient durch direkte Datumsarithmetik und String-Operationen auf dem Datumstyp erfolgen. Obwohl es auch Klassen wie `cl_abap_date_helper` gibt, ist für diese spezifische Altersberechnung die direkte Methode oft ausreichend und performant. Die Verwendung von `sy-datum` für das aktuelle Datum ist Standard.
keywords: Date, Time, Age Calculation, Datumsarithmetik

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode auf einem Mitarbeiterobjekt auf, dessen Name als String übergeben wird. Das Mitarbeiterobjekt soll eine Methode `get_name` haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_employee)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_employee_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_employee    TYPE REF TO zcl_employee_dynamic
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_employee_method_dynamically.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_employee RECEIVING rv_name = lv_result.
        rv_result = lv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_method_call_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_success.
    DATA(lo_employee) = NEW zcl_employee_dynamic( 'Alice' ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_employee_method_dynamically( io_employee = lo_employee iv_method_name = 'GET_NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Alice' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call_failure.
    DATA(lo_employee) = NEW zcl_employee_dynamic( 'Bob' ).
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_caller->call_employee_method_dynamically( io_employee = lo_employee iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error:' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mittels `CALL METHOD (method_name) OF object` ist ein mächtiges Feature für Szenarien, in denen der Methodenname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies wird oft in Frameworks oder bei der Implementierung von generischen Funktionen verwendet. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler bei ungültigen Methodenaufrufen abzufangen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, Reflection, Object Orientation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Mitarbeiter-Einträgen nach ihrer Abteilung und zählen Sie die Mitarbeiter pro Abteilung. Verwenden Sie die moderne `GROUP BY`-Syntax für interne Tabellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `COUNT(*)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data,
             id        TYPE string,
             name      TYPE string,
             department TYPE string,
           END OF ty_employee_data,
           tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_department_count,
             department TYPE string,
             count      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_department_count,
           tt_department_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_department_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_employees_by_department
      IMPORTING
        it_employees TYPE tt_employee_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_department_counts) TYPE tt_department_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_employees_by_department.
    LOOP AT it_employees INTO DATA(ls_employee) GROUP BY ls_employee-department.
      APPEND VALUE #( department = ls_employee-department
                      count      = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_department_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_employees FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_employees.
    DATA: lt_employees TYPE zcl_employee_grouper=>tt_employee_data.

    APPEND VALUE #( id = '001' name = 'Max' department = 'HR' ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '002' name = 'Anna' department = 'IT' ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '003' name = 'Peter' department = 'HR' ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '004' name = 'Lena' department = 'IT' ) TO lt_employees.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '005' name = 'Tom' department = 'Sales' ) TO lt_employees.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_employee_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_grouper->group_employees_by_department( it_employees = lt_employees ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_hr_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS department = 'HR' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_hr_count-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_it_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS department = 'IT' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_it_count-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_sales_count) = lt_counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS department = 'Sales' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sales_count-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`-Syntax ist eine der wichtigsten Neuerungen im Umgang mit internen Tabellen in modernen ABAP-Versionen. Sie ermöglicht das Gruppieren von Tabellenzeilen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien und den Zugriff auf aggregierte Informationen wie `GROUP SIZE` (Anzahl der Elemente in der Gruppe) oder `GROUP INDEX`. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationsaufgaben erheblich und macht den Code viel lesbarer als frühere Ansätze mit `COLLECT` oder manuellen Schleifen und Hilfstabellen.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, Aggregation, LOOP AT, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines Feldes in einer Mitarbeiterstruktur zur Laufzeit und geben Sie dessen Datentyp-Name zurück. Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_ddic_type_by_name` und `cl_abap_typedescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_employee_rtti_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_info,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             age  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_employee_info.

    METHODS get_field_type_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_type_name) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_employee_rtti_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_type_name.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_datadescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'ZCL_EMPLOYEE_RTTI_ANALYZER=>TY_EMPLOYEE_INFO' ).
        lo_data_descr = lo_struct_descr->get_component_type( iv_field_name ).
        rv_type_name = lo_data_descr->get_type_name( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error INTO DATA(lx_descr_ref_error).
        rv_type_name = |Error: { lx_descr_ref_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_struct_descr_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_struct_descr_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_field_type_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_field_type_name FOR TESTING.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, Typinformationen zur Laufzeit dynamisch abzufragen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen oder Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Klassen `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` bieten Methoden, um Typbeschreibungen zu erhalten und Komponenten von Strukturen zu analysieren. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Anwendungen.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, Type Information, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. JSONPlaceholder) durch und geben Sie den empfangenen JSON-String zurück. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die URI-Konstruktion.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine ungültige URL durch und fangen Sie die erwartete Ausnahme `cx_http_dest_state_error` ab. Die Methode soll einen booleschen Wert zurückgeben, der anzeigt, ob die Ausnahme erfolgreich abgefangen wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `cx_http_dest_state_error` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_url.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( iv_invalid_url ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( cl_http_client=>co_request_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).
        rv_exception_caught = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error.
        rv_exception_caught = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_http_client_error.
        rv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_caught) = lo_cut->test_invalid_url( 'http://this.url.does.not.exist.com' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_caught exp = abap_true ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei HTTP-Requests. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach `carrid` und `connid` und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_seats_occupied TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN group_key
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid = group_key-carrid
        connid = group_key-connid
        total_seats_occupied = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_grouped_seats( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_summary ) >= 0 ).

    " Basic check: total seats should be non-negative
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_summary-total_seats_occupied >= 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " More specific test would require inserting known test data into sflights
    " Example: Check if a specific carrid/connid has an expected sum.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Innerhalb der Gruppe wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um Aggregationen durchzuführen. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und ausdrucksstarke Methode zur Datenverarbeitung, die komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationslogik vereinfacht.

CLASS zcl_split_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS count_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_split_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words.
    rv_word_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                              FOR <word> IN ( SPLIT iv_sentence AT ' ' )
                              WHERE ( <word> IS NOT INITIAL )
                              NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_filter_lines IMPLEMENTATION.

TYPES ty_integer_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_split_map_int IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_split_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string

        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_split_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_multiple_delimiters.
    " Split by comma, semicolon, or one or more spaces
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT REGEX '[,; ]+' INTO TABLE rt_parts.
    " Remove empty entries that might result from multiple delimiters or leading/trailing delimiters
    rt_parts = FILTER string_table( rt_parts USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( table_line IS NOT INITIAL ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Sie erhalten einen String mit Wörtern, die durch Leerzeichen getrennt sind. Bilden Sie einen neuen String, in dem jedes Wort in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt und dann durch einen Bindestrich verbunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` und `REDUCE` mit `TO UPPER` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_and_concatenate
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_concatenate.
    rv_output_string = REDUCE string( INIT result = ''
                                      FOR <word> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT ' ' )
                                      WHERE ( <word> IS NOT INITIAL )
                                      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN to_upper( <word> )
                                                                 ELSE |{ result }-{ to_upper( <word> ) }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die alle Fluggesellschaften enthält, deren Name mit 'LH' beginnt oder 'UA' ist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.

CLASS zcl_range_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    METHODS get_airline_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_range.
    DATA(lt_sflight_carrids) = SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrids_raw).

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_carrids_raw
                                 WHERE ( carrid CP 'LH*' OR carrid = 'UA' )
                                 ( sign   = 'I'
                                   option = 'EQ'
                                   low    = ls_carrid-carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Flügen, deren Flugnummer (FLDATE) in einem vorgegebenen Datumsbereich liegt. Nutzen Sie eine Range-Tabelle und die `FILTER` Expression.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currkey,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        it_date_range   TYPE RANGE OF s_date
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate IN it_date_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_filter_sflight=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250115' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250201' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA lt_date_range TYPE RANGE OF s_date.
    APPEND VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '20250101' high = '20250131' ) TO lt_date_range.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_date( it_flights = lt_flights it_date_range = lt_date_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Two flights expected' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight date' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second flight date' act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20250115' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Nutzen Sie die `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_airline
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_airline.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_agg) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_lh_price) = lo_agg->get_total_price_for_airline( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_ua_price) = lo_agg->get_total_price_for_airline( 'UA' ).

    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT für LH und UA
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'LH total price should not be initial' act = lv_lh_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'UA total price should not be initial' act = lv_ua_price ).

    " Für einen präzisen Test müsste man die SFLIGHT-Daten mocken oder genau wissen
    " Hier nur ein Beispiel, dass der Wert nicht 0 ist, wenn Daten existieren.
    " Wenn SFLIGHT leer ist, würden diese Asserts fehlschlagen.
    IF lv_lh_price > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'LH total price should be positive' act = xsdbool( lv_lh_price > 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Expression zusammenzufassen, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht. Der Unit Test prüft, ob ein nicht-initialer Wert zurückgegeben wird, was auf eine erfolgreiche Aggregation hindeutet.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, SELECT, ASSERT

Instructions: Greifen Sie auf einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle mittels Table Expression zu. Wenn der Eintrag nicht existiert, soll ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` mit einer Table Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( ... itab[ key = value ] OPTIONAL )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS get_text_by_id
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
        iv_id   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_id.
    rv_text = VALUE #( it_data[ id = iv_id ]-text OPTIONAL DEFAULT 'ID nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_access.
    DATA(lo_accessor) = NEW zcl_table_accessor( ).
    DATA lt_data TYPE zcl_table_accessor=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag A' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag B' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(lv_text_found) = lo_accessor->get_text_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Text for ID 1' act = lv_text_found exp = 'Eintrag A' ).

    DATA(lv_text_not_found) = lo_accessor->get_text_by_id( it_data = lt_data iv_id = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Text for non-existent ID' act = lv_text_not_found exp = 'ID nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Table Expressions (`itab[ key = value ]`) bieten einen direkten und modernen Zugriff auf Einträge in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `VALUE #( ... OPTIONAL DEFAULT ... )` kann man elegant einen Standardwert definieren, falls der gesuchte Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, ohne explizite `IF` oder `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: Table Expressions, Internal Tables, VALUE, OPTIONAL, DEFAULT, ASSERT

Instructions: Kopieren Sie korrespondierende Felder von einer Struktur in eine andere, wobei Sie nur bestimmte Felder einschließen oder ausschließen. Nutzen Sie die `CORRESPONDING` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... EXCEPT ... )` oder `MAPPING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             field4 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field_x TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source MAPPING field3 = field_x EXCEPT field4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mapping.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).
    DATA ls_source TYPE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_source.
    ls_source-field1 = 'Value 1'.
    ls_source-field2 = 123.
    ls_source-field3 = 'Value 3'.
    ls_source-field4 = sy-datum.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( is_source = ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field1 mapped' act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field2 mapped' act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field_x mapped from Field3' act = ls_target-field_x exp = 'Value 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field4 should not be mapped' act = ls_target-field4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Expression ist eine moderne und flexible Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING`. Sie erlaubt nicht nur das Kopieren gleichnamiger Felder, sondern auch das explizite Mapping von Feldern mit unterschiedlichen Namen (`MAPPING`) und das Ausschließen bestimmter Felder (`EXCEPT`). Dies macht den Code für Datenzuweisungen sehr präzise und wartungsfreundlich.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Handling, MAPPING, EXCEPT, ASSERT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) basierend auf einer dynamischen Bedingung, die zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie `COND` und `VALUE` Expressions.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... COND ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_carrid,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_carrid.
    TYPES tt_sflight_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE string " e.g., 'STARTS_WITH_L', 'EQUALS_UA'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_carrid_range.
    DATA(lt_all_carrids) = SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrids_raw).

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_all_carrids
                                 ( COND #( WHEN iv_condition = 'STARTS_WITH_L' AND ls_carrid-carrid CP 'L*' THEN
                                             VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'L*' )
                                           WHEN iv_condition = 'EQUALS_UA' AND ls_carrid-carrid = 'UA' THEN
                                             VALUE #( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' )
                                           ELSE THROW cx_abap_invalid_value( textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>cx_abap_invalid_value ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_l FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_ua FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_condition FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_range_l.
    DATA(lo_drange) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_drange->get_dynamic_carrid_range( 'STARTS_WITH_L' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should be in range' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'LH' ] ) ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'UA should not be in range' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'UA' ] ) ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_range_ua.
    DATA(lo_drange) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_drange->get_dynamic_carrid_range( 'EQUALS_UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_range ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'UA should be in range' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'UA' ] ) ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH should not be in range' act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_range[ low = 'LH' ] ) ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_condition.
    DATA(lo_drange) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance( NEW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) )
                                         exp = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance( NEW cx_abap_invalid_value( ) )
                                         msg = 'Invalid condition should raise exception' ).
    lo_drange->get_dynamic_carrid_range( 'UNKNOWN_CONDITION' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `VALUE` und `COND` Expressions, um eine Range-Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einer zur Laufzeit übergebenen Bedingung zu erstellen. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb der `VALUE` Expression ermöglicht es, verschiedene Range-Einträge je nach Bedingung zu generieren. Dies ist sehr flexibel für dynamische Filteranforderungen. Der Unit Test prüft verschiedene Bedingungen und auch den Fehlerfall.
keywords: RANGES, VALUE, COND, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, SELECT, ASSERT, Exceptions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Liste von Strings zurückgibt. Schreiben Sie einen Unit Test, der mit `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_diff` die Unterschiede zwischen zwei internen Tabellen (erwartet vs. tatsächlich) anzeigt.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_gen) = NEW zcl_list_generator( ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_gen->get_string_list( 3 ).

    APPEND 'Item 1' TO lt_expected.
    APPEND 'Item 2' TO lt_expected.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die alle Fluggesellschaften enthält, deren Name nicht 'AA' und nicht 'DL' ist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... WHERE ... )` mit einer Negationsbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_neg_range_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_non_excluded_airline_range
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_neg_range_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_non_excluded_airline_range.
    DATA(lt_sflight_carrids) = SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_carrids_raw).

    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_carrid IN lt_carrids_raw

Instructions: Erstelle eine ALV-Tabelle, die die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus `sflights` anzeigt. Nutze moderne ABAP-Features für die Aggregation.
hint: Nutze `GROUP BY` in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung oder `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `cl_salv_aggregations`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_aggregated_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_aggregated_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA lt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg.

    " Modern ABAP aggregation using REDUCE
    lt_aggregated_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE ty_sflight_agg_tt( )
                                   FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                   LET total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                               NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) IN
                                   NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_price = total_price ) ) ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>screen0
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_aggregated_data
        ).

        DATA(lo_aggregations) = lo_salv_table->get_aggregations( ).
        lo_aggregations->add_aggregation( columnname = 'TOTAL_PRICE' aggregation = if_salv_c_aggregation=>sum ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_agg.
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = 100. <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-price = 200. <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-price = 150. <fs_sflight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA lt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg.

    lt_aggregated_data = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE ty_sflight_agg_tt( )
                                   FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                   LET total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.0
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                               NEXT sum = sum + member-price ) IN
                                   NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid total_price = total_price ) ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_aggregated_data ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Should have 2 aggregated entries'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_data WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_agg-total_price,
      exp = 300,
      msg = 'LH total price should be 300'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_aggregated_data WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_agg-total_price,
      exp = 150,
      msg = 'AA total price should be 150'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `REDUCE`-Anweisung in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` für die Aggregation von Daten direkt in ABAP. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu gruppieren und zu summieren, ohne auf temporäre Tabellen oder Schleifen mit `AT END OF` zurückgreifen zu müssen. Die `cl_salv_aggregations`-Klasse wird verwendet, um die Aggregationseinstellungen für die ALV-Spalte zu definieren.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_table, REDUCE, GROUP BY, aggregation, sflights

CLASS zcl_abapedit_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_and_get_text.
    DATA: lo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit,
          lt_text   TYPE cl_gui_abapedit=>t_text_stream.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0.

    APPEND iv_text TO lt_text.
    lo_editor->set_text_as_stream( lt_text ).

    CLEAR lt_text.
    lo_editor->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lt_text ).
    READ TABLE lt_text INDEX 1 INTO rv_read_text.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen festen Wert von einer numerischen Variablen und demonstrieren Sie dabei den `SUBTRACT`-Befehl im Vergleich zu modernen Zuweisungsoperatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SUBTRACT`-Befehl und vergleichen Sie ihn mit `-=` oder `=` mit dem `-`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtraction_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_subtraction IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i
                                RETURNING VALUE(rs_results) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtraction_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_subtraction.
    DATA: lv_value_old TYPE i VALUE 100,
          lv_value_modern1 TYPE i VALUE 100,
          lv_value_modern2 TYPE i VALUE 100,
          lv_subtrahend TYPE i VALUE 25.

    " Old-style SUBTRACT command
    SUBTRACT lv_subtrahend FROM lv_value_old.

    " Modern assignment operator -=
    lv_value_modern1 -= lv_subtrahend.

    " Modern assignment with explicit subtraction
    lv_value_modern2 = lv_value_modern2 - lv_subtrahend.

    " Return results in a structure for comparison
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_subtraction_results,
             old_style    TYPE i,
             modern_minus TYPE i,
             modern_eq    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_subtraction_results.
    DATA(ls_results) = VALUE ty_subtraction_results(
      old_style    = lv_value_old
      modern_minus = lv_value_modern1
      modern_eq    = lv_value_modern2
    ).
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_results INTO rs_results.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_subtraction_methods FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_subtraction_methods.
    DATA(lo_demo) = NEW zcl_subtraction_demo( ).
    DATA(lr_results) = lo_demo->perform_subtraction( 100 ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_subtraction_results,
             old_style    TYPE i,
             modern_minus TYPE i,
             modern_eq    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_subtraction_results.
    DATA(ls_actual_results) = CAST ty_subtraction_results( lr_results->* ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_results-old_style    exp = 75 msg = 'Old style subtraction failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_results-modern_minus exp = 75 msg = 'Modern -= subtraction failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual_results-modern_eq    exp = 75 msg = 'Modern = subtraction failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SUBTRACT`-Befehl ist eine ältere Syntax. In modernem ABAP werden Zuweisungsoperatoren wie `-=` oder die direkte Subtraktion in einer Zuweisung (`= ... - ...`) bevorzugt, da sie prägnanter und besser lesbar sind und dem funktionalen Programmierstil entsprechen. Dieses Beispiel zeigt alle drei Varianten.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Arithmetic, Operators, Modern ABAP, Assignment

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die kumulative Differenz einer numerischen Spalte in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer initialen Summe und subtrahieren Sie in jedem Schritt den Wert der aktuellen Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_cumulative_difference
      IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_difference) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_cumulative_difference.
    rv_difference = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 0
      FOR  item IN it_items
      NEXT result = result - item-value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_cumulative_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cumulative_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtraction( ).
    DATA(lt_test_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_subtraction=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 )
      ( id = 2 value = 5 )
      ( id = 3 value = 2 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_cumulative_difference( lt_test_items ).

    " Expected: 0 - 10 - 5 - 2 = -17
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -17 msg = 'Cumulative difference incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_reduce_subtraction=>tt_items( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_calculator->calculate_cumulative_difference( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_result exp = 0 msg = 'Empty table result incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` ist ein leistungsstarker funktionaler Operator in ABAP 7.40+, der es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine kumulative Subtraktion durchzuführen, was eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Alternative zu einer expliziten Schleife darstellt. Die Subtraktion `result = result - item-value` ist hier die moderne Schreibweise.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Subtraction, ABAP 7.40

solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_from_field_symbol
      IMPORTING CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                iv_field_name TYPE string
                iv_subtrahend TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_field_symbol.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Using -= for modern subtraction, but SUBTRACT <subtrahend> FROM <fs_value> would also work
        <fs_value> -= iv_subtrahend.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

Innerhalb der Schleife wird das Feld `PRICE` dynamisch zugewiesen und dann der Wert mittels des modernen `-=` Operators subtrahiert. Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen festen Betrag von der `PRICE`-Spalte aller Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle und geben Sie die modifizierten Daten zurück. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` mit `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und dem `-`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit den subtrahierten Werten zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_price_subtraction DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_from_sflight_prices
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
                iv_subtrahend TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_price_subtraction IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_from_sflight_prices.
    rt_modified_sflights = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( ls_sflight WITH price = ls_sflight-price - iv_subtrahend )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_price_subtraction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_price_subtraction.
    DATA(lo_modifier) = NEW zcl_sflight_price_subtraction( ).
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_price_subtraction=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_modifier->subtract_from_sflight_prices(
      it_sflights = lt_initial_flights
      iv_subtrahend = '25.00'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '75.00' msg = 'Price of first flight incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_modified_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '175.00' msg = 'Price of second flight incorrect' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_modified_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Number of flights changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` (ABAP 7.40+) um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, deren `PRICE`-Werte um einen bestimmten Betrag reduziert wurden. Dies ist ein funktionaler Ansatz, der die ursprüngliche Tabelle nicht modifiziert und sehr prägnant ist. Die Subtraktion erfolgt direkt im `WITH price = ... - ...` Ausdruck.
keywords: SUBTRACT, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `ZCL_WORKITEM_ABSTRACT` mit einer konkreten Methode `GET_STATUS` und einer abstrakten Methode `PROCESS`. Erstellen Sie zwei Unterklassen `ZCL_TASK_CONCRETE` und `ZCL_BUG_CONCRETE`, die `PROCESS` implementieren und `GET_STATUS` erben.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `ZCL_DOCUMENT_ABSTRACT` mit einer abstrakten Methode `RENDER`. Implementieren Sie eine statische Factory-Methode in einer separaten Klasse `ZCL_DOCUMENT_FACTORY`, die Instanzen von konkreten Unterklassen (z.B. `ZCL_PDF_DOCUMENT` und `ZCL_HTML_DOCUMENT`) basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erstellt und als Referenz auf `ZCL_DOCUMENT_ABSTRACT` zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CLASS-METHODS` für die Factory und `CASE` für die Typunterscheidung. Der Rückgabetyp der Factory-Methode sollte die abstrakte Basisklasse sein.
solution:
CLASS zcl_document_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC CREATE PROTECTED.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS render ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_document_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
    METHODS render REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pdf_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_content = iv_content.
  ENDMETHOD.

    rv_output = |PDF-Dokument mit Inhalt: { mv_content }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_content = iv_content.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD render.
    rv_output = |<HTML><BODY>{ mv_content }</BODY></HTML>|.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_document_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_type    TYPE string
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_document) TYPE REF TO zcl_document_abstract
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'PDF'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_pdf_document( iv_content = iv_content ).
      WHEN 'HTML'.
        ro_document = NEW zcl_html_document( iv_content = iv_content ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Dokumenttyp: { iv_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory.
    DATA: lo_document TYPE REF TO zcl_document_abstract.

    lo_document = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'PDF' iv_content = 'Test PDF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_document->render( )
      exp = 'PDF-Dokument mit Inhalt: Test PDF'
      msg = 'PDF-Dokument Rendering falsch'
    ).

    lo_document = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'HTML' iv_content = 'Test HTML' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_document->render( )
      exp = '<HTML><BODY>Test HTML</BODY></HTML>'
      msg = 'HTML-Dokument Rendering falsch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_invalid_type.
    DATA: lo_document TYPE REF TO zcl_document_abstract.
    TRY.
        lo_document = zcl_document_factory=>create_document( iv_type = 'XML' iv_content = 'Test XML' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception für unbekannten Typ erwartet' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Exception für unbekannten Typ korrekt gefangen' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern in Kombination mit abstrakten Klassen. Die Factory-Methode kapselt die Logik zur Objekterzeugung und gibt eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Basisklasse zurück. Dies entkoppelt den Client-Code von den konkreten Implementierungen und ermöglicht eine einfache Erweiterung um neue Dokumenttypen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, FACTORY, OBJECT ORIENTATION, POLYMORPHISM, DESIGN PATTERNS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `ZCL_NOTIFICATION_ABSTRACT` mit einer abstrakten Methode `SEND`. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Unterklassen `ZCL_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION` und `ZCL_SMS_NOTIFICATION`. Erzeugen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Basisklasse, füllen Sie diese mit Instanzen beider konkreter Typen und rufen Sie die `SEND`-Methode polymorph für jedes Element auf.
hint: Deklarieren Sie die interne Tabelle mit dem Typ `REF TO ZCL_NOTIFICATION_ABSTRACT`. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_notification_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC CREATE PROTECTED.

CLASS zcl_notification_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_email_notification IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_recipient = iv_recipient.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sms_notification DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_notification_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_sms_notification IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.

CLASS zcl_notification_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_notification_entry,
             notification TYPE REF TO zcl_notification_abstract,
           END OF ty_notification_entry.
    TYPES tt_notifications TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_notification_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_notifications IMPORTING it_notifications TYPE tt_notifications.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_notification_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_notifications.
    LOOP AT it_notifications INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      ls_entry-notification->send( 'Dies ist eine Testnachricht.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polymorphic_send FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polymorphic_send.
    DATA: lt_notifications TYPE zcl_notification_processor=>tt_notifications,
          lo_processor     TYPE REF TO zcl_notification_processor.

    APPEND VALUE #( notification = NEW zcl_email_notification( iv_recipient = 'test@example.com' ) ) TO lt_notifications.
    APPEND VALUE #( notification = NEW zcl_sms_notification( iv_phone_number = '+491761234567' ) ) TO lt_notifications.
    APPEND VALUE #( notification = NEW zcl_email_notification( iv_recipient = 'another@example.com' ) ) TO lt_notifications.

    lo_processor = NEW zcl_notification_processor( ).

    " Capture output for verification (cl_demo_output writes to a buffer)
    DATA(lv_output_before) = cl_demo_output=>get_output( ).
    lo_processor->process_notifications( lt_notifications ).
    DATA(lv_output_after) = cl_demo_output=>get_output( ).

    " Simple check if output contains expected strings
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_output_after
      exp = 'E-Mail an test@example.com: Dies ist eine Testnachricht. gesendet.'
      msg = 'E-Mail-Nachricht nicht gefunden'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_output_after
      exp = 'SMS an +491761234567: Dies ist eine Testnachricht. gesendet.'
      msg = 'SMS-Nachricht nicht gefunden'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel veranschaulicht die leistungsstarke Kombination von abstrakten Klassen und Polymorphie in internen Tabellen. Durch die Speicherung von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Basisklasse können verschiedene konkrete Objekttypen einheitlich verarbeitet werden, ohne dass der aufrufende Code die spezifische Implementierung kennen muss. Dies ist ein Kernprinzip der objektorientierten Programmierung.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse `ZCL_REPORT_TEMPLATE_ABSTRACT`. Die Basisklasse soll eine konkrete 'Template'-Methode `EXECUTE_REPORT` haben, die eine Abfolge von Schritten definiert (z.B. `PREPARE_DATA`, `PROCESS_DATA`, `DISPLAY_RESULTS`). `PREPARE_DATA` und `DISPLAY_RESULTS` sollen abstrakte Methoden sein, die von Unterklassen implementiert werden müssen, während `PROCESS_DATA` eine konkrete Standardimplementierung in der Basisklasse hat. Erstellen Sie zwei Unterklassen, die die abstrakten Schritte implementieren.
hint: Die Template-Methode sollte `FINAL` sein, um die Reihenfolge der Schritte zu sichern. Nutzen Sie `PROTECTED` für die Schritte, die von Unterklassen überschrieben werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_template_abstract DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC CREATE PROTECTED.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_report FINAL. " Template method
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_data ABSTRACT.
    METHODS process_data. " Concrete default implementation
    METHODS display_results ABSTRACT.
    DATA mt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY. " Shared data
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_report_template_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_report.
    prepare_data( ).
    process_data( ).
    display_results( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    " Default processing: just add a generic entry
    APPEND 'Default processed data' TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report_concrete DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS display_results REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_data.
    " Simulate fetching sales data
    APPEND 'Sales Data Row 1' TO mt_data.
    APPEND 'Sales Data Row 2' TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD display_results.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |--- Sales Report Results ---| ).
    LOOP AT mt_data INTO DATA(lv_row).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_row ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |----------------------------| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hr_report_concrete DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS display_results REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hr_report_concrete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_data.
    " Simulate fetching HR data
    APPEND 'HR Data Entry A' TO mt_data.
    APPEND 'HR Data Entry B' TO mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD display_results.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |--- HR Report Results ---| ).
    LOOP AT mt_data INTO DATA(lv_row).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( lv_row ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |-------------------------| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
