CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_grouped_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflight_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight ) ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_xlsx->create_document( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sheet_name) = |Flights for { ls_flight-carrid }|.
      DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_document->add_sheet( lv_sheet_name ).

      DATA(lt_carrid_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        ( carrid    = <fs_flight>-carrid,
          connid    = <fs_flight>-connid,
          fldate    = <fs_flight>-fldate,
          planetype = <fs_flight>-planetype,
          seatsocc  = <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ).

      lo_sheet->add_table( i_table = lt_carrid_flights ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_document->save_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Importiere Flugdaten aus einer XLSX-Datei und berechne die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft. Exportiere das Ergebnis in eine neue XLSX-Datei.
hint: Importiere die Daten, verwende `REDUCE` zur Aggregation der Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft und exportiere das Ergebnis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_aggregate_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrid_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_and_export
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath_in TYPE string
        iv_filepath_out TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_aggregate_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_and_export.
    DATA(lo_xlsx_in) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document_in) = lo_xlsx_in->create_document( ).
    lo_document_in->load_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath_in ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_in) = lo_document_in->get_sheet_by_index( 0 ).

    DATA(lt_imported_data) = lo_sheet_in->get_table_data( ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    " Annahme: Erste Zeile ist Header, Daten ab Zeile 1 (Index 1)
    LOOP AT lt_imported_data INTO DATA(ls_row) FROM 1.
      DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.
      SPLIT ls_row AT ',' INTO ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid ls_flight-fldate ls_flight-planetype ls_flight-seatsocc.
      APPEND ls_flight TO lt_all_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_seats) = REDUCE tt_carrid_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrid_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      LET lv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
      IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_seatsocc = lv_total_seats ) ) ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx_out) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document_out) = lo_xlsx_out->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_out) = lo_document_out->add_sheet( 'Aggregated Seats' ).

    lo_sheet_out->add_table( i_table = lt_aggregated_seats ).

    lo_document_out->save_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath_out ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lade ein Bild von einer externen URL herunter und zeige es in einem SAP GUI-Bildschirm an. Verwende `cl_http_client` für den Download.
hint: Nutze `cl_http_client` zum Herunterladen der binären Bilddaten und `cl_gui_picture->load_picture_from_data` zum Anzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_display_url_picture DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_picture_from_url
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        iv_url       TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_display_url_picture IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture_from_url.
    DATA lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA lv_xstring_data TYPE xstring.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url                = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client             = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        argument_not_found = 1
        plugin_not_active  = 2
        internal_error     = 3
        OTHERS             = 4 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        http_communication_failure = 1
        http_invalid_state         = 2
        http_processing_error      = 3
        OTHERS                     = 4 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lv_xstring_data = lo_http_client->response->get_data( ).

    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = io_container ).
    lo_picture->load_picture_from_data( lv_xstring_data ).
    lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Importiere eine XLSX-Datei, die Flugdaten enthält, und bereinige die Fluggesellschafts-IDs, indem du führende und nachfolgende Leerzeichen entfernst. Exportiere die bereinigten Daten in eine neue XLSX-Datei. Verwende String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
hint: Importiere die Daten mit `cl_ehfnd_xlsx`, bereinige die Strings mit `CONDENSE` oder `strip` und exportiere sie wieder. Nutze String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_clean_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS clean_and_export_carrids
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath_in TYPE string
        iv_filepath_out TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_clean_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_and_export_carrids.
    DATA(lo_xlsx_in) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document_in) = lo_xlsx_in->create_document( ).
    lo_document_in->load_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath_in ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_in) = lo_document_in->get_sheet_by_index( 0 ).

    DATA(lt_imported_data) = lo_sheet_in->get_table_data( ).

    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.
    LOOP AT lt_imported_data INTO DATA(ls_row) FROM 1.
      DATA ls_flight TYPE ty_flight_data.
      SPLIT ls_row AT ',' INTO ls_flight-carrid ls_flight-connid ls_flight-fldate ls_flight-planetype ls_flight-seatsocc.
      " Bereinigung der Fluggesellschafts-ID
      ls_flight-carrid = |{ ls_flight-carrid ALPHA = IN }|.
      APPEND ls_flight TO lt_all_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_out) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document_out) = lo_xlsx_out->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_out) = lo_document_out->add_sheet( 'Cleaned Flight Data' ).

    lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 0 i_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 1 i_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 2 i_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 3 i_value = 'PLANETYPE' ).
    lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 4 i_value = 'SEATSOCC' ).

    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = 0 i_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = 1 i_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = 2 i_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = 3 i_value = ls_flight-planetype ).
      lo_sheet_out->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = 4 i_value = ls_flight-seatsocc ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_document_out->save_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath_out ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_and_export FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_and_export.
    DATA(lv_filepath_in) = '/tmp/test_clean_in.xlsx'.
    DATA(lv_filepath_out) = '/tmp/test_clean_out.xlsx'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xlsx_clean_carrid( ).

    " Vorbereitung: Eine Test-XLSX-Datei mit Leerzeichen erstellen
    DATA(lo_xlsx_prep) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_doc_prep) = lo_xlsx_prep->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet_prep) = lo_doc_prep->add_sheet( 'Test Data' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 0 i_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = 1 i_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 1 i_column = 0 i_value = ' LH ' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 1 i_column = 1 i_value = '0400' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 2 i_column = 0 i_value = 'AA  ' ).
    lo_sheet_prep->add_cell( i_row = 2 i_column = 1 i_value = '0017' ).
    lo_doc_prep->save_document( i_filepath = lv_filepath_in ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->clean_and_export_carrids( iv_filepath_in = lv_filepath_in iv_filepath_out = lv_filepath_out ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Cleaning and export should complete without exception' ).

        " Optional: Importieren und überprüfen der bereinigten Daten
        DATA(lo_xlsx_check) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
        DATA(lo_doc_check) = lo_xlsx_check->create_document( ).
        lo_doc_check->load_document( i_filepath = lv_filepath_out ).
        DATA(lo_sheet_check) = lo_doc_check->get_sheet_by_index( 0 ).
        DATA(lt_checked_data) = lo_sheet_check->get_table_data( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_checked_data[ 1 ] exp = 'LH,0400,,' msg = 'First row should be cleaned' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_checked_data[ 2 ] exp = 'AA,0017,,' msg = 'Second row should be cleaned' ).

      CATCH cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error INTO DATA(lx_xlsx).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_xlsx->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Importieren von Daten aus einer XLSX-Datei, das Bereinigen von String-Feldern (hier: Entfernen von Leerzeichen mit `ALPHA = IN` in einem String-Template) und das Exportieren der bereinigten Daten in eine neue XLSX-Datei. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) mit dem Operator `ALPHA = IN` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur String-Manipulation, die den Code sehr lesbar macht.
keywords: XLSX, String Processing, String Templates, ALPHA, cl_ehfnd_xlsx

Instructions: Erstelle eine generische Methode, die ein Bild in einem `cl_gui_picture`-Control anzeigt. Die Methode soll RTTI verwenden, um sicherzustellen, dass der übergebene Container tatsächlich ein `cl_gui_custom_container` ist, bevor das Bild geladen wird.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_classdescr` oder `cl_abap_typedescr` für die RTTI-Prüfung und `CAST` für die Typumwandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_picture_rtti_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_picture_generic
      IMPORTING
        io_generic_container TYPE REF TO object
        iv_filepath          TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_picture_rtti_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture_generic.
    DATA lo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    " RTTI-Prüfung: Sicherstellen, dass es sich um einen Custom Container handelt
    IF io_generic_container IS INSTANCE OF cl_gui_custom_container.
      lo_custom_container ?= io_generic_container. " Down-Cast
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = 'Invalid container type provided'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = lo_custom_container ).
    lo_picture->load_picture_from_file( iv_filepath ).
    lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine generische Methode zum Exportieren beliebiger interner Tabellen in eine XLSX-Datei. Die Methode soll die Spaltenüberschriften dynamisch aus den Feldnamen der internen Tabelle generieren. Verwende RTTI für die Feldnamengenerierung.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_ehfnd_xlsx`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_generic_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_any_table_to_xlsx
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_filepath TYPE string
        iv_sheetname TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RAISING
        cx_ehfnd_xlsx_error
        cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_generic_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_any_table_to_xlsx.
    DATA(lo_xlsx) = NEW cl_ehfnd_xlsx( ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_xlsx->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_sheet) = lo_document->add_sheet( COND string( WHEN iv_sheetname IS SUPPLIED THEN iv_sheetname ELSE 'Generic Data' ) ).

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Dynamische Header-Zeile
    DATA(lv_column) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_sheet->add_cell( i_row = 0 i_column = lv_column i_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_column = lv_column + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Datenzeilen
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data_line>).
      lv_column = 0.
      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_sheet->add_cell( i_row = lv_row i_column = lv_column i_value = CONV string( <fs_field_value> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_column = lv_column + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_document->save_document( i_filepath = iv_filepath ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode zum Anzeigen eines Bildes, die eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass das Bild nicht gefunden wird, beinhaltet. Zeige ein Standard-Platzhalterbild an, wenn das angeforderte Bild nicht geladen werden kann.

solution:
CLASS zcl_picture_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_robust_picture
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container
        iv_filepath  TYPE string
        iv_placeholder_filepath TYPE string
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_picture_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_robust_picture.
    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture( parent = io_container ).

    TRY.
        lo_picture->load_picture_from_file( iv_filepath ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Wenn das Bild nicht gefunden wird, lade ein Platzhalterbild
        lo_picture->load_picture_from_file( iv_placeholder_filepath ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_picture->set_display_mode( cl_gui_picture=>display_mode_stretch ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine externe URL durch und geben Sie den Inhalt der Antwort zurück. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Fehlerbehandlung und Datenverarbeitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT für den Request und CL_HTTP_UTILITY für die URL-Kodierung. Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS fetch_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Create HTTP client
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " Simplified for example
        ENDIF.

        " Set request method
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).

        " Send request
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " Simplified
        ENDIF.

        " Receive response
        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTING
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lo_http_client->get_last_error( IMPORTING message = lv_error_message ).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " Simplified
        ENDIF.

        " Get response content
        rv_content = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_communication_error cx_http_ext_error INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        lv_error_message = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. " Re-raise or handle appropriately
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie ein JSON-Objekt als Payload in einem HTTP POST-Request an eine externe URL. Verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort und verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Serialisierung und Deserialisierung von JSON.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT für den Request, CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER für die JSON-Serialisierung und CL_ABAP_JSON_DESERIALIZER für die Deserialisierung. String Templates für die Payload.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             id TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_response_data.

    METHODS send_json_post
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        is_data TYPE ty_request_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_response_data
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_json_post.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_json_request TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_json_response TYPE string.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    " Serialize request data to JSON
    cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_data
        pretty_print = abap_false
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_request
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

        " Deserialize JSON response
        cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize(
          EXPORTING
            json        = lv_json_response
          RECEIVING
            data        = rs_response
        ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_communication_error cx_http_ext_error cx_abap_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        lv_error_message = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_headers_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_headers,
             content_type TYPE string,
             server_header TYPE string,
             custom_header_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_headers.

    METHODS fetch_with_headers
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_custom_header_name TYPE string
        iv_custom_header_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_headers) TYPE ty_headers

CLASS zcl_http_headers_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_with_headers.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_error_message TYPE string.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url    = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client = lo_http_client
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_get ).

        " Set custom request header
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
          name  = iv_custom_header_name
          value = iv_custom_header_value
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).

        " Read response headers
        rs_headers-content_type = lo_http_client->response->get_header_field( 'Content-Type' ).
        rs_headers-server_header = lo_http_client->response->get_header_field( 'Server' ).
        rs_headers-custom_header_value = lo_http_client->request->get_header_field( iv_custom_header_name ). " Verify custom header was set

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_communication_error cx_http_ext_error INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        lv_error_message = lx_exception->get_text( ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
      FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache Baumstruktur (CL_GUI_LIST_TREE) und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Zeigen Sie dabei Fluggesellschaften als Wurzelknoten und deren Flüge als Kindknoten an. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenaufbereitung.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_GUI_LIST_TREE, VALUE-Operator und FOR-Schleifen. Die Daten aus SFLIGHTS können gruppiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_sflights_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_flight_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_sflights_tree_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    " Group by carrier and then by connection
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid.
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrier_key) = lv_node_key.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_carrier_key text = <fs_flight>-carrid parent_key = '' ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_flight> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_in_group>) GROUP BY <fs_flight_in_group>-connid.
        lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = lv_node_key.
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_conn_key text = <fs_flight_in_group>-connid parent_key = lv_carrier_key ) TO rt_nodes.

        LOOP AT GROUP <fs_flight_in_group> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_final_flight>).
          lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node(
            node_key = lv_node_key
            text = |Flight: { <fs_final_flight>-fldate DATE = USER } - { <fs_final_flight>-planetype }|
            parent_key = lv_conn_key
          ) TO rt_nodes.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Behandlung eines Klicks auf einen Knoten in einem CL_GUI_LIST_TREE. Zeigen Sie eine Meldung mit dem Text des geklickten Knotens an. Der Fokus liegt auf der Event-Registrierung und -Behandlung.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " In a real scenario, mo_container would be linked to a screen element.
    " For this example, we just instantiate it.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " This name must match a custom control on a screen

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    " Add some dummy nodes for demonstration
    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'ROOT1'
        i_text     = 'Root Node 1'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'CHILD1'
        i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT1'
        i_relationship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text     = 'Child Node 1.1'
    ).
    mo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'CHILD2'
        i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT1'
        i_relationship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
        i_text     = 'Child Node 1.2'
    ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT1' ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    DATA: lv_text TYPE lvc_value.
    mo_tree->get_node_text(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = node_key
      IMPORTING
        e_text     = lv_text
    ).
    mv_node_text = lv_text. " Store for testing
    MESSAGE |Node '{ lv_text }' ({ node_key }) double-clicked!| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein "Lazy Loading" für einen CL_GUI_LIST_TREE. Nur wenn ein Knoten expandiert wird, sollen seine Kindknoten geladen und hinzugefügt werden. Verwenden Sie das EXPAND_NO_CHILDREN-Event.
hint: Nutzen Sie das EXPAND_NO_CHILDREN-Event und die Methode ADD_NODES_AND_ITEM.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_tree.
    METHODS handle_expand_no_children FOR EVENT expand_no_children OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: mt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: mv_last_expanded_node TYPE lvc_nkey. " For testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_expand_no_children FOR mo_tree.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE mt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    " Add root nodes (carriers) initially, mark them for lazy loading
    LOOP AT mt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid.
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = <fs_flight>-carrid
          i_text     = <fs_flight>-carrid
          i_exp_image = 'EXPANDED' " Placeholder for an image indicating expandable
          i_collapsed_image = 'COLLAPSED' " Placeholder
          i_is_folder = abap_true " Mark as folder
          i_exp_by_double_click = abap_true " Enable expand by double click
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'LH' ). " Example: Set first visible node
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_expand_no_children.
    mv_last_expanded_node = node_key. " Store for testing

    " Load child nodes based on the expanded node_key (which is a carrier ID here)
    DATA(lv_parent_carrier) = node_key.
    DATA(lt_connections) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights_connid_key
      FOR flight IN mt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = lv_parent_carrier )
      GROUP BY flight-connid ( connid = flight-connid ).

    LOOP AT lt_connections ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_conn>).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = |{ lv_parent_carrier }-{ <fs_conn>-connid }|
          i_relat_node_key = lv_parent_carrier
          i_relationship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text     = <fs_conn>-connid
          i_exp_image = 'EXPANDED'
          i_collapsed_image = 'COLLAPSED'
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_by_double_click = abap_true
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    " In a real scenario, you might need to add another level of lazy loading for flights
    " or load them directly if only two levels are desired.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lazy_loading FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lazy_loading.
    " Mock the container and tree for testing purposes
    DATA(lo_container_mock) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_tree_mock) = NEW cl_gui_list_tree( parent = lo_container_mock ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_lazy_loading( ).

    " Simulate initial display (adding root nodes)
    lo_cut->display_tree( ).

    " Simulate expanding a root node (e.g., 'LH')

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_last_expanded_node exp = 'LH' msg = 'EXPAND_NO_CHILDREN event should be triggered for LH' ).

    " Verify that child nodes for 'LH' were added to the mock tree
    " This requires inspecting the mock tree's internal state, which is not directly exposed.
    " For a real test, you'd need a more sophisticated mock or a different assertion strategy.
    " For now, we check if the event handler was called, the logic within it executed.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking the add_node method of cl_gui_list_tree.
    " For now, we check if the event was processed for the correct node.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Lazy Loading verbessert die Performance bei großen Datenmengen, indem Kindknoten erst dann geladen werden, wenn der übergeordnete Knoten expandiert wird. Das EXPAND_NO_CHILDREN-Event von CL_GUI_LIST_TREE ist der Schlüssel dazu. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie der VALUE-Operator und FOR-Iteratoren helfen bei der effizienten Datenfilterung und -aufbereitung.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Baumstruktur, die Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS in drei Ebenen darstellt: Fluggesellschaft -> Flugverbindung -> Einzelner Flug. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Gruppierung und Knotenerstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisungen und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_multi_lvl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node_data.
    TYPES tt_tree_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflights_tree_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_multi_lvl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflights_tree_structure.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: lv_node_counter TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid.
      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      DATA(lv_carrier_key) = |CARR_{ lv_node_counter }|.
      APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node_data(
        node_key = lv_carrier_key
        text = <fs_flight>-carrid
        parent_key = ''
        is_folder = abap_true
      ) TO rt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_flight> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_conn_group>) GROUP BY <fs_conn_group>-connid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_conn_key) = |CONN_{ lv_node_counter }|.
        APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node_data(
          node_key = lv_conn_key
          text = <fs_conn_group>-connid
          parent_key = lv_carrier_key
          is_folder = abap_true
        ) TO rt_nodes.

        LOOP AT GROUP <fs_conn_group> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_detail>).
          lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
          APPEND VALUE ty_tree_node_data(
            node_key = |FLIGHT_{ lv_node_counter }|
            text = |{ <fs_flight_detail>-fldate DATE = USER } - { <fs_flight_detail>-planetype } ({ <fs_flight_detail>-seatsocc }/{ <fs_flight_detail>-seatsmax })|
            parent_key = lv_conn_key
            is_folder = abap_false
          ) TO rt_nodes.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_multi_level_tree_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_level_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_sflights_multi_lvl( ).
    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_cut->get_sflights_tree_structure( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_nodes ) msg = 'Node table should not be empty' ).

    " Check for at least one root node (carrier)
    DATA(lv_root_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR node IN lt_nodes WHERE ( parent_key IS INITIAL AND is_folder = abap_true ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_root_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should have at least one carrier root node' ).

    " Check for at least one second-level node (connection)
    DATA(lv_conn_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR node IN lt_nodes WHERE ( parent_key IS NOT INITIAL AND node_key CP 'CONN_*' AND is_folder = abap_true ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_conn_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should have at least one connection node' ).

    " Check for at least one third-level node (flight detail)
    DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR node IN lt_nodes WHERE ( parent_key IS NOT INITIAL AND node_key CP 'FLIGHT_*' AND is_folder = abap_false ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should have at least one flight detail node' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer mehrstufigen Baumstruktur aus SFLIGHTS-Daten. Die verschachtelte Verwendung von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um hierarchische Daten zu verarbeiten. Der VALUE-Operator und String Templates vereinfachen die Knotenerstellung und Textformatierung erheblich.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS display_tree.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key
        menu.
    METHODS handle_context_menu_selected FOR EVENT context_menu_selected OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

    DATA: mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA: mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA: mv_last_fcode TYPE ui_func. " For testing
    DATA: mv_last_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey. " For testing

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_container.

    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_selected FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'ROOT1' i_text = 'Root Node with Context Menu' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD1' i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT1' i_relationship = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_last_child i_text = 'Child Item 1' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT1' ).
    mo_tree->set_first_visible_node( 'ROOT1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    mv_last_node_key = node_key. " Store for testing
    DATA(lo_context_menu) = NEW cl_gui_context_menu( ).
    lo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION1' text = 'Aktion 1 für Knoten' ).
    lo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'ACTION2' text = 'Aktion 2 für Knoten' ).
    menu = lo_context_menu. " Pass the menu object back to the tree control
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_selected.
    mv_last_fcode = fcode. " Store for testing
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'ACTION1'.
        MESSAGE |Aktion 1 für Knoten '{ mv_last_node_key }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN 'ACTION2'.
        MESSAGE |Aktion 2 für Knoten '{ mv_last_node_key }' ausgewählt!| TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle other function codes if necessary
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_halve_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_halves) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_while_halve_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD halve_and_count.
    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.
    rv_halves = 0.
    WHILE lv_current_number > 1.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number / 2.
      rv_halves = rv_halves + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadratwurzeln von Zahlen, beginnend bei 1, bis die kumulierte Summe einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife in Kombination mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu akkumulieren.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife kombiniert werden, um eine iterative Akkumulation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_reduce_sqrt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sqrt_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_reduce_sqrt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sqrt_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
           counter = 1
      WHILE sum <= iv_threshold
      NEXT
        sum = sum + sqrt( counter )
        counter = counter + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` in Blöcken von 2 Einträgen. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Blockverarbeitung zu steuern, und eine `FOR`-Schleife, um die Einträge innerhalb jedes Blocks zu verarbeiten. Geben Sie die Flugnummern der verarbeiteten Einträge zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit einem Offset und `LOOP AT ... FROM ... TO` für die Blockverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_sflights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights_in_chunks.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_total_entries) = lines( it_sflights ).

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_total_entries.
      DATA(lv_current_chunk_end) = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size - 1.
      IF lv_current_chunk_end >= lv_total_entries.
        lv_current_chunk_end = lv_total_entries - 1.
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) FROM lv_offset + 1 TO lv_current_chunk_end + 1.
        APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_key(
          carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
          connid = ls_sflight-connid
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
        ) TO rt_processed_keys.
      ENDLOOP.

      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Wert einer Konstante aus der Klasse `cl_mmpur_constants` dynamisch zur Laufzeit, basierend auf dem Namen der Konstante als String. Verwenden Sie RTTI.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `get_static_attributes` in Verbindung mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_mmpur_const DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_constant_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_constant_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_mmpur_const IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_constant_value_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_attributes  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_static_attributes,
          ls_attribute   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>s_static_attribute.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS' ).
        lt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_static_attributes( ).

        READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO ls_attribute WITH KEY name = iv_constant_name.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN (lo_class_descr->get_name( ))=>(iv_constant_name) TO <fs_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_value = <fs_value>.
          ELSE.
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
              EXPORTING
                text = 'Could not assign field symbol for constant'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
            EXPORTING
              text = 'Constant not found'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verarbeitung einer einfachen Warteschlange (Queue) von Flugverbindungen. Fügen Sie einige Einträge hinzu und verarbeiten Sie diese nacheinander, bis die Warteschlange leer ist. Geben Sie die verarbeiteten Flugnummern zurück. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife und Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` mit `LINES()` und `DELETE TABLE` oder `REMOVE` für die Queue-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_queue_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flight_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_initial_flights TYPE tt_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_queue_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_queue.
    DATA(lt_flight_queue) = it_initial_flights.

    WHILE lines( lt_flight_queue ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_current_flight) = lt_flight_queue[ 1 ].
      APPEND ls_current_flight TO rt_processed_flights.
      DELETE lt_flight_queue INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_value_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flights_with_while
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_while_value_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights_with_while.
    DATA(lv_counter) = 0.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR i = 1 WHILE lv_counter < iv_num_entries
      ( id = i
        carrid = COND #( WHEN i MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'LH' ELSE 'AA' )
        connid = |{ i * 100 }|
      )
      ( lv_counter = lv_counter + 1 ) " Increment counter in a separate line
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_while_approval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_while_approval IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_approval_process.
    DATA(lv_current_status) = iv_initial_status.
    DATA(lv_approval_level) = 1.
    DATA(lv_max_approval_levels) = 3. " Simulate a constant, e.g., from a custom config or MMPUR

    " Example constants from cl_mmpur_constants (conceptual use)
    DATA(lc_status_approved) = 'APPROVED'. " cl_mmpur_constants=>status_approved
    DATA(lc_status_rejected) = 'REJECTED'. " cl_mmpur_constants=>status_rejected
    DATA(lc_status_pending)  = 'PENDING'.  " cl_mmpur_constants=>status_pending

    WHILE lv_approval_level <= lv_max_approval_levels AND lv_current_status = lc_status_pending.
      " Simulate approval logic
      IF lv_approval_level = 3. " Last level always approves for this demo
        lv_current_status = lc_status_approved.
      ELSE.
        " Simulate some condition for rejection/approval
        IF lv_approval_level = 2 AND iv_initial_status = 'REJECTED_INIT'. " Example rejection condition
          lv_current_status = lc_status_rejected.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.

      lv_approval_level = lv_approval_level + 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_final_status = lv_current_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_while_string_shorten DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shorten_string_until
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_max_length   TYPE i
        iv_delimiter    TYPE c
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_shortened_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_string_shorten IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shorten_string_until.
    DATA(lv_current_string) = iv_input_string.

    WHILE strlen( lv_current_string ) > iv_max_length AND
          ( CONTAINS( val = lv_current_string sub = iv_delimiter ) OR
            CONTAINS( val = lv_current_string sub = |{ iv_delimiter }| ) ). " Handle char vs string delimiter

      " Find the last occurrence of the delimiter
      FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF iv_delimiter IN lv_current_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_offset).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_current_string = lv_current_string(lv_offset).
      ELSE.
        " If delimiter not found, just shorten from end
        lv_current_string = lv_current_string(iv_max_length).
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_shortened_string = lv_current_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fakultät einer Zahl iterativ mit einer `WHILE`-Schleife.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_factorial
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_factorial) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_factorial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_factorial.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Input must be a non-negative number'.
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_number = 0.
      rv_factorial = 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_number) = iv_number.
    rv_factorial = 1.

    WHILE lv_current_number > 0.
      rv_factorial = rv_factorial * lv_current_number.
      lv_current_number = lv_current_number - 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die alle gültigen Kategorien zurückgibt, die in `cl_mmpur_constants` definiert sind und einem bestimmten Muster entsprechen. Verwenden Sie `WHILE` und RTTI.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_category_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_category_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_categories
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categories) TYPE tt_category_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mmpur_category_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_categories.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lt_attributes  TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>tt_static_attributes,
          ls_attribute   TYPE cl_abap_classdescr=>s_static_attribute.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( 'CL_MMPUR_CONSTANTS' ).
        lt_attributes = lo_class_descr->get_static_attributes( ).

        DATA(lv_index) = 1.
        DATA(lv_total_attributes) = lines( lt_attributes ).

        WHILE lv_index <= lv_total_attributes.
          READ TABLE lt_attributes INTO ls_attribute INDEX lv_index.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Check if the constant name matches the pattern
            IF matches( val = ls_attribute-name regex = iv_pattern ).
              APPEND ls_attribute-name TO rt_categories.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
          lv_index = lv_index + 1.
        ENDWHILE.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error: class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_process_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_values_until_end
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE tt_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_process_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_values_until_end.
    DATA(lt_working_list) = it_values.
    DATA(lc_end_value) = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base_end_value. " Assuming this constant exists and is relevant

    WHILE lines( lt_working_list ) > 0 AND lt_working_list[ 1 ] <> lc_end_value.
      DATA(lv_current_value) = lt_working_list[ 1 ].
      APPEND lv_current_value TO rt_processed_values.
      DELETE lt_working_list INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.

    " If the loop terminated because lc_end_value was found, add it to processed list
    IF lines( lt_working_list ) > 0 AND lt_working_list[ 1 ] = lc_end_value.
      APPEND lc_end_value TO rt_processed_values.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_process_list( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_values_until_end( lt_input_values ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_processed ),
      exp = 1,
      msg = 'Should process only the end value if it is first'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_processed[1],
      exp = cl_mmpur_constants=>mmpur_base_end_value
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Schleife läuft, solange die Liste nicht leer ist und der aktuelle Wert nicht dem definierten 'Endwert' entspricht. Dies ist ein häufiges Muster für die Verarbeitung von Datenströmen oder Workflows.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Arbeitstagen in der Zukunft liegt, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` und die Klasse `cl_abap_date_helper` oder manuelle Datumsberechnungen mit `sy-datum` und `+1`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_workday_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_future_workday
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_workdays   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_workday_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_workday.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_days_added) = 0.

    WHILE lv_days_added < iv_workdays.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).

      " 1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_day_of_week <> 6 AND lv_day_of_week <> 7. " Not Saturday or Sunday
        lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.

    rv_future_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Flugverbindungen nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` und eine `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Verarbeitung der Gruppen zu steuern, falls eine weitere Iteration über die Gruppen erforderlich ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP` für die Gruppierung und eine äußere `WHILE`-Schleife, um die Gruppen bei Bedarf erneut zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_while_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_and_count_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_while_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_and_count_flights.
    DATA(lv_reprocess_groups) = abap_true.
    DATA(lt_current_grouped_counts) = VALUE tt_flight_count( ).

    WHILE lv_reprocess_groups = abap_true.
      lv_reprocess_groups = abap_false. " Assume no re-processing needed unless a condition is met
      CLEAR lt_current_grouped_counts.

      " Grouping using FOR ... IN GROUP
      lt_current_grouped_counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
        FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          count  = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) )
      ).

      " Example: If any group has more than 2 flights, re-process (dummy condition)
      IF EXISTS lt_current_grouped_counts[ count > 2 ].
        lv_reprocess_groups = abap_true.
        " In a real scenario, you might modify it_sflights here for the next iteration
        " For this demo, we just show the re-processing flag.
      ENDIF.

      " If re-processing is not needed, assign to final result
      IF lv_reprocess_groups = abap_false.
        rt_grouped_counts = lt_current_grouped_counts.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_grouped ),
      exp = 3,
      msg = 'Should have 3 distinct carriers'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' ]-count,
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'AA should have 2 flights'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'BB' ]-count,
      exp = 1,

    ).

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_and_count_flights( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_grouped,

  METHOD test_reprocess_condition.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '003' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '004' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_while_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_and_count_flights( lt_sflights ).

    " In this specific demo, the re-processing condition (count > 2) is met for 'AA'.
    " The WHILE loop will run twice, but the output will be the same as the grouping logic is static.
    " The key is to demonstrate the WHILE controlling the re-evaluation of groups.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_grouped ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Should have 2 distinct carriers'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Die äußere `WHILE`-Schleife dient dazu, die Gruppierung und nachfolgende Verarbeitung bei Bedarf zu wiederholen, z.B. wenn eine Bedingung innerhalb der Gruppen eine erneute Iteration über die Daten erfordert. Dies ist nützlich für komplexe Aggregations- oder Iterationsmuster.

Instructions: Finden Sie den höchsten Flugpreis (MAXIMUM `price`) aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (`sflights_tab`) unter Verwendung eines funktionalen Ansatzes.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einer Inline-Schleife und einem Vergleich, um das Maximum zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_price = 0
                             FOR flight IN it_flights
                             NEXT max_price = nmax( val1 = max_price val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen. Wenn eine Zahl einen vordefinierten `MAXIMUM_ALLOWED` Wert überschreitet, soll die Verarbeitung abgebrochen und eine lokal definierte Exception `lcx_value_too_high` ausgelöst werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `COND` oder `THROW` in Kombination mit `RAISE EXCEPTION`.

CLASS lcx_value_too_high DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA value TYPE i.
    DATA max_allowed TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid      LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous    LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_value     TYPE i
        i_max_allowed TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcx_value_too_high IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->value = i_value.
    me->max_allowed = i_max_allowed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS co_maximum_allowed TYPE i VALUE 100.
    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        lcx_value_too_high.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    LOOP AT it_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number > co_maximum_allowed.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_value_too_high
          EXPORTING
            i_value = lv_number
            i_max_allowed = co_maximum_allowed.
      ENDIF.
      " Simulate processing
      " ...
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Für jeden Fluggesellschaftscode (`carrid`) in der Tabelle `sflights` finden Sie den Flug mit dem spätesten Flugdatum (MAXIMUM `fldate`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `CORRESPONDING` um die spätesten Flugdaten pro Fluggesellschaft zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_latest_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_latest_flight.
    TYPES tt_latest_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_latest_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_flight_per_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_latest_flights) TYPE tt_latest_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_flight_per_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_latest_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                                 ( VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid
                                            fldate = REDUCE #( INIT max_fldate = flight-fldate
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                               NEXT max_fldate = nmax( val1 = max_fldate val2 = member-fldate ) )
                                            connid = REDUCE #( INIT max_connid = flight-connid
                                                               FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                               WHERE ( member-fldate = REDUCE #( INIT max_fldate_inner = flight-fldate
                                                                                                 FOR member_inner IN GROUP flight
                                                                                                 NEXT max_fldate_inner = nmax( val1 = max_fldate_inner val2 = member_inner-fldate ) ) )
                                                               NEXT max_connid = nmax( val1 = max_connid val2 = member-connid ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_latest_flight_per_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_latest_flight_per_carrier.
    " Test data setup (assuming sflight table has data)
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_latest_flights) = lo_cut->get_latest_flight_per_carrier( ).

    " Assertions for known carriers and their latest flight dates
    " This test assumes specific data in SFLIGHT. For a robust unit test,
    " one would mock the database access or use a dedicated test fixture.
    DATA(ls_lh_latest) = lt_latest_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_latest ).
    " Example: Assert that the latest flight date for LH is '20250301' (adjust based on actual SFLIGHT data)
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_latest-fldate exp = '20250301' ).

    " More generic check: ensure at least some results are returned
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_latest_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lines( lt_latest_flights ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature in ABAP 7.50+. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten innerhalb von Gruppen auf eine deklarative und effiziente Weise, um hier das maximale Flugdatum pro Fluggesellschaft zu finden. Die innere `REDUCE`-Anweisung mit `WHERE` ist notwendig, um die `connid` des Fluges mit dem spätesten Datum zu finden, falls es mehrere Flüge am selben spätesten Datum gibt.
keywords: MAXIMUM, GROUP BY, LOOP AT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Entwerfen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_calculator` mit verkettbaren Methoden `add`, `subtract`, `multiply` und `divide`. Die `divide`-Methode soll eine lokal definierte Exception `lcx_division_by_zero` auslösen, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung dieser Methoden und die Behandlung der Exception am Ende der Kette.
hint: Lassen Sie die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen. Behandeln Sie die Exception im aufrufenden Code.
solution:
CLASS lcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check. ENDCLASS.
CLASS lcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION. ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE f.
    METHODS add      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator.
    METHODS divide   IMPORTING iv_value TYPE f RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_calculator RAISING lcx_division_by_zero.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_result = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_result = mv_result * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    mv_result = mv_result / iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chained_operations FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chained_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING lcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chained_operations.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calc->add( 5 )->subtract( 2 )->multiply( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 39.0 ). " (10+5-2)*3 = 13*3 = 39
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chained_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calc) = NEW zcl_calculator( 10 ).
    TRY.
        lo_calc->add( 5 )->divide( 0 )->get_result( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception lcx_division_by_zero was not raised.' ).
      CATCH lcx_division_by_zero.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception lcx_division_by_zero caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Verkettung) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem Methodenaufrufe sequenziell auf dem Ergebnis des vorherigen Aufrufs ausgeführt werden. Jede Methode gibt eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurück. Die Exception-Behandlung mit `RAISE EXCEPTION` integriert sich nahtlos in dieses Muster, wobei die Exception am Ende der Kette abgefangen werden kann.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Exception Handling

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Verbindungs-ID (MAXIMUM `connid`) aus einer gefilterten Liste von `sflight`-Einträgen für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um relevante Einträge zu erhalten, dann `SORT` und `VALUE` um den letzten Eintrag zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_connid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_key) TYPE ty_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_connid.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT lt_filtered_flights BY connid DESCENDING.
      rs_flight_key = VALUE #( lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ] OPTIONAL ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_with_max_connid FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_with_max_connid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with connids like 0017, 0018, 0019, etc.
    " and the maximum is 0019 for example.
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_connid( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    " This assertion depends on actual SFLIGHT data. Adjust as needed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0019' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_with_max_connid_no_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_finder( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_connid( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `SORT` ist ein moderner und effizienter Weg, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu manipulieren. `FILTER` erstellt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung, während `SORT` die Reihenfolge der Einträge ändert. Durch das Sortieren in absteigender Reihenfolge und den Zugriff auf den ersten Eintrag (`[ 1 ]`) kann der Eintrag mit dem `MAXIMUM` Wert einer bestimmten Spalte gefunden werden. `VALUE #( ... OPTIONAL )` stellt sicher, dass kein Dump auftritt, wenn die Tabelle leer ist.
keywords: MAXIMUM, FILTER, SORT, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse `zcl_person` mit einem Konstruktor, der `first_name` und `last_name` entgegennimmt. Wenn einer der Namen leer ist, soll eine lokal definierte Exception `lcx_invalid_person_data` ausgelöst werden.
hint: Definieren Sie `lcx_invalid_person_data` und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION` im Konstruktor zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS lcx_invalid_person_data DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA field_name TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid      LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous    LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_field_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcx_invalid_person_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->field_name = i_field_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_person DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_first_name TYPE string
        iv_last_name  TYPE string
      RAISING
        lcx_invalid_person_data.

    METHODS get_full_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_full_name) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_first_name TYPE string.
    DATA mv_last_name  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_person IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF iv_first_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_invalid_person_data
        EXPORTING
          i_field_name = 'First Name'.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_last_name IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE lcx_invalid_person_data
        EXPORTING
          i_field_name = 'Last Name'.
    ENDIF.

    mv_first_name = iv_first_name.
    mv_last_name  = iv_last_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_full_name.
    rv_full_name = |{ mv_first_name } { mv_last_name }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle und ein Feldname als String. Finden Sie den höchsten Wert (MAXIMUM) dieses Feldes dynamisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO ...` innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife, um auf das Feld dynamisch zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_maximum
      IMPORTING
        it_data    TYPE tt_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_value) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_max_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_maximum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_current_max TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> TYPE i.
        IF <fs_value> > lv_current_max.
          lv_current_max = <fs_value>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_max_value = lv_current_max.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_max_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_max_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_max_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_assign_error.
    METHODS test_dynamic_max_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_max_value.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_max_finder=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 text = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 50 text = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 20 text = 'C' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_max_finder( ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_maximum( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = 50 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_max_id.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_max_finder=>tt_data(
      ( id = 100 value = 10 text = 'A' )
      ( id = 20 value = 50 text = 'B' )
      ( id = 300 value = 20 text = 'C' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_max_finder( ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_maximum( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_max_invalid_field.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_max_finder=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 text = 'A' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_max_finder( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_dynamic_maximum( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_assign_error was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_assign_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'cx_sy_assign_error caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_max_empty_table.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_max_finder=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_max_finder( ).
    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_maximum( it_data = lt_data iv_field_name = 'VALUE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit Feldsymbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit auf Komponenten einer Struktur zuzugreifen, deren Name erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Funktionen, die mit verschiedenen Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Prüfung von `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN` und das Auslösen von `CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR` ist entscheidend für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei ungültigen Feldnamen.
keywords: MAXIMUM, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis (MAXIMUM `price`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Verbindungs-ID (`connid`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `MAX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und den `MAX`-Funktionsaufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_price_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_for_flight.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
                             NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_max_price_for_specific_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_max_price_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_price_for_specific_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' '0400' has prices like 100, 120, 150
    DATA(lv_max_price) = lo_cut->get_max_price_for_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    " This assertion depends on actual SFLIGHT data. Adjust as needed.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_max_price exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_max_price_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel bietet eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Möglichkeit, Aggregationen auf gefilterten Daten in internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Hier wird der höchste Preis für eine spezifische Flugverbindung ermittelt, ohne dass eine separate `LOOP` und `IF`-Anweisung erforderlich ist. `nmax` stellt sicher, dass der größte Wert korrekt gefunden wird.
keywords: MAXIMUM, REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String in eine Ganzzahl konvertiert. Wenn der String keine gültige Zahl darstellt, soll eine Exception `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER` ausgelöst werden.

CLASS zcl_string_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_string_converter IMPLEMENTATION.

        rv_number = iv_input.

        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_no_number.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_conversion FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_converter( ).

explanation: Die direkte Zuweisung eines Strings zu einer numerischen Variable kann eine systemseitige Exception `CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER` auslösen, wenn der String keine gültige Zahl enthält.
