Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis (MAXIMUM `price`) pro Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugdatum (`fldate`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft, das Flugdatum und den maximalen Preis zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit mehreren Schlüsselfeldern und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation des maximalen Preises.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_per_day_and_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_per_day_and_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, fldate = flight-fldate )
                                 ( VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid
                                            fldate = flight-fldate
                                            max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                                                                  FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                                  NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = member-price ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von IDs verarbeitet. Wenn eine ID in der Liste den Wert 999 hat, soll eine Exception `lcx_forbidden_id` ausgelöst werden, die den Wert der verbotenen ID enthält. Nutzen Sie `THROW` in einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `THROW` um die Exception direkt im Ausdruck auszulösen.
solution:
CLASS lcx_forbidden_id DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA forbidden_id TYPE i.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid      LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous    LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_forbidden_id TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcx_forbidden_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->forbidden_id = i_forbidden_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_id_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS co_forbidden_id TYPE i VALUE 999.
    METHODS process_ids
      IMPORTING
        it_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        lcx_forbidden_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_id_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_ids.
    DATA(lv_dummy) = REDUCE i(
      INIT r = 0
      FOR id IN it_ids
      NEXT r = COND #( WHEN id = co_forbidden_id THEN THROW lcx_forbidden_id( i_forbidden_id = id )
                       ELSE r ) ).
    " Simulate further processing if no exception was thrown
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_valid_ids FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_process_forbidden_id FOR TESTING RAISING lcx_forbidden_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_valid_ids.
    DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 200 ) ( 300 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_id_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_ids( lt_ids ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Processing successful for valid IDs.' ).
      CATCH lcx_forbidden_id.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Unexpected exception for valid IDs.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_forbidden_id.
    DATA(lt_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 100 ) ( 999 ) ( 200 ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_id_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_ids( lt_ids ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception lcx_forbidden_id was not raised.' ).
      CATCH lcx_forbidden_id INTO DATA(lx_forbidden).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_forbidden->forbidden_id exp = zcl_id_processor=>co_forbidden_id ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE`, `FOR`, `COND` und `THROW` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht das Auslösen von Exceptions direkt innerhalb von Ausdrücken. Anstatt einer separaten `IF`-Anweisung kann die Bedingung und die Exception-Auslösung in einer Zeile formuliert werden.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis (MAXIMUM `price`) aus der Tabelle `sflight` für alle Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum (`iv_min_fldate`) stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` um die relevanten Flüge zu selektieren und dann `REDUCE` um den maximalen Preis zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_date_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price_after_date.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > iv_min_fldate ).

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_p = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_filtered_flights
                             NEXT max_p = nmax( val1 = max_p val2 = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine hierarchische Baumstruktur in einem Custom Control. Die Daten sollen aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, die mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten befüllt wird. Demonstrieren Sie das Hinzufügen von Knoten zu einem `cl_gui_simple_tree`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_simple_tree` und füllen Sie die Baumstruktur mit `ADD_NODE` in einer `FOR`-Schleife, die eine `VALUE`-Konstruktion verwendet, um die Knotendaten vorzubereiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key   TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE string,
             text       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_tree_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.

    METHODS display_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_nodes TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_tree_data.
    rt_nodes = VALUE #( ( node_key = 'ROOT' parent_key = '' text = 'Wurzel' )
                        ( node_key = 'NODE1' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Knoten 1' )
                        ( node_key = 'NODE2' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Knoten 2' )
                        ( node_key = 'SUB1' parent_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Unterknoten 1.1' )
                        ( node_key = 'SUB2' parent_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Unterknoten 1.2' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    " In a real scenario, lo_container would be linked to a screen element.
    " For this example, we simulate the tree population.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    LOOP AT it_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-parent_key IS INITIAL.
        lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_relat_node_key = '' i_text = ls_node-text ).
      ELSE.
        lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_relat_node_key = ls_node-parent_key i_text = ls_node-text ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " In a real scenario, the tree would be displayed on a screen.
    " For the purpose of this example, we just ensure the methods are called.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_nodes[ node_key = 'SUB1' ]-parent_key exp = 'NODE1' msg = 'Subnode parent key incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_display_tree.

solution:
CLASS zcl_image_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_image_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lo_image_info TYPE REF TO cl_fxs_image_info.

        lo_image_info = cl_fxs_image_info=>create_from_xstring( iv_image_xstring ).

        rs_dimensions-height = lo_image_info->get_height( ).
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_info).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_image_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Baumstruktur, die nur bestimmte Knoten basierend auf einem Filterkriterium aus einer Quelltabelle anzeigt. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die Daten vorzubereiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die Quelltabelle zu reduzieren, bevor Sie die Knoten zum Baum hinzufügen. Die `LINE_EXISTS`-Funktion kann nützlich sein, um die Existenz von Elternelementen zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filtered_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key   TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE string,
             text       TYPE string,
             is_active  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_tree_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_active TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.

    METHODS display_filtered_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_filtered_nodes TYPE tt_node_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_tree_data.
    DATA(lt_all_nodes) = VALUE tt_node_data(
      ( node_key = 'ROOT' parent_key = '' text = 'Wurzel' is_active = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'NODE1' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Knoten 1' is_active = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'NODE2' parent_key = 'ROOT' text = 'Knoten 2 (inaktiv)' is_active = abap_false )
      ( node_key = 'SUB1' parent_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Unterknoten 1.1' is_active = abap_true )
      ( node_key = 'SUB2' parent_key = 'NODE1' text = 'Unterknoten 1.2 (inaktiv)' is_active = abap_false )
      ( node_key = 'SUB3' parent_key = 'NODE2' text = 'Unterknoten 2.1' is_active = abap_true ) ).

    rt_filtered_nodes = FILTER #( lt_all_nodes USING KEY primary_key WHERE is_active = iv_filter_active OR node_key = 'ROOT' ).

    " Ensure parent nodes are included if their children are active, even if the parent itself is inactive.
    LOOP AT rt_filtered_nodes ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_node>).
      IF <fs_node>-parent_key IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT line_exists( rt_filtered_nodes[ node_key = <fs_node>-parent_key ] ).
        INSERT lt_all_nodes[ node_key = <fs_node>-parent_key ] INTO TABLE rt_filtered_nodes.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_filtered_tree.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    LOOP AT it_filtered_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
      IF ls_node-parent_key IS INITIAL.
        lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_relat_node_key = '' i_text = ls_node-text ).
      ELSE.
        lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = ls_node-node_key i_relat_node_key = ls_node-parent_key i_text = ls_node-text ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_active_nodes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_inactive_nodes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_active_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_tree_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_tree_data( iv_filter_active = abap_true ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of active nodes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'ROOT' ] ) msg = 'Root node missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'NODE1' ] ) msg = 'Node 1 missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'SUB1' ] ) msg = 'Subnode 1.1 missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'NODE2' ] ) msg = 'Inactive Node 2 should be filtered out' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_inactive_nodes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filtered_tree_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_tree_data( iv_filter_active = abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of inactive nodes' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'ROOT' ] ) msg = 'Root node missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'NODE2' ] ) msg = 'Node 2 missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'SUB2' ] ) msg = 'Subnode 1.2 missing' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( line_exists( lt_filtered[ node_key = 'NODE1' ] ) msg = 'Active Node 1 should be filtered out' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS` ermöglicht er eine flexible Datenaufbereitung für UI-Elemente wie den `cl_gui_simple_tree`, indem nur relevante Knoten angezeigt werden.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie den MIME-Typ eines Bildes (als XSTRING), bevor Sie weitere Verarbeitungsschritte durchführen. Nutzen Sie `cl_fxs_image_info` und eine `CASE`-Anweisung, um verschiedene Bildtypen zu identifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fxs_image_info=>create_from_xstring` und `get_mime_type`. Eine `CASE`-Anweisung kann den Typ effizient prüfen und entsprechende Aktionen auslösen.

CLASS zcl_image_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_mime_type TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: gc_mime_jpeg TYPE ty_mime_type VALUE 'image/jpeg',
               gc_mime_png  TYPE ty_mime_type VALUE 'image/png',
               gc_mime_gif  TYPE ty_mime_type VALUE 'image/gif'.

    METHODS validate_image_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_fxs_image_info.

    METHODS get_image_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_mime_type) TYPE ty_mime_type

        cx_fxs_image_info.

CLASS zcl_image_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_image_type.
    DATA(lv_mime_type) = get_image_mime_type( iv_image_xstring ).

    CASE lv_mime_type.
      WHEN gc_mime_jpeg OR gc_mime_png OR gc_mime_gif.
        rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_image_mime_type.
    DATA: lo_image_info TYPE REF TO cl_fxs_image_info.

    TRY.
        lo_image_info = cl_fxs_image_info=>create_from_xstring( iv_image_xstring ).
        rv_mime_type = lo_image_info->get_mime_type( ).
      CATCH cx_fxs_image_info INTO DATA(lx_image_info).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_image_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines numerischen Feldes in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Demonstrieren Sie auch die Verwendung von `REDUCE` für die String-Konkatenation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `INIT`-Wert und einer Schleife über die Tabelle, um die Summe oder den konkatenierten String zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_values
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

    METHODS concatenate_texts
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concatenated_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_values.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT s = s + item-value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_texts.
    rv_concatenated_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN item-text ELSE s && ', ' && item-text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_values.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_reducer=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 text = 'A' )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 text = 'B' )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 text = 'C' ) ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_values( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 60 msg = 'Incorrect sum' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_texts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_reducer=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 value = 10 text = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 value = 20 text = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 value = 30 text = 'Cherry' ) ).

    DATA(lv_concatenated) = lo_cut->concatenate_texts( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_concatenated exp = 'Apple, Banana, Cherry' msg = 'Incorrect concatenated text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reducer( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_items) = VALUE zcl_reducer=>tt_items( ).

    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_values( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 0 msg = 'Sum of empty table should be 0' ).

    DATA(lv_concatenated) = lo_cut->concatenate_texts( lt_empty_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_concatenated exp = '' msg = 'Concatenation of empty table should be empty string' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein funktionales Programmierkonzept in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren. Dies ist ideal für Aggregationen wie Summenbildung oder String-Konkatenation und führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code im Vergleich zu traditionellen `LOOP`-Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, COND

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen für Variablen (`DATA(...)`) und Feldsymbolen (`FIELD-SYMBOLS(<...>)`) in einer Schleife über eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DATA(lv_variable)` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_structure>)` direkt an der Verwendungsstelle, um den Code kompakter und lesbarer zu machen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inline_declarations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_keys_as_string
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_keys) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inline_declarations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(ls_item).
      rv_total_value = rv_total_value + ls_item-value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_keys_as_string.
    LOOP AT it_input ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_item>).
      IF rv_keys IS INITIAL.
        rv_keys = <fs_item>-key.
      ELSE.
        rv_keys = rv_keys && ', ' && <fs_item>-key.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle transformieren und dabei nur bestimmte Felder übernehmen. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )`, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren und dabei die Felder der Quelltabelle zu mappen oder zu transformieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
             flag  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             item_id   TYPE string,
             item_name TYPE string,
             calculated_value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_target_data.
    TYPES tt_target_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_table.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           WHERE ( flag = abap_true )
                           ( item_id = ls_source-id,
                             item_name = ls_source-name,
                             calculated_value = ls_source-value * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_no_matching_flags FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_transformer=>tt_source_data(
      ( id = 'A' name = 'Item A' value = 10 flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 'B' name = 'Item B' value = 20 flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 'C' name = 'Item C' value = 30 flag = abap_true ) ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_table( lt_source ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Nutzen Sie Feldsymbole und den `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Befehl.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE ls_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>)` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Unterschied in Tagen zwischen zwei Datumsangaben und formatieren Sie ein Datum in ein benutzerfreundliches Format. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Datum/Zeit-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_context_info` für Datumsberechnungen und String-Templates für die Formatierung.

CLASS zcl_date_time_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.

    METHODS format_date_german
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_time_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between.
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_timestamp( iv_date1 ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_timestamp( iv_date2 ).

    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_diff_in_seconds( iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp1 iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).
    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / 86400. " 86400 seconds in a day
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_date_german.
    rv_formatted_date = |{ iv_date DATE = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine bedingte Zuweisung mit dem `COND`-Operator, um einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu setzen. Demonstrieren Sie auch die Verwendung von `SWITCH` für mehrere Bedingungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND type( WHEN condition THEN value ELSE other_value )` und `SWITCH type( WHEN condition1 THEN value1 WHEN condition2 THEN value2 ELSE other_value )`.

CLASS zcl_conditional_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_text_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_priority_text_switch
      IMPORTING
        iv_priority_level TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_priority_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text_cond.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_status_code = 1 THEN 'Aktiv'
      ELSE 'Inaktiv' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_priority_text_switch.
    rv_priority_text = SWITCH string(
      iv_priority_level
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Hoch'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Mittel'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Niedrig'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie 'sflights' nach Flügen mit verfügbaren Sitzen und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER mit FOR und VALUE, um eine neue Struktur zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_map.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE seatsocc < seatsmax )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial' act = ls_flight_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial' act = ls_flight_key-connid ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen vollständigen CSV-String (mit Header) in eine interne Tabelle von 'sflight'-Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_string_utilities=>string_to_string_table und eine Schleife mit cl_icf_csv=>parse_csv_line.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parse_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parsed_data) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parse_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_table.
    DATA: lt_csv_lines TYPE string_table.
    cl_abap_string_utilities=>string_to_string_table( EXPORTING i_string = iv_csv_string i_separator = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf IMPORTING e_string_table = lt_csv_lines ).

    IF lines( lt_csv_lines ) > 0.
      DELETE lt_csv_lines INDEX 1. " Remove header
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_csv_lines INTO DATA(lv_line).
      DATA(ls_sflight) TYPE sflight.
      cl_icf_csv=>parse_csv_line( EXPORTING i_csv_line = lv_line IMPORTING e_s_data = ls_sflight ).
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_parsed_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, die mehr als 100 Sitze haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit FILTER für die Aggregation auf einer gefilterten Untermenge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > 100 )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_calculate_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( 'LH' ).

    " This test assumes there is at least one LH flight with seatsocc > 100
    " For a real scenario, you'd either mock sflight data or assert a specific known value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats should be greater than 0' act = ( lv_total_seats > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats should be 0 for non-existent carrier' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_calculate_empty_table.
    " To properly test with an empty table, we would need to mock the SELECT statement
    " or ensure sflight is empty in the test system. For this example, we rely on
    " the previous test for 'XX' carrier which effectively results in an empty filtered table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( 'YY' ). " Assuming 'YY' has no flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total seats should be 0 for no matching flights' act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einem funktionalen Stil. In Kombination mit FILTER kann er auf einer gefilterten Untermenge der Daten operieren, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft in 'sflights'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck REDUCE, um den Maximalwert zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        rs_max_flight = REDUCE ty_sflight(
            INIT max_flight = VALUE ty_sflight( )
            FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
            NEXT max_flight = COND #( WHEN flight-seatsocc > max_flight-seatsocc THEN flight ELSE max_flight ) ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_not_found. " If FILTER returns empty table
        CLEAR rs_max_flight.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_seats_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_seats_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_seats_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_seats( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_seats( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH' act = ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrier should be LH' act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    " Verify that the found flight indeed has the maximum seatsocc for LH
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_max_seats=>tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_max_seatsocc) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seatsocc > lv_max_seatsocc.
        lv_max_seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Seats occupied mismatch' act = ls_result-seatsocc exp = lv_max_seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_seats_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max_seats( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be initial for non-existent carrier' act = ls_result-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Ausdruck kann verwendet werden, um einen einzelnen Wert oder eine Struktur aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. Hier wird er genutzt, um iterativ den Flug mit der höchsten Anzahl belegter Sitze zu finden, was eine funktionale und effiziente Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen darstellt.
keywords: REDUCE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Max Value, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze aus sflights enthält. Nutzen Sie verschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR mit GROUP BY und REDUCE für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_agg_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_agg.
    TYPES tt_flight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_agg_flights) TYPE tt_flight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_agg_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flights.
    rt_agg_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid )
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT x = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT x = x + 1 )
        total_seats_occ = REDUCE sflight-seatsocc( INIT x = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT x = x + ls_flight-seatsocc )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_aggregated_flights FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lt_agg_flights) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_agg_flights ).
    IF line_exists( lt_agg_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ).
      DATA(ls_lh_agg) = lt_agg_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight count for LH should be positive' act = xsdbool( ls_lh_agg-flight_count > 0 ) ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats occupied for LH should be positive' act = xsdbool( ls_lh_agg-total_seats_occ >= 0 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY ermöglichen leistungsstarke Aggregationen direkt bei der Tabellenkonstruktion. Der REDUCE-Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Gruppe zu berechnen. Die FINAL-Klasse kapselt diese Logik.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Quadratzahlen von 1 bis zu einer gegebenen Zahl unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Initialisieren Sie eine Variable und addieren Sie in jedem Schritt das Quadrat der aktuellen Zahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_squares DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_of_squares IMPORTING iv_max TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_squares IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_of_squares.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 UNTIL i > iv_max
                       NEXT sum = sum + ( i * i ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_of_squares FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_of_squares.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_squares( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( 3 ). " 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 1 + 4 + 9 = 14
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of squares for 3 should be 14' exp = 14 act = lv_sum ).

    lv_sum = lo_cut->calculate_sum_of_squares( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sum of squares for 0 should be 0' exp = 0 act = lv_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für die Aggregation von Werten oder die Durchführung iterativer Berechnungen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der Quadratzahlen in einem bestimmten Bereich zu berechnen, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt. Die Klasse ist FINAL.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Loop, FINAL

Instructions: Filtern Sie die sflights-Tabelle nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('AA') und eine Mindestanzahl an belegten Sitzen ('50') haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid DEFAULT 'AA'
        iv_min_seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights( FOR ls_sflight IN sflights
                                             ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                               connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                               fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                               seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc ) ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc >= iv_min_seats_occ ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_seats_occ = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Filtered table should not be initial' act = lt_filtered_flights ).
    IF NOT lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be AA' exp = 'AA' act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'First entry should have >= 100 seats occupied' act = xsdbool( lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-seatsocc >= 100 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist besonders nützlich, um eine Untermenge von Daten zu extrahieren, ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden. Die Klasse ist FINAL und verwendet den VALUE-Operator zur Initialisierung der Quelltabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, FINAL, sflights, VALUE

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Fluggesellschaft und das Datum eines bestimmten Fluges (connid) aus der sflights-Tabelle unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Flug nicht gefunden wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie sflights[ KEY ... ] und den TRY...CATCH-Block für Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_result.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_details) TYPE ty_flight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_sflight_entry) = sflights[ carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                                           connid = is_flight_key-connid ].
        rs_flight_details = VALUE #( carrid = ls_sflight_entry-carrid
                                     fldate = ls_sflight_entry-fldate ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rs_flight_details = VALUE #( carrid = 'N/A' fldate = '00000000' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_details_not_found FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_details_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expression_flight( ).

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus sflights in einer hierarchischen Struktur vor, die für die Anzeige in einem cl_gui_simple_tree geeignet ist. Die Struktur soll Fluggesellschaften als Wurzelknoten und deren Flüge als Kindknoten darstellen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den notwendigen Feldern für den Tree Control (Node Key, Parent Key, Text, etc.). Nutzen Sie FOR GROUPS und VALUE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             is_folder  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_tree_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA: lv_node_key TYPE i VALUE 0.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
      LET lv_carrid_node_key = CONV lvc_nkey( ++lv_node_key ) IN
      ( node_key   = lv_carrid_node_key
        parent_key = ''
        text       = |Fluggesellschaft: { ls_flight-carrid }|
        is_folder  = abap_true )
      ( FOR ls_flight_in_group IN GROUP ls_flight
        ( node_key   = CONV lvc_nkey( ++lv_node_key )
          parent_key = lv_carrid_node_key
          text       = |Flug { ls_flight_in_group-connid } am { ls_flight_in_group-fldate DATE = USER }|
          is_folder  = abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_tree_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = lo_cut->get_flight_tree_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tree nodes table should not be initial' act = lt_tree_nodes ).

    " Check for at least one carrier node
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain carrier nodes' 
                                     act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_tree_nodes[ parent_key = '' AND is_folder = abap_true ] ) ) ).

    " Check for at least one flight node under a carrier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should contain flight nodes' 
                                     act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_tree_nodes[ parent_key IS NOT INITIAL AND is_folder = abap_false ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine FINAL-Klasse, die dynamisch eine Methode einer anderen Klasse aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den dynamischen Methodenaufruf CALL METHOD (lv_method_name).
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_message_container TYPE REF TO cl_abap_container_services.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA: ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Annahme: Methode erwartet Parameter IV_INPUT
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>kind_importing.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
      INSERT ls_parameter INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_fixed_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_input_string IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fixed_string.
    rv_string = 'Fixed String'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_input_string.
    rv_string = |Input: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus sflights nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie den GROUP BY-Zusatz in einer LOOP-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( ... ) und den GROUP SIZE-Zusatz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: ls_flight_group TYPE ty_flight_group.

    LOOP AT sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                                     connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                                     group_size = GROUP SIZE ) 
                                                     INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      ls_flight_group-carrid = ls_group_key-carrid.
      ls_flight_group-connid = ls_group_key-connid.
      ls_flight_group-flight_count = ls_group_key-group_size.
      APPEND ls_flight_group TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den verbleibenden Lagerbestand, indem Sie verbrauchte Mengen von einem Anfangsbestand subtrahieren, unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um über die Tabelle zu iterieren und die Subtraktion zu akkumulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stock_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_consumption,
        material TYPE string,
        quantity TYPE i,
      END OF ty_consumption,
      tt_consumption TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_consumption WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_remaining_stock
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_stock TYPE i
        it_consumption   TYPE tt_consumption
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_remaining_stock) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stock_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_remaining_stock.
    rv_remaining_stock = REDUCE i(
      INIT stock = iv_initial_stock
      FOR <fs_item> IN it_consumption
      NEXT stock = stock - <fs_item>-quantity
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen Wert nur dann, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, unter Verwendung des COND-Ausdrucks.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS subtract_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i
        iv_subtract_value TYPE i
        iv_condition     TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie dynamisch einen Wert von einer Komponente einer Struktur, die über ein Feldsymbol zugänglich ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie FIELD-SYMBOLS und ASSIGN COMPONENT, um dynamisch auf die Strukturkomponente zuzugreifen, und DATA() für die Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id     TYPE string,
        value  TYPE i,
        amount TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
      END OF ty_data.

    METHODS subtract_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_data
        iv_component  TYPE string
        iv_subtract_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_dynamic.
    rs_result = is_data. " Copy initial data
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE rs_result TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Check if the field symbol points to a numeric type
      IF <fs_value> IS SUPPLIED AND <fs_value> IS NUMERIC.
        DATA(lv_current_value) = <fs_value>. " Inline declaration
        SUBTRACT iv_subtract_val FROM lv_current_value.
        <fs_value> = lv_current_value.
      ELSE.
        " Handle non-numeric or unassigned component
        " (e.g., raise exception, log error)
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, in der ein spezifisches Feld das Ergebnis einer Subtraktion von einem Feld der Originaltabelle ist, unter Verwendung eines FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und DATA() für die Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item_in,
        id       TYPE string,
        quantity TYPE i,
        discount TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item_in,
      tt_item_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_in WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item_out,
        id            TYPE string,
        net_quantity  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item_out,
      tt_item_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_out WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_quantities
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_item_in
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_items) TYPE tt_item_out.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_quantities.
    rt_transformed_items = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_item IN it_items
      ( id = ls_item-id
        net_quantity = ls_item-quantity - ls_item-discount ) " Direct subtraction
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).

      ( id = 'P1' quantity = 100 discount = 10 )
      ( id = 'P2' quantity = 50  discount = 5 )

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_for_subtract=>tt_item_out(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-net_quantity exp = 90 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-net_quantity exp = 45 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_seat_difference.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > iv_threshold
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Summe der freien Sitze (seatsmax - seatsocc) unter Verwendung von GROUP BY und REDUCE.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT mit GROUP BY und den REDUCE-Operator für die Aggregation der Differenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
        carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
        free_seats_total TYPE i,
      END OF ty_sflight_agg,
      tt_sflight_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_free_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_free_seats) TYPE tt_sflight_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_free_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) 
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        free_seats_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum_free = 0 FOR <fs_group_item> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT sum_free = sum_free + ( <fs_group_item>-seatsmax - <fs_group_item>-seatsocc ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 50  seatsmax = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 180 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 10  seatsmax = 100 )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Testdaten aus SFLIGHT löschen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA').
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_subtract( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-free_seats_total exp = 100 + 100 ). " (200-100) + (150-50)

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-free_seats_total exp = 20 + 90 ). " (200-180) + (100-10)
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die mächtigen GROUP BY- und REDUCE-Operatoren für die Aggregation von Daten. Zuerst werden Daten aus SFLIGHT gelesen, dann werden sie nach 'carrid' gruppiert. Innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird REDUCE verwendet, um die Summe der freien Sitze (berechnet durch Subtraktion) zu akkumulieren. Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen vor einem gegebenen Datum liegt.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Differenz zwischen zwei Mengenfeldern aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, unter Verwendung eines FOR-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, und DATA() für die Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_diff,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        empty_seats TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_diff,
      tt_flight_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_empty_seats_for_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_empty_seats) TYPE tt_flight_diff.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_empty_seats_for_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_empty_seats = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate
        empty_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_empty_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_empty_seats_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 180 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 195 seatsmax = 200 )
    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA').
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_empty_seats FOR TESTING.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_diff( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_empty_seats_for_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_result-empty_seats exp = 100 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_result-empty_seats exp = 20 ).

    DATA(ls_ua_result) = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_result-empty_seats exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_empty_seats_no_data.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA'). " Ensure table is empty
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_diff( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_empty_seats_for_flights( ).

CLASS zcl_textedit_filter_lines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_text_by_keyword
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
        iv_keyword  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_filter_lines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_text_by_keyword.
    DATA(lv_full_text) TYPE string.
    io_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_full_text ).

    SPLIT lv_full_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_all_lines.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die den Inhalt eines `cl_gui_textedit`-Controls in eine interne Tabelle von Zeilen umwandelt und umgekehrt. Verwenden Sie dabei `VALUE` und `FOR` für die Transformation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_text_as_stream`, `SPLIT`, `VALUE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_line_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS text_to_lines
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lines) TYPE string_table.

    METHODS lines_to_text
      IMPORTING
        it_lines    TYPE string_table
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_line_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD text_to_lines.
    DATA(lv_full_text) TYPE string.
    io_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_full_text ).

    SPLIT lv_full_text AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE rt_lines.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD lines_to_text.
    DATA(lv_full_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <line> IN it_lines
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <line> ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && <line> )
    ).
    io_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_full_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( ).
    DATA(lo_mock_textedit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_textedit_line_converter( ).

    DATA(lt_original_lines) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Erste Zeile' )
      ( 'Zweite Zeile' )
      ( 'Dritte Zeile' )
    ).

    lo_cut->lines_to_text( it_lines = lt_original_lines io_textedit = lo_mock_textedit ).

    DATA(lt_retrieved_lines) = lo_cut->text_to_lines( io_textedit = lo_mock_textedit ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_retrieved_lines ) exp = lines( lt_original_lines ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_retrieved_lines[ 1 ] exp = lt_original_lines[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_retrieved_lines[ 2 ] exp = lt_original_lines[ 2 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_retrieved_lines[ 3 ] exp = lt_original_lines[ 3 ] ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `text_to_lines` verwendet `get_text_as_stream` und `SPLIT` zur einfachen Umwandlung. `lines_to_text` demonstriert den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle von Zeilen effizient und kompakt zu einem einzigen String zusammenzufügen, wobei `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` für Zeilenumbrüche sorgt. Dies ist eine moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art der String-Manipulation.
keywords: cl_gui_textedit, get_text_as_stream, set_text_as_stream, SPLIT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, String Manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die den Inhalt eines `cl_gui_abapedit`-Controls ausliest und alle Kommentare (Zeilen, die mit `*` oder `"` beginnen) entfernt. Verwenden Sie dabei `FOR` und `COND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_text_as_stream`, `SPLIT` und `FOR` mit `COND` zur Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_remove_comments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_comments
      IMPORTING
        io_abapedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_code_without_comments) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_remove_comments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_comments.
    DATA(lv_full_code) TYPE string.
    io_abapedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_full_code ).

    DATA(lt_all_lines) TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT lv_full_code AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_all_lines.

    rt_code_without_comments = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <line> IN lt_all_lines
      WHERE ( NOT <line> CS '*' AND NOT <line> CS '"' )
      ( <line> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_display_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

CLASS zcl_textedit_display_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_airlines.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_textedit
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_container.

    SELECT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(lt_scarr_data).

    DATA(lv_display_text) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = 'Fluggesellschaften aus SCARR:' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR ls_scarr IN lt_scarr_data
      NEXT s = s && |
        { ls_scarr-carrid } - { ls_scarr-carrname }
      |
    ).

    mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( lv_display_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_check_select_star DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        io_abapedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_abapedit_check_select_star IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_for_select_star.
    DATA(lv_full_code) TYPE string.
    io_abapedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = lv_full_code ).

    rv_warning_message = COND string(
      WHEN contains( val = lv_full_code sub = 'SELECT *' case = abap_false )
      THEN 'Warnung: Der Code enthält SELECT * Anweisungen. Bitte prüfen Sie auf Performance-Auswirkungen.'
      ELSE ''

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

                                FOR flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Demonstrieren Sie dies mit einer einfachen Klasse, die verschiedene 'Aktionen' ausführt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_actions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS action_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS action_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_action
      IMPORTING
        iv_action_name TYPE string
        iv_input       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_actions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD action_a.
    rv_output = |Action A executed with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD action_b.
    rv_output = |Action B executed with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_dynamic_action.
    DATA: lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE iv_action_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF ME
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method { iv_action_name } not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_action_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_action_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_action_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_action_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_actions( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_action( iv_action_name = 'ACTION_A' iv_input = 'Test Input' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Action A executed with: Test Input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_action_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_actions( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_action( iv_action_name = 'ACTION_B' iv_input = 'Another Input' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Action B executed with: Another Input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_action_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_actions( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_action( iv_action_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_ACTION' iv_input = 'Invalid' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string( substring = 'Error' in = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf ermöglicht es, die aufzurufende Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen, was für flexible Architekturen und Plugin-Szenarien nützlich ist. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CALL METHOD, Dynamic Call

Instructions: Fragen Sie Attribute eines ABAP-Programms oder einer Klasse mithilfe der `cl_ci_query_attributes`-Klasse ab, um beispielsweise die letzte Änderungszeit oder den Autor zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes_for_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_object_attribute,
             attribute_name  TYPE string,
             attribute_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_object_attribute,
           tt_object_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_object_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_object_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE trobjtype
        iv_object_name TYPE trobj_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_object_attributes
      RAISING
        cx_ci_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_object_attributes.
    DATA: ls_attributes TYPE s_ci_attributes,
          lt_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_attributes_tab.

    cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes_for_object(
      EXPORTING
        i_object_type = iv_object_type
        i_object_name = iv_object_name
      IMPORTING
        e_attributes  = ls_attributes
        et_attributes = lt_attributes
    ).

    " Convert structure to internal table for easier consumption
    rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR attribute IN lt_attributes
                             ( attribute_name = attribute-attribute_name,
                               attribute_value = attribute-attribute_value ) ).

    " Add some common attributes from ls_attributes if needed, e.g., last changed by/on
    APPEND VALUE ty_object_attribute( attribute_name = 'LAST_CHANGED_BY' attribute_value = ls_attributes-aedat ) TO rt_attributes.
    APPEND VALUE ty_object_attribute( attribute_name = 'LAST_CHANGED_ON' attribute_value = ls_attributes-aetim ) TO rt_attributes.
    APPEND VALUE ty_object_attribute( attribute_name = 'AUTHOR' attribute_value = ls_attributes-uname ) TO rt_attributes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_text_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_id.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag 2' )
    ).

    TRY.
        rv_text = lt_data[ id = iv_id ]-text.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_text = 'ID nicht gefunden'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_text_by_id_default.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Eintrag 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Eintrag 2' )
    ).

    rv_text = VALUE #( lt_data[ id = iv_id ]-text DEFAULT 'Standardtext' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR`-Loop.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group,
           tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                 ( carrid = CORRESPONDING #( flight )-carrid,
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, und extrahieren Sie bei Erfolg Teile des Strings. Verwenden Sie reguläre Ausdrücke mit `FIND`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND REGEX` und die `MATCH OFFSET`/`MATCH LENGTH` Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_result,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
             value  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_match_result,
           tt_match_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_match_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_numbers_from_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE tt_match_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers_from_text.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_text RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_match_results
                           ( offset = match-offset,
                             length = match-length,
                             value  = iv_text+match-offset(match-length) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Transformation auf einer internen Tabelle durch, bei der jeder Eintrag basierend auf einer komplexen Logik modifiziert wird. Verwenden Sie den `MAP`-Operator (implizit durch `FOR` mit Zuweisung).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer Zuweisung zu einer neuen Tabelle und komplexer Logik innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_original_data,
           tt_original_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_data,
             id       TYPE i,
             new_value TYPE i,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_data,
           tt_transformed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_data
      IMPORTING
        it_original_data TYPE tt_original_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE tt_transformed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_data.
    rt_transformed_data = VALUE #( FOR original_line IN it_original_data
                                   LET lv_new_value = original_line-value * 2 IN
                                   ( id        = original_line-id,
                                     new_value = lv_new_value,
                                     status    = COND string(
                                                   WHEN lv_new_value > 100 THEN 'High'
                                                   WHEN lv_new_value > 50 THEN 'Medium'
                                                   WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Low' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( id = 1 value = 30 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Medium' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-new_value exp = 120 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 2 ]-status exp = 'High' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 3 ]-new_value exp = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_transformed[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Low' ).

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_carrier,
           tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_fae_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = @it_carriers-carrid.
    ENDIF.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
