Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Objekten unterschiedlichen Typs dynamisch basierend auf ihrem Laufzeittyp. Nutzen Sie `CASE TYPE OF` für die Typunterscheidung.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und implementieren Sie es in verschiedenen Klassen. Verwenden Sie dann `CASE TYPE OF` auf die Interface-Referenzen.
solution:
INTERFACE lif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS lcl_circle DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES lif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD lif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD lif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Kreis'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_square DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES lif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_side TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_side = iv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD lif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_side * mv_side.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD lif_shape~get_type.
    rv_type = 'Quadrat'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO lif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE tt_shapes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      CASE TYPE OF lo_shape.
        WHEN TYPE lcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
          APPEND |Kreis: Fläche = { lo_circle->lif_shape~get_area( ) }| TO rt_results.
        WHEN TYPE lcl_square INTO DATA(lo_square).
          APPEND |Quadrat: Fläche = { lo_square->lif_shape~get_area( ) }| TO rt_results.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |Unbekannte Form: Typ = { lo_shape->lif_shape~get_type( ) }| TO rt_results.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shape_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shape_processing.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE zcl_shape_processor=>tt_shapes.

    APPEND NEW lcl_circle( 5 ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW lcl_square( 4 ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Ergebnisse vorhanden sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Kreis: Fläche = 78.53975' act = lt_results[ 1 ] msg = 'Erstes Ergebnis sollte Kreis sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Quadrat: Fläche = 16' act = lt_results[ 2 ] msg = 'Zweites Ergebnis sollte Quadrat sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die typsichere Verarbeitung von Objekten zur Laufzeit. Es ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für Polymorphie, bei dem der konkrete Typ eines Objekts in einer Hierarchie zur Laufzeit ermittelt und entsprechend behandelt werden kann, ohne Downcasts manuell durchführen zu müssen. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, RTTI, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Interface

CLASS zcl_table_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             flight_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seats_occ TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_source_line.
    TYPES: tt_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             departure_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupied_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_line.
    TYPES: tt_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_source_flights MAPPING carrier_id   = flight_id
                                                                  connection_id = flight_num
                                                                  departure_date = flight_date
                                                                  occupied_seats = seats_occ
                                          BASE ( status = 'NEW' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie für Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und der maximalen Kapazität (`max_seats`) eine Kategorie (z.B. 'Große Airline', 'Kleine Airline', 'Regionalflug').
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb einer `LOOP` über die Flugdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats   TYPE sflight-max_seats,
             category    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES: tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, max_seats
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      DATA(ls_category_line) = VALUE ty_flight_category(
                                  carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                                  connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                                  fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                                  max_seats = ls_sflight-max_seats ).

      CASE ls_sflight-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'. "Lufthansa
          IF ls_sflight-max_seats > 200.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Große Airline (LH)'.
          ELSE.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Regionale Airline (LH)'.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN 'AA'. "American Airlines
          IF ls_sflight-max_seats > 300.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Große Airline (AA)'.
          ELSE.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Mittlere Airline (AA)'.
          ENDIF.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          IF ls_sflight-max_seats < 100.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Kleine Airline'.
          ELSE.
            ls_category_line-category = 'Unbekannte Airline'.
          ENDIF.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_category_line TO rt_categorized_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_categorization.
    " Testdaten in sflight sicherstellen oder mocken

    DATA: lv_count TYPE i.

          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 100 max_seats = 250 )
          ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 50 max_seats = 150 )
          ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 350 seatsocc = 200 max_seats = 350 )

CLASS zcl_combined_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             value  TYPE decfloat16,
             status TYPE string,
             comment TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_with_status
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
        iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_combined_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_with_status.
    DATA(ls_base_target) = SWITCH ty_target_data(
                              iv_status_code
                              WHEN 1 THEN VALUE ty_target_data( status = 'ACTIVE' comment = 'Initial aktiv' )
                              WHEN 2 THEN VALUE ty_target_data( status = 'PENDING' comment = 'Wartet auf Freigabe' )
                              ELSE VALUE ty_target_data( status = 'UNKNOWN' comment = 'Unbekannter Status' ) ).

    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( ls_base_target ) is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) und führen Sie unterschiedliche Aktionen basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus, indem Sie die Daten in separate Tabellen aufteilen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT` Schleife mit einer `CASE`-Anweisung innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_splitter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_split_flights,
             lh_flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
             aa_flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
             other_flights TYPE tt_flight_data,
           END OF ty_split_flights.

    METHODS split_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_split_flights) TYPE ty_split_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_splitter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      CASE ls_flight-carrid.
        WHEN 'LH'.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rs_split_flights-lh_flights.
        WHEN 'AA'.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rs_split_flights-aa_flights.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rs_split_flights-other_flights.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung einer internen Tabelle durch, indem Sie Felder aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle kopieren, die nur eine Untermenge der Felder enthält, aber mit übereinstimmenden Namen.

CLASS zcl_table_updater DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_item,
             key_field TYPE i,
             data_field1 TYPE string,
             data_field2 TYPE string,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_source_item.
    TYPES: tt_source_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_item,
             key_field TYPE i,
             data_field1 TYPE string,
             data_field3 TYPE string,
             last_updated TYPE timestampl,
           END OF ty_target_item.
    TYPES: tt_target_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS update_target_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_updates TYPE tt_source_items
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table TYPE tt_target_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_updater IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_target_table.
    " Initialisieren der Zieltabelle für den Test, falls leer
    IF ct_target_table IS INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 1 data_field1 = 'Old Data 1' data_field3 = 'Old Data A' last_updated = '20230101000000' ) TO ct_target_table.
      APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 2 data_field1 = 'Old Data 2' data_field3 = 'Old Data B' last_updated = '20230101000000' ) TO ct_target_table.
    ENDIF.

    MODIFY TABLE ct_target_table FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE it_source_updates.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_update.
    DATA: lt_target TYPE zcl_table_updater=>tt_target_items.
    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_table_updater( ).

    " Initialdaten für Zieltabelle
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 1 data_field1 = 'Initial 1' data_field3 = 'Initial A' last_updated = '20230101000000' ) TO lt_target.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 2 data_field1 = 'Initial 2' data_field3 = 'Initial B' last_updated = '20230101000000' ) TO lt_target.

    DATA: lt_updates TYPE zcl_table_updater=>tt_source_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 1 data_field1 = 'Updated 1' data_field2 = 'Ignored' timestamp = '20231204100000' ) TO lt_updates.
    APPEND VALUE #( key_field = 3 data_field1 = 'New Data 3' data_field2 = 'Also Ignored' timestamp = '20231204110000' ) TO lt_updates.

    lo_updater->update_target_table( CHANGING ct_target_table = lt_target
                                     IMPORTING it_source_updates = lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 Zeilen in der Zieltabelle sein' ).

    DATA(ls_item1) = lt_target[ key_field = 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-data_field1 exp = 'Updated 1' msg = 'data_field1 von Item 1 sollte aktualisiert sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-data_field3 exp = 'Initial A' msg = 'data_field3 von Item 1 sollte unverändert sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item1-last_updated exp = '20231204100000' msg = 'last_updated von Item 1 sollte aktualisiert sein' ).

    DATA(ls_item2) = lt_target[ key_field = 2 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item2-data_field1 exp = 'Initial 2' msg = 'data_field1 von Item 2 sollte unverändert sein' ).

    DATA(ls_item3) = lt_target[ key_field = 3 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item3-data_field1 exp = 'New Data 3' msg = 'data_field1 von Item 3 sollte neu sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_item3-last_updated exp = '20231204110000' msg = 'last_updated von Item 3 sollte neu sein' ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie dabei ein zusätzliches Feld in der Zielstruktur mit einem Standardwert, wenn es in der Datenbank nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `BASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_default_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_enriched,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_enriched.
    TYPES: tt_flight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_enriched_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_data) TYPE tt_flight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_default_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_enriched_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    rt_enriched_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( CORRESPONDING ty_flight_enriched(
                                     BASE ( status = 'PLANNED' )
                                     ls_sflight
                                     MAPPING currency = curr ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (Auftragstyp und Wert) und geben Sie eine entsprechende Statusbeschreibung zurück. Nutzen Sie die `CASE`-Anweisung mit `WHEN TYPE` und `WHERE`.

CLASS zcl_order_status_evaluator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_data,
             order_type TYPE c LENGTH 4,
             order_value TYPE decfloat16,
             is_urgent TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_order_data.

    METHODS evaluate_order_status
      IMPORTING
        is_order TYPE ty_order_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_evaluator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD evaluate_order_status.
    CASE is_order-order_type.
      WHEN 'SALE'.
        IF is_order-order_value > 1000 AND is_order-is_urgent = abap_true.
          rv_status_text = 'Verkauf: Dringend & Hochwertig'.
        ELSE IF is_order-order_value > 500.
          rv_status_text = 'Verkauf: Hochwertig'.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_text = 'Verkauf: Standard'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'RETN'.
        IF is_order-order_value > 200.
          rv_status_text = 'Retoure: Großvolumig'.
        ELSE.
          rv_status_text = 'Retoure: Kleinvolumig'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_text = 'Unbekannter Auftragstyp'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie große Mengen von Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT mithilfe eines Cursors und verarbeiten Sie diese zeilenweise mit modernen ABAP-Syntaxelementen. Filtern Sie dabei Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_cursor_modern DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE spfli-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE spfli-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_cursor_modern IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, p~cityfrom, p~cityto
        FROM sflight AS s
        JOIN spfli AS p ON s~carrid = p~carrid AND s~connid = p~connid
        WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrier.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_reduce_operator=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '200.50' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_flights ).

      act = lv_total
      exp = '350.50'
      msg = 'Total price should be 350.50'

Er ist Teil der funktionalen Programmierparadigmen in ABAP und macht explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen oft überflüssig, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Tagen zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln unter Berücksichtigung von Zeitzonen, indem Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract` und `cl_abap_tstmp=>move`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_datetime_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl
        iv_tzone  TYPE timezone
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_datetime_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between_timestamps.
    DATA: lv_tstmp1_local TYPE timestampl,
          lv_tstmp2_local TYPE timestampl.

    " Convert timestamps to local time zone
    cl_abap_tstmp=>move(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp_utc = iv_tstmp1
        tzone     = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        tstmp_l   = lv_tstmp1_local
    ).
    cl_abap_tstmp=>move(
      EXPORTING
        tstmp_utc = iv_tstmp2
        tzone     = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        tstmp_l   = lv_tstmp2_local
    ).

    " Calculate difference in seconds
    DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>subtract(
                               tstmp1 = lv_tstmp2_local
                               tstmp2 = lv_tstmp1_local
                             ).

    " Convert seconds to days (86400 seconds in a day)
    rv_days = lv_diff_seconds / 86400.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_days_between_timestamps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_days_between_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_datetime_diff( ).

    " Example timestamps (UTC)
    DATA(lv_tstmp_start) = '20251201000000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_tstmp_end)   = '20251203000000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_timezone)    = 'CET'. " Central European Time

    DATA(lv_days) = lo_cut->get_days_between_timestamps(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_start
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_end
      iv_tzone  = lv_timezone
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_days
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Difference should be 2 days'
    ).

    " Test with same timestamp
    lv_days = lo_cut->get_days_between_timestamps(
      iv_tstmp1 = lv_tstmp_start
      iv_tstmp2 = lv_tstmp_start
      iv_tzone  = lv_timezone
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_days
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Difference should be 0 days for same timestamp'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet umfangreiche Funktionalität für die Arbeit mit Zeitstempeln, einschließlich der Umrechnung zwischen UTC und lokalen Zeitzonen sowie der Berechnung von Differenzen. Dies ist der moderne und empfohlene Weg, um mit Datums- und Zeitberechnungen in ABAP umzugehen, insbesondere wenn Zeitzonen eine Rolle spielen.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Timestamp, Time Zone, Date/Time Calculation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge in einer internen Tabelle nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe, indem Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( key1 = field1 key2 = field2 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_key.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                        connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      count  = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_group_by_loop=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251201' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_loop( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_grouped_aa17) = lt_grouped[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_grouped_aa17-count exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, indem Sie `CREATE DATA` und Feld-Symbole verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
        it_data_rows   TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    " Define components dynamically
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ). " All fields as string for simplicity
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create structure and table type
    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                p_line_type = lr_struct_descr
                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                                p_unique = abap_false ).

    " Create dynamic internal table
    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).

    " Fill dynamic table
    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_data_row).
      DATA(lt_row_values) = cl_abap_string_utilities=>split(
                                iv_string = lv_data_row
                                iv_delimiter = ',' ).

      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).

      DO lines( lt_components ) TIMES.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT sy-index OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_field> = lt_row_values[ sy-index ].
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND <fs_line> TO <fs_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).

    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_rows) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Value1A,Value1B' ) ( 'Value2A,Value2B' ) ).

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
                                 it_field_names = lt_field_names
                                 it_data_rows   = lt_data_rows ).

    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    ASSIGN <fs_table>[ 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_line> ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'Value1A' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 'Value1B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen und Strukturen zur Laufzeit ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature, das mit `CREATE DATA` und den RTTI-Klassen (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) realisiert wird. Dies ermöglicht hochflexible Programme, die sich an unbekannte Datenstrukturen anpassen können. Die Verwendung von Feld-Symbolen ist dabei unerlässlich.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis von Flügen in einer internen Tabelle mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator und der Division.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `lines()` für die Anzahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                     NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( it_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_average_price FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_average_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_price( ).

    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_average_price=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '300.00' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '200.00' ).

    " Test with empty table
    CLEAR lt_flights.
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den `REDUCE`-Operator zur Summenbildung mit der Funktion `lines()` zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Einträge, um den Durchschnittspreis zu berechnen. Dies zeigt die Effizienz und Lesbarkeit moderner ABAP-Operatoren für mathematische Operationen auf internen Tabellen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Internal Tables, lines()

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge, deren Auslastung als 'hoch' eingestuft wird, wobei die Logik zur Bestimmung der 'hohen Auslastung' in einer separaten Methode gekapselt ist.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_high) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_high_occupancy.
    IF iv_seatsocc_f > 150.
      rv_is_high = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_high = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_high_occupancy_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE me->is_high_occupancy( seatsocc_f = seatsocc_f ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,

hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte aus der Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE s_seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE s_seatsocc(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc_f
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total seats should not be zero for LH' act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
    " A more precise test would require mocking sflight data or knowing expected sum.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die grundlegende Struktur einer Methode in einem ABAP RAP Behavior Handler für eine Entität, die Instanz-Features (z.B. Read-Only-Felder) definiert.
hint: Fokus auf die Signatur `FOR INSTANCE FEATURES` und den Zugriff auf `entities` und `result` Parameter.
solution:
CLASS zcl_my_rap_handler DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_abap_behavior_handler.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    " Beispiel für eine Methode, die Instanz-Features definiert
    METHODS get_instance_features FOR INSTANCE FEATURES
      IMPORTING
        entities       FOR ENTITY zmy_entity IN LOCAL MODE
      RESULT
        result         FOR INSTANCE FEATURES zmy_entity.

    " Weitere RAP-Methoden (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, SAVE) würden hier folgen
    " ...
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_rap_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_instance_features.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde 'zmy_entity' eine CDS-Entität sein
    " und 'status' ein Feld dieser Entität.
    " Hier wird ein Dummy-Struktur verwendet, um das Prinzip zu zeigen.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_zmy_entity_tky,
             key_field TYPE string,
             status    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_zmy_entity_tky.

    DATA: lt_entities_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_zmy_entity_tky WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: ls_entity_dummy LIKE LINE OF lt_entities_dummy.

    " Dummy-Daten für Demonstration
    ls_entity_dummy-key_field = '1'.
    ls_entity_dummy-status = 'COMPLETED'.
    APPEND ls_entity_dummy TO lt_entities_dummy.

    ls_entity_dummy-key_field = '2'.
    ls_entity_dummy-status = 'NEW'.
    APPEND ls_entity_dummy TO lt_entities_dummy.

    LOOP AT entities ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_entity>).
      " Annahme: <fs_entity> hat ein Feld 'status'
      " In RAP würde <fs_entity> direkt auf die Entitätsfelder zugreifen.
      READ TABLE lt_entities_dummy INTO DATA(ls_current_entity) WITH KEY key_field = <fs_entity>-%tky-key_field.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_current_entity-status = 'COMPLETED'.
        APPEND VALUE #( %tky = <fs_entity>-%tky
                        %field-description = if_abap_behv=>mk-read_only ) TO result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_instance_features FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_instance_features.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_my_rap_handler( ).

    " Dummy-Daten für den Test, da ein vollständiger RAP-Kontext nicht simuliert werden kann.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_tky,
             key_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entity_tky.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entity_for_rap,
             %tky TYPE ty_entity_tky,
           END OF ty_entity_for_rap.
    TYPES: tt_entity_for_rap TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entity_for_rap WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_entities_input) = VALUE tt_entity_for_rap(
      ( %tky = VALUE ty_entity_tky( key_field = '1' ) )
      ( %tky = VALUE ty_entity_tky( key_field = '2' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_instance_features( lt_entities_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    " Überprüfen, ob für den 'COMPLETED'-Eintrag ein Read-Only-Feature gesetzt wurde
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'One entity should have read-only description' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check key of read-only entity' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-%tky-key_field exp = '1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Beispielklasse zeigt die grundlegende Struktur eines Behavior Handlers im ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP). Methoden wie `get_instance_features` werden vom RAP-Framework aufgerufen, um dynamische Eigenschaften von Entitätsinstanzen (z.B. ob ein Feld bearbeitbar ist) zu steuern. `cl_abap_behavior_handler` ist die Basisklasse für solche Handler.
keywords: RAP, Behavior Handler, cl_abap_behavior_handler, Object Orientation, Entity, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers (z.B. 'AA') und erstellen Sie dann eine neue Tabelle mit nur der Flugnummer und dem Abflugort dieser gefilterten Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck, um Filtern und Transformieren in einem Schritt zu erledigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_combine DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_and_transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_transformed) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_combine IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_transform_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_transformed = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = ls_sflight-connid, cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_and_transform FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_and_transform.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_combine( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_and_transform_flights( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for AA' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First entry should not be initial' act = lt_result[ 1 ] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Check cityfrom of first entry' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-cityfrom exp = 'NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` in einem `VALUE` Ausdruck ermöglicht effizientes Filtern und Transformieren von Daten in einem einzigen, deklarativen Schritt. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und moderne Technik für die Bearbeitung interner Tabellen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Transformation, Chaining, Deklarativ

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die in einer Liste von bevorzugten Abflugorten enthalten sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `IN` Operator im `WHERE`-Teil des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks mit einer internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_cities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF s_city WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_cities
      IMPORTING
        it_preferred_cities TYPE tt_cities
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_cities.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom IN it_preferred_cities ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_in_operator FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_in_operator_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_in_operator.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_in_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_cities) = VALUE zcl_filter_in_operator=>tt_cities( ( 'FRANKFURT' ) ( 'NEW YORK' ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_cities( lt_cities ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All filtered flights should be from preferred cities' act = lines( FILTER #( lt_result WHERE cityfrom <> 'FRANKFURT' AND cityfrom <> 'NEW YORK' ) ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_in_operator_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_in_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_cities) = VALUE zcl_filter_in_operator=>tt_cities( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_cities( lt_cities ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should be empty for empty city list' act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 kann der `IN` Operator im `WHERE`-Teil von `FILTER`-Ausdrücken verwendet werden, um zu prüfen, ob ein Feldwert in einer internen Tabelle von Werten enthalten ist. Dies vereinfacht die Filterung basierend auf dynamischen Listen erheblich.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, IN Operator, Dynamic Filtering, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP DELETE Request auf eine Ressource aus und prüfen Sie, ob der Statuscode '204 No Content' zurückgegeben wurde, was einen erfolgreichen Löschvorgang ohne Rückgabeinhalt signalisiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_rest_client` für den DELETE-Aufruf und `cl_rest_status_code=>no_content` zur Statusprüfung. Verwenden Sie Dependency Injection für Testbarkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_delete_204 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rest_client. " For dependency injection
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_resource
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_204 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ). " Dummy URL
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_resource.
    TRY.
        mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
        DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          " Log error or handle other status codes
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
        " Handle REST client exceptions
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_204 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_204.
    CLASS lcl_mock_rest_client DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_rest_client.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
        METHODS if_rest_client~delete REDEFINITION.
        METHODS get_status REDEFINITION.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_mock_status TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_rest_client IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        super->constructor( io_http_client ).
        mv_mock_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content. " Simulate 204
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_rest_client~delete.
        " No action needed, status is predefined
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD get_status.
        rv_status = mv_mock_status.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_http_client_dummy) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://dummy.com' ).
    DATA(lo_mock_rest_client) = NEW lcl_mock_rest_client( lo_http_client_dummy ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_delete_204( io_rest_client = lo_mock_rest_client ).

Durch Dependency Injection im Konstruktor wird die Testbarkeit der Klasse gewährleistet, indem ein Mock-REST-Client für Unit-Tests verwendet werden kann.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_200 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP DELETE Request aus und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass die zu löschende Ressource nicht gefunden wird (Statuscode '404 Not Found').
hint: Prüfen Sie den Statuscode gegen `cl_rest_status_code=>not_found` in einem `CASE`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_delete_404 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rest_client.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_resource_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_404 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ).
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_resource_safe.
    TRY.
        mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
        DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
        CASE lv_status.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
            rv_message = 'Ressource erfolgreich gelöscht oder war bereits nicht vorhanden.'.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>not_found.
            rv_message = 'Fehler: Ressource nicht gefunden.'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = |Fehler: Unerwarteter Status { lv_status }|.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
        rv_message = |Exception: { lx_rest->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP DELETE Request aus und behandeln Sie den Fall, dass der Benutzer nicht authentifiziert ist (Statuscode '401 Unauthorized').
hint: Prüfen Sie den Statuscode gegen `cl_rest_status_code=>unauthorized`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_delete_401 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rest_client.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_resource_auth
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_401 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ).
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_resource_auth.
    TRY.
        mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
        DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
        CASE lv_status.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
            rv_message = 'Ressource erfolgreich gelöscht.'.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>unauthorized.
            rv_message = 'Fehler: Nicht autorisiert. Bitte melden Sie sich an.'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = |Fehler: Unerwarteter Status { lv_status }|.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
        rv_message = |Exception: { lx_rest->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_dynamic_url DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Löschen Sie mehrere Ressourcen in einer Schleife und sammeln Sie die Ergebnisse (Erfolg/Fehler) in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife und `VALUE` für die Ergebnisaggregation. Behandeln Sie jeden DELETE-Aufruf einzeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_delete_multiple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_delete_result,
             resource_path TYPE string,
             success       TYPE abap_bool,
             message       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_delete_result.
    TYPES tt_delete_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_delete_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    INTERFACES if_rest_client.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_multiple_resources
      IMPORTING
        it_resource_paths TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_delete_results.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_multiple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ).
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_multiple_resources.
    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR path IN it_resource_paths
                          ( resource_path = path
                            ( LET lv_success = abap_false
                                  lv_message = '' IN
                                TRY.
                                    mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( path ).
                                    DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
                                    IF lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
                                      lv_success = abap_true.
                                      lv_message = 'Erfolgreich gelöscht.'.
                                    ELSE.
                                      lv_message = |Fehler: Status { lv_status }|.
                                    ENDIF.
                                  CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
                                    lv_message = |Exception: { lx_rest->get_text( ) }|.
                                ENDTRY.
                                success = lv_success
                                message = lv_message ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_delete_multiple.
    CLASS lcl_mock_rest_client DEFINITION INHERITING FROM cl_rest_client.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
        METHODS if_rest_client~delete REDEFINITION.
        METHODS get_status REDEFINITION.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_mock_status TYPE i.
        DATA mt_paths_to_fail TYPE string_table.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_mock_rest_client IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        super->constructor( io_http_client ).
        mv_mock_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content. " Default success
        APPEND '/flights/fail' TO mt_paths_to_fail.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_rest_client~delete.
        IF line_exists( mt_paths_to_fail[ table_line = iv_resource_path ] ).
          mv_mock_status = cl_rest_status_code=>not_found. " Simulate failure for specific path
        ELSE.
          mv_mock_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD get_status.
        rv_status = mv_mock_status.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_http_client_dummy) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://dummy.com' ).
    DATA(lo_mock_rest_client) = NEW lcl_mock_rest_client( lo_http_client_dummy ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_delete_multiple( io_rest_client = lo_mock_rest_client ).

    DATA(lt_paths) = VALUE string_table( ( '/flights/001' ) ( '/flights/fail' ) ( '/flights/003' ) ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->delete_multiple_resources( lt_paths ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_result_ok) = lt_results[ resource_path = '/flights/001' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_ok-success exp = abap_true ).

    DATA(ls_result_fail) = lt_results[ resource_path = '/flights/fail' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_fail-success exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_result_fail-message exp = 'Fehler: Status 404' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Implementierung für Batch-Operationen und die direkte Erstellung der Ergebnis-Tabelle.

    METHODS delete_with_custom_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_path TYPE string

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.

    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.

      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.

  METHOD delete_with_custom_header.
    TRY.
        mo_rest_client->get_http_client( )->request->set_header_field(
          name  = 'X-Custom-ID'
          value = iv_custom_id
        ).
        mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
        DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_http_dest_error INTO DATA(lx_http_dest).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_case_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rest_client.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_and_handle_status
      IMPORTING

    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_case_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ).
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_and_handle_status.
    TRY.
        mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
        DATA(lv_status) = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
        CASE lv_status.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
            rv_message = 'Ressource erfolgreich gelöscht.'.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>not_found.
            rv_message = 'Ressource existiert nicht und konnte nicht gelöscht werden.'.
          WHEN cl_rest_status_code=>forbidden.
            rv_message = 'Keine Berechtigung zum Löschen dieser Ressource.'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: Status { lv_status }|.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
        rv_message = |REST Client Exception: { lx_rest->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP DELETE Request mit einer einfachen Wiederholungslogik (Retry-Mechanismus) für den Fall, dass ein temporärer Fehler (z.B. '503 Service Unavailable') auftritt. Begrenzen Sie die Anzahl der Wiederholungsversuche.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `DO...ENDDO`-Schleife mit `TRY...CATCH` und `WAIT UP TO` für die Verzögerung zwischen den Versuchen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_delete_retry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_rest_client.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client OPTIONAL.
    METHODS delete_with_retry
      IMPORTING
        iv_resource_path TYPE string
        iv_max_retries   TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_rest_client TYPE REF TO if_rest_client.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_delete_retry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_rest_client IS SUPPLIED.
      mo_rest_client = io_rest_client.
    ELSE.
      DATA(lo_http_client) = cl_http_client=>create_by_url( 'http://example.com' ).
      mo_rest_client = NEW cl_rest_client( lo_http_client ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_with_retry.
    DATA lv_retries TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_status TYPE i.

    DO iv_max_retries + 1 TIMES. " +1 for initial attempt
      TRY.
          mo_rest_client->if_rest_client~delete( iv_resource_path ).
          lv_status = mo_rest_client->get_status( ).
          IF lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>no_content OR lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>ok.
            rv_success = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ELSEIF lv_status = cl_rest_status_code=>service_unavailable AND lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
            " Log retry attempt
            WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS. " Wait before retrying
          ELSE.
            " Permanent error or max retries reached
            rv_success = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_rest_client_exception INTO DATA(lx_rest).
          IF lv_retries < iv_max_retries.
            " Log exception and retry
            WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
          ELSE.
            rv_success = abap_false.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
      lv_retries = lv_retries + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_success = abap_false. " Should only be reached if all retries fail
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES ty_flight_infos TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_infos) TYPE ty_flight_infos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_infos = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( connid > '0100' )
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsocc, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte, klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn eine ungültige Flugnummer übergeben wird, und fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt, und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ... und TRY ... CATCH.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_id DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_invalid_flight_id.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_id.

    METHODS process_flight_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight_id.
    IF iv_connid IS INITIAL OR iv_connid = '0000'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_id
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_id=>default.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_id.
    TRY.
        validate_flight_id( iv_connid ).
        rv_message = |Flight ID { iv_connid } is valid.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_id INTO DATA(lx_invalid_id).
        rv_message = |Error: { lx_invalid_id->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->process_flight_id( '0400' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Passagierauslastung für eine Liste von Flügen unter Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator, um die Summe zu berechnen, und teilen Sie dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES ty_flight_occupancies TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_flight_occupancies
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupancy.
    DATA(lv_total_occupied) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
    DATA(lv_total_max) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight IN it_flights NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax ).

    IF lv_total_max > 0.
      rv_average = ( lv_total_occupied / lv_total_max ) * 100.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_average=>ty_flight_occupancies(
      ( seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 200 )
      ( seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupancy( lt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '50.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE zcl_math_average=>ty_flight_occupancies( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_occupancy( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des REDUCE-Operators zur Aggregation mit Inline-Deklarationen ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Berechnung von Durchschnittswerten, ohne temporäre Variablen explizit deklarieren zu müssen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Internal Table, Inline Declaration

solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_booking, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, bookid TYPE sbook-bookid, END OF ty_sflight_booking. METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates CHANGING ct_bookings TYPE ty_sflight_booking_tt. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_del_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates. SORT ct_bookings BY carrid connid fldate. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_bookings COMPARING carrid connid fldate. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

solution: CLASS zcl_del_db_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. CLASS zcl_del_db_single IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD delete_flight. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND fldate = iv_fldate. IF sy-subrc = 0. rv_success = abap_true. ELSE. rv_success = abap_false. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

METHOD delete_flights_by_capacity. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE max_seats < iv_max_capacity. rv_deleted_count = sy-dbcnt. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge *ohne* bestimmte Kriterien enthält, anstatt direkt zu löschen. Dies demonstriert einen modernen, funktionalen Ansatz, der in vielen Fällen DELETE ersetzen kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, END OF ty_sflight. TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tt. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_filtered_flights. rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE price >= iv_min_price ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (ab 7.40), das eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf einer Bedingung erstellt. Dies ist oft lesbarer und funktionaler als das direkte Löschen aus einer bestehenden Tabelle, da die Originaltabelle unverändert bleibt.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine große Menge von Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` in Paketen mithilfe eines expliziten Cursors, um Speicher zu schonen. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die die Anzahl der Flüge zurückgibt, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats, END OF ty_sflight_key. TYPES ty_sflight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS count_flights_by_capacity IMPORTING iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-max_seats RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD count_flights_by_capacity. DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor, lt_flights_package TYPE ty_sflight_key_tt, lv_total_count TYPE i. OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, max_seats FROM sflights WHERE max_seats > iv_min_capacity. IF sy-subrc = 0. DO. FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_flights_package PACKAGE SIZE 1000. IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF. lv_total_count = lv_total_count + lines( lt_flights_package ). ENDDO. CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. ENDIF. rv_count = lv_total_count. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats, END OF ty_sflight_key. TYPES ty_sflight_key_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS setup FOR TESTING. METHODS teardown FOR TESTING. METHODS test_count_flights_by_capacity FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD setup. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '1000' fldate = '20250101' max_seats = 50 price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '1001' fldate = '20250102' max_seats = 75 price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'YY' connid = '2000' fldate = '20250101' max_seats = 100 price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'YY' connid = '2001' fldate = '20250102' max_seats = 120 price = '250' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD teardown. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('XX', 'YY') AND connid IN ('1000', '1001', '2000', '2001'). COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_count_flights_by_capacity. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_package( ). DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_capacity( iv_min_capacity = 70 ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'Should count 3 flights with capacity > 70' ). lv_count = lo_cut->count_flights_by_capacity( iv_min_capacity = 150 ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'Should count 0 flights with capacity > 150' ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Explizite Cursor mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR` sind entscheidend für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen in Paketen (`PACKAGE SIZE`). Dies verhindert, dass die gesamte Datenmenge auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher geladen wird, was zu Performance-Problemen führen könnte. `WITH HOLD` hält den Cursor auch nach einem `COMMIT WORK` offen.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, SFLIGHTS, Performance

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor für eine Datenbanktabelle und demonstrieren Sie das sichere Schließen des Cursors auch im Fehlerfall.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `CLOSE CURSOR` im `FINALLY`-Block.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, END OF ty_sflight_data. CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS process_flights_safely IMPORTING iv_max_rows TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_db. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD process_flights_safely. DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor, ls_flight TYPE ty_sflight_data, lv_processed TYPE i. TRY. OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights. IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_open_sql_db=>open_cursor_failed. ENDIF. DO iv_max_rows TIMES. FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_flight. IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF. lv_processed = lv_processed + 1. " Simulate some processing IF lv_processed = 2 AND iv_max_rows > 2. " Simulate an error after 2 records RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_open_sql_db=>fetch_cursor_failed. ENDIF. ENDDO. CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error). " Log error or handle it MESSAGE lx_db_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'. RAISE EXCEPTION lx_db_error. FINALLY. IF lv_cursor IS NOT INITIAL. CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. ENDIF. ENDTRY. rv_processed_count = lv_processed. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, END OF ty_sflight_data. CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS setup FOR TESTING. METHODS teardown FOR TESTING. METHODS test_cursor_closes_on_success FOR TESTING. METHODS test_cursor_closes_on_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_db. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD setup. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '1000' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '1001' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '1002' fldate = '20250103' price = '200' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD teardown. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid IN ('1000', '1001', '1002'). COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_cursor_closes_on_success. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ). DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights_safely( iv_max_rows = 3 ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 3 msg = 'Should process 3 flights successfully' ). ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_cursor_closes_on_error. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ). TRY. lo_cut->process_flights_safely( iv_max_rows = 5 ). " Simulate error after 2 records CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db. " Expected error cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true msg = 'Exception should be caught' ). ENDTRY. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das explizite Schließen eines Cursors im `FINALLY`-Block eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks stellt sicher, dass der Cursor auch dann geschlossen wird, wenn während der Datenverarbeitung ein Fehler auftritt. Dies ist entscheidend, um Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden und die Datenbankverbindung sauber zu halten.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, TRY CATCH, FINALLY, Error Handling, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge *ohne* bestimmte Kriterien enthält, anstatt direkt zu löschen. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einem Datum in der Vergangenheit auszuschließen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, END OF ty_sflight. TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_for_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_filtered_flights. rt_filtered_flights = VALUE ty_sflight_tt( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid <> iv_carrid OR fldate >= iv_cut_off_date ) ( ls_flight ) ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100' ) ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' price = '150' ) ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20240101' price = '200' ) ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20240102' price = '250' ) ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, END OF ty_flight_summary. TYPES ty_flight_summary_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_cursor_field_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION.
