Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Cursor, um Daten aus `SFLIGHTS` zu lesen und diese in eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren, wobei Sie die moderne Inline-Deklaration für den Cursor und die Zieltabelle nutzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`).
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, total_flights TYPE i, END OF ty_flight_agg. TYPES ty_flight_agg_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_cursor_inline_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS get_flight_counts RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_agg_tt. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_cursor_inline_agg IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_flight_counts. DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor. DATA(lt_flights_raw) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY. OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights. IF sy-subrc = 0. DO. FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flights_raw PACKAGE SIZE 1000. IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF. ENDDO. CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. ENDIF. rt_flight_counts = VALUE ty_flight_agg_tt( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flights_raw BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING GROUP BY carrid ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_flights = GROUP SIZE ) ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_agg, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, total_flights TYPE i, END OF ty_flight_agg. TYPES ty_flight_agg_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_agg WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS setup FOR TESTING. METHODS teardown FOR TESTING. METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD setup. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD teardown. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA') AND connid IN ('0400', '0401', '0017'). COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_get_flight_counts. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_inline_agg( ). DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have counts for 2 airlines' ). DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ]. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-total_flights exp = 2 msg = 'LH should have 2 flights' ). DATA(ls_aa_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ]. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-total_flights exp = 1 msg = 'AA should have 1 flight' ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von expliziten Cursorn mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(...)`) und `FOR GROUPS OF` (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr moderne und lesbare Art der Datenaggregation. Der Cursor wird für die effiziente Datenbeschaffung in Paketen verwendet, während `FOR GROUPS OF` die Gruppierung und Zählung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft übernimmt.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines Cursors in einer funktionalen Kette, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Features wie `REDUCE` und `FOR`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH` mit `REDUCE` und `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats, END OF ty_sflight_data. TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, count TYPE i, END OF ty_carrid_count. TYPES ty_carrid_count_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid. CLASS zcl_cursor_functional_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS get_flight_counts_functional IMPORTING iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-max_seats RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_carrid_count_tt. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_cursor_functional_agg IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_flight_counts_functional. DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor, lt_flights_package TYPE ty_sflight_data_tt. OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR SELECT carrid, max_seats FROM sflights WHERE max_seats > iv_min_capacity. IF sy-subrc = 0. DO. FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_flights_package PACKAGE SIZE 1000. IF sy-subrc <> 0. EXIT. ENDIF. rt_flight_counts = REDUCE ty_carrid_count_tt( INIT result = VALUE ty_carrid_count_tt( ) FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights_package GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING INTO GROUP ls_group ( LET lv_carrid = ls_group-carrid IN VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = lv_carrid count = result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = lv_carrid ]-count + GROUP SIZE ) ) ) ). ENDDO. CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

TYPES ty_sflight_data_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY. TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_count, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, count TYPE i, END OF ty_carrid_count. TYPES ty_carrid_count_tt TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_carrid_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid. CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' max_seats = 120 price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' max_seats = 80 price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' max_seats = 150 price = '250' currency = 'USD' ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS. COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD teardown. DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid IN ('LH', 'AA', 'UA') AND connid IN ('0400', '0401', '0017', '0010'). COMMIT WORK. ENDMETHOD. METHOD test_get_flight_counts_functional. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_functional_agg( ). DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_functional( iv_min_capacity = 90 ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_counts ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have counts for 2 airlines' ). DATA(ls_lh_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ]. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-count exp = 2 msg = 'LH should have 2 flights' ). DATA(ls_ua_count) = lt_flight_counts[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ]. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_count-count exp = 1 msg = 'UA should have 1 flight' ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Effizienz von Cursorn für die Datenbeschaffung mit der Ausdrucksstärke funktionaler Operatoren wie `REDUCE` und `FOR GROUPS OF` (ab ABAP 7.50, `REDUCE` ab 7.40). Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und performante Aggregation von Daten direkt nach dem `FETCH` in Paketen, was den Code modern und wartbar macht.
keywords: CURSOR, OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Functional Programming, Aggregation, ABAP 7.55

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die ein bestimmtes Feld (z.B. `price`) nicht initial haben, aber ein anderes Feld (z.B. `fldate`) initial ist. Nutzen Sie dabei die moderne `DELETE ... WHERE ...` Syntax mit komplexen Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE ... WHERE ... AND ... IS INITIAL`.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, END OF ty_sflight. TYPES ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_del_it_complex_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS delete_invalid_flights CHANGING ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tt. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_del_it_complex_initial IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD delete_invalid_flights. DELETE ct_flights WHERE price IS NOT INITIAL AND fldate IS INITIAL. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

METHODS test_delete_invalid_flights FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD test_delete_invalid_flights. DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_del_it_complex_initial( ). DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '100' ) ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '' price = '150' ) " Should be deleted ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20240101' price = '' ) " Should not be deleted ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '' price = '' ) " Should not be deleted ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0020' fldate = '' price = '200' ) " Should be deleted ). lo_cut->delete_invalid_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have deleted 2 invalid flights' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First remaining flight should be LH' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20230101' msg = 'First remaining flight date should be 20230101' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second remaining flight should be AA' ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

WHERE ...`-Anweisung kann mit komplexen logischen Ausdrücken, einschließlich `IS INITIAL` und `IS NOT INITIAL`, verwendet werden, um Zeilen basierend auf dem Zustand mehrerer Felder zu entfernen. Dies ist eine präzise Methode zur Bereinigung von Daten in internen Tabellen.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, WHERE, IS INITIAL, IS NOT INITIAL, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen `cl_gui_custom_container` und einen `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` nur, wenn ein übergebener Parameter `iv_create` wahr ist. Implementieren Sie auch eine Methode zum Freigeben der Objekte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `IF iv_create = abap_true` und `FREE OBJECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    METHODS create_gui_elements IMPORTING iv_create TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS free_gui_elements.
    METHODS get_container RETURNING VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container. " Getter
    METHODS get_viewer RETURNING VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer. " Getter
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_gui_elements.
    IF iv_create = abap_true.
      IF mo_container IS NOT BOUND.
        TRY.
            mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
                container_name = mv_container_name
                parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            ).
            mo_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer(
                parent = mo_container
            ).
          CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
            MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      free_gui_elements( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_gui_elements.
    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_viewer->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_viewer.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_container.
    ro_container = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_viewer.
    ro_viewer = mo_viewer.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_table_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_model_data,
             id  TYPE string,
             url TYPE string,
           END OF ty_model_data.
    TYPES tt_model_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_model_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    METHODS load_first_model_from_table.
    METHODS get_model_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_model_table) TYPE tt_model_data. " Getter for test

    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    DATA mt_models TYPE tt_model_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_table_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_viewer = io_viewer.
    mt_models = VALUE #(
        ( id = 'ModelA' url = 'https://example.com/models/modelA.gltf' )
        ( id = 'ModelB' url = 'https://example.com/models/modelB.gltf' )
        ( id = 'ModelC' url = 'https://example.com/models/modelC.gltf' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_first_model_from_table.
    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND AND mt_models IS NOT INITIAL.
      READ TABLE mt_models INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_model).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        TRY.
            mo_viewer->load_model(
                model_id = ls_model-id
                url      = ls_model-url
            ).
            mo_viewer->display_model( model_id = ls_model-id ).
          CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
            MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_model_table.
    rt_model_table = mt_models.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS load_model IMPORTING iv_model_id TYPE string iv_model_url TYPE string.
    METHODS register_object_selected_event.
    METHODS free_viewer.
    METHODS get_container RETURNING VALUE(ro_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container. " Getter
    METHODS get_viewer RETURNING VALUE(ro_viewer) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer. " Getter
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_container_name TYPE scrfname.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.

    CLASS-METHODS handle_object_selected FOR EVENT object_selected OF cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer
      IMPORTING object_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_viewer_facade IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD initialize_viewer.
    IF mo_container IS NOT BOUND.
      TRY.
          mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
              container_name = mv_container_name
              parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          ).
          mo_viewer = NEW cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer(
              parent = mo_container
          ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
          MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_model.
    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND.
      TRY.
          mo_viewer->load_model(
              model_id = iv_model_id
              url      = iv_model_url
          ).
          mo_viewer->display_model( model_id = iv_model_id ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
          MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD register_object_selected_event.
    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND.
      SET HANDLER handle_object_selected FOR mo_viewer.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_object_selected.
    MESSAGE |Object '{ object_id }' selected in 3D viewer (Facade).| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD free_viewer.
    IF mo_viewer IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_viewer->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_viewer.
    ENDIF.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          cntl_error        = 1
          cntl_system_error = 2
          OTHERS            = 3.
      CLEAR mo_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_container.
    ro_container = mo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_viewer.
    ro_viewer = mo_viewer.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Dateinamen (ohne Pfad und Erweiterung) aus einer URL und geben Sie ihn in einer Meldung aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Funktionen wie `FIND`, `SUBSTRING` oder `REPLACE` oder reguläre Ausdrücke.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_filename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_filename_from_url
      IMPORTING iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_filename) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_filename IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_filename_from_url.
    DATA(lv_filename_with_ext) = iv_url.

    FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF '/' IN lv_filename_with_ext MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_slash_pos).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_filename_with_ext = lv_filename_with_ext+lv_slash_pos+1.
    ENDIF.

    FIND LAST OCCURRENCE OF '.' IN lv_filename_with_ext MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_dot_pos).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_filename = lv_filename_with_ext(lv_dot_pos).
    ELSE.
      rv_filename = lv_filename_with_ext.
    ENDIF.

    MESSAGE |Extrahierter Dateiname: '{ rv_filename }'| TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln in Sekunden und formatieren Sie diese in ein lesbares Format (z.B. 'X Stunden Y Minuten Z Sekunden').
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_timefm` für die Zeitstempel-Differenz und String-Templates für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_and_format_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp_from TYPE timestamp
        iv_timestamp_to   TYPE timestamp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_and_format_duration.
    DATA(lv_seconds) = cl_abap_timefm=>get_seconds_between_timestamps(
                          iv_timestamp_from = iv_timestamp_from
                          iv_timestamp_to   = iv_timestamp_to ).

    DATA(lv_hours)   = lv_seconds DIV 3600.
    DATA(lv_minutes) = ( lv_seconds MOD 3600 ) DIV 60.
    DATA(lv_secs)    = lv_seconds MOD 60.

    rv_duration_string = |{ lv_hours } Stunden { lv_minutes } Minuten { lv_secs } Sekunden|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, bei denen ein bestimmtes Feld einen spezifischen Wert hat. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um eine neue Tabelle mit den gewünschten Einträgen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE carrid <> iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_it_filter_delete( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_filter_delete=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20231201' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231201' price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20231202' price = '150' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_to_delete) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_it_filter_delete=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20231201' price = '200' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual) = lo_deleter->delete_flights_by_carrier(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      iv_carrid  = lv_carrid_to_delete
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual )
      exp = lines( lt_expected )
      msg = 'Incorrect number of flights after filtering' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_expected[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'Incorrect flight data after filtering' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und deklarative Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die gewünschten Zeilen enthält. Dies ist oft effizienter und lesbarer als explizite Schleifen mit `DELETE` Anweisungen, da es eine funktionale Herangehensweise an die Datenmanipulation bietet.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem oder mehreren Schlüsselfeldern. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine moderne ABAP-Technik.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hash-Tabelle, um Duplikate effizient zu eliminieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_deduplicate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deduplicate_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_deduplicate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deduplicate_flights.
    DATA(lt_hash_table) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_key
                            WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid
                            FOR it_flights.
    rt_unique_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_hash_table ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deduplicate_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deduplicate_flights.
    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_it_deduplicate( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_dups) = VALUE zcl_it_deduplicate=>ty_t_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_unique) = VALUE zcl_it_deduplicate=>ty_t_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual_unique) = lo_deduplicator->deduplicate_flights( lt_flights_with_dups ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_unique )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_unique )
      msg = 'Incorrect number of unique flights' ).

    " Check content (order might vary for hashed tables, so check existence)
    LOOP AT lt_expected_unique INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.
      READ TABLE lt_actual_unique WITH TABLE KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid connid = ls_expected-connid TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = sy-subrc
        msg = |Expected flight { ls_expected-carrid }-{ ls_expected-connid } not found| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Erstellen einer Hash-Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel aus der Quelltabelle ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um Duplikate zu entfernen. Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator wird dann verwendet, um die Daten zurück in eine Standardtabelle zu übertragen. Dies ist performanter als `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach einem `SORT`, da kein explizites Sortieren erforderlich ist und die Daten in einem Schritt verarbeitet werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, DELETE, Duplicates, HASHED TABLE, CORRESPONDING, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Zeilen der Quelltabelle enthält, außer denen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `WHERE`.
hint: Der `FOR`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer Schleife und Bedingungen zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_cond_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_max_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_cond_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( ls_flight-price <= iv_max_price )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_delete_line DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und geben Sie die gelöschten Zeilen zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Der `REDUCE`-Operator kann verwendet werden, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen und gleichzeitig die nicht übernommenen Elemente zu sammeln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_and_return_deleted
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      EXPORTING
        et_deleted_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_delete IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_and_return_deleted.
    rt_remaining_flights = REDUCE zcl_it_reduce_delete=>ty_t_sflight
      INIT lt_remaining = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_delete=>ty_t_sflight( )
           lt_deleted   = VALUE zcl_it_reduce_delete=>ty_t_sflight( )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT
        IF ls_flight-price < iv_min_price.
          APPEND ls_flight TO lt_deleted.
        ELSE.
          APPEND ls_flight TO lt_remaining.
        ENDIF.
    et_deleted_flights = lt_deleted.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_fra.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto

        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto
      )

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND fldate > lv_today ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, deren Flugnummer eine bestimmte Prüfsumme (berechnet durch eine Methode) erfüllt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine statische Methode im `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_method_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS METHODS calculate_checksum
      IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_checksum) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_flights_by_checksum
      IMPORTING iv_target_checksum TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_method_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_checksum.
    rv_checksum = iv_connid MOD 10. " Simple checksum for demo
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights_by_checksum.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto
      )
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE zcl_filter_method_cond=>calculate_checksum( connid ) = iv_target_checksum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_project IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid

        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge von 'NEW YORK' und berechnen Sie die Summe der verfügbaren Sitze für diese Flüge.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
             cityto   TYPE sflight-cityto,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_available_seats
      IMPORTING iv_cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_available_seats.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      FOR ls_sflight IN sflights ( 
        carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        cityfrom = ls_sflight-cityfrom
        cityto   = ls_sflight-cityto
        seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsocc
        seatsmax = ls_sflight-seatsmax
      )
    ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE cityfrom = iv_cityfrom )
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_reduce.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_city) = 'NEW YORK'. " Assuming NEW YORK exists in SFLIGHTS

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_available_seats( lv_city ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Total seats should not be negative' act = ( lv_total_seats >= 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE` ist ein Paradebeispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, und dann werden die gefilterten Elemente zu einem einzigen Ergebnis (hier die Summe der verfügbaren Sitze) aggregiert. Dies ist sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient.
keywords: FILTER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, ABAP 7.50, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine wiederverwendbare ABAP-Klasse, die ein Dialogfenster mit einem Textfeld und einem 'OK'-Button kapselt. Der Dialog soll einen übergebenen Text anzeigen und bei 'OK' geschlossen werden.
hint: Kapseln Sie die Logik für den Dialog in einer eigenen Klasse und verwenden Sie Events für die Kommunikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reusable_dialog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS ok_pressed.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_title TYPE string
        iv_text  TYPE string.

    METHODS display.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA: mo_dialog_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_dialogbox_container,
          mo_text_edit      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
          mo_button_ok      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    DATA: mv_title TYPE string,
          mv_text  TYPE string.

    METHODS on_ok_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button
      IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reusable_dialog IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_title = iv_title.
    mv_text  = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dialog_container
      EXPORTING
        width  = 400
        height = 200
        left   = 250
        top    = 250
        caption = mv_title.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dialog_container.
    mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( mv_text ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button_ok
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_dialog_container
        text   = 'OK'
        left   = 150
        top    = 160.

    SET HANDLER on_ok_click FOR mo_button_ok.

    CALL METHOD (cl_gui_cfw=>flush).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_ok_click.
    mo_dialog_container->free( ).
    RAISE EVENT ok_pressed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reusable_dialog_creation FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reusable_dialog_creation.
    DATA(lo_dialog) = NEW zcl_reusable_dialog( iv_title = 'Test Dialog' iv_text = 'Dies ist ein Testtext.' ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern und modifizieren Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Wertebereich für die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die effiziente Zeilenbearbeitung und setzen Sie den Flugstatus auf 'CANCELLED' für die gefilterten Zeilen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS> WHERE ...` und eine `RANGE` Tabelle. Die Konstanten für den Range-Typ könnten von einer Schnittstelle wie `if_fsbp_const_range` stammen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_my_const_range.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
           sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
           low    TYPE s_carr_id,
           high   TYPE s_carr_id,
         END OF ty_range_line.
  TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line WITH EMPTY KEY.
  CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_carrid_range,
               include_equal TYPE ty_range_line VALUE '{ sign = ''I'', option = ''EQ'', low = ''LH'', high = '''' }',
               exclude_bt    TYPE ty_range_line VALUE '{ sign = ''E'', option = ''BT'', low = ''AA'', high = ''UA'' }',
             END OF gc_carrid_range.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING

Die Methode soll den Wert dieses dynamisch angegebenen Feldes in jeder Zeile auf einen neuen Wert setzen. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      EXCEPTIONS
        field_not_found
        type_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE field_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE type_conversion_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE zif_my_const_range_date.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line_date,
           sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
           low    TYPE s_date,
           high   TYPE s_date,
         END OF ty_range_line_date.
  TYPES: ty_range_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_line_date WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_fldate_range TYPE zif_my_const_range_date=>ty_range_fldate OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( fldate IN it_fldate_range )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
    rv_total_price = round( val = rv_total_price dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und eine dynamische Feldliste akzeptiert. Die Methode soll nur die angegebenen Felder aus jeder Zeile der Tabelle in einer neuen Tabelle zurückgeben. Nutzen Sie RTTI und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS select_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE REF TO data
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_table_type
        field_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_dynamic_fields.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_source_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_source_component> TYPE ANY,
                   <lt_result_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_result_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_result_component> TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_new_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lv_new_table_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_source_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE invalid_table_type.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_source_table>[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA lt_new_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      READ TABLE lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component) WITH KEY name = lv_field_name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE field_not_found.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_new_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_new_struct_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_new_components ).
    lv_new_table_type  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lv_new_struct_type ).

    CREATE DATA rt_result_table TYPE HANDLE lv_new_table_type.
    ASSIGN rt_result_table->* TO <lt_result_table>.

    LOOP AT <lt_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_result_line> TYPE HANDLE lv_new_struct_type.
      INSERT <fs_result_line> INTO TABLE <lt_result_table>.
      ASSIGN <lt_result_table>[ sy-tabix ] TO <fs_result_line>.

      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_component>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_result_line> TO <fs_result_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_result_component> = <fs_source_component>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie Werte aus einem String, der durch Trennzeichen getrennte Feld-Wert-Paare enthält (z.B. 'CARRID=LH;CONNID=0400'), und weisen Sie diese dynamisch einem Strukturfeld zu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SPLIT` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_assign
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_target_structure TYPE ANY
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_format
        field_not_found
        type_conversion_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_string_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_assign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE ANY.
    DATA: lt_pairs TYPE string_table,
          lv_field_name TYPE string,
          lv_field_value TYPE string.

    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO lv_field_name lv_field_value.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_field_name IS INITIAL.
        RAISE invalid_format.
      ENDIF.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_target_structure TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE field_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      TRY.
          <fs_component> = lv_field_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          RAISE type_conversion_error.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie für jede Zeile ein neues Feld hinzufügen, das den Status des Fluges (z.B. 'ON_TIME', 'DELAYED') basierend auf dem Flugdatum und der aktuellen Zeit berechnet. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die direkte Modifikation und dynamische Felderstellung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT COMPONENT` mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_flight_status
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_transformed_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_status>  TYPE ANY,
                   <lt_transformed> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_transformed_line> TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_new_struct_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lv_new_table_type  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ct_sflights[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Add new component for status
    DATA(ls_new_component) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
      name = 'FLIGHT_STATUS'
      type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( )
    ).
    APPEND ls_new_component TO lt_components.

    lv_new_struct_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lv_new_table_type  = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lv_new_struct_type ).

    CREATE DATA rr_transformed_table TYPE HANDLE lv_new_table_type.
    ASSIGN rr_transformed_table->* TO <lt_transformed>.

    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      CREATE DATA <fs_transformed_line> TYPE HANDLE lv_new_struct_type.
      <fs_transformed_line> = <fs_sflight>. " Copy existing data

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLIGHT_STATUS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_transformed_line> TO <fs_status>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF <fs_sflight>-fldate < sy-datum.
          <fs_status> = 'COMPLETED'.
        ELSEIF <fs_sflight>-fldate = sy-datum.
          <fs_status> = 'TODAY'.
        ELSE.
          <fs_status> = 'SCHEDULED'.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_transformed_line> INTO TABLE <lt_transformed>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle und eine Liste von Feldnamen akzeptiert. Die Methode soll überprüfen, ob alle angegebenen Felder in der Tabelle vorhanden sind und ob sie vom erwarteten Typ sind.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DESCRIBE FIELD` oder `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_fields_and_types
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data
        it_field_specs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_spec
      EXCEPTIONS
        invalid_table_type
        field_not_found
        type_mismatch.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_spec,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string, " e.g., 'C', 'N', 'I', 'F', 'P', 'D', 'T', 'STRING'
           END OF ty_field_spec.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_fields_and_types.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE ANY,
                   <fs_component> TYPE ANY.

    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_type_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE invalid_table_type.
    ENDIF.

    IF lines( <lt_table> ) = 0.
      " Cannot check fields if table is empty, assume valid for structure check
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN <lt_table>[ 1 ] TO <fs_line>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE invalid_table_type. " Should not happen if lines > 0
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_line> ).

    LOOP AT it_field_specs INTO DATA(ls_field_spec).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_spec-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE field_not_found.
      ENDIF.

      lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_component> ).
      IF lo_type_descr->type_kind <> ls_field_spec-type.
        RAISE type_mismatch.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_date_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_internal_to_external
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_internal TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_external) TYPE string.

    METHODS convert_external_to_internal
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_external TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_date_internal) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_date_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_internal_to_external.
    rv_date_external = |{ iv_date_internal+6(2) }.{ iv_date_internal+4(2) }.{ iv_date_internal+0(4) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_external_to_internal.
    DATA(lv_day) = iv_date_external+0(2).
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date_external+3(2).
    DATA(lv_year) = iv_date_external+6(4).
    rv_date_internal = CONV d( |{ lv_year }{ lv_month }{ lv_day }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_currency_amount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_packed_to_float
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_packed TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_amount_float) TYPE fltp.

    METHODS convert_float_to_packed
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount_float TYPE fltp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_amount_packed) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_currency_amount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_packed_to_float.
    rv_amount_float = CONV fltp( iv_amount_packed ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_float_to_packed.
    rv_amount_packed = CONV p( iv_amount_float ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_amount_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_amount_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conv_currency_amount( ).
    DATA(lv_packed_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2 VALUE '123.45'.
    DATA(lv_float_amount) TYPE fltp.
    DATA(lv_converted_packed) TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2.

    lv_float_amount = lo_cut->convert_packed_to_float( lv_packed_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_float_amount exp = 123.45 ).

    lv_converted_packed = lo_cut->convert_float_to_packed( lv_float_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_packed exp = lv_packed_amount ).

    lv_packed_amount = '0.01'.
    lv_float_amount = lo_cut->convert_packed_to_float( lv_packed_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_float_amount exp = 0.01 ).
    lv_converted_packed = lo_cut->convert_float_to_packed( lv_float_amount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_packed exp = lv_packed_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht eine direkte und präzise Konvertierung zwischen gepackten Zahlen (`p`) und Gleitkommazahlen (`fltp`), wobei die Dezimalstellen automatisch gehandhabt werden. Die Methoden sind in der `PUBLIC SECTION` definiert.
keywords: CONV, Packed Number, Float, Type Conversion, PUBLIC SECTION

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die von 'FRANKFURT' abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
        deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
        arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
        fromcity TYPE sflight-fromcity,
        tocity   TYPE sflight-tocity,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_from_city
      IMPORTING
        iv_from_city TYPE sflight-fromcity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_city.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, deptime, arrtime, fromcity, tocity
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fromcity = iv_from_city ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_from_fra) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'FRANKFURT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights_from_fra ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_from_fra INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fromcity exp = 'FRANKFURT' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_flights_from_nonexistent) = lo_cut->get_flights_from_city( 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_from_nonexistent ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht das Filtern von internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und performante Weise, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE`-Anweisungen. Die Methode ist in der `PUBLIC SECTION` definiert.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        price  TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight_price,
      tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( "INIT sum TYPE sflight-price
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_price_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_price_lh >= 0 ) ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Aggregation, Modern ABAP, PUBLIC SECTION

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
      END OF ty_sflight_key,
      tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_keys.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight). " Inline declaration in loop
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) TO rt_flight_keys.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_keys ).
    LOOP AT lt_flight_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_key-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Daten aus `sflights` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte hinzu, die den Flugpreis in einer anderen Währung (z.B. USD) umrechnet, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_currency_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
        price_usd TYPE sflight-price,
      END OF ty_sflight_ext,
      tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_usd_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights_usd) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_currency_conversion IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_usd_price.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS " Limit for example
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    " Simplified conversion rate for demonstration
    CONSTANTS: lc_eur_to_usd_rate TYPE f VALUE '1.08'.

    rt_flights_usd = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
                                 connid   = ls_flight-connid
                                 price    = ls_flight-price
                                 currency = ls_flight-currency
                                 price_usd = CONV sflight-price( ls_flight-price * lc_eur_to_usd_rate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_currency_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_currency_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_currency_conversion( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_usd) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_usd_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights_usd ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights_usd INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-price ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-price_usd ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price_usd > ls_flight-price ) ). " Assuming EUR to USD rate > 1
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die Transformation und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen in einer deklarativen und funktionalen Weise. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei eine Währungsumrechnung durchzuführen. `CONV` wird für die Typkonvertierung des umgerechneten Preises verwendet. Die Methode ist in der `PUBLIC SECTION` definiert.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, CONV, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT, Functional Programming, Modern ABAP, PUBLIC SECTION

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole und den `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Befehl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = CONV string( <fs_field> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_field_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_field_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_read_field( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_read_field=>ty_data( field1 = 'Testwert' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_value1) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value1 exp = 'Testwert' ).

    DATA(lv_value2) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value2 exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_read_field( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_read_field=>ty_data( field1 = 'Testwert' field2 = 123 ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_value exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf Felder mittels Feldsymbolen und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programme. `CONV` wird hier verwendet, um den dynamisch gelesenen Wert in einen String zu konvertieren. Die Methode ist in der `PUBLIC SECTION` definiert.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, CONV, PUBLIC SECTION

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Interface-Definition für eine Flugdatenquelle und implementieren Sie diese in einer Klasse, die Daten aus `sflights` liefert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INTERFACE` und `CLASS ... IMPLEMENTING INTERFACE`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_flight_data_source PUBLIC.
  TYPES:
    BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
      carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
      connid TYPE sflight-connid,
    END OF ty_flight_key,
    tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_all_flight_keys
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_flight_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_flight_data_source~get_all_flight_keys.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_implementation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_implementation.
    DATA(lo_data_source) = NEW zcl_sflight_data_source( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_data_source->zif_flight_data_source~get_all_flight_keys( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschafts-IDs aus `sflights` zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas, aber nur für Flüge, die teurer als ein bestimmter Wert sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_carrids_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_carrids_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat_carrid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_carrids_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_carrids_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ''
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN flight-carrid ELSE result && ',' && flight-carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_concat_carrids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concat_carrids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_concat_carrid( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 100. " Example minimum price

    " Ensure some data exists for testing
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 50 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'YY' connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'XX' connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = 'ZZ' connid = '004' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 ) ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_carrids_string( lv_min_price ).

    " Expected result: 'YY,XX,ZZ' (order might vary depending on DB, but content should be there)
    " For robust testing, check if all expected elements are present, regardless of order.
    DATA(lt_expected_parts) = VALUE string_table( ( 'YY' ) ( 'XX' ) ( 'ZZ' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT lv_result AT ',' INTO TABLE lt_actual_parts.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_parts )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_parts )
      msg = 'Number of concatenated carrid parts should match'
    ).
    LOOP AT lt_expected_parts INTO DATA(lv_expected_part).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
        act = sy-subrc
        msg = |Expected part { lv_expected_part } not found in result|
      ) ##NO_TEXT.
      READ TABLE lt_actual_parts WITH KEY table_line = lv_expected_part TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Transformation und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. Die `COND`-Expression innerhalb von `NEXT` sorgt für eine korrekte Komma-Trennung.
keywords: REDUCE, String Concatenation, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, COND

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge jede Fluggesellschaft in der Tabelle `sflights` hat, und geben Sie das Ergebnis als Map (Fluggesellschaft -> Anzahl Flüge) zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `HASHED TABLE` als Akkumulator und `FOR GROUPS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        count  TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE tt_flight_count(
      INIT counts = VALUE tt_flight_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      NEXT counts = VALUE tt_flight_count(
        counts
        ( carrid = flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_group_count( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid_a) = 'CA'.
    DATA(lv_carrid_b) = 'CB'.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_a OR carrid = lv_carrid_b.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '002' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_b connid = '003' fldate = '20250101' price = 300 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '004' fldate = '20250101' price = 400 ) ).

    DATA(lt_actual_counts) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    DATA(ls_expected_a) = VALUE zcl_reduce_group_count=>ty_flight_count( carrid = lv_carrid_a count = 3 ).
    DATA(ls_expected_b) = VALUE zcl_reduce_group_count=>ty_flight_count( carrid = lv_carrid_b count = 1 ).

    READ TABLE lt_actual_counts INTO DATA(ls_actual_a) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid_a.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = ls_expected_a-count

    ).

    READ TABLE lt_actual_counts INTO DATA(ls_actual_b) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid_b.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um die Summe und die Anzahl der Flüge zu akkumulieren, und teilen Sie dann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_flight_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct(
      INIT sum   = 0 TYPE s_price
           count = 0 TYPE i
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum   = sum + flight-price
           count = count + 1
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und einer komplexeren Akkumulatorstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_summary_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_complex_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( fldate >= iv_min_fldate ) GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      NEXT summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
        summaries
        ( carrid       = flight-carrid
          flight_count = GROUP SIZE
          total_price  = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT sum = sum + member-price )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_complex_agg( ).
    DATA(lv_min_date) = '20250102'.
    DATA(lv_carrid_x) = 'CX'.
    DATA(lv_carrid_y) = 'CY'.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_x OR carrid = lv_carrid_y.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_x connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_x connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_x connid = '003' fldate = '20250103' price = 300 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_y connid = '004' fldate = '20250102' price = 400 ) ).

    DATA(lt_actual_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary_by_carrier( lv_min_date ).

    DATA(ls_expected_x) = VALUE zcl_reduce_complex_agg=>ty_flight_summary( carrid = lv_carrid_x flight_count = 2 total_price = 500 ).
    DATA(ls_expected_y) = VALUE zcl_reduce_complex_agg=>ty_flight_summary( carrid = lv_carrid_y flight_count = 1 total_price = 400 ).

    READ TABLE lt_actual_summary INTO DATA(ls_actual_x) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid_x.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_x-flight_count
      exp = ls_expected_x-flight_count
      msg = |Flight count for { lv_carrid_x } should be 2|
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_x-total_price
      exp = ls_expected_x-total_price
      msg = |Total price for { lv_carrid_x } should be 500|
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_actual_summary INTO DATA(ls_actual_y) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid_y.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_y-flight_count
      exp = ls_expected_y-flight_count
      msg = |Flight count for { lv_carrid_y } should be 1|
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_actual_y-total_price
      exp = ls_expected_y-total_price
      msg = |Total price for { lv_carrid_y } should be 400|
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verschachtelung von `REDUCE`-Operatoren, um komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen. Der äußere `REDUCE` gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft, während der innere `REDUCE` die Summe der Preise für jede Gruppe berechnet. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Daten vor der Gruppierung.
keywords: REDUCE, Grouping, Aggregation, Internal Tables, FOR GROUPS OF, Nested REDUCE, Data Structures

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern von Flügen enthält, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt und die an einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die neue Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
        iv_fldate    TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_filter_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = REDUCE tt_filtered_flight(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_filtered_flight( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price AND fldate = iv_fldate )
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_filtered_flight( result ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_filter_transform( ).
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 200.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20250105'.
    DATA(lv_carrid_a) = 'FA'.
    DATA(lv_carrid_b) = 'FB'.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid_a OR carrid = lv_carrid_b.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '001' fldate = '20250105' price = 150 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '002' fldate = '20250105' price = 300 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_b connid = '003' fldate = '20250104' price = 400 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid_b connid = '004' fldate = '20250105' price = 500 ) ).

    DATA(lt_actual_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_min_price = lv_min_price iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    DATA(lt_expected_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_filter_transform=>tt_filtered_flight(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_a connid = '002' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid_b connid = '004' )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_flights )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_flights )
      msg = 'Number of filtered flights should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_expected_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      msg = 'First flight carrid should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_flights[ 1 ]-connid
      exp = lt_expected_flights[ 1 ]-connid
      msg = 'First flight connid should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_flights[ 2 ]-carrid
      exp = lt_expected_flights[ 2 ]-carrid
      msg = 'Second flight carrid should match'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_flights[ 2 ]-connid
      exp = lt_expected_flights[ 2 ]-connid
      msg = 'Second flight connid should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `REDUCE` verwendet werden kann, um eine interne Tabelle zu filtern und gleichzeitig die Struktur der Elemente zu transformieren. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die Einträge, und die `VALUE`-Expression im `NEXT`-Teil erstellt neue Zeilen für die Ergebnistabelle.
keywords: REDUCE, Filtering, Data Transformation, Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, VALUE

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer in eine interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei eine Inline-Deklaration für die interne Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,

    METHODS get_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid.
    rt_flights = lt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
