Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 500 enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und einer Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                          ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-price > 500 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lt_result = lo_filter->get_expensive_flights( 999999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND ...` Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, VALUE #, Internal Tables, Filter, SFLIGHTS, INTO TABLE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_price_lh exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ) exp = 0 ).

    " Manuelle Berechnung zur Verifikation (Beispiel für LH)
    DATA: lt_sflights_lh TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_lh) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price FOR flight IN lt_sflights_lh NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price_lh exp = lv_expected_lh ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr prägnante und funktionale Weise. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP`- und `SUM`-Anweisungen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, INTO TABLE

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach einem bestimmten Datum und einer Mindestkapazität. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...) FROM ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE fldate = iv_fldate AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter_op( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_fldate = lv_test_date iv_min_free_seats = 10 ).

    " Assuming some flights exist for today with at least 10 free seats
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = lv_test_date ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 10 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
    ENDIF.

    lt_result = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_fldate = '19000101' iv_min_free_seats = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern. Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für die Darstellung in einem Chart auf und übergeben Sie diese an eine Instanz von `CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN`. CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             label TYPE string,
             value TYPE f,
           END OF ty_chart_data,
           tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data_for_chart
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.

    METHODS display_chart_mock
      IMPORTING
        it_chart_data TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data_for_chart.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY fldate.

    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             ( label = |{ flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                               value = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart_mock.
    " In a real scenario, this would involve creating a custom control
    " and embedding CL_GUI_CHART_ENGINE_WIN. For this example, we mock
    " the interaction to focus on data preparation.
    " The actual chart display would require a PBO/PAI context.

    " Mocking the chart engine interaction
    DATA: lo_chart_engine TYPE REF TO cl_gui_chart_engine_win.
    " lo_chart_engine = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine_win( ... ). " Requires container

    " Example of how data would be passed (mocked)
    DATA: lt_chart_values TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>t_chart_values.
    DATA: ls_chart_value  TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>s_chart_value.

    LOOP AT it_chart_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      ls_chart_value-value = ls_data-value.
      ls_chart_value-label = ls_data-label.
      APPEND ls_chart_value TO lt_chart_values.
    ENDLOOP.

    " lo_chart_engine->set_data( lt_chart_values ).
    " lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine_win=>co_chart_type_column ).
    " lo_chart_engine->draw_chart( ).

    " For demonstration, we just output a message that data was prepared.
    IF it_chart_data IS NOT INITIAL.
      MESSAGE |Chart data prepared for { lines( it_chart_data ) } entries.| TYPE 'I'.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No chart data to display.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Flugpreis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll 'Teuer' zugewiesen werden, sonst 'Normal'. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining und die Verwendung des `NEW`-Operators zur Instanziierung und direkten Methodenaufrufen.
hint: Instanziieren Sie mit `NEW #()` und rufen Sie Methoden direkt auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS add_value IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_value.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_value( 10 )->add_value( 5 )->add_value( 3 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 18 ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( )->set_value( 100 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining, ermöglicht durch Methoden, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz zurückgeben (`RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining`), verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit von Objektinteraktionen. In Kombination mit dem `NEW`-Operator für die direkte Instanziierung und den Aufruf von Methoden wird der Code sehr flüssig und ausdrucksstark.
keywords: Method Chaining, NEW, Object Orientation, FINAL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Währung und einem Preis über einem Schwellenwert enthält. Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator und eine `WHERE`-Klausel mit mehreren Bedingungen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...) FROM ... WHERE ... AND ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered,
           tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights_multi
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency  TYPE sflight-currency
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_multi.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE currency = iv_currency AND price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_filter.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_multi_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights_multi( iv_currency = 'EUR' iv_min_price = 500 ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch Felder aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine interne Tabelle. Die zu lesenden Felder werden als Liste von Feldnamen übergeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT (field_list) FROM ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_sflights.
    DATA: lv_field_list TYPE string.
    DATA: lr_table      TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Build dynamic field list for SELECT statement
    lv_field_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ',' && field ) ).

    CREATE DATA lr_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <lt_table>.

    TRY.
        SELECT (lv_field_list)
          FROM sflight
          INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
        rt_dynamic_data = lr_table.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., invalid field name
        MESSAGE 'Dynamic SELECT failed due to invalid field list.' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_select FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_select_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lo_dyn_select) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_select=>tt_field_names( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'PRICE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_dyn_select->get_dynamic_sflights( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_sflights>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_sflights> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( <lt_sflights> ) > 0 ).

    " Check if the structure contains the expected fields (requires RTTI for full check)
    " For simplicity, we just check if data was returned.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_select_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_dyn_select) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_select=>tt_field_names( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'INVALID_FIELD' ) ).
    " Expecting a short dump or error message in a real system, here we just ensure it doesn't crash the test.
    " The solution includes a CATCH for cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_dyn_select->get_dynamic_sflights( lt_fields ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lr_data ). " Should be initial if error occurred and caught
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische `SELECT`-Befehl mit einer Feldliste in Klammern `SELECT (lv_field_list)` ermöglicht es, die zur Laufzeit benötigten Felder zu bestimmen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen, bei denen die Feldselektion flexibel sein muss. Die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zum Aufbau der Feldliste ist ein modernes ABAP-Muster.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, SELECT, Field List, SFLIGHTS, INTO TABLE, REDUCE

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(group_key) GROUP BY ( field1 field2 ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count,
           tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_group) = NEW zcl_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_group->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_counts ).

    " Check if LH exists and has a count
    DATA(ls_lh_count) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>ty_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_lh_count WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_lh_count-flight_count > 0 ).

    " Check if AA exists and has a count
    DATA(ls_aa_count) = VALUE zcl_group_by=>ty_flight_count( ).
    READ TABLE lt_counts INTO ls_aa_count WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( sy-subrc = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...`-Syntax ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für Aggregationen und führt zu deutlich saubererem und effizienterem Code.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, INTO TABLE

CLASS zcl_insert_into_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,

  METHOD add_new_flights.
    rt_updated_flights = it_existing_flights.

    INSERT VALUE ty_sflight_simple( carrid = 'BA' connid = '1234' ) INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.
    INSERT VALUE ty_sflight_simple( carrid = 'AF' connid = '5678' ) INTO TABLE rt_updated_flights.

    " Alternative: Using VALUE # for initial table creation with new entries
    " rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( BASE it_existing_flights
    "                                ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '1234' )
    "                                ( carrid = 'AF' connid = '5678' ) ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_process_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_process_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price )
    DO.
      " Simulate some processing, e.g., adding to a new table
      APPEND flight TO rt_processed_flights.
    ENDFOR.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception wurde nicht ausgelöst' ).

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Zeitstempel in eine benutzerdefinierte String-Darstellung.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_timestamp_as_string` der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` mit Formatierungsoptionen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_format_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_tstmp_to_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
        iv_format TYPE string OPTIONAL " z.B. 'YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_format_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_tstmp_to_string.
    DATA(lo_tstmp) = NEW cl_abap_tstmp( iv_tstmp ).

    IF iv_format IS INITIAL.
      rv_formatted_string = lo_tstmp->get_timestamp_as_string( ). " Standardformat
    ELSE.
      " Beispiel für benutzerdefiniertes Format (hier nur als Platzhalter, da get_timestamp_as_string
      " keine direkte Formatstring-Eingabe wie CONVERT DATE/TIME bietet, sondern vordefinierte Formate)
      " Für flexible Formate müsste man Datum/Uhrzeit extrahieren und String-Templates nutzen.
      " Hier demonstrieren wir ein vordefiniertes Format oder die manuelle Zusammensetzung.
      DATA(lv_date) TYPE d.
      DATA(lv_time) TYPE t.
      lo_tstmp->move_tstmp_to_date_time( IMPORTING date = lv_date time = lv_time ).
      rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_date DATE = USER } { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_tstmp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_tstmp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_format_string( ).
    DATA(lv_tstmp) = '20231027103045.1234567'.

    " Test Standardformat (abhängig von Systemeinstellungen)
    DATA(lv_formatted_default) = lo_cut->format_tstmp_to_string( lv_tstmp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_formatted_default ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` bei einer Ausnahme.
hint: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und nutzen Sie das in der Ausnahme enthaltene `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER`-Objekt zur Nachrichtenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_try_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS handle_error
      IMPORTING
        ix_exception TYPE REF TO cx_abap_message_helper
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_msg) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_try_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lo_exception_raiser) = NEW zcl_msg_raise_exception( ).
    TRY.
        IF iv_value < 0.
          lo_exception_raiser->raise_custom_exception( |Ungültiger Wert: { iv_value }| ).
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = |Verarbeitung erfolgreich für Wert { iv_value }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_message_helper INTO DATA(lx_msg_helper).
        rv_result = handle_error( lx_msg_helper ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_error.
    DATA(lo_caught_msg_helper) = ix_exception->message_helper.
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_caught_msg_helper->get_messages( ).
    IF lt_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_error_msg = |Fehler aufgetreten: { lt_messages[ 1 ]-message }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_error_msg = 'Unbekannter Fehler aufgetreten'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_past DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_timestamp_in_past
      IMPORTING
        iv_tstmp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_past) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_is_past IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_timestamp_in_past.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_current_tstmp).
    IF iv_tstmp < lv_current_tstmp.

    ELSE.
      rv_is_past = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_is_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_past( ).
    DATA(lv_past_tstmp) = '20000101000000.0000000'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_past_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_not_past.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tstmp_is_past( ).
    " Erzeuge einen Zeitstempel in der Zukunft (z.B. 1 Stunde später)
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD DATA(lv_current_tstmp).
    DATA(lo_future_tstmp) = NEW cl_abap_tstmp( lv_current_tstmp ).

    DATA(lv_future_tstmp) = lo_future_tstmp->get_tstmp( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_in_past( lv_future_tstmp ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für Flüge, die als 'heiß' (nicht gealtert) gelten, unter Verwendung einer REDUCE-Expression. Simuliere den 'heiß'-Status durch eine Bedingung auf die Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl belegter Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie die REDUCE-Expression mit einer FOR-Schleife und einer WHERE-Bedingung, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_hot_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_hot_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsocc > 100 ) " Simulation: 'hot' data condition
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_aggregator->get_total_hot_flight_price( 'LH' ).
    " Da SFLIGHT-Daten variieren können, prüfen wir hier nur auf Initialwert oder einen erwarteten Bereich.
    " Für einen präzisen Test müssten Testdaten in SFLIGHT eingefügt werden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_total ). " Annahme: Keine 'heißen' Flüge für LH in Testsystem oder spezifischer Wert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In Kombination mit FOR und WHERE können Filterbedingungen direkt in die Aggregation integriert werden, was den Code lesbarer und effizienter macht. Der 'hot'-Status wird hier simuliert, um die Anwendung im Kontext der 'DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging' zu verdeutlichen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, SUM, Internal Tables, Data Aging (context), DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben und deren maximale Sitzplätze über einem Schwellenwert liegen, unter Verwendung der FILTER-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die FILTER-Expression mit einer WHERE-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE s_seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax > iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ). " Annahme: Einige Flüge passen zur Bedingung
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-seatsmax > 200 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FILTER-Expression bietet eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Sie ist effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle LOOP- und DELETE-Anweisungen und unterstützt die Verwendung von Schlüsseln für eine optimierte Filterung. Dies ist ideal, um relevante Datensätze schnell aus einer größeren Menge zu extrahieren, z.B. um nur 'heiße' Daten zu verarbeiten, die von der 'DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging' als relevant eingestuft werden.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft mit der REDUCE-Expression.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_seats = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flug in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie seinen Index, unter Verwendung von Tabellenausdrücken (LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit Tabellenausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_existence
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
        it_flights    TYPE tt_sflight
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists     TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index      TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_existence.
    ev_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( it_flights[ carrid = is_flight_key-carrid connid = is_flight_key-connid ] ) ).
    IF ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( it_flights[ carrid = is_flight_key-carrid connid = is_flight_key-connid ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool, lv_index TYPE i.
    NEW zcl_flight_checker( )->check_flight_existence( EXPORTING is_flight_key = ls_key it_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_flight_checker=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_checker=>ty_sflight_key( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool, lv_index TYPE i.
    NEW zcl_flight_checker( )->check_flight_existence( EXPORTING is_flight_key = ls_key it_flights = lt_flights IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke mit `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` bieten eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Möglichkeit, die Existenz von Zeilen in internen Tabellen zu prüfen und deren Index zu ermitteln. Sie sind eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE` mit `TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und verbessern die Performance, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen, wenn ein eindeutiger Schlüssel verwendet wird. Dies ist nützlich, um schnell zu prüfen, ob ein Datensatz (z.B. ein 'heißer' Datensatz) vorhanden ist, bevor weitere Operationen durchgeführt werden.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Table Expressions, Internal Tables, Data Aging (context)

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung aus SFLIGHT unter Verwendung einer FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY.
hint: Nutzen Sie FOR ... GROUP BY ... mit einer VALUE-Expression für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_summary,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_seats_occ
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_group_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_seats_occ.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                           ( carrid         = flight-carrid
                             connid         = flight-connid
                             total_seatsocc = SUM( flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_agg) = NEW zcl_flight_group_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_agg->get_grouped_seats_occ( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Beispiel: Prüfen Sie eine bestimmte Gruppe
    DATA(ls_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' DEFAULT INITIAL ].
    IF ls_group IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_group-total_seatsocc > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY ermöglicht eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ist eine moderne Alternative zu LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und bietet eine kompaktere Syntax für komplexe Aggregationsszenarien. Die Verwendung von SUM() innerhalb der VALUE-Expression für die Gruppenergebnisse ist besonders effizient.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, SUM, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische Methode, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer Struktur basierend auf dem Feldnamen setzt. Dies könnte in Szenarien der 'DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging' nützlich sein, um Metadaten dynamisch zu aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und die Zuweisung mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`. Denken Sie an RTTI für Typprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_aging_meta,
             object_id TYPE string,
             aging_status TYPE string,
             last_access_date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data_aging_meta.

    METHODS set_field_dynamically
      CHANGING
        cs_data TYPE ty_data_aging_meta
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          " Versuchen, den Wert zuzuweisen. Typkonvertierung kann hier fehlschlagen.
          <fs_field> = iv_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Ausnahme auslösen
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Feld nicht gefunden, Fehlerbehandlung
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_set_object_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_aging_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_object_id.
    DATA: ls_meta TYPE zcl_dynamic_setter=>ty_data_aging_meta.
    DATA(lo_setter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_setter( ).
    lo_setter->set_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_meta
                                      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'OBJECT_ID'
                                                iv_value = 'OBJ_001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_meta-object_id exp = 'OBJ_001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_aging_status.
    DATA: ls_meta TYPE zcl_dynamic_setter=>ty_data_aging_meta.
    DATA(lo_setter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_setter( ).
    lo_setter->set_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_meta
                                      IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'AGING_STATUS'
                                                iv_value = 'HOT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_meta-aging_status exp = 'HOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA: ls_meta TYPE zcl_dynamic_setter=>ty_data_aging_meta.
    DATA(lo_setter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_setter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_setter->set_field_dynamically( CHANGING cs_data = ls_meta
                                          IMPORTING iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
                                                    iv_value = 'X' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST expected' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit Feldsymbolen ermöglicht den Zugriff und die Manipulation von Datenstrukturen zur Laufzeit, wenn Feldnamen nicht fest zur Kompilierzeit bekannt sind. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung von Metadaten, wie sie bei der 'DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging' anfallen könnten, um flexible Aktualisierungen zu ermöglichen. Die Fehlerbehandlung ist hierbei entscheidend.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI (conceptual), DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze pro Flugverbindung (carrid und connid) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT unter Verwendung von LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und SUM für die Gruppenmitglieder.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key) ... SUMMING ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_sum_result,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_seatsocc TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_sum_result.
    TYPES: tt_flight_group_sum_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_sum_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_sum_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_group_sum_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_sum_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
                                              ASCENDING.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      total_seatsocc = SUM( ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Beispiel: Prüfen Sie eine bestimmte Gruppe

    IF ls_group IS NOT INITIAL.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

GROUP BY`-Anweisung mit der `SUM`-Aggregation für die Gruppenmitglieder ist eine leistungsstarke und moderne Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Sie bietet eine klare und effiziente Syntax für die Verarbeitung von Gruppen von Zeilen, was besonders nützlich ist, um Übersichten oder Berichte zu erstellen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, SUM, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

CLASS zcl_weekday_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_weekday_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_category.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_week_day( iv_date ).

        rv_category = 'Wochenende'.
      WHEN OTHERS.

CLASS zcl_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.

                 WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Hoch' ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und bestimmen Sie für jede Gruppe, ob es sich um eine 'Premium'-Fluggesellschaft handelt (z.B. wenn die durchschnittliche Flugdauer über einem bestimmten Wert liegt). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `WHEN`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `WHEN`-Bedingung für die Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        is_premium  TYPE abap_bool,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        avg_duration TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_premium_airlines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_premium_airlines.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                              ASCENDING
                                              INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_avg_duration) = REDUCE i(
                                INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_member>-fltime
                                     count = count + 1 ).
      DATA(lv_is_premium) = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_avg_duration > 300 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ). "Example threshold

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        is_premium   = lv_is_premium
        flight_count = lines( GROUP ls_group_key )
        avg_duration = lv_avg_duration
      ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_premium_airlines( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    " Assert that at least one premium airline is found (depends on data)
    DATA(lv_premium_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary).
      IF ls_summary-is_premium = abap_true.
        lv_premium_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_premium_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_series_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_series_point,
        x_axis_label TYPE string, "Month
        y_value      TYPE i,     "Flight count
      END OF ty_series_point,
      tt_series_points TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_series_point WITH EMPTY KEY,

      BEGIN OF ty_chart_series,
        series_label TYPE string, "Airline ID
        data_points  TYPE tt_series_points,
      END OF ty_chart_series,
      tt_chart_series TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_series WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_monthly_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_series) TYPE tt_chart_series.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_series_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_monthly_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_chart_series = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      LET lv_carrid = ls_flight-carrid IN
      ( series_label = lv_carrid
        data_points = VALUE tt_series_points(
                        FOR GROUPS OF ls_month_flight IN GROUP ls_flight GROUP BY ( month = ls_month_flight-fldate+4(2) )
                        LET lv_month = ls_month_flight-fldate+4(2) IN
                        ( x_axis_label = lv_month
                          y_value      = lines( GROUP ls_month_flight ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_chart_series) = lo_cut->prepare_monthly_flights( ).

    " Check if data for at least one series (airline) is present

      IF ls_series-series_label IS NOT INITIAL.
        lv_series_found = abap_true.

        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filtered_chart_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data_item,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_flight_data_item,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_filtered_chart_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights_for_chart.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    " Optionally map to a simpler structure for charting if needed
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN rt_filtered_flights
                                   ( fldate = ls_flight-fldate
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_future_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_flights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring_csv) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_convert_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_flights_to_csv.
    DATA lv_string_csv TYPE string.

    CALL METHOD cl_bcs_convert=>itf_to_string
      EXPORTING
        i_tab_cnv = it_flights
        i_field_sep = ','
      RECEIVING
        r_string  = lv_string_csv.

    CALL METHOD cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring
      EXPORTING
        i_string = lv_string_csv
        i_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      RECEIVING
        r_xstring = rv_xstring_csv.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_to_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_convert_to_csv( ).
    DATA lt_flights TYPE zcl_bcs_convert_to_csv=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.50' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lv_xstring_csv) = lo_cut->convert_flights_to_csv( lt_flights ).
    DATA lv_expected_string TYPE string.
    lv_expected_string = 'LH,0400,'.
    lv_expected_string = lv_expected_string && sy-datum && ',100.00' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
    lv_expected_string = lv_expected_string && 'AA,0017,' && sy-datum && ',200.50'.

    DATA(lv_actual_string) = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_string( iv_xstring = lv_xstring_csv iv_codepage = '4103' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_string exp = lv_expected_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_nested_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_count_nested_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_info.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0800' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '1234' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.

    rv_count = COUNT(
      FOR flight IN lt_flights
      WHERE ( flight-carrid = iv_carrid AND flight-connid CP '0*' )
      ( 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_with_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_with_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT c = c + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

             count  TYPE i,

    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_per_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ( VALUE #(
          carrid = <group>-carrid
          count  = COUNT( <group> )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, einschließlich CC- und BCC-Empfängern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address` für jeden Empfänger und `lo_bcs->add_recipient` mit dem entsprechenden Empfängertyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_multi_recipient_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_to_recipient  TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_cc_recipient  TYPE ad_smtpadr OPTIONAL
        iv_bcc_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr OPTIONAL
        iv_subject       TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body          TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_multi_recipient_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli_tab( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Hauptempfänger
    DATA(lo_to) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_to_recipient ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to i_express = abap_true ).

    " CC-Empfänger (optional)
    IF iv_cc_recipient IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_cc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_cc_recipient ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc i_express = abap_true i_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.

    " BCC-Empfänger (optional)
    IF iv_bcc_recipient IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_bcc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_bcc_recipient ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc i_express = abap_true i_blind_copy = abap_true ).
    ENDIF.

    lo_bcs->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).

    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lo_cut->send_multi_recipient_email(

Durch die Parameter `i_copy` und `i_blind_copy` in der Methode `add_recipient` können CC- und BCC-Empfänger einfach hinzugefügt werden. Inline-Deklarationen und die klare Strukturierung des Codes machen die Handhabung mehrerer Empfänger übersichtlich.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und aggregieren Sie die Gesamtzahl der Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung. Nutzen Sie moderne Open SQL-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` mit `GROUP BY` und Aggregatfunktionen wie `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_open_sql_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_open_sql_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, connid, SUM( seatsocc ) AS total_seats
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid, connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_summary.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_open_sql_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    " Beispiel-Assertion: Prüfen, ob für eine bekannte Fluggesellschaft Daten vorhanden sind
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count_lh > 0
      MSG = 'Es sollten aggregierte Daten für Lufthansa vorhanden sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert moderne Open SQL-Funktionen, die für die effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, wie sie im Kontext von Data Aging anfallen, unerlässlich sind. Die `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` Syntax ermöglicht die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle. `GROUP BY` und `SUM` werden direkt in der Datenbank ausgeführt, was die Performance erheblich verbessert, da weniger Daten zum Applikationsserver transportiert werden müssen. Dies ist ein 'Push-Down'-Ansatz.
keywords: Open SQL, Data Aging, Aggregation, sflights, GROUP BY, SUM, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) nach Flügen, die nach einem bestimmten Datum stattfinden und eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten unter Verwendung von `FILTER` und `FOR`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator für die effiziente Filterung und den `FOR`-Operator für die Konstruktion der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_filter_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_date TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_filter_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    " Daten aus der Datenbank lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Filtern und neue Tabelle mit FOR-Operator erstellen
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate > iv_min_date AND carrid = iv_carrid ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_filter_for( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365.
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      iv_min_date = lv_test_date
      iv_carrid   = lv_test_carrid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_filtered ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle gefilterten Einträge den Kriterien entsprechen
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate > lv_test_date
        MSG = |Datum { ls_flight-fldate } ist nicht größer als { lv_test_date }| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_test_carrid
        MSG = |Fluggesellschaft { ls_flight-carrid } ist nicht { lv_test_carrid }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die leistungsstarken Operatoren `FILTER` und `FOR` für die Manipulation interner Tabellen. `FILTER` ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von Tabellen, während `FOR` die Konstruktion neuer Tabellen basierend auf den Elementen einer anderen Tabelle oder eines Bereichs vereinfacht. Diese funktionalen Ansätze sind wesentlich effizienter und lesbarer als traditionelle `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und `APPEND`-Konstrukte, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen, die im Kontext von Data Aging häufig vorkommen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, FOR, Data Filtering, Data Aging, sflights

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `SELECT`-Abfrage auf der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` aus, bei der die `WHERE`-Bedingung zur Laufzeit aus einer internen Tabelle von Selektionskriterien aufgebaut wird. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Abfragen, z.B. für Data Aging-Szenarien.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... WHERE (itab_cond)` für dynamische `WHERE`-Klauseln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_where_conditions TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_dynamic_where_clause
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflights
      WHERE (it_where_conditions)
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_dynamic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_dynamic_where( ).
    DATA: lt_conditions TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_dynamic_where_clause.

    " Bedingung 1: carrid = 'LH'
    APPEND `carrid = 'LH'` TO lt_conditions.
    " Bedingung 2: fldate > '20200101'
    APPEND `AND fldate > '20200101'` TO lt_conditions.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( lt_conditions ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    " Prüfen, ob alle gefilterten Einträge den dynamischen Kriterien entsprechen
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH'
        MSG = |Fluggesellschaft { ls_flight-carrid } ist nicht LH| ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-fldate > '20200101'
        MSG = |Datum { ls_flight-fldate } ist nicht größer als 20200101| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel (`WHERE (itab_cond)`) ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion in modernem Open SQL, die es ermöglicht, Selektionskriterien zur Laufzeit flexibel zu gestalten. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien wie Data Aging, wo die Kriterien für die Auswahl von 'kalten' oder 'warmen' Daten variieren können. Die Verwendung einer internen Tabelle von Strings für die Bedingungen ist sauberer und sicherer als die String-Verkettung in älteren ABAP-Versionen.
keywords: Dynamic SQL, WHERE, Data Aging, sflights, cl_abap_dyn_prg

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHTS`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    " Daten aus der Datenbank lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    " Summe der belegten Sitze mit REDUCE berechnen
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_test_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->get_total_occupied_seats( lv_test_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_seats > 0
      MSG = 'Die Gesamtzahl der Sitze sollte größer als 0 sein.' ).

    " Zusätzliche manuelle Prüfung (optional, für komplexere Szenarien)
    DATA: lt_sflights_check TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT SUM( seatsocc ) AS sum_seats
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @lv_test_carrid
      INTO @DATA(lv_expected_sum).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = lv_expected_sum
      MSG = 'Die berechnete Summe stimmt nicht mit der direkten DB-Summe überein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug in modernem ABAP, um interne Tabellen zu aggregieren oder zu transformieren. Er ermöglicht es, komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung zusammenzufassen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich und ist besonders nützlich für die Zusammenfassung von Daten, die im Rahmen von Data Aging-Analysen anfallen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Data Aging, sflights

CLASS zcl_cond_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cond_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.

Sie ersetzen die traditionellen `IF/ELSE IF` und `CASE/WHEN`-Konstrukte, wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf Bedingungen zuzuweisen. Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Ereignis-Handling in ABAP, bei dem eine Klasse ein Ereignis auslöst und eine andere Klasse darauf reagiert.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Ereignis mit `EVENTS`, registrieren Sie einen Handler mit `SET HANDLER` und lösen Sie das Ereignis mit `RAISE EVENT` aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_event_publisher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS data_changed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_new_value) TYPE string.
    METHODS change_data IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_publisher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD change_data.
    " Daten ändern und Ereignis auslösen
    RAISE EVENT data_changed EXPORTING iv_new_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_publisher TYPE REF TO zcl_event_publisher.
    METHODS handle_data_changed FOR EVENT data_changed OF zcl_event_publisher
      IMPORTING iv_new_value TYPE string.
    DATA mv_last_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_subscriber IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    SET HANDLER handle_data_changed FOR io_publisher.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_data_changed.
    mv_last_value = iv_new_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_publisher) = NEW zcl_event_publisher( ).
    DATA(lo_subscriber) = NEW zcl_event_subscriber( lo_publisher ).

    DATA(lv_test_value) = 'Neuer Wert 123'.
    lo_publisher->change_data( lv_test_value ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->mv_last_value exp = lv_test_value
      MSG = 'Ereignis wurde nicht korrekt verarbeitet.' ).

    DATA(lv_another_value) = 'Zweiter Wert ABC'.
    lo_publisher->change_data( lv_another_value ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_subscriber->mv_last_value exp = lv_another_value
      MSG = 'Zweites Ereignis wurde nicht korrekt verarbeitet.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ereignis-Handling ist ein zentrales Konzept der Objektorientierung und ermöglicht eine lose Kopplung zwischen Objekten. Eine Klasse (Publisher) löst ein Ereignis aus, ohne die Empfänger (Subscriber) zu kennen, und andere Klassen können sich für dieses Ereignis registrieren. Dies fördert modularen und erweiterbaren Code. Die Syntax mit `EVENTS`, `SET HANDLER` und `RAISE EVENT` ist seit langem in ABAP verfügbar, wird aber in modernem OO-Design verstärkt eingesetzt.
keywords: Object Orientation, Events, Event Handling, Publisher-Subscriber, Loose Coupling

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Nutzen Sie moderne interne Tabellenoperationen und mathematische Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `DIVIDE` für den Durchschnitt. Für die Rundung können Sie `CEIL`, `FLOOR` oder `TRUNC` in Kombination mit Multiplikation/Division verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average_round DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_rounded_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average_round IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_rounded_average.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR n IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + n
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    DATA(lv_raw_average) = lv_sum / lv_count.

    " Rundung auf zwei Dezimalstellen
    rv_average = round( val = lv_raw_average dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_rounded_average FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_rounded_average.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average_round( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_average_round=>tt_numbers(
      ( 10.123 ) ( 20.456 ) ( 30.789 ) ( 40.000 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_average( lt_test_numbers ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '25.34' ).

    DATA(lt_single_number) = VALUE zcl_math_average_round=>tt_numbers(
      ( 15.789 )
    ).
    lv_average = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_average( lt_single_number ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = '15.79' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_average_round( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_numbers) = VALUE zcl_math_average_round=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_rounded_average( lt_empty_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe der Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle effizient zu berechnen. Die Division zur Ermittlung des Durchschnitts ist Standard. Die Funktion `round()` ist eine moderne, eingebaute Funktion, die das Runden auf eine bestimmte Anzahl von Dezimalstellen vereinfacht und präziser macht als manuelle Multiplikations- und Divisionsschritte. Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` sorgt für hohe Präzision bei Gleitkommazahlen.
keywords: REDUCE, Math, Average, Rounding, decfloat34, Internal Tables

Instructions: Komprimieren Sie einen gegebenen String in ein XSTRING-Format mittels `CL_ABAP_ZIP`.

CLASS zcl_zip_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_string
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitzplätze (`seatsocc`) für jeden Flugzeugtyp (`planetype`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Nutzen Sie dabei `SELECT` und den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation in ABAP.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` um die Daten zu holen und anschließend `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             planetype TYPE sflights-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_seats,
             planetype TYPE sflights-planetype,
             avg_seats TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_avg_seats.
    TYPES tt_avg_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_plane RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE tt_avg_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_plane.
    SELECT planetype, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_data).

    rt_avg_seats = REDUCE #( INIT result TYPE tt_avg_seats
                             FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_flight_data GROUP BY ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype )
                             LET total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_flight>-seatsocc )
                                 count_flights = lines( GROUP ls_flight ) IN
                             NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result
                                                     ( planetype = ls_flight-planetype
                                                       avg_seats = COND decfloat16( WHEN count_flights > 0 THEN total_seats / count_flights ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_seats) = lo_cut->get_avg_seats_by_plane( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Ergebnis sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_avg_seats ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob ein Flugzeugtyp einen Durchschnitt hat

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie eine spezifische Datei (z.B. 'report.txt') aus einem gegebenen ZIP-Archiv (XSTRING). Wenn die Datei nicht existiert, soll ein leerer XSTRING zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` mit `LOAD` und `GET`, und prüfen Sie die Existenz der Datei mit `GET_FILE_NAMES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unzip_single_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_file_from_zip
      IMPORTING iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
                iv_file_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_file_content) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unzip_single_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_file_from_zip.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        DATA(lt_file_names) = lo_zip->get_file_names( ).

        IF line_exists( lt_file_names[ table_line = iv_file_name ] ).
          rv_file_content = lo_zip->get( iv_file_name ).
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        " Fehler beim Laden des ZIP-Archivs, rv_file_content bleibt initial
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_extract_file_from_zip FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_non_existent_file FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_file_from_zip.
    DATA(lo_multi_zipper) = NEW zcl_zip_multiple_files( ). " Reuse multi-file zipper
    DATA(lt_files) TYPE zcl_zip_multiple_files=>tt_file_content.
    DATA(lv_content1) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->convert( 'Inhalt der ersten Datei.' ).
    DATA(lv_content2) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->convert( 'Inhalt der zweiten Datei.' ).

    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'file1.txt' content = lv_content1 ) TO lt_files.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'report.txt' content = lv_content2 ) TO lt_files.

    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_multi_zipper->create_multi_file_zip( lt_files ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unzip_single_file( ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = lo_cut->extract_file_from_zip( iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring iv_file_name = 'report.txt' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Extrahierter Inhalt sollte dem Original entsprechen' act = lv_extracted_content exp = lv_content2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_non_existent_file.
    DATA(lo_multi_zipper) = NEW zcl_zip_multiple_files( ).
    DATA(lt_files) TYPE zcl_zip_multiple_files=>tt_file_content.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'file1.txt' content = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_converter( )->convert( 'Dummy' ) ) TO lt_files.
    DATA(lv_zip_xstring) = lo_multi_zipper->create_multi_file_zip( lt_files ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unzip_single_file( ).
    DATA(lv_extracted_content) = lo_cut->extract_file_from_zip( iv_zip_xstring = lv_zip_xstring iv_file_name = 'non_existent.txt' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Für nicht existierende Datei sollte leerer XSTRING zurückgegeben werden' act = lv_extracted_content exp = X'' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung zeigt den gezielten 'Import' einer einzelnen Datei aus einem ZIP-Archiv. Die Methode `GET_FILE_NAMES` wird verwendet, um die Existenz der Datei zu prüfen, bevor `GET` aufgerufen wird. Dies ist robust und verhindert Fehler, wenn eine angeforderte Datei nicht im Archiv vorhanden ist.
