Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UNION ALL`-Operation auf der Tabelle `sflights` durch, um alle Flüge der Airline 'LH' und 'AA' in einer einzigen Ergebnismenge zu erhalten. Die Ergebnisse sollen nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ... ORDER BY ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_union,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_union.
    TYPES tt_flight_union TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_aa_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_union.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_aa_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      ORDER BY carrid, fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_aa_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_aa_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_aa_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte LH Flüge enthalten' act = lv_lh_count exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-greater ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sollte AA Flüge enthalten' act = lv_aa_count exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-greater ).

    " Prüfen der Sortierung (optional, aber gute Praxis)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflights-carrid VALUE ' '.
    DATA(lv_prev_fldate) TYPE sflights-fldate VALUE '00000000'.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight.
      IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-fldate < lv_prev_fldate ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Ergebnisse sind nicht korrekt sortiert' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_fldate = ls_flight-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator in ABAP SQL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Statements zu kombinieren, ohne Duplikate zu entfernen. Dies ist effizient, wenn alle Zeilen benötigt werden. Die `ORDER BY`-Klausel sortiert das Gesamtergebnis direkt auf der Datenbank.
keywords: SELECT, UNION ALL, SQL, sflights, Database Access

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes XSTRING ein gültiges ZIP-Archiv ist, ohne es vollständig zu dekomprimieren. Geben Sie die Anzahl der enthaltenen Dateien zurück, oder 0, wenn es kein gültiges Archiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_ZIP` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_ABAP_ZIP_ERROR` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_zip_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_zip_validity
      IMPORTING iv_zip_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_num_files) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_zip_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_zip_validity.
    DATA(lo_zip) = NEW cl_abap_zip( ).

    TRY.
        lo_zip->load( iv_zip_xstring ).
        rv_num_files = lo_zip->get_num_files( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_zip_error.
        rv_num_files = 0. " Kein gültiges ZIP-Archiv
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_zip.
    DATA(lo_zipper) = NEW zcl_zip_string( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_zip) = lo_zipper->compress_string( 'Testinhalt' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_num_files) = lo_cut->check_zip_validity( lv_valid_zip ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gültiges ZIP sollte 1 Datei enthalten' act = lv_num_files exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_zip.
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = X'41424344'. " Ungültiges XSTRING, kein ZIP

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_num_files) = lo_cut->check_zip_validity( lv_invalid_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Ungültiges ZIP sollte 0 Dateien zurückgeben' act = lv_num_files exp = 0 ).

  METHOD test_empty_zip.
    DATA(lv_empty_xstring) = X''.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_zip_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_num_files) = lo_cut->check_zip_validity( lv_empty_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Leeres XSTRING sollte 0 Dateien zurückgeben' act = lv_num_files exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert eine robuste Validierung von ZIP-Archiven. Durch das Laden des XSTRING in `CL_ABAP_ZIP` innerhalb eines `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks kann überprüft werden, ob das XSTRING ein gültiges ZIP-Format darstellt. Bei einem Fehler wird die Ausnahme abgefangen und 0 Dateien zurückgegeben, ansonsten die tatsächliche Anzahl.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_having DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_stats,
             carrid      TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_stats.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Nachrichten-Factory, die verschiedene Typen von Nachrichtenobjekten (Info, Warnung, Fehler) erzeugt. Die Factory-Klasse und die konkreten Nachrichtentypen sollen als `FINAL` deklariert sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die ein Interface zurückgibt, und den `NEW` Operator für die Instanziierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_message PUBLIC.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_data,
           type      TYPE string, " 'INFO', 'WARNING', 'ERROR'
           content   TYPE string,
           timestamp TYPE timestampl,
         END OF ty_message_data.

  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_message_data.
  METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
  METHODS get_timestamp RETURNING VALUE(rv_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_message_base DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_message.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA ms_data TYPE zif_message=>ty_message_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_data-content = iv_content.
    GET TIME STAMP FIELD ms_data-timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message~get_data.
    rs_data = ms_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message~get_type.
    rv_type = ms_data-type.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message~get_content.
    rv_content = ms_data-content.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_message~get_timestamp.
    rv_timestamp = ms_data-timestamp.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_info_message DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_message_base FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_info_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_content ).
    ms_data-type = 'INFO'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_warning_message DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_message_base FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_warning_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_content ).
    ms_data-type = 'WARNING'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_message DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_message_base FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_content TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( iv_content ).
    ms_data-type = 'ERROR'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_type    TYPE string
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message) TYPE REF TO zif_message
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_message.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'INFO'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_info_message( iv_content ).
      WHEN 'WARNING'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_warning_message( iv_content ).
      WHEN 'ERROR'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_error_message( iv_content ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown message type: { iv_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_info_message FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_warning_message FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_error_message FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_message FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_info_message.
    DATA(lo_message) = zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'INFO' iv_content = 'Test Info' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_type() exp = 'INFO' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_content() exp = 'Test Info' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_warning_message.
    DATA(lo_message) = zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'WARNING' iv_content = 'Test Warning' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_type() exp = 'WARNING' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_content() exp = 'Test Warning' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_error_message.
    DATA(lo_message) = zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'ERROR' iv_content = 'Test Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_type() exp = 'ERROR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_message->get_content() exp = 'Test Error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_message.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_create_object_error ).
    zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'UNKNOWN' iv_content = 'Invalid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Factory-Pattern in modernem ABAP. Die Factory-Methode `create_message` erzeugt dynamisch Instanzen von konkreten Nachrichtentypen, die alle das `zif_message` Interface implementieren. Die Verwendung von `FINAL` für die Factory-Klasse und die konkreten Nachrichtentypen verhindert eine weitere Vererbung und stellt sicher, dass die Implementierung stabil bleibt. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_message)`) und der `NEW` Operator vereinfachen den Code.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory, Interface, FINAL, NEW, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Nachrichten (erzeugt von der Factory) so, dass nur Fehlermeldungen übrig bleiben. Die Klasse soll `FINAL` sein.

solution:
TYPE-POOLS: abap.

" (ZIF_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_BASE, ZCL_INFO_MESSAGE, ZCL_WARNING_MESSAGE, ZCL_ERROR_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_FACTORY definitions from oo_001 example are assumed to exist)

TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_message_filter DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        it_all_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_messages.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_errors FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_errors.
    DATA: lt_all_messages TYPE tt_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'INFO' iv_content = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_all_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'ERROR' iv_content = 'Error 1' ) TO lt_all_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'WARNING' iv_content = 'Warning 1' ) TO lt_all_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'ERROR' iv_content = 'Error 2' ) TO lt_all_messages.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_message_filter().
    DATA(lt_error_messages) = lo_filter->filter_error_messages( lt_all_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_error_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_messages[ 1 ]->get_content() exp = 'Error 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_error_messages[ 2 ]->get_content() exp = 'Error 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_errors.
    DATA: lt_all_messages TYPE tt_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'INFO' iv_content = 'Info 1' ) TO lt_all_messages.
    APPEND zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'WARNING' iv_content = 'Warning 1' ) TO lt_all_messages.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_message_filter().
    DATA(lt_error_messages) = lo_filter->filter_error_messages( lt_all_messages ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_error_messages ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er erstellt eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die der angegebenen Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist deutlich lesbarer und oft performanter als explizite Schleifen mit `IF`-Anweisungen. Die Methode `get_type()` wird direkt auf den Objektreferenzen in der Tabelle aufgerufen, was die Objektorientierung optimal nutzt. Die Klasse ist `FINAL`, um die Implementierung zu fixieren.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Functional Programming, Object Orientation, FINAL

" (ZIF_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_BASE, ZCL_INFO_MESSAGE, ZCL_WARNING_MESSAGE, ZCL_ERROR_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_FACTORY definitions from oo_001 example are assumed to exist)

TYPES: tt_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_operation_with_messages DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.

    METHODS perform_operation

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_message_handler DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_message
      IMPORTING
        io_message TYPE REF TO zif_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_info) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_error_specific
      IMPORTING
        io_error_message TYPE REF TO zcl_error_message
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_message_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_message.
    IF io_message IS INSTANCE OF zcl_error_message.
      DATA(lo_error_message) = CAST zcl_error_message( io_message ).
      rv_processed_info = handle_error_specific( lo_error_message ).
    ELSEIF io_message IS INSTANCE OF zcl_warning_message.
      rv_processed_info = |Warning message handled: { io_message->get_content() }|.
    ELSEIF io_message IS INSTANCE OF zcl_info_message.
      rv_processed_info = |Info message handled: { io_message->get_content() }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_processed_info = |Unknown message type handled: { io_message->get_content() }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_error_specific.
    " In a real scenario, this might log the error, trigger an alert, etc.
    rv_info = |Specific error handling for: { io_error_message->get_content() }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: ty_message_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

CLASS zcl_message_aggregator DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_message_types
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_message_count_map.

CLASS zcl_message_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_message_types.
    rt_counts = REDUCE ty_message_count_map(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_message_count_map( )
      FOR lo_message IN it_messages
      LET lv_type = lo_message->get_type() IN
      NEXT counts = VALUE ty_message_count_map(
        counts
        ( lv_type = counts[ lv_type ] + 1 OPTIONAL )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory_dynamic DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_default_prefix TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    METHODS create_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_type    TYPE string
        iv_content TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_message) TYPE REF TO zif_message
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_default_prefix TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_factory_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_default_prefix = iv_default_prefix.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_message.
    DATA(lv_final_content) = iv_content.
    IF mv_default_prefix IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_final_content = |{ mv_default_prefix }: { iv_content }|.
    ENDIF.

    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'INFO'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_info_message( lv_final_content ).
      WHEN 'WARNING'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_warning_message( lv_final_content ).
      WHEN 'ERROR'.
        ro_message = NEW zcl_error_message( lv_final_content ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unknown message type: { iv_type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouper DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE tt_flight_counts(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        count  = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Die Klasse soll `FINAL` sein.

solution:
TYPE-POOLS: abap.

CLASS zcl_sflights_math DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_math IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_flight IN lt_filtered_flights
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price
      ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" (ZIF_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_BASE, ZCL_INFO_MESSAGE, ZCL_WARNING_MESSAGE, ZCL_ERROR_MESSAGE, ZCL_MESSAGE_FACTORY definitions from oo_001 example are assumed to exist)

CLASS zcl_generic_message_list DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_message IMPORTING io_message TYPE REF TO zif_message.
    METHODS get_all_messages_formatted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_output) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_messages TYPE tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_message_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_message.
    APPEND io_message TO mt_messages.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_messages_formatted.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_message_formatter(). " Reusing formatter from str_003

    rv_formatted_output = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR lo_msg IN mt_messages
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lo_formatter->format_message( lo_msg )
        ELSE s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lo_formatter->format_message( lo_msg )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_message_list) = NEW zcl_generic_message_list().
    DATA(lo_info_msg) = zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'INFO' iv_content = 'First info.' ).
    WAIT UP TO '0.001' SECONDS.
    DATA(lo_error_msg) = zcl_message_factory=>create_message( iv_type = 'ERROR' iv_content = 'Critical error.' ).

    lo_message_list->add_message( lo_info_msg ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( lo_error_msg ).

    DATA(lv_output) = lo_message_list->get_all_messages_formatted().

    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_message_formatter().
    DATA(lv_expected_info) = lo_formatter->format_message( lo_info_msg ).
    DATA(lv_expected_error) = lo_formatter->format_message( lo_error_msg ).
    DATA(lv_expected_output) = lv_expected_info && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_expected_error.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_output exp = lv_expected_output ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_message_list.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = NEW zcl_generic_message_list().
    DATA(lv_output) = lo_message_list->get_all_messages_formatted().
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_output ).

INTERFACE zif_message_collector PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_message_collector_impl DEFINITION FINAL PUBLIC.

    rb_has_errors = COND abap_bool(

CLASS zcl_ida_custom_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ida_custom_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lo_alv_ida) = cl_salv_gui_table_ida=>create_for_table( iv_table_name = 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv_ida->get_columns( ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).
        lo_column->set_aggregation( if_salv_gui_column_ida=>g_aggregation_sum ).
        lo_column->set_long_text( 'Total Price' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ida_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        out->write( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_grouping) = lo_alv_ida->get_grouping( ).
    TRY.
        lo_grouping->add_group_by_column( 'CARRID' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_ida_error INTO lx_error.
        out->write( lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    lo_alv_ida->display( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem Betreff und einem Text an einen Empfänger.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'your.email@example.com'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA(lv_subject)   = 'Test E-Mail from ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_body)      = 'This is a test email sent from a modern ABAP program using BCS.'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( 'abap.sender@example.com' ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( i_sender = lo_sender ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->set_subject( lv_subject ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
                              i_subject = lv_subject ).
        lo_bcs->set_main_document( lo_document ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
        COMMIT WORK.

        out->write( |E-Mail sent successfully to { lv_recipient }!| ).

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        out->write( |Error sending email: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Betreff, einem Text und einem angehängten Textdokument.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_document_bcs=>create_document` für den Haupttext und `add_attachment` für den Anhang.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_with_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'your.email@example.com'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA(lv_subject)   = 'E-Mail with Attachment from ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_body)      = 'Please find the attached document.'.
    DATA(lv_attachment_content) = 'This is the content of the attached text file.'.
    DATA(lv_attachment_name) = 'attachment.txt'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( 'abap.sender@example.com' ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( i_sender = lo_sender ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->set_subject( lv_subject ).

        DATA(lo_main_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                                    i_type    = 'RAW'
                                    i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
                                    i_subject = lv_subject ).
        lo_bcs->set_main_document( lo_main_document ).

        " Create attachment
        DATA(lt_attachment_soli) = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_attachment_content ).
        DATA(lo_attachment) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                                 i_type    = 'RAW'
                                 i_text    = lt_attachment_soli
                                 i_length  = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>soli_to_xstring( lt_attachment_soli ) )
                                 i_subject = lv_attachment_name ).
        lo_bcs->add_attachment( i_document = lo_attachment
                                i_attachment_type = 'TXT'
                                i_attachment_size = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>soli_to_xstring( lt_attachment_soli ) )
                                i_attachment_filename = lv_attachment_name ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
        COMMIT WORK.

        out->write( |E-Mail with attachment sent successfully to { lv_recipient }!| ).

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        out->write( |Error sending email with attachment: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger, einschließlich TO, CC und BCC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_to_recipient)  = 'to.email@example.com'.   " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA(lv_cc_recipient)  = 'cc.email@example.com'.   " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA(lv_bcc_recipient) = 'bcc.email@example.com'. " Ersetzen Sie dies durch eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse
    DATA(lv_subject)       = 'Multi-Recipient E-Mail'.
    DATA(lv_body)          = 'This email is sent to multiple recipients (TO, CC, BCC).'.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_instance( ).

        DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( 'abap.sender@example.com' ).
        lo_bcs->set_sender( i_sender = lo_sender ).

        " Add TO recipient
        DATA(lo_to) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_to_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_to
                               i_express   = abap_true ). " i_express = abap_true for TO

        " Add CC recipient
        DATA(lo_cc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_cc
                               i_express   = abap_false
                               i_copy      = abap_true ). " i_copy = abap_true for CC

        " Add BCC recipient
        DATA(lo_bcc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_bcc
                               i_express   = abap_false
                               i_copy      = abap_true
                               i_blind_copy = abap_true ). " i_blind_copy = abap_true for BCC

        lo_bcs->set_subject( lv_subject ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                              i_type    = 'RAW'
                              i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
                              i_subject = lv_subject ).
        lo_bcs->set_main_document( lo_document ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
        COMMIT WORK.

        out->write( |E-Mail sent successfully to multiple recipients!| ).

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        out->write( |Error sending multi-recipient email: { lx_bcs->get_text( ) }| ).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight, carrid TYPE sflight-carrid, connid TYPE sflight-connid, fldate TYPE sflight-fldate, price TYPE sflight-price, END OF ty_sflight. TYPES sflights_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE sflights_tt
        iv_date    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflights_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate = iv_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE sflights_tt,
          lv_test_date  TYPE sflight-fldate VALUE '20251201'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251202'. <fs_flight>-price = '200'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = '20251201'. <fs_flight>-price = '150'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_date( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_flights = lt_test_flights iv_date = lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).

    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE sflights_tt,

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'DL'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0002'. <fs_flight>-fldate = lo_next_month->value. <fs_flight>-price = '400'.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen UTC-Timestamp in einen Timestamp einer bestimmten Zeitzone (z.B. 'CET').

CLASS zcl_xco_timezone_conversion DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utc_to_timezone

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timezone_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_timezone_conversion( ).

    " UTC 2023-01-01 12:00:00
    DATA(lv_utc_ts_string) = '20230101120000'.
    " CET is UTC+1, so 12:00 UTC should be 13:00 CET
    DATA(lv_expected_cet_ts) = '20230101130000'.

    DATA(lv_converted_ts) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_timezone( iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_ts_string iv_timezone_id = 'CET' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_ts exp = lv_expected_cet_ts ).

    " Test with another timezone, e.g., EST (UTC-5)
    DATA(lv_expected_est_ts) = '20230101070000'.
    lv_converted_ts = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_timezone( iv_utc_timestamp = lv_utc_ts_string iv_timezone_id = 'EST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_ts exp = lv_expected_est_ts ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_last_month_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_last_month_flights.
    DATA(lo_today) = xco_cp_time=>date->get_current( ).
    DATA(lo_first_day_current_month) = xco_cp_time=>date->get_first_day_of_month( lo_today ).
    DATA(lo_first_day_last_month) = xco_cp_time=>date->subtract( lo_first_day_current_month )->months( 1 ).
    DATA(lo_last_day_last_month) = xco_cp_time=>date->subtract( lo_first_day_current_month )->days( 1 ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate BETWEEN lo_first_day_last_month->value AND lo_last_day_last_month->value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt einer Liste von Dezimalzahlen. Fange dabei eine mögliche Division durch Null ab und gib in diesem Fall 0 zurück.
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und den `DIVIDE` Operator, kombiniert mit `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE decfloat34( INIT s = 0 FOR <num> IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + <num> ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    TRY.
        IF lv_count > 0.
          rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
        ELSE.
          rv_average = 0.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_average = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_percentage_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_percentage_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_percentage) = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN iv_total <> 0 THEN ( iv_part / iv_total ) * 100

  ENDMETHOD.

             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS divide_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_divisor TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_divided_prices) TYPE tt_sflight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_flight_prices.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_divided_prices = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid   = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
                                   price    = ls_sflight-price / iv_divisor
                                   currency = ls_sflight-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führe eine Division durch und fange den Fehler 'Division durch Null' (cx_sy_arithmetic_error) ab. Gib im Fehlerfall eine spezifische Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwende `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausnahme `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat34
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat34
      EXPORTING
        ev_result      TYPE decfloat34
        ev_error_msg   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    CLEAR ev_error_msg.
    TRY.
        ev_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        ev_result = 0.
        ev_error_msg = |Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die zwei Zahlen dividiert. Wenn der Divisor Null ist, soll stattdessen ein vordefinierter Standardwert zurückgegeben werden, ohne eine Ausnahme auszulösen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_divided_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat34
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat34
        iv_default     TYPE decfloat34 DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_divided_value.
    rv_result = COND decfloat34(
      WHEN iv_denominator <> 0 THEN iv_numerator / iv_denominator
      ELSE iv_default
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Nutze dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für Gruppierung und Aggregation.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` in Kombination mit dem `DIVIDE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES: tt_avg_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                             ( carrid    = ls_group-carrid
                               avg_price = REDUCE decfloat34(
                                 INIT s = 0 c = 0
                                 FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_group
                                 NEXT s = s + ls_member-price,
                                      c = c + 1
                                 FINALLY: COND decfloat34( WHEN c > 0 THEN s / c ELSE 0 )
                               )
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF decfloat34 WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS divide_numbers_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers     TYPE tt_numbers
        iv_divisor     TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_divided_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers_dynamically.
    rt_divided_numbers = VALUE #( FOR <num> IN it_numbers
                                  ( COND decfloat34(
                                      WHEN iv_divisor <> 0 THEN <num> / iv_divisor
                                      ELSE 0 " Default value for division by zero
                                    ) )
                                ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Quotienten aus zwei Spalten (`PRICE` und `SEATSMAX`) der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für jeden Flug und speichere das Ergebnis in einer neuen Spalte einer internen Tabelle. Behandle Division durch Null.
hint: Nutze eine `FOR` Expression mit `VALUE` und `COND` für die bedingte Division.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_price_per_seat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             price_per_seat TYPE decfloat34,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_price_per_seat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_data) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_price_per_seat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_per_seat.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid connid fldate price seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                               ( carrid       = ls_sflight-carrid
                                 connid       = ls_sflight-connid
                                 fldate       = ls_sflight-fldate
                                 price        = ls_sflight-price
                                 seatsmax     = ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                 price_per_seat = COND decfloat34(
                                                    WHEN ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_sflight-price / ls_sflight-seatsmax
                                                    ELSE 0
                                                  )
                               ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_per_seat_calculation FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_per_seat_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_per_seat( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_price_per_seat( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result).
      IF ls_result-seatsmax > 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price_per_seat exp = ls_result-price / ls_result-seatsmax ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price_per_seat exp = 0 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_price_per_seat_zero_seats.
    " This test requires specific data in SFLIGHTS or mocking.
    " For simplicity, we'll assume the logic handles it correctly.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_price_per_seat( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_price_per_seat( ).
    " If there are any entries with seatsmax = 0, price_per_seat should be 0
    DATA(lv_found_zero_seats) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result) WHERE seatsmax = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-price_per_seat exp = 0 ).
      lv_found_zero_seats = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
    " If no zero seats found, this assertion will pass vacuously.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die den Durchschnitt von Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle berechnet. Die Methode soll generisch sein und mit verschiedenen numerischen Typen umgehen können. Nutze RTTI, um den Typ der Zahlen zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen und eine sichere Division durchzuführen.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_datadescr` für RTTI. Die Aggregation und Division müssen typunabhängig erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_generic_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_defined.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_average IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_generic_average.
    DATA: lv_sum TYPE decfloat34 VALUE 0,
          lv_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( it_numbers ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF lo_line_descr->kind <> cl_abap_datadescr=>kind_num AND
       lo_line_descr->kind <> cl_abap_datadescr=>kind_int AND
       lo_line_descr->kind <> cl_abap_datadescr=>kind_float AND
       lo_line_descr->kind <> cl_abap_datadescr=>kind_decfloat.
      " Handle non-numeric types, or raise an exception
      MESSAGE 'Table line type is not numeric' TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_defined.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_numbers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_number>).
      lv_sum = lv_sum + <fs_number>.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        IF lv_count > 0.
          rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
        ELSE.
          rv_average = 0.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_average = 0.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.
    lt_string_table = VALUE #( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_average( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_generic_average( lt_string_table ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for non-numeric table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_defined.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for non-numeric table' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) in ABAP, um eine generische Methode zur Durchschnittsberechnung zu erstellen. `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `cl_abap_datadescr` werden verwendet, um den Typ der Tabellenzeilen zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen. Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugpreis (PRICE) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT, indem Sie einen neuen Preis aus einer internen Tabelle verwenden. Nutzen Sie die moderne Syntax mit `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_new_prices TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lt_sflight_filtered) = FILTER #( it_new_prices USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    IF lt_sflight_filtered IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflight_filtered.
      rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Expression mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING` um die interne Tabelle zu modifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_for_carrier.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                                            THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-price = ls_flight-price + iv_increase )
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_flight_node.

      IMPORTING

        VALUE(ro_list_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

    DATA mt_nodes TYPE tt_flight_nodes.

      IMPORTING

      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE lvc_value
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey

CLASS zcl_tree_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_flight_tree.
    ro_list_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container

    ).

    DATA(lv_node_key_lh) = add_root_node( 'Lufthansa' ).
    add_child_node( iv_text = 'Flight LH 0400' iv_parent_key = lv_node_key_lh ).

    DATA(lv_node_key_ua) = add_root_node( 'United Airlines' ).
    add_child_node( iv_text = 'Flight UA 0001' iv_parent_key = lv_node_key_ua ).

    ro_list_tree->set_table_for_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_TREE_BUILDER=>TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        i_node_key_field       = 'NODE_KEY'
        i_parent_key_field     = 'PARENT_KEY'
        i_text_field           = 'TEXT'
      CHANGING
        t_outtab               = mt_nodes
    ).

    ro_list_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    rv_node_key = |NODE_{ sy-tabix }|.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = rv_node_key text = iv_text parent_key = '' ) TO mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_child_node.
    rv_node_key = |NODE_{ sy-tabix }|.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = rv_node_key text = iv_text parent_key = iv_parent_key ) TO mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Flugverbindung (CONNID) und erstellen Sie eine hierarchische interne Tabelle, die für die Anzeige in einem Tree Control geeignet wäre. Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR GROUPS` Expression, um hierarchische Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_for_tree DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_tree_node,
             node_key   TYPE lvc_nkey,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text       TYPE lvc_value,
             level      TYPE i,
           END OF ty_tree_node.
    TYPES: tt_tree_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_tree_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flights_for_tree
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_tree_nodes) TYPE tt_tree_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_for_tree IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights_for_tree.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.

    rt_tree_nodes = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_sflight
                               GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
                               ASCENDING BY carrid
                               LET lv_carrid_key = |CARR_{ ++lv_node_counter }|
                               IN (
                                 " Root node for carrier
                                 VALUE ty_tree_node( node_key = lv_carrid_key parent_key = '' text = ls_flight-carrid level = 0 )
                                 " Child nodes for connections
                                 FOR GROUPS OF ls_conn IN GROUP ls_flight
                                   GROUP BY ( connid = ls_conn-connid )
                                   ASCENDING BY connid
                                   LET lv_connid_key = |CONN_{ ++lv_node_counter }|
                                   IN (
                                     VALUE ty_tree_node( node_key = lv_connid_key parent_key = lv_carrid_key text = |{ ls_conn-carrid } { ls_conn-connid }| level = 1 )
                                     " Grandchild nodes for individual flights
                                     FOR ls_fldate IN GROUP ls_conn
                                       ASCENDING BY fldate
                                       LET lv_fldate_key = |FLT_{ ++lv_node_counter }|
                                       IN (
                                         VALUE ty_tree_node( node_key = lv_fldate_key parent_key = lv_connid_key text = |{ ls_fldate-fldate } ({ ls_fldate-price } EUR)| level = 2 )
                                       )
                                   )
                               )
                             ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_for_tree.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_for_tree( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE zcl_group_for_tree=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = 120.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 200.00 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 300.00 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_tree_nodes) = lo_cut->get_grouped_flights_for_tree( it_sflight = lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_tree_nodes ) exp = 7 msg = 'Should have 7 nodes (2 carriers, 2 connections, 3 flights)' ).

    " Check root nodes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 1 ]-text exp = 'LH' msg = 'First root node should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_tree_nodes[ 1 ]-parent_key msg = 'LH should be a root node' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 5 ]-text exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second root node should be AA' ).

    " Check child nodes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 2 ]-text exp = 'LH 0400' msg = 'First child node should be LH 0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 2 ]-parent_key exp = lt_tree_nodes[ 1 ]-node_key msg = 'LH 0400 should be child of LH' ).

    " Check grandchild nodes
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 3 ]-text exp = '20250101 (100.00 EUR)' msg = 'First grandchild node should be flight date' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_tree_nodes[ 3 ]-parent_key exp = lt_tree_nodes[ 2 ]-node_key msg = 'Flight date should be child of LH 0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS` Expression (ABAP 7.50+) ist ideal, um hierarchische Datenstrukturen aus flachen internen Tabellen zu generieren. Durch verschachtelte `FOR GROUPS` und die Verwendung von `LET` für temporäre Variablen (wie `lv_node_counter` zur Generierung eindeutiger Schlüssel) kann man sehr effizient und deklarativ die Daten für ein Tree Control vorbereiten. Dies ersetzt komplexe Schleifen und manuelle Schlüsselverwaltung.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, FOR GROUPS, HIERARCHY, TREE CONTROL, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT-Struktur) nach Flügen, die einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben und aktualisieren Sie diese gefilterten Einträge in einer neuen internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um die relevanten Zeilen auszuwählen, und dann eine `FOR` Expression, um die Werte zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_update_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_price_threshold TYPE sflight-price
        iv_discount_amount TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_update_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_expensive_flights.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_price_threshold
                                            THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-price = ls_flight-price - iv_discount_amount )
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 200.00 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 250.00 currency = 'USD' )

In Kombination mit einer `FOR` Expression und `COND` kann man die gefilterten Daten direkt in einer neuen internen Tabelle aktualisieren, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `MODIFY` Anweisungen. Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie hierfür die `REDUCE` Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE` Expression, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum_prices( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum_prices=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 250.00 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 300.00 currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250102' price = 150.00 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 500.00 msg = 'Total price for LH should be 500.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 300.00 msg = 'Total price for AA should be 300.00' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0.00 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0.00' ).

explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression (ABAP 7.40+) ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit Akkumulator in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung auszudrücken. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb von `REDUCE` filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen effizient, was zu sehr kompaktem und ausdrucksstarkem Code führt.
keywords: INTERNAL TABLES, REDUCE, AGGREGATION, SUM, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von Flugdaten in der Tabelle SFLIGHT durch, indem Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den zu aktualisierenden Werten verwenden. Nutzen Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit `FROM TABLE` und einer `WHERE` Klausel, die auf Schlüsselfeldern basiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_updates WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid AND connid = @ls_update-connid AND fldate = @ls_update-fldate`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_update.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE tt_sflight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_update_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flights.
    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      UPDATE sflight SET price = @ls_update-price, planetype = @ls_update-planetype
        WHERE carrid = @ls_update-carrid AND connid = @ls_update-connid AND fldate = @ls_update-fldate.
      rv_updated_rows = rv_updated_rows + sy-dbcnt.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mass_update FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' planetype = '747' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 200.00 currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mass_update_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_mass_update_sflight=>tt_sflight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 150.00 planetype = 'A380' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250101' price = 250.00 planetype = 'A321' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_updated) = lo_cut->mass_update_flights( it_updates = lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated exp = 2 msg = 'Two rows should be updated' ).

    DATA(ls_sflight_check1) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_check1
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check1-price exp = 150.00 msg = 'Price for LH 0400 should be 150.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check1-planetype exp = 'A380' msg = 'Planetype for LH 0400 should be A380' ).

    DATA(ls_sflight_check2) = VALUE sflight( ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_sflight_check2
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0401' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check2-price exp = 250.00 msg = 'Price for LH 0401 should be 250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight_check2-planetype exp = 'A321' msg = 'Planetype for LH 0401 should be A321' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP 7.40+ die `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Syntax bietet, kann es Szenarien geben, in denen eine zeilenweise Aktualisierung mit einer `LOOP AT` und `UPDATE SET ... WHERE` Anweisung vorteilhafter ist, insbesondere wenn die `WHERE`-Klausel komplexer ist oder nicht alle Felder der internen Tabelle aktualisiert werden sollen. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(ls_update)`) und Hostvariablen (`@ls_update-field`) ist hierbei der moderne Standard.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE, SFLIGHT, MASS UPDATE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Event-Handler für das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK` Ereignis einer `cl_gui_list_tree` Instanz. Die Methode soll den Schlüssel des doppelt geklickten Knotens auslesen und verarbeiten.
hint: Definieren Sie eine `WITH EVENTS` Schnittstelle oder eine lokale Klasse mit `FOR EVENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS get_tree_control
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_list_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_list_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE zcl_tree_builder=>tt_flight_nodes. " Reusing type from previous example

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

    METHODS add_root_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE lvc_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS add_child_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE lvc_value
        iv_parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_list_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_selection_mode_single
    ).

    DATA(lv_node_key_lh) = add_root_node( 'Lufthansa' ).
    add_child_node( iv_text = 'Flight LH 0400' iv_parent_key = lv_node_key_lh ).

    mo_list_tree->set_table_for_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_TREE_BUILDER=>TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        i_node_key_field       = 'NODE_KEY'
        i_parent_key_field     = 'PARENT_KEY'
        i_text_field           = 'TEXT'
      CHANGING
        t_outtab               = mt_nodes
    ).
    mo_list_tree->expand_tree( ).

    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tree_control.
    ro_list_tree = mo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    " In a real application, you would process the node_key here.
    " For demonstration, we'll just store it or log it.
    cl_demo_output=>display( |Node '{ node_key }' double-clicked!| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_root_node.
    rv_node_key = |ROOT_{ sy-tabix }|.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_builder=>ty_flight_node( node_key = rv_node_key text = iv_text parent_key = '' ) TO mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_child_node.
    rv_node_key = |CHILD_{ sy-tabix }|.
    APPEND VALUE zcl_tree_builder=>ty_flight_node( node_key = rv_node_key text = iv_text parent_key = iv_parent_key ) TO mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_handler FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_container( ). " Dummy container
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( io_container = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_list_tree) = lo_cut->get_tree_control( ).

    " Simulate a double-click event. This requires calling the event handler directly
    " as GUI events cannot be triggered in a pure unit test environment.
    DATA(lv_test_node_key) = 'CHILD_1'. " Assuming this is the key for 'Flight LH 0400'

    " We need to call the event handler method directly for testing purposes.
    " In a real scenario, the framework would call it.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->handle_node_double_click( node_key = lv_test_node_key ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( '' msg = 'Event handler executed without dump' ).
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Event handler call failed' ).
    ENDTRY.

    FREE lo_container.
    FREE lo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Event-Behandlung in ABAP Objects erfolgt über die `FOR EVENT` Syntax in der Methodendefinition und die `SET HANDLER` Anweisung. Dies ist der moderne Weg, um auf GUI-Ereignisse zu reagieren. Im Beispiel wird das `NODE_DOUBLE_CLICK` Ereignis der `cl_gui_list_tree` abgefangen. Die Methode `handle_node_double_click` empfängt den `node_key` des geklickten Knotens, der dann weiterverarbeitet werden kann. `cl_demo_output=>display` ist hier ein Platzhalter für die tatsächliche Anwendungslogik.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einer internen Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT-Struktur) neue Einträge hinzu, wobei Sie den `VALUE` Operator und `FOR` Expressions verwenden, um die Daten aus einer anderen Quelle zu transformieren und einzufügen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #` mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` um neue Zeilen zu generieren und einzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_with_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_new_flight_data,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflight-connid,
             departure_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             base_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_new_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_new_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_new_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_new_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_existing_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_source_data TYPE tt_new_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_with_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_flights.
    rt_combined_flights = VALUE #( it_existing_flights
                                   FOR ls_source IN it_source_data
                                   ( VALUE #( carrid   = ls_source-airline_id
                                             connid   = ls_source-flight_num
                                             fldate   = ls_source-departure_date
                                             price    = ls_source-base_price
                                             currency = 'EUR' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_with_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_insert_with_value_for=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = 100.00 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_insert_with_value_for=>tt_new_flight_data(
      ( airline_id = 'AA' flight_num = '0001' departure_date = '20250101' base_price = 200.00 )
      ( airline_id = 'UA' flight_num = '0002' departure_date = '20250101' base_price = 300.00 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_combined) = lo_cut->add_new_flights( it_existing_flights = lt_existing it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_combined ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should have 3 flights after adding' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First flight should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second flight should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Third flight should be UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_combined[ 2 ]-price exp = 200.00 msg = 'AA flight price should be 200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie mehrere Felder einer internen Tabelle von Flügen (SFLIGHT-Struktur) basierend auf einer Bedingung. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine `FOR` Expression mit `COND` und `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` und `VALUE #` um bedingt mehrere Felder zu aktualisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_multi_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_new_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_multi_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_details.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrid
                                            THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-price = iv_new_price
                                                          ls_flight-planetype = iv_new_planetype )
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie dynamisch einen neuen Root-Knoten zu einer bestehenden `cl_gui_list_tree` Instanz hinzu und aktualisieren Sie die Anzeige.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `ADD_NODE` der Klasse `cl_gui_list_tree` und anschließend `UPDATE_ITEM`.

CLASS zcl_tree_add_node DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE lvc_value,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
           END OF ty_flight_node.
    TYPES: tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS get_tree_control
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_list_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

    METHODS add_new_root_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE lvc_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_list_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE tt_flight_nodes.

    METHODS add_initial_nodes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_add_node IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_list_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_selection_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_selection_mode_single
    ).
    add_initial_nodes( ).
    mo_list_tree->set_table_for_nodes(
      EXPORTING
        i_table_structure_name = 'ZCL_TREE_ADD_NODE=>TY_FLIGHT_NODE'
        i_node_key_field       = 'NODE_KEY'
        i_parent_key_field     = 'PARENT_KEY'
        i_text_field           = 'TEXT'
      CHANGING
        t_outtab               = mt_nodes
    ).
    mo_list_tree->expand_tree( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_tree_control.
    ro_list_tree = mo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_initial_nodes.
    DATA(lv_node_key_lh) = |ROOT_1|.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = lv_node_key_lh text = 'Lufthansa' parent_key = '' ) TO mt_nodes.
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_node( node_key = |CHILD_1| text = 'Flight LH 0400' parent_key = lv_node_key_lh ) TO mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_new_root_node.
    DATA(lv_new_key) = |NEW_ROOT_{ lines( mt_nodes ) + 1 }|.
    DATA(ls_node_data) = VALUE lvc_s_nkey(
      node_key = lv_new_key
      text     = iv_text
    ).

    mo_list_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = lv_new_key
        i_relat_node_key = '' " Root node
        i_position = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_pos_last
        i_node_data = ls_node_data
    ).
    mo_list_tree->update_item( ). " Refresh the display
    rv_new_node_key = lv_new_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_root_node FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_root_node.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_container( ). " Dummy container
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_add_node( io_container = lo_container ).
    DATA(lo_list_tree) = lo_cut->get_tree_control( ).

    DATA(lv_initial_node_count) = lines( lo_cut->mt_nodes ).

    DATA(lv_new_node_key) = lo_cut->add_new_root_node( 'New Airline' ).

    " We cannot directly check the tree's internal state after ADD_NODE
    " without mocking. We assert that the method executed and returned a key.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_new_node_key msg = 'New node key should be generated' ).
    " A more advanced test would mock CL_GUI_LIST_TREE and verify ADD_NODE call.

    FREE lo_container.
    FREE lo_list_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
