Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu, unter Verwendung des COND-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie COND anstelle von IF...ENDIF für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 THEN |Verspätet um { iv_delay_minutes } Minuten|
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes = 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 10 ) exp = 'Verspätet um 10 Minuten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 0 ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( -5 ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Werts basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen in einer einzigen Zeile, was den Code für bedingte Logik deutlich kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle IF-Konstrukte.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT in eine interne Tabelle, wobei nur die benötigten Felder und der INTO TABLE @DATA()-Syntax verwendet werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie SELECT mit FIELDS, INTO TABLE @DATA() und CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).
    ELSE.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw).
    ENDIF.

    " Using CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF for potential type conversion/mapping if needed
    " In this simple case, direct assignment would also work if types match exactly.
    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflight_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sflight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sflight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_select( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights IS NOT INITIAL ). " Check if data was retrieved
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 20 ). " Assuming LH has 20 entries in SFLIGHT
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von SELECT mit INTO TABLE @DATA() und dem @-Escape-Zeichen für Host-Variablen ist der moderne Standard für Datenbankzugriffe. CORRESPONDING ermöglicht eine typsichere Zuweisung zwischen Strukturen/Tabellen mit gleichen Feldnamen.
keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA(), CORRESPONDING, Database Access, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen, um Operationen auf einem Objekt sequenziell auszuführen.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt zurückgibt (ME->).
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS set_value2 IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 30 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zusammengefasst werden. Dies wird durch Methoden ermöglicht, die eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in einen JSON-String.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_flights_to_json
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serializer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_flights_to_json.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = it_flights
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = rv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serializer( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_json_serializer=>ty_t_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.50' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_flights_to_json( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_json IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"CARRID": "LH"' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '"PRICE": "200.50"' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER bietet eine standardisierte und effiziente Möglichkeit, ABAP-Datenstrukturen in JSON-Strings zu serialisieren, was für die Integration mit externen Systemen unerlässlich ist. Die Option PRETTY_PRINT verbessert die Lesbarkeit des JSON-Outputs.
keywords: JSON, Serialization, CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER, Data Exchange, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_number DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_int
      IMPORTING
        iv_min TYPE i
        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_number IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_int.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>seed(
      min  = iv_min
      max  = iv_max
    ).
    rv_random_number = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_int FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_int.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_number( ).
    DATA(lv_rand) = lo_cut->generate_random_int( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_rand >= 1 AND lv_rand <= 10 ) ).

    " Test multiple times to increase confidence, though true randomness is hard to test
    DATA(lv_rand2) = lo_cut->generate_random_int( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
    DATA(lv_rand3) = lo_cut->generate_random_int( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_rand2 >= 1 AND lv_rand2 <= 10 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_rand3 >= 1 AND lv_rand3 <= 10 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT bietet eine sichere und standardisierte Methode zur Generierung von Zufallszahlen. Die Verwendung von cl_abap_random=>seed() stellt sicher, dass eine neue Seed für jede Instanz verwendet wird, was zu besseren Zufallsergebnissen führt.
keywords: Random Numbers, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Utilities, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle nach einem Feld und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppen, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... mit dem GROUP SIZE Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_t_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itb_group_by=>ty_t_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0600' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_output) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_output ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' INTO DATA(ls_lh_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_count-count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_output WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_count-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Syntax ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Einträgen in internen Tabellen. Der GROUP SIZE-Operator liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was Aggregationen vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Bildschirm mit einem Custom Container und integrieren Sie `cl_gui_gos_container` darin, um die Generic Object Services (GOS) für ein beliebiges Business-Objekt (z.B. eine Flugbuchung aus `SFLIGHTS`) anzuzeigen. Der Fokus liegt auf der Anzeige von Anlagen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_gos_container`. Denken Sie daran, `cl_gui_cfw=>flush` aufzurufen, um die Controls zu aktualisieren. Nutzen Sie `BORIDENT` für das Business-Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_mgr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        is_sflight_key    TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS display_gos_services.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_gos_container    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container.
    DATA ms_sflight_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA mv_object_type      TYPE borident-objtype VALUE 'BUS2017'. " Example: Flight Booking
    DATA mv_object_key       TYPE borident-objkey.

    METHODS create_object_key
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_key) TYPE borident-objkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_mgr IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight_key = is_sflight_key.
    mv_object_key = create_object_key( ms_sflight_key ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Error handling in real application
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_gos_container
      EXPORTING
        ip_container = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Error handling in real application
    ENDIF.

    mo_gos_container->set_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE borident( objtype = mv_object_type objkey = mv_object_key )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_gos_services.
    " In a real screen, this would be called in PBO.
    " The GOS container automatically displays its services.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_key.
    " Modern string template for object key creation
    rv_object_key = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    " Pad with spaces to match BORIDENT-OBJKEY length (70 chars)
    rv_object_key = rv_object_key && |{ space( 70 - strlen( rv_object_key ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_gos_container_init FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_object_key_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_gos_container_init.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE zcl_gos_attachment_mgr=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_sflight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight_key-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER_01'.

    DATA(lo_gos_mgr) = NEW zcl_gos_attachment_mgr(
      iv_container_name = lv_container_name
      is_sflight_key    = ls_sflight_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_gos_mgr->mo_custom_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_gos_mgr->mo_gos_container ).

    DATA(lv_expected_objkey) = lo_gos_mgr->create_object_key( ls_sflight_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_gos_mgr->mv_object_key
      exp = lv_expected_objkey
      msg = 'Object key should be correctly set'
    ).

    lo_gos_mgr->display_gos_services( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_object_key_creation.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE zcl_gos_attachment_mgr=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_sflight_key-carrid = 'AA'.
    ls_sflight_key-connid = '0001'.
    ls_sflight_key-fldate = '20251204'.

    DATA(lo_gos_mgr) = NEW zcl_gos_attachment_mgr(
      iv_container_name = 'DUMMY'
      is_sflight_key    = ls_sflight_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_generated_key) = lo_gos_mgr->create_object_key( ls_sflight_key ).
    DATA(lv_expected_key) = |AA000120251204|.
    lv_expected_key = lv_expected_key && |{ space( 70 - strlen( lv_expected_key ) ) }|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_generated_key
      exp = lv_expected_key
      msg = 'Object key creation should be correct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE` für die Inline-Initialisierung von Strukturen und String-Templates (`|...|`) für die dynamische Erstellung des Objekt-Keys. Die Kapselung in einer Klasse fördert die Objektorientierung. Der Unit-Test überprüft die korrekte Instanziierung und die Zuweisung des Business-Objekts.
keywords: GOS, UI, Custom Container, BORIDENT, SFLIGHTS, String Templates

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das vorherige GOS-Beispiel, um spezifisch die 'Notizen'-Funktion der Generic Object Services für ein `SFLIGHTS`-Objekt zu aktivieren und anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `set_display_options` von `cl_gos_manager` oder `cl_gos_container` (indirekt) um die anzuzeigenden Services zu filtern. Für `cl_gui_gos_container` ist dies über die `set_object` Methode und den `ip_no_display_services` Parameter möglich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_notes_mgr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        is_sflight_key    TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS display_gos_notes.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_gos_container    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container.
    DATA ms_sflight_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA mv_object_type      TYPE borident-objtype VALUE 'BUS2017'.
    DATA mv_object_key       TYPE borident-objkey.

    METHODS create_object_key
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_key) TYPE borident-objkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_notes_mgr IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight_key = is_sflight_key.
    mv_object_key = create_object_key( ms_sflight_key ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_gos_container
      EXPORTING
        ip_container = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1.

    " Define which services NOT to display (all except notes)
    DATA(lt_no_display_services) = VALUE gos_t_no_display_services(
      ( service = 'VIEW_ATTA' ) " Attachments
      ( service = 'VIEW_URL' )  " URLs
      ( service = 'VIEW_REL' )  " Relationships
      ( service = 'VIEW_FOL' )  " Folder
      ( service = 'VIEW_WF' )   " Workflow
      ( service = 'VIEW_SEND' ) " Send Object
    ).

    mo_gos_container->set_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object            = VALUE borident( objtype = mv_object_type objkey = mv_object_key )
        ip_no_display_services = lt_no_display_services
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_gos_notes.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_key.
    rv_object_key = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    rv_object_key = rv_object_key && |{ space( 70 - strlen( rv_object_key ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_gos_notes_init FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_gos_notes_init.
    DATA: ls_sflight_key TYPE zcl_gos_notes_mgr=>ty_sflight_key.
    ls_sflight_key-carrid = 'LH'.
    ls_sflight_key-connid = '0400'.
    ls_sflight_key-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER_02'.

    DATA(lo_gos_mgr) = NEW zcl_gos_notes_mgr(
      iv_container_name = lv_container_name
      is_sflight_key    = ls_sflight_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_gos_mgr->mo_custom_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_gos_mgr->mo_gos_container ).

    lo_gos_mgr->display_gos_notes( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man spezifische GOS-Dienste (hier nur Notizen) über den Parameter `ip_no_display_services` der Methode `set_object` von `cl_gui_gos_container` steuern kann. Die Verwendung von `VALUE` für die interne Tabelle `lt_no_display_services` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature zur kompakten Initialisierung.
keywords: GOS, UI, Notes, Filter Services, VALUE, BORIDENT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_textedit` Control in einem Custom Container initialisiert und einfachen Text darin anzeigt. Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_cfw` zur Verwaltung des Controls.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und dann `cl_gui_textedit`. Rufen Sie `set_text_as_stream` auf, um den Text zu setzen, und `cl_gui_cfw=>flush`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_textedit_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS set_and_display_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_textedit_display IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_and_display_text.
    mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream(
      EXPORTING
        text = iv_text
    ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_textedit_init FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_textedit_init.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'TEXT_EDIT_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_text_edit_mgr) = NEW zcl_textedit_display(
      iv_container_name = lv_container_name
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_text_edit_mgr->mo_custom_container ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( exp = lo_text_edit_mgr->mo_text_edit ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_text.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'TEXT_EDIT_CONTAINER_2'.
    DATA(lo_text_edit_mgr) = NEW zcl_textedit_display(
      iv_container_name = lv_container_name
    ).

    DATA(lv_test_text) = 'Dies ist ein Testtext für den Texteditor.'.
    lo_text_edit_mgr->set_and_display_text( lv_test_text ).

    " In a real scenario, you would read back the text to assert.
    " For cl_gui_textedit, reading back requires a different method call.
    " Here, we assert that the method call itself did not dump.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die zwei Controls (z.B. `cl_gui_textedit` und `cl_gui_picture`) in einem einzigen Custom Container verwaltet und deren Layout dynamisch anpasst. Demonstrieren Sie die Interaktion mit `cl_gui_cfw`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_splitter_container` innerhalb des `cl_gui_custom_container`, um das Layout zu teilen. Jedes Panel des Splitters kann dann ein eigenes Control aufnehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_control_mgr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS setup_controls
      IMPORTING
        iv_text      TYPE string
        iv_mime_path TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_splitter         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.
    DATA mo_text_edit        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_picture          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_picture.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_control_mgr IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_splitter
      EXPORTING
        parent  = mo_custom_container
        rows    = 2
        columns = 1
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD setup_controls.
    " Get top panel for textedit
    DATA(lo_top_panel) = mo_splitter->get_container(
      EXPORTING
        row    = 1
        column = 1
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_text_edit
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_top_panel
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    mo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).

    " Get bottom panel for picture
    DATA(lo_bottom_panel) = mo_splitter->get_container(
      EXPORTING
        row    = 2
        column = 1
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_picture
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_bottom_panel
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    mo_picture->load_picture_from_mime( iv_mime_path ).

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Integrieren Sie `cl_gui_gos_container` in einem Custom Container, um die 'URLs und Web-Links'-Funktion der Generic Object Services für ein `SFLIGHTS`-Objekt zu demonstrieren.
hint: Ähnlich wie bei den Notizen, verwenden Sie `ip_no_display_services` in `set_object`, um alle Dienste außer 'VIEW_URL' auszublenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_url_mgr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        is_sflight_key    TYPE ty_sflight_key.

    METHODS display_gos_urls.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_gos_container    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_gos_container.
    DATA ms_sflight_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA mv_object_type      TYPE borident-objtype VALUE 'BUS2017'.
    DATA mv_object_key       TYPE borident-objkey.

    METHODS create_object_key
      IMPORTING
        is_sflight_key TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_object_key) TYPE borident-objkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_url_mgr IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight_key = is_sflight_key.
    mv_object_key = create_object_key( ms_sflight_key ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_gos_container
      EXPORTING
        ip_container = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1.

    DATA(lt_no_display_services) = VALUE gos_t_no_display_services(
      ( service = 'VIEW_ATTA' )
      ( service = 'VIEW_NOTE' )
      ( service = 'VIEW_REL' )
      ( service = 'VIEW_FOL' )
      ( service = 'VIEW_WF' )
      ( service = 'VIEW_SEND' )
    ).

    mo_gos_container->set_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object            = VALUE borident( objtype = mv_object_type objkey = mv_object_key )
        ip_no_display_services = lt_no_display_services
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_gos_urls.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_key.
    rv_object_key = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    rv_object_key = rv_object_key && |{ space( 70 - strlen( rv_object_key ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `cl_gui_button` in einem Custom Container anzeigt und auf dessen Klick-Ereignis reagiert. Nutzen Sie das Control Framework für die Ereignisbehandlung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_button_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS create_and_display_button.

    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_button           TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.

    METHODS on_button_click FOR EVENT click OF cl_gui_button
      IMPORTING
        sender.

CLASS zcl_button_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
        text   = 'Klick mich!'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.

    SET HANDLER on_button_click FOR mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_display_button.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD on_button_click.
    " In a real application, this would trigger some action.
    " For demonstration, we can just log or set a flag.
    MESSAGE 'Button wurde geklickt!' TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_button_init FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_button_click_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_init.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'BUTTON_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_button_mgr) = NEW zcl_button_event_handler(

  METHOD test_button_click_event.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'BUTTON_CONTAINER_2'.
    DATA(lo_button_mgr) = NEW zcl_button_event_handler(
      iv_container_name = lv_container_name
    ).

    " Simulate button click (this is a simplified approach for unit testing GUI events)
    " In a real scenario, you might need to use test doubles or more complex mocking.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_button_mgr->on_button_click
          EXPORTING
            sender = lo_button_mgr->mo_button.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

Die `FOR EVENT` Syntax in der Methodendefinition und `SET HANDLER` sind die Schlüssel für die Implementierung von Event-Driven Programming. Der Unit-Test versucht, den Event-Handler direkt aufzurufen, um die Logik zu testen, was eine gängige Praxis für die Testbarkeit von GUI-Ereignissen ist.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die `cl_gui_gos_container` verwendet, um die Generic Object Services für ein *dynamisch erstelltes* Business-Objekt anzuzeigen, das nicht direkt in der BOR existiert (z.B. ein temporäres Objekt basierend auf `SFLIGHTS`-Daten).

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_obj_mgr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_dynamic_obj_mgr IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.

      EXPORTING

    rv_object_key = rv_object_key && |{ space( 70 - strlen( rv_object_key ) ) }|.

CLASS zcl_gos_custom_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_custom_toolbar IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    ms_sflight_key = is_sflight_key.
    mv_object_key = create_object_key( ms_sflight_key ).

    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_gos_container
      EXPORTING
        ip_container = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1.

    " Define custom toolbar buttons (e.g., only 'Create Attachment' and 'Display Notes')
    DATA(lt_toolbar_buttons) = VALUE gos_t_toolbar_buttons(
      ( function = 'CREATE_ATTA' text = 'Anlage erstellen' icon = icon_create )
      ( function = 'VIEW_NOTE'   text = 'Notizen anzeigen' icon = icon_note )
    ).

    " Set the object first
    mo_gos_container->set_object(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE borident( objtype = mv_object_type objkey = mv_object_key )
    ).

    " Then set the custom toolbar buttons
    mo_gos_container->set_toolbar_buttons(
      EXPORTING
        it_toolbar_buttons = lt_toolbar_buttons
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).

    rv_object_key = |{ is_sflight_key-carrid }{ is_sflight_key-connid }{ is_sflight_key-fldate DATE = ISO }|.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_control_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_control_config,
             id   TYPE string,
             text TYPE string,
             top  TYPE i,
             left TYPE i,
           END OF ty_control_config.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

      IMPORTING
        it_config TYPE tt_control_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_text_edit_ref,
             id        TYPE string,
             ref       TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
           END OF ty_text_edit_ref.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_control_creator IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_display_text_edits.
    LOOP AT it_config INTO DATA(ls_config).
      DATA(lo_text_edit) = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
        parent = mo_custom_container
        left   = ls_config-left
        top    = ls_config-top
        width  = 200
        height = 30
      ).
      lo_text_edit->set_text_as_stream( ls_config-text ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_text_edit_ref( id = ls_config-id ref = lo_text_edit ) TO mt_text_edit_refs.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_top_level_parent_setter IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Finde alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Teilstrings in einem gegebenen Text und gib deren Startpositionen zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `RESULTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_substring DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_offsets) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_substring IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_occurrences.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_substring IN SECTION LENGTH OF iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match_result).
      APPEND ls_match_result-offset TO rt_offsets.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Zahlen (Sequenzen von Ziffern) in einem gegebenen Text und gib sie als String-Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `RESULTS` und dem passenden regulären Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_regex_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_regex_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_numbers.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\d+' IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR ls_match_result IN lt_match_results
                           ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match_result-offset len = ls_match_result-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) mit 'LH' beginnt und gib die Flugnummern (FLIGHTNUM) zurück.
hint: Nutze `FILTER` für interne Tabellen in Kombination mit dem `CP` (Contains Pattern) Operator oder `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_lh_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flightnums) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-flightnum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flightnums = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid CP 'LH*' )
                             ( ls_sflight-flightnum ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_lh_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    " Annahme: Es gibt Daten in SFLIGHT mit CARRID beginnend mit 'LH'
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_flightnums) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flightnums ).

    " Überprüfe, ob alle gefundenen Flugnummern von 'LH' sind (indirekt)
    DATA(lv_first_flightnum) = lt_flightnums[ 1 ].
    DATA(lv_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflight INTO lv_carrid WHERE flightnum = @lv_first_flightnum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_carrid CP 'LH*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde alle Wörter in einem Text, die entweder mit 'ABAP' beginnen oder mit 'SAP' enden (Groß-/Kleinschreibung ignorieren).
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einer komplexeren Regex-Gruppe und der Option `IGNORING CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_regex_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_words_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_regex_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_words_by_pattern.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    " Regex: Wortgrenze (\b), dann 'ABAP' gefolgt von beliebigen Zeichen (.*?) bis zur Wortgrenze (\b)
    " ODER Wortgrenze (\b), dann beliebige Zeichen (.*?) gefolgt von 'SAP' bis zur Wortgrenze (\b)
    " Wichtig: \b für Wortgrenzen, (?:...) für nicht-fangende Gruppe, | für ODER
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\b(ABAP.*?)\b|\b(.*SAP)\b'
      IN iv_text IGNORING CASE
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR ls_match_result IN lt_match_results
                           ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match_result-offset len = ls_match_result-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Splitten Sie einen String per Regex.
hint: Nutzen Sie `split` mit Regex-Objekt oder Workarounds in älteren Versionen, hier modern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_regex IMPORTING iv_val TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_res) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_regex.
    " Direkter Regex-Split ist in ABAP nicht so einfach wie in anderen Sprachen ohne CL_ABAP_REGEX.
    " Hier ein Workaround mit FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX, um die Teile zu extrahieren.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.
    DATA: lv_last_offset TYPE i VALUE 0.

    " Finde alle Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma oder Leerzeichen)
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[\s,]+' IN iv_val
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    IF lt_match_results IS INITIAL.
      APPEND iv_val TO rt_res.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_match_results INTO DATA(ls_match_result).
      IF ls_match_result-offset > lv_last_offset.
        APPEND substring( val = iv_val off = lv_last_offset len = ( ls_match_result-offset - lv_last_offset ) ) TO rt_res.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_match_result-offset + ls_match_result-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Rest des Strings nach dem letzten Trennzeichen hinzufügen
    IF lv_last_offset < strlen( iv_val ).
      APPEND substring( val = iv_val off = lv_last_offset ) TO rt_res.
    ENDIF.

    " Entferne leere Einträge, die durch aufeinanderfolgende Trennzeichen entstehen könnten
    DELETE rt_res WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahiere alle Wörter aus einem Text, die eine bestimmte Mindestlänge haben.
hint: Nutze `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit einer Regex für Wörter und einer Längenbeschränkung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_find_words_min_len DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_long_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        iv_min_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_find_words_min_len IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_long_words.
    DATA: lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.
    DATA: lv_regex TYPE string.

    " Regex für Wörter mit mindestens iv_min_length Zeichen
    " \b für Wortgrenzen, \w+ für ein oder mehr Wortzeichen
    lv_regex = |\b\w{\iv_min_length},\b|.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_words = VALUE #( FOR ls_match_result IN lt_match_results
                           ( substring( val = iv_text off = ls_match_result-offset len = ls_match_result-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_sort_strings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_strings_locale_aware
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE string_table
        iv_locale  TYPE sy-langu OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_sort_strings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_strings_locale_aware.
    rt_sorted_strings = it_strings.
    DATA(lo_i18n_utils) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_instance( ).

    " Sortieren mit einem Custom-Comparator, der cl_i18n_utils=>compare verwendet
    SORT rt_sorted_strings BY table_line ASCENDING AS TEXT USING COMPARATOR
      NEW zcl_i18n_comparator( iv_locale = iv_locale ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsklasse für den Custom-Comparator
CLASS zcl_i18n_comparator DEFINITION FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_sort_comparator.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_locale TYPE sy-langu OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_locale TYPE sy-langu.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_locale = iv_locale.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD if_abap_sort_comparator~compare.
    DATA(lo_i18n_utils) = cl_i18n_utils=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_i18n_utils->compare( iv_string1 = i_operand1 iv_string2 = i_operand2 iv_locale = mv_locale ).
    IF lv_result < 0.
      r_result = if_abap_sort_comparator=>less.
    ELSEIF lv_result = 0.
      r_result = if_abap_sort_comparator=>equal.
    ELSE.
      r_result = if_abap_sort_comparator=>greater.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zähle die Anzahl der Vorkommen eines bestimmten Zeichens in einem String.
hint: Nutze `COUNT` mit `FIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_count_char DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_character
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_char TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_count_char IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_character.
    DATA: lv_offset TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_temp_text TYPE string.

    lv_temp_text = iv_text.
    DO.
      FIND iv_char IN lv_temp_text MATCH OFFSET lv_offset.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_count = rv_count + 1.
        lv_temp_text = lv_temp_text+lv_offset+1.
      ELSE.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugpreis (PRICE) für einen bestimmten Flug in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Nutzen Sie die UPDATE-Anweisung mit SET und WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights
      SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    rv_success = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AA'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0017'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20251204'.
    DATA mv_original_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure a test entry exists and store original price
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
        carrid = mv_carrid
        connid = mv_connid
        fldate = mv_fldate
        price = 100.00
        currency = 'EUR'
        planetype = 'BOEING747'
        seatsmax = 300
        seatsocc = 150
      ) ).
      mv_original_price = 100.00.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Revert to original price or delete test entry
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_simple( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 150.00.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_new_price
      msg = 'Flight price should be updated'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UPDATE` mit Hostvariablen (`@`) ist die moderne und sichere Art, Datenbanktabellen zu aktualisieren. `COND` für die Zuweisung des Rückgabewerts ist eine kompakte Form der bedingten Zuweisung.
keywords: UPDATE, Open SQL, Hostvariable, COND, Database

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_multiple_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_test_flight.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure test entries exist and store original prices
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_db_update_itab=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251204' price = 200.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251205' price = 250.00 )
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_test_data INTO DATA(ls_test_data).
      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_original)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_test_data-carrid AND connid = @ls_test_data-connid AND fldate = @ls_test_data-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
          carrid = ls_test_data-carrid
          connid = ls_test_data-connid
          fldate = ls_test_data-fldate
          price = ls_test_data-price
          currency = 'EUR'
          planetype = 'AIRBUS320'
          seatsmax = 180
          seatsocc = 100
        ) ).
        ls_original = CORRESPONDING #( ls_test_data ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_original TO mt_original_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Revert to original prices
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights SET price = @ls_original-price
        WHERE carrid = @ls_original-carrid AND connid = @ls_original-connid AND fldate = @ls_original-fldate.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_multiple_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_itab( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_db_update_itab=>tt_flight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251204' price = 220.00 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251205' price = 275.00 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flights_from_table( lt_updates ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    DATA(lt_actual_prices) = VALUE zcl_db_update_itab=>tt_flight_update( ).
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_actual_prices
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @lt_updates
      WHERE carrid = @lt_updates-carrid
        AND connid = @lt_updates-connid
        AND fldate = @lt_updates-fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_updates INTO DATA(ls_expected).
      READ TABLE lt_actual_prices INTO DATA(ls_actual) WITH KEY carrid = ls_expected-carrid connid = ls_expected-connid fldate = ls_expected-fldate.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-price
        exp = ls_expected-price
        msg = |Price for { ls_expected-carrid } { ls_expected-connid } { ls_expected-fldate } should be updated|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ermöglicht die effiziente Aktualisierung mehrerer Zeilen in einer Datenbanktabelle aus einer internen Tabelle. Die Hostvariablen-Syntax (`@`) ist hier ebenfalls obligatorisch.
keywords: UPDATE, Internal Table, Open SQL, CORRESPONDING FIELDS

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis von Flügen, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen, um 10% und den Preis von Flügen, die an oder nach diesem Datum liegen, um 5%.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine interne Tabelle, um die zu aktualisierenden Daten vorzubereiten, und dann UPDATE FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE. Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck für die Preisanpassung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_price_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_prices_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_cutoff_date TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_prices_conditionally.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_updates TYPE tt_flight_price_update.

    " Select all relevant flights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Prepare updates using FOR expression and conditional logic
    lt_updates = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
          connid = ls_flight-connid
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate
          price  = COND #( 
                     WHEN ls_flight-fldate < iv_cutoff_date
                       THEN ls_flight-price * '1.10'
                     ELSE
                       ls_flight-price * '1.05'
                   )
        )
    ).

    UPDATE sflights FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_updates.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_price_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mv_carrid1 TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AZ'.
    DATA mv_connid1 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0010'.
    DATA mv_fldate1 TYPE s_date VALUE '20251201'.
    DATA mv_price1 TYPE s_price VALUE 100.00.

    DATA mv_carrid2 TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AZ'.
    DATA mv_connid2 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0020'.
    DATA mv_fldate2 TYPE s_date VALUE '20251210'.
    DATA mv_price2 TYPE s_price VALUE 200.00.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Insert test data
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
      carrid = mv_carrid1 connid = mv_connid1 fldate = mv_fldate1 price = mv_price1 currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A380' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 200
    ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
      carrid = mv_carrid2 connid = mv_connid2 fldate = mv_fldate2 price = mv_price2 currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'B777' seatsmax = 400 seatsocc = 150
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Store original data for teardown
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = @mv_carrid1 AND connid = @mv_connid1 AND fldate = @mv_fldate1 )
         OR ( carrid = @mv_carrid2 AND connid = @mv_connid2 AND fldate = @mv_fldate2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Revert changes
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_original.
    ENDLOOP.
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid1 AND connid = @mv_connid1 AND fldate = @mv_fldate1.
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid2 AND connid = @mv_connid2 AND fldate = @mv_fldate2.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conditional_price_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_cond( ).
    DATA(lv_cutoff_date) = '20251205'. " Flights before this date get 10%, on/after get 5%

    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->update_prices_conditionally( lv_cutoff_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_updated_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Two flights should be updated'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price1) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price1
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid1 AND connid = @mv_connid1 AND fldate = @mv_fldate1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price1
      exp = mv_price1 * '1.10' " Should be 10% increase
      msg = 'Price for flight 1 should be increased by 10%'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price2) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price2

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING

          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_salv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_events) = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
        SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR lo_events.

        mo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    READ TABLE mo_salv_table->get_data_ref( )->* INTO ls_flight INDEX row.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } wurde doppelt geklickt.| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_db_alv_combined DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             total_seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_alv_aggregation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA lt_flight_summary TYPE tt_flight_summary.

      INTO TABLE @lt_flight_summary.

            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING

          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_flight_summary

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische `UPDATE`-Anweisung auf der Tabelle SFLIGHTS aus, bei der die zu aktualisierende Spalte und der Wert zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.

CLASS zcl_db_update_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_update_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_update_sflights.
    DATA lv_set_clause TYPE string.

    " Construct dynamic SET clause using string templates
    lv_set_clause = |{ iv_field_name } = '{ iv_new_value }'|.

    TRY.
        UPDATE sflights
          SET (lv_set_clause)
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        rv_success = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle dynamic SQL error, e.g., invalid field name or value type
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_mgmt DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_and_save_layout
      IMPORTING
        iv_layout_name TYPE salv_s_layout-layout
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_mgmt IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_and_save_layout.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_layout) = lo_salv_table->get_layout( ).

        " Hide CURRENCY column
        DATA(lo_column_currency) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CURRENCY' ).
        lo_column_currency->set_visible( abap_false ).

        " Change column order (example: move FLDATE to first position)
        DATA(lt_column_order) = VALUE salv_t_column_list(
          ( columnname = 'FLDATE' )
          ( columnname = 'CARRID' )
          ( columnname = 'CONNID' )
          ( columnname = 'PRICE' )
          ( columnname = 'PLANETYPE' )
          ( columnname = 'SEATSMAX' )
          ( columnname = 'SEATSOCC' )
        ).
        lo_columns->set_column_position( lt_column_order ).

        " Set layout key and save
        DATA(ls_layout_key) = VALUE salv_s_layout_key(
          report = sy-repid
          handle = iv_layout_name
        ).
        lo_layout->set_key( ls_layout_key ).
        lo_layout->set_default( abap_true ). " Make it default for this report
        lo_layout->save_layout( ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten in eine interne Tabelle, filtern Sie diese nach einem Kriterium, aktualisieren Sie die gefilterten Einträge und speichern Sie die Änderungen in der Datenbank.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT INTO TABLE`, `FILTER` und `UPDATE FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_filter_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_and_update_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
        iv_price_increase TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_filter_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_update_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_filtered_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    " Select all flights for the given airline
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    " Filter flights based on price using FILTER expression
    lt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE price > iv_min_price ).

    " Increase price for filtered flights
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + iv_price_increase.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Update database with modified data
    UPDATE sflights FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_filtered_flights.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Flugdatensatz zu aktualisieren, der nicht existiert, und fangen Sie den Fehler ab, um eine benutzerfreundliche Meldung auszugeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE` und überprüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, falls zutreffend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_non_existent_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_non_existent_flight.
    UPDATE sflights
      SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_message = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } erfolgreich aktualisiert.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Fehler: Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } konnte nicht gefunden oder aktualisiert werden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_non_existent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existent FOR TESTING.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'XX'.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '9999'.
    DATA mv_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20251231'.

    DATA mv_existent_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'SQ'.
    DATA mv_existent_connid TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0001'.
    DATA mv_existent_fldate TYPE s_date VALUE '20251201'.
    DATA mv_original_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Ensure an existent test entry for positive test case
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_existent_carrid AND connid = @mv_existent_connid AND fldate = @mv_existent_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
        carrid = mv_existent_carrid
        connid = mv_existent_connid
        fldate = mv_existent_fldate
        price = 100.00
        currency = 'SGD'
        planetype = 'A380'
        seatsmax = 500
        seatsocc = 100
      ) ).
      mv_original_price = 100.00.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Revert changes for existent test entry
    UPDATE sflights SET price = @mv_original_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_existent_carrid AND connid = @mv_existent_connid AND fldate = @mv_existent_fldate.
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = @mv_existent_carrid AND connid = @mv_existent_connid AND fldate = @mv_existent_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_error( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->update_non_existent_flight(
      iv_carrid = mv_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_fldate
      iv_new_price = 999.99
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'Fehler:'
      msg = 'Expected error message for non-existent flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_error( ).
    DATA(lv_new_price) = 110.00.
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->update_non_existent_flight(
      iv_carrid = mv_existent_carrid
      iv_connid = mv_existent_connid
      iv_fldate = mv_existent_fldate
      iv_new_price = lv_new_price
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_message
      exp = 'erfolgreich aktualisiert.'
      msg = 'Expected success message for existent flight'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price
      WHERE carrid = @mv_existent_carrid AND connid = @mv_existent_connid AND fldate = @mv_existent_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price
      exp = lv_new_price
      msg = 'Price not updated for existent flight'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Überprüfung von `sy-subrc` nach einer `UPDATE`-Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um den Erfolg oder Misserfolg einer Datenbankoperation zu ermitteln. Dies ermöglicht eine gezielte Fehlerbehandlung und die Ausgabe von aussagekräftigen Meldungen an den Benutzer.
keywords: UPDATE, sy-subrc, Error Handling, Database Operations

Instructions: Zeigen Sie SFLIGHTS-Daten an und formatieren Sie die Spalte 'PRICE' so, dass sie immer mit zwei Dezimalstellen und dem Währungssymbol angezeigt wird.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung von Flugdaten durch, indem Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den zu aktualisierenden Schlüsseln und Werten verwenden, um die Performance zu optimieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE FROM TABLE` mit einer internen Tabelle, die nur die Schlüssel und die zu aktualisierenden Felder enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_key_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_key_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_price_updates TYPE tt_flight_key_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flight_prices.
    UPDATE sflights FROM TABLE @it_price_updates.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_update FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id VALUE 'AF'.
    DATA mv_connid1 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0050'.
    DATA mv_fldate1 TYPE s_date VALUE '20251210'.
    DATA mv_price1 TYPE s_price VALUE 300.00.

    DATA mv_connid2 TYPE s_conn_id VALUE '0051'.
    DATA mv_fldate2 TYPE s_date VALUE '20251211'.
    DATA mv_price2 TYPE s_price VALUE 350.00.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    " Insert test data
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
      carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid1 fldate = mv_fldate1 price = mv_price1 currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A340' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 200
    ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights(
      carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid2 fldate = mv_fldate2 price = mv_price2 currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A340' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 220
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Store original data for teardown
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_flights
      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    " Revert changes
    LOOP AT mt_original_flights INTO DATA(ls_original).
      UPDATE sflights FROM @ls_original.
    ENDLOOP.
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mass_update.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_mass_update( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_db_mass_update=>tt_flight_key_price(
      ( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid1 fldate = mv_fldate1 price = 320.00 )
      ( carrid = mv_carrid connid = mv_connid2 fldate = mv_fldate2 price = 370.00 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_updated_count) = lo_cut->mass_update_flight_prices( lt_updates ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_updated_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of updated flights'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price1) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price1
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid1 AND fldate = mv_fldate1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price1
      exp = 320.00
      msg = 'Price for flight 1 not updated'
    ).

    DATA(lv_actual_price2) = 0.
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @lv_actual_price2
      WHERE carrid = mv_carrid AND connid = mv_connid2 AND fldate = mv_fldate2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_price2
      exp = 370.00
      msg = 'Price for flight 2 not updated'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UPDATE FROM TABLE` ist die performanteste Methode für Massenaktualisierungen in der Datenbank, da die Daten in einem einzigen Paket an die Datenbank übergeben werden. Die interne Tabelle sollte dabei nur die Primärschlüssel und die zu aktualisierenden Felder enthalten.
keywords: UPDATE, Mass Update, Performance, Open SQL, Internal Table

CLASS zcl_db_update_currency DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHERE carrid = @mv_carrid AND connid = @mv_connid AND fldate = @mv_fldate.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie SFLIGHTS-Daten in einem hierarchischen ALV-Grid an, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugverbindung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table` mit der Option für hierarchische Listen, was jedoch eine spezielle Datenstruktur erfordert. Für `cl_salv_table` ist dies nicht direkt möglich, daher wird eine Gruppierung simuliert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_hierarchy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_grouped,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_flight_grouped.
    TYPES tt_flight_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_grouped WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_grouped_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_hierarchy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA lt_grouped_flights TYPE tt_flight_grouped.

    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Group flights by carrid and connid
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      COLLECT ls_flight INTO lt_grouped_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_grouped>).
      APPEND ls_flight TO <fs_grouped>-flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Note: cl_salv_table does not directly support hierarchical display like cl_gui_alv_grid.
    " This example simulates grouping for display in a flat ALV.
    " For true hierarchical ALV, cl_gui_alv_grid would be used with a specific field catalog setup.
    " Here, we display the grouped data as a flat list, showing the primary grouping keys.
    DATA lt_display_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped_flights INTO DATA(ls_grouped).
      LOOP AT ls_grouped-flights INTO DATA(ls_detail).
        APPEND ls_detail TO lt_display_data.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_display_data
        ).

        " To visually represent grouping, we can sort and potentially use sub-totals/grouping features
        " of cl_salv_table, but a true hierarchy is not its strength.
        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' position = 1 ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CONNID' position = 2 ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle. Die Tabelle enthält Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und die Anzahl der Passagiere.

CLASS zcl_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_passengers,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             passcount TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_passengers.
    TYPES: tt_flight_passengers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_passengers WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_passengers
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-passcount
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Zahlen. Erstellen Sie eine neue Liste, die nur die geraden Zahlen enthält, und ersetzen Sie ungerade Zahlen durch 0.

solution:
CLASS zcl_even_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_number_entry,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_number_entry.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_number_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_numbers
      IMPORTING it_input_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_even_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_numbers.
    rt_processed_numbers = VALUE #( FOR number_entry IN it_input_numbers
                                    ( value = COND #( WHEN number_entry-value MOD 2 = 0 THEN number_entry-value ELSE 0 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_even_numbers=>tt_numbers.

    APPEND VALUE #( value = 2 ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 3 ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 4 ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_even_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_numbers( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-value exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-value exp = 4 ).

Instructions: Wandeln Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugort) in eine neue Tabelle um, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und den Abflugort enthält, aber mit umbenannten Feldnamen.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             cityfrom TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_location,
             airline TYPE sflight-carrid,
             origin  TYPE sflight-cityfrom,
           END OF ty_target_location.

      IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_locations) TYPE tt_target_locations.

CLASS zcl_flight_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_to_locations.
    rt_target_locations = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_source_flights
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( flight MAPPING airline = carrid origin = cityfrom ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_entry,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_entry.
    TYPES: tt_flight_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights
                                  GROUP BY flight-carrid

CLASS zcl_sflight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_limit_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflight` zu einem String, getrennt durch Kommas. Ignorieren Sie Flüge, bei denen die Flugnummer leer ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `FOR ... IN ...` mit `REDUCE` und `STRING_CONCAT_LINES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS concatenate_flight_ids
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_ids) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_flight_ids.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_info.

    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rv_concatenated_ids = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_all_flights WHERE ( connid IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN |
                                  { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
                             ELSE |
                                  { result }, { flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_concat_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_ids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN lv_result IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'LH-0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
