hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und `SORTED BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES: tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_expensive_flights) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_prices.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_expensive_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                    WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                    ( flight ) ).
    SORT rt_expensive_flights BY price DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN lines( lt_result ) > 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-price >= lt_result[ 2 ]-price ).
    ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-price > 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Filtern mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und die anschließende Sortierung der Ergebnis-Tabelle. Die Struktur `ty_flight_price` wird mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` definiert. Die Sortierung erfolgt nach der Erstellung der Tabelle, da `SORTED BY` direkt in `FOR` nicht für dynamische Sortierkriterien gedacht ist.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, Filtering, Sorting, Structure, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `FOR ... IN ...` mit `DISTINCT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_carriers.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_input.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Flugnummern als komma-separierten String enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_connid_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_entry,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_entry.
    TYPES: tt_flight_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_connids,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE string,
           END OF ty_carrier_connids.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_connid_lists
      IMPORTING it_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_entries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_connid_lists) TYPE tt_carrier_connids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_connid_lists.
    rt_carrier_connid_lists = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights
                                       GROUP BY flight-carrid
                                       ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                         connids = REDUCE string(
                                                     INIT s = ``
                                                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                                     NEXT s = COND #( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN member-connid ELSE |{ s }, { member-connid }| ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_carrier_connid_lists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_connid_lists.
    DATA: lt_input TYPE zcl_flight_connid_list=>tt_flight_entries.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0011' ) TO lt_input.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_connid_list( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_connid_lists( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connids exp = '0400, 0401' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connids exp = '0010, 0011' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Gruppierung mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...`, bei der innerhalb jeder Gruppe eine weitere Aggregation mit `REDUCE` durchgeführt wird, um die Flugnummern zu einem String zu verketten. Die Strukturen werden mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` definiert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, String Concatenation, Aggregation, Structure

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Abflugdatum). Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, die in der Zukunft liegen, und fügen Sie ein neues Feld 'IS_FUTURE' hinzu, das auf 'X' gesetzt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` für die Struktur und `FOR ... IN ...` mit `WHERE` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Transformation und das Hinzufügen eines neuen Feldes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_date,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_date.
    TYPES: tt_flight_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_future_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             is_future TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_future_flight.
    TYPES: tt_future_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_future_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_future_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_dates.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_all_flights
                                 WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                 ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) is_future = abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND #( WHEN lines( lt_result ) > 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ).
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_future exp = abap_true ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate > sy-datum ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Filtern von Daten basierend auf einem Datum (`fldate > sy-datum`) und die gleichzeitige Erweiterung der Struktur mit einem neuen Feld (`is_future`) unter Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` innerhalb der `FOR ... IN ...` Expression. Die Strukturen werden mit `TYPES BEGIN OF ... END OF` definiert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, WHERE, CORRESPONDING, Filtering, Date, Structure, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle, die direkt deklariert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie die neue Open SQL Syntax mit INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_key.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_key( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Assuming no data in SFLIGHTS for AA 0017 by default

    " To make it pass if SFLIGHTS has data, you might need to insert test data or adjust expectation.
    " For demonstration, we assume it might be empty or check for specific count if data is known.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax mit Inline-Deklaration (INTO TABLE @DATA(...)) und Hostvariablen-Markierung (@) macht Datenbankzugriffe wesentlich kürzer und lesbarer. Es entfällt die Notwendigkeit, die interne Tabelle vorab zu deklarieren.
keywords: Open SQL, Database Access, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen, um nur die geraden Zahlen zu behalten, unter Verwendung des FILTER-Operators.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Elemente einer internen Tabelle von Zahlen unter Verwendung des REDUCE-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den REDUCE-Operator zur Aggregation von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR  number IN it_numbers
                       NEXT sum = sum + number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_reduce_sum=>tt_numbers( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem man über die Elemente iteriert und einen Akkumulator aktualisiert. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und ausdrucksstarke Art, solche Operationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu, unter Verwendung des SWITCH-Operators.

solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_day_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_day_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_type.
    rv_day_type = SWITCH string(
      iv_day_number
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_weekday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_weekend FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_day FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_weekday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_operator( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_type( 1 ) exp = 'Montag' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_day_type( 5 ) exp = 'Freitag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekend.

Instructions: Greifen Sie direkt auf ein Element einer internen Tabelle über einen Tabellenausdruck zu und prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie Tabellenausdrücke mit eckigen Klammern `[]` und `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS get_item_value
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_key   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.

    METHODS item_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_key   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_item_value.
    TRY.
        rv_value = it_items[ key = iv_key ]-value.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_value = 'Nicht gefunden'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD item_exists.
    rb_exists = xsdbool( line_exists( it_items[ key = iv_key ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_props_consumer_demo( ).

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe.
hint: Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit der INTO-Klausel und dem GROUP SIZE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.
    TYPES tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                    group_size = GROUP SIZE ) INTO DATA(ls_group).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group-carrid
                      connid = ls_group-connid
                      flight_count = ls_group-group_size ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250103' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights( lt_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_lh_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' INTO DATA(ls_aa_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_group_by_flights=>tt_flight_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die LOOP AT ... GROUP BY-Anweisung ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Der GROUP SIZE-Operator liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was den Code für solche Anwendungsfälle stark vereinfacht.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen, indem Sie jede Zahl verdoppeln, unter Verwendung des FOR-Operators.

CLASS zcl_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie mehrere Methodenaufrufe aneinanderreihen, die jeweils das Objekt selbst zurückgeben.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.

    METHODS get_sum RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION:

  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 30 ).

explanation: Method Chaining verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Eleganz des Codes, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede 'Setter'-Methode eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (ME) zurückgibt.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen, unter Verwendung eines `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE` in Kombination mit einem `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights EXCEPT IN it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_filter.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_delete_filter=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_itab_delete_filter=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_carrid( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Es sollte ein Eintrag übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Der verbleibende Eintrag sollte AA sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht das deklarative Filtern von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `EXCEPT` kann man Elemente ausschließen, die einem Kriterium entsprechen, was eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu Schleifen mit `DELETE` darstellt.
keywords: DELETE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Integrieren Sie ein ALV Grid in einen `cl_gui_custom_container` und zeigen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_alv_grid` und `cl_gui_custom_container` zusammen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui_alv_in_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_ui_alv_in_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_in_container.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen (moderne Open SQL Syntax)
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    " Custom Container instanziieren
    mo_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL_AREA' ).

    " ALV Grid instanziieren und in den Container einbetten
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      i_parent = mo_container
    ).

    " ALV Grid anzeigen
    mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'ZCL_UI_ALV_IN_CONTAINER=>TY_SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = lt_sflight
    ).

    CALL SCREEN iv_dynpro_number.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    " Ähnlich wie beim ersten Beispiel kann die UI-Integration nicht direkt getestet werden.
    " Wir testen die Instanziierung der Objekte.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'TEST_ALV_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_container) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA(lo_alv_grid) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.

Instructions: Löschen Sie Einträge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einem Kriterium unter Verwendung von modernem Open SQL.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel und Inline-Deklarationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS delete_old_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_limit TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_old_flights.
    " Zuerst prüfen, ob Einträge vorhanden sind, um den DELETE-Befehl zu rechtfertigen.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier eine Transaktion starten und committen/rollbacken.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE fldate < @iv_date_limit INTO @DATA(lv_count_before).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE fldate < @iv_date_limit.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.

    " Optional: COMMIT WORK oder ROLLBACK WORK je nach Kontext
    " COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 365.

    " Testdaten einfügen, die gelöscht werden sollen
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_test_date - 1 price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = lv_test_date - 2 price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_old_flights( lv_test_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen gelöscht werden' ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Zeilen wirklich weg sind
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND fldate < @lv_test_date INTO @DATA(lv_remaining).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 0 msg = 'Keine Testzeilen sollten übrig sein' ).

    " Aufräumen (falls der Test fehlschlägt und Daten übrig bleiben)
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes Open SQL (ABAP 7.50+) erlaubt die Verwendung von Host-Variablen mit `@` direkt in SQL-Anweisungen, was die Lesbarkeit und Sicherheit verbessert. Der `DELETE FROM` Befehl ist die Standardmethode zum Löschen von Datenbankeinträgen.
keywords: DELETE, Open SQL, Database Operations, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einer anderen Tabelle enthalten sind, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` um eine neue Tabelle ohne die zu löschenden Einträge zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_items_in_list
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_item
        it_items_to_delete TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_items_in_list.
    " Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle der zu löschenden IDs für effiziente Suche
    DATA(lt_delete_ids) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                           FOR ls_item IN it_items_to_delete ( ls_item-id ).

    rt_result_items = REDUCE #( INIT result = it_source_items
                                 FOR ls_item IN it_source_items
                                 WHERE ( id IS NOT IN lt_delete_ids )
                                 " Hier wird eigentlich eine neue Tabelle aufgebaut, nicht gelöscht.
                                 " Der Effekt ist der gleiche wie DELETE, aber funktionaler.
                                 NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( ls_item ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_reduce FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_reduce.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_reduce=>tt_item(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Item D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_to_delete) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_reduce=>tt_item(
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Item D' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_items_in_list( it_source_items = lt_source it_items_to_delete = lt_to_delete ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte ID 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte ID 3 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten oder die Konstruktion neuer Datenstrukturen. Hier wird er verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Elemente enthält, die nicht in der 'zu löschenden' Liste sind. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr effiziente Art, Elemente zu 'löschen', indem man die gewünschten behält.
keywords: DELETE, REDUCE, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Löschen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, indem Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` verwenden, um eine neue, eindeutige Tabelle zu erstellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... GROUP BY` um eindeutige Gruppen zu bilden und daraus eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    rt_unique_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN it_source_data BY ls_group-key_field
                               ( ls_group ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_duplicates=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B1' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A2' ) " Duplicate key
      ( key_field = 'C' value = 'Value C1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B2' ) " Duplicate key
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte Key A sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'B' msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte Key B sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'C' msg = 'Dritter Eintrag sollte Key C sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.50+) ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Hier wird er genutzt, um implizit Duplikate basierend auf dem `key_field` zu entfernen, indem nur der erste Eintrag jeder Gruppe in die neue Tabelle übernommen wird. Dies ist eine deklarative und effiziente Alternative zu `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach einem `SORT`.
keywords: DELETE, FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Löschen Sie benachbarte Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle, nachdem diese sortiert wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` gefolgt von `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_adj_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key_field TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE tt_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_data) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_adj_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_data = it_source_data.
    SORT rt_unique_data BY key_field.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_data COMPARING key_field.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_adj_dup=>tt_item(
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B1' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Value B2' ) " Duplicate key, but not adjacent yet
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Value A2' ) " Duplicate key, but not adjacent yet
      ( key_field = 'C' value = 'Value C1' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_adj_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_source_data = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Es sollten 3 eindeutige Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte Key A sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'B' msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte Key B sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'C' msg = 'Dritter Eintrag sollte Key C sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist ein klassischer ABAP-Befehl, der jedoch in modernen Kontexten immer noch nützlich ist, insbesondere wenn die Tabelle bereits sortiert ist oder sortiert werden kann. Die Kombination mit `SORT` ist effizient, um Duplikate zu entfernen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Initialisierung von Testdaten ist eine moderne Syntax.
keywords: DELETE, SORT, Internal Tables, Duplicates

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, die einen bestimmten Wert in einem Schlüsselfeld haben, unter Verwendung von `DELETE TABLE` mit `TABLE EXPRESSION`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE` und greifen Sie auf die Tabelle mit einem `TABLE EXPRESSION` zu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_table_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS delete_flight_by_key
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_remaining_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_table_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flight_by_key.
    rt_remaining_flights = it_flights.
    DELETE TABLE rt_remaining_flights FROM rt_remaining_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_table_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_table_expression.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_delete_table_expr=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_itab_delete_table_expr=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum ).
    INSERT ls_flight INTO TABLE lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_table_expr( ).

explanation: Der `TABLE EXPRESSION` (ABAP 7.40+) ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über ihren Schlüssel. In Kombination mit `DELETE TABLE` kann man so gezielt Einträge löschen, was eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Syntax darstellt.

Instructions: Löschen Sie Einträge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` basierend auf einer Liste von Schlüsseln, die aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, unter Verwendung von modernem Open SQL mit `FOR ALL ENTRIES` (oder einer moderneren Alternative).
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM` mit `WHERE IN` oder `FOR ALL ENTRIES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_delete_for_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_key.
    TYPES tt_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_keys
      IMPORTING
        it_keys TYPE tt_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_delete_for_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_keys.
    " Sicherstellen, dass it_keys nicht leer ist, um Syntaxfehler zu vermeiden
    IF it_keys IS INITIAL.
      rv_deleted_rows = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Moderne Alternative zu FOR ALL ENTRIES für DELETE ist nicht direkt verfügbar
    " Daher bleibt FOR ALL ENTRIES die gängige Methode für Massenlöschungen basierend auf einer ITAB.
    DELETE sflight FROM TABLE @it_keys.
    rv_deleted_rows = sy-dbcnt.

    " COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_for_all_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_for_all_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_delete_for_all( ).
    DATA(lt_keys_to_delete) = VALUE zcl_db_delete_for_all=>tt_key(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0004' )
    ).

    " Testdaten einfügen
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE @( VALUE sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0003' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0004' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '0005' fldate = sy-datum price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->delete_flights_by_keys( lt_keys_to_delete ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Zeilen gelöscht werden' ).

    " Prüfen, ob die Zeilen wirklich weg sind
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND ( connid = '0003' OR connid = '0004' ) INTO @DATA(lv_remaining).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remaining exp = 0 msg = 'Keine Testzeilen sollten übrig sein' ).

    " Aufräumen
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'XX' OR carrid = 'YY'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `FOR ALL ENTRIES` eine ältere Syntax ist, ist sie immer noch die primäre Methode für Massenoperationen auf Datenbanktabellen basierend auf internen Tabellen. Die Verwendung von `@` für Host-Variablen ist jedoch modern (ABAP 7.50+). Für `DELETE` gibt es keine direkte funktionale Entsprechung wie bei `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
keywords: DELETE, Open SQL, FOR ALL ENTRIES, Database Operations, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, die nicht in einer Referenztabelle vorhanden sind, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks mit `COND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `COND` um nur die gewünschten Einträge zu behalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_delete_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_non_matching_items
      IMPORTING
        it_source_items TYPE tt_item
        it_reference_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_matching_items) TYPE tt_item.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_delete_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_non_matching_items.
    " Erstelle eine Hash-Tabelle der Referenz-IDs für effiziente Suche
    DATA(lt_ref_ids_hashed) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
                               FOR ls_id IN it_reference_ids ( ls_id ).

    rt_matching_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_source_items
                                 WHERE ( id IS IN lt_ref_ids_hashed )
                                 ( ls_item ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_cond FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_cond.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itab_delete_cond=>tt_item(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Item D' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_reference_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY(
      1
      3
      5 " Not in source
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_delete_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_non_matching_items( it_source_items = lt_source it_reference_ids = lt_reference_ids ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 passende Einträge übrig bleiben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'Erster Eintrag sollte ID 1 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-id exp = 3 msg = 'Zweiter Eintrag sollte ID 3 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40+) mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht das deklarative Erstellen einer neuen internen Tabelle, die nur die Elemente enthält, die einer Bedingung entsprechen. Dies ist eine funktionale Art, Elemente zu 'löschen', indem man nur die gewünschten behält, und ist oft effizienter und lesbarer als explizite `DELETE` Schleifen.
keywords: DELETE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen haben.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights     TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      it_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 140. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150. " 10 free
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).

      it_sflights = lt_sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern und die Anzahl der freien Sitze aus einer SFLIGHTS-Tabelle enthält, wobei die Anzahl der freien Sitze berechnet wird.

CLASS zcl_for_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             free_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
        ( connid = ls_flight-connid
          free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt basierend auf einem Bestellwert: 10% für Bestellungen über 1000 EUR, sonst 5%.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator für eine prägnante bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_discount DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_order_value TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discount_rate) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_discount IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discount.
    rv_discount_rate = COND #( WHEN iv_order_value > 1000 THEN '0.10' ELSE '0.05' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_discount FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_discount.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_discount( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '1200' )
      exp = '0.10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '500' )
      exp = '0.05' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->calculate_discount( '1000' )
      exp = '0.05' ). " Exactly 1000 is not > 1000
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten in einem einzigen Ausdruck, was den Code kompakter und funktionaler macht als traditionelle `IF`-Anweisungen für einfache Bedingungen.
keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, Expression, 7.40

CLASS zcl_open_sql_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_occupied_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_reduce_sflights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 100. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 140. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 150.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-seatsocc = 50. <fs_flight>-seatsmax = 100.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid = 'LH'
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
    ).
    DATA(lv_total_seats_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_occupied_seats(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats_lh
      exp = 240
      msg = 'Total occupied seats for LH should be 240' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats_aa
      exp = 50
      msg = 'Total occupied seats for AA should be 50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats_xx
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total occupied seats for XX should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion für funktionale Programmierung und macht den Code oft kürzer und verständlicher als manuelle Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Functional Programming, 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Status-Code (1, 2, 3, 4) eine entsprechende Statusbeschreibung zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie hierfür den modernen SWITCH-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den SWITCH-Ausdruck mit COND für die Zuweisung des Rückgabewertes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING iv_status_code TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = SWITCH #( iv_status_code
                               WHEN 1 THEN 'Offen'
                               WHEN 2 THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                               WHEN 3 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
                               ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_status_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_status_mapping.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_status_mapper( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_mapper->get_status_description( 1 ) exp = 'Offen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_mapper->get_status_description( 2 ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_mapper->get_status_description( 3 ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_mapper->get_status_description( 99 ) exp = 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der SWITCH-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen, ähnlich einem CASE-Statement, aber als Ausdruck verwendbar.
keywords: SWITCH, COND, CASE, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach Flügen, die in 'LH' starten und deren Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie hierfür eine FOR-Schleife mit FILTER.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit dem FILTER-Operator, um die Tabelle zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = 250. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-price = 300. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->filter_flights( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_min_price = 150 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck mit dem WHERE-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht.
keywords: FOR, FILTER, Internal Tables, VALUE, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Grußtext dynamisch generiert. Der Gruß soll sich basierend auf der Tageszeit (Morgen, Tag, Abend) ändern. Verwenden Sie String-Templates und einen SWITCH-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `sy-uzeit` und einen SWITCH-Ausdruck innerhalb eines String-Templates.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_time_category) = SWITCH #( sy-uzeit
                                       WHEN BETWEEN '060000' AND '115959' THEN 'Morgen'
                                       WHEN BETWEEN '120000' AND '175959' THEN 'Tag'
                                       ELSE 'Abend' ).

    rv_greeting = |Guten { lv_time_category }, Welt!|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_greeting_generation.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_greeting_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_greeting) = lo_generator->get_greeting( ).

    " Due to time dependency, we can only assert that it contains 'Guten' and 'Welt!'
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Guten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Welt!' ).

    " For a more robust test, one would mock sy-uzeit or test specific time ranges.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Enddatum eines Projekts basierend auf einem Startdatum und einer Dauer in Tagen. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei, ob Wochenenden übersprungen werden sollen oder nicht. Verwenden Sie einen SWITCH-Ausdruck für die Logik.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder einfache Datumarithmetik und einen SWITCH-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_end_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_duration_days TYPE i
        iv_skip_weekends TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_end_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_end_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DATA(lv_days_added) = 0.

    DO iv_duration_days TIMES.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
      IF iv_skip_weekends = abap_true.
        DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
        IF lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7. " 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
          CONTINUE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_days_added = lv_days_added + 1.
    ENDDO.

    rv_end_date = lv_current_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_end_date_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_end_date_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_date_calculator( ).

    " Test without skipping weekends
    DATA(lv_end_date_no_skip) = lo_calculator->calculate_end_date( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_duration_days = 5 iv_skip_weekends = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_end_date_no_skip exp = '20251206' ).

    " Test skipping weekends (2025-12-01 is Monday, +5 days skipping Sat/Sun should be 2025-12-08)
    " Mon 1, Tue 2, Wed 3, Thu 4, Fri 5, Sat (skip), Sun (skip), Mon 8
    DATA(lv_end_date_skip) = lo_calculator->calculate_end_date( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_duration_days = 5 iv_skip_weekends = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_end_date_skip exp = '20251208' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Datumarithmetik in ABAP ist einfach (+/- Tage). Die Logik zum Überspringen von Wochenenden wird hier mit einer Schleife und einer Bedingung implementiert. Ein SWITCH-Ausdruck könnte hier verwendet werden, um verschiedene Arten von Dauerberechnungen zu steuern (z.B. Arbeitstage, Kalendertage).
keywords: Date, Time, Calculation, LOOP, IF, CASE

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der Tabelle sflights, aber nur für Flüge, die einen bestimmten Flugzeugtyp verwenden. Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Ausdruck mit einem SWITCH-Ausdruck, um den Flugzeugtyp zu berücksichtigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie REDUCE, um die Summe zu aggregieren, und einen SWITCH-Ausdruck, um den Flugzeugtyp zu filtern oder zu kategorisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_planetype TYPE sflight-planetype
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( planetype = iv_planetype )
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_price_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price_calculation.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100. <fs_flight>-planetype = '747'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-price = 250. <fs_flight>-planetype = 'A320'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-price = 300. <fs_flight>-planetype = '747'.

    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_planetype = '747' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_price exp = 400 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen Weise. In Kombination mit dem WHERE-Operator kann die Aggregation auf bestimmte Zeilen beschränkt werden, was den Code sehr prägnant macht.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, FOR, WHERE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null abfängt und eine spezifische Ausnahme auslöst. Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH und eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt. Nutzen Sie dann `TRY...CATCH` und `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING zcx_division_by_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING zcx_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_calculator->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception zcx_division_by_zero not raised.' ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Exception zcx_division_by_zero caught as expected.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP verwendet Ausnahmeklassen (ab ABAP 7.40). Eigene Ausnahmen, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erben, müssen deklariert und abgefangen werden, was zu robusterem und wartbarerem Code führt. `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ist die moderne Syntax zum Auslösen von Ausnahmen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, EXCEPTIONS, RAISE EXCEPTION, Error Handling, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts aufruft, basierend auf einem übergebenen Methodennamen. Verwenden Sie hierfür den modernen Operator `NEW` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Namen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` oder `NEW` für die Instanziierung und `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name)` für den dynamischen Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Helper class for demonstration
CLASS zcl_demo_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a.
    METHODS method_b.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Method A called!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD method_b.
    cl_demo_output=>display( 'Method B called!' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_success.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_demo_target( ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_failure.
    DATA(lo_caller) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_demo_target( ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_caller->call_dynamic_method( io_object = lo_target iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Methodenaufrufe (ab ABAP 7.50 mit dem `NEW` Operator für Instanziierung) sind nützlich, wenn der aufzurufende Methodenname erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Syntax `CALL METHOD (object)->(method_name)` ist der Standardweg dafür. Fehler beim Aufruf können mit `CX_SY_DYN_CALL_ERROR` abgefangen werden.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, CALL METHOD, NEW, Object Orientation, TRY, CATCH
