Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (sflights) nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Verwenden Sie den GROUP BY-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY, um die Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_flight_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights BY flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_grouper=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_result[ KEY carrid COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck mit GROUP BY (ab ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten aus internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe LOOP- und AT NEW/END-Konstrukte.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, VALUE

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) basierend auf dem Fluggesellschafts- und Verbindungs-ID. Wenn der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie einen Standardwert zurück. Verwenden Sie hierfür einen Tabellenausdruck mit einem SWITCH-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ ... ]` und den SWITCH-Ausdruck mit `COND` für den Fall, dass der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price.
    DATA(ls_default_flight) = VALUE ty_sflight( price = 0 currency = 'EUR' ).

    " For 7.40, a direct TRY-CATCH is often clearer for default values with table expressions.
    TRY.
        rv_price = it_sflights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-price.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_price = 0.
    ENDTRY.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_price_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_price.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_reader=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_reader->get_flight_price( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_price_not_found.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_flight_reader=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-price = 100.

    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_price) = lo_reader->get_flight_price( it_sflights = lt_test_flights iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Wenn ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, löst dies eine Ausnahme `CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND` aus, die mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen werden kann, um einen Standardwert zurückzugeben. Ab ABAP 7.50 gibt es den `DEFAULT`-Operator für noch kompaktere Lösungen.
keywords: Table Expressions, Internal Tables, TRY, CATCH, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND, sflights, CASE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebener numerischer Wert 'positiv', 'negativ' oder 'null' ist. Verwenden Sie hierfür den COND-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den COND-Ausdruck mit WHEN-Bedingungen, um den entsprechenden String zurückzugeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_number_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS analyze_number
      IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_number_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_number.
    rv_category = COND #( WHEN iv_number > 0 THEN 'positiv'
                          WHEN iv_number < 0 THEN 'negativ'
                          ELSE 'null' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_analyze_number FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_analyze_number.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_number_analyzer( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->analyze_number( 5 ) exp = 'positiv' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->analyze_number( -3 ) exp = 'negativ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_analyzer->analyze_number( 0 ) exp = 'null' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40) ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten IF-Statements für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er macht den Code kürzer und leichter lesbar.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, IF, ELSE, CASE

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Verwenden Sie hierfür moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit Regex und `CONDENSE` oder `STRIP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_cleaned_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_input_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces
    lv_temp_string = |{ lv_temp_string ALPHA = IN }|.

    " Replace multiple spaces with single space using regex
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.

    rv_cleaned_string = lv_temp_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_clean_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string.
    DATA(lo_cleaner) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cleaner->clean_string( '  Hello   World  ' ) exp = 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cleaner->clean_string( 'SingleWord' ) exp = 'SingleWord' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cleaner->clean_string( '   ' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cleaner->clean_string( '' ) exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von String-Templates mit dem `ALPHA = IN` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) für das Entfernen führender/nachfolgender Leerzeichen und `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` (ab ABAP 7.40) für das Ersetzen mehrerer Leerzeichen ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode zur String-Bereinigung.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, ALPHA, REGEX, REPLACE, CONDENSE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine neue Tabelle transformiert. Dabei sollen nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 100 EUR berücksichtigt und der Flugpreis um 10% erhöht werden. Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit MAPPING und FILTER.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit MAPPING und FILTER, um die Transformation in einer Zeile durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsfree TYPE sflight-seatsfree,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                     WHERE ( price > 100 AND currency = 'EUR' )
                                     ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) EXCEPT price
                                       price = flight-price * '1.1' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        it_data TYPE ANY TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_table_type) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_type_name.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ) ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder einer Quelltabelle enthält, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators und `VALUE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_reduced_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_reduced_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_reduced_sflights.
    rt_reduced_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                   ( carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                     connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                     fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_value.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_reduced) = lo_cut->get_reduced_sflights( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_reduced ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 1 ]-connid exp = '400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_reduced[ 1 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum ).
    DATA(lo_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_reduced[ 1 ] ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_descr->get_components( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es ist eine funktionale Art, neue Tabellen basierend auf den Inhalten einer anderen Tabelle zu erstellen, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen und `APPEND`.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, funktionale Programmierung

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' price = '50.00' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    DATA(lv_total_ua) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'UA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '300.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_ua exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer `WHERE`-Klausel ermöglicht er eine sehr prägnante und effiziente Berechnung von Summen, Zählungen oder anderen Aggregationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Summe, funktionale Programmierung

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und einer Mindestflugzeit (`FLTIME`).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_fltime TYPE sflight-fltime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fltime >= iv_min_fltime ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fltime = 120 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '401' fltime = 60 ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fltime = 180 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_fltime = 90 ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_min_fltime = 100 ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_none) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( it_sflights = lt_sflight iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_min_fltime = 0 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_lh ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_lh[ 1 ]-connid exp = '400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_aa ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_aa[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered_none ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Selektion, funktionale Programmierung

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Abgesagt') basierend auf einer Bedingung, unter Verwendung des `COND`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `COND` für kompakte bedingte Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_delay_minutes TYPE i
        iv_is_cancelled  TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string( WHEN iv_is_cancelled EQ abap_true THEN 'Abgesagt'
                              WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 THEN 'Verspätet'
                              ELSE 'Pünktlich' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Pünktlich' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 30 iv_is_cancelled = abap_false ) exp = 'Verspätet' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_flight_status( iv_delay_minutes = 0 iv_is_cancelled = abap_true ) exp = 'Abgesagt' ).

keywords: Conditional Logic, COND, IF, bedingte Zuweisung

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Daten zwischen internen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Zeilentypen, die aber kompatible Felder haben, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES tt_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_sflight_to_simple
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simple_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_sflight_to_simple.
    rt_simple_flights = CORRESPONDING #( it_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum + 1 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_simple) = lo_cut->map_sflight_to_simple( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_simple ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_simple[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_simple[ 2 ]-fldate exp = sy-datum + 1 ).
    DATA(lo_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_simple[ 1 ] ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_descr->get_components( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_components ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING`-Operator bietet eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zu kopieren, deren Komponenten gleichnamig und typkompatibel sind. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: Internal Tables, CORRESPONDING, Datenkopie, Transformation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer gegebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES: tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component(
        name = ls_component_descr-name
        type = ls_component_descr-type_descr->get_name( )
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_components.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Components should not be empty' act = lines( lt_components ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Component CARRID not found' act = COND string( WHEN line_exists( lt_components[ name = 'CARRID' ] ) THEN 'Found' ELSE 'Not Found' ) exp = 'Found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Component CONNID not found' act = COND string( WHEN line_exists( lt_components[ name = 'CONNID' ] ) THEN 'Found' ELSE 'Not Found' ) exp = 'Found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Type of CARRID incorrect' act = lt_components[ name = 'CARRID' ]-type exp = '\TYPE=C(3)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und anschließendem Cast auf `cl_abap_structdescr` kann man auf strukturspezifische Methoden wie `get_components` zugreifen. Dies ermöglicht die dynamische Analyse von Strukturen.
keywords: RTTI, Struktur, Komponenten, cl_abap_structdescr, dynamisch

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Tabellentypnamen und füllen Sie diese mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_name` und `create_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT_TAB'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_data        TYPE REF TO data,
          lo_new_line    TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        lo_line_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " Example: Fill with one line if it's SFLIGHT
        IF iv_table_type_name = 'SFLIGHT_TAB'. " Or check line type components
          CREATE DATA lo_new_line TYPE HANDLE lo_line_descr.
          ASSIGN lo_new_line->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_new_line>).
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = '0400'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.

          INSERT <fs_new_line> INTO TABLE rr_data->*.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT_TAB' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table reference should not be initial' act = lr_sflight_table ).
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( <fs_table> ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should contain one entry' act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    ASSIGN <fs_table>[ 1 ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'First line should not be initial' act = <fs_line> ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH' act = <fs_carrid> exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Should be initial for invalid type' act = lr_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit Datenobjekte (hier eine interne Tabelle) basierend auf einem Typnamen erstellen kann. Dies ist essenziell für generische Programme, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen. Die Zuweisung von Werten erfolgt über Field-Symbols.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamische Daten, CREATE DATA, Field-Symbols, cl_abap_tabledescr

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob eine gegebene Klasse ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_interfaces`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_test_interface.
  METHODS dummy_method.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_test_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_test_interface.
    METHODS: constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_test_interface~dummy_method.
    " Implementation
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS implements_interface
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name     TYPE string
        iv_interface_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_implements) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_interface IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD implements_interface.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_interfaces( ) INTO DATA(ls_interface_descr).
          IF ls_interface_descr-name = iv_interface_name.
            rv_implements = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        " Class or interface not found, or not a class
        rv_implements = abap_false.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_implements = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_implements_interface FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_does_not_implement FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_implements_interface.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    DATA(lv_implements) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                             iv_class_name = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS'
                             iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS should implement ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE' act = lv_implements ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_does_not_implement.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    DATA(lv_implements) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                             iv_class_name = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS'
                             iv_interface_name = 'IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS' ). " A standard interface it doesn't implement
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'ZCL_TEST_CLASS should not implement IF_ABAP_CONSTANTS' act = lv_implements ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_class.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_check_interface( ).
    DATA(lv_implements) = lo_cut->implements_interface(
                             iv_class_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS'
                             iv_interface_name = 'ZIF_TEST_INTERFACE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should return false for non-existent class' act = lv_implements ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mit `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` und einem Cast zu `cl_abap_classdescr` kann man die Metadaten einer Klasse abrufen. Die Methode `get_interfaces` liefert eine Liste aller implementierten Interfaces, die dann durchsucht werden kann.
keywords: RTTI, Interface, Klasse, cl_abap_classdescr, dynamisch

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle Attribute (Namen und Typen) einer gegebenen Klasse.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und die Methode `get_attributes`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attribute,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             visibility TYPE string, " PUBLIC, PROTECTED, PRIVATE
           END OF ty_attribute.
    TYPES: tt_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attributes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA: lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_attributes( ) INTO DATA(ls_attribute_descr).
          DATA(lv_visibility) = SWITCH string( ls_attribute_descr-visibility
                                WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>public    THEN 'PUBLIC'
                                WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>protected THEN 'PROTECTED'
                                WHEN cl_abap_objectdescr=>private   THEN 'PRIVATE'
                                ELSE 'UNKNOWN' ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_attribute(
            name       = ls_attribute_descr-name
            type       = ls_attribute_descr-type_descr->get_name( )
            visibility = lv_visibility
          ) TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        " Class not found or not a class
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_attributes_of_self FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_attributes_of_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_attributes_of_self.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_class_attributes( 'ZCL_RTTI_CLASS_ATTRIBUTES' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Attributes should not be empty' act = lines( lt_attributes ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Attribute LO_CLASS_DESCR not found' act = COND string( WHEN line_exists( lt_attributes[ name = 'LO_CLASS_DESCR' ] ) THEN 'Found' ELSE 'Not Found' ) exp = 'Found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Visibility of LO_CLASS_DESCR incorrect' act = lt_attributes[ name = 'LO_CLASS_DESCR' ]-visibility exp = 'PRIVATE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_attributes_of_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_class_attributes( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_cut->get_class_attributes( 'SFLIGHT' ). " SFLIGHT is a structure, not a class, should return empty
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHT is a structure, should have no class attributes' act = lines( lt_attributes ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Ähnlich wie bei Interfaces kann man mit `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_attributes` eine Liste aller Attribute einer Klasse abrufen. Dies ist nützlich für die dynamische Inspektion und Manipulation von Objekten.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener String vollständig einem regulären Ausdruck entspricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_matcher` mit der Methode `match`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_check_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_full_match
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_matches) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_check_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_full_match.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_matches = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_full_match_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_full_match_fail FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_match_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_full_match_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_check_match( ).
    DATA(lv_matches) = lo_cut->check_full_match( iv_text = 'ABAP' iv_pattern = '^ABAP$' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Should fully match' act = lv_matches ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_full_match_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_check_match( ).
    DATA(lv_matches) = lo_cut->check_full_match( iv_text = 'ABAP ' iv_pattern = '^ABAP$' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = 'Should not fully match (trailing space)' act = lv_matches ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_match_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_check_match( ).
    DATA(lv_matches) = lo_cut->check_full_match( iv_text = 'My ABAP code' iv_pattern = 'ABAP' ).

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie spezifische Teile eines Strings mithilfe von Regex-Gruppen (Capturing Groups).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_matcher` mit `find` und `get_submatch`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_extracted_data,
             part1 TYPE string,
             part2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_extracted_data.
    TYPES: tt_extracted_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_extracted_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_data_with_groups
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string " e.g., '(\w+)-(\d+)'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_extracted) TYPE tt_extracted_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_data_with_groups.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find( ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_extracted_data(
        part1 = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 1 )
        part2 = lo_matcher->get_submatch( 2 )
      ) TO rt_extracted.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Datenobjekt vom Typ einer bestimmten internen Tabelle ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data` und die Methode `is_of_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_check_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_table_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_table) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_check_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_table_type.
    DATA: lo_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    IF ir_data IS NOT BOUND.
      rv_is_table = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        lo_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
        IF lo_typedescr->is_table_type( ) = abap_true.
          rv_is_table = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_table = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_typedescr_error.
        rv_is_table = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Feldkatalog-Struktur für eine ALV-Spalte basierend auf einem übergebenen Parameter konfiguriert. Wenn der Parameter 'CRITICAL' ist, soll die Spalte als technisch und nicht ausgabebereit markiert werden. Nutzen Sie hierfür moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` und `SWITCH` für die Zuweisung der Feldkatalog-Eigenschaften.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_config DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fcat,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             scrtext_s TYPE lvc_s_text,
             scrtext_m TYPE lvc_m_text,
             scrtext_l TYPE lvc_l_text,
             tech      TYPE abap_bool,
             no_out    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_fcat.

    METHODS get_fcat_for_column
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_name TYPE lvc_fname
        iv_config_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_fcat) TYPE ty_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_config IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fcat_for_column.
    rs_fcat = VALUE #( fieldname = iv_column_name
                       scrtext_s = |{ iv_column_name } (S)|
                       scrtext_m = |{ iv_column_name } (M)|
                       scrtext_l = |{ iv_column_name } (L)|
                       tech      = SWITCH abap_bool(
                                     iv_config_type
                                     WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN abap_true
                                     ELSE abap_false )
                       no_out    = SWITCH abap_bool(
                                     iv_config_type
                                     WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN abap_true
                                     ELSE abap_false ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_header_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_column_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_column_id TYPE string
        iv_language  TYPE sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_header_text) TYPE lvc_l_text.

CLASS zcl_alv_header_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_header.
    rv_header_text = SWITCH lvc_l_text(
                       iv_column_id
                       WHEN 'CARRID' THEN
                         SWITCH lvc_l_text(
                           iv_language
                           WHEN 'D' THEN 'Fluggesellschaft'
                           WHEN 'E' THEN 'Airline'
                           ELSE 'Carrier' )
                       WHEN 'CONNID' THEN
                         SWITCH lvc_l_text(
                           iv_language
                           WHEN 'D' THEN 'Flugnummer'
                           WHEN 'E' THEN 'Flight Number'
                           ELSE 'Connection' )
                       ELSE |Unbekannte Spalte: { iv_column_id }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_conditional_price_sum
      IMPORTING
        iv_destination TYPE s_to_city
        iv_price_threshold TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_conditional_price_sum.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                       INIT sum = 0
                       FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                       WHERE ( to_city = iv_destination AND price > iv_price_threshold )
                       NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             currency   TYPE s_currcode,
             price_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category.
    TYPES tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS categorize_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_categorized_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_categorized_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid       = flight-carrid
                                        connid       = flight-connid
                                        price        = flight-price
                                        currency     = flight-currency
                                        price_category = SWITCH string(
                                                           flight-price
                                                           WHEN < 300 THEN 'Günstig'
                                                           WHEN < 700 THEN 'Normal'
                                                           ELSE 'Teuer' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE ( ( from_city = 'NEW YORK' AND to_city = 'FRANKFURT' )
                                            OR ( carrid = 'LH' AND price > 500 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " Expected: LH400 (NY-FRA, 600), LH402 (NY-FRA, 700), UA017 (NY-FRA, 500) - but UA017 price is not > 500
    " So, LH400, LH402 should be in. Also, any other LH flight > 500.
    " Example: LH001 (FRA-NY, 500) - not > 500
    " Example: LH002 (FRA-NY, 700) - should be in (CARRID = LH AND PRICE > 500)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh400) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_filtered WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_lh400 exp = 1 msg = 'LH400 not found or duplicated' ).

    DATA(lv_count_lh002) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR flight IN lt_filtered WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0002' ) NEXT c = c + 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_lh002 exp = 1 msg = 'LH002 not found or duplicated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_match.
    " To test no match, we would need to mock sflights or use a specific filter that yields no results.

    " A more robust test would involve setting up test data.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( ).
    " This test is more about ensuring the filter runs without error and returns a table.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered table should not be initial for standard SFLIGHTS data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, wobei der Feldname zur Laufzeit basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression bestimmt wird. Geben Sie den Wert des Feldes zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung in Kombination mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression zur Bestimmung des Feldnamens.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_field_name TYPE string.

    lv_field_name = SWITCH string(
                      iv_field_key
                      WHEN 'KEY1' THEN 'FIELD1'
                      WHEN 'KEY2' THEN 'FIELD2'
                      WHEN 'KEY3' THEN 'FIELD3'
                      ELSE THROW cx_sy_assign_error( textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>cx_sy_assign_error ) ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` zuerst nach Fluggesellschaft und dann nach einer dynamisch bestimmten Preiskategorie ('Günstig', 'Normal', 'Teuer'). Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit zwei Gruppierungsebenen und einer `SWITCH`-Expression zur Bestimmung der Preiskategorie.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group_result,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             price_category TYPE string,
             flight_count   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_group_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_category
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_flight_group_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_category.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                price_category = SWITCH string(
                                                                   ls_flight-price
                                                                   WHEN < 300 THEN 'Günstig'
                                                                   WHEN < 700 THEN 'Normal'
                                                                   ELSE 'Teuer' )
                                                INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_grouped_flight).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid         = ls_group_key-carrid
                      price_category = ls_group_key-price_category
                      flight_count   = lv_flight_count ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).

    " Example assertions based on typical SFLIGHTS data
    DATA(ls_lh_normal) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'LH' price_category = 'Normal' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_normal-flight_count exp = 2 msg = 'LH Normal flights count incorrect' ). " e.g., LH001, LH004

    DATA(ls_aa_cheap) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'AA' price_category = 'Günstig' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_cheap-flight_count exp = 1 msg = 'AA Günstig flights count incorrect' ). " e.g., AA001

    DATA(ls_ua_expensive) = lt_grouped[ carrid = 'UA' price_category = 'Teuer' ].

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine der mächtigsten modernen ABAP-Funktionen für die Datenaggregation und -gruppierung. In diesem Beispiel wird sie mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression kombiniert, um eine dynamische Gruppierung nach einer berechneten Preiskategorie zu ermöglichen. Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Absolutwert einer Zahl. Wenn die Zahl negativ ist, soll der positive Wert zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten die Zahl selbst. Nutzen Sie `COND`.

CLASS zcl_math_abs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_math_abs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_absolute_value.
    rv_abs_value = COND i(
                     WHEN iv_number < 0 THEN iv_number * -1

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum in der Zukunft, Vergangenheit oder heute liegt. Nutzen Sie hierfür `SWITCH` mit Vergleichsoperatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` mit Vergleichsoperatoren (`WHEN <`, `WHEN >`, `WHEN =`) um das Datum zu klassifizieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_relation) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_relation.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rv_relation = SWITCH string(
                    iv_date
                    WHEN < lv_today THEN 'Vergangenheit'
                    WHEN > lv_today THEN 'Zukunft'
                    ELSE 'Heute' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die verschiedene Objekttypen basierend auf einem Eingabeschlüssel erzeugt. Nutzen Sie hierfür `NEW` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` um den zu instanziierenden Klassennamen zu bestimmen und `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    ro_product = NEW #( SWITCH #( iv_product_type
                                  WHEN 'TYPE_A' THEN 'ZCL_PRODUCT_A'
                                  WHEN 'TYPE_B' THEN 'ZCL_PRODUCT_B'
                                  ELSE THROW cx_sy_create_object_error( textid = cx_sy_create_object_error=>cx_sy_create_object_error ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_product_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_product_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_product EXPECTING CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_product_a.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'TYPE_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product A' msg = 'Product A not created correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_product_b.
    DATA(lo_product) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'TYPE_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product->get_name( ) exp = 'Product B' msg = 'Product B not created correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_product.
    zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'UNKNOWN_TYPE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Factory-Methode nutzt die moderne `NEW`-Expression in Kombination mit einer `SWITCH`-Expression, um dynamisch den Klassennamen zu bestimmen und das entsprechende Objekt zu instanziieren. Die `THROW`-Expression innerhalb von `SWITCH` ermöglicht eine direkte und prägnante Fehlerbehandlung bei ungültigen Eingaben. Dies ist eine sehr elegante und typsichere Art, das Factory-Pattern in modernem ABAP zu implementieren.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory Pattern, NEW, SWITCH, WHEN, THROW, Exceptions

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit Kopfzeile in eine dynamisch erzeugte interne Tabelle. Die Struktur der internen Tabelle soll zur Laufzeit aus der Kopfzeile des CSV-Strings abgeleitet werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Lesen der Kopfzeile und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`, `cl_abap_tabledescr`) zur dynamischen Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_dynamic_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_dynamic_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_dynamic_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string( iv_csv_data ).
    lo_csv->set_has_header( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_header) = lo_csv->get_header( ).

    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    LOOP AT lt_header INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      APPEND VALUE #( name = lv_field_name type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ) ) TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    lo_csv->get_table( CHANGING ct_table = <lt_table> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_dynamic_csv_parsing.

    DATA(lv_csv_data) = 'COL1,COL2\r\nValue1A,Value1B\r\nValue2A,Value2B'.
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_parser->parse_dynamic_csv( lv_csv_data ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_icf_csv` mit RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) und dynamischer Programmierung. Zuerst wird die Kopfzeile des CSV-Strings gelesen. Dann wird mit `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit erstellt, deren Struktur den Spalten der Kopfzeile entspricht. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Importfunktionen, bei denen die Datenstruktur nicht im Voraus bekannt ist.
keywords: cl_icf_csv, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, CSV, Internal Table, Dynamic Table Creation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Klasse, die den Skelett-Algorithmus einer Datenverarbeitung definiert. Die konkreten Schritte sollen von Unterklassen implementiert werden.
hint: Definieren Sie eine `template_method` und mehrere abstrakte `hook_methods`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_template_process DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_template_method FINAL.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS step_initialize ABSTRACT.
    METHODS step_process_data ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_data) TYPE string.
    METHODS step_finalize ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_processed_data TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_template_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_template_method.
    " Common steps
    step_initialize( ).
    DATA(lv_processed) = step_process_data( 'Initial Data' ).
    step_finalize( lv_processed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_template_impl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_template_process CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_log TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS step_initialize REDEFINITION.
    METHODS step_process_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS step_finalize REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_template_impl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD step_initialize.
    mv_log = mv_log && 'Initialized; '.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD step_process_data.
    rv_processed_data = iv_input && ' -> Processed Data'.
    mv_log = mv_log && 'Data Processed; '.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD step_finalize.
    mv_log = mv_log && 'Finalized with ' && iv_processed_data && '.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_template_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_template_method.
    DATA(lo_concrete) = NEW zcl_concrete_template_impl( ).
    lo_concrete->execute_template_method( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_concrete->mv_log exp = 'Initialized; Data Processed; Finalized with Initial Data -> Processed Data.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern definiert den Algorithmus-Skelett in einer Basisklasse, überlässt aber die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte den Unterklassen. Dies ermöglicht es Unterklassen, bestimmte Schritte eines Algorithmus zu überschreiben, ohne die Struktur des Algorithmus zu ändern. `FINAL` für die Template-Methode verhindert das Überschreiben des Algorithmus-Skeletts.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Template Method, Design Pattern, Object Orientation, FINAL

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Parsen eines fehlerhaften CSV-Strings mit `cl_icf_csv`. Fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Ausnahmen, die von `cl_icf_csv` ausgelöst werden können, z.B. `cx_sy_read_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_data TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        et_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string( iv_csv_data ).
        lo_csv->get_table( IMPORTING et_table = et_data ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_error INTO DATA(lx_read_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_read_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_conv_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_error_message = 'An unexpected error occurred: ' && lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_csv FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_malformed_csv FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_csv.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handler( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_csv_error_handler=>tt_data.
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_handler->parse_csv_with_error_handling( EXPORTING et_data = lt_data IV_CSV_DATA = 'A,B\r\nC,D' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_malformed_csv.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handler( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_csv_error_handler=>tt_data.
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_handler->parse_csv_with_error_handling( EXPORTING et_data = lt_data IV_CSV_DATA = 'A,B\r\nC' ). " Missing field

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = lv_error pattern = 'Zeile' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_csv_error_handler( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_num_data,
             num_field TYPE i,
             text_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_num_data.
    DATA: lt_num_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_num_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = '123,Text\r\nABC,AnotherText'. " ABC cannot be converted to I

    " Need to dynamically create a parser for ty_num_data
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string( lv_csv_data ).
    TRY.
        lo_csv->get_table( IMPORTING et_table = lt_num_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected conversion error' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lx_conv_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Programme nutzen `TRY...CATCH` zur strukturierten Fehlerbehandlung. `cl_icf_csv` kann verschiedene Ausnahmen auslösen, z.B. `cx_sy_read_error` bei fehlerhaftem CSV-Format oder `cx_sy_conversion_error` bei Typkonflikten. Das Abfangen dieser Ausnahmen ermöglicht es, auf Fehler elegant zu reagieren und aussagekräftige Meldungen zu liefern, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
keywords: cl_icf_csv, Error Handling, TRY CATCH, Exception, cx_sy_read_error, cx_sy_conversion_error

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategy Pattern mit einer abstrakten Klasse für verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien. Jede Strategie soll eine abstrakte Methode `calculate` haben. Erstellen Sie konkrete Strategien für Addition und Multiplikation.
hint: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für die Strategie und konkrete Unterklassen, die die Berechnung implementieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_operand1 TYPE i
        iv_operand2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_operand1 + iv_operand2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multiply_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate.
    rv_result = iv_operand1 * iv_operand2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_calculation
      IMPORTING
        io_strategy TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy
        iv_op1      TYPE i
        iv_op2      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_calculation.
    rv_result = io_strategy->calculate( iv_operand1 = iv_op1 iv_operand2 = iv_op2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_strategy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiply_strategy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_strategy.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lo_add_strategy) = NEW zcl_add_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_add_strategy iv_op1 = 5 iv_op2 = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiply_strategy.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_calculator( ).
    DATA(lo_multiply_strategy) = NEW zcl_multiply_strategy( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->perform_calculation( io_strategy = lo_multiply_strategy iv_op1 = 5 iv_op2 = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 15 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategy Pattern ermöglicht es, Algorithmen austauschbar zu machen. Eine abstrakte Basisklasse (`zcl_abstract_calculation_strategy`) definiert die Schnittstelle für die Strategie, während konkrete Unterklassen (z.B. `zcl_add_strategy`, `zcl_multiply_strategy`) die spezifischen Implementierungen liefern. Der Kontext (`zcl_calculator`) verwendet die Strategie über die gemeinsame Schnittstelle, ohne deren konkrete Implementierung zu kennen. Dies fördert Flexibilität und Wartbarkeit.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Strategy Pattern, Design Pattern, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen CSV-String aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei ein benutzerdefiniertes Trennzeichen (z.B. Semikolon) anstelle des Kommas verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` und die Methode `set_delimiter`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_custom_delimiter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_csv_with_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE tt_data
        iv_delimiter TYPE c LENGTH 1 DEFAULT ';'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_custom_delimiter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_csv_with_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_table( it_data ).
    lo_csv->set_delimiter( iv_delimiter ).
    rv_csv_string = lo_csv->get_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_semicolon_delimiter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_tab_delimiter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_semicolon_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_csv_custom_delimiter( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_csv_custom_delimiter=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( col1 = 'Val1' col2 = 'Val2' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( col1 = 'Val3' col2 = 'Val4' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_generator->generate_csv_with_delimiter( it_data = lt_data iv_delimiter = ';' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv exp = 'Val1;Val2\r\nVal3;Val4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_tab_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_csv_custom_delimiter( ).
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_csv_custom_delimiter=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( col1 = 'A' col2 = 'B' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_csv) = lo_generator->generate_csv_with_delimiter( it_data = lt_data iv_delimiter = cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_csv exp = 'A\tB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `set_delimiter` von `cl_icf_csv` ermöglicht die einfache Anpassung des Trennzeichens beim Generieren oder Parsen von CSV-Daten. Dies ist wichtig für die Kompatibilität mit verschiedenen Systemen, die unterschiedliche CSV-Formate verwenden. Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_char_utilities=>horizontal_tab` ist eine moderne Art, spezielle Zeichen darzustellen.
keywords: cl_icf_csv, CSV, Delimiter, String, Internal Table, Customization

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_abstract_data_source` mit einer abstrakten Methode `fetch_data`, die eine generische interne Tabelle zurückgibt. Erstellen Sie dann eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_csv_reporter` mit einer abstrakten Methode `get_report_data` und einer konkreten Methode `generate_csv_report`, die `cl_icf_csv` verwendet.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_abstract_csv_reporter DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse `zcl_abstract_validator` mit einer abstrakten Methode `validate`, die einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt. Implementieren Sie konkrete Validatoren für 'Nicht leer' und 'Numerisch'. Verwenden Sie eine Liste von Validatoren, um ein Eingabefeld zu prüfen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Referenzen auf die abstrakte Validator-Klasse, um mehrere Validierungen durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_validator CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_validator CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_value CO '0123456789' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_value      TYPE string
        it_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_validator WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_all_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_input.
    rv_all_valid = abap_true.
    LOOP AT it_validators INTO DATA(lo_validator).
      IF lo_validator->validate( iv_value ) = abap_false.
        rv_all_valid = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_empty_input.

    DATA: lt_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_validator WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ) TO lt_validators.

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_checker->check_input( iv_value = '' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_numeric_input.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_input_checker( ).
    DATA: lt_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_abstract_validator WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW zcl_numeric_validator( ) TO lt_validators.

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_checker->check_input( iv_value = 'ABC' it_validators = lt_validators ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_valid exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt abstrakte Klassen, um das Validator-Pattern zu implementieren. Jede Validierungsregel ist eine konkrete Unterklasse der abstrakten `zcl_abstract_validator`. Der `zcl_input_checker` kann eine Liste von Validatoren dynamisch anwenden, was eine flexible und erweiterbare Validierungslogik ermöglicht. `COND abap_bool(...)` ist eine moderne Kurzform für bedingte Zuweisungen.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine CSV-Datei von einem HTTP-Service (simuliert durch einen String) und verarbeiten Sie die Daten mit modernen ABAP-Konstrukten (z.B. `FOR` für Transformationen).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_icf_csv` zum Parsen und `FOR` für die Datenverarbeitung.

CLASS zcl_csv_http_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_raw_flight,
             carrid TYPE string,
             connid TYPE string,
             fldate TYPE string,
           END OF ty_raw_flight.
    TYPES tt_raw_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_flight,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_processed_flight.
    TYPES tt_processed_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_http_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_payload TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_processed_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_http_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_http_csv.
    DATA(lo_csv) = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string( iv_csv_payload ).
    lo_csv->set_has_header( abap_true ).

    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE tt_raw_flights( ).
    lo_csv->get_table( IMPORTING et_table = lt_raw_flights ).

    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights
                                    ( airline_id  = ls_raw-carrid
                                      flight_num  = ls_raw-connid
                                      flight_date = cl_abap_datfm=>convert_date_to_int( ls_raw-fldate ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Datenbankoperation, die fehlschlagen kann, und stellen Sie sicher, dass Ressourcen (z.B. ein temporärer Eintrag) im Fehlerfall bereinigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `CLEANUP`-Block innerhalb von `TRY...ENDTRY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check. "Generic exception for demo

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_temp_entry_created TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS cleanup_temp_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    mv_temp_entry_created = abap_true. "Simulate resource creation
    " Simulate a temporary entry in a global variable or actual DB table
    " ...

    TRY.
        IF iv_data = 'ERROR'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        " Simulate successful DB update
        " ...
        mv_temp_entry_created = abap_false. "Resource no longer needed
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        " Handle specific error
        MESSAGE 'Operation failed!' TYPE 'E'.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed if an exception occurs in TRY block
        cleanup_temp_entry( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_temp_entry.
    IF mv_temp_entry_created = abap_true.
      " Simulate deletion of temporary entry
      " ...
      mv_temp_entry_created = abap_false.
      " cl_demo_output=>display( 'Temporary entry cleaned up.' ). " For demo output
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operation_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_operation_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operation_success.
    DATA(lo_op) = NEW zcl_db_operation( ).
    lo_op->perform_operation( 'SUCCESS' ).
    " No exception expected, cleanup should not be strictly necessary here
    " but if it was, it would be handled by the normal flow.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_op->mv_temp_entry_created ). " Assuming mv_temp_entry_created is public for test
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_operation_failure.
    DATA(lo_op) = NEW zcl_db_operation( ).
    TRY.
        lo_op->perform_operation( 'ERROR' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception was expected but not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check.
        " Exception caught, now check if cleanup happened
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_op->mv_temp_entry_created ). " Assuming mv_temp_entry_created is public for test
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block stellt sicher, dass bestimmte Aktionen (z.B. das Freigeben von Ressourcen oder das Zurücksetzen von Zuständen) immer ausgeführt werden, wenn eine Ausnahme im `TRY`-Block auftritt, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird. Dies ist entscheidend für die Robustheit von Anwendungen.
keywords: CATCH, CLEANUP, TRY, EXCEPTIONS, Resource Management, Error Handling
