Instructions: Bestimmen Sie dynamisch die Struktur des Zeilentyps einer internen Tabelle mit RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA` und dann `GET_TABLE_LINE_TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
        name TYPE fieldname,
        type TYPE string,
      END OF ty_component_info,
      tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_components.
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
    DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF lo_line_type_descr->is_structure( ).
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_type_descr ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      rt_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lt_components
                               ( name = comp-name
                                 type = comp-type_descr_ref->get_ddic_type_name( ) ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und lesen Sie dessen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` in Kombination mit RTTI, um den Feldnamen zu validieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error. "If field not found

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Check if field exists using RTTI first
    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ir_data->* TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = CONV string( <fs_field> ).
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_assign_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei beliebige Strukturen zur Laufzeit, um festzustellen, ob sie den gleichen Typ haben (d.h., die gleiche Anzahl und Reihenfolge von Komponenten mit identischen Typen).

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_comparer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        ir_data1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_data2 TYPE REF TO data

CLASS zcl_string_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.

      FOR  i = 1 THEN 1 " Dummy loop for REDUCE structure
      WHILE i = 1 " Only one iteration
      NEXT
        result = TRY.
                   substring( val = iv_input_string off = iv_offset len = iv_length )
                 CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
                   `` " Return empty string on error
               ENDTRY ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine generische Ausnahme ab und extrahieren Sie die Fehlermeldung, um sie zu protokollieren oder anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH cx_root` und die Methode `GET_TEXT` der Ausnahmeinstanz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_risky_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>default_text.
        ENDIF.
        rv_message = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_message = lx_exception->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_error_handling.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld sortiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um den Typ des Sortierfeldes zu überprüfen, und `SORT` mit dynamischem Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_sort_field   TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_prg_error. " If sort field not found or invalid
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_sflight_table.
    rt_sorted_data = it_sflight_data.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( rt_sorted_data ).
    DATA(lo_line_type_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    IF lo_line_type_descr->is_structure( ).
      DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_line_type_descr ).
      DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

      READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_sort_field TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_prg_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_prg_error=>default_text.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_prg_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_prg_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        SORT rt_sorted_data BY (iv_sort_field).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_prg_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_prg_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_prg_error=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sort_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_by_fldate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sort_invalid_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_prg_error.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_by_carrid.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251203' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_sflight_table( it_sflight_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'CARRID' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_by_fldate.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251203' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251202' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_sorted) = lo_sorter->sort_sflight_table( it_sflight_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'FLDATE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 1 ]-fldate exp = '20251201' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 2 ]-fldate exp = '20251202' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted[ 3 ]-fldate exp = '20251203' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sort_invalid_field.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_sorter) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_sort( ).
    lo_sorter->sort_sflight_table( it_sflight_data = lt_data iv_sort_field = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    " Expecting cx_sy_dyn_prg_error
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert RTTI, um die Gültigkeit des dynamisch angegebenen Sortierfeldes zu überprüfen, mit der dynamischen `SORT`-Anweisung. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Sortierung von internen Tabellen basierend auf Benutzereingaben oder Konfigurationen, während gleichzeitig Laufzeitfehler durch ungültige Feldnamen vermieden werden.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Zahlen, wobei einige Einträge ungültig sein können (z.B. nicht-numerische Strings). Fangen Sie Konvertierungsfehler ab und überspringen Sie die ungültigen Einträge, um nur die gültigen Zahlen zu summieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` innerhalb einer Schleife und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_number_summer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_valid_numbers
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_number_summer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_valid_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR  lv_string IN it_input_strings
      NEXT
        total = total + TRY.
                            CONV i( lv_string )
                          CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                            0 " Add 0 if conversion fails
                        ENDTRY ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_update_price( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_sflight_update_price=>tt_sflight_update(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' )

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_sflight_update_status IMPLEMENTATION.

      WHERE ( carrid, connid, fldate ) IN @it_flight_keys.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verschieben Sie die Abflug- und Ankunftszeiten aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft in SFLIGHT um eine Stunde in die Zukunft, unter Verwendung der XCO CP Time API für die Zeitberechnung und `UPDATE` für die Datenbankaktualisierung.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `xco_cp_time=>create_time()->add_hours()` mit `UPDATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_shift_time DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS shift_flight_times
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_hours_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_shift_time IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shift_flight_times.
    DATA: lt_sflight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      DATA(lo_deptime) = xco_cp_time=>create_time( <fs_flight>-deptime )->add_hours( iv_hours_to_add ).
      DATA(lo_arrtime) = xco_cp_time=>create_time( <fs_flight>-arrtime )->add_hours( iv_hours_to_add ).

      <fs_flight>-deptime = lo_deptime->value( ).
      <fs_flight>-arrtime = lo_arrtime->value( ).
      APPEND <fs_flight> TO lt_sflight_updates.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_sflight_updates IS NOT INITIAL.
      UPDATE sflight FROM @lt_sflight_updates.
      rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows exp = 1 ).

Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist hierbei Standard in modernem Open SQL.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag/Sonntag), unter Verwendung der XCO CP Time API.
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und nutzen Sie `get_day_of_week()` zur Überprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_working_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_current_date) = xco_cp_time=>create_date( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lo_end_date)     = xco_cp_time=>create_date( iv_end_date ).

    WHILE lo_current_date->is_before_or_equal( lo_end_date ).
      DATA(lv_day_of_week) = lo_current_date->get_day_of_week( )->value( ).
      IF lv_day_of_week <> 6 AND lv_day_of_week <> 7. " 6=Saturday, 7=Sunday
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lo_current_date = lo_current_date->add_days( 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_working_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_working_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_working_days( ).

    " 2025-01-01 (Wed) to 2025-01-07 (Tue) -> 5 working days (Wed, Thu, Fri, Mon, Tue)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_end_date = '20250107' ) exp = 5 ).

    " 2025-01-01 (Wed) to 2025-01-01 (Wed) -> 1 working day
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_end_date = '20250101' ) exp = 1 ).

    " 2025-01-04 (Sat) to 2025-01-05 (Sun) -> 0 working days
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250104' iv_end_date = '20250105' ) exp = 0 ).

    " 2025-01-03 (Fri) to 2025-01-06 (Mon) -> 2 working days (Fri, Mon)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_working_days( iv_start_date = '20250103' iv_end_date = '20250106' ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die XCO CP Time API für komplexere Datumsberechnungen wie die Ermittlung von Arbeitstagen genutzt werden kann. Durch die objektorientierte Kapselung von Datumsoperationen wird der Code lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig als bei manuellen Berechnungen mit ABAP-Standarddatentypen.
keywords: XCO, Time API, Working Days, Date Calculation, Loop

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das 'Last Change Date' (LASTCHDATE) und 'Last Change Time' (LASTCHTIME) in der SFLIGHT-Tabelle für alle Flüge, die vor einem bestimmten Datum liegen, auf den aktuellen Zeitpunkt. Nutzen Sie hierfür die XCO CP Time API und eine einzelne `UPDATE`-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `xco_cp_time=>now()->get_date()` und `get_time()` in Kombination mit `UPDATE ... SET ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_update_lchg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_last_change_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_cutoff_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_update_lchg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_last_change_date.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = xco_cp_time=>now( )->get_date( )->value( ).
    DATA(lv_current_time) = xco_cp_time=>now( )->get_time( )->value( ).

    UPDATE sflight SET
      lastchdate = @lv_current_date,
      lastchtime = @lv_current_time
      WHERE fldate < @iv_cutoff_date.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Verwendung von TRY...CATCH, um eine Division durch Null abzufangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die vordefinierte Ausnahme `CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_zerodivide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_zerodivide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " In einem realen Szenario würde hier eine Fehlerbehandlung stattfinden
        " oder die Ausnahme weitergereicht werden.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_zerodivide( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_zerodivide( ).
    lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE was not raised' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Syntax ist der moderne Weg zur Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, spezifische Ausnahmen abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt Laufzeitfehler zu verursachen. `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition deklariert, welche Ausnahmen die Methode werfen kann.
keywords: CATCH, TRY, EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE, Error Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn eine ungültige Eingabe erfolgt. Fangen Sie sie anschließend ab.
hint: Erben Sie von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_input TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_exception=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_input TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_input = iv_input.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_input
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_input.
    IF iv_value IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          iv_input = iv_value
          textid   = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_processed_value = |Processed: { iv_value }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_input_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->process_input( 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Processed: Hello' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_input_processor( ).
    TRY.
        lo_processor->process_input( '' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'zcx_invalid_input was not raised' ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lx_invalid_input->mv_input ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) exp = 'Invalid input provided.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Erstellen eigener Ausnahme-Klassen (hier `zcx_invalid_input`) ist ein Best Practice für die Fehlerbehandlung in komplexen Anwendungen. Es ermöglicht eine semantisch reichere Fehlerinformation und eine spezifischere Reaktion im `CATCH`-Block. Die Vererbung von `cx_static_check` erzwingt die Deklaration der Ausnahme im `RAISING`-Zusatz.
keywords: CATCH, CLASS-BASED EXCEPTIONS, RAISE EXCEPTION, CX_STATIC_CHECK, Custom Exception, Object Orientation

Instructions: Fangen Sie mehrere Ausnahmen in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block ab und verwenden Sie den `CLEANUP`-Block, um Ressourcen freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke und einen `CLEANUP`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_mode TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide
        cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_exception_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lv_resource_open) = abap_false.
    TRY.
        " Simulate opening a resource
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        IF iv_mode = 1.
          DATA(lv_num) = 10 / 0. " Raises CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
        ELSEIF iv_mode = 2.
          DATA(lv_char) TYPE c LENGTH 1.
          DATA(lv_int) TYPE i.
          lv_int = lv_char. " Raises CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR (if char is not numeric)
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Operation successful'.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero_divide).
        rv_result = |Error: Division by zero - { lx_zero_divide->get_text( ) }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_zero_divide. " Re-raise for caller
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error INTO DATA(lx_move_cast).
        rv_result = |Error: Move/Cast error - { lx_move_cast->get_text( ) }|.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_move_cast. " Re-raise for caller
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed, regardless of whether an exception occurred
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Simulate closing the resource
          " e.g., CLOSE DATABASE, FREE OBJECT, etc.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
          " Log or perform cleanup actions
          " cl_demo_output=>display( 'Resource cleaned up.' ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_success_case FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_divide FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
    METHODS test_move_cast_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_move_cast_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_success_case.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_multi_exception_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Operation successful' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_divide.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_multi_exception_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 1 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_move_cast_error.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_multi_exception_handler( ).
    TRY.
        lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CX_SY_MOVE_CAST_ERROR was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ). " Exception caught as expected
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist ein mächtiges Feature der modernen ABAP-Ausnahmebehandlung. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, sei es durch normalen Programmfluss oder durch eine Ausnahme. Dies ist ideal, um Ressourcen (Dateien, Datenbankverbindungen, Objekte) konsistent freizugeben und somit Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden. Mehrere `CATCH`-Blöcke ermöglichen eine differenzierte Reaktion auf verschiedene Fehlertypen.
keywords: CATCH, CLEANUP, MULTIPLE EXCEPTIONS, TRY, Error Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `RESUME` für wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen, um nach einem Fehler die Ausführung fortzusetzen.
hint: Eine Ausnahme muss als `RESUMABLE` deklariert sein. Verwenden Sie `RESUME` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check RESUMABLE.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_exception=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_list
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_values) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_list.
    LOOP AT it_values INTO DATA(lv_value).
      TRY.
          IF lv_value = 0.
            RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_error
              EXPORTING
                iv_value = lv_value
                textid   = zcx_resumable_error=>default_text.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ( lv_value * 2 ) TO rt_processed_values.
        CATCH zcx_resumable_error INTO DATA(lx_resumable_error).
          " Log the error, but continue processing
          " cl_demo_output=>display( |Resumable error for value { lx_resumable_error->mv_value }: { lx_resumable_error->get_text( ) }| ).
          " Optionally, append a default value or skip this entry
          APPEND 0 TO rt_processed_values.
          RESUME.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_resumable_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_processing.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 0 ) ( 3 ) ( 0 ) ( 4 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( 2 ) ( 4 ) ( 0 ) ( 6 ) ( 0 ) ( 8 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->process_list( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RESUMABLE`) sind ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept, das es ermöglicht, nach dem Abfangen einer Ausnahme die Programmausführung an der Stelle fortzusetzen, an der die Ausnahme aufgetreten ist. Dies ist nützlich für Fehler, die behoben oder ignoriert werden können, ohne den gesamten Prozess abzubrechen. Die Ausnahme-Klasse muss explizit mit `RESUMABLE` deklariert werden, und im `CATCH`-Block wird `RESUME` verwendet.
keywords: CATCH, RESUME, RESUMABLE, EXCEPTION, Error Handling, Flow Control

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und lesen Sie deren Attribute aus, wie den Fehlermeldungstext und die vorherige Ausnahme (falls vorhanden).
hint: Verwenden Sie Methoden wie `GET_TEXT()` und das Attribut `PREVIOUS` des Ausnahmeobjekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_nested_error
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_nested_error.
    DATA(lv_info) = ``.
    TRY.
        TRY.
            DATA(lv_num) = 10 / 0. " First exception
          CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_inner).
            RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
              EXPORTING
                previous = lx_inner.
        ENDTRY.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_outer).
        lv_info = |Outer Error: { lx_outer->get_text( ) }\n|.
        IF lx_outer->previous IS BOUND.
          DATA(lx_previous) = CAST cx_root( lx_outer->previous ).
          lv_info = lv_info && |Previous Error: { lx_previous->get_text( ) } ({ lx_previous->get_source_position( )-progname }/{ lx_previous->get_source_position( )-lineno } )|.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
    rv_error_info = lv_info.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_exception_attributes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_attributes.
    DATA(lo_inspector) = NEW zcl_exception_inspector( ).
    DATA(lv_error_info) = lo_inspector->trigger_nested_error( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_error_info ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Outer Error: ' act = lv_error_info ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Previous Error: ' act = lv_error_info ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Division by zero' act = lv_error_info ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Jedes Ausnahmeobjekt in ABAP enthält nützliche Attribute und Methoden, um detaillierte Informationen über den aufgetretenen Fehler zu erhalten. `GET_TEXT()` liefert die Fehlermeldung, während das Attribut `PREVIOUS` es ermöglicht, eine Kette von Ausnahmen zu verfolgen, was bei der Fehlersuche in komplexen Szenarien unerlässlich ist. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) macht die Formatierung der Ausgabe sehr lesbar.
keywords: CATCH, EXCEPTION OBJECT, GET_TEXT, PREVIOUS, Error Handling, Nested Exceptions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `RANGE`-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) aus einer Liste von Werten, die sowohl einzelne Codes als auch Muster enthalten kann, unter Verwendung des `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` und `COND` für die dynamische Zuweisung von `OPTION` und `SIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input_value,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_input_value.
    TYPES: tt_input_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_input_values TYPE tt_input_values
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_range_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = VALUE #( FOR ls_input IN it_input_values
                                LET lv_value = to_upper( ls_input-value ) IN
                                ( sign   = 'I'
                                  option = COND string( WHEN lv_value CA '*' THEN 'CP' ELSE 'EQ' )
                                  low    = lv_value
                                  high   = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_build_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_build_range.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_dynamic_range_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_range_builder=>tt_input_values (
      ( value = 'LH' )
      ( value = 'AA*' )
      ( value = 'UA' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'AA*' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' high = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_builder->build_carrid_range( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range exp = lt_expected_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE #(...)` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Erstellung von internen Tabellen, einschließlich `RANGE`-Tabellen. Hier wird dynamisch entschieden, ob `CP` (Contains Pattern) oder `EQ` (Equals) als `OPTION` verwendet wird, basierend auf dem Vorhandensein eines Wildcard-Zeichens (`*`). Dies ist ein Beispiel für moderne, funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: RANGES, FOR, VALUE, COND, INTERNAL TABLES, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Verwenden Sie eine `RANGE`-Tabelle in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung, um Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften zu filtern.
hint: Deklarieren Sie eine `RANGE OF s_carr_id` und verwenden Sie diese im `WHERE`-Zusatz mit `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_select_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_carrid_range TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_select_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid IN @it_carrid_range
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_select_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_flights.
    DATA(lo_selector) = NEW zcl_select_with_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' high = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_selector->get_flights_by_carrier( lt_carrid_range ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' OR ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `RANGE`-Tabellen im `WHERE`-Zusatz einer `SELECT`-Anweisung mit dem `IN`-Operator ist eine Standardmethode, um dynamische Selektionen auf Datenbanktabellen durchzuführen. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen vor `it_carrid_range` sind Teil der neuen Open SQL Syntax (ABAP 7.40+), die die Übergabe von Hostvariablen an die Datenbank explizit macht und SQL-Injections vorbeugt.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, IN, SFIGHTS, Database Access, Open SQL

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten mit einer `RANGE`-Tabelle und dem `FILTER`-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_filter_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in ABAP 7.40+, um interne Tabellen auf funktionale und deklarative Weise zu filtern. In Kombination mit einer `RANGE`-Tabelle bietet er eine sehr elegante und effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten in-memory zu selektieren, ohne explizite Schleifen oder `DELETE`-Anweisungen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, INTERNAL TABLES, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine komplexe `RANGE`-Tabelle (z.B. mit mehreren Inklusionen und Exklusionen) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks aus einer Liste von Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE ... FOR ...` und fügen Sie dynamisch Zeilen zur `RANGE`-Tabelle hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_range_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_condition,
             sign   TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             option TYPE c LENGTH 2,
             low    TYPE s_carr_id,
             high   TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_condition.
    TYPES: tt_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_condition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_complex_carrid_range
      IMPORTING
        it_conditions TYPE tt_conditions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_range_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_complex_carrid_range.
    rt_carrid_range = REDUCE #( INIT r = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( )
                                FOR ls_cond IN it_conditions
                                  NEXT r = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( BASE r ( sign = ls_cond-sign
                                                                             option = ls_cond-option
                                                                             low    = ls_cond-low
                                                                             high   = ls_cond-high ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_reduce_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_range.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_reduce_range_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_conditions) = VALUE zcl_reduce_range_builder=>tt_conditions (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'AZ' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' high = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = 'AA' high = 'AZ' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = 'UA' high = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_builder->build_complex_carrid_range( lt_conditions ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range exp = lt_expected_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein sehr mächtiges funktionales Programmierkonstrukt in ABAP 7.50+, das es ermöglicht, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable (hier die `RANGE`-Tabelle) iterativ aus einer internen Tabelle aufzubauen. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Erstellung komplexer `RANGE`-Tabellen aus einer Liste von Bedingungen, da es den Code sehr kompakt und deklarativ hält, im Gegensatz zu traditionellen `LOOP`- und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: RANGES, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, Functional Programming, Complex Ranges

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGE`-Tabelle für Flugdaten (`fldate`) basierend auf einer Liste von String-Eingaben, die sowohl einzelne Daten (`YYYYMMDD`) als auch Datumsbereiche (`YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD`) enthalten können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR`, `COND` und String-Operationen, um die Eingaben zu parsen und die `RANGE`-Zeilen zu konstruieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_range_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_date_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_date_strings_to_range
      IMPORTING
        it_date_strings TYPE tt_date_strings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_date_range) TYPE RANGE OF s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_date_strings_to_range.
    rt_date_range = VALUE #( FOR lv_date_str IN it_date_strings
                                LET lv_hyphen_pos = find( val = lv_date_str sub = '-' ) IN
                                ( sign   = 'I'
                                  option = COND string( WHEN lv_hyphen_pos IS NOT INITIAL THEN 'BT' ELSE 'EQ' )
                                  low    = COND s_date( WHEN lv_hyphen_pos IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_date_str(lv_hyphen_pos) ELSE lv_date_str )
                                  high   = COND s_date( WHEN lv_hyphen_pos IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_date_str+lv_hyphen_pos+1 ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_parse_date_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_mixed_date_range FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_date_range.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_date_range_parser( ).
    DATA(lt_date_strings) = VALUE zcl_date_range_parser=>tt_date_strings (
      ( '20251201' )
      ( '20251205-20251210' )
      ( '20251215' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_date (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '20251201' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '20251205' high = '20251210' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = '20251215' high = '' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_parser->parse_date_strings_to_range( lt_date_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range exp = lt_expected_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_mixed_date_range.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW zcl_date_range_parser( ).
    DATA(lt_date_strings) = VALUE zcl_date_range_parser=>tt_date_strings (
      ( '20250101' )
      ( '20250110-20250120' )
      ( '20250201' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_parser->parse_date_strings_to_range( lt_date_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_range ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range[1]-low exp = '20250101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range[2]-option exp = 'BT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range[2]-low exp = '20250110' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_range[2]-high exp = '20250120' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene dynamische Erstellung von `RANGE`-Tabellen aus variablen String-Eingaben. Durch die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken, `LET`-Ausdrücken (für lokale Variablen), `COND`-Ausdrücken (für konditionale Zuweisungen) und String-Operationen (`find`, Offset/Length-Zugriff) kann der Code sehr flexibel und kompakt gestaltet werden. Dies ist typisch für moderne ABAP-Entwicklung, die auf funktionale und deklarative Muster setzt.
keywords: RANGES, FOR, COND, LET, String Processing, Dynamic Programming, Date/Time

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine einfache `RANGE`-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften (`carrid`) mit festen Werten.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlermeldung aus, ohne die Ausnahme weiterzuleiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MESSAGE` im `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_on_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_on_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_message.
    rv_success = abap_true.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_denominator.
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Result: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt!' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_success_case FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_success_case.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_message_on_catch( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_handler->perform_operation_with_message( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_case.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_message_on_catch( ).
    " Um die MESSAGE-Anweisung im Unit-Test zu fangen, müsste man
    " einen Test-Double für die Nachrichtenbehandlung verwenden oder
    " den Test so gestalten, dass er den Rückgabewert prüft.
    " Hier prüfen wir den Rückgabewert der Methode.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_handler->perform_operation_with_message( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In manchen Fällen ist es nicht notwendig, eine Ausnahme weiterzuleiten, sondern es genügt, eine informative Meldung an den Benutzer auszugeben und den Fehler intern zu behandeln. Die `MESSAGE`-Anweisung im `CATCH`-Block ermöglicht dies. `DISPLAY LIKE 'I'` sorgt dafür, dass eine Fehlermeldung als Informationsmeldung angezeigt wird, was oft für eine bessere Benutzererfahrung sorgt, da es keine Abbruchmeldung ist.
keywords: CATCH, MESSAGE, Error Handling, User Feedback

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine `RANGE`-Tabelle für Flugverbindungsnummern (`connid`), die alle Verbindungen außer einer bestimmten ausschließt, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `COND`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_exclude_range_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_exclude_range_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_excluded_connid_range.
    rt_connid_range = VALUE #( ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = '*' high = '' ) " Include all initially
                               ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = iv_connid_to_exclude high = '' ) ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_exclude_range_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_connid_to_exclude) = '0017'.
    DATA(lt_result_range) = lo_creator->create_excluded_connid_range( lv_connid_to_exclude ).

    DATA(lt_expected_range) = VALUE RANGE OF s_conn_id (
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = '*' high = '' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = '0017' high = '' )
    ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_flight,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

explanation: Das Erstellen einer `RANGE`-Tabelle, die alle Werte außer einem bestimmten ausschließt, ist ein gängiges Szenario. Die moderne ABAP-Syntax ermöglicht dies elegant durch die Kombination einer 'Include All'-Zeile (`SIGN = 'I'`, `OPTION = 'CP'`, `LOW = '*'`) und einer 'Exclude Specific'-Zeile (`SIGN = 'E'`, `OPTION = 'EQ'`). Der `VALUE #(...)` Ausdruck macht die Initialisierung sehr direkt und lesbar.
keywords: RANGES, EXCLUDE, INTERNAL TABLES, VALUE, COND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Custom Container auf einem Dynpro und betten Sie einen Texteditor darin ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_textedit`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_text_editor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_editor
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynpro_prog TYPE sy-repid DEFAULT sy-repid
        iv_dynpro_num  TYPE sy-dynnr DEFAULT '0100'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_text_editor      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_text_editor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_editor.
    " Create custom container
    TRY.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER' " Name des Containers auf dem Dynpro
            parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
        ).
        " Create text editor within the container
        mo_text_editor = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_custom_container
        ).
        " Set some text
        mo_text_editor->set_text_as_stream(
          EXPORTING
            text = 'Dies ist ein moderner ABAP Texteditor.'
        ).
        " Call screen (requires a Dynpro 0100 with a CUSTOM_CONTAINER element)
        CALL SCREEN iv_dynpro_num.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_editor_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_editor_creation.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_generation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256_generator( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_sha256( iv_message = lv_message iv_key = lv_key ).
    " Re-calculate to verify
    DATA(lo_hmac_verify) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        if_key       = lv_key
    ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_hmac_verify->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_message )->read( )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac msg = 'HMAC should match' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_empty_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = ''.
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).
    DATA(lv_hmac) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_sha256( iv_message = lv_message iv_key = lv_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'HMAC for empty message should not be initial' act = lv_hmac IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_different_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha256_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test'.
    DATA(lv_key1) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).
    DATA(lv_key2) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).

    DATA(lv_hmac2) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_sha256( iv_message = lv_message iv_key = lv_key2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_hmac1 exp = lv_hmac2 msg = 'HMACs with different keys should differ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen JSON-String als Nachricht und einen Schlüssel akzeptiert, einen HMAC-SHA256 generiert und diesen zusammen mit der Nachricht zurückgibt. Eine zweite Methode soll die Integrität der Nachricht überprüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie String Templates für JSON, `cl_abap_hmac` und `cl_abap_conv_codepage`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_json_integrity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_json_payload,
             data TYPE string,
             hmac TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_json_payload.

    METHODS create_signed_payload
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
        iv_key  TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_payload) TYPE ty_json_payload
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.

    METHODS verify_signed_payload
      IMPORTING
        is_payload TYPE ty_json_payload
        iv_key     TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_json_integrity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_signed_payload.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        if_key       = iv_key
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( iv_data )->read( )
      RECEIVING
        ef_hmac = rs_payload-hmac
    ).
    rs_payload-data = iv_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD verify_signed_payload.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        if_key       = iv_key
    ).
    rb_is_valid = lo_hmac->verify_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( is_payload-data )->read( )
        if_hmac = is_payload-hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_json_integrity_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_json_integrity( ).
    DATA(lv_data) = `{ "orderId": "123", "amount": 100.50 }`.
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).

  METHOD test_json_integrity_tampered_data.

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`). Berechnen Sie für jede Zeile einen HMAC-SHA256, der die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` kombiniert, und speichern Sie den HMAC in einem neuen Feld der Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN`, `VALUE`, String Templates und `cl_abap_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_hmac,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             hmac     TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_sflight_hmac.
    TYPES tt_sflight_hmac TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_hmac WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sflight_hmacs
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_key      TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights_hmac) TYPE tt_sflight_hmac
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sflight_hmacs.
    rt_sflights_hmac = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                LET lv_message = |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }{ <fs_sflight>-connid }{ <fs_sflight>-fldate DATE = ISO }| IN
                                ( hmac     = NEW cl_abap_hmac( if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256 if_key = iv_key )->calculate_hmac(
                                               if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_message )->read( ) )
                                  carrid   = <fs_sflight>-carrid
                                  connid   = <fs_sflight>-connid
                                  fldate   = <fs_sflight>-fldate
                                  price    = <fs_sflight>-price
                                  currency = <fs_sflight>-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_hmac_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sflight_hmac_consistency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_hmac_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sflights( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 2 ROWS.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.

    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_with_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_sflight_hmacs( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_key = lv_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sflights_with_hmac ) exp = lines( lt_sflights ) msg = 'Number of lines should match' ).
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_with_hmac INTO DATA(ls_sflight_hmac).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'HMAC should not be initial' act = ls_sflight_hmac-hmac IS NOT INITIAL ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sflight_hmac_consistency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sflights( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.

    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).
    DATA(lt_sflights_with_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_sflight_hmacs( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_key = lv_key ).
    READ TABLE lt_sflights_with_hmac INTO DATA(ls_first_flight_hmac) INDEX 1.
    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.

    " Manually calculate HMAC for the first flight to verify
    DATA(lv_message) = |{ ls_first_flight_hmac-carrid }{ ls_first_flight_hmac-connid }{ ls_first_flight_hmac-fldate DATE = ISO }|.
    DATA(lo_hmac_manual) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        if_key       = lv_key
    ).
    DATA(lv_manual_hmac) = lo_hmac_manual->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( lv_message )->read( )
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight_hmac-hmac exp = lv_manual_hmac msg = 'Calculated HMAC should match manual calculation' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `FOR ... IN` und `VALUE #(` für die effiziente Verarbeitung interner Tabellen. Für jede Zeile der `sflight`-Tabelle wird ein HMAC-SHA256 basierend auf ausgewählten Feldern generiert und in einem neuen Feld gespeichert.
keywords: cl_abap_hmac, Security, HMAC, Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, String Templates, sflight

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine variable Anzahl von Custom Containern und Texteditoren dynamisch auf einem Dynpro anzeigt, basierend auf einer übergebenen Liste von Namen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container`, `cl_gui_textedit` und eine Schleife zur dynamischen Erstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_containers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_container_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS display_dynamic_editors
      IMPORTING
        it_container_names TYPE tt_container_names
        iv_dynpro_prog     TYPE sy-repid DEFAULT sy-repid
        iv_dynpro_num      TYPE sy-dynnr DEFAULT '0100'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_container_ref,
             name      TYPE string,
             container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
             editor    TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit,
           END OF ty_container_ref.
    DATA mt_containers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_container_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_containers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_editors.
    CLEAR mt_containers.
    TRY.
        LOOP AT it_container_names INTO DATA(lv_name).
          DATA(ls_container_ref) = VALUE ty_container_ref( name = lv_name ).
          ls_container_ref-container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
            EXPORTING
              container_name = lv_name
              parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          ).
          ls_container_ref-editor = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
            EXPORTING
              parent = ls_container_ref-container
          ).
          ls_container_ref-editor->set_text_as_stream( |Editor für { lv_name }| ).
          INSERT ls_container_ref INTO TABLE mt_containers.
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL SCREEN iv_dynpro_num.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_container_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_dynamic_containers( ).
    DATA(lt_names) = VALUE zcl_gui_dynamic_containers=>tt_container_names( ( 'CONT1' ) ( 'CONT2' ) ).
    TRY.
        " We cannot call display_dynamic_editors directly due to CALL SCREEN.
        " We'll simulate the creation part.
        DATA: lt_test_containers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_gui_dynamic_containers=>ty_container_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.
        LOOP AT lt_names INTO DATA(lv_name).
          DATA(ls_container_ref) = VALUE zcl_gui_dynamic_containers=>ty_container_ref( name = lv_name ).
          ls_container_ref-container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
            EXPORTING
              container_name = lv_name
              parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          ).
          ls_container_ref-editor = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
            EXPORTING
              parent = ls_container_ref-container
          ).
          INSERT ls_container_ref INTO TABLE lt_test_containers.
        ENDLOOP.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_containers ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two containers should be created' ).
        LOOP AT lt_test_containers INTO DATA(ls_test_container).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_test_container-container IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Container object should be created' ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_test_container-editor IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'Editor object should be created' ).
          CALL METHOD ls_test_container-container->free. " Clean up
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_container_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_dynamic_containers( ).
    DATA(lt_names) = VALUE zcl_gui_dynamic_containers=>tt_container_names( ).
    TRY.
        " Simulate creation logic for empty list
        DATA: lt_test_containers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_gui_dynamic_containers=>ty_container_ref WITH EMPTY KEY.
        LOOP AT lt_names INTO DATA(lv_name).
          " This loop won't execute
        ENDLOOP.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_containers ) exp = 0 msg = 'No containers should be created for empty list' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_gui->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen HMAC für eine Nachricht generiert, wobei der Algorithmus (SHA256 oder SHA512) dynamisch übergeben werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_hmac` und die Konstanten `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>ALG_SHA256` und `CL_ABAP_HMAC=>ALG_SHA512`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_algorithm TYPE cl_abap_hmac=>ty_algorithm.
    METHODS generate_hmac_with_alg
      IMPORTING
        iv_message  TYPE string
        iv_key      TYPE xstring
        iv_algorithm TYPE ty_algorithm
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_with_alg.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = iv_algorithm
        if_key       = iv_key
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( iv_message )->read( )
      RECEIVING
        ef_hmac = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_hmac_sha256.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test with SHA256'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = xstrlen( lv_hmac ) exp = 32 msg = 'HMAC SHA256 length should be 32 bytes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_sha512.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test with SHA512'.
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 64 ).
    DATA(lv_hmac) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_with_alg(
      iv_message   = lv_message
      iv_key       = lv_key
      iv_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_hmac IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'HMAC SHA512 should be generated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = xstrlen( lv_hmac ) exp = 64 msg = 'HMAC SHA512 length should be 64 bytes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_invalid_alg.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_dynamic_alg( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Test'.
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>create_random_key( 32 ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_hmac_with_alg(
          iv_message   = lv_message
          iv_key       = lv_key
          iv_algorithm = 'INVALID_ALG' " Invalid algorithm
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_abap_hmac_error for invalid algorithm' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_hmac_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = abap_true msg = 'cx_abap_hmac_error caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Flexibilität von `cl_abap_hmac` durch die dynamische Auswahl des Hash-Algorithmus (SHA256 oder SHA512). Dies ist nützlich, wenn die Anwendung verschiedene Sicherheitsanforderungen erfüllen muss.
keywords: cl_abap_hmac, Security, HMAC, SHA256, SHA512, Algorithms, xstring

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Custom Container und zeigen Sie darin eine ALV-Liste mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_salv_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_alv_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_alv
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynpro_prog TYPE sy-repid DEFAULT sy-repid
        iv_dynpro_num  TYPE sy-dynnr DEFAULT '0100'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_alv_table        TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_alv_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_alv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'
            parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
        ).

        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = mo_custom_container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table     = lt_sflights
        ).

        mo_alv_table->display( ).

        CALL SCREEN iv_dynpro_num.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv).
        MESSAGE lx_salv->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 Hash für eine Nachricht unter Verwendung eines festen, aus einem String abgeleiteten Schlüssels.
hint: Wandeln Sie den String-Schlüssel mit `cl_abap_conv_codepage` in `xstring` um.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_string_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_hmac_from_string_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_message TYPE string
        iv_string_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_string_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_hmac_from_string_key.
    DATA(lv_key_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( iv_string_key )->read( ).
    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
        if_key       = lv_key_xstring
    ).
    lo_hmac->calculate_hmac(
      EXPORTING
        if_data = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string( iv_message )->read( )
      RECEIVING
        ef_hmac = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hmac_string_key FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_hmac_string_key_consistency FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_string_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_string_key( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Secret Message'.
    DATA(lv_string_key) = 'MySuperSecretKey'.
    DATA(lv_hmac) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_from_string_key(
      iv_message    = lv_message
      iv_string_key = lv_string_key
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_hmac IS NOT INITIAL msg = 'HMAC should be generated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_string_key_consistency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_string_key( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Consistent Message'.
    DATA(lv_string_key) = 'ConsistentKey'.
    DATA(lv_hmac1) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_from_string_key(
      iv_message    = lv_message
      iv_string_key = lv_string_key
    ).
    DATA(lv_hmac2) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_from_string_key(
      iv_message    = lv_message
      iv_string_key = lv_string_key
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hmac1 exp = lv_hmac2 msg = 'HMACs with same message and key should be identical' ).

    DATA(lv_different_message) = 'Different Message'.
    DATA(lv_hmac_diff_msg) = lo_cut->generate_hmac_from_string_key(
      iv_message    = lv_different_message
      iv_string_key = lv_string_key
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lv_hmac1 exp = lv_hmac_diff_msg msg = 'HMACs with different messages should differ' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie ein HMAC-Schlüssel aus einem einfachen String abgeleitet werden kann. Dies ist oft der Fall, wenn Schlüssel aus Konfigurationen oder Umgebungsvariablen gelesen werden. Die Umwandlung des Strings in `xstring` ist dabei ein wichtiger Schritt.
keywords: cl_abap_hmac, Security, HMAC, String Key, xstring, cl_abap_conv_codepage

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine Liste von Nachrichten und einen Schlüssel akzeptiert und für jede Nachricht einen HMAC-SHA256 generiert, wobei die Ergebnisse in einer internen Tabelle gesammelt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN`, `VALUE #(` und `cl_abap_hmac`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_list_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_hmac,
             message TYPE string,
             hmac    TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_message_hmac.
    TYPES tt_message_hmac TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_message_hmac WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_messages_with_hmac
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
        iv_key      TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_message_hmacs) TYPE tt_message_hmac
      RAISING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Custom Container und zeigen Sie darin eine Baumstruktur (`cl_gui_tree_control`) an, die Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge aus der `sflights`-Tabelle darstellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_custom_container` und `cl_gui_tree_control`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_tree_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflight_tree
      IMPORTING
        iv_dynpro_prog TYPE sy-repid DEFAULT sy-repid
        iv_dynpro_num  TYPE sy-dynnr DEFAULT '0100'.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_tree_control     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_tree_control.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_tree_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflight_tree.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    TRY.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
          EXPORTING
            container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'
            parent         = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
        ).

        mo_tree_control = NEW cl_gui_tree_control(
          EXPORTING
            parent = mo_custom_container
            node_selection_mode = cl_gui_tree_control=>node_selection_single
        ).

        DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
        DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF sflight-carrid
                                 FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                 ( ls_flight-carrid ) UNIQUE KEY table_line.

        LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(lv_carrier).
          lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
          DATA(lv_carrier_key) = |C{ lv_node_key }|.
          mo_tree_control->add_node(
            EXPORTING
              i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_tree_control=>relat_root
              i_node_text      = lv_carrier
              i_node_key       = lv_carrier_key
          ).

          LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = lv_carrier.
            lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
            mo_tree_control->add_node(
              EXPORTING
                i_relat_node_key = lv_carrier_key
                i_node_text      = |{ ls_flight-connid } - { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                i_node_key       = |F{ lv_node_key }|
            ).
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

        mo_tree_control->expand_tree( ).
        CALL SCREEN iv_dynpro_num.
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        MESSAGE lx_gui->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_list
      IMPORTING
        it_string_list TYPE string_table

        VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_str_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_list.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR <item> IN it_string_list
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN <item> ELSE |{ result }, { <item> }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf der Menge (`iv_quantity`) und dem Lieferdatum (`iv_delivery_date`). Ein Auftrag ist "Überfällig", wenn das Lieferdatum in der Vergangenheit liegt und die Menge > 0 ist. Er ist "Offen", wenn das Lieferdatum in der Zukunft liegt und die Menge > 0 ist. Sonst ist er "Abgeschlossen" (Menge = 0).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CASE`-Ausdruck ohne expliziten Operanden, um boolesche Bedingungen in den `WHEN`-Klauseln zu nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_order_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_quantity     TYPE i
        iv_delivery_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status.
    rv_status = CASE.
                  WHEN iv_quantity > 0 AND iv_delivery_date < sy-datum THEN 'Überfällig'.
                  WHEN iv_quantity > 0 AND iv_delivery_date >= sy-datum THEN 'Offen'.
                  WHEN iv_quantity = 0 THEN 'Abgeschlossen'.
                  WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannt'. " Fallback for unexpected scenarios
                END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie einem Feldsymbol dynamisch einen Wert zu, basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter, der den Feldnamen angibt. Die Werte sollen aus einer Struktur stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in Kombination mit `CASE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS assign_dynamic_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value_as_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD assign_dynamic_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    CASE iv_field_name.
      WHEN 'FIELD1'.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
      WHEN 'FIELD2'.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
      WHEN 'FIELD3'.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD3' OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown field name
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_value_as_string = |{ <fs_value> }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Daten aus der `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte `FLIGHT_STATUS` hinzu. Der Status soll "Verfügbar" sein, wenn `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC` > 10 ist, "Wenige Plätze" wenn `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC` zwischen 1 und 10 liegt, und "Ausgebucht" wenn `SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC` = 0 ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SQL `CASE`-Ausdruck direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_sql_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid       TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate       TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seats_free   TYPE i,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_sql_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    SELECT carrid,
           connid,
           fldate,
           seatsmax - seatsocc AS seats_free,
           CASE
             WHEN seatsmax - seatsocc > 10 THEN 'Verfügbar'
             WHEN seatsmax - seatsocc BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Wenige Plätze'
             WHEN seatsmax - seatsocc = 0 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
             ELSE 'Unbekannt'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_statuses
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_flight_status_selection.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_sql_case( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Keine Flüge gefunden, SFLIGHTS Tabelle möglicherweise leer'

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-seats_free > 10.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-flight_status
          exp = 'Verfügbar'
          msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate }: Status falsch für Verfügbar| ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-seats_free BETWEEN 1 AND 10.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-flight_status
          exp = 'Wenige Plätze'
          msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate }: Status falsch für Wenige Plätze| ).
      ELSE IF ls_flight-seats_free = 0.

          exp = 'Ausgebucht'
          msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate }: Status falsch für Ausgebucht| ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          act = ls_flight-flight_status
          exp = 'Unbekannt'
          msg = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } { ls_flight-fldate }: Status falsch für Unbekannt| ).

CLASS zcl_cond_price_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_cond_price_range IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_range = CASE iv_price.
                 WHEN 0 TO gc_price_low_max THEN 'Niedrig'.
                 WHEN gc_price_low_max + 1 TO gc_price_medium_max THEN 'Mittel'.
                 WHEN gc_price_medium_max + 1 TO gc_price_high_max THEN 'Hoch'.
                 WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Premium'.
               END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der die Werte einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen in einem tabellarischen Format darstellt, wobei jede Spalte eine feste Breite hat.

CLASS zcl_str_table_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data_row,
           ty_data_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_table) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_table_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_table.
    rv_formatted_table = |
      { 'Spalte 1' ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 15 }
      { 'Spalte 2' ALIGN = RIGHT WIDTH = 10 }
      { 'Spalte 3' ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 20 }
      { FOR row IN it_data
        SEPARATOR |
|
        ( |{ row-col1 ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 15 }
          { row-col2 ALIGN = RIGHT WIDTH = 10 }
          { row-col3 ALIGN = LEFT WIDTH = 20 }| ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDCLASS.
    DATA(lo_unknown) = NEW lcl_unknown_shape( ).

explanation: Der `CASE TYPE OF`-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.55) ist eine leistungsstarke Erweiterung für die objektorientierte Programmierung. Er ermöglicht es, den konkreten Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen und basierend darauf unterschiedliche Logik auszuführen, ohne auf klassische `IF TYPE OF` oder `CAST`-Operationen zurückgreifen zu müssen.
