Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Aufgaben (Strings) aus einer internen Tabelle, die als Warteschlange fungiert, bis diese leer ist. Jede Aufgabe soll dabei simuliert verarbeitet und aus der Warteschlange entfernt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife in Kombination mit READ TABLE INDEX 1 und DELETE TABLE INDEX 1.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_queue_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_queue
      IMPORTING
        it_tasks TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_queue_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_queue.
    DATA(lt_queue) = it_tasks.
    DATA(lv_task)  TYPE string.

    WHILE lines( lt_queue ) > 0.
      READ TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1 INTO lv_task.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND lv_task TO rt_processed_tasks.
        DELETE TABLE lt_queue INDEX 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Zinseszins für ein Startkapital, bis ein bestimmter Zielbetrag erreicht oder überschritten wird. Geben Sie die Anzahl der Jahre zurück, die dafür benötigt wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife und arithmetische Operationen. Achten Sie auf Gleitkommazahlen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_years
      IMPORTING
        iv_principal TYPE decfloat16 " Startkapital
        iv_rate      TYPE decfloat16 " Zinssatz (z.B. 0.05 für 5%)
        iv_target    TYPE decfloat16 " Zielbetrag
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_years) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_years.
    DATA(lv_current_amount) = iv_principal.
    rv_years = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_amount < iv_target.
      lv_current_amount = lv_current_amount * ( 1 + iv_rate ).
      rv_years = rv_years + 1.
      IF rv_years > 1000. " Schutz vor Endlosschleife
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen Eingabestring, der durch verschiedene, dynamisch definierte Trennzeichen getrennt ist. Extrahieren Sie alle Segmente, bis keine Trennzeichen mehr gefunden werden. Die Trennzeichen können sich im String wiederholen.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife in Kombination mit FIND und SUBSTRING oder SHIFT LEFT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_dynamic_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiters   TYPE string " Z.B. ',;-'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_segments) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_dynamic_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_string.
    DATA(lv_remaining_string) = iv_input_string.
    DATA(lv_offset)           TYPE i.
    DATA(lv_segment)          TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_found_delimiter_pos) TYPE i.

    WHILE lv_remaining_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_found_delimiter_pos = -1. " Reset

      LOOP AT iv_delimiters INTO DATA(lv_delimiter).
        FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF lv_delimiter IN lv_remaining_string MATCH OFFSET DATA(lv_current_pos).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          IF lv_found_delimiter_pos = -1 OR lv_current_pos < lv_found_delimiter_pos.
            lv_found_delimiter_pos = lv_current_pos.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_found_delimiter_pos = -1. " No delimiter found, rest is one segment
        lv_segment = lv_remaining_string.
        CLEAR lv_remaining_string.
      ELSE.
        lv_segment = lv_remaining_string(lv_found_delimiter_pos).
        lv_remaining_string = lv_remaining_string+lv_found_delimiter_pos+1. " Skip delimiter
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_segment IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_segment TO rt_segments.
      ENDIF.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine große interne Tabelle in festen Blöcken (Chunks) von einer bestimmten Größe. Die Verarbeitung soll fortgesetzt werden, bis alle Zeilen der Tabelle verarbeitet wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine WHILE-Schleife mit OFFSET und LINES OF, um die Chunks zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_chunk_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        it_data     TYPE string_table
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_chunks) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_chunk_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_in_chunks.
    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    DATA(lv_total_lines) = lines( it_data ).
    DATA(lt_current_chunk) TYPE string_table.

    WHILE lv_offset < lv_total_lines.
      CLEAR lt_current_chunk.
      " Extract chunk
      lt_current_chunk = it_data+lv_offset(iv_chunk_size).

      " Simulate processing the chunk (e.g., concatenate for result)
      APPEND |Processed chunk from offset { lv_offset } with { lines( lt_current_chunk ) } lines| TO rt_processed_chunks.

      lv_offset = lv_offset + iv_chunk_size.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Mechanismus, der eine fehlschlagende Operation bis zu einer maximalen Anzahl von Versuchen wiederholt. Zwischen den Versuchen soll eine kurze Pause eingelegt werden. Verwenden Sie eine WHILE-Schleife und Exception Handling.
hint: Nutzen Sie WHILE, TRY...CATCH und WAIT UP TO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_whl_retry_mechanism DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_retriable_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_retries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
        iv_delay_seconds TYPE i DEFAULT 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Example exception if all retries fail

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_attempt_count TYPE i.
    METHODS _simulate_failing_operation RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_whl_retry_mechanism IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_retriable_operation.
    DATA(lv_current_retry) = 0.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    mv_attempt_count = 0.

    WHILE lv_current_retry < iv_max_retries.
      lv_current_retry = lv_current_retry + 1.
      mv_attempt_count = lv_current_retry. " For test assertion

      TRY.
          _simulate_failing_operation( ).
          rv_success = abap_true.
          EXIT. " Success, exit loop
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Simulate a specific error
          IF lv_current_retry < iv_max_retries.
            WAIT UP TO iv_delay_seconds SECONDS.
          ENDIF.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF rv_success = abap_false.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>division_by_zero.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _simulate_failing_operation.
    " Simulate an operation that fails for the first 2 attempts
    IF mv_attempt_count < 3.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    ENDIF.
    " On 3rd attempt, it succeeds
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_retry FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_retries FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_retry.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_retry_mechanism( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation(
      iv_max_retries = 3
      iv_delay_seconds = 0 " No actual delay for unit test
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Operation sollte nach Wiederholungen erfolgreich sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_retries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_whl_retry_mechanism( ).
    " Simulate an operation that always fails (or fails more than max_retries)
    " For this test, we need to adjust _simulate_failing_operation to always fail
    " or set iv_max_retries to a value less than 3.
    " Let's assume _simulate_failing_operation fails for 3 attempts, so max_retries=2 will fail.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->perform_retriable_operation(
          iv_max_retries = 2
          iv_delay_seconds = 0
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error erwartet.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Exception cx_sy_arithmetic_error korrekt gefangen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: WHILE-Schleifen sind essenziell für die Implementierung von Retry-Mechanismen, bei denen eine Operation wiederholt wird, bis sie erfolgreich ist oder eine maximale Anzahl von Versuchen erreicht wurde. Die Kombination mit TRY...CATCH und WAIT UP TO ermöglicht robuste Fehlerbehandlung und Verzögerungen.
keywords: WHILE, Retry, Error Handling, TRY...CATCH, WAIT UP TO

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge von 'Lufthansa' (CARRID 'LH') mit Abflugort 'Frankfurt' (CITYFROM 'FRANKFURT') in der Tabelle SFLIGHT um 10%. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax zur Datenvorbereitung und führen Sie ein Massen-UPDATE durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT, FOR, VALUE und UPDATE FROM TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upd_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_cityfrom TYPE s_cityfrom
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    " Read relevant flights into an internal table
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND cityfrom = @iv_cityfrom
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_data).

    " Prepare data for update using functional programming
    DATA(lt_flights_to_update) = VALUE sflight_tt(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
        ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
          connid   = ls_flight-connid
          fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
          price    = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) " Increase price
          currency = ls_flight-currency )
    ).

    " Perform mass update
    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_update.
    rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Flugzeugtyp (PLANETYPE) eines spezifischen Fluges in der Tabelle SFLIGHT auf 'AIRBUS A380', aber nur, wenn der Flug in der Vergangenheit liegt und die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (SEATSMAX) unter 200 liegt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Bedingungsprüfung.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE, sy-datum und UPDATE SET WHERE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upd_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_planetype
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_planetype.
    rv_updated = abap_false.

    " Read flight details to check conditions
    SELECT SINGLE fldate, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Check conditions using modern logical expressions
      IF ls_flight-fldate < sy-datum AND ls_flight-seatsmax < 200.
        UPDATE sflight
          SET planetype = 'AIRBUS A380'
          WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
            AND connid = @iv_connid
            AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_updated = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie das Feld 'SEATSOCC' (belegte Sitze) in der Tabelle SFLIGHT für einen bestimmten Flug. Der neue Wert soll basierend auf einer Bedingung gesetzt werden: Wenn der Flug von 'LH' ist, erhöhen Sie die belegten Sitze um 5, sonst um 2. Nutzen Sie COND für die Wertzuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie UPDATE SET WHERE und COND für die dynamische Wertbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upd_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_seats_occupied
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_rows) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seats_occupied.
    DATA(lv_new_seats_to_add) = COND i( WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' THEN 5 ELSE 2 ).

    " Read current SEATSOCC to calculate new value
    SELECT SINGLE seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(lv_current_seatsocc).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      UPDATE sflight
        SET seatsocc = @( lv_current_seatsocc + lv_new_seats_to_add )
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
          AND connid = @iv_connid
          AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
      rv_updated_rows = sy-dbcnt.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated_rows = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Geben Sie zurück, ob der UPDATE erfolgreich war oder ein Fehler auftrat.

CLASS zcl_upd_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_error_handling.
    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulate an update that might fail (e.g., if primary key is changed to an existing one,
        " or if a non-existent record is updated and we expect a change)
        " For demonstration, we'll try to update a record that might not exist,
        " or if it exists, we'll change a non-key field.
        " To truly simulate an error, we'd need a more complex scenario or a test double.
        " Here, we'll just check sy-subrc after a standard update.

        UPDATE sflight SET seatsocc = @is_flight_data-seatsocc
          WHERE carrid = @is_flight_data-carrid
            AND connid = @is_flight_data-connid
            AND fldate = @is_flight_data-fldate.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          " No record found or other non-exception error
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Database error occurred
        " Log error: lx_db_error->get_text( )
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_dynamic_context.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = mo_alv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = mt_sflight
        ).

        SET HANDLER me->handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_alv->get_event_manager( ).

        mo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    DATA(lo_menu) = r_menu.
    mv_selected_row = mo_alv->get_selections( )->get_selected_rows( )[ 1 ].

    DATA: ls_sflight_line TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE mt_sflight INTO ls_sflight_line INDEX mv_selected_row.

      lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_DETAILS' text = 'Flugdetails anzeigen' ).
      IF ls_sflight_line-seatsocc = ls_sflight_line-seatsmax.

      ELSE.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CASE fcode.
        WHEN 'SHOW_DETAILS'.
          MESSAGE |Flugdetails:\nCarrier: { ls_sflight_line-carrid }\nFlugnr: { ls_sflight_line-connid }\nDatum: { ls_sflight_line-fldate }| TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
        WHEN 'FLIGHT_FULL'.
          MESSAGE |Flug { ls_sflight_line-carrid } { ls_sflight_line-connid } ist bereits ausgebucht.| TYPE 'W'.
        WHEN 'BOOK_SEAT'.
          MESSAGE |Sitzplatzbuchung für Flug { ls_sflight_line-carrid } { ls_sflight_line-connid } eingeleitet.| TYPE 'S'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid für SFLIGHT. Fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'Auslastung' hinzu, die den Prozentsatz der belegten Sitze anzeigt. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Berechnung und die ALV-Anzeige.
hint: Erweitern Sie die interne Tabelle mit einem zusätzlichen Feld und berechnen Sie den Wert mit `FOR` oder `MAP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_calc_col.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_calculated_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_calc_col.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             utilization TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.

    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight_ext TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    lt_sflight_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( ls_raw
                                 utilization = COND p( WHEN ls_raw-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_raw-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_raw-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) )
                              ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_alv)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflight_ext
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_util_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'UTILIZATION' ).
        lo_util_col->set_long_text( 'Auslastung (%)' ).
        lo_util_col->set_alignment( if_salv_c_alignment=>right ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_predefined_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_filter.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             INCLUDE TYPE sflight,
             utilization TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.

    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight_ext TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    lt_sflight_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( ls_raw
                                 utilization = COND p( WHEN ls_raw-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( ls_raw-seatsocc * 100 ) / ls_raw-seatsmax ELSE 0 ) )
                              ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING

        lo_filters->add_filter(
          columnname = 'UTILIZATION'
          sign       = 'I'
          option     = 'GT'
          low        = '80.00'
        ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und fangen Sie sowohl die Division-by-zero-Ausnahme als auch eine mögliche Konvertierungs-Ausnahme ab, falls die Eingabe keine Zahl ist. Geben Sie im Fehlerfall eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke oder mehrere `CATCH` Blöcke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_division_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE string
        iv_denominator TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string. " Returns result or error message
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_division_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_strings.
    DATA: lv_num TYPE i,
          lv_den TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_num = iv_numerator.
        lv_den = iv_denominator.

        TRY.
            rv_result = lv_num / lv_den.
          CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
            rv_result = |Fehler: Division durch Null oder arithmetischer Fehler ({ lx_arith->get_text( ) })|.
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_no_number INTO DATA(lx_conv).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Ungültige Zahleneingabe ({ lx_conv->get_text( ) })|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Catch any other unexpected exception
        rv_result = |Unerwarteter Fehler: ({ lx_root->get_text( ) })|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Objekten unterschiedlichen Typs, die eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle implementieren. Führen Sie typspezifische Aktionen basierend auf dem konkreten Objekttyp aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.14159'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_length TYPE decfloat16 iv_width TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_length TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_length = iv_length.
    mv_width = iv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_length * mv_width.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Rechteck mit Länge { mv_length } und Breite { mv_width }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE tt_shapes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      DATA(lv_description) = lo_shape->get_description( ).
      DATA(lv_area) = lo_shape->get_area( ).
      APPEND |{ lv_description }: Fläche = { lv_area }| TO rt_results.

      " Type-specific action using CASE TYPE OF
      CASE TYPE OF lo_shape.
        WHEN TYPE zcl_circle INTO DATA(lo_circle).
          APPEND |  (Spezifisch für Kreis: Radius ist { lo_circle->mv_radius } )| TO rt_results. " Access specific attribute
        WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle INTO DATA(lo_rectangle).
          APPEND |  (Spezifisch für Rechteck: Länge ist { lo_rectangle->mv_length } )| TO rt_results. " Access specific attribute
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |  (Unbekannter Formtyp)|
          TO rt_results.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shapes.
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE zcl_shape_processor=>tt_shapes.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = '5' ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_length = '10' iv_width = '4' ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 4 ). " 2 shapes * 2 lines each
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Kreis mit Radius 5' in = lt_results[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fläche = 78.53975' in = lt_results[1] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Radius ist 5' in = lt_results[2] ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Rechteck mit Länge 10' in = lt_results[3] ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Länge ist 10' in = lt_results[4] ).

explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` (ab ABAP 7.40) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die polymorphe Programmierung. Es erlaubt, den konkreten Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen und typspezifische Operationen durchzuführen, ohne auf Downcasts angewiesen zu sein, die zu Laufzeitfehlern führen könnten. Die `INTO DATA(lo_...)` Syntax deklariert die Referenz direkt im `WHEN`-Zweig.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, Polymorphism, Object Orientation, Interface, Class

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Stellen Sie sicher, dass eine bestimmte Aufräumaktion (z.B. das Schließen einer Ressource oder das Zurücksetzen eines Status) immer ausgeführt wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLEANUP` im `TRY...ENDTRY` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    mv_resource_open = abap_true. " Simulate opening a resource
    rv_status_message = 'Operation gestartet. Ressource geöffnet.'.

    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Simulate an error
        ENDIF.
        rv_status_message = rv_status_message && ' Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_status_message = rv_status_message && ' Fehler: Arithmetischer Fehler aufgetreten.'.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block is always executed, regardless of exception or not
        IF mv_resource_open = abap_true.
          mv_resource_open = abap_false. " Simulate closing the resource
          rv_status_message = rv_status_message && ' Ressource geschlossen (CLEANUP).'.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_operation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_operation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.' in = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ressource geschlossen (CLEANUP).' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Arithmetischer Fehler aufgetreten.' in = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ressource geschlossen (CLEANUP).' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block innerhalb eines `TRY...ENDTRY`-Konstruktes (ab ABAP 7.50) stellt sicher, dass bestimmte Anweisungen immer ausgeführt werden, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob dies durch eine Ausnahme oder durch normalen Programmfluss geschieht. Dies ist ideal für Aufräumarbeiten wie das Freigeben von Ressourcen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception Handling, Resource Management

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die basierend auf einem Feldwert der Quelltabelle einen Status zuweist. Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `SWITCH`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE`, `FOR` und `SWITCH` für eine funktionale Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_value_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             status   TYPE char1,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_processed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_flights) TYPE tt_processed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_value_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                    ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
                                      connid    = ls_flight-connid
                                      fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
                                      price     = ls_flight-price
                                      status_text = SWITCH #( ls_flight-status
                                                              WHEN 'X' THEN 'Gebucht'
                                                              WHEN 'O' THEN 'Offen'
                                                              WHEN 'C' THEN 'Storniert'
                                                              ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_case_value_table=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '250.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    <fs_flight>-status = 'O'.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'.
    <fs_flight>-connid = '0001'.
    <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    <fs_flight>-price = '50.00'.
    <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    <fs_flight>-status = 'Z'. " Unknown status

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_value_table( ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[1]-status_text exp = 'Gebucht' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[2]-status_text exp = 'Offen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_processed[3]-status_text exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination des `VALUE`-Operators mit `FOR`-Iteratoren und dem `SWITCH`-Ausdruck (ab ABAP 7.40). Dies ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und wartungsfreundlicher macht als traditionelle `LOOP`- und `CASE`-Konstrukte.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, SWITCH, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und werfen Sie diese, wenn eine bestimmte Geschäftslogikbedingung nicht erfüllt ist. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und verarbeiten Sie sie.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` oder `CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_input_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_input_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_input_value = iv_input_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_invalid_input.
    METHODS execute_process
      IMPORTING
        iv_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_custom_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    IF iv_data IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text
          iv_input_value = iv_data.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = |Daten '{ iv_data }' erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_process.
    TRY.
        rv_log = process_data( iv_data ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_log = |Fehler bei der Verarbeitung: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_log = |Unerwarteter Systemfehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->execute_process( 'Testdaten' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'erfolgreich verarbeitet' in = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_custom_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_log) = lo_cut->execute_process( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung' in = lv_log ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ungültige Eingabe' in = lv_log ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Eigene Ausnahme-Klassen (hier `zcx_invalid_input`, erbend von `cx_static_check`) ermöglichen eine granulare Fehlerbehandlung und die Kapselung von Fehlerinformationen. Die `RAISING`-Klausel in der Methodendefinition macht die Ausnahme explizit. Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block fängt die spezifische Ausnahme ab und verarbeitet sie geschäftslogikgerecht. Die Verwendung von `if_t100_message` ermöglicht die Integration in das SAP-Nachrichtensystem.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Custom Exception, RAISE EXCEPTION, CX_STATIC_CHECK, IF_T100_MESSAGE

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag für ein gegebenes Datum und geben Sie eine spezifische Nachricht zurück. Für Wochenenden soll eine allgemeine Nachricht ausgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` für spezifische Tage und `WHEN OTHERS` für den Rest. Nutzen Sie `sy-datum+6(1)` für den Wochentag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_weekday_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_day_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_weekday_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_day_message.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = iv_date+6(1). " 1=Monday, 7=Sunday

    CASE lv_weekday.
      WHEN '1'.
        rv_message = 'Es ist Montag, eine neue Woche beginnt!'.
      WHEN '2'.
        rv_message = 'Es ist Dienstag, der Wochenanfang ist geschafft.'.
      WHEN '3'.
        rv_message = 'Es ist Mittwoch, Bergfest!'.
      WHEN '4'.
        rv_message = 'Es ist Donnerstag, fast Wochenende.'.
      WHEN '5'.
        rv_message = 'Es ist Freitag, das Wochenende steht vor der Tür!'.
      WHEN OTHERS. " Covers '6' (Saturday) and '7' (Sunday)
        rv_message = 'Es ist Wochenende, Zeit zum Entspannen!'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_monday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_friday FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_weekend FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_monday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_weekday_message( ).
    " Assuming 20251201 is a Monday
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_day_message( '20251201' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Montag' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_friday.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_weekday_message( ).
    " Assuming 20251205 is a Friday
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->get_day_message( '20251205' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Freitag' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_weekday_message( ).
    " Assuming 20251206 is a Saturday
    DATA(lv_message_sat) = lo_cut->get_day_message( '20251206' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Wochenende' in = lv_message_sat ).
    " Assuming 20251207 is a Sunday
    DATA(lv_message_sun) = lo_cut->get_day_message( '20251207' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Wochenende' in = lv_message_sun ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Anweisung ist ein grundlegendes Kontrollstrukturelement in ABAP. In Kombination mit `WHEN OTHERS` ermöglicht sie eine klare und strukturierte Behandlung verschiedener Fälle, wobei ein Standardverhalten für alle nicht explizit genannten Bedingungen definiert wird. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: CASE, WHEN OTHERS, Conditional Logic, Date Processing

Instructions: Führen Sie eine kritische Operation aus. Protokollieren Sie immer den Abschluss der Operation, unabhängig davon, ob sie erfolgreich war oder fehlschlug.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLEANUP` um sicherzustellen, dass der Protokolleintrag immer geschrieben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_finally_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_critical_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_finally_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_critical_operation.
    DATA(lv_status) = 'Erfolgreich'.
    DATA(lv_detail) = ''.

    TRY.
        IF iv_input = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
        ENDIF.
        lv_detail = |Ergebnis: { 100 / iv_input }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero).
        lv_status = 'Fehlerhaft'.
        lv_detail = |Fehler: { lx_zero->get_text( ) }|.
      CLEANUP.
        " This block acts like a finally block, always executed
        rv_log_message = |Operation abgeschlossen. Status: { lv_status }. Details: { lv_detail }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_operation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_operation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_finally_log( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_critical_operation( 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Status: Erfolgreich' in = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Ergebnis: 50' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_operation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_finally_log( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_critical_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Status: Fehlerhaft' in = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Division durch Null' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP kein explizites `FINALLY`-Schlüsselwort wie einige andere Sprachen hat, kann der `CLEANUP`-Block (ab ABAP 7.50) eine ähnliche Funktionalität bieten, indem er Code enthält, der immer ausgeführt wird, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird. Dies ist nützlich für Logging, Aufräumarbeiten oder das Zurücksetzen von Zuständen, die unabhängig vom Erfolg oder Misserfolg der Operation erfolgen müssen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Logging, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie eine Flugbuchung basierend auf dem Preis in verschiedene Kategorien (Budget, Standard, Premium). Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` für Wertebereiche und mehrere Einzelwerte.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN ... TO ...` und `WHEN ... OR ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_price_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_category
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_price_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_category.
    CASE iv_price.
      WHEN '0.00' TO '99.99'.
        rv_category = 'Budget'.
      WHEN '100.00' TO '499.99'.
        rv_category = 'Standard'.
      WHEN '500.00' OR '500.01' TO '999999.99'. " Example for single value and range
        rv_category = 'Premium'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_category = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_budget_category FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_standard_category FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_premium_category FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_premium_category_exact FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_category FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_budget_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '50.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Budget' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_standard_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '250.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_premium_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '750.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Premium' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_premium_category_exact.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Premium' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_price_category( ).
    DATA(lv_category) = lo_cut->get_price_category( '-10.00' ). " Negative price
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_category exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Anweisung in ABAP unterstützt flexible Bedingungen mit `WHEN ... TO ...` für Wertebereiche und `WHEN ... OR ...` für die Kombination mehrerer Einzelwerte. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise und lesbare Klassifizierung von Daten basierend auf numerischen Kriterien, was die Komplexität von verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen reduziert.
keywords: CASE, WHEN TO, WHEN OR, Conditional Logic, Ranges

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die fehlschlagen kann. Im Fehlerfall soll eine Fehlermeldung an den Benutzer ausgegeben werden, ohne das Programm abzubrechen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MESSAGE` in einem `CATCH`-Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_message_feedback DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_divisor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_message_feedback IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lv_numerator) = 100.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lv_numerator / iv_divisor.
        rv_result_message = |Operation erfolgreich: { lv_numerator } / { iv_divisor } = { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " MESSAGE 'Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' TYPE 'E'. " In real scenario, use MESSAGE E...
        rv_result_message = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_message_feedback( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Operation erfolgreich: 100 / 5 = 20' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_message_feedback( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler: Division durch Null nicht erlaubt!' in = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `TRY...CATCH` mit der Ausgabe von Nachrichten (hier simuliert durch eine Rückgabe-Nachricht, in echten Anwendungen oft `MESSAGE E...`) ermöglicht eine benutzerfreundliche Fehlerbehandlung. Anstatt eines Programmabbruchs erhält der Benutzer eine klare Rückmeldung, und die Anwendung kann ihren Betrieb fortsetzen oder einen alternativen Pfad einschlagen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, MESSAGE, User Feedback, Exception Handling, CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie den Typ eines dynamisch zugewiesenen Feldsymbols und führen Sie typspezifische Aktionen aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE TYPE OF` mit Feldsymbolen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_dynamic_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_dynamic_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_description = 'Fehler: Datenreferenz ungültig.'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE TYPE OF <fs_data>.
      WHEN TYPE i.
        rv_description = |Integer-Wert: { <fs_data> }|.
      WHEN TYPE string.
        rv_description = |String-Wert: '{ <fs_data> }' (Länge: { strlen( <fs_data> ) })|.
      WHEN TYPE d.
        rv_description = |Datum-Wert: { <fs_data> DATE = USER }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_description = 'Unbekannter Datentyp.'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_integer_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_string_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_date_type FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unknown_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_integer_type.
    DATA: lv_int TYPE i VALUE 123.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( lv_int ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_dynamic_type( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_data( lr_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'Integer-Wert: 123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_string_type.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Hallo Welt'.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( lv_string ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_dynamic_type( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_data( lr_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = |String-Wert: 'Hallo Welt' (Länge: 10)| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_date_type.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE sy-datum VALUE '20251204'.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( lv_date ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_dynamic_type( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_data( lr_data ).
    " Date format depends on user settings, so check for part of the string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Datum-Wert' in = lv_description ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = '2025' in = lv_description ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unknown_type.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring VALUE '00'.
    DATA(lr_data) = REF #( lv_xstring ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_case_dynamic_type( ).
    DATA(lv_description) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_data( lr_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_description exp = 'Unbekannter Datentyp.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CASE TYPE OF` kann auch mit Feldsymbolen verwendet werden, die auf dynamisch zugewiesene Daten zeigen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien der dynamischen Programmierung, wo der genaue Datentyp zur Kompilierzeit nicht bekannt ist. Es ermöglicht eine typsichere Verarbeitung von Datenreferenzen zur Laufzeit.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, Data Reference, RTTI

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und führen Sie eine Aktion aus, bevor der Stack-Unwind beginnt, um den Kontext der Ausnahme zu protokollieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CATCH ... BEFORE UNWIND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_before_unwind DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.
    METHODS execute_with_before_unwind
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_before_unwind IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_error.
    DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_value. " Will raise CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE if iv_value is 0
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_with_before_unwind.
    DATA(lv_context_info) = 'Initial Context'.
    TRY.
        lv_context_info = |Context vor Aufruf mit Wert { iv_value }|.
        trigger_error( iv_value ).
        rv_log = |Erfolgreich: { lv_context_info }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero) BEFORE UNWIND.
        " This block is executed before the stack unwinding starts
        rv_log = |Fehler (BEFORE UNWIND): { lx_zero->get_text( ) }. Kontext: { lv_context_info }|.
        " Re-raise the exception if needed, or handle it completely
        " RAISE EXCEPTION lx_zero.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Normal CATCH for other exceptions or if not re-raised
        rv_log = |Fehler (Normal CATCH): { lx_root->get_text( ) }. Kontext: { lv_context_info }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf mehreren Kriterien: ob er abgeschlossen ist, ob er überfällig ist und ob er eine hohe Priorität hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` und logischen Operatoren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_data,
             order_id   TYPE numc10,
             is_completed TYPE abap_bool,
             due_date   TYPE sy-datum,
             priority   TYPE char1, " H=High, M=Medium, L=Low
           END OF ty_order_data.

    METHODS get_order_status_text
      IMPORTING
        is_order TYPE ty_order_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status_text.
    CASE abap_true. " Use abap_true to evaluate complex conditions in WHEN
      WHEN is_order-is_completed = abap_true.
        rv_status_text = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN is_order-due_date < sy-datum AND is_order-priority = 'H'.
        rv_status_text = 'Überfällig und hohe Priorität'.
      WHEN is_order-due_date < sy-datum.
        rv_status_text = 'Überfällig'.
      WHEN is_order-priority = 'H'.
        rv_status_text = 'Offen mit hoher Priorität'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_text = 'Offen (Standard)'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme auslösen kann. Zeigen Sie, wie diese Ausnahme abgefangen und die Verarbeitung nach der Fehlerbehebung fortgesetzt werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION` und `RESUME`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_resumable_warning DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        iv_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_resumable_warning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_resumable_ex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_resumable_warning.
    METHODS execute_process_with_resume
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_resumable_ex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_input < 0.
      RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_resumable_warning
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_resumable_warning=>default_text
          iv_value = iv_input.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = |Wert { iv_input } erfolgreich verarbeitet.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_process_with_resume.
    DATA(lv_processed_value) = iv_input.
    TRY.
        rv_log = process_value( lv_processed_value ).
      CATCH RESUMABLE zcx_resumable_warning INTO DATA(lx_warning).
        " Handle the warning, e.g., log it, correct the value
        rv_log = |Warnung abgefangen: { lx_warning->get_text( ) }. Korrigiere Wert von { lx_warning->mv_value } zu 0.|.
        lv_processed_value = 0. " Correct the problematic value
        RESUME. " Continue execution from where the exception was raised
    ENDTRY.
    " This part is executed after RESUME
    rv_log = rv_log && | Endgültige Verarbeitung mit Wert { lv_processed_value }.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Wort zu einer Liste von "Stoppwörtern" gehört und geben Sie eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` und einer Liste von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_stopwords DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_word
      IMPORTING
        iv_word TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_stopwords IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_word.
    CASE iv_word.
      WHEN 'der' OR 'die' OR 'das' OR 'ein' OR 'eine'.
        rv_message = |Das Wort '{ iv_word }' ist ein Artikel (Stoppwort).|.
      WHEN 'und' OR 'oder' OR 'aber'.
        rv_message = |Das Wort '{ iv_word }' ist eine Konjunktion (Stoppwort).|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_message = |Das Wort '{ iv_word }' ist kein bekanntes Stoppwort.|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_basic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = VALUE #( )
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display.
    " Da cl_salv_table=>display() eine UI-Aktion ist, kann sie nicht direkt in einem Unit-Test
    " ohne UI-Kontext getestet werden. Dieser Test prüft lediglich, ob die Factory-Methode
    " erfolgreich aufgerufen werden kann und keine Exception wirft.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = VALUE #( )
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflights
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SALV table object should be created' act = lo_salv_table IS NOT BOUND ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `cl_salv_table=>factory`-Methode ist der moderne Weg, ein ALV-Objekt zu instanziieren. `VALUE #()` wird für optionale Parameter verwendet, und `DATA(lo_salv_table)` ist eine Inline-Deklaration. `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA()` ist die moderne Open SQL Syntax.
keywords: cl_salv_table, ALV, factory, display, Open SQL, Inline-Deklaration

CLASS zcl_sql_case_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflights-connid,

CLASS zcl_sql_case_expr IMPLEMENTATION.

      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight_info)

CLASS zcl_sql_exceptions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_exceptions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_error_handling.
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 4. " OTHERS = 4 means an error occurred

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rs_flight = ls_flight.
    ELSEIF sy-subrc = 4.
      " Handle SQL error, e.g., log it or return default
      MESSAGE 'SQL-Fehler beim Lesen des Fluges' TYPE 'W'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem generischen SAP-Objekt (z.B. einem Material) eine einfache Notiz über die Generic Object Services (GOS) hinzu. Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_gos_manager`.

CLASS zcl_gos_create_note DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_note_to_object
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibfboriid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfboriid
        iv_note_text   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_create_note IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_note_to_object.
    DATA: lv_lporb TYPE sibflporb.

    lv_lporb-typeid = iv_object_type.
    lv_lporb-instid = iv_object_key.
    lv_lporb-catid = 'BO'. " Business Object

    TRY.
        cl_gos_manager=>create_note(
          EXPORTING
            is_lporb = lv_lporb
            ip_text  = iv_note_text
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        " Error handling for GOS operations
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_get_services DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_gos_service,
             service_id TYPE gos_service,
             service_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_gos_service.
    TYPES: tt_gos_services TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_gos_service WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_gos_services
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibfboriid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfboriid
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_gos_get_services IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lv_lporb TYPE sibflporb.

    lv_lporb-typeid = iv_object_type.
    lv_lporb-instid = iv_object_key.
    lv_lporb-catid = 'BO'. " Business Object

    TRY.
        cl_gos_service_manager=>get_service_list(
          EXPORTING
            is_lporb    = lv_lporb
          IMPORTING
            et_service_list = lt_services_raw
        ).

        rt_services = VALUE #( FOR <ls_service_raw> IN lt_services_raw
                                ( service_id = <ls_service_raw>-service
                                  service_text = <ls_service_raw>-text ) ).
      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines Fluges aus SFLIGHTS und verwenden Sie die Flugdaten, um eine GOS-Notiz zu diesem spezifischen Flugobjekt zu erstellen. Simulieren Sie die Erstellung einer Notiz, die Flugdetails enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` um die Flugdaten zu erhalten und dann `cl_gos_manager=>create_note` mit einem passenden Objekttyp und -schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mix_sql_gos DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_note
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mix_sql_gos IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_note.
    DATA: lv_lporb TYPE sibflporb.
    DATA: lv_note_text TYPE string.

    " 1. Get flight data using SELECT SINGLE
    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Construct object key for GOS (e.g., concatenate CARRIER and CONNECTION ID)
      " Note: This is a simplified example. Real GOS integration requires a defined
      "       Business Object type and a valid key for that type.
      "       Here, we'll use a generic object type and a constructed key.
      lv_lporb-typeid = 'FLIGHT'. " Dummy object type for flight
      lv_lporb-instid = |{ ls_flight-carrid }{ ls_flight-connid }|.
      lv_lporb-catid = 'BO'.

      " Create note text using string templates
      lv_note_text = |Notiz zum Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }.\n| &&
                     |Abflug: { ls_flight-deptime TIME = USER } von { ls_flight-cityfrom }.\n| &&
                     |Ankunft: { ls_flight-arrtime TIME = USER } in { ls_flight-cityto }.|.

      " 2. Create GOS note
      TRY.
          cl_gos_manager=>create_note(
            EXPORTING
              is_lporb = lv_lporb
              ip_text  = lv_note_text
          ).
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
          MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Flight not found
      MESSAGE 'Flug nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'W'.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit 5 Einträgen, die eine fortlaufende Nummer und einen Text enthalten, unter Verwendung von `VALUE #` und einer `FOR`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `VALUE #` Konstruktion in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife, um die Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_insert_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_table_with_value RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_insert_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_table_with_value.
    rt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL i > 5
                       ( id = i text = |Entry { i }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->create_table_with_value( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Table should have 5 entries' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry-id
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Third entry ID should be 3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_entry-text
      exp = 'Entry 3'
      msg = 'Third entry text should be "Entry 3"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE #` Konstruktion ermöglicht die deklarative Initialisierung von internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife können Tabellen kompakt und lesbar mit generierten Daten gefüllt werden, ohne explizite `APPEND` oder `INSERT` Anweisungen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, Functional Programming, INSERT

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen einzelnen Datensatz in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT INTO` für einzelne Datensätze. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Primärschlüssel eindeutig ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_planetype TYPE s_planetye
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_sflight.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid   = iv_carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid   = iv_connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate   = iv_fldate.
    ls_sflight-planetype = iv_planetype.

    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sflight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS cleanup_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_planetype) = 'BOEING747'.

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_sflight(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_planetype = lv_planetype ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Insert should be successful' ).

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_check).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc
      msg = 'Record should exist in SFLIGHT' ).

    lv_success = lo_cut->insert_sflight(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
      iv_planetype = lv_planetype ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_false
      msg = 'Duplicate insert should fail' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_sflight.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT` Anweisung wird verwendet, um einen einzelnen Datensatz in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Es ist wichtig, die Primärschlüsselbedingungen zu beachten, da ein doppelter Primärschlüssel zu einem Fehler führt (`sy-subrc <> 0`). Die Verwendung von `@DATA` für Inline-Deklarationen ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Database Operations, INSERT, SFLIGHT, sy-subrc

Instructions: Fügen Sie mehrere Datensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT FROM TABLE` für Massenoperationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_sflights.
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE it_sflights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 OR sy-subrc = 4.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_sflights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS cleanup_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_table( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'BB'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_table=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate planetype = 'AIRBUS320' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = lv_fldate planetype = 'AIRBUS321' ) ).

    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_sflights( it_sflights = lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Bulk insert should be successful' ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = lv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(lv_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Two records should be inserted' ).

    DATA(lt_duplicate_flights) = VALUE zcl_db_insert_table=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = lv_fldate planetype = 'AIRBUS320' )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = lv_fldate planetype = 'AIRBUS330' ) ).

    lv_success = lo_cut->insert_sflights( it_sflights = lt_duplicate_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Insert with duplicates (accepted) should be successful' ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = lv_fldate
      INTO @lv_count.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 3
      msg = 'Three records should exist after inserting one new and one duplicate' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_sflights.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'BB' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT FROM TABLE` ist die bevorzugte Methode für Massen-Inserts in Datenbanktabellen, da sie performanter ist als das Einfügen einzelner Datensätze in einer Schleife. Der Zusatz `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` verhindert einen Laufzeitfehler, wenn versucht wird, Datensätze mit bereits existierenden Primärschlüsseln einzufügen, und setzt `sy-subrc` auf 4.
keywords: Database Operations, INSERT, FROM TABLE, SFLIGHT, Massenoperationen, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS

unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_insert_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_corr=>tt_source(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = '10.5' )

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_itb_insert_corr=>tt_target(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'Second entry ID should be 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_check_entry-name

Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (`#`) sorgt dafür, dass nur Felder mit identischen Namen zugewiesen werden, was den Code robuster und wartungsfreundlicher macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, INSERT, CORRESPONDING, Field Mapping

Instructions: Messen Sie die Laufzeit von 100.000 `INSERT` Operationen in eine interne Tabelle mit `cl_abap_runtime`. Vergleichen Sie die Performance von `INSERT` mit `APPEND`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( )` vor und nach den Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_runtime_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_insert_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtime_info) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_runtime=>ty_runtime_info.

    METHODS measure_append_performance
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 100000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtime_info) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_runtime=>ty_runtime_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_runtime_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_insert_performance.
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_data.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE ty_data.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      ls_entry-id = sy-index.
      ls_entry-text = |Entry { sy-index }|.
      INSERT ls_entry INTO TABLE lt_data INDEX 1. " Insert at beginning
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    CREATE OBJECT rs_runtime_info.
    rs_runtime_info->runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
    rs_runtime_info->description = |INSERT { iv_num_entries } entries at index 1|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD measure_append_performance.
    DATA lt_data TYPE tt_data.
    DATA ls_entry TYPE ty_data.
    DATA(lv_start_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).

    DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
      ls_entry-id = sy-index.
      ls_entry-text = |Entry { sy-index }|.
      APPEND ls_entry TO lt_data.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_end_time) = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime( ).
    CREATE OBJECT rs_runtime_info.
    rs_runtime_info->runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
    rs_runtime_info->description = |APPEND { iv_num_entries } entries|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_performance_comparison FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_performance_comparison.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_runtime_insert( ).
    CONSTANTS lc_num_entries TYPE i VALUE 10000.

    DATA(lo_insert_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_insert_performance( lc_num_entries ).
    DATA(lo_append_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_append_performance( lc_num_entries ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_insert_runtime->runtime
      msg = 'Insert runtime should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lo_append_runtime->runtime
      msg = 'Append runtime should not be initial' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lo_append_runtime->runtime < lo_insert_runtime->runtime )
      msg = |APPEND ({ lo_append_runtime->runtime } µs) should be faster than INSERT INDEX 1 ({ lo_insert_runtime->runtime } µs)| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` bietet statische Methoden zur Messung der Laufzeit von ABAP-Code in Mikrosekunden. Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie man die Performance von `INSERT ... INDEX 1` (Einfügen am Anfang, was teuer ist) im Vergleich zu `APPEND` (Einfügen am Ende, was sehr effizient ist) messen kann. Es unterstreicht die Wichtigkeit der Wahl der richtigen Operation für interne Tabellen.
keywords: Performance, Runtime Measurement, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, INSERT, APPEND, Internal Tables

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

explanation: Der `TABLE` Ausdruck ermöglicht es, interne Tabellen direkt in Ausdrücken zu verwenden und zu modifizieren, was zu kompakterem und funktionalerem Code führt. In diesem Beispiel wird eine temporäre Tabelle erstellt, der Eintrag eingefügt und das Ergebnis zugewiesen, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Datensätze in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein, die aus einer internen Tabelle stammen, aber nur Felder, die in beiden Strukturen übereinstimmen, sollen übertragen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_corr_tab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
             custom_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES tt_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_sflights_corresponding
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_corr_tab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_sflights_corresponding.
    INSERT sflight FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE it_source ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 OR sy-subrc = 4.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
