Instructions: Geben Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS nur dann auf dem Bildschirm aus, wenn der Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine IF-Bedingung innerhalb der LOOP AT-Schleife, um die Ausgabe zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_write_conditional DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING iv_min_price TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_conditional IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    WRITE: / '--- Teure Flüge (Preis >', iv_min_price, ') ---'.
    WRITE: / 'Carrier ConnID Date       Price    Currency'.
    WRITE: / '-------------------------------------------'.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-price > iv_min_price.
        WRITE: / ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid,
                 (10)ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER,
                 (10)ls_flight-price CURRENCY ls_flight-currency,
                 ls_flight-currency.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    WRITE: / '-------------------------------------------'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_write_conditional( ).
    " Wir können die Bildschirmausgabe nicht direkt testen. Stattdessen stellen wir sicher, dass die Methode läuft.
    " Für einen ordnungsgemäßen Test müsste die Methode die gefilterten Daten zurückgeben.
    lo_cut->display_expensive_flights( 500 ).

    " Bestätigen Sie, dass SFLIGHTS Daten enthält, damit der Test sinnvoll ist.
    DATA(lt_sflights_check) TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( p_act = lines( lt_sflights_check ) p_msg = 'Tabelle SFLIGHTS sollte Daten für die Testeinrichtung enthalten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Anwendung von bedingter Logik (IF-Statement) in Kombination mit dem WRITE-Statement. Es demonstriert, wie man Daten aus SFLIGHTS filtert und nur die Zeilen ausgibt, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen (hier: Flugpreis über einem Schwellenwert).
keywords: WRITE, IF, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic, Output

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String in SOLIX_TAB konvertiert und dabei eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH für mögliche Ausnahmen von CL_BCS_CONVERT verwendet. Geben Sie Fehlermeldungen mit WRITE aus.
hint: Umschließen Sie den Aufruf von CL_BCS_CONVERT mit TRY...CATCH und fangen Sie CX_BCS_CONVERT_INVALID_ARGUMENT oder die allgemeinere CX_BCS ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_safely
      IMPORTING iv_input_string   TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_solix_tab) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_safely.
    TRY.
        cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
          EXPORTING
            iv_string  = iv_input_string
            iv_codepage = '1103'
            iv_add_bom  = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            et_solix   = rt_solix_tab
        ).
        WRITE: / 'Konvertierung erfolgreich.'.
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_invalid_argument INTO DATA(lx_invalid_arg).
        WRITE: / 'Fehler bei Konvertierung (ungültiges Argument):', lx_invalid_arg->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        WRITE: / 'Allgemeiner BCS-Fehler bei Konvertierung:', lx_bcs->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        WRITE: / 'Unerwarteter Fehler bei Konvertierung:', lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_successful_conversion FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Dies ist ein Teststring.'.
    DATA(lt_solix) = lo_cut->convert_string_safely( lv_test_string ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( p_act = lines( lt_solix ) p_msg = 'SOLIX_TAB sollte für gültige Eingabe nicht leer sein' ).
    DATA(lv_string_back) = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string( lt_solix ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_string_back exp = lv_test_string p_msg = 'Konvertierter String sollte dem Original entsprechen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_error_handling( ).
    " Simulieren Sie eine Fehlerbedingung (z.B. durch Übergabe einer ungültigen Codepage, falls möglich, oder eines sehr langen Strings)
    " Für CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLIX ist es schwierig, einen 'ungültigen Argument'-Fehler mit einem einfachen String auszulösen.
    " Ein realistischerer Test würde das Mocking von CL_BCS_CONVERT oder das Testen eines Szenarios, in dem es fehlschlagen könnte, beinhalten.
    " Zur Demonstration rufen wir es einfach mit einem gültigen String auf und stellen sicher, dass kein Dump auftritt.
    DATA(lv_long_string) TYPE string VALUE 'A'.
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      lv_long_string = lv_long_string && 'A'.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lt_solix) = lo_cut->convert_string_safely( lv_long_string ).
    " Die Behauptung hier ist hauptsächlich, dass die Methode ohne unbehandelte Ausnahmen abgeschlossen wird.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( p_act = lines( lt_solix ) p_msg = 'Sollte großen String ohne Dump verarbeiten' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Implementierung einer robusten Fehlerbehandlung bei der Verwendung von CL_BCS_CONVERT. Durch den Einsatz von TRY...CATCH-Blöcken können spezifische Ausnahmen wie CX_BCS_CONVERT_INVALID_ARGUMENT oder allgemeinere BCS-Fehler abgefangen und entsprechende Fehlermeldungen mit WRITE ausgegeben werden. Dies erhöht die Stabilität der Anwendung und ermöglicht eine gezielte Reaktion auf Probleme bei der Datenkonvertierung.
keywords: cl_bcs_convert, Error Handling, TRY...CATCH, CX_BCS, WRITE, Exceptions

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Gesamtpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS und geben Sie das Ergebnis formatiert mit WRITE aus. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne funktionale Programmieransätze.
hint: Verwenden Sie GROUP BY und REDUCE, um die Aggregation durchzuführen, und String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_write_grouped_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_grouped_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_write_grouped_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_grouped_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT carrid, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_grouped_prices) = VALUE tt_grouped_price(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid currency = ls_flight-currency ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        currency = ls_flight-currency
        total_price = REDUCE s_price(
          INIT sum = 0
          FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
          NEXT sum = sum + member-price
        )
      )
    ).

    WRITE: / '--- Gesamtpreise pro Fluggesellschaft ---'.
    WRITE: / 'Carrier Currency Total Price'.
    WRITE: / '---------------------------------------'.

    LOOP AT lt_grouped_prices INTO DATA(ls_grouped).
      WRITE: / ls_grouped-carrid, ls_grouped-currency,
               (15)ls_grouped-total_price CURRENCY ls_grouped-currency.
    ENDLOOP.
    WRITE: / '---------------------------------------'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF tt_grouped_price_line,
         carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
         currency  TYPE s_currkey,
         total_price TYPE s_price,
       END OF tt_grouped_price_line.
TYPES: tt_grouped_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tt_grouped_price_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_write_grouped_flights( ).
    lo_cut->display_grouped_flight_prices( ).

    " Um richtig zu testen, müssten wir die Ausgabe erfassen oder die Methode umgestalten.
    " Hier überprüfen wir, ob SFLIGHTS Daten hat und die Gruppierungslogik solide ist.
    DATA(lt_sflights_check) TYPE TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 1 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( p_act = lines( lt_sflights_check ) p_msg = 'Tabelle SFLIGHTS sollte Daten für die Testeinrichtung enthalten' ).

    " Ein fortgeschrittenerer Test: Manuelle Berechnung der erwarteten Summen für einen kleinen Datensatz
    " und Vergleich mit der Logik, wenn die Methode die gruppierte Tabelle zurückgeben würde.
    " Für dieses Beispiel verlassen wir uns auf die Methodenausführung und das Vorhandensein von Daten.
  ENDMETHOD.

Es gruppiert Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung und berechnet den Gesamtpreis für jede Gruppe. Das Ergebnis wird dann mit dem WRITE-Statement formatiert ausgegeben. Dies zeigt einen modernen, funktionalen Ansatz zur Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den MIME-Typ für die Konvertierung eines Strings in SOLIX_TAB mit CL_BCS_CONVERT basierend auf einer Eingabe bestimmt. Geben Sie das Ergebnis mit WRITE aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine CASE-Anweisung oder IF-ELSEIF, um den MIME-Typ zu bestimmen. CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLIX kann verschiedene MIME-Typen verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_mime DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_dynamic_mime
      IMPORTING iv_input_string TYPE string
                iv_mime_type    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_solix_tab) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_mime IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_dynamic_mime.
    DATA(lv_codepage) TYPE abap_codepage VALUE '1103'. " UTF-8
    DATA(lv_mime_type_actual) TYPE string.

    CASE iv_mime_type TO LOWER( ).
      WHEN 'text/plain'.
        lv_mime_type_actual = 'text/plain'.
      WHEN 'text/html'.
        lv_mime_type_actual = 'text/html'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_mime_type_actual = 'text/plain'. " Default
        WRITE: / 'Unbekannter MIME-Typ:', iv_mime_type, '. Verwende Standard: text/plain.'.
    ENDCASE.

    cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
      EXPORTING
        iv_string   = iv_input_string
        iv_codepage = lv_codepage
        iv_add_bom  = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        et_solix    = rt_solix_tab
    ).

    WRITE: / 'Konvertierung abgeschlossen für MIME-Typ:', lv_mime_type_actual.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` um die Filterung direkt bei der Zuweisung durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) >= iv_min_seats )
        ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, fldate = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    " Further assertions could check specific content if test data is controlled

Anstatt eine explizite Schleife mit `IF` Bedingungen zu schreiben, wird die Filterlogik direkt in die Zuweisung integriert. `VALUE #(` erzeugt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf den gefilterten Elementen.

CLASS zcl_itb_transform_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtkapazität aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
        NEXT total = total + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_capacity_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_capacity( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    " Assuming some flights exist for LH and AA in sflight
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'LH capacity should not be zero' exp = 0 act = lv_total_capacity_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'AA capacity should not be zero' exp = 0 act = lv_total_capacity_aa ).
    " Specific values would require mocking sflight data
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_str_textedit_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_text_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE string_table " Simuliert cl_gui_textedit->get_text_as_r3table

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Methodennamen aus einem `string_table` (simuliert `cl_gui_textedit` Inhalt) und rufen Sie diese Methode dynamisch auf einer Instanz der Klasse `zcl_dyn_target_class` auf.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_target_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS:
      method_a IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string,
      method_b IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dyn_target_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_output = |Method A called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD method_b.
    rv_output = |Method B called with: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        it_method_name_line TYPE string_table " Simuliert cl_gui_textedit->get_text_as_r3table
        iv_input_param      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result)    TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA(lv_method_name) = it_method_name_line[ 1 ]. " Assume method name is in the first line
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dyn_target_class( ).

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (lo_target)->(lv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input_param
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = |Error: Method '{ lv_method_name }' not found or invalid call.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_con_cond_carrid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` einen Status basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze zuweist ('Full' für < 10 freie Sitze, 'Almost Full' für < 50, 'Available' sonst).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` innerhalb von `FOR` für die komplexe bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_con_switch_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_switch_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
        ( carrid = flight-carrid,
          connid = flight-connid,
          fldate = flight-fldate,
          free_seats = lv_free_seats,
          status = SWITCH string(
                     WHEN lv_free_seats < 10 THEN 'Full'
                     WHEN lv_free_seats < 50 THEN 'Almost Full'
                     ELSE 'Available'
                   )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_con_switch_flight_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lt_result ).

    " Test cases for different statuses (requires specific sflight data or mocking)
    " For demonstration, we'll just check if any 'Full' or 'Available' exists.
    DATA(lv_full_exists) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_available_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_status).
      IF ls_flight_status-status = 'Full'.
        lv_full_exists = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_flight_status-status = 'Available'.
        lv_available_exists = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one "Full" status expected' act = lv_full_exists ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'At least one "Available" status expected' act = lv_available_exists ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `SWITCH` Operator bietet eine moderne und übersichtliche Möglichkeit, komplexe bedingte Logik zu implementieren, die traditionell viele `IF ... ELSE IF ... ENDIF` Blöcke erfordern würde. In Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...` und dem `LET` Ausdruck zur Berechnung temporärer Werte wird der Code extrem kompakt und gut lesbar, was die Wartbarkeit erheblich verbessert.
keywords: SWITCH, FOR, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables, LET, Expression

Instructions: Finden Sie den Index des ersten Fluges in `sflights` einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft, der mehr als 100 freie Sitze hat. Wenn kein solcher Flug gefunden wird, geben Sie 0 zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit `FOR` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_find_flight_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_flight_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_find_flight_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_index = COND i(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ 
                           carrid = iv_carrid
                           ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > iv_min_free_seats
                         ] )
        THEN LINE_INDEX( lt_sflights[ 
                             carrid = iv_carrid
                             ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > iv_min_free_seats
                           ] )
      ELSE 0
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_find_existing_flight FOR TESTING.

ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_find_flight_index( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' has flights with > 100 free seats

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Index should be greater than 0' exp = 0 act = lv_index ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Index should be positive' act = ( lv_index > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lv_index) = lo_cut->find_flight_index( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_free_seats = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Index should be 0 for non-existing flight' exp = 0 act = lv_index ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` in Kombination mit `COND` ermöglicht das Auffinden des Index einer Tabellenzeile basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen in einer einzigen, funktionalen Anweisung. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` Prüfungen und macht den Code prägnanter und fehlerresistenter.

CLASS zcl_itb_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE tt_connid,
           END OF ty_carrier_flights.
    TYPES tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_flight_lists
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flight_lists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid
        ( carrid = flight-carrid,
          connids = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP
                               ( member-connid ) )

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls (simuliert durch `string_table`), zählen Sie die Anzahl der Wörter und geben Sie die Zählung zurück. Wörter sind durch Leerzeichen getrennt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `split` oder `find` mit `FOR` um die Wörter zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_word_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_words_in_text
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE string_table " Simuliert cl_gui_textedit->get_text_as_r3table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_word_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_word_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_words_in_text.
    rv_word_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_words = 0
      FOR line IN it_text_lines
        LET words = split( val = line sep = ` ` )
        NEXT total_words = total_words + lines( words )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_count_words_in_text FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_count_empty_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_words_in_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_word_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_text) = VALUE string_table( ( `Hello World` ) ( `ABAP is great` ) ( `One two three` ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_words_in_text( lt_input_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Word count should be 7' exp = 7 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_count_empty_text.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_word_counter( ).
    DATA(lt_input_text) = VALUE string_table( ( `` ) ( ` ` ) ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->count_words_in_text( lt_input_text ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Word count should be 0 for empty/space lines' exp = 0 act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `FOR ... IN ...` und dem `LET` Ausdruck, um die Wörter in einem mehrzeiligen Text zu zählen. Die `split` Funktion teilt jede Zeile in Wörter auf, und `lines()` zählt die resultierenden Wörter. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und funktionale Methode zur Textanalyse, die den Inhalt eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls verarbeiten könnte.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, LET, split, lines, String Processing, cl_gui_textedit

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einzelnen String, der eine Zusammenfassung der ersten 3 Flüge aus `sflights` enthält. Jeder Flug soll in einer neuen Zeile mit Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und Datum formatiert sein. Geben Sie diesen String zurück (simuliert den Inhalt für `cl_gui_textedit`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die formatierten Zeilen zu einem einzigen String zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_reduce_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_summary_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary_string) TYPE string. " Simuliert cl_gui_textedit->set_text_as_string
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_reduce_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_summary_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO iv_max_entries ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_summary_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT result = COND string( WHEN result IS INITIAL
                                 THEN |Flug: { flight-carrid } { flight-connid }, Datum: { flight-fldate DATE = USER }|
                                 ELSE |{ result }{ cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf }Flug: { flight-carrid } { flight-connid }, Datum: { flight-fldate DATE = USER }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_summary_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_summary_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_summary_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_reduce_format( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_summary_string( iv_max_entries = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain "Flug:"' substring = 'Flug:' act = lv_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Result should contain newline' substring = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_summary_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_reduce_format( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_summary_string( iv_max_entries = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result should be empty for 0 entries' exp = `` act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `REDUCE` zur Aggregation von formatierten Zeilen in einen einzigen String. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn der Inhalt eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls als ein zusammenhängender String gesetzt werden soll (z.B. mit `set_text_as_string`). Die Kombination mit String Templates und `cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf` ermöglicht eine flexible und lesbare Formatierung über mehrere Zeilen hinweg.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_bsp_event_handler. " Dummy interface for event handling in real scenario
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL. " For real UI, pass container

      RETURNING

    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.

    ENDIF.

    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(

      rv_count = lines( lt_buttons ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Preis eines Fluges aus `SFLIGHTS`. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie den Wert 0 zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit dem `COND` Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_price_cond
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflights-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_cond.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE *
      FROM sflights
      INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rv_price = COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN ls_flight-price ELSE 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erweitern Sie eine Toolbar, sodass beim Klick auf einen 'Save'-Button ein Event ausgelöst und eine Meldung angezeigt wird.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(iv_fcode) TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL.

    METHODS create_toolbar
      RETURNING

      IMPORTING
        fcode.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container = io_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( ).
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'SAVE'
      icon  = icon_save
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
      text  = 'Speichern'

      mo_toolbar->get_button_info( IMPORTING et_button_info = lt_buttons ).
      rv_count = lines( lt_buttons ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    " In a real scenario, this would trigger UI updates or backend calls.
    " For unit test, we just raise an event.
    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING iv_fcode = fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

  METHOD test_button_click_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_event( ).
    DATA(lo_toolbar) = lo_cut->create_toolbar( ).

    " Local event handler for testing
    CLASS lcl_event_receiver DEFINITION.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines Fluges aus `SFLIGHTS` in eine Struktur. Wenn kein Flug gefunden wird, initialisieren Sie die Struktur mit Standardwerten (z.B. 'N/A' für Strings, 0 für Zahlen).
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` und den `VALUE` Operator für die Initialisierung der Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
             currency TYPE sflights-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_data_with_default
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflights-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data_with_default.
    DATA ls_flight_from_db TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight_from_db
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    rs_flight = VALUE #( BASE ls_flight_from_db
                         carrid   = COND string( WHEN sy-subrc <> 0 THEN 'N/A' ELSE ls_flight_from_db-carrid ) 
                         connid   = COND sflights-connid( WHEN sy-subrc <> 0 THEN '0000' ELSE ls_flight_from_db-connid ) 
                         fldate   = COND sflights-fldate( WHEN sy-subrc <> 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE ls_flight_from_db-fldate ) 
                         price    = COND sflights-price( WHEN sy-subrc <> 0 THEN 0 ELSE ls_flight_from_db-price ) 
                         currency = COND string( WHEN sy-subrc <> 0 THEN 'XXX' ELSE ls_flight_from_db-currency ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_existing_flight_with_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existing_flight_with_value FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_flight_with_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_select_value( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data_with_default(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101' " Adjust date
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_flight_with_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_select_value( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_data_with_default(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '19000101'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'N/A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = 0 ).

explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator ermöglicht die Initialisierung von Strukturen und internen Tabellen mit Standardwerten oder Werten aus anderen Variablen. In Kombination mit `COND` kann eine elegante Fallunterscheidung für die Initialisierung nach einem `SELECT SINGLE` durchgeführt werden.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, VALUE, COND, Data Manipulation, Default Values

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar, die dynamisch Buttons basierend auf einer Liste von Aktionen hinzufügt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_button_def,
             fcode     TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode,
             icon      TYPE icon_name,
             text      TYPE string,
             quickinfo TYPE string,
           END OF ty_button_def.
    TYPES tt_button_defs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_button_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL.

    METHODS create_dynamic_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        it_button_defs TYPE tt_button_defs
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_toolbar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    METHODS get_button_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container = io_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dynamic_toolbar.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( ).
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_button_defs INTO DATA(ls_button_def).
      mo_toolbar->add_button(
        fcode     = ls_button_def-fcode
        icon      = ls_button_def-icon
        butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
        text      = ls_button_def-text
        quickinfo = ls_button_def-quickinfo
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    ro_toolbar = mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button_count.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button_info_table.
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar->get_button_info( IMPORTING et_button_info = lt_buttons ).
      rv_count = lines( lt_buttons ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'On Time', 'Delayed', 'Cancelled') basierend auf einem Feld aus `SFLIGHTS` und geben Sie eine entsprechende Beschreibung zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `CASE` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` in Kombination mit einem `CASE` Ausdruck für die Statusermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflights-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflights-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status_text = CASE ls_flight-planetype
                         WHEN '747' THEN 'On Time'
                         WHEN 'A380' THEN 'Delayed'
                         ELSE 'Unknown Status'
                       END.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_text = 'Flight Not Found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie der Toolbar ein Dropdown-Menü mit mehreren Optionen hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ADD_BUTTON` mit `MENU_HANDLE` und `ADD_FUNCTION` für die Menüpunkte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_dropdown DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS menu_item_selected EXPORTING VALUE(iv_fcode) TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL.

    METHODS create_toolbar_with_dropdown
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_toolbar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    METHODS get_button_count
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_dropdown IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container = io_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar_with_dropdown.
    DATA lv_menu_handle TYPE i.

    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( ).
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    " Add a regular button
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'SAVE'
      icon  = icon_save
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
      text  = 'Speichern'
      quickinfo = 'Daten speichern'
    ).

    " Add a dropdown button
    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'OPTIONS'
      icon  = icon_system_settings
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_dropdown
      text  = 'Optionen'
      quickinfo = 'Weitere Optionen'
      menu_handle = lv_menu_handle " Get a handle for the dropdown menu
    ).

    " Add items to the dropdown menu
    mo_toolbar->add_function(
      menu_handle = lv_menu_handle
      fcode = 'OPT1'
      text = 'Option 1'
    ).
    mo_toolbar->add_function(
      menu_handle = lv_menu_handle
      fcode = 'OPT2'
      text = 'Option 2'
    ).
    mo_toolbar->add_function(
      menu_handle = lv_menu_handle
      fcode = 'OPT3'
      text = 'Option 3'
    ).

    ro_toolbar = mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_button_count.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button_info_table.
    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar->get_button_info( IMPORTING et_button_info = lt_buttons ).
      rv_count = lines( lt_buttons ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    RAISE EVENT menu_item_selected EXPORTING iv_fcode = fcode.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Toolbar mit einem Button. Beim Klick auf den Button soll ein spezifischer Flug aus `SFLIGHTS` per `SELECT SINGLE` gelesen und dessen Preis in einer Meldung angezeigt werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gui_toolbar` Event Handling mit `SELECT SINGLE` und String Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_db_int DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS flight_price_displayed EXPORTING VALUE(iv_price_info) TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL.

    METHODS create_toolbar_and_integrate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_toolbar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS handle_display_flight_price FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_db_int IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container = io_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar_and_integrate.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( ).
    ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_display_flight_price FOR mo_toolbar.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'SHOW_PRICE'
      icon  = icon_display_price
      butn_type = cl_gui_toolbar=>button_type_button
      text  = 'Flugpreis anzeigen'
      quickinfo = 'Preis für Flug AA 0017 am 20250101 anzeigen'
    ).
    ro_toolbar = mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_display_flight_price.
    IF fcode = 'SHOW_PRICE'.
      DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.

      SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights
        INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @ls_flight
        WHERE carrid = 'AA'
          AND connid = '0017'
          AND fldate = '20250101'. " Adjust date

      DATA(lv_price_info) = COND string(
        WHEN sy-subrc = 0
        THEN |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } kostet { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
        ELSE |Flug AA 0017 am 20250101 nicht gefunden.|
      ).
      RAISE EVENT flight_price_displayed EXPORTING iv_price_info = lv_price_info.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Ein Klick auf einen Toolbar-Button löst ein Event aus, das wiederum einen `SELECT SINGLE` auf die `SFLIGHTS`-Tabelle ausführt. Das Ergebnis wird dann mit einem String Template formatiert und über ein weiteres Event zurückgegeben, was eine saubere Trennung der Verantwortlichkeiten ermöglicht.

Instructions: Suchen Sie den ersten Flug in `SFLIGHTS`, der eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität für Economy-Sitze hat und dessen Fluggesellschaft mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt. Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit einer komplexeren `WHERE`-Klausel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `LIKE` und `AND` in der `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_complex_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_by_criteria
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid_prefix TYPE string
        iv_min_eco_seats TYPE sflights-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_complex_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_by_criteria.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid LIKE @( iv_carrid_prefix && '%' )
        AND seatsmax - seatsocc >= @iv_min_eco_seats.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_select_complex_where( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_criteria(
      iv_carrid_prefix = 'AA'
      iv_min_eco_seats = 100
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-carrid CS 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_select_complex_where( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_by_criteria(
      iv_carrid_prefix = 'ZZ'
      iv_min_eco_seats = 9999
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `WHERE`-Klausel in `SELECT SINGLE` kann komplexe Bedingungen enthalten, einschließlich des `LIKE`-Operators für Mustervergleiche und arithmetischer Ausdrücke. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@` ist obligatorisch und fördert die Sicherheit und Lesbarkeit.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, WHERE, LIKE, Host Variables, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_state DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container OPTIONAL.

    METHODS create_toolbar_with_disabled_button
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_toolbar) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    METHODS is_button_enabled
      IMPORTING
        iv_fcode TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>fcode
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_enabled) TYPE abap_bool.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mo_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_toolbar_state IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_container IS BOUND.
      mo_container = io_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar_with_disabled_button.
    IF mo_container IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( parent = mo_container ).
    ELSE.
      mo_toolbar = NEW cl_gui_toolbar( ).
    ENDIF.

    mo_toolbar->add_button(
      fcode = 'PROCESS'
      icon  = icon_process
      text  = 'Verarbeiten'
      quickinfo = 'Daten verarbeiten'
    ).

    mo_toolbar->set_button_state(
      fcode = 'PROCESS'
      enabled = 0 " 0 for disabled, 1 for enabled
    ).

    ro_toolbar = mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_button_enabled.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button_info_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_button> LIKE LINE OF lt_buttons.

    IF mo_toolbar IS BOUND.
      mo_toolbar->get_button_info( IMPORTING et_button_info = lt_buttons ).
      READ TABLE lt_buttons ASSIGNING <ls_button> WITH KEY fcode = iv_fcode.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <ls_button>-enabled = 1.
        rv_enabled = abap_true.
      ELSE.
        rv_enabled = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_into_vars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS get_flight_price_currency
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_into_vars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_currency.

      INTO (@ev_price, @ev_currency)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail an einen Empfänger mit einem dynamisch generierten Betreff und Text. Verwenden Sie String-Templates für die Inhalte.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                              iv_subject         TYPE string
                              iv_body            TYPE string
                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).

        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        " Log error or handle exception
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Größe und das Änderungsdatum einer Datei, deren Pfad vom Benutzer über einen Dateiauswahldialog ausgewählt wird. Geben Sie diese Informationen als Struktur zurück.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog` mit `get_file_properties` und nutzen Sie Inline-Deklarationen.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_properties,
         size TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_fnt_file_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_file_details RETURNING VALUE(rs_file_props) TYPE ty_file_properties.

CLASS zcl_fnt_file_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_file_details.
    DATA(lt_file_table) = VALUE filetable( ).
    DATA(lv_rc) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title            = 'Datei für Details auswählen'

        file_table              = lt_file_table
        rc                      = DATA(lv_return_code)
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error              = 1
        error_no_gui            = 2
        OTHERS                  = 3
    ).

    IF lv_rc = 0 AND lv_return_code = 1.
      DATA(lv_file_path) = lt_file_table[ 1 ]-fullpath.
      cl_gui_frontend_services=>get_file_properties(
        EXPORTING
          the_file                = lv_file_path
        IMPORTING
          file_size               = rs_file_props-size
          file_date               = DATA(lv_file_date)
          file_time               = DATA(lv_file_time)
        EXCEPTIONS
          file_not_found          = 1
          cntl_error              = 2
          error_no_gui            = 3
          OTHERS                  = 4
      ).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CONCATENATE lv_file_date lv_file_time INTO DATA(lv_timestamp_str).
        TRY.
            rs_file_props-last_modified = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_char( lv_timestamp_str ).
          CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_invalid_date_time.
            " Handle error, e.g., set to initial

      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Anhang, der den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle als Textdatei enthält. Der Anhang soll einen dynamischen Dateinamen haben.
hint: Erstellen Sie den Anhang mit `cl_bcs_document_bcs=>add_attachment` aus einer internen Tabelle, die mit `FOR` gefüllt wurde.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_with_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_with_attachment IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                                                iv_subject         TYPE string
                                                iv_body            TYPE string
                                                it_attachment_data TYPE tt_data
                                                iv_attachment_name TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_with_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_with_attachment.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lt_attachment_content) = VALUE soli_tab(
          FOR <fs_data> IN it_attachment_data
          ( line = |{ <fs_data>-field1 } | { <fs_data>-field2 }| )
        ).

        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
          i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
          i_attachment_size    = cl_bcs_convert=>soli_tab_to_xstring( lt_attachment_content )->length( )
          i_att_content_text   = lt_attachment_content
        ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

              application        = 'notepad.exe'
              parameter          = lv_file_path
              get_response       = abap_false
              minimized          = abap_false
              maximized          = abap_false
              synchronous        = abap_false
            EXCEPTIONS
              cntl_error         = 1
              error_no_gui       = 2
              bad_parameter      = 3
              file_not_found     = 4
              OTHERS             = 5

          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_success = abap_true.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fnt_error).
          " Log error
          rv_success = abap_false.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger (TO, CC, BCC). Die Empfängeradressen sollen aus einer internen Tabelle stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address` und einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um mehrere Empfänger hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_multi_recip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_recipient,
             email TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             type  TYPE char1, " T=TO, C=CC, B=BCC
           END OF ty_recipient.
    TYPES tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_recipient WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_to_multiple_recipients IMPORTING iv_subject         TYPE string
                                                     iv_body            TYPE string
                                                     it_recipients      TYPE tt_recipients
                                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_multi_recip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_to_multiple_recipients.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        LOOP AT it_recipients INTO DATA(ls_recipient_data).
          DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( ls_recipient_data-email ).
          CASE ls_recipient_data-type.
            WHEN 'T'.
              lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
            WHEN 'C'.
              lo_send_request->add_cc_recipient( lo_recipient ).
            WHEN 'B'.
              lo_send_request->add_bcc_recipient( lo_recipient ).
            WHEN OTHERS.
              " Handle invalid recipient type
          ENDCASE.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail, deren Betreff und Inhalt dynamisch aus Daten der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` generiert werden. Die E-Mail soll Informationen zu Flügen enthalten, die mit einem `SELECT`-Statement abgefragt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration und String-Templates, um die E-Mail-Inhalte zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_sflight_mail IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                                      iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_sflight_mail.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight_tab(
          FOR sflight_line IN (
            SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsocc, seatsmax
              FROM sflight
              WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
              ORDER BY fldate ASC
              UP TO 5 ROWS
          )
          ( sflight_line )
        ).

        IF lt_sflight_data IS INITIAL.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_subject) = |Fluginformationen für Airline { iv_carrid }|.
        DATA(lv_body_header) = |Hallo,\n\nHier sind die neuesten Fluginformationen für Ihre ausgewählte Airline { iv_carrid }:\n\n|.
        DATA(lv_body_flights) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
          NEXT s = s && |Flug { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }, Belegung: { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax }\n|
        ).
        DATA(lv_body_footer) = |\nMit freundlichen Grüßen,\nIhr ABAP System|.
        DATA(lv_full_body) = lv_body_header && lv_body_flights && lv_body_footer.

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_full_body )
          i_subject = lv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt einer vom Benutzer ausgewählten Textdatei vom Frontend in eine interne Tabelle. Geben Sie die interne Tabelle zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload` und `file_open_dialog`.

CLASS zcl_fnt_upload_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_text_file RETURNING VALUE(rt_file_content) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnt_upload_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA(lt_file_table) = VALUE filetable( ).
    DATA(lv_rc_dialog) = cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        window_title            = 'Textdatei zum Hochladen auswählen'
        default_filename        = '*.txt'
        multiselection          = abap_false
      CHANGING
        file_table              = lt_file_table
        rc                      = DATA(lv_return_code_dialog)
      EXCEPTIONS
        cntl_error              = 1
        error_no_gui            = 2
        OTHERS                  = 3
    ).

    IF lv_rc_dialog = 0 AND lv_return_code_dialog = 1.
      DATA(lv_file_path) = lt_file_table[ 1 ]-fullpath.
      TRY.
          cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
            EXPORTING
              filename                = lv_file_path
              filetype                = 'ASC'
            CHANGING
              data_tab                = rt_file_content
            EXCEPTIONS
              file_open_error         = 1
              file_read_error         = 2
              no_batch                = 3
              gui_refuse_filetransfer = 4
              invalid_type            = 5
              no_authority            = 6
              unknown_error           = 7
              bad_data_format         = 8
              cant_calculate_line     = 9
              OTHERS                  = 10
          ).
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            CLEAR rt_file_content.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_fnt_error).
          CLEAR rt_file_content.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_pdf_attach DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_with_pdf_attachment IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                                                    iv_subject         TYPE string
                                                    iv_body            TYPE string
                                                    iv_app_server_path TYPE string
                                                    iv_attachment_name TYPE string
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_pdf_attach IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_with_pdf_attachment.
    DATA: lv_xstring TYPE xstring.
    DATA: lt_bintab  TYPE solix_tab.

    TRY.
        OPEN DATASET iv_app_server_path FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE MESSAGE DATA(lv_msg).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          " Handle error: file not found or cannot be opened
          rv_success = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ DATASET iv_app_server_path INTO lv_xstring.
        CLOSE DATASET iv_app_server_path.

        cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( EXPORTING iv_xstring = lv_xstring
                                          IMPORTING et_solix   = lt_bintab ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_document->add_attachment(
          i_attachment_type    = 'PDF'
          i_attachment_subject = iv_attachment_name
          i_attachment_size    = lv_xstring->length( )
          i_att_content_hex    = lt_bintab
        ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_sy_file_access_error INTO DATA(lx_file_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit einem Betreff und Text, die aus einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` Daten generiert werden. Der E-Mail-Body soll eine formatierte Liste der Flüge enthalten, die mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates erstellt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit Inline-Deklaration, `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um den E-Mail-Inhalt zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_sflight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_sflight_mail_formatted IMPORTING iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
                                                iv_carrid          TYPE s_carr_id
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_mail_sflight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_sflight_mail_formatted.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_sflight_data) = VALUE sflight_tab(
          FOR sflight_line IN (
            SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsocc, seatsmax
              FROM sflight
              WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
              ORDER BY fldate ASC
              UP TO 5 ROWS
          )
          ( sflight_line )
        ).

        IF lt_sflight_data IS INITIAL.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lv_subject) = |Detaillierte Fluginformationen für Airline { iv_carrid }|.
        DATA(lv_body) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = |Hallo,\n\nHier sind die detaillierten Fluginformationen für Ihre ausgewählte Airline { iv_carrid }:\n\n|
          FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight_data
          NEXT s = s && |Flug: { ls_flight-connid }\nDatum: { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER }\nPreis: { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }\nBelegung: { ls_flight-seatsocc }/{ ls_flight-seatsmax }\n--------------------\n|
        ).
        lv_body = lv_body && |\nMit freundlichen Grüßen,\nIhr ABAP System|.

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_bcs_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( lv_body )
          i_subject = lv_subject
        ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_bcs_recipient_persistent=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
        DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs_message=>create_message( ).
        lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
        lo_send_request->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).
        lo_send_request->set_sender( cl_bcs_sender_persistent=>create_system_user( sy-uname ) ).

        lo_send_request->send( i_with_dialog = abap_false ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_sflight_mail_formatted FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_send_sflight_mail_formatted_no_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_sflight_mail_formatted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_mail_sflight_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'sflight_formatted@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'. " American Airlines, assuming data exists in SFLIGHT

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_sflight_mail_formatted(

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_send_sflight_mail_formatted_no_data.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge von 'LH' enthält und dabei die Flugnummern in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax wie den FOR-Ausdruck und VALUE-Konstruktoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE #(...)` und `COND` oder `FILTER` für die Selektion. String-Funktionen wie `to_upper()` sind hilfreich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
        ( carrid = to_upper( ls_sflight-carrid ),
          connid = ls_sflight-connid,
          fldate = ls_sflight-fldate,
          planetype = ls_sflight-planetype )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.' ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fluggesellschaft sollte LH sein.' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE #(...)` zur Transformation und Filterung interner Tabellen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine effiziente Filterung, während die Zuweisung der Komponenten direkt im `VALUE`-Konstruktor erfolgt. `to_upper()` ist eine moderne String-Funktion. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_cut)`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, Filter, Inline Declaration, String Functions

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit Methoden-Chaining, um eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Objekt auszuführen. Demonstrieren Sie die Erstellung des Objekts mit `NEW` und die Verkettung der Methoden.
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME->`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_calculator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_result TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    mv_result = mv_result + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_result = mv_result - iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_chainable_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_final_result) = lo_calculator->add( 10 )->subtract( 3 )->add( 5 )->get_result( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_final_result exp = 12 msg = 'Das Ergebnis der Kette sollte 12 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methoden-Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und flüssiger macht. Jede verkettbare Methode gibt eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Objektinstanz (`ME->`) zurück. Der `NEW`-Operator wird für die Instanziierung verwendet, und `REF TO` ist entscheidend für den Rückgabetyp der Methoden.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, NEW, REF TO, Class

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einem Startwert und iterieren Sie über die gefilterten Einträge der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_price FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_flights( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_price) TYPE s_price.

    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_price.

    DATA(lv_actual_price) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_expected_price msg = 'Die berechnete Summe sollte mit der Datenbanksumme übereinstimmen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (z.B. Summe, Maximum, Minimum). Er ist besonders nützlich für Aggregationen und vermeidet explizite Schleifen, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht. Die `INIT`-Klausel setzt den Startwert des Akkumulators.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Open SQL

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes einer Struktur aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` ausliest, dessen Name als String übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie dabei Feld-Symbole und Datenreferenzen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid    TYPE s_conn_id

        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE ls_sflight TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
      ELSE.
        rv_field_value = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = 'Flug nicht gefunden'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (z.B. 'Pünktlich', 'Verspätet', 'Annulliert') basierend auf einer übergebenen Verspätungszeit in Minuten. Nutzen Sie dafür den `COND`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` mit mehreren `WHEN`-Bedingungen und einem `ELSE`-Zweig.

CLASS zcl_flight_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_flight_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes <= 0 THEN 'Pünktlich'
      WHEN iv_delay_minutes > 0 AND iv_delay_minutes <= 30 THEN 'Verspätet'
      ELSE 'Annulliert'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer (`CONNID`) zu erhalten. Nutzen Sie dafür den `FILTER`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #(...)` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate   TYPE s_date,

      IMPORTING
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_connection.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    " Beispiel-Daten füllen
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251205' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #(
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE connid = iv_connid
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie RTTI (Run-Time Type Information), um den Typ eines dynamisch übergebenen Datenobjekts zu ermitteln und dessen Komponenten aufzulisten. Nutzen Sie dabei Datenreferenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` und `CAST` zu `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` oder `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data_object_info
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_info) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_object_info.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    APPEND |Typname: { lo_typedescr->get_name( ) }| TO rt_info.
    APPEND |Typkind: { lo_typedescr->type_kind }| TO rt_info.

    CASE lo_typedescr->type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
        DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
        APPEND |Strukturkomponenten:| TO rt_info.
        LOOP AT lo_structdescr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND |  - { ls_component-name } (Typ: { ls_component-type_descr_ref->get_name( ) })| TO rt_info.
        ENDLOOP.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table.
        DATA(lo_tabledescr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_typedescr ).
        APPEND |Tabellentyp: { lo_tabledescr->table_kind }| TO rt_info.
        APPEND |Zeilentyp: { lo_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) }| TO rt_info.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit Informationen über Datentypen und -objekte zu erhalten. `CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` ist der Einstiegspunkt, um eine Typbeschreibung für eine Datenreferenz (`REF TO data`) zu erhalten. Durch `CAST` auf spezifischere Deskriptor-Klassen (z.B. `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`) können Details wie Komponenten einer Struktur ausgelesen werden.
