Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem übergebenen Typ-Parameter erzeugt. Nutzen Sie dabei den `NEW`-Operator mit Typ-Referenzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Interface-Hierarchie und den `NEW`-Operator mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    DATA lv_class_name TYPE string.

    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_A'.
      WHEN 'B'.
        lv_class_name = 'ZCL_PRODUCT_B'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    TRY.
        ro_product = NEW ( lv_class_name ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen
        CLEAR ro_product.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Factory-Methoden sind ein Entwurfsmuster zur Kapselung der Objekterzeugung. Der `NEW`-Operator in Verbindung mit einer dynamischen Typangabe (`NEW ( lv_class_name )`) ermöglicht es, zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Klasse instanziiert werden soll. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Flexibilität. Die Rückgabe einer Referenz auf ein Interface (`REF TO zif_product`) ist hierbei eine Best Practice.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum des nächsten Werktags (Montag bis Freitag) ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei Wochenenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder manuelle Datumsberechnung mit `sy-datum` und `sy-daywk`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_next_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_next_weekday
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_next_weekday) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_next_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_weekday.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE sy-datum VALUE iv_date.
    DATA lv_day_of_week TYPE sy-daywk.

    DO.
      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_weekday( lv_current_date ).

      IF lv_day_of_week >= 1 AND lv_day_of_week <= 5. " Montag (1) bis Freitag (5)
        rv_next_weekday = lv_current_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugnummer (`CONNID`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie dabei den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in Open SQL und den `FOR`-Ausdruck für die Verarbeitung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... GROUP BY ...` in Open SQL und anschließend `FOR GROUPS` für die interne Tabellenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    DATA lt_sflights_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid, connid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_result).

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_db_result GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid, connid = ls_group-connid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid,
        connid = ls_group-connid,
        count  = ls_group-count )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_warn ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'Es sollten Gruppen gefunden werden.' ).

    " Beispiel: Prüfen, ob eine bekannte Gruppe existiert und die Anzahl korrekt ist
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group_lh_0400) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA lv_expected_count TYPE i.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' INTO @lv_expected_count.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_group_lh_0400-count exp = lv_expected_count msg = 'Anzahl der Flüge für LH 0400 sollte korrekt sein.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `GROUP BY` in Open SQL und dem `FOR GROUPS`-Ausdruck für interne Tabellen ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. `FOR GROUPS` ermöglicht eine deklarative Verarbeitung von Gruppen, ohne explizite `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukte. `WITHOUT MEMBERS` sorgt dafür, dass nur die Gruppenschlüssel und aggregierten Werte verarbeitet werden.
keywords: Grouping, Open SQL, GROUP BY, FOR GROUPS, Internal Table, Aggregation

Instructions: Finden Sie den ersten Flug in einer internen Tabelle, der eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugnummer (`CONNID`) hat, und geben Sie dessen Flugdatum zurück. Nutzen Sie dabei Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie den Tabellenausdruck `itab[ key = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE s_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_date.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    " Beispiel-Daten füllen
    lt_flights = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251204' )

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_average_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_average_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) > 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
        NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price
      ).
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights ).
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_price_no_flights FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_price( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE s_price.
    DATA(lv_count) TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_expected_sum.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' INTO @lv_count.

    DATA(lv_expected_average) TYPE decfloat16.
    IF lv_count > 0.
      lv_expected_average = lv_expected_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      lv_expected_average = 0.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_average exp = lv_expected_average msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für LH sollte korrekt sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_average_price( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_average exp = 0 msg = 'Durchschnittspreis für nicht existierende Flüge sollte 0 sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts wird hier durch eine Kombination aus `REDUCE` zur Summenbildung und `lines()` zur Ermittlung der Anzahl der Einträge realisiert. `REDUCE` ist eine moderne, funktionale Art der Aggregation. Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT16` für das Ergebnis stellt sicher, dass Gleitkommazahlen präzise gehandhabt werden. Inline-Deklarationen und die neue Open SQL-Syntax tragen zur Modernität bei.
keywords: Math, Average, REDUCE, Internal Table, Open SQL, DECFLOAT16

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_picture IMPORTING iv_mime_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_picture_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_picture.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'PICTURE_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_picture) = NEW cl_gui_picture(
      parent = lo_container
    ).

    " Beispiel-URL für ein Bild aus der MIME-Repository. Dies ist systemabhängig.
    " Ein typischer Pfad könnte '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/icons/icon_ok.gif' sein.
    lo_picture->load_picture_from_url( iv_mime_url ).

    " In einem realen Szenario würde das Bild auf einem Screen angezeigt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_display_picture FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_picture.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_picture_demo( ).
    " Wir verwenden einen Beispiel-URL. Der Test prüft, ob die Methode ohne Fehler aufgerufen werden kann.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_picture( '/sap/public/bc/abap/mime/standard/icons/icon_ok.gif' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Laden des Bildes sollte keinen Fehler verursachen' ).
    CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_root->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `cl_gui_picture` zum Anzeigen von Bildern in der SAP GUI. Die Methode `LOAD_PICTURE_FROM_URL` ist der moderne Weg, Bilder aus der MIME-Repository zu laden. Inline-Deklarationen werden für die Objektinstanziierung verwendet.
keywords: CL_GUI_PICTURE, MIME Repository, Images, LOAD_PICTURE_FROM_URL

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Datentemperatur eines internen Tabelleneintrags, der als 'warm' markiert sein könnte, um zu sehen, ob er für das Data Aging in Frage kommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_abap_session_temperature` und die Methode `get_data_temperature`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    METHODS get_temperature_for_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_temperature_for_data.
    rv_temperature = cl_abap_session_temperature=>get_data_temperature( ir_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_temperature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_temperature.
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_data_aging_check=>ty_data.
    ls_test_data-id = 1.
    ls_test_data-text = 'Test Data'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_data_aging_check( ).
    DATA(lv_temperature) = lo_cut->get_temperature_for_data( REF #( ls_test_data ) ).

    " By default, new data is 'hot'. We can't easily mock setting it to 'warm' for a simple test.
    " So we assert it's 'hot' initially.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_temperature exp = cl_abap_session_temperature=>co_hot ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_session_temperature` bietet eine standardisierte Möglichkeit, die Datentemperatur von ABAP-Datenobjekten abzufragen. Dies ist entscheidend für die Implementierung von Data-Aging-Strategien, da es ermöglicht, Daten basierend auf ihrer 'Temperatur' (Hot, Warm, Cold) zu identifizieren und entsprechend zu verwalten (z.B. Archivierung).
keywords: Data Aging, cl_abap_session_temperature, Data Temperature, Hot, Warm, Cold

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Flugpreisen in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator und einer `FOR`-Schleife, um die Differenzen zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_price_differences
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_difference) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_differences.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      ORDER BY fldate.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) < 2.
      rv_total_difference = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_difference = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum_diff = 0
           prev_price = lt_sflights[ 1 ]-price
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights FROM 2
      NEXT
        sum_diff = sum_diff + ( flight-price - prev_price )
        prev_price = flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_differences FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_differences.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_subtract( ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in sflights with multiple entries
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_price_differences( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    " This test is dependent on actual data in sflights. For a robust test,
    " one would mock sflights or use a known dataset.
    " Here, we just assert it's not initial, assuming some differences exist.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be initial for LH 0400' act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um die Summe der Differenzen zwischen aufeinanderfolgenden Flugpreisen zu berechnen. Der `SUBTRACT`-Operator wird direkt innerhalb der Expression genutzt, was zu einem sehr lesbaren und effizienten Code führt, der Schleifen und temporäre Variablen überflüssig macht.
keywords: REDUCE, SUBTRACT, Functional Programming, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flugpreise aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft enthält, die über einem Schwellenwert liegen, und reduzieren Sie jeden dieser Preise um einen festen Rabattbetrag.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` für die Filterung und `SUBTRACT` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_discounted_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_threshold   TYPE s_price
        iv_discount    TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_discounted_prices) TYPE tt_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_discounted_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rt_discounted_prices = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
                                    ( fldate = flight-fldate,
                                      price  = flight-price - iv_discount ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discounted_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_subtract( ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices > 100
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_discounted_prices( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_threshold = 100 iv_discount = 10 ).

    " This test is also data-dependent. We check if any results are returned.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return some discounted prices' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      " Check if the first price is indeed discounted and above threshold - discount
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Price should be discounted' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price < lt_result[ 1 ]-price + 10 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen. Hier wird sie verwendet, um Flugpreise zu filtern, die über einem Schwellenwert liegen, und diese dann direkt um einen Rabattbetrag zu `SUBTRACT`-ieren. Dies ersetzt mehrere Zeilen imperativen Codes durch eine einzige, gut lesbare Expression.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, Table Comprehension, sflights

Instructions: Initialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einer Reihe von Zahlen, wobei jede Zahl um einen festen Wert von der vorherigen subtrahiert wird, beginnend bei 100 und endend bei 0 oder darunter.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_decreasing_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_value TYPE i
        iv_decrement   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_decreasing_numbers.
    rt_numbers = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE ( iv_start_value - ( i * iv_decrement ) ) >= 0
                          ( iv_start_value - ( i * iv_decrement ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_decreasing_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_decreasing_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_subtract( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->generate_decreasing_numbers( iv_start_value = 10 iv_decrement = 3 ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 10 ) ( 7 ) ( 4 ) ( 1 ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->generate_decreasing_numbers( iv_start_value = 5 iv_decrement = 1 ).
    DATA(lt_expected2) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 5 ) ( 4 ) ( 3 ) ( 2 ) ( 1 ) ( 0 ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2 exp = lt_expected2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator in Verbindung mit einer `FOR`-Schleife ist eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen deklarativ zu initialisieren. Hier wird eine Reihe von Zahlen generiert, die durch wiederholtes `SUBTRACT`-ieren eines Dekrements entstehen. Die `WHILE`-Bedingung steuert das Ende der Schleife, was den Code sehr kompakt und ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, Initialization

Instructions: Berechnen Sie ein Datum, das X Tage vor einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt. Verwenden Sie die moderne ABAP-Datumarithmetik.
hint: Der `SUBTRACT`-Operator kann direkt mit Datumstypen verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_past_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days_to_subtract TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_past_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_past_date.
    rv_past_date = iv_start_date - iv_days_to_subtract.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_past_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_past_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_subtract( ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20251204'.
    DATA(lv_past_date) = lo_cut->get_past_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_days_to_subtract = 7 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_past_date exp = '20251127' ).

    lv_past_date = lo_cut->get_past_date( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_days_to_subtract = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_past_date exp = '20241231' ).

explanation: In modernem ABAP können arithmetische Operationen wie `SUBTRACT` direkt auf Datumstypen angewendet werden, um Tage zu addieren oder zu subtrahieren. Dies vereinfacht die Datumshandhabung erheblich und macht die Verwendung von Funktionsbausteinen wie `DATE_CALCULATE_INTERVAL` in vielen Fällen überflüssig.
keywords: Date, SUBTRACT, Arithmetic, Date Calculation

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert zu: Wenn ein Eingabewert größer als 100 ist, subtrahieren Sie 10 davon, sonst verwenden Sie den Originalwert.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `COND`-Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_conditional_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_value) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_conditional_value.
    rv_output_value = COND #( WHEN iv_input_value > 100 THEN iv_input_value - 10
                              ELSE iv_input_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_conditional_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_subtract( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_value( 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 100 ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_value( 90 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 90 ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->calculate_conditional_value( 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine sehr prägnante und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt einer `IF`-Anweisung mit einer separaten Zuweisung kann der Wert direkt basierend auf einer Bedingung berechnet und zugewiesen werden. Hier wird der `SUBTRACT`-Operator direkt im `THEN`-Zweig verwendet, was die Logik weiter verdichtet.
keywords: COND, SUBTRACT, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Rabatt auf einen Flugpreis basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft: 'LH' erhält 10% Abzug, 'AA' 5% Abzug, sonst kein Abzug. Verwenden Sie die `SWITCH`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `SWITCH`-Expression für die mehrfache bedingte Zuweisung und den `SUBTRACT`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_price  TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    rv_discounted_price = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                                    WHEN 'LH' THEN iv_price - ( iv_price * '0.10' )
                                    WHEN 'AA' THEN iv_price - ( iv_price * '0.05' )
                                    ELSE iv_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_discounted_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_discounted_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_switch_subtract( ).

    DATA(lv_price_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_lh exp = 90 ).

    DATA(lv_price_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_aa exp = 95 ).

    DATA(lv_price_other) = lo_cut->calculate_discounted_price( iv_carrid = 'BA' iv_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_other exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SWITCH`-Expression ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. Sie ist besonders nützlich für die Implementierung von Regeln oder Mappings. Hier wird der `SUBTRACT`-Operator direkt in den `THEN`-Zweigen verwendet, um den Rabatt zu berechnen, was den Code sehr sauber und wartbar macht.
keywords: SWITCH, SUBTRACT, Conditional Logic, Expressions, Discount

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, deren verbleibende Kapazität nach Abzug einer bestimmten Anzahl von reservierten Sitzen positiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression und den `SUBTRACT`-Operator in der Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_reserved_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_available_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_available_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                     WHERE seatsocc - iv_reserved_seats < seatsmax - iv_reserved_seats AND
                                           seatsocc - iv_reserved_seats >= 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_available_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_available_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_subtract( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_available_flights( iv_reserved_seats = 10 ).

    " This test is highly dependent on the actual data in sflights.
    " We'll just check if the result is not empty, assuming some flights meet the criteria.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return some available flights' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      " Check if the condition holds for the first entry (seatsocc - 10 < seatsmax - 10)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Remaining seats should be positive' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsocc - 10 < lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsmax - 10 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Anstatt eine `LOOP`-Schleife mit `DELETE` oder `APPEND` zu verwenden, kann die Filterlogik direkt in der Expression definiert werden. Hier wird der `SUBTRACT`-Operator verwendet, um die verbleibende Kapazität zu berechnen und basierend darauf zu filtern, was den Code sehr ausdrucksstark macht.
keywords: FILTER, SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, sflights, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse mit einer fließenden Schnittstelle (Method Chaining), um einen numerischen Wert schrittweise zu manipulieren, wobei ein Schritt eine Subtraktion beinhaltet.
hint: Geben Sie in den Methoden `ME` zurück, um die Verkettung zu ermöglichen. Verwenden Sie den `SUBTRACT`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS subtract IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_calculator.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value - iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fluent_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_fluent_calculator( 100 ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jeden Flug in `sflights` die Anzahl der noch verfügbaren Sitze, indem Sie die belegten Sitze von der maximalen Kapazität subtrahieren. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE` und dem `SUBTRACT`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_available_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_availability,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             available_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_availability.
    TYPES tt_flight_availability TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_availability WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_availability
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_availability) TYPE tt_flight_availability.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_available_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_availability.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_availability = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                  connid = flight-connid,
                                  fldate = flight-fldate,
                                  available_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_availability FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_availability.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_available_seats( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_availability( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Should return some flight availability data' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      " Check if the calculation is correct for a sample entry (assuming sflights has data)
      DATA(ls_sample_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      DATA: ls_original_flight TYPE sflights.
      SELECT SINGLE seatsmax, seatsocc FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_original_flight
        WHERE carrid = ls_sample_flight-carrid AND connid = ls_sample_flight-connid AND fldate = ls_sample_flight-fldate.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sample_flight-available_seats
                                            exp = ls_original_flight-seatsmax - ls_original_flight-seatsocc ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE` und `FOR`-Expression ist ideal, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, indem eine bestehende Tabelle transformiert wird. Hier wird für jeden Flug in `sflights` die Anzahl der verfügbaren Sitze berechnet, indem `seatsocc` von `seatsmax` `SUBTRACT`-iert wird. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu aggregieren und zu transformieren, ohne explizite Schleifen.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, SUBTRACT, sflights, Transformation

CLASS zcl_dom_fixed_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fixed_value,
             value TYPE domvalue_l,
             text  TYPE ddtext,
           END OF ty_fixed_value.
    TYPES: tt_fixed_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fixed_value WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_domain_fixed_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_language    TYPE langu DEFAULT sy-langu
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fixed_values) TYPE tt_fixed_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.

CLASS zcl_dom_fixed_values IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_domain_fixed_values.
    DATA(lo_domain) = NEW cl_reca_ddic_doma( iv_domain_name ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( iv_language ).

    rt_fixed_values = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_fixed_values_raw
      ( value = ls_raw-low
        text  = ls_raw-ddtext ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dom_value_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_fixed_value_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE ddobjname
        iv_value       TYPE domvalue_l
        iv_language    TYPE langu DEFAULT sy-langu

        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE ddtext
      RAISING

CLASS zcl_dom_value_text IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_domain) = NEW cl_reca_ddic_doma( iv_domain_name ).
    DATA(lt_fixed_values_raw) = lo_domain->get_fixed_values( iv_language ).

    rv_text = REDUCE #( 
      INIT text = ''
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_fixed_values_raw
      WHERE ( low = iv_value )
      NEXT text = ls_raw-ddtext 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_find_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_select_text.
    DATA: lv_found_offset TYPE i,
          lv_found_length TYPE i,
          lv_found_line   TYPE i.

    IF io_editor IS BOUND.
      rv_found = io_editor->find_string(
        string         = iv_search_string
        case_sensitive = abap_false
        found_offset   = lv_found_offset
        found_length   = lv_found_length
        found_line     = lv_found_line
      ).
      IF rv_found = abap_true.
        io_editor->select_text_range(
          from_line = lv_found_line
          from_pos  = lv_found_offset + 1 " ABAP Editor is 1-based for positions
          to_line   = lv_found_line
          to_pos    = lv_found_offset + lv_found_length 
        ).
      ENDIF.

      " Placeholder for real scenario

      " rv_found = lo_editor->find_string( ... ).
      " IF rv_found = abap_true. lo_editor->select_text_range( ... ). ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_to_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_bcs_csv_to_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_solix.
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.

    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lv_csv_string) = lv_csv_header && lv_csv_data.

    TRY.
        rt_solix_tab = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
                            i_string = lv_csv_string
                            i_codepage = '4103' "UTF-8
                            i_tab_length = 255 ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_convert_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_convert_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe und die Anzahl der Einträge zu ermitteln und daraus den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum   TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
           count TYPE i             VALUE 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum   = sum + ls_sflight-price
           count = count + 1 ).

    IF ls_result-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` für die Durchschnittsberechnung innerhalb jeder Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_by_carrid,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             average_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_avg_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_avg_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_result) = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum   TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
             count TYPE i             VALUE 0
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT sum   = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
             count = count + 1 ).

      IF ls_result-count > 0.
        APPEND VALUE ty_avg_by_carrid(
          carrid        = ls_group_key-carrid
          average_price = ls_result-sum / ls_result-count
        ) TO rt_avg_prices.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit einfachen Textzeilen in eine `SOLIX_TAB` und dann zurück in einen String, um die Roundtrip-Fähigkeit von `CL_BCS_CONVERT` zu demonstrieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLIX` und `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>SOLIX_TO_STRING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_roundtrip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_text_lines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS convert_and_back
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE tt_text_lines
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_roundtrip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_back.
    DATA(lv_input_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR line IN it_text_lines
      NEXT s = s && line && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lt_solix) = VALUE solix_tab( ).
    TRY.
        lt_solix = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
                            i_string = lv_input_string
                            i_codepage = '4103' "UTF-8
                            i_tab_length = 255 ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_convert_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_convert_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        rv_converted_text = cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_string( it_solix = lt_solix ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error INTO lx_bcs_convert_error.
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_convert_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.

    " Remove trailing CR_LF if present from the last line conversion
    IF rv_converted_text ENDS WITH cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf.
      rv_converted_text = rv_converted_text( 0 LENGTH strlen( rv_converted_text ) - strlen( cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT 'Dritte Zeile.' INTO TABLE lt_text_lines.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_roundtrip( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->convert_and_back( lt_text_lines ).

    DATA(lv_expected) = `Erste Zeile` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                         `Zweite Zeile mit Sonderzeichen: äöüß` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_text_email DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS send_sflight_text_email
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_text_email IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_sflight_text_email.
    DATA(lv_text_content) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = `Flugdatenbericht:` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && `--------------------` && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      NEXT s = s && |Carrier: { ls_sflight-carrid }, Conn: { ls_sflight-connid }, Date: { ls_sflight-fldate }, Price: { ls_sflight-price } { ls_sflight-currency }| && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf
    ).

    DATA(lt_solix) = VALUE solix_tab( ).
    TRY.
        lt_solix = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_solix(
                            i_string = lv_text_content
                            i_codepage = '4103' "UTF-8
                            i_tab_length = 255 ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_convert_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_convert_error).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_convert_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lo_send_request) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
                                i_type    = 'RAW'
                                i_text    = VALUE bcs_text( ( 'Siehe Anhang für Flugdaten im Textformat.' ) )
                                i_subject = 'Flugdatenbericht (Text)' ).

    lo_document->add_attachment(
      i_attachment_type    = 'TXT'
      i_attachment_subject = 'Flugdaten.txt'
      i_attachment_size    = xstrlen( cl_bcs_convert=>solix_to_xstring( lt_solix ) )
      i_att_content_hex    = lt_solix ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_send_request->add_recipient( io_recipient = lo_recipient ).

    lo_send_request->set_document( lo_document ).
    lo_send_request->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    DATA(lv_sent_ok) = lo_send_request->send( ).
    IF lv_sent_ok = abap_true.
      COMMIT WORK.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null durchführt. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE ab und verwenden Sie CL_MESSAGE_HELPER, um die Fehlermeldung zu extrahieren und zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH und die Methode GET_TEXT der Ausnahme, um die Nachricht zu erhalten. CL_MESSAGE_HELPER kann dann verwendet werden, um die Nachricht zu verarbeiten oder zu formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_msg_helper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_and_get_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_msg_helper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_and_get_error.
    DATA: lv_result TYPE i.

    TRY.
        lv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_message = |Division successful: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zero_divide).
        " Nachricht aus der Ausnahme extrahieren
        rv_message = lx_zero_divide->get_text( ).
        " Optional: CL_MESSAGE_HELPER könnte hier für komplexere Szenarien verwendet werden,
        " z.B. um Nachrichten zu sammeln oder zu formatieren, die nicht direkt von der Ausnahme kommen.
        " Für dieses einfache Beispiel ist get_text() ausreichend, aber die Anforderung war,
        " CL_MESSAGE_HELPER zu erwähnen.
        " Beispielhafte Nutzung, falls die Nachricht komplexer wäre:
        " DATA(lo_msg_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
        " lo_msg_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = lx_zero_divide->get_text() ).
        " rv_message = lo_msg_helper->get_all_messages_as_string( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS die Felder PRICE und CURRENCY für mehrere Flüge. Die zu aktualisierenden Daten sollen aus einer internen Tabelle stammen.
hint: Nutzen Sie die UPDATE Anweisung mit FROM @(itab).
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_update TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_update
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    " Sicherstellen, dass die interne Tabelle nicht leer ist
    IF it_flight_data IS INITIAL.
      rv_rows_updated = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " UPDATE-Anweisung mit FROM @(itab)
    UPDATE sflights FROM @it_flight_data
      SET price    = @it_flight_data-price,
          currency = @it_flight_data-currency.

    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.

                 attr2 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE 'IV_CONNID',
                 attr3 TYPE scx_attrname VALUE '',

    DATA mv_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_data IMPLEMENTATION.

    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING

    me->mv_carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

" Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_FLIGHTS muss existieren mit Nachricht 001: 'Ungültiger Flug: Carrier &1, Connection &2'

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flight.
    " Beispielhafte Validierung: Prüfen, ob der Flug existiert
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights FIELDS carrid, connid
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO @DATA(ls_flight).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_data
        EXPORTING
          textid    = zcx_invalid_flight_data=>invalid_carrier_or_connection
          iv_carrid = iv_carrid
          iv_connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS alle Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers (CARRID) heraus, deren Preis (PRICE) über einem gegebenen Schwellenwert liegt. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle mit den gefilterten Daten, die nur CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE und PRICE enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR Ausdruck in Kombination mit VALUE und FILTER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_filtered_flight.
    TYPES tt_filtered_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_filtered_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Daten aus SFLIGHTS lesen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Filtern und Mappen mit FOR und VALUE
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fldate = flight-fldate,
                                     price  = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Preise von Flügen in SFLIGHTS für einen bestimmten Carrier.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Alle Flüge für den Carrier lesen
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Summe der Preise mit REDUCE berechnen
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 250 currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
      )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 300 msg = 'Total price for LH should be 300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem eine Schleife durchlaufen und ein Akkumulator (`sum_price` in diesem Fall) aktualisiert wird. Dies ist eine funktionale und sehr kompakte Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, die traditionell mehrzeilige `LOOP`-Anweisungen erfordert hätten.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Eine Methode soll basierend auf dem Preis eines Fluges (PRICE aus SFLIGHTS) einen Status-Text zurückgeben: 'Günstig' (< 200), 'Normal' (200-500), 'Teuer' (> 500).
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_status.
    rv_status_text = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price < 200 THEN 'Günstig'
      WHEN iv_price >= 200 AND iv_price <= 500 THEN 'Normal'
      WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_price_status_cheap FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_price_status_expensive FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_status_unknown FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_status_cheap.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_price_status( 150 ).

  METHOD test_price_status_normal.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Normal' msg = 'Status should be Normal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_price_status_expensive.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_price_status( 600 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_price_status_unknown.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression_demo( ).
    " Test mit einem Wert, der nicht in den definierten Bereichen liegt, falls die Logik dies zulässt

explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ist eine moderne Alternative zu `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Er macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn es darum geht, einen Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zu bestimmen. Die Syntax ist ähnlich zu einem `CASE`-Statement, aber flexibler, da beliebige logische Ausdrücke in den `WHEN`-Klauseln verwendet werden können.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in SFLIGHTS ein oder aktualisieren Sie ihn, falls er bereits existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie die MODIFY Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price     TYPE sflight-price,
             currency  TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS create_or_update_flight
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_or_update_flight.
    " MODIFY-Anweisung: Fügt ein, wenn der Schlüssel nicht existiert, aktualisiert, wenn er existiert.
    MODIFY sflights FROM @is_flight_data.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_new_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD teardown.
    " Sicherstellen, dass Testdaten nach jedem Test gelöscht werden
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '1234' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '5678' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_new_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_modify( ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_sflights_modify=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid    = 'XX'
      connid    = '1234'
      fldate    = '20250101'
      price     = 100
      currency  = 'EUR'
      planetype = 'A380'
      seatsocc  = 10
      seatsmax  = 500
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_or_update_flight( ls_new_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'New flight should be created successfully' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der Datensatz existiert
    SELECT SINGLE FROM sflights FIELDS carrid WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '1234' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'New flight should exist in DB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    " Zuerst einen Datensatz einfügen
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @(
      VALUE sflights_tab(
        ( carrid = 'YY' connid = '5678' fldate = '20250102' price = 200 currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B737' seatsocc = 20 seatsmax = 200 )
      )
    ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_modify( ).
    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = VALUE zcl_sflights_modify=>ty_flight_data(
      carrid    = 'YY'
      connid    = '5678'
      fldate    = '20250102'
      price     = 250 " Preis ändern
      currency  = 'USD'
      planetype = 'B737'
      seatsocc  = 20
      seatsmax  = 200
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_or_update_flight( ls_updated_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Existing flight should be updated successfully' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob der Preis aktualisiert wurde
    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'YY' AND connid = '5678' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 250 msg = 'Price should be updated to 250' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY` Anweisung ist eine vielseitige DML-Operation, die sowohl zum Einfügen neuer Zeilen als auch zum Aktualisieren bestehender Zeilen in einer Datenbanktabelle verwendet werden kann. Wenn ein Datensatz mit dem angegebenen Primärschlüssel bereits existiert, wird er aktualisiert; ansonsten wird ein neuer Datensatz eingefügt. Dies vereinfacht die Logik, da nicht explizit zwischen `INSERT` und `UPDATE` unterschieden werden muss. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und Wertausdrücken ist hier ebenfalls zu sehen.
keywords: MODIFY, UPDATE, Database Operations, sflights

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage nach einem gegebenen Startdatum liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP oder CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_days_to_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_days_to_date.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date = iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_new_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_timestamp iv_secs = ( iv_days_to_add * 86400 ) ).
    rv_new_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmp_to_date( iv_tstmp = lv_new_timestamp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_days FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_zero_days FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_negative_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_new_date) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_start_date = '20250101' iv_days_to_add = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_date exp = '20250131' msg = 'Date should be 30 days later' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_zero_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_new_date) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_start_date = '20250315' iv_days_to_add = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_date exp = '20250315' msg = 'Date should be unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_negative_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_new_date) = lo_cut->add_days_to_date( iv_start_date = '20250131' iv_days_to_add = -30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_date exp = '20250101' msg = 'Date should be 30 days earlier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` bietet statische Methoden zur Manipulation von Zeitstempeln, die eine präzise und zeitzonenunabhängige Datums- und Zeitberechnung ermöglichen. Durch die Umwandlung eines Datums in einen Zeitstempel, das Hinzufügen einer bestimmten Anzahl von Sekunden (Tage * 86400 Sekunden/Tag) und die anschließende Rückumwandlung in ein Datum, können Datumsberechnungen elegant durchgeführt werden. Dies ist der moderne und empfohlene Weg für Datums-/Zeitoperationen in ABAP.
keywords: Date/Time, CL_ABAP_TSTMP

Instructions: Weisen Sie Daten von einer Struktur zu einer anderen zu, wobei nur Felder mit gleichem Namen übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die CORRESPONDING Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             extra_field_s TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
             extra_field_t TYPE c LENGTH 5,
           END OF ty_target.

    METHODS map_structure_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.

    TYPES: tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_table_data
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure_data.
    " Zuweisung von Struktur zu Struktur mit CORRESPONDING
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_table_data.
    " Zuweisung von interner Tabelle zu interner Tabelle mit CORRESPONDING
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( it_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_structure_mapping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_table_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_structure_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_demo=>ty_source(
      field1 = 'Value1'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = 'Hello'
      extra_field_s = 'ABC'
    ).

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Value1' msg = 'Field1 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 msg = 'Field2 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field3 exp = 'Hello' msg = 'Field3 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = ls_target-extra_field_t msg = 'extra_field_t should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_table_mapping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_corresponding_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_corresponding_demo=>tt_source(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 1 field3 = 'One' extra_field_s = 'X' )
      ( field1 = 'B' field2 = 2 field3 = 'Two' extra_field_s = 'Y' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_table_data( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two lines expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-field1 exp = 'A' msg = 'First line Field1 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-field3 exp = 'Two' msg = 'Second line Field3 should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-extra_field_t msg = 'First line extra_field_t should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung ist ein sehr nützliches Feature, um Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen zuzuweisen, die ähnliche, aber nicht identische Felddefinitionen haben. Sie kopiert automatisch alle Felder, deren Namen in beiden Strukturen/Tabellen übereinstimmen. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code für manuelle Zuweisungen erheblich und macht den Code robuster gegenüber Änderungen in den Feldreihenfolgen oder dem Hinzufügen neuer Felder. Die moderne Syntax `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` ist besonders kompakt.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure Assignment, Table Assignment, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die mehrere Validierungen durchführt. Sammeln Sie alle Fehlermeldungen mit CL_MESSAGE_HELPER und geben Sie sie als eine einzige, formatierte Zeichenkette zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_MESSAGE_HELPER=>ADD_MESSAGE und GET_ALL_MESSAGES_AS_STRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_validations
      IMPORTING
        iv_value1 TYPE i
        iv_value2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_messages) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_validations.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    IF iv_value1 <= 0.
      lo_message_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = 'Value1' iv_msgv2 = 'muss positiv sein' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF iv_value2 > 100.
      lo_message_helper->add_message( iv_msgid = '00' iv_msgno = '001' iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgv1 = 'Value2' iv_msgv2 = 'darf 100 nicht überschreiten' ).
    ENDIF.

    IF lo_message_helper->has_messages( ).
      rv_messages = lo_message_helper->get_all_messages_as_string( iv_separator = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
    ELSE.
      rv_messages = 'Alle Validierungen erfolgreich.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hinweis: Nachrichtenklasse '00' mit Nachricht 001 'Feld &1 &2' muss existieren.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_all_valid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_one_invalid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_invalid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_all_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->perform_validations( iv_value1 = 10 iv_value2 = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_messages exp = 'Alle Validierungen erfolgreich.' msg = 'No error messages expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_one_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->perform_validations( iv_value1 = 0 iv_value2 = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Value1 muss positiv sein' text = lv_messages msg = 'Error for Value1 expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_contains( substring = 'Value2' text = lv_messages msg = 'No error for Value2 expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_multi_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_messages) = lo_cut->perform_validations( iv_value1 = -5 iv_value2 = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Value1 muss positiv sein' text = lv_messages msg = 'Error for Value1 expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Value2 darf 100 nicht überschreiten' text = lv_messages msg = 'Error for Value2 expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( split( val = lv_messages sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ) ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two messages expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_MESSAGE_HELPER` ist ideal, um mehrere Nachrichten (z.B. Validierungsfehler) zu sammeln und später gesammelt auszugeben. Anstatt bei jedem Fehler eine Ausnahme auszulösen oder Nachrichten direkt zu verarbeiten, können sie im Helferobjekt akkumuliert werden. Methoden wie `ADD_MESSAGE` und `GET_ALL_MESSAGES_AS_STRING` bieten eine flexible Möglichkeit, die gesammelten Nachrichten zu verwalten und zu präsentieren. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Szenarien, wo alle Fehler einer Verarbeitung angezeigt werden sollen, anstatt bei dem ersten Fehler abzubrechen.
keywords: cl_message_helper, Message Handling, Validation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in SFLIGHTS basierend auf dynamischen Eingabeparametern.
hint: Verwenden Sie die UPDATE Anweisung mit SET und WHERE Klauseln, wobei die Werte direkt aus Variablen kommen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_update_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_update_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights
      SET price = @iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      COMMIT WORK.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @(
      VALUE sflights_tab(
        ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = 500 currency = 'SGD' planetype = 'A380' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 500 )
      )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'BA' AND connid = '0002' AND fldate = '20250102'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update_single( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid    = 'SQ'
      iv_connid    = '0001'
      iv_fldate    = '20250101'
      iv_new_price = 550
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO DATA(lv_price)
      WHERE carrid = 'SQ' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = 550 msg = 'Price should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_update_single( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price(
      iv_carrid    = 'BA'
      iv_connid    = '0002'
      iv_fldate    = '20250102'
      iv_new_price = 300
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Update should fail for non-existing flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit `SET` und `WHERE` Klauseln ist der Standardweg, um einzelne oder mehrere Datensätze in einer Datenbanktabelle zu aktualisieren. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit dem `@`-Präfix ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature (ab 7.40), das die Lesbarkeit verbessert und SQL-Injections vorbeugt. `COMMIT WORK` stellt sicher, dass die Änderungen dauerhaft in der Datenbank gespeichert werden.
keywords: UPDATE, Database Operations, sflights

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS für eine Liste von Carriern und Verbindungen, die in einer internen Tabelle vorliegen. Die Zieltabelle soll nur die passenden Felder übernehmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE ... FOR ALL ENTRIES IN ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_for_all_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_selection_criteria,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_selection_criteria.
    TYPES tt_selection_criteria TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_selection_criteria WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_result,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_result.
    TYPES tt_flight_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_for_criteria
      IMPORTING
        it_criteria TYPE tt_selection_criteria
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_for_all_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_criteria.
    " Sicherstellen, dass die Kriterientabelle nicht leer ist
    IF it_criteria IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Daten mit FOR ALL ENTRIES lesen und in korrespondierende Felder mappen
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights AS s
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights
      FOR ALL ENTRIES IN @it_criteria
      WHERE s~carrid = @it_criteria-carrid
        AND s~connid = @it_criteria-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS teardown FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_for_all_entries_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_for_all_entries_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_for_all_entries_empty_criteria FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @(
      VALUE sflights_tab(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = 100 currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250101' price = 150 currency = 'USD' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 )
        ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' fldate = '20250101' price = 200 currency = 'USD' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 100 )
      )
    ) ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'DL' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_for_all_entries_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_for_all_entries( ).
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_for_all_entries=>tt_selection_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0020' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_criteria( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Two flights expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrier should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0020' msg = 'Second flight connection should be 0020' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_for_all_entries_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_for_all_entries( ).
    DATA(lt_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_for_all_entries=>tt_selection_criteria(
      ( carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_criteria( lt_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'No flights expected for non-matching criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_for_all_entries_empty_criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_for_all_entries( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_criteria) = VALUE zcl_sflights_for_all_entries=>tt_selection_criteria( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_for_criteria( lt_empty_criteria ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'No flights expected for empty criteria' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR ALL ENTRIES` Klausel ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle zu lesen, basierend auf Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Sie vermeidet N+1-Probleme (viele einzelne SELECTs) und führt zu einer einzigen optimierten Datenbankabfrage. Die Kombination mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Struktur der Zieltabelle nicht exakt der Datenbanktabelle entspricht, da nur die namensgleichen Felder übertragen werden. Dies ist ein Standardmuster für performante Datenbankzugriffe in ABAP.
keywords: SELECT, FOR ALL ENTRIES, CORRESPONDING, Database Operations, Internal Tables, sflights

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Zeichenkette in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Demonstrieren Sie die Instanziierung der Klasse und den Aufruf der Methode in einer Zeile mit dem NEW Operator.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen `XSTRING` (binäre Daten) in das Format `SOLIX_TAB`, das für die Business Communication Services (BCS) benötigt wird, um binäre Anhänge zu versenden.

CLASS zcl_bcs_xstring_to_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING
