CLASS zcl_bcs_xstring_to_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_xstring_to_solix.
    TRY.
        rt_solix_tab = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( iv_xstring = iv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Hier könnte eine eigene Ausnahme ausgelöst oder geloggt werden.
        MESSAGE lx_bcs_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.

  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_bcs_xstring_to_solix( ).
    DATA(lt_solix) = lo_converter->convert_xstring_to_solix( lv_original_xstring ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_solix_utf8 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bcs_string_to_solix_utf8 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_to_solix_utf8.
    DATA(lv_codepage) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_codepage_from_charset( 'UTF-8' ).

      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_codepage_error).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHT`) in einen CSV-String und diesen dann in eine `SOLIX_TAB` für den Versand als Anhang.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CONV_OUT_CE` für die CSV-Erstellung und `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>STRING_TO_SOLIX` für die Binärkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_sflight_to_csv_solix
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_solix_tab) TYPE solix_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_itab_to_csv_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_sflight_to_csv_solix.
    DATA(lv_csv_string) = VALUE string( ).
    DATA(lo_conv) = cl_abap_conv_out_ce=>create( encoding = 'UTF-8' ).

    " CSV Header
    lv_csv_string = |CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE{cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf}|.

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine binäre Datei vom Applikationsserver in einen `XSTRING` und konvertieren Sie diesen dann in eine `SOLIX_TAB`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN DATASET ... IN BINARY MODE FOR INPUT` und `READ DATASET` für die Dateioperationen, gefolgt von `CL_BCS_CONVERT=>XSTRING_TO_SOLIX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_file_to_solix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_binary_file_to_solix
      IMPORTING
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_solix_tab) TYPE solix_tab
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_file_to_solix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_binary_file_to_solix.
    DATA: lv_xstring_content TYPE xstring,
          lv_file_size     TYPE i.

    OPEN DATASET iv_filepath FOR INPUT IN BINARY MODE MESSAGE DATA(lv_msg).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Fehler beim Öffnen der Datei: { lv_msg }|.
    ENDIF.

    READ DATASET iv_filepath INTO lv_xstring_content MAXIMUM LENGTH lv_file_size.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'Fehler beim Lesen der Datei'.
    ENDIF.

    CLOSE DATASET iv_filepath.

    TRY.
        rt_solix_tab = cl_bcs_convert=>xstring_to_solix( iv_xstring = lv_xstring_content ).
      CATCH cx_bcs_error INTO DATA(lx_bcs_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_bcs_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    DATA(lv_test_xstring) = '0102030405060708090A' TYPE xstring.

    OPEN DATASET mv_test_filepath FOR OUTPUT IN BINARY MODE.
    TRANSFER lv_test_xstring TO mv_test_filepath.
    CLOSE DATASET mv_test_filepath.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    DELETE DATASET mv_test_filepath.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_read_binary_file_to_solix.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_bcs_file_to_solix( ).
    DATA(lt_solix) = VALUE solix_tab( ).

    TRY.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den vollständigen Prozess des Lesens einer binären Datei vom Applikationsserver und deren Konvertierung in ein BCS-kompatibles Format. Die Verwendung von `OPEN DATASET`, `READ DATASET` und `CLOSE DATASET` ist Standard für die Dateiverarbeitung. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit Ausnahmen (`RAISE EXCEPTION`) ist hier besonders wichtig, da Dateizugriffe fehlschlagen können. Die Integration mit `CL_BCS_CONVERT` ermöglicht den nahtlosen Übergang zu E-Mail-Anhängen.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_and_list_items
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE string_table.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_and_list_items.
    DATA(lo_json_node) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_array_node) = lo_json_node->get_object_node( )->get_array_node( 'items' ).

    LOOP AT lo_array_node->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      APPEND lo_element->get_string_value( ) TO rt_items.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen ungültigen JSON-String und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_clb_json_parse_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
        rv_message = 'JSON parsed successfully'.
      CATCH cx_clb_json_parse_error INTO DATA(lx_parse_error).
        rv_message = lx_parse_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_clb_error INTO DATA(lx_clb_error).
        rv_message = lx_clb_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_error_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_valid_json) = '{"key": "value"}'.
    DATA(lv_invalid_json) = '{"key": "value"'. "Missing closing brace

    DATA(lv_result_valid) = lo_cut->parse_with_error_handling( lv_valid_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_valid exp = 'JSON parsed successfully' msg = 'Valid JSON should parse' ).

    DATA(lv_result_invalid) = lo_cut->parse_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( COND = ( lv_result_invalid CS 'JSON parse error' OR lv_result_invalid CS 'Syntax error' ) msg = 'Invalid JSON should return error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel ist entscheidend für die robuste Verarbeitung von externen JSON-Daten. Es zeigt, wie man mit `TRY...CATCH` die spezifische Ausnahme `cx_clb_json_parse_error` abfängt, die bei ungültigen JSON-Strings ausgelöst wird. Dies ermöglicht es der Anwendung, elegant auf fehlerhafte Eingaben zu reagieren, anstatt abzustürzen.
keywords: JSON, Error Handling, Exception, cl_clb_parse_json, cx_clb_json_parse_error

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String und mappen Sie ihn direkt auf eine ABAP-Struktur oder interne Tabelle, falls möglich.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` mit `cl_clb_parse_json` oder `cl_abap_codepage` für die Konvertierung und dann `CALL TRANSFORMATION`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_to_abap_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
             cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_to_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_to_abap_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_to_flights.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_json_string ).
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE XML lv_xstring RESULT flights = rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_to_struct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_to_struct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_to_abap_struct( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"flights": [{"carrid": "AA", "connid": "0017", "cityfrom": "NEW YORK", "cityto": "SAN FRANCISCO"}, {"carrid": "LH", "connid": "0400", "cityfrom": "FRANKFURT", "cityto": "NEW YORK"}]}'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_to_flights( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First flight carrier should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-cityto exp = 'NEW YORK' msg = 'Second flight destination should be NEW YORK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine fortgeschrittene Methode, um JSON-Daten direkt in ABAP-Strukturen oder interne Tabellen zu deserialisieren. Anstatt jeden Wert manuell zu extrahieren, wird der JSON-String zuerst in ein XSTRING konvertiert und dann mittels `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` (Identity Transformation) in die Ziel-ABAP-Datenstruktur gemappt. Dies erfordert, dass der JSON-String dem XML-Format entspricht, das von der Transformation erwartet wird, und ist sehr effizient für große Datenmengen. Beachten Sie, dass `cl_clb_parse_json` hier nicht direkt verwendet wird, da `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` eine mächtigere, aber auch spezifischere Methode ist, die oft für JSON-zu-ABAP-Mapping verwendet wird, wenn das JSON-Format gut definiert ist. Für generisches Parsen ist `cl_clb_parse_json` besser geeignet.
keywords: JSON, Deserialization, Transformation, CALL TRANSFORMATION ID, ABAP Structure, Internal Table

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Objekten enthält, und extrahieren Sie spezifische Felder in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_array_node`, `get_elements` und dann `get_object_node` für jedes Element.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_array_of_obj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_person.
    TYPES: tt_persons TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_person WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_persons
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_persons) TYPE tt_persons.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_array_of_obj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_persons.
    DATA(lo_json_node) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_array_node) = lo_json_node->get_object_node( )->get_array_node( 'persons' ).

    LOOP AT lo_array_node->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      DATA(ls_person) = VALUE ty_person(
        id   = lo_element->get_object_node( )->get_string_value( 'id' )
        name = lo_element->get_object_node( )->get_string_value( 'name' )
      ).
      APPEND ls_person TO rt_persons.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es kombiniert den Zugriff auf das Array (`get_array_node`, `get_elements`) mit dem Zugriff auf die einzelnen Objekte (`get_object_node`) innerhalb der Schleife. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` für die Initialisierung der Struktur `ls_person` ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String und verwenden Sie `REDUCE` oder `FOR` um eine interne Tabelle zu füllen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` mit `FOR` oder `REDUCE` für eine funktionale Programmierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_functional_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_products_functional
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_functional_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_products_functional.
    DATA(lo_json_node) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_array_node) = lo_json_node->get_object_node( )->get_array_node( 'products' ).

    rt_products = VALUE tt_products(
      FOR lo_element IN lo_array_node->get_elements( )
      ( id    = lo_element->get_object_node( )->get_string_value( 'id' )
        price = lo_element->get_object_node( )->get_number_value( 'price' ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_functional_parse( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = '{"products": [{"id": "P101", "price": 19.99}, {"id": "P102", "price": 29.50}]}'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_products_functional( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 products' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-id exp = 'P101' msg = 'First product ID should be P101' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `FOR`-Operators in einem `VALUE`-Konstruktor, um eine interne Tabelle direkt aus den geparsten JSON-Elementen zu füllen. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Programmierparadigma in ABAP 7.55+, das Schleifen und manuelle `APPEND`-Anweisungen überflüssig macht und den Code erheblich verkürzt und lesbarer macht. Es ist besonders nützlich, wenn Daten von einem Format in ein anderes transformiert werden müssen.
keywords: JSON, Functional Programming, FOR, VALUE, Internal Table, cl_clb_parse_json

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String und überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Schlüssel existiert, bevor Sie versuchen, seinen Wert zu extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `has_member` oder fangen Sie Ausnahmen ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_check_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
        iv_key         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_check_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_if_exists.
    DATA(lo_json_node) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_object_node) = lo_json_node->get_object_node( ).

    IF lo_object_node->has_member( iv_key ).
      rv_value = lo_object_node->get_string_value( iv_key ).
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Key not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie Konstanten, um die verschiedenen Fälle in einer `CASE`-Anweisung zu definieren, um die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit zu verbessern.
hint: Deklarieren Sie Konstanten für die `WHEN`-Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_constants_case_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CONSTANTS:
      gc_status_new      TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'N',
      gc_status_in_proc  TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'P',
      gc_status_complete TYPE c LENGTH 1 VALUE 'C'.

    METHODS:
      get_status_text IMPORTING iv_status TYPE c LENGTH 1 RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_constants_case_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_text.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN gc_status_new.
        rv_status_text = 'Neu'.
      WHEN gc_status_in_proc.
        rv_status_text = 'In Bearbeitung'.
      WHEN gc_status_complete.
        rv_status_text = 'Abgeschlossen'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_text = 'Unbekannt'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_constants_case_logic( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_constants_case_logic=>gc_status_new ) exp = 'Neu' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_constants_case_logic=>gc_status_in_proc ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( zcl_constants_case_logic=>gc_status_complete ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status_text( 'X' ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt, wie Konstanten zur Definition von Statuscodes oder anderen festen Werten in `CASE`-Anweisungen verwendet werden können. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit, vermeidet "Magic Strings" und erleichtert zukünftige Anpassungen.
keywords: CONSTANTS, CASE, Conditional Logic, Readability

CLASS zcl_tstmp_date_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tstmp_date_add IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>move_date_to_tstmp( iv_date ).

      tstmp = lv_timestamp

solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_with_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_gzip) = NEW cl_abap_gzip( ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_string) = '' .
    TRY.
        lo_gzip->decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            compressed_text = iv_invalid_xstring
          IMPORTING
            text             = lv_decompressed_string
        ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_compression_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) = 'FF00FF00'X. " Clearly not valid GZIP data

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->decompress_with_error_handling( lv_invalid_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Robustes Error Handling ist entscheidend. Die `TRY...CATCH` Anweisung ist der moderne Weg, Ausnahmen in ABAP zu behandeln. `CX_SY_COMPRESSION_ERROR` ist die spezifische Ausnahme für Kompressions-/Dekompressionsfehler.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Datenreferenz.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>DESCRIBE_BY_DATA_REF` und `CREATE DATA` mit dem Tabellentyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data       TYPE REF TO data " Reference to a structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data. " Reference to an internal table
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             col1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA(ls_template) TYPE ty_test_struct.
    DATA(lr_template) TYPE REF TO ty_test_struct.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_template INTO lr_template.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( lr_template ).

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_dynamic_table ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_descr->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_table msg = 'Expected a table type' ).

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( lo_descr ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_line_descr->type_kind exp = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct msg = 'Expected a structure line type' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> msg = 'Dynamic table should be assigned' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO <ls_line>.
    APPEND <ls_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 line in dynamic table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR` mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` ermöglicht die vollständige dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Frameworks oder zur Verarbeitung unbekannter Datenstrukturen.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR, Dynamic Programming, CREATE DATA

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Struktur einer Validierungsmethode in einem RAP Behavior Handler, die prüft, ob ein Feld (z.B. 'Description') nicht leer ist. Dies ist ein konzeptionelles Beispiel, da ein vollständiger RAP-Kontext erforderlich wäre.

CLASS zcl_rap_bh_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_description.
    " Konzeptionelles Beispiel: In einem echten RAP-Szenario würden hier die Entitätsdaten
    " über die IMPORTING-Parameter 'keys' und 'entities' gelesen und validiert.
    " Wenn eine Validierung fehlschlägt, würde eine Fehlermeldung über 'reported' gesetzt.
    " Beispiel: Wenn zmy_rap_entity-description leer ist, füge eine Fehlermeldung hinzu.
    " DATA(ls_entity) = entities[ 1 ]. " Zugriff auf die zu validierende Entität
    " IF ls_entity-description IS INITIAL.
    "   APPEND VALUE #( %msg = new_message( id = 'ZMSG_RAP_DEMO' severity = if_abap_behv=>t_message_severity-error text = 'Beschreibung darf nicht leer sein' ) %element = zmy_rap_entity-description ) TO reported-zmy_rap_entity.
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (als Konkatenation von Carrier ID und Connection ID) und den verdoppelten Preis enthält.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             flight_number TYPE string,

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_itb_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Währung (z.B. 'EUR').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '100' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '500' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total_eur) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_total_usd) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis EUR sollte 250.00 sein' act = lv_total_eur exp = '250.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Gesamtpreis USD sollte 250.50 sein' act = lv_total_usd exp = '250.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Reduktionen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem über die Einträge iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable (`sum` im Beispiel) aktualisiert wird. Die `WHERE` Klausel erlaubt dabei eine Vorfilterung der zu verarbeitenden Daten.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, Sum, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_dyn_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den durchschnittlichen Preis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit Inline-Deklaration der Gruppenschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             avg_price     TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_flights.
    DATA: lv_sum_price TYPE sflight-price,
          lv_count     TYPE i.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      CLEAR: lv_sum_price, lv_count.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_flight INTO DATA(ls_group_flight).
        lv_sum_price = lv_sum_price + ls_group_flight-price.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_count

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Initialwert eines beliebigen Datentyps zur Laufzeit zurückgibt, basierend auf einem übergebenen Typ-Handle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_initial_value` und übergeben Sie ein `cl_abap_typedescr` Objekt, das aus dem Typ-Handle gewonnen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_generic_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_initial_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_generic_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_value_dynamic.
    DATA: lo_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

    TRY.
        lo_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
        CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_type_descr.
        cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_initial_value( EXPORTING p_type = lo_type_descr IMPORTING p_value = rr_data->* ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_type_descr_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log or raise custom exception
        CLEAR rr_data.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine bestimmte GUI-Eigenschaft (z.B. 'SAPGUI/Theme') über `cl_gui_props_consumer` existiert, ohne einen Fehler zu verursachen, auch wenn keine GUI-Umgebung aktiv ist.
hint: Die Methode `get_property_value` kann verwendet werden, um die Existenz indirekt zu prüfen, indem man den Rückgabewert auf Initialität prüft. Eine dedizierte `has_property` Methode existiert in dieser Klasse nicht direkt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_props_check_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS property_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_property_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_props_check_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD property_exists.
    DATA(lo_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_property_value) TYPE string.

    CALL METHOD lo_consumer->get_property_value
      EXPORTING
        property_name = iv_property_name
      IMPORTING
        property_value = lv_property_value.

    " If a property exists and has a value, it won't be initial.
    " In a non-GUI context, even existing properties might return initial.
    " This check is more about the *attempt* to retrieve without dump.
    rv_exists = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_property_exists_theme FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_property_exists_non_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_property_exists_theme.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_props_check_exist( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->property_exists( 'SAPGUI/Theme' ).
    " In a non-GUI environment, this will still return ABAP_TRUE as the call itself is valid.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true msg = 'Known property check failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_property_exists_non_existent.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_props_check_exist( ).
    DATA(lv_exists) = lo_cut->property_exists( 'NON_EXISTENT_PROPERTY' ).
    " The method will still return ABAP_TRUE as it only checks if the call is valid, not the value.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true msg = 'Non-existent property check failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Da `cl_gui_props_consumer` keine direkte `has_property`-Methode bietet, kann die Existenz einer Eigenschaft indirekt über `get_property_value` geprüft werden. Der Unit Test bestätigt, dass der Aufruf selbst gültig ist und keine Laufzeitfehler verursacht, auch wenn der zurückgegebene Wert in einer Nicht-GUI-Umgebung initial sein mag. Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values` in Kombination mit modernen Tabellenoperationen (z.B. `REDUCE`), um den Initialwert eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle zu ermitteln und zu setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_initial_value` für den Feldtyp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exc_table_initial DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_initial_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_initial_price) TYPE sflight-price.

    METHODS set_initial_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_modified) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exc_table_initial IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_initial_price.
    DATA(lo_price_type) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_p( p_length = 15 p_decimals = 2 ). " Assuming sflight-price type
    rv_initial_price = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>get_initial_value( lo_price_type ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_initial_price.
    DATA(lv_initial_price) = get_initial_price( it_sflight ).

    rt_sflight_modified = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight EXCEPT price )
                                     price = lv_initial_price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_initial_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_set_initial_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_initial_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_table_initial( ).
    DATA(lv_initial) = lo_cut->get_initial_price( VALUE #( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial exp = 0 msg = 'Initial price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_set_initial_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exc_table_initial( ).
    DATA(lt_sflight_in) = VALUE zcl_exc_table_initial=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflight_out) = lo_cut->set_initial_price( lt_sflight_in ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight_out[ 1 ]-price exp = 0 msg = 'First price not initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight_out[ 2 ]-price exp = 0 msg = 'Second price not initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflight_out[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Other field changed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `cl_abap_exceptional_values` zur dynamischen Ermittlung des Initialwerts eines Feldes mit modernen internen Tabellenoperationen (`VALUE` mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING`). Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und effiziente Manipulation von Tabellendaten, indem spezifische Felder auf ihren typspezifischen Initialwert gesetzt werden.
keywords: cl_abap_exceptional_values, Internal Tables, REDUCE, VALUE, FOR, Initialwert, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Code Inspector Prüfungen, die zu einer bestimmten Kategorie gehören (z.B. 'PERFORMANCE').
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode GET_ALL_CHECKS und anschließend eine FILTER-Expression. Da CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES keine direkte Methode zum Filtern nach Kategorie bietet, wird hier ein Beispiel mit einer simulierten Datenquelle gezeigt, um die FILTER-Expression zu demonstrieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_filter_by_category DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_checks
      IMPORTING
        iv_category TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>t_check_category
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_checks) TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_check_names.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_filter_by_category IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_checks.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_check_with_category,
             name     TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>t_check_name,
             category TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>t_check_category,
           END OF ty_check_with_category.
    TYPES tt_check_with_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_check_with_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_dummy_checks) = VALUE tt_check_with_category(
      ( name = 'CHECK_PERF_01' category = 'PERFORMANCE' )
      ( name = 'CHECK_SYNTAX_01' category = 'SYNTAX' )
      ( name = 'CHECK_PERF_02' category = 'PERFORMANCE' )
      ( name = 'CHECK_SEC_01' category = 'SECURITY' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_checks = VALUE #( FOR check IN FILTER #( lt_dummy_checks WHERE category = iv_category ) ( check-name ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_checks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_checks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ci_filter_by_category( ).
    DATA(lt_perf_checks) = lo_cut->filter_checks( 'PERFORMANCE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_perf_checks ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_perf_checks[ 1 ] exp = 'CHECK_PERF_01' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_perf_checks[ 2 ] exp = 'CHECK_PERF_02' ).

    DATA(lt_syntax_checks) = lo_cut->filter_checks( 'SYNTAX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_syntax_checks ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_syntax_checks[ 1 ] exp = 'CHECK_SYNTAX_01' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die FILTER-Expression ermöglicht das Filtern von internen Tabellen auf eine moderne und deklarative Weise. In Kombination mit VALUE # kann das Ergebnis direkt in eine neue Tabelle transformiert werden.
keywords: Code Inspector, CL_CI_QUERY_ATTRIBUTES, FILTER, Internal Tables, VALUE #

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_cal_set_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_calendar_date.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde ein Custom Container benötigt:
    " DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    " CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'MY_CONTAINER'.
    " CREATE OBJECT ro_calendar EXPORTING parent = lo_container.

    " Für den Unit Test instanziieren wir ohne Parent, da die visuelle Darstellung nicht getestet wird.
    CREATE OBJECT ro_calendar.
    ro_calendar->set_date( id_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_cal_next_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rs_new_month_year) TYPE zcl_cal_get_month_year=>ty_month_year.

CLASS zcl_cal_next_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD navigate_next_month.
    DATA(lo_calendar) = NEW cl_gui_calendar( ).
    lo_calendar->next_month( ).

    rs_new_month_year-year = lo_calendar->get_year( ).
    rs_new_month_year-month = lo_calendar->get_month( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_navigate_next_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_navigate_next_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_next_month( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->navigate_next_month( ).

    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).

    DATA(lv_expected_month) TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_month.
    DATA(lv_expected_year) TYPE cl_gui_calendar=>t_year.

    IF lv_current_month = '12'.
      lv_expected_month = '01'.
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year + 1.
    ELSE.
      lv_expected_month = lv_current_month + 1.
      lv_expected_year = lv_current_year.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-year exp = lv_expected_year ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-month exp = lv_expected_month ).

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor auf der Tabelle `sflights`, holen Sie Daten in Blöcken und transformieren Sie diese mithilfe von `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und anschließend `FOR ... IN` mit `VALUE #(...)` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_for_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_for_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflights PACKAGE SIZE 10.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND LINES OF VALUE tt_flight_info(
        FOR wa_sflight IN lt_sflights
          ( carrid   = wa_sflight-carrid,
            connid   = wa_sflight-connid,
            fldate   = wa_sflight-fldate,
            price    = wa_sflight-price,
            currency = wa_sflight-currency ) )
        TO rt_flights.

      CLEAR lt_sflights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_for_value( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( iv_max_rows = 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL exp = abap_false msg = 'No flights returned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 20 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-carrid msg = 'Carrid is initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate TYPE s_date,

CLASS zcl_cursor_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor auf der Tabelle `sflights`, holen Sie Daten und berechnen Sie eine Summe (z.B. die Gesamtzahl der Sitzplätze) mithilfe des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und anschließend `REDUCE #(...)` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT seatsocc FROM sflights.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR wa_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + wa_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total_seats > 0 msg = 'Total seats should be greater than 0' ).

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lv_dynamic_sql TYPE string,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    lv_dynamic_sql = |SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights { COND string( WHEN iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL THEN |WHERE { iv_where_clause }| ELSE `` ) }|.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_dynamic_sql).

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_flights = VALUE tt_dynamic_flight(
      FOR wa_sflight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid = wa_sflight-carrid,
          connid = wa_sflight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung für `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH`-Operationen unter Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` und relevanten Ausnahmeklassen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db` oder spezifischere Ausnahmen für Datenbankfehler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_cursor_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_cursor_operation.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_data   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_sql    TYPE string.

    rv_success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Simulate an invalid table name for error demonstration
        lv_sql = |SELECT carrid, connid FROM { iv_table_name } UP TO 1 ROWS|.

        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR (lv_sql).

        FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_data.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Log the error or handle it appropriately
        MESSAGE lx_db_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db EXPORTING previous = lx_db_error.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch any other unexpected errors
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db EXPORTING previous = lx_root.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR` um Daten aus `sflights` zu lesen und anschließend mit einem `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einer internen Tabelle zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_seats_occ TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, seatsocc FROM sflights.

    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    rt_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF wa_group IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = wa_group-carrid ) ASCENDING
      ( carrid        = wa_group-carrid,
        total_flights   = GROUP SIZE,
        total_seats_occ = REDUCE i(
                            INIT sum = 0
                            FOR wa_flight IN GROUP wa_group
                            NEXT sum = sum + wa_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_summary-total_seats_occ > 0 msg = 'LH total seats occupied should be > 0' ).
    ENDIF.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE char10, " External date format
             price    TYPE s_price,

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

                          WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )

                            connid = flight-connid

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` und `scarr` und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit korrespondierenden Feldern. Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_ex_util=>get_external_time` zur Konvertierung der Flugzeit.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             deptime  TYPE char8, " External time format
             arrtime  TYPE char8, " External time format

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_details) TYPE tt_flight_detail.

CLASS zcl_flight_data_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~deptime, s~arrtime
      FROM sflights AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      WHERE s~carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_details.

    LOOP AT rt_details ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_detail>).
      <fs_detail>-deptime = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_external_time( <fs_detail>-deptime ).
      <fs_detail>-arrtime = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_external_time( <fs_detail>-arrtime ).

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_field_catalog DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_field_catalog.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Datenmodifikation, wie sie in einem ABAP RAP Behavior Handler für eine Flugbuchung stattfinden könnte. Setzen Sie den Status einer Buchung auf 'bestätigt', wenn sie gültig ist.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die konzeptionell die Rolle eines Behavior Handlers übernimmt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` für die effiziente Datenmodifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_booking_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             status   TYPE char10,
           END OF ty_booking_data.
    TYPES tt_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS confirm_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_booking_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_confirmed_bookings) TYPE tt_booking_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_booking_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD confirm_bookings.
    " In a real RAP scenario, this would be part of a handler method
    " like FOR MODIFY.
    rt_confirmed_bookings = VALUE #( FOR booking IN it_bookings
                                     ( booking-carrid
                                       booking-connid
                                       booking-fldate
                                       status = COND string( WHEN booking-fldate >= sy-datum THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'REJECTED' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Aggregation über die interne Tabelle durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie eine bestehende interne Tabelle von Flugdaten, indem Sie den Preis für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz erhöhen. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator mit `BASE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( BASE ... FOR ... )` um eine neue Tabelle basierend auf einer bestehenden zu erstellen und dabei selektive Änderungen vorzunehmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_modifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_flight_price
        iv_carrid_to_modify TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage   TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_modifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_prices.
    rt_modified_flights = VALUE #( BASE it_flights
                                   FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid_to_modify )
                                   ( flight WITH price = flight-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_increase.
    DATA: lt_original_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_modifier=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '100.00' ) TO lt_original_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' price = '200.00' ) TO lt_original_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_modifier( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->increase_prices(
                                   it_flights      = lt_original_flights
                                   iv_carrid_to_modify = 'AA'
                                   iv_percentage   = '10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for AA 0017 incorrect' act = lt_modified_flights[1]-price exp = '110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for AA 0018 incorrect' act = lt_modified_flights[2]-price exp = '220.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for LH 0400 incorrectly modified' act = lt_modified_flights[3]-price exp = '150.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_change_other_carrid.
    DATA: lt_original_flights TYPE zcl_flight_price_modifier=>tt_flight_price.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '150.00' ) TO lt_original_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_modifier( ).
    DATA(lt_modified_flights) = lo_cut->increase_prices(
                                   it_flights      = lt_original_flights
                                   iv_carrid_to_modify = 'AA'
                                   iv_percentage   = '10' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price for LH 0400 incorrectly modified when AA was target' act = lt_modified_flights[1]-price exp = '150.00' ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Objekt ein bestimmtes Interface implementiert, und rufen Sie dann eine Interface-Methode auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CAST` in Verbindung mit einer `IF ... IS BOUND`-Prüfung, um die Implementierung zur Laufzeit zu verifizieren.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_processable.
  METHODS process_data
    IMPORTING
      iv_input TYPE string
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_processable.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_processable~process_data.
    rv_output = |Processed: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_non_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_info RETURNING VALUE(rv_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_non_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_info.
    rv_info = 'I do not process data.'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_and_process
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_process.
    DATA(lo_processable) = CAST zif_processable( io_object ).

    IF lo_processable IS BOUND.
      rv_result = lo_processable->process_data( 'Some input' ).
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Object does not implement ZIF_PROCESSABLE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_with_implementing_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_non_implementing_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_with_implementing_object.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_rtti_checker( ).
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_checker->check_and_process( lo_processor ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Processed: Some input'
      msg = 'Should process data if interface is implemented'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_non_implementing_object.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_rtti_checker( ).
    DATA(lo_non_processor) = NEW zcl_non_processor( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_checker->check_and_process( lo_non_processor ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Object does not implement ZIF_PROCESSABLE'
      msg = 'Should indicate no implementation if interface is missing'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die RTTI (Run-Time Type Identification) ermöglicht es, die Eigenschaften von Objekten zur Laufzeit zu überprüfen. Mit `CAST` kann versucht werden, ein Objekt auf einen Interface-Typ zu casten. Eine anschließende `IS BOUND`-Prüfung stellt sicher, dass der Cast erfolgreich war, bevor Interface-Methoden aufgerufen werden. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für flexible und erweiterbare Architekturen.
keywords: RTTI, INTERFACE, CAST, IS INSTANCE OF, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming

CLASS zcl_filter_entities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

solution:
INTERFACE zif_value_provider.
  METHODS get_numeric_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE i.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_item DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_value_provider.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_id TYPE i iv_value TYPE i iv_name TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_id TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_item IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_id = iv_id.
    mv_value = iv_value.
    mv_name = iv_name.

  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_value_provider~get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_values
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_value_provider WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_values.
    rv_total_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                             FOR item IN it_items
                             NEXT sum = sum + item->get_numeric_value( ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine interne Tabelle von Daten in ein JSON-Format serialisiert und als HTTP-Antwort zurückgibt.

CLASS zcl_http_json_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_http_json_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251204' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251205' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_json_string) = ''.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = lt_flights
            pretty_print = abap_true
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lv_json_string = lx_error->get_text( ).
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.

    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    server->response->set_content_type( 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_json_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Daten zurückgibt, und implementieren Sie diese Methode in einer Klasse, die den `VALUE`-Operator verwendet, um die Tabelle zu füllen.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Tabellentyp im Interface und nutzen Sie `VALUE #( ... )` in der Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_source.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entry,
           key   TYPE string,
           value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_entry.
  TYPES tt_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS get_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_entries.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_static_data_source DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_source.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_static_data_source IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_source~get_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #(
      ( key = 'Name' value = 'Alice' )
      ( key = 'City' value = 'Berlin' )
      ( key = 'Age' value = '30' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data_from_interface.
    DATA(lo_data_source) = NEW zcl_static_data_source( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = lo_data_source->get_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data )

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert Interfaces mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine moderne und flexible Datenbereitstellung zu demonstrieren. Das Interface definiert den Vertrag für die Datenlieferung, während die Implementierung den `VALUE`-Operator nutzt, um die interne Tabelle kompakt und lesbar zu füllen. Dies fördert die Trennung von Interface und Implementierung und die Verwendung moderner ABAP-Syntax.
keywords: INTERFACE, VALUE, Internal Tables, Object Orientation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der einen Query-Parameter aus der URL liest und diesen in der Antwort verwendet.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SERVER->REQUEST->GET_FORM_FIELD` um Query-Parameter zu lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_query_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_name) = server->request->get_form_field( 'name' ).

    IF lv_name IS INITIAL.
      lv_name = 'Guest'.

    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
    server->response->set_content_type( 'text/plain' ).

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Methode, die einen Parameter mit einem Standardwert hat, und rufen Sie diese Methode sowohl mit als auch ohne Angabe des Parameters auf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `DEFAULT` für Parameter in Interface-Methoden (ABAP 7.55+).
solution:
INTERFACE zif_configurable_printer.
  METHODS print_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string
      iv_prefix  TYPE string DEFAULT VALUE 'LOG: '.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_printer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_configurable_printer.
    METHODS get_last_printed_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_last_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_printer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_configurable_printer~print_message.
    mv_last_message = |{ iv_prefix }{ iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_printed_message.
    rv_message = mv_last_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_print_with_default_prefix FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_print_with_custom_prefix FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_print_with_default_prefix.
    DATA(lo_printer) = NEW zcl_console_printer( ).
    DATA(lo_printer_intf) = CAST zif_configurable_printer( lo_printer ).
    lo_printer_intf->print_message( iv_message = 'System started' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_printer->get_last_printed_message( )
      exp = 'LOG: System started'
      msg = 'Should use default prefix'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_print_with_custom_prefix.
    DATA(lo_printer) = NEW zcl_console_printer( ).
    DATA(lo_printer_intf) = CAST zif_configurable_printer( lo_printer ).
    lo_printer_intf->print_message( iv_message = 'Error occurred' iv_prefix = 'ERROR: ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_printer->get_last_printed_message( )
      exp = 'ERROR: Error occurred'
      msg = 'Should use custom prefix'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: ABAP 7.55 ermöglicht die Definition von Standardwerten für Parameter in Interface-Methoden. Dies erhöht die Flexibilität von Interfaces, da implementierende Klassen nicht gezwungen sind, alle Parameter explizit zu übergeben, wenn ein Standardwert ausreicht. Es fördert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes, indem es optionale Parameter klar definiert.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT, Parameters, ABAP 7.55, Object Orientation

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle `sflights` nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') und kopieren Sie die relevanten Felder (Carrid, Connid, Fldate) in eine neue Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` in Kombination mit `VALUE` für eine kompakte Filterung und Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                     fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_ua FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected some flights for LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be LH' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_ua.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected some flights for UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry should be UA' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result should be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` ist eine moderne und funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren. Dies ersetzt klassische `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleifen mit explizitem `APPEND` und ist deutlich kompakter und lesbarer.
keywords: LOOP AT, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, VALUE, Filter

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Geben Sie das Ergebnis als interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Anzahl zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                   flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected some grouped flights' ).

    DATA(lv_lh_count) = VALUE i( FOR ls_entry IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' ) ( ls_entry-flight_count ) OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'LH count should be greater than 0' act = lv_lh_count exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected LH flights' ).

    DATA(lv_aa_count) = VALUE i( FOR ls_entry IN lt_result WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' ) ( ls_entry-flight_count ) OPTIONAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'AA count should be greater than 0' act = lv_aa_count exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected AA flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine deklarative Gruppierung von Daten direkt in der Schleife, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit gegenüber manuellen Gruppierungen erheblich verbessert. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` können Aggregationen wie Zählungen oder Summen effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Count

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (`price`) aus `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AA').
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_flight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices_lh FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_prices_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices_lh.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total price for LH should be greater than 0' act = lv_total_price exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected a sum for LH flights' ).
    " Further assertions could check against a known sum if test data is fixed.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_prices_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_flight_prices( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = lv_total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP. Er ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen (z.B. Summen, Minima, Maxima) in einem einzigen Ausdruck, was den Code kürzer und ausdrucksstärker macht als klassische `LOOP`-Schleifen mit manueller Akkumulation.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Sum, Aggregation, FOR, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von `sflights` enthält, deren Flugdatum (`fldate`) in der Zukunft liegt (bezogen auf das aktuelle Systemdatum).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    rt_future_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate > lv_current_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_future_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_future_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights( ).

    " Since sflights data is static, we might not always have future flights.
    " This test assumes there might be some or none, but checks the logic.
    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight date must be in the future' cond = ( ls_flight-fldate > sy-datum ) ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'No future flights found (expected for static data)' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und performante Möglichkeit, eine neue interne Tabelle zu erstellen, die nur die Zeilen der Quelltabelle enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Dies ist effizienter und lesbarer als eine manuelle `LOOP`-Schleife mit `IF` und `APPEND`.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Date, Future, LOOP AT

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflights`, die nur die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` enthält und das Flugdatum (`fldate`) in ein String-Format 'YYYY-MM-DD' umwandelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_transform_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate_str TYPE string,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_transformed_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_transform_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                        connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                        fldate_str = |{ ls_flight-fldate(4) }-{ ls_flight-fldate+4(2) }-{ ls_flight-fldate+6(2) }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_transform_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_transformed_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 err_msg = 'Expected some transformed flights' ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_result[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Carrid should be LH' act = ls_first_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_matches( msg = 'Fldate_str should be in YYYY-MM-DD format' pattern = '\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' act = ls_first_flight-fldate_str ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... )` ermöglicht die deklarative Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen, wobei jede Zeile der Quelltabelle transformiert werden kann. String-Templates (`|...|`) bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax zur Formatierung von Strings, was die Datumsumwandlung hier sehr elegant macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Transformation, Date, String Templates, LOOP AT

Instructions: Kodieren Sie einen String, der Sonderzeichen und Leerzeichen enthält, für die Verwendung in einer URL (URL-Encoding).
hint: Verwenden Sie die statische Methode `cl_http_utility=>escape_url`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_url_encoding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS encode_url_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_encoded_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_url_encoding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_url_string.
    rv_encoded_string = cl_http_utility=>escape_url( iv_raw_string ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_basic_encoding FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_special_chars FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_basic_encoding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_url_encoding( ).
    DATA(lv_encoded) = lo_cut->encode_url_string( 'Hello World' ).
