solution:
CLASS zcl_http_query_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_query_params TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS parse_http_query
      IMPORTING
        iv_query_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_query_params) TYPE ty_query_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_query_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_http_query.
    DATA: lt_params TYPE cl_http_utility=>t_parameters.

    cl_http_utility=>parse_query_string(
      EXPORTING
        i_query_string = iv_query_string
      IMPORTING
        e_parameters   = lt_params
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_params INTO DATA(ls_param).
      rt_query_params = VALUE #( BASE rt_query_params ( key = ls_param-name value = ls_param-value ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        i_parameters = lt_params

  ENDMETHOD.

      connid = '0001'

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS (z.B. Gesamtanzahl der Passagiere pro Fluggesellschaft) und fügen Sie die Ergebnisse in eine neue interne Tabelle ein, indem Sie den REDUCE Operator verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um die Aggregation durchzuführen und dann `VALUE` um die Ergebnisse zu speichern. Denken Sie an eine geeignete Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_pax,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_pax.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_pax TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_pax WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_total_pax_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_pax) TYPE tt_carrier_pax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_reduce_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_pax_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflights_db) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_carrier_pax = REDUCE tt_carrier_pax(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_carrier_pax( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_db
      LET lv_index = line_index( result[ carrid = ls_flight-carrid ] ) IN
      NEXT result = COND #( WHEN lv_index IS INITIAL
                            THEN VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_passengers = ls_flight-seatsocc ) )
                            ELSE VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_passengers = result[ lv_index ]-total_passengers + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_reduce_insert( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_pax_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    " Example check for a specific carrier (assuming 'AA' exists in SFLIGHTS test data)
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' INTO DATA(ls_aa_pax).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( msg = 'Total passengers for AA should be greater than 0' act = ls_aa_pax-total_passengers exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.

    " More robust test: manually calculate expected values for a small, fixed dataset if possible
    " For SFLIGHTS, this is harder without knowing the exact test data.
    " This test primarily checks if the REDUCE operation runs and produces a non-empty, plausible result.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für komplexe Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert oder eine neue Tabelle zu reduzieren, indem er über die Zeilen iteriert und einen Akkumulator (hier `result`) schrittweise aufbaut. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: INSERT, REDUCE, Internal Table, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Anhänge (Attachments) für ein gegebenes Business-Objekt (z.B. eine Bestellung oder ein Material) unter Verwendung von cl_gos_attachment_query.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query` und rufen Sie die Methode `query_attachments` auf. Sie benötigen einen Objekttyp und einen Objektschlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             obj_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             obj_type TYPE so_obj_tp,
             obj_name TYPE so_obj_nam,
             obj_descr TYPE so_obj_des,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfinstid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_attachments.
    DATA: lo_gos_query TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA: lt_sobl_cont TYPE sobl_cont_tab.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_type = iv_object_type
            is_object_key  = iv_object_key
          IMPORTING
            et_sobl_cont   = lt_sobl_cont
        ).

        rt_attachments = VALUE #( FOR ls_cont IN lt_sobl_cont
                                  ( obj_id    = ls_cont-obj_id
                                    obj_type  = ls_cont-obj_type
                                    obj_name  = ls_cont-obj_name
                                    obj_descr = ls_cont-obj_descr ) ).

      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        " For this example, we'll just return an empty table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Anhänge eines Business-Objekts, um nur solche eines bestimmten Typs (z.B. PDF-Dokumente) zu erhalten, unter Verwendung von cl_gos_attachment_query und modernen ABAP-Filtertechniken.
hint: Rufen Sie `query_attachments` auf und filtern Sie das Ergebnis anschließend mit dem `FILTER` Operator basierend auf dem Objekttyp (z.B. 'PDF').
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
             obj_id   TYPE so_obj_id,
             obj_type TYPE so_obj_tp,
             obj_name TYPE so_obj_nam,
             obj_descr TYPE so_obj_des,
           END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments_by_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfinstid
        iv_file_type   TYPE so_obj_tp " e.g., 'PDF', 'JPG'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments_by_type.
    DATA: lo_gos_query TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.
    DATA: lt_sobl_cont TYPE sobl_cont_tab.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_query.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_type = iv_object_type
            is_object_key  = iv_object_key
          IMPORTING
            et_sobl_cont   = lt_sobl_cont
        ).

        rt_attachments = FILTER #( VALUE tt_attachment_info( FOR ls_cont IN lt_sobl_cont
                                                              ( obj_id    = ls_cont-obj_id
                                                                obj_type  = ls_cont-obj_type
                                                                obj_name  = ls_cont-obj_name
                                                                obj_descr = ls_cont-obj_descr ) )
                                   USING KEY primary_key WHERE ( obj_type = iv_file_type ) ).

      CATCH cx_gos_api_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_get_content DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_binary_content TYPE xstring.

    METHODS get_attachment_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfinstid
        iv_obj_id      TYPE so_obj_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_content) TYPE ty_binary_content
      RAISING
        cx_gos_api_error
        cx_bds_document_set.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_get_content IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_content.
    DATA: lo_bds_document_set TYPE REF TO cl_bds_document_set.
    DATA: lt_content          TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF solisti1.
    DATA: lv_size             TYPE i.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_bds_document_set.

    TRY.
        lo_bds_document_set->get_content(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_id = iv_obj_id
          IMPORTING
            e_content   = lt_content
            e_size      = lv_size
        ).

        CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_XSTRING_TO_BINARY'
          EXPORTING
            buffer        = cl_bds_document_set=>convert_solisti1_to_xstring( lt_content )
          IMPORTING
            binary_buffer = rv_content.

      CATCH cx_bds_document_set INTO DATA(lx_bds).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bds_document_set EXPORTING previous = lx_bds.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_exist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_check_exist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_attachments.
    DATA: lo_gos_query TYPE REF TO cl_gos_attachment_query.

        lo_gos_query->query_attachments(
          EXPORTING

          IMPORTING

        IF lines( lt_sobl_cont ) > 0.

        ELSE.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_from_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_from_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_data.
    DATA:
      lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,
      lt_fieldcat   TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Create dynamic internal table and field catalog
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_structname = iv_struct_name
      IMPORTING
        ep_table     = lr_data
        e_fieldcat   = lt_fieldcat. " Field catalog is also generated

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Fill with some data (example for SFLIGHT)
    IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_table> UP TO 5 ROWS.
    ELSEIF iv_struct_name = 'TY_SFLIGHT_SUBSET'. " Example for a local type
      DATA(lt_local_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset(
        ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' )
        ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' )
      ).
      <lt_table> = lt_local_data.
    ENDIF.

    rr_data = lr_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV-Grid basierend auf der Struktur 'SFLIGHT'. Modifizieren Sie den Feldkatalog, um bestimmte Spalten auszublenden und die Beschriftung anderer Spalten zu ändern, bevor das ALV angezeigt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table` und manipulieren Sie den `e_fieldcat` Parameter, bevor Sie ihn an `cl_salv_table` übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fcat_manip DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_modified_alv
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_fcat_manip IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_modified_alv.
    DATA:
      lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,
      lt_fieldcat   TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
      lo_alv_table  TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Create dynamic internal table and field catalog
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_structname = iv_struct_name
      IMPORTING
        ep_table     = lr_data
        e_fieldcat   = lt_fieldcat.

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Fill with some data
    IF iv_struct_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
      SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE <lt_table> UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    " --- Field Catalog Manipulation ---
    LOOP AT lt_fieldcat ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_fcat>).
      CASE <fs_fcat>-fieldname.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Fluggesellschaft'.
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          <fs_fcat>-coltext = 'Flugnummer'.
        WHEN 'PLANETYPE'.
          <fs_fcat>-no_out = abap_true. " Hide this column
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Do nothing
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
    " ---------------------------------

    " Create ALV instance
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_table>
        ).

        " Apply modified field catalog
        lo_alv_table->set_field_catalog( lt_fieldcat ).

        " Display ALV
        lo_alv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, die Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) enthält, und fügen Sie eine berechnete Spalte hinzu, z.B. die Differenz zwischen Max. und Aktueller Belegung. Zeigen Sie das Ergebnis in einem ALV an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die Basisstruktur und erweitern Sie den Feldkatalog manuell. Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff auf die dynamischen Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_calc_col DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_calculated_alv.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_calc_col IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_calculated_alv.
    DATA:
      lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
      lr_data        TYPE REF TO data,
      lt_fieldcat    TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
      lo_alv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
      <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any,
      <lv_carrid>        TYPE sflight-carrid,
      <lv_connid>        TYPE sflight-connid,
      <lv_fldate>        TYPE sflight-fldate,
      <lv_seatsocc>      TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
      <lv_seatsmax>      TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      <lv_free_seats>    TYPE i.

    " Get raw data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight_raw
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Define the structure for the dynamic table
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create(
      VALUE abap_compdescr_tab(
        ( name = 'CARRID'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_c( 3 ) )
        ( name = 'CONNID'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_n( 4 ) )
        ( name = 'FLDATE'   type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_d( ) )
        ( name = 'SEATSOCC' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'SEATSMAX' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) )
        ( name = 'FREE_SEATS' type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_i( ) ) " Calculated field
      )
    ).

    " Create dynamic internal table and field catalog
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_udata_descr = lo_struct_descr
      IMPORTING
        ep_table      = lr_data
        e_fieldcat    = lt_fieldcat.

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Fill and calculate using modern ABAP
    LOOP AT lt_sflight_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <ls_dynamic_line>.

      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID'   OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID'   OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_connid>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE'   OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_fldate>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SEATSOCC' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_seatsocc>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'SEATSMAX' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_seatsmax>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FREE_SEATS' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_free_seats>.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_carrid>    = ls_sflight_raw-carrid.
        <lv_connid>    = ls_sflight_raw-connid.
        <lv_fldate>    = ls_sflight_raw-fldate.
        <lv_seatsocc>  = ls_sflight_raw-seatsocc.
        <lv_seatsmax>  = ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax.
        <lv_free_seats> = ls_sflight_raw-seatsmax - ls_sflight_raw-seatsocc.
        APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Create ALV instance
    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_alv_table
          CHANGING
            t_table      = <lt_dynamic_table>
        ).

        " Display ALV
        lo_alv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur `SFLIGHT`. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten und filtern Sie diese anschließend, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft anzuzeigen. Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` und moderne ABAP-Filterfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_alv_table_create` für die dynamische Tabelle und `FILTER` für die Datenreduktion.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_alv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflight_data.
    DATA:
      lr_data       TYPE REF TO data,
      lt_fieldcat   TYPE lvc_t_fcat,
      lt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS:
      <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    " Create dynamic internal table and field catalog for SFLIGHT
    CALL METHOD cl_alv_table_create=>create_dynamic_table
      EXPORTING
        i_structname = 'SFLIGHT'
      IMPORTING
        ep_table     = lr_data
        e_fieldcat   = lt_fieldcat.

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    " Get all SFLIGHT data
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight_all UP TO 20 ROWS.

    " Filter data using modern ABAP syntax
    <lt_table> = FILTER #( lt_sflight_all WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    rr_data = lr_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_alv_filter( ).
    DATA(lr_data_aa) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflight_data( 'AA' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_aa> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data_aa->* TO <lt_aa>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_aa> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT <lt_aa> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_aa>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_aa> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid> exp = 'AA' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lr_data_lh) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflight_data( 'LH' ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_lh> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_data_lh->* TO <lt_lh>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <lt_lh> IS NOT INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT <lt_lh> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<ls_lh>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_lh> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_carrid_lh>).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_carrid_lh> exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_appointment_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_appointment_creator IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    lo_appointment->set_end_time( iv_end_time ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Dauer eines Termins in Minuten. Erstellen Sie einen Termin und geben Sie dessen Dauer zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methoden `get_start_timestamp` und `get_end_timestamp` von `cl_appointment` und die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` zur Berechnung der Differenz.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_appointment_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_start_time TYPE t
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
        iv_end_time   TYPE t
        iv_description TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_duration_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_appointment_duration.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    lo_appointment->set_start_date( iv_start_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_time( iv_start_time ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_date( iv_end_date ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_time( iv_end_time ).
    lo_appointment->set_description( iv_description ).

    TRY.
        lo_appointment->create( ). " Create to ensure timestamps are set

        DATA(lv_start_tstmp) = lo_appointment->get_start_timestamp( ).
        DATA(lv_end_tstmp)   = lo_appointment->get_end_timestamp( ).

        DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_end_tstmp iv_tstmp2 = lv_start_tstmp ).
        rv_duration_minutes = lv_diff_seconds / 60.

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_error INTO DATA(lx_tstmp_error).
        MESSAGE lx_tstmp_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die prüft, ob ein Termin mit einem anderen Termin kollidiert (überlappende Zeiträume). Geben Sie 'X' zurück, wenn eine Kollision vorliegt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_collision DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_collision
      IMPORTING
        iv_guid1 TYPE szatk_guid
        iv_guid2 TYPE szatk_guid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_collides) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_collision IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_collision.
    DATA: lo_app1 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment,
          lo_app2 TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.

    TRY.
        lo_app1 = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( iv_guid1 ).
        lo_app2 = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( iv_guid2 ).

        DATA(lv_start1) = lo_app1->get_start_timestamp( ).
        DATA(lv_end1)   = lo_app1->get_end_timestamp( ).
        DATA(lv_start2) = lo_app2->get_start_timestamp( ).
        DATA(lv_end2)   = lo_app2->get_end_timestamp( ).

        " Check for overlap: (Start1 < End2) AND (End1 > Start2)
        IF lv_start1 < lv_end2 AND lv_end1 > lv_start2.
          rv_collides = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_collides = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_collides = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Appointment 1: Today 09:00 - 10:00
    DATA(lv_guid1) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      sy-datum '090000' sy-datum '100000' 'Termin 1'
    ).

    " Appointment 2: Today 09:30 - 10:30 (collides)
    DATA(lv_guid2) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      sy-datum '093000' sy-datum '103000' 'Termin 2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_collision_checker->check_collision( lv_guid1 lv_guid2 ) exp = abap_true ).

    " Appointment 3: Today 11:00 - 12:00 (no collision with 1 or 2)
    DATA(lv_guid3) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      sy-datum '110000' sy-datum '120000' 'Termin 3'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_collision_checker->check_collision( lv_guid1 lv_guid3 ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Appointment 4: Today 08:00 - 09:00 (touches, but no overlap)
    DATA(lv_guid4) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      sy-datum '080000' sy-datum '090000' 'Termin 4'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_collision_checker->check_collision( lv_guid1 lv_guid4 ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_daily_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_info,
             guid        TYPE szatk_guid,
             description TYPE string,
             start_time  TYPE t,
             end_time    TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_info,
           tt_appointment_info TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_appointment_info WITH UNIQUE KEY guid.

    METHODS get_sorted_daily_appointments
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_daily_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_daily_appointments.
    DATA: lt_guids TYPE szatk_guids,
          lt_raw_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_info.

    TRY.
        lt_guids = cl_appointment=>get_appointments_by_date_range(
          iv_start_date = iv_date
          iv_end_date   = iv_date
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_guids INTO DATA(lv_guid).
          DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( lv_guid ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_appointment_info(
            guid        = lv_guid
            description = lo_appointment->get_description( )
            start_time  = lo_appointment->get_start_time( )
            end_time    = lo_appointment->get_end_time( )
          ) TO lt_raw_appointments.
        ENDLOOP.

        " Sort using modern ABAP syntax (FOR ... SORTED BY)
        rt_appointments = VALUE tt_appointment_info( FOR ls_app IN lt_raw_appointments SORTED BY start_time ( ls_app ) ).

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sorted_daily_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sorted_daily_appointments.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_list_getter) = NEW zcl_appointment_daily_list( ).

    " Create appointments for today
    lo_creator->create_new_appointment( sy-datum '110000' sy-datum '120000' 'Mittagessen' ).
    lo_creator->create_new_appointment( sy-datum '090000' sy-datum '100000' 'Morgenmeeting' ).
    lo_creator->create_new_appointment( sy-datum '140000' sy-datum '150000' 'Nachmittags-Call' ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_apps) = lo_list_getter->get_sorted_daily_appointments( sy-datum ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_sorted_apps ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check sorting order
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_apps[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Morgenmeeting' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_apps[ 2 ]-description exp = 'Mittagessen' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_apps[ 3 ]-description exp = 'Nachmittags-Call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Abrufen und Sortieren von Terminen für einen bestimmten Tag. Es verwendet `cl_appointment=>get_appointments_by_date_range` und anschließend die moderne ABAP-Syntax `FOR ... SORTED BY`, um die Termine effizient nach ihrer Startzeit zu sortieren. Die Verwendung eines `SORTED TABLE` als Rückgabetyp stellt sicher, dass die Daten bereits sortiert sind und einen schnellen Zugriff ermöglichen.
keywords: cl_appointment, Date/Time, Sorting, Internal Tables, FOR SORTED BY

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die die Beschreibung eines Termins basierend auf seiner GUID und einer neuen Beschreibung aktualisiert. Nutzen Sie `cl_appointment` und geben Sie die alte und neue Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid`, `get_description`, `set_description` und `update`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_desc_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_description_change,
             old_description TYPE string,
             new_description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_description_change.

    METHODS update_appointment_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_appointment_guid TYPE szatk_guid
        iv_new_description  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_description_change) TYPE ty_description_change.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_desc_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_appointment_description.
    DATA: lo_appointment TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.

    TRY.
        lo_appointment = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( iv_appointment_guid ).

        rs_description_change-old_description = lo_appointment->get_description( ).

        lo_appointment->set_description( iv_new_description ).
        lo_appointment->update( ).

        rs_description_change-new_description = lo_appointment->get_description( ).

      CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_description FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_description.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_guid) = lo_creator->create_new_appointment(
      sy-datum '170000' sy-datum '180000' 'Alte Beschreibung'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_guid IS NOT INITIAL ).

    DATA(lo_updater) = NEW zcl_appointment_desc_update( ).
    DATA(lv_new_desc) = 'Neue Beschreibung durch Unit Test'.
    DATA(ls_changes) = lo_updater->update_appointment_description(
      iv_appointment_guid = lv_guid
      iv_new_description  = lv_new_desc
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_changes-old_description exp = 'Alte Beschreibung' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_changes-new_description exp = lv_new_desc ).

    " Verify by reading it again
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_verify_app) = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( lv_guid ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_verify_app->get_description( ) exp = lv_new_desc ).
      CATCH cx_appointment_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Error verifying updated description' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Aktualisieren der Beschreibung eines Termins und das Zurückgeben sowohl der alten als auch der neuen Beschreibung. Es nutzt die Standardmethoden von `cl_appointment` zum Abrufen, Setzen und Aktualisieren von Daten. Die Rückgabe einer Struktur mit alten und neuen Werten ist ein nützliches Muster für Änderungslogiken oder Bestätigungen.
keywords: cl_appointment, Update, Description, Object Orientation, Data Change

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data1,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data1,
           tt_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data1 WITH EMPTY KEY,

    DATA: lt_data1 TYPE tt_data1,
          lt_data2 TYPE tt_data2.

    lt_data1 = VALUE #( ( col1 = 'A' col2 = 10 )
                        ( col1 = 'B' col2 = 20 ) ).

    DATA(lo_sheet2) = lo_xlsx->add_sheet( 'Blatt 2' ).
    lo_sheet2->add_header( VALUE #( ( 'Artikel' ) ( 'Wert' ) ) ).
    lo_sheet2->add_data( lt_data2 ).

Instructions: Deserialisieren Sie einen fehlerhaften JSON-String und fangen Sie die auftretende Ausnahme `cx_sy_strg_par_val` ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme `cx_sy_strg_par_val` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS deserialize_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING   cx_sy_strg_par_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json_string
                                   IMPORTING data = rs_data ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Zahlen verarbeitet. Wenn eine Division durch Null auftritt, fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung mit `cl_message_helper` hinzu. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` für die Initialisierung der Eingabedaten und String-Templates für die Fehlermeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` und `cl_message_helper=>add_message`. Initialisieren Sie die Daten mit `VALUE #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_div_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_input,
             dividend TYPE i,
             divisor  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_input.
    TYPES: tt_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_divisions
      IMPORTING
        it_input TYPE tt_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_div_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_divisions.
    DATA(lo_message_helper) = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    LOOP AT it_input INTO DATA(ls_input).
      TRY.
          DATA(lv_result) = ls_input-dividend / ls_input-divisor.
          lo_message_helper->add_message(
            iv_msgty = 'S'
            iv_msgid = '00' " Example message class
            iv_msgno = '001' " Example message number
            iv_msgv1 = |Division { ls_input-dividend } / { ls_input-divisor } = { lv_result } erfolgreich.|
          ).
        CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
          lo_message_helper->add_message(
            iv_msgty = 'E'
            iv_msgid = '00' " Example message class
            iv_msgno = '002' " Example message number
            iv_msgv1 = |Fehler bei Division { ls_input-dividend } / { ls_input-divisor }: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|
          ).
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_messages = lo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_div_error( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Für jeden Flug, dessen maximale Kapazität (MAX_OCC) unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, erstellen Sie einen Warnungseintrag im Anwendungslog mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log`. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für die Iteration und String-Templates für die Log-Nachricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights)` und `FOR ... IN lt_sflights`. Erstellen Sie eine Log-Objektinstanz und fügen Sie Nachrichten mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message` hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_low_capacity_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh. " Returns the log handle for verification
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_low_capacity_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'. " Application log mode

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE max_occ < iv_threshold.
      cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          iv_msgty      = 'W'
          iv_msgid      = 'SFLIGHT' " Example message class for SFLIGHT
          iv_msgno      = '003'     " Example message number
          iv_msgv1      = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } hat geringe Kapazität: { ls_flight-max_occ } (Schwellenwert: { iv_threshold })|
          iv_probclass  = '2'       " Problem class: medium
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Nachrichten, die mit `cl_message_helper` gesammelt wurden, um nur Fehlermeldungen zu erhalten. Reduzieren Sie diese Fehlermeldungen dann zu einem einzigen String, der alle Fehlermeldungstexte durch Semikolon getrennt enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` für die Meldungstabelle und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Texte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_summarize_errors
      IMPORTING
        it_all_messages TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_summarize_errors.
    DATA(lt_error_messages) = FILTER cl_message_helper=>tt_messages(
                                 it_all_messages
                                 WHERE msgty = 'E' OR msgty = 'A' ).

    rv_error_summary = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_msg IN lt_error_messages
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_msg-message ELSE s && `; ` && ls_msg-message )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_messages) = VALUE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages(
      ( msgty = 'S' message = 'Success 1' )
      ( msgty = 'E' message = 'Error A' )
      ( msgty = 'W' message = 'Warning X' )
      ( msgty = 'E' message = 'Error B' )
      ( msgty = 'A' message = 'Abort C' )

    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_actions INTO DATA(ls_action).
      DATA(lv_msgty) = SWITCH char1( ls_action-action_type
                                     WHEN 'CREATE' THEN 'S'
                                     WHEN 'UPDATE' THEN 'I'
                                     WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 'W'
                                     ELSE 'E' ).
      DATA(lv_message) = COND string(
                               WHEN ls_action-action_type = 'CREATE' THEN |Objekt { ls_action-object_id } erfolgreich erstellt.|
                               WHEN ls_action-action_type = 'UPDATE' THEN |Objekt { ls_action-object_id } aktualisiert.|
                               WHEN ls_action-action_type = 'DELETE' THEN |Objekt { ls_action-object_id } gelöscht.|
                               ELSE |Unbekannte Aktion { ls_action-action_type } für Objekt { ls_action-object_id }.|
                             ).

      cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          iv_msgty      = lv_msgty
          iv_msgid      = 'ZAPP' " Example message class
          iv_msgno      = '001'
          iv_msgv1      = lv_message
          iv_probclass  = SWITCH bal_probcl( lv_msgty
                                              WHEN 'S' THEN '1'
                                              WHEN 'I' THEN '1'
                                              WHEN 'W' THEN '2'
                                              WHEN 'E' THEN '3'
                                              ELSE '4' )
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob eine bestimmte Fehlermeldung bereits in einer mit `cl_message_helper` gesammelten Meldungstabelle existiert. Wenn ja, geben Sie deren Index zurück. Wenn nicht, fügen Sie die Meldung hinzu und geben Sie den neuen Index zurück. Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` auf der Tabelle, die von `cl_message_helper=>get_messages()` zurückgegeben wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_check_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_and_add_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_msgty TYPE symsgty
        iv_msgid TYPE sycprog
        iv_msgno TYPE symsgno
        iv_msgv1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_index) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_check_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_and_add_message.
    DATA(lt_messages) = mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
    DATA(ls_new_message) = VALUE bal_s_msg( msgty = iv_msgty msgid = iv_msgid msgno = iv_msgno msgv1 = iv_msgv1 ).

    IF LINE_EXISTS( lt_messages[ msgty = ls_new_message-msgty
                                 msgid = ls_new_message-msgid
                                 msgno = ls_new_message-msgno
                                 msgv1 = ls_new_message-msgv1 ] ).
      rv_index = LINE_INDEX( lt_messages[ msgty = ls_new_message-msgty
                                         msgid = ls_new_message-msgid
                                         msgno = ls_new_message-msgno
                                         msgv1 = ls_new_message-msgv1 ] ).
    ELSE.
      mo_message_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgty = iv_msgty,
        iv_msgid = iv_msgid,
        iv_msgno = iv_msgno,
        iv_msgv1 = iv_msgv1
      ).
      rv_index = lines( mo_message_helper->get_messages( ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (ähnlich `sflights`). Validieren Sie für jeden Flug, ob das Ankunftsdatum nach dem Abflugdatum liegt. Sammeln Sie ungültige Flüge und protokollieren Sie diese als Fehler im Anwendungslog mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log`. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `GROUP BY` für die Verarbeitung und `REDUCE` für die Zusammenfassung der Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` für die Filterung und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation der Fehler. `cl_s_aut_bal_log` für die Protokollierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_flight_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             arrdate  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS validate_flights_and_log
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_flight_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_flights_and_log.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_invalid_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data(
                                   it_flights
                                   WHERE arrdate < fldate ).

    IF lt_invalid_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_invalid_flights INTO DATA(ls_invalid_flight).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
          EXPORTING
            iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
            iv_msgty      = 'E'
            iv_msgid      = 'SFLIGHT' " Example message class
            iv_msgno      = '004'
            iv_msgv1      = |Flug { ls_invalid_flight-carrid } { ls_invalid_flight-connid } hat ungültige Daten: Abflug { ls_invalid_flight-fldate } > Ankunft { ls_invalid_flight-arrdate }|
            iv_probclass  = '4'
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch Log-Einträge für verschiedene Objekte und Aktionen generiert. Die Log-Nachricht soll dabei dynamisch aus einer Struktur und einem String-Template erstellt werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log` und dynamische Feldzugriffe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>`. String-Templates für die Nachricht.

CLASS zcl_log_dynamic_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_data,
             object_type TYPE string,
             object_key  TYPE string,
             action      TYPE string,
             status      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_data.

    METHODS create_dynamic_log_entry
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_dynamic_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_dynamic_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_log_entry.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_msgty) = COND char1( WHEN is_data-status = 'ERROR' THEN 'E'
                                 WHEN is_data-status = 'WARNING' THEN 'W'
                                 ELSE 'S' ).

    DATA(lv_message) = |Aktion '{ is_data-action }' für Objekt '{ is_data-object_type }' mit Schlüssel '{ is_data-object_key }' abgeschlossen mit Status: { is_data-status }|.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
        iv_msgty      = lv_msgty
        iv_msgid      = 'ZDYNL'
        iv_msgno      = '001'
        iv_msgv1      = lv_message
        iv_probclass  = SWITCH bal_probcl( lv_msgty
                                            WHEN 'S' THEN '1'
                                            WHEN 'W' THEN '2'
                                            WHEN 'E' THEN '4' )
    ).

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Eingabestring verarbeitet und alle Vorkommen eines bestimmten Substrings durch einen anderen ersetzt. Wenn Ersetzungen vorgenommen wurden, fügen Sie eine Erfolgsmeldung mit `cl_message_helper` hinzu, andernfalls eine Informationsmeldung. Nutzen Sie String-Funktionen und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF ... IN ... WITH ...` und `cl_message_helper=>add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_string_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_and_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_string_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_and_message.
    DATA(lv_replaced_string) = iv_input_string.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_substring IN lv_replaced_string WITH iv_new_substring.

    IF lv_replaced_string <> iv_input_string.
      mo_message_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgty = 'S'
        iv_msgid = 'ZSTR'
        iv_msgno = '001'
        iv_msgv1 = |'{ iv_old_substring }' wurde durch '{ iv_new_substring }' ersetzt.|
      ).
    ELSE.
      mo_message_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgty = 'I'
        iv_msgid = 'ZSTR'
        iv_msgno = '002'
        iv_msgv1 = |Keine Ersetzungen für '{ iv_old_substring }' gefunden.|
      ).
    ENDIF.

    rs_result = lv_replaced_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_and_message( iv_input_string = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP' iv_old_substring = 'Hello' iv_new_substring = 'Hi' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP' msg = 'String sollte korrekt ersetzt werden.' ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' msg = 'Es sollte eine Erfolgsmeldung geben.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello World' msg = 'String sollte unverändert bleiben.' ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).

CLASS zcl_log_batch_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD run_batch_process.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.

    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = rv_log_handle
    ).

    IF rv_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_start_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
        iv_msgty      = 'I'
        iv_msgid      = 'ZBATCH'
        iv_msgno      = '001'
        iv_msgv1      = |Batch-Verarbeitung gestartet um { lv_start_timestamp } (UTC).|
        iv_probclass  = '1'
    ).

    " Simulate some processing and potential error
    DATA(lv_error_occurred) = abap_false.
    IF sy-uzeit MOD 2 = 0. " Simulate error every second run
      lv_error_occurred = abap_true.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_error_occurred = abap_true.
      cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
          iv_msgty      = 'E'
          iv_msgid      = 'ZBATCH'
          iv_msgno      = '002'
          iv_msgv1      = |Fehler während der Batch-Verarbeitung aufgetreten.|
          iv_probclass  = '4'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_end_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong_from_syst( ).
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle
        iv_msgty      = 'I'
        iv_msgid      = 'ZBATCH'
        iv_msgno      = '003'
        iv_msgv1      = |Batch-Verarbeitung beendet um { lv_end_timestamp } (UTC).|
        iv_probclass  = '1'
    ).

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = rv_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in ein anderes Format. Wenn dabei Datenfehler auftreten (z.B. ungültige Werte), sammeln Sie diese Fehler mit `cl_message_helper`. Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Transformation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für die Transformation. `cl_message_helper` für die Fehlermeldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_data_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_source_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
      EXPORTING
        et_target_flights TYPE tt_target_flight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_data_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_flights.
    LOOP AT it_source_flights INTO DATA(ls_source).
      DATA(ls_target) = CORRESPONDING ty_target_flight( ls_source MAPPING carrid = airline_id connid = flight_num fldate = flight_date ).

      " Simulate a data error: price too high
      IF ls_source-price > 1000.
        mo_message_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZTRANS'
          iv_msgno = '001'
          iv_msgv1 = |Flug { ls_source-carrid } { ls_source-connid } hat einen zu hohen Preis: { ls_source-price } { ls_source-currency }.|
        ).
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      ls_target-formatted_price = |{ ls_source-price } { ls_source-currency }|.
      APPEND ls_target TO et_target_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
    rt_messages = mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine Liste von Meldungen, die von `cl_message_helper` gesammelt wurden, nach ihrem Nachrichtentyp (E, W, I, S). Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Meldungen pro Typ und geben Sie das Ergebnis zurück. Nutzen Sie `FOR GROUPS`.

CLASS zcl_msg_group_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             msgty TYPE symsgty,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_msg_count.
    TYPES: tt_msg_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_msg_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_messages_by_type
      IMPORTING
        it_all_messages TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_msg_group_by_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_messages_by_type.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE tt_msg_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_msg IN it_all_messages GROUP BY ( msgty = ls_msg-msgty ) ASCENDING
      ( msgty = ls_msg-msgty
        count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine kritische Operation ausführt. Bei einem Fehler soll nicht nur eine Ausnahme ausgelöst, sondern auch ein detaillierter Fehler im Anwendungslog mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log` protokolliert werden, bevor die Ausnahme weitergegeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message` innerhalb eines `CATCH`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_log_critical_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_critical_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_log_critical_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.
    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = mo_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_critical_operation.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = 100 / iv_input.
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
          EXPORTING
            iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
            iv_msgty      = 'S'
            iv_msgid      = 'ZCRIT'
            iv_msgno      = '001'
            iv_msgv1      = |Kritische Operation erfolgreich mit Ergebnis { lv_result }.|
            iv_probclass  = '1'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
          EXPORTING
            iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
            iv_msgty      = 'E'
            iv_msgid      = 'ZCRIT'
            iv_msgno      = '002'
            iv_msgv1      = |Fehler bei kritischer Operation: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|
            iv_probclass  = '4'
        ).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle ).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_arith_error.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Wenn ein Flug nicht gefunden wird, fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung mit `cl_message_helper` hinzu. Nutzen Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `@DATA()` und String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO @DATA(...)` und `IF sy-subrc <> 0`. `cl_message_helper` für die Meldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_read_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      EXPORTING
        es_flight_data TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE cl_message_helper=>tt_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_read_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @es_flight_data
      WHERE carrid = @is_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = @is_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = @is_flight_key-fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      mo_message_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgty = 'E'
        iv_msgid = 'ZFLIGHT'
        iv_msgno = '001'
        iv_msgv1 = |Flug { is_flight_key-carrid } { is_flight_key-connid } am { is_flight_key-fldate } nicht gefunden.|
      ).
    ELSE.
      mo_message_helper->add_message(
        iv_msgty = 'S'
        iv_msgid = 'ZFLIGHT'
        iv_msgno = '002'
        iv_msgv1 = |Flug { is_flight_key-carrid } { is_flight_key-connid } am { is_flight_key-fldate } erfolgreich gefunden.|
      ).
    ENDIF.
    rt_messages = mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Integrationsprozess, bei dem Daten von einem externen System empfangen werden. Validieren Sie die empfangenen Daten. Sammeln Sie Validierungsfehler mit `cl_message_helper` und protokollieren Sie den gesamten Prozess (Start, Validierungsfehler, Ende) im Anwendungslog mit `cl_s_aut_bal_log`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_message_helper` für Validierungsfehler und `cl_s_aut_bal_log` für den Prozesslog. Nutzen Sie `VALUE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_integration_log_msg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_external_data,
             id      TYPE string,
             value1  TYPE i,
             value2  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_external_data.
    TYPES: tt_external_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_external_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_external_data
      IMPORTING
        it_external_data TYPE tt_external_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE bal_logh.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_message_helper TYPE REF TO cl_message_helper.
    DATA mo_log_handle TYPE bal_logh.
    METHODS constructor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_integration_log_msg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_message_helper = NEW cl_message_helper( ).

    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log.
    ls_log_header-alprog = sy-repid.
    ls_log_header-aluser = sy-uname.
    ls_log_header-aldate = sy-datum.
    ls_log_header-altime = sy-uzeit.
    ls_log_header-almode = 'A'.
    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log(
      EXPORTING
        is_log_header = ls_log_header
      IMPORTING
        ev_log_handle = mo_log_handle
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_external_data.
    rv_log_handle = mo_log_handle.
    IF mo_log_handle IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
      EXPORTING
        iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
        iv_msgty      = 'I'
        iv_msgid      = 'ZINT'
        iv_msgno      = '001'
        iv_msgv1      = |Integrationsprozess gestartet.|
        iv_probclass  = '1'
    ).

    LOOP AT it_external_data INTO DATA(ls_data).
      IF ls_data-value1 <= 0.
        mo_message_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZINT'
          iv_msgno = '002'
          iv_msgv1 = |Datenfehler für ID { ls_data-id }: Value1 muss positiv sein.|
        ).
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_data-value2 > 100.
        mo_message_helper->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'W'
          iv_msgid = 'ZINT'
          iv_msgno = '003'
          iv_msgv1 = |Warnung für ID { ls_data-id }: Value2 ist sehr hoch.|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_validation_messages) = mo_message_helper->get_messages( ).
    IF lt_validation_messages IS NOT INITIAL.
      LOOP AT lt_validation_messages INTO DATA(ls_val_msg).
        cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
          EXPORTING
            iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
            iv_msgty      = ls_val_msg-msgty
            iv_msgid      = ls_val_msg-msgid
            iv_msgno      = ls_val_msg-msgno
            iv_msgv1      = ls_val_msg-message
            iv_probclass  = SWITCH bal_probcl( ls_val_msg-msgty WHEN 'E' THEN '4' WHEN 'W' THEN '2' ELSE '1' )
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_s_aut_bal_log->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
          iv_msgty      = 'W'
          iv_msgid      = 'ZINT'
          iv_msgno      = '004'
          iv_msgv1      = |Integrationsprozess beendet mit { lines( lt_validation_messages ) } Validierungsfehlern/Warnungen.|
          iv_probclass  = '2'
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_s_aut_bal_log=>add_message(
        EXPORTING
          iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle
          iv_msgty      = 'S'
          iv_msgid      = 'ZINT'
          iv_msgno      = '005'
          iv_msgv1      = |Integrationsprozess erfolgreich beendet.|
          iv_probclass  = '1'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log( EXPORTING iv_log_handle = mo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_integration_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_integration_with_errors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_integration_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_integration_log_msg( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_integration_log_msg=>tt_external_data(
      ( id = 'EXT001' value1 = 10 value2 = 50 )
      ( id = 'EXT002' value1 = 20 value2 = 80 )
    ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->process_external_data( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_log_handle msg = 'Log-Handle sollte nicht initial sein.' in_case_of_failure = cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail_if_not_initial ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_integration_with_errors.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_integration_log_msg( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_integration_log_msg=>tt_external_data(
      ( id = 'EXT003' value1 = 0 value2 = 50 ) " Error
      ( id = 'EXT004' value1 = 30 value2 = 120 ) " Warning
    ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_cut->process_external_data( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_log_handle msg = 'Log-Handle sollte nicht initial sein.' in_case_of_failure = cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail_if_not_initial ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Integration von `cl_message_helper` für die Validierung von Daten und `cl_s_aut_bal_log` für die umfassende Protokollierung eines Integrationsprozesses. Validierungsfehler werden zunächst mit `cl_message_helper` gesammelt und dann in das Business Application Log übertragen. Dies bietet eine klare Trennung zwischen anwendungsspezifischen Meldungen und dem technischen Prozesslog, was die Fehleranalyse und das Monitoring erheblich verbessert.
keywords: cl_message_helper, cl_s_aut_bal_log, Integration, Data Validation, Error Handling, Logging, BAL

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse 'Shape' mit einer abstrakten Methode 'calculate_area'. Erstellen Sie zwei konkrete Unterklassen 'Circle' und 'Rectangle', die diese Methode implementieren. Berechnen Sie die Fläche für Instanzen beider Formen.
hint: Nutzen Sie ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHODS und REDEFINITION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_shape DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string.
    METHODS calculate_area ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS get_name FINAL RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_name = iv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_name.
    rv_name = mv_name.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( 'Circle' ).
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_radius * mv_radius * '3.1415926535'. " Pi
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_shape FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE decfloat16 iv_height TYPE decfloat16.
    METHODS calculate_area REDEFINITION.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE decfloat16.
    DATA mv_height TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_concrete_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    super->constructor( 'Rectangle' ).
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD calculate_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_area_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_area_calculation.
    DATA(lo_circle) = NEW zcl_concrete_circle( iv_radius = '10' ).
    DATA(lv_circle_area) = lo_circle->calculate_area( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_circle_area exp = '314.15926535' dec = 8 msg = 'Circle area incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_rectangle) = NEW zcl_concrete_rectangle( iv_width = '5' iv_height = '10' ).
    DATA(lv_rectangle_area) = lo_rectangle->calculate_area( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rectangle_area exp = '50' msg = 'Rectangle area incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` erzwingen eine gemeinsame Schnittstelle für Unterklassen, ohne eine vollständige Implementierung in der Basisklasse zu liefern. `REDEFINITION` ermöglicht es Unterklassen, die abstrakten Methoden spezifisch zu implementieren. Dies fördert Polymorphie und eine saubere Objektorientierung.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, REDEFINITION, Object Orientation, Polymorphism

Instructions: Definieren Sie ein Interface mit einer Standardimplementierung (Default Method) für eine Methode. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert und die Standardmethode nutzt, sowie eine weitere Klasse, die die Standardmethode überschreibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie INTERFACES ... DEFAULT METHODS.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  METHODS get_default_prefix DEFAULT 'Default Log:'.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_simple_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_simple_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ), iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
    METHODS zif_logger~get_default_prefix REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    WRITE: / zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ), iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_logger~get_default_prefix.
    rv_value = 'Custom Log:'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_default_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_default_method.
    DATA(lo_simple_logger) = NEW zcl_simple_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_simple_prefix) = lo_simple_logger->zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_simple_prefix exp = 'Default Log:' msg = 'Simple logger prefix incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_custom_logger) = NEW zcl_custom_logger( ).
    DATA(lv_custom_prefix) = lo_custom_logger->zif_logger~get_default_prefix( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_custom_prefix exp = 'Custom Log:' msg = 'Custom logger prefix incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DEFAULT METHODS` in Interfaces ermöglichen es, eine Standardimplementierung für Methoden direkt im Interface zu definieren. Implementierende Klassen können diese Standardimplementierung entweder nutzen oder mit `REDEFINITION` überschreiben. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und bietet mehr Flexibilität.
keywords: INTERFACE, DEFAULT METHODS, REDEFINITION, Object Orientation

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Factory Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse für Produkte und einer Factory-Klasse, die konkrete Produktinstanzen basierend auf einem Typ-Parameter erstellt.
hint: Nutzen Sie ABSTRACT CLASS, CREATE PUBLIC/PROTECTED und CASE TYPE OF.
solution:
CLASS zcl_product_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_product_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_desc = 'This is Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_product_abstract FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_desc = 'This is Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zcl_product_abstract.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return initial
        " For simplicity, we'll return initial here.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory_creation.
    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_product_a msg = 'Product A not created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_a->get_description( ) exp = 'This is Product A' msg = 'Product A description incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_product_b msg = 'Product B not created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_product_b->get_description( ) exp = 'This is Product B' msg = 'Product B description incorrect' ).

    DATA(lo_product_unknown) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'X' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_product_unknown msg = 'Unknown product should be initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory Method Pattern entkoppelt die Erstellung von Objekten von ihrer Verwendung. Die abstrakte Basisklasse `zcl_product_abstract` definiert die Schnittstelle, während die Factory-Methode `create_product` in `zcl_product_factory` die Logik zur Instanziierung konkreter Unterklassen (`zcl_product_a`, `zcl_product_b`) kapselt. `NEW` wird für die Instanziierung verwendet.
keywords: Factory Method, Design Pattern, ABSTRACT CLASS, Object Orientation, NEW

Instructions: Kodieren und Dekodieren Sie einen URL-String, der Sonderzeichen und Leerzeichen enthält, unter Verwendung der Klasse CL_HTTP_UTILITY.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE und CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_DECODE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_encoder_decoder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS encode_decode_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_raw_url TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_encoded_url TYPE string
        ev_decoded_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_encoder_decoder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD encode_decode_url.
    ev_encoded_url = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( iv_raw_url ).
    ev_decoded_url = cl_http_utility=>url_decode( ev_encoded_url ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_url_encoding_decoding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_encoding_decoding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_url_encoder_decoder( ).
    DATA(lv_raw_url) = `https://example.com/search?q=ABAP Modern & Version=7.50`.
    DATA: lv_encoded TYPE string,
          lv_decoded TYPE string.

    lo_cut->encode_decode_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_raw_url   = lv_raw_url
      IMPORTING
        ev_encoded_url = lv_encoded
        ev_decoded_url = lv_decoded
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_encoded exp = `https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com%2Fsearch%3Fq%3DABAP%20Modern%20%26%20Version%3D7.50` msg = 'URL encoding incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decoded exp = lv_raw_url msg = 'URL decoding incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE` und `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_DECODE` sind statische Methoden, die eine einfache und standardkonforme Möglichkeit bieten, URLs für die Übertragung zu kodieren und wieder zu dekodieren. Dies ist entscheidend, um Sonderzeichen in URLs korrekt zu behandeln.
keywords: CL_HTTP_UTILITY, URL_ENCODE, URL_DECODE, HTTP, String Processing

Instructions: Parsen Sie die Parameter aus einem URL-Query-String und speichern Sie diese in einer Hash-Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>PARSE_URL_PARAMETERS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_param_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.
    TYPES tt_params TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_param WITH UNIQUE KEY name.

    METHODS parse_query_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_query_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_param_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_query_string.
    DATA(lt_raw_params) = cl_http_utility=>parse_url_parameters( iv_query_string ).
    rt_params = VALUE #( FOR <fs_param> IN lt_raw_params ( name = <fs_param>-name value = <fs_param>-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_param_parsing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_param_parsing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_url_param_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = `param1=value1&param2=value%20with%20space&param3=another_value`.
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->parse_query_string( lv_query ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_params ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect number of parameters' ).

    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'param1' INTO DATA(ls_param1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param1-value exp = 'value1' msg = 'Param1 value incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_params WITH KEY name = 'param2' INTO DATA(ls_param2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_param2-value exp = 'value with space' msg = 'Param2 value incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>PARSE_URL_PARAMETERS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um URL-Query-Strings in eine interne Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren zu zerlegen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` demonstriert eine moderne und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren und zu füllen.
keywords: CL_HTTP_UTILITY, PARSE_URL_PARAMETERS, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR, HTTP

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine vollständige URL aus einer Basis-URL und einer Liste von Parametern, wobei die Parameter korrekt URL-kodiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates und CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.
    TYPES tt_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_url TYPE string
        it_params   TYPE tt_params OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_url.
    DATA(lv_query_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs_param> IN it_params
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
          |{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( <fs_param>-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( <fs_param>-value ) }|
        ELSE
          |{ s }&{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( <fs_param>-name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( <fs_param>-value ) }|
      )
    ).

    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_full_url = |{ iv_base_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_full_url = iv_base_url.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_url_building FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_url_building_no_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_building.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lv_base_url) = `https://api.example.com/data`.
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE zcl_url_builder=>tt_params(
      ( name = 'id' value = '123' )
      ( name = 'filter' value = 'active users' )
      ( name = 'sort' value = 'name asc' )

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Basisklasse, die einen Algorithmus-Skelett definiert, und konkreten Unterklassen, die spezifische Schritte implementieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHODS, FINAL METHODS und REDEFINITION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_report_template DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

    METHODS process_data ABSTRACT.
    METHODS display_results ABSTRACT.
