CLASS zcl_sales_report DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_report_template FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mt_sales_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS select_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS process_data REDEFINITION.
    METHODS display_results REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_report IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @mt_sales_data UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    LOOP AT mt_sales_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sales>).
      <fs_sales>-price = <fs_sales>-price * '1.1'. " Increase price by 10%
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_results.
    WRITE: / '--- Sales Report ---'.
    LOOP AT mt_sales_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sales>).
      WRITE: / <fs_sales>-carrid, <fs_sales>-connid, <fs_sales>-fldate, <fs_sales>-price.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sales_report FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sales_report.
    DATA(lo_sales_report) = NEW zcl_sales_report( ).
    " Redirect output for testing purposes (simplified for example)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = lo_sales_report msg = 'Sales report object not created' ).
    " We cannot directly assert the output of WRITE statements in a unit test.
    " A real test would involve capturing output or checking internal state changes.
    " For this example, we'll just ensure the method runs without dump.
    lo_sales_report->run_report( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Report execution should not dump' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Template Method Pattern definiert das Skelett eines Algorithmus in einer Basisklasse (`run_report`), überlässt aber die Implementierung bestimmter Schritte (`select_data`, `process_data`, `display_results`) den Unterklassen. `ABSTRACT METHODS` erzwingen die Implementierung in Unterklassen, während `FINAL METHODS` verhindern, dass das Algorithmus-Skelett selbst überschrieben wird.
keywords: Template Method, Design Pattern, ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, FINAL METHOD, Object Orientation

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie einen komplexen URL-Query-String aus einer Hash-Tabelle von Parametern, wobei die Parameter korrekt URL-kodiert und mit `REDUCE` aggregiert werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`, `FOR`, `VALUE` und `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_complex_url_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_param_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF string WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS build_query_string
      IMPORTING
        it_params TYPE ty_param_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_complex_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_query_string.
    rv_query_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR param_name IN SORTED it_params ASCENDING
      LET param_value = it_params[ param_name ] IN
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN
          |{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param_name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param_value ) }|
        ELSE
          |{ s }&{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param_name ) }={ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param_value ) }|
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_query_string FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_params FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_query_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE zcl_complex_url_builder=>ty_param_map(
      ( 'param_c' = 'value C' )
      ( 'param_a' = 'value A with space' )
      ( 'param_b' = 'value B' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_cut->build_query_string( lt_params ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_query
      exp = `param_a=value%20A%20with%20space&param_b=value%20B&param_c=value%20C`
      msg = 'Complex query string incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_params.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_complex_url_builder( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE zcl_complex_url_builder=>ty_param_map( ).
    DATA(lv_query) = lo_cut->build_query_string( lt_params ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_query exp = '' msg = 'Empty query string incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `REDUCE` mit `FOR` und `LET` in Kombination mit `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE`, um eine Hash-Tabelle von Parametern in einen URL-kodierten Query-String zu transformieren. Die `SORTED` Iteration stellt sicher, dass die Parameter in einer definierten Reihenfolge (alphabetisch) hinzugefügt werden, was für konsistente URLs wichtig sein kann.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, VALUE, LET, CL_HTTP_UTILITY, URL_ENCODE, Hashed Table, String Processing, HTTP

CLASS zcl_abstract_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.

    DATA(lt_objects) = VALUE zcl_abstract_processor=>tt_object_refs(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Liste von Objekten filtert. Die Filterkriterien sollen durch eine abstrakte Methode in den Unterklassen definiert werden, die einen booleschen Wert zurückgibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHODS, FILTER und FOR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_filterable_object TYPE REF TO object.
    TYPES: tt_filterable_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filterable_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_objects
      IMPORTING
        it_all_objects TYPE tt_filterable_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_objects) TYPE tt_filterable_objects.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS is_match ABSTRACT IMPORTING io_object TYPE ty_filterable_object RETURNING VALUE(rb_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_objects.
    rt_filtered_objects = FILTER #( it_all_objects USING is_match = is_match ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_starts_with_a_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_filter FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS is_match REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_starts_with_a_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_match.
    DATA(lo_string_obj) = CAST zcl_string_object( io_object ).
    IF lo_string_obj->mv_value CP 'A*'.
      rb_match = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_match = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_starts_with_a FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_starts_with_a_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_all_objects) = VALUE zcl_abstract_filter=>tt_filterable_objects(
      ( NEW zcl_string_object( 'Apple' ) )
      ( NEW zcl_string_object( 'Banana' ) )
      ( NEW zcl_string_object( 'Apricot' ) )

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHODS` in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Operator. Die abstrakte Methode `is_match` definiert das Filterkriterium, das von Unterklassen implementiert wird. Der `FILTER` Operator wendet diese Kriterien effizient auf eine interne Tabelle an, was eine moderne und funktionale Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.
keywords: ABSTRACT CLASS, ABSTRACT METHOD, FILTER, FOR, Object Orientation, Functional Programming, Internal Tables

Instructions: Definieren Sie zwei unterschiedliche lokale Strukturtypen. Füllen Sie eine Struktur und übertragen Sie die gleichnamigen Felder in die andere Struktur mit `CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für die Strukturdefinitionen und `CORRESPONDING #( ... )` für die Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dat_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field_x TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data IMPORTING is_source TYPE ty_source_data
                     RETURNING VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dat_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dat_corresponding( ).
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dat_corresponding=>ty_source_data(
      field1 = 'Value A'
      field2 = 123
      field3 = 'Value C'
    ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field1
      exp = 'Value A'
      msg = 'Field1 not mapped correctly'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_target-field3
      exp = 'Value C'
      msg = 'Field3 not mapped correctly'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_target-field_x
      msg = 'Field_x should be initial as no corresponding field in source'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `TYPES` ermöglicht die Definition spezifischer Strukturen für Quell- und Zieldaten. Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator (hier in der funktionalen Form) ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zwischen Strukturen oder Tabellen mit gleichnamigen Feldern zu verschieben, ohne explizite Zuweisungen für jedes Feld vornehmen zu müssen.
keywords: TYPES, CORRESPONDING, Structures, Data Transfer, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen generischen Datenreferenztyp (`TYPE REF TO DATA`) als Parameter akzeptiert, um den Inhalt eines beliebigen Datenobjekts dynamisch zu lesen und als String zurückzugeben.

CLASS zcl_dyn_ref_to_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_data_ref TYPE REF TO DATA.
    METHODS get_data_as_string IMPORTING ir_data TYPE ty_data_ref

CLASS zcl_dyn_ref_to_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_as_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

      rv_string = |{ <fs_data> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_string = 'Error: Data reference not valid'.
    ENDIF.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_data_as_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_ref_to_data( ).
    DATA lv_value TYPE string VALUE 'Hello Dynamic World'.

explanation: Die Verwendung von `TYPES ty_data_ref TYPE REF TO DATA` ermöglicht es, Methoden zu schreiben, die mit beliebigen Datenobjekten arbeiten können, deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist. In Kombination mit `ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>` wird der Inhalt der Referenz einem Feldsymbol zugewiesen, was den dynamischen Zugriff und die Verarbeitung ermöglicht. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die einfache Konvertierung in einen String verwendet.
keywords: TYPES, REF TO DATA, ASSIGN, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, RTTI

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den `MAX_SEATS` aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um 10%, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` für effiziente Modifikationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs> WHERE ...` und modifizieren Sie `<fs>-field`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_assign_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_seats IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                     CHANGING ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_assign_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_seats.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight> WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-max_seats = <fs_flight>-max_seats * '1.1'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_seats FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_seats.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>`-Syntax ist die performanteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Einträge zu modifizieren. Anstatt Zeilen zu kopieren, wird ein Feldsymbol direkt auf die Tabellenzeile referenziert, was direkte Änderungen ohne zusätzlichen Speicher- und Zeitaufwand ermöglicht. Die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen effizient.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Struktur und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Lesen Sie den Wert des dynamisch angegebenen Feldes und geben Sie ihn als String zurück.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             name   TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Error: Component not found'.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein generisches Feldsymbol (`TYPE ANY`) akzeptiert, das auf ein Objekt einer Oberklasse zeigt. Versuchen Sie, dieses Feldsymbol sicher auf ein Feldsymbol eines spezifischeren Unterklassentyps herunterzucasten.

CLASS zcl_oo_fs_casting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS downcast_field_symbol IMPORTING ir_generic_fs TYPE any
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rr_sub_type) TYPE REF TO lcl_sub.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_fs_casting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD downcast_field_symbol.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sub> TYPE lcl_sub.

    ASSIGN ir_generic_fs TO <fs_sub> CASTING.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rr_sub_type = REF #( <fs_sub> ). " Return reference to the downcasted object
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_downcast_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_fs_casting( ).
    DATA(lo_sub_instance) = NEW lcl_sub( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_generic> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lo_sub_instance TO <fs_generic>.

    DATA(lo_downcasted) = lo_cut->downcast_field_symbol( <fs_generic> ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lo_downcasted
      msg = 'Downcast to sub class should be successful'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_downcasted->get_sub_type( )
      exp = 'Sub'
      msg = 'Method of sub class should be callable'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_downcast_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_fs_casting( ).
    DATA(lo_super_instance) = NEW lcl_super( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_generic> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lo_super_instance TO <fs_generic>.

    DATA(lo_downcasted) = lo_cut->downcast_field_symbol( <fs_generic> ).

Dies ist entscheidend in der objektorientierten Programmierung, wenn man mit generischen Referenzen arbeitet, aber spezifische Methoden der Unterklasse aufrufen möchte. `sy-subrc` nach `ASSIGN` ist wichtig für die Fehlerbehandlung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Flugdatensatz aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf `carrid` und `connid` und modifizieren Sie dessen `fldate` direkt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE itab WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING <fs>`.

CLASS zcl_itb_read_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS update_flight_date IMPORTING is_key      TYPE ty_sflight_key
                                        iv_new_date TYPE sflight-fldate
                               CHANGING ct_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_read_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_date.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight_data.

    READ TABLE ct_flights WITH KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
                                 connid = is_key-connid
                                 ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-fldate = iv_new_date.
      rv_updated = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit einem beliebigen Zeilentyp (`TYPE STANDARD TABLE`) akzeptiert. Die Methode soll dynamisch eine neue interne Tabelle desselben Typs erstellen und mit den ersten N Zeilen der Quelltabelle füllen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und -bearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_first_n_rows IMPORTING it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                                        iv_num_rows     TYPE i
                              RETURNING VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_copy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_first_n_rows.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line>  TYPE any.

    " Get description of source table
    lr_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
    lr_line_descr  ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

    " Create dynamic target table of the same type
    CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    " Assign source table to field symbol
    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_target_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line> UP TO iv_num_rows.
        " Create new line for target table
        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_new_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_line_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_new_line->* TO <fs_target_line>.

        " Move content and append
        <fs_target_line> = <fs_source_line>.
        APPEND <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_table>.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_copy( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: ty_test_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE ty_test_data_tab(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Row 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Row 2' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Row 3' )
      ( id = 4 text = 'Row 4' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_target) = lo_cut->copy_first_n_rows( it_source_table = lt_source iv_num_rows = 2 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_table> TYPE ty_test_data_tab.
    ASSIGN lr_target->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned(
      act = <fs_target_table>
      msg = 'Target table should be assigned'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( <fs_target_table> )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Expected 2 rows in target table'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_target_table>[ 1 ]-id
      exp = 1
      msg = 'First row ID mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = <fs_target_table>[ 2 ]-text
      exp = 'Row 2'
      msg = 'Second row text mismatch'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Erstellung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen, deren Typ zur Kompilierzeit unbekannt ist. `cl_abap_typedescr` und `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` werden verwendet, um den Typ der Quelltabelle zu ermitteln und eine Zieltabelle desselben Typs zu erstellen. Feldsymbole (`ASSIGN`) sind unerlässlich, um auf die dynamisch erstellten Datenobjekte zuzugreifen und sie zu manipulieren.
keywords: ASSIGN, CREATE DATA, TYPE HANDLE, Dynamic Programming, RTTI, Field Symbols, Internal Tables

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Tabellentyp für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbank. Filtern Sie anschließend die Tabelle nach Flügen mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die gefilterten Flüge zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für den Tabellentyp und `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)` für die Datenbankabfrage. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` oder `FILTER` für die Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_types_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_types_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_tab.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)`-Syntax ist eine moderne Art, Daten aus der Datenbank zu lesen, wobei `@DATA` für die Inline-Deklaration der Zieltabelle steht. Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um interne Tabellen zu filtern.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Datenreferenz (`TYPE REF TO DATA`) akzeptiert. Ermitteln Sie mit RTTI den Typ des referenzierten Objekts und geben Sie den Namen des Typs als String zurück. Wenn es sich um eine interne Tabelle handelt, geben Sie zusätzlich den Zeilentyp zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref` und `CAST` auf `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_info IMPORTING ir_data_ref TYPE REF TO data
                            RETURNING VALUE(rv_type_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_info.
    DATA: lr_typedescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_tabledescr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    lr_typedescr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data_ref ).

    rv_type_info = |Type: { lr_typedescr->get_name( ) }|.

    TRY.
        lr_tabledescr ?= lr_typedescr.
        IF lr_tabledescr IS BOUND.
          DATA(lr_line_type) = lr_tabledescr->get_table_line_type( ).
          rv_type_info = rv_type_info && | (Table Line Type: { lr_line_type->get_name( ) })|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Not a table type, ignore
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_line,

  METHOD test_get_type_info_structure.

             comp1 TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA ls_struct TYPE ty_test_struct.
    DATA lr_struct TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF ls_struct INTO lr_struct.

    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->get_type_info( lr_struct ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Die `CAST`-Operation (`?=`) wird verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob es sich um einen Tabellentyp handelt, und um dann spezifische Informationen wie den Zeilentyp abzurufen. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von `SFLIGHT` akzeptiert. Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `GROUP BY` um die Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft zu gruppieren und für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln. Geben Sie eine Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und Fluganzahl zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für die Ergebnisstruktur und `FOR GROUPS OF ... INTO DATA(group_key)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_flight_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts IMPORTING it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF DATA(ls_flight_group) IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight_group-carrid
                         ( carrid = ls_flight_group-carrid
                           flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit einem beliebigen Zeilentyp (`TYPE STANDARD TABLE`) und einen Feldnamen als String akzeptiert. Die Methode soll den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile der Tabelle dynamisch auf einen neuen Wert setzen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_dynamic_field IMPORTING it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
                                            iv_field_name   TYPE string
                                            iv_new_value    TYPE string
                                   CHANGING ct_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_target_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_dynamic_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_dynamic_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_update( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             status TYPE string,
             value  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: ty_test_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_test_data_tab(
      ( id = 1 status = 'A' value = 'Old Value 1' )
      ( id = 2 status = 'B' value = 'Old Value 2' )
      ( id = 3 status = 'C' value = 'Old Value 3' )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_dynamic_field(
      EXPORTING
        it_source_table = lt_data " Not used, but required for signature
        iv_field_name   = 'STATUS'
        iv_new_value    = 'X'
      CHANGING
        ct_target_table = lt_data
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-status
      exp = 'X'
      msg = 'Status of first row not updated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 2 ]-status
      exp = 'X'
      msg = 'Status of second row not updated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 3 ]-status
      exp = 'X'
      msg = 'Status of third row not updated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 'Old Value 1'
      msg = 'Other fields should not be affected'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs_line>` für die effiziente Iteration über eine interne Tabelle mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_field>` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf ein spezifisches Feld jeder Zeile. Dies ermöglicht es, generische Update-Routinen zu schreiben, die den Feldnamen zur Laufzeit erhalten und den Wert entsprechend setzen können, ohne den genauen Tabellentyp zur Kompilierzeit kennen zu müssen.
keywords: ASSIGN, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Field Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Update

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Typ für eine interne Tabelle, die nur die Felder `carrid` und `connid` aus `SFLIGHT` enthält. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit Daten aus `SFLIGHT` und geben Sie sie zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES` für die Struktur und den Tabellentyp. Verwenden Sie `SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: ty_flight_key_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_keys RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE ty_flight_key_tab.
ENDCLASS.

      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_keys FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_keys.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_projection( ).
    DATA(lt_keys) = lo_cut->get_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_keys
      msg = 'Should retrieve flight keys'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_key-carrid
        msg = 'Carrier ID should not be initial'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_key-connid
        msg = 'Connection ID should not be initial'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check if a known entry exists
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_test_key) = lt_keys[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
          act = ls_test_key
          msg = 'Known flight key LH 0400 should exist'
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Known flight key LH 0400 not found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TYPES` zur Definition einer spezifischen Struktur (`ty_flight_key`) und eines Tabellentyps (`ty_flight_key_tab`) ermöglicht eine klare und typsichere Datenhaltung. Die `SELECT`-Anweisung projiziert nur die benötigten Felder in die interne Tabelle, was effizienter ist als `SELECT *` wenn nicht alle Felder benötigt werden. Die Inline-Deklaration `@rt_flight_keys` ist eine moderne Vereinfachung.
keywords: TYPES, SELECT, Internal Tables, Projection, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine lokale Interface-Typdefinition und eine Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert. Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Referenz auf das Interface akzeptiert und eine Methode des Interfaces aufruft.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TYPES ty_if_ref TYPE REF TO lif_my_interface` und `CALL METHOD ir_interface->do_something`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_interface_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES lif_my_interface.

    METHODS call_interface_method IMPORTING ir_interface TYPE REF TO lif_my_interface
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE lif_my_interface.
  METHODS do_something RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_oo_interface_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD lif_my_interface~do_something.
    rv_text = 'Method called via interface!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_interface_method.
    rv_result = ir_interface->do_something( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_interface_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_interface_call.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_interface_call( ).

    " The class itself implements the interface
    DATA(lr_interface) TYPE REF TO lif_my_interface.
    lr_interface ?= lo_cut.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound(
      act = lr_interface
      msg = 'Interface reference should be bound'
    ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_interface_method( lr_interface ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Method called via interface!'
      msg = 'Interface method call failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `TYPES` zur Definition eines Referenztyps auf ein lokales Interface (`lif_my_interface`). Interfaces fördern die lose Kopplung und Polymorphie in der objektorientierten Programmierung. Die Methode `call_interface_method` kann jede Klasse akzeptieren, die `lif_my_interface` implementiert, was den Code flexibler und erweiterbarer macht.
keywords: TYPES, Interface, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, REF TO

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

                                        iv_field_name TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sort_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_sort( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sort_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sort_data.
    TYPES: ty_sort_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sort_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_sort_data_tab(
      ( id = 3 name = 'Charlie' value = 100 )
      ( id = 1 name = 'Alpha'   value = 300 )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Bravo'   value = 200 )
    ).

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO ty_sort_data_tab.
    GET REFERENCE OF lt_data INTO lr_data.

    lo_cut->sort_dynamic_table( ir_table_ref = lr_data iv_field_name = 'NAME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-name
      exp = 'Alpha'
      msg = 'Table not sorted correctly by NAME (first entry)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 3 ]-name
      exp = 'Charlie'
      msg = 'Table not sorted correctly by NAME (last entry)'

    lo_cut->sort_dynamic_table( ir_table_ref = lr_data iv_field_name = 'VALUE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value
      exp = 100
      msg = 'Table not sorted correctly by VALUE (first entry)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_data[ 3 ]-value
      exp = 300
      msg = 'Table not sorted correctly by VALUE (last entry)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Durch `ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>` wird das Feldsymbol auf die übergebene Tabelle referenziert. Die `SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name)`-Syntax ermöglicht die Sortierung nach einem zur Laufzeit bestimmten Feld, was für generische Sortierfunktionen sehr nützlich ist.

Instructions: Finden Sie den kleinsten Flugpreis aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (simuliert sflights) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft, indem Sie eine Variable mit dem maximal möglichen Wert für einen Dezimaltyp initialisieren und den `REDUCE`-Operator verwenden.
hint: Initialisieren Sie den Akkumulator von `REDUCE` mit `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_min_price_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_min_price_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_price.
    rv_min_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT min_price = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT min_price = COND #( WHEN flight-price < min_price THEN flight-price ELSE min_price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie die Inline-Deklaration für die Range-Tabelle und den `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_simple_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,

           END OF ty_range_line.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_simple_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_carrid_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( 
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = iv_carrid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_simple_range( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_carrid_range( 'LH' ).

      exp = 'EQ'
      msg = 'Incorrect option'

      msg = 'Incorrect low value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die moderne ABAP-Syntax mit `VALUE #( )` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Definition von internen Tabellen, einschließlich Range-Tabellen. Dies ist effizienter als die traditionelle `APPEND`-Anweisung.

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus, deren Flugdatum im aktuellen Monat liegt.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für das Flugdatum und verwenden Sie diese in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_fldate_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             high   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_range_fldate_line.
    TYPES tt_range_fldate TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_fldate_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_current_month
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_select_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_current_month.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = lv_current_date.
    lv_first_day_of_month+6(2) = '01'. " Set day to 01

    DATA(lv_last_day_of_month) = lv_first_day_of_month.
    CALL FUNCTION 'LAST_DAY_OF_MONTHS'
      EXPORTING
        day_in            = lv_current_date
      IMPORTING
        last_day_of_month = lv_last_day_of_month.

    DATA(lt_fldate_range) = VALUE tt_range_fldate(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = lv_first_day_of_month high = lv_last_day_of_month )
    ).

    " In a real scenario, this would select from the database.
    " For unit testing, we simulate with dummy data.
    " SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_flights WHERE fldate IN @lt_fldate_range.
    DATA(lt_dummy_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251215' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251120' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Previous month
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251231' price = '75.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20260105' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Next month
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_dummy_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE fldate IN lt_fldate_range ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_current_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_current_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_select_with_range( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_current_month( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 3 " Expecting 3 flights for current month (20251201, 20251215, 20251231)
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= '20251201' AND ls_flight-fldate <= '20251231' )
        msg = |Flight date { ls_flight-fldate } not in current month|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Range-Tabellen sind ein mächtiges Werkzeug für dynamische Selektionen. In modernen ABAP-Versionen können sie direkt in `SELECT`-Anweisungen mit `IN` verwendet werden. Für interne Tabellen kann der `FILTER`-Operator mit Ranges genutzt werden, was eine flexible und effiziente Datenmanipulation ermöglicht.
keywords: RANGES, SELECT, sflights, Date, FILTER

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, deren Flugnummern mit '4' beginnen oder zwischen '0010' und '0020' liegen.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle mit `CP` und `BT` Einträgen und verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_with_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_connid_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid_line.
    TYPES tt_range_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_filter_with_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_connid.
    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE tt_range_connid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = '04*' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '0010' high = '0020' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE connid IN lt_connid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,

    mt_test_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0015' fldate = '20251202' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0005' fldate = '20251120' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251231' price = '75.00'  currency = 'EUR' )

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener Integer-Wert innerhalb der gültigen Grenzen des ABAP-Typs `i` liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int` und `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int` für die Grenzwerte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_int_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_integer_in_bounds
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_int_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_integer_in_bounds.
    IF iv_value >= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>min_int AND
       iv_value <= cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_int.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle für Fluggesellschaften basierend auf einer Liste von Strings (die auch Wildcards enthalten können) und verwenden Sie diese, um Flüge aus einer simulierten `sflights`-Tabelle auszuwählen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die dynamische Erstellung der Range-Tabelle und den `FILTER`-Operator für die Selektion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             high   TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_range_carrid_line.
    TYPES tt_range_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_carrid_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_carrids TYPE string_table
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid.
    DATA(lt_carrid_range) = VALUE tt_range_carrid(
      FOR ls_carrid_pattern IN it_carrids
      ( sign = 'I'
        option = COND #( WHEN ls_carrid_pattern CA '*' THEN 'CP' ELSE 'EQ' )
        low = ls_carrid_pattern
      )
    ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN lt_carrid_range ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_eq FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_cp FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_range_mixed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_input FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0015' fldate = '20251202' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0005' fldate = '20251120' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251231' price = '75.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0025' fldate = '20260105' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_range_eq.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'DL' ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid( it_carrids = lt_carrid_input it_flights = mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'DL' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_range_cp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'U*' ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid( it_carrids = lt_carrid_input it_flights = mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_range_mixed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'A*' ) ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid( it_carrids = lt_carrid_input it_flights = mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_dynamic_range( ).
    DATA(lt_carrid_input) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_dynamic_carrid( it_carrids = lt_carrid_input it_flights = mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Iteratoren und `COND`-Ausdrücken ermöglicht die dynamische und flexible Erstellung von Range-Tabellen basierend auf variablen Eingaben. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn Filterkriterien zur Laufzeit generiert werden müssen, z.B. aus Benutzereingaben. Der `FILTER`-Operator wendet diese dynamisch erstellten Ranges effizient auf interne Tabellen an.
keywords: RANGES, FOR, COND, FILTER, Dynamic Programming, Wildcards

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die den Standardwert für einen String-Typ zurückgibt, wenn ein leerer String übergeben wird, ansonsten den übergebenen String.
hint: Der Standardwert für einen String ist ein leerer String. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>initial_string`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_default_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_default_if_empty
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_default_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_default_if_empty.
    rv_output_string = COND string(
      WHEN iv_input_string IS INITIAL THEN cl_abap_exceptional_values=>initial_string
      ELSE iv_input_string
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_default_string( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_default_if_empty( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result

  METHOD test_non_empty_string_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_default_string( ).

Dies ist besonders nützlich in funktionalen Ausdrücken, wo eine kompakte Zuweisung basierend auf einer Bedingung gewünscht ist.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter Flugpreis in einer vordefinierten Range von akzeptablen Preisen liegt.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Range-Tabelle mit `BT` (Between) und verwenden Sie den `IN`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_price_range_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_price_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-price,
             high   TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_range_price_line.
    TYPES tt_range_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_price_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_price_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_price_range_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_price_in_range.
    DATA(lt_acceptable_prices) = VALUE tt_range_price(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'BT' low = '50.00' high = '200.00' )
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = '150.00' ) " Exclude 150.00
    ).

    IF iv_price IN lt_acceptable_prices.
      rv_in_range = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_in_range = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_in_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_below_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_above_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_excluded FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_at_boundary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_in_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_price_range_check( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` aus, deren Flugnummern nicht in einer bestimmten Liste von ausgeschlossenen Flugnummern enthalten sind.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle mit `EXCLUDE` (`E`) und `EQ` (`EQ`) Einträgen und verwenden Sie diese in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung mit `NOT IN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_exclude_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_connid_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,
             option TYPE ddshlvalue-option,
             low    TYPE sflight-connid,
             high   TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_range_connid_line.
    TYPES tt_range_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_range_connid_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_excluding_connids
      IMPORTING
        it_excluded_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_exclude_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_excluding_connids.
    DATA(lt_connid_range) = VALUE tt_range_connid(
      FOR ls_connid IN it_excluded_connids
      ( sign = 'E' option = 'EQ' low = ls_connid )
    ).

    " Simulate sflights data
    DATA(lt_dummy_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '50.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251120' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251231' price = '75.00'  currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20260105' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_dummy_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE connid IN lt_connid_range ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Flugpreisen aus einer internen Tabelle, wobei Sie sicherstellen, dass die Summe der Preise nicht den maximalen Wert eines Dezimaltyps überschreitet, um einen Überlauf zu vermeiden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec` für eine Überlaufprüfung und den `SUM`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_avg_price_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_avg_price_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = VALUE sflight-price( 0 ).
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      " Simple overflow check (can be more sophisticated)
      IF lv_total_price > cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec - ls_flight-price.
        " Handle potential overflow, e.g., raise exception or return max_dec
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
      ENDIF.
      lv_total_price = lv_total_price + ls_flight-price.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_test_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    METHODS setup FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_price_normal FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_price_empty FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_price_overflow RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    mt_test_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251120' price = '300.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_normal.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_avg_price_check( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_avg_price_check( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_average_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_avg_price exp = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_price_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_avg_price_check( ).
    DATA(lt_large_prices) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec - 1000 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '2000.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_average_price( lt_large_prices ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Caught expected cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei arithmetischen Operationen mit großen Zahlen ist es wichtig, potenzielle Überläufe zu berücksichtigen. `cl_abap_exceptional_values=>max_dec` kann verwendet werden, um vor der Addition zu prüfen, ob der maximale Wert des Dezimaltyps überschritten wird. Dies erhöht die Robustheit der Anwendung und verhindert unerwartete Fehler.
keywords: cl_abap_exceptional_values, Math, Overflow, Decimal, Exception Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Range-Tabelle, die alle Fluggesellschaften auswählt, deren Name mit 'A' beginnt und alle, deren Name mit 'Z' endet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_ai_complex_cp_range DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_range_carrid_line,
             sign   TYPE ddshlvalue-sign,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_range) TYPE tt_range_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_ai_complex_cp_range IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_complex_carrid_range.
    rt_range = VALUE #( 
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = 'A*' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'CP' low = '*Z' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_complex_carrid_range FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_complex_carrid_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_abap_ai_complex_cp_range( ).
    DATA(lt_range) = lo_cut->create_complex_carrid_range( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_range ) exp = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-sign exp = 'I' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-option exp = 'CP' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 1 ]-low exp = 'A*' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_range[ 2 ]-low exp = '*Z' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Range-Tabellen unterstützen den `CP`-Operator (Contains Pattern), der die Verwendung von Wildcards ermöglicht. Dies ist sehr nützlich, um flexible Suchmuster zu definieren, die dann in `SELECT`-Anweisungen oder mit dem `FILTER`-Operator angewendet werden können. Die moderne `VALUE #( )`-Syntax macht die Definition solcher komplexen Ranges sehr übersichtlich.
keywords: RANGES, CP, Wildcards, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der mit dem UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) beginnt, gefolgt von einem Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_order_mark_utf8`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_char_bom DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_utf8_string_with_bom RETURNING VALUE(rv_utf8_string) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_char_bom IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_utf8_string_with_bom.
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hallo Welt!'.
    DATA(lv_xtext) TYPE xstring.

    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text     = lv_text
        encoding = 'UTF-8'
      IMPORTING
        buffer   = lv_xtext
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
* Handle error, e.g., RAISE EXCEPTION
    ENDIF.

    rv_utf8_string = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_order_mark_utf8 && lv_xtext.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_utf8_bom_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf8_bom_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_char_bom( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_utf8_string_with_bom( ).
    DATA(lv_bom) = cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_order_mark_utf8.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_starts_with( act = lv_result exp = lv_bom ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = xstrlen( lv_result ) exp = xstrlen( lv_bom ) + 11 ). " BOM (3 bytes) + 'Hallo Welt!' (11 chars)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) ist eine spezielle Byte-Sequenz, die am Anfang einer Textdatei stehen kann, um die Byte-Reihenfolge und die Codierung anzugeben. `cl_abap_char_utilities=>byte_order_mark_utf8` stellt diese Sequenz bereit, was bei der Erstellung von Dateien für externe Systeme wichtig sein kann.
keywords: cl_abap_char_utilities, UTF-8, BOM, XSTRING, Codepage

Instructions: Klassifizieren Sie eine Temperatur in 'Kalt', 'Mittel' oder 'Heiß' basierend auf Temperaturbereichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN ... TO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_temperature DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS classify_temperature IMPORTING iv_temperature TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_classification) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_temperature IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD classify_temperature.
    CASE iv_temperature.
      WHEN -273 TO 0.
        rv_classification = 'Kalt'.
      WHEN 1 TO 20.
        rv_classification = 'Mittel'.
      WHEN 21 TO 1000.
        rv_classification = 'Heiß'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_classification = 'Extremwert'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse zur Verarbeitung von Dokumenten. Implementieren Sie zwei konkrete Unterklassen für PDF- und Textdokumente, die jeweils eine spezifische Verarbeitungsmethode implementieren.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Template Method Pattern mit einer abstrakten Klasse für die Datenextraktion und -transformation. Die abstrakte Klasse soll eine Template-Methode definieren, die abstrakte Methoden für das Lesen und Transformieren von Daten aufruft.
hint: Die Template-Methode ist final und ruft abstrakte 'Hook'-Methoden auf, die in Unterklassen implementiert werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data FINAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_data) TYPE string_table.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS read_raw_data ABSTRACT RETURNING VALUE(rt_raw_data) TYPE string_table.
    METHODS transform_data ABSTRACT IMPORTING it_raw_data TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_transformed_data) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lt_raw) = read_raw_data( ).
    rt_processed_data = transform_data( lt_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_csv_processor DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_data_processor FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Verknüpfung zwischen einem Flug (SFLIGHT) und einem generischen Dokument. Verwenden Sie hierfür die Klasse CL_BINARY_RELATION.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_BINARY_RELATION=>CREATE_LINK. Sie benötigen die Objekt-IDs des Fluges und des Dokuments.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sobl_create_link DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS create_flight_doc_link
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_document_id TYPE so_obj_id " Example: Document ID
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sobl_create_link IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_document_id) = 'DOC12345678901234567890'. " Placeholder for a real document ID

    " Ensure flight exists for demo purposes
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Create a dummy flight entry if it doesn't exist
      ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                           planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
      INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        out->write( |Dummy Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } { lv_fldate } erstellt.| ).
      ELSE.
        out->write( |Fehler beim Erstellen des Dummy-Fluges.| ).
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_success) = create_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid      = lv_carrid
      iv_connid      = lv_connid
      iv_fldate      = lv_fldate
      iv_document_id = lv_document_id
    ).

    IF lv_success = abap_true.
      out->write( |Verknüpfung erfolgreich erstellt für Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } { lv_fldate } und Dokument { lv_document_id }.| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Fehler beim Erstellen der Verknüpfung.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_flight_doc_link.
    DATA: lo_object_a TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation,
          lo_object_b TYPE REF TO cl_binary_relation.

    " Define object A (SFLIGHT)
    DATA(ls_object_a_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|
      objtype = 'BUS2000110' " Business Object Type for SFLIGHT
    ).

    " Define object B (Generic Document - using SOFM as an example for a document object type)
    DATA(ls_object_b_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = iv_document_id
      objtype = 'SOFM' " Example: Business Object Type for Generic Folder Item (Document)
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = ls_object_a_key
            is_object_b = ls_object_b_key
            ip_reltype  = 'ATTA' " Relationship type: ATTA (Attachment)
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS      = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_bo_error INTO DATA(lx_bo_error).
        " Handle error
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " In a real scenario, log lx_bo_error->get_text( )
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    ).

    DATA(ls_object_a_key) = VALUE sibflporb(

    ).

  METHOD test_create_link_duplicate.
    " First create the link
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sobl_create_link( ).
    lo_cut->create_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid      = mv_carrid,
      iv_connid      = mv_connid,
      iv_fldate      = mv_fldate,

    ).
    " Try to create it again - should return false or raise error
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->create_flight_doc_link(
      iv_carrid      = mv_carrid,
      iv_connid      = mv_connid,
      iv_fldate      = mv_fldate,
      iv_document_id = mv_document_id
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_success,
      msg = 'Doppelte Verknüpfung sollte nicht erfolgreich sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode 'create_flight_doc_link' verwendet 'CL_BINARY_RELATION=>CREATE_LINK', um eine Verknüpfung zwischen einem Flugobjekt (BUS2000110) und einem generischen Dokumentobjekt (SOFM) herzustellen. Die Objekt-IDs werden dynamisch aus den Eingabeparametern konstruiert. Der 'VALUE'-Operator wird für die Initialisierung der Schlüsselstrukturen verwendet, was modernen ABAP-Code kompakter macht. Fehlerbehandlung mit TRY...CATCH ist integriert.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Dokumente, die mit einem bestimmten Flug (SFLIGHT) verknüpft sind, mithilfe von CL_BINARY_RELATION.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_BINARY_RELATION=>GET_LINKS und den FOR-Operator, um die Ergebnisse zu verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sobl_read_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_flight_documents
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_document_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sobl_read_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_document_id) = 'DEMODOC_001'.

    " Ensure flight exists and a link is created for demo
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                                     planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight.

    DATA(ls_object_a_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|
      objtype = 'BUS2000110'
    ).
    DATA(ls_object_b_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = lv_document_id
      objtype = 'SOFM'
    ).
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = ls_object_a_key
            is_object_b = ls_object_b_key
            ip_reltype  = 'ATTA'
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Ignore if link already exists
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lt_docs) = get_flight_documents(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    IF lt_docs IS NOT INITIAL.
      out->write( |Gefundene Dokumente für Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } { lv_fldate }:| ).
      LOOP AT lt_docs INTO DATA(lv_doc).
        out->write( lv_doc ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Keine Dokumente für Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } { lv_fldate } gefunden.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_documents.
    DATA(ls_object_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|
      objtype = 'BUS2000110'
    ).

    DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object_key
        ip_reltype  = 'ATTA'
    ).

    rt_document_ids = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_link IN lt_links
      WHERE ( objtype = 'SOFM' )
      ( ls_link-objkey )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sobl_bulk_create_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_doc_pair,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             document_id  TYPE so_obj_id,
           END OF ty_flight_doc_pair,
           tt_flight_doc_pair TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_doc_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_bulk_links
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_doc_pairs TYPE tt_flight_doc_pair
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sobl_bulk_create_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_pairs) = VALUE tt_flight_doc_pair(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum document_id = 'BULKDOC_001' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum document_id = 'BULKDOC_002' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum document_id = 'BULKDOC_003' )
    ).

    " Ensure flights exist for demo purposes
    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(ls_pair).
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
        WHERE carrid = @ls_pair-carrid AND connid = @ls_pair-connid AND fldate = @ls_pair-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = ls_pair-carrid connid = ls_pair-connid fldate = ls_pair-fldate
                             planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
        INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = create_bulk_links( lt_pairs ).

    IF lv_success = abap_true.
      out->write( |Massenverknüpfungen erfolgreich erstellt.| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Fehler beim Erstellen der Massenverknüpfungen.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_bulk_links.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_link_entry,
             object_a TYPE sibflporb,
             object_b TYPE sibflporb,
             reltype  TYPE bor_reltyp,
           END OF ty_link_entry,
           tt_link_entry TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_link_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_links_to_create) = VALUE tt_link_entry(
      FOR ls_pair IN it_flight_doc_pairs
      ( object_a = VALUE sibflporb(
                   objkey = |{ ls_pair-carrid }{ ls_pair-connid }{ ls_pair-fldate DATE = ISO }|
                   objtype = 'BUS2000110' ),
        object_b = VALUE sibflporb(
                   objkey = ls_pair-document_id
                   objtype = 'SOFM' ),
        reltype  = 'ATTA' )
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_links(
          EXPORTING
            it_links = lt_links_to_create
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bo_error INTO DATA(lx_bo_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Log error: lx_bo_error->get_text( )
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abstract_data_access DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_by_key ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS create_entry ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE REF TO data.
    METHODS update_entry ABSTRACT
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_dao DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_abstract_data_access FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_by_key REDEFINITION.
    METHODS create_entry REDEFINITION.
    METHODS update_entry REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_dao IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_by_key.
    DATA: lv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
          lv_connid TYPE s_conn_id,
          lv_fldate TYPE s_date.

    " Key format: CARRID_CONNID_FLDATE (e.g., 'AA_0017_20251204')
    SPLIT iv_key AT '_' INTO lv_carrid lv_connid lv_fldate.

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      GET REFERENCE OF ls_sflight INTO rs_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_entry.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN is_data->* TO <ls_sflight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      INSERT sflight FROM <ls_sflight>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD update_entry.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_sflight> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN is_data->* TO <ls_sflight>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      UPDATE sflight FROM <ls_sflight>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
