Instructions: Löschen Sie alle binären Verknüpfungen eines bestimmten Fluges (SFLIGHT) zu Dokumenten mithilfe von CL_BINARY_RELATION.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_BINARY_RELATION=>DELETE_LINKS für die Massenlöschung. Zuerst alle Links abrufen, dann löschen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sobl_bulk_delete_links DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS delete_all_flight_doc_links
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sobl_bulk_delete_links IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_document_id1) = 'BULKDEL_001'.
    DATA(lv_document_id2) = 'BULKDEL_002'.

    " Ensure flight exists and links are created for demo
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                                     planetype = '747' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 100 ).
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_flight.

    DATA(ls_object_a_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = |{ lv_carrid }{ lv_connid }{ lv_fldate DATE = ISO }|
      objtype = 'BUS2000110'
    ).
    DATA(ls_object_b_key1) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_document_id1 objtype = 'SOFM' ).
    DATA(ls_object_b_key2) = VALUE sibflporb( objkey = lv_document_id2 objtype = 'SOFM' ).
    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link( is_object_a = ls_object_a_key is_object_b = ls_object_b_key1 ip_reltype = 'ATTA' ).
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link( is_object_a = ls_object_a_key is_object_b = ls_object_b_key2 ip_reltype = 'ATTA' ).
        COMMIT WORK.
      CATCH cx_bo_error.
        " Ignore if links already exist
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_success) = delete_all_flight_doc_links(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    IF lv_success = abap_true.
      out->write( |Alle Verknüpfungen für Flug { lv_carrid } { lv_connid } { lv_fldate } erfolgreich gelöscht.| ).
    ELSE.
      out->write( |Fehler beim Löschen der Verknüpfungen.| ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_all_flight_doc_links.
    DATA(ls_object_key) = VALUE sibflporb(
      objkey = |{ iv_carrid }{ iv_connid }{ iv_fldate DATE = ISO }|
      objtype = 'BUS2000110'
    ).

    DATA(lt_existing_links) = cl_binary_relation=>get_links(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = ls_object_key
        ip_reltype  = 'ATTA'
    ).

    IF lt_existing_links IS INITIAL.
      rv_success = abap_true. " Keine Links zum Löschen
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>delete_links(
          EXPORTING
            it_links = lt_existing_links
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bo_error INTO DATA(lx_bo_error).
        rv_success = abap_false.
        " Log error: lx_bo_error->get_text( )
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String mit verschachtelten Objekten und Arrays und extrahieren Sie spezifische Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` und navigieren Sie durch die JSON-Struktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parser_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES: tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order,
             order_id TYPE string,
             customer TYPE string,
             items    TYPE tt_items,
           END OF ty_order.

    METHODS parse_nested_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_order) TYPE ty_order
      RAISING
        cx_clb_parse_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parser_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_nested_json.
    DATA(lo_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    lo_parser->parse( ).

    DATA(lo_root) = lo_parser->get_root( ).
    rs_order-order_id = lo_root->get_member_by_name( 'order_id' )->get_string( ).
    rs_order-customer = lo_root->get_member_by_name( 'customer' )->get_string( ).

    DATA(lo_items_array) = lo_root->get_member_by_name( 'items' )->get_array( ).
    DATA(lt_items) TYPE tt_items.
    LOOP AT lo_items_array->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_item_node).
      DATA(ls_item) TYPE ty_item.
      ls_item-id   = lo_item_node->get_member_by_name( 'id' )->get_string( ).
      ls_item-name = lo_item_node->get_member_by_name( 'name' )->get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_item TO lt_items.
    ENDLOOP.
    rs_order-items = lt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS zcl_xml_parser_simple DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product.

      IMPORTING

      RAISING

CLASS zcl_xml_parser_simple IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_product_xml.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml=>create_system( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory istream = lo_istream document = lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ixml_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_root) = lo_document->get_root_element( ).
    IF lo_root IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_root->get_name( ) = 'Product'.
      rs_product-id    = lo_root->get_attribute( 'id' )->get_value( ).
      rs_product-name  = lo_root->get_first_child_by_name( 'Name' )->get_value( ).
      rs_product-price = lo_root->get_first_child_by_name( 'Price' )->get_value( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen XML-String aus einer ABAP-Struktur, die Kundendaten enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `iXML`-Bibliothek (`cl_ixml`) zum Erstellen des XML-Dokuments.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_generator_customer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_customer,
             id      TYPE string,
             name    TYPE string,
             city    TYPE string,
           END OF ty_customer.

    METHODS generate_customer_xml
      IMPORTING
        is_customer TYPE ty_customer
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_ixml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_generator_customer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_customer_xml.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml=>create_system( ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).

    DATA(lo_root) = lo_document->create_element( 'Customer' ).
    lo_root->set_attribute( name = 'id' value = is_customer-id ).
    lo_document->append_child( lo_root ).

    DATA(lo_name) = lo_document->create_element( 'Name' ).
    lo_name->append_child( lo_document->create_text_node( is_customer-name ) ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_name ).

    DATA(lo_city) = lo_document->create_element( 'City' ).
    lo_city->append_child( lo_document->create_text_node( is_customer-city ) ).
    lo_root->append_child( lo_city ).

    DATA(lo_render_factory) = lo_ixml->create_render_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_ostream) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( )->create_ostream_string( rv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_renderer) = lo_render_factory->create_renderer( ostream = lo_ostream document = lo_document ).

    IF lo_renderer->render( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ixml_error.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'XML should contain Customer tag' substring = '<Customer id="C001">' in = lv_xml ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebener XML-String wohlgeformt ist und keine grundlegenden Parsing-Fehler enthält. Dies ist ein grundlegender Schritt für XML-Sicherheit.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `iXML`-Bibliothek zum Parsen und prüfen Sie den Rückgabewert des Parsers. `cl_secxml_helper` ist für fortgeschrittene Sicherheitsprüfungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_security_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_xml_well_formed
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_security_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_xml_well_formed.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml=>create_system( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory istream = lo_istream document = lo_document ).

    TRY.
        IF lo_parser->parse( ) = 0.
          rv_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_ixml_error.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_well_formed_xml FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_malformed_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_well_formed_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_security_check( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Value</item></data>`.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_xml_well_formed( lv_xml ) msg = 'Well-formed XML should return true' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_malformed_xml.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xml_security_check( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = `<data><item>Value</data>`.

    lv_xml = `<data><item>Value</item>`. " Missing root closing tag
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_xml_well_formed( lv_xml ) msg = 'Malformed XML (missing closing tag) should return false' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Überprüfung der Wohlgeformtheit eines XML-Dokuments ist ein grundlegender Sicherheitsaspekt, um Angriffe durch fehlerhafte oder bösartige XML-Strukturen zu verhindern. Die `iXML`-Bibliothek kann dies während des Parsens erkennen. Für fortgeschrittene XML-Sicherheitsprüfungen wie Signaturen oder Verschlüsselung wird `cl_secxml_helper` verwendet.
keywords: XML, Security, Well-formed, `iXML`, `cl_secxml_helper` (related)

Instructions: Lesen Sie spezifische Daten aus einem XML-Dokument mithilfe von XPath-Ausdrücken.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ixml` und die Methode `select_nodes` des Dokuments.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_node_value_by_xpath
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_string TYPE string
        iv_xpath      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_ixml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_xpath_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_node_value_by_xpath.
    DATA(lo_ixml) = cl_ixml=>create_system( ).
    DATA(lo_stream_factory) = lo_ixml->create_stream_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_istream) = lo_stream_factory->create_istream_string( iv_xml_string ).
    DATA(lo_document) = lo_ixml->create_document( ).
    DATA(lo_parser) = lo_ixml->create_parser( stream_factory = lo_stream_factory istream = lo_istream document = lo_document ).

    IF lo_parser->parse( ) <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_ixml_error.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_node_list) = lo_document->select_nodes( iv_xpath ).
    IF lo_node_list IS NOT INITIAL AND lo_node_list->get_length( ) > 0.
      DATA(lo_node) = lo_node_list->get_item( 0 ).
      IF lo_node IS BOUND.
        rv_value = lo_node->get_value( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,

hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und einer `WHERE`-Klausel.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                                     FOR flight IN it_sflights
                                     WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `FINAL` für Methoden und Klassen sowie `READ-ONLY` für Attribute in einer ABAP-Klasse.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Schlüsselwörter `FINAL` und `READ-ONLY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_oo_final_readonly DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_initial_value TYPE i.

    METHODS get_doubled_value FINAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_doubled_value) TYPE i.

    METHODS set_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_new_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_final_readonly IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_doubled_value.
    rv_doubled_value = mv_value * 2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value.
    " mv_value ist READ-ONLY und kann hier nicht direkt geändert werden.
    " Dies würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen.
    " mv_value = iv_new_value. " <--- Syntaxfehler
    " Für dieses Beispiel wird die Methode nur deklariert, um die READ-ONLY Eigenschaft zu zeigen.
    " In einem realen Szenario würde man hier eine andere Logik implementieren oder das Attribut nicht READ-ONLY machen.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_final_readonly FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_final_readonly.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_oo_final_readonly( iv_initial_value = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 10 msg = 'Initial value should be 10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_doubled_value( ) exp = 20 msg = 'Doubled value should be 20' ).

    " Versuch, ein READ-ONLY Attribut zu ändern (würde Syntaxfehler geben, hier nur zur Demonstration)
    " lo_cut->mv_value = 5; " <--- Dies würde einen Syntaxfehler verursachen

    " Test, dass die set_value Methode existiert, aber das Attribut nicht ändert
    lo_cut->set_value( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_value exp = 10 msg = 'READ-ONLY attribute should not change' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Schlüsselwort `FINAL` bei Klassen verhindert die Vererbung, bei Methoden verhindert es das Überschreiben. `READ-ONLY` bei Attributen stellt sicher, dass diese nur im Konstruktor der Klasse gesetzt und danach nur gelesen werden können. Dies fördert die Kapselung und Unveränderlichkeit von Objekten, was zu robusterem Code führt.
keywords: Object Orientation, `FINAL`, `READ-ONLY`, Encapsulation, Immutability

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_names TYPE string_table
        it_data_rows   TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>t_component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_row>   TYPE any,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_table>.

    LOOP AT it_data_rows INTO DATA(lv_data_row).
      CREATE DATA <ls_row> TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN <ls_row>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).

      DATA(lt_values) = VALUE string_table( FOR val IN cl_abap_string_utilities=>split( val = lv_data_row sep = ',' ) ( val ) ).

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_field> = lt_values[ sy-tabix ].
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND <fs_row> TO <lt_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_table_creation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table_creation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'ID' ) ( 'Name' ) ( 'City' ) ).
    DATA(lt_data_rows) = VALUE string_table( ( '001,Alice,New York' ) ( '002,Bob,London' ) ).

    DATA(lo_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( it_field_names = lt_field_names it_data_rows = lt_data_rows ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_row>   TYPE any,
                   <lv_id>            TYPE string,
                   <lv_name>          TYPE string,
                   <lv_city>          TYPE string.

    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 rows' ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_row>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lv_id>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'Name' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lv_name>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'City' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lv_city>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_id> exp = '001' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_name> exp = 'Alice' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <lv_city> exp = 'New York' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Could not read first row' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` ermöglicht das Erstellen von Datenstrukturen und internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit. Dies ist nützlich für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur der Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, z.B. beim Parsen unbekannter Dateiformate oder bei generischen Schnittstellen.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, `cl_abap_tabledescr`, `cl_abap_structdescr`, `CREATE DATA`, Field Symbols

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf seinem Wert und einem Flag bestimmt, unter Verwendung des `COND`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck für konditionale Zuweisungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_order_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_order_status TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_status,
                 new        TYPE ty_order_status VALUE 'NEW',
                 pending    TYPE ty_order_status VALUE 'PENDING',
                 completed  TYPE ty_order_status VALUE 'COMPLETED',
                 cancelled  TYPE ty_order_status VALUE 'CANCELLED',
               END OF gc_status.

    METHODS get_order_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_order_value TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        ib_is_cancelled TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE ty_order_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_order_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_status.
    rv_status = COND #( WHEN ib_is_cancelled = abap_true THEN gc_status-cancelled
                        WHEN iv_order_value = 0 THEN gc_status-new
                        WHEN iv_order_value > 0 AND iv_order_value < 100 THEN gc_status-pending
                        ELSE gc_status-completed ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (aus `sflight`) in einen JSON-String. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer` und `write_data`. Für die Datenbeschaffung verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS
      ( carrid   = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid   = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate   = ls_sflight-fldate
        price    = ls_sflight-price
        currency = ls_sflight-currency )
    ).

    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_fdt_json=>create_json_writer( ).
    lo_writer->write_data( EXPORTING iv_name = 'flights' ia_value = lt_sflights ).
    rv_json_string = lo_writer->get_json_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_sflight( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine binäre Beziehung zwischen einem Flug (`sflight`) und einer Buchung (`sbook`), um anzuzeigen, dass eine Buchung zu einem bestimmten Flug gehört.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>create_link` und die GOS-Objektreferenzen (`cl_gos_object_manager`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_create_flight_booking_rel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_bookid TYPE sbook-bookid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_create_flight_booking_rel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_relation.
    DATA: lo_gos_object_flight TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object_manager,
          lo_gos_object_booking TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object_manager.

    " Define object types for SFLIGHT and SBOOK (example values)
    CONSTANTS: lc_objtype_sflight TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000110', " Example: Flight object type
               lc_objtype_sbook   TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000111'. " Example: Booking object type

    " Create object references for GOS
    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_object_flight
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE sibflporb(
          objtype = lc_objtype_sflight
          objkey  = iv_carrid && iv_connid && iv_fldate
        ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_object_booking
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE sibflporb(
          objtype = lc_objtype_sbook
          objkey  = iv_bookid
        ).

    TRY.
        " Create the binary relation
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lo_gos_object_flight->get_object_id( )
            is_object_b = lo_gos_object_booking->get_object_id( )
            ip_relation = 'FLIGHT_BOOKING' " Custom relation type
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        " In a real scenario, log the error or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Buchungen, die mit einem bestimmten Flug verknüpft sind, unter Verwendung der binären Beziehungen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_query_flight_booking_rel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_bookings_for_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_bookids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook-bookid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_query_flight_booking_rel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_bookings_for_flight.
    DATA: lo_gos_object_flight TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object_manager.

    CONSTANTS: lc_objtype_sflight TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000110',
               lc_objtype_sbook   TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000111'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_object_flight
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE sibflporb(
          objtype = lc_objtype_sflight
          objkey  = iv_carrid && iv_connid && iv_fldate
        ).

    DATA(lt_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links(
      EXPORTING
        is_object = lo_gos_object_flight->get_object_id( )
        ip_relation = 'FLIGHT_BOOKING' " Custom relation type
    ).

    rt_bookids = VALUE #( " Modern ABAP for filtering and mapping
      FOR ls_link IN lt_links
        WHERE ( objtype_b = lc_objtype_sbook ) " Ensure it's a booking object
        ( CONV sbook-bookid( ls_link-objkey_b ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_creator TYPE sy-uname
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_create_rel_with_attr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_relation_with_attr.
    DATA: lo_gos_object_flight TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object_manager,
          lo_gos_object_booking TYPE REF TO cl_gos_object_manager.

    CONSTANTS: lc_objtype_sflight TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000110',
               lc_objtype_sbook   TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000111'.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_object_flight
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE sibflporb(
          objtype = lc_objtype_sflight
          objkey  = iv_carrid && iv_connid && iv_fldate
        ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_gos_object_booking
      EXPORTING
        is_object = VALUE sibflporb(
          objtype = lc_objtype_sbook
          objkey  = iv_bookid
        ).

    DATA(lt_attributes) = VALUE sibflporb_attr_t(
      ( attrname = 'CREATED_BY' attrvalue = iv_creator )
      ( attrname = 'CREATED_ON' attrvalue = sy-datum )
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_binary_relation=>create_link_with_attributes(
          EXPORTING
            is_object_a = lo_gos_object_flight->get_object_id( )
            is_object_b = lo_gos_object_booking->get_object_id( )
            ip_relation = 'FLIGHT_BOOKING_EXT' " A different relation type for attributes
            it_attributes = lt_attributes
        ).
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_binary_relation_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Beziehungen eines bestimmten Typs für eine Liste von Quellobjekten effizient aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_binary_relation=>read_links_of_objects` für die Massenverarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mass_read_relations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_relation_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             relation TYPE string,
           END OF ty_relation_info.
    TYPES tt_relation_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_relation_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mass_flight_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_keys TYPE tt_flight_keys
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_relations) TYPE tt_relation_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mass_read_relations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mass_flight_bookings.
    DATA: lt_gos_objects TYPE sibflporb_t.

    CONSTANTS: lc_objtype_sflight TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000110',
               lc_objtype_sbook   TYPE gos_objtyp VALUE 'BUS2000111'.

    " Convert flight keys to GOS object IDs
    lt_gos_objects = VALUE #( " Modern ABAP for populating internal table
      FOR ls_key IN it_flight_keys
      ( objtype = lc_objtype_sflight
        objkey  = ls_key-carrid && ls_key-connid && ls_key-fldate )
    ).

    DATA(lt_all_links) = cl_binary_relation=>read_links_of_objects(
      EXPORTING
        it_objects  = lt_gos_objects
        ip_relation = 'FLIGHT_BOOKING' " Or 'FLIGHT_BOOKING_EXT' if attributes were used
    ).

    " Map the results back to a more readable structure
    rt_relations = VALUE #( " Modern ABAP for filtering and mapping
      FOR ls_link IN lt_all_links
        WHERE ( objtype_b = lc_objtype_sbook ) " Ensure it's a booking object
        ( carrid   = ls_link-objkey_a+0(2) " Extract CARRIER from objkey_a
          connid   = ls_link-objkey_a+2(4) " Extract CONNECTION ID from objkey_a
          fldate   = ls_link-objkey_a+6(8) " Extract FLIGHT DATE from objkey_a
          bookid   = CONV sbook-bookid( ls_link-objkey_b ) " Convert booking ID
          relation = ls_link-relation )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_read_relations.
    " Create some test relations first
    DATA(lo_create) = NEW zcl_create_flight_booking_rel( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid1) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_bookid1) = '00000005'.
    lo_create->create_relation( lv_carrid1 lv_connid1 lv_fldate1 lv_bookid1 ).

    DATA(lv_carrid2) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_bookid2) = '00000006'.
    lo_create->create_relation( lv_carrid2 lv_connid2 lv_fldate2 lv_bookid2 ).

    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = VALUE zcl_mass_read_relations=>tt_flight_keys(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid1 connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate1 )
      ( carrid = lv_carrid2 connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate2 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mass_read_relations( ).
    DATA(lt_relations) = lo_cut->get_mass_flight_bookings( lt_flight_keys ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sollte 2 Beziehungen finden' act = lines( lt_relations ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Buchungs-ID der ersten Beziehung' act = lt_relations[ 1 ]-bookid exp = lv_bookid1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Buchungs-ID der zweiten Beziehung' act = lt_relations[ 2 ]-bookid exp = lv_bookid2 ).

    " Clean up
    DATA(lo_delete) = NEW zcl_delete_flight_booking_rel( ).
    lo_delete->delete_relation( lv_carrid1 lv_connid1 lv_fldate1 lv_bookid1 ).
    lo_delete->delete_relation( lv_carrid2 lv_connid2 lv_fldate2 lv_bookid2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `read_links_of_objects` ist für die effiziente Abfrage von Beziehungen für eine Liste von Quellobjekten konzipiert. Dies vermeidet N+1-Probleme, die bei der Einzelabfrage in einer Schleife auftreten könnten. Die Transformation der GOS-Objektschlüssel zurück in lesbare ABAP-Felder unterstreicht die Notwendigkeit, die Schlüsselstruktur zu kennen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` ist hier wieder ein Schlüssel für kompakten Code.
keywords: Binary Relation, GOS, cl_binary_relation, Mass Processing, FOR, VALUE

hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer Schleife.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ty_s_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values. " Use string template for conversion
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, wobei der Methodenname zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Methode und `CALL METHOD` mit dem `(name)`-Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS dummy_method_one RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS dummy_method_two RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_method> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ('(IO_OBJECT)->' && iv_method_name) TO <fs_method>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CALL METHOD <fs_method> RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Error: Method '{ iv_method_name }' not found or callable.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_one.
    rv_text = 'Method One Executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_two.
    rv_text = 'Method Two Executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für das `TEXT_CHANGED` Ereignis eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls, um auf Änderungen im Textfeld zu reagieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SET HANDLER` und definieren Sie eine lokale Klasse als Ereignisbehandler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_events DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

    METHODS register_event_handler.

    METHODS get_last_changed_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mv_last_changed_text TYPE string.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS handle_text_changed FOR EVENT text_changed OF cl_gui_textedit
          IMPORTING
            sender.

        DATA mv_changed_text TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD handle_text_changed.
        DATA lt_text_lines TYPE string_table.
        sender->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = lt_text_lines ).
        mv_changed_text = cl_abap_string_util=>concatenate_string_table( it_string_table = lt_text_lines sep = cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    DATA mo_event_handler TYPE REF TO lcl_event_handler.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_events IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).
    mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
        parent = mo_custom_container
    ).
    mo_event_handler = NEW lcl_event_handler( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD register_event_handler.
    SET HANDLER mo_event_handler->handle_text_changed FOR mo_textedit.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_last_changed_text.
    rv_text = mo_event_handler->mv_changed_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_new_text) = VALUE string_table( ( 'First line changed.' ) ( 'Second line added.' ) ).

    lo_cut->mo_event_handler->handle_text_changed( sender = lo_mock_textedit ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI-Klassen wie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `cl_abap_tabledescr` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_field,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_field.
    TYPES: ty_t_field TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default to string or handle error
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
        p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
    ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.

      DO 3 TIMES. " Add 3 dummy rows
        ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO DATA(<fs_current_line>).
        IF <fs_current_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_current_line> TO <fs_comp>.
            IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
              CASE ls_component-name.
                WHEN 'ID'.
                  <fs_comp> = sy-index.
                WHEN 'NAME'.
                  <fs_comp> = |Item { sy-index }|.
                WHEN 'VALUE'.
                  <fs_comp> = |Value { sy-index * 10 }|.
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  <fs_comp> = |Dynamic { sy-index }|.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <fs_current_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Suchen-und-Ersetzen-Funktionalität innerhalb eines `cl_gui_textedit` Controls.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `FIND_REPLACE` des `cl_gui_textedit` Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_find_repl DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

    METHODS set_initial_text
      IMPORTING
        it_text_lines TYPE string_table.

    METHODS find_and_replace
      IMPORTING
        iv_find_string    TYPE string
        iv_replace_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replacements) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_current_text RETURNING VALUE(rt_text_lines) TYPE string_table.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_textedit_find_repl IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).
    mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
        parent = mo_custom_container
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_initial_text.
    mo_textedit->set_text_as_r3table( table = it_text_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD find_and_replace.
    mo_textedit->find_replace(
        EXPORTING
            string        = iv_find_string
            replacement   = iv_replace_string
            all_occurrences = abap_true
        IMPORTING
            replacements  = rv_replacements
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_text.
    mo_textedit->get_text_as_r3table( IMPORTING table = rt_text_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->find_and_replace(
        iv_find_string    = 'World'

    DATA(lt_expected_text) = VALUE string_table(
        ( 'Hello ABAP' )
        ( 'ABAP is great' )
        ( 'Another ABAP' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_actual_text) = lo_cut->get_current_text( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_replacements
        exp = 3
        msg = 'Should report 3 replacements'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lt_actual_text
        exp = lt_expected_text
        msg = 'Text should be correctly replaced'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_match.
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_textedit_find_repl( iv_container_name = lv_container_name ).

    DATA(lt_initial_text) = VALUE string_table(
        ( 'Hello World' )
    ).
    lo_cut->set_initial_text( lt_initial_text ).

    DATA(lv_replacements) = lo_cut->find_and_replace(
        iv_find_string    = 'SAP'
        iv_replace_string = 'ABAP'
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_text) = lo_cut->get_current_text( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = lv_replacements
        exp = 0
        msg = 'Should report 0 replacements'

        exp = lt_initial_text
        msg = 'Text should remain unchanged'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Funktion, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld summiert, sofern das Feld numerisch ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum = REDUCE p( INIT s = 0
                       FOR <fs_line> IN <fs_table>
                       LET lv_component_value = '' IN
                       BLOCK
                         ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
                         IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
                           TRY.
                               lv_component_value = <fs_value>.
                               s = s + lv_component_value.
                             CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                               " Ignore non-numeric values
                           ENDTRY.
                         ENDIF.
                       ENDBLOCK
                       RESULT s ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie den Inhalt einer dynamisch erstellten internen Tabelle in einem `cl_gui_textedit` Control an. Die Spaltennamen sollen dabei als Header dienen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI zur Tabellenerzeugung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Datenzugriff und `cl_gui_textedit` zur Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_fs_dynamic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_field_def,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_field_def.
    TYPES: ty_t_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE cl_gui_container=>container_name.

    METHODS display_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field_def.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_fs_dynamic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
        container_name = iv_container_name
        dynpro_program = sy-repid
        dynpro_number  = sy-dynnr
    ).
    mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit(
        parent = mo_custom_container
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_int( ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
        p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
    ).

    CREATE DATA ro_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ro_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.

      DO 3 TIMES. " Add 3 dummy rows
        ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO DATA(<fs_current_line>).
        IF <fs_current_line> IS ASSIGNED.
          LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_current_line> TO <fs_comp>.
            IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
              CASE ls_component-name.
                WHEN 'ID'.
                  <fs_comp> = sy-index.
                WHEN 'NAME'.
                  <fs_comp> = |Item { sy-index }|.
                WHEN 'VALUE'.
                  <fs_comp> = |Value { sy-index * 10 }|.
                WHEN OTHERS.
                  <fs_comp> = |Dynamic { sy-index }|.
              ENDCASE.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <fs_current_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_table_ref) = create_dynamic_table( it_field_definitions ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_dynamic_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lt_display_lines TYPE string_table.
    DATA lv_header_line TYPE string.
    DATA lv_separator_line TYPE string.

    " Build header line
    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      lv_header_line = lv_header_line && |{ ls_field_def-name ALPHA = OUT } |.
      lv_separator_line = lv_separator_line && |---------- |.
    ENDLOOP.
    APPEND lv_header_line TO lt_display_lines.
    APPEND lv_separator_line TO lt_display_lines.

    " Build data lines
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA lv_data_line TYPE string.
      LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO ls_field_def.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_def-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
        IF <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
          lv_data_line = lv_data_line && |{ <fs_comp> ALPHA = OUT } |.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND lv_data_line TO lt_display_lines.
    ENDLOOP.

    mo_textedit->set_text_as_r3table( table = lt_display_lines ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        ( 'ID         NAME       ' )

        ( '1          Item 1     ' )
        ( '2          Item 2     ' )

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine Open SQL `SELECT`-Anweisung, basierend auf zur Laufzeit übergebenen Kriterien.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die dynamischen Werte und die `WHERE (itab)`-Syntax für die dynamische Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_sflight_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_where_conditions TYPE string_table " e.g., ( 'CARRID = ''LH''' ), ( 'CONNID = ''0400''' )
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_sflight_dynamic.
    DATA lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    " Construct the WHERE clause string from the table
    lv_where_clause = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR condition IN it_where_conditions
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN condition ELSE s && ' AND ' && condition )
    ).

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        WHERE (lv_where_clause)
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflight.
    ELSE.
      " If no conditions, select all (or handle as error)
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_sflight.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle dynamisch in eine CSV-formatierte String-Tabelle, wobei die Spaltennamen als Header dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Datenzugriff und `cl_abap_tabledescr` für die Spalteninformationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_table_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_delimiter  TYPE string DEFAULT ';'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_csv_lines) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_to_csv.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA lv_header_line TYPE string.
    lv_header_line = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR comp IN lt_components
        NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp-name ELSE s && iv_delimiter && comp-name )
    ).
    APPEND lv_header_line TO rt_csv_lines.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA lv_data_line TYPE string.
      lv_data_line = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR comp IN lt_components
          LET lv_component_value = '' IN
          BLOCK
            ASSIGN COMPONENT comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.
            IF <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
              lv_component_value = |{ <fs_value> }|.
            ENDIF.
            s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN lv_component_value ELSE s && iv_delimiter && lv_component_value )
          ENDBLOCK
      ).
      APPEND lv_data_line TO rt_csv_lines.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Spaltennamen und einer Sortierrichtung durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und die `SORT` Anweisung mit dynamischen Kriterien.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_direction  TYPE string DEFAULT 'ASCENDING' " 'ASCENDING' or 'DESCENDING'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sorted_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sorted_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA ro_sorted_table LIKE <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN ro_sorted_table->* TO <fs_sorted_table>.
    IF <fs_sorted_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    <fs_sorted_table> = <fs_table>.

    DATA lv_sort_key TYPE string.
    lv_sort_key = iv_column_name.

    IF iv_direction = 'DESCENDING'.
      SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (lv_sort_key) DESCENDING.
    ELSE.
      SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (lv_sort_key) ASCENDING.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Spaltennamen und einem Vergleichswert, die zur Laufzeit übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und den `FILTER` Ausdruck für die dynamische Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE p DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_table      TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE string
        iv_compare_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_filtered_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA ro_filtered_table LIKE <fs_table>.
    ASSIGN ro_filtered_table->* TO <fs_filtered_table>.
    IF <fs_filtered_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamic filtering using FILTER expression
    <fs_filtered_table> = FILTER #( <fs_table> USING KEY primary_key WHERE (lv_column_name) = iv_compare_value ).
    " Note: The above line is conceptual. Direct dynamic column access in FILTER WHERE is not supported.
    " We need to iterate and check dynamically.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_comp> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF |{ <fs_comp> }| = iv_compare_value.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_filtered_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Filterung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit bekannten Spaltennamen und Vergleichswert. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für generische Filterfunktionen. Die Verwendung von `REF #` und `CREATE DATA` ist modern.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `GET_COMPONENT_VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_sflight_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_data         TYPE REF TO data.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_value> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
        CREATE DATA lr_data LIKE is_data.
        ASSIGN is_data TO lr_data->*.

        CALL METHOD lr_struct_descr->get_component_value
          EXPORTING
            p_name  = iv_field_name
            p_struct = lr_data
          IMPORTING
            p_value = <fs_value>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_value>.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_component_error.
        " Handle error
        rv_value = 'Error: Field not found or type mismatch'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vereinigen Sie die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT`-Anweisungen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in einer internen Tabelle. Wählen Sie Flüge von 'LH' und 'AA' aus und kombinieren Sie diese.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `UNION` Operator in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_sql_union IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_lh_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_aa_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain AA flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `UNION`-Operator in Open SQL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. Dabei werden Duplikate automatisch entfernt. Dies vereinfacht komplexe Abfragen, die zuvor möglicherweise mit `APPEND LINES OF` oder temporären Tabellen gelöst werden mussten, und verbessert die Performance, da die Datenbank die Vereinigung effizienter durchführen kann.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur Flüge von 'LH' aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` enthält, und mappen Sie dabei nur die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.

    METHODS get_lh_flights_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_lh_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flights_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_lh_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_lh_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = lo_cut->get_lh_flights_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_lh_flights msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    LOOP AT lt_lh_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Only LH flights should be present' ).
    ENDLOOP.

explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `FILTER` ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt expliziter `LOOP`s und `APPEND`s kann man direkt eine neue Tabelle basierend auf gefilterten und gemappten Daten einer Quelltabelle erzeugen. Dies ist funktionaler und reduziert Boilerplate-Code.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für einen bestimmten Flug (`CARRID` und `CONNID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum_price TYPE s_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_total_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_total > 0 msg = 'Total price should be greater than 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->get_total_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0 msg = 'Total price should be 0 for non-existent flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem man eine Startwert (`INIT`) definiert und dann in einer Schleife (`FOR`) über die Tabellenzeilen iteriert, um den Wert schrittweise zu aktualisieren (`NEXT`). Dies ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`s mit Akkumulatorvariablen.
keywords: REDUCE, internal tables, aggregation, functional programming, constructor expression

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` nach `CARRID` und `CONNID` und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_group
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_group.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid, ls_flight-connid.
      DATA(ls_group) = VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_group TO rt_flight_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_groups) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_group( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flight_groups msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    DATA(lv_found_lh_0400) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_groups INTO DATA(ls_group).
      IF ls_group-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_group-connid = '0400'.
        lv_found_lh_0400 = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_group-flight_count > 0 msg = 'Flight count for LH 0400 should be positive' ).
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_lh_0400 msg = 'Should find a group for LH 0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Klausel in `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine direkte Gruppierung von internen Tabellen, ohne dass manuelle Sortierungen oder Hash-Tabellen erforderlich sind. Innerhalb der Schleife kann man auf die Gruppenschlüssel zugreifen und Aggregatsfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` verwenden, um Informationen über die Gruppe zu erhalten. Dies vereinfacht die Datenaggregation erheblich.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, internal tables, grouping, GROUP SIZE

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Flugpreis über 500 liegt, soll der Status 'Expensive' sein, sonst 'Standard'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND #( WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_standard_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 600 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Expensive' msg = 'Status should be Expensive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_standard_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 450 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Standard' msg = 'Status should be Standard' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen. Er ersetzt die traditionelle `IF`-`ELSE`-Struktur für einfache Zuweisungen und macht den Code lesbarer und kürzer. Dies ist ein Beispiel für einen Konstruktorausdruck, der einen Wert zurückgibt.
keywords: COND, conditional logic, constructor expression, IF-ELSE

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf mehreren möglichen Werten einer Eingabevariablen zu. Wenn der `CARRID` 'LH' ist, soll 'Lufthansa' zurückgegeben werden, bei 'AA' 'American Airlines', sonst 'Other Airline'.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_switch_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_airline_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_airline_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_switch_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_name.
    rv_airline_name = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                                WHEN 'LH' THEN 'Lufthansa'
                                WHEN 'AA' THEN 'American Airlines'
                                ELSE 'Other Airline' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
