explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist eine elegante und moderne Alternative zur `CASE`-Anweisung für die Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf mehreren möglichen Eingabewerten. Er macht den Code kompakter und lesbarer, insbesondere wenn viele Bedingungen geprüft werden müssen. Auch dies ist ein Konstruktorausdruck.
keywords: SWITCH, conditional logic, constructor expression, CASE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer gegebenen Strukturdefinition (z.B. `SFLIGHT`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
            p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
            p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
            p_unique     = abap_false ).

        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_unknown_type.
        " Handle error
        CLEAR rr_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_struct_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Dynamic table should be created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_sflight> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_sflight>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <lt_sflight> msg = 'Dynamic table should be empty initially' ).

    DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_sflight>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_sflight> ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should contain one entry' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_struct_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_STRUCT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_dynamic_table msg = 'Should return initial reference for invalid struct' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit RTTI (`Run Time Type Services`) dynamisch eine interne Tabelle zur Laufzeit erstellen kann. `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name` holt die Typbeschreibung einer Struktur, die dann an `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` übergeben wird, um eine Tabellenbeschreibung zu erstellen. Mit `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` wird schließlich die dynamische Tabelle erzeugt. Dies ist essenziell für generische Frameworks, die mit unbekannten Datenstrukturen arbeiten müssen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_tabledescr, CREATE DATA, dynamic programming, reflection, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Vereinigen Sie die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT`-Anweisungen aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in einer internen Tabelle, wobei Duplikate beibehalten werden sollen. Wählen Sie Flüge von 'LH' und 'AA' aus und kombinieren Sie diese.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `UNION ALL` Operator in Open SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_combined_flights_all
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights_all.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights_all( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_aa_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_lh_count = lv_lh_count + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_aa_count = lv_aa_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_lh_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_aa_count > 0 msg = 'Should contain AA flights' ).

    " To properly test UNION ALL vs UNION, one would need to know the exact counts
    " of LH and AA flights in SFLIGHT and assert that the sum matches.
    " For this example, we just ensure both types of flights are present.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `UNION ALL`-Operator in Open SQL kombiniert die Ergebnisse mehrerer `SELECT`-Anweisungen, wobei im Gegensatz zu `UNION` auch Duplikate beibehalten werden. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die vollständige Menge aller Zeilen aus den einzelnen Abfragen benötigt wird, ohne dass eine Duplikatsprüfung durchgeführt werden soll. Es kann auch performanter sein, wenn keine Duplikatsentfernung erforderlich ist.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, SELECT, internal tables, database access

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining und Inline-Deklarationen, indem Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen verwenden, um eine Flugnummer zu validieren und zu formatieren.
hint: Entwerfen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    METHODS validate_connid RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_formatter.
    METHODS format_alpha_out RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_flight_formatter.
    METHODS get_formatted_connid RETURNING VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    DATA mv_is_valid TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD validate_connid.
    IF mv_connid IS INITIAL OR NOT mv_connid CO '0123456789'.
      mv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_alpha_out.
    IF mv_is_valid = abap_true.
      mv_connid = mv_connid ALPHA = OUT.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_formatted_connid.
    IF mv_is_valid = abap_true.
      rv_connid = mv_connid.
    ELSE.
      rv_connid = 'INVALID'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_connid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_connid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_connid.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( '400' )->validate_connid( )->format_alpha_out( )->get_formatted_connid( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted exp = '00000400' msg = 'Valid connid should be formatted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_connid.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( 'ABC' )->validate_connid( )->format_alpha_out( )->get_formatted_connid( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted exp = 'INVALID' msg = 'Invalid connid should return INVALID' ).

    lv_formatted = NEW zcl_flight_formatter( '' )->validate_connid( )->format_alpha_out( )->get_formatted_connid( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted exp = 'INVALID' msg = 'Empty connid should return INVALID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was zu einem flüssigeren und lesbareren Code führt (Fluent API). Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. In Kombination mit Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lv_var) = NEW ...`) wird der Code noch kompakter und moderner.
keywords: Method Chaining, Fluent API, Object Orientation, Inline Declaration, NEW operator

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 1000 enthält, und sortieren Sie diese absteigend nach Preis. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER`, `SORT` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights_sorted.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE price > 1000 )
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid = ls_sflight-connid,
        price  = ls_sflight-price ) 
    ).

    SORT rt_flights BY price DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_expensive_flights_sorted FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_expensive_flights_sorted.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights_sorted( ).

    " This test assumes SFLIGHT contains flights with price > 1000.
    " If not, the test might fail or pass vacuously.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price > 1000 msg = 'First flight should be expensive' ).
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price > 1000 msg = 'All flights should be expensive' ).
      ENDLOOP.
      " Check sorting
      DATA(lv_prev_price) = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO ls_flight FROM 2.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-price LE lv_prev_price msg = 'Flights should be sorted descending by price' ).
        lv_prev_price = ls_flight-price.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_expensive_flights.
    " To properly test this, one would need to mock SFLIGHT or ensure no expensive flights exist.
    " For now, we assume a scenario where no flights match the criteria.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter_sort( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flights_sorted( ).
    " If SFLIGHT has no flights > 1000, this will pass.
    " If it does, this test might fail, indicating a need for controlled test data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should be empty if no expensive flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert moderne Tabellenoperationen: Zuerst wird mit `FILTER` und `VALUE` eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur die gewünschten Zeilen enthält. Anschließend wird diese Tabelle mit der `SORT`-Anweisung sortiert. Diese Kombination ist sehr effizient und lesbar, da sie die Schritte der Datenmanipulation klar voneinander trennt und die Notwendigkeit temporärer Variablen oder komplexer Schleifen reduziert.
keywords: FILTER, SORT, VALUE, internal tables, constructor expression, data manipulation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit vordefinierten Daten unter Verwendung des `VALUE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #(...)` mit Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' cityfrom = 'CHICAGO' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_create( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CARRIER ID should be LH' act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die kompakte Initialisierung von internen Tabellen mit Daten in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und reduziert den Codeumfang im Vergleich zu traditionellen `APPEND`-Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, Internal Tables, Inline Declaration, Table Expression

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur Flugnummer und Abflugort enthält, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ...` und `VALUE #(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid cityfrom = flight-cityfrom ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Table should not be initial' act = lt_summaries IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should have entries' act = lines( lt_summaries ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry CARRIER ID should not be initial' act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Assuming LH is in SFLIGHTS
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine Schleife zu schreiben und Zeile für Zeile zu verarbeiten, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus der Quelltabelle abgeleitet.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die `sflights`-Tabelle nach Flügen, die von 'FRA' abfliegen, und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `VALUE` und `FILTER`.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_fr,

           END OF ty_flight.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_from_fra.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' ) ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und `VALUE`.
hint: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_value_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_value_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                         FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                         NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob eine gegebene interne Tabelle eine Standardtabelle, sortierte Tabelle oder Hash-Tabelle ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `get_table_kind()` von `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_kind_name IMPORTING it_data TYPE any TABLE
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_kind_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_kind IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_kind_name.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
        CASE lo_table_descr->get_table_kind( ).
          WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard.
            rv_kind_name = 'Standard Table'.
          WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_sorted.
            rv_kind_name = 'Sorted Table'.
          WHEN cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed.
            rv_kind_name = 'Hash Table'.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_kind_name = 'Unknown Table Kind'.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_kind_name = 'Error: Not a table type'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA lt_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should be Standard Table' act = lo_cut->get_table_kind_name( lt_standard ) exp = 'Standard Table' ).

    TYPES tt_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should be Sorted Table' act = lo_cut->get_table_kind_name( lt_sorted ) exp = 'Sorted Table' ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (`sflights`) und fügen Sie einige Daten hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table IMPORTING it_source_table TYPE any TABLE
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lo_new_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_source_table ).
        lo_line_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).

        " Create a new table descriptor based on the source table's line type
        lo_new_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                p_line_type  = lo_line_descr
                                p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
                                p_unique     = abap_false ).

        " Create dynamic internal table
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_new_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

        " Fill with some example data (assuming it_source_table has at least one line)
        IF it_source_table IS NOT INITIAL.
          LOOP AT it_source_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_source_line>) UP TO 2 ROWS.
            CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
            ASSIGN <ls_dynamic_line> TO <fs_source_line>. " This is a simplified copy, real copy needs field-symbol iteration
            APPEND <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Handle error
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_sflights ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be initial' act = <lt_dynamic_table> IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Dynamic table should have 2 entries' act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).
    " Further checks would involve comparing content, which is more complex with dynamic types.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Erstellung von internen Tabellen mittels RTTI ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Anwendungen. Zuerst wird die Typbeschreibung des Zeilentyps der Quelltabelle ermittelt. Dann wird mit `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create()` ein neuer Tabellentyp definiert und mit `CREATE DATA` eine Instanz dieser dynamischen Tabelle erzeugt. Daten können dann über Field-Symbols eingefügt werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs als Eingabe akzeptiert und deren Inhalt in eine Tabelle von Strings umwandelt, wobei RTTI und String-Templates verwendet werden.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Komponenten des Zeilentyps und verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOL` für den dynamischen Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_to_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS table_to_string_table IMPORTING it_any_table TYPE any TABLE
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_string_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_generic_to_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD table_to_string_table.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA lv_line_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_any_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT it_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
          CLEAR lv_line_string.
          LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              lv_line_string = lv_line_string && |{ <fs_component> } |. 
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND lv_line_string TO rt_string_table.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND 'Error: Input is not a structured table.' TO rt_string_table.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp.
        APPEND 'Error: Cannot describe table components.' TO rt_string_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_to_string_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_to_string_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_generic_to_string( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( id = 1 text = 'Hello' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE ty_test_data( id = 2 text = 'World' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result_strings) = lo_cut->table_to_string_table( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_result_strings ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First string should contain 1 and Hello' act = lt_result_strings[ 1 ] exp = '1 Hello ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second string should contain 2 and World' act = lt_result_strings[ 2 ] exp = '2 World ' ).

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.
    DATA(lt_sflights_strings) = lo_cut->table_to_string_table( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'SFLIGHTS result table should have 1 entry' act = lines( lt_sflights_strings ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'SFLIGHTS string should not be empty' act = lt_sflights_strings[ 1 ] IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Methode demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von RTTI und Field-Symbols für generische Datenverarbeitung. Sie kann den Inhalt jeder strukturierten internen Tabelle lesen und in eine String-Tabelle umwandeln, ohne den genauen Typ zur Kompilierzeit zu kennen. Die String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung der einzelnen Zeilen verwendet, was eine moderne Syntax darstellt.
keywords: RTTI, Field-Symbols, Dynamic Programming, Generic Programming, String Templates, SABP_RTTI, Run Time Type Services

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Schlüsseldefinition einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `get_keys()` von `cl_abap_tabledescr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_key_info IMPORTING it_data TYPE any TABLE
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_key_components) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_key_info.
    DATA lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    DATA lt_keys TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_table.
    DATA lv_key_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_data ).
        lt_keys = lo_table_descr->get_keys( ).

        LOOP AT lt_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
          lv_key_string = |Key Type: { ls_key-key_kind }|.
          IF ls_key-components IS NOT INITIAL.
            lv_key_string = lv_key_string && | Components: { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR comp IN ls_key-components NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp-name ELSE s && ', ' && comp-name ) ) }|.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND lv_key_string TO rt_key_components.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        APPEND 'Error: Input is not a table type.' TO rt_key_components.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Dies ist essenziell für die dynamische Verarbeitung von Tabellen, bei der die Schlüsselstruktur zur Laufzeit bekannt sein muss. Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und fügen Sie sie einer neuen internen Tabelle hinzu.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise pro Fluggesellschaft. Fügen Sie die Ergebnisse einer neuen Tabelle hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` oder `SUM` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES tt_carrier_total TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_total.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_carrier_total TYPE ty_carrier_total.

    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_carrier_total-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_carrier_total-total_price = REDUCE #( 
        INIT sum_price = 0 TYPE sflight-price
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + grouped_flight-price
      ).
      APPEND ls_carrier_total TO rt_carrier_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'GBP' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itl_append_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_carrier( mt_test_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      exp = 3

    ).
    DATA(ls_lh_total) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_lh_total-total_price
      exp = '270.00' " 100 + 120 + 50
      msg = 'Total price for LH should be 270.00'
    ).
    DATA(ls_aa_total) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_aa_total-total_price

      msg = 'Total price for AA should be 200.00'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie das Ergebnis in einer Tabelle mit einer Zeile zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itl_append_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_count_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
        iv_carrier     TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_count) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itl_append_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_count_by_carrier.
    DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
    APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = iv_carrier count = lv_count ) TO rt_flight_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen gegebenen Zeitstempel von einer Quellzeitzone (z.B. 'UTC') in eine Zielzeitzone (z.B. 'CET') und formatieren Sie das Ergebnis für die deutsche Ländereinstellung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitzonenkonvertierung und `cl_abap_datfm` für die Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_int_timezone_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_format_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp   TYPE timestampl
        iv_source_tz   TYPE timezone DEFAULT 'UTC'
        iv_target_tz   TYPE timezone DEFAULT 'CET'
        iv_locale      TYPE sy-langu DEFAULT 'DE'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_datetime) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_int_timezone_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_format_timestamp.
    DATA: lv_target_date TYPE d,
          lv_target_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_syst(
      EXPORTING
        iv_tstmp   = iv_timestamp
        iv_tzone   = iv_target_tz
      IMPORTING
        ev_date    = lv_target_date
        ev_time    = lv_target_time
    ).

    DATA(lo_datfm) = cl_abap_datfm=>get_instance( iv_locale ).
    rv_formatted_datetime = |{ lo_datfm->format_date( lv_target_date ) } { lo_datfm->format_time( lv_target_time ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_and_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_and_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_int_timezone_conv( ).
    " UTC 2025-12-04 10:00:00
    DATA(lv_utc_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp_from_date_time(
                               iv_date = '20251204'
                               iv_time = '100000' ).

    " CET is UTC+1 (standard time) or UTC+2 (daylight saving)
    " For Dec 4, 2025, CET is UTC+1
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->convert_and_format_timestamp(
      iv_timestamp = lv_utc_timestamp
      iv_source_tz = 'UTC'
      iv_target_tz = 'CET'
      iv_locale    = 'DE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_formatted
      exp = '04.12.2025 11:00:00' " 10:00 UTC -> 11:00 CET
      msg = 'Timestamp should be converted to CET and formatted for German locale'
    ).

    " Test with US locale (EST is UTC-5)
    DATA(lv_formatted_us) = lo_cut->convert_and_format_timestamp(
      iv_timestamp = lv_utc_timestamp
      iv_source_tz = 'UTC'
      iv_target_tz = 'EST' " Eastern Standard Time
      iv_locale    = 'EN'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_formatted_us
      exp = '12/04/2025 05:00:00 AM' " 10:00 UTC -> 05:00 EST
      msg = 'Timestamp should be converted to EST and formatted for US locale'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `cl_abap_tstmp` für die präzise Zeitzonenkonvertierung und `cl_abap_datfm` für die ländereinstellungsspezifische Formatierung ist der moderne Ansatz, um Datums- und Zeitangaben korrekt und benutzerfreundlich in globalen Anwendungen darzustellen.
keywords: cl_abap_datfm, cl_abap_tstmp, Date/Time, Internationalization, Time Zone Conversion, Formatting

CLASS zcl_idx_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_idx_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO idx
                                  ( fldate = flight_line-fldate, index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Reduzieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen auf die Summe der Passagierkapazität, aber nur für die ersten 5 Zeilen. Verwenden Sie dabei `REDUCE` und `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife, die `LINE_INDEX` berücksichtigt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idx_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_capacity_first_n
      IMPORTING iv_n_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE sflight-seatsocc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idx_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_capacity_first_n.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR flight_line IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO idx
                                  WHERE ( idx <= iv_n_rows )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight_line-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idx_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_sum_capacity_first_n( 5 ).

    DATA lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test UP TO 5 ROWS.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR flight_line IN lt_sflights_test NEXT sum = sum + flight_line-seatsocc ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf funktionale Weise. Durch die Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `INDEX INTO` kann die Aggregation auf bestimmte Zeilenbereiche beschränkt werden, was eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Syntax ergibt.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, INDEX INTO, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_idx_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_idx_sequential_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_idx_sequential_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sequential_items.

                        ( id = i, value = |Item { i }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Meldungen eines Anwendungslogs, das zuvor mit einem bestimmten Objekt und Unterobjekt erstellt wurde.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET_LOG_HANDLE` und `GET_MESSAGES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_s_msg-msgty,
             msgid TYPE bal_s_msg-msgid,
             msgno TYPE bal_s_msg-msgno,
             msgv1 TYPE bal_s_msg-msgv1,
           END OF ty_log_message.
    TYPES tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_custom_log
      IMPORTING iv_object   TYPE bal_s_log-object
                iv_subobject TYPE bal_s_log-subobject
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_test_log
      IMPORTING iv_object   TYPE bal_s_log-object
                iv_subobject TYPE bal_s_log-subobject.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_custom_log.
    DATA(lo_bal_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_bal_log->get_log_handle(
      i_object   = iv_object
      i_subobject = iv_subobject
    ).

    IF lv_log_handle IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA lt_bal_messages TYPE bal_t_msg.
      lo_bal_log->get_messages(
        EXPORTING
          i_log_handle = lv_log_handle
        IMPORTING
          e_t_msg      = lt_bal_messages
      ).

      rt_messages = VALUE #( FOR msg IN lt_bal_messages
                             ( msgty = msg-msgty, msgid = msg-msgid, msgno = msg-msgno, msgv1 = msg-msgv1 ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_log.
    DATA(lo_bal_log) = NEW cl_s_aut_bal_log( ).
    DATA(ls_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object   = iv_object
      subobject = iv_subobject
      extnumber = 'TEST_LOG_001'
    ).
    lo_bal_log->create_log( i_s_log_header = ls_header ).
    lo_bal_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Testmeldung 1' ).
    lo_bal_log->add_message( i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Testmeldung 2' ).
    lo_bal_log->save_log( ). " Wichtig: Log speichern, damit es gelesen werden kann
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_custom_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_custom_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    CONSTANTS: lc_object TYPE bal_s_log-object VALUE 'Z_TEST_OBJ',
               lc_subobject TYPE bal_s_log-subobject VALUE 'Z_TEST_SUB'.

    " Vorbereitung: Test-Log erstellen und speichern
    lo_cut->create_test_log( iv_object = lc_object iv_subobject = lc_subobject ).

    " Test: Log lesen
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_custom_log( iv_object = lc_object iv_subobject = lc_subobject ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of messages should be 2' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First message text incorrect' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Testmeldung 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Lesen von Anwendungslogs erfolgt über die Log-Handle-Verwaltung. Zuerst wird mit `GET_LOG_HANDLE` ein Handle für das gewünschte Log abgerufen. Anschließend können mit `GET_MESSAGES` alle Meldungen, die zu diesem Handle gehören, ausgelesen werden. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und gezielte Analyse von Protokolldaten.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugnummern und den Index der Zeilen enthält, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft haben, aber nur für jede zweite gefundene Zeile.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` mit `WHERE` und `INDEX INTO` sowie dem Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_idx_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             index  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_filtered.
    TYPES tt_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_indexed_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_idx_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_indexed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight_line IN lt_sflights INDEX INTO idx
                                  WHERE ( flight_line-carrid = iv_carrid AND idx MOD 2 = 0 )
                                  ( carrid = flight_line-carrid, connid = flight_line-connid, index = idx ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_indexed_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_filtered_indexed_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_idx_complex_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_indexed_flights( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First filtered index should be even' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index MOD 2 exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'All entries should be for LH' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die Leistungsfähigkeit von `FOR`-Schleifen in Kombination mit `WHERE`-Bedingungen und `INDEX INTO`. Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von Daten in einem einzigen, funktionalen Ausdruck, wobei komplexe Bedingungen wie der Modulo-Operator auf den Index angewendet werden können, um spezifische Zeilen auszuwählen.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, INDEX INTO, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Modulo

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den frühesten Zeitstempel aus einer Liste von Zeitstempeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tst_min_tstmp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_min_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        it_timestamps TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_tstmp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tst_min_tstmp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_timestamp.
    rv_min_tstmp = REDUCE timestampl(
      INIT min_tstmp = '99991231235959'
      FOR tstmp IN it_timestamps
      NEXT min_tstmp = COND timestampl( WHEN tstmp < min_tstmp THEN tstmp ELSE min_tstmp )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_min_tstmp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_min_tstmp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tst_min_tstmp( ).
    DATA(lt_timestamps) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF timestampl(
      ( '20251204100000' )
      ( '20251204090000' )
      ( '20251204110000' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_min) = '20251204090000'.

    DATA(lv_actual_min) = lo_cut->get_min_timestamp( lt_timestamps ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_min
      exp = lv_expected_min
      msg = 'Minimum timestamp calculation failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP, um eine einzelne Ergebniswert aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um iterativ den kleinsten Zeitstempel zu finden, indem jeder Zeitstempel mit dem bisher gefundenen Minimum verglichen wird.
keywords: TIMESTAMP, REDUCE, MINIMUM, INTERNE TABELLEN

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Währungsumrechnung von einem Betrag in EUR nach USD durch, unter Berücksichtigung eines Umrechnungskurses. Instructions: Führen Sie einen Down-Cast einer generischen Objekt-Referenz auf eine spezifischere Subklassen-Referenz durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CAST` Operator.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE f.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_shape DEFINITION ABSTRACT PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    " Standardimplementierung oder abstrakt
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_shape.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE f.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE f.
    METHODS zif_shape~get_area REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cast_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_down_cast
      IMPORTING
        io_generic_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_circle) TYPE REF TO zcl_circle.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cast_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_down_cast.
    " Versuch, die generische Form auf einen spezifischen Kreis herunterzucasten
    TRY.
        ro_circle = CAST #( io_generic_shape ).
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, falls der Cast nicht möglich ist (z.B. es ist kein Kreis)
        CLEAR ro_circle.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_successful_cast FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_failed_cast FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_cast.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_demo( ).
    DATA(lo_circle_instance) = NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = 5 ).
    DATA(lo_generic_shape) = CAST zif_shape( lo_circle_instance ). " Up-Cast zuerst

    DATA(lo_casted_circle) = lo_cut->perform_down_cast( lo_generic_shape ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_casted_circle ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_casted_circle->mv_radius exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_cast.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cast_demo( ).
    " Simulieren eines fehlgeschlagenen Casts durch Übergabe einer initialen Referenz
    DATA lo_initial_shape TYPE REF TO zif_shape.
    DATA(lo_failed_cast) = lo_cut->perform_down_cast( lo_initial_shape ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_failed_cast ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CAST` Operator ist die moderne und typsichere Methode, um Referenzen zwischen Objekten in einer Vererbungshierarchie zu konvertieren (Down-Cast). Er ersetzt die ältere `MOVE`-Anweisung für Referenzen und bietet eine klare Syntax, die zur Laufzeit eine `cx_sy_move_cast_error`-Exception auslöst, wenn der Cast nicht möglich ist.
keywords: CAST, Object Orientation, Down-Cast, Polymorphism

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und konvertieren Sie den Preis von der ursprünglichen Währung in eine Zielwährung (vereinfacht, nur Multiplikation).
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO TABLE` und den `FOR` Iterator mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_currency_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price_eur TYPE p DECIMALS 2, " Price in EUR
           END OF ty_s_flight_price,
           ty_t_flight_prices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_eur
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency_rate TYPE f " e.g., 1.08 for USD to EUR
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_prices.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_currency_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_eur.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    " Konvertieren Sie Preise in EUR (hypothetisch, angenommen Original ist USD und Rate ist USD->EUR)
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          LET lv_price_eur = ls_sflight-price * iv_currency_rate IN
                          ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                            price_eur = CONV p( lv_price_eur ) ) ). " CONV zur Sicherstellung der korrekten Dezimalbehandlung
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_currency_conv( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_eur( iv_currency_rate = '0.90' ). " USD to EUR Rate

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ) ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Preise konvertiert wurden (z.B. erster Eintrag)
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_first_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-price_eur ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Lesen von Daten aus einer Datenbanktabelle (`sflights`) und die anschließende Transformation der Daten, einschließlich einer vereinfachten Währungsumrechnung. Die Verwendung des `FOR` Iterators mit `VALUE` ermöglicht eine funktionale und kompakte Datenverarbeitung und -zuweisung. Der `CONV` Operator wird hier verwendet, um das Ergebnis der Multiplikation sicher in den Dezimaltyp zu konvertieren.
keywords: sflights, SELECT, VALUE, FOR, CONV, Currency, Internal Tables

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen basierend auf einer Bedingung einen Wert zu, wobei der zugewiesene Wert eine Typkonvertierung erfordert.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `COND` Operator in Kombination mit `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_conv_assign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_converted_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_condition TYPE abap_bool
        iv_string_val_true TYPE string
        iv_string_val_false TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_integer_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_conv_assign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_converted_value.
    rv_integer_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_condition = abap_true THEN CONV i( iv_string_val_true )
      ELSE CONV i( iv_string_val_false )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Summieren Sie die numerischen Werte einer Spalte einer internen Tabelle, wobei die Werte als String vorliegen und vor der Addition in einen Integer konvertiert werden müssen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit `CONV` für die Inline-Typkonvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string, " Numerischer Wert als String
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_conv_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_total_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR item IN it_items
      NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( item-value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle nach Einträgen, deren numerischer Wert (als String gespeichert) einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet.

solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_conv_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string, " Numerischer Wert als String
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_value
      IMPORTING
        it_data       TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_conv_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_value.
    rt_filtered_data = FILTER #(
      it_data
      WHERE CONV i( value ) > iv_threshold
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Listen Sie alle konfigurierbaren Attribute für einen bestimmten Code Inspector Check auf, inklusive ihrer Beschreibungen. (Hinweis: Die genauen Check-Namen können je nach System variieren. Hier wird ein hypothetisches Beispiel verwendet.)
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes_for_check`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_list_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_attribute,
             name        TYPE string,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_attribute,
           ty_t_attributes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_attribute WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_check_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE ty_t_attributes.

CLASS zcl_ci_list_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_check_attributes.
    DATA: lt_ci_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>ty_t_attributes.

    TRY.
        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes_for_check(
          EXPORTING
            i_check_name = iv_check_name
          IMPORTING
            et_attributes = lt_ci_attributes
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_ci_attributes INTO DATA(ls_ci_attr).
          APPEND VALUE ty_s_attribute(
            name        = ls_ci_attr-attribute_name
            description = ls_ci_attr-attribute_text
          ) TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_ci_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Check nicht gefunden
        " In einem realen Szenario den Fehler protokollieren oder eine Exception auslösen
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge dieser Gesellschaft um einen gegebenen Prozentsatz. Nutzen Sie dabei `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und moderne Tabellenoperationen.

CLASS zcl_fs_flight_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percentage TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2
      CHANGING
        ct_flights   TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_flight_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percentage / 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die den Wert einer spezifischen Komponente einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest. Der Komponentenname wird als String übergeben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_component_name) OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data         TYPE REF TO data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_value>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    rv_value = <fs_value>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Methode, die in einer internen Tabelle (beliebigen Typs) den Wert eines dynamisch angegebenen Feldes für alle Zeilen aktualisiert, die ein bestimmtes Kriterium erfüllen. Das Kriterium ist hier ein fester Wert für ein anderes dynamisch angegebenes Feld.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` für den Feldnamen und den Kriteriumsfeldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_generic_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_table_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref      TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_to_update TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
        iv_criteria_field TYPE string
        iv_criteria_value TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_generic_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_table_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table>       TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>        TYPE any,
                   <fs_update_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_criteria_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_criteria_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_criteria_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.

      IF <fs_criteria_field> = iv_criteria_value.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_to_update OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_update_field>.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error. ENDIF.
        <fs_update_field> = iv_new_value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Item A' value = 'Old Value 1' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Item B' value = 'Old Value 2' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Item A' value = 'Old Value 3' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_table) = REF #( lt_data ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fs_generic_update( ).

    lo_cut->update_table_field(
      ir_table_ref       = lr_table
      iv_field_to_update = 'VALUE'
      iv_new_value       = 'New Value'
      iv_criteria_field  = 'NAME'
      iv_criteria_value  = 'Item A'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-value exp = 'New Value' msg = 'Item 1 value should be updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_data ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-value exp = 'Old Value 2' msg = 'Item 2 value should not be updated' ).
    READ TABLE lt_data ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 3.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-value exp = 'New Value' msg = 'Item 3 value should be updated' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( id = 1 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_assign_error ).
    lo_cut->update_table_field(
      ir_table_ref       = lr_table
      iv_field_to_update = 'NON_EXISTENT'
      iv_new_value       = 'X'
      iv_criteria_field  = 'ID'
      iv_criteria_value  = '1'

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines dynamisch bestimmten numerischen Feldes (z.B. 'PRICE' oder 'FLDATE' (als Zahl interpretiert)) in der Tabelle `sflights` für alle Einträge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)   TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rv_sum = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
                       FOR <fs_line> IN it_flights
                       LET lv_value = 0 TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 IN
                       BLOCK
                         ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
                         IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                           RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
                         ENDIF.
                         TRY.
                             lv_value = <fs_field>.
                           CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                             " Ignore non-numeric values or handle as needed
                         ENDTRY.
                         s = s + lv_value
                       ENDBLOCK ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle `sflights` mindestens ein Flug existiert, bei dem ein dynamisch angegebener Feldname einen bestimmten Wert enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` in einer `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_field_value_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_flights      TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name   TYPE string
        iv_search_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_exists) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_field_value_exists.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_flights ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
      ENDIF.

      IF <fs_field> = iv_search_value.
        rb_exists = abap_true.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rb_exists = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_mime_display( lo_container ).

    " This path must exist in your MIME repository for the test to pass.
    " Example: /SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/MIME_REPOSITORY_TEST_IMAGE.PNG
    DATA(lv_mime_path) = '/SAP/PUBLIC/BC/ABAP/MIME_REPOSITORY_TEST_IMAGE.PNG'.

    " Create a dummy entry in MIME repository for testing if it doesn't exist
    DATA(lo_mime_api) = cl_mime_repository_api=>get_api( ).
    DATA(lx_png_data) = '89504E470D0A1A0A0000000D49484452000000010000000108060000001F15C4890000000D4944415478DA63600000000200012F3BFF0000000049454E44AE426082'.
    TRY.
        lo_mime_api->put( i_path = lv_mime_path i_content = lx_png_data i_language = sy-langu i_devclass = '$TMP' i_suppress_dialog = abap_true ).
      CATCH cx_mime_repository_exception.
        " Ignore if already exists or cannot create
    ENDTRY.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->load_and_display_from_mime( lv_mime_path ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Loading from MIME repository should not raise an exception' ).
      CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |GUI Exception: { lx_gui->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_mime_repository_exception INTO DATA(lx_mime).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = |MIME Exception: { lx_mime->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    FREE lo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_mime_path.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'DUMMY_CONTAINER' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_pic_mime_display( lo_container ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_mime_path) = '/SAP/PUBLIC/NON_EXISTENT_IMAGE.JPG'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_mime_repository_exception ).
    lo_cut->load_and_display_from_mime( lv_invalid_mime_path ).

    FREE lo_container.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration von `cl_gui_picture` mit dem SAP MIME-Repository. Bilder, die im MIME-Repository gespeichert sind, können über `cl_mime_repository_api` als XSTRING-Daten abgerufen und dann mit `load_picture_from_data` im Bild-Control angezeigt werden. Dies ist eine gängige Methode zur Verwaltung und Anzeige von statischen Bildern in SAP-Anwendungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Datenobjekt basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit ermittelten Typ und weisen Sie ihm einen Wert zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_datadescr=>create_data` und Feld-Symbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_set_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_data.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_type_name ).
    DATA(lo_data_descr) = CAST cl_abap_datadescr( lo_type_descr ).

    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_data_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          <fs_data> = iv_value.
          rv_result = |Dynamisch erstelltes Objekt vom Typ { iv_type_name } mit Wert '{ <fs_data> }' zugewiesen.|.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
          rv_result = |Fehler bei der Typkonvertierung für Typ { iv_type_name } und Wert '{ iv_value }'.|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = |Fehler: Feld-Symbol konnte nicht zugewiesen werden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Hello Dynamic' in = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_int_fail.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_set_data( iv_type_name = 'I' iv_value = 'Not an integer' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Fehler bei der Typkonvertierung' in = lv_result ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die mächtige Fähigkeit, Datenobjekte zur Laufzeit zu erstellen. `CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_data_descr` nutzt das RTTI-Objekt, um den Typ zu definieren. Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) sind unerlässlich, um auf den Inhalt dynamisch erstellter Datenobjekte zuzugreifen. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die formatierte Ausgabe verwendet.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_datadescr, create_data, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Dynamic Programming, String Templates

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rt_param_names = VALUE #( FOR param IN lo_method_descr->get_parameter_list( )

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_compatible
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name1 TYPE string
        iv_type_name2 TYPE string

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_compatible.

    IF lo_type_descr1->get_absolute_name( ) = lo_type_descr2->get_absolute_name( ).
      rv_compatible = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen Down-Cast einer Referenzvariablen mit dem `CAST`-Operator durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `CAST`-Operator und `IS INSTANCE OF` zur Prüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_superclass DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_superclass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type_name.
    rv_name = 'Superclass'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_subclass DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_rtti_superclass PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sub_type_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_subclass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sub_type_name.
    rv_name = 'Subclass Specific'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_cast_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_down_cast
      IMPORTING
        io_super_ref TYPE REF TO zcl_rtti_superclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sub_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_cast_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_down_cast.
    IF io_super_ref IS INSTANCE OF zcl_rtti_subclass.
      DATA(lo_sub_ref) = CAST zcl_rtti_subclass( io_super_ref ).
      rv_sub_type_name = lo_sub_ref->get_sub_type_name( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_sub_type_name = 'Not a subclass instance'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_failed_cast FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_cast.
    DATA(lo_sub_obj) = NEW zcl_rtti_subclass( ).
    DATA(lo_super_ref) = CAST zcl_rtti_superclass( lo_sub_obj ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_cast_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_down_cast( lo_super_ref ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Subclass Specific' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_failed_cast.
    DATA(lo_super_obj) = NEW zcl_rtti_superclass( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_cast_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_down_cast( lo_super_obj ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Not a subclass instance' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Die Prüfung `IS INSTANCE OF` ist entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler zu vermeiden, falls das Objekt nicht vom erwarteten Typ ist. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Konzept der objektorientierten Programmierung in modernem ABAP.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit, ob ein Typ ein Referenztyp ist und zu welchem Typ er referenziert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_refdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_referenced_type`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_ref_type_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_referenced_type_name
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ref_type_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_ref_type_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_referenced_type_name.
    DATA(lo_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( ir_data ).

    IF lo_type_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_ref.
      DATA(lo_ref_descr) = CAST cl_abap_refdescr( lo_type_descr ).
      DATA(lo_referenced_type) = lo_ref_descr->get_referenced_type( ).
      rv_ref_type_name = lo_referenced_type->get_absolute_name( ).
    ELSE.
      rv_ref_type_name = 'Not a reference type'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_non_ref_type FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_data_ref_type.
    DATA: lv_string TYPE string VALUE 'Test'.
    DATA: lr_string TYPE REF TO string.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_string INTO lr_string.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_ref_type_info( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_referenced_type_name( lr_string ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '\TYPE=STRING' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_ref_type.
    DATA: lv_int TYPE i VALUE 1.
    DATA: lr_int TYPE REF TO data.
    GET REFERENCE OF lv_int INTO lr_int.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_ref_type_info( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_referenced_type_name( lr_int ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '\TYPE=I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Referenztypen zur Laufzeit analysiert. Zuerst wird geprüft, ob es sich um einen Referenztyp handelt (`type_kind = typekind_ref`). Dann wird das generische `cl_abap_typedescr`-Objekt in `cl_abap_refdescr` gecastet, um die Methode `get_referenced_type` aufzurufen, die den Typ des referenzierten Objekts zurückgibt.

Instructions: Fragen Sie die Attribute eines spezifischen Code Inspector Checks ab, z.B. ob er aktiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_check_attributes`.

CLASS zcl_ci_check_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_check_active_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_check_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_active) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_check_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_check_active_status.
    DATA: lt_check_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>ty_t_check_attributes.

    TRY.
        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_check_attributes(
          EXPORTING
            i_check_name      = iv_check_name
          IMPORTING
            e_t_check_attr    = lt_check_attributes
        ).

        IF line_exists( lt_check_attributes[ 1 ] ).
          rv_is_active = lt_check_attributes[ 1 ]-is_active.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_active = abap_false.
        END IF.

      CATCH cx_ci_error.
        rv_is_active = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
