Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie den Fluggesellschaftscode sowie die Anzahl der Flüge für jede Gruppe aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... INTO DATA(group_key)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_count,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             num_flights TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_count.
    TYPES tt_grouped_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING it_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_grouped_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member).
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid num_flights = lv_count ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_loop_group_by=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' distance = 1000 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' distance = 1200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' distance = 500 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' distance = 1500 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' distance = 800 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_group ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-num_flights exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_group ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-num_flights exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ermöglicht die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code. Dies ist eine moderne und lesbare Alternative zu älteren Methoden mit `AT NEW` oder manuellen Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen. `group_key` repräsentiert die Gruppierungskriterien, und `LOOP AT GROUP` iteriert über die Mitglieder der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Grouping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten die durchschnittliche Flugdistanz mithilfe von `REDUCE` innerhalb einer `GROUP BY`-Schleife.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für benutzerdefinierte Aggregationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_dist,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_distance TYPE s_distance,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_dist.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_dist TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_dist WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_avg_distance
      IMPORTING it_flights        TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_avg_distances) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_dist.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_avg_distance.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key).
      DATA(lv_avg_distance) = REDUCE s_distance(
        INIT sum_dist = 0 count = 0
        FOR member IN GROUP group_key
        NEXT sum_dist = sum_dist + member-distance
             count = count + 1
        RESULT COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_dist / count ELSE 0 ) ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = group_key-carrid avg_distance = lv_avg_distance ) TO rt_avg_distances.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_group_by_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_group_by_reduce=>tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' distance = 1000 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' distance = 1200 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' distance = 500 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' distance = 1500 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250101' distance = 800 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_avg_distance( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_lh_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_lh_group ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-avg_distance exp = ( 1000 + 1200 + 1500 ) / 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_group) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_aa_group ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-avg_distance exp = 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit dem `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht es, komplexe Aggregationen und Berechnungen pro Gruppe auf eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Weise durchzuführen. `REDUCE` initialisiert Variablen und iteriert über die Gruppenmitglieder, um ein Endergebnis zu berechnen.
keywords: GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail IMPLEMENTATION.

        cl_bcs_utilities=>send_mail(

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte in einer internen Tabelle zu und geben Sie diese Werte zurück.

CLASS zcl_dyn_col_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_column_values
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_column_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_col_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_value>   TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_table ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zufällig, um eine zufällige Reihenfolge zu erhalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` um zufällige Indizes zu generieren und tauschen Sie Elemente.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_shuffle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        text TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_shuffle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( ct_table ).
    IF lv_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_size
    ).

    LOOP AT ct_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-tabix.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap current line with a random line
      SWAP ct_table INDEX lv_current_index WITH ct_table INDEX lv_random_index.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA: lt_original TYPE zcl_random_shuffle=>ty_t_data,
          lt_shuffled TYPE zcl_random_shuffle=>ty_t_data.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_original ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>).
      <fs_line>-id = sy-index.
      <fs_line>-text = |Item { sy-index }|.
    ENDDO.

    lt_shuffled = lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_shuffle( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_shuffled ).

    " Assert that the table size remains the same
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    " Assert that all original elements are still present (order might change)
    LOOP AT lt_original ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_orig>).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_shuffled ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_shuf>).
        IF <fs_orig>-id = <fs_shuf>-id AND <fs_orig>-text = <fs_shuf>-text.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found msg = |Element { <fs_orig>-id } not found after shuffle.| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " It's highly improbable for a shuffled table to be identical to the original (for >1 element)
    IF lines( lt_original ) > 1.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = lt_shuffled exp = lt_original msg = 'Table was not shuffled (unlikely).' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `shuffle_table` verwendet `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` um eine Instanz eines Zufallszahlengenerators zu erstellen. In einer Schleife wird für jede Zeile ein zufälliger Index generiert und die aktuelle Zeile mit der Zeile am zufälligen Index getauscht. Dies führt zu einer zufälligen Permutation der Tabellenzeilen.
keywords: RANDOM, SHUFFLE, INTERNAL TABLE, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Wert einer bestimmten Spalte in einer internen Tabelle für alle Zeilen auf einen neuen Wert setzt. Die interne Tabelle und der Spaltenname sind generisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für die Tabelle und die Zeile, sowie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_mod DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_column_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref   TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_new_value   TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_mod IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_column_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: Not a valid table reference
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Assign new value, type conversion might be needed depending on <fs_field> type
        TRY.
            <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
            " Handle type conversion error if necessary
            " For simplicity, we assume compatible types or string conversion is fine.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` um einen zufälligen Index zu generieren und `READ TABLE` mit diesem Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_t_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_item
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_item
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_item) TYPE ty_item
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_item.
    DATA(lv_size) = lines( it_items ).
    IF lv_size = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_items INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_item.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Should not happen if lv_random_index is within bounds
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_random_item.

CLASS zcl_helper_for_dyn_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_helper_for_dyn_call IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object      TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL " For methods with one string import
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab,
          ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_INPUT'. " Assuming the target method has an IV_INPUT parameter
      ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>parameter_importing.
      GET REFERENCE OF iv_param_value INTO ls_parameter-value.
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            VALUE(result) = rv_result. " Direct assignment if return type is string
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen String (z.B. für ein Passwort) einer bestimmten Länge, der Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben und Ziffern enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates, um Zeichen aus einem vordefinierten Zeichensatz auszuwählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
    ENDIF.

    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE
      'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_set_length) = strlen( lc_chars ).

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 0
      high = lv_char_set_length - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lc_chars+lv_random_index(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_random_string) = lo_cut->generate_random_string( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = 10 ).
    " Check if the string contains only allowed characters
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_chars TYPE string VALUE
      'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_contains_only_allowed) = abap_true.
    DO strlen( lv_random_string ) TIMES.
      DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_string+sy-index(1).
      IF NOT ( find( val = lc_allowed_chars sub = lv_char ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
        lv_contains_only_allowed = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_contains_only_allowed msg = 'String contains forbidden characters.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
        class_name = 'CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS'
        method_name = 'GENERATE_RANDOM_STRING'
        object_instance = lo_cut
        parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IV_LENGTH' value = REF #( 0 ) ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

In einer Schleife wird für jeden Index ein Zeichen aus dem Zeichensatz ausgewählt und an den Ergebnisstring angehängt. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die prüft, ob eine bestimmte Spalte in einer internen Tabelle einen bestimmten Wert enthält. Der Spaltenname und der Wert sind dynamisch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den dynamischen Zugriff und Vergleich.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_column_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS contains_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref   TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        iv_column_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_search_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_column_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD contains_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF |{ <fs_field> }| = iv_search_value.
          rv_found = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    rv_found = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Würfelwurf (Zahl zwischen 1 und 6).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit den entsprechenden Grenzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roll DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roll IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD roll_dice.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = 6
    ).
    rv_result = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_roll_dice_range FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_roll_dice_distribution FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_roll_dice_range.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roll( ).
    DO 100 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_roll) = lo_cut->roll_dice( ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_roll >= 1 AND lv_roll <= 6 ) msg = |Roll { lv_roll } is out of range.| ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_roll_dice_distribution.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roll( ).
    DATA: lt_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_sum     TYPE i.

    DO 1000 TIMES.
      APPEND lo_cut->roll_dice( ) TO lt_results.
    ENDDO.

    " Check if all numbers from 1 to 6 appeared at least once (highly probable with 1000 rolls)
    DATA(lv_all_numbers_present) = abap_true.
    DO 6 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_number) = sy-index.
      READ TABLE lt_results WITH KEY table_line = lv_number TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_all_numbers_present = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_all_numbers_present msg = 'Not all numbers (1-6) appeared in 1000 rolls (unlikely).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `roll_dice` instanziiert `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` mit den Grenzen 1 und 6, um einen Zufallszahlengenerator für einen Würfelwurf zu erstellen. Der Aufruf von `get_next()` liefert dann die zufällige Zahl innerhalb dieses Bereichs. Dies ist die moderne und sichere Art, Zufallszahlen in ABAP zu generieren.
keywords: RANDOM, MATH, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, DICE ROLL

Instructions: Wählen Sie N eindeutige zufällige Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine Hilfstabelle für bereits ausgewählte Indizes, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_entries DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_t_item TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_n_random_unique_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_t_item
        iv_count TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_items) TYPE ty_t_item
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_entries IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_n_random_unique_items.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_items ).
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_count > lv_table_size.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lt_selected_indices TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_table_size
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = 0.
      DO.
        lv_random_index = lo_random->get_next( ).
        INSERT lv_random_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. " Index was unique and inserted
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
      APPEND it_items[ lv_random_index ] TO rt_random_items.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_random_unique_entries=>ty_t_item(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Date' )
      ( id = 5 name = 'Elderberry' )

    DATA(lt_random_items) = lo_cut->get_n_random_unique_items( it_items = lt_items iv_count = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_random_items ) exp = 3 ).

    " Check for uniqueness in the result
    DATA(lt_unique_ids) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_random_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      INSERT ls_item-id INTO TABLE lt_unique_ids.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_ids ) exp = 3 msg = 'Resulting items are not unique.' ).

    " Check if all returned items are from the original list
    LOOP AT lt_random_items INTO ls_item.
      READ TABLE lt_items WITH KEY id = ls_item-id TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = |Item { ls_item-id } not from original list.| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_count.

      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_entries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
        class_name = 'CX_SY_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS'
        method_name = 'GET_N_RANDOM_UNIQUE_ITEMS'

        object_instance = lo_cut
        parameters = VALUE #( ( name = 'IT_ITEMS' value = REF #( lt_items ) ) 
                              ( name = 'IV_COUNT' value = REF #( 2 ) ) ) 
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Sortierfunktion für interne Tabellen, bei der die Sortierfelder dynamisch zur Laufzeit angegeben werden können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `SORT` mit der `BY` Option, die dynamische Feldnamen akzeptiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref   TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
        it_sort_fields TYPE string_table. " List of field names to sort by
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sort_string) = ``.
    LOOP AT it_sort_fields INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      IF lv_sort_string IS INITIAL.
        lv_sort_string = lv_field_name.
      ELSE.
        lv_sort_string = lv_sort_string && ` ` && lv_field_name.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_sort_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      SORT <fs_table> BY (lv_sort_string).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine zufällige Auswahl von Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, wobei die Anzahl der Flüge und die Kriterien (z.B. Fluggesellschaft) zufällig sein können.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` für die Anzahl und `FOR` mit `COND` für die Filterung, sowie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff auf die Flugdaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_flights TYPE i OPTIONAL
        iv_carrid_filter TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_sflight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE ty_sflight_table.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    IF lt_all_flights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_all_flights ).
    DATA(lv_num_flights_to_select) = iv_max_flights.

    IF lv_num_flights_to_select = 0.
      DATA(lo_random_count) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_table_size ).
      lv_num_flights_to_select = lo_random_count->get_next( ).
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_table_size ).
    DATA(lt_selected_indices) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.

    DO lv_num_flights_to_select TIMES.
      DATA(lv_index) = 0.
      DO.
        lv_index = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
        INSERT lv_index INTO TABLE lt_selected_indices.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. " Unique index found
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_flight> TYPE sflight.
      READ TABLE lt_all_flights INDEX lv_index ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        IF iv_carrid_filter IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid_filter IS NOT INITIAL.
          IF <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_carrid_filter.
            APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_flights.
          ELSE.
            " If filtered, and not matching, decrement counter to try again
            lv_num_flights_to_select = lv_num_flights_to_select + 1.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          APPEND <fs_flight> TO rt_flights.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle in eine CSV-formatierte Zeichenkette umwandelt. Die Spaltennamen sollen als Header dienen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Zugriff auf Zeilen und Komponenten und `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` für die Spaltennamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_to_csv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref   TYPE REF TO data " Reference to any internal table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_csv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_to_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_csv.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table> ).
    DATA(lo_line_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_line_descr->get_components( ).

    " Build header row
    DATA(lv_header) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR comp IN lt_components
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN comp-name ELSE s && ',' && comp-name )
    ).
    rv_csv_string = lv_header.

    " Build data rows
    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      DATA(lv_data_row) = REDUCE string(
        INIT s = ''
        FOR comp IN lt_components
        NEXT s = COND string(
          WHEN s IS INITIAL
          THEN |
| && ( ASSIGN COMPONENT comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component> THEN |{ <fs_component> }| ELSE '' )
          ELSE s && ',' && ( ASSIGN COMPONENT comp-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component> THEN |{ <fs_component> }| ELSE '' )
        )
      ).
      rv_csv_string = rv_csv_string && lv_data_row.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle nach einem dynamisch angegebenen Feld filtert und nur Zeilen zurückgibt, bei denen der Feldwert einem Suchmuster entspricht (z.B. LIKE-Operator).
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den dynamischen Feldzugriff und `FILTER` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die dynamische Vergleiche ermöglicht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        price    TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_table      TYPE ty_t_sflight
        iv_column_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_pattern     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE ty_t_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE ty_sflight,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    rt_filtered_table = FILTER #( it_table USING KEY primary_key WHERE
      ( ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field> AND
        <fs_field> CP iv_pattern ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_end_date   TYPE d
        iv_count      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_random_dates) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF d WITH EMPTY KEY
      RAISING
        cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_dates.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date OR iv_count <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = iv_end_date - iv_start_date.
    IF lv_days_diff < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_day_offset) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 0
      high = lv_days_diff
    ).

    DATA(lt_selected_offsets) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE SORTED KEY table_line.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
      DO.
        lv_offset = lo_random_day_offset->get_next( ).
        INSERT lv_offset INTO TABLE lt_selected_offsets.
        IF sy-subrc = 0. " Unique offset found
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
        IF lines( lt_selected_offsets ) > lv_days_diff. " All possible days selected
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.

      IF lines( lt_selected_offsets ) > lv_days_diff AND sy-subrc <> 0. " All possible days selected and no more unique offsets
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      APPEND ( iv_start_date + lv_offset ) TO rt_random_dates.
    ENDDO.

    SORT rt_random_dates ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_random_dates.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle SFLIGHT und lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen. Schließen Sie den Cursor anschließend explizit.
hint: Verwenden Sie OPEN CURSOR, FETCH NEXT CURSOR und CLOSE CURSOR.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_sflight_with_cursor
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_sflight_with_cursor.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
        FROM sflight.

    DO 5 TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflight.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_sflight_with_cursor( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 5 msg = 'Es sollten 5 Zeilen gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result[1]-carrid msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte nicht initial sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die explizite Steuerung eines Datenbank-Cursors mit `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`. Obwohl in den meisten Fällen `SELECT ... INTO TABLE` oder `PACKAGE SIZE` bevorzugt werden, ist die Cursor-Steuerung für sehr große Datenmengen oder spezielle Szenarien weiterhin relevant. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, FETCH, CLOSE CURSOR, SFLIGHT, Database Access

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor, schließen Sie ihn und versuchen Sie dann, ihn erneut zu schließen, um den Fehler zu demonstrieren. Fangen Sie den Fehler ab und prüfen Sie den Rückgabewert.
hint: Prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` nach `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS close_cursor_twice
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_subrc) TYPE sy-subrc.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD close_cursor_twice.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR lv_cursor FOR SELECT * FROM sflight.
    FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

    " Zweiter Versuch, einen bereits geschlossenen Cursor zu schließen
    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
    rv_subrc = sy-subrc.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_close_twice FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_close_twice.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_subrc) = lo_cut->close_cursor_twice( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_subrc exp = 0 msg = 'sy-subrc sollte ungleich 0 sein, da der Cursor bereits geschlossen ist.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man den Rückgabewert `sy-subrc` nach `CLOSE CURSOR` überprüft, um Fehler zu erkennen. Ein `sy-subrc` ungleich 0 nach dem Schließen eines bereits geschlossenen Cursors signalisiert einen Fehler. Dies ist wichtig für eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung in Anwendungen, die explizite Cursor verwenden.
keywords: CLOSE CURSOR, sy-subrc, Error Handling, Database Access

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor mit dynamischem SQL, das eine dynamische WHERE-Klausel enthält, und schließen Sie ihn nach dem Lesen der Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_dynamic_sflight
      IMPORTING iv_where_clause TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_sflight.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor,
          ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight,
          lv_source  TYPE string.

    lv_source = |SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR lv_source.

        DO.
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_sflight.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Fehlerbehandlung für dynamisches SQL
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cursor_dynamic_sql( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->read_dynamic_sflight( `carrid = 'LH'` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Es sollten Daten für LH gelesen werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Erste Zeile sollte Carried LH haben.' ).

    CLEAR lt_result.
    lt_result = lo_cut->read_dynamic_sflight( `carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0000'` ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Es sollten keine Daten für XX gelesen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die fortgeschrittene Verwendung von Cursorn in Verbindung mit dynamischem SQL (`OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE`). Dies ist nützlich, wenn die SQL-Anweisung zur Laufzeit konstruiert werden muss, z.B. bei flexiblen Suchmasken. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error` ist hierbei essenziell. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die dynamische SQL-Generierung verwendet.
keywords: OPEN CURSOR, CLOSE CURSOR, Dynamic SQL, Database Access, String Templates

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, deren Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie deren Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_component DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS set_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data         TYPE ty_data
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value    TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_modified_data) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_component IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    rs_modified_data = is_data.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE rs_modified_data TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Wert dynamisch setzen
      <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_set_component FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_set_component.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_component( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_assign_component=>ty_data( field1 = 'Old Value' field2 = 10 ).

    DATA(ls_modified) = lo_cut->set_component_value( is_data = ls_data iv_component_name = 'FIELD1' iv_new_value = 'New Value' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified-field1 exp = 'New Value' msg = 'FIELD1 sollte geändert werden.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified-field2 exp = 20 msg = 'FIELD2 sollte geändert werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>`, um dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Feldsymbole ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf den Speicherbereich, was Kopiervorgänge vermeidet und die Performance verbessert.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und modifizieren Sie diese Zeile.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD ... TO <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_table_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_table_row
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_new_text TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_items) TYPE tt_items.

CLASS zcl_assign_table_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_row> TYPE ty_item.
    rt_modified_items = it_items.

    ASSIGN TABLE FIELD (rt_modified_items)[ iv_index ] TO <fs_row>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_row>-text = iv_new_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_row.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_table_field( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_assign_table_field=>tt_items(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' )

    DATA(lt_modified) = lo_cut->modify_table_row( it_items = lt_items iv_index = 2 iv_new_text = 'Modified B' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_modified[2]-text exp = 'Modified B' msg = 'Zeile 2 sollte geändert werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_modified[1]-text exp = 'Item A' msg = 'Zeile 1 sollte unverändert bleiben.' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_modified[2]-text exp = 'Item B' msg = 'Bei ungültigem Index sollte keine Änderung erfolgen.' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet `ASSIGN TABLE FIELD (itab)[index] TO <field_symbol>`, um eine spezifische Zeile einer internen Tabelle über ihren Index dynamisch zu referenzieren. Dies ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Tabellenzeile ohne Kopiervorgänge, was besonders bei großen Tabellen performant ist. category: Object Orientation, Field Symbols, Type Handling
Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Basisklasse und eine Unterklasse. Instanziieren Sie die Unterklasse, weisen Sie das Objekt einem generischen Feldsymbol zu und casten Sie es dann auf ein typspezifisches Feldsymbol, um auf eine Methode der Unterklasse zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO <field_symbol> CASTING TYPE ...`.
solution:
CLASS lcl_base DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_base IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Base'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_sub DEFINITION INHERITING FROM lcl_base.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sub_type RETURNING VALUE(rv_sub_type) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_type REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_sub IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sub_type.
    rv_sub_type = 'Sub'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_type.
    rv_type = 'Sub (Redefined)'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_casting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sub_type_dynamically
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_casting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sub_type_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_sub) = NEW lcl_sub( ).
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any> TYPE any,
                   <fs_sub> TYPE lcl_sub.

    " Zuweisung an generisches Feldsymbol
    ASSIGN lo_sub TO <fs_any>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Casting auf spezifischen Typ
      ASSIGN <fs_any> TO <fs_sub> CASTING TYPE lcl_sub.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_type = <fs_sub>->get_sub_type( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_casting.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_casting( ).
    DATA(lv_type) = lo_cut->get_sub_type_dynamically( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_type exp = 'Sub' msg = 'Die Methode der Unterklasse sollte aufgerufen werden.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht den Zugriff auf typspezifische Komponenten oder Methoden eines Objekts, das ursprünglich über eine generischere Referenz oder ein generisches Feldsymbol zugewiesen wurde. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der Objektorientierung und dynamischen Programmierung, das Polymorphie zur Laufzeit unterstützt.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CASTING, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und modifizieren Sie die Zeilen direkt mit einem Feldsymbol, um Kopiervorgänge zu vermeiden und die Performance zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <field_symbol>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_table_in_loop
      IMPORTING it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_in_loop.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE ty_data.
    rt_modified_data = it_data.

    LOOP AT rt_modified_data ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
      <fs_data>-text = |{ <fs_data>-text } - Modified|.

CLASS zcl_read_table_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE i,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_product_status
      IMPORTING
        it_products     TYPE tt_products
        iv_key_field    TYPE string
        iv_key_value    TYPE string
        iv_new_status   TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_products) TYPE tt_products.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_status.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_product> TYPE ty_product.
    rt_modified_products = it_products.

    " Dynamischer READ TABLE mit Feldsymbol
    READ TABLE rt_modified_products ASSIGNING <fs_product>
      WITH KEY (iv_key_field) = iv_key_value.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_product>-status = iv_new_status.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Datenreferenz auf eine interne Tabelle und weisen Sie diese Referenz einem Feldsymbol zu, um auf die Tabelle zuzugreifen und sie zu modifizieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF ... INTO ...` und `ASSIGN dr_ref->* TO <field_symbol_table>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_table_via_ref
      IMPORTING it_values TYPE tt_values
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_modified_values) TYPE tt_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_via_ref.
    DATA: dr_values TYPE REF TO tt_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE tt_values,
                   <fs_row>   TYPE ty_value.

    rt_modified_values = it_values.

    " Referenz auf die interne Tabelle holen
    GET REFERENCE OF rt_modified_values INTO dr_values.

    " Datenreferenz einem Feldsymbol zuweisen
    ASSIGN dr_values->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
        <fs_row>-value = |{ <fs_row>-value }_UPDATED|.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>` innerhalb eines `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_generic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_column_values
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE REF TO data " Generische Referenz auf beliebige Tabelle
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_generic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_column_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_row>   TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
        " Dynamischer Zugriff auf die erste Komponente der Zeile
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          APPEND |{ <fs_field> }| TO rt_values.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle nach einem Feld und verarbeiten Sie die Gruppenergebnisse. Innerhalb der Gruppierung sollen die Zeilen über Feldsymbole modifiziert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>)` und `LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group> ASSIGNING <fs_member>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_item,
             region TYPE string,
             product TYPE string,
             amount TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_item.
    TYPES tt_sales_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_grouped_sales
      IMPORTING it_sales TYPE tt_sales_items
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_grouped_sales.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_group>  TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sales_item WITH UNIQUE KEY region,
                   <fs_member> TYPE ty_sales_item.

    LOOP AT it_sales INTO DATA(ls_sales_item).
      APPEND ls_sales_item TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.

    LOOP AT rt_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_current_item>)
      GROUP BY ( region = <fs_current_item>-region )
      ASCENDING
      ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_group_header>).

      DATA(lv_total_amount) = 0.
      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_header> ASSIGNING <fs_member>.
        lv_total_amount = lv_total_amount + <fs_member>-amount.
        " Beispiel: Modifikation der Gruppenmitglieder
        <fs_member>-product = 'Grouped Product'.
      ENDLOOP.
      " Beispiel: Modifikation des Gruppenschlüssels (hier nicht direkt möglich, da <fs_group_header> nur den Schlüssel repräsentiert)
      " Stattdessen könnte man ein separates Ergebnisobjekt füllen
      <fs_group_header>-amount = lv_total_amount.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_sales_data) = VALUE zcl_assign_group_by=>tt_sales_items(
      ( region = 'North' product = 'A' amount = 10 )
      ( region = 'South' product = 'B' amount = 20 )
      ( region = 'North' product = 'C' amount = 15 )
      ( region = 'South' product = 'D' amount = 25 )

    " Prüfen der modifizierten Produkte innerhalb der Gruppen

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[2]-product exp = 'Grouped Product' msg = 'Produkt in Gruppe South sollte modifiziert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[3]-product exp = 'Grouped Product' msg = 'Produkt in Gruppe North sollte modifiziert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[4]-product exp = 'Grouped Product' msg = 'Produkt in Gruppe South sollte modifiziert sein.' ).

    " Prüfen der aggregierten Beträge in den Gruppenschlüsseln

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO ls_north_group WITH KEY region = 'North'.

Dies ermöglicht eine effiziente und speicherschonende Verarbeitung von gruppierten Daten, da keine Kopiervorgänge für die Gruppenzeilen oder deren Mitglieder stattfinden. Die direkte Modifikation der Gruppenmitglieder über das Feldsymbol `<fs_member>` ist hierbei ein zentrales Feature.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Datenreferenz erhält und dynamisch eine neue Spalte zu jeder Zeile hinzufügt. Der Name und der Wert der neuen Spalte sollen ebenfalls dynamisch übergeben werden.
hint: Dies erfordert die Verwendung von `CREATE DATA` für eine dynamische Struktur, `ASSIGN` für Komponenten und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_add_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_dynamic_column
      IMPORTING
        ir_table        TYPE REF TO data " Referenz auf beliebige Tabelle
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
        iv_column_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_add_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_dynamic_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_row>   TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    DATA: lr_line_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_new_line_type TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr,
          lr_new_data   TYPE REF TO data.

    ASSIGN ir_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. RETURN. ENDIF.

    " Aktuelle Zeilenstruktur ermitteln
    lr_line_type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table>[1] ).
    lt_components = lr_line_type->get_components( ).

    " Neue Komponente hinzufügen
    ls_component-name = iv_column_name.
    ls_component-type ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'STRING' ).
    APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.

    " Neue Zeilenstruktur erstellen
    lr_new_line_type = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).

    " Neue Tabelle mit erweiterter Struktur erstellen
    CREATE DATA lr_new_data TYPE HANDLE lr_new_line_type OCCURS 0.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_new_data->* TO <fs_new_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
        " Neue Zeile mit erweiterter Struktur erstellen
        CREATE DATA lr_new_data TYPE HANDLE lr_new_line_type.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_row> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN lr_new_data->* TO <fs_new_row>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Alte Komponenten kopieren
          <fs_new_row> = <fs_row>.

          " Neue Komponente zuweisen
          ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_new_row> TO <fs_field>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_field> = iv_column_value.
          ENDIF.

          APPEND <fs_new_row> TO <fs_new_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      " Originaltabelle durch die neue Tabelle ersetzen
      <fs_table> = <fs_new_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Struktur als Parameter erhält und dynamisch alle String-Komponenten dieser Struktur in Großbuchstaben umwandelt. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO <fs_field>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_assign_string_to_upper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mixed_data,
             text1 TYPE string,
             number TYPE i,
             text2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mixed_data.

    METHODS convert_strings_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_mixed_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_converted_data) TYPE ty_mixed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_assign_string_to_upper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_strings_to_upper.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_component> TYPE any.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    rs_converted_data = is_data.

    " Struktur-Beschreibung holen
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_converted_data ).
    lt_components = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
      " Prüfen, ob die Komponente vom Typ STRING ist
      IF ls_component-type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
        " Dynamische Zuweisung der Komponente zu einem Feldsymbol
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE rs_converted_data TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Wert in Großbuchstaben umwandeln
          TRANSLATE <fs_component> TO UPPER CASE.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_assign_string_to_upper( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_assign_string_to_upper=>ty_mixed_data(
      text1 = 'hello world'
      number = 123
      text2 = 'abap is great'
    ).

    DATA(ls_converted) = lo_cut->convert_strings_to_upper( ls_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted-text1 exp = 'HELLO WORLD' msg = 'TEXT1 sollte in Großbuchstaben sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted-number exp = 123 msg = 'NUMBER sollte unverändert sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_converted-text2 exp = 'ABAP IS GREAT' msg = 'TEXT2 sollte in Großbuchstaben sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Verarbeitung von Strukturkomponenten basierend auf ihrem Typ. Mithilfe von `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr` wird die Struktur zur Laufzeit analysiert. `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <field_symbol>` wird verwendet, um dynamisch auf jede Komponente zuzugreifen. Nur String-Komponenten werden dann über das Feldsymbol in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt. Dies ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster für generische Datenmanipulationen.

Instructions: Parsen Sie eine Logzeile, um Datum, Uhrzeit, Level und Nachricht zu extrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>FIND` und `GET_GROUP` mit benannten Gruppen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             date    TYPE string,
             time    TYPE string,
             level   TYPE string,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.

CLASS zcl_reg_parse_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_log_entry IMPORTING iv_log_line TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rs_log_entry) TYPE ty_log_entry.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_parse_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_log_entry.
    " Example log line: '2023-10-26 14:30:00 INFO: User logged in.'
    " Regex with named groups: (?<name>pattern)
    DATA(lv_log_pattern) = '^(?<DATE>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s(?<TIME>\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s(?<LEVEL>\w+):\s(?<MESSAGE>.*)$'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_log_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_log_line ).

    IF lo_matcher->find( ) EQ abap_true.
      rs_log_entry-date    = lo_matcher->get_group( 'DATE' ).
      rs_log_entry-time    = lo_matcher->get_group( 'TIME' ).
      rs_log_entry-level   = lo_matcher->get_group( 'LEVEL' ).
      rs_log_entry-message = lo_matcher->get_group( 'MESSAGE' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String anhand eines regulären Ausdrucks als Trennzeichen in eine Tabelle von Teilstrings auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>FIND_ALL` auf das Trennzeichen und extrahieren Sie die dazwischenliegenden Teile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_split_by_regex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_string_by_regex
      IMPORTING
        iv_input   TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_split_by_regex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_string_by_regex.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).
    DATA(lt_delimiters) = lo_matcher->find_all( ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_delimiters INTO DATA(ls_delimiter).
      IF ls_delimiter-offset > lv_last_offset.
        APPEND iv_input+lv_last_offset(ls_delimiter-offset - lv_last_offset) TO rt_parts.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = ls_delimiter-offset + ls_delimiter-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add the remaining part after the last delimiter
    IF lv_last_offset < strlen( iv_input ).
      APPEND iv_input+lv_last_offset TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.

    " Handle case where no delimiters are found or input is empty
    IF lines( rt_parts ) = 0 AND NOT iv_input IS INITIAL.
      APPEND iv_input TO rt_parts.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Zahlen in einem String durch ihren doppelten Wert. (z.B. '123' wird zu '246').
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit `EVALUATION` und einer lokalen Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_replace_eval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_numbers_doubled IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS double_number FOR REPLACEMENT FILTER '(\d+)'
      IMPORTING
        match_result TYPE match_result_structure
      RETURNING
        VALUE(replacement_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_replace_eval IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_numbers_doubled.
    rv_output = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '(\d+)' IN iv_input
                WITH EVALUATION zcl_reg_replace_eval=>double_number.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD double_number.
    DATA(lv_number_str) = match_result-submatches[1]-found.
    DATA(lv_number_int) = CONV i( lv_number_str ).
    replacement_string = CONV string( lv_number_int * 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format YYYY-MM-DD enthält und extrahieren Sie es.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MATCHER=>FIND` mit einem präzisen Regex-Muster und `GET_MATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reg_validate_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_valid_date IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_date) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reg_validate_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_valid_date.
    " Regex for YYYY-MM-DD date format, considering leap years and month days for basic validation
    " This is a simplified regex; full date validation is complex and often done with date functions.
    " (?:(?:1[6-9]|[2-9]\d)\d{2}) - Year 1600-9999
    " (?:0[1-9]|1[0-2]) - Month 01-12
    " (?:0[1-9]|1\d|2\d|3[01]) - Day 01-31
    DATA(lv_date_pattern) = '\b(?:(?:1[6-9]|[2-9]\d)\d{2})-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|1\d|2\d|3[01])\b'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_date_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).

    IF lo_matcher->find( ) EQ abap_true.
      rv_date = lo_matcher->get_match( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_valid_date( 'Date: 1999-01-01' ) exp = '1999-01-01' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_invalid_date_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reg_validate_date( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_valid_date( 'Invalid date 2023/11/20' ) exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_valid_date( '2023-1-1' ) exp = '' ). " Not YYYY-MM-DD
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_no_date.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->extract_valid_date( 'No date here.' ) exp = '' ).

CLASS zcl_reg_extract_url IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Robust regex for URLs (simplified for demonstration, real-world can be more complex)
    DATA(lv_url_pattern) = 'https?:\/\/(?:www\.)?[-a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\+~#=]{1,256}\.[a-zA-Z0-9()]{1,6}\b(?:[-a-zA-Z0-9()@:%_\+.~#?&\/=]*)'.

    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).

    IF lo_matcher->find( ) EQ abap_true.
      rv_url = lo_matcher->get_match( ).

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fltime   TYPE s_time,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die sflights-Tabelle nach Flügen, die in der Zukunft liegen, basierend auf dem aktuellen UTC-Zeitstempel, und geben Sie für jeden zukünftigen Flug das Flugdatum und die Flugzeit in UTC aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie cl_abap_utclong=>now(), cl_abap_utclong=>convert_tstmp_to_utc() und den FILTER-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_utc_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fltime   TYPE s_time,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_utc_detail,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate        TYPE s_date,
             fltime        TYPE s_time,
             utc_timestamp TYPE utclong,
           END OF ty_flight_utc_detail.
    TYPES: ty_flight_utc_tt TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_utc_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flights_utc
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tt
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights_utc) TYPE ty_flight_utc_tt.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_utc_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flights_utc.
    DATA(lv_current_utc) = cl_abap_utclong=>now( ).
    DATA(ls_current_tstmp) = cl_abap_utclong=>convert_utc_to_tstmp( utc_timestamp = lv_current_utc ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = ls_current_tstmp-date.

    DATA(lt_future_flights) = FILTER #( it_sflights WHERE fldate > lv_current_date ).

    rt_future_flights_utc = VALUE ty_flight_utc_tt(
      FOR flight IN lt_future_flights
      LET lv_flight_tstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_tstmp(
                               iv_date = flight-fldate
                               iv_time = flight-fltime )
          lv_flight_utc = cl_abap_utclong=>convert_tstmp_to_utc(
                            utc_timestamp = lv_flight_tstmp )
      IN (
        carrid = flight-carrid,
        connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        fltime = flight-fltime,
        utc_timestamp = lv_flight_utc
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_tomorrow) = lv_today + 1.
    DATA(lv_yesterday) = lv_today - 1.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = lv_yesterday fltime = '100000' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = lv_today     fltime = '110000' seatsocc = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = lv_tomorrow  fltime = '120000' seatsocc = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_flights_utc( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-fldate exp = lv_tomorrow msg = 'Future flight date incorrect' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-utc_timestamp exp = lv_expected_utc msg = 'Future flight UTC timestamp incorrect' ).

CLASS zcl_itab_update_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             fltime   TYPE s_time,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS update_seats_by_carrier
      CHANGING

        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_delta    TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_itab_update_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seats_by_carrier.
    ct_sflights = VALUE ty_sflight_tt(
      FOR flight IN ct_sflights
      ( COND #( WHEN flight-carrid = iv_carrid THEN flight-seatsocc + iv_delta ELSE flight-seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Reihenfolge der Einträge in einer internen Tabelle zufällig.
hint: Implementieren Sie den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus mit `cl_abap_random_int` und Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS shuffle_table
      CHANGING
        ct_table TYPE ty_string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( ct_table ).
    IF lv_table_size <= 1.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( seed = cl_abap_random=>create_seed( ) ).

    DO lv_table_size - 1 TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_index) = sy-index.
      lo_random->set_min( lv_current_index ).
      lo_random->set_max( lv_table_size ).
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

      " Swap elements
      ASSIGN ct_table[ lv_current_index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_current>).
      ASSIGN ct_table[ lv_random_index ] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_random>).
      DATA(lv_temp) = <fs_current>.
      <fs_current> = <fs_random>.
      <fs_random> = lv_temp.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>ty_string_table( ( 'A' ) ( 'B' ) ( 'C' ) ( 'D' ) ( 'E' ) ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled) = lt_original.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    lo_cut->shuffle_table( CHANGING ct_table = lt_shuffled ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_shuffled ) exp = lines( lt_original ) ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_original.
    SORT lt_sorted_original ASCENDING.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled ASCENDING.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_shuffled exp = lt_sorted_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_shuffled <> lt_original ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert den Fisher-Yates-Shuffle-Algorithmus, um eine interne Tabelle zufällig zu mischen. Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` zur Generierung der Zufallsindizes und Field-Symbols für den effizienten Tausch von Tabellenzeilen.

Instructions: Wählen Sie ein Element aus einer Liste basierend auf einer Gewichtung zufällig aus.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine kumulative Gewichtungsliste und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Auswahl.
solution:
CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weighted_item,
             item    TYPE string,
             weight  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_weighted_item.
    TYPES tt_weighted_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weighted_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS select_random_item
      IMPORTING
        it_weighted_items TYPE tt_weighted_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_item) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_weighted_random_selector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD select_random_item.
    IF it_weighted_items IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_cumulative_weights) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_total_weight) = 0.

    LOOP AT it_weighted_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      lv_total_weight = lv_total_weight + ls_item-weight.
      APPEND lv_total_weight TO lt_cumulative_weights.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_total_weight = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      seed = cl_abap_random=>create_seed( )
      min  = 1
      max  = lv_total_weight
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    LOOP AT lt_cumulative_weights INTO DATA(lv_cumulative_weight).
      IF lv_random_value <= lv_cumulative_weight.
        READ TABLE it_weighted_items INDEX sy-tabix INTO DATA(ls_selected).
        rv_selected_item = ls_selected-item.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_weighted_selection FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_weighted_random_selector=>tt_weighted_items(
      ( item = 'Apple'  weight = 10 )
      ( item = 'Banana' weight = 20 )
      ( item = 'Cherry' weight = 5 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_weighted_random_selector( ).
    DATA(lv_selected) = lo_cut->select_random_item( it_weighted_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      lv_selected = 'Apple' OR
      lv_selected = 'Banana' OR
      lv_selected = 'Cherry'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        num_flights TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_flight_data,
      ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_data_for_chart
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE ty_t_flight_data.

    METHODS display_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_chart_data TYPE ty_t_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data_for_chart.
    SELECT fldate, COUNT(*) AS num_flights
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY fldate
      ORDER BY fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_chart_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_chart.
    " This is a conceptual example. In a real scenario,
    " cl_time_chart_simple would be used in a UI context (e.g., Web Dynpro, SAP GUI custom control).
    " The data preparation is the core of this example.
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    " Prepare data for the chart (example structure, actual structure might vary)
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_chart_entry,
             timestamp TYPE timestampl,
             value     TYPE f,
           END OF ty_s_chart_entry,
           ty_t_chart_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_chart_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_chart_entries) = VALUE ty_t_chart_entries(
      FOR ls_data IN it_chart_data
      ( timestamp = CONV timestampl( ls_data-fldate ) " Convert date to timestamp
        value     = CONV f( ls_data-num_flights ) ) " Convert integer to float
    ).

    " Add series to the chart (conceptual)
    lo_chart->add_series(
      iv_series_id = 'FLIGHTS_PER_DAY'
      iv_series_name = 'Anzahl Flüge'
      it_data = lt_chart_entries " This would be the actual data for the chart
    ).
    " lo_chart->render( ). " Render the chart in a UI container
    " For this example, we just log the prepared data.
    LOOP AT lt_chart_entries INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      WRITE: / ls_entry-timestamp, ls_entry-value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
