Instructions: Bereiten Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` so auf, dass sie von `cl_time_chart_simple` als Zeitreihendaten für mehrere Serien (z.B. Anzahl Flüge pro Datum pro Fluggesellschaft) dargestellt werden können.
hint: Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` mit mehreren Schlüsseln und `FOR` mit `GROUPING` für die Datenaggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_multi_series DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_detail,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
        num_flights TYPE i,
      END OF ty_s_flight_detail,
      ty_t_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_chart_series_data,
        series_id TYPE string,
        series_name TYPE string,
        data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_time_chart_simple=>ty_s_data_point WITH EMPTY KEY,
      END OF ty_s_chart_series_data,
      ty_t_chart_series_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_chart_series_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_multi_series_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_series_data) TYPE ty_t_chart_series_data.

    METHODS display_multi_series_chart
      IMPORTING
        it_chart_series_data TYPE ty_t_chart_series_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_multi_series IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_multi_series_data.
    DATA: lt_raw_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, fldate, connid
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_raw_data.

    " Group by carrid and fldate to count flights
    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = VALUE ty_t_flight_detail(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_raw_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_group-carrid fldate = ls_group-fldate )
      ( carrid = ls_group-carrid
        fldate = ls_group-fldate
        num_flights = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group NEXT count = count + 1 ) )
    ).

    " Group by carrid to create separate series
    rt_chart_series_data = VALUE ty_t_chart_series_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_series IN lt_aggregated_data GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_series-carrid )
      ( series_id   = ls_series-carrid
        series_name = |Flüge für { ls_series-carrid }|
        data        = VALUE #( " Use CONV for data points
          FOR ls_data IN GROUP ls_series
          ( timestamp = CONV timestampl( ls_data-fldate )
            value     = CONV f( ls_data-num_flights ) )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_multi_series_chart.
    DATA(lo_chart) = NEW cl_time_chart_simple( ).

    LOOP AT it_chart_series_data INTO DATA(ls_series).
      lo_chart->add_series(
        iv_series_id = ls_series-series_id
        iv_series_name = ls_series-series_name
        it_data = ls_series-data
      ).
      " For this example, we just log the prepared data.
      WRITE: / 'Series:', ls_series-series_name.
      LOOP AT ls_series-data INTO DATA(ls_point).
        WRITE: / ls_point-timestamp, ls_point-value.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
    " lo_chart->render( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        iv_date_str TYPE string

CLASS zcl_conv_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE ty_t_sflight.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und eine Liste von Spaltennamen als Eingabe erhält. Die Methode soll eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgeben, die nur die angegebenen Spalten enthält. Diese neue Tabelle könnte dann in `cl_salv_table` angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_subset,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_subset.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_subset TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_subset WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_column_names TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_columns.
    DATA: lr_data_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build dynamic structure for the target table
    lr_data_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table>[ 1 ] ).
    LOOP AT it_column_names INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      TRY.
          ls_component = lr_data_descr->get_component( lv_column_name ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
          " Column not found, ignore or handle error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_data_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_data_descr ).

    " Create dynamic target table
    CREATE DATA rt_result_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_result_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    " Populate target table
    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_target_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_data_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <fs_target_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_target_line> INTO TABLE <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_columns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_salv_dynamic_columns( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 2 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_columns) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ).
    DATA(lr_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_columns( it_source_table = lt_sflight it_column_names = lt_columns ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_result_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_result_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_result->* TO <fs_result_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = <fs_result_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of rows should match' act = lines( <fs_result_table> ) exp = lines( lt_sflight ) ).

    " Verify structure and content of the first row
    READ TABLE <fs_result_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_result_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result line should not be initial' act = <fs_result_line> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_result_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should match' act = <fs_field> exp = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_result_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should match' act = <fs_field> exp = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-connid ).

    " Test with non-existent column
    DATA(lt_invalid_columns) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ) ).
    DATA(lr_invalid_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_columns( it_source_table = lt_sflight it_column_names = lt_invalid_columns ).
    ASSIGN lr_invalid_result->* TO <fs_result_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial for invalid columns' act = <fs_result_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und einen Spaltennamen sowie einen Multiplikator als Eingabe erhält. Die Methode soll eine Kopie der Tabelle zurückgeben, bei der der Wert der angegebenen numerischen Spalte mit dem Multiplikator multipliziert wurde. Dies ist nützlich, um Preise oder Mengen dynamisch anzupassen, bevor sie in `cl_salv_table` angezeigt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `TYPE 'N'` oder `TYPE 'P'` für numerische Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_numeric_column
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
        iv_multiplier   TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_modified_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_numeric_column.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_modified_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_modified_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_numeric_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a deep copy of the source table structure
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table> ) ).
    CREATE DATA rt_modified_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_modified_table->* TO <fs_modified_table>.

    " Populate and modify the target table
    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      " Create a new line with the same structure as source
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_modified_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr->get_line_type( ).
      ASSIGN lr_modified_line->* TO <fs_modified_line>.

      " Move content from source to target line
      <fs_modified_line> = <fs_source_line>.

      " Dynamically access and modify the specified numeric column
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_modified_line> TO <fs_numeric_field>.
      IF <fs_numeric_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Check if it's a numeric type before multiplication
        DATA(lv_type_kind) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_numeric_field> )->type_kind.
        IF lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
          <fs_numeric_field> = <fs_numeric_field> * iv_multiplier.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_modified_line> INTO TABLE <fs_modified_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_generic_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_salv_instance
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_salv_table) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table
      RAISING
        cx_salv_msg.

CLASS zcl_salv_generic_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_salv_instance.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_any_table>.
    IF <fs_any_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_any_table> IS INITIAL.
      " Handle empty table case, maybe raise exception or return initial object
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    cl_salv_table=>factory(
      EXPORTING
        r_container = cl_salv_container_none=>get_instance( ) " No container needed for unit test, just for factory call
      IMPORTING
        r_salv_table = ro_salv_table
      CHANGING
        t_table      = <fs_any_table>
    ).

    " Dynamically adjust column headers
    DATA(lo_columns) = ro_salv_table->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lt_column_list) = lo_columns->get_column_list( ).

    LOOP AT lt_column_list INTO DATA(lv_column_id).
      DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( lv_column_id ).
      DATA(lv_long_text) = lo_column->get_long_text( ).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '_' IN lv_long_text WITH ' '.
      lo_column->set_long_text( lv_long_text ).
      lo_column->set_medium_text( lv_long_text ).
      lo_column->set_short_text( lv_long_text ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_sorted_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a deep copy of the source table structure
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table> ) ).
    CREATE DATA rt_sorted_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_sorted_table->* TO <fs_sorted_table>.

    " Copy data
    <fs_sorted_table> = <fs_source_table>.

    " Dynamically sort the table
    TRY.
        SORT <fs_sorted_table> BY (iv_column_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_table_sort_error.
        " Handle error if column does not exist or is not sortable
        CLEAR rt_sorted_table. " Return empty/initial if sort fails
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_table_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_filtered_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Create a deep copy of the source table structure
    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table> ) ).
    CREATE DATA rt_filtered_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_filtered_table->* TO <fs_filtered_table>.

    " Dynamically filter the table
    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        " Convert filter value to the type of the field for comparison
        DATA(lv_field_value) = CONV string( <fs_field> ).
        IF lv_field_value = iv_filter_value.
          INSERT <fs_source_line> INTO TABLE <fs_filtered_table>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) und einen numerischen Spaltennamen als Eingabe erhält. Die Methode soll die Summe aller Werte in dieser Spalte berechnen und zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_dynamic_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum)   TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_sum.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_numeric_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_sum = REDUCE decfloat34(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <fs_source_line> IN <fs_source_table>
      LET
        lv_field_assigned = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_line> )->has_component( iv_column_name )
      IN
      IF lv_field_assigned = abap_true.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_numeric_field>.
        IF <fs_numeric_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          DATA(lv_type_kind) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_numeric_field> )->type_kind.
          IF lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR
             lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
            sum = sum + <fs_numeric_field>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF>
      NEXT sum = sum
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dieser Feldkatalog kann dann verwendet werden, um ein `cl_salv_table` oder `cl_gui_alv_grid` mit spezifischen Spalteneigenschaften zu konfigurieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR=>GET_COMPONENTS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zur Inspektion der Struktur.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fcat_line,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             coltext   TYPE lvc_coltxt,
             outputlen TYPE lvc_outlen,
             datatype  TYPE lvc_dataty,
           END OF ty_fcat_line.
    TYPES: tt_fcat TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fcat_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcatalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_any_line> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_any_table>.
    IF <fs_any_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_any_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE <fs_any_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_any_line>.
    IF <fs_any_line> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_any_line> ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_fcat_line) TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
      ls_fcat_line-fieldname = ls_component-name.
      ls_fcat_line-coltext   = ls_component-name. " Default, can be enhanced with DDIC lookup
      ls_fcat_line-outputlen = ls_component-length. " Default, can be enhanced

      " Determine data type for ALV
      DATA(lr_type_descr) = ls_component-type_descr.
      CASE lr_type_descr->type_kind.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'CHAR'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'NUMC'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'INT4'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'P'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'FLTP'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'DF16_DEC'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_date.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'DATS'.
        WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_time.
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'TIMS'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          " Default or specific handling for other types
          ls_fcat_line-datatype = 'CHAR'. " Fallback
      ENDCASE.

      APPEND ls_fcat_line TO rt_fieldcatalog.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_highlight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_dynamic_highlight
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_column_name  TYPE string
        iv_threshold    TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_highlighted_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_highlight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_dynamic_highlight.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_highlighted_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_highlighted_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_numeric_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_color_field> TYPE lvc_t_colo.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build dynamic structure for the target table with an additional color column
    DATA(lr_source_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table>[ 1 ] ) ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_source_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(ls_color_component) TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.
    ls_color_component-name = 'LINE_COLOR'.
    ls_color_component-type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'LVC_T_COLO' ).
    APPEND ls_color_component TO lt_components.

    DATA(lr_target_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lr_target_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_target_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic target table
    CREATE DATA rt_highlighted_table TYPE HANDLE lr_target_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_highlighted_table->* TO <fs_highlighted_table>.

    " Populate target table and add highlight info
    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_highlighted_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_highlighted_line->* TO <fs_highlighted_line>.

      " Move content from source to target line
      <fs_highlighted_line> = <fs_source_line>. " This moves all fields by name

      " Dynamically access the specified numeric column
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_column_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_highlighted_line> TO <fs_numeric_field>.
      IF <fs_numeric_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        DATA(lv_type_kind) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_numeric_field> )->type_kind.
        IF lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_float OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_decfloat OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int1 OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int2 OR
           lv_type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int8.

          IF <fs_numeric_field> > iv_threshold.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 'LINE_COLOR' OF STRUCTURE <fs_highlighted_line> TO <fs_color_field>.
            IF <fs_color_field> IS ASSIGNED.
              APPEND VALUE lvc_s_colo( fname = '' color = '3' int = '0' ) TO <fs_color_field>. " Color 3 = yellow
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      INSERT <fs_highlighted_line> INTO TABLE <fs_highlighted_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Methode soll eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer dynamisch erstellten Struktur zurückgeben, die nur die angegebenen Zielspalten enthält und die Daten entsprechend aus der Quelltabelle füllt.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_transfer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transfer_data_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        it_target_columns TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_transfer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transfer_data_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_source_field> TYPE any,
                   <fs_target_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Build dynamic structure for the target table
    DATA(lr_source_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_table>[ 1 ] ) ).
    DATA(lt_target_components) TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_target_columns INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_component) = lr_source_struct_descr->get_component( lv_column_name ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_target_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
          " Column not found in source, ignore or handle error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_target_components IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_target_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_target_components ).
    DATA(lr_target_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_target_struct_descr ).

    " Create dynamic target table
    CREATE DATA rt_target_table TYPE HANDLE lr_target_table_descr.
    ASSIGN rt_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.

    " Populate target table
    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      CREATE DATA DATA(lr_target_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_target_struct_descr.
      ASSIGN lr_target_line->* TO <fs_target_line>.

      LOOP AT lt_target_components INTO DATA(ls_target_component).
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_source_line> TO <fs_source_field>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_target_field>.
        IF <fs_source_field> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_target_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_target_field> = <fs_source_field>.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_target_line> INTO TABLE <fs_target_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'BB' connid = '002' fldate = '20250102' price = '50' ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_target_cols) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lr_target_table) = lo_cut->transfer_data_dynamically(
                                   it_source_table = lt_sflight
                                   it_target_columns = lt_target_cols ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_target_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Target table should not be initial' act = <fs_target_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of rows should match source' act = lines( <fs_target_table> ) exp = lines( lt_sflight ) ).

    " Verify structure and content of the first row
    READ TABLE <fs_target_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_target_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Target line should not be initial' act = <fs_target_line> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should match' act = <fs_field> exp = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-carrid ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'FLDATE should match' act = <fs_field> exp = lt_sflight[ 1 ]-fldate ).

    " Check that 'PRICE' column does not exist in target
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'PRICE should not exist in target table' act = <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED ).

    " Test with non-existent target columns
    DATA(lt_invalid_target_cols) = VALUE string_table( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'NON_EXISTENT' ) ).
    DATA(lr_invalid_target_table) = lo_cut->transfer_data_dynamically(
                                           it_source_table = lt_sflight
                                           it_target_columns = lt_invalid_target_cols ).
    ASSIGN lr_invalid_target_table->* TO <fs_target_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Target table should not be initial for invalid columns' act = <fs_target_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Number of rows should match source for invalid columns' act = lines( <fs_target_table> ) exp = lines( lt_sflight ) ).
    READ TABLE <fs_target_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_target_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'CARRID should exist in target table' act = <fs_field> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'NON_EXISTENT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_target_line> TO <fs_field>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'NON_EXISTENT should not exist in target table' act = <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Transformation von Daten zwischen Tabellen mit unterschiedlichen Strukturen. Eine neue Zielstruktur wird zur Laufzeit basierend auf einer Liste gewünschter Spalten aus der Quelltabelle erstellt. Anschließend werden die Daten zeilenweise kopiert, wobei `ASSIGN COMPONENT` verwendet wird, um die Werte von Quellfeldern den entsprechenden Zielfeldern zuzuweisen. Dies ist nützlich für flexible Datenintegration oder die Vorbereitung von Daten für generische UI-Komponenten.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, RTTI, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CREATE DATA, cl_salv_table

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die ein `CL_SALV_TABLE` Objekt und eine interne Tabelle von Feldnamen-zu-Label-Paaren als Eingabe erhält. Die Methode soll die Spaltenüberschriften des ALV-Objekts dynamisch gemäß den bereitgestellten Paaren aktualisieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_SALV_COLUMNS->GET_COLUMN` und `CL_SALV_COLUMN->SET_LONG_TEXT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_rename DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_column_mapping,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             label     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_column_mapping.
    TYPES: tt_column_mapping TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_column_mapping WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS apply_dynamic_column_labels
      IMPORTING
        io_salv_table   TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table
        it_column_labels TYPE tt_column_mapping.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_salv_dynamic_rename IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_dynamic_column_labels.
    CHECK io_salv_table IS BOUND.

    DATA(lo_columns) = io_salv_table->get_columns( ).
    IF lo_columns IS NOT BOUND.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_column_labels INTO DATA(ls_mapping).
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( ls_mapping-fieldname ).
          lo_column->set_long_text( ls_mapping-label ).
          lo_column->set_medium_text( ls_mapping-label ).
          lo_column->set_short_text( ls_mapping-label ).
        CATCH cx_salv_not_found.
          " Column not found, ignore or log error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_salv) TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.

        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_salv_container_none=>get_instance( )
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = lo_salv
          CHANGING
            t_table      = lt_sflight
        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'CL_SALV_TABLE object should be created' act = lo_salv IS NOT BOUND ).

    DATA(lt_labels) = VALUE zcl_salv_dynamic_rename=>tt_column_mapping(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' label = 'Airline ID' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' label = 'Flight Number' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  label = 'Ticket Price' )
    ).

    lo_cut->apply_dynamic_column_labels(
      io_salv_table    = lo_salv

    ).

    DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv->get_columns( ).
    DATA(lo_carrid_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID label should be updated' act = lo_carrid_col->get_long_text( ) exp = 'Airline ID' ).

    DATA(lo_connid_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID label should be updated' act = lo_connid_col->get_long_text( ) exp = 'Flight Number' ).

    DATA(lo_price_col) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).

    " Test with non-existent column (should not cause error)
    DATA(lt_invalid_label) = VALUE zcl_salv_dynamic_rename=>tt_column_mapping(
      ( fieldname = 'NON_EXISTENT' label = 'Invalid Column' )
    ).

Durch Iteration über eine Mapping-Tabelle von Feldnamen und gewünschten Labels wird für jede Spalte das entsprechende `CL_SALV_COLUMN` Objekt abgerufen und dessen Text (`SET_LONG_TEXT`, etc.) aktualisiert. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Anpassung der ALV-Anzeige an Benutzervorgaben oder sprachabhängige Anforderungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle mit geschachtelten Strukturen (z.B. eine Kombination aus `sflight` und `sbook`) und einen Pfad zu einem Feld in der geschachtelten Struktur (z.B. 'BOOKINGS-CUSTOMID') als String erhält. Die Methode soll eine neue Tabelle zurückgeben, die nur die Werte dieses dynamisch adressierten Feldes enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT` mit dem vollen Pfad oder iterativ.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_nested_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_sbook,
             sflight TYPE sflight,
             sbook   TYPE sbook,
           END OF ty_sflight_sbook.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_sbook WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_nested_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_field_path   TYPE string " e.g., 'SBOOK-CUSTOMID'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_nested_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_nested_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_source_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_nested_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_source_table TO <fs_source_table>.
    IF <fs_source_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_source_table> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_source_table> ASSIGNING <fs_source_line>.
      ASSIGN ('<FS_SOURCE_LINE>-' && iv_field_path) TO <fs_nested_field>. " Dynamic access to nested field
      IF <fs_nested_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND CONV string( <fs_nested_field> ) TO rt_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Objektreferenz und einen Methodennamen als String erhält. Die Methode soll versuchen, die angegebene Methode dynamisch aufzurufen und einen möglichen Rückgabewert als String zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` für den Methodennamen und `CALL METHOD`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    " Helper method for testing
    METHODS get_test_string RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
    METHODS get_test_int RETURNING VALUE(rv_int) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_method> TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr. " Not directly used for CALL METHOD, but for context

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name) RECEIVING RESULTS rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or call failed'.
      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Type conversion failed'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_test_string.
    rv_string = 'Hello Dynamic World!'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_test_int.
    rv_int = 123.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Int method call should succeed and convert to string' act = lv_int_result exp = '123' ).

Dies ist ein Kernstück der dynamischen Programmierung und wird oft in Frameworks oder generischen Verarbeitungsengines verwendet, um zur Laufzeit zu entscheiden, welche Logik ausgeführt werden soll. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Typnamen als String (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und eine Zeilenanzahl erhält. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle dieses Typs dynamisch erstellen, mit der angegebenen Anzahl leerer Zeilen füllen und eine Referenz auf diese Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE TABLE OF (type_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table_ref
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        iv_num_rows  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_data_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_ref.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
            APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
          ENDDO.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Handle error if type name is invalid
        CLEAR rr_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_global_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_global_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_global_variable_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_global_variable> TYPE any.

    " Assign to a global variable. For SY-DATUM, it's directly accessible.
    " For variables in other programs, use ('(PROGRAM_NAME)VARIABLE_NAME')
    " Here, we assume SY-DATUM is globally accessible.

    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Error: Variable not found or not accessible'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen Typnamen als String (z.B. 'SFLIGHT') und eine interne Tabelle von Wertpaaren (Feldname, Wert) erhält. Die Methode soll eine interne Tabelle des angegebenen Typs dynamisch erstellen und eine Zeile mit den bereitgestellten Werten füllen, dann eine Referenz auf diese Tabelle zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` zum Füllen der Zeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             fieldname TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES: tt_field_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
        it_field_values TYPE tt_field_value
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_fill IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE TABLE OF (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
          IF <fs_line> IS ASSIGNED.
            LOOP AT it_field_values INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
              IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
                " Attempt to assign value, conversion might be needed
                TRY.
                    <fs_field> = ls_field_value-value.
                  CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                    " Handle conversion error, e.g., log or ignore
                ENDTRY.
              ENDIF.
            ENDLOOP.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        " Handle error if type name is invalid
        CLEAR rr_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table_fill( ).

    DATA(lt_values) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_fill=>tt_field_value(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' value = 'LH' )
      ( fieldname = 'CONNID' value = '0400' )
      ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' value = '20251204' )
      ( fieldname = 'PRICE'  value = '123.45' )
    ).

    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
                                   iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'
                                   it_field_values = lt_values ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_sflight_line> TYPE sflight.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHT table reference should be assigned' act = <fs_sflight_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'SFLIGHT table should have 1 row' act = lines( <fs_sflight_table> ) exp = 1 ).

    READ TABLE <fs_sflight_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'SFLIGHT line should be assigned' act = <fs_sflight_line> IS NOT ASSIGNED ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH' act = <fs_sflight_line>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CONNID should be 0400' act = <fs_sflight_line>-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'FLDATE should be 20251204' act = <fs_sflight_line>-fldate exp = '20251204' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'PRICE should be 123.45' act = <fs_sflight_line>-price exp = '123.45' ).

    " Test with invalid type name
    DATA(lr_invalid_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
                                   iv_type_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE'
                                   it_field_values = lt_values ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Invalid type name should return initial reference' act = lr_invalid_table IS BOUND ).

    " Test with non-existent field in values
    DATA(lt_invalid_field_values) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_table_fill=>tt_field_value(
      ( fieldname = 'CARRID' value = 'LH' )
      ( fieldname = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' value = 'XYZ' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_partial_fill_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table(
                                         iv_type_name = 'SFLIGHT'
                                         it_field_values = lt_invalid_field_values ).
    ASSIGN lr_partial_fill_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.
    READ TABLE <fs_sflight_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'CARRID should be LH for partial fill' act = <fs_sflight_line>-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'CONNID should be initial for partial fill' act = <fs_sflight_line>-connid IS NOT INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die dynamische Tabellenerstellung mit dem dynamischen Füllen von Zeilen. Nach der Erstellung einer Tabelle eines zur Laufzeit bestimmten Typs wird eine neue Zeile hinzugefügt. `ASSIGN COMPONENT` wird dann verwendet, um die Felder dieser Zeile dynamisch mit Werten aus einer übergebenen Mapping-Tabelle zu befüllen. Dies ist eine flexible Methode zur Initialisierung von Datenstrukturen, deren genaue Form erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
keywords: CREATE DATA, ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Internal Tables, Data References

hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator in Kombination mit `WHERE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_simple TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_carrids IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE zcl_itab_value=>ty_t_sflight
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_carrids) TYPE ty_t_sflight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_carrids.
    rt_filtered_carrids = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                                       WHERE ( carrid CP 'L*' )
                                       ( carrid = to_lower( ls_sflight-carrid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_data_source) = NEW zcl_itab_value( ).

In diesem Beispiel wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, die nur Einträge enthält, deren `carrid` mit 'L' beginnt, und diese werden gleichzeitig in Kleinbuchstaben umgewandelt. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und ausdrucksstärker als eine klassische `LOOP AT` Schleife.
keywords: FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Data Transformation, METHOD

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `connid`s aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_connid_sum IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE zcl_itab_value=>ty_t_sflight
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_connid_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                       FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                       NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-connid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    rv_carrier_type = COND string( WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' OR iv_carrid = 'UA' THEN 'Premium Carrier'

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle direkt über einen Tabellenausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Syntax `itab[ key ]` oder `itab[ <index> ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_flight_connid IMPORTING it_sflight TYPE ty_t_sflight_key
                                  IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  IMPORTING iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_connid.
    TRY.
        rv_connid = it_sflight[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ]-connid.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_connid = '0000'. " Default value if not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_expression.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_table_expression=>ty_t_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_table_expression( ).

    DATA(lv_connid_found) = lo_reader->get_flight_connid( it_sflight = lt_flights
                                                          iv_carrid = 'LH'
                                                          iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid_found exp = '0400' msg = 'Flight connid not found' ).

    DATA(lv_connid_not_found) = lo_reader->get_flight_connid( it_sflight = lt_flights
                                                              iv_carrid = 'XX'
                                                              iv_connid = '9999' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid_not_found exp = '0000' msg = 'Default connid not returned' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke ermöglichen den direkten Zugriff auf einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle über Schlüssel oder Index. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Alternative zu `READ TABLE` und sollte in modernem ABAP bevorzugt werden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist dabei wichtig.
keywords: Table Expressions, Internal Tables, Data Access, METHOD, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Teilstrings in einem gegebenen String durch einen anderen Teilstring, unter Berücksichtigung der Groß- und Kleinschreibung.

CLASS zcl_string_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_occurrences IMPORTING iv_text        TYPE string
                                      IMPORTING iv_old_sub   TYPE string
                                      IMPORTING iv_new_sub   TYPE string
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_occurrences.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_sub IN rv_result WITH iv_new_sub.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Methoden einer ABAP-Klasse (inklusive geerbter Methoden) unter Verwendung der XCO Library.
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_ABAP_REPOSITORY=>OBJECT->CLASS->FOR(...)` und die Methode `GET_METHODS()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_class_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_method_info,
             name        TYPE sxco_ar_method_name,
             description TYPE sxco_ar_method_description,
             is_static   TYPE abap_bool,
             is_public   TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ts_method_info.
    TYPES tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_methods
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE sxco_ar_object_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_methods) TYPE tt_method_info
      RAISING
        cx_xco_cp_abap_repository.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_class_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_methods.
    DATA(lo_class) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->class->for( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_xco_methods) = lo_class->get_methods( ).

    rt_methods = VALUE #( FOR ls_xco_method IN lt_xco_methods
                          ( name        = ls_xco_method->get_name( )
                            description = ls_xco_method->get_description( )
                            is_static   = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_xco_method->get_properties( )->is_static( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                            is_public   = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_xco_method->get_properties( )->get_visibility( ) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->method->visibility->public THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_html_viewer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_gui_html_viewer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_html_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating HTML viewer' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_html_string.
    DATA lv_url TYPE string.
    DATA lt_html_xstring TYPE xstring.

    " Convert string to xstring (UTF-8)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SCMS_STRING_TO_XSTRING'
      EXPORTING
        text   = iv_html_content
        mimetype = 'text/html'
      IMPORTING
        buffer = lt_html_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error converting string to xstring' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD mo_html_viewer->load_data
      EXPORTING
        url          = 'local.html' " Dummy URL
        type         = 'text'
        subtype      = 'html'
        size         = xstrlen( lt_html_xstring )
        data_xstring = lt_html_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS       = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error loading HTML data' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und dessen Control dynamisch erzeugt und wieder freigibt. (Annahme: Dynpro-Bildschirm mit Custom Control Bereich existiert)

solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_container DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS create_alv_in_container
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    METHODS destroy_container_and_alv.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_alv_grid         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mv_container_name   TYPE scrfname.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_container IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_container_name = iv_container_name.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_in_container.
    IF mo_custom_container IS NOT BOUND.
      CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
        EXPORTING
          container_name = mv_container_name
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS         = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

      CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
        EXPORTING
          i_parent = mo_custom_container
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS   = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV grid' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_data
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS           = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error setting ALV table' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD destroy_container_and_alv.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_alv_grid.
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_custom_container IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_custom_container->free
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1.
      CLEAR mo_custom_container.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Parameter einer Methode einer ABAP-Klasse mit der XCO Library.
hint: Verwenden Sie `XCO_CP_ABAP_REPOSITORY=>OBJECT->CLASS->FOR(...)`, dann `METHOD->FOR(...)` und `GET_PARAMETERS()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_method_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ts_parameter_info,
             name        TYPE sxco_ar_parameter_name,
             direction   TYPE sxco_ar_parameter_direction,
             type_name   TYPE sxco_ar_type_name,
             is_optional TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ts_parameter_info.
    TYPES tt_parameter_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_parameter_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_method_parameters
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE sxco_ar_object_name
        iv_method_name TYPE sxco_ar_method_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parameters) TYPE tt_parameter_info
      RAISING
        cx_xco_cp_abap_repository.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_method_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_method_parameters.
    DATA(lo_class) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->class->for( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lo_method) = lo_class->method->for( iv_method_name ).
    DATA(lt_xco_parameters) = lo_method->get_parameters( ).

    rt_parameters = VALUE #( FOR ls_xco_param IN lt_xco_parameters
                              ( name        = ls_xco_param->get_name( )
                                direction   = ls_xco_param->get_direction( )
                                type_name   = ls_xco_param->get_type( )->get_name( )
                                is_optional = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_xco_param->get_properties( )->is_optional( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_method_parameters FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_non_existent_method FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_method_parameters.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_method_params( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->get_method_parameters(
      iv_class_name  = 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT'
      iv_method_name = 'ASSERT_EQUALS'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_params )
      msg = 'Should find parameters for ASSERT_EQUALS'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = xsdbool( line_exists( lt_params[ name = 'ACT' direction = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->parameter->direction->importing ] ) )
      msg = 'Parameter ACT should exist as importing'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_method_params( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        i_exception_type = 'CX_XCO_CP_ABAP_REPOSITORY'
        i_code_block = VALUE #( ( code = |lo_cut->get_method_parameters( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT', 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD_PARAMS' ).| ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die XCO Library ermöglicht den detaillierten Zugriff auf die Signatur von Methoden. Mit `GET_PARAMETERS()` können alle Parameter einer Methode abgerufen und deren Eigenschaften wie Name, Richtung und Typ analysiert werden. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und `COND` bietet eine moderne und prägnante Möglichkeit zur Datenaggregation.
keywords: XCO Library, ABAP Repository, Method Parameters, Metadata, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR` in einem `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` anzeigt und auf Button-Klicks reagiert. (Annahme: Dynpro-Bildschirm mit Custom Control Bereich existiert)
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_TOOLBAR`. Fügen Sie Buttons hinzu und registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `BUTTON_CLICK`.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS create_toolbar_with_buttons.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_toolbar          TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating custom container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating toolbar' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_toolbar_with_buttons.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button.

    APPEND VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>s_button( function = 'SAVE' icon = icon_save text = 'Speichern' tooltip = 'Daten speichern' ) TO lt_buttons.
    APPEND VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>s_button( function = 'REFRESH' icon = icon_refresh text = 'Aktualisieren' tooltip = 'Daten aktualisieren' ) TO lt_buttons.

    CALL METHOD mo_toolbar->add_button_group
      EXPORTING
        buttons = lt_buttons
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS  = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error adding buttons' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CALL METHOD mo_toolbar->set_button_info
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error setting button info' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SAVE'.
        MESSAGE 'Save button clicked!' TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN 'REFRESH'.
        MESSAGE 'Refresh button clicked!' TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        MESSAGE |Button with FCODE { fcode } clicked!| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_find_datatype_users DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_data_type_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sxco_ar_object_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_data_types_using_element
      IMPORTING
        iv_data_element_name TYPE sxco_ar_object_name

      RAISING
        cx_xco_cp_abap_repository.

CLASS zcl_xco_find_datatype_users IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_data_types_using_element.

    lo_selector->where->used_data_element->name->eq( iv_data_element_name ).

                                  ( lo_data_type->get_name( ) ) ).

        cx_xco_cp_abap_repository.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_class_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA(lo_class) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->class->for( iv_class_name ).
    DATA(lt_xco_attributes) = lo_class->get_attributes( ).

    rt_attributes = VALUE #( FOR ls_xco_attribute IN lt_xco_attributes
                              ( name        = ls_xco_attribute->get_name( )
                                type_name   = ls_xco_attribute->get_type( )->get_name( )
                                is_static   = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_xco_attribute->get_properties( )->is_static( ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
                                is_public   = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_xco_attribute->get_properties( )->get_visibility( ) = xco_cp_abap_repository=>object->attribute->visibility->public THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_alv_combo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name_toolbar TYPE scrfname
        iv_container_name_alv     TYPE scrfname.

    METHODS display_alv_with_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container_toolbar TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_toolbar                  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_toolbar.
    DATA mo_custom_container_alv     TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_toolbar
      IMPORTING
        fcode.

CLASS zcl_gui_toolbar_alv_combo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " Toolbar Container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name_toolbar
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating toolbar container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_toolbar
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container_toolbar
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating toolbar' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_toolbar.

    " ALV Container
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container_alv
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name_alv
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS         = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV container' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_custom_container_alv
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS   = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error creating ALV grid' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv_with_toolbar.
    DATA lt_buttons TYPE cl_gui_toolbar=>t_button.
    APPEND VALUE cl_gui_toolbar=>s_button( function = 'SAVE' icon = icon_save text = 'Speichern' ) TO lt_buttons.
    CALL METHOD mo_toolbar->add_button_group( buttons = lt_buttons ).
    CALL METHOD mo_toolbar->set_button_info( ).

    CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
      EXPORTING
        i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHT'
      CHANGING
        it_outtab        = it_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0. MESSAGE 'Error setting ALV table' TYPE 'E'. ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SAVE'.
        MESSAGE 'Save from combined toolbar clicked!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ref_to_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (iv_typename).
    ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    " Example: Add some data if type is sflights
    IF iv_typename = 'SFLIGHTS'.

      ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'.
      ls_sflight-connid = '0017'.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
      ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'.
      ls_sflight-connid = '0400'.
      APPEND ls_sflight TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle öffentlichen Methoden einer Klasse und deren Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und `get_methods`.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
        name TYPE string,
        parameters TYPE string_table,
      END OF ty_method_info,
      ty_method_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_method_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_info) TYPE ty_method_info_tab.

    METHODS dummy_public_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_param_one TYPE string
        iv_param_two TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_rtti_method_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_method_info.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        LOOP AT lo_class_descr->get_methods( ) INTO DATA(ls_method_descr) WHERE visibility = cl_abap_objectdescr=>public.
          DATA(ls_method_info) = VALUE ty_method_info( name = ls_method_descr->get_name( ) ).
          LOOP AT ls_method_descr->get_parameters( ) INTO DATA(ls_param_descr).
            APPEND ls_param_descr->get_name( ) TO ls_method_info-parameters.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND ls_method_info TO rt_method_info.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Handle error, e.g., class not found
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_public_method.
    " Dummy method for testing purposes
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf einem Objekt auf, dessen Name und Methodenname zur Laufzeit bekannt sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` und `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischen Namen und `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS: test_method_one
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS: test_method_two
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    IF iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      INSERT VALUE #( name = 'IV_INPUT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>importing value = REF #( iv_param_value ) ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    DATA lv_result TYPE string.
    INSERT VALUE #( name = 'RV_OUTPUT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>returning value = REF #( lv_result ) ) INTO TABLE lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD (lo_object)->(iv_method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
    rv_result = lv_result.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_one.
    rv_output = |Hello from Method One: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method_two.
    rv_output = 'Hello from Method Two (no params)'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_one FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_two FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_one.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_CALL'
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_ONE'
      iv_param_value = 'World'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from Method One: World' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_two.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_RTTI_DYNAMIC_CALL'
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD_TWO'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from Method Two (no params)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf von Methoden mit `CALL METHOD` und `PARAMETER-TABLE`. Die Verwendung von `REF #()` für Parameterübergabe ist eine moderne Technik. String-Templates (`|...|`) verbessern die Lesbarkeit.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Call, CREATE OBJECT, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE, abap_parmbind_tab, String Templates

CLASS zcl_sql_single_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
        cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
      END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_single_flight_corr
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight_corr.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251204'
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING'
      seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 50

CLASS zcl_sql_single_default IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight_with_default.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto

      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid

      rs_flight = VALUE ty_flight_data( carrid = 'N/A' connid = '0000' fldate = '00000000' cityfrom = 'UNKNOWN' cityto = 'UNKNOWN' ).

CLASS zcl_sql_single_where_in DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_case_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        status   TYPE string,
      END OF ty_flight_status.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_status) TYPE ty_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_single_case_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate,
      CASE
        WHEN seatsocc < seatsmax / 2 THEN 'LOW OCCUPANCY'
        WHEN seatsocc >= seatsmax / 2 AND seatsocc < seatsmax THEN 'MEDIUM OCCUPANCY'
        ELSE 'FULL'
      END AS status
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight_status
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      iv_fldate = '20251204'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'MEDIUM OCCUPANCY' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20251204'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_full_occupancy.
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #(
      carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251204'
      price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'BOEING'
      seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 100 " Full
      cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK'
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_single_case_select( ).
    DATA(ls_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20251204'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_status-status exp = 'FULL' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20251204'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE`-Anweisung direkt in der `SELECT`-Liste ermöglicht es, Daten bereits auf der Datenbankebene zu transformieren und zu kategorisieren. Dies reduziert die Datenübertragung und die Verarbeitungslogik im ABAP-Programm, was zu einer besseren Performance führt. Dies ist ein Feature von Open SQL ab ABAP 7.55.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CASE, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS, Data Transformation

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch Kommas getrennte Zahlen enthält, und geben Sie die Summe dieser Zahlen zurück. Leere Einträge sollen ignoriert werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie SPLIT mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_for_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_split_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_for_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_split_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT ',' )
      WHERE ( <part> IS NOT INITIAL )
      NEXT sum = sum + CONV i( <part> )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_split_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_split_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_for_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_sum1) = lo_cut->sum_split_numbers( '10,20,,30' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum1 exp = 60 ).

    DATA(lv_sum2) = lo_cut->sum_split_numbers( '5' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum2 exp = 5 ).

    DATA(lv_sum3) = lo_cut->sum_split_numbers( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum3 exp = 0 ).

    DATA(lv_sum4) = lo_cut->sum_split_numbers( ',,' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum4 exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `SPLIT` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und dem `REDUCE`-Operator. Der `SPLIT`-Befehl erzeugt eine temporäre interne Tabelle, über die `FOR` iteriert. `WHERE` filtert leere Einträge, und `REDUCE` aggregiert die Werte, was zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code führt.
keywords: SPLIT, FOR, REDUCE, String Processing, Functional Programming

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String der Form 'Feld1:Wert1;Feld2:Wert2' in eine Struktur auf, wobei die Feldnamen und Werte extrahiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie SPLIT mehrfach oder eine Kombination mit FIND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_value,
             field_name TYPE string,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_value.
    TYPES tt_field_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS split_to_field_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE tt_field_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_to_field_values.
    DATA: lt_pairs TYPE string_table.
    SPLIT iv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_pairs.

    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      DATA: lv_field_name TYPE string,
            lv_field_value TYPE string.
      SPLIT lv_pair AT ':' INTO lv_field_name lv_field_value.
      APPEND VALUE #( field_name = lv_field_name field_value = lv_field_value ) TO rt_field_values.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    METHODS test_split_to_field_values FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_to_struct( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_to_field_values( 'NAME:John Doe;AGE:30;CITY:New York' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_name exp = 'NAME' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-field_value exp = 'John Doe' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-field_name exp = 'AGE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-field_value exp = '30' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-field_value exp = 'New York' ).
