explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die sequentielle Anwendung des `SPLIT`-Befehls, um hierarchisch strukturierte String-Daten zu parsen. Zuerst wird nach dem Haupttrenner (`;`) gesplittet, dann jeder Teil nach dem Untertrenner (`:`) aufgeteilt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` beim `APPEND` ist eine moderne Art, neue Zeilen zu erstellen.
keywords: SPLIT, String Processing, Structure, Loop

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` den Preis (`PRICE`) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) um einen prozentualen Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie MODIFY DATABASE TABLE mit einer WHERE-Klausel und einer temporären internen Tabelle für die Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_percentage TYPE decfloat16. " e.g., 10 for 10% increase
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 1 + ( iv_percentage / 100 ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_to_update).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * lv_factor.
    ENDLOOP.

    MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_to_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE mt_original_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_percentage) = '10'.

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_old_price)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      DATA(ls_sflight) = VALUE sflights(
        carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101'
        price = 1000 currency = 'EUR'
      ).
      INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
      lv_old_price = 1000.
    ENDIF.

    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_percentage = lv_percentage ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_new_price)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20250101'.

    DATA(lv_expected_price) = lv_old_price * ( 1 + lv_percentage / 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_price exp = lv_expected_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Aktualisierung von Datenbanktabellen mit `MODIFY`. Da direkte Berechnungen in der `MODIFY`-Anweisung für Datenbanktabellen komplex sein können, wird hier eine Strategie verwendet: Zuerst werden die relevanten Daten gelesen, dann die Berechnungen in einer internen Tabelle durchgeführt und schließlich die gesamte interne Tabelle zurück in die Datenbank geschrieben. Dies ist eine gängige und sichere Methode für Massenaktualisierungen.
keywords: MODIFY, Database Table, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, LOOP, DECFLOAT16

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der sowohl durch Kommas als auch durch Semikolons getrennte Werte enthält, in eine Liste von einzelnen Werten auf. Entfernen Sie dabei führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen und leere Einträge.
hint: Führen Sie mehrere SPLIT-Operationen nacheinander durch oder verwenden Sie REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES, um Delimiter zu vereinheitlichen. Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit ALPHA = IN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_multi_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_normalized_string) = REPLACE( val = iv_input_string old = ';' new = ',' ).

    SPLIT lv_normalized_string AT ',' INTO TABLE rt_result_table.

    LOOP AT rt_result_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_part>).
      <fs_part> = |{ <fs_part> ALPHA = IN }|. " ALPHA = IN removes leading/trailing spaces
    ENDLOOP.

    DELETE rt_result_table WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_multi_delimiter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_multi_delim( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( 'Apple, Banana; Orange , Grape;' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Banana' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'Orange' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ] exp = 'Grape' ).

    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( 'One;Two,Three' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 1 ] exp = 'One' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 2 ] exp = 'Two' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 3 ] exp = 'Three' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine Strategie zum Umgang mit mehreren Trennzeichen: Zuerst werden alle unterschiedlichen Trennzeichen durch ein einheitliches ersetzt (`REPLACE`), dann wird der String mit dem vereinheitlichten Trennzeichen gesplittet. Die Verwendung von String-Templates mit `ALPHA = IN` ist eine moderne Methode, um führende/nachfolgende Leerzeichen zu entfernen, und `DELETE WHERE` entfernt leere Einträge effizient.
keywords: SPLIT, REPLACE, String Templates, Internal Table, DELETE

Instructions: Suchen Sie in einer internen Tabelle eine Zeile anhand eines Schlüssels und aktualisieren Sie ein Feld nur, wenn ein bestimmter Zustand erfüllt ist. Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit `MODIFY TABLE` und einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_itab_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id     TYPE string,
             name   TYPE string,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             price  TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES tt_products TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_product_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_id TYPE string
        iv_new_price TYPE decfloat16
      CHANGING
        ct_products TYPE tt_products
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_itab_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_product_price.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.
    TRY.
        lv_index = ct_products[ id = iv_product_id ]-table_line_index.
        IF ct_products[ lv_index ]-status = 'A'.
          MODIFY TABLE ct_products INDEX lv_index TRANSPORTING price = iv_new_price.
          rv_updated = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_product_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_product_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_itab_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_products) = VALUE zcl_modify_itab_cond=>tt_products(
      ( id = 'P001' name = 'Laptop' status = 'A' price = 1200.00 )
      ( id = 'P002' name = 'Mouse'  status = 'I' price = 25.00 )
      ( id = 'P003' name = 'Keyboard' status = 'A' price = 75.00 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_updated1) = lo_cut->update_product_price(
      EXPORTING iv_product_id = 'P001' iv_new_price = 1150.00
      CHANGING  ct_products = lt_products
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_updated1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[ id = 'P001' ]-price exp = 1150.00 ).

    DATA(lv_updated2) = lo_cut->update_product_price(
      EXPORTING iv_product_id = 'P002' iv_new_price = 20.00
      CHANGING  ct_products = lt_products
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_products[ id = 'P002' ]-price exp = 25.00 ).

    DATA(lv_updated3) = lo_cut->update_product_price(
      EXPORTING iv_product_id = 'P004' iv_new_price = 50.00
      CHANGING  ct_products = lt_products
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt Tabellenausdrücke, um eine Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu finden und deren Index zu ermitteln. Die Aktualisierung erfolgt dann über `MODIFY TABLE INDEX`. Die Bedingung für die Aktualisierung (Status 'A') wird nach dem Auffinden der Zeile geprüft. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` für `cx_sy_itab_line_not_found` ist eine moderne Art, das Fehlen einer Zeile zu behandeln.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, Table Expression, LINE_EXISTS, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch ein komplexes Muster (z.B. '---' oder '===') getrennte Abschnitte enthält, in eine interne Tabelle auf. Die Trennzeichen selbst sollen nicht Teil der Ergebniswerte sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` für fortgeschrittene Split-Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_regex_advanced DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_regex_advanced IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_pattern.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ignore_case = abap_false ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input_string ).

    DATA(lv_offset) = 0.
    WHILE lo_matcher->match( ).
      DATA(lv_match_offset) = lo_matcher->get_offset( ).
      DATA(lv_match_length) = lo_matcher->get_length( ).

      IF lv_match_offset > lv_offset.
        APPEND iv_input_string+lv_offset(lv_match_offset - lv_offset) TO rt_result_table.
      ENDIF.
      lv_offset = lv_match_offset + lv_match_length.
    ENDWHILE.

    IF lv_offset < strlen( iv_input_string ).
      APPEND iv_input_string+lv_offset TO rt_result_table.
    ENDIF.

    DELETE rt_result_table WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_by_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_by_pattern.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_regex_advanced( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Header---Section 1===Section 2---Footer'.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '---|==='.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_by_pattern( iv_input_string = lv_input iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'Header' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'Section 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'Section 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ] exp = 'Footer' ).

    DATA(lv_input2) = 'OnlyOnePart'.
    DATA(lt_result2) = lo_cut->split_by_pattern( iv_input_string = lv_input2 iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result2 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 1 ] exp = 'OnlyOnePart' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für komplexe Trennmuster, die über einfache Zeichen hinausgehen, ist die Klasse `CL_ABAP_REGEX` das Werkzeug der Wahl. Hier wird ein Matcher erstellt, der iterativ nach dem Muster sucht. Die Teile des Strings zwischen den Matches werden extrahiert und der Ergebnistabelle hinzugefügt. Dies bietet maximale Flexibilität bei der String-Aufteilung.
keywords: SPLIT, REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Processing, Advanced

Instructions: Ändern Sie in einer internen Tabelle mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel eine Zeile, indem Sie einen Tabellenausdruck verwenden, um die zu ändernde Zeile direkt zu referenzieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit einem Tabellenausdruck auf der linken Seite der Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_itab_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_config.
    TYPES tt_config TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_config WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS update_config_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_key TYPE string
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_config TYPE tt_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_itab_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_config_value.
    TRY.
        ct_config[ key = iv_key ]-value = iv_new_value.
        rv_updated = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        rv_updated = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_config_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_config_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_itab_expr( ).
    DATA(lt_config) = VALUE zcl_modify_itab_expr=>tt_config(
      ( key = 'SETTING_A' value = 'Old Value A' )
      ( key = 'SETTING_B' value = 'Old Value B' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_updated1) = lo_cut->update_config_value(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 'SETTING_A' iv_new_value = 'New Value A'
      CHANGING  ct_config = lt_config
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_updated1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_config[ key = 'SETTING_A' ]-value exp = 'New Value A' ).

    DATA(lv_updated2) = lo_cut->update_config_value(
      EXPORTING iv_key = 'SETTING_C' iv_new_value = 'Value C'
      CHANGING  ct_config = lt_config
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_updated2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_config ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In modernen ABAP-Versionen kann eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel direkt über einen Tabellenausdruck auf der linken Seite einer Zuweisung geändert werden. Dies ist die kompakteste und performanteste Methode für Einzelzeilenaktualisierungen. Das `TRY...CATCH` fängt den Fehler ab, wenn der Schlüssel nicht gefunden wird.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, Table Expression, Unique Key, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in zwei Teile an der ersten gefundenen Instanz eines Trennzeichens. Der Rest des Strings soll als zweiter Teil zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` in Kombination mit `SUBSTRING` oder `SPLIT` mit einer Variablen für den Rest.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_first_occurrence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_at_first
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_part1 TYPE string
        ev_part2 TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_first_occurrence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_at_first.
    DATA(lv_offset) = find( val = iv_input_string sub = iv_delimiter ).

    IF lv_offset IS NOT INITIAL.
      ev_part1 = iv_input_string(lv_offset).
      ev_part2 = iv_input_string+lv_offset+strlen( iv_delimiter ).
    ELSE.
      ev_part1 = iv_input_string.
      ev_part2 = ''.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_split_at_first FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_at_first.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_first_occurrence( ).
    DATA: lv_p1 TYPE string, lv_p2 TYPE string.

    lo_cut->split_at_first( EXPORTING iv_input_string = 'apple:banana:orange' iv_delimiter = ':'
                            IMPORTING ev_part1 = lv_p1 ev_part2 = lv_p2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p1 exp = 'apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p2 exp = 'banana:orange' ).

    lo_cut->split_at_first( EXPORTING iv_input_string = 'no_delimiter_here' iv_delimiter = ':'
                            IMPORTING ev_part1 = lv_p1 ev_part2 = lv_p2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p1 exp = 'no_delimiter_here' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p2 exp = '' ).

    lo_cut->split_at_first( EXPORTING iv_input_string = ':leading_delimiter' iv_delimiter = ':'
                            IMPORTING ev_part1 = lv_p1 ev_part2 = lv_p2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p1 exp = '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_p2 exp = 'leading_delimiter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet die Funktion `FIND`, um die Position des ersten Trennzeichens zu ermitteln. Anschließend werden String-Offsets und Längen verwendet, um die beiden Teile des Strings zu extrahieren. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um einen String nur an der ersten Übereinstimmung zu teilen, ohne den gesamten String zu parsen.
keywords: SPLIT, FIND, SUBSTRING, String Processing

Instructions: Ändern Sie in einer internen Tabelle alle Zeilen, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und setzen Sie ein Feld auf einen berechneten Wert, der von anderen Feldern der Zeile abhängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` in Kombination mit `MODIFY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_calc_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             order_id TYPE string,
             item_id  TYPE i,
             quantity TYPE i,
             unit_price TYPE decfloat16,
             total_price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_prices
      CHANGING
        ct_order_items TYPE tt_order_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_calc_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_prices.
    LOOP AT ct_order_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_item>)
      WHERE quantity IS NOT INITIAL AND unit_price IS NOT INITIAL.
      <fs_item>-total_price = <fs_item>-quantity * <fs_item>-unit_price.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_calc_value( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_modify_calc_value=>tt_order_items(
      ( order_id = 'ORD1' item_id = 1 quantity = 2 unit_price = 10.50 total_price = 0 )
      ( order_id = 'ORD1' item_id = 2 quantity = 1 unit_price = 5.00 total_price = 0 )
      ( order_id = 'ORD2' item_id = 1 quantity = 3 unit_price = 20.00 total_price = 0 )
      ( order_id = 'ORD3' item_id = 1 quantity = 0 unit_price = 100.00 total_price = 0 ) " Should not be calculated
    ).

    lo_cut->calculate_total_prices( CHANGING ct_order_items = lt_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 1 ]-total_price exp = 21.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 2 ]-total_price exp = 5.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 3 ]-total_price exp = 60.00 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_items[ 4 ]-total_price exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die effiziente Aktualisierung von Feldern in einer internen Tabelle, deren Werte von anderen Feldern derselben Zeile abhängen. Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation der Zeile im Speicher, ohne dass ein expliziter `MODIFY`-Befehl erforderlich ist. Die `WHERE`-Klausel im `LOOP` filtert die zu verarbeitenden Zeilen.
keywords: MODIFY, Internal Table, LOOP, Field-Symbol, Calculation

Instructions: Ändern Sie in der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` den Status (`STATUS`) aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und Flugverbindung (`CONNID`) auf 'X', wenn das Flugdatum (`FLDATE`) in der Vergangenheit liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY DATABASE TABLE` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel, die auch eine Datumsprüfung beinhaltet.
solution:
CLASS zcl_modify_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_past_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_modify_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_past_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    " Read relevant flights that are in the past and need update
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, status
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate < @lv_current_date
        AND status <> 'X'
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_to_update).

    LOOP AT lt_flights_to_update ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-status = 'X'.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Modify database table
    MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE lt_flights_to_update.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_past_flight_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS setup.
    METHODS teardown.
    DATA mt_original_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD setup.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @mt_original_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD teardown.
    MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE mt_original_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_past_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_modify_sflights_status( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_past_date) = sy-datum - 10.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 10.

    " Ensure test data exists
    DATA(ls_sflight_past) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_past_date
      price = 100 currency = 'USD' status = ''
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight_past.

    DATA(ls_sflight_future) = VALUE sflights(
      carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_future_date
      price = 200 currency = 'USD' status = ''
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight_future.

    lo_cut->update_past_flight_status( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_connid = lv_connid ).

    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_status_past)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_past_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_past exp = 'X' ).

    SELECT SINGLE status FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_status_future)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_future_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_future exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die bedingte Aktualisierung von Datenbanktabellen basierend auf Datumsvergleichen. Es wird eine `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet, um nur die relevanten Zeilen zu lesen, die die Kriterien (Fluggesellschaft, Verbindung, vergangenes Datum und aktueller Status) erfüllen. Diese Zeilen werden dann in einer internen Tabelle aktualisiert und mit `MODIFY sflights FROM TABLE` effizient in die Datenbank zurückgeschrieben. Dies ist eine sichere Methode, um Massenaktualisierungen mit komplexen Bedingungen durchzuführen.
keywords: MODIFY, Database Table, SFLIGHTS, SELECT, Date/Time, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in eine interne Tabelle von Werten auf, wobei jeder Wert vor der Aufnahme in die Tabelle transformiert (z.B. in Großbuchstaben umgewandelt) werden soll.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `SPLIT` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und einer String-Funktion wie `TO_UPPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_split_and_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_and_transform_to_upper
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_table) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_split_and_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_and_transform_to_upper.
    rt_transformed_table = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT iv_input_string AT iv_delimiter )
      WHERE ( <part> IS NOT INITIAL )
      ( to_upper( <part> ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_split_and_transform FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_split_and_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->split_and_transform_to_upper( iv_input_string = 'apple,Banana,orange' iv_delimiter = ',' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = 'APPLE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = 'BANANA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = 'ORANGE' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 1 ] exp = 'TEST' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result2[ 2 ] exp = 'VALUE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kombination von `SPLIT` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und dem `VALUE`-Operator, um eine interne Tabelle zu füllen. Innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks wird jede gesplittete Komponente direkt mit der Funktion `TO_UPPER` transformiert, bevor sie in die Ergebnistabelle aufgenommen wird. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Verarbeitung von String-Daten.
keywords: SPLIT, FOR, VALUE, TO_UPPER, String Processing, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_random_exc_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_max TYPE i
      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_random_exc_handle IMPLEMENTATION.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = iv_min iv_max = iv_max ).

        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_abap_random_range INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        MESSAGE lx_range_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_abap_random INTO DATA(lx_random_error).
        MESSAGE lx_random_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Lesen Sie alle Einträge in eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für den Index.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sflight RETURNING VALUE(rs_sflight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight( FOR ls_sflight IN SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS WHERE carrid IS NOT NULL AND connid IS NOT NULL AND fldate IS NOT NULL ( ls_sflight ) ).

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_max_index) = lines( lt_sflights ) - 1.
    DATA(lo_random_int) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_max_index ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_int->get_next( ).

    rs_sflight = lt_sflights[ lv_random_index + 1 ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_random_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_sflight) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_sflight-carrid msg = 'No flight returned, check SFLIGHT data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert das Auslesen von Daten in eine interne Tabelle mit `FOR` und `SELECT`, gefolgt von der Auswahl eines zufälligen Eintrags mittels `cl_abap_random_int` und einem Tabellenausdruck.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme und lösen Sie diese aus, wenn eine generierte Zufallszahl einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Meldung aus.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt. Verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `MESSAGE ... INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_random_threshold DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    DATA mv_threshold TYPE f READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_random_value TYPE f READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid        LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous      LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL
        i_threshold   TYPE f
        i_random_value TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_random_threshold IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
    mv_threshold = i_threshold.
    mv_random_value = i_random_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_threshold_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_random_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_random_threshold.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_threshold_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_random_value.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_rand_val) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_rand_val > iv_threshold.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_random_threshold
        EXPORTING
          i_threshold   = iv_threshold
          i_random_value = lv_rand_val.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Zufallswert { lv_rand_val } liegt unterhalb des Schwellenwerts { iv_threshold }.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_threshold_exceeded FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_threshold_exceeded.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_threshold_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_message) TYPE string.
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        lv_message = lo_cut->check_random_value( iv_threshold = 0.1 ).
      CATCH zcx_random_threshold INTO DATA(lx_threshold).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exception_caught ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lx_threshold->mv_random_value > lx_threshold->mv_threshold ) ).
    ENDTRY.

    IF lv_exception_caught = abap_false.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'unterhalb' act = lv_message ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Definition und Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_random_threshold`), die ausgelöst wird, wenn eine Zufallszahl einen Schwellenwert überschreitet. Die Ausnahme wird abgefangen und verarbeitet.
keywords: CATCH, EXCEPTION, CUSTOM EXCEPTION, RAISE EXCEPTION, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von `CATCH OTHERS` für die generische Fehlerbehandlung, wenn eine unerwartete Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, und fangen Sie diese mit `CATCH OTHERS` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_catch_others_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation RETURNING VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_catch_others_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lv_numerator) = 10.
    DATA(lv_denominator) = 0.

    TRY.
        DATA(lv_result) = lv_numerator / lv_denominator.
        rv_status_message = |Operation erfolgreich: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_status_message = |Spezifischer Fehler: { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_any_exception).
        rv_status_message = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_any_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_catch_others FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_catch_others.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_catch_others_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->perform_risky_operation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Spezifischer Fehler' act = lv_message ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( pattern = 'Division durch Null' act = lv_message ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt die Hierarchie der Ausnahmebehandlung, wobei `CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error` zuerst versucht wird und `CATCH OTHERS` als Fallback für alle anderen Ausnahmen dient.
keywords: CATCH, CATCH OTHERS, EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Datum innerhalb eines bestimmten Jahresbereichs.
hint: Generieren Sie zufällige Tage seit einem Startdatum oder verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für Jahr, Monat und Tag.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_date_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_year TYPE i
        iv_end_year   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date_in_range.
    DATA(lv_start_date) = CONV d( |{ iv_start_year }0101| ).
    DATA(lv_end_date)   = CONV d( |{ iv_end_year }1231| ).

    DATA(lv_days_diff) = cl_abap_date_helper=>diff( iv_date1 = lv_end_date iv_date2 = lv_start_date ).

    DATA(lo_random_days) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_days_diff ).
    DATA(lv_random_offset) = lo_random_days->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_random_offset ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_date_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_start_year) = 2000.

    DATA(lv_random_date) = lo_cut->get_random_date_in_range( iv_start_year = lv_start_year iv_end_year = lv_end_year ).

    DATA(lv_min_date) = CONV d( |{ lv_start_year }0101| ).

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Würfelwurf mit einer variablen Anzahl von Seiten und fangen Sie ungültige Eingaben ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `TRY...CATCH` für den Fall, dass die Anzahl der Seiten kleiner als 1 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dice_roll DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS roll_dice
      IMPORTING
        iv_sides TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_random_range.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dice_roll IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD roll_dice.
    IF iv_sides < 1.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_random_range
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_random_range=>cx_abap_random_range.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 1 iv_max = iv_sides ).
    rv_result = lo_random->get_next( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dice_roll( ).

        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exception_caught ).

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen String einer bestimmten Länge aus einem vorgegebenen Zeichensatz. Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, wenn der Zeichensatz leer ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Auswahl der Zeichen und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_string_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length      TYPE i
        iv_char_set    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_gen IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_string.
    IF iv_char_set IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value=>cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_char_set_len) = strlen( iv_char_set ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 0 iv_max = lv_char_set_len - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_string_builder) TYPE string.

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_char_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).
      lv_random_string_builder = lv_random_string_builder && iv_char_set+lv_random_char_index(1).
    ENDDO.

    rv_random_string = lv_random_string_builder.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_string_gen FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_char_set FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_string_gen.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = 10.
    DATA(lv_char_set) = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'.
    DATA(lv_random_string) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_random_string = lo_cut->generate_random_string( iv_length = lv_length iv_char_set = lv_char_set ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_random_string ) exp = lv_length ).
        DO lv_length TIMES.
          DATA(lv_char) = lv_random_string+sy-index-1(1).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( iv_char_set CS lv_char ) ).
        ENDDO.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Unexpected exception for valid input' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_char_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_string_gen( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_random_string( iv_length = 5 iv_char_set = '' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_parameter_value.
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exception_caught ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Erzeugt einen zufälligen String, indem Zeichen aus einem vorgegebenen Satz zufällig ausgewählt werden. Eine Ausnahme wird ausgelöst und abgefangen, wenn der Zeichensatz leer ist.
keywords: RANDOM, STRING, CATCH, EXCEPTION, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, CX_ABAP_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Verketten von Ausnahmen, indem Sie eine spezifische Ausnahme abfangen und eine neue, generischere Ausnahme mit der ursprünglichen Ausnahme als 'Previous Exception' auslösen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `PREVIOUS` Parameter im Konstruktor der neuen Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcx_application_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid   LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_static_check=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_application_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        textid   = textid
        previous = previous.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_application_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    DATA(lv_denominator) = iv_value.

    TRY.
        IF lv_denominator = 0.
          DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / lv_denominator.
        ENDIF.
        DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
        DATA(lv_rand) = lo_random->get_next( ).
        IF lv_rand > 8.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_random_range.
        ENDIF.
        rv_result = lv_rand * 10.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_application_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_arith
            textid   = zcx_application_error=>default_text.
      CATCH cx_abap_random_range INTO DATA(lx_random).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_application_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_random
            textid   = zcx_application_error=>default_text.
      CATCH OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_other).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_application_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_other
            textid   = zcx_application_error=>default_text.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_chain_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_exception_chain_random FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_chain_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( iv_value = 0 ).
      CATCH zcx_application_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exception_caught ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_app_error->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_app_error->previous->get_class_name( ) exp = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_exception_chain_random.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->process_data( iv_value = 1 ).
      CATCH zcx_application_error INTO DATA(lx_app_error).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_exception_caught ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_app_error->previous ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lx_app_error->previous->get_class_name( ) = 'CX_ABAP_RANDOM_RANGE' OR lx_app_error->previous->get_class_name( ) = 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' ) ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_exception_caught OR abap_true ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert das Verketten von Ausnahmen. Spezifische Systemausnahmen (`cx_sy_arithmetic_error`, `cx_abap_random_range`) werden abgefangen und in eine benutzerdefinierte Anwendungsfehler-Ausnahme (`zcx_application_error`) gewickelt, wobei die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als `PREVIOUS` erhalten bleibt.
keywords: CATCH, EXCEPTION CHAINING, CUSTOM EXCEPTION, PREVIOUS EXCEPTION, CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR, CX_ABAP_RANDOM_RANGE

CLASS zcl_ctmenu_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  METHOD create_dynamic_menu.
    ro_menu = NEW cl_ctmenu( ).

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit Kopfzeile und Semikolon als Trennzeichen in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT`.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA(lo_csv_parser) = cl_icf_csv=>create_with_string(
      i_string = iv_csv_data
      i_separator = ';'
      i_has_header = abap_true
    ).

    lo_csv_parser->parse(
      IMPORTING
        e_table = rt_sflight
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_csv.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_csv_parser( ).
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = 'CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&
                        'LH;0400;20251204' && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf &&

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight2-connid exp = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight2-fldate exp = '20251205' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_icf_csv` bietet eine einfache und effiziente Möglichkeit, CSV-Daten in ABAP zu verarbeiten. Die statische Methode `create_with_string` erstellt eine Instanz aus einem String, und `parse` füllt eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur der Tabelle und den CSV-Daten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine vorhandene Tabelle filtern und dabei nur bestimmte Felder mit `VALUE` und `FOR` in einer Zeile transformieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_expressions DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             flag TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_original.
    TYPES tt_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_filtered,
             new_id   TYPE i,
             new_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_filtered.
    TYPES tt_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table IMPORTING it_original TYPE tt_original
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_expressions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_original WHERE ( flag = abap_true )
                            ( new_id = ls_item-id * 10
                              new_text = |Processed: { ls_item-text }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_expressions( ).
    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_table_expressions=>tt_original(
      ( id = 1 text = 'First' flag = abap_true )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Second' flag = abap_false )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Third' flag = abap_true )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->process_table( lt_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_filtered1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered1-new_id exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered1-new_text exp = 'Processed: First' ).

    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_filtered2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered2-new_id exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_filtered2-new_text exp = 'Processed: Third' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke mit `VALUE` und `FOR` (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglichen die deklarative Erstellung und Transformation interner Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und lesbarem Code, der die Notwendigkeit expliziter Schleifen reduziert.
keywords: Interne Tabellen, VALUE, FOR, Tabellenausdrücke, Filter

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) und die Verwendung von Konstruktorausdrücken für die Objekterzeugung.
hint: Erstellen Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, und nutzen Sie `NEW type( ... )->method1()->method2()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_add_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_mul_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mul_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( iv_initial_value = 5 ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->mv_value.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (ab ABAP 7.50) erhöht die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, indem mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Zeile ausgeführt werden können. Dies wird durch Methoden ermöglicht, die eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben. In Kombination mit Konstruktorausdrücken (`NEW type( ... )`) entsteht ein flüssiger Programmierstil.
keywords: Method Chaining, Objekterzeugung, NEW, OO, Objektorientierung

CLASS zcl_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe eines Feldes in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             name  TYPE string,

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr` und `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabellenerstellung und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für den Zugriff auf Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table IMPORTING it_field_names TYPE string_table
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    DATA(lo_table_descr) = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line>  TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_table>.
    CREATE DATA <ls_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_table>.

    " Fill with some dummy data
    DO 2 TIMES.
      ASSIGN <ls_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line_wa>).
      LOOP AT it_field_names INTO lv_field_name.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line_wa> TO <lv_field>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <lv_field> = |{ lv_field_name }_Value_{ sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_line_wa> INTO TABLE <lt_table>.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lt_fields) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD2' ) ).

    DATA(lr_data) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_fields ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_line>  TYPE any.

    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 INTO <ls_dynamic_line>.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field1>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field1> exp = 'FIELD1_Value_1' ).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field2>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_field2> exp = 'FIELD2_Value_1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittswert einer Liste von Ganzzahlen in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von `REDUCE` und dem `DIVIDE`-Operator. Achten Sie auf Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und anschließend durch die Anzahl der Elemente zu teilen. Implementieren Sie eine Prüfung auf Division durch Null.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_average
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average.
    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR <number> IN it_numbers
      NEXT s = s + <number>
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lines( it_numbers ).

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_average = lv_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie für jeden Flug in der Tabelle `sflight` eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugnummer und das Verhältnis der belegten Sitze zu den Gesamtsitzen (Auslastung) enthält. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einem `LET`-Ausdruck, um die Division sicher durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE tt_flight_occupancy(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_occupancy = COND f(
                             WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                             ELSE ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                           )
      IN
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
          occupancy = lv_occupancy )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_occupancy) = lo_cut->get_flight_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_occupancy IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_occupancy ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_occupancy INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_entry-occupancy GE 0 AND ls_entry-occupancy LE 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_seats.
    " Testet die Logik für Division durch Null, da das Mocken von SELECT * FROM sflight komplex wäre.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_zero_max) = COND f(
                                     WHEN 0 = 0 THEN 0
                                     ELSE ( 10 / 0 ) * 100
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_occupancy_zero_max exp = 0.0 ).

    DATA(lv_occupancy_zero_occ) = COND f(
                                     WHEN 100 = 0 THEN 0
                                     ELSE ( 0 / 100 ) * 100
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_occupancy_zero_occ exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ist eine sehr moderne und lesbare Art der Tabellenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division unter Verwendung von `cl_abap_math=>divide` durch, um potenzielle Überläufe oder Division durch Null mit spezifischen Ausnahmen zu behandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block, um die Ausnahmen von `cl_abap_math=>divide` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_robust_divider DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS robust_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE decfloat34
        iv_denominator TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_robust_divider IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD robust_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = cl_abap_math=>divide( val1 = iv_numerator val2 = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Hier könnte eine spezifischere Fehlerbehandlung erfolgen
        " z.B. Loggen des Fehlers oder Rückgabe eines Default-Wertes
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_normal_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_overflow RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_normal_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_robust_divider( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->robust_divide( iv_numerator = '100.0' iv_denominator = '4.0' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '25.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_robust_divider( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->robust_divide( iv_numerator = '100.0' iv_denominator = '0.0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for division by zero' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true, 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_robust_divider( ).
    TRY.
        " Simulate a very large number divided by a very small number to trigger potential overflow
        lo_cut->robust_divide( iv_numerator = '1E+30' iv_denominator = '1E-30' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for overflow' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true, 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_math=>divide` bietet eine robuste Möglichkeit zur Durchführung von Divisionen, insbesondere bei Gleitkommazahlen (`decfloat34`). Es wirft spezifische Ausnahmen (`cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) bei Problemen wie Division durch Null oder Überlauf, die mit `TRY...CATCH` abgefangen und behandelt werden können. Dies ist der moderne Ansatz für mathematische Operationen, die eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung erfordern.
keywords: cl_abap_math, DIVIDE, Exception Handling, Math, decfloat34

CLASS zcl_is_weekend IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_day_of_week) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_day_of_week( lv_date ).

    IF lv_day_of_week = 6 OR lv_day_of_week = 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      rv_is_weekend = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_weekend = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflight`, die die Flugnummer und die Auslastung in Prozent enthält. Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `LET`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... ( LET ... IN ... )` mit `DIVIDE` für die Prozentberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             percentage  TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES tt_flight_percentage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_occupancy_percentage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_occupancy_percentage.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_percentages = VALUE tt_flight_percentage(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_percentage = COND p(
                              WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax = 0 THEN 0
                              ELSE ( ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ) * 100
                            )
      IN
        ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
          connid = ls_flight-connid,
          fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
          percentage = lv_percentage )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    ENDLOOP.

  METHOD test_zero_seats_max.
    " Testet die Logik für Division durch Null, da das Mocken von SELECT * FROM sflight komplex wäre.
    DATA(lv_percentage_zero_max) = COND p(
                                     WHEN 0 = 0 THEN 0
                                     ELSE ( 10 / 0 ) * 100
                                   ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_percentage_zero_max exp = 0.00 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken, `VALUE` und `LET` ist ein leistungsstarkes Muster in modernem ABAP zur deklarativen Transformation von internen Tabellen. Der `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb von `LET` stellt sicher, dass die Division durch Null sicher behandelt wird, was zu robustem und lesbarem Code führt.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen eindeutigen Bezeichner, indem Sie den aktuellen Programmnamen, den Benutzer und einen berechneten Wert (z.B. aktuelle Zeit geteilt durch eine Konstante) kombinieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_syst` für Programmname und Benutzer, und `DIVIDE` für den numerischen Teil. Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_id.
    DATA(lv_program) = cl_abap_syst=>get_repid( ).
    DATA(lv_user) = cl_abap_syst=>get_uname( ).
    DATA(lv_time) = cl_abap_syst=>get_uzeit( ).
    DATA(lv_constant) = 100. " Beispielkonstante

    DATA(lv_calculated_value) = COND i(
      WHEN lv_constant = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE lv_time / lv_constant
    ).

    rv_unique_id = |{ lv_program }-{ lv_user }-{ lv_calculated_value ALPHA = OUT }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflight` nach Flügen, deren Preis pro Sitzplatz unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt. Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und den `DIVIDE`-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Ausdruck und berechnen Sie den Preis pro Sitzplatz innerhalb der Filterbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cheap_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_price_per_seat_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_flights_by_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cheap_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER tt_sflight(
      lt_sflights
      WHERE ( price / COND f(
                         WHEN seatsmax = 0 THEN 1 " Avoid division by zero, treat as 1 to not filter out
                         ELSE seatsmax
                       ) ) < iv_price_per_seat_threshold
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_cheap_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_cheap_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_cheap_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_price( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_cheap_flights( 100 ). " Beispiel-Schwellenwert

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered IS NOT INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_filtered ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_price_per_seat) = COND f(
                                   WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax = 0 THEN ls_flight-price " Wenn keine Sitze, Preis pro Sitz = Gesamtpreis
                                   ELSE ls_flight-price / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_price_per_seat < 100 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_cheap_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_price( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_cheap_flights( 0.01 ). " Sehr niedriger Schwellenwert
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_filtered ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_flights_by_price( ).
    " Erstellen Sie einen Mock-Flug mit seatsmax = 0
    DATA lt_mock_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = 500 seatsmax = 0 ) TO lt_mock_sflights.

    " Da wir SELECT * verwenden, können wir hier nur die Logik des COND-Ausdrucks testen.
    DATA(lv_divisor) = COND f(
                         WHEN 0 = 0 THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_divisor exp = 1.0 ).

    DATA(lv_price_per_seat_calc) = 500 / lv_divisor.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price_per_seat_calc exp = 500.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck ist eine moderne und deklarative Methode zum Filtern interner Tabellen. In Kombination mit einem `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb der `WHERE`-Bedingung kann der `DIVIDE`-Operator sicher verwendet werden, um dynamische Berechnungen (hier Preis pro Sitzplatz) durchzuführen und gleichzeitig Division durch Null zu vermeiden. Dies macht den Code sehr ausdrucksstark und effizient.
keywords: FILTER, DIVIDE, Internal Tables, sflight, Conditional Logic, Price Calculation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Tage, die seit dem Jahresanfang bis zum aktuellen Systemdatum vergangen sind, und verwenden Sie dabei `cl_abap_syst` und Datumsarithmetik.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_syst=>get_datum()` und die Datumsarithmetik für die Differenzberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_days_since_year_start DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_days
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_days_since_year_start IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_days.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_current_date(4).
    DATA(lv_year_start_date) = lv_year && '0101'.

    rv_days = lv_current_date - lv_year_start_date.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_days FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_first_day_of_year FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_last_day_of_year FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_days_since_year_start( ).
    DATA(lv_days) = lo_cut->calculate_days( ).

    " Da der Test an einem beliebigen Tag läuft, können wir nur prüfen, ob der Wert plausibel ist.
    " Er sollte nicht negativ sein und nicht über 365/366 liegen.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_days GE 0 AND lv_days LE 366 ).

    " Für eine präzisere Prüfung müsste cl_abap_syst gemockt werden.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_current_date(4).
    DATA(lv_year_start_date) = lv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_expected_days) = lv_current_date - lv_year_start_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_days exp = lv_expected_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_first_day_of_year.
    " Mocking cl_abap_syst for specific date (e.g., 01.01.YYYY)
    " In real scenario, use test seams or dependency injection.
    DATA(lv_mock_date) = '20250101'.
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_mock_date(4).
    DATA(lv_year_start_date) = lv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_expected_days) = lv_mock_date - lv_year_start_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_days exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_last_day_of_year.
    " Mocking cl_abap_syst for specific date (e.g., 31.12.YYYY)
    DATA(lv_mock_date) = '20241231'. " Schaltjahr
    DATA(lv_year) = lv_mock_date(4).
    DATA(lv_year_start_date) = lv_year && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_expected_days) = lv_mock_date - lv_year_start_date.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_days exp = 365 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_syst=>get_datum()` für das aktuelle Datum und die direkte Datumsarithmetik (`datum1 - datum2`) ist der moderne und effiziente Weg, um die Differenz zwischen zwei Daten in Tagen zu berechnen. Dies ist wesentlich einfacher und weniger fehleranfällig als manuelle Berechnungen mit Hilfsvariablen.
keywords: cl_abap_syst, Date, Date Arithmetic, System Fields, Days Calculation

CLASS zcl_ui_simple_html DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS display_html IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string DEFAULT 'Simple HTML Display'. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_ui_simple_html IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD display_html. DATA(lv_html) = |{ iv_title }

Hello from ABAP!

hint: Nutzen Sie CALL TRANSFORMATION ID SOURCE ... RESULT XML ... und CL_ABAP_BROWSER=>SHOW_HTML.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_as_xml.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_sflights_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_as_xml.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 5 ROWS. "Limit for demo purposes

    DATA lv_xml_string TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE sflights = lt_sflights
          RESULT XML lv_xml_string.

        cl_abap_browser=>show_html(
          EXPORTING
            html_xstring = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( lv_xml_string )
            title        = 'SFLIGHTS as XML'
        ).
      CATCH cx_xslt_format_error cx_xslt_runtime_error INTO DATA(lx_xslt_error).
        MESSAGE lx_xslt_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

    " Hier wird nur geprüft, ob die XML-Generierung und der Aufruf der Anzeigemethode

        lo_xml_display->display_sflights_as_xml( ).

    ENDTRY.

Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (DATA(...)) und der neuen SELECT-Syntax ab ABAP 7.40/7.50 sind moderne Praktiken. CALL TRANSFORMATION ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für XML-Serialisierung.

Instructions: Lesen Sie den Inhalt einer lokalen HTML-Datei vom Applikationsserver und zeigen Sie ihn im ABAP-Browser an.
hint: Verwenden Sie OPEN DATASET / READ DATASET für Dateien auf dem Applikationsserver. Dann CL_ABAP_BROWSER=>SHOW_HTML.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui_local_html_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS display_local_html_file IMPORTING iv_file_path TYPE string. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_ui_local_html_file IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD display_local_html_file. DATA lv_html_content TYPE string. DATA(lv_file_path_internal) = iv_file_path. " Use the imported path " Create a dummy HTML file on application server for demonstration OPEN DATASET lv_file_path_internal FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING UTF8. IF sy-subrc = 0. TRANSFER |Local File

Content from Local File

This HTML was read from { lv_file_path_internal }.

| TO lv_file_path_internal. CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path_internal. ELSE. MESSAGE |Could not create dummy file { lv_file_path_internal }| TYPE 'E'. RETURN. ENDIF. " Read the content OPEN DATASET lv_file_path_internal FOR INPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING UTF8. IF sy-subrc = 0. READ DATASET lv_file_path_internal INTO lv_html_content. CLOSE DATASET lv_file_path_internal. cl_abap_browser=>show_html( EXPORTING html_xstring = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_utf8_encoder( )->convert( lv_html_content ) title = |HTML from { iv_file_path }| ). ELSE. MESSAGE |Could not read file { lv_file_path_internal }| TYPE 'E'. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_read_and_display.
    DATA(lo_local_html) = NEW zcl_ui_local_html_file( ).
    DATA(lv_test_file) = '/tmp/abap_browser_test_file.html'.

    " Create a dummy file for testing
    OPEN DATASET lv_test_file FOR OUTPUT IN TEXT MODE ENCODING UTF8.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRANSFER '<html><body>Test Content</body></html>' TO lv_test_file.
      CLOSE DATASET lv_test_file.
    ENDIF.

    " Ruft die Methode auf. Hier wird nur geprüft, ob der Methodenaufruf
    " ohne Ausnahme abgeschlossen wird.
    TRY.
        lo_local_html->display_local_html_file( lv_test_file ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true "Dateilesen und Anzeigeaufruf abgeschlossen" ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( |Ausnahme abgefangen: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Clean up the dummy file
    DELETE DATASET lv_test_file.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Rufen Sie grundlegende Informationen für ein gegebenes ABAP-Paket ab (z.B. '$TMP').
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode CL_PAK_PACKAGE_QUERIES=>GET_PACKAGE_INFO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_pak_get_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_package_info,
             package_name    TYPE devclass,
             description     TYPE as4text,
             transport_layer TYPE trlayer,
             super_package   TYPE devclass,
           END OF ty_package_info.

    METHODS get_package_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_name TYPE devclass
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_package_info) TYPE ty_package_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_pak_get_info IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_package_details.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_pak_info) = cl_pak_package_queries=>get_package_info( iv_package_name ).
        rs_package_info = VALUE #(
          package_name    = ls_pak_info-package_name
          description     = ls_pak_info-description
          transport_layer = ls_pak_info-transport_layer
          super_package   = ls_pak_info-super_package
        ).
      CATCH cx_pak_package_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        MESSAGE lx_not_found->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        CLEAR rs_package_info.
      CATCH cx_pak_error INTO DATA(lx_pak_error).
        MESSAGE lx_pak_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
        CLEAR rs_package_info.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        " Hier würde die Logik zur Prüfung des Änderungsdatums folgen.
        " Beispiel: SELECT * FROM tadir WHERE pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object IN ('CLAS', 'FUGR', 'PROG') AND obj_name IN @rt_objects AND datats >= @( sy-datum - iv_days_ago ).

        MESSAGE lx_not_found->get_text( ) TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_pak_error INTO DATA(lx_pak_error).

CLASS zcl_for_loop_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights.
    rt_processed_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights ( <fs_flight> ) ). " Simple copy for demonstration
    " Example: Modify each flight's carrid
    LOOP AT rt_processed_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight_mod>).
      <fs_flight_mod>-carrid = |{ <fs_flight_mod>-carrid }_NEW|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `DATA(...) = REDUCE #( INIT ... FOR ... IN ... NEXT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight_count.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carrier IMPORTING it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carrier.
    rv_total_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR flight IN it_flights
      NEXT total = total + flight-count
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' count = 5 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' count = 12 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->count_flights_by_carrier( lt_test_data ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie Elemente einer bestehenden Tabelle transformieren und filtern, unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `COND` in einem `VALUE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... ( COND ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_processed,
             flight_key TYPE string,
             status     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_processed.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight_processed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_processed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_cond IMPORTING it_raw_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight_raw
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed) TYPE ty_t_sflight_processed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_cond.
    rt_processed = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_raw_flights
                             WHERE ( price > 100 )
                             ( flight_key = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|,
                               status     = COND string( WHEN flight-price > 500 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights_cond FOR TESTING.
