CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_cond.
    DATA: lt_raw TYPE zcl_for_cond_value=>ty_t_sflight_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = 80 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = 150 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0987' price = 600 ) TO lt_raw.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '1234' price = 90 ) TO lt_raw.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_cond_value( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_flights_cond( lt_raw ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-flight_key exp = 'AA-0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Standard' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-flight_key exp = 'UA-0987' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Expensive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` in einem einzigen Ausdruck. Es ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von Tabellendaten in einer sehr kompakten und funktionalen Weise, was den Code extrem lesbar und wartbar macht. `DATA` wird für die Inline-Deklaration verwendet und die Klasse ist `FINAL`.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Transformation, Filtering, DATA, FINAL

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTF-8-String in die Codepage '88591' (ISO-8859-1) und anschließend wieder zurück nach UTF-8. Überprüfen Sie, ob der String nach der Hin- und Rückkonvertierung identisch ist.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string    TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring.

    METHODS convert_back_to_string

        iv_input_xstring   TYPE xstring
        iv_source_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string.
    rv_converted_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source   = iv_input_string
      codepage = iv_target_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD convert_back_to_string.
    rv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source   = iv_input_xstring
      codepage = iv_source_codepage
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_codepage_convert( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello, World! ÄÖÜäöüß'.
    DATA(lv_target_codepage) = '88591'. "ISO-8859-1

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_converter->convert_string(

Dies ist essentiell für die Interaktion mit Systemen, die andere Codepages verwenden, und stellt eine moderne, objektorientierte Herangehensweise dar.

Instructions: Erkennen Sie die Codepage eines gegebenen XSTRINGs, der Text in einer unbekannten Codepage enthält. Implementieren Sie eine Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass die Erkennung fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage` und `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_detect DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS detect_codepage_from_xstring
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_detected_codepage) TYPE abap_codepage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_detect IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD detect_codepage_from_xstring.
    TRY.
        rv_detected_codepage = cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage(
          source = iv_input_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
        " Handle error if detection fails, e.g., return a default or raise exception
        rv_detected_codepage = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_detection FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_detection_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_detection.
    DATA(lo_detector) = NEW zcl_codepage_detect( ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Test mit Umlauten: ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_test_string codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_iso_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_test_string codepage = '88591' ).

    DATA(lv_detected_utf8) = lo_detector->detect_codepage_from_xstring( lv_utf8_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detected_utf8 exp = 'UTF-8' msg = 'Should detect UTF-8' ).

    DATA(lv_detected_iso) = lo_detector->detect_codepage_from_xstring( lv_iso_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detected_iso exp = '88591' msg = 'Should detect ISO-8859-1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_detection_fail.
    DATA(lo_detector) = NEW zcl_codepage_detect( ).
    DATA(lv_invalid_xstring) TYPE xstring VALUE '00000000'. "Invalid byte sequence

    DATA(lv_detected_codepage) = lo_detector->detect_codepage_from_xstring( lv_invalid_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_detected_codepage exp = 'UNKNOWN' msg = 'Should return UNKNOWN for invalid xstring' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `detect_codepage` der Klasse `cl_abap_codepage` versucht, die Codepage eines XSTRINGs zu identifizieren. Dies ist nützlich, wenn man Daten von externen Systemen erhält, deren Codepage nicht bekannt ist, um eine korrekte Weiterverarbeitung zu gewährleisten. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hier wichtig, um robuste Anwendungen zu erstellen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, DETECT_CODEPAGE, CODEPAGE, XSTRING, ERROR HANDLING, SABP_CONVERT

Instructions: Ein interner String soll als XSTRING für einen Download vorbereitet werden, der in der Codepage 'UTF-16BE' (UTF-16 Big Endian) vorliegen muss. Fügen Sie auch eine Byte Order Mark (BOM) hinzu.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` mit der Ziel-Codepage und der Option `add_bom = abap_true`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_file_codepage_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS prepare_for_download
      IMPORTING
        iv_content         TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_download_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_codepage_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_for_download.
    rv_download_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source   = iv_content
      codepage = iv_target_codepage
      add_bom  = abap_true " Add Byte Order Mark
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_prepare_utf16be FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_utf16be.
    DATA(lo_preparer) = NEW zcl_file_codepage_prep( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello, World! ÄÖÜ'.
    DATA(lv_target_codepage) = 'UTF-16BE'. "UTF-16 Big Endian

    DATA(lv_download_xstring) = lo_preparer->prepare_for_download(
      iv_content         = lv_original_string
      iv_target_codepage = lv_target_codepage
    ).

    " Expected BOM for UTF-16BE is X'FEFF'
    DATA(lv_expected_bom) TYPE xstring VALUE 'FEFF'.
    DATA(lv_actual_bom) TYPE xstring.
    lv_actual_bom = lv_download_xstring(2). " Take first 2 bytes

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_bom
      exp = lv_expected_bom
      msg = 'XSTRING should start with UTF-16BE BOM'
    ).

    " Convert back to verify content (excluding BOM)
    DATA(lv_converted_back) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source   = lv_download_xstring+2 " Skip BOM
      codepage = lv_target_codepage
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_back
      exp = lv_original_string
      msg = 'Content should be correctly converted and recoverable'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim Export von Textdateien, insbesondere für Windows-Systeme, ist es oft notwendig, eine spezifische Codepage und eine Byte Order Mark (BOM) zu verwenden. `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` bietet hierfür die `add_bom` Option, die eine korrekte Dateikodierung sicherstellt und somit die Kompatibilität mit externen Systemen verbessert.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, CONVERT_TO, CODEPAGE, XSTRING, BOM, FILE DOWNLOAD, SABP_CONVERT

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Strings, die als XSTRINGs in unterschiedlichen Codepages vorliegen könnten, auf Gleichheit ihres Textinhalts. Die Methode soll `abap_true` zurückgeben, wenn die Inhalte gleich sind, ansonsten `abap_false`.
hint: Konvertieren Sie beide XSTRINGs in eine gemeinsame Codepage (z.B. UTF-8) als ABAP-String, bevor Sie sie vergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_xstrings_by_content
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring1  TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage1 TYPE abap_codepage
        iv_xstring2  TYPE xstring
        iv_codepage2 TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_xstrings_by_content.
    DATA(lv_string1_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source   = iv_xstring1
      codepage = iv_codepage1
    ).
    DATA(lv_string2_utf8) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
      source   = iv_xstring2
      codepage = iv_codepage2
    ).

    IF lv_string1_utf8 = lv_string2_utf8.
      rb_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rb_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_equal_strings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unequal_strings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_equal_strings.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_codepage_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Hallo Welt mit ÄÖÜ'.

    " String 1 in UTF-8
    DATA(lv_xstring1) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_content codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_codepage1) = 'UTF-8'.

    " String 2 in ISO-8859-1
    DATA(lv_xstring2) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_content codepage = '88591' ).
    DATA(lv_codepage2) = '88591'.

    DATA(lb_result) = lo_comparer->compare_xstrings_by_content(
      iv_xstring1  = lv_xstring1
      iv_codepage1 = lv_codepage1
      iv_xstring2  = lv_xstring2
      iv_codepage2 = lv_codepage2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lb_result
      msg = 'Strings with different codepages but same content should be equal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unequal_strings.
    DATA(lo_comparer) = NEW zcl_codepage_compare( ).
    DATA(lv_content1) = 'Hallo Welt'.
    DATA(lv_content2) = 'Hello World'.

    DATA(lv_xstring1) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_content1 codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_codepage1) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lv_xstring2) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( source = lv_content2 codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
    DATA(lv_codepage2) = 'UTF-8'.

    DATA(lb_result) = lo_comparer->compare_xstrings_by_content(
      iv_xstring1  = lv_xstring1
      iv_codepage1 = lv_codepage1
      iv_xstring2  = lv_xstring2
      iv_codepage2 = lv_codepage2
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lb_result
      msg = 'Unequal strings should remain unequal after conversion'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um XSTRINGs, die in verschiedenen Codepages kodiert sind, inhaltlich zu vergleichen, müssen sie zuerst in eine gemeinsame Textrepräsentation (ABAP-String, intern UTF-8) konvertiert werden. Die Methode `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from` ist hierfür das geeignete Werkzeug. Dies gewährleistet einen korrekten Vergleich unabhängig von der ursprünglichen Kodierung.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, CONVERT_FROM, CODEPAGE, XSTRING, STRING COMPARISON, SABP_CONVERT

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Byte-Länge eines Strings in einer spezifischen Codepage (z.B. UTF-16BE) und vergleichen Sie diese mit der Zeichenlänge des ursprünglichen Strings. Die Methode soll die Byte-Länge zurückgeben.

solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_length DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_byte_length_in_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_content         TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_byte_length) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_length IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_byte_length_in_codepage.
    DATA(lv_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      source   = iv_content
      codepage = iv_target_codepage
    ).
    rv_byte_length = xstrlen( lv_xstring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_byte_length FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_byte_length.
    DATA(lo_length_calc) = NEW zcl_codepage_length( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Hello ÄÖÜ'. " 10 characters

    " UTF-8: 'Hello ' (6 bytes) + Ä (2 bytes) + Ö (2 bytes) + Ü (2 bytes) = 12 bytes
    DATA(lv_byte_length_utf8) = lo_length_calc->get_byte_length_in_codepage(
      iv_content         = lv_original_string
      iv_target_codepage = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_byte_length_utf8 exp = 12 msg = 'UTF-8 byte length incorrect' ).

    " UTF-16BE: Each character is 2 bytes. 'Hello ÄÖÜ' (10 chars) = 20 bytes
    DATA(lv_byte_length_utf16be) = lo_length_calc->get_byte_length_in_codepage(
      iv_content         = lv_original_string
      iv_target_codepage = 'UTF-16BE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_byte_length_utf16be exp = 20 msg = 'UTF-16BE byte length incorrect' ).

    " ISO-8859-1: 'Hello ' (6 bytes) + Ä (1 byte) + Ö (1 byte) + Ü (1 byte) = 9 bytes
    DATA(lv_byte_length_iso) = lo_length_calc->get_byte_length_in_codepage(
      iv_content         = lv_original_string
      iv_target_codepage = '88591'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_byte_length_iso exp = 9 msg = 'ISO-8859-1 byte length incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Byte-Länge eines Strings hängt stark von der verwendeten Codepage ab, insbesondere bei Zeichen außerhalb des ASCII-Bereichs. Durch die Konvertierung des Strings in ein XSTRING mit der gewünschten Codepage mittels `cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to` und anschließender Verwendung von `XSTRLEN` kann die exakte Byte-Länge ermittelt werden. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Größenberechnung bei der Datenübertragung oder Speicherung.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CODEPAGE, CONVERT_TO, CODEPAGE, XSTRING, XSTRLEN, BYTE LENGTH, SABP_CONVERT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und Verbindungsnummer (CONNID). Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über eine gefilterte interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data retrieval from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_sflight_raw-price.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_calculator->get_total_price(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Total price should match sum of filtered flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_no_data.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Non-existent carrier
    DATA(lv_connid) = '9999'.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_calculator->get_total_price(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total price should be 0 for non-existent flights'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine funktionale und kompakte Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit der `FOR` Schleife und der `WHERE` Bedingung kann man direkt über gefilterte Daten iterieren und eine Summe bilden, ohne explizite Schleifen und Zwischenvariablen. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Art der Datenverarbeitung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, SFLIGHTS, COMPUTE

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Berechnung auf einem Feld einer Struktur durch, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird. Nutzen Sie Field-Symbols und die `COMPUTE` Anweisung. Die Methode soll den aktualisierten Wert des Feldes zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und anschließend `COMPUTE <fs> = <fs> * 2`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_compute DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value1 TYPE i,
             value2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS multiply_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_factor   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_updated_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_compute IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD multiply_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    rs_updated_data = is_data.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE rs_updated_data TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_assign_error.
    ENDIF.

    " COMPUTE is still relevant for dynamic operations with field symbols
    COMPUTE <fs_value> = <fs_value> * iv_factor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_multiply FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_multiply.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_calc) = NEW zcl_dynamic_compute( ).
    DATA(ls_initial_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_compute=>ty_data( value1 = 10 value2 = 20 ).
    DATA(lv_factor) = 2.

    DATA(ls_result_value1) = lo_dynamic_calc->multiply_dynamic_field(
      is_data     = ls_initial_data
      iv_field_name = 'VALUE1'
      iv_factor   = lv_factor
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_value1-value1 exp = 20 msg = 'Value1 should be multiplied' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_value1-value2 exp = 20 msg = 'Value2 should be unchanged' ).

    DATA(ls_result_value2) = lo_dynamic_calc->multiply_dynamic_field(
      is_data     = ls_initial_data
      iv_field_name = 'VALUE2'
      iv_factor   = lv_factor
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_value2-value1 exp = 10 msg = 'Value1 should be unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result_value2-value2 exp = 40 msg = 'Value2 should be multiplied' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_field.
    DATA(lo_dynamic_calc) = NEW zcl_dynamic_compute( ).
    DATA(ls_initial_data) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_compute=>ty_data( value1 = 10 value2 = 20 ).
    DATA(lv_factor) = 2.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( 'CX_SY_ASSIGN_ERROR' ).
    lo_dynamic_calc->multiply_dynamic_field(
      is_data     = ls_initial_data
      iv_field_name = 'INVALID_FIELD'
      iv_factor   = lv_factor
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `COMPUTE` in vielen Fällen durch modernere Ausdrücke ersetzt werden kann, bleibt es in Szenarien der dynamischen Programmierung, insbesondere in Verbindung mit Field-Symbols, relevant. Hier wird gezeigt, wie man zur Laufzeit auf ein Feld einer Struktur zugreift und eine Berechnung durchführt. Die Fehlerbehandlung für den Fall, dass das Feld nicht gefunden wird, ist dabei entscheidend.
keywords: DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, COMPUTE, MATH

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnittspreis aller Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` für eine gegebene Fluggesellschaft (CARRID). Nutzen Sie dabei eine Kombination aus `FOR` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um die Summe zu bilden und zählen Sie die Einträge mit `lines()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    " Simulate data retrieval from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_prices
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_sflights_prices ) = 0.
      rv_average_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                                     FOR flight IN lt_sflights_prices
                                     NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).

    rv_average_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_sflights_prices ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_price FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_price.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_avg( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_count) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_sflight_raw-price.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_expected_avg) TYPE f.
    IF lv_count > 0.
      lv_expected_avg = lv_expected_sum / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      lv_expected_avg = 0.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_actual_avg) = lo_calculator->get_average_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_approx_equals(
      act   = lv_actual_avg
      exp   = lv_expected_avg
      delta = '0.001' " Allow for floating point inaccuracies
      msg   = 'Average price should be correct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_avg( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'ZZ'. " Non-existent carrier

    DATA(lv_actual_avg) = lo_calculator->get_average_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_avg exp = 0 msg = 'Average price should be 0 for no flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung des Durchschnitts kombiniert hier den `REDUCE` Operator zur Summenbildung mit der `lines()` Funktion zur Bestimmung der Anzahl der Elemente. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Aggregationen auf internen Tabellen durchzuführen. Die explizite Prüfung auf eine leere Tabelle verhindert eine Division durch Null und erhöht die Robustheit des Codes.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, LINES, INTERNAL TABLES, AGGREGATION, AVERAGE, SFLIGHTS, COMPUTE

Instructions: Finden Sie den maximalen Flugpreis (PRICE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Nutzen Sie dabei den `MAX` Aggregationsoperator in einem `REDUCE` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `MAX` als Aggregationsfunktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_price.
    DATA lt_sflights_prices TYPE tt_sflight_price.

    " Simulate data retrieval from SFLIGHTS
    SELECT price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_prices
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF lines( lt_sflights_prices ) = 0.
      rv_max_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_price = REDUCE #( INIT max_price TYPE sflight-price VALUE 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights_prices
                             NEXT max_price = nmax( max_price, flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_max_price( ).

    DATA lt_sflights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_raw INTO DATA(ls_sflight_raw).
      IF ls_sflight_raw-price > lv_expected_max.

    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_actual_max) = lo_calculator->get_max_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_max
      exp = lv_expected_max
      msg = 'Max price should be correct'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sflights_max_price( ).

CLASS zcl_filter_every_second_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_rows IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_data.

CLASS zcl_filter_every_second_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_rows.
    LOOP AT it_source INTO DATA(ls_row).
      IF ( sy-tabix MOD 2 ) = 1. " Jede ungerade Zeile (1., 3., 5., ...) wird genommen
        APPEND ls_row TO rt_filtered.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Zeilen einer Quelltabelle enthält, deren Index eine Primzahl ist. Verwenden Sie funktionale Konstrukte mit `LINE_INDEX`.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `LINE_INDEX` und einer Hilfsfunktion zur Primzahlprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_prime_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_prime_index IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered) TYPE tt_data.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS is_prime IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_prime) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_prime_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_prime_index.
    rt_filtered = VALUE #( FOR ls_row IN it_source WHERE ( is_prime( line_index( ) ) = abap_true )
                           ( ls_row ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_prime.
    IF iv_number <= 1. " 0 and 1 are not prime numbers
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number = 2. " 2 is the only even prime number
      rv_is_prime = abap_true.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_number MOD 2 = 0. " Other even numbers are not prime
      rv_is_prime = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lv_limit) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    DO WHILE sy-index <= lv_limit.
      IF iv_number MOD ( sy-index * 2 + 1 ) = 0. " Check odd divisors
        rv_is_prime = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    rv_is_prime = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_prime_indices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_prime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_prime_indices.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_filter_prime_index=>tt_data,
          lt_expected TYPE zcl_filter_prime_index=>tt_data.

    DO 10 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( value = sy-index ) TO lt_source.
    ENDDO.

    APPEND VALUE #( value = 2 ) TO lt_expected. " Index 2
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 3 ) TO lt_expected. " Index 3
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 5 ) TO lt_expected. " Index 5
    APPEND VALUE #( value = 7 ) TO lt_expected. " Index 7

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_prime_index( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_prime_index( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered rows' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected msg = 'Filtered content mismatch' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_prime.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 0 ) msg = '0 is not prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 1 ) msg = '1 is not prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 2 ) msg = '2 is prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 3 ) msg = '3 is prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 4 ) msg = '4 is not prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 5 ) msg = '5 is prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 9 ) msg = '9 is not prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 11 ) msg = '11 is prime' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_filter_prime_index=>is_prime( 13 ) msg = '13 is prime' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne, funktionale Art, interne Tabellen zu verarbeiten, indem `FOR`-Expressions mit `LINE_INDEX` verwendet werden. `LINE_INDEX()` ist die funktionale Entsprechung zu `sy-tabix` in Konstruktorausdrücken und ermöglicht eine prägnante und lesbare Filterung basierend auf dem Zeilenindex, ohne explizite `LOOP`-Schleifen.
keywords: LINE_INDEX, FOR, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Primzahl, Filter

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus der `sflights`-Tabelle basierend auf `carrid` und `connid`. Wenn der Eintrag gefunden wird, geben Sie seinen Index in der internen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` und `sy-tabix`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_table_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_index IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                       iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_index) TYPE sy-tabix.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_table_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_index.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    READ TABLE lt_sflight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid
                                 connid = iv_connid
                                 TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_index = sy-tabix.
    ELSE.
      rv_index = 0. " Not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_index_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_flight_index_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_index_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_table_index( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.

    " Ensure test data exists in sflight
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO @DATA(ls_sflight_check) WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " If test data not found, insert dummy data for the test
      INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = sy-datum price = 100 ) ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise aus der `sflights`-Tabelle, aber nur für jede dritte Zeile, beginnend mit der ersten. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `LINE_INDEX`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_prices DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum_every_third RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflight_prices IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum_every_third.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                WHERE ( ( line_index( ) - 1 ) MOD 3 = 0 )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " A more robust test would insert specific test data into a local table and then calculate expected sum.

CLASS zcl_div_avg_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

  ENDMETHOD.

hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `VALUE` und `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_percentage,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             price      TYPE s_price,
             percentage TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_flight_percentage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_price_percentage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_flight_percentage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_price_percentage.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE decfloat16(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-price
    ).

    IF lv_total_price = 0. " Avoid division by zero if all prices are zero
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
        ( carrid     = flight-carrid
          connid     = flight-connid
          fldate     = flight-fldate
          price      = flight-price
          percentage = ( flight-price / lv_total_price ) * 100 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division basierend auf einem dynamisch übergebenen Ausdruck durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALCULATE` für dynamische arithmetische Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_dynamic_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_expression TYPE string " e.g., '10 / 2'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arith_errors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_dynamic_division.
    DATA: lv_result_str TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALCULATE iv_expression INTO lv_result_str.
        rv_result = lv_result_str.
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_errors INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arith_errors
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_arith_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_division_by_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_invalid_expression FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_division( '10 / 2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_dynamic( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_division( '10 / 0' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arith_errors' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_errors.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_expression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_dynamic( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->calculate_dynamic_division( '10 / A' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected cx_sy_arith_errors' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arith_errors.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CALCULATE` ermöglicht die Auswertung von arithmetischen Ausdrücken zur Laufzeit, was in Szenarien nützlich sein kann, in denen die Berechnung dynamisch definiert werden muss. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei essenziell.
keywords: DIVIDE, CALCULATE, Dynamic Programming, Error Handling, DECFLOAT

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt von Werten in einer internen Tabelle, wobei nur positive Werte berücksichtigt werden sollen.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE` für eine effiziente Berechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_avg_positive DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS calculate_average_of_positives
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_avg_positive IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_of_positives.
    DATA(lt_positive_numbers) = FILTER tt_numbers(
      it_numbers WHERE table_line > 0
    ).

    IF lines( lt_positive_numbers ) = 0.
      rv_average = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR num IN lt_positive_numbers
      NEXT s = s + num
    ).

    rv_average = lv_sum / lines( lt_positive_numbers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_positives.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_avg_positive( ).
    DATA(lt_test_numbers) = VALUE zcl_div_avg_positive=>tt_numbers( ( 10 ) ( -5 ) ( 20 ) ( 0 ) ( 30 ) ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_cut->calculate_average_of_positives( lt_test_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_average exp = 20 ). " (10+20+30)/3 = 20
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_positives.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_div_avg_positive( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den prozentualen Anteil von Flügen pro Fluggesellschaft am Gesamtvolumen aller Flüge, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einer `FOR` Schleife mit `VALUE` und `DIVIDE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_div_grouped_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_percentage,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             percentage TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_percentage.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_percentage TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_percentage WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_carrier_percentages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_percentages) TYPE tt_carrier_percentage.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_div_grouped_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_carrier_percentages.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lines( lt_sflights ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = lines( lt_sflights ).

    rt_percentages = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(carrier_group)
        ( carrid     = carrier_group-carrid
          flight_count = lines( carrier_group )
          percentage = ( CONV decfloat16( lines( carrier_group ) ) / lv_total_flights ) * 100 ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch die Feldnamen und deren Typen einer beliebigen Struktur (z.B. SFLIGHT).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_dref` und die Methode `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_get_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_fields
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_get_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_fields.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        APPEND VALUE ty_field_info(
          name = ls_component-name
          type = ls_component-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( )
        ) TO rt_field_info.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_rtti_read_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF <fs_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        rv_field_value = <fs_field>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie dynamisch zwei Strukturen, um festzustellen, ob sie die gleiche Anzahl und die gleichen Namen von Komponenten haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_structure_layout
      IMPORTING
        ir_data1 TYPE REF TO data
        ir_data2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_same_layout) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_structure_layout.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_struct_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data1> TYPE any,
                   <fs_data2> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data1->* TO <fs_data1>.
    ASSIGN ir_data2->* TO <fs_data2>.

    IF <fs_data1> IS NOT ASSIGNED OR <fs_data2> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr1 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data1> ).
    lo_struct_descr2 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data2> ).

    DATA(lt_components1) = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).
    DATA(lt_components2) = lo_struct_descr2->get_components( ).

    IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
      rb_same_layout = abap_false.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
      READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_comp1-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( ) <> ls_comp2-type_descr_ref->get_relative_name( ).
        rb_same_layout = abap_false.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rb_same_layout = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle mit einer Kopfzeile, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit aus einer anderen Struktur abgeleitet wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` in Kombination mit `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table_with_header
      IMPORTING
        ir_source_structure TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dyn_table_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table_with_header.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_source_structure> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_source_structure->* TO <fs_source_structure>.
    IF <fs_source_structure> IS ASSIGNED.
      lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_source_structure> ).
      lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
        p_line_type = lo_struct_descr
        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_standard
        p_with_header = abap_true
      ).

      CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Inhalt eines bestimmten Feldes aus einer internen Tabelle und konvertieren Sie ihn in einen XSTRING, um ihn als separaten Anhang zu verwenden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie Schleifen über die interne Tabelle mit `cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_extract_field DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_field_to_xstring
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_xstrings) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_extract_field IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_field_to_xstring.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE sflight,
                   <fs_field>   TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_field>.
      IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_xstring(
          i_string = |{ <fs_field> }|
          i_encoding = 'UTF-8'
        ) TO rt_field_xstrings.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch, ob ein Feld in einer Struktur vom Typ STRING ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` und `cl_abap_elemdescr=>type_kind`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_is_field_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_field_string_type
      IMPORTING
        ir_data     TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_string) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_is_field_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_field_string_type.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_elem_descr   TYPE REF TO cl_abap_elemdescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
      lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
        IF ls_component-name = iv_field_name.
          lo_elem_descr ?= ls_component-type_descr_ref.
          IF lo_elem_descr IS BOUND AND lo_elem_descr->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_string.
            rb_is_string = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine interne Tabelle mit Zahlen. Erstelle eine neue Tabelle, die nur die geraden Zahlen enthält.
hint: Nutze den `FOR` Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_int_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS filter_even_numbers IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE ty_int_table RETURNING VALUE(rt_even_numbers) TYPE ty_int_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_even_numbers.
    rt_even_numbers = VALUE ty_int_table( FOR number IN it_numbers WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 ) ( number ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_itab_for_filter=>ty_int_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_even_numbers( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1] exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2] exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Zahlen in einer gegebenen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Elemente zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_int_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS sum_numbers IMPORTING it_numbers TYPE ty_int_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_numbers.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR number IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + number ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce=>ty_int_table( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_sum) = lo_cut->sum_numbers( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sum exp = 15 ).

    DATA(lt_empty_input) = VALUE zcl_math_reduce=>ty_int_table( ).
    DATA(lv_empty_sum) = lo_cut->sum_numbers( lt_empty_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_sum exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einem einzigen Ergebniswert. Er ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu klassischen `LOOP` und `SUM` Anweisungen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Bestimme, ob eine gegebene Zahl positiv oder negativ ist. Gib 'Positiv' oder 'Negativ' zurück. Null soll als 'Neutral' behandelt werden.
hint: Nutze den `COND` Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_number_sign IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_sign) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_number_sign.
    rv_sign = COND string(
      WHEN iv_number > 0 THEN 'Positiv'
      WHEN iv_number < 0 THEN 'Negativ'
      ELSE 'Neutral'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->check_number_sign( -3 ) exp = 'Negativ' ).

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht die Zuweisung eines Wertes basierend auf Bedingungen in einer einzigen Zeile. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `IF...ELSE IF...ENDIF` Blöcken für einfache Fallunterscheidungen.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und ein bestimmtes Datum in eine interne Tabelle. Nutze dabei Inline-Deklaration und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
hint: Verwende `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           ty_flight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_open_sql_inline( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum. " Annahme: Es gibt Flüge für heute

    " Testdaten in SFLIGHT sicherstellen (optional, für echten Test)
    " INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' ).
    " INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'B747' ).
    " INSERT sflight FROM VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = ( sy-datum - 1 ) planetype = 'A321' ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier_date( iv_carrid = lv_carrid iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Ergebnisse zurückgegeben wurden (kann variieren je nach Testsystemdaten)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_flights ). " Erwartet, dass keine Flüge gefunden werden, wenn keine Testdaten eingefügt wurden.
                                       " Oder assert_not_initial( lt_flights ) wenn Testdaten vorhanden sind.
                                       " Für einen robusten Test müsste man Testdaten einfügen und wieder löschen.
    " Beispiel für einen spezifischeren Assert, wenn Testdaten bekannt sind:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Modernes Open SQL erlaubt Inline-Deklarationen für die Zielvariable (`@DATA(...)`) und die Verwendung von Hostvariablen mit `@`. `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` füllt die interne Tabelle automatisch mit passenden Feldern, was den Code kürzer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.
keywords: Open SQL, Inline Declaration, Database Access, SFLIGHT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem Wert ermöglicht (z.B. Addieren, Multiplizieren) durch Methodenverkettung.
hint: Jede Methode, die verkettet werden soll, muss eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chaining.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_value TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_value = iv_initial_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value + iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_current_value = mv_current_value * iv_value.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_current_value.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chaining.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 5 ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add( 3 )->multiply( 2 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 16 ). " (5 + 3) * 2 = 16

    DATA(lo_calculator2) = NEW zcl_method_chaining( 10 ).
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_calculator2->multiply( 3 )->add( 5 )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 35 ). " (10 * 3) + 5 = 35
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und den Fluss des Codes, indem es eine flüssigere, deklarative Syntax schafft. Jede verkettbare Methode muss dabei eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) zurückgeben.
keywords: Method Chaining, Object Orientation, Fluent Interface

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen aktuellen UTC-Zeitstempel und formatieren Sie ihn in ein lesbares Datum und eine Uhrzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_utclong=>create_current` und `cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_current DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_formatted_utc RETURNING VALUE(rv_timestamp_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_current IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_utclong) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_current( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp(
      utclong = lv_utclong
      tzone   = 'UTC' " Oder eine andere Zeitzone, z.B. 'CET'
    ).
    rv_timestamp_str = |{ lv_timestamp DATE = ISO TIME = ISO }|.

unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_current_formatted_utc.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_current_formatted_utc( ).

Die Methode `create_current` erzeugt den aktuellen Zeitstempel, und `utclong_to_timestamp` konvertiert ihn in ein lesbares Format, wobei Zeitzonen berücksichtigt werden können. Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT (lv_field_name) OF STRUCTURE ls_data TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_s_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Field not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_field_value FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_field_value.
    DATA: ls_test_data TYPE zcl_dyn_struct_access=>ty_s_data.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Hello Dynamic'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 123.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_struct_access( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello Dynamic' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD1 value' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '123' msg = 'Should retrieve FIELD2 value' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->get_field_value( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NONEXISTENT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 'Field not found' msg = 'Should handle non-existent field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` Anweisung ermöglicht den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten zur Laufzeit. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Programmen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Field-Symbols (`<fs_field>`) sind dabei der Schlüssel zur Manipulation dieser dynamisch zugewiesenen Daten.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic, Structure, Component

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, deren Index zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und ändern Sie deren Inhalt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (lv_table_name)[lv_index] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_item_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_index      TYPE i
        iv_new_text   TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_items      TYPE ty_t_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_item_dynamically.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE ty_s_item.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ASSIGN <fs_table>[iv_index] TO <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <fs_line>-text = iv_new_text.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_update_item_dynamically FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_item_dynamically.
    DATA: lt_my_items TYPE zcl_dyn_itab_access=>ty_t_items.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_my_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_new_item>).
    <fs_new_item>-id = 1.
    <fs_new_item>-text = 'Original Text 1'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_my_items ASSIGNING <fs_new_item>.
    <fs_new_item>-id = 2.
    <fs_new_item>-text = 'Original Text 2'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_itab_access( ).

    lo_cut->update_item_dynamically(
      iv_table_name = 'LT_MY_ITEMS'
      iv_index      = 2
      iv_new_text   = 'Updated Text'
      CHANGING
        ct_items      = lt_my_items
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_my_items[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Updated Text' msg = 'Second item text should be updated' ).

    lo_cut->update_item_dynamically(
      iv_table_name = 'LT_MY_ITEMS'
      iv_index      = 99 " Non-existent index
      iv_new_text   = 'No Change'
      CHANGING
        ct_items      = lt_my_items
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_my_items[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Updated Text' msg = 'No change expected for invalid index' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Zugriff auf interne Tabellenzeilen mittels `ASSIGN (lv_table_name)[lv_index] TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_line>)` ist eine mächtige Technik. Hierbei wird der Tabellenname als String übergeben und der Zugriff auf die Zeile erfolgt über den Index. Dies ermöglicht es, generische Routinen zu schreiben, die mit verschiedenen Tabellen und Indizes arbeiten können. Field-Symbols erlauben die direkte Modifikation des Tabelleninhalts.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Table, Dynamic, Index

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz zwischen zwei `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempeln in Sekunden.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `cl_abap_utclong=>diff`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_time_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_diff IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_time_difference.
    rv_seconds = cl_abap_utclong=>diff(
      utclong1 = iv_utclong1
      utclong2 = iv_utclong2
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_calculate_time_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_time_difference.
    DATA(lv_utclong_now) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_current( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_later) = cl_abap_utclong=>add(
      utclong = lv_utclong_now
      seconds = 60
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_diff( ).

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_later
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_now
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 60 msg = 'Difference should be 60 seconds' ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_now
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_later
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = -60 msg = 'Difference should be -60 seconds' ).

    lv_diff = lo_cut->calculate_time_difference(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_now
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_now
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_diff exp = 0 msg = 'Difference should be 0 seconds' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die statische Methode `cl_abap_utclong=>diff` bietet eine einfache und präzise Möglichkeit, die Differenz zwischen zwei `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempeln in Sekunden zu berechnen. Dies ist wesentlich zuverlässiger als manuelle Berechnungen mit Datum- und Uhrzeitfeldern, insbesondere im Hinblick auf Schaltsekunden oder Zeitzonenübergänge, da `UTCLONG` eine hohe Präzision bietet.
keywords: UTCLONG, Time Difference, Date/Time, Diff

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und übergeben Sie Parameter.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method1
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
    METHODS test_method2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_exceptions TYPE abap_excpbind_tab.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF io_object
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
          EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_exceptions.

        LOOP AT it_parameters ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_param>).
          IF <fs_param>-name = 'RV_OUTPUT'.
            ASSIGN <fs_param>-value->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              rv_result = <fs_value>.
              EXIT.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method1.
    rv_output = |Hello { iv_input } from Method 1!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_method2.
    rv_output = 'Hello from Method 2!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_dynamic_method_call FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_method_call.
    DATA(lo_target) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_method_call( ).

    " Test method with import parameter
    DATA(lt_params1) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
      ( name = 'IV_INPUT' value = REF #( 'World' ) )
      ( name = 'RV_OUTPUT' value = NEW cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p( p_length = 255 )->get_ddic_object( )->get_data_ref( ) )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD1'
      it_parameters = lt_params1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Hello World from Method 1!' msg = 'Dynamic call to TEST_METHOD1 failed' ).

    " Test method without import parameter
    DATA(lt_params2) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
      ( name = 'RV_OUTPUT' value = NEW cl_abap_typedescr=>get_p( p_length = 255 )->get_ddic_object( )->get_data_ref( ) )
    ).
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'TEST_METHOD2'
      it_parameters = lt_params2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'Hello from Method 2!' msg = 'Dynamic call to TEST_METHOD2 failed' ).

    " Test non-existent method
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      io_object     = lo_target
      iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error' in = lv_result3 msg = 'Should return error for non-existent method' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für hochflexible Anwendungen. Er erlaubt es, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode und deren Parameter zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Die Parameter werden dabei in einer Tabelle vom Typ `abap_parmbind_tab` übergeben, was eine präzise Steuerung der Parameterbindung ermöglicht. Dies ist ideal für Frameworks oder generische Schnittstellen.
keywords: CALL METHOD, Dynamic, Object Orientation, PARAMETER-TABLE, FIELD-SYMBOLS

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_utclong_to_local.
    " Beispiel-UTCLONG: 2023-10-27 10:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_utclong_example) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_timestamp(
      timestamp = '20231027100000'

    " Konvertierung nach EST (UTC-5)

      iv_utclong = lv_utclong_example

        ev_time    = lv_time
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_date exp = '20231027' msg = 'Date for EST should be 20231027' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_time exp = '050000' msg = 'Time for EST should be 050000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem Strukturtyp, der zur Laufzeit als String übergeben wird, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (lv_struct_type)` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_table>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_sflight.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_itab
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type TYPE string
        iv_num_entries TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_data_ref) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA ro_data_ref TYPE TABLE OF (iv_struct_type).
    ASSIGN ro_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DO iv_num_entries TIMES.
        INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          " Dynamische Zuweisung von Werten (Beispiel für SFLIGHT)
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_carrid> = 'LH'. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CONNID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_connid>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_connid> = 100 + sy-index. ENDIF.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_fldate>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0. <fs_fldate> = sy-datum. ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDDO.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_create_and_fill_dynamic_itab FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_fill_dynamic_itab.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_itab_create( ).

    DATA(lo_data_ref) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_dynamic_itab(
      iv_struct_type = 'ZCL_DYN_ITAB_CREATE=>TY_S_SFLIGHT'
      iv_num_entries = 3
    ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data_ref->* TO <fs_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_table> msg = 'Table should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_table> ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table should have 3 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE zcl_dyn_itab_create=>ty_s_sflight.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First entry CARRID incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_line>-connid exp = 101 msg = 'First entry CONNID incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das dynamische Erstellen und Füllen von internen Tabellen ist ein fortgeschrittenes Szenario der dynamischen Programmierung. `CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (lv_struct_type)` ermöglicht die Erstellung einer Tabelle, deren Zeilentyp erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Anschließend wird die Datenreferenz einem Field-Symbol zugewiesen (`ASSIGN dref->* TO <fs_table>`), um die Tabelle zu manipulieren. Das Füllen der Tabelle erfolgt ebenfalls dynamisch über `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die einzelnen Felder der Zeile.
keywords: CREATE DATA, ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic, Internal Table, Data Reference

Instructions: Addieren oder subtrahieren Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Sekunden zu einem `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `cl_abap_utclong=>add` oder `cl_abap_utclong=>subtract`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_arithmetic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_seconds TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_utclong) TYPE utclong.

    METHODS subtract_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_seconds TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_utclong) TYPE utclong.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_arithmetic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_seconds.
    rv_new_utclong = cl_abap_utclong=>add(
      utclong = iv_utclong
      seconds = iv_seconds
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    rv_new_utclong = cl_abap_utclong=>subtract(
      utclong = iv_utclong

    ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_utclong_arithmetic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utclong_arithmetic.
    DATA(lv_base_utclong) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_timestamp(
      timestamp = '20231027100000'
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_arithmetic( ).

    " Add seconds
    DATA(lv_added_utclong) = lo_cut->add_seconds(
      iv_utclong = lv_base_utclong
      iv_seconds = 3600 " 1 hour
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_add) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_timestamp(
