    " Subtract seconds
    DATA(lv_subtracted_utclong) = lo_cut->subtract_seconds(
      iv_utclong = lv_base_utclong
      iv_seconds = 1800 " 30 minutes
    ).
    DATA(lv_expected_subtract) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_timestamp(
      timestamp = '20231027093000'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_subtracted_utclong exp = lv_expected_subtract msg = 'Subtracting 30 minutes failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methoden `cl_abap_utclong=>add` und `cl_abap_utclong=>subtract` bieten eine robuste Möglichkeit zur Zeitarithmetik mit `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempeln. Sie ermöglichen das Hinzufügen oder Abziehen einer bestimmten Anzahl von Sekunden, ohne sich um komplexe Datums- und Uhrzeitberechnungen kümmern zu müssen. Dies ist besonders vorteilhaft, da `UTCLONG` die Präzision und Korrektheit über Zeitzonen und Schaltsekunden hinweg gewährleistet.
keywords: UTCLONG, Time Arithmetic, Date/Time, Add, Subtract

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie eine Datenreferenz auf eine Variable, weisen Sie diese einem Field-Symbol zu und greifen Sie über das Field-Symbol auf den Inhalt zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET REFERENCE OF lv_variable INTO dref` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_dref_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_value_via_dynamic_dref
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_dref_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_via_dynamic_dref.
    DATA: lv_local_variable TYPE string VALUE 'Initial Value'.
    DATA: lr_data_ref     TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    lv_local_variable = iv_input.

    GET REFERENCE OF lv_local_variable INTO lr_data_ref.

    IF lr_data_ref IS BOUND.
      ASSIGN lr_data_ref->* TO <fs_data>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_output = <fs_data>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_get_value_via_dynamic_dref FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_value_via_dynamic_dref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_dref_access( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_value_via_dynamic_dref( 'Hello Dynamic Reference' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello Dynamic Reference' msg = 'Value should be retrieved via dynamic reference' ).

    DATA(lv_empty_result) = lo_cut->get_value_via_dynamic_dref( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_empty_result exp = '' msg = 'Empty string should be handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `GET REFERENCE OF` und `ASSIGN dref->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ist ein grundlegendes Muster der dynamischen Programmierung in ABAP. `GET REFERENCE OF` erzeugt eine Datenreferenz auf eine bestehende Variable, während `ASSIGN dref->*` diese Referenz dereferenziert und den Speicherbereich einem Field-Symbol zuweist. Dies ermöglicht den indirekten Zugriff und die Manipulation von Daten, deren Typ oder Speicherort zur Kompilierzeit nicht feststeht, was für generische Frameworks unerlässlich ist.
keywords: ASSIGN, DATA REFERENCE, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic, Dereference

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.
hint: `UTCLONG`-Werte können direkt mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (<, >, =, <=, >=) verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utclong_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_utclongs
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong1 TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong2 TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_comparison_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utclong_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_utclongs.
    IF iv_utclong1 < iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'UTCLONG1 is earlier than UTCLONG2'.
    ELSEIF iv_utclong1 > iv_utclong2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'UTCLONG1 is later than UTCLONG2'.
    ELSE.
      rv_comparison_result = 'UTCLONG1 is equal to UTCLONG2'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_compare_utclongs FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_utclongs.
    DATA(lv_utclong_t1) = cl_abap_utclong=>create_timestamp(
      timestamp = '20231027100000'
    ).
    DATA(lv_utclong_t2) = cl_abap_utclong=>add(
      utclong = lv_utclong_t1
      seconds = 60
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utclong_compare( ).

    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->compare_utclongs(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_t1
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_t2
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'UTCLONG1 is earlier than UTCLONG2' msg = 'T1 should be earlier than T2' ).

    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->compare_utclongs(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_t2
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_t1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'UTCLONG1 is later than UTCLONG2' msg = 'T2 should be later than T1' ).

    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->compare_utclongs(
      iv_utclong1 = lv_utclong_t1
      iv_utclong2 = lv_utclong_t1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 'UTCLONG1 is equal to UTCLONG2' msg = 'T1 should be equal to T1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Datentyp `UTCLONG` ist ein numerischer Typ, der die Anzahl der Nanosekunden seit dem 1. Januar 0001, 00:00:00 UTC, speichert. Dies ermöglicht einen direkten und präzisen Vergleich von Zeitstempeln mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (<, >, = usw.), ohne dass spezielle Konvertierungs- oder Vergleichsmethoden erforderlich sind. Dies vereinfacht die Logik und erhöht die Lesbarkeit des Codes.
keywords: UTCLONG, Comparison, Date/Time, Operators

Instructions: Iterieren Sie dynamisch über eine interne Tabelle und greifen Sie auf deren Felder zu, um eine bestimmte Bedingung zu prüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE <fs_line>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE string
        iv_key_field  TYPE string
        iv_value_field TYPE string
        iv_threshold  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_key>   TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN (iv_table_name) TO <fs_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_key_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_key>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_value_field OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_value>.

        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_key> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_value> IS ASSIGNED.
          IF <fs_value> > iv_threshold.
            rv_found = abap_true.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    rv_found = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den Statuscode und den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und `send/receive`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1. "Error creating client"
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2. "Error sending request"
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3. "Error receiving response"
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP POST-Request an eine API durch, senden Sie einen JSON-Payload und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `set_header_field`, `set_cdata`, `send/receive` und `cl_abap_conv_json_utils`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_request_data,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_request_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_response_data,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_response_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_data TYPE ty_response_data,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        is_request  TYPE ty_request_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Serialize request data to JSON
    cl_abap_conv_json_utils=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = is_request
      RECEIVING
        json   = lv_json_request
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    IF rs_response-status_code >= 200 AND rs_response-status_code < 300.
      " Deserialize response JSON
      TRY.
          cl_abap_conv_json_utils=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json = lv_json_response
            RECEIVING
              data = rs_response-response_data
          ).
        CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
          rs_response-error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rs_response-error_message = lv_json_response. " Store error body
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und setzen Sie einen benutzerdefinierten Header. Überprüfen Sie, ob der Header korrekt gesendet wurde (simuliert durch eine Echo-API).

CLASS zcl_http_custom_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_with_custom_header
      IMPORTING
        iv_url        TYPE string
        iv_header_name TYPE string
        iv_header_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.

CLASS zcl_http_custom_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_custom_header.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name  = iv_header_name
      value = iv_header_value
    ).

    lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine lokale Schnittstelle und eine lokale Klasse, die diese Schnittstelle implementiert. Verwenden Sie `TYPES` für die Definition von Parametern und Rückgabewerten in den Methoden der Schnittstelle.
hint: Lokale Klassen und Interfaces sind in ABAP 7.40+ gängig.
solution:
CLASS zcl_local_oo_example DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_calculation_input,
             operand1 TYPE i,
             operand2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_calculation_input.
    TYPES: ty_calculation_result TYPE i.

    INTERFACES lif_calculator.
      TYPES: ty_operation TYPE c LENGTH 1.
      METHODS calculate
        IMPORTING
          is_input    TYPE ty_calculation_input
          iv_operation TYPE ty_operation
        RETURNING
          VALUE(rv_result) TYPE ty_calculation_result.
    END INTERFACES.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS LCL_ADDER DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES lif_calculator.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_initial_value TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS LCL_ADDER IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_initial_value = iv_initial_value.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD lif_calculator~calculate.
        CASE iv_operation.
          WHEN '+'.
            rv_result = is_input-operand1 + is_input-operand2 + mv_initial_value.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_result = 0.
        ENDCASE.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    METHODS run
      FOR IMPLEMENTATION if_oo_adt_classrun~run.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_local_oo_example IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~run.
    DATA(ls_input) = VALUE ty_calculation_input( operand1 = 10 operand2 = 5 ).
    DATA(lo_adder) = NEW lcl_adder( 100 ). " Initial value for adder

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_adder->lif_calculator~calculate(
      is_input = ls_input
      iv_operation = '+'
    ).
    " For ADT Classrun, output is typically via out->write
    " out->write( |Result of calculation: { lv_result }| ). " Expected: 10 + 5 + 100 = 115
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-Request an eine ungültige URL durch und fangen Sie die auftretenden Ausnahmen ab. Protokollieren Sie die Fehlermeldung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY ... CATCH cx_static_check ...` und `get_text()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_error_info,
             error_code TYPE i,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_error_info.

    METHODS perform_request_with_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_error) TYPE ty_error_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_request_with_error.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url        = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client     = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS     = 1
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_error-error_code = -1.
          rs_error-error_message = 'Error creating HTTP client (SY-SUBRC <> 0)'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_error-error_code = -2.
          rs_error-error_message = 'Error sending HTTP request (SY-SUBRC <> 0)'.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rs_error-error_code = -3.
          rs_error-error_message = 'Error receiving HTTP response (SY-SUBRC <> 0)'.
          lo_http_client->close( ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        rs_error-error_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
        IF rs_error-error_code >= 400.
          rs_error-error_message = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->close( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_no_authority cx_http_dest_no_service cx_http_dest_no_url INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        rs_error-error_code = -99.
        rs_error-error_message = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rs_error-error_code = -100.
        rs_error-error_message = lx_static_check->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen generischen Tabellentyp und eine Methode, die diesen Typ als Parameter akzeptiert, um eine Filterung mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck zu demonstrieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ... TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ANY TABLE` und `FILTER` mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any table WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_any_table
        iv_filter_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_table) TYPE tt_any_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_table.
    " This example is conceptual. Direct filtering of ANY TABLE with a generic lambda
    " on a specific field name is not directly possible without RTTI or dynamic programming.
    " For a concrete example, we'd need a known structure.
    " Let's assume for demonstration that it_source_table contains structures with a 'NAME' field.
    " In a real scenario, you'd use RTTI to access fields dynamically.

    " For demonstration, we'll simulate with a known structure if it were passed.
    " If the table elements were known to have a 'NAME' field:
    " rt_filtered_table = FILTER #(
    "   it_source_table USING ( name = iv_filter_value )
    " ).

    " To make it truly generic, RTTI would be needed, which is beyond a simple lambda filter.
    " A more practical generic filter would involve a predicate interface.

    " Let's provide a concrete example using a known structure for the filter logic
    " and explain the generic type usage.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_concrete_table) = CAST tt_data( it_source_table ).

    rt_filtered_table = VALUE tt_data(
      FOR wa IN lt_concrete_table WHERE ( wa-name CP iv_filter_value )
      ( wa )
    ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_generic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_generic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_table_filter( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_test_data.
    TYPES: tt_test_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE tt_test_data(
      ( id = 1 name = 'Apple' )
      ( id = 2 name = 'Banana' )
      ( id = 3 name = 'Cherry' )
      ( id = 4 name = 'Date' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_table(
      it_source_table = CAST zcl_generic_table_filter=>tt_any_table( lt_source )
      iv_filter_value = 'B*'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Expected 1 filtered entry'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_filtered_entry).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_filtered_entry-name
      exp = 'Banana'
      msg = 'Expected "Banana" as filtered entry'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TYPES tt_any_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF any table` ermöglicht die Definition von Methoden, die generische interne Tabellen verarbeiten können. Obwohl ein direkter `FILTER` mit einem Lambda-Ausdruck auf generische Feldnamen komplex ist (benötigt RTTI), zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck und einem `WHERE` Bedingung eine Filterung durchführt, sobald die Struktur bekannt ist oder dynamisch ermittelt wird. Dies ist ein Schritt in Richtung flexiblerer Datenverarbeitung in modernem ABAP.
keywords: TYPES, Generic Table, ANY TABLE, FILTER, FOR, Lambda, Internal Table

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request mit Basic Authentication durch. Die Zugangsdaten sollen sicher übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_authorization`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_with_basic_auth
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        iv_username TYPE string
        iv_password TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_basic_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_with_basic_auth.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_authorization(
      EXPORTING
        scheme = 'Basic'
        data   = cl_http_utility=>encode_base64(
                   cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                     text = |{ iv_username }:{ iv_password }|
                     codepage = 'UTF-8'
                   )
                 )
    ).

    lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_basic_auth_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_basic_auth_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_basic_auth( ).
    " Using httpbin.org/basic-auth/user/passwd for testing
    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_with_basic_auth(
      iv_url = 'https://httpbin.org/basic-auth/user/passwd'

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen generischen Referenztyp für eine interne Tabelle und verwenden Sie RTTI, um die Struktur der Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu analysieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ty_ref_to_table TYPE REF TO data` und `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_table_analysis DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_ref_to_table TYPE REF TO data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: tt_field_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_table_structure
      IMPORTING
        ir_table TYPE ty_ref_to_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE tt_field_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_analysis IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_table_structure.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
          APPEND VALUE ty_field_info(
            name = ls_component-name
            type = ls_component-type_descr_ref->get_ddic_type_name( )
            length = ls_component-type_descr_ref->length
          ) TO rt_field_info.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., if ir_table is not a table reference
        MESSAGE lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP PATCH-Request durch, um eine Ressource teilweise zu aktualisieren. Senden Sie einen JSON-Patch-Payload.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch )` und `set_cdata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_patch_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_request,
             title TYPE string,
           END OF ty_patch_request.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_patch_response,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_patch_response.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_data TYPE ty_patch_response,
             error_message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS patch_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        is_request  TYPE ty_patch_request
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_patch_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD patch_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    cl_abap_conv_json_utils=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data   = is_request
      RECEIVING
        json   = lv_json_request
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_patch ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.
      rs_response-error_message = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    IF rs_response-status_code >= 200 AND rs_response-status_code < 300.
      TRY.
          cl_abap_conv_json_utils=>deserialize(
            EXPORTING
              json = lv_json_response
            RECEIVING
              data = rs_response-response_data
          ).
        CATCH cx_sy_json_parser_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
          rs_response-error_message = lx_json_error->get_text( ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      rs_response-error_message = lv_json_response.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Definieren Sie eine Enumeration für den Status eines Auftrags und verwenden Sie diese in einer Methode.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES ENUM BEGIN OF ... END OF ENUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_order_status_enum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ENUM BEGIN OF ty_order_status,
             new,
             in_process,
             completed,
             cancelled,
           ENUM END OF ty_order_status.

    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE ty_order_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

    METHODS is_final_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_status TYPE ty_order_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_final) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_order_status_enum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    CASE iv_status.
      WHEN ty_order_status-new THEN rv_description = 'New Order'.
      WHEN ty_order_status-in_process THEN rv_description = 'Order in Process'.
      WHEN ty_order_status-completed THEN rv_description = 'Order Completed'.
      WHEN ty_order_status-cancelled THEN rv_description = 'Order Cancelled'.
      WHEN OTHERS THEN rv_description = 'Unknown Status'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_final_status.
    rv_is_final = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_status = ty_order_status-completed OR
           iv_status = ty_order_status-cancelled
      THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP POST-Request durch, um eine Binärdatei (z.B. ein Bild) als Multipart-Form-Data hochzuladen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url`, `request->set_form_field_data` und `request->set_form_field_byte_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_upload_file DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS upload_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_url      TYPE string
        iv_file_name TYPE string
        iv_file_content TYPE xstring
        iv_mime_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_upload_file IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_file.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_boundary TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).

    " Generate a unique boundary
    lv_boundary = |----WebKitFormBoundary{ sy-uzeit }{ sy-datum }|.
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name = 'Content-Type'
      value = |multipart/form-data; boundary={ lv_boundary }|
    ).

    " Add other form fields if necessary
    lo_http_client->request->set_form_field_data(
      name  = 'description'
      value = 'Uploaded via ABAP'
      boundary = lv_boundary
    ).

    " Add the file content
    lo_http_client->request->set_form_field_byte_data(
      name       = 'file'
      filename   = iv_file_name
      content_type = iv_mime_type
      value      = iv_file_content
      boundary   = lv_boundary
    ).

    lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request an eine HTTPS-URL durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass die SSL-Verbindung korrekt gehandhabt wird.
hint: HTTPS-URLs werden von `cl_http_client` automatisch mit SSL/TLS behandelt, sofern die Systemkonfiguration korrekt ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_https_get DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_secure_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_https_get IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_secure_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url        = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client     = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS     = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -1.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error creating HTTP client'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " For HTTPS, SSL/TLS is handled automatically by the system's ICM/SSL configuration.
    " No explicit code is usually needed here unless specific SSL client PSEs are required.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -2.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error sending HTTP request'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rs_response-status_code = -3.
      rs_response-response_body = 'Error receiving HTTP response'.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->get_status_code( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_https_get_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_https_get_invalid_ssl FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_https_get_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_https_get( ).
    " Using a reliable public HTTPS API
    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_secure_data( 'https://www.google.com' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'Expected status code 200 for successful HTTPS GET request'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_response-response_body
      msg = 'Expected non-empty response body'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_https_get_invalid_ssl.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_https_get( ).
    " Using a known invalid SSL site (if available, or simulate by blocking certs)
    " Note: This test might fail due to network/system configuration rather than code logic.
    " For demonstration, we'll use a non-existent HTTPS URL to trigger a connection error.
    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_secure_data( 'https://invalid-ssl-site.example.com' ).

Es sind keine speziellen Codeänderungen für HTTPS erforderlich, was die Entwicklung von sicheren Kommunikationslösungen vereinfacht. Die `TYPES`-Definition für die Antwortstruktur sorgt für klare Datenübergabe.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Type Pool mit einer benutzerdefinierten Struktur und einem Tabellentyp. Verwenden Sie diese Typen in einer Klasse.
hint: Definieren Sie einen Type Pool (Transaktion SE11, Type Group) und referenzieren Sie ihn mit `TYPE-POOLS`.
solution:
TYPE-POOLS: zmy_types.

CLASS zcl_type_pool_usage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE zmy_types=>tt_my_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS get_sample_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE zmy_types=>tt_my_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_type_pool_usage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    rv_count = lines( it_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sample_data.
    rt_data = VALUE #(
      ( id = 10 name = 'Item A' )
      ( id = 20 name = 'Item B' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" --- Definition of Type Pool ZMY_TYPES (created in SE11, Type Group) ---
" TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_my_data,
"          id   TYPE i,
"          name TYPE string,
"        END OF ty_my_data.
" TYPES: tt_my_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_my_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
" --------------------------------------------------------------------
unit_test:
TYPE-POOLS: zmy_types.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_sample_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_type_pool_usage( ).
    DATA(lt_sample_data) = lo_cut->get_sample_data( ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_data( lt_sample_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    DATA(lt_data) = lo_cut->get_sample_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_data )

Dies fördert die Konsistenz und reduziert Redundanz. Die Referenzierung der Typen erfolgt über den Type Pool Namen und den Typnamen (`zmy_types=>tt_my_data`).

Instructions: Gegeben ist eine Liste von Geschäftsjahresperioden. Ermitteln Sie für jede Periode den Start- und Endtermin. Nutzen Sie moderne Mapping- und Iterationskonstrukte.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR`-Iterationen mit `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_fiscal_period_dates` und `VALUE`-Ausdrücken.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_map_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_fiscal_input,
             fisc_year       TYPE t009b-bdatj,
             fisc_period     TYPE t009b-poper,
             fisc_year_variant TYPE t009b-periv,
           END OF ty_fiscal_input,
           tt_fiscal_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_fiscal_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_with_dates,
             fisc_year       TYPE t009b-bdatj,
             fisc_period     TYPE t009b-poper,
             fisc_year_variant TYPE t009b-periv,
             start_date      TYPE d,
             end_date        TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period_with_dates,
           tt_period_with_dates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_with_dates WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_periods_to_dates IMPORTING it_fiscal_periods TYPE tt_fiscal_input
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_period_dates) TYPE tt_period_with_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_map_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_periods_to_dates.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).

    rt_period_dates = VALUE #( FOR ls_period_in IN it_fiscal_periods
                                 LET lv_start_date = CONV d( '' )
                                     lv_end_date   = CONV d( '' )
                                 IN
                                 ( TRY.
                                     lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_period_dates( EXPORTING iv_fisc_year       = ls_period_in-fisc_year
                                                                                             iv_fisc_period     = ls_period_in-fisc_period
                                                                                             iv_fisc_year_variant = ls_period_in-fisc_year_variant
                                                                                   IMPORTING ev_start_date      = lv_start_date
                                                                                             ev_end_date        = lv_end_date ).
                                     VALUE ty_period_with_dates(
                                       fisc_year         = ls_period_in-fisc_year
                                       fisc_period     = ls_period_in-fisc_period
                                       fisc_year_variant = ls_period_in-fisc_year_variant
                                       start_date      = lv_start_date
                                       end_date        = lv_end_date
                                     )
                                   CATCH cx_bs_period.
                                     " Log error, skip or return initial entry
                                     VALUE ty_period_with_dates( fisc_year = ls_period_in-fisc_year
                                                               fisc_period = ls_period_in-fisc_period
                                                               fisc_year_variant = ls_period_in-fisc_year_variant )
                                   ENDTRY
                                 )
                             ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_periods_to_dates FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_periods_to_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_map_dates( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_period_map_dates=>tt_fiscal_input(
      ( fisc_year = '2025' fisc_period = '001' fisc_year_variant = 'K4' )
      ( fisc_year = '2025' fisc_period = '002' fisc_year_variant = 'K4' )

CLASS zcl_period_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_date_in_posting_period IMPORTING iv_date          TYPE d
                                                iv_target_period TYPE t009b-poper

CLASS zcl_period_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_date_in_posting_period.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    rv_is_in_period = abap_false.

    TRY.
        DATA(ls_posting_period) = lo_period_toolset->get_posting_period_by_date( EXPORTING iv_date         = iv_date
                                                                                           iv_company_code = iv_company_code ).

        IF ls_posting_period-period = iv_target_period AND
           ls_posting_period-year   = iv_target_year.
          rv_is_in_period = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bs_period INTO DATA(lx_bs_period).
        " Log error for date not falling into any valid posting period
        " MESSAGE lx_bs_period->get_text( ) TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_is_in_period = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Kalenderwoche (Jahr und KW-Nummer) in den entsprechenden Start- und Endtermin. Da `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` hauptsächlich Geschäftsperioden behandelt, finden Sie einen Weg, dies mit SAP Standard-Funktionen zu lösen.
hint: Die Klasse `cl_sh_bc_date` ist hierfür passender. Nutzen Sie deren Funktionalitäten zur Datumsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_week_to_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_week_dates,
             week_year  TYPE gjahr,
             week_number TYPE woche,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_week_dates.

    METHODS get_dates_for_calendar_week IMPORTING iv_year       TYPE gjahr
                                                  iv_calendar_week TYPE woche
                                        RETURNING VALUE(rs_week_dates) TYPE ty_week_dates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_week_to_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dates_for_calendar_week.
    DATA(lo_date_helper) = cl_sh_bc_date=>get_instance( ).
    rs_week_dates-week_year = iv_year.
    rs_week_dates-week_number = iv_calendar_week.

    TRY.
        lo_date_helper->get_first_date_of_week( EXPORTING iv_year       = iv_year
                                                           iv_week       = iv_calendar_week
                                                 IMPORTING ev_first_weekday = rs_week_dates-start_date ).
        lo_date_helper->get_last_date_of_week( EXPORTING iv_year       = iv_year
                                                          iv_week       = iv_calendar_week
                                                IMPORTING ev_last_weekday  = rs_week_dates-end_date ).
      CATCH cx_sh_bc_date INTO DATA(lx_date_error).
        MESSAGE lx_date_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rs_week_dates-start_date.
        CLEAR rs_week_dates-end_date.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interaktive HTML-Seite mit dynamischen Feldern, die über das ABAP-Browser-Control angezeigt wird und bei Interaktion (z.B. Button-Klick) eine Aktion in ABAP auslösen kann.

solution:
CLASS zcl_browser_interactive_html DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. TYPES: ty_parameter TYPE string_table. METHODS display_interactive IMPLEMEMENTING iv_data TYPE string. METHODS handle_browser_event FOR EVENT hot_request OF cl_abap_browser IMPORTING url query_string target. PRIVATE SECTION. DATA mo_browser TYPE REF TO cl_abap_browser. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_browser_interactive_html IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD display_interactive. CREATE OBJECT mo_browser. SET HANDLER me->handle_browser_event FOR mo_browser. DATA(lv_html) = | Interaktiver Browser

Interaktives Beispiel

Eingabe:

|. DATA: lt_html_lines TYPE cl_abap_browser=>html_table. APPEND lv_html TO lt_html_lines. mo_browser->create_url_from_html_table( EXPORTING html_table = lt_html_lines IMPORTING url = DATA(lv_url) EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ). IF sy-subrc = 0. mo_browser->show_url( EXPORTING url = lv_url title = 'Interaktiver ABAP Browser' show_tool_bar = abap_true EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ). ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. METHOD handle_browser_event. DATA: lt_query_params TYPE string_table. SPLIT query_string AT '&' INTO TABLE lt_query_params. DATA: lv_action TYPE string, lv_value TYPE string. LOOP AT lt_query_params INTO DATA(lv_param). IF lv_param CS 'action='. lv_action = lv_param+7. ELSEIF lv_param CS 'value='. lv_value = cl_http_utility=>unescape_url( lv_param+6 ). ENDIF. ENDLOOP. IF lv_action = 'UPDATE'. MESSAGE i000(00) WITH |Aktion '{lv_action}' empfangen! Wert: '{lv_value}'|. " Example: Display message " FURTHER ABAP PROCESSING HERE ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_html_generation.

  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_browser_interactive_html( ).
    lo_cut->display_interactive( iv_data = 'Testwert' ). " Initialize browser object and set handler

    " Simulate a browser event by directly calling the event handler method
    DATA(lv_query_string) = `action=UPDATE&value=` & cl_http_utility=>escape_url( 'Beispielwert mit Leerzeichen' ).
    " Need to catch the MESSAGE as it causes an immediate exit in unit test if not handled.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>set_global_message_handler( lo_message_handler ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_message_handler->has_messages()

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_message_handler->contains_text( 'Aktion ''UPDATE'' empfangen! Wert: ''Beispielwert mit Leerzeichen''' )
                                           msg = 'Message content mismatch' ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage in einer Geschäftsjahresperiode für einen gegebenen Buchungskreis, unter Berücksichtigung von Feiertagen und Wochenenden (erfordert indirekte Nutzung oder Annahmen, da `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` dies nicht direkt bietet).
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` zur Ermittlung des Datumsbereichs mit `cl_fdt_calendar_function` (oder ähnlichem) für die eigentliche Arbeitstagsberechnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_in_period IMPORTING iv_fisc_year       TYPE gjahr
                                              iv_fisc_period     TYPE t009b-poper
                                              iv_fisc_year_variant TYPE t009b-periv
                                              iv_company_code    TYPE bukrs
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_workdays)   TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_in_period.
    DATA(lo_period_toolset) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_instance( ).
    DATA: lv_start_date TYPE d,
          lv_end_date   TYPE d.

    rv_workdays = 0.

    TRY.
        lo_period_toolset->get_fiscal_period_dates( EXPORTING iv_fisc_year       = iv_fisc_year
                                                              iv_fisc_period     = iv_fisc_period
                                                              iv_fisc_year_variant = iv_fisc_year_variant
                                                    IMPORTING ev_start_date      = lv_start_date
                                                              ev_end_date        = lv_end_date ).
        " For actual workday calculation, usually a factory calendar is needed.
        " This example uses a simplified approach for demonstration or assumes a default factory calendar
        " For a real-world scenario, you'd use classes like CL_FDT_CALENDAR_FUNCTION or FM like DATE_CONVERT_TO_FACTORYDATE.
        " Let's simulate by counting weekdays (Mon-Fri).
        DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d.
        lv_current_date = lv_start_date.
        WHILE lv_current_date <= lv_end_date.
          DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_sh_bc_date=>get_instance( )->get_weekday_for_date( iv_date = lv_current_date ).
          IF lv_weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 5. " Monday (1) to Friday (5)
            rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
        ENDWHILE.

      CATCH cx_bs_period INTO DATA(lx_bs_period).
        MESSAGE lx_bs_period->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        CLEAR rv_workdays.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_workdays_in_period FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_workdays_partial_month FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_workdays_in_period.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_workdays( ).

    " Januar 2025: 1. Jan ist Feiertag (Mittwoch), aber in unserer Simulation nur Wochenenden ausgeschl. Montag ist 30.12.2024. Jan startet Mittwoch 01.01.2025
    " 01.01.2025 (W) - 31.01.2025 (F). Mo, Di, Mi, Do, Fr, Sa, So (x4). Plus Mo,Di,Mi,Do,Fr (5). Abzüglich 8 Wochenende-Tage = 23.
    " Our simple weekday counter will count 23 days for Jan 2025 (Wed-Fri, then 4 full weeks Mon-Fri).
    DATA(lv_workdays) = lo_cut->get_workdays_in_period( iv_fisc_year = '2025' iv_fisc_period = '001' iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' iv_company_code = '1000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays exp = 23 ).

    " Februar 2025: 01.02.2025 (Sa) - 28.02.2025 (Fr). 20 Arbeitstage (4x5)
    lv_workdays = lo_cut->get_workdays_in_period( iv_fisc_year = '2025' iv_fisc_period = '002' iv_fisc_year_variant = 'K4' iv_company_code = '1000' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_workdays exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_get_workdays_partial_month.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_workdays( ).
    " A fiscal period might not align with a calendar month. K4 variant in 2025 has period 1 from 01.01 to 31.01.
    " Assume a specific fiscal variant that makes a period partial (not provided in example, so stick to K4)
    " The current test with K4 already covers full calendar months.
    " If K4 had partial months, it would still use the derived start/end dates correctly.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Test for partial months relies on specific fiscal year variants, which is not set up here.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses 'Advanced'-Beispiel zeigt die Kombination verschiedener SAP-Standard-Klassen zur Lösung komplexerer Datumsfragen. Während `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` die Perioden-Grenzen liefert, ist für die Berechnung der Arbeitstage eine separate Logik oder Klasse (wie `cl_sh_bc_date` für Wochentage oder spezialisierte Kalenderfunktionen) erforderlich. Die moderne Schleife (`WHILE`) in Verbindung mit dem `GET_WEEKDAY_FOR_DATE` ist eine effektive Methode zur iterativen Datumsverarbeitung. Im realen System würde die Arbeitstagsberechnung über einen Fabrikkalender erfolgen, aber hier wird ein vereinfachtes Zählen von Wochentagen demonstriert.
keywords: cl_bs_period_toolset_basics, cl_sh_bc_date, Workdays, Fiscal Period, Date Calculation, WHILE

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sample_log.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_browser_log_display( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_cut->get_sample_log( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_log msg = 'Sample log should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( CONV i( lines( lt_log ) ) exp = 4 msg = 'Incorrect number of log lines' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD test_display_log_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_browser_log_display( ).
    DATA(lt_log_content) = lo_cut->get_sample_log( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_log( iv_title = 'Anwendungsprotokoll' iv_log_content = lt_log_content ).

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den MIME-Typ einer Datei basierend auf ihrer Dateierweiterung und vergleichen Sie ihn mit einem bekannten MIME-Typ-Konstanten.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Funktionsbaustein `SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET` und Konstanten aus `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_mime_type_and_compare
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_pdf) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mime_type_and_compare.
    DATA: lv_extension TYPE string,
          lv_mime_type TYPE string.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\.([^\.]+)$' IN iv_filename IGNORING CASE MATCH SUBMATCHES lv_extension.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET'
        EXPORTING
          extension = lv_extension
        IMPORTING
          mimetype  = lv_mime_type
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.

      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        rv_is_pdf = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_application_pdf THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_batch_image_resizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_batch_image_resizer IMPLEMENTATION.

                                 IN ( lo_processor->add_image( ls_image );
                                      lo_processor->resize( iv_width = iv_new_width iv_height = iv_new_height );
                                      lo_processor->get_image( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Bildkomprimierung, indem Sie ein Bild laden, seine Größe reduzieren und dann die resultierende XSTRING-Größe überprüfen. (Hinweis: `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR` bietet keine direkte Komprimierungsfunktion, aber Größenänderung reduziert oft die Dateigröße).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR=>RESIZE` und vergleichen Sie die Längen der XSTRINGs.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_image_by_resizing
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_image TYPE xstring
        iv_scale_factor   TYPE f
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_image) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_fxs_image_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_compressor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_image_by_resizing.
    DATA(lo_image_processor) = NEW cl_fxs_image_processor( ).

    lo_image_processor->add_image( iv_image_data = iv_original_image ).
    lo_image_processor->get_info(
      IMPORTING
        ev_width  = DATA(lv_original_width)
        ev_height = DATA(lv_original_height)
    ).

    DATA(lv_new_width) = CONV i( lv_original_width * iv_scale_factor ).
    DATA(lv_new_height) = CONV i( lv_original_height * iv_scale_factor ).

    lo_image_processor->resize( iv_width = lv_new_width iv_height = lv_new_height ).
    rv_compressed_image = lo_image_processor->get_image( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_compression_by_resize FOR TESTING RAISING cx_fxs_image_processor.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compression_by_resize.
    DATA: lv_dummy_image TYPE xstring VALUE '47494638396101000100800000FFFFFF00000021F90401000000002C00000000010001000002024401003B'. "1x1 GIF
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_image_compressor( ).

    DATA(lv_original_size) = xstrlen( lv_dummy_image ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_image) = lo_compressor->compress_image_by_resizing( iv_original_image = lv_dummy_image iv_scale_factor = 0.5 ).
    DATA(lv_compressed_size) = xstrlen( lv_compressed_image ).

    " For a 1x1 GIF, resizing to 0.5x might still result in a 1x1 image or similar small size.
    " The key is that the operation completes and the output is not initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_compressed_image msg = 'Compressed image should not be initial' err_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_err_level_warning ).
    " A more realistic test would involve a larger image and asserting lv_compressed_size < lv_original_size.
    " For this dummy, we can only assert it's not initial.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen ist moderne ABAP-Syntax.

CLASS zcl_file_mime_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_image_files.
    CONSTANTS: lc_allowed_image_mimes TYPE string_table VALUE
      ##NO_TEXT
      ( (
        cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_jpeg,
        cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_gif,
        cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_png,
        cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_image_bmp
      ) ).

    rt_image_filenames = FILTER string_table FROM it_filenames
                         USING KEY default
                         WHERE ( LET lv_extension = COND string( WHEN find( val = table_line regex = '\.([^\.]+)$' ) THEN substring( val = table_line off = match_offset( 1 ) len = match_length( 1 ) ) ELSE '' ) IN
                                 LET lv_mime_type = COND string( WHEN lv_extension IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                                                  BLOCK OF FUNCTION 'SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET'
                                                                    EXPORTING extension = lv_extension
                                                                    IMPORTING mimetype  = DATA(lv_found_mime)
                                                                    EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1
                                                                  END_BLOCK OF FUNCTION
                                                                  THEN lv_found_mime ELSE '' ) IN
                                 line_exists( lc_allowed_image_mimes[ table_line = lv_mime_type ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String-Template, der einen Dateinamen und seinen ermittelten MIME-Typ in einem lesbaren Format kombiniert. Verwenden Sie `SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET` und `CL_FXS_MIME_TYPES` Konstanten für den Fallback.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates und den Funktionsbaustein `SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mime_type_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_file_with_mime_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mime_type_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_file_with_mime_type.
    DATA: lv_extension TYPE string,
          lv_mime_type TYPE string.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF REGEX '\.([^\.]+)$' IN iv_filename IGNORING CASE MATCH SUBMATCHES lv_extension.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CALL FUNCTION 'SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET'
        EXPORTING
          extension = lv_extension
        IMPORTING
          mimetype  = lv_mime_type
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS    = 1.
    ENDIF.

    IF lv_mime_type IS INITIAL.
      lv_mime_type = cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_binary.
    ENDIF.

    rv_formatted_string = |Datei: { iv_filename }, MIME-Typ: { lv_mime_type }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Dateinamen akzeptiert und eine interne Tabelle zurückgibt, die für jeden Dateinamen den Dateinamen, die Erweiterung und den ermittelten MIME-Typ enthält. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Transformation.

solution:
CLASS zcl_file_mime_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_file_analysis,
             filename  TYPE string,
             extension TYPE string,
             mime_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_file_analysis,
           tt_file_analysis TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_file_analysis WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS analyze_files_mime_types
      IMPORTING
        it_filenames TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_analysis) TYPE tt_file_analysis.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_mime_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_files_mime_types.
    rt_analysis = REDUCE tt_file_analysis( INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_file_analysis( )
                                          FOR lv_filename IN it_filenames
                                          LET lv_extension = COND string( WHEN find( val = lv_filename regex = '\.([^\.]+)$' ) THEN substring( val = lv_filename off = match_offset( 1 ) len = match_length( 1 ) ) ELSE '' ) IN
                                          LET lv_mime_type = COND string( WHEN lv_extension IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                                                           BLOCK OF FUNCTION 'SDOK_MIMETYPE_GET'
                                                                             EXPORTING extension = lv_extension
                                                                             IMPORTING mimetype  = DATA(lv_found_mime)
                                                                             EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1
                                                                           END_BLOCK OF FUNCTION
                                                                           THEN lv_found_mime ELSE cl_fxs_mime_types=>co_binary ) IN
                                          NEXT lt_result = VALUE #( BASE lt_result ( filename = lv_filename
                                                                                     extension = lv_extension
                                                                                     mime_type = lv_mime_type ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein Bild lädt, es auf eine maximale Kantenlänge skaliert (wobei das Seitenverhältnis beibehalten wird) und das resultierende Bild zurückgibt.
hint: Berechnen Sie die neuen Dimensionen unter Beibehaltung des Seitenverhältnisses und verwenden Sie `CL_FXS_IMAGE_PROCESSOR=>RESIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_scaler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS scale_image_to_max_edge
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_image TYPE xstring
        iv_max_edge_length TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_scaled_image) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_fxs_image_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_scaler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD scale_image_to_max_edge.
    DATA(lo_image_processor) = NEW cl_fxs_image_processor( ).

    lo_image_processor->add_image( iv_image_data = iv_original_image ).
    lo_image_processor->get_info(
      IMPORTING
        ev_width  = DATA(lv_original_width)
        ev_height = DATA(lv_original_height)
    ).

    DATA: lv_scale_factor TYPE f.
    IF lv_original_width > lv_original_height.
      lv_scale_factor = CONV f( iv_max_edge_length ) / lv_original_width.
    ELSE.
      lv_scale_factor = CONV f( iv_max_edge_length ) / lv_original_height.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_new_width) = CONV i( lv_original_width * lv_scale_factor ).
    DATA(lv_new_height) = CONV i( lv_original_height * lv_scale_factor ).

    lo_image_processor->resize( iv_width = lv_new_width iv_height = lv_new_height ).
    rv_scaled_image = lo_image_processor->get_image( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_access_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,

           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS access_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE ty_data

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_processed_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_call_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    mv_processed_value = iv_value && ' processed'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_local_value> TYPE string.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_local_value>. " Assign local variable to field symbol

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_VALUE'.
    GET REFERENCE OF <fs_local_value> INTO ls_parameter-value. " Pass reference of field symbol
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD me->process_value
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

    UNASSIGN <fs_local_value>. " Explicitly unassign after use
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle. Wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol auf eine Komponente der aktuellen Zeile zu, verarbeiten Sie es und entzugewiesen Sie es sofort wieder, um sicherzustellen, dass es nicht unbeabsichtigt auf eine andere Zeile zeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `UNASSIGN` für Komponenten-Feldsymbole.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items_with_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE tt_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_ids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_in_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items_with_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_item> TYPE ty_item.

    LOOP AT it_items ASSIGNING <fs_item>.
      IF <fs_item>-id MOD 2 = 0. " Process only even IDs
        APPEND <fs_item>-id TO rt_processed_ids.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE string.
        ASSIGN <fs_item>-value TO <fs_value>.
        " Use <fs_value> here, e.g., for logging or further processing
        " LOG-POINT ID Z_UNASSIGN_DEMO FIELDS <fs_value>.
        UNASSIGN <fs_value>. " Explicitly unassign the component field symbol
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unassign_in_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_unassign_in_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_in_loop( ).
    DATA lt_test_items TYPE zcl_unassign_in_loop=>tt_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 value = 'One' ) TO lt_test_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 value = 'Two' ) TO lt_test_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 value = 'Three' ) TO lt_test_items.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 4 value = 'Four' ) TO lt_test_items.

    DATA(lt_processed_ids) = lo_cut->process_items_with_unassign( lt_test_items ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed_ids ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_processed_ids[ table_line = 2 ] )
      msg = 'ID 2 sollte verarbeitet worden sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      cond = line_exists( lt_processed_ids[ table_line = 4 ] )
      msg = 'ID 4 sollte verarbeitet worden sein.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      cond = line_exists( lt_processed_ids[ table_line = 1 ] )
      msg = 'ID 1 sollte nicht verarbeitet worden sein.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` das Feldsymbol für die Zeile am Ende jeder Iteration automatisch entzugewiesen, ist das explizite `UNASSIGN` für *zusätzlich* innerhalb der Schleife zugewiesene Feldsymbole (z.B. auf Komponenten) wichtig. Es stellt sicher, dass diese temporären Zuweisungen sofort aufgehoben werden, was die Speichernutzung optimiert und potenzielle Fehler durch veraltete Referenzen verhindert.
keywords: UNASSIGN, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, LOOP AT ASSIGNING

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_create_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_unassign_dynamic_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_value     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_create_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_unassign_dynamic_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.

    TRY.
        CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE (iv_type_name).
        ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.

        IF <fs_data> IS ASSIGNED.
          <fs_data> = iv_value. " Assign value to the dynamically created data object
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.

    UNASSIGN <fs_data>. " Explicitly unassign the field symbol after use
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine interne Tabelle beliebigen Typs empfängt. Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle und weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol auf jede Zeile zu. Wenn die Zeile eine Komponente 'STATUS' enthält, ändern Sie deren Wert. Stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol für die Komponente nach der Verwendung entzugewiesen wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(...)` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ...` sowie `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gen_table_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_status_if_exists
      IMPORTING
        CHANGING ct_generic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gen_table_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_status_if_exists.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table_row> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_status>    TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_generic_table ASSIGNING <fs_table_row>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'STATUS' OF STRUCTURE <fs_table_row> TO <fs_status>.

      IF <fs_status> IS ASSIGNED.
        IF cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_status> )->type_kind = cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
          <fs_status> = 'PROCESSED'.
        ENDIF.
        UNASSIGN <fs_status>. " Unassign component field symbol after use
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige Struktur empfängt und eine Kopie davon erstellt. Verwenden Sie Feldsymbole für den Zugriff auf die Quell- und Zielstruktur. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Feldsymbole nach der Kopieroperation entzugewiesen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA ... LIKE STRUCTURE ...`, `ASSIGN` und `UNASSIGN`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gen_struct_copy_unassign DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS copy_generic_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source_structure TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_copied_structure) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gen_struct_copy_unassign IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_generic_structure.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_source> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target> TYPE any.
    DATA lr_target TYPE REF TO data.

    ASSIGN is_source_structure TO <fs_source>.

    IF <fs_source> IS ASSIGNED.
      CREATE DATA lr_target LIKE <fs_source>.
      rr_copied_structure = lr_target.

      ASSIGN lr_target->* TO <fs_target>.

      IF <fs_target> IS ASSIGNED.
        <fs_target> = <fs_source>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_source>.
    UNASSIGN <fs_target>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gen_struct_copy_unassign( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA ls_source TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ls_source-field1 = 'Original String'.
    ls_source-field2 = 12345.

    DATA(lr_copied_ref) = lo_cut->copy_generic_structure( ls_source ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_copied> TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ASSIGN lr_copied_ref->* TO <fs_copied>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_copied> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_copied>-field1 exp = 'Original String' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_copied>-field2 exp = 12345 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_differs( act = REF #( ls_source ) exp = lr_copied_ref ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_generic_structure_copy_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gen_struct_copy_unassign( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_empty_struct,
             field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_empty_struct.
    DATA ls_empty TYPE ty_empty_struct.

    DATA(lr_copied_ref) = lo_cut->copy_generic_structure( ls_empty ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_copied> TYPE ty_empty_struct.
    ASSIGN lr_copied_ref->* TO <fs_copied>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_assigned( <fs_copied> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( <fs_copied>-field ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die generische Kopie von Strukturen unter Verwendung von `CREATE DATA LIKE` und Feldsymbolen ist ein fortgeschrittenes Muster. Die Feldsymbole `<fs_source>` und `<fs_target>` ermöglichen den typunabhängigen Zugriff auf die Daten. Das explizite `UNASSIGN` dieser Feldsymbole nach der Kopieroperation ist eine gute Praxis, um sicherzustellen, dass keine veralteten Referenzen bestehen bleiben und die Ressourcen sauber verwaltet werden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, CREATE DATA, Generic Programming, Field Symbols, Structures, Data References

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Wörter, die mit einem Großbuchstaben beginnen, in einem gegebenen Satz.

solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS find_capitalized_words
      IMPORTING
        iv_sentence TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_capitalized_words.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = '\b[A-Z]\w*\b' ). " Word boundary, capital letter, then word characters
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_sentence ).

    lo_matcher->find_all( ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->get_matches( ).

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND ls_match-submatch_str TO rt_words.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE string_table( ( `This` ) ( `Test` ) ( `Sentence` ) ( `Multiple` ) ( `Words` ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_fixed_values DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             low  TYPE ddtext,

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` auf, um die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und der jeweiligen Fluganzahl sein, geeignet für die Darstellung in einem Balkendiagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` um die Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_bar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_chart_data,
           tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_bar_chart_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_bar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_bar_chart_data.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(ls_chart_entry) = VALUE ty_chart_data( carrid = ls_flight-carrid flight_count = GROUP SIZE ).
      APPEND ls_chart_entry TO rt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' connid = '0001' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_bar( ).
    DATA(lt_chart) = lo_cut->prepare_bar_chart_data( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart[ carrid = 'AA' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart[ carrid = 'LH' ]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
