explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu aggregieren. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe, was ideal für Zählungen ist. Die resultierende Tabelle kann direkt als Datenquelle für ein Balkendiagramm verwendet werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, Charting, cl_gui_chart_engine

Instructions: Bereiten Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` auf, um den Gesamtumsatz (`price * seatsocc`) pro Fluggesellschaft zu ermitteln. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `REDUCE`-Operator. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und dem Gesamtumsatz sein, geeignet für ein Kreisdiagramm mit `cl_gui_chart_engine`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` in Kombination mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_pie DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_revenue TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_chart_data,
           tt_chart_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_pie_chart_data
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_chart_data) TYPE tt_chart_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_pie IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_pie_chart_data.
    rt_chart_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                              ( carrid = GROUP KEY
                                total_revenue = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( 0 ) FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( sum = sum + ( <fs_flight>-price * <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_pie_chart_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_pie_chart_data.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_chart_data_pie=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_chart_data_pie=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' seatsocc = 10 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '200.00' seatsocc = 5  ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '150.00' seatsocc = 20 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_pie( ).
    DATA(lt_chart) = lo_cut->prepare_pie_chart_data( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_chart ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart[ carrid = 'AA' ]-total_revenue exp = '4000.00' ). " (100*10) + (150*20) = 1000 + 3000 = 4000
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_chart[ carrid = 'LH' ]-total_revenue exp = '1000.00' ). " (200*5) = 1000
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Code demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE`. `FOR GROUPS OF` gruppiert die Daten nach `carrid`, und `REDUCE` aggregiert den Gesamtumsatz innerhalb jeder Gruppe. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, komplexe Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, Charting, cl_gui_chart_engine, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Preis pro Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights`. Die Ausgabe soll eine interne Tabelle mit Fluggesellschaft und dem Durchschnittspreis sein, geeignet für ein Balkendiagramm oder eine Tabelle mit `cl_gui_chart_engine`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chart_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_chart_avg_price,
           tt_chart_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chart_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_price_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_chart_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_price_by_carrier.
    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                               ( carrid = GROUP KEY,
                                 avg_price = REDUCE p( INIT sum = ( 0 ) count = 0
                                                       FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP
                                                       NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price
                                                            count = count + 1
                                                       FINAL = COND p( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Datenaufbereitung für ein Chart, das die Top N Fluggesellschaften nach Gesamtumsatz anzeigt. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `SORT` und `FOR` um die Top 3 Fluggesellschaften zu ermitteln.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation, `SORT` für die Rangfolge und `FOR` für die Begrenzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_topn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_top_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_revenue TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_top_carrier,
           tt_top_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_top_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_top_n   TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_carriers) TYPE tt_top_carriers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_topn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_carriers.
    DATA(lt_all_revenues) = VALUE tt_top_carrier( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN it_flights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
                                                  ( carrid = GROUP KEY,
                                                    total_revenue = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( 0 ) FOR <fs_flight> IN GROUP ( sum = sum + ( <fs_flight>-price * <fs_flight>-seatsocc ) ) ) ) ).

    SORT lt_all_revenues BY total_revenue DESCENDING.

    rt_top_carriers = VALUE #( FOR ls_revenue IN lt_all_revenues INDEX FROM 1 TO iv_top_n ( ls_revenue ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_top_n_carriers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_top_n_less_than_available FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_top_n_carriers.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_chart_data_topn=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_chart_data_topn=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' seatsocc = 10 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '200.00' seatsocc = 5  ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' price = '300.00' seatsocc = 2  ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'SQ' price = '50.00'  seatsocc = 10 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '150.00' seatsocc = 20 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_topn( ).
    DATA(lt_top) = lo_cut->get_top_n_carriers( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ). " Revenue: 100*10 + 150*20 = 1000 + 3000 = 4000
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Revenue: 200*5 = 1000
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'SQ' ). " Revenue: 50*10 = 500
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_top_n_less_than_available.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_chart_data_topn=>tt_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_chart_data_topn=>ty_sflight.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' price = '100.00' seatsocc = 10 ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' price = '200.00' seatsocc = 5  ). APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_topn( ).
    DATA(lt_top) = lo_cut->get_top_n_carriers( it_flights = lt_flights iv_top_n = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine mehrstufige Datenaufbereitung: Zuerst werden die Daten mit `FOR GROUPS OF` und `REDUCE` aggregiert, dann mit `SORT` nach dem aggregierten Wert sortiert und schließlich mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, der `INDEX FROM 1 TO iv_top_n` verwendet, auf die Top N Einträge begrenzt. Dies ist ein komplexes, aber sehr effizientes Muster für die Erstellung von Ranglisten für Diagramme.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR GROUPS OF, SORT, FOR, Internal Tables, Data Aggregation, Charting, cl_gui_chart_engine, Functional Programming, Top N

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Validierungsmethode für eine Liste von Bestellmengen. Wenn die Anzahl der Fehlermeldungen (Mengen <= 0) einen Schwellenwert von 3 überschreitet, soll die Verarbeitung abgebrochen und ein spezieller Fehlercode zurückgegeben werden. Ansonsten wird die Anzahl der gültigen Positionen zurückgegeben.
hint: Sammeln Sie Nachrichten im Nachrichtensammler. Prüfen Sie die Anzahl der Fehlermeldungen mit `get_number_of_messages_by_type()` und verwenden Sie eine `IF`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_conditional_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_orders
      IMPORTING
        it_quantities TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_error_threshold TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_code) TYPE i. " 0 = OK, -1 = Too many errors
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_conditional_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_orders.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_quantities INTO DATA(lv_quantity).
      IF lv_quantity <= 0.
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
          iv_msgno = '003'
          iv_msgv1 = |Menge { lv_quantity } ist ungültig|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lo_message_list->get_number_of_messages_by_type( iv_msgty = 'E' ) > iv_error_threshold.
      rv_result_code = -1.
    ELSE.
      rv_result_code = COUNT( it_quantities ) - lo_message_list->get_number_of_messages_by_type( iv_msgty = 'E' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Objekten (simuliert durch Strings). Jedes Objekt kann mehrere Nachrichten generieren. Zählen Sie die Anzahl der *eindeutigen* Nachrichtentypen (z.B. 'E', 'W', 'I'), die insgesamt gesammelt wurden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_message_list`. Holen Sie sich alle Nachrichten und verwenden Sie dann einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` oder `REDUCE` um die eindeutigen Nachrichtentypen zu ermitteln und zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_count_unique_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_and_count_unique
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_types_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_count_unique_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_count_unique.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(lv_item).
      IF lv_item = 'Error'.
        lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '004' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler' ).
      ELSEIF lv_item = 'Warning'.
        lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '005' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung' ).
      ELSEIF lv_item = 'Info'.
        lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '006' iv_msgv1 = 'Info' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rv_unique_types_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR GROUPS msg_group OF ls_message IN lt_all_messages GROUP BY ( msgty = ls_message-msgty )
      NEXT count = count + 1
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Error' ) ( 'Warning' ) ( 'Error' ) ( 'Info' ) ( 'Warning' ) ).

    DATA(lv_unique_count) = lo_cut->process_and_count_unique( lt_test_data ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugbuchungen (z.B. `sflights`). Für jede Buchung, bei der die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (SEATS_OCC) die maximale Kapazität (MAX_SEATS) überschreitet, fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung hinzu. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um die Anzahl der gültigen Buchungen zu zählen (d.h. Buchungen ohne Fehlermeldung).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_message_list` und `add_message()`. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Bedingung, um gültige Einträge zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_booking,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seats_occ TYPE sflight-seats_occ,
             max_seats TYPE sflight-max_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight_booking.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_valid_bookings
      IMPORTING
        it_bookings TYPE tt_sflight_booking
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_valid_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_valid_bookings.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    rv_valid_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT count = 0
      FOR ls_booking IN it_bookings
      LET lv_has_error = abap_false IN
        IF ls_booking-seats_occ > ls_booking-max_seats.
          lo_message_list->add_message(
            iv_msgty = 'E'
            iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
            iv_msgno = '007'
            iv_msgv1 = |Überbuchung für Flug { ls_booking-carrid } { ls_booking-connid }|
            iv_object_id = |{ ls_booking-carrid }-{ ls_booking-connid }-{ ls_booking-fldate }|
          ).
          lv_has_error = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
        IF lv_has_error = abap_false.
          NEXT count = count + 1.
        ENDIF.
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum seats_occ = 100 max_seats = 50 ) " Error
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seats_occ = 150 max_seats = 200 ) " Valid
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0246' fldate = sy-datum seats_occ = 80 max_seats = 80 ) " Valid

  ENDMETHOD.

Innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks werden Nachrichten hinzugefügt und gleichzeitig eine Zählung basierend auf der Validierung durchgeführt. Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Operation, die eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und fügen Sie eine Fehlermeldung zum Nachrichtensammler hinzu. Zählen Sie, ob nach der Operation Fehlermeldungen vorhanden sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke. Im `CATCH`-Block `add_message()` aufrufen. Prüfen Sie mit `has_errors()` oder `get_number_of_messages_by_type()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_try_catch_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_raise_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_has_errors) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _risky_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_raise_error TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_try_catch_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    TRY.
        _risky_method( iv_raise_error ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_error).
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
          iv_msgno = '012'
          iv_msgv1 = lx_error->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    rv_has_errors = lo_message_list->has_errors( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _risky_method.
    IF iv_raise_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING textid = cx_static_check=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Nachrichten (die zuvor gesammelt wurden) nach einem bestimmten Nachrichtentyp und zählen Sie die Anzahl der gefilterten Nachrichten. Verwenden Sie hierfür den `FILTER`-Operator.

CLASS zcl_msg_filter_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

      RETURNING

CLASS zcl_msg_filter_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_and_count_messages.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    " Beispielnachrichten hinzufügen
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '017' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler 1' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '018' iv_msgv1 = 'Warnung 1' ).
    lo_message_list->add_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP' iv_msgno = '019' iv_msgv1 = 'Fehler 2' ).

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_messages) = FILTER #( lt_all_messages USING KEY primary_key WHERE msgty = iv_filter_msgty ).

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Daten, die jeweils eine Kategorie und einen Wert enthalten. Fügen Sie Nachrichten basierend auf dem Wert hinzu. Zählen Sie die Anzahl der Fehlermeldungen pro Kategorie unter Verwendung von `FOR GROUPS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_reca_message_list` und `add_message()`. Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` mit `GROUP BY` auf der Nachrichtenliste, um pro Kategorie zu zählen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_msg_group_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data_item,
             category TYPE string,
             value    TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data_item.
    TYPES: tt_data_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data_item WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_category_error_count,
             category TYPE string,
             error_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_category_error_count.
    TYPES: tt_category_error_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_category_error_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_errors_by_category
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_counts) TYPE tt_category_error_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_msg_group_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_errors_by_category.
    DATA(lo_message_list) = cl_reca_message_list_factory=>get_message_list( ).

    LOOP AT it_data INTO DATA(ls_item).
      IF ls_item-value < 0.
        lo_message_list->add_message(
          iv_msgty = 'E'
          iv_msgid = 'ZMSG_APP'
          iv_msgno = '022'
          iv_msgv1 = |Ungültiger Wert für Kategorie { ls_item-category }|
          iv_object_id = ls_item-category
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_all_messages) = lo_message_list->get_messages( ).

    rt_error_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS msg_group OF ls_message IN lt_all_messages
                                GROUP BY ( category = ls_message-object_id )
                                WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
                                ( category = msg_group-category
                                  error_count = COUNT( msg_group ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_grouped_error_count FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouped_error_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_msg_group_count( ).
    DATA(lt_test_data) = VALUE zcl_msg_group_count=>tt_data_items(
      ( category = 'A' value = 10 )
      ( category = 'B' value = -5 ) " Error
      ( category = 'A' value = -2 ) " Error
      ( category = 'C' value = 20 )
      ( category = 'B' value = -1 ) " Error
      ( category = 'A' value = -3 ) " Error
    ).

    DATA(lt_error_counts) = lo_cut->count_errors_by_category( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_error_counts ) exp = 2 msg = 'Es sollten 2 Kategorien mit Fehlern sein' ).
    DATA(ls_count_a) = lt_error_counts[ category = 'A' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_a-error_count exp = 2 msg = 'Kategorie A sollte 2 Fehler haben' ).
    DATA(ls_count_b) = lt_error_counts[ category = 'B' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_count_b-error_count exp = 2 msg = 'Kategorie B sollte 2 Fehler haben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Gruppierung und Zählung von Nachrichten mit `FOR GROUPS` und `GROUP BY`. Es ermöglicht die Aggregation von Fehlermeldungen pro Kategorie (hier als `object_id` verwendet), was für detaillierte Fehleranalysen unerlässlich ist. Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API durch und geben Sie den Statuscode und den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und `send/receive`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             body        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_data_from_url
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_from_url.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        rs_response-body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rs_response-status_code = 500.
        rs_response-body = 'Error during HTTP request or client creation'.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen HTTP POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an eine öffentliche Test-API und verarbeiten Sie die JSON-Antwort.
hint: Verwenden Sie `lo_http_client->request->set_cdata` für den Payload und `set_header_field` für `Content-Type`. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für den JSON-Payload.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             body        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_post_response.

    METHODS post_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url    TYPE string
        iv_title  TYPE string
        iv_body   TYPE string
        iv_userid TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_post_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_payload TYPE string.

    lv_json_payload = |{{ "title": "{ iv_title }", "body": "{ iv_body }", "userId": { iv_userid } }}|.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_payload ).

        lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        rs_response-body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rs_response-status_code = 500.
        rs_response-body = 'Error during HTTP POST request'.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request über einen konfigurierten HTTP-Proxy durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_http_client=>create_by_url` und `set_proxy`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_proxy_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             body        TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.

    METHODS get_data_via_proxy
      IMPORTING
        iv_url       TYPE string
        iv_proxy_host TYPE string
        iv_proxy_port TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_proxy_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_via_proxy.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->set_proxy(
          EXPORTING
            host = iv_proxy_host
            service = iv_proxy_port
        ).

        lo_http_client->send( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive( EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 4 ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check. ENDIF.

        rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
        rs_response-body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_static_check.
        rs_response-status_code = 500.
        rs_response-body = 'Error during HTTP request via proxy'.
    ENDTRY.

    IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
      lo_http_client->close( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_proxy_request( ).
    DATA(lv_url) = 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1'.
    DATA(lv_proxy_host) = 'proxy.example.com'.
    DATA(lv_proxy_port) = '8080'.

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->get_data_via_proxy(
                           iv_url        = lv_url

Die Methode `set_proxy` des HTTP-Clients ermöglicht die Angabe von Host und Port des Proxys. Dies ist wichtig in Unternehmensumgebungen, wo direkter Internetzugang oft eingeschränkt ist.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_descr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen und Typen aller Felder des Zeilentyps einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_line_type` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_props DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_field_info.
    TYPES: ty_field_info_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_field_properties
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_info) TYPE ty_field_info_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_props IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_properties.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_table ).
        lo_struct_descr ?= lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_field_info = VALUE #( FOR component IN lt_components
                                 ( name = component-name
                                   type = component-type_descr_ref->get_name( ) ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE zcl_rtti_field_props=>ty_sflight_table.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflight_data.

    DATA(lt_field_info) = lo_cut->get_field_properties( lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_field_info ) exp = 4 msg = 'Expected 4 fields' ).

    DATA(lv_carrid_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_connid_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_fldate_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_price_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_field_info INTO DATA(ls_field).
      CASE ls_field-name.
        WHEN 'CARRID'.
          lv_carrid_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'CARRID' in = ls_field-type msg = 'Expected CARRID type' ).
        WHEN 'CONNID'.
          lv_connid_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'CONNID' in = ls_field-type msg = 'Expected CONNID type' ).
        WHEN 'FLDATE'.
          lv_fldate_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'FLDATE' in = ls_field-type msg = 'Expected FLDATE type' ).
        WHEN 'PRICE'.
          lv_price_found = abap_true.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'PRICE' in = ls_field-type msg = 'Expected PRICE type' ).
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_carrid_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_connid_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_fldate_found ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_price_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die RTTI-Nutzung, um detaillierte Informationen über die Komponenten (Felder) eines Zeilentyps zu erhalten. Nach dem Abrufen des `cl_abap_structdescr` für den Zeilentyp wird `get_components` verwendet, um eine Tabelle mit Feldinformationen zu erhalten. CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.

      IMPORTING
        it_template_table TYPE ty_sflight_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_dynamic_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( it_template_table ).

        lo_dynamic_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                                     p_line_type = lo_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )
                                     p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_hashed
                                     p_unique = abap_true
                                     p_key = VALUE #( ( name = 'CARRID' ) ( name = 'CONNID' ) )
                                 ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_dynamic_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Strukturen (Feldnamen und -typen) von zwei internen Tabellen zur Laufzeit und geben Sie an, ob sie identisch sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_table_line_type` und `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_components` für beide Tabellen und vergleichen Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line1,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_line1.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line1 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line2,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_line2.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line2 WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line_diff,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight_line_diff.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_table_diff TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line_diff WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS compare_table_structures
      IMPORTING
        it_table1 TYPE REF TO data
        it_table2 TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_identical) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_compare_tables IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_structures.
    DATA: lo_table_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_table_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lo_struct_descr1 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_struct_descr2 TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components1   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lt_components2   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    rv_are_identical = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr1 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( it_table1 ).
        lo_table_descr2 ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( it_table2 ).

        IF lo_table_descr1->table_kind_name <> lo_table_descr2->table_kind_name.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        lo_struct_descr1 ?= lo_table_descr1->get_table_line_type( ).
        lo_struct_descr2 ?= lo_table_descr2->get_table_line_type( ).

        lt_components1 = lo_struct_descr1->get_components( ).
        lt_components2 = lo_struct_descr2->get_components( ).

        IF lines( lt_components1 ) <> lines( lt_components2 ).
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        LOOP AT lt_components1 INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
          READ TABLE lt_components2 INTO DATA(ls_comp2) WITH KEY name = ls_comp1-name.
          IF sy-subrc <> 0.
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF ls_comp1-type_descr_ref->get_name( ) <> ls_comp2-type_descr_ref->get_name( ).
            RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_are_identical = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Schlüsseldefinition (Schlüsselfelder und deren Art) einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_line
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight_line
                                    WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_key_info,
             name TYPE string,
             is_primary TYPE abap_bool,
             is_unique TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_key_info.
    TYPES: ty_key_info_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_key_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_key_info
      IMPORTING
        it_table TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_key_info) TYPE ty_key_info_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_table_keys IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_key_info.
    DATA: lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_key_components TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_component_table,
          ls_key_definition TYPE cl_abap_tabledescr=>key_definition.

    TRY.
        lo_table_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( it_table ).

        lt_key_components = lo_table_descr->get_key_components( ).

        ls_key_definition = lo_table_descr->get_key_definition( ).

        rt_key_info = VALUE #( FOR component IN lt_key_components
                               ( name = component-name
                                 is_primary = abap_true
                                 is_unique = ls_key_definition-is_unique ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_flights_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_flights_project DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_project.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_project( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

CLASS zcl_flights_nested_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_flight_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_bookings) TYPE tt_flight_booking.

CLASS zcl_flights_nested_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_bookings.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).

    " Simulate sbook data for demo purposes
    DATA lt_sbook TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sbook( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000001' ) INTO TABLE lt_sbook.
    INSERT VALUE sbook( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000002' ) INTO TABLE lt_sbook.
    INSERT VALUE sbook( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' bookid = '00000003' ) INTO TABLE lt_sbook.

    rt_bookings = VALUE tt_flight_booking( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                          FOR ls_book IN lt_sbook
                                            WHERE ( ls_flight-carrid = ls_book-carrid AND
                                                    ls_flight-connid = ls_book-connid AND
                                                    ls_flight-fldate = ls_book-fldate )
                                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                            connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                            fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                            bookid = ls_book-bookid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie die Ergebnisse aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_at_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_seats,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrid_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrid_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_seats) TYPE tt_carrid_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_at_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrid.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid. " Sortierung ist für GROUP BY nicht zwingend, aber gute Praxis für konsistente Gruppenreihenfolge

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_seats( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                    total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                            FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP
                                                            NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ) ) TO rt_carrid_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(ls_lh_seats) = lt_results[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_seats-total_seats exp = 1000 ). " Assuming LH has 4 flights with 250 seats each occupied.

    DATA(ls_aa_seats) = lt_results[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_seats-total_seats exp = 500 ). " Assuming AA has 2 flights with 250 seats each occupied.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Alternative zu den veralteten `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukten. `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` bildet Kontrollgruppen, und innerhalb jeder Gruppe wird der `REDUCE`-Operator verwendet, um die Aggregation (hier die Summe der belegten Sitze) durchzuführen. Dies ist eine flexiblere und besser lesbare Lösung für Gruppenaggregationen.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, TYPES, Aggregation, Control Break

CLASS zcl_flights_line_ops DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flights_line_ops IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und eine berechnete 'Auslastungsrate' (belegte Sitze / Gesamtsitze) enthält. Filtern Sie anschließend diese Tabelle, um nur Flüge mit einer Auslastungsrate über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `LET` zur Berechnung der Auslastungsrate und anschließend `WHERE` zum Filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flights_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_utilization,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             utilization_rate TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_utilization.
    TYPES tt_flight_utilization TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_utilization WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_high_utilization_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_utilization TYPE decfloat16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utilization) TYPE tt_flight_utilization.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_utilization_flights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).

    rt_utilization = VALUE tt_flight_utilization( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                                  LET lv_util = COND decfloat16( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0
                                                                                THEN CONV decfloat16( ls_flight-seatsocc ) / ls_flight-seatsmax
                                                                                ELSE 0 )
                                                  WHERE ( lv_util > iv_min_utilization )
                                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                                    connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                                    utilization_rate = lv_util ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flights_let( ).
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->get_high_utilization_flights( '0.9' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_results ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 6 ). " Assuming all demo flights have >= 90% utilization
    DATA(ls_first) = lt_results[ 1 ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first-utilization_rate exp = '1.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung des `LET`-Ausdrucks innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks. `LET` ermöglicht die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen (`lv_util`), die nur innerhalb des `FOR`-Ausdrucks gültig sind. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit bei komplexeren Berechnungen oder Bedingungen, die auf den Elementen der Schleife basieren, und hält den Code kompakt und funktional.

Die Ausgabe soll eine Tabelle von Strukturen sein, die die Fluggesellschaft und eine Tabelle der zugehörigen Flugnummern enthält.

CLASS zcl_flights_nested_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrid_connids,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE tt_connids,
           END OF ty_carrid_connids.
    TYPES tt_carrid_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrid_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_carrids_with_filtered_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrid_connids) TYPE tt_carrid_connids.

CLASS zcl_flights_nested_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrids_with_filtered_connids.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = cl_demo_sflight=>get_flights( ).

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrid_connids( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                      connids = VALUE tt_connids( FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP
                                                                  WHERE ( ls_group_member-seatsocc >= iv_min_seats )
                                                                  ( ls_group_member-connid ) ) ) TO rt_carrid_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                                                 ( carrid = ls_group-carrid

GROUP BY` verwendet) ermöglicht die Erstellung einer neuen internen Tabelle, indem er die Elemente einer Quelltabelle gruppiert und jede Gruppe in ein neues Element der Zieltabelle transformiert. Instructions: Senden Sie eine einfache E-Mail mit einem dynamischen Betreff und Inhalt an einen Empfänger unter Verwendung der Business Communication Services (BCS).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bcs_message` und String-Templates für den E-Mail-Inhalt.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_send_simple_mail IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine ALV-Liste der `SFLIGHTS`-Daten an, gruppiert nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindung, mit der Summe der Preise pro Gruppe. Nutzen Sie neue Open SQL-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung.

CLASS zcl_alv_agg_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_agg,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

    METHODS display_aggregated_sflights.

CLASS zcl_alv_agg_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, SUM( price ) AS total_price, currency
      FROM sflight
      GROUP BY carrid, connid, currency
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_agg).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            IMPORTING
              r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table)
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflight_agg
          ).

          lr_salv_table->set_screen_status(
            pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
            report     = sy-repid
            set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
          ).

          DATA(lo_columns) = lr_salv_table->get_columns( ).
          DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'TOTAL_PRICE' ).
          lo_column->set_total( abap_true ).

          lr_salv_table->display( ).

        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid, das `SFLIGHTS`-Daten anzeigt. Wenn der Benutzer auf die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) klickt, soll ein Pop-up mit weiteren Details zur Fluggesellschaft angezeigt werden.
hint: Implementieren Sie das Interface `IF_SALV_EVENTS_LIST` oder `IF_SALV_EVENTS_TABLE` und registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `LINK_CLICK`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_link.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS handle_link_click FOR EVENT link_click OF cl_salv_events_list
      IMPORTING
        row
        column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_link.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          mo_salv_table = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights
          ).

          mo_salv_table->set_screen_status(
            pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
            report     = sy-repid
            set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
          ).

          DATA(lo_columns) = mo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
          DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
          lo_column_carrid->set_cell_type( if_salv_c_cell_type=>hotspot ).

          DATA(lo_events) = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler( ).
          SET HANDLER handle_link_click FOR lo_events.

          mo_salv_table->display( ).

        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_link_click.
    READ TABLE mo_salv_table->get_data( ) INDEX row INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE |Details for Airline: { ls_sflight-carrid } (Connection: { ls_sflight-connid })| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " This test is conceptual. Directly testing ALV event handlers in unit tests is complex

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger (TO, CC, BCC) unter Verwendung von BCS.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs=>add_recipient` mehrfach mit verschiedenen Empfängertypen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_recipients TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ad_smtpadr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS send_mail_to_multiple
      IMPORTING
        it_to_recipients  TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        it_cc_recipients  TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        it_bcc_recipients TYPE tt_recipients OPTIONAL
        iv_subject        TYPE string
        iv_body           TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_multi_recipient IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_to_multiple.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Add TO recipients
    LOOP AT it_to_recipients INTO DATA(lv_to_email).
      DATA(lo_recipient_to) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_to_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient_to i_express = 'X' ). " 'X' for TO
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add CC recipients
    LOOP AT it_cc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_cc_email).
      DATA(lo_recipient_cc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_cc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient_cc i_copy = 'X' ). " 'X' for CC
    ENDLOOP.

    " Add BCC recipients
    LOOP AT it_bcc_recipients INTO DATA(lv_bcc_email).
      DATA(lo_recipient_bcc) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( lv_bcc_email ).
      lo_bcs->add_recipient( i_recipient = lo_recipient_bcc i_blind_copy = 'X' ). " 'X' for BCC
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_mail_to_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_mail_to_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_multi_recipient( ).
    DATA(lt_to) = VALUE zcl_bcs_multi_recipient=>tt_recipients( ( 'to1@example.com' ) ( 'to2@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lt_cc) = VALUE zcl_bcs_multi_recipient=>tt_recipients( ( 'cc1@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lt_bcc) = VALUE zcl_bcs_multi_recipient=>tt_recipients( ( 'bcc1@example.com' ) ).
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'Test E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'Dies ist eine Test-E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger.'.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_mail_to_multiple(
      it_to_recipients  = lt_to
      it_cc_recipients  = lt_cc
      it_bcc_recipients = lt_bcc
      iv_subject        = lv_subject
      iv_body           = lv_body
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'E-Mail an mehrere Empfänger sollte erfolgreich gesendet werden.'
    ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid, das Daten aus einer beliebigen internen Tabelle anzeigt, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit ermittelt wird (RTTI).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` mit einem Feld-Symbol und RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_rtti DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_rtti IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Invalid data reference provided.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = <lt_data>
        ).

        lr_salv_table->set_screen_status(
          pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
          report     = sy-repid
          set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
        ).

        lr_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_dynamic_table.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_test_data,
            field1 TYPE c LENGTH 10,
            field2 TYPE i,
          END OF ls_test_data.
    DATA lt_test_data LIKE STANDARD TABLE OF ls_test_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Test A'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 100.
    APPEND ls_test_data TO lt_test_data.

    ls_test_data-field1 = 'Test B'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 200.
    APPEND ls_test_data TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_rtti( ).
    DATA(lr_data) = REF TO lt_test_data.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_dynamic_table( lr_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during dynamic ALV display' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Anzeige von Daten in einem ALV-Grid, wobei die Struktur der internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit über RTTI (`TYPE REF TO data` und `ASSIGN ... TO FIELD-SYMBOLS`) ermittelt wird. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische ALV-Anzeigen, bei denen der Datentyp nicht fest zur Designzeit bekannt ist. `cl_salv_table=>factory` kann direkt mit einem Feld-Symbol verwendet werden.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine robuste E-Mail-Versandfunktion mit BCS, die Fehler beim Versand abfängt und protokolliert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_bcs` und die Methode `get_text()` der Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_robust
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_robust.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Log the error message for analysis
        DATA(lv_error_message) = lx_bcs->get_text( ).
        MESSAGE |E-Mail-Versand fehlgeschlagen: { lv_error_message }| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " In a real scenario, you would log this to a custom application log (e.g., SLG1)
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid für `SFLIGHTS`-Daten und wenden Sie ein benutzerdefiniertes Layout an, das Spaltenreihenfolge, Sortierung und Filterung vordefiniert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table=>get_layout()` und `cl_salv_layout_service`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_layout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_layout.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_layout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_layout.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 20 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights
          ).

          lo_alv->set_screen_status(
            pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
            report     = sy-repid
            set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
          ).

          " Get layout object
          DATA(lo_layout) = lo_alv->get_layout( ).
          lo_layout->set_key( VALUE salv_s_layout_key( report = sy-repid handle = 'MY_LAYOUT' ) ).
          lo_layout->set_default( abap_true ).

          " Set column order
          DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
          lo_columns->set_column_position(
            VALUE salv_t_fieldcatalog(
              ( fieldname = 'FLDATE' )
              ( fieldname = 'CARRID' )
              ( fieldname = 'CONNID' )
              ( fieldname = 'PRICE' )
              ( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' )
            )
          ).

          " Set sort order
          DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_alv->get_sorts( ).
          lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' position = 1 sortorder = if_salv_c_sort=>sort_order_ascending ).
          lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'FLDATE' position = 2 sortorder = if_salv_c_sort=>sort_order_descending ).

          " Set filter (example: only show flights with price > 100)
          DATA(lo_filters) = lo_alv->get_filters( ).
          lo_filters->add_filter( columnname = 'PRICE' sign = 'I' option = 'GT' low = '100' ).

          lo_alv->display( ).

        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_sflights_with_layout FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_sflights_with_layout.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_custom_layout( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_sflights_with_layout( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during ALV layout setup' ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein benutzerdefiniertes ALV-Layout zur Laufzeit konfiguriert. Es werden Spaltenreihenfolge, Sortierung und Filterung über die entsprechenden Methoden der `cl_salv_table`-Objekte (`get_columns`, `get_sorts`, `get_filters`) eingestellt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #()` für die Spaltenpositionierung und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV-Grid vollständig dynamisch zur Laufzeit, basierend auf der Struktur einer internen Tabelle, die über RTTI ermittelt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_ddic_object_ref()` und `cl_salv_controller_metadata`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_dynamic_alv
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_rtti_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_dynamic_alv.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <lt_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Invalid data reference provided.' TYPE 'E'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = <lt_data>
        ).

        lr_salv_table->set_screen_status(
          pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
          report     = sy-repid
          set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
        ).

        " Dynamically create field catalog using RTTI
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <lt_data> )->get_table_line_type( )->get_ddic_object_ref( ).
        DATA(lo_metadata) = cl_salv_controller_metadata=>factory(
          r_ddic_object = lo_struct_descr
        ).
        DATA(lt_fieldcatalog) = lo_metadata->get_field_catalog( ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lr_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_column_position(
          EXPORTING
            value = lt_fieldcatalog
        ).

        lr_salv_table->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_descr_type INTO DATA(lx_descr_type).
        MESSAGE lx_descr_type->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit BCS, wobei der Absender dynamisch festgelegt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs=>set_sender()` mit `cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_sender DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_with_sender
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_sender_email    TYPE ad_smtpadr

        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_dynamic_sender IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    " Set dynamic sender
    DATA(lo_sender) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_sender_email ).
    lo_bcs->set_sender( lo_sender ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_true ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie dem ALV-Toolbar einen benutzerdefinierten Button hinzu und reagieren Sie auf dessen Klick-Ereignis.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table=>get_functions()` und `cl_salv_functions_list=>add_function()` sowie Event-Handling.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_toolbar DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_button.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_salv_table TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS handle_function_event FOR EVENT added_function OF cl_salv_events_functions
      IMPORTING
        e_salv_function.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_toolbar IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_button.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          mo_salv_table = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights
          ).

          mo_salv_table->set_screen_status(
            pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
            report     = sy-repid
            set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
          ).

          " Add custom button to toolbar
          DATA(lo_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_functions( ).
          lo_functions->add_function(
            name     = 'MY_BUTTON'
            text     = 'Mein Button'
            tooltip  = 'Klicken Sie hier für eine Aktion'
            icon     = icon_information
          ).

          " Register event handler for custom button
          DATA(lo_event_functions) = mo_salv_table->get_event_handler_functions( ).
          SET HANDLER handle_function_event FOR lo_event_functions.

          mo_salv_table->display( ).

        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_function_event.
    IF e_salv_function = 'MY_BUTTON'.
      MESSAGE 'Benutzerdefinierter Button wurde geklickt!' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_display_alv_with_button FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_handle_function_event FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_display_alv_with_button.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_custom_toolbar( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_alv_with_button( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during ALV with custom button setup' ).

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit BCS und überprüfen Sie anschließend den Versandstatus der Nachricht.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bcs=>send()` und dann `cl_bcs=>get_status()` oder `cl_bcs=>get_document_flow()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_status_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_and_check_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_ok) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_status_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_and_check_status.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Do NOT send immediately to check status later
    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_false ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        " Commit work to ensure the send request is processed
        COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.

        " Check status after commit
        DATA(lv_status) = lo_bcs->get_status( ).
        IF lv_status = 'S'. " 'S' for sent successfully
          MESSAGE 'E-Mail erfolgreich gesendet.' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
          rv_status_ok = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          MESSAGE |E-Mail-Versandstatus: { lv_status } (Nicht erfolgreich).| TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
          rv_status_ok = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_status_ok = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_send_mail_and_check_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_send_mail_and_check_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_status_check( ).
    DATA(lv_recipient) = 'status_check@example.com'.
    DATA(lv_subject) = 'BCS Status Check Test'.
    DATA(lv_body) = 'Diese E-Mail wird gesendet und ihr Status überprüft.'.

    DATA(lv_status_ok) = lo_cut->send_mail_and_check_status(
      iv_recipient_email = lv_recipient
      iv_subject         = lv_subject
      iv_body            = lv_body
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_status_ok
      msg = 'E-Mail sollte erfolgreich gesendet und der Status als OK gemeldet werden.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert, wie der Versandstatus einer E-Mail nach dem Senden mit BCS überprüft werden kann. Der Schlüssel hierfür ist, `set_send_immediately( abap_false )` zu verwenden, um den Versand in den Hintergrund zu verschieben, und dann `COMMIT WORK AND WAIT` auszuführen, um sicherzustellen, dass der Sendeauftrag verarbeitet wird. Anschließend kann `lo_bcs->get_status()` aufgerufen werden, um den aktuellen Status abzufragen. Dies ist wichtig für die Überwachung und Fehlerbehandlung von Kommunikationsprozessen.
keywords: BCS, E-Mail, Status, Communication, `cl_bcs`, `COMMIT WORK`, `get_status`

Instructions: Zeigen Sie `SFLIGHTS`-Daten in einem ALV an, aber filtern Sie die Daten vor der Anzeige mit einem funktionalen `FILTER` Ausdruck, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Währung anzuzeigen.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen vor der Übergabe an `cl_salv_table`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_functional_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_functional_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_filtered_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER tt_sflight(
        lt_all_sflights WHERE currency = iv_currency
      ).

      IF lt_filtered_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
        TRY.
            DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
              EXPORTING
                r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
              IMPORTING
                r_salv_table = DATA(lr_salv_table)
              CHANGING
                t_table = lt_filtered_sflights
            ).

            lr_salv_table->set_screen_status(
              pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
              report     = sy-repid
              set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
            ).

            lr_salv_table->display( ).

          CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
            MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        ENDTRY.
      ELSE.
        MESSAGE |No flights found for currency { iv_currency } after filtering.| TYPE 'I'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail mit BCS im Hintergrund, ohne sofortigen Versand, und lassen Sie den Versand durch einen separaten Job oder die Standard-Sendeprozesse steuern.
hint: Setzen Sie `set_send_immediately( abap_false )` und verzichten Sie auf `COMMIT WORK AND WAIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_background_send DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_mail_in_background
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient_email TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject         TYPE string
        iv_body            TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success)  TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_background_send IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_mail_in_background.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_convert=>string_to_soli( iv_body )

    DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient_email ).
    lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

    " Do NOT send immediately
    lo_bcs->set_send_immediately( abap_false ).

    TRY.
        lo_bcs->send( ).
        " The send request is now in the queue and will be processed by a background job (e.g., RSCONN01)
        " No COMMIT WORK AND WAIT here, as it's a background send.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.

  ENDMETHOD.
