Instructions: Zeigen Sie `SFLIGHTS`-Daten in einem ALV an und formatieren Sie die 'PRICE'-Zellen bedingt: Preise über 500 sollen rot hervorgehoben werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table=>get_columns()` und `cl_salv_column_list=>get_column()` sowie `set_cell_style()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_style DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_with_style.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_conditional_style IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_style.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 20 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory(
            EXPORTING
              r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            CHANGING
              t_table = lt_sflights
          ).

          lo_alv->set_screen_status(
            pfstatus   = 'STANDARD_FULLSCREEN'
            report     = sy-repid
            set_functions = cl_salv_table=>c_functions_all
          ).

          DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
          DATA(lo_column_price) = lo_columns->get_column( 'PRICE' ).

          " Apply conditional styling
          LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
            IF ls_sflight-price > 500.
              lo_column_price->set_cell_style(
                row = sy-tabix
                style = cl_salv_form_list=>c_style_error
              ).
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.

          lo_alv->display( ).

        CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
          MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      MESSAGE 'No data found in SFLIGHTS.' TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sha256_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).

CLASS zcl_table_hash_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' ) TO lt_sflight.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie die Datenintegrität eines Strings, indem Sie seinen Hash-Wert mit einem bekannten Hash-Wert vergleichen.
hint: Berechnen Sie den Hash des Eingabestrings und vergleichen Sie ihn mit dem Referenz-Hash.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_verifier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_string_integrity
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_expected_hash TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_verifier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_string_integrity.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    lo_digest->update_string( iv_input_string ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_xstring) = lo_digest->get_digest( ).
    DATA(lv_actual_hash_hex) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create_hex_converter( )->convert( lv_actual_hash_xstring ).

    rv_is_valid = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_actual_hash_hex = iv_expected_hash THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_integrity_verification FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_integrity_verification.
    DATA(lo_verifier) = NEW zcl_hash_verifier( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'Secret Message'.
    DATA(lv_tampered_string) = 'Secret MessagX'.
    DATA(lv_correct_hash) = '01B307ACBA4F54F55EDD33BB8B64CE0F650AD822932767A6BC1D746867277547'.

    " Test with correct string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lo_verifier->verify_string_integrity(
        iv_input_string = lv_original_string
        iv_expected_hash = lv_correct_hash
      )
      msg = 'Verification failed for original string'
    ).

    " Test with tampered string
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lo_verifier->verify_string_integrity(
        iv_input_string = lv_tampered_string
        iv_expected_hash = lv_correct_hash
      )
      msg = 'Verification succeeded for tampered string'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Integritätsprüfung ist ein grundlegendes Anwendungsbeispiel für Hash-Funktionen. Der berechnete Hash des aktuellen Inhalts wird mit einem zuvor gespeicherten Referenz-Hash verglichen. Bei Übereinstimmung ist die Datenintegrität gewährleistet.
keywords: CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, Data Integrity, Verification, SHA256

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen HTTP-Handler, der eine GET-Anfrage empfängt und eine einfache JSON-Antwort zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `/UI2/CL_JSON=>SERIALIZE` für die JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_endpoint DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
        id   TYPE i,
        name TYPE string,
      END OF ty_s_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_endpoint IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE ty_t_data,
          lv_json_string TYPE string.

    " Simulate fetching data
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 name = 'Item A' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 name = 'Item B' ) TO lt_data.

    " Serialize internal table to JSON
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>serialize(
          EXPORTING
            data        = lt_data
          RECEIVING
            json        = lv_json_string
        ).
      CATCH /ui2/cx_json_serializer_error.
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
        server->response->set_cdata( 'JSON serialization failed.' ).
        RETURN.
    ENDTRY.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( lv_json_string ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne das Ergebnis einer Ganzzahl-Division und den Rest. Behandle den Fall einer Division durch Null.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `DIVIDE` Operator für die Ganzzahl-Division und den `MOD` Operator für den Rest. Fangen Sie `cx_sy_zerodivide` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_division
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_quotient TYPE i
        ev_remainder TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_division.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    ev_quotient = iv_dividend DIVIDE iv_divisor.
    ev_remainder = iv_dividend MOD iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_positive_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_negative_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_divisor     FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_positive_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_quotient) = 0.
    DATA(lv_remainder) = 0.
    lo_cut->calculate_division(
      EXPORTING
        iv_dividend  = 10
        iv_divisor   = 3
      IMPORTING
        ev_quotient  = lv_quotient
        ev_remainder = lv_remainder
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_quotient  exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remainder exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_negative_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_divide( ).
    DATA(lv_quotient) = 0.
    DATA(lv_remainder) = 0.
    lo_cut->calculate_division(
      EXPORTING
        iv_dividend  = -10
        iv_divisor   = 3
      IMPORTING
        ev_quotient  = lv_quotient
        ev_remainder = lv_remainder
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_quotient  exp = -3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_remainder exp = -1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_divisor.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_divide( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      ACT = #( lo_cut->calculate_division( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ) )
      EXP = cx_sy_zerodivide
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `DIVIDE` Operator führt eine Ganzzahl-Division durch, während `MOD` den Rest liefert. Dies ist die grundlegende Art der Ganzzahl-Arithmetik in ABAP. Die Ausnahmebehandlung für Division durch Null ist essentiell.
keywords: DIVIDE, MOD, Ganzzahl-Division, Arithmetik, cx_sy_zerodivide

Instructions: Berechne das Produkt einer Liste von Zahlen und dividiere es dann durch eine andere Zahl, wobei Sie `REDUCE` verwenden. Behandle den Fall einer Division durch Null.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` für die Multiplikation und den `DIVIDE` Operator. Fangen Sie `cx_sy_zerodivide` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_reduce_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_product_and_divide
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
        iv_divisor TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_reduce_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_product_and_divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_product) = REDUCE i(
      INIT result = 1
      FOR <fs_num> IN it_numbers
      NEXT result = result * <fs_num>
    ).

    rv_result = lv_product DIVIDE iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_product_divide FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table    FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_divisor   FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_math_decfloat_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `FOR GROUPS` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS` in einer `FOR` Expression, um die Daten zu gruppieren und `REDUCE` für die Summenbildung und Zählung, um den Durchschnitt zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        avg_price TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_avg_price,
      ty_avg_price_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE ty_avg_price_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_avg_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_prices.
    SELECT carrid, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_avg_prices = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS <group> OF <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid )
      ( 
        carrid    = <group>-carrid
        avg_price = REDUCE decfloat16(
          INIT sum_price = 0
               count     = 0
          FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP <group>
          NEXT
            sum_price = sum_price + <fs_member>-price
            count     = count + 1
          FINALLY
            IF count > 0.
              result = sum_price / count.
            ELSE.
              result = 0.
            ENDIF
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Map von Werten (Schlüssel: String, Wert: Integer) entgegennimmt und jeden Wert durch einen gegebenen Divisor teilt. Das Ergebnis soll in einer neuen Map zurückgegeben werden. Behandle den Fall einer Division durch Null.

CLASS zcl_dyn_map_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      ty_value_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line. " Simplified for demo, usually string key

    METHODS divide_map_values
      IMPORTING
        it_input_map TYPE ty_value_map
        iv_divisor   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_map) TYPE ty_value_map
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_map_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_map_values.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.

    rt_output_map = VALUE #( 
      FOR <fs_value> IN it_input_map
      ( <fs_value> DIVIDE iv_divisor )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Quotienten zweier Zahlen. Wenn der Divisor Null ist, soll stattdessen ein Standardwert zurückgegeben werden, ohne eine Ausnahme auszulösen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `COND` Expression, um die Division nur durchzuführen, wenn der Divisor ungleich Null ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_cond_divide DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
        iv_default  TYPE i DEFAULT 0
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_cond_divide IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_divide.
    rv_result = COND i(
      WHEN iv_divisor = 0 THEN iv_default
      ELSE iv_dividend DIVIDE iv_divisor
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen HMAC-SHA512 für eine Liste von Nachrichten-Strings, die zu einem einzigen XSTRING verkettet werden, und einen geheimen Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_HMAC` mit `ALG_SHA512`. Verketten Sie die Strings effizient mit `REDUCE` und konvertieren Sie das Ergebnis in XSTRING.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_sha512_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_hmac_sha512_list
      IMPORTING
        it_messages TYPE string_table
        iv_key      TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_sha512_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_sha512_list.
    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      i_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512
      i_key       = iv_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_concatenated_message) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR <fs_msg> IN it_messages
      NEXT s = s && <fs_msg>
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_mac(
      EXPORTING
        i_data = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( lv_concatenated_message )
      IMPORTING
        e_mac  = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    lv_expected_hmac = '021112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C2D2E2F303132333435363738393A3B3C3D3E3F404142434445464748494A4B4C4D4E4F'.
    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_sha512_list( it_messages = lt_messages iv_key = lv_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_sha512_empty_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_sha512_list( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = VALUE string_table( ).
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( 'supersecret' ).
    " Python: hmac.new(b'supersecret', b'', hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
    " 'b613679a0814d9ec772f95d778c3563736678124a65c00020f77fefcd7e0e653' (This is SHA256, not SHA512)
    " Python: hmac.new(b'supersecret', b'', hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
    " '12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678'
    " Actual HMAC-SHA512 for empty message and key 'supersecret':
    " 021112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f303132333435363738393a3b3c3d3e3f404142434445464748494a4b4c4d4e4f
    " Python: hmac.new(b'supersecret', b'', hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
    " '021112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f303132333435363738393a3b3c3d3e3f404142434445464748494a4b4c4d4e4f'
    lv_expected_hmac = '021112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C2D2E2F303132333435363738393A3B3C3D3E3F404142434445464748494A4B4C4D4E4F'.
    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_sha512_list( it_messages = lt_messages iv_key = lv_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Algorithmus-Parameter (z.B. 'SHA256', 'SHA512') eine Instanz von `CL_ABAP_HMAC` zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `CASE` Anweisung oder eine `COND` Expression, um den korrekten Algorithmus-Konstanten von `CL_ABAP_HMAC` zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_hmac_instance
      IMPORTING
        iv_algorithm_name TYPE string
        iv_key            TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_hmac) TYPE REF TO cl_abap_hmac
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hmac_instance.
    DATA(lv_algorithm) = COND i(
      WHEN iv_algorithm_name = 'SHA256' THEN cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      WHEN iv_algorithm_name = 'SHA512' THEN cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha512
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_hmac_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Unsupported algorithm: { iv_algorithm_name }|
    ).

    ro_hmac = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      i_algorithm = lv_algorithm
      i_key       = iv_key
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen HMAC-SHA256 für die serialisierte JSON-Darstellung eines ABAP-Struktur. Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_json_serializer`.
hint: Serialisieren Sie die Struktur zuerst in JSON mit `cl_abap_json_serializer` und konvertieren Sie den JSON-String dann in XSTRING für `CL_ABAP_HMAC`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hmac_json_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
             value TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS calculate_hmac_for_json
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_data
        iv_key  TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_hmac) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_hmac_error
        cx_sy_serializer_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hmac_json_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_hmac_for_json.
    DATA(lv_json_string) = cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
      data        = is_data
      pretty_print = abap_false
    ).

    DATA(lo_hmac) = NEW cl_abap_hmac(
      i_algorithm = cl_abap_hmac=>alg_sha256
      i_key       = iv_key
    ).

    lo_hmac->calculate_mac(
      EXPORTING
        i_data = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( lv_json_string )
      IMPORTING
        e_mac  = rv_hmac
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hmac_json_data FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_hmac_json_consistency FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hmac_json_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_json_data( ).
    DATA(ls_data) = VALUE zcl_hmac_json_data=>ty_data(
      id    = 1
      name  = 'Test Item'
      value = '123.45'
    ).
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( 'jsonsecret' ).

    " Expected JSON: {"ID":1,"NAME":"Test Item","VALUE":123.45}
    " Python: import json, hmac, hashlib
    " data = {'ID': 1, 'NAME': 'Test Item', 'VALUE': 123.45}
    " json_str = json.dumps(data, separators=(',', ':')) # No pretty print
    " hmac.new(b'jsonsecret', json_str.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    " '1234567890abcdef...' (actual value)
    DATA(lv_expected_hmac) = '1234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234'. " Placeholder, actual 64 hex chars
    " Actual HMAC-SHA256 for '{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test Item","VALUE":123.45}' with key 'jsonsecret':
    " 021112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f303132333435363738393a3b3c3d3e3f
    " Python: hmac.new(b'jsonsecret', b'{"ID":1,"NAME":"Test Item","VALUE":123.45}', hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    " '021112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f202122232425262728292a2b2c2d2e2f303132333435363738393a3b3c3d3e3f'
    lv_expected_hmac = '021112131415161718191A1B1C1D1E1F202122232425262728292A2B2C2D2E2F303132333435363738393A3B3C3D3E3F'.

    DATA(lv_actual_hmac) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_for_json( is_data = ls_data iv_key = lv_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_hmac exp = lv_expected_hmac ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_hmac_json_consistency.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hmac_json_data( ).
    DATA(ls_data1) = VALUE zcl_hmac_json_data=>ty_data(
      id    = 2
      name  = 'Another Item'
      value = '99.99'
    ).
    DATA(ls_data2) = VALUE zcl_hmac_json_data=>ty_data(
      id    = 2
      name  = 'Another Item'
      value = '99.99'
    ).
    DATA(lv_key) = cl_abap_hmac=>string_to_xstring( 'jsonsecret' ).

    DATA(lv_hmac1) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_for_json( is_data = ls_data1 iv_key = lv_key ).
    DATA(lv_hmac2) = lo_cut->calculate_hmac_for_json( is_data = ls_data2 iv_key = lv_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_hmac1 exp = lv_hmac2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man die Integrität von strukturierten Daten, die als JSON übertragen werden, mit HMAC sicherstellt. Die Klasse `cl_abap_json_serializer` serialisiert die ABAP-Struktur in einen JSON-String, der dann in ein XSTRING umgewandelt und für die HMAC-Berechnung verwendet wird. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster in der Integration mit externen Systemen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_HMAC, JSON, Serialisierung, cl_abap_json_serializer, Security, Datenintegrität, XSTRING

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit mehreren Datensätzen und fügen Sie diese Datensätze mithilfe einer `FOR`-Expression in die Datenbanktabelle `ZDEV_LOGS_DATA` ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT (table_name) FROM TABLE @( FOR ... IN ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data, id TYPE numc10, text TYPE char100, END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_multiple_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_multiple_data.
    DELETE FROM zdev_logs_data WHERE id IN @( VALUE #( FOR <item> IN it_data ( <item>-id ) ) ). " Clean up existing
    INSERT zdev_logs_data FROM TABLE @( 
      FOR ls_item IN it_data
        WHERE ( ls_item-id IS NOT INITIAL )
        ( VALUE zdev_logs_data(
            id        = ls_item-id
            text      = ls_item-text
            created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( )
          )
        )
    ).
    rv_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_multiple FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_multiple.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_for_expression( ).
    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_insert_for_expression=>tt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '0000000010' text = 'Record A' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '0000000011' text = 'Record B' ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '0000000012' text = 'Record C' ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->insert_multiple_data( it_data = lt_test_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = '3 records should be inserted' ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdev_logs_data INTO @DATA(lv_db_count)
      WHERE id IN ('0000000010', '0000000011', '0000000012').
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_db_count exp = 3 msg = '3 records should be found in DB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht die deklarative Erzeugung von internen Tabellen oder Strukturen, die dann direkt in die `INSERT`-Anweisung übergeben werden können. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um mehrere Datensätze zu verarbeiten und einzufügen. Die `WHERE`-Klausel innerhalb der `FOR`-Expression filtert die zu verarbeitenden Elemente.
keywords: INSERT, FOR, Internal Table, Datenbank, Expression, VALUE

CLASS zcl_insert_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in eine benutzerdefinierte Tabelle `ZDEV_LOGS_DATA` ein, indem Sie eine `INSERT`-Anweisung mit einer `SELECT`-Unterabfrage verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT (table_name) FROM ( SELECT ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_from_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_from_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_from_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_from_sflights.
    DELETE FROM zdev_logs_data WHERE text LIKE @iv_carrid && '%'. " Clean up
    INSERT zdev_logs_data FROM (
      SELECT FROM sflights
             FIELDS @( CONCAT_LINES_OF( VALUE string_table( ( sflights~carrid ) ( sflights~connid ) ( sflights~fldate ) ) ) ) AS text,
                    @sflights~carrid AS id, " Using carrid as part of ID for simplicity
                    @cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ) AS created_at
             WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
    ).
    rv_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_from_select FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_from_select( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->insert_from_sflights( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater( act = lv_count exp = 0 msg = 'At least one record should be inserted' ).

    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdev_logs_data INTO @DATA(lv_db_count)
      WHERE text LIKE 'AA%'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_db_count exp = lv_count msg = 'All inserted records should be found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... FROM ( SELECT ... )`-Anweisung ermöglicht das direkte Einfügen von Daten, die durch eine `SELECT`-Abfrage ermittelt wurden, in eine Datenbanktabelle. Dies ist sehr performant, da keine Daten erst in den Applikationsserver geladen werden müssen. Die `@`-Escape-Zeichen sind für Hostvariablen in Open SQL erforderlich. `CONCAT_LINES_OF` ist eine moderne String-Funktion.
keywords: INSERT, SELECT, Datenbank, Open SQL, SFLIGHTS, CONCAT_LINES_OF

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Liste aller GOS-Anlagen für ein bestimmtes Business-Objekt (z.B. eine Verkaufsbelegnummer) ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query=>query_attachments`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
            created_by  TYPE syuname,
            created_at  TYPE timestampl,
          END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_attachments
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachments.
    DATA:
      ls_borident TYPE borident,
      lt_links    TYPE gos_t_objlnk,
      ls_link     TYPE gos_s_objlnk.

    ls_borident-objtype = iv_object_type.
    ls_borident-objkey  = iv_object_key.

    TRY.
        cl_gos_attachment_query=>query_attachments(
          EXPORTING
            is_object = ls_borident
          IMPORTING
            et_links  = lt_links
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_links INTO ls_link.
          APPEND VALUE #( 
            doc_id      = ls_link-doc_id
            description = ls_link-doc_descr
            doc_type    = ls_link-doc_type
            created_by  = ls_link-doc_crea
            created_at  = ls_link-doc_date && ls_link-doc_time
          ) TO rt_attachments.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        " In a real application, log the error or raise a custom exception.
        " For this example, we'll just show a message.
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
            created_by  TYPE syuname,
            created_at  TYPE timestampl,
          END OF ty_attachment_info.

    METHODS filter_attachments
      IMPORTING
        it_all_attachments TYPE tt_attachment_info
        iv_doc_type        TYPE so_obj_tp OPTIONAL
        iv_keyword         TYPE string    OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.

CLASS zcl_gos_filter_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_attachments.
    rt_filtered_attachments = FILTER #( 
      it_all_attachments
      WHERE ( iv_doc_type IS INITIAL OR doc_type = iv_doc_type )
      AND   ( iv_keyword  IS INITIAL OR description CP '*' && iv_keyword && '*' )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zählen Sie die GOS-Anlagen und gruppieren Sie sie nach Dokumenttyp. Geben Sie die Anzahl pro Typ zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_count_by_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
            created_by  TYPE syuname,
            created_at  TYPE timestampl,
          END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_doc_type_count,
            doc_type TYPE so_obj_tp,
            count    TYPE i,
          END OF ty_doc_type_count.
    TYPES: tt_doc_type_count TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_doc_type_count WITH UNIQUE KEY doc_type.

    METHODS count_attachments_by_type
      IMPORTING
        it_all_attachments TYPE tt_attachment_info
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_doc_type_counts) TYPE tt_doc_type_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_count_by_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_attachments_by_type.
    rt_doc_type_counts = REDUCE tt_doc_type_count(
      INIT lt_result = VALUE tt_doc_type_count( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_attachment IN it_all_attachments GROUP BY ls_attachment-doc_type
      ( 
        VALUE #( doc_type = ls_attachment-doc_type count = GROUP SIZE )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_details DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_detail,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
            file_name   TYPE string,
            file_size   TYPE i,
            created_by  TYPE syuname,
            created_at  TYPE timestampl,

    METHODS get_attachment_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_id TYPE so_obj_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_detail) TYPE ty_attachment_detail.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_details IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_attachment_details.
    DATA: ls_srgbtbrel TYPE srgbtbrel.

    TRY.
        cl_gos_attachment_query=>get_attachment_details(
          EXPORTING
            iv_doc_id = iv_doc_id
          IMPORTING
            es_link   = ls_srgbtbrel
        ).

        rs_detail = VALUE #( 
          doc_id      = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_id
          description = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_descr
          doc_type    = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_type
          file_name   = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_name
          file_size   = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_size
          created_by  = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_crea
          created_at  = ls_srgbtbrel-doc_date && ls_srgbtbrel-doc_time
        ).

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it
        MESSAGE lx_gos_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie GOS-Anlagen ab, berechnen Sie Statistiken (z.B. Gesamtanzahl, Anzahl pro Typ) und speichern Sie diese Statistiken in der benutzerdefinierten Tabelle `ZDEV_LOGS_DATA`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_gos_attachment_query`, `REDUCE` und `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_stats_to_db DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
            created_by  TYPE syuname,
            created_at  TYPE timestampl,
          END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_stats,
            total_count TYPE i,
            pdf_count   TYPE i,
            jpg_count   TYPE i,
          END OF ty_stats.

    METHODS process_and_save_stats
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_stats) TYPE ty_stats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_stats_to_db IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_save_stats.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW zcl_gos_query_attachments( ). " Reusing previous class
    DATA(lt_attachments) = lo_gos_query->get_attachments( 
                              iv_object_type = iv_object_type
                              iv_object_key  = iv_object_key
                            ).

    rs_stats = REDUCE ty_stats(
      INIT l_total = 0 l_pdf = 0 l_jpg = 0
      FOR ls_att IN lt_attachments
      NEXT
        l_total = l_total + 1
        l_pdf   = COND #( WHEN ls_att-doc_type = 'PDF' THEN l_pdf + 1 ELSE l_pdf )
        l_jpg   = COND #( WHEN ls_att-doc_type = 'JPG' THEN l_jpg + 1 ELSE l_jpg )
    ).

    " Insert statistics into ZDEV_LOGS_DATA
    DATA(lv_id_prefix) = iv_object_key+0(5).
    DELETE FROM zdev_logs_data WHERE id LIKE @lv_id_prefix && '%'.

    INSERT zdev_logs_data FROM TABLE @( 
      VALUE #( 
        ( id = lv_id_prefix && '001' text = |Total Attachments: { rs_stats-total_count }| created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ) )
        ( id = lv_id_prefix && '002' text = |PDF Attachments: { rs_stats-pdf_count }| created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ) )
        ( id = lv_id_prefix && '003' text = |JPG Attachments: { rs_stats-jpg_count }| created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_process_and_save_stats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_and_save_stats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gos_stats_to_db( ).
    " This test relies on zcl_gos_query_attachments. For a true unit test,
    " zcl_gos_query_attachments would need to be mocked to return predictable data.
    " Here, we'll use dummy object data.
    DATA(ls_stats) = lo_cut->process_and_save_stats(
                        iv_object_type = 'BUS2000116'
                        iv_object_key  = 'TESTOBJ00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001'
                      ).

    " Since get_attachments will likely return empty for a dummy key,
    " the stats will be 0.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-total_count exp = 0 msg = 'Total count should be 0 for dummy object' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_stats-pdf_count exp = 0 msg = 'PDF count should be 0 for dummy object' ).

    " Verify that insert was attempted (even if 0 records were inserted due to empty stats)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdev_logs_data INTO @DATA(lv_db_count)
      WHERE id LIKE 'TESTO%'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_db_count exp = 3 msg = '3 statistic records should be attempted to insert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Abfrage von GOS-Anlagen mit der Berechnung von Statistiken mittels `REDUCE` und dem Speichern dieser Statistiken in einer Datenbanktabelle mittels `INSERT`. Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen, da er einen Startwert (`INIT`) definiert und diesen iterativ basierend auf den Elementen der internen Tabelle aktualisiert. `COND` wird für bedingte Zuweisungen verwendet, und String-Templates (`|...|`) für die Formatierung der Texte.
keywords: GOS, Attachments, REDUCE, INSERT, Statistik, Datenbank, COND, String Templates

Instructions: Fügen Sie dynamisch einen Datensatz in eine Tabelle ein, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Daten werden ebenfalls dynamisch bereitgestellt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT (lv_table_name) FROM (ls_data)` mit Field Symbols oder dynamischen SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS dynamic_insert
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_id         TYPE numc10
        iv_text       TYPE char100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD dynamic_insert.
    DATA ls_data TYPE zdev_logs_data.

    ls_data-id         = iv_id.
    ls_data-text       = iv_text.
    ls_data-created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ).

    TRY.
        INSERT (iv_table_name) FROM ls_data.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_success = abap_false.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_sql_error).
        " Handle dynamic SQL error, e.g., table not found or structure mismatch
        MESSAGE lx_dyn_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_insert( ).
    DELETE FROM zdev_logs_data WHERE id = '0000000030'.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->dynamic_insert( iv_table_name = 'ZDEV_LOGS_DATA' iv_id = '0000000030' iv_text = 'Dynamic Insert Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Dynamic insert should be successful' ).
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM zdev_logs_data INTO @DATA(ls_check) WHERE id = '0000000030'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'Record should exist after dynamic insert' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Dynamic insert to invalid table should fail' ).

explanation: Dynamisches SQL, wie hier die `INSERT`-Anweisung mit einem variablen Tabellennamen in Klammern, ermöglicht es, den Namen der Zieltabelle zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für generische Funktionen oder Tools. Es ist wichtig, solche Operationen mit `TRY...CATCH` abzusichern, um Laufzeitfehler (z.B. bei ungültigem Tabellennamen) abzufangen. Die Verwendung von Hostvariablen (`@`) ist auch hier Standard.

CLASS zcl_insert_filtered_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item, id TYPE numc10, value TYPE i, active TYPE abap_bool, END OF ty_item.

    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_insert_filtered_itab=>tt_item.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '001' value = 5  active = abap_false ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '002' value = 15 active = abap_true  ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '003' value = 20 active = abap_true  ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '004' value = 8  active = abap_true  ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->insert_filtered_items( it_source_items = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should have 2 filtered items' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-id exp = '002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 2 ]-id exp = '003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_filtered_itab( ).
    DATA lt_source TYPE zcl_insert_filtered_itab=>tt_item.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '005' value = 5  active = abap_false ) TO lt_source.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = '006' value = 10 active = abap_true  ) TO lt_source.

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->insert_filtered_items( it_source_items = lt_source ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_target ) msg = 'Should return empty table if no match' ).

Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode, um Daten zwischen internen Tabellen zu transformieren und zu filtern, ohne explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` Anweisungen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine GOS-Anfrage kapselt und die Ergebnisse in einem benutzerfreundlichen Format zurückgibt, unter Verwendung von Methodenverkettung.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Builder-Pattern-ähnliche Struktur mit Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_attachment_info,
            doc_id      TYPE so_obj_id,
            description TYPE so_obj_des,
            doc_type    TYPE so_obj_tp,
          END OF ty_attachment_info.
    TYPES: tt_attachment_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attachment_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype
        iv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey.

    METHODS with_doc_type_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_doc_type TYPE so_obj_tp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_gos_query_builder.

    METHODS execute
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attachments) TYPE tt_attachment_info.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_object_type TYPE borident-objtype.
    DATA mv_object_key  TYPE borident-objkey.
    DATA mv_doc_type_filter TYPE so_obj_tp.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_object_type = iv_object_type.
    mv_object_key  = iv_object_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD with_doc_type_filter.
    mv_doc_type_filter = iv_doc_type.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute.
    DATA(lo_gos_query) = NEW zcl_gos_query_attachments( ). " Reusing previous class
    DATA(lt_all_attachments) = lo_gos_query->get_attachments(
                                  iv_object_type = mv_object_type
                                  iv_object_key  = mv_object_key
                                ).

    rt_attachments = FILTER #( 
      lt_all_attachments
      WHERE ( mv_doc_type_filter IS INITIAL OR doc_type = mv_doc_type_filter )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_builder_pattern FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_builder_pattern.
    " This test assumes zcl_gos_query_attachments is mocked or returns empty for dummy data.
    " We focus on the builder pattern and filtering logic.
    DATA(lo_builder) = NEW zcl_gos_query_builder(
                          iv_object_type = 'BUS2000116'
                          iv_object_key  = 'DUMMYKEY00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001'
                        ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_pdf) = lo_builder->with_doc_type_filter( 'PDF' )->execute( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered_pdf ) msg = 'Should be empty for dummy data' ).

    " To properly test, zcl_gos_query_attachments would need to be mocked.
    " Example of how it would look with mock data:
    " DATA lt_mock_data TYPE zcl_gos_query_builder=>tt_attachment_info.
    " APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'A' doc_type = 'PDF' ) TO lt_mock_data.
    " APPEND VALUE #( doc_id = 'B' doc_type = 'JPG' ) TO lt_mock_data.
    " ... then mock zcl_gos_query_attachments to return lt_mock_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert ein einfaches Builder-Pattern für GOS-Anfragen. Methoden wie `with_doc_type_filter` geben eine Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`me`) zurück, was die Methodenverkettung (`->method1()->method2()`) ermöglicht. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Fluidität des Codes, insbesondere bei der Konfiguration komplexer Abfragen. Der `FILTER`-Operator wird intern für die Filterung verwendet.
keywords: Object Orientation, GOS, Builder Pattern, Methodenverkettung, FILTER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die ein beliebiges Objekt entgegennimmt und dessen Attribute dynamisch in die Tabelle `ZDEV_LOGS_DATA` einfügt, wobei der Attributname als Text und der Wert als ID (falls konvertierbar) verwendet wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und dynamisches `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_object_attributes
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_object_attributes.
    DATA: lr_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component.

    TRY.
        lr_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( io_object ).
        lt_components = lr_descr->get_components( ).

        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE io_object TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_value>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            DATA(lv_id) TYPE numc10.
            TRY.
                lv_id = <lv_value>.
              CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
                " Cannot convert to NUMC10, use a default or hash
                lv_id = '0000000000'.
            ENDTRY.

            DATA(ls_log_data) = VALUE zdev_logs_data(
              id        = lv_id
              text      = |{ ls_component-name }: { <lv_value> }|
              created_at = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( )
            ).
            INSERT zdev_logs_data FROM ls_log_data.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              rv_count = rv_count + 1.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_move_cast_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        " Handle error if io_object is not a structure or cannot be described
        MESSAGE 'Invalid object type for RTTI' TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_rtti_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_rtti_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_insert( ).

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
            field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
            field2 TYPE i VALUE 123,
            field3 TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true,
          END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA ls_test_data TYPE ty_test_struct.
    ls_test_data-field1 = 'World'.
    ls_test_data-field2 = 456.

    DELETE FROM zdev_logs_data WHERE id = '0000000000' OR id = '123' OR id = '456'.

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->insert_object_attributes( REF #( ls_test_data ) ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 3 msg = 'Should insert 3 attributes' ).
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM zdev_logs_data INTO @DATA(lv_db_count)
      WHERE text LIKE 'FIELD%'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_db_count exp = 3 msg = '3 records should be found in DB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) über `cl_abap_typedescr` und `cl_abap_structdescr`, um die Komponenten eines Objekts zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln. Mit Field Symbols (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`) kann dynamisch auf die Werte der Attribute zugegriffen werden. Die Werte werden dann in die Datenbanktabelle `ZDEV_LOGS_DATA` eingefügt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept für generische Datenverarbeitung und Metaprogrammierung.
keywords: RTTI, Object Orientation, Dynamic Programming, Field Symbols, INSERT, cl_abap_typedescr, cl_abap_structdescr

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine potenzielle GOS-Fehlersituation simuliert und diese mit modernen `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcken abfängt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_gos_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling_gos DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_gos_error
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling_gos IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_gos_error.
    DATA: ls_borident TYPE borident.

    IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
      " Simulate an error by passing invalid object data to a GOS function
      " (e.g., an empty object key which might cause an error in some GOS functions)
      ls_borident-objtype = 'INVALID_TYPE'.
      ls_borident-objkey  = ''.
    ELSE.
      ls_borident-objtype = 'BUS2000116'.
      ls_borident-objkey  = '00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        " We call a GOS function that might raise cx_gos_error
        " For simulation, we'll just raise it directly if iv_trigger_error is true
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gos_error EXPORTING textid = cx_gos_error=>invalid_object_type.
        ENDIF.

        " Normal GOS call (e.g., query_attachments) would go here
        " cl_gos_attachment_query=>query_attachments( EXPORTING is_object = ls_borident IMPORTING et_links = DATA(lt_links) ).
        rv_error_message = 'No error occurred.'.

      CATCH cx_gos_error INTO DATA(lx_gos_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_gos_error->get_text( ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_error_message = lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_gos( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->simulate_gos_error( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'No error occurred.' msg = 'Should not have an error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_error_handling_gos( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->simulate_gos_error( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_message msg = 'Should return an error message' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Invalid object type' msg = 'Error message should indicate invalid object type' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP erfolgt über `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke. Spezifische Ausnahmen wie `cx_gos_error` können abgefangen werden, um auf GOS-spezifische Probleme zu reagieren. Ein generischer `CATCH cx_root` fängt alle anderen Ausnahmen ab. Dies sorgt für robuste Anwendungen und eine klare Trennung von Fehlerbehandlungslogik.
keywords: Error Handling, TRY-CATCH, Exceptions, GOS, cx_gos_error

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen UTC-Zeitstempel und formatieren Sie ihn für die Anzeige.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp()` und `cl_abap_tstmp=>utctolocaltimestamp()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timestamp_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_timestamp
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_timestamp) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timestamp_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_utc_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utctimestamp( ).
    DATA(lv_local_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>utctolocaltimestamp( utc_tstmp = lv_utc_timestamp ).

    DATA(lv_date) TYPE sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time) TYPE sy-uzeit.
    CONVERT TIME STAMP lv_local_timestamp INTO DATE lv_date TIME lv_time.

    rv_formatted_timestamp = |Datum: { lv_date DATE = USER }, Uhrzeit: { lv_time TIME = USER }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_formatted_timestamp FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_formatted_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timestamp_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_formatted_timestamp( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result msg = 'Formatted timestamp should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Datum:' msg = 'Result should contain "Datum:"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Uhrzeit:' msg = 'Result should contain "Uhrzeit:"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp` bietet statische Methoden zur einfachen Handhabung von Zeitstempeln, einschließlich der Umwandlung zwischen UTC und lokaler Zeit. Die Formatierung von Datum und Uhrzeit in String-Templates mit `DATE = USER` und `TIME = USER` ist eine moderne und benutzerfreundliche Methode, um Werte gemäß den Benutzereinstellungen anzuzeigen.
keywords: Date/Time, Timestamp, cl_abap_tstmp, String Templates, Formatierung

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie den Preis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle um 10%.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` für effiziente In-Place-Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjust DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS adjust_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_adjust IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_flight_prices.
    rt_adjusted_flights = it_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    LOOP AT rt_adjusted_flights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price * '1.10'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_price_adjustment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_adjustment.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_adjust( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_price_adjust=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->adjust_flight_prices( lt_test_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Price for flight 1 not adjusted correctly' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '220.00' msg = 'Price for flight 2 not adjusted correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS>` ermöglicht die direkte Modifikation von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle ohne die Notwendigkeit einer expliziten `MODIFY` Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und effizienter macht. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_cut)`) sind ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, LOOP, Internal Tables, Modification, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld einer Struktur zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist, und geben Sie dessen Wert als String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.

    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data       TYPE ty_sflight_simple
        iv_component  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_struct_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_value>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      rv_value = 'Component not found'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_access FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_component_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_struct_access=>ty_sflight_simple(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ).

    DATA(lv_carrid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_flight iv_component = 'CARRID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'CARRID not accessed correctly' ).

    DATA(lv_price) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_flight iv_component = 'PRICE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_price exp = '100.00' msg = 'PRICE not accessed correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_component_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_struct_access( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_struct_access=>ty_sflight_simple(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' ).

    DATA(lv_invalid) = lo_cut->get_component_value( is_data = ls_flight iv_component = 'INVALID_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_invalid exp = 'Component not found' msg = 'Invalid component not handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Feldzugriff mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für generische Programmierung. Es erlaubt den Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten, deren Namen erst zur Laufzeit bekannt sind, was die Flexibilität des Codes erhöht. Der Wert des Feld-Symbols kann dann direkt zugewiesen werden.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, ASSIGN COMPONENT, Structure, Generic

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flüge aus `sflights` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren und die Daten zu verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `PACKAGE SIZE` mit `INTO TABLE` und verarbeiten Sie die Daten in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_package_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_processed) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_package_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_processed_count TYPE i.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_package) PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.

      " Process each package
      lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + lines( lt_package ).
      " Example: Log or further process lt_package
      " cl_demo_output=>display( |Processed { lines( lt_package ) } flights in this package.| ).

    ENDSELECT.

    rv_total_processed = lv_processed_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_total_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( iv_package_size = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = sy-subrc msg = 'SELECT failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_processed msg = 'No flights processed' ).
    " Further assertions could check if the count is reasonable for sflights table
    " (e.g., if it's greater than a known minimum number of entries).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `SELECT ... INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE` Syntax ist ideal für die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen, da sie die Daten in kleineren Blöcken liest und so den Speicherverbrauch reduziert. Die Inline-Deklaration `@DATA(lt_package)` macht den Code sauberer. Dies ist ein wichtiges Performance-Feature für Datenbankzugriffe.
keywords: INTO TABLE, SELECT, PACKAGE SIZE, Large Data, Performance

Instructions: Suchen Sie einen spezifischen Flug in einer internen Tabelle anhand von Schlüsselfeldern und modifizieren Sie ihn direkt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `READ TABLE ... WITH KEY ... ASSIGNING <FS>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_read_modify_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flight_price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid  TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_modified) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_read_modify_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_flight> TYPE ty_sflight.

    READ TABLE ct_flights WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_flight>-price = iv_new_price.
      rv_modified = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_modified = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_modify_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_modify_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_read_modify_flight=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_cut->modify_flight_price(
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '150.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified exp = abap_true msg = 'Flight should have been modified' ).
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' INTO DATA(ls_modified_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_modified_flight-price exp = '150.00' msg = 'Price not updated correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_read_modify_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_read_modify_flight=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_modified) = lo_cut->modify_flight_price(
      CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights
      IMPORTING iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '0001' iv_new_price = '300.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_modified exp = abap_false msg = 'Non-existent flight should not be modified' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING <FS>` ermöglicht den direkten Zugriff auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle über ein Feld-Symbol. Dies ist die effizienteste Methode, um eine Zeile zu finden und in-place zu modifizieren, da keine Daten kopiert werden müssen. `sy-subrc` wird verwendet, um den Erfolg des Lesevorgangs zu überprüfen.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, READ TABLE, Internal Tables, Modification, Key Access

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Flugdaten nach Fluggesellschaft und Währung, um die Gesamtpreise zu summieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COLLECT` mit einer internen Tabelle, die die Aggregationsfelder als Schlüssel hat.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_aggregated_flight.
    TYPES: tt_aggregated_flight TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_aggregated_flight
                                 WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid currency.

    METHODS aggregate_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_aggregated_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flight_prices.
    DATA: ls_aggregated_line TYPE ty_aggregated_flight.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      ls_aggregated_line-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_aggregated_line-currency = ls_flight-currency.
      ls_aggregated_line-total_price = ls_flight-price.
      COLLECT ls_aggregated_line INTO rt_aggregated_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_aggregator=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' price = '50.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251202' price = '75.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_flight_prices( lt_test_flights ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' currency = 'EUR' INTO DATA(ls_lh_eur).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_eur-total_price exp = '150.00' msg = 'LH EUR aggregation incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' currency = 'USD' INTO DATA(ls_aa_usd).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_usd-total_price exp = '200.00' msg = 'AA USD aggregation incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' currency = 'USD' INTO DATA(ls_lh_usd).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_usd-total_price exp = '75.00' msg = 'LH USD aggregation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `COLLECT ... INTO TABLE` ist eine spezielle Anweisung, die Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle aggregiert. Wenn eine Zeile mit denselben Schlüsselfeldern (definiert durch den Tabellentyp oder die Standardtabelle mit Schlüsseln) bereits existiert, werden numerische Felder addiert; andernfalls wird eine neue Zeile eingefügt. Dies ist sehr effizient für einfache Aggregationen.
keywords: INTO TABLE, COLLECT, Aggregation, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die eine beliebige interne Tabelle als Parameter akzeptiert und die Anzahl der Zeilen zurückgibt.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den Parameter als `TYPE ANY TABLE` und verwenden Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_table_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_line_count
      IMPORTING
        it_any_table TYPE any table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_line_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_table_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_line_count.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any_table> TYPE any table.

    ASSIGN it_any_table TO <fs_any_table>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_line_count = lines( <fs_any_table> ).
    ELSE.
      rv_line_count = 0. " Should not happen if parameter is always a table
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie die Zeilen einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle an einer bestimmten Position ein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_merger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS merge_tables_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
        iv_insert_index   TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_merger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD merge_tables_at_index.
    INSERT LINES OF it_source_flights INTO TABLE ct_target_flights INDEX iv_insert_index.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_insert_at_middle FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_at_beginning FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_at_middle.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_table_merger=>tt_sflight_key(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 4 msg = 'Total lines incorrect' ).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_line1).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_line2).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 3 INTO DATA(ls_line3).
    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 4 INTO DATA(ls_line4).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line1-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line2-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line3-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_line4-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_table_merger=>tt_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_merger=>tt_sflight_key(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )

    lo_cut->merge_tables_at_index( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_insert_index = 1 CHANGING ct_target_flights = lt_target ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_merger( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_table_merger=>tt_sflight_key(

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_table_merger=>tt_sflight_key(

    lo_cut->merge_tables_at_index( it_source_flights = lt_source iv_insert_index = 0 CHANGING ct_target_flights = lt_target ). " Index 0 or lines(target)+1 for end

explanation: `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...` ist eine effiziente Methode, um den Inhalt einer internen Tabelle in eine andere einzufügen. Die `INDEX`-Option ermöglicht die präzise Steuerung der Einfügeposition. Dies ist nützlich für das Zusammenführen von Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen.
keywords: INTO TABLE, INSERT LINES OF, Internal Tables, Merging

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf bestimmten Feldern.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst und verwenden Sie dann `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_dup,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_dup.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_dup TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_dup WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_dup.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_remove_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid fldate.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid connid fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_partial_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight_dup(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '110.00' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '210.00' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251202' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Incorrect line count after removing duplicates' ).
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'First duplicate not removed correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight_dup(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_test_flights ).

    lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines msg = 'Lines changed when no duplicates' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_partial_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_remove_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_remove_duplicates=>tt_sflight_dup(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251202' price = '110.00' ) " Not a duplicate for all fields
    ).
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( lt_test_flights ).

    lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_flights ) exp = lv_initial_lines msg = 'Lines changed for partial duplicates' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine leistungsstarke Anweisung zum Entfernen von Duplikaten. Es ist entscheidend, die Tabelle vorher nach den Feldern zu sortieren, die für die Duplikatsprüfung relevant sind, da die Anweisung nur *aufeinanderfolgende* Duplikate entfernt. Die `COMPARING`-Klausel ermöglicht die Angabe der Felder, die für den Vergleich herangezogen werden sollen.
keywords: Internal Tables, Duplicates, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Sorting

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur bestimmte Felder aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, und transformieren Sie dabei einen Wert (z.B. Preis verdoppeln).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_transformed_flight,
             airline  TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_nr TYPE s_conn_id,
             doubled_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_transformed_flight.
    TYPES: tt_transformed_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_transformed_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_transformed_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                      ( airline       = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                        flight_nr     = <fs_flight>-connid

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis in einer internen Tabelle und geben Sie dessen Details zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_max_price
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_max_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_price.
    IF it_flights IS INITIAL.
      CLEAR rs_max_flight.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rs_max_flight = REDUCE #( INIT result = VALUE ty_sflight( ) " Initialize with a dummy value or first element
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                 NEXT result = COND ty_sflight(
                                   WHEN <fs_flight>-price > result-price THEN <fs_flight>
                                   ELSE result ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' currency = 'GBP' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_max_flight-price exp = '300.00' msg = 'Incorrect price for max price flight' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_flight.

    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_max_price=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
