explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ab ABAP 7.50) ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen. In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um iterativ den Flug mit dem höchsten Preis zu finden. `INIT` initialisiert das Ergebnis, und die `FOR` Schleife mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` durchläuft die Tabelle. `COND` wird verwendet, um bedingt den aktuellen Flug oder das bisherige Ergebnis zuzuweisen, was den Code sehr kompakt und funktional macht.
keywords: REDUCE, FIELD SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional

CLASS zcl_flight_conditional_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_high_price_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count_processed) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_conditional_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_high_price_flights.
    DATA: lv_processed_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE price > iv_min_price.
      " Example action: Increase price by a fixed amount
      <fs_flight>-price = <fs_flight>-price + '10.00'.
      lv_processed_count = lv_processed_count + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_count_processed = lv_processed_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' ) " Above min
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20251202' price = '300.00' currency = 'GBP' ) " Above min
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 2 msg = 'Incorrect number of flights processed' ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '100.00' msg = 'Flight 1 price should not change' ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '260.00' msg = 'Flight 2 price not adjusted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_conditional_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_conditional_loop=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_high_price_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price = '500.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 0 msg = 'No flights should be processed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_process_all_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_conditional_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_flight_conditional_loop=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_high_price_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_flights IMPORTING iv_min_price = '50.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 2 msg = 'All flights should be processed' ).
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '110.00' msg = 'Flight 1 price not adjusted' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <FS> WHERE ...` Syntax ist eine sehr effiziente Methode, um über Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu iterieren und diese direkt zu modifizieren, wenn sie eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen. Das `WHERE`-Kriterium wird direkt auf die Tabelle angewendet, was die Performance verbessert, da nicht alle Zeilen in den Arbeitsbereich kopiert werden müssen. Das Feld-Symbol ermöglicht die direkte In-Place-Modifikation.
keywords: FIELD SYMBOLS, LOOP, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Modification

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflight

      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_DYN' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_dynamic_fieldcatalog( it_data = lt_sflights it_selected_fields = it_selected_fields ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid )
          i_structure_name              = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = lt_sflights.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
        EXPORTING
          i_ready_for_input = 0.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_DYN'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dynamic_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.
    DATA: lv_col_pos TYPE i VALUE 1.

    LOOP AT it_selected_fields INTO DATA(lv_field).
      CLEAR ls_fcat.
      ls_fcat-fieldname = lv_field.
      ls_fcat-coltext   = lv_field.
      ls_fcat-col_pos   = lv_col_pos.
      APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
      lv_col_pos = lv_col_pos + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten, basierend auf einer Kombination von Feldern (z.B. 'CARRID' und 'CONNID'), und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit `FOR` und `GROUP BY`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... GROUP BY` mit `VALUE` und `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_group_delete_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_group_delete_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_flights
                                  GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid connid = flight-connid )
                                  WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                  ( CORRESPONDING #( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_tab_group_delete_dup=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_group_delete_dup( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY ... WITHOUT MEMBERS` und `VALUE` ist eine sehr moderne und leistungsstarke Methode, um Duplikate zu entfernen oder Aggregationen durchzuführen. `WITHOUT MEMBERS` stellt sicher, dass nur ein Eintrag pro Gruppe in die neue Tabelle übernommen wird, was effektiv Duplikate basierend auf den Gruppierungskriterien entfernt.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, FOR, GROUP BY, VALUE, Duplicates, Functional Programming

Instructions: Zeigen Sie in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` eine aggregierte Ansicht der Flugdaten an, z.B. die Gesamtzahl der Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft, berechnet mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Daten vorzubereiten und dann im ALV anzuzeigen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_aggregate DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw,
           tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_seats,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_seats,
           tt_carr_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_aggregated_seats.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS create_alv_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_carr_seats
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_aggregate IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_aggregated_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE zcl_alv_reduce_aggregate=>tt_carr_seats(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_alv_reduce_aggregate=>tt_carr_seats( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      GROUP BY flight-carrid
      ASCENDING
      ( LET total_seats_for_carrid = REDUCE i(
            INIT s = 0
            FOR member IN GROUP flight
            NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc )
        IN
        APPEND VALUE #( carrid = flight-carrid total_seats = total_seats_for_carrid ) TO result ) ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_AGG' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_alv_fieldcatalog( lt_aggregated_data ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid )
          i_structure_name              = 'ZCL_ALV_REDUCE_AGGREGATE=>TY_CARR_SEATS'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = lt_aggregated_data.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
        EXPORTING
          i_ready_for_input = 0.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_AGG'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Airline'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'TOTAL_SEATS'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Total Occupied Seats'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregated_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregated_display.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_aggregate( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_aggregated_seats( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No dump during aggregated ALV setup' ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Dump occurred during aggregated ALV setup' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator in Kombination mit `FOR GROUPS OF` ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und performante Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze pro Fluggesellschaft berechnet. Die resultierende aggregierte Tabelle wird dann im `cl_gui_alv_grid` angezeigt. Dies ist ein hervorragendes Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in ABAP.
keywords: ALV, cl_gui_alv_grid, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Table, FOR GROUPS OF, Functional Programming, SLIS

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge außer einem spezifischen Flug (identifiziert durch Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer) enthält, indem Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `COND` verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... COND ... )` in Kombination mit `LINE_EXISTS`.

CLASS zcl_tab_cond_delete DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tab_cond_delete IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_alv_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_formatted_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights_raw TYPE tt_sflight_raw.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_raw
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_sflights_formatted) = VALUE tt_sflight_formatted(
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( flight_info = |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid }|
        fldate      = flight-fldate
        price       = flight-price
        currency    = flight-currency ) ).

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_STR' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_alv_fieldcatalog( lt_sflights_formatted ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid )
          i_structure_name              = 'ZCL_ALV_STRING_TEMPLATE=>TY_SFLIGHT_FORMATTED'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = lt_sflights_formatted.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
        EXPORTING
          i_ready_for_input = 0.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_STR'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLIGHT_INFO'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Flight Info'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Flight Date'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Price'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'.
    ls_fcat-coltext   = 'Currency'.
    APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle, bei denen der Preis unter einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt, und verwenden Sie dabei `DELETE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE itab FROM LINE_INDEX( ... )` in Kombination mit `FOR` oder `DELETE itab WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_delete_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_low_price_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_delete_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_low_price_flights.
    " While FOR is great for constructing new tables, direct DELETE WHERE is often simpler for in-place modification.
    " To demonstrate a 'DELETE' with a FOR-like logic, we can use a temporary table or a direct DELETE WHERE.
    " For modern ABAP, FILTER is preferred for new tables, DELETE WHERE for in-place.
    " If the requirement strictly implies 'FOR' for deletion, it's usually for building a new table.
    " Let's stick to the spirit of 'DELETE' and use DELETE WHERE, as it's the most direct 'deletion' operation.
    DELETE ct_flights WHERE price < iv_min_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_delete_low_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_low_price.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_tab_delete_for=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '100'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '50'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0401'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = '200'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_for( ).
    lo_cut->delete_low_price_flights( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_test_data IMPORTING iv_min_price = '100' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_test_data ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_test_data[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0401' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl die Anweisung nach einem `FOR`-Ausdruck fragte, ist für das direkte Löschen von Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle die `DELETE itab WHERE ...`-Anweisung die idiomatischste und effizienteste Lösung in modernem ABAP. `FOR`-Ausdrücke werden typischerweise verwendet, um *neue* Tabellen zu konstruieren, nicht um bestehende in-place zu modifizieren. Die gewählte Lösung ist klar und performant.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, WHERE, Price

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid`, um Details des ausgewählten Fluges anzuzeigen.
hint: Registrieren Sie ein Ereignis für `cl_gui_alv_grid` und implementieren Sie die Methode `handle_double_click`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_with_events.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_alv.

    METHODS create_alv_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_alv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_with_events.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_EVT' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_alv_fieldcatalog( mt_sflights ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid )
          i_structure_name              = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = mt_sflights.

      SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_EVT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Price'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Currency'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: ls_selected_row TYPE ty_sflight_alv.
    READ TABLE mt_sflights INDEX e_row INTO ls_selected_row.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE |Flight { ls_selected_row-carrid } { ls_selected_row-connid } on { ls_selected_row-fldate } selected!|
              TYPE 'I' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Zeilen aus einer internen Tabelle, die in einer anderen 'Blacklist'-Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind, unter Verwendung von `DELETE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck und `LINE_EXISTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS( ... ) )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_delete_blacklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,
           tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: ty_blacklist_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_by_blacklist
      IMPORTING
        it_flights        TYPE tt_sflight
        it_blacklist_carrid TYPE ty_blacklist_carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_delete_blacklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_by_blacklist.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_flights
                                   WHERE NOT LINE_EXISTS( it_blacklist_carrid[ table_line = flight-carrid ] )
                                   ( flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_blacklist.
    DATA: lt_test_data TYPE zcl_tab_delete_blacklist=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_test_data ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0018'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum.

    DATA(lt_blacklist) = VALUE zcl_tab_delete_blacklist=>ty_blacklist_carrid( ( 'LH' ) ( 'UA' ) ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_blacklist( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_by_blacklist( it_flights = lt_test_data it_blacklist_carrid = lt_blacklist ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert eine leistungsstarke Kombination aus `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und `LINE_EXISTS` mit einer `WHERE NOT`-Bedingung, um Elemente aus einer Tabelle zu 'löschen', die in einer anderen Tabelle (der Blacklist) vorhanden sind. `LINE_EXISTS` ist eine moderne und performante Art, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, insbesondere bei Tabellen mit einem definierten Schlüssel.
keywords: DELETE, Internal Table, Blacklist, LINE_EXISTS, VALUE, FOR, Functional Programming

Instructions: Passen Sie die Layout-Variante eines `cl_gui_alv_grid` dynamisch an, um eine vordefinierte Ansicht zu laden oder zu speichern.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Parameter `is_variant` und `i_save` in `set_table_for_first_display`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_layout_variant DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_variant
      IMPORTING
        iv_variant_name TYPE slis_vari-variant DEFAULT 'DEFAULT'
        iv_save_variant TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.

    METHODS create_alv_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_alv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_layout_variant IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_variant.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_alv.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_VAR' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(ls_variant) = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid variant = iv_variant_name ).
      DATA(lv_save) = COND i( WHEN iv_save_variant = abap_true THEN 'A' ELSE '' ). " 'A' for all users, 'U' for user-specific

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_alv_fieldcatalog( lt_sflights ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = ls_variant
          i_save                        = lv_save
          i_structure_name              = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = lt_sflights.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
        EXPORTING
          i_ready_for_input = 0.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_VAR'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Price'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Currency'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine clientseitige Filterung in einem `cl_gui_alv_grid` basierend auf einem Benutzereingabewert (z.B. Fluggesellschaft).
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `set_filter_criteria` des `cl_gui_alv_grid`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_client_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_alv,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_alv,
           tt_sflight_alv TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_alv WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_alv_with_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_alv.

    METHODS create_alv_fieldcatalog
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE tt_sflight_alv
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_fieldcat) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_client_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_filter.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @mt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      IF mo_custom_container IS INITIAL.
        mo_custom_container = NEW cl_gui_custom_container( container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER_FIL' ).
      ENDIF.

      IF mo_alv_grid IS INITIAL.
        mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = mo_custom_container ).
      ENDIF.

      DATA(lt_fieldcat) = create_alv_fieldcatalog( mt_sflights ).

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          is_variant                    = VALUE slis_vari( report = sy-repid )
          i_structure_name              = 'SFLIGHT'
          it_fieldcatalog               = lt_fieldcat
        CHANGING
          it_outtab                     = mt_sflights.

      IF iv_filter_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
        DATA(lt_filter_criteria) = VALUE lvc_t_filt(
          ( fieldname = 'CARRID' sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' value = iv_filter_carrid ) ).
        CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_filter_criteria
          EXPORTING
            it_filter_criteria = lt_filter_criteria.
      ENDIF.

      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_ready_for_input
        EXPORTING
          i_ready_for_input = 0.

      CALL SCREEN 100 STARTING NEW TASK 'ALV_SCREEN_FIL'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_alv_fieldcatalog.
    DATA: ls_fcat TYPE lvc_s_fcat.

    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CARRID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Airline'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CONNID'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight No.'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'FLDATE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Flight Date'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'PRICE'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Price'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
    ls_fcat-fieldname = 'CURRENCY'. ls_fcat-coltext = 'Currency'. APPEND ls_fcat TO rt_fieldcat.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_img_filetype_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_file_paths TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_file_types TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_file_types
      IMPORTING
        it_file_paths TYPE tt_file_paths
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_file_types) TYPE tt_file_types.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_filetype_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_file_types.
    rt_file_types = VALUE #( FOR lv_path IN it_file_paths
                               LET lv_dot_pos = find( val = lv_path sub = '.' occ = -1 )
                               IN
                               ( COND string( WHEN lv_dot_pos > 0 THEN substring( val = lv_path off = lv_dot_pos + 1 ) ELSE '' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtgröße aller Bilder in einer Liste von Bildmetadaten, die vom `cl_fxs_image_processor` verarbeitet werden sollen. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_img_size_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_metadata,
             file_name TYPE string,
             size_kb   TYPE i,
             file_type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_image_metadata,
           tt_image_metadata TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_metadata WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_size
      IMPORTING
        it_metadata TYPE tt_image_metadata
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_size_kb) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_size_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_size.
    rv_total_size_kb = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                 FOR ls_meta IN it_metadata
                                 NEXT sum = sum + ls_meta-size_kb ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen, um eine Reihe von Operationen auf einem Bildobjekt zu simulieren, das vom `cl_fxs_image_processor` verarbeitet wird. Implementieren Sie Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.

CLASS zcl_img_fluent_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_image_state TYPE string READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.

    METHODS resize
      IMPORTING
        iv_width  TYPE i
        iv_height TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_img_fluent_processor.

    METHODS apply_filter
      IMPORTING
        iv_filter_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_img_fluent_processor.

    METHODS save
      IMPORTING
        iv_path TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_img_fluent_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_img_fluent_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_image_state = 'Initial'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD resize.
    mv_image_state = |{ mv_image_state } -> Resized to { iv_width }x{ iv_height }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_filter.
    mv_image_state = |{ mv_image_state } -> Filter '{ iv_filter_type }' applied|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD save.
    mv_image_state = |{ mv_image_state } -> Saved to { iv_path }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_img_fluent_processor( ).

    lo_processor->resize( iv_width = 800 iv_height = 600 )
                 ->apply_filter( iv_filter_type = 'Grayscale' )
                 ->save( iv_path = '/tmp/output.jpg' ).

    DATA(lv_expected_state) = 'Initial -> Resized to 800x600 -> Filter ''Grayscale'' applied -> Saved to /tmp/output.jpg'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_processor->mv_image_state exp = lv_expected_state ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (oder Fluent Interface) ist ein Designmuster, das die Lesbarkeit von Code verbessert, indem es ermöglicht, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode `ME` (eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Instanz) zurückgibt. Dies ist eine moderne Praxis in der objektorientierten Programmierung, die seit ABAP 7.55 durch verbesserte Syntax noch flüssiger wird.
keywords: cl_fxs_image_processor, Object Orientation, Method Chaining, Fluent Interface

INTERFACE zif_viewer_command.

CLASS lcl_zoom_command DEFINITION FINAL.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_viewer_command_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        io_command_object TYPE REF TO zif_viewer_command
        iv_method_name    TYPE string
        iv_parameter      TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_viewer_command_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_param> TYPE any.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter  TYPE abap_parmbind.

    ls_parameter-name = 'IV_COMMAND_PARAM'.
    GET REFERENCE OF iv_parameter INTO ls_parameter-value.
    APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.

    CALL METHOD io_command_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_dynamic_caller( ).

    " This will write to the output, which is hard to assert in unit tests directly.
    " For a real scenario, the command object would have a state to check.
    lo_cut->call_viewer_command_dynamic( io_command_object = lo_zoom_cmd
                                         iv_method_name    = 'ZIF_VIEWER_COMMAND~EXECUTE_COMMAND'
                                         iv_parameter      = '1.8' ).

    " Asserting the internal state of the command object if it were to change.
    " For this example, we assert the constructor parameter.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_zoom_cmd->mv_zoom_level exp = '2.0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE s_price = 0
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflights

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppiere Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf ihrem Preis in Kategorien: 'Budget' (< 200), 'Standard' (200-500), 'Premium' (> 500).
hint: Nutze `FOR ... GROUP BY` und einen `SWITCH` Ausdruck für die Gruppierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             price_category TYPE string,
             flights        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights,
             total_price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_group.

    CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS group_flights_by_price
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_groups = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                                GROUP BY ( price_category = SWITCH #( flight-price
                                                                      WHEN BETWEEN 0 AND 199.99 THEN 'Budget'
                                                                      WHEN BETWEEN 200 AND 500 THEN 'Standard'
                                                                      ELSE 'Premium' ) )
                                ( price_category = CORRESPONDING #( flight )->price_category
                                  flights        = VALUE #( FOR member IN GROUP ( member ) ( member ) )
                                  total_price    = REDUCE #( INIT sum_price TYPE s_price = 0
                                                             FOR member IN GROUP ( member )
                                                             NEXT sum_price = sum_price + member-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping_logic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping_logic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_price( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_groups ) > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_budget_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_standard_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA(lv_premium_found) TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_groups INTO DATA(ls_group).
      IF ls_group-price_category = 'Budget'.
        lv_budget_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_group-total_price >= 0 ).
      ELSEIF ls_group-price_category = 'Standard'.
        lv_standard_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_group-total_price >= 0 ).
      ELSEIF ls_group-price_category = 'Premium'.
        lv_premium_found = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_group-total_price >= 0 ).
      ENDIF.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( ls_group-flights ) > 0 ).
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_budget_found OR lv_standard_found OR lv_premium_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR ... GROUP BY` (ABAP 7.40) und dem `SWITCH` Ausdruck (ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht eine sehr mächtige und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Anstatt manuell zu schleifen und zu aggregieren, wird die gesamte Logik in einem Ausdruck zusammengefasst, was den Code extrem kompakt und effizient macht.
keywords: FOR GROUPS OF, GROUP BY, SWITCH, Internal Tables, Grouping, NUMBER, CASE

Instructions: Implementiere eine Methode, die einen Wert basierend auf dem Inhalt eines dynamisch übergebenen Feldes und einer Liste von Bedingungen zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und eine `LOOP` über Bedingungen, um ein `CASE`-ähnliches Verhalten zu simulieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_condition,
             value TYPE string,
             result TYPE string,
           END OF ty_condition.
    TYPES tt_conditions TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_condition WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_result
      IMPORTING
        is_data      TYPE any
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        it_conditions TYPE tt_conditions
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_result.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_result = 'Feld nicht gefunden'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_conditions INTO DATA(ls_condition).
      IF <fs_field> = ls_condition-value.
        rv_result = ls_condition-result.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_result = 'Keine Bedingung erfüllt'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_case_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_case_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_case_field_missing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_case_found.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            status TYPE string VALUE 'ACTIVE',
            value  TYPE i      VALUE 10,
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA lt_conditions TYPE zcl_dynamic_case=>tt_conditions.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_conditions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cond>).
    <fs_cond>-value = 'ACTIVE'.
    <fs_cond>-result = 'Status ist Aktiv'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_conditions ASSIGNING <fs_cond>.
    <fs_cond>-value = 'INACTIVE'.
    <fs_cond>-result = 'Status ist Inaktiv'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_case( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_result(
      is_data       = ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'STATUS'
      it_conditions = lt_conditions
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Status ist Aktiv' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_case_not_found.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            status TYPE string VALUE 'PENDING',
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA lt_conditions TYPE zcl_dynamic_case=>tt_conditions.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_conditions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cond>).
    <fs_cond>-value = 'ACTIVE'.
    <fs_cond>-result = 'Status ist Aktiv'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_case( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_result(
      is_data       = ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'STATUS'
      it_conditions = lt_conditions
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Keine Bedingung erfüllt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_case_field_missing.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            status TYPE string VALUE 'ACTIVE',
          END OF ls_data.
    DATA lt_conditions TYPE zcl_dynamic_case=>tt_conditions.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_conditions ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cond>).
    <fs_cond>-value = 'ACTIVE'.
    <fs_cond>-result = 'Status ist Aktiv'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_case( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_result(
      is_data       = ls_data
      iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'
      it_conditions = lt_conditions
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Feld nicht gefunden' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert dynamische Programmierung mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und einer `LOOP` über Bedingungen, um ein `CASE`-ähnliches Verhalten für ein zur Laufzeit bestimmtes Feld zu erreichen. Obwohl kein direkter `CASE`-Ausdruck verwendet wird, simuliert es die Logik dynamisch. Dies ist nützlich, wenn die zu prüfenden Felder und Bedingungen nicht zur Kompilierzeit bekannt sind.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CASE, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_flight_average DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_average IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` den Flugpreis um 10% erhöht.
hint: Nutze den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` Schleife.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_markup,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             markup_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_with_markup.
    TYPES tt_flights_with_markup TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_markup WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_flight_markup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS add_price_markup
          IMPORTING
            iv_markup_percent TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flights_with_markup) TYPE tt_flights_with_markup.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_markup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_price_markup.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights_with_markup = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid       = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid       = ls_flight-connid
                                        fldate       = ls_flight-fldate
                                        price        = ls_flight-price
                                        markup_price = ls_flight-price * ( 1 + iv_markup_percent / 100 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_markup_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_markup( ).
    DATA(lt_marked_up) = lo_cut->add_price_markup( 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_marked_up ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_marked_up INTO DATA(ls_flight_markup).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight_markup-markup_price
        exp = ls_flight_markup-price * 1.10
        delta = '0.01'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_markup_zero_percent.

Instructions: Bestimme den Typ eines Objekts zur Laufzeit und gib eine entsprechende Beschreibung zurück.
hint: Nutze den `SWITCH` Ausdruck mit `TYPE OF`.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
      METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
    ENDINTERFACE.

    CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_shape.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE i.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_radius TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_radius = iv_radius.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
        rv_desc = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_square DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES zif_shape.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_side TYPE i.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA mv_side TYPE i.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_square IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        mv_side = iv_side.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
        rv_desc = |Quadrat mit Seitenlänge { mv_side }|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_object_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS analyze_object
          IMPORTING
            io_object TYPE REF TO object
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_type_description) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_object_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD analyze_object.
    rv_type_description = SWITCH #( io_object
                                    WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN |Es ist ein Kreis: { CAST zif_shape( io_object )->get_description( ) }|
                                    WHEN TYPE zcl_square THEN |Es ist ein Quadrat: { CAST zif_shape( io_object )->get_description( ) }|
                                    WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unbekannter Objekttyp' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle aus `sflights`, in der der Preis für Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft verdoppelt wird, ansonsten bleibt er gleich.
hint: Nutze `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `COND` für die bedingte Preisberechnung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_adjusted,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             adjusted_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_adjusted.
    TYPES tt_flights_adjusted TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_adjusted WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_flight_adjuster DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS adjust_prices_by_carrier
          IMPORTING
            iv_target_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_adjusted_flights) TYPE tt_flights_adjusted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_adjuster IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD adjust_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_adjusted_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   ( carrid         = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid         = ls_flight-connid
                                     fldate         = ls_flight-fldate
                                     price          = ls_flight-price
                                     adjusted_price = COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_target_carrid
                                                              THEN ls_flight-price * 2
                                                              ELSE ls_flight-price ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_price_adjustment FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_price_no_adjustment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_price_adjustment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_adjuster( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->adjust_prices_by_carrier( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_adjusted ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_adjusted INTO DATA(ls_flight_adj).
      IF ls_flight_adj-carrid = 'LH'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_adj-adjusted_price exp = ls_flight_adj-price * 2 ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_adj-adjusted_price exp = ls_flight_adj-price ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_price_no_adjustment.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_adjuster( ).
    DATA(lt_adjusted) = lo_cut->adjust_prices_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_adjusted ) > 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_adjusted INTO DATA(ls_flight_adj).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_adj-adjusted_price exp = ls_flight_adj-price ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination des `VALUE` Operators mit einer `FOR` Schleife und dem `COND` Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50) ermöglicht eine sehr elegante und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Bedingte Logik zur Berechnung neuer numerischer Werte kann direkt in den Ausdruck integriert werden, was den Code extrem prägnant und lesbar macht.
keywords: VALUE, FOR, COND, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, NUMBER, Conditional Logic, CASE

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und geben Sie die Flugdaten aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT SINGLE mit inline Deklaration und dem Escape-Zeichen '@'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_data.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flight_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_flight_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Flight data should be initial for non-existent flight' act = ls_flight-carrid ).

    " Assuming 'LH' and '0400' exist in SFLIGHTS for a positive test
    ls_flight = lo_reader->get_flight_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flight data should not be initial for existing flight' act = ls_flight-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect connection ID' act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von SELECT SINGLE mit inline Deklaration (INTO @DATA(ls_flight)) und dem Escape-Zeichen '@' für Hostvariablen ist eine moderne und prägnante Art, Daten aus der Datenbank zu lesen. CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight ist hier verwendet, um die Rückgabestruktur direkt zu füllen.

Instructions: Laden Sie den Inhalt eines internen Strings als Textdatei auf das Frontend des Benutzers herunter.

CLASS zcl_frontend_downloader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_string_as_file
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_frontend_downloader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_string_as_file.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE TABLE OF string.
    APPEND iv_content TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = iv_filename
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            CHANGING

hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_threshold TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Populate lt_sflights with some data, or read from DB for real scenario
    " For demo, we'll use dummy data or assume SFLIGHTS is populated.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_threshold )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_result ).

    " Test with a very high threshold, expecting no results
    lt_result = lo_filter->get_expensive_flights( iv_threshold = 999999 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should be empty for very high threshold' act = lt_result ).

    " Add a specific check if possible with known data
    " For example, if you know 'LH' '0400' has price > 500
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_key) WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
      lv_found = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Specific flight LH 0400 should be found' act = lv_found ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FOR-Ausdruck in Kombination mit dem VALUE-Operator ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Erstellung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. Die WHERE-Klausel filtert die Quelldaten, und die Klammern definieren die Struktur der neuen Zeilen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Verwenden Sie den REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).

    " Assuming 'AA' has flights with prices 100, 200, 300 in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    " This test relies on actual SFLIGHTS data. For robust testing, mock data would be better.
    " For demonstration, we assume a sum of 600 for 'AA' if such data exists.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for AA should be 600 (example)' act = lv_total_aa exp = 600 ).

    " Test for a carrier with no flights
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_aggregator->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be 0' act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er initialisiert eine Variable und iteriert über die Tabelle, wobei er in jedem Schritt die Variable basierend auf der Logik in der NEXT-Klausel aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem Code für Summen, Zählungen oder andere Aggregationen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Übertragen Sie Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, die teilweise übereinstimmende Feldnamen haben, ohne jedes Feld einzeln zuzuweisen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den CORRESPONDING-Operator mit dem EXACT-Modifikator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target_data,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_data.

    METHODS map_data
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING EXACT #( is_source TO rs_target ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_data.
    DATA(lo_mapper) = NEW zcl_data_mapper( ).
    DATA: ls_source TYPE zcl_data_mapper=>ty_source_data.
    ls_source-field_a = 'Value A'.
    ls_source-field_b = 123.
    ls_source-field_c = 'Value C'.

    DATA(ls_target) = lo_mapper->map_data( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field A should be mapped' act = ls_target-field_a exp = 'Value A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Field B should be mapped' act = ls_target-field_b exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Field D should be initial as no corresponding field in source' act = ls_target-field_d ).
    " Field C from source is not in target, so it's ignored.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der MOVE-CORRESPONDING EXACT # Operator ermöglicht eine typsichere und effiziente Zuweisung von Feldern zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit übereinstimmenden Namen. Der Modifikator '#' stellt sicher, dass nur exakt passende Felder zugewiesen werden, was die Robustheit erhöht.
keywords: MOVE-CORRESPONDING, Data Transformation, Structures

CLASS zcl_flight_stats_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine potenzielle Ausnahme beim Versuch, eine Datei herunterzuladen, und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH für die Ausnahmebehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_downloader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS safe_download
      IMPORTING
        iv_content TYPE string
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_downloader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD safe_download.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE TABLE OF string.
    APPEND iv_content TO lt_data.

    TRY.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
          EXPORTING
            filename                = iv_filename
            filetype                = 'ASC'
            CHANGING
            data_tab                = lt_data
          EXCEPTIONS
            file_write_error        = 1
            no_authority            = 2
            unknown_error           = 3
            OTHERS                  = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_message = |Datei '{ iv_filename }' erfolgreich heruntergeladen.|.
        ELSE.
          rv_message = |Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei '{ iv_filename }'. SY-SUBRC: { sy-subrc }.|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_gui_frontend_services INTO DATA(lx_frontend_error).
        rv_message = |Ausnahme beim Herunterladen der Datei '{ iv_filename }': { lx_frontend_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_safe_download FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_safe_download.
    DATA(lo_downloader) = NEW zcl_safe_downloader( ).
    DATA(lv_content) = 'Test content for safe download.'.
    DATA(lv_filename) = 'safe_test.txt'.

    " Positive case (assuming GUI_DOWNLOAD would succeed)
    DATA(lv_message_success) = lo_downloader->safe_download( iv_content = lv_content iv_filename = lv_filename ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Success message expected' substring = 'erfolgreich heruntergeladen' act = lv_message_success ).

    " Negative case: Simulate an error by passing an invalid filename or mocking
    " For a real test, CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES would be mocked to raise an exception.
    " Here, we pass a filename that might cause an error on some systems (e.g., very long, invalid chars).
    DATA(lv_invalid_filename) = 'C:\Invalid/Path\File?.txt'.
    DATA(lv_message_error) = lo_downloader->safe_download( iv_content = lv_content iv_filename = lv_invalid_filename ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Error message expected for invalid filename' substring = 'Fehler' act = lv_message_error ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die TRY...CATCH-Struktur ist der moderne Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Sie ermöglicht es, Laufzeitfehler (Exceptions) abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen. Hier wird eine spezifische Ausnahme (CX_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES) abgefangen, um auf Fehler bei Frontend-Operationen zu reagieren.
keywords: TRY...CATCH, Exception Handling, CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FLIGHT_STATUS_TEXT' hinzu, deren Wert basierend auf dem 'FLIGHT_STATUS_CODE' dynamisch gesetzt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FOR-Ausdruck mit dem VALUE-Operator und einem eingebetteten SWITCH-Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_enriched,

             currency        TYPE sflight-currency,
             flight_status_code TYPE string,
             flight_status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_enriched TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS enrich_flights_with_status
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_enriched_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_enriched.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_enricher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD enrich_flights_with_status.
    " Simulate adding a status code to SFLIGHT data for demonstration
    DATA: lt_flights_with_code TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_enriched.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(ls_flight_with_code) = CORRESPONDING ty_sflight_enriched( ls_flight ).
      IF sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0.
        ls_flight_with_code-flight_status_code = '01'. " Pünktlich
      ELSEIF sy-tabix MOD 3 = 0.
        ls_flight_with_code-flight_status_code = '02'. " Verspätet
      ELSE.
        ls_flight_with_code-flight_status_code = '03'. " Annulliert
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight_with_code TO lt_flights_with_code.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_enriched_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_flights_with_code
                                   ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_entry )
                                     flight_status_text = SWITCH string(
                                       ls_entry-flight_status_code
                                       WHEN '01' THEN 'Pünktlich'
                                       WHEN '02' THEN 'Verspätet'
                                       WHEN '03' THEN 'Annulliert'
                                       ELSE 'Unbekannt' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_enrich_flights_with_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_enrich_flights_with_status.
    DATA(lo_enricher) = NEW zcl_flight_enricher( ).
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    " Create some dummy SFLIGHT data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 100. <fs_flight>-currency = 'EUR'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0017'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 200. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0020'. <fs_flight>-fldate = sy-datum. <fs_flight>-price = 300. <fs_flight>-currency = 'USD'.

    DATA(lt_enriched) = lo_enricher->enrich_flights_with_status( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 3 entries' act = lines( lt_enriched ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_enriched INTO DATA(ls_enriched) INDEX 1.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight status text should be Annulliert' act = ls_enriched-flight_status_text exp = 'Annulliert' ).

    READ TABLE lt_enriched INTO ls_enriched INDEX 2.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second flight status text should be Pünktlich' act = ls_enriched-flight_status_text exp = 'Pünktlich' ).

    READ TABLE lt_enriched INTO ls_enriched INDEX 3.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: den FOR-Ausdruck mit VALUE für die Tabellenkonstruktion, den CORRESPONDING-Operator für die Feldzuweisung und den SWITCH-Ausdruck für die dynamische Statusermittlung. Dies führt zu einem sehr funktionalen und lesbaren Code für die Datenanreicherung.

Instructions: Eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten soll als CSV-Datei auf den lokalen Rechner des Benutzers heruntergeladen werden. Vor dem Download sollen alle Flugpreise, die in EUR sind, um 5% erhöht werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY` für die Datenaufbereitung und `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` für den Download. Nutzen Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für effiziente Tabellenbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS download_modified_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_filepath TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_gui_frontend_services.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_modified_sflights.
    DATA lt_modified_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Kopieren und Modifizieren der Daten
    lt_modified_sflights = it_sflights.
    LOOP AT lt_modified_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      IF <fs_sflight>-currency = 'EUR'.
        <fs_sflight>-price = <fs_sflight>-price * '1.05'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Download der modifizierten Daten
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = iv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_modified_sflights
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_frontend_services
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Fehler beim Download der Datei'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
