keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, Deklarativ

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden, die Verbindungs-ID '0400' haben und deren Preis über 500 liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie mehrere Bedingungen im `WHERE`-Teil des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_specific_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND price > 500 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_specific_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_specific_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_specific_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All flights should match criteria' act = ( NOT line_exists( lt_result[ carrid <> 'LH' OR connid <> '0400' OR price <= 500 ] ) ) ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Mehrere Bedingungen können mit `AND` oder `OR` im `WHERE`-Teil des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks verknüpft werden, um komplexe Filterlogik kompakt auszudrücken.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, Mehrere Bedingungen

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die von den Fluggesellschaften 'LH' oder 'AA' durchgeführt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `IN`-Operator im `WHERE`-Teil des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks, um gegen eine Liste von Werten zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_in_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_preferred_carrier_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_preferred_carriers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( 'AA' ) ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid IN lt_preferred_carriers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_preferred_carrier_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_preferred_carrier_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_in_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_preferred_carrier_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'All flights should be LH or AA' act = ( NOT line_exists( lt_result[ carrid <> 'LH' AND carrid <> 'AA' ] ) ) ).

explanation: Der `IN`-Operator innerhalb des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks ermöglicht das einfache Filtern von Zeilen, deren Feldwerte in einer Liste von Werten enthalten sind. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu mehreren `OR`-Bedingungen.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die an einem Wochenende (Samstag oder Sonntag) abfliegen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Hilfsmethode oder einen Funktionsbaustein, um den Wochentag zu bestimmen, und rufen Sie diese innerhalb des `FILTER`-Ausdrucks auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_weekend DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weekend_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS is_weekend
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_weekend) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_weekend IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekend_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE is_weekend( fldate ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_weekend.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).
    IF lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7. " 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      rv_is_weekend = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_weekend = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_weekend_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_is_weekend FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_weekend_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_weekend( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_weekend_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( ls_flight-fldate ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Flight should be on a weekend' act = ( lv_weekday = 6 OR lv_weekday = 7 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_is_weekend.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_weekend( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '20251206 should be Saturday' act = lo_cut->is_weekend( '20251206' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = '20251207 should be Sunday' act = lo_cut->is_weekend( '20251207' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( msg = '20251208 should be Monday' act = lo_cut->is_weekend( '20251208' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.50 können Methoden oder Funktionsbausteine direkt im `WHERE`-Teil von `FILTER`-Ausdrücken aufgerufen werden. Dies ermöglicht die Anwendung komplexer, wiederverwendbarer Logik für die Filterung.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Predicate, SFLIGHTS, Date, Method Call

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Liste aller Verbindungs-IDs (CONNID) aus SFLIGHTS für Flüge, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren Preis über 1000 liegt.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die gefilterten Daten zu transformieren und nur die gewünschten Felder zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_for_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_connid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_connids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE tt_connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_for_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_connids.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_connids = VALUE tt_connid(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND price > 1000 )
      ( ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_filtered_connids FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_connids.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_for_map( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_connids( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    " Further assertions could check specific connids if test data is stable
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Result should contain some connids' act = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `FILTER` und `FOR` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und funktionale Transformation von Daten. Zuerst wird die Tabelle gefiltert, und dann werden die gefilterten Zeilen durchlaufen, um eine neue Tabelle mit nur den benötigten Feldern zu erstellen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, Internal Table, Mapping, SFLIGHTS, Transformation

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und fangen Sie eine mögliche Division-durch-Null-Ausnahme ab. Geben Sie im Fehlerfall eine entsprechende Nachricht zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_division_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_division_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    DATA: lv_quotient TYPE decfloat34.

    TRY.
        lv_quotient = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Ergebnis: { lv_quotient }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_result = 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' .
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Ergebnis: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_division_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler: Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `TRY...CATCH`-Block ist der Standardmechanismus zur Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` ist die spezifische Ausnahme für arithmetische Fehler wie die Division durch Null.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception, Division by Zero, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch ein Objekt einer Klasse, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls die Klasse nicht existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE (lv_class_name)` und fangen Sie `cx_sy_create_object_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_object_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_object) TYPE REF TO object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_object_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_object_dynamically.
    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT ro_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Klasse existiert nicht oder kann nicht instanziiert werden
        MESSAGE `Klasse &1 konnte nicht instanziiert werden.` TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
        CLEAR ro_object.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_create_valid_object FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_object FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_valid_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_object_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_object) = lo_cut->create_object_dynamically( 'CL_ABAP_UNIT_ASSERT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_object msg = 'Object should be created' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_object_creator( ).
    DATA(lo_object) = lo_cut->create_object_dynamically( 'NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lo_object msg = 'Object should not be created for invalid class' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Objekterzeugung mit `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (name)` ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug. Die Ausnahme `cx_sy_create_object_error` fängt Probleme ab, wenn die angegebene Klasse nicht gefunden wird oder andere Instanziierungsfehler auftreten.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception, Dynamic Object Creation, CREATE OBJECT, cx_sy_create_object_error

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode eines Objekts auf. Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab, falls die Methode nicht existiert oder der Aufruf fehlschlägt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF lo_object` und fangen Sie `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS dummy_method.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_method_dynamically.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD io_object->(iv_method_name).
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Methode existiert nicht oder Aufruf fehlgeschlagen
        MESSAGE `Dynamischer Methodenaufruf '&1' fehlgeschlagen.` TYPE 'W' DISPLAY LIKE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method.
    " Eine einfache Methode für Testzwecke
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_call_existing_method FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_call_non_existing_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_call_existing_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Existing method should be called successfully' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_call_non_existing_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->call_method_dynamically( io_object = lo_cut iv_method_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success msg = 'Non-existing method call should fail' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD (name) OF object` ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature. `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist die Ausnahme, die bei Problemen mit dem dynamischen Aufruf ausgelöst wird, z.B. wenn die Methode nicht gefunden wird oder die Signatur nicht passt.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Exception, Dynamic Method Call, RTTI, cx_sy_dyn_call_error

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode mit verschachtelten `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcken. Ein innerer Block soll eine Division durch Null abfangen, ein äußerer Block einen Fehler bei der dynamischen Objekterzeugung.
hint: Platzieren Sie einen `TRY...CATCH`-Block vollständig innerhalb eines anderen `TRY...CATCH`-Blocks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_try_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_complex_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_try_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_complex_operation.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA: lv_quotient       TYPE decfloat34.

    TRY. " Äußerer Block für dynamische Objekterzeugung
        CREATE OBJECT lo_dynamic_object TYPE (iv_class_name).
        rv_message = |Objekt der Klasse '{ iv_class_name }' erfolgreich erstellt. |.

        TRY. " Innerer Block für Division
            lv_quotient = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
            rv_message = rv_message && |Division: { lv_quotient }|.
          CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
            rv_message = rv_message && 'Innerer Fehler: Division durch Null.' .
        ENDTRY.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error.
        rv_message = |Äußerer Fehler: Klasse '{ iv_class_name }' konnte nicht erstellt werden.|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung eines `CLEANUP`-Blocks in `TRY...CATCH`, um sicherzustellen, dass eine Ressource (simuliert durch eine Statusvariable) immer freigegeben wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Der `CLEANUP`-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, sei es durch normale Ausführung oder durch eine Ausnahme.
solution:
CLASS zcl_try_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation_with_cleanup
      IMPORTING
        iv_cause_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mv_resource_locked TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_try_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation_with_cleanup.
    mv_resource_locked = abap_true. " Ressource wird 'gesperrt'
    rv_status = 'Ressource gesperrt. '.

    TRY.
        rv_status = rv_status && 'Operation gestartet. '.
        IF iv_cause_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_status = rv_status && 'Operation erfolgreich. '.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        rv_status = rv_status && 'Ausnahme gefangen. '.
      CLEANUP.
        mv_resource_locked = abap_false. " Ressource wird 'freigegeben'
        rv_status = rv_status && 'Ressource freigegeben.' .
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_cleanup_no_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cleanup_with_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Ressource gesperrt. Operation gestartet. Operation erfolgreich. Ressource freigegeben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Resource should be unlocked after no error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_with_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_try_cleanup( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->perform_operation_with_cleanup( abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Ressource gesperrt. Operation gestartet. Ausnahme gefangen. Ressource freigegeben.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked msg = 'Resource should be unlocked after error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Ressourcenfreigabe oder der Wiederherstellung eines konsistenten Zustands, selbst wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt. Er wird immer ausgeführt, wenn der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, bevor die Kontrolle an den aufrufenden Kontext zurückgegeben wird.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception, Resource Management, Finally

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Flügen, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt und deren Preis unter einem bestimmten Maximalwert liegt. Extrahieren Sie dann für diese Flüge die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und die Verbindungs-ID (CONNID) in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` mit mehreren Bedingungen und anschließend `FOR` mit `CORRESPONDING` oder `VALUE` um die Struktur der neuen Tabelle zu definieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_affordable_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_affordable_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_today) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_system_date( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights.

    rt_flight_info = VALUE tt_flight_info(
      FOR ls_flight IN FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate > lv_today AND price < iv_max_price )
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_future_affordable_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_affordable_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_future_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_future_affordable_flights( 500 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_info).
      " We cannot easily verify fldate and price here without re-reading sflight
      " but we can check if the structure is correct and not empty.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_info-connid ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert `FILTER` für die Auswahl von Zeilen basierend auf mehreren Kriterien (Datum in der Zukunft, Preis unter Maximalwert) mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um die gefilterten Daten in eine neue Struktur zu projizieren. Dies ist ein sehr effizientes und modernes Muster für Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: FILTER, FOR, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, Date, Price, Transformation

Instructions: Simulieren Sie eine Datenbankoperation, die fehlschlagen kann (z.B. durch eine ungültige Eingabe). Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` um die Ausnahme abzufangen und geben Sie eine detaillierte Fehlermeldung zurück, die die Ausnahmeinformationen enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine generische Ausnahme wie `CX_ROOT` oder eine spezifischere, wenn verfügbar, und greifen Sie auf die Attribute der Ausnahme zu (z.B. `GET_TEXT`).

CLASS zcl_db_error_simulator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS simulate_db_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_data TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

        iv_data TYPE string
      RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_error.

CLASS zcl_db_error_simulator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_db_operation.
    TRY.
        _perform_db_write( iv_input_data ).
        rv_message = 'Datenbankoperation erfolgreich.' .
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_message = |Datenbankfehler: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_db_write.
    " Simulieren einer fehlerhaften DB-Operation
    IF iv_data = 'ERROR'.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_error.
    ENDIF.
    " In einer echten Anwendung würde hier eine INSERT/UPDATE-Anweisung stehen
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        io_object     TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.

    METHODS get_farewell
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_farewell) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters,
          ls_parameter  TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>s_parameter.

    IF iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
      ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_param_value ).
      APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = io_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = lt_parameters
          IMPORTING
            ev_result   = rv_result
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = lx_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_greeting.
    rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_farewell.
    rv_farewell = 'Goodbye!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Zahlen (ganze Zahlen) aus einem gegebenen Text.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `FIND_NEXT` und dem Muster `\d+`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_number_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_numbers) TYPE TABLE OF string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_number_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_numbers.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `\d+`. " Matches one or more digits
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    WHILE lo_matcher->find_next( ).
      APPEND lo_matcher->get_found_string( ) TO rt_numbers.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_extract_single_number FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_multiple_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_extract_no_numbers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_single_number.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_regex_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( 'The year is 2023.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '2023' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_multiple_numbers.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_regex_number_extractor( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_extractor->extract_numbers( 'Item 1 has 10 units, item 2 has 5.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ] exp = '1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ] exp = '10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ] exp = '5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_extract_no_numbers.
    DATA(lo_extractor) = NEW zcl_regex_number_extractor( ).

explanation: Die `CL_ABAP_REGEX`-Klasse bietet eine leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, Muster in Strings zu finden. Die `FIND_NEXT`-Methode in einer Schleife ermöglicht das iterative Extrahieren aller Treffer, was sehr effizient ist.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_assigner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        field1 TYPE string,
        field2 TYPE i,
      END OF ty_data,
      ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        ir_data_ref   TYPE REF TO data " Reference to structure or table line
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_assigner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>assign_component(
      EXPORTING
        p_name      = iv_field_name
        p_struct_ref = ir_data_ref
      IMPORTING
        p_field     = <fs_field>
    ).

    IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Attempt to convert and assign the value
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Conversion error for field { iv_field_name }: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
        EXPORTING
          text = |Field { iv_field_name } not found or could not be assigned.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit einer zur Laufzeit definierten Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_table_from_struct` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_data_ref`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_struct_def,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_dynamic_struct_def,
      ty_t_dynamic_struct_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_struct_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_dynamic_struct_def
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'STRING' ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'I' ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Unsupported type: { ls_field_def-type }|.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                         p_line_type = lr_struct_descr
                         p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                         p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_struct_def,

        type TYPE string,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_dynamic_struct_def,

    METHODS test_create_table_with_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_table_invalid_type FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_simple_table.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE ty_t_dynamic_struct_def.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID' type = 'INT' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'DESCRIPTION' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <ft_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <ft_dynamic_table> ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_table_with_data.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE ty_t_dynamic_struct_def.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'ID' type = 'INT' ) TO lt_field_defs.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ASSIGN <fs_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'ID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_id>).
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text>).

    IF <fs_id> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_text> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_id> = 1.
      <fs_text> = 'First Entry'.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <ft_dynamic_table>.

      <fs_id> = 2.
      <fs_text> = 'Second Entry'.
      APPEND <fs_dynamic_line> TO <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <ft_dynamic_table> ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ft_dynamic_table>[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <ft_dynamic_table>[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Second Entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_table_invalid_type.
    DATA: lt_field_defs TYPE ty_t_dynamic_struct_def.
    APPEND VALUE #( name = 'FIELD' type = 'INVALID_TYPE' ) TO lt_field_defs.

    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_creator( ).
    TRY.
        lo_creator->create_and_fill_dynamic_table( lt_field_defs ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_ABAP_DYN_PRG_ERROR was not raised for invalid type' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'CX_ABAP_DYN_PRG_ERROR correctly raised for invalid type' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es ermöglicht die Anpassung der Datenstruktur zur Laufzeit, was in generischen Frameworks oder bei der Verarbeitung unbekannter Datenformate unerlässlich ist.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_executor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_executor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA: lv_select_statement TYPE string,
          lv_field_list     TYPE string.

    lv_field_list = REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_fields NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ',' && field ) ).

    IF lv_field_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'No fields provided for SELECT statement.'.
    ENDIF.

    lv_select_statement = |SELECT { lv_field_list } FROM { iv_table_name }|.
    IF iv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_select_statement = lv_select_statement && | WHERE { iv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_abap_dyn_prg=>execute_select(
      EXPORTING
        p_statement = lv_select_statement
      IMPORTING
        p_out_table = rr_result_table
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie benannte Gruppen aus einem String mithilfe eines regulären Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `FIND` und `GET_SUBMATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_address_parts,
        street TYPE string,
        house_number TYPE string,
        city TYPE string,
      END OF ty_address_parts.

    METHODS extract_address_parts
      IMPORTING
        iv_address TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_address_parts) TYPE ty_address_parts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_named_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_address_parts.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = `^(?<street>[A-Za-z\s]+)\s+(?<house_number>\d+[A-Za-z]?)\s*,\s*(?<city>[A-Za-z\s]+)$`.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_address ).

    IF lo_matcher->find( ).
      rs_address_parts-street = lo_matcher->get_submatch( name = 'street' ).
      rs_address_parts-house_number = lo_matcher->get_submatch( name = 'house_number' ).
      rs_address_parts-city = lo_matcher->get_submatch( name = 'city' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Klasse und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf. Dies demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von RTTI und dynamischer Programmierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr` und `cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_object`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_class_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call_dynamic_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_dynamic_class.
    DATA: lr_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr,
          lr_object      TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        lr_class_descr = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_descr( iv_class_name ).
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>create_object(
          EXPORTING
            p_class_descr = lr_class_descr
          IMPORTING
            p_object      = lr_object
        ).

        DATA: lt_parameters TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>t_parameters,
              ls_parameter  TYPE cl_abap_dyn_prg=>s_parameter.

        IF iv_param_value IS NOT INITIAL.
          ls_parameter-name = 'IV_NAME'.
          ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_param_value ).
          APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
        ENDIF.

        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>call_method(
          EXPORTING
            ii_object   = lr_object
            iv_method   = iv_method_name
            it_parameters = lt_parameters
          IMPORTING
            ev_result   = rv_result
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_class_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Class { iv_class_name } not found: { lx_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Dynamic programming error: { lx_dyn_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String vollständig einem regulären Ausdruck entspricht (nicht nur ein Teil davon).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_REGEX` mit `MATCH` und Ankern `^` und `$` im Muster.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_full_match DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_full_match
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_match) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_full_match IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_full_match.
    " Ensure pattern matches the entire string by adding anchors
    DATA(lv_full_pattern) = |^{ iv_pattern }$|.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_full_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).
    rv_is_match = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_matcher) = NEW zcl_regex_full_match( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = '12345' iv_pattern = '\d+' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = 'Hello' iv_pattern = 'Hello' ) ).

  METHOD test_full_match_fail_partial.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = NEW zcl_regex_full_match( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = '12345abc' iv_pattern = '\d+' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_full_match_fail_extra_chars.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = NEW zcl_regex_full_match( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = 'abc12345' iv_pattern = '\d+' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_full_match_empty_string.
    DATA(lo_matcher) = NEW zcl_regex_full_match( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = '' iv_pattern = '^$' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_matcher->is_full_match( iv_text = 'abc' iv_pattern = '^$' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Um sicherzustellen, dass ein regulärer Ausdruck den *gesamten* String abdeckt, werden die Anker `^` (Anfang des Strings) und `$` (Ende des Strings) verwendet. Dies ist entscheidend für Validierungszwecke, bei denen keine zusätzlichen Zeichen erlaubt sind. Die String-Templates (`|...|`) sind ein modernes ABAP-Feature für lesbare String-Konkatenation.
keywords: REGEX, Full Match, Validation, Anchors, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch die Metadaten (Komponenten) einer internen Tabelle oder Struktur zur Laufzeit aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>get_by_data` oder `cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_by_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_metadata_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type_name TYPE string,
        length TYPE i,
      END OF ty_component_info,
      ty_t_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_table_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_t_component_info
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_metadata_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_components.
    DATA: lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lr_line_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    TRY.
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>get_by_data( ir_table_ref ).
        lr_line_descr ?= lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( ).
        lt_components = lr_line_descr->get_components( ).

        rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
                                   ( name = ls_comp-name
                                     type_name = ls_comp-type->get_name( )
                                     length = ls_comp-type->length ) ).

      CATCH cx_sy_rtti_error INTO DATA(lx_rtti_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |RTTI error: { lx_rtti_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und fügen Sie Zeilen mit Daten ein, deren Struktur und Werte zur Laufzeit bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` mit Field-Symbols.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_field_def,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
      END OF ty_field_def,
      ty_t_field_def TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field_def WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_row_data,
        field_name TYPE string,
        value TYPE string,
      END OF ty_row_data,
      ty_t_row_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_row_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_insert_data
      IMPORTING
        it_field_definitions TYPE ty_t_field_def
        it_rows_data         TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_t_row_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data
      RAISING
        cx_abap_dyn_prg_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_insert_data.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr,
          lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_descr.

    LOOP AT it_field_definitions INTO DATA(ls_field_def).
      ls_component-name = ls_field_def-name.
      CASE ls_field_def-type.
        WHEN 'STRING'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'STRING' ).
        WHEN 'INT'.
          ls_component-type = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_name( 'I' ).
        WHEN OTHERS.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Unsupported type: { ls_field_def-type }|.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                         p_line_type = lr_struct_descr
                         p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                         p_unique = abap_false ).

    CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <ft_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <ft_dynamic_table>.

    LOOP AT it_rows_data INTO DATA(lt_row_data).
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_new_line> TYPE any.
      CREATE DATA <fs_new_line> LIKE LINE OF <ft_dynamic_table>.
      ASSIGN <fs_new_line>->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).

      LOOP AT lt_row_data INTO DATA(ls_cell_data).
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.
        cl_abap_dyn_prg=>assign_component(
          EXPORTING
            p_name      = ls_cell_data-field_name
            p_struct_ref = <fs_dynamic_line>
          IMPORTING
            p_field     = <fs_field>
        ).
        IF <fs_field> IS ASSIGNED.
          TRY.
              <fs_field> = ls_cell_data-value.
            CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
              RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
                EXPORTING
                  text = |Conversion error for field { ls_cell_data-field_name }: { lx_conv_error->get_text( ) }|.
          ENDTRY.
        ELSE.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
            EXPORTING
              text = |Field { ls_cell_data-field_name } not found in dynamic line.|.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      INSERT <fs_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <ft_dynamic_table>.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_insert_two_rows.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE ty_t_field_def(
      ( name = 'ID' type = 'INT' )
      ( name = 'TEXT' type = 'STRING' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_rows_data) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_t_row_data(
      ( VALUE ty_t_row_data( ( field_name = 'ID' value = '1' ) ( field_name = 'TEXT' value = 'First' ) ) )
      ( VALUE ty_t_row_data( ( field_name = 'ID' value = '2' ) ( field_name = 'TEXT' value = 'Second' ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_insert( ).
    DATA(lr_table) = lo_inserter->create_and_insert_data( it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs it_rows_data = lt_rows_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN <ft_dynamic_table>[ 1 ] TO <fs_line>.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'TEXT' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_text>).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_text> exp = 'First' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_id> exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_text> exp = 'Second' ).

  METHOD test_create_and_insert_with_conversion_error.
    DATA(lt_field_defs) = VALUE ty_t_field_def(

      ( VALUE ty_t_row_data( ( field_name = 'ID' value = 'ABC' ) ) )
    ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_ABAP_DYN_PRG_ERROR was not raised for conversion error' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Conversion error' text = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_and_insert_with_missing_field.

      ( VALUE ty_t_row_data( ( field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' value = '1' ) ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_inserter) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_insert( ).
    TRY.
        lo_inserter->create_and_insert_data( it_field_definitions = lt_field_defs it_rows_data = lt_rows_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'CX_ABAP_DYN_PRG_ERROR was not raised for missing field' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_dyn_prg_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Field NON_EXISTENT not found' text = lx_error->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_other_client.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sel_single_client( ).
    " Annahme: Mandant '000' existiert und enthält Daten für 'AA' '0017'
    " In einem echten System müsste man sicherstellen, dass diese Daten existieren.
    DATA(lv_current_mandt) = sy-mandt.
    DATA(lv_test_mandt) = '000'. " Beispielmandant, der nicht der aktuelle ist

    IF lv_current_mandt = lv_test_mandt.
      " Test kann nicht sinnvoll ausgeführt werden, wenn Testmandant = aktuellem Mandant
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Testmandant ist gleich dem aktuellen Mandanten. Test übersprungen.' ).
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_cross_client( iv_mandt = lv_test_mandt iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    " Assert, dass der Datensatz aus dem angegebenen Mandanten stammt
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-mandt exp = lv_test_mandt ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel `CLIENT SPECIFIED` ist notwendig, um die automatische Mandantenbehandlung von Open SQL zu umgehen. Dies ermöglicht das Lesen von Daten aus einem beliebigen Mandanten, der explizit in der `WHERE`-Klausel angegeben wird. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Funktion, die mit Vorsicht zu verwenden ist, da sie die Mandantentrennung durchbricht.
keywords: SELECT SINGLE, CLIENT SPECIFIED, Cross-Client, SFLIGHTS, Mandant

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol einer Variablen zu und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend wieder auf. Prüfen Sie den Zuweisungsstatus.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN und UNASSIGN. Prüfen Sie mit IF <fs> IS ASSIGNED.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_any> TYPE any.
    DATA: lv_local_value TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.

    ASSIGN iv_value TO <fs_any>.
    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_status = 'Assigned: ' && <fs_any>.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Not Assigned after ASSIGN (Error)'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.

    IF <fs_any> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_status = rv_status && ', Still Assigned after UNASSIGN (Error)'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = rv_status && ', Unassigned successfully'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unassign_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->demonstrate_unassign( 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Assigned: Hello World, Unassigned successfully' ).

Dies ist wichtig, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nicht mehr auf einen Speicherbereich verweist, wenn dieser nicht mehr gültig oder benötigt wird. Obwohl ABAP die Zuweisung am Ende eines Scopes automatisch aufhebt, ist die explizite Aufhebung für Klarheit und in bestimmten dynamischen Szenarien nützlich.
keywords: UNASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN, Memory Management, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol dynamisch einem Feld zu, verarbeiten Sie es und heben Sie die Zuweisung auf, bevor Sie es einem anderen Feld zuweisen. Verwenden Sie lokale Variablen für die Zuweisung.
hint: Nutzen Sie ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)FIELD_NAME') TO <fs> und UNASSIGN.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_dynamic_fields
      IMPORTING
        iv_field1_val TYPE string
        iv_field2_val TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_concat_values) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_fields.
    DATA: lv_data1 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial1',
          lv_data2 TYPE string VALUE 'Initial2'.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    lv_data1 = iv_field1_val.
    lv_data2 = iv_field2_val.

    ASSIGN ('(ZCL_UNASSIGN_DYNAMIC)LV_DATA1') TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_concat_values = <fs_data>.
      UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN ('(ZCL_UNASSIGN_DYNAMIC)LV_DATA2') TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_concat_values = rv_concat_values && ' ' && <fs_data>.
      UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_assign_unassign FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_assign_unassign.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_fields( iv_field1_val = 'First' iv_field2_val = 'Second' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'First Second' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ('(ZCL_UNASSIGN_DYNAMIC)LV_DATA1') TO <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = <fs_check> ). " Should be initial after method call
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der dynamischen Zuweisung mit `ASSIGN ('(PROGRAM)FIELD_NAME')` ist es gute Praxis, das Feldsymbol nach Gebrauch mit `UNASSIGN` freizugeben. Dies stellt sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nicht versehentlich auf einen falschen Speicherbereich verweist, wenn es später erneut zugewiesen wird, und hilft, potenzielle Fehler in komplexen dynamischen Szenarien zu vermeiden.
keywords: UNASSIGN, ASSIGN DYNAMIC, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Local Variables

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu, ändern Sie ihren Wert und heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf. Verwenden Sie eine SFLIGHTS-Struktur.
hint: Verwenden Sie ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs_component>.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_flight_component
      IMPORTING
        iv_component_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value      TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_sflight        TYPE sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_component.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_component_name OF STRUCTURE cs_sflight TO <fs_component>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_component> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_assign_cast_error.
          " Type mismatch, assignment failed
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
      UNASSIGN <fs_component>.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_carrid FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_type_mismatch FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_carrid.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_comp( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_flight_component( iv_component_name = 'CARRID' iv_new_value = 'AA' CHANGING cs_sflight = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE ls_flight TO <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_check> ). " Should still be assigned to the component
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existent.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_comp( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_flight_component( iv_component_name = 'NON_EXISTENT' iv_new_value = 'X' CHANGING cs_sflight = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_type_mismatch.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    ls_flight-seatsmax = 100.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_comp( ).
    " Attempt to assign a string to an integer field
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->modify_flight_component( iv_component_name = 'SEATSMAX' iv_new_value = 'ABC' CHANGING cs_sflight = ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_success ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-seatsmax exp = 100 ). " Value should remain unchanged
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Beim dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist `UNASSIGN` entscheidend, um die Referenz des Feldsymbols auf die Komponente zu lösen. Dies ist besonders wichtig, wenn das Feldsymbol in einem weiteren Schritt für eine andere Komponente oder einen anderen Zweck verwendet werden soll, um unerwünschte Seiteneffekte zu vermeiden. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist hierbei ebenfalls wichtig.
keywords: UNASSIGN, ASSIGN COMPONENT, RTTI, Dynamic Structure Access, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von UNASSIGN in einem Szenario, in dem eine dynamische Zuweisung fehlschlagen könnte. Geben Sie einen Status zurück, ob die Zuweisung erfolgreich war und das Feldsymbol zugewiesen ist.
hint: Prüfen Sie sy-subrc nach ASSIGN und verwenden Sie UNASSIGN bei Bedarf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS handle_dynamic_assign
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD handle_dynamic_assign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    DATA: lv_local_data TYPE string VALUE 'Local Value'.

    " Versuch, ein Feldsymbol dynamisch zuzuweisen
    ASSIGN (iv_field_name) TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_status_message = 'Assignment successful. Field symbol is assigned.' && ' Value: ' && <fs_data>.
      " Nach erfolgreicher Verarbeitung, explizit UNASSIGN
      UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
      IF <fs_data> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        rv_status_message = rv_status_message && '. Unassigned successfully.'.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.
      rv_status_message = 'Assignment failed. Field symbol is not assigned.'.
      " In diesem Fall ist UNASSIGN nicht streng notwendig, da die Zuweisung fehlschlug,
      " aber es schadet nicht und kann in komplexeren Logiken zur Klarheit beitragen.
      UNASSIGN <fs_data>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_assign_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_assign_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_assign_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->handle_dynamic_assign( '(ZCL_UNASSIGN_ERROR_HANDLING)LV_LOCAL_DATA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Assignment successful. Field symbol is assigned. Value: Local Value. Unassigned successfully.' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ('(ZCL_UNASSIGN_ERROR_HANDLING)LV_LOCAL_DATA') TO <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_check> exp = 'Local Value' ). " Value should still be there
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_assign_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->handle_dynamic_assign( '(ZCL_UNASSIGN_ERROR_HANDLING)NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Assignment failed. Field symbol is not assigned.' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ('(ZCL_UNASSIGN_ERROR_HANDLING)NON_EXISTENT_FIELD') TO <fs_check>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = (<fs_check> IS ASSIGNED) ).
    UNASSIGN <fs_check>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In der dynamischen Programmierung ist es entscheidend, den Rückgabewert (`sy-subrc`) nach einer `ASSIGN`-Anweisung zu prüfen. Wenn die Zuweisung fehlschlägt, ist das Feldsymbol nicht zugewiesen. Obwohl `UNASSIGN` in diesem Fall nicht zwingend erforderlich ist, da das Feldsymbol ohnehin nicht zugewiesen ist, kann es in komplexeren Fehlerbehandlungsroutinen zur Klarheit beitragen und sicherstellen, dass der Zustand des Feldsymbols immer explizit ist.
keywords: UNASSIGN, ASSIGN, Error Handling, sy-subrc, Dynamic Programming

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die explizite Aufhebung der Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols innerhalb einer Schleife, um zu zeigen, wie Ressourcen freigegeben werden können, auch wenn dies in modernem ABAP oft implizit geschieht.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs> und UNASSIGN innerhalb der Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_flights_with_unassign
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_unassign.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      " Verarbeitung des Flugdatensatzes
      rv_processed_count = rv_processed_count + 1.
      " Explizite Aufhebung der Zuweisung (optional, aber demonstriert die Funktion)
      UNASSIGN <fs_sflight>.
      " Hier wäre <fs_sflight> nicht mehr zugewiesen, bis zum nächsten Schleifendurchlauf
      " oder bis es erneut zugewiesen wird.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unassign_in_loop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unassign_in_loop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_loop( ).
    DATA(lv_processed) = lo_cut->process_flights_with_unassign( 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_processed exp = 5 ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_check> TYPE sflights.
    " Nach der Schleife sollte das Feldsymbol nicht mehr zugewiesen sein
    IF <fs_check> IS ASSIGNED.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Field symbol should be unassigned after loop.' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP-Laufzeitsysteme Feldsymbole, die innerhalb einer Schleife zugewiesen wurden, am Ende jedes Schleifendurchlaufs oder spätestens am Ende des Scopes automatisch aufheben, kann die explizite Verwendung von `UNASSIGN` in sehr spezifischen, ressourcenkritischen Szenarien oder zur Verdeutlichung der Absicht nützlich sein. Es stellt sicher, dass die Referenz sofort gelöst wird, was in extrem langen Schleifen theoretisch zu einer geringfügig besseren Ressourcenverwaltung führen könnte, obwohl dies in der Praxis selten einen spürbaren Unterschied macht.
keywords: UNASSIGN, LOOP AT ASSIGNING, Performance, Resource Management, FIELD-SYMBOLS

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer aus der Tabelle `sflight` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit Inline-Deklaration für die Zielstruktur.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_single,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_single.

    METHODS get_single_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight_single.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_single_flight.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_001( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_single_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ). " Assuming 'AA' and '0017' exist in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `SELECT SINGLE ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_data)` (hier `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_flight`) ist eine moderne ABAP-Syntax (ab 7.40), die die Inline-Deklaration der Zielstruktur ermöglicht und den Code kompakter macht.
keywords: SELECT, SINGLE, INTO @DATA, WHERE, Database Operations

Instructions: Wählen Sie alle Flugdatensätze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight` aus und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` für die Inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_002 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_line,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_line.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_002 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_002( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' ). " Assuming 'LH' has flights in SFLIGHT
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ). " Example: Expect 2 flights for LH
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

keywords: SELECT, INTO TABLE @DATA, WHERE, Database Operations

Instructions: Wählen Sie die 5 teuersten Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflight` aus, sortiert nach Preis absteigend.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_003 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_price.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n  TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_expensive_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      ORDER BY price DESCENDING
      UP TO @iv_top_n ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_top_n_expensive_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_003( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_top_n_expensive_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_top_n = 2 ). " Assuming 'AA' has enough flights
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    " Verify order (e.g., first flight is more expensive than second)
    IF lines( lt_flights ) = 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_flights[ 1 ]-price >= lt_flights[ 2 ]-price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `ORDER BY` und `UP TO N ROWS` ist eine effiziente Methode, um eine begrenzte Anzahl von Datensätzen aus der Datenbank abzurufen. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Alternative zu älteren Ansätzen, die alle Daten abrufen und dann in ABAP filtern würden. Es entspricht dem Verhalten von `FETCH NEXT` für die ersten N Zeilen.
keywords: SELECT, ORDER BY, UP TO N ROWS, FETCH NEXT, Database Operations

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie alle Flugdatensätze der Tabelle `sflight` in Paketen von 100 Zeilen, um den Speicherverbrauch zu optimieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ... ENDSELECT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_004 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_process,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_process.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_process WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_004 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA: lv_total_processed TYPE i VALUE 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_package PACKAGE SIZE @iv_package_size.
      " Process each package
      lv_total_processed = lv_total_processed + lines( lt_package ).
      CLEAR lt_package. " Clear for next package
    ENDSELECT.
    rv_processed_count = lv_total_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights_in_packages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_in_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_004( ).
    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_packages( iv_package_size = 10 ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT has at least some entries
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_count ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_count > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `PACKAGE SIZE` in Verbindung mit `SELECT ... ENDSELECT` ist eine bewährte Methode, um große Datenmengen effizient zu verarbeiten. Anstatt alle Daten auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher zu laden, werden sie in kleineren Paketen abgerufen und verarbeitet, was den Speicherverbrauch reduziert und die Performance bei sehr großen Tabellen verbessert.
keywords: SELECT, PACKAGE SIZE, ENDSELECT, Database Operations, Performance

Instructions: Wählen Sie Flugdaten zusammen mit dem Namen der Fluggesellschaft aus den Tabellen `sflight` und `scarr` aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `sflight` und `scarr`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_carrier,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_with_carrier.
    TYPES tt_flights_with_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_with_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    SELECT s~carrid, c~carrname, s~connid, s~fldate, s~price, s~currency
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN scarr AS c ON s~carrid = c~carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_carrier_name FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_005( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_carrier_name( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    " Check if carrname is filled for at least one entry
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrname IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_flight-carrname ).

CLASS zcl_db_007 IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lv_offset) = ( iv_page_num - 1 ) * iv_page_size.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die ersten 2 Flüge von 'AA' mit den ersten 2 Flügen von 'LH' in einer einzigen Ergebnisliste.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UNION ALL` um die Ergebnisse zweier `SELECT`-Statements zu verbinden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_009 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_union,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_union.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_union WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_combined_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_009 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_aa)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      ORDER BY fldate, connid
      FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights_lh)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      ORDER BY fldate, connid
      FETCH NEXT 2 ROWS ONLY.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( BASE rt_flights ( lt_flights_aa ) ( lt_flights_lh ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_009( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_combined_flights( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 4 ). " Expect 2 from AA + 2 from LH
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_aa exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_lh exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY` Klausel (ab 7.50) wird hier verwendet, um die Anzahl der Zeilen pro Teilabfrage zu begrenzen.

CLASS zcl_db_010 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_percent,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_percent.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_db_010 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_percent_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_eligible_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " First, find carriers with more than 10 flights
    SELECT carrid
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_eligible_carriers
      GROUP BY carrid
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 10.

    IF lt_eligible_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflight
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
        WHERE carrid IN @lt_eligible_carriers
        ORDER BY carrid, price DESCENDING
        FETCH NEXT 50 PERCENT ROWS ONLY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " 20250106 = Monday

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'NEW YORK' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250104' cityfrom = 'DALLAS'    cityto = 'LONDON' ) " Saturday
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250105' cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' cityto = 'LONDON' ) " Sunday

    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE is_weekend( fldate ) = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_weekend.
    DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( iv_date ).

      rv_is_weekend = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_weekend = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
