solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    rt_unique_flights = it_sflights.
    SORT rt_unique_flights BY carrid. " Important for ADJACENT DUPLICATES
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM rt_unique_flights COMPARING carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_delete_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0018'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " Duplicate after sort
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0401'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_duplicates.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0017'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0018'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0019'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( it_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` ist eine performante Anweisung, um redundante Zeilen aus internen Tabellen zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den relevanten Feldern zu sortieren, da nur *aufeinanderfolgende* Duplikate gelöscht werden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei jeder String die verkettete Fluggesellschafts-ID und Flugverbindungs-ID aus `SFLIGHTS` im Format 'CARRID-CONNID' darstellt.

CLASS zcl_tab_value_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_tab_value_concat IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    rt_flight_strings = VALUE string_table(
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights
      ( |{ <fs_sflight>-carrid }-{ <fs_sflight>-connid }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    ls_sflight_test-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-test-connid = '0400'. APPEND ls_sflight_test TO lt_sflights_test.

Instructions: Verketten Sie drei Strings mit einem Trennzeichen. Zeigen Sie sowohl die alte `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung als auch die moderne String-Template-Variante.
hint: Vergleichen Sie `CONCATENATE ... SEPARATED BY` mit String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_concat_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_old_style
      IMPORTING
        iv_part1 TYPE string
        iv_part2 TYPE string
        iv_part3 TYPE string
        iv_separator TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS concatenate_new_style
      IMPORTING
        iv_part1 TYPE string
        iv_part2 TYPE string
        iv_part3 TYPE string
        iv_separator TYPE string

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_concat_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_old_style.
    CONCATENATE iv_part1 iv_part2 iv_part3 INTO rv_result SEPARATED BY iv_separator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD concatenate_new_style.
    rv_result = |{ iv_part1 }{ iv_separator }{ iv_part2 }{ iv_separator }{ iv_part3 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `SFLIGHTS` enthält, außer denen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschafts-ID haben und deren Flugverbindungs-ID kleiner als ein gegebener Wert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHERE` Bedingung, um die zu behaltenden Zeilen zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tab_delete_complex DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_complex
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_max_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tab_delete_complex IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_complex.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid <> iv_carrid OR connid >= iv_max_connid )
      ( flight )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_complex FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_filter FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_all_filtered FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_complex.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0010'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " Should be filtered
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0020'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " Should remain (connid >= 0015)
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0005'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " Should remain (carrid <> AA)
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'BB'. ls_sflight-connid = '0030'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights. " Should remain (carrid <> AA)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_complex(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'AA'
      iv_max_connid = '0015'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0020' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_filter.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0010'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sflight-connid = '0020'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_complex(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'XX' " Not matching any carrid
      iv_max_connid = '0000'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_all_filtered.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          ls_sflight  TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0010'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.
    ls_sflight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sflight-connid = '0005'. APPEND ls_sflight TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tab_delete_complex( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights_complex(
      it_sflights = lt_sflights
      iv_carrid   = 'AA'
      iv_max_connid = '0015'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination des `VALUE` Operators mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer komplexen `WHERE` Bedingung kann man sehr präzise steuern, welche Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine neue Zieltabelle übernommen werden. Dies ist eine funktionale Alternative zum direkten Löschen und fördert die Unveränderlichkeit von Daten.
keywords: DELETE, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und geben Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis zurück. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Nutzen Sie 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...' und innerhalb der Gruppe 'REDUCE' oder 'FOR' für die Aggregation. Die Bedingung für den Preis kann im 'WHERE'-Teil des 'LOOP AT' oder des 'SELECT' erfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_loop_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_grouped_result,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_grouped_result.
    TYPES: ty_t_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE ty_t_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_loop_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA lt_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights
      WHERE price > @iv_min_price.

    LOOP AT lt_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         GROUP BY <fs_flight>-carrid
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_flight_count) = 0.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group_member>).
        lv_flight_count = lv_flight_count + 1.
        lv_total_price = lv_total_price + <fs_group_member>-price.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_s_grouped_result(
        carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = lv_flight_count
        total_price  = lv_total_price
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_grouping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_loop_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrid( iv_min_price = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result IS INITIAL ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_result_lh-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'LH flight count should not be zero' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_result_lh-total_price exp = 0 msg = 'LH total price should not be zero' ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_result_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_result_aa-flight_count exp = 0 msg = 'AA flight count should not be zero' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_result_aa-total_price exp = 0 msg = 'AA total price should not be zero' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die 'LOOP AT ... GROUP BY'-Anweisung ist ein mächtiges Feature in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten in internen Tabellen effizient zu gruppieren und zu aggregieren. Es ersetzt oft komplexe Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen für manuelle Gruppierung und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance erheblich. Die 'WHEN'-Klausel kann hier implizit durch den 'WHERE'-Teil des 'SELECT' oder des 'LOOP AT' genutzt werden, um die zu gruppierenden Daten vorab zu filtern.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT und fügen Sie eine Spalte 'FLIGHT_STATUS' hinzu, die basierend auf dem Flugdatum (fldate) den Status 'Past', 'Current' oder 'Future' anzeigt. Nutzen Sie dafür eine SQL-CASE-Expression direkt im SELECT-Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END AS FLIGHT_STATUS' im SELECT-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dba_sql_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_status,
             carrid       TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid       TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate       TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_flight_status.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dba_sql_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           CASE
             WHEN fldate < @sy-datum THEN 'Past'
             WHEN fldate = @sy-datum THEN 'Current'
             ELSE 'Future'
           END AS flight_status
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dba_sql_case( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 0 ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fldate < sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Past' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-fldate = sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Current' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_status exp = 'Future' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die SQL-CASE-Expression im 'SELECT'-Statement ermöglicht es, bedingte Logik direkt auf der Datenbankebene auszuführen. Dies reduziert die Datenübertragung und die Notwendigkeit, die Logik in ABAP nachzubilden, was zu einer besseren Performance führt. Die 'WHEN'-Klauseln definieren die Bedingungen für die Statuszuweisung.
keywords: SELECT, CASE, WHEN, SQL, Database Access, ABAP 7.50

hint: Definieren Sie eine Zielstruktur mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF' und verwenden Sie 'VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fun_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_s_flight_filtered.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_filtered.

CLASS zcl_fun_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                   WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem übergebenen String-Parameter (z.B. 'ADD', 'SUBTRACT') eine entsprechende mathematische Operation ausführt. Nutzen Sie eine 'CASE'-Anweisung, um die Operation zu steuern.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine klassische 'CASE'-Anweisung mit 'WHEN' für die verschiedenen Operationen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_case_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_operation TYPE string
        iv_val1      TYPE i
        iv_val2      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_case_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    CASE iv_operation.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
      WHEN 'SUBTRACT'.
        rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
      WHEN 'MULTIPLY'.
        rv_result = iv_val1 * iv_val2.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = 0.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_operations FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_operations.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_case_operation( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_operation = 'ADD' iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_operation = 'SUBTRACT' iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_operation = 'MULTIPLY' iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 15 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->perform_operation( iv_operation = 'UNKNOWN' iv_val1 = 5 iv_val2 = 3 ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die klassische 'CASE'-Anweisung mit 'WHEN'-Klauseln ist nach wie vor ein grundlegendes und klares Mittel zur Implementierung bedingter Logik, insbesondere wenn mehrere diskrete Werte oder Bereiche unterschiedliche Aktionen erfordern. Sie ist gut lesbar und wartbar.
keywords: CASE, WHEN, Conditional Logic, Dynamic

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHT. Nutzen Sie dafür den 'REDUCE'-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'REDUCE' mit 'INIT' und 'FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...' um die Preise zu summieren. Definieren Sie eine Struktur für den Akkumulator mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fun_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fun_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fun_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for LH should not be zero' ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for AA should not be zero' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Total price for non-existent carrier should be zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'REDUCE'-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Konstrukt in ABAP 7.50+, um eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (z.B. Summe, Maximum, Minimum). In Kombination mit 'FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...' ermöglicht er eine sehr kompakte und effiziente Aggregation von Daten. Die 'INIT'-Klausel initialisiert den Akkumulator.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, WHERE, Functional Programming, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen Text basierend auf einer Bedingung zurückgibt. Wenn der Preis über einem Schwellenwert liegt, soll 'Teuer' zurückgegeben werden, ansonsten 'Günstig'. Nutzen Sie dafür den 'COND'-Ausdruck.

solution:
CLASS zcl_con_cond_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_con_cond_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_assessment.
    rv_assessment = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price > iv_threshold THEN 'Teuer'
      ELSE 'Günstig'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ist vergleichbar mit dem ternären Operator in anderen Sprachen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit von Code, der auf einer Bedingung basierend einen Wert zuweisen soll. Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, die zu einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gehören und deren Preis unter einem Maximalwert liegt. Nutzen Sie dafür den 'FILTER'-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'FILTER #( ... WHERE ... )' um die interne Tabelle zu filtern. Definieren Sie eine Struktur für die gefilterte Tabelle mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_filter_expr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_filtered,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_s_flight_filtered.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_max_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_expr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND price < iv_max_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_filter_expr( ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_max_price = 300 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_lh IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_lh INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price < 300 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_max_price = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered_aa IS INITIAL ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_aa INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-price < 1000 ) ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lt_filtered_none) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_max_price = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered_none ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FILTER'-Operator ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature, das eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen effizient filtert und eine neue Tabelle mit den passenden Einträgen zurückgibt. Dies ist eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Alternative zu manuellen 'LOOP AT ... WHERE ... APPEND'-Konstrukten. Die Zielstruktur wird hier mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF' definiert.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, WHERE, BEGIN OF

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem übergebenen Typ-String verschiedene Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie 'CASE WHEN' für die Objekterzeugung.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und mehrere Klassen, die dieses implementieren. Verwenden Sie 'CASE iv_type WHEN ... THEN NEW zcl_...' in der Factory-Methode.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_operation.
  METHODS execute IMPORTING iv_val1 TYPE i iv_val2 TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_add_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_add_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_val1 + iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sub_operation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sub_operation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_operation~execute.
    rv_result = iv_val1 - iv_val2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_operation) TYPE REF TO zif_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_operation_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_operation.
    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'ADD'.
        ro_operation = NEW zcl_add_operation( ).
      WHEN 'SUBTRACT'.
        ro_operation = NEW zcl_sub_operation( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_factory FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_factory_invalid RAISING cx_abap_unit_assert.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_factory.
    DATA(lo_add) = zcl_operation_factory=>get_operation( 'ADD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_add->execute( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 5 ) exp = 15 ).

    DATA(lo_sub) = zcl_operation_factory=>get_operation( 'SUBTRACT' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_sub->execute( iv_val1 = 10 iv_val2 = 5 ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_factory_invalid.
    TRY.
        zcl_operation_factory=>get_operation( 'MULTIPLY' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception for invalid operation type' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught expected exception' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Factory-Methoden sind ein gängiges Entwurfsmuster in der Objektorientierung, um die Erzeugung von Objekten zu kapseln. Die 'CASE'-Anweisung mit 'WHEN'-Klauseln ist hier ideal, um basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter dynamisch die passende Implementierung eines Interfaces zu instanziieren. Dies fördert lose Kopplung und Erweiterbarkeit.
keywords: Object Orientation, Factory, Interface, CASE, WHEN, Dynamic

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (carrid, connid, fldate) in eine neue Tabelle, die zusätzlich eine Spalte für das Jahr des Flugdatums enthält. Nutzen Sie dafür den 'FOR'-Ausdruck mit 'LET' und 'BEGIN OF'.
hint: Verwenden Sie 'VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... LET ... IN ... )' und definieren Sie die Zielstruktur mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF'.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_let DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_source,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_flight_source.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_target,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             flight_year TYPE n4,
           END OF ty_s_flight_target.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE ty_t_flight_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE ty_t_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_let IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights
                                   LET lv_year = ls_flight-fldate(4) IN
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid,
                                     fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
                                     flight_year = lv_year ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA: lt_source TYPE zcl_itb_for_let=>ty_t_flight_source,
          ls_source LIKE LINE OF lt_source.

    ls_source-carrid = 'LH'. ls_source-connid = '0400'. ls_source-fldate = '20231026'. APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.
    ls_source-carrid = 'AA'. ls_source-connid = '0017'. ls_source-fldate = '20240115'. APPEND ls_source TO lt_source.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_let( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_source_flights = lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_target1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-flight_year exp = '2023' ).

    READ TABLE lt_target INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_target2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target2-flight_year exp = '2024' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der 'FOR'-Ausdruck mit der 'LET'-Klausel in Kombination mit 'VALUE' ermöglicht eine elegante und deklarative Transformation von internen Tabellen. 'LET' erlaubt die Definition lokaler Hilfsvariablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, was die Lesbarkeit bei komplexeren Berechnungen verbessert. Die Zielstruktur wird hier mit 'BEGIN OF ... END OF' definiert.
keywords: FOR, LET, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, BEGIN OF, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die einen String-Parameter empfängt und basierend auf dessen Inhalt eine Begrüßung zurückgibt. Wenn der String 'Herr' ist, soll 'Guten Tag Herr!' zurückgegeben werden, bei 'Frau' 'Guten Tag Frau!', ansonsten 'Hallo!'. Nutzen Sie eine 'CASE'-Anweisung.

CLASS zcl_con_simple_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      WHEN OTHERS.

Sie ist auch in modernem ABAP weiterhin relevant und gut lesbar, insbesondere wenn die 'SWITCH'-Expression aufgrund ihrer Komplexität nicht ideal ist.     DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_it_consumption( ).
    DATA(lt_data) TYPE zcl_mem_it_consumption=>ty_t_data.
    DATA(lv_memory) = lo_cut->get_table_memory_consumption( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_memory exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filled_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_it_consumption( ).
    DATA(lt_data) TYPE zcl_mem_it_consumption=>ty_t_data.
    LOOP AT sy-tab_range INTO DATA(idx) FROM 1 TO 100.
      APPEND VALUE #( field1 = |String { idx }| field2 = idx ) TO lt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
    DATA(lv_memory) = lo_cut->get_table_memory_consumption( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_memory > 0 ).
    DATA(lv_initial_memory) = lv_memory.
    LOOP AT sy-tab_range INTO DATA(idx) FROM 101 TO 200.
      APPEND VALUE #( field1 = |String { idx }| field2 = idx ) TO lt_data.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_memory = lo_cut->get_table_memory_consumption( lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_memory > lv_initial_memory ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Geben Sie den Speicher eines dynamisch erzeugten Datenobjekts explizit frei.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES=>FREE_MEMORY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_mem_free_memory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_free_data IMPORTING iv_size TYPE i
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rv_initial_memory) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mem_free_memory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_free_data.
    DATA lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lv_memory_before TYPE i.

    " Create a large data object dynamically
    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE x LENGTH iv_size.
    " Fill it to ensure memory is allocated
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE xstring.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_data> = cl_abap_random_utilities=>get_instance( )->get_xstring( iv_size ).
    ENDIF.

    " Get memory consumption before freeing
    lv_memory_before = cl_abap_memory_utilities=>get_memory_consumption( lr_data ).
    rv_initial_memory = lv_memory_before. " Return this for comparison in test

    " Free the memory
    cl_abap_memory_utilities=>free_memory( lr_data ).
    CLEAR lr_data. " Clear the reference
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_free_memory FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_free_memory.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_mem_free_memory( ).
    DATA(lv_size) TYPE i VALUE 1024 * 1024. " 1 MB
    DATA(lv_memory_before) = lo_cut->create_and_free_data( lv_size ).

    " Assert that memory was allocated (before freeing)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_memory_before >= lv_size ).
    " The FREE_MEMORY call itself is the action we are testing.
    " A more robust test would involve system-wide memory checks, which are hard in unit tests.
    " For this example, we assert that a significant amount of memory was initially consumed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `CL_ABAP_MEMORY_UTILITIES=>FREE_MEMORY` ermöglicht die explizite Freigabe von Speicher, der von Datenobjekten belegt wird. Dies ist in Szenarien mit sehr hohem Speicherbedarf oder bei der Arbeit mit großen, kurzlebigen dynamischen Objekten nützlich, um den Speicherbedarf der ABAP-Sitzung aktiv zu steuern.
keywords: Memory, Speicherfreigabe, Dynamisch, Performance, Ressourcenmanagement

CLASS zcl_date_weekend_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag bis Freitag) zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten (inklusive Start- und Enddatum).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie eine `IF`-Bedingung, um Wochenenden auszuschließen. Für den Wochentag kann eine einfache Berechnung basierend auf einem Referenzdatum verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_day_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_day_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_working_days.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_day_of_week  TYPE sy-dayw.

    lv_current_date = iv_start_date.

    DO.
      IF lv_current_date > iv_end_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      " 19900101 was a Monday (sy-dayw 0)
      DATA(lv_days_since_ref) = lv_current_date - '19900101'.
      lv_day_of_week = lv_days_since_ref MOD 7.

      IF lv_day_of_week <> 5 AND lv_day_of_week <> 6. " Not Saturday (5) or Sunday (6)
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob es in einer Liste von Ereignissen (mit Start- und Enddatum) Überschneidungen gibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte `LOOP AT` Schleifen und `IF`-Bedingungen, um Überschneidungen zu erkennen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             id        TYPE i,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_event.
    TYPES tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_event_scheduler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS has_overlapping_events
          IMPORTING
            it_events TYPE tt_events
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_has_overlap) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_scheduler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD has_overlapping_events.
    " Check for overlaps: Event A overlaps with Event B if
    " (A.start <= B.end AND A.end >= B.start) AND A is not B.
    LOOP AT it_events INTO DATA(ls_event_a).
      LOOP AT it_events INTO DATA(ls_event_b).
        IF ls_event_a-id <> ls_event_b-id AND
           ls_event_a-start_date <= ls_event_b-end_date AND
           ls_event_a-end_date   >= ls_event_b-start_date.
          rv_has_overlap = abap_true.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von Daten für die nächsten N Tage, beginnend mit einem Startdatum.

CLASS zcl_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dates.
    rt_dates = VALUE #( FOR i = 0 THEN i + 1 WHILE i < iv_num_days
                        ( iv_start_date + i ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf einem Start- und Enddatum. Verwenden Sie `IF` implizit in der Filterlogik.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
TYPES tt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflights.

    " Simulate fetching data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE fldate >= iv_start_date AND
                                          fldate <= iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    DATA(lv_end_date) = '20000131'.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should find some flights' ).
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-fldate >= lv_start_date AND ls_flight-fldate <= lv_end_date )
                                         msg = 'Flight date outside range' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '99990101'. " Future date, unlikely to have flights
    DATA(lv_end_date) = '99990131'.
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should find no flights' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_date( iv_start_date = lv_start_date iv_end_date = lv_end_date ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Should find all initial flights' ).
    " This test assumes that the initial SELECT returns some data.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum im aktuellen Monat liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `sy-datum` und `IF`-Bedingungen, um den Monat und das Jahr zu vergleichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_current_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_in_current_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_current) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_current_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_in_current_month.
    DATA(lv_current_year) = sy-datum(4).
    DATA(lv_current_month) = sy-datum+4(2).

    DATA(lv_input_year) = iv_date(4).
    DATA(lv_input_month) = iv_date+4(2).

    IF lv_input_year = lv_current_year AND lv_input_month = lv_current_month.
      rv_is_current = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_current = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_current_month( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum - 30. " Approximately last month
    DATA(lv_is_current) = lo_cut->is_in_current_month( lv_test_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_current msg = 'Date from previous month should not be current' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_current_month( ).

CLASS zcl_date_relative_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_relation) TYPE string. " 'PAST', 'PRESENT', 'FUTURE'

CLASS zcl_date_relative_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_relation.
    IF iv_date < sy-datum.
      rv_relation = 'PAST'.
    ELSE IF iv_date = sy-datum.
      rv_relation = 'PRESENT'.
    ELSE.
      rv_relation = 'FUTURE'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Quartal eines gegebenen Datums unter Verwendung des `COND`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator mit `WHEN` für verschiedene Monatsbereiche.

CLASS zcl_date_quarter_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_quarter
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_quarter) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_quarter_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_quarter.
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2).

    rv_quarter = COND i( WHEN lv_month BETWEEN '01' AND '03' THEN 1
                         WHEN lv_month BETWEEN '04' AND '06' THEN 2
                         WHEN lv_month BETWEEN '07' AND '09' THEN 3
                         WHEN lv_month BETWEEN '10' AND '12' THEN 4
                         ELSE 0 ). " Should not happen for valid dates
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_leap_year_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_leap_year
      IMPORTING
        iv_year TYPE gdatj
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_leap) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_leap_year_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_leap_year.
    IF ( iv_year MOD 4 = 0 AND iv_year MOD 100 <> 0 ) OR iv_year MOD 400 = 0.
      rv_is_leap = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_leap = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP POST Handler, der einen JSON-Payload empfängt, diesen parst und eine Bestätigungs-JSON-Antwort zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `server->request->get_cdata` für den Request-Body und `cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial` für die Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_json_post DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_json_post IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_request_body) = server->request->get_cdata( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = 'Error'.
    DATA(lv_message) = 'Invalid JSON or missing data'.

    IF lv_request_body IS NOT INITIAL.
      TRY.
          " In a real scenario, you would use CALL TRANSFORMATION ID or cl_abap_json_parser
          " For this example, we simulate parsing with a simple check
          IF lv_request_body CS '"name":'. " Simple check for demo purposes
            DATA(lv_name_start) = find( val = lv_request_body sub = '"name": "' ).
            IF lv_name_start >= 0.
              DATA(lv_name_end) = find( val = lv_request_body off = lv_name_start + 8 sub = '"' ).
              IF lv_name_end >= 0.
                DATA(lv_name) = substring( val = lv_request_body off = lv_name_start + 8 len = lv_name_end - ( lv_name_start + 8 ) ).
                lv_status = 'Success'.
                lv_message = |Data received for: { lv_name }|.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.

        CATCH cx_sy_json_parse_error.
          lv_message = 'JSON parse error'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_json_response) = |{{ "status": "{ lv_status }", "message": "{ lv_message }" }}|.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( data = lv_json_response ).
    server->response->set_status( code = COND #( WHEN lv_status = 'Success' THEN 200 ELSE 400 ) reason = COND #( WHEN lv_status = 'Success' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Bad Request' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP GET Handler, der Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` (oder einer ähnlichen internen Tabelle) abruft und diese als JSON-Array zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` für die JSON-Serialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_sflight_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_sflight_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for demo

    DATA(lv_json_string) = '' TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE sflight = lt_sflight
          RESULT XML lv_json_string.

        " The above creates XML, for JSON we need a proper JSON serializer
        " For simplicity in this example, we'll just wrap it as a string.
        " In a real scenario, use cl_abap_json_serializer or CALL TRANSFORMATION with a JSON template.
        lv_json_string = |[ { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <fs> IN lt_sflight NEXT s = s && COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE ',' ) && `{{"carrid":"{ <fs>-carrid }","connid":"{ <fs>-connid }"}}` ) } ]|.

      CATCH cx_xslt_exception.
        " Handle transformation error
        lv_json_string = |{{ "error": "Failed to serialize data" }}|.
        server->response->set_status( code = 500 reason = 'Internal Server Error' ).
    ENDTRY.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( data = lv_json_string ).
    server->response->set_status( code = COND #( WHEN server->response->get_status() = 500 THEN 500 ELSE 200 ) reason = COND #( WHEN server->response->get_status() = 500 THEN 'Internal Server Error' ELSE 'OK' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_json_data) = lo_server->response->get_cdata( ).

    " Check if it's a JSON array and contains SFLIGHT fields

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    " Simulate a resource not found error
    DATA(lv_error_code) = 'NOT_FOUND'.
    DATA(lv_error_message) = 'The requested resource could not be found.'.

    DATA(lv_json_response) = |{{ "error_code": "{ lv_error_code }", "message": "{ lv_error_message }" }}|.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( data = lv_json_response ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 404 reason = 'Not Found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_error_response.
    DATA: lo_server TYPE REF TO cl_http_server,
          lo_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request,
          lo_response TYPE REF TO cl_http_response.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_response.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_server EXPORTING request = lo_request response = lo_response.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handler( ).
    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( server = lo_server ).

    DATA(lv_status_code) = lo_server->response->get_status( ).
    DATA(lv_reason) = lo_server->response->get_status_text( ).
    DATA(lv_json_data) = lo_server->response->get_cdata( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status_code exp = 404 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_reason exp = 'Not Found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_json_data CS '"error_code": "NOT_FOUND"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_json_data CS 'The requested resource could not be found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine dynamische interne Tabelle basierend auf einem gegebenen Struktur- oder Tabellennamen (z.B. `SFLIGHT`).

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_name ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_table_creation_failed
            struct_name = iv_struct_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben sei eine dynamische interne Tabelle und ein Feldname. Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert dieses Feldes für jede Zeile aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <FS>`) in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_dynamic_field
      IMPORTING
        ir_table_ref TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_values) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_dynamic_field.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <ls_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                   <lv_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_table_ref->* TO <lt_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR <lt_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>invalid_table_reference.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <lt_table> ASSIGNING <ls_line>.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_line> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <lv_field> IS ASSIGNED.
        APPEND |{ <lv_field> }| TO rt_field_values.
      ELSE.
        " Handle field not found or not assignable
        APPEND |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found or not accessible| TO rt_field_values.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, die Parameter akzeptiert und einen Wert zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT ... TYPE (class_name)` und `CALL METHOD ... OF ... PARAMETER-TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters  TYPE abap_parmbind_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lt_exceptions TYPE abap_excpbind_tab.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_result> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
          EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_exceptions.

        READ TABLE it_parameters ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_param>) WITH KEY name = 'RV_RESULT'.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <ls_param>-kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>co_kind_receiving.
          ASSIGN <ls_param>-value->* TO <lv_result>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = |{ <lv_result> }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        rv_result = |Error calling method: { sy-msgv1 }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für eine `SELECT`-Anweisung basierend auf Eingabeparametern und führen Sie die Abfrage aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates, um die `WHERE`-Klausel zu erstellen, und `SELECT ... WHERE (dynamic_where_clause)`.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_select
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_operator   TYPE string " e.g., '=', '>', '<'
        iv_value      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result_table) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_select_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_select.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |{ iv_field_name } { iv_operator } '{ iv_value }'|.

    TRY.
        SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE @rt_result_table
          WHERE (lv_where_clause).

      CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_sql_error.
        " Handle dynamic SQL error
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_sql_error
            where_clause = lv_where_clause.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Struktur mit angegebenen Komponenten und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` für die Struktur, dann Feld-Symbole für den Zugriff auf Komponenten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component,
           ty_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_dynamic_struct
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE ty_components
        it_values     TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_struct) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_struct_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_dynamic_struct.
    DATA: lt_comp_descr TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_comp_descr) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_comp_descr TO lt_comp_descr.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_comp_descr ).
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_struct TYPE HANDLE lo_struct_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_dynamic_struct> TYPE any.
        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_struct->* TO <ls_dynamic_struct>.

        LOOP AT it_components INTO ls_component.
          DATA(lv_index) = sy-tabix.
          READ TABLE it_values INTO DATA(lv_value) INDEX lv_index.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_struct> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<lv_field>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <lv_field> = lv_value.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_struct_creation_failed.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field1> TYPE string.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_field2> TYPE i.

Anschließend werden die Komponenten der dynamischen Struktur über Feld-Symbole mit Werten gefüllt. Dies ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen die Struktur von Daten erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP GET Handler, der eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus der Tabelle `SCARR` abruft und diese als JSON-Array von Objekten zurückgibt, wobei jedes Objekt nur 'CARRID' und 'CARRNAME' enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... AS ...` für die Feldumbenennung und `REDUCE` mit String-Templates für die JSON-Formatierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_scarr_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_scarr_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             id   TYPE scarr-carrid,
             name TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier,
           ty_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_carriers) = VALUE ty_carriers( FOR <fs> IN
      ( SELECT carrid, carrname FROM scarr UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( id = <fs>-carrid, name = <fs>-carrname ) ).

    DATA(lv_json_string) = |[ { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR <fs> IN lt_carriers NEXT s = s && COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN '' ELSE ',' ) && `{{"id":"{ <fs>-id }","name":"{ <fs>-name }"}}` ) } ]|.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( data = lv_json_string ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_scarr_json_response FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_scarr_json_response.
    " Ensure some test data exists in SCARR
    INSERT scarr FROM VALUE scarr( carrid = 'LH' carrname = 'Lufthansa' currcode = 'EUR' url = 'http://www.lufthansa.com' ).
    INSERT scarr FROM VALUE scarr( carrid = 'AA' carrname = 'American Airlines' currcode = 'USD' url = 'http://www.aa.com' ).

    DATA: lo_server TYPE REF TO cl_http_server,
          lo_request TYPE REF TO cl_http_request,
          lo_response TYPE REF TO cl_http_response.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_request.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_response.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_server EXPORTING request = lo_request response = lo_response.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_scarr_json( ).
    lo_cut->if_http_extension~handle_request( server = lo_server ).

    DATA(lv_json_data) = lo_server->response->get_cdata( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_json_data CS '[' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_json_data CS '"id":"LH"' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_json_data CS '"name":"Lufthansa"' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert die Abfrage von Datenbankdaten mit der Erstellung einer spezifischen JSON-Struktur. Es verwendet eine `FOR` Expression, um die `SELECT`-Ergebnisse direkt in eine interne Tabelle mit umbenannten Feldern zu mappen. Die JSON-Serialisierung erfolgt dann effizient mit einer `REDUCE` Expression und String-Templates, um ein Array von JSON-Objekten zu erzeugen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle, deren Zeilentyp eine Kombination aus Feldern mehrerer vorhandener Strukturen ist, und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` mit einer Liste von Komponenten, die aus verschiedenen Typen stammen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_combined_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_component,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_component,
           ty_combined_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_fill_combined_table
      IMPORTING
        it_components TYPE ty_combined_components
        it_data       TYPE STANDARD TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_combined_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_combined_table.
    DATA: lt_comp_descr TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      DATA(ls_comp_descr) = VALUE cl_abap_structdescr=>component(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( ls_component-type )
      ).
      APPEND ls_comp_descr TO lt_comp_descr.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_comp_descr ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                       <ls_source_line> TYPE any.

        ASSIGN rr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
        IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED. RETURN. ENDIF.

        LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
          CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.
          LOOP AT lt_comp_descr INTO DATA(ls_target_comp).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_source_field>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_target_comp-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_target_field>).
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <lv_target_field> = <lv_source_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <ls_dynamic_line> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_table_creation_failed.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen HTTP GET Handler, der einen Header-Parameter (z.B. 'X-Custom-Header') aus der Anfrage liest und dessen Wert in der JSON-Antwort zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `server->request->get_header_field` um Header-Parameter zu lesen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_header_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_http_extension.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_header_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
    DATA(lv_custom_header) = server->request->get_header_field( 'X-Custom-Header' ).

    DATA(lv_json_response) = |{{ "customHeader": "{ lv_custom_header }" }}|.

    server->response->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'application/json' ).
    server->response->set_cdata( data = lv_json_response ).
    server->response->set_status( code = 200 reason = 'OK' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine Klasse und rufen Sie eine ihrer Methoden auf. Die Klasse soll eine Methode `GET_GREETING` haben, die einen Namen als Parameter akzeptiert und einen Gruß zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>create` und `CREATE OBJECT ... TYPE (class_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_class_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call_dynamic_class
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_class_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_dynamic_class.
    DATA: lv_class_name TYPE string VALUE 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_GREETING',
          lv_source TYPE string_table.

    APPEND 'CLASS ZCL_DYNAMIC_GREETING DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND '  PUBLIC SECTION.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND '    METHODS get_greeting IMPORTING iv_name TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND 'ENDCLASS.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND 'CLASS ZCL_DYNAMIC_GREETING IMPLEMENTATION.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND '  METHOD get_greeting.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND '    rv_greeting = |Hello, { iv_name }!|.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND '  ENDMETHOD.' TO lv_source.
    APPEND 'ENDCLASS.' TO lv_source.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_compiler=>compile_class( iv_class_name = lv_class_name iv_source = lv_source ).

        DATA(lo_dynamic_object) = CREATE OBJECT (lv_class_name).

        DATA(lt_parameters) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
          ( name = 'IV_NAME' kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>co_kind_importing value = REF #( iv_name ) )
          ( name = 'RV_GREETING' kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>co_kind_receiving value = NEW string( ) )
        ).

        CALL METHOD lo_dynamic_object->('GET_GREETING')
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters.

        READ TABLE lt_parameters ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_param>) WITH KEY name = 'RV_GREETING'.
        IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <ls_param>-kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>co_kind_receiving.
          ASSIGN <ls_param>-value->* TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_result>).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_greeting = <lv_result>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_compile_error.
        rv_greeting = |Error: { sy-msgv1 }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_class_creation.

    DATA(lv_greeting) = lo_cut->create_and_call_dynamic_class( 'Alice' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_greeting exp = 'Hello, Alice!' ).

Die Klasse wird mit `cl_abap_compiler=>compile_class` kompiliert und anschließend mit `CREATE OBJECT` instanziiert. Eine Methode dieser dynamisch erstellten Klasse wird dann mit `CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE` aufgerufen. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für Szenarien, in denen die Logik erst zur Laufzeit generiert oder angepasst werden muss.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `SFLIGHT` und füllen Sie diese mit Daten, die aus einer anderen internen Tabelle stammen, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA` für die Zieltabelle, und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS map_data_to_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_target_type TYPE tabname
        it_fields_to_map TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_target_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_data_to_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_target_line_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_target_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lo_target_line_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_target_type ).
        lo_target_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lo_target_line_descr ).
        CREATE DATA rr_target_table TYPE HANDLE lo_target_table_descr.

        FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_target_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                       <ls_target_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE,
                       <ls_source_line> TYPE any TABLE LINE.

        ASSIGN rr_target_table->* TO <lt_target_table>.
        IF <lt_target_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED. RETURN. ENDIF.

        LOOP AT it_source_data ASSIGNING <ls_source_line>.
          CREATE DATA <ls_target_line> LIKE LINE OF <lt_target_table>.
          LOOP AT it_fields_to_map INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_source_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_source_field>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <ls_target_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOLS(<lv_target_field>).
              IF sy-subrc = 0.
                <lv_target_field> = <lv_source_field>.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          INSERT <ls_target_line> INTO TABLE <lt_target_table>.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_struct_creation cx_sy_table_creation.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_dyn_prg_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_abap_dyn_prg_error=>dynamic_table_creation_failed.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json=>data_from_json`.
solution:

Instructions: Zeigen Sie eine einfache Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus `sflights` in einem `cl_gui_list_tree` an. (Die UI-Anzeige wird simuliert, der Fokus liegt auf der Datenaufbereitung und Tree-Logik).

solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_simple_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
           END OF ty_carrier,
           tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_carriers_in_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container " Placeholder for actual container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_simple_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_carriers_in_tree.
    DATA: lt_carriers TYPE tt_carriers.

    SELECT DISTINCT carrid, carrname
      FROM scarr
      INTO TABLE @lt_carriers.

    IF io_container IS INITIAL.
      " In a real scenario, io_container would be a custom control container.
      " For this example, we'll skip tree creation if no container is provided.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_sel_mode_single ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_carriers INTO DATA(ls_carrier).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      ro_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = |{ lv_node_key }|
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_text = ls_carrier-carrname
        i_is_folder = abap_false
        i_exp_image = icon_airline
        i_coll_image = icon_airline ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_tree->frontend_update( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights` hierarchisch an: Fluggesellschaft -> Flugnummer -> Datum. (Die UI-Anzeige wird simuliert, der Fokus liegt auf der Datenaufbereitung und Tree-Logik).
hint: Verwenden Sie `add_node` mit Parent-IDs, um die Hierarchie aufzubauen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchical_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_node,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_node,
           tt_flight_nodes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_node WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_flights_in_tree
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container " Placeholder for actual container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_hierarchical_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flights_in_tree.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 100 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid fldate.

    IF io_container IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single
      i_item_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>item_sel_mode_single ).

    DATA: lv_carrid_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_connid_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_fldate_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      IF ls_sflight-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        lv_carrid_node_key = |C{ lv_node_counter }|.
        ro_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_carrid_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
          i_text = ls_sflight-carrid
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_image = icon_airline
          i_coll_image = icon_airline ).
        lv_prev_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
        lv_prev_connid = '' " Reset for new carrier
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_sflight-connid <> lv_prev_connid OR ls_sflight-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        lv_connid_node_key = |F{ lv_node_counter }|.
        ro_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_connid_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carrid_node_key
          i_text = ls_sflight-connid
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_image = icon_flight
          i_coll_image = icon_flight ).
        lv_prev_connid = ls_sflight-connid.
      ENDIF.

      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      lv_fldate_node_key = |D{ lv_node_counter }|.
      ro_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_fldate_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = lv_connid_node_key
        i_text = |{ ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|
        i_is_folder = abap_false
        i_exp_image = icon_date
        i_coll_image = icon_date ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_tree->frontend_update( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS node_selected EXPORTING VALUE(i_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_tree = io_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Node doppelt geklickt:' node_key DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
    RAISE EVENT node_selected EXPORTING i_node_key = node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example usage (requires a screen and container):
" DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
"       lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree,
"       lo_handler   TYPE REF TO zcl_tree_event_handler.
"
" CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CONTAINER'.
" lo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree( i_parent = lo_container ).
" lo_handler = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( lo_tree ).
"
" " Add some nodes to lo_tree...
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'ROOT' i_text = 'Root' ).
" lo_tree->frontend_update( ).
"
" " To react to the custom event:
" CLASS lcl_receiver DEFINITION.
"   PUBLIC SECTION.
"     METHODS on_node_selected FOR EVENT node_selected OF zcl_tree_event_handler
"       IMPORTING i_node_key.
" ENDCLASS.
" CLASS lcl_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
"   METHOD on_node_selected.
"     MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Custom event received for node:' i_node_key DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
"   ENDMETHOD.
" ENDCLASS.
" DATA(lo_receiver) = NEW lcl_receiver( ).
" SET HANDLER lo_receiver->on_node_selected FOR lo_handler.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_event_registration FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_registration.
    DATA(lo_tree_mock) = CAST cl_gui_list_tree( NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ) ). " Mock tree
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( lo_tree_mock ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_handler msg = 'Event handler should be created' ).
    " Asserting event registration directly is difficult without reflection or mocking frameworks.
    " The constructor implicitly registers the handler.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_event_handling.
    DATA(lo_tree_mock) = CAST cl_gui_list_tree( NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ) ).
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_tree_event_handler( lo_tree_mock ).

    DATA(lv_received_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.
    CLASS lcl_test_receiver DEFINITION.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS on_node_selected FOR EVENT node_selected OF zcl_tree_event_handler
          IMPORTING i_node_key.
        DATA mv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    ENDCLASS.
    CLASS lcl_test_receiver IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD on_node_selected.
        mv_node_key = i_node_key.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
    DATA(lo_test_receiver) = NEW lcl_test_receiver( ).
    SET HANDLER lo_test_receiver->on_node_selected FOR lo_handler.

    " Simulate the event call (this is how you'd trigger it in a test)
    CALL METHOD lo_handler->handle_node_double_click
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'TEST_NODE'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_test_receiver->mv_node_key exp = 'TEST_NODE'
      msg = 'Custom event should be raised and received with correct node key' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Ereignisbehandlung in ABAP Objects erfolgt über die `FOR EVENT` Syntax und `SET HANDLER`. Ein lokaler Event-Handler wird in der Klasse definiert, die auf das Ereignis reagieren soll. Im Konstruktor der Handler-Klasse wird der Handler für das Baumobjekt registriert. Bei einem Doppelklick auf einen Knoten wird die Methode `handle_node_double_click` aufgerufen, die dann ein eigenes, anwendungsspezifisches Ereignis auslösen kann, um die Entkopplung zu fördern.
