Instructions: Fügen Sie einem Knoten im `cl_gui_list_tree` ein Kontextmenü hinzu und behandeln Sie die Auswahl. (Fokus auf Kontextmenü-Logik).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_contextmenu` und registrieren Sie das `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST` Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mo_context_menu TYPE REF TO cl_gui_contextmenu.

    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING node_key item_key.

    METHODS handle_menu_select FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_gui_contextmenu
      IMPORTING fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_tree = io_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_context_menu.
    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_menu_select FOR mo_context_menu.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    " Clear previous menu items
    mo_context_menu->delete_all( ).

    " Add menu items based on selected node/item
    IF node_key IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_DETAIL' text = 'Details anzeigen' ).
      mo_context_menu->add_function( fcode = 'EDIT_NODE' text = 'Knoten bearbeiten' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Show the context menu
    mo_context_menu->show_context_menu( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_menu_select.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SHOW_DETAIL'.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Details für Knoten anzeigen' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      WHEN 'EDIT_NODE'.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Knoten bearbeiten' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Do nothing
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example usage (requires a screen and container):
" DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
"       lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree,

" CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CONTAINER'.
" lo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree( i_parent = lo_container ).
" lo_context = NEW zcl_tree_context_menu( lo_tree ).
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'NODE1' i_text = 'Node with Context Menu' ).
" lo_tree->frontend_update( ).

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_menu_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_menu_selection FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_menu_creation.
    DATA(lo_tree_mock) = CAST cl_gui_list_tree( NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ) ).
    DATA(lo_context_menu_handler) = NEW zcl_tree_context_menu( lo_tree_mock ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_context_menu_handler msg = 'Context menu handler should be created' ).
    " Direct testing of menu items added to cl_gui_contextmenu is difficult.
    " We assume the methods are called correctly.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_menu_selection.
    DATA(lo_tree_mock) = CAST cl_gui_list_tree( NEW cl_gui_custom_container( 'MOCK_CONTAINER' ) ).
    DATA(lo_context_menu_handler) = NEW zcl_tree_context_menu( lo_tree_mock ).

    " Simulate context menu request to populate the menu
    CALL METHOD lo_context_menu_handler->handle_context_menu_request
      EXPORTING
        node_key = 'TEST_NODE'
        item_key = ''.

    " Simulate menu item selection
    DATA(lv_message_text) TYPE string.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_context_menu_handler->handle_menu_select
          EXPORTING
            fcode = 'SHOW_DETAIL'.
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_a_method INTO DATA(lx_message).
        lv_message_text = lx_message->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message_text exp = 'Details für Knoten anzeigen'
      msg = 'Correct message should be displayed for SHOW_DETAIL' ).

    CLEAR lv_message_text.
    TRY.
        CALL METHOD lo_context_menu_handler->handle_menu_select
          EXPORTING
            fcode = 'EDIT_NODE'.
      CATCH cx_sy_message_in_a_method INTO lx_message.
        lv_message_text = lx_message->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message_text exp = 'Knoten bearbeiten'
      msg = 'Correct message should be displayed for EDIT_NODE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Kontextmenüs werden mit `cl_gui_contextmenu` erstellt und über das `CONTEXT_MENU_REQUEST`-Ereignis des `cl_gui_list_tree` dynamisch befüllt. Die Methode `add_function` fügt Menüpunkte hinzu. Die Auswahl eines Menüpunkts löst das `FUNCTION_SELECTED`-Ereignis des Kontextmenü-Objekts aus, das dann in einem separaten Handler behandelt wird. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible und kontextsensitive Benutzerinteraktion.
keywords: cl_gui_list_tree, UI, Kontextmenü, cl_gui_contextmenu, Event Handling

CLASS zcl_tree_with_icons DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_tree_with_icons
      IMPORTING

    ro_tree->add_node(

      i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT'
      i_text = 'Child Node 2'
      i_is_folder = abap_false

    ro_tree->frontend_update( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus `sflights`, konvertieren Sie sie in einen JSON-String, parsen Sie den JSON-String zurück in eine interne Tabelle und zeigen Sie diese Daten dann hierarchisch in einem `cl_gui_list_tree` an.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `cl_fdt_json` für die Konvertierung und `cl_gui_list_tree` für die Anzeige.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_tree_integration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_and_display
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container " Placeholder for actual container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_tree_integration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_and_display.
    DATA: lt_sflights_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_flight_data   TYPE tt_flight_data,
          lv_json_string   TYPE string,
          lt_flight_data_parsed TYPE tt_flight_data.

    " 1. Read data from sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 50 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_sflights_orig.

    " Map to simpler type for JSON conversion
    lt_flight_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_orig IN lt_sflights_orig (
      carrid = ls_orig-carrid
      connid = ls_orig-connid
      fldate = ls_orig-fldate
      price = ls_orig-price
      currency = ls_orig-currency ) ).

    " 2. Convert to JSON string
    TRY.
        lv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>json_from_data( lt_flight_data ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.

    " 3. Parse JSON string back to internal table
    TRY.
        cl_fdt_json=>data_from_json( EXPORTING iv_json = lv_json_string
                                     IMPORTING ev_data = lt_flight_data_parsed ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO lx_json_error.
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.

    " 4. Display in cl_gui_list_tree (hierarchically)
    IF io_container IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    SORT lt_flight_data_parsed BY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA: lv_carrid_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_connid_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
    DATA(lv_node_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.

    LOOP AT lt_flight_data_parsed INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        lv_carrid_node_key = |C{ lv_node_counter }|.
        ro_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_carrid_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
          i_text = ls_flight-carrid
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_image = icon_airline
          i_coll_image = icon_airline ).
        lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
        lv_prev_connid = '' " Reset for new carrier
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_flight-connid <> lv_prev_connid OR ls_flight-carrid <> lv_prev_carrid.
        lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
        lv_connid_node_key = |F{ lv_node_counter }|.
        ro_tree->add_node(
          i_node_key = lv_connid_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = lv_carrid_node_key
          i_text = ls_flight-connid
          i_is_folder = abap_true
          i_exp_image = icon_flight
          i_coll_image = icon_flight ).
        lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      ENDIF.

      lv_node_counter = lv_node_counter + 1.
      ro_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = |D{ lv_node_counter }|
        i_relat_node_key = lv_connid_node_key
        i_text = |{ ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } - { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }|
        i_is_folder = abap_false
        i_exp_image = icon_date
        i_coll_image = icon_date ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_tree->frontend_update( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie `cl_fdt_json` zusammen mit `SELECT` und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` um Daten direkt in eine JSON-kompatible Struktur zu lesen und zu serialisieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `CORRESPONDING` Klausel und `cl_fdt_json=>json_from_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_select_to_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_json,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_json,
           tt_flight_json TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_json WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_as_json
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_select_to_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_as_json.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE tt_flight_json.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights.

    TRY.
        rv_json_string = cl_fdt_json=>json_from_data( lt_flights ).
      CATCH cx_fdt_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json_string = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_select_to_json FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_select_to_json.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_json_select_to_json( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_converter->get_flights_as_json( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lv_json+0(6) msg = 'JSON conversion should not result in an error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_json msg = 'JSON string should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'carrid' msg = 'JSON should contain carrid field' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_json exp = 'fldate' msg = 'JSON should contain fldate field' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Datenbankdaten direkt in eine für die JSON-Serialisierung vorbereitete interne Tabelle liest. Die `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` Klausel ist hierbei entscheidend, da sie die Felder der `sflight`-Tabelle automatisch den gleichnamigen Feldern der Zielstruktur `ty_flight_json` zuordnet. Anschließend kann `cl_fdt_json=>json_from_data` direkt verwendet werden, um den JSON-String zu erzeugen.
keywords: JSON, cl_fdt_json, SELECT, CORRESPONDING, SFLIGHT, Konvertierung

Instructions: Fügen Sie einem `cl_gui_list_tree` Spalten hinzu und zeigen Sie zusätzliche Informationen zu den Knoten an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `set_table_for_first_display` oder `add_column` und `add_item`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_with_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_col,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_col,
           tt_flight_col TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_col WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_tree_with_columns
      IMPORTING
        io_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container " Placeholder for actual container
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree) TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_with_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_columns.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, price
      FROM sflight
      UP TO 5 ROWS
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF io_container IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ro_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree(
      i_parent = io_container
      i_node_selection_mode = cl_gui_list_tree=>node_sel_mode_single ).

    " Add columns
    ro_tree->add_column( i_column_id = 'TEXT' i_text = 'Beschreibung' i_width = 30 ).
    ro_tree->add_column( i_column_id = 'CARRID' i_text = 'Flugges.' i_width = 10 ).
    ro_tree->add_column( i_column_id = 'CONNID' i_text = 'Flugnr.' i_width = 10 ).
    ro_tree->add_column( i_column_id = 'PRICE' i_text = 'Preis' i_width = 15 ).

    DATA(lv_node_key) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      lv_node_key = lv_node_key + 1.
      DATA(lv_current_node_key) = |NODE_{ lv_node_key }|.

      ro_tree->add_node(
        i_node_key = lv_current_node_key
        i_relat_node_key = cl_gui_list_tree=>relat_node_root
        i_text = |Flug { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid }|
        i_is_folder = abap_false ).

      " Add items (column values) to the node
      ro_tree->add_item(
        i_node_key = lv_current_node_key
        i_item_name = 'CARRID'
        i_text = ls_sflight-carrid ).
      ro_tree->add_item(
        i_node_key = lv_current_node_key
        i_item_name = 'CONNID'
        i_text = ls_sflight-connid ).
      ro_tree->add_item(
        i_node_key = lv_current_node_key
        i_item_name = 'PRICE'
        i_text = |{ ls_sflight-price } EUR| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    ro_tree->frontend_update( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie die Drag-and-Drop-Funktionalität für Knoten in einem `cl_gui_list_tree`.
hint: Registrieren Sie die Ereignisse `DRAG_DROP_REQUEST` und `DRAG_DROP` und verwenden Sie `cl_dragdrop`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree.
    DATA mo_dragdrop TYPE REF TO cl_dragdrop.
    DATA mv_dragged_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS handle_drag_drop_request FOR EVENT drag_drop_request OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING node_key item_key.

    METHODS handle_drag_drop FOR EVENT drag_drop OF cl_gui_list_tree
      IMPORTING node_key item_key drop_pos.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_tree = io_tree.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_dragdrop.
    SET HANDLER handle_drag_drop_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_drag_drop FOR mo_tree.

    " Enable drag and drop for the tree
    mo_tree->set_dragdrop_mode( cl_gui_list_tree=>dragdrop_mode_full ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_drop_request.
    mv_dragged_node_key = node_key.
    mo_dragdrop->set_data( data = node_key ). " Store the dragged node key
    mo_dragdrop->set_effect( cl_dragdrop=>effect_move ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_drop.
    DATA(lv_dropped_on_node_key) = node_key.
    DATA(lv_dragged_data) = mo_dragdrop->get_data( ).

    MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Node' lv_dragged_data 'wurde auf Node' lv_dropped_on_node_key 'gedroppt.' DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.

    " Implement actual tree re-parenting logic here
    " Example: Move lv_dragged_data as child of lv_dropped_on_node_key
    IF lv_dragged_data IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_dropped_on_node_key IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_tree->change_node(
        i_node_key = lv_dragged_data
        i_relat_node_key = lv_dropped_on_node_key
        i_position = cl_gui_list_tree=>position_last_child ).
      mo_tree->frontend_update( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example usage (requires a screen and container):
" DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
"       lo_tree      TYPE REF TO cl_gui_list_tree,
"       lo_dragdrop  TYPE REF TO zcl_tree_drag_drop.
" CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CONTAINER'.
" lo_tree = NEW cl_gui_list_tree( i_parent = lo_container ).
" lo_dragdrop = NEW zcl_tree_drag_drop( lo_tree ).
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'PARENT' i_text = 'Parent Node' i_is_folder = abap_true ).
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD_A' i_text = 'Child A' i_relat_node_key = 'PARENT' ).
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD_B' i_text = 'Child B' i_relat_node_key = 'PARENT' ).
" lo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'STANDALONE' i_text = 'Standalone Node' ).
" lo_tree->frontend_update( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Zahlen deklariert, diese mit Werten füllt und die Summe der geraden Zahlen mit einer funktionalen Iteration (FOR, REDUCE) berechnet und ausgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_classrun_sum_even DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_sum_even IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).

    DATA(lv_sum_even) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR  number IN lt_numbers WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 )
      NEXT sum = sum + number
    ).
    out->write( |Summe der geraden Zahlen: { lv_sum_even }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    TYPES: tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE tt_numbers( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ( 6 ) ).

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 2 + 4 + 6. " Expected sum for even numbers

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR  number IN lt_numbers WHERE ( number MOD 2 = 0 )
      NEXT sum = sum + number
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Summe der geraden Zahlen korrekt' act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Preis) deklariert. Transformieren Sie diese Tabelle in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und den um 10% erhöhten Preis enthält, unter Verwendung des `MAP`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `MAP` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_classrun_map_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_transformed,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_flight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_map_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_raw(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = MAP tt_flight_transformed FROM lt_raw_flights
      USING NEW_PRICE = ( price * '1.10' )
      ( carrid = carrid new_price = NEW_PRICE ).

    out->write( |Original Flüge:|
 ).
    LOOP AT lt_raw_flights INTO DATA(ls_raw).
      out->write( |{ ls_raw-carrid }, { ls_raw-connid }, { ls_raw-price }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    out->write( |Transformierte Flüge (Preis +10%):|
 ).
    LOOP AT lt_transformed_flights INTO DATA(ls_transformed).
      out->write( |{ ls_transformed-carrid }, { ls_transformed-new_price }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_map_flights FOR TESTING.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES: tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             new_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_transformed.

    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_raw(

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die versucht, eine nicht-existierende Systemvariable über `cl_abap_syst` abzurufen (was zu einer Ausnahme führen würde). Fangen Sie die Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung aus. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_syst` und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `cx_sy_read_only_attr` oder `cx_sy_dyn_read_error` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_classrun_syst_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_syst_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_dummy_value) = ''.
    TRY.
        " Eine direkte Methode in cl_abap_syst, die cx_sy_read_only_attr wirft, ist schwer zu finden,
        " da cl_abap_syst für sicheren Zugriff konzipiert ist.
        " Stattdessen demonstrieren wir TRY/CATCH allgemein durch das Auslösen einer Ausnahme.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_read_only_attr.

        out->write( |Wert: { lv_dummy_value }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_read_only_attr INTO DATA(lx_read_only).
        out->write( |Fehler beim Zugriff auf Systemvariable: { lx_read_only->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        out->write( |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ausführbare Klasse, die dynamisch eine Instanz einer anderen Klasse erzeugt und eine ihrer Methoden aufruft. Die Klasse soll den Namen der zu instanziierenden Klasse und der aufzurufenden Methode als String erhalten. Nutzen Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit Typangabe und `CALL METHOD`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` mit `TYPE` und `CALL METHOD` mit `NAME`.

CLASS zcl_classrun_dynamic_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_classrun_dynamic_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_class_name) = 'ZCL_DYN_TARGET_CLASS'. " Name der Zielklasse
    DATA(lv_method_name) = 'GET_MESSAGE'.        " Name der Zielmethode

    DATA lo_target_object TYPE REF TO object.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_target_object TYPE (lv_class_name).
        CALL METHOD lo_target_object->(lv_method_name) RECEIVING r_result = DATA(lv_result).
        out->write( |Dynamischer Aufruf erfolgreich: { lv_result }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        out->write( |Fehler beim Erzeugen des Objekts: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        out->write( |Fehler beim dynamischen Methodenaufruf: { lx_call_error->get_text( ) }| ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        out->write( |Ein unerwarteter Fehler ist aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die das aktuelle Systemdatum und die Systemzeit ermittelt. Berechnen Sie dann die Anzahl der Tage, die seit dem Jahresanfang vergangen sind, und die Anzahl der Sekunden, die seit Mitternacht vergangen sind. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_syst` und moderne Datums-/Zeitfunktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_syst=>get_datum()` und `cl_abap_syst=>get_uzeit()`. Für die Berechnung können Sie `cl_abap_tims` oder direkte Datums-/Zeitoperationen nutzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syst_date_time_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_time_since_midnight RETURNING VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
    METHODS get_days_since_year_start RETURNING VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_syst_date_time_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_time_since_midnight.
    DATA(lv_current_time) = cl_abap_syst=>get_uzeit( ).
    DATA(lv_midnight) = '000000'.
    rv_seconds = cl_abap_tims=>diff( iv_tims1 = lv_current_time iv_tims2 = lv_midnight ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_days_since_year_start.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_year_start) = lv_current_date(4) && '0101'. " YYYY0101
    rv_days = cl_abap_datm=>diff( iv_datm1 = lv_current_date iv_datm2 = lv_year_start ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_time_since_midnight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_days_since_year_start FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_time_since_midnight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syst_date_time_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_seconds) = lo_cut->get_time_since_midnight( ).
    DATA(lv_current_time_sy) = cl_abap_syst=>get_uzeit( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( msg = 'Sekunden seit Mitternacht im gültigen Bereich' act = lv_seconds low = 0 high = 86399 ).
    DATA(lv_expected_seconds) = ( lv_current_time_sy(2) * 3600 ) + ( lv_current_time_sy+2(2) * 60 ) + lv_current_time_sy+4(2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Sekunden seit Mitternacht korrekt berechnet' act = lv_seconds exp = lv_expected_seconds ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_days_since_year_start.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syst_date_time_calc( ).
    DATA(lv_days) = lo_cut->get_days_since_year_start( ).
    DATA(lv_current_date_sy) = cl_abap_syst=>get_datum( ).
    DATA(lv_year_start_sy) = lv_current_date_sy(4) && '0101'.
    DATA(lv_expected_days) = cl_abap_datm=>diff( iv_datm1 = lv_current_date_sy iv_datm2 = lv_year_start_sy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Tage seit Jahresanfang korrekt berechnet' act = lv_days exp = lv_expected_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `cl_abap_syst` für den Abruf des aktuellen Datums und der Zeit. Für die Berechnung der Differenzen werden die Klassen `cl_abap_tims` und `cl_abap_datm` verwendet, die moderne und robuste Funktionen für Zeit- und Datumsberechnungen bieten. Dies ist der bevorzugte Weg, um solche Operationen in ABAP durchzuführen, anstatt manuelle Berechnungen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle Fluggesellschaften, die im Jahr 2025 mehr als 5 Flüge hatten. Verwenden Sie einen `INNER JOIN` zwischen `SCARR` und `SFLIGHT`, filtern Sie nach dem Flugdatum und aggregieren Sie die Ergebnisse. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Verarbeitung der internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `INNER JOIN`, `WHERE`, `GROUP BY`, `HAVING` und verarbeiten Sie das Ergebnis mit `FOR` oder `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_join_advanced DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE scarr-carrid,
             carrname    TYPE scarr-carrname,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_carriers_2025
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_join_advanced IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_carriers_2025.
    SELECT c~carrid,
           c~carrname,
           COUNT( s~connid ) AS flight_count
      FROM scarr AS c
      INNER JOIN sflight AS s ON c~carrid = s~carrid
      WHERE s~fldate BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20251231'
      GROUP BY c~carrid, c~carrname
      HAVING COUNT( s~connid ) > 5
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_db_result).

    " Modern processing of the result table (e.g., sorting or further filtering)
    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_db_result
                                  ( <fs_entry> ) ).
    SORT rt_summary BY flight_count DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_active_carriers_2025( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_result )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty'

    ).
    " Check if all returned carriers have more than 5 flights
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_entry-flight_count > 5 )
        msg = |Carrier { ls_entry-carrid } has { ls_entry-flight_count } flights, expected > 5|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit eines einfachen `LOOP AT` über eine interne Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen unter Verwendung von `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME=>GET_RUNTIME_IN_MICROSECONDS()` vor und nach dem zu messenden Codeblock.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_loop_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS measure_loop_runtime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_microseconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_loop_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_loop_runtime.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i.

    " Prepare data
    lt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UP TO 100000 ( i ) ).

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    LOOP AT lt_data INTO DATA(lv_value).
      " Simulate some work
      lv_value = lv_value * 2. " This modification is local to lv_value, not lt_data
    ENDLOOP.

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    rv_microseconds = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_loop_runtime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_loop_runtime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_loop_measure( ).
    DATA(lv_runtime) = lo_cut->measure_loop_runtime( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'Runtime should be a positive value'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME=>GET_RUNTIME_IN_MICROSECONDS()` liefert die aktuelle Laufzeit des Programms in Mikrosekunden. Durch Subtraktion der Start- von der Endzeit kann die Dauer eines Codeblocks gemessen werden. Dies ist nützlich für einfache Performance-Analysen.
keywords: Performance, Runtime, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, LOOP, Internal Table

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer Datenmanipulation mittels `LOOP AT` und einer äquivalenten `FOR`-Expression für eine interne Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen. Geben Sie beide Laufzeiten zurück.
hint: Messen Sie beide Ansätze separat mit `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_for_vs_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             val TYPE i,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_runtimes,
             loop_runtime TYPE i,
             for_runtime  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_runtimes.

    METHODS compare_runtimes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE struct_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_for_vs_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_data,
          lt_target_data TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start_time  TYPE i,
          lv_end_time    TYPE i.

    " Prepare data
    lt_source_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UP TO 100000 ( id = i val = i * 10 ) ).

    " Measure LOOP AT
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_source_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      ls_entry-val = ls_entry-val + 1.
      APPEND ls_entry TO lt_target_data.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-loop_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    CLEAR lt_target_data. " Reset for FOR expression

    " Measure FOR expression
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_target_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_source_data
                                      ( id = ls_entry-id val = ls_entry-val + 1 ) ).
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-for_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_vs_loop_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_vs_loop_runtimes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_for_vs_loop( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_runtimes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-loop_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'LOOP AT runtime should be positive'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-for_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'FOR expression runtime should be positive'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den Vergleich der Performance zwischen traditionellem `LOOP AT` und der modernen `FOR`-Expression. `FOR`-Expressions sind oft kompakter und können in bestimmten Szenarien performanter sein, da sie die Datenverarbeitung auf einer höheren Abstraktionsebene ermöglichen.
keywords: Performance, Runtime, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, FOR, LOOP, Internal Table, Comparison

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit der Summenbildung über eine Spalte einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen unter Verwendung der `REDUCE`-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_reduce_measure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             num TYPE i,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES tt_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS measure_reduce_runtime
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_microseconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_reduce_measure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD measure_reduce_runtime.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE tt_values,
          lv_sum  TYPE i,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i.

    " Prepare data
    lt_data = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UP TO 100000 ( num = i ) ).

    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    lv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR ls_entry IN lt_data NEXT s = s + ls_entry-num ).

    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).

    rv_microseconds = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie die Ausführungszeit des Zugriffs auf einen einzelnen Datensatz in einer Datenbanktabelle (`SFLIGHT`) mittels `SELECT SINGLE` und den Zugriff auf einen Datensatz in einer internen Tabelle (die zuvor aus der Datenbank geladen wurde) mittels `READ TABLE` mit `BINARY SEARCH`. Messen Sie beide Szenarien 1000 Mal.
hint: Laden Sie die Daten einmalig in eine sortierte interne Tabelle. Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` für die Messung und `DO ... TIMES` für die Wiederholung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_db_vs_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_access_runtimes,
             db_access_runtime TYPE i,
             itab_access_runtime TYPE i,
           END OF struct_access_runtimes.

    METHODS compare_access_runtimes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE struct_access_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_db_vs_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_access_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight,
          ls_sflight_wa TYPE sflight,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000.

    " Prepare internal table (load once, sort for BINARY SEARCH)
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data.
    SORT lt_sflight_data BY carrid connid fldate.

    " Define a key to search for
    DATA(ls_search_key) = VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250228' ).

    " Measure SELECT SINGLE
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight
        WHERE carrid = @ls_search_key-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_search_key-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_search_key-fldate
        INTO @DATA(ls_db_result).
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-db_access_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure READ TABLE with BINARY SEARCH
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      READ TABLE lt_sflight_data INTO ls_sflight_wa
        WITH KEY carrid = ls_search_key-carrid
                 connid = ls_search_key-connid
                 fldate = ls_search_key-fldate
        BINARY SEARCH.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-itab_access_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_access_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit für das Filtern einer internen Tabelle mit 100.000 Einträgen unter Verwendung der `FILTER`-Expression im Vergleich zu einem `LOOP AT` mit `IF`-Bedingung. Geben Sie beide Laufzeiten zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` und `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_filter_vs_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_filter_runtimes,
             loop_filter_runtime TYPE i,
             filter_exp_runtime  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_filter_runtimes.

    METHODS compare_filter_runtimes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE struct_filter_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_filter_vs_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_filter_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_data,
          lt_filtered_data TYPE tt_data,
          lv_start_time  TYPE i,
          lv_end_time    TYPE i.

    " Prepare data
    DO 100000 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( id = sy-index category = COND string( WHEN sy-index MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'EVEN' ELSE 'ODD' ) ) TO lt_source_data.
    ENDDO.

    " Measure LOOP AT with IF
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    LOOP AT lt_source_data INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE category = 'EVEN'.
      APPEND ls_entry TO lt_filtered_data.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-loop_filter_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    CLEAR lt_filtered_data. " Reset for FILTER expression

    " Measure FILTER expression
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    lt_filtered_data = FILTER #( lt_source_data WHERE category = 'EVEN' ).
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-filter_exp_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_runtimes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_filter_vs_loop( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_filter_runtimes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-loop_filter_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'LOOP AT filter runtime should be positive'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-filter_exp_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'FILTER expression runtime should be positive'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance des Filterns interner Tabellen mit der traditionellen `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Syntax und der modernen `FILTER`-Expression. `FILTER`-Expressions sind oft effizienter und lesbarer für Filteroperationen.

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit für das Erstellen einer Hash-Tabelle aus einer Standardtabelle mit 50.000 Einträgen im Vergleich zum direkten Zugriff auf eine Standardtabelle mit einem Schlüssel. Geben Sie beide Laufzeiten zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME` und `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für die Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_hash_vs_std DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_std_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES tt_hash_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_table_runtimes,
             std_access_runtime TYPE i,
             hash_access_runtime  TYPE i,
           END OF struct_table_runtimes.

    METHODS compare_table_access_runtimes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE struct_table_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_hash_vs_std IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_table_access_runtimes.
    DATA: lt_source_data TYPE tt_std_data,
          lt_hash_data TYPE tt_hash_data,
          lv_start_time  TYPE i,
          lv_end_time    TYPE i,
          lv_iterations TYPE i VALUE 1000.

    " Prepare source data
    DO 50000 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE ty_data( key_field = sy-index value_field = |Value { sy-index }| ) TO lt_source_data.
    ENDDO.

    " Create hash table once
    lt_hash_data = VALUE #( FOR ls_entry IN lt_source_data ( ls_entry ) ).

    " Measure standard table access (linear search)
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      READ TABLE lt_source_data INTO DATA(ls_std_result) WITH KEY key_field = ( lv_iterations - sy-index + 1 ).
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-std_access_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure hashed table access
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      READ TABLE lt_hash_data INTO DATA(ls_hash_result) WITH KEY key_field = ( lv_iterations - sy-index + 1 ).
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-hash_access_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_access_runtimes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_access_runtimes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_hash_vs_std( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_table_access_runtimes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-std_access_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'Standard table access runtime should be positive'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-hash_access_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'Hashed table access runtime should be positive'
    ).
    " Assert that hashed table access is significantly faster for large tables
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-std_access_runtime > ls_runtimes-hash_access_runtime )
      msg = 'Hashed table access should be faster than standard table access'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Zugriffsperformance auf eine Standardtabelle (die einen linearen Suchalgorithmus verwendet) mit der auf eine Hash-Tabelle (die einen direkten, schnellen Zugriff über den Hash-Schlüssel ermöglicht). Für große Datenmengen und häufige Einzelzugriffe ist die Hash-Tabelle deutlich performanter.
keywords: Performance, Runtime, CL_ABAP_RUNTIME, Hashed Table, Standard Table, READ TABLE, Comparison

Instructions: Messen Sie die Ausführungszeit einer `COND`-Expression im Vergleich zu einer `IF`-Anweisung für eine einfache Bedingung, die 100.000 Mal ausgeführt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND` und `CL_ABAP_RUNTIME`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_perf_cond_vs_if DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_cond_runtimes,
             if_runtime TYPE i,
             cond_runtime TYPE i,
           END OF struct_cond_runtimes.

    METHODS compare_conditional_runtimes
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_runtimes) TYPE struct_cond_runtimes.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_perf_cond_vs_if IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_conditional_runtimes.
    DATA: lv_input TYPE i,
          lv_result TYPE string,
          lv_start_time TYPE i,
          lv_end_time   TYPE i,
          lv_iterations TYPE i VALUE 100000.

    CREATE DATA rs_runtimes.

    " Measure IF statement
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_input = sy-index.
      IF lv_input MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_result = 'EVEN'.
      ELSE.
        lv_result = 'ODD'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-if_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

    " Measure COND expression
    lv_start_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      lv_input = sy-index.
      lv_result = COND string( WHEN lv_input MOD 2 = 0 THEN 'EVEN' ELSE 'ODD' ).
    ENDDO.
    lv_end_time = cl_abap_runtime=>get_runtime_in_microseconds( ).
    rs_runtimes-cond_runtime = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_perf_cond_vs_if( ).
    DATA(ls_runtimes) = lo_cut->compare_conditional_runtimes( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-if_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'IF statement runtime should be positive'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( ls_runtimes-cond_runtime > 0 )
      msg = 'COND expression runtime should be positive'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel vergleicht die Performance von `IF`-Anweisungen und `COND`-Expressions für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen. `COND`-Expressions sind oft kompakter und können in manchen Fällen zu optimierterem Bytecode führen, was zu einer besseren Performance führt.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0

Instructions: Selektieren Sie alle Flüge und die zugehörigen Buchungsinformationen aus `sflights` und `sbook`. Zeigen Sie auch Flüge an, für die keine Buchung existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... ON ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_left_outer_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
           END OF ty_flight_with_booking.
    TYPES tt_flight_with_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_bookings
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_booking.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_left_outer_join IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid
      FROM sflights AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND
                                     s~connid = b~connid AND
                                     s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights_with_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_with_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_left_outer_join( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_bookings( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    " Check if there are entries where bookid is initial (no booking found)
    DATA(lv_no_booking_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_booking).
      IF ls_flight_booking-bookid IS INITIAL.
        lv_no_booking_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_no_booking_found exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Expected to find at least one flight without booking information' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LEFT OUTER JOIN` ist nützlich, wenn alle Datensätze von der 'linken' Tabelle (hier `sflights`) beibehalten werden sollen, auch wenn keine passenden Datensätze in der 'rechten' Tabelle (`sbook`) gefunden werden. In solchen Fällen werden die Felder der rechten Tabelle mit Initialwerten gefüllt.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, SFLIGHTS, SBOOK, Database Access

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Flug mit der Fluggesellschaft 'AZ' und der Flugnummer '001' in einer internen Tabelle von `sflights` existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LINE_EXISTS` mit einem Tabellenausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid      TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_all_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_check_flight_exists FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_flight_exists.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_line_exists=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_line_exists( ).

    " Test existing flight
    DATA(lv_exists_true) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
                                                        iv_carrid      = 'LH'
                                                        iv_connid      = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_true exp = abap_true ).

    " Test non-existing flight
    DATA(lv_exists_false) = lo_cut->check_flight_exists( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights
                                                         iv_carrid      = 'AZ'
                                                         iv_connid      = '001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists_false exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LINE_EXISTS` Operator in Kombination mit Tabellenausdrücken (`itab[ key_field = value ]`) bietet eine moderne und sichere Möglichkeit, die Existenz einer Zeile in einer internen Tabelle zu prüfen, ohne einen Dump zu riskieren, falls die Zeile nicht gefunden wird. `COND` wird hier für eine kompakte Zuweisung des booleschen Ergebnisses verwendet.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, TABLE EXPRESSIONS, LINE_EXISTS, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der freien Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in einer internen Tabelle um 10.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_update_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_seats_for_lh
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_update_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seats_for_lh.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'
                                            THEN VALUE #( ls_flight-carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                                          connid = ls_flight-connid
                                                          seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax + 10 )
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  METHOD test_update_seats_for_lh.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_update_sflights=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_update_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->update_seats_for_lh( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-seatsmax exp = 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-seatsmax exp = 200 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-seatsmax exp = 160 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR`, `VALUE #` und `COND #` ermöglicht eine funktionale und unveränderliche Aktualisierung von internen Tabellen. Anstatt Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren, wird eine neue Tabelle erstellt, wobei Zeilen, die eine Bedingung erfüllen, transformiert und andere unverändert übernommen werden. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FOR, VALUE, COND, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,

             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      count  = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_grouped_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' ) TO lt_test_flights.

explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Sie ermöglicht es, Daten nach bestimmten Kriterien zu gruppieren und Aggregatfunktionen wie `GROUP SIZE` direkt im Loop zu nutzen, was den Code sehr kompakt und effizient macht.

CLASS zcl_corresponding_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Finden Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) unter allen Flügen der Fluggesellschaft 'UA'.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_seats_ua
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_seats_ua.
    DATA(lt_ua_flights) = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = 'UA' ).

    IF lt_ua_flights IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_max_seats = REDUCE sflight-seatsmax( INIT max_val = 0
                                              FOR ls_flight IN lt_ua_flights
                                              NEXT max_val = nmax( max_val = max_val val = ls_flight-seatsmax ) ).
    ELSE.
      rv_max_seats = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_max_seats_ua FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_max_seats_ua_empty FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_max_seats_ua.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' seatsmax = 250 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' seatsmax = 300 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' seatsmax = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_max_seats_ua( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_max_seats_ua_empty.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE zcl_filter_reduce=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_max_seats_ua( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FILTER` und `REDUCE`. Zuerst wird die Tabelle mit `FILTER` auf die relevanten Flüge reduziert, und anschließend wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Maximalwert der Sitzplatzkapazität aus der gefilterten Menge zu ermitteln. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und effizienter Ansatz für komplexe Datenmanipulationen.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FILTER, REDUCE, SFLIGHTS, Aggregation, Internal Tables

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_delete_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->delete_aa_flights( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Anstatt `DELETE itab WHERE ...` zu verwenden, was die Originaltabelle modifiziert, wird hier ein funktionaler Ansatz mit `FOR` und `VALUE #` gewählt. Eine neue Tabelle wird erstellt, die nur die Zeilen enthält, die die Bedingung (`carrid <> 'AA'`) erfüllen. Dies ist besonders nützlich, wenn die Unveränderlichkeit von Datenstrukturen bevorzugt wird.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, DELETE, FOR, VALUE, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die Flugnummern aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` als Integer anstelle von Strings enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `VALUE` und `CONV`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_id,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid_int TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_id.
    TYPES tt_flight_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_ids_as_int
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_ids) TYPE tt_flight_ids.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_ids_as_int.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flight_ids = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                             ( carrid = <fs_flight>-carrid
                               connid_int = CONV i( <fs_flight>-connid ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_id_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_id_conversion.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_conv_for_loop( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_converter->get_flight_ids_as_int( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_not_equal ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_id).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_id-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight_id-connid_int ).
      " Check if it's actually an integer (no leading zeros, etc.)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_id-connid_int exp = CONV i( |{ ls_flight_id-connid_int ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #( FOR ... )` und dem `CONV`-Operator ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite `LOOP` und `APPEND` zu verwenden, wird die neue Tabelle direkt mit den konvertierten Werten initialisiert.
keywords: CONV, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine Struktur mit String-Feldern in eine ähnliche Struktur, deren Felder jedoch vom Typ Integer sind, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONV` in Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` und `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_structure DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_string_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_string_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_int_data,
             field1 TYPE i,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_int_data.

    METHODS convert_string_struct_to_int
      IMPORTING
        is_string_data TYPE ty_string_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_int_data) TYPE ty_int_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_structure IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_struct_to_int.
    rs_int_data = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( rs_int_data ) is_string_data MAPPING field1 = CONV i( is_string_data-field1 )
                                                                           field2 = CONV i( is_string_data-field2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugverbindungsnummern (CONNID) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, nachdem diese in Integer konvertiert wurden, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `CONV` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conv_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_connids_with_reduce
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conv_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_connids_with_reduce.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                       FOR <fs_flight> IN lt_sflight
                       NEXT s = s + CONV i( <fs_flight>-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Since SFLIGHT content can vary, we can only assert it's not negative
    " or if we know specific test data, we can assert exact value.
    " For now, let's assume some flights exist and sum is positive.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Sum should be positive' act = lv_sum exp = 0 operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_greater ).

    " More robust test would involve mocking SFLIGHT or using known test data.
    " Example with known data:
    " DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( ( connid = '0001' ) ( connid = '0002' ) ).
    " ... then calculate expected sum and assert.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_docking_button_event DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_docking_button_event IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_button_in_dock.
    IF mo_docking_container IS NOT BOUND.
      mo_docking_container = NEW cl_gui_docking_container(
        parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0
        repid = sy-repid
        dynnr = sy-dynnr
        side = cl_gui_docking_container=>dock_at_bottom
        extension = 50
      ).
    ENDIF.

    IF mo_button IS NOT BOUND.
      mo_button = NEW cl_gui_button(
        parent = mo_docking_container
        text = 'Klick mich!'
      ).
      " Register event handler using SET HANDLER
      SET HANDLER me->handle_button_click FOR mo_button.
    ENDIF.

    mo_docking_container->set_visible( abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    " Event handler logic
    mv_button_clicked = abap_true.
    " In a real scenario, you might update a field on screen or trigger further logic
    MESSAGE 'Button wurde geklickt!' TYPE 'S' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_and_handle_event IMPORTING io_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.
    METHODS get_event_triggered_flag RETURNING VALUE(rv_flag) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-DATA gv_event_triggered TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    CLASS ltcl_event_handler DEFINITION FOR EVENTS evt_dummy_event OF cl_gui_control.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        CLASS-METHODS on_dummy_event FOR EVENT evt_dummy_event OF cl_gui_control IMPORTING sender.
    ENDCLASS.

        gv_event_triggered = abap_true.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_event_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_and_handle_event.
    " Define a dummy event for demonstration purposes
    CONSTANTS: lc_event_id TYPE i VALUE 9999.
    CONSTANTS: lc_event_name TYPE string VALUE 'DUMMY_EVENT'.

    io_control->control_register_event(
      EXPORTING
        eventid = lc_event_id
        eventname = lc_event_name
    ).

    SET HANDLER ltcl_event_handler=>on_dummy_event FOR io_control.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_event_triggered_flag.
    rv_flag = gv_event_triggered.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

        lo_cut->register_and_handle_event( lo_container ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No exception expected during event registration' act = sy-subrc ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Exception caught during event registration' ).
    ENDTRY.

    " Cannot trigger GUI events in unit test, so we only test registration.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Event triggered flag should be initial initially' act = lo_cut->get_event_triggered_flag( ) ).

    lo_container->free( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die moderne Syntax erlaubt die Definition von Ereignishandlern als statische Methoden in lokalen Klassen, was zu sauberem und wartbarem Code führt. Im Unit Test kann nur die erfolgreiche Registrierung, nicht aber die Auslösung des GUI-Ereignisses selbst, geprüft werden.
